text: The present invention belongs to the field of humanoid robot technology A wheeled humanoid robot is disclosed Comprises a chassis mechanism,  a lifting mechanism and a body mechanism The lifting mechanism is installed on the top of the chassis mechanism The body mechanism includes a trunk structure,  a head structure is installed on the trunk structure Arm structures are provided on both sides of the trunk structure along the second direction The chassis mechanism comprises a chassis,  the chassis is equipped with radar,  the chassis is equipped with obstacle detection parts,  the lifting mechanism is equipped with a left camera and a right camera The trunk structure is equipped with a waist camera. The head structure is equipped with a head camera. The angle of view of the waist camera intersects with the angle of view of the radar,  the angle of view of the head camera intersects with the angle of view of the waist camera,  the projection distance between the edge of the angle of view of the left camera and the edge of the angle of view of the right camera on the plane where the shoulder of the trunk structure is located is W1,  the width of the shoulder of the trunk structure is W0,  and W1 > W0 The invention has high global obstacle avoidance ability. nan

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots,  and discloses a trunk and waist rotation linkage adjustment device of a humanoid robot,  which includes a lower trunk mounting plate,  a central rotation axis,  a middle connecting bracket,  a left hip connecting seat and a right hip connecting seat; the lower trunk mounting plate is horizontally arranged at the bottom of the robot trunk The central rotating shaft is arranged along the vertical direction,  and the upper end of the central rotating shaft is coaxially and fixedly connected with the lower surface of the trunk lower mounting plate; the middle connecting bracket is sleeved in the middle of the central rotating shaft and is rotationally connected with the central rotating shaft; and the left hip connecting seat and the right hip connecting seat are symmetrically arranged at the lower ends of the two sides of the middle connecting bracket The invention realizes the synchronous adjustment of the trunk waist rotation and the lower limb posture through the mechanical linkage structure,  can adjust the lower limb posture in time during the waist rotation process,  effectively offset the center of gravity shift caused by the trunk rotation,  and improve the balance stability of the robot in dynamic motion scenarios. nan

The invention discloses a linear actuator Comprises a joint shell,  a brushless hollow cup motor,  a reverse planetary roller lead screw assembly and a main control board,  wherein the brushless hollow cup motor,  the reverse planetary roller lead screw assembly and the main control board are arranged in the joint shell; guide blocks and tension and pressure sensors are arranged at two ends of the shell; the brushless hollow cup motor is coaxially nested at the periphery of the lead screw assembly; magnetic steel of the brushless hollow cup motor is fixed on the outer wall of a lead screw nut; and the lead screw nut drives a lead screw shaft to realize linear motion through a roller An O-shaped ring is arranged between the guide block and the front end cover to form an upper limit buffer,  and a rubber buffer pad is arranged at the end part of the screw nut to realize the lower limit buffer The main control board drives the motor according to the feedback of the tension pressure sensor and the motor speed and angle information to achieve thrust closed-loop control,  and conducts heat to the entire shell through thermally conductive silica gel and the rear end cover slot. The linear actuator of the present invention has the advantages of compact structure,  high rigidity,  impact resistance,  good heat dissipation and modular assembly,  and is suitable for flexible wrist joints of humanoid robots and high-precision linear motion scenes. nan

The invention discloses a VLA-based aircraft control method,  a VLA-based aircraft control system and a VLA-based aircraft control storage medium applied to a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-modal data including image data,  voice data,  action data and state data,  and preprocessing the multi-modal data; input the pre-processed multi-modal data into the trained VLA large model to obtain the end pose increment and clamp control instructions; obtain the target end pose based on the end pose increment,  solve the corresponding target joint angle based on the target end pose,  generate an initial trajectory from the current joint angle to the target joint angle,  and perform trajectory optimization and constraints on the initial trajectory to obtain the optimized joint trajectory. The invention can break the interactive limitations of aircraft control,  has multi-modal perception capabilities,  and improves adaptive decision-making capabilities and safety. nan

The invention relates to a dual-arm humanoid robot trajectory tracking method based on an improved terminal sliding mode algorithm The method aims at the problems that the controller is easy to induce high-frequency vibration and the robustness is reduced due to neglect of joint flexibility in the prior art,  and the instantaneous vibration frequency and damping characteristic parameters of the system are extracted on line by establishing a state space model containing flexibility dynamics Using these characteristic parameters to dynamically construct an adaptive non-singular terminal sliding mode surface with frequency avoidance and damping injection capabilities; combined with linear expansion state observer,  the lumped disturbance of the system is estimated in real time and feedforward compensated,  and a continuous and smooth composite control law is designed The above steps are integrated through the closed-loop execution process to achieve high-precision tracking of the desired trajectory,  while effectively suppressing the residual vibration of the flexible joint,  significantly improving the stability and robustness of the system under complex working conditions. nan

The invention discloses a control method and system for preventing a humanoid robot arm from falling,  belonging to the technical field of robot control The method comprises collecting temperature data and output torque data of each joint of the humanoid robot,  and current posture and load information of the arm; based on the above data,  determine the remaining time for each joint temperature to rise to the safe upper limit and the shortest movement time for the arm to move from the current posture to the safe position; compare the remaining time with the shortest movement time,  dynamically adjust the output torque limit of each joint according to the comparison results,  and generate a smooth and slow-down control command for the arm based on the output torque limit. The invention can realize active graded protection of joint overheating,  prevent arms from falling out of control,  and at the same time generate a slow-down trajectory without mechanical impact and automatically continue operations after the temperature is restored,  which significantly improves the safety of robot operation,  operation continuity and equipment service life. nan

The invention discloses a humanoid robot astronaut,  wherein the arm includes a large arm base,  a first shoulder driving component and a second shoulder driving component; the first shoulder driving component realizes the heading movement and rolling movement of the shoulder joint of the arm through the linear push-pull stroke difference; the shoulder second drive assembly achieves pitching motion of the shoulder joint of the arm by converting linear motion into rotational motion; the elbow converts linear motion into rotational motion in the form of a linear actuator plus a slider. The leg includes a thigh base,  a first hip drive assembly,  and a second hip drive assembly; the hip first driving component realizes the pitching movement and rolling movement of the hip joint of the thigh through the linear push-pull stroke difference; the hip second drive assembly converts linear motion into crank-link rotation to achieve heading motion of the hip joint of the leg. The knee converts linear motion into rotational motion in the form of a linear actuator plus a slider. The humanoid robot astronaut joints in the embodiment of the present invention use linear actuators to realize main movements The structure is relatively simple,  the shoulder and hip movement is closer to the human shoulder and hip movement,  the mechanical efficiency and reliability are high,  and during the movement,  the joint movements of the hip,  shoulder,  knee and elbow do not exceed the shape envelope,  achieving a bionic robot design that is closer to the human shape size. nan

The invention is applicable to the technical field of industrial robot control Provides a multi-modal collaborative decision-making method and device for humanoid robots in industrial scenes The industrial scene humanoid robot multi-modal collaborative decision-making method comprises the following steps of :  calculating a manipulator acceleration limit value through a preset acceleration limit model according to the weight of a workpiece,  the estimated friction coefficient,  the current actual clamping pressure,  the comprehensive damage risk index and the real-time deformation rate of the workpiece obtained in real time The invention provides a multi-modal collaborative decision-making method for an industrial scene humanoid robot. In the fourth step and the fifth step,  the application realizes the collaborative calculation of the manipulator pressure optimization value and the acceleration limit value. While increasing the clamping pressure to cope with the slip risk,  the pressure optimization model will take into account the stiffness of the workpiece and the comprehensive damage risk to avoid excessive pressure. nan

The invention relates to the technical field of robot lifting Specifically,  it relates to a leg lifting structure of a wheel-arm robot,  which includes a leg lifting mechanism,  a chassis and a humanoid upper body. The upper part of the chassis is equipped with a leg lifting mechanism,  and the upper part of the leg lifting mechanism is connected to the humanoid upper body. The leg lifting mechanism includes a leg base,  lower connecting rod,  foot joint motor,  lower elastic member,  knee joint motor,  upper connecting rod and upper elastic member; the foot joint motor is installed at the hinge of the leg base and the lower connecting rod; the lower elastic member is fixed between the leg base and the lower connecting rod,  and when the lower elastic member is in a stretched state,  the lower connecting rod can swing upward; the knee joint motor is installed at the hinge of the lower connecting rod and the upper connecting rod; one end of the upper elastic member is fixed between the lower connecting rod and the upper connecting rod. When the upper elastic member is in a stretched state,  it can make the upper connecting rod swing upward. The invention realizes lifting and pitching actions,  and at the same time reduces the load of the motor through the assistance of elastic parts,  reduces energy consumption and manufacturing costs,  and improves operating stability. nan

The invention discloses a robot navigation method and system based on semantic perception and multi-level cost maps This invention abandons the limitation of traditional path planning technology that only relies on geometric obstacle information and ignores the physical attributes of the road surface The ability to perceive the depth of environmental pavement materials using visual semantic segmentation technology By constructing a multi-level cost map that integrates physical attribute weights and quantifying the "traffic risk" of the road surface into the resistance value of the search algorithm,  intelligent trade-offs and adaptive speed control of path length and traffic safety are achieved,  which significantly improves the performance of mobile robots in complex The operational safety and robustness in unstructured environments End-to-end intelligent decision-making from "environment perception" to "motion control" was achieved. Not only can it automatically learn the humanoid driving strategy of "slowing down" or "detour avoidance" when encountering areas with low adhesion or high vibration,  it also significantly improves the robot's adaptive ability and navigation in unknown unstructured environments. Safety. nan

The present disclosure provides a rope-driven differential omnidirectional wheeled humanoid robot fall self-recovery method and device,  and relates to the field of control technology. The method includes :  inputting the current angle,  angular velocity and current of the motor into the forward mapping network to obtain joint state estimation; input the joint state estimation,  the current posture and angular velocity of the base,  and the current contact state of the robot into the reinforcement learning strategy network for strategy reasoning to obtain joint space action instructions; input the joint space action command into the inverse mapping network to obtain the motor space command; control the motor to perform the fall recovery action based on the motor space command. This disclosure absorbs the non-ideal characteristics of the control interface layer of the rope drive differential through the forward mapping network and the reverse mapping network,  so that the strategy can be learned and thought in the joint space. After deployment,  the motor can be correctly driven through the learned mapping,  which improves the robot's recovery. Accuracy and fluency of action nan

A control method and apparatus for a humanoid robot with a body for an elevator In the method,  a permission access vector is constructed; generating a target floor scheduling instruction based on the permitted access vector; determining the three-dimensional space physical coordinates of the target floor call control according to the target floor scheduling instruction; generating safety release signal according to the real-time operation parameter of elevator and environment state monitoring data; generate pose approximation trajectory based on the safety release signal and three-dimensional space physical coordinates; generating physical contact feedback torque data according to the pose approaching track; determine the pressing state based on the physical contact feedback torque data And the driving current waveform is reversely modulated to generate a reverse driving current waveform,  so that the execution end moves to the initial standby position,  and the end detachment reset trajectory is generated. Implementing the technical solution provided by this application improves the multi-dimensional safety perception and disposal of the elevator's autonomous operation. ability nan

This application belongs to the technical field of robot autonomous decision-making,  and specifically relates to a humanoid robot autonomous decision-making method and system for complex tasks. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environment sensing data and task instructions; construct an environment geometric model based on environment-aware data,  and extract object labels,  regional attributes,  and dynamic obstacle distribution; construct a semantic topology map based on the environment geometric model,  object labels and regional attributes,  analyze task instructions to obtain subtask sequences,  determine path node sequences and interactive poses,  and generate operation decision sequences; updating the semantic topology map according to the environment sensing data in the execution process,  and reconstructing the operation decision sequence; determine the deviation compensation value according to the deviation between the actual trajectory and the planned trajectory,  and correct the subsequent operation decision sequence to obtain the final execution sequence. The application can improve the continuous decision-making ability,  environment adaptability and task execution stability of the humanoid robot in a dynamic environment nan

The invention provides a humanoid robot dynamic obstacle avoidance method and device based on UWB positioning,  and relates to the field of robot technology. It includes :  obtaining the position observation value of the humanoid robot,  the position observation value of the dynamic obstacle and the body of the robot through ultra-wideband (UWB). Speed observation value,  and build an environment model; perform joint filtering on the position observations and ontology velocity observations of the humanoid robot to obtain fusion positioning results,  and combine the environmental model to plan the path to generate the initial planned path; during the movement,  path replanning is triggered based on the safe distance to update the path,  and the humanoid robot movement is controlled based on the updated path. According to the method and the device provided by the invention,  the environment model is constructed based on the position information acquired by the UWB,  the UWB and kinematics self-adaptive fusion positioning is adopted to carry out the path planning,  and the path re-planning updating path is triggered based on the safe distance relation,  so that the real-time avoidance of the dynamic obstacle and the stable and continuous motion control are ensured nan

The invention relates to a terrain self-adaptive motion control system of a foot-type robot,  belongs to the technical field of motion control of the foot-type robot,  and solves the problem that the foot-type robot in the prior art is poor in foot falling safety when moving in complex unstructured terrain The system comprises a foot type robot body and an upper computer The foot type robot body is provided with a sensor and a joint controller which are respectively in communication connection with the upper computer Wherein,  the sensor is used to collect the surrounding environment information of the foot robot and obtain the body status information of the foot robot; the joint controller is used to drive the joint movement of the legged robot body; the host computer is used to receive and based on the surrounding environment information and the body status information,  and combine the received task target information to obtain decision-making actions for controlling the legged robot and send them to the joint controller for execution. nan

The invention discloses a streaming processing method and system for multi-modal interaction and an application thereof. The method comprises the following steps of :  receiving input data from a user client,  wherein the input data at least comprises audio data; perform automatic speech recognition ASR processing on the audio data to generate the user text of the current round; performing trigger word detection on the user text to judge whether the user text hits a preset visual trigger condition; if the visual trigger condition is hit,  the visual injection sub-process is executed; if the visual trigger condition is missed,  the current round is determined to be a plain text round; a multi-modal prompt context is constructed based on user text,  visual input determination results,  and context information obtained from a fixed scrolling memory window The invention can realize the comprehensive improvement of the system in terms of low delay,  high consistency,  high concurrent stability and response accuracy,  and significantly improves the core engineering technical indicators of trendy play products and humanoid robots in real-time multi-modal interaction. nan

The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm structure and a humanoid robot thereof. The humanoid robot arm structure comprises a shoulder module,  a wrist module and two wedge-shaped modules,  wherein each wedge-shaped module comprises a first mounting seat,  a second mounting seat,  an auxiliary supporting block,  a first driver and a second driver; and the first mounting seat comprises a connecting plate,  a first mounting ring and a second mounting ring The modular setting enhances the maintenance convenience of the arm structure and solves the problem of increased workload due to frequent maintenance,  or partial damage that cannot be maintained separately and needs to be replaced as a whole,  resulting in high usage costs. In addition,  the opposite auxiliary support blocks and connecting plates effectively reduce the vibration and shaking of the arm structure during movement,  and solve the problem of insufficient overall stability and reliability when detachable connections or unilateral connections are used inside the arm structure. nan

The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots,  and discloses a humanoid robot foot structure and a humanoid robot thereof. The humanoid robot foot structure comprises a front support,  a rear support and a first rotating shaft,  wherein the first rotating shaft penetrates through the front support and the rear support,  and the front support and the rear support can relatively rotate around the axis of the first rotating shaft The back support is integrally formed by the front connecting part,  the connecting part and the back palm part The tops of the front connecting part and the connecting part are provided with a first shaft end mounting part extending upward The top of the rear palm is provided with a second shaft end mounting part that extends upward and protrudes. The first shaft end mounting part is provided with an inclined surface that slopes downward toward the second shaft end mounting part. The inclined surface is provided with a hollow part. The bottom of the palm extends from bottom to top and has a cavity. The weight of the back support is reduced through the hollow part and the cavity,  so that the humanoid robot is easier to maintain balance,  and the problem that the foot structure cannot reduce the weight while ensuring support stability and overall strength is solved. nan

The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots,  and discloses a humanoid robot foot structure and a humanoid robot thereof. The humanoid robot foot structure comprises a front support,  a rear support,  a first elastic piece,  a second elastic piece,  a third elastic piece,  a first rotating shaft,  a second rotating shaft and a third rotating shaft There are two buffer gaps between the front support and the rear support along the axial direction of the first rotating shaft,  and the first elastic member,  the second elastic member and the third elastic member are located in the interval area of the two buffer gaps. By adding a buffer gap at the first rotating shaft The first elastic member realizes axial buffering between the front support and the rear support The second elastic member and the third elastic member cooperate to buffer the rotation between the front support and the rear support,  solving the problem that the feet of conventional humanoid robots can only achieve one-way buffering support,  but cannot effectively achieve side buffering,  reducing the overall impact on the feet. The impact force cannot effectively coordinate the stability and cushioning performance of the foot structure. nan

This application discloses a module motor end cover assembly structure,  a module motor and a legged robot. The module motor end cover assembly structure includes a gearbox assembly and an annular end cover; the end cover is provided with a limit groove,  and the gear box assembly is provided with a limit protrusion corresponding to the limit groove; the bottom wall of the limiting groove and the limiting protrusion are correspondingly provided with connecting holes through which fasteners can pass to connect the end cover and the gear box assembly through the fasteners. Through the cooperation of the limit groove and the limit protrusion and the design of the connection hole and fastener connection,  stress dispersion and multi-directional limit are achieved,  improving impact resistance and structural stability,  improving impact resistance,  and optimizing structural stability. nan

The present invention relates to a Personality-Driven Consequence Reasoning (PDCR) system [100] for autonomous humanoid robotic decision-making. The system comprises a perception layer [210] configured to acquire and encode multimodal sensor data into a latent scene representation,  a world model layer [220] configured to predict future environmental states and action trajectories,  a personality inference layer [230] configured to determine user personality representations,  preferences,  and uncertainty estimates,  a consequence evaluation layer [240] configured to generate multi-dimensional consequence assessments for candidate actions,  a multi- objective decision layer [250] configured to select an optimal action while prioritizing predefined safety constraints over user preferences,  and a policy execution and feedback layer [260] configured to execute actions and continuously update system models through closed-loop feedback. Auxiliary governance modules provide secure memory,  explainability,  privacy,  multi-user preference resolution,  safety override,  and fault recovery,  enabling safe,  adaptive,  transparent,  and context-aware human-robot interaction. nan

[Solution] A ladder link fixing structure including a horizontal pipe and two link structures. The link structure includes a first link 4 and a second link 5. A connecting sleeve 6 is provided on one end of the fixing sleeve of the first link 4. A pin rod is slidably connected inside the connecting sleeve 6. At Link 5 of the second link,  Jack is open. The horizontal pipe 2 is connected between two connecting sleeves 6. Inside the horizontal pipe 2 and the two connecting sleeves 6,  a driving structure is provided to pull back inside the connecting sleeve 6 by moving two pin rods and generating a rebound force on the pin rods.[Effect] When the humanoid ladder is fully deployed,  the first link 4 and second link 5 can be automatically secured,  thereby enhancing the stability of the ladder. Moreover,  a single key can unlock two link structures simultaneously,  making the unlocking process quick and convenient without affecting the efficiency of storing the ladder.[Selected Diagram] Figure 2 nan

The invention relates to a low-noise gait control method and system for a quadruped robot based on a soft landing reward function. The method includes :  constructing a quadruped robot motion control environment and defining foot contact judgment standards; design a soft landing reward function based on vertical contact force,  which is used to negatively punish the large contact force at the moment of landing,  and guide the quadruped robot to learn the landing mode with low contact force; collect the real-time contact force and historical contact status of the quadruped robot's feet Taking the soft landing reward function as the core optimization goal,  a reinforcement learning algorithm is used,  combined with gait stability constraints,  and iterative training is performed on the strategy network to obtain a low-noise gait strategy network,  which is used to optimize the output gait control signal to control the four-legged robot accordingly. Compared with the existing technology,  the present invention can take into account the noise control and gait stability of the robot by accurately determining the landing moment,  designing the negative reward of the contact force,  and combining reinforcement learning to actively optimize the gait strategy. nan

The invention provides a bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection method,  a bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection device and a bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection device. The bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection method,  the bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection device and the bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection device comprise the following steps of :  acquiring task point distribution data,  determining a necessary node sequence based on coverage requirements,  and establishing an inspection state mapping table; using probability backtracking to construct path probability distribution tree to identify main path family and alternative path family to form probability inspection chain; decompose the inspection chain into continuous sections,  extract the traffic difficulty coefficient and path complexity index,  predict the gait energy consumption distribution,  determine the obstacle avoidance rhythm,  and generate path compensation parameters; conduct risk assessment on road sections,  form a risk balance plan through the hedging combination of high-risk paths and safe paths,  and formulate coordination rules; obtaining polling efficiency coordination factor based on path overlapping analysis,  and generating beat navigation parameter; the dynamic inspection unit is generated by matching the beat parameter with the probability inspection chain,  the arrival time of the task is adjusted,  the elastic inspection process is constructed,  and the intelligent autonomous inspection under the control of bionic gait is realized. nan

The invention belongs to the technical field related to robots,  and discloses a method and a system for slip detection and balance control of a foot-type robot based on three-dimensional force perception The method includes the following steps :  judging the number of the sliding foot of the multi-legged robot based on the three-dimensional force signal of the multi-legged robot in contact with the ground; when slippage occurs,  adjust the multi-legged robot in the following ways :  (1) Adjust the height of the center of mass of the multi-legged robot; (2) actively adjusting the joint stiffness and joint damping of the foot to mitigate the instantaneous impact for the foot that has slipped; applying foot acceleration and adjusting normal support force to suppress slip; adjust the target foothold for the next moment. Through the invention,  the balance of the robot can be quickly restored after the slippage occurs,  the risk of instability can be reduced,  and the stability of the robot in complex environments can be ensured. nan

The invention provides a humanoid robot-oriented multi-regulatory domain real-time compliance decision-making and data management and control method,  and relates to the technical field of robot control and data security The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environment perception,  an ontology state and a target task instruction in real time; identify the current regulatory domain based on environmental awareness data and retrieve the corresponding regulatory constraint set; calculate dynamic compliance impact factors based on ontology status,  task instructions,  and regulatory constraint sets; based on this factor,  the task instruction is decomposed and reconstructed to generate an executable subtask sequence that conforms to the regulatory constraint set; monitor interactive data streams in real time during execution,  and calculate regulatory domain operational entropy based on data privacy rules and dynamic compliance impact factors; determining whether the entropy exceeds a predetermined safety threshold; if it exceeds,  it will trigger blocking,  desensitization or degradation processing,  and output the final control command The invention realizes real-time compliance decision-making and dynamic data management and control in multiple regulatory domains,  avoids cross-domain violations,  ensures privacy and security,  and continuously optimizes decision-making accuracy through a self-learning mechanism. nan

The invention relates to the field of robot technology and discloses an autonomous obstacle avoidance trajectory planning method for a humanoid robot robotic arm. By sensing the environment and pose,  an initial virtual three-dimensional lattice network is generated in the work space mapping. Calculate the manipulator operation degree matrix and extract eigenvalues,  establish the mapping relationship with the negative Poisson's ratio,  and update the anisotropic compliance tensor of the lattice network. The obstacle is equivalent to a rigid indenter intruding into the lattice network,  and the comprehensive strain tensor in the compressed area is solved based on the negative Poisson's ratio same-sign strain effect,  and the continuous low potential energy channel coordinate system formed by tangential contraction is extracted. The manipulator is fitted as a continuous elastic spline curve,  and the internal smooth strain energy and the external constraint energy are superimposed to generate the total strain energy functional. Solve the obstacle avoidance spline trajectory corresponding to the functional minimum based on the variation method and convert it into the driving instruction execution. The invention eliminates the minimum standing point and ensures the continuity and mechanical stability of obstacle avoidance nan

The invention discloses a quadruped robot dog movement risk assessment method and a quadruped robot dog movement risk assessment system,  and relates to the technical field of machine movement assessment A four-legged robot dog movement risk assessment system comprises a data acquisition module,  a topological network module,  a load coupling module,  a delay instability module,  a static instability module,  a risk guiding module and a comprehensive assessment module The present invention unifies the load coupling risk assessment results,  the delayed instability risk assessment results of external force interference,  and the static instability risk assessment results as different types of risk flow inputs Combining the risk transfer impedance parameters and capacity parameters,  the risk flow coupling dynamics model is established,  and the coupling propagation relationship of different types of risk flows in the risk flow topology network and its superposition effect on the overall motion risk are described,  so as to realize the system-level description of the multi-source risk coupling mechanism under complex working conditions. nan

This application relates to an intelligent robot fire extinguishing system based on a fire extinguishing pod The invention relates to the field of fire fighting,  which comprises a fire fighting nacelle mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle,  a fire fighting aerial ladder or a climbing platform,  wherein a mechanical dog is arranged in the nacelle; and a foldable walking module,  a fire fighting module,  a fire source identification module,  an environment sensing module,  a propulsion module,  a central control module and a battery are arranged on the dog The robot dog can be split into a bipedal robot,  has a splicing mechanism,  and is also equipped with a door-breaking manipulator,  a buffer protective shell,  etc. The propulsion module is available in a variety of propellants. This application achieves integrated operations such as remote delivery,  autonomous sensing,  autonomous travel,  and autonomous fire extinguishing. It has flexible deployment,  high safety,  strong environmental adaptability,  and precise fire extinguishing. It can cope with complex and high-risk fire scenes,  and can also achieve multi-point synchronous fire extinguishing,  improving Fire extinguishing efficiency,  protection of internal devices and other technical effects. nan

The invention discloses an ultra-thin double-sided spindle lathe for producing a humanoid robot joint screw,  which belongs to the technical field of machine tool processing This application includes a base table and a processing table The processing tables are slidably arranged on both sides of the sliding table Used to turn the workpiece clamped on the clamping assembly The sliding platform is slidably installed on the base platform There is a hole in the middle of the sliding table and a driving housing is provided for rotation A clamping assembly is provided in the drive housing. The clamping assembly includes thrust guide rings that are rotatably installed in the openings on both sides of the drive housing. The end openings of the thrust guide rings are tapered openings. The end openings of the thrust guide rings are equipped with triangular chucks. There are two rotatable annular plates between the two triangular chucks. According to the invention,  the workpiece is clamped at two points,  so that the stability of the workpiece in the turning process is higher; and additional air pressure boosting equipment is not required,  so that the use cost of the whole lathe can be greatly reduced nan

The invention discloses an intelligent hexapod robot for geological disaster rescue,  and relates to the technical field of geological disaster rescue This invention constructs a virtual spring-damping model through a virtual model control algorithm,  combines an acceleration compensation strategy,  realizes dynamic attitude adjustment on a low-cost steering gear platform,  and significantly improves the stability and movement flexibility of the robot in complex terrain such as landslides and rubble piles; using the SLAM system,  integrating the Ego ‑ Planner dynamic path planning algorithm,  through B-spline trajectory optimization and collision guidance path mechanism,  real-time obstacle avoidance and incremental map update under dynamic interference such as aftershocks and rockfalls can be achieved to ensure that the robot can quickly reach the target area; the six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm is used to perform complex operations such as material delivery and obstacle removal to meet the needs of multiple tasks,  and the end positioning algorithm is used to achieve precise operations,  which significantly expands the functional boundaries of the robot and provides support for complex rescue tasks. nan

The invention provides a training method,  a control method and equipment of a robot control model,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of :  generating teacher strategy information of a current time step by adopting a preset teacher strategy model; according to the observation history sequence,  the reference motion future sequence and the point cloud,  the preset dynamic perception world model is used to obtain the prediction privilege characteristics of the current time step; using a preset student strategy model to generate student strategy information at the current time step; the preset teacher strategy model,  the preset dynamics perceived world model and the preset student strategy model are trained,  and the target student strategy model and the target dynamics perceived world model are determined as the robot control model. This application improves the humanoid robot's effective perception of objects and the stability and reliability of the robot's control in real scenes. nan

This application relates to the field of robots,  and in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom waist structure and a humanoid robot. The multi-degree-of-freedom waist structure includes a moving platform,  a pitch-side swing redundant mechanism and a waist base. The lower connecting end of the moving platform is connected to the waist base through a joint universal joint; the pitch-roll redundancy mechanism includes a redundancy drive assembly and two main body drive assemblies; in the left and right direction,  the two main body driving components are symmetrically arranged,  and the redundant driving component is located between the two main body driving components; in the front-rear direction,  the driving end of the redundant driving assembly faces one end,  and the driving ends of the two main body driving assemblies face the other end; the redundant drive component and the two main body drive components are both installed on the moving platform,  and the driving ends of the redundant drive component and the driving ends of the two main body drive components are connected to the waist base to drive the moving platform around the joint universal joint relative to The waist base performs pitching and/or side swing movements. This application can reduce system jitter and improve system accuracy nan

The invention provides a tandem bionic mechanical arm. The tandem bionic mechanical arm comprises a shell,  wherein a tandem driving assembly is arranged in the shell and comprises a first driving module and a second driving module; the first drive module includes a first driver and a first drive shaft,  the first driver is fixedly connected to the housing,  and the first drive shaft is drivingly connected to the first driver; the first drive shaft is hollow,  and the second drive module is disposed in the first drive shaft The tandem bionic mechanical arm provided by the invention has the advantages of compact and simple structure and high reliability; since the drivers are arranged in the shell in series,  the appropriate motor size can be selected according to the load needs,  which can make the shape of the humanoid robot closer to that of humans and improve the adaptability of the humanoid robot to application scenarios. nan

The invention provides a tandem bionic mechanical arm. The tandem bionic mechanical arm comprises a shell,  wherein a tandem driving assembly is arranged in the shell and comprises a first driving module and a second driving module; the first drive module includes a first driver and a first drive shaft,  the first driver is fixedly connected to the housing,  and the first drive shaft is drivingly connected to the first driver; the second drive module includes a second driver and a second drive shaft,  the second driver is fixedly connected to the housing,  and the second drive shaft is drivingly connected to the second driver; the second drive shaft is hollow,  and the first drive shaft is disposed in the second drive shaft The tandem bionic mechanical arm provided by the invention has the advantages of compact and simple structure and high reliability; since the drivers are arranged in the shell in series,  the appropriate size of the motor can be selected according to the load needs,  which can make the shape of the humanoid robot closer to that of humans and improve the application scene adaptability of the humanoid robot. nan

The invention relates to the technical field of farmland inspection,  and specifically relates to a method and system for inspecting a quadruped robotic dog on the farmland ground. The method identifies abnormal areas on the inspection path in real time through an environment sensing module and a terrain stiffness detection module,  and calculates The distance between the mechanical dog and the edge of the abnormal area; according to the abnormal area type,  the central control module generates a corresponding sole area adjustment instruction,  that is,  the collapsed area expands the sole area,  and the crop-dense area reduces the sole area; and gait adjustment instructions,  that is,  low-frequency high-step lifting is used in the collapsed area,  and high-frequency low-step lifting is used in the crop-dense area. The actuator drives the power element through the movement of the thigh and calf joints,  and transmits the generated positive or negative pressure to the foot. The dynamic adjustment piece realizes progressive or rapid adjustment of the sole area; it effectively improves the terrain adaptability and inspection stability of the quadruped robot dog in complex farmland environments. nan

The invention provides a legged robot obstacle avoidance navigation control method and system,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method includes :  obtaining building information model,  construction stage and operation task information; perform component semantic analysis and traffic space extraction on the model to generate a multi-layer navigation prior map; the sensor is used to complete initial pose estimation and real scene perception to obtain online results,  which are spatio-temporal registered with a priori map to identify environmental differences; update risk weights and refresh a priori maps based on environmental differences and construction phase information; generating an initial global path based on the updated semantic topology constraints and task information; obtaining a comprehensive evaluation result according to the path,  the on-line result,  the foot end state and the motion posture; based on the results,  local obstacle avoidance and trajectory correction are performed to obtain the final path and gait parameters and send them to the controller for execution. The invention improves the environmental adaptability,  path enforceability and long-term deployment self-sustaining ability of the robot in the dynamic construction site nan

The invention discloses an MIPI camera application method and system based on an open source Euler operating system,  and relates to the technical field of computer application. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows :  the method is used for an ROS platform under an openEuler system and comprises the following steps of :  starting an ROS node by application; the ROS node sets the ivp attribute and initializes the camera; the MIPI driver builds a video processing link; the ROS node initializes AI algorithm resources; the camera collects panel data; through ROS node and MIPI driver collaborative processing,  the human face humanoid area is identified and calibrated. According to the invention,  by reconstructing an interaction mechanism between the ROS node and the MIPI driver,  the high-efficiency acquisition of image data is realized by means of MIPI interface configuration,  and the image frame is analyzed and processed in real time by combining a human face and human shape detection interface in the ROS system,  so that the recognition function of a specific target in the video image is realized nan

The utility model discloses a robot lower limb and a robot,  and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots The lower limb of the robot comprises a lower limb framework,  a sole and a cardan shaft,  wherein the bottom end of the lower limb framework is connected with the sole through the cardan shaft and is provided with X-direction and Y-direction driving components The X-direction driving assembly forms a four-link driving structure around the X-direction axis of the cardan shaft,  and the Y-direction driving assembly forms a four-link driving structure around the Y-direction axis of the cardan shaft,  realizing complete decoupling of the rotation of the sole around the two axes. Through the independent four-link structure design,  the utility model enables the motion parameters of each driving component to be independently designed and controlled,  simplifies the control logic and improves the real-time performance and accuracy; at the same time,  when a single driving component fails,  the other component can still drive the corresponding degree of freedom movement,  which significantly enhances the system reliability and movement capacity retention rate. nan

The utility model discloses a chassis assembly with high stability and a wheeled humanoid robot. The chassis assembly comprises a swing arm chassis mechanism,  the swing arm chassis mechanism comprises a chassis and a swing arm,  and the central axis of the swing arm is rotatably arranged on the chassis; two first wheel mechanisms respectively arranged on the chassis; two second wheel mechanisms symmetrically arranged on both sides of the swing arm; a locking mechanism is provided on the chassis and on the side of the swing arm,  which can lock the swing arm. The utility model locks or relaxes the swing arm through the locking mechanism,  so that the chassis assembly can sufficiently contact,  support and connect with the ground,  and effectively solves the problem of poor stability of the existing wheeled humanoid robot. nan

The invention discloses a quadruped robot for continuous inspection of aircraft fuel tanks Including fuselage,  both sides of the fuselage are movable with three-degree-of-freedom mechanical legs for supporting the movement of the fuselage The top of the fuselage is movable with a camera arm assembly,  and the camera arm assembly is equipped with a collection camera for collecting images inside the fuel tank. The top of the fuselage is fixed with a camera for self-positioning,  3D environment mapping,  Lidar sensors for path planning and obstacle avoidance and surmounting functions. The invention uses four three-degree-of-freedom mechanical legs Converted from full elbow type to full knee type,  and return from full knee to full elbow,  the three-degree-of-freedom mechanical leg is driven to move in cooperation with the linear guide rail,  so that the fuselage can complete a complete span,  so that the device can perform continuous inspection through the inspection holes on the ribs vertically installed in the aircraft fuel tank to separate each sub-fuel tank,  thereby achieving the purpose of uninterrupted and continuous automated inspection of the fuel tank. nan

This application provides a power-off control method and system for a bipedal robot Involving the field of robot technology,  the method starts the controlled stop mode when the bipedal robot is in a power-off condition Adjust from the current posture to the preset safe positioning posture,  and monitor the overturning margin and power energy value in real time during the process When it is detected that the overturning margin is insufficient,  it switches to the external support mode,  actively obtains the available support plane from the current environment,  and drives the end of the robotic arm to move from the current position to the support point for external support to offset the overturning moment until the overturning margin returns to a safe range. This application dynamically adjusts the safe positioning strategy of the biped robot under complex power-down conditions by introducing external support points,  avoiding problems such as falling and damage of the robot caused by a single shutdown strategy. nan

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot joint modules,  and specifically relates to a pin output cycloid reducer joint module under a large hollow structure,  which includes an inner rotor motor. The two ends of the inner rotor motor are provided with an electronic control component and an output component.,  the hollow fixed shaft extends from the electronic control assembly to the output assembly; the rotor is matched and connected with a rotating shaft,  an eccentric shaft sleeve is sleeved on the rotating shaft and is connected with a fourth bearing and a fifth bearing,  a first cycloid disc is matched outside the fourth bearing,  a second cycloid disc is arranged outside the fifth bearing,  and the first cycloid disc and the second cycloid disc are coaxially arranged and are connected and matched through a lock pin The lock pin also drives the output flange to rotate By improving the structural components in the installation cavity,  the number of components is reduced,  and the cooperation between adjacent components is more compact. The structure of the joint module is simplified as a whole,  the size of the joint module is reduced,  and the joint module can be simplified. The processing and manufacturing process of the module also ensures the overall stability and reliability of the joint module nan

This application discloses a test hydraulic system,  which includes a gantry and a Z-axis loading mechanism,  an X-axis loading mechanism and a Y-axis loading mechanism installed on the gantry; the loading mechanism for loading along the pedaling direction of the foot type robot comprises a support frame,  a loading oil cylinder,  a stroke reducing component and a hydraulic control module The loading oil cylinder is fixedly mounted on the support frame and connected with the hydraulic control module,  and the hydraulic control module is suitable for providing back pressure when a piston rod of the loading oil cylinder extends out The stroke reducing component is installed on the support frame and connected to the piston rod of the loading cylinder through the traction end. The stroke reducing component is used to reduce the stroke of the legged robot according to the set ratio and then pull the piston rod of the loading cylinder. The utility model has the advantages that the stroke reducing component is adopted for transmission instead of directly acting on the loading oil cylinder by pedaling,  so that the stability problem of the piston rod caused by the long stroke of the loading oil cylinder is avoided,  the volume of the support frame is effectively reduced,  and the cost is reduced nan

The invention relates to the technical field of military equipment,  and specifically relates to a six-legged high-maneuverability all-terrain armed combat robot,  which includes a six-legged robot dog body,  an automatic target identification module,  a machine gun quick replacement and convenient pick-and-place mechanism,  a two-degree-of-freedom automatic alignment mechanism,  and an automatic bullet replenishment module; the automatic target identification module and the two-degree-of-freedom automatic alignment mechanism are respectively arranged at the tops of the front side and the middle and rear sides of the six-legged robot dog body The automatic bullet replenishment module is mechanically connected to the double-degree-of-freedom automatic alignment mechanism,  and the automatic bullet replenishment module is connected to the gun body through a machine gun quick replacement and convenient pick-and-place mechanism. The invention has the characteristics of strong adaptability to complex terrain and excellent maneuverability. At the same time,  it has a high degree of automation and rapid combat response. It can complete target detection,  locking,  and aiming. It has short recognition response time and high aiming accuracy,  which greatly improves the response of unmanned combat. Speed and intelligence level nan

The present invention relates to the field of robot technology And discloses a path planning and gait optimization method for complex terrain inspection robots Through multi-scale terrain perception and uncertainty quantification,  for the first time,  cross-scale parallel sensing of macro grids and micro footholds is achieved It fundamentally solves the fundamental contradiction between macroscopic accessibility and microscopic inaccessibility. By constructing a multi-constraint collaborative programming and foot-ground interaction time-varying model,  the microscopic foothold accessibility and terrain evolution laws are integrated into the path-gait joint optimization.,  resolving the full-cycle conflict between dynamic walking stability and static operation stability from the root cause. Aiming at the coupling resonance problem of legged robot contact operations,  establish a cross-domain coupling dynamics model and use model reduction and lightweight networks to achieve millisecond-level real-time solution at the edge,  actively suppress resonance and ensure operation accuracy of ± 1 N/0.5 mm,  and introduce full-link uncertainty nonlinear conduction and Risk classification closed-loop correction mechanism realizes system self-learning and self-healing. nan

This application provides a humanoid robot that can rotate and lift,  including a base,  a rotating mechanism,  a lifting mechanism and a humanoid robot body; the rotating mechanism is installed on the base to drive the lifting mechanism to rotate as a whole; the upper end of the lifting mechanism is connected to the robot body to realize the lifting movement; the robot rises and falls synchronously with the lifting mechanism and rotates as a whole. This application uses a rotating mechanism to drive the lifting mechanism to rotate as a whole It solves the problems of limited in-situ rotation angle and small operating range of traditional humanoid robots. It is compatible with various lifting structures such as screws,  chains,  and racks. It can be used with fixed bases or AGVs. It has high structural integration,  good stability,  and flexible operation. It is suitable for various types of humanoid robot lifting and rotating working platforms. nan

The invention discloses a robot autonomous consciousness realization system based on external perception mapping and an internal state machine,  and belongs to the technical fields of artificial intelligence,  humanoid consciousness construction and robot autonomous decision-making control. The robot autonomous consciousness realization system comprises an external perception module configured to collect real-time state data of a robot and an external environment; a mirror mapping module connected to the external sensing module and configured to map the collected local environment and its own state data actually contacted by the robot into the corresponding state of the internal state machine in real time; internal state machine module; by constructing a robot autonomous awareness implementation system based on external perception mapping and internal state machine,  it can solve the problems in the existing technology such as the inability to autonomously construct internal mirrors,  the dependence on manual deviation processing,  the lack of process correction,  storage redundancy,  and disconnection from the frame,  and realize the robot's fully autonomous closed-loop consciousness from perception,  mapping,  detection,  deduction,  correction to memory purification. nan

The invention provides a humanoid robot and a safe and intelligent control method for humanoid robot behavior. The method includes :  constructing a visually guided dynamic operating domain based on image stream and depth information combined with the current pose to obtain a visual navigation potential field map; based on the torque feedback value and joint current feedback value combined with the end contact state,  the contact exploration domain dominated by force sense is defined,  and the contact force constraint envelope surface is obtained; based on the accelerometer and gyroscope data combined with the plantar pressure distribution center,  the static preservation domain of inertial locking is determined to obtain a stable attitude cone; based on the visual navigation potential field map,  contact force constrained envelope surface and stable attitude cone,  multi-modal control domain priority adjudication is carried out to obtain the target behavior mode of dominant control; generate hierarchical safety control instructions based on the target behavior pattern,  and control each joint driver of the humanoid robot to execute torque instructions based on the hierarchical safety control instructions. The present invention realizes the behavior safety of humanoid robot in dynamic unstructured environment nan

The invention provides a training method of a motion control strategy network and a humanoid robot motion control method,  and relates to the technical field of robot control The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a human body motion image sequence of a preset scene; the human motion image sequence includes multiple frames of continuous human motion images; performing multi-modal perception on the human body motion image sequence to obtain an environment geometric reconstruction model and a human body geometric motion model; obtain the effective contact area in the preset scene from the environmental geometric reconstruction model; based on the geometric motion model of human body and the effective contact area,  the local motion simulation scene with simulation robot is constructed The local motion simulation scene is used to train the motion control strategy network,  and the target motion control strategy network is obtained. Through the method provided by the invention,  a motion control strategy with terrain perception capability can be trained,  so that the humanoid robot can adaptively adjust motion according to terrain geometric characteristics,  and the motion stability and the task success rate in a real complex environment are improved nan

The invention relates to a single-side support non-hollow nested high-torque force-controlled joint module,  which belongs to the technical field of robot joint modules and includes a rear end cover,  a main circuit board,  a motor,  a high rotor shaft,  a bearing assembly,  and a harmonic wave. Reducer,  hollow shaft and force control assembly; the high rotor shaft single-side bearing support structure is adopted to reduce the processing coaxiality requirements and simplify assembly and maintenance. Set up a double code disk and double encoder structure to collect the rotation angle signals of the motor end and the output end respectively to improve the accuracy of position detection and force control. Relying on the cooperation of the heat dissipation patch and the concave and convex platform of the rear end cover to construct an efficient heat dissipation channel,  the hollow shaft and the wave generator form a labyrinth combination seal,  which effectively prevents the reducer from leaking oil and impurities from invading. The built-in contracting brake structure realizes reliable braking,  has compact overall structure,  good load-bearing capacity and stable operation,  effectively overcomes the defects of traditional joint processing difficulty,  poor heat dissipation,  sealing failure,  low control accuracy and the like,  and is suitable for high-end intelligent equipment such as humanoid robots,  collaborative robotic arms and the like. nan

The invention relates to the field of fully autonomous robots,  specifically an unmanned autonomous small hexapod robot that can climb columns and a column climbing method. A column-climbing unmanned autonomous small six-legged robot,  including a body; six machine legs are installed on the machine body,  and the six machine legs are paired in pairs and respectively installed at the front end,  middle part and rear end of the machine body; the paired robot legs have at least four movement postures :  holding column posture,  releasing posture,  moving forward posture and retreating posture,  and each robot leg can move independently; the body is equipped with a central control system that can receive wireless signals for remote control and/or autonomously control the movement of the six robot legs. Compared with the prior art,  the special tree climbing gait stability of the hexapod robot provided by the invention is higher,  and the special foot assembling claws assembled by the hexapod robot can be more stably fixed on a tree The selected material simulation structure stress shows that the foot assembly claw structure can support the hexapod robot to stay and move on the tree. nan

The invention discloses a bionic cheetah spine elastic energy storage high-speed gait mechanism,  which belongs to the technical field of motion execution and efficient gait control of bionic foot-type robots Currently,  quadruped and humanoid robots generally have technical problems such as low energy utilization,  large overall motion power consumption,  obvious gait rigid impact,  and limited ability to travel continuously over long distances and at high speeds under high-speed running conditions Conventional rigid connecting rod structures are difficult to achieve efficient conversion and recycling of kinetic energy and elastic potential energy during biological movement. The present invention imitates the biological movement mechanism of cheetah in which the spine bends and stretches periodically and is accompanied by elastic energy storage and release of tendons during high-speed running Design a multi-segment bionic flexible spine main structure Cooperate with high-modulus energy storage tendon components,  joint damping buffer units and cooperative drive linkage mechanisms Make the robot realize the recovery,  storage and directional release of energy in the complete gait cycle of stepping,  flying and landing,  thereby significantly increasing the running speed,  reducing the load of the drive system,  reducing the vibration and impact of the fuselage,  and improving the overall stability and endurance under high-speed motion. The technical scheme has strong structure originality,  has obvious technical difference with the existing bionic gait mechanism,  and can be widely applied to equipment such as high-speed quadruped robots,  emergency rescue robots,  outdoor inspection robots,  racing robot platforms and the like nan

The invention discloses a foot-type robot climbing close-range detection system for a cross-sea bridge and a detection method thereof The core of the system includes a foot-type mobile body,  a switchable terminal tooling,  a multi-modal sensing unit,  a stability control unit,  a detection and evidence collection unit,  and a ground control and report generation unit The legged robot is used to achieve safe climbing and stable contact of complex bridge components,  combined with multi-modal sensing fusion to achieve accurate detection of surface and hidden defects,  and equipped with wind-resistant stability control and dual redundant safety protection to ensure reliable operation in strong wind environments. The invention realizes the unmanned,  automated and standardized entire bridge detection process,  can reduce the accident rate of high-altitude operations by more than 90%,  and the comprehensive detection rate of common bridge defects is ≥ 98%. nan

The invention discloses a semi-passive gait control method and system for a bipedal robot based on adaptive Hopf-CPG,  which relates to the field of robots and includes the following steps :  establishing a dynamic model of a bipedal robot with a knee joint; optimizing key structural parameters of the robot based on the dynamic model; build an adaptive Hopf ‑ CPG network; introducing adaptive mechanisms including frequency adaptation,  amplitude adaptation,  and phase adaptation; the adaptive Hopf-CPG network and semi-passive gait are integrated and controlled,  and the active adjustment proportion of the CPG network is dynamically adjusted according to the walking environment in which the robot is located to achieve a balance between passive energy saving and active stability. Compared with the existing technology,  the movement stability is significantly improved,  the anti-disturbance ability is strong,  the energy consumption is low and the endurance is improved. It has strong environmental adaptability and does not require manual parameter debugging. nan

The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot real-time task scheduling method and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of robots The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a plurality of task schedules of the humanoid robot,  wherein the task schedules are used for representing motion tasks of a motion association group with the same degree of freedom; binding the task scheduling table and the scheduling thread according to the static priority of the motion task to obtain the task ready table; based on the reference time of the synchronous clock reference,  the task time of different ready tasks in the task ready table is extracted to obtain the time characteristics; based on the time characteristics and real-time scenes collected by humanoid robots,  dynamic priority calculation is performed on ready tasks to obtain the scheduling priority of tasks; scheduling execution of multiple ready tasks through scheduling threads according to scheduling priorities According to the embodiment of the invention,  the accuracy,  the real-time performance and the stability of the humanoid robot for executing the task can be improved nan

The invention discloses a system and a method for adjusting and controlling the posture of a paddy field weeding machine imitating a multi-legged robot,  and belongs to the technical field of agricultural machinery The system monitors the inclination angle,  wheel speed and terrain height difference of the fuselage in real time through sensors. After the data are pre-processed by Kalman filtering and coordinate conversion,  the virtual model,  PID and MPC fusion control algorithm are used to calculate the adjustment amount,  so as to realize the horizontal maintenance of the fuselage and prevent sideslip The inertial measurement unit (IMU) is used to detect the inclination angle and angular velocity of the fuselage,  the terrain sensor quantifies the height difference of the driving wheel,  and the controller generates wheel speed difference or suspension adjustment instructions based on the inverse kinematics model to simulate multi-legged adjustment. The system ensures rapid response in the paddy field dynamic environment through a closed-loop feedback mechanism,  and the inclination angle error is controlled within 3 °. This method improves the adaptability of agricultural machinery,  reduces tipping risks,  optimizes energy consumption,  supports wireless communication remote monitoring,  and is suitable for automated transformation of wheeled agricultural machinery. nan

The invention provides a method,  a device,  electronic equipment and a program product for constructing and integrating a test model of a legged robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  generating a scene model file by a data acquisition terminal and a scene modeling configuration module,  and constructing a standardized test scene; the sensor modeling configuration module generates a sensor simulation model file coupled to the environment based on the file to simulate the robot's sensing function; the dynamic modeling configuration module combines the basic information of the robot with the scene characteristics to generate a verified dynamic model file to simulate the motion function of the robot; the integrated test module loads three types of models to complete the collaborative simulation test and realize the collaborative verification of perception and motion functions; finally,  update the test process configuration,  realize the standardized construction and integrated test of the test model,  optimize the test process by relying on the standardized model,  improve the standardization and adaptability of the legged robot simulation test,  and provide reliable support for its test. nan

The invention discloses a humanoid robot full-scene multi-task interaction data generation method and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of robot data set construction The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a multi-modal data set corresponding to a humanoid robot target operation task; segmenting the scene image to generate a robot body mask and an interactive target object mask,  and normalizing the robot joint action sequence and kinematic parameters based on the degree of freedom adaptation coefficient matrix to obtain normalized motion labels adapted to robots with different degrees of freedom; multi-modal sample pairs,  double masks,  normalized motion labels,  target scenes and task text descriptions are used as multi-conditional constraints,  and input into the pre-trained conditional diffusion model to generate new scene images; combine the new scene image with the source pose data to obtain the full-scene multi-task interaction data. The invention can generate interactive data with complete multi-modal labels that are adapted to robots with different degrees of freedom at low cost,  and improve the generalization ability and full-scene adaptability of large robot models. nan

The embodiment of the present invention discloses an AI humanoid detection device Including :  AI chip control circuit,  switching output circuit and camera module input circuit The camera module input circuit is used to generate shooting signals based on shooting The AI chip control circuit is used for receiving a shooting signal and performing AI humanoid detection processing on the shooting signal to obtain a humanoid detection result signal; the switching value output circuit is used for receiving the humanoid detection result signal and determining a switching value signal according to the humanoid detection result signal; and the switching value signal is used for indicating whether a humanoid is detected or not By combining the AI humanoid detection algorithm,  ensure that even in complex and multi-interfering environments It can also detect the presence of human body accurately and timely,  effectively avoiding false triggering or missing triggering. Compared with existing products on the market,  it has higher reliability,  more stable information transmission,  smaller occupied space and lower cost.,  providing users with an ideal choice in industries with high reliability requirements. nan

This application belongs to the field of humanoid robot technology Relates to a robot joint module and a robot Comprises a mounting bracket,  a motor,  an output part,  a support bearing,  a mounting part and a support assembly The mounting bracket is provided with an arc-shaped groove surrounding the output shaft of the motor. The two ends of the output shaft are respectively a connecting end and an output end. The connecting end is fixedly connected to the motor. The output piece is fixedly sleeved on the output end. The inner ring of the support bearing is fixedly connected to the output piece,  and the outer ring of the support bearing is fixedly installed on the mounting bracket The mounting member is fixedly connected to the output member; the support assembly comprises a connecting piece,  wherein one end of the connecting piece is fixedly provided with a fixed part fixedly connected with the mounting piece,  the other end of the connecting piece is provided with a rotating part rotatably mounted on the connecting piece,  the rotating part is arranged in the arc-shaped groove,  the rotating part is in contact with the inner side wall of the arc-shaped groove,  and the rotating part is close to the connecting end in the axial direction of the output shaft The robot joint module provided by the invention can meet the requirements of integral rigidity and stability on the premise of compact structure nan

The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robot heat dissipation,  and discloses a heat dissipation system for a robot joint module The heat dissipation system includes :  VC vapor chamber,  VC vapor chamber surrounds the joint module; the liquid cooling plate is a semicircular opening structure surrounding the VC soaking plate. One of the opening ends of the liquid cooling plate is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet. There are a positive flow channel and a return flow channel inside. One end of the positive flow channel and the return flow channel are connected to the water inlet and the water outlet respectively,  and the other ends are connected in series with each other The heat dissipation component includes a heat dissipation box installed on the joint module. The outer side of the heat dissipation box is installed on a fan. A circulating water pump is installed above the fan. The circulating water pump,  heat dissipation box and liquid cooling plate are connected to each other to form a circulating liquid cooling system. Since the heat dissipation system is installed outside the joint module,  the closed joint module structure can also achieve efficient heat dissipation,  improving the stability and reliability of the joint module. nan

The utility model discloses a wheel-foot robot,  which comprises a frame body,  at least two first wheel sets and at least two second wheel sets,  wherein each first wheel set comprises a first rotating part which can rotate around a first rotating shaft relative to the frame body and a first wheel foot which can roll along a working surface The second wheel set includes a fourth rotating part capable of rotating around a fourth rotating shaft relative to the frame body and a second wheel foot capable of rolling along the working surface The first rotating part rotates around the first rotating shaft to adjust the rolling direction of the first wheel foot,  and the fourth rotating part rotates around the fourth rotating shaft relative to the frame body to adjust the distance between two adjacent second wheel feet In the utility model,  the first wheel set improves the flexibility of the wheel-legged robot,  and the second wheel set enhances the stability of the wheel-legged robot,  and is compatible with stability and flexibility at the same time. nan

The purpose of this application is to provide a leg structure of a humanoid robot and a humanoid robot. The leg structure includes a first joint motor (1),  a hip joint (2),  a hip universal joint (3),  and a thigh fixing structure (4),  multiple joint shafts,  multiple angular contact bearings; wherein,  the rotor of the first joint motor (1) is connected to the hip joint (2),  each of the plurality of joint axes is embedded in the groove of the hip joint (2) or embedded in the groove of the thigh fixation structure (4),  each joint shaft is embedded in the inner ring of one of the plurality of angular contact bearings,  and each of the plurality of angular contact bearings is embedded in the inner ring of the hip universal joint (3). In a groove,  the leg structure is compact,  the robot occupies a small space,  and the leg structure is symmetrically distributed,  which is beneficial to the stability of the robot's center of gravity. nan

A voice-activated autonomous robot system incorporating multimodal artificial intelligence for indoor exploration and human-robot interaction is disclosed. The system includes a Raspberry Pi microcontroller as the central processing unit interfaced with a USB microphone for voice input,  a camera module for visual perception,  ultrasonic sensors for obstacle detection,  and an L298N dual H- bridge motor driver for locomotion control. A wake-word detection module continuously monitors audio input and activates a speech- to-text pipeline upon recognition of a designated trigger phrase,  without requiring cloud connectivity. The microcontroller processes transcribed voice commands through a locally deployed large language model to determine navigational intent and generate executable motor control instructions. A computer vision subsystem performs real-time object detection and distance estimation from captured image frames to support environment-aware decision-making. When operating in autonomous exploration mode,  a frontier- based navigation algorithm maintains a spatial map of visited regions,  generates targets toward unexplored areas,  and enforces collision avoidance through confidence-scored motion policies. A vibration-free,  tactile-independent feedback mechanism delivers audio responses via an onboard speaker to facilitate natural conversational interaction.
