The proposed system enables real-time voice- commanded navigation,  autonomous indoor exploration,  and obstacle avoidance with minimal latency,  while preserving data privacy through fully local AI inference. The compact,  affordable,  and modular design makes the device suitable for deployment in educational institutions,  small research laboratories,  and connectivity-restricted environments. nan

Techniques for the use of verbal commands in human-robot communication. The number of tasks the robot can perform is limited to a specific set,  while providing syntactic flexibility to users. The system includes two components :  a speech recognizer for speech-to-text conversion and a natural language understanding module that maps the text to a command for the robot. After speech is transcribed to text,  a nearest neighbor classifier can be applied in the high dimensional space of embedding tokens. Multiple variants of each command are provided in a database of reference embeddings,  and the classifier can identify the k nearest reference embedding tokens to determine the command. The text similarity model allows for quick detection solutions to be deployed locally on a robot or other device. Local deployment reduces potential latency caused by a cloud connection,  which can be important in many assistant robot applications. nan

The invention relates generally to a mobile robot,  e.g. a humanoid robot,  configured to provide reality capture and metrology grade geometric measurement,  e.g. to generally support infrastructure surveillance and/or to support workflows in the field of metrology. Aspects of the mobile robot,  inter alia,  relate to providing increased accuracy of metrology grade devices to overcome deficiencies in mobile reality capture. On the other hand,  benefits of mobility provided by mobile robots are transformed to the field of metrology while maintaining metrology grade accuracy.

Systems and methods are described for detecting changes at a location based on image data by a mobile robot. A system can instruct navigation of the mobile robot to a location. For example,  the system can instruct navigation to the location as part of an inspection mission. The system can obtain input identifying a change detection. Based on the change detection and obtained image data associated with the location,  the system can perform the change detection and detect a change associated with the location. For example,  the system can perform the change detection based on one or more regions of interest of the obtained image data. Based on the detected change and a reference model,  the system can determine presence of an anomaly condition in the obtained image data.

The invention provides a humanoid robot whole body control method based on human body movement collection,  which includes :  step 1 :  multi-modal human body movement data collection; step 2 :  Standardize the format of the collected multi-modal human motion data; step 3 :  Relocation method of humanoid robot reference motion data. Using human body movement data sequence input Extract key motion information from it,  and relocate this information to the humanoid robot Can fully adapt to different modalities of human motion data,  analyze its corresponding joint position,  rotation and other information Generate a reference dataset for humanoid robots to imitate human motion,  and deploy reinforcement learning algorithms to enable the robots to achieve robust whole-body control in diverse and dynamically changing environments,  which not only improves the robustness of control,  but also effectively unifies a variety of human motion data paradigms that act on humanoid robot learning. 1. A whole body control method of humanoid robot based on human body action collection,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 :  multi-modal human body motion data collection;  Step 2 :  performing format standardization to the collected multi-mode human body motion data;  Step 3 :  relocating the human-shaped robot with reference to the motion data;  The method for relocating the reference motion data of the human-shaped robot is specifically as follows :  Step 3.1 :  URDF file processing :  URDF is an XML format file for describing robot structure,  defining the geometric shape,  connection mode,  joint type and position of each joint,  rotating shaft,  the information with limited range matches the joint position and angle in the human body movement data with the parameter defined in the URDF file;  Step 3.2 :  joint mapping and conversion :  determining the number and type of the human-shaped robot joint,  comprising a rotary joint,  a translation joint and a moving shaft;  according to the number and type of the human-shaped robot joint,  comprising a rotary joint,  a translation joint and a moving shaft,  establishing a one-to-one mapping relationship between the human body joint and the robot joint;  Step 3.3 :  local and global coordinate system conversion :  because the coordinate systems used by the human body and the robot are different,  the coordinate system needs to be converted;  Step 3.4 :  motion data optimization and correction :  after the basic joint mapping is finished,  the motion data is further corrected so as to ensure the continuity and physical feasibility;  Step 3.5 :  The converted motion data is written in the control system of the humanoid robot in a format supported by the URDF.

The present invention designs a multi-sensor spatiotemporal information fusion humanoid robot fall prediction method,  which is characterized by including the following steps :  S1. Multi-sensor data collection,  S2. Data preprocessing,  S3. Multi-sensor spatiotemporal information fusion network model construction,  S4. Model training,  S5. Model verification and application. The method provided by the invention comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  acquiring multi-sensor data of the humanoid robot; then,  sequentially performing multi-source information weighting,  multi-scale space feature extraction,  time feature information extraction and space-time feature dimensionality reduction fusion through a designed multi-sensor space-time information fusion neural network; and finally,  predicting the falling state of the humanoid robot This method has high fall recognition accuracy,  low false positives,  good noise robustness,  and long advance prediction time,  which can provide sufficient buffer time for subsequent controllers to customize fall solutions. 1.  S2,  data pre-processing,  intercepting the multi-dimensional time sequence obtained by S1 into multiple groups of short sub-sequences with fixed time step length through non-overlapping sliding window segmentation technology,  respectively obtaining multiple groups of trunk acceleration sub-sequence data,  trunk angular velocity sub-sequence data,  the plantar pressure central point sub-sequence data,  then the trunk acceleration sub-sequence data of each group,  the trunk angular velocity sub-sequence data and the plantar pressure central point sub-sequence data are respectively in parallel to form a characteristic vector,  so as to obtain a multi-dimensional channel sample set,  so that a plurality of sensor monitoring information dispersed at different positions are associated,  and a corresponding label is marked on the data sample,  then randomly sampling all samples into a training set and a test set,  at the same time,  standardizing each sample; The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based interactive communication humanoid robot expression simulation method,  which relates to the technical field of expression simulation and includes :  collecting user brain wave signals,  preprocessing them,  and generating power spectrum density features; input the power spectral density characteristics into the pre-trained emotion classification model,  and output the user's emotion category and emotion intensity value; map the emotion categories and emotion intensity values to emotional expressions and output bionic muscle contraction instructions; performing facial adjustment on facial muscle fibers of the humanoid robot according to bionic muscle contraction instructions,  dynamically adjusting surface texture details of the humanoid robot,  and generating simulated micro-expressions; capture the user's facial feedback data through the camera eyeball,  evaluate the user's acceptance of simulated micro-expressions based on the user's facial feedback data,  and output an expression optimization strategy. The invention realizes the biological simulation of the micro-expression of the humanoid robot through deformation matching and expression optimization double closed-loop modeling driven by user feedback. 1. An interactive communication humanoid robot expression simulation method based on artificial intelligence,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  collecting the brain wave signal of the user and pre-processing the signal to generate the power spectrum density characteristic;  inputting the power spectrum density characteristic into the pre-trained emotion classification model,  performing emotion classification and intensity quantification to the power spectrum density characteristic through the deep convolution neural network,  outputting the emotion classification and emotion intensity value of the user;  performing emotion expression mapping on the emotion type and emotion intensity value,  generating expression amplitude parameter,  adjusting the facial layout of the human-shaped robot based on the expression amplitude parameter,  outputting bionic muscle shrinking instruction;  adjusting the face of the facial muscle fibre of the human-shaped robot according to the bionic muscle shrinking instruction,  combining the physical deformation characteristic of the covering layer of the human-shaped robot,  dynamically adjusting the surface texture detail of the human-shaped robot,  generating the simulation micro expression;  capturing the face feedback data of the user by shooting the eyeball,  evaluating the acceptance degree of the user to the simulation micro-expression based on the face feedback data of the user,  comparing the acceptance degree with the power spectrum density characteristic,  and outputting the expression optimizing strategy;  the specific steps are as follows :  capturing the user face dynamic data through the camera eyeball;  identifying the feature of the user face dynamic data to obtain the standard face action;  performing intensity grading matching on the standardized face action,  quantizing the face intensity value of the user,  generating face feedback data of the user;  performing weighting correction on the user face feedback data,  evaluating the acceptance degree of the user to the simulation micro-emoticons;  the specific steps are as follows :  aligning the coordinates of the user face dynamic data to generate a standardized image sequence;  extracting the face coordinate of the user from the standardized image sequence,  constructing the face motion track according to the face coordinate of the user;  The facial coordinate displacement change in the motion track of the opposite part performs expression identification to obtain the standardized facial action.

This application discloses a humanoid robot control method and related equipment based on multi-modal biofeedback. The method includes :  collecting original multi-modal data; perform data preprocessing on the original multi-modal data to obtain candidate multi-modal data; performing feature alignment and fusion on the candidate multi-modal data to generate a fusion feature vector; input the fusion feature vector into the control model and output the joint control sequence; converting the joint control sequence into servo motor PWM driving signal to drive the joint actuator of humanoid robot to move; based on the biofeedback signal,  the motion of the humanoid robot is asynchronously controlled and the state is adjusted,  and the joint actuator of the humanoid robot is fine-tuned online based on the robot response deviation data. According to the invention,  the adaptability and the interaction accuracy of the robot to the complex environment can be improved,  the precise and flexible control of the robot can be realized,  and the method and the device can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control 1. A humanoid robot control method based on multimodal biofeedback,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  collecting the original multimodal data by the multimodal data collecting module;  the original multimodal data comprises a user electroencephalogram signal,  a robot end touch signal,  environment visual image and joint posture data,  the multi-modal data collecting module further collects biological feedback signal,  the biological feedback signal comprises EOG electrooculogram signal,  the user electroencephalogram signal is used for sensing user intention,  the EOG electrooculogram signal is used as the reward basis or penalty basis of the execution result feedback or reinforcement learning agent;  performing data pre-processing on the original multimodal data by a data pre-processing module to obtain candidate multimodal data;  performing feature alignment and fusion on the candidate multimodal data by the attention mechanism through the cross-modal fusion processing module to generate a fusion feature vector;  inputting the fusion feature vector into the control model in the end-to-end training module,  and outputting the joint control sequence aiming at the humanoid robot;  the control model is a mapping model from the fusion characteristic vector to the joint control sequence of the humanoid robot based on the establishment of the B-to-B framework;  when realizing the online update of the control model,  taking the EOG electrooculogram signal in the biological feedback signal as the reward basis or punishment basis of the strengthening learning agent,  and realizing the dynamic optimization of the model parameters by dynamically adjusting the reward function;  converting the joint control sequence into a servo motor PWM drive signal by an execution control module,  and driving the joint actuator of the humanoid robot to move according to the servo motor PWM drive signal;  obtaining the biological feedback signal and the robot response deviation data dynamically through the human-computer interaction feedback module,  performing asynchronous control and state adjustment on the action of the human-shaped robot based on the biological feedback signal,  and performing online fine adjustment on the joint actuator of the humanoid robot according to the robot response deviation data;  wherein the human-computer interaction feedback module dynamically obtains the biological feedback signal and the robot response deviation data,  based on the biological feedback signal,  performing asynchronous control and state adjustment on the action of the humanoid robot,  and performing online fine adjustment on the joint actuator of the humanoid robot according to the robot response deviation data,  comprising :  dynamically obtaining the biological feedback signal through the human-computer interaction feedback module and pre-processing the biological feedback signal to obtain the pre-processed biological feedback signal;  inputting the pre-processed biological feedback signal into a classification model,  outputting a state adjusting instruction aiming at the human-shaped robot,  performing asynchronous control and state adjustment to the action of the human-shaped robot according to the state adjusting instruction;  dynamically obtaining the robot response deviation data through the human-computer interaction feedback module,  and feeding the robot response deviation data back to the cross-mode fusion processing module,  generating a modified fusion characteristic vector;  inputting the modified fusion feature vector into the control model in the end-to-end training module,  outputting the modified joint control sequence,  and performing online fine adjustment to the joint actuator of the humanoid robot according to the modified joint control sequence.

The invention relates to a biped robot approximate period control method and a biped robot approximate period control system based on an adaptive period control obstacle function The method comprises the following steps of :  establishing a state space model of approximate period walking of the biped robot,  obtaining the measured instantaneous frequency of a system state in real time through short-time Fourier transform,  and introducing accumulated phase time to represent the approximate period characteristic of the system; the adaptive extended Kalman filter is used to obtain the estimated instantaneous frequency of the system state in real time,  adjust the frequency of the control obstacle function,  and construct an adaptive periodic discrete time control obstacle function to obtain the function-based security set forward invariance guarantee; analyze the cumulative phase time error,  use three reset strategies to alleviate the cumulative phase time error,  and select the appropriate reset strategy according to the actual situation; under the model predictive control framework of single-step prediction,  the control obstacle function is applied as a constraint,  and the bipedal robot can complete the walking task by solving the optimization problem. The present invention adapts to the approximate period characteristics of the system by estimating the system period in real time 1. A dual-foot robot probability period control method based on adaptive period control obstacle function,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S100,  establishing the state space model of the biped robot periodic walking,  obtaining the measuring instantaneous frequency of the system state in real time through the short-time Fourier transformation,  and introducing the accumulated phase time to represent the periodic characteristic of the system;  S200,  using the self-adaptive extended Kalman filter to obtain the estimated instantaneous frequency of the system state in real time;  S300,  based on the estimated instantaneous frequency obtained by the adaptive extended Kalman filtering,  adjusting the frequency of the control obstacle function to adapt to the state of the probability period,  so as to construct and obtain the adaptive period discrete time control obstacle function,  obtaining a secure set forward invariant guarantee based on the adaptive periodic discrete time control barrier function;  S400,  analyzing the accumulated phase time error,  using three reset strategies to relieve the accumulated phase time error,  and selecting the proper reset strategy according to the actual condition so as to ensure the reliability of the frequency estimation;  S500,  under the model prediction control frame of the single-step prediction,  using the adaptive period discrete time control obstacle function as the constraint,  through solving the optimization problem to make the biped robot stably and safely finish the walking task.

The invention discloses a full-dimensional defect detection method of a humanoid robot and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring robot posture data,  and carrying out whole-body joint cooperative control on the humanoid robot according to the robot posture data so as to acquire thermal imaging data,  image data and three-dimensional point cloud data of target equipment; identify abnormal areas on thermal imaging data to obtain intermediate defective areas; performing feature extraction on the image data and the three-dimensional point cloud data according to the intermediate defect area to obtain image features of the image data and point cloud features of the three-dimensional point cloud data; performing single-dimensional feature fusion on the point cloud features according to the image features to obtain a single-dimensional fusion result; according to the robot attitude data,  the single-dimensional fusion results are updated in all dimensions to obtain the full-dimensional defect detection results of the target device. The method can improve the accuracy and robustness of defect detection for industrial equipment. The invention relates to the technical field of defect detection 1. A full-dimensional defect detection method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the robot posture data,  and according to the robot posture data,  cooperatively controlling the whole body joint of the humanoid robot,  so as to obtain the multi-source sensing data of the target device,  the multi-source sensing data comprises thermal imaging data,  image data and three-dimensional point cloud data;  performing abnormal area identification to the thermal imaging data to obtain an intermediate defect area;  extracting characteristics of the image data and the three-dimensional point cloud data according to the middle defect area to obtain the image characteristics of the image data and the point cloud characteristics of the three-dimensional point cloud data;  performing single-dimensional feature fusion on the point cloud feature according to the image feature to obtain a single-dimensional fusion result,  wherein the single-dimensional fusion result is corresponding to robot attitude data of one detection dimension;  the detection dimension is used for representing the visual angle dimension when the humanoid robot collects the multi-source sensing data based on the robot posture data;  according to the robot attitude data,  performing full-dimensional updating on the single-dimensional fusion result,  obtaining the full-dimensional defect detection result of the target device,  the full-dimensional defect detection result is fused with the single-dimensional fusion result under the robot attitude data of several different detection dimensions;  according to the robot posture data,  performing full-dimensional update on the single-dimensional fusion result,  obtaining the full-dimensional defect detection result of the target device,  comprising :  performing dimension detection on the current single-dimension fusion result to obtain a dimension detection result,  wherein the dimension detection result is used for indicating whether the current single-dimension fusion result is the single-dimension fusion result of the last detection dimension;  if the dimension detection result is that the current single-dimension fusion result is not the single-dimension fusion result of the last detection dimension,  then the current single-dimension fusion result is reserved and the robot attitude data is updated,  then the robot attitude data is returned and executed,  and a step of cooperatively controlling the whole body joint of the humanoid robot according to the robot posture data;  or if the dimension detection result is the current single-dimension fusion result is the single-dimension fusion result of the last detection dimension,  performing full-dimension fusion on all the single-dimension fusion results to obtain the full-dimension defect detection result.

This application discloses a humanoid robot operation decision-making and execution method and related equipment based on bodily cognitive enhancement The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring sensor data of the current operating environment through a sensor group of the humanoid robot,  performing two-stage fusion to obtain operating environment information,  and inputting the operating environment information into a body cognitive data generation model to obtain simulated body cognitive data; input the working environment information and simulated body cognitive data into the end-to-end humanoid robot working model for multi-dimensional query Execute cross-attention calculations based on simulated body cognitive data and multi-dimensional query results,  generate humanoid operation trajectory planning results and convert them into control instructions,  and execute corresponding operation actions through the actuator of the humanoid robot. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the simulation cognitive data and the sensor data can be fused as the operation decision-making basis,  so that the flexibility and the execution reliability of the robot operation decision-making are improved This application can be widely used in the field of robot control technology. 1. A human-shaped robot operation decision and execution method based on body cognitive enhancement,  wherein it is applied to human-shaped robot,  the human-shaped robot operation decision and execution method comprises :  obtaining the sensor data of the current working environment by the sensor group of the humanoid robot,  and performing data level fusion and characteristic level fusion to the sensor data to obtain the working environment information of the current working environment;  inputting the operation environment information to a pre-trained tool body cognitive data generation model to obtain a simulated tool body cognitive data corresponding to the current operation environment;  inputting the operation environment information and the simulation specific body cognitive data to the pre-trained end-to-end humanoid robot operation model,  performing multi-dimensional inquiry on the operation environment information through the end-to-end humanoid robot operation model,  obtaining multi-dimensional inquiry result,  and performing cross-attention calculation according to the simulated specific cognitive data and the multi-dimensional query result,  generating a human-like operation track planning result;  converting the human-like operation track planning result into a control instruction,  and executing the corresponding operation action according to the control instruction by the execution mechanism of the human-like robot.

The invention provides a bionic lower limb robot prosthetic limb testing system and method,  which includes :  a humanoid robot testing body,  a load module,  a support module and a data acquisition module; the humanoid robot test body at least includes human lower limb joints,  which are used to simulate human lower limb walking; the human lower limb joint includes at least one of knee joint,  ankle joint and foot modularization,  and at least part of the human lower limb joint can be replaced with an artificial limb unit to be tested,  so that the humanoid robot test body can drive the artificial limb unit to be tested to perform walking testing; the load module is set on the humanoid robot test body and is used to provide the target load to the prosthetic unit to be tested; the support module is used to provide a walking road for the humanoid robot test body to perform walking tests on it; the data acquisition module is used to monitor the test parameters of the prosthetic unit to be tested when performing walking tests. The invention can simulate real usage scenarios and realize accurate detection of multi-dimensional performance of prosthetics. 1. A bionic lower limb robot artificial limb test system,  wherein the system comprises :  a human-shaped robot testing main body,  a load module,  a supporting module and a data collecting module;  the human-shaped robot test main body at least comprises a human lower limb joint for simulating the walking of the human lower limb;  the lower limb joint of human body comprises at least one of knee joint,  ankle joint and foot modularization,  at least part of the lower limb joint of human body can be replaced by the unit to be tested of artificial limb,  so that the human-shaped robot test main body can drive the unit to be tested of artificial limb to perform walking test;  the load module is arranged on the human-shaped robot test main body for providing a target load matched with the walking test solution to the artificial limb unit to be tested;  the supporting module is used for providing a walking road for the walking test of the human-shaped robot test main body thereon;  the data collecting module is used for monitoring the test parameter when the artificial limb unit to be tested performs walking test;  the data collecting module comprises :  a kinematics parameter monitoring unit for obtaining at least one data of gait time phase,  joint angle,  joint speed and joint acceleration;  wherein said gait phase at least comprises step length and step frequency data;  a mechanical parameter monitoring unit for obtaining at least one data of the joint force,  the joint moment and the ground reaction force;  The system further comprises a data analysis storage module,  the data analysis storage module comprises :  a fatigue index obtaining unit for associating the step frequency data collected by the kinematics parameter monitoring unit,  the related mechanical data collected by the mechanical parameter monitoring unit,  and the continuous observation result of the joint structure after walking test;  fatigue evaluation index based on step frequency is 1 to 2Hz,  single side walking accumulated 3 million times of test condition,  according to joint structure continuity and associated data;  the joint structure continuity is determined by directly observing the integrity and activity smoothness of the unit joint to be tested of the artificial limb after walking test;  a bionic index obtaining unit for associating the kinematics parameter and the mechanical parameter on the two sides of the human-shaped robot test main body;  the kinematics parameter comprises gait time phase,  joint angle,  joint moving speed,  joint moving angular speed,  the mechanical parameter comprises ground reaction force,  joint force,  joint moment,  the gait time phase at least comprises step length and step frequency data;  it is used for comparing the consistency of the kinematics parameter and the mechanical parameter on the two sides;  an intelligent and adaptability index obtaining unit,  for obtaining the response speed and response degree when the intelligent artificial limb faces to the road condition change,  wherein the response speed is the kinematics parameter of the artificial limb side after the road condition change,  the mechanical parameter tends to stable time,  the response degree is the similar degree of the gait phase,  motion expression and mechanical expression of the parameter stable artificial limb side and the robot side.

The invention belongs to the technical field of motion control and intelligent control of quadruped robots,  and discloses a robust gait control method for a quadruped robot suitable for multiple terrains. The robust gait control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring body state information and foot end state information of the quadruped robot; determining the supporting feet of the quadruped robot in the current period,  estimating the terrain of the quadruped robot in the current period based on the fuselage state information of the current period,  and extracting the slope characteristics and height characteristics of the terrain; generate fuselage attitude reference and fuselage height reference adapted to the terrain in the current period; construct a model predictive control optimization model with terrain-adaptive Lyapunov stability constraints; solve the model predictive control optimization model to obtain the optimal foot end contact force sequence in the prediction time domain,  and select the first step in the optimal foot end contact force sequence as the gait control instruction of the quadruped robot in the current period. The invention realizes the stable walking of the quadruped robot in a complex terrain environment,  and significantly improves the engineering applicability and environmental robustness of the system. 1. A four-foot robot robust gait control method suitable for multi-terrain,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the machine body state information and the foot end state information of the current period of the four-foot robot;  according to the foot end state information,  determining the supporting foot of the current period of the four-foot robot,  combining the machine body state information of the current period to estimate the terrain of the current period of the four-foot robot,  and extracting the gradient characteristic and height characteristic of the terrain;  according to the gradient characteristic and the height characteristic of the terrain,  generating a fuselage attitude reference and a fuselage height reference adapted to the terrain in which the current period is located;  based on the fuselage attitude reference and the fuselage height reference,  constructing a model prediction control optimization model with terrain adaptive Lyapunov stability constraint;  solving the model prediction control optimization model,  obtaining the optimal foot end contact force sequence in the prediction time domain,  and selecting the first step in the optimal foot end contact force sequence as the gait control instruction of the current period four-foot robot;  wherein,  based on the fuselage attitude reference and the fuselage height reference,  constructing a model predictive control optimization model with terrain adaptive Lyapunov stability constraint,  comprising :  constructing the dynamic model of the four-foot robot;  obtaining the expected state vector of the current period according to the machine body attitude reference and the machine body height reference,  and constructing the cost function of the model predictive control optimization model;  calculating the terrain risk index based on the gradient characteristic and height characteristic of the terrain in which the current period of the four-foot robot is located,  and performing non-linear self-adaptive scheduling on the convergence rate parameter of Lyapunov stability constraint;  calculating the error of the state vector of the prediction step,  and constructing a Lyapunov function,  constructing a Lyapunov stability constraint according to the Lyapunov function of the adjacent prediction step and the convergence rate parameter after non-linear adaptive scheduling.

The invention relates to the technical field of path planning,  and in particular to an intelligent obstacle avoidance path planning method and device for a quadruped robot,  which includes :  obtaining the current position and global planned path of the quadruped robot; according to the position distribution between the current position of the quadruped robot and the future path nodes and the path cost constraints,  the direct planned path and the sequential planned path are obtained; according to the path cost difference between the direct planning path and the sequential planning path,  the path loss characteristic value is obtained; according to the distance between each local position and the obstacle on the direct planned path and the sequential planned path,  and the speed constraints of the quadruped robot on the direct planned path and the sequential planned path,  combined with the steering speed loss of the quadruped robot on the sequential planned path,  the speed loss characteristic value is obtained; screen the direct planned path and the sequential planned path to obtain the local planned path. The quadruped robot path planning result of the present invention is more reasonable. 1. An intelligent planning method for obstacle avoidance path of four-foot robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the current position of the four-foot robot and a global planning path,  wherein the global planning path comprises a preset number of continuous future path nodes after the history path node;  according to the position distribution between the current position of the four-foot robot and the future path node and the path cost constraint,  performing local path planning on the four-foot robot,  obtaining the direct planning path and the pathwise planning path of the four-foot robot reaching the target path node;  the target path node is the last future path node;  obtaining the path loss characteristic value of the four-foot robot reaching the target path node according to the path cost difference between the direct planning path and the pathwise planning path;  according to the distance between each local position on the direct planning path and the synposition planning path and the obstacle,  and the speed constraint of the four-foot robot on the direct planning path and the synposition planning path,  combining the steering speed loss of the four-foot robot on the synposition planning path,  obtaining the speed loss characteristic value of the four-foot robot reaching the target path node;  according to the path loss characteristic value and the speed loss characteristic value,  screening the direct planning path and the synposition planning path,  obtaining the local planning path of the four-foot robot reaching the target path node;  wherein the method for obtaining the direct planning path and the synposition planning path of the four-foot robot to the target path node specifically comprises :  taking the current position of the four-foot robot as the starting point,  taking the target path node as the end point,  taking the obstacle distance as the constraint,  using the path planning algorithm to obtain the first planning path of the four-foot robot reaching the target path node,  according to the path length of the first planning path and the distance between the path track and the obstacle,  obtaining the path cost of the first planning path;  taking the first planning path with the minimum path cost as the direct planning path;  planning the path between each two adjacent nodes between the current position of the four-foot robot and the target path node to obtain the second planning path between each two adjacent nodes between the four-foot robot and the target path node;  obtaining the path cost of each second planning path,  and forming the second planning path corresponding to the minimum value of the path cost of all the second planning paths between each two adjacent nodes into a synposition planning path.

The invention provides a control method and system for a universal legged robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The control method comprises the following steps of :  uniformly tokenizing time sequence observation data of a multi-source sensor and adding modality,  time and sensor configuration embedding to construct a uniform input representation compatible with heterogeneous sensors and different sampling frequencies; introducing a masking mask to enable the masking temporal attention encoder to cope with data occlusion and frame loss; fusion of robot morphological description information and world state latent variables in a cross-morphological fusion module enables a single policy network (composed of a shaded temporal attention encoder,  a cross-morphological fusion module and a general policy head) to adapt to different kinematic topologies and dynamics Parametric legged robot morphology; finally,  joint-level control instructions are output to drive the robot to move,  forming a complete universal legged robot control scheme,  which effectively solves the core problems of existing technology that relies on specific sensors and shapes and is difficult to cope with the lack of sensing data. 1. A control method of universal foot type robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the multi-source sensor time sequence observation data of the foot robot in the current control period and the history control period;  performing unified token on the time sequence observation data of the multi-source sensor,  obtaining a modal token sequence,  and performing embedding processing on each modal token in the modal token sequence,  adding modal embedding,  time embedding and sensor configuration embedding,  obtaining the modal token sequence after adding embedding;  generating a mask code according to the pre-set mask strategy of the training stage or the quality indication of the reasoning stage;  inputting the added embedded modal token sequence and the mask code to a mask time sequence attention encoder,  and outputting world state latent variable;  obtaining the form description information of the foot-type robot,  and inputting the form description information and the world state latent variable into the cross-form fusion module,  obtaining the form condition latent variable,  and inputting the form condition latent variable into the universal strategy head,  outputting the joint level control instruction,  to control the motion of the foot-type robot;  wherein the step of inputting the added embedded modal token sequence and the mask code into a mask timing attention encoder,  and outputting a world state latent variable comprises :  obtaining the length information of the current sliding window,  and determining the causal mask according to the length information;  in each attention layer of the shielding time sequence attention encoder,  taking the added embedded modal token sequence as the source of query,  key and value,  calculating the attention score,  and superposing the causal mask and the shielding mask on the attention score;  normalizing the attention score after overlapping the mask code to obtain the attention weight,  and performing weighted summation to the value according to the attention weight to obtain the attention output of the current layer;  extracting the feature representation corresponding to the current time from the attention output of the last layer after the stacking processing of the multiple attention layers,  and polymerizing to obtain the world state latent variable through the pool operation;  the cross-morphological fusion module comprises a morphological image encoder and a feature fusion device;  the step of inputting the form description information and the world state latent variable into the cross-form fusion module to obtain a form conditioned latent variable comprises :  constructing the morphogram encoder based on a graph neural network or a morphogram encoder;  constructing the kinematics topology and dynamics parameter of the foot-type robot into a morphological diagram,  wherein the node of the morphological diagram represents a joint or a connecting rod,  the side of the morphological diagram represents a connecting relationship,  the attribute of the node comprises at least one of the length of the connecting rod,  the quality,  the moment of inertia,  the type of the joint and the joint limit;  inputting the morphogram into the graph neural network or the morphogram encoder to obtain a morphogram sequence;  and fusing the form token with the world state latent variable through the feature fusion device to obtain the form conditioned latent variable.

The method includes performing feature extraction on an ontology sensing sequence through a preset active dynamic load model and quantizing the key feature quantities of the active dynamic load carried by the quadruped robot; the key features include real-time interactive interference force to realize adaptive perception of load changes and real-time interference force; actively correcting the motion command of the quadruped robot through the preset hybrid force position control model and real-time interactive interference force to generate an anti-interference target command,  thereby guiding the robot to actively correct the motion command; generate actuator action instructions for driving the quadruped robot through a preset motion control strategy network The balance of the quadruped robot in the process of carrying active dynamic loads in complex terrain is maintained through actuator action instructions,  the self-adaptive adjustment of the quadruped robot is realized,  and the balance control capability and anti-interference robustness of the quadruped robot in the task of carrying active dynamic loads in complex terrain are improved 1. A hybrid force level control method for four-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the main body sensing sequence of the four-foot robot;  extracting the characteristic of the main body sensing sequence by a preset active dynamic load model and quantifying the key characteristic quantity of the active dynamic load carried by the four-foot robot;  the key characteristic quantity comprises a real-time interactive interference force generated by the active dynamic load to the four-foot robot;  actively correcting the motion instruction of the four-foot robot by the preset mixed force position control model and the real-time interactive interference force to generate an anti-interference target instruction;  inputting the motion instruction into a preset motion control strategy network,  and taking the anti-interference target instruction as the guide reference of the reward function in the preset motion control strategy network,  generating an actuator action instruction for driving the four-foot robot,  and maintaining the balance of the four-foot robot in the process of moving the active dynamic load under the complex terrain by the action instruction of the actuator.

The invention discloses a robot control right anchoring method,  a robot control right anchoring system and robot control right anchoring equipment based on three-dimensional dynamic trust roots and time series constraints,  and belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control and information security The invention aims to solve the safety pain points of the prior art that static single verification has weak anti-attack ability,  cannot identify progressive control hijacking,  and is difficult to adapt to the dynamic operation of the robot's full life cycle. The invention constructs an initial trust root bound with hardware in a local safe execution environment isolated from a general operating system,  generates a multi-dimensional feature vector based on three-dimensional features of identity,  behavior and environment,  and constructs a one-way irreversible control state node sequence through irreversible coupling operation; the core sets the continuity determination of control right as the pre-necessary condition for controlling the execution of instructions. Combined with the hardware-level gating mechanism,  only if the verification passes,  the dynamic verification value is allowed to be generated and the instructions are executed. The invention realizes the continuous closed-loop constraint of the robot control right in the whole life cycle,  can effectively resist progressive hijacking,  replay attack and tampering during operation,  and greatly improves the robot control safety and anti-interference ability. 1. A robot control power anchoring method,  wherein the robot comprises but not limited to a double-foot humanoid robot,  a fixed multi-shaft cooperative mechanical arm,  a wheel-type moving robot,  a crawler-type special robot,  a track-type logistics robot,  a medical special robot,  a storage sorting robot,  an air robot,  An underwater robot,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  in the robot initialization stage,  in the local safe execution environment isolated from the universal operating system,  obtaining the control right main body identity data and the device hardware identification data,  generating an initial trust root with fixed length based on the preset hash operation;  S2,  based on the initial trust root,  generating a multi-dimensional feature vector in the local security execution environment,  wherein the multi-dimensional feature vector at least comprises an identity feature dimension,  a behaviour feature dimension and an environment feature dimension;  S3,  performing irreversible coupling operation on the multidimensional characteristic vector to generate a control check vector;  the non-reversible coupling operation is a non-linear combination operation of bit-level cross mapping,  sectional mixing and sequence dependent processing,  and the hash operation is executed after the operation;  the operation structure of the irreversible coupling operation is bound and generated with the initial trust root,  and the structure is kept unchanged in the device life period,  and the operation structure cannot be replaced or reconstructed externally;  S4,  storing the control check vector in the security storage unit in the local security execution environment,  forming a control state node corresponding to the legal operation of this time,  constructing a one-way irreversible history control check vector sequence;  S5,  when receiving the control instruction,  firstly executing the control power continuity judging step in the local safe execution environment,  then executing all subsequent check flow;  the continuity determination is performed based on a history control check vector sequence,  at least comprising a node one-way evolution validity check,  a history node consistency check and a time sequence continuity check,  for judging whether the current control check vector satisfies the one-way irreversible continuous evolution constraint relation composed of at least three continuous legal history control check vectors (N is more than or equal to 3);  The one-way irreversible continuous evolution constraint relationship is :  the hash value of the next node must comprise the complete hash value of the former N nodes as the input parameter,  the node sequence only can be added with non-modifiable and non-rollback,  the single bit change of any node will trigger the avalanche change of the following all nodes;  S6,  the local security execution environment forcibly intercepts the execution path of the control instruction through the hardware-level or firmware-level gating mechanism of the control instruction execution channel;  only when the control power continuity is judged to be passed,  the door control mechanism is opened to allow the subsequent steps to be executed;  when the continuity judgment is not passed,  the gating mechanism keeps the normally closed state,  does not generate the dynamic check value,  refuses to execute the control instruction,  and locks the control power state and triggers the control power rebuilding flow,  and the control instruction is directly blocked on the execution path,  cannot enter the execution scheduling stage;  S7,  after the continuity determination is passed,  in the local security execution environment,  performing joint hash operation based on the current control check vector and the complete semantic field of the control instruction,  generating a disposable dynamic check value,  wherein the pass/fail state value of the control right continuity determination is used as the necessary input parameter of the joint hash operation,  participating in the generation process of the dynamic check value,  no state value cannot generate legal dynamic check value;  S8,  performing consistency verification on the dynamic check value and the check information carried by the control instruction,  and executing the control instruction only when the verification is passed;  when the continuity is not passed,  no matter whether the dynamic check value is passed,  the whole check is directly failed and the control instruction is refused to be executed,  and the failure state is synchronously written in the control state node sequence to trigger the structural change of the subsequent node generation path;  S9,  after the legal control instruction is executed,  the updated behaviour feature vector,  the environment feature vector and the current control check vector are input into the hash function to generate a new control check vector and finish the coverage update,  so as to form a dynamic evolution control right anchoring mechanism.

The invention relates to the field of robot technology and discloses an AI humanoid robot control method suitable for complex terrain; the method comprises :  dividing the single-footstep cycle of the humanoid robot into three phases :  a swing early phase,  a swing late phase and a support phase; in the early stage of swing,  according to the plantar pressure distribution data and local terrain depth map,  a prediction command package is generated,  and the prediction command package contains the expected ankle joint ground contact angle,  the expected ground stiffness level and the expected plantar slip level; in the later stage of the swing,  the parameters in the pre-judgment command package are loaded to the ankle joint controller according to the height of the swing leg from the ground; during the support period,  compare the actual contact data with the predictive instruction package,  identify the source of deviation and update the predictive model; the three phases of the left and right feet are executed asynchronously and in parallel,  coordinated by the phase state mutual exclusion rule and the cross-foot trigger signal; the invention solves the problem of time mismatch between control instructions and physical feedback in robot motion control under complex terrain,  and realizes instant adaptation to terrain changes. 1. An AI humanoid robot control method suitable for complex terrain,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  the single-foot gait period of the human-shaped robot is divided into three phases of the swinging early period,  the swinging late period and the supporting period;  S2 :  generating a pre-judging instruction packet according to the foot pressure distribution data of the moment when the foot is off the ground and the local terrain depth map of the next foot falling point collected by the visual sensor,  wherein the pre-judging instruction packet comprises a pre-judging ankle joint touchdown angle,  an expected ground rigidity level and an expected foot sliding level;  S3 :  in the swinging later period,  according to the height from the swinging leg to the ground,  the expected ankle joint grounding angle,  the expected ground rigidity level and the expected sole sliding level are loaded to the ankle joint controller in layers;  S4 :  in the supporting period,  comparing the foot pressure distribution data of the foot touchdown moment and the actual touchdown angle of the ankle joint with the pre-judging instruction packet,  identifying the deviation source,  updating the pre-judging model according to the identification result;  S5 :  The three phases of the left and right feet are executed asynchronously and in parallel,  and the left and right feet are coordinated with the cross-foot trigger signal through the phase state mutual exclusion rule.

This application provides a humanoid robot occlusion grabbing method and equipment. The method includes :  obtaining the target material,  selecting the target sub-array set and array excitation parameters from the sub-array mapping library according to the material and end orientation,  and controlling the end effector arranged on the robotic arm. Distributed RFID antenna array in the base and/or phalanx extension area; determining the sampling pose according to the pose uncertainty reduction amount and the cost of moving from the candidate sampling pose to the preset grasping approach pose,  and scanning to obtain the micro-scanning frame; monitoring the tactile array,  generating multiple contact absolute reference events in the grasping approach or micro-scanning trajectory and forming a continuous tactile contact point sequence,  and based on the continuous tactile contact point sequence,  the corresponding robotic arm pose and contact point geometric information joint online calibration of RF phase offset and end extrinsic parameter error to grasp the pose This application can solve the problems of low pose accuracy and disconnection between scanning and grabbing actions in robot grabbing in occluded environments. 1. A human-shaped robot shielding and grabbing method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the material type of the target object output by the visual system of the humanoid robot,  and according to the material type and the direction of the tail end of the current mechanical arm of the humanoid robot,  selecting the corresponding target sub-array set and array excitation parameter from the pre-constructed sub-array mapping library,  to control the corresponding antenna unit in the distributed RFID antenna array arranged on the mechanical arm end actuator base and/or the phalanx extending area to transmit and receive the RF signal according to the array excitation parameter;  dynamically planning the next sampling pose of the mechanical arm,  wherein the next sampling pose is jointly determined according to the reduction amount of the uncertainty of the pose and the cost from the movement of the candidate sampling pose to the preset grabbing approach pose;  controlling the distributed RFID antenna array to scan and sample the target object at the next sampling position,  and obtaining a micro-scanning frame containing RFID observation data;  real-timely monitoring whether the output signal of the touch array arranged on the terminal actuator base satisfies the preset contact triggering condition;  if so,  generating the contact absolute reference event,  and accumulating the continuous touch contact point sequence formed by multiple contact absolute reference events in the grabbing approach or micro-scanning track;  based on the continuous touch contact point sequence,  corresponding current and historical mechanical arm position and contact point geometric information,  performing joint online calibration to the RF phase offset and end external reference error,  so as to obtain the online calibration result data containing touch contact constraint;  according to the RFID observation data and the online calibration result data,  fusing the visual sensing information output by the visual system,  the touch contact restriction and the preset geometric prior information of the target object,  determining a six-degree-of-freedom pose for controlling the mechanical arm to perform the operation of grabbing the target object.

The present invention relates to the field of intelligent sensing control technology A method,  system,  equipment and medium for sensing the hand contact state of a humanoid robot based on multi-modal tactile fusion are disclosed. The method includes :  collecting array pressure signals through a pressure tactile sensor provided in the contact area of the dexterous hand of the humanoid robot,  and collecting array pressure signals through a sliding tactile sensor. The sensor collects the deformation image sequence of the contact area; fusion of pressure branch features and slip branch features to obtain multi-modal tactile fusion features and generate single-moment recognition output results; conduct state merging on the recognition output results at multiple consecutive moments to obtain continuous contact state segments; the abnormal contact event is determined by using the state parameter determination rule,  and the structured contact event output result is generated and sent to the robot control system. The invention realizes the continuous perception,  stable identification and structured output of the robot hand contact state,  and improves the slip trend identification ability and control linkage ability under complex operation scenes. 1. A human-shaped robot hand contact state sensing method based on multimodal tactile fusion,  wherein it comprises :  the array pressure signal is collected by the pressure touch sensor arranged in the contact area of the smart hand of the human-shaped robot,  and the deformed image sequence of the contact area is collected by the sliding touch sensor;  performing a first pre-processing operation on the array pressure signal to obtain a pressure branch characteristic;  performing a second pre-processing operation on the deformed image sequence to obtain a sliding branch feature;  fusing the pressure branch characteristic and the sliding branch characteristic to obtain a multi-mode touch fusion characteristic,  and generating a single-time identification output result based on the multi-mode touch fusion characteristic;  performing state combination to the identification output result at multiple continuous moments to obtain a continuous contact state section;  judging the abnormal contact event based on the state parameter judging rule of the continuous contact state section,  generating the structured contact event output result,  and sending the structured contact event output result to the robot control system.

The invention discloses a decision control method,  system,  equipment and medium for a humanoid robot,  wherein a unified strategy model in the method is trained through the following steps :  obtaining several full-dimensional training features of the humanoid robot; according to each full-dimension training feature,  the single-dimension strategy model is trained to obtain several trained single-dimension strategy models and the original trajectory information corresponding to each trained single-dimension strategy model; the original trajectory information includes state behavior data,  action behavior data and reward behavior data; all original trajectory information is rewarded and unified across scenarios to obtain a unified trajectory data set; according to the unified trajectory data set,  the initialized unified strategy model is trained to obtain the trained unified strategy model. The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology 1. A decision control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the current state data of the humanoid robot;  inputting the current state data to the trained uniform strategy model,  obtaining the behaviour instruction data output by the trained uniform strategy model,  and controlling the humanoid robot to execute the behaviour instruction data;  wherein the trained unified policy model is obtained by training the following steps :  obtaining a plurality of full-dimensional training features of the human-shaped robot,  each of the full-dimensional training features corresponding to one operation scene of the human-shaped robot;  performing model training on the single-dimensional strategy model according to each full-dimensional training characteristic to obtain multiple trained single-dimensional strategy models and original track information corresponding to each trained single-dimensional strategy model;  each single-dimensional strategy model is corresponding to one job scene;  the original track information comprises state action data,  action action data and reward action data;  rewarding and cross-scene unifying all the original track information to obtain a uniform track data set;  the uniform track data set comprises several target track information,  the reward standard corresponding to all the target track information is the same;  according to the uniform track data set,  performing model training on the initialized uniform strategy model,  obtaining the trained uniform strategy model.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot-oriented multi-modal teleoperation control method and system,  aiming at solving the technical bottlenecks of poor input compatibility,  weak environmental adaptability and unsmooth movement in the prior art The method includes :  S100,  normalizing adaptation and intention reconstruction of multi-source heterogeneous inputs from VR,  motion capture,  vision,  etc.,  to generate a standardized target skeleton sequence; s200,  build a teacher-student asymmetric deep network,  and enable the student network to have the ability to infer environmental parameters from ontology feedback through implicit feature distillation; s300,  perform dynamic manifold filtering on the operator's intention to extract smooth motion components,  and design a composite reward function to achieve precise tracking and whole-body collaboration; s400,  execute the control strategy online and integrate the security fuse mechanism. A multi-mode remote operation control method for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S100,  normalization adaptation of multi-modal heterogeneous interaction data :  Obtaining an original data stream from at least one human-computer interaction unit and reconstructing and aligning the original data to generate a standardized target skeleton sequence and constructing an observation vector containing robot main body state and intention time sequence characteristic ;  S200,  constructing a deep neural network based on asymmetric feature coupling :  constructing a dual-flow network architecture comprising a teacher network and a student network,  wherein the teacher network is based on an extended state vector training,  student network based on observation vector performing the online deployment,  and enabling the student network to learn the environment deducing ability of the teacher network through the implicit feature distillation;  S300,  control law calculation based on dynamic manifold alignment :  Speed vector for input intent performing low-pass filtering,  extracting low-frequency principal component as smoothing intention and designing a composite reward function to guide the robot to track the smooth intention and realize the systemic cooperative movement;  S400,  online reasoning and safe fusing :  Student network output motion residual the moment instruction is generated by the controller controlling the movement of the robot,  monitoring the state of the robot in real time,  and switching to the safe mode under the abnormal condition.

The invention discloses a balance operation control management system and method applied to wheel-legged robots,  and relates to the technical field of balance operation control of wheel-legged robots. It includes collecting the center of mass,  posture and wheel-foot contact sequence of the wheel-legged robot traveling in a low-speed channel,  and obtaining the initial foot end center of gravity adjustment range; performing multi-scale decomposition on its response sequence to generate multiple second foot end adjustment amplitudes,  and mapping them into foot end displacement and action time as execution targets; apply to the robot to complete the balance operation and control,  collect the center of mass fluctuation and attitude oscillation to train the Markov model to generate the adjustment amplitude score; identify the best interval according to the score,  screen the best adjustment amplitude and use it for balance operation control and trajectory tracking,  which solves the problems of balance operation control attitude oscillation and insufficient active stability under high center of gravity and low speed channel. 1. A balance operation control management method applied to wheel foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  collecting the centroid position,  the attitude angle and the wheel-foot contact state sequence in the low-speed passage travelling process of the wheel-foot robot,  obtaining the initial foot end gravity centre adjusting amplitude according to the relation between the centroid and the attitude change;  performing multi-scale decomposition to the mass centre response sequence corresponding to the initial foot end gravity centre adjusting amplitude,  extracting the action component intervened by the foot end under different time scales,  generating several different second foot end gravity centre adjusting amplitudes;  each second foot end gravity centre adjusting amplitude is mapped to the corresponding foot end single displacement and action duration,  so that each adjusting amplitude can be converted into the specific foot end execution target;  respectively applying the foot end execution target mapped by the second foot end gravity centre adjusting amplitude to the wheel foot robot,  finishing the balance operation process under multiple groups of different adjusting amplitudes;  collecting the centroid transverse fluctuation and attitude oscillation sequence after each adjusting amplitude application,  constructing a state vector and training a Markov model based on the state transition rule,  generating an adjusting amplitude score of each second foot end gravity centre adjusting amplitude by the model;  expanding the adjusting amplitude score along the adjusting amplitude of the gravity centre of the second foot end,  identifying the best interval of the score curve,  selecting the best value from the adjusting amplitude of the gravity centre of the second foot end,  and applying to the balance operation control and target track tracking of the wheel foot robot.

The invention provides a quadruped robot terrain sensing and motion state identification method and system based on a multi-dimensional acceleration sensor The method includes signal acquisition,  signal preprocessing,  feature extraction,  terrain perception,  motion state decoupling and state output. The system comprises a sensor module,  a data acquisition and signal conditioning module and a processor module Solved the problems of motion state coupling and low accuracy of feature recognition of quadruped robots in complex unstructured environments. This method has high recognition accuracy and real-time response speed under various working conditions where terrain and gait are intertwined,  and significantly improves the environmental adaptability of the quadruped robot during autonomous navigation and the intelligent level of gait control. 1. A four-foot robot terrain sensing and motion state identification method based on multi-dimensional acceleration sensor,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1) signal acquisition;  the six-dimensional piezoelectric acceleration sensor (1) and four three-dimensional piezoelectric acceleration sensors (2) are used for synchronously collecting the acceleration sequence signals of the trunk and each leg of the four-foot robot under different motion tracks by the set frequency;  wherein the six-dimensional piezoelectric acceleration sensor (1) is installed on the back of the trunk of the four-foot robot;  four three-dimensional piezoelectric acceleration sensors (2) are respectively installed on each leg hip joint;  S2) pre-processing the signal;  performing wavelet noise reduction and low-pass filtering processing on all collected channel signals to remove high-frequency noise;  S3) extracting features;  segmenting the pre-processed signal by a sliding time window,  extracting the time domain feature in each time window and constructing a multi-dimensional feature vector;  S4) terrain sensing;  inputting the multi-dimensional feature vector into the trained first-level classifier,  and identifying the current terrain type of the four-foot robot;  S5) decoupling the motion state;  according to the terrain type output in the step S4),  indexing and calling the corresponding second-level classifier;  inputting the multi-dimensional characteristic vector to the second-level classifier,  and outputting the current gait mode,  motion state and/or gait phase;  S6) state output;  synthesizing terrain type,  gait mode,  motion state and gait phase,  generating and outputting the state mark of the four-foot robot.

This application relates to a nonlinear trajectory planning and obstacle avoidance method for quadruped robots operating in small spaces,  including the following methods :  S1. Rough trajectory generation for motion anisotropy perception; s2. Nonlinear trajectory optimization; s3. Real-time obstacle avoidance decision-making based on multi-modal perception and reinforcement learning; s4. Hierarchical tracking control; according to the structure provided by the embodiment of the invention,  the safety and the agility of passing through a narrow space are obviously improved; realize highly robust obstacle avoidance in dynamic environment; taking into account global optimization and local real-time response :  The hierarchical architecture of "global rough planning (S1) → local perception optimization (S2 and S3) → underlying tracking control (S4)" is adopted,  which not only ensures the feasibility of the global path from the starting point to the end point,  but also can control the path based on real-time perception information. Local fine-tuning and obstacle avoidance of trajectories,  response delay ≤ 100 ms,  strong adaptability to dynamic obstacles and sudden terrain changes. 1. A four-foot robot nonlinear track planning and obstacle avoidance method for narrow space operation,  wherein comprising the following method :  S1,  generating a coarse trajectory of motion anisotropy perception :  establishing a kinematics model containing four-foot robot motion anisotropy constraint (OMA),  using separation planning strategy to respectively plan the plane position and orientation of the robot,  using improved sampling planning algorithm to search in the state space considering OMA constraint,  generating a non-collision rough track from the starting point to the target point;  S2,  nonlinear track optimization :  using the collision-free rough track generated in the step S1 as an initial guess,  using a high-order polynomial parameterization track,  constructing an optimization model comprising a robot dynamic equation,  a joint torque limitation,  a foot end contact constraint and a real-time obstacle avoidance constraint,  obtaining a dynamic feasible solution through a numerical optimization solver,  smooth and satisfy the optimized track of anisotropy constraint;  S3,  real-time obstacle avoidance decision based on multi-modal perception and intensive learning :  parallel or alternate operation with step S1 and S2,  through complex narrow terrain modelling,  heterogeneous sensor data fusion,  path point guiding the strengthening learning strategy,  output local obstacle-avoiding navigation point or speed instruction,  as dynamic constraint input to step S2 the optimization model;  S4,  hierarchical tracking control :  taking the optimized track of the step S2 as a reference track,  sending the reference track to a bottom nonlinear model prediction controller (NMPC) for high-frequency tracking control,  realizing accurate track tracking and stable body posture.

The invention provides a brain-computer interface system for continuous control of the whole body of a humanoid robot and an execution method,  belonging to the technical field of brain-computer interfaces and robot control The system comprises an EEG data stream acquisition and online sliding window segmentation module,  an EEG feature extraction and classification module,  a double-threshold smoothing module and an instruction space mapping and execution module Among them,  continuous decoding of streaming EEG signals is realized through on-line sliding window segmentation with fixed step size; through the confidence rejection and residence time confirmation mechanism in the double-threshold smoothing module,  the unstable original prediction of the decoding model is converted into a safe execution instruction,  which effectively filters the invalid EEG signals caused by line of sight transfer,  blinking,  etc.,  and eliminates instruction jitter The safety instructions are mapped into incremental motion primitives to achieve full-body continuous and fine control of high-degree-of-freedom humanoid robots. The invention takes into account both low control delay and high stability,  and significantly improves the safety and control accuracy of brain-controlled robot interaction. 1. A brain-computer interface system for systemic continuous control of humanoid robot,  wherein the system comprises :  a brain wave data stream acquisition and online sliding window segmentation module :  a series of brain wave data windows for decoding in real time are generated;  an electroencephalogram feature extraction and classification module :  for receiving the brain wave data window,  extracting the steady state visual evoked potential SSVEP (Steady-State Visual Evoked Potential,  SSVEP) characteristic,  and outputting the classification score corresponding to each control instruction type in each decoding time step;  wherein the classification is divided into the score vector output by the decoding model aiming at each control instruction type,  the control instruction type corresponding to the maximum score in the classification score is defined as the original prediction type,  the original prediction type is used as the candidate instruction of the current decoding time step;  a dual-threshold smoothing module :  for converting the candidate instruction into a secure execution instruction,  the dual-threshold smoothing module comprises :  a confidence degree refusing unit for calculating the prediction confidence degree of the current decoding time step according to the classification score,  and refusing the current candidate instruction and outputting the non-action instruction when the prediction confidence degree is lower than the preset confidence degree threshold;  a residence time confirming unit,  for when the current candidate instruction is different from the current stable instruction,  judging whether the current candidate instruction continuously appears to reach the preset confirming step number,  if reaches the preset confirming step number,  if so,  confirming the current candidate instruction as a new stable instruction and outputting it as a safe execution instruction,  otherwise,  outputting a non-action instruction;  an instruction space mapping and executing module for mapping the safe executing instruction output by the double-threshold smoothing module into the increment motion primitive of the robot so as to drive the robot to execute the continuous action;  controlling the robot to maintain the current state when receiving the no-action instruction.

An intelligent body self-adaptive control system for binding cloud end memory based on personal account number,  wherein it comprises :  a user account management module,  configured to establish a unique binding relationship between the user personal account and the cloud storage instance;  a cloud memory iteration storage module for storing and iteratively updating the personalized memory data bound with the user account;  the cloud cooperative decision scheduling module is used for distributing the calculation force resource according to the task demand,  and supporting three scheduling modes of firstly calculating and then calculating,  firstly calculating and then calculating,  and simultaneously calculating;  a local data self-adaptive updating module for executing the basic action and adjusting the parameter according to the cloud instruction;  an off-line mode management module for switching to the off-line memory mode for calling the local pre-stored memory data when the network is interrupted;  the memory data migration module is used for responding to the migration instruction,  encrypting and packing the memory data under the source account and transmitting to the target account to establish a new binding relationship.
