It realizes dynamic release and recovery of lubricating oil through microporous capillary action. It forms a lubricating film when working and returns the oil when stationary. It effectively solves the leakage pollution of traditional liquid lubricants and frequent maintenance. This technology has self-lubricating and zero-pollution characteristics,  significantly reducing maintenance costs and extending bearing life,  improving the operational reliability and environmental adaptability of the robot system. 1. A maintenance-free and leakage-proof bearing for humanoid robot and industrial robot,  wherein it comprises an outer ring,  an inner ring,  a rolling body and plastic oil;  the plastic body oil is used for lubricating the rolling body,  the plastic body oil is polyethylene (PE),  ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene,  the polyimide or PEEK polymer is used as the base material,  after mixing with the lubricating oil and the additive,  it is heated and solidified to form the micro-pore oil-containing lubricating particle,  the micro-pore in the inner part thereof absorbs the saturated lubricating oil,  it is stored in the polymer micro-pore through the surface tension,  in the moving process,  The lubricating oil moves to the surface of the friction pair under the action of the micro-pore capillary under the extrusion and heat influence to form the lubricating oil film,  and the lubricating oil will be absorbed to the polymer again to be stored when the operation is stopped.

When an unscheduled human physical intervention (contact,  grabbing,  blocking,  or occupying a path) occurs to a robot autonomously working in a shared space,  a human-robot task coordination system and method are disclosed that interprets this as a semantic signal rather than a uniform emergency stop target. The present invention detects unscheduled physical interventions,  identifies intervention subjects,  assigns authority grades,  and assigns the lowest base grade to unidentified subjects. Based on the intervention force profile,  contact location,  duration,  direction of action,  path occupancy,  and work context,  the invention classifies interventions into intent categories such as accidental contact,  trajectory correction,  partial concession,  demand for substitute performance,  and emergency stop. Depending on the combination of classified intent categories and authority levels,  control authority is differentially transferred only to degrees of freedom or subtasks affected by the intervention,  while remaining work resources are maintained in parallel,  and intervention by underprivileged entities is limited to safety suspension. At the end of the intervention,  the changed site conditions are reconciled with the planned status,  the remaining plan is recounted,  safety verification is conducted,  and the entire process is preserved as audit records. The invention relates to a humanoid robot OTA automation upgrade method and system,  and relates to the field of robot software maintenance. It includes :  determining a target robot set based on robot status information; issue batch upgrade tasks to the target robot set,  and install and upgrade them in a silent installation method; collect the current battery level of the robot; if the current battery power is lower than the upgrade maintenance threshold,  determine the nearest target charging area based on the current robot position; determine an idle robot based on the current robot position,  and control the idle robot to transport the current robot to the target charging area for charging,  while completing the silent installation process in the target charging area; after the installation and upgrade is completed,  the self-test program is automatically run to verify the core functions. When the upgrade self-test results meet the preset self-test requirements,  the upgraded version information is marked as successful upgrade and reported to the cloud management platform. The invention has the effect of improving the upgrading efficiency of the robot 1. A humanoid robot OTA automatic upgrading method,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the robot state information;  determining a target robot set based on the robot state information;  controlling the preset cloud management platform to send batch upgrading task to the target robot set,  and controlling the robot to collect OTA upgrading packet through the safety channel,  and performing installation upgrading by the preset silent installation method;  in the process of executing silent installation,  collecting the current battery electric quantity of the robot;  judging whether it is lower than the pre-set upgrading maintaining threshold value according to the current battery electric quantity;  if the electric quantity of the current battery is lower than the upgrading maintaining threshold value,  collecting the position of the current robot;  determining the nearest target charging region from the preset charging facility position list according to the current robot position;  based on the position of the current robot,  determining the idle robot,  and controlling the idle robot to carry the current robot to the target charging area for charging,  at the same time,  finishing the silent installation process in the target charging area;  after finishing installing and upgrading,  automatically operating the pre-set self-checking program to verify the core function,  and collecting the upgrading self-checking result and the upgraded version information;  when the upgrading self-checking result is in accordance with the preset self-checking request result,  marking the upgraded version information as the upgrading success and reporting to the cloud management platform;  further comprising a robot carrying method :  collecting the robot posture information and weight distribution parameter of the robot to be carried;  obtaining the current orientation of the robot according to the posture information of the robot;  combining the current direction of the robot,  the current robot position and the target charging area to determine the optimal approach path of the idle robot;  determining the position of the carrying supporting point according to the weight distribution parameter;  generating a mechanical arm grabbing track parameter based on the position of the conveying supporting point;  controlling the idle robot to execute the grabbing operation according to the grabbing track parameter of the mechanical arm,  and moving to the target charging area according to the optimal approach path after the grabbing is finished;  further comprising :  after moving to the target charging area,  collecting the real-time posture data of the current robot;  according to the real-time attitude data,  judging whether it meets the preset charging safety attitude condition;  when the charging safety posture condition is not satisfied,  calculating the posture adjusting angle based on the real-time posture data and the charging safety posture condition;  adjusting the angle according to the posture to generate the posture correction parameter;  based on the posture correction parameter,  controlling the idle robot to perform posture adjustment operation on the current robot;  further comprising an anti-toppling mutual aid method in the target charging area :  collecting the number of the charging robots in the target charging area;  when the number of the charging robots exceeds the preset mutual aid standard number,  collecting the current charging electric quantity of each charging robot;  calculating the electric quantity difference value between each robot based on the current charging electric quantity;  establishing a robot mutual-aid pairing relationship according to the electric quantity difference value;  controlling the paired robot to adjust the posture into the pre-set anti-toppling mutual posture according to the mutual pairing relationship of the robot so as to form a stable supporting structure,  and continuing to execute the charging and upgrading flow after the supporting structure is formed.

The invention relates to a multi-skill integrated control method and system for a wheel-footed robot. The method includes :  initializing the parameters of the bottom network of the wheel-footed robot; obtaining a first sampled skill command including a speed command and a motor skill command; according to the first sampling skill command,  the bottom skill interaction with the environment is carried out through the existing bottom strategy of the wheel-legged robot,  and the bottom interaction trajectory is collected; calculate the underlying reward function and constraint function to update the underlying network; initialize the parameters of the high-level network of the control model; obtain the second sampling skill command,  interact with the environment through high-level strategies,  and collect high-level interaction trajectories; calculate the corresponding high-level reward function to update the high-level network,  which is finally used for motion control of wheel-footed robots. Compared with the prior art,  the invention has the advantages that seamless switching of various physical skills can be realized,  the success rate of migration from simulation to a real object is obviously improved,  the peak performance of the motor can be fully excavated and safely utilized,  and the like 1. A multi-skill integrated control method for wheel-foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  initializing the parameter of the bottom network of the control model of the wheel-foot robot to be trained;  S2 :  obtaining a first sample skill command for underlying skill training,  the first sample skill command comprising a speed instruction and a motion skill instruction,  the motion skill instruction comprising different motion skills;  S3 :  according to the first sampling skill command,  performing the bottom layer skill interaction with the environment through the existing bottom layer strategy of the wheel-foot robot,  and collecting the bottom layer interaction track;  S4 :  according to the bottom layer interaction track,  aiming at the corresponding motion skill instruction,  calculating the bottom layer reward function and constraint function,  the bottom layer reward function comprises skill reward and behaviour standard reward,  so as to update the bottom layer network of the control model;  S5 :  repeating the step S2-S4 until the updated bottom policy is converged;  S6 :  initializing the parameter of the high layer network of the control model;  S7 :  obtaining a second sample skill command for high level skill training,  the second sample skill command comprising a speed instruction;  S8 :  according to the second sampling skill command,  interacting with the environment through the existing high-level strategy of the wheel-foot robot,  and collecting the high-level interaction track;  S9 :  calculating the corresponding high-layer reward function according to the collected high-layer interaction track so as to update the high-layer network of the control model;  S10 :  repeating the step S7-S9 until the updated high level policy is converged;  S11 :  the updated bottom layer strategy and the high layer strategy are used for controlling the movement of the wheel-foot robot.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control,  and discloses a humanoid robot zero position automatic calibration method and system based on current characteristic analysis,  which includes determining the zero position calibration sequence and zero return direction of each joint; calibrate the offset of each joint moving from the mechanical limit position to the zero position along the zero return direction as the initial zero return offset; controlling each joint to move to the mechanical limit position,  collecting real-time active current signal of joint motor in each sampling period,  if several continuous real-time collected active current signals exceed the current zero return current threshold,  judging that the joint has reached the mechanical limit position; control each joint to move along the zero return direction until the initial zero return offset is reached; after correcting the initial zero return offset,  it is used to control the joint to return to zero. The invention can realize efficient,  safe,  automatic and fast calibration of multi-joint zero position through adaptive analysis and zero return control of the current characteristics of the robot body drive motor without external sensors. 1. A humanoid robot zero position automatic calibration method based on current characteristic analysis,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  when demarcating for the first time,  according to the space layout of each joint of the humanoid robot and the motion coupling relation,  determining the zero position demarcating sequence and the zero returning direction of each joint;  obtaining the offset of each joint moving from the mechanical limiting position to the zero position along the zero-returning direction as the initial zero-returning offset of each joint;  orderly controlling each joint to move towards the mechanical limiting position according to the zero position calibration sequence,  collecting the active current signal of the joint motor in real time in each sampling period,  determining the current return zero threshold value according to the active current signal collected in real time,  if the continuous multiple real-time collected active current signals exceed the zero-return current threshold value,  judging that the joint reaches the mechanical limiting position and stops;  when all the joints move to the mechanical limiting position,  controlling each joint to move along the zero-return direction according to the zero-position calibration sequence until the movement offset reaches the initial zero-return offset and stops;  correcting the initial return-to-zero offset according to the difference between the current position of each joint and the expected zero position,  generating the final return-to-zero offset of each joint,  and controlling the return-to-zero of the joint according to the final return-to-zero offset in the subsequent calibration.

 S2 cathode-precision forging mould constructing step,  manufacturing the cathode-precision forging mould matched with the bevel gear finished product mirror image,  the mould is internally provided with a sub-area micro-flow passage network,  the surface of the work piece is provided with a micron-level micro-hole connected with the micro-flow passage network,  the mould is installed on the mechanical pulse generator and connected with the pulse power supply cathode;  S3 system loading and initializing step,  loading the anode blank prepared by S1 on the equipment tooling,  driving the cathode-precision forging mould constructed by S2 and the anode blank to form an initial micron-level processing gap,  starting the electrolyte supply system to make the electrolyte to be sprayed to the processing gap through the mould micro-flow passage and the micro-hole,  starting the gap state monitoring unit to collect the electrochemical impedance signal between two electrodes in real time; The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical manufacturing,  and discloses a manufacturing process method for a dexterous hand worm of a humanoid robot. The manufacturing process method comprises the following specific steps of :  firstly,  selecting and pretreating materials; step two :  rough turning and semi-finishing processing,  step three :  thread forming processing; step four :  heat treatment process,  placing the worm formed in step three into a vacuum heat treatment furnace for processing,  step five :  fine grinding and polishing; step 6 :  Cleaning and anti-rust treatment In the present invention,  the temperature is raised to 820 °C to 880 °C at a rate of 8 °C/min to 12 °C/min in a vacuum heat treatment furnace,  and the temperature is maintained for 20min to 40min to complete austenitization,  and then high-pressure gas quenching is performed to control the cooling rate. 60 ℃/s ~ 100 ℃/s,  and closed-loop control of infrared thermometer ensures that the axial temperature difference is ≤ 15 ℃,  effectively solving the problem of uneven temperature field distribution due to cross-sectional size differences. 1. A manufacturing technique method of dexterous hand worm applied to humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  selecting and pre-processing the material,  selecting 9Mn2V or T10A steel material as the worm blank,  confirming that the material component meets the standard through spectrum analysis,  then performing blanking processing,  cutting the worm blank to a preset length,  and performing chamfering and deburring processing on the cutting end face,  step two :  rough turning and semi-fine turning processing,  the worm blank processed in the step one is subjected to rough outer circle by a precise numerical control lathe,  the single side is left with an allowance of 0.3 mm to 0.8 mm,  then the fine processing cutter is switched to perform semi-fine turning,  the outer circle size tolerance is controlled in the range of +/ - 0.05 mm,  and ensures the proper alignment error of each shaft section is less than 0.01mm,  step three :  thread forming processing,  using a multi-head worm special numerical control milling machine or a cyclone milling device,  pre-setting a spiral lead angle and a lead,  and according to the pre-set spiral lead angle and the lead,  performing layered milling on the worm blank tooth part processed in the step two through a forming cutter,  the cutting depth of each layer is 0.05 mm to 0.1 mm,  in the milling process,  continuously applying the cooling liquid to control the temperature rise,  to obtain the formed worm,  step four :  a heat treatment process,  placing the worm formed in the step three in a vacuum heat treatment furnace,  firstly raising the temperature to 820 degrees centigrade to 880 degrees centigrade at the speed of 8 degrees centigrade/min to 12 degrees centigrade/min,  keeping the temperature for 20 min to 40 min to finish austenitizing,  then performing high pressure gas quenching,  The cooling rate is controlled at 60 ° C. /s to 100 ° C. /s,  and finally tempered at 160 ° C. to 200 ° C. for 1.5 h to 2.5 h. Step 5 :  fine grinding and polishing,  using a numerical control thread grinding machine to perform fine grinding on the worm tooth surface after heat treatment in the step four,  using a cubic boron nitride grinding wheel,  the grinding line speed is 30m/s to 40m/s,  real-time feedback and correcting the grinding path through an online measuring system,  ensuring that the precision of the spiral line reaches P1 level,  the change amount of the middle diameter size is less than or equal to 0.01 mm,  step six :  cleaning and anti-rust treatment,  performing ultrasonic cleaning on the worm after fine grinding in the step five,  removing residual abrasive particles and oil stain,  then dip-coating the anti-rust oil and drying at 70 ℃ to 90 ℃.

The invention discloses a method and a system for locking and unlocking feet of an intelligent humanoid robot with a spatial body in a microgravity environment The system obtains the foot end pose and speed information in a unified coordinate system,  and obtains the preset attachable target point set of the environmental structure; the target point pose can be provided by a preset point library,  or the marked points can be detected by a visual sensor to obtain or correct. Perform left and right side matching on the target point set based on the foot identifier to obtain the corresponding side target point subset Select candidate target points from the subset,  combine the distance threshold,  speed threshold and unlocking cooling window to form a locking gating criterion,  and establish an equivalent rigid constraint between the foot end and the environmental structure when the criterion is met and the locking enable is allowed to achieve foot locking. This method abstracts the foot-end attachment process into composable body skills,  improves microgravity contact switching stability and system consistency,  and can be used for climbing and moving inside and outside the space station and providing stable support for subsequent operations. 1. A foot locking and unlocking method of intelligent humanoid robot with space and body under microgravity environment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  obtaining the robot foot end state and the target point set,  obtaining the pose information of the left foot end and the right foot end under the uniform coordinate system,  and obtaining the pose information and the target point mark of multiple attachable target points preset on the environment structure;  step S2 :  selecting left and right side target point matching and candidate target point,  performing left and right side matching for multiple attachable target points according to foot mark,  obtaining left side target point set and right side target point set;  for the left foot end only in the left side target point set,  for the right foot end only in the right side target point set,  calculating the distance between the foot end and the target point and selecting the candidate target point,  at the same time,  calculating the foot end speed or the relative speed of the foot end relative to the candidate target point,  and receiving the locking enabling signal sent by the external task module;  step S3 :  establishing an equivalent rigid constraint and issuing a locking state,  when the locking enabling signal allows and satisfies the locking gating criterion,  establishing an equivalent rigid constraint object for limiting the relative degree of freedom between the foot end rigid body and the environmental structure main body rigid body to realize foot locking,  and recording the constraint identification information and the target point identification;  step S4 :  performing the unlocking arbitration,  the restriction releasing and the consistency maintenance,  when receiving the unlocking instruction or the locking enabling signal prohibiting,  executing the unlocking arbitration,  only when the left foot end and the right foot end are in the locking state,  allowing to release the equivalent rigid restriction corresponding to one foot to realize the single foot unlocking;  after allowing unlocking,  updating the unlocking time and entering the preset cooling window,  if detecting that the constraint identification information is invalid or the constraint release is failed,  executing the search and cleaning of the residual constraint;  issuing the locking state information to the external task module.

This application provides a method and device for generating cooperative handling actions of both arms of a humanoid robot The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a hand and foot phase deviation angle on the same side,  an angular velocity peak value of an object around a transverse shaft and an instantaneous joint moment in a walking period of the humanoid robot,  and determining a rotational inertia estimation value of the conveyed object according to the instantaneous joint moment and the angular velocity peak value of the object around the transverse shaft; by comparing the estimated value of the moment of inertia with a preset threshold value,  the inertia level of the transported object is judged; determine the corresponding phase correction strategy according to the inertia level of different transported objects; after the phase deviation angle of the hands and feet on the same side is adjusted using a phase correction strategy,  the phase correction strategy is corrected according to the monitoring results of the peak angular velocity of the object around the horizontal axis and the trunk pitch oscillation amplitude until the phase deviation angle of the hands and feet on the same side converges. to the preset range 1. A double-arm cooperative conveying action generating method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the phase deviation angle of the hand and foot at the same side in the walking period of the human-shaped robot,  the angular velocity peak value of the object around the transverse shaft and the instantaneous joint moment,  determining the rotary inertia estimation value of the object according to the instantaneous joint moment and the angular velocity peak value of the object around the transverse shaft;  comparing the rotary inertia estimation value with the pre-set threshold value to judge the inertia level of the carrying object;  aiming at the inertia level of different carrying objects,  determining the corresponding phase correcting strategy;  after using the phase correcting strategy to adjust the phase deviation angle of the hand and foot at the same side,  correcting the phase correcting strategy according to the monitoring result of the angular speed peak value of the object around the transverse shaft and the pitching oscillation amplitude of the trunk until the phase deviation angle of the hand and foot at the same side is converged to the preset range.

This application provides an interactive projection guidance control method,  an interactive robotic arm and a humanoid robot. This application realizes the integrated closed-loop service of autonomous movement,  precise projection,  laser explanation,  intelligent light filling and safe recharging of the robot in a dynamic office environment. 1. An interactive projection guidance control method,  wherein it comprises :  in response to the user voice instruction,  generating the content to be displayed and the corresponding explanation script;  controlling the four-wheel intelligent chassis to move to the target display area,  and identifying the target projection plane,  according to the space parameter of the target projection plane,  the positioning state of the four-wheel intelligent chassis and the current joint state of the interactive mechanical arm,  jointly solving the expected position at the tail end of the interactive mechanical arm;  controlling the interactive mechanical arm to move the projection module to the desired pose,  and performing geometric correction on the content to be displayed and then projecting to the target projection plane;  according to the explanation script,  controlling the laser guiding module to dynamically indicate or track the target area in the content to be displayed,  and according to the environment illumination intensity,  task mode and user position,  controlling the illumination module to perform light compensation illumination;  After the task is finished,  the humanoid robot is controlled to execute standby,  following or automatically backfilling.

The invention discloses a joint parameter detection method of a robot,  the robot and a storage medium The method collects attitude data through two detection units rigidly fixed at the reference end and dynamic end of the joint,  calculates the relative attitude transformation matrix,  and then calculates the full-dimensional motion parameters such as expansion,  rotation and multi-turn rotation values of the joint. This method effectively filters out the overall motion interference of the robot,  and can realize high-precision and high-reliability joint parameter detection without relying on fragile mechanical counting devices or high-cost external calibration. It is especially suitable for various joints of humanoid robots with composite motion characteristics. 1. A method for detecting joint parameter of robot,  comprising :  obtaining the attitude data respectively collected by the reference end detection unit and the dynamic end detection unit,  wherein the reference end detection unit is rigidly fixed on the reference end component,  the reference end component has no relative displacement with the joint to be detected,  the dynamic end detection unit is rigidly fixed on the dynamic end component,  the dynamic end component is synchronously linked with the joint to be detected;  based on the attitude data of the reference end detection unit and the dynamic end detection unit,  respectively calculating a reference end attitude matrix R0 and a dynamic end attitude matrix R1;  based on the reference end attitude matrix R0 and the dynamic end attitude matrix R1,  calculating the relative attitude transformation matrix R of the dynamic end component relative to the reference end component,  the relative attitude transformation matrix R=R1 * R0-1;  determining the motion parameter of the joint to be detected based on the relative posture transformation matrix R.

The invention discloses a bionic joint compliant driving system oriented to compliant interaction and a control method thereof The system includes a brushless DC motor,  a low reduction ratio reducer,  an encoder,  a current sampling circuit and a main controller Using a collimated direct drive (QDD) architecture or a series elastic (SEA) architecture,  the external torque is estimated in real time using the motor current and encoder signal through an external force observer (such as an interference observer) without the need for additional torque sensors. Based on the estimated external force,  the impedance control module enables the joints to exhibit adjustable mass-spring-damping characteristics,  achieving muscle-like compliant motion. When a collision is detected,  the system can respond within 2ms and shut down safely; when a continuous external force is detected,  it automatically enters the drag teaching mode. The invention has low cost,  fast response and high safety,  and is suitable for quadruped robots,  humanoid robots,  collaborative robotic arms and other scenes requiring human-machine physical interaction. 1. A bionic joint compliance driving system for compliance interaction,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  a brushless direct current motor;  S2,  a speed reducer with low speed reduction ratio,  which is connected with the output shaft of the brushless direct current motor;  S3,  an absolute value encoder installed on the output end of the motor shaft or the speed reducer for detecting the angular position and the angular speed;  S4,  a current sampling circuit for collecting the three-phase current of the motor;  S5,  a main controller integrated with a magnetic field orientation control module,  an external force observer,  an impedance control module and a collision detecting module;  S6,  the external force observer estimates the external moment in real time based on the motor current and the coder signal,  the impedance control module adjusts the motion flexibility of the joint according to the external moment,  the collision detecting module triggers the safety response when the external moment exceeds the set threshold.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot with bionic buttocks based on the golden mass ratio of the human body. According to the invention,  the mass ratio of buttocks is limited to the golden ratio range of a human body,  and a double-layer control strategy of a three-dimensional adjustable weighing structure,  macroscopic gravity center adjustment and microscopic fluctuation control is combined,  so that the load of the knee joint is effectively reduced,  and the dynamic stability and the bionic performance are improved 1. A humanoid robot with bionic buttocks based on human gold mass ratio,  wherein it comprises :  a trunk,  a lower limb and a bionic hip connected between the trunk and the lower limb;  the bionic hip comprises a pelvis structure frame,  the pelvis structure frame is internally provided with a function integrated tray,  the function integrated tray is integrally installed with a plurality of function modules,  the function module at least comprises a quality adjusting module for changing the quality distribution of the hip area;  the quality adjusting module comprises a sliding rail system set at the middle part of the function integrated tray,  an adjustable counterweight block array capable of moving along the sliding rail system,  and a driving unit in transmission connection with the adjustable counterweight block array,  the adjustable counterweight block array is composed of multiple counterweight blocks,  the driving unit is used for driving the counterweight block to move along the slide rail system to adjust the gravity centre of the whole machine;  the ratio n of the total mass Mhip of the bionic hip and the total mass Mtorso of the trunk is not less than 0.15 and not more than 0.40.

The invention relates to the technical field of quadruped robot navigation,  and discloses a quadruped robot intelligent navigation system combining a behavior tree and visual recognition,  which comprises a path processing module,  a turning pre-judgment module,  a behavior tree decision-making module,  a blocking judgment module,  a visual recognition and language evaluation module and a navigation decision-making module The path processing module fuses multi-sensor data to obtain pose and gait states; the turning prediction module calculates the safe turning speed and trigger distance based on the gait phase sliding window; the behavior tree decision module dynamically adjusts the node priority according to the trigger intensity,  and the gait phase arbiter controls the switching opportunity; a blocking determination module generates a path blocking flag; the visual recognition module adopts a two-level architecture and calls a visual language model to evaluate the footing area for static crossable obstacles; the Navigation Decision Module fuses footing semantic confidence and outputs spanning,  bypassing,  waiting or returning instructions The invention can realize the active predictive navigation and intelligent obstacle avoidance decision-making of the quadruped robot in complex industrial environments. 1. A four-foot robot intelligent navigation system for behaviour tree and visual identification,  wherein it comprises :  the path processing module is used for fusing the inertia measurement,  the laser radar and the leg kinematics data to obtain the robot pose,  converting the global path point to the main body coordinate system,  and outputting the path point sequence and the gait state information;  a turning pre-judging module for extracting the path curvature based on the sliding window sensed by the gait phase according to the path point sequence and the gait state information,  and calculating the safe turning speed and the turning trigger distance;  a behaviour tree decision module for receiving the safe turning speed and the turning trigger distance,  dynamically adjusting the priority of the navigation behaviour node by the trigger intensity mapping,  and obtaining the motion execution parameter by controlling the switching time by the gait phase arbiter;  the block judging module is used for obtaining the motion executing parameter,  executing the deceleration,  gait switching and posture adjustment according to the priority of the behaviour node,  verifying the path block early warning and generating the formal path block mark;  a visual identification and language evaluation module,  for according to the path blocking mark and obstacle position,  real-time geometric identification obstacle attribute,  the static can cross obstacle trigger visual language model evaluation foot area to obtain semantic evaluation result;  a navigation decision module for matching the obstacle attribute with the robot motion capability parameter based on the obstacle attribute data and the landing semantic evaluation result,  and fusing the landing semantic confidence to generate the navigation decision.

The invention discloses a mobile radio frequency spectrum monitoring system and a mobile radio frequency spectrum monitoring method based on a quadruped robot platform,  and belongs to the technical field of radio orientation The system comprises a quadruped robot body and a monitoring module carried by the quadruped robot body,  wherein the monitoring module comprises a seeker,  a built-in array antenna and a seeker head; the seeker head is erected above the robot body through a heightening frame; the built-in array antenna is used for collecting radio frequency signals; the signal processing room,  the built-in SDR receiver is connected to the array antenna to receive the signal,  the pose sensor module obtains the robot pose,  the data processing module performs spatial spectrum direction finding on the signal and fuses the pose data,  outputs the radiation source coordinates and transmits them through the communication module; the power room is used to power the system. The invention effectively realizes the integration of the quadruped robot and the radio monitoring system,  improves the transient signal capture accuracy and monitoring response efficiency,  can meet the needs of radio management departments for large-scale deployment and normalized inspection in complex scenes,  and helps maintain electromagnetic Space safety and order 1. A mobile radio frequency spectrum monitoring system based on four-foot robot platform,  comprising a four-foot robot main body (1),  wherein it further comprises a monitoring module set on the four-foot robot main body (1),  the monitoring module comprises :  a guide head (2),  which is set above the four-foot robot main body (1) through a heightening frame (3),  the guide head (2) is internally provided with an array antenna (21) composed of a plurality of omni-directional antennas (211) arranged according to a predetermined array,  for collecting space radio-frequency signal;  a signal processing chamber (4),  which is internally provided with an SDR receiver (411),  a position sensor module,  a data processing module (42) and a communication module (43),  the SDR receiver (411) is connected with the array antenna (21) signal to receive radio frequency signal;  the position sensor module is used for obtaining the real-time geographical position and course angle of the four-foot robot main body (1);  the data processing module (42) performs spatial spectrum direction measurement on the signal of the SDR receiver (411),  calculates the arrival angle of the incoming wave,  and fuses the data of the pose sensor module,  outputs the precise coordinate of the radiation source relative to the geographical north pole reference,  the communication module (43) is transmitted to the remote display control end;  a power supply chamber (5) for supplying power.

A quadruped robot multi-source positioning method and system based on geometric space decoupling and full-dimensional dynamic confidence. The data is collected and input into the data preprocessing module to obtain the dedistorted effective point cloud data Input the effective point cloud data into the geometric information matrix construction module to construct the geometric information matrix; based on the geometric information matrix,  subspace decoupling,  algebraic stiffness calculation and time domain inertial smoothing are completed through the full-dimensional space decoupling and sensing module to form a geometric confidence factor in the [0,  1] interval; input the geometric confidence factor into the multi-source covariance elastic reconstruction module,  and dynamically reconstruct the observation noise covariance of the lidar and leg constraints respectively according to the geometric confidence factor to obtain the reconstructed lidar observation constraints and leg contact Observation constraints; input the reconstructed observation constraints into the error state Kalman filter,  and output the high-precision pose of the quadruped robot. According to the invention,  the accurate positioning of the quadruped robot can be realized 1. A four-foot robot multi-source positioning method based on geometric space decoupling and full-dimensional dynamic confidence,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  collecting the laser radar original point cloud data carried by the four-foot robot,  the angular speed and acceleration data output by the inertia measuring unit,  the leg joint angle data output by the leg joint encoder,  inputting the data pre-processing module,  obtaining the effective point cloud data after removing distortion and a leg contact observation constraint;  S2,  the effective point cloud data obtained in the step S1 an input geometric information matrix constructing module for constructing a geometric information matrix,  wherein the geometric information matrix is used for representing the geometric constraint strength of the point cloud residual in each degree of freedom direction and the coupling relation between each degree of freedom;  S3,  based on the geometric information matrix constructed in the step S2,  completing the sub-space decoupling,  algebraic rigidity calculation and time domain inertia smoothing processing by the full-dimensional space decoupling and sensing module,  forming the geometric confidence factor of the [0,  1] interval;  S4,  inputting the geometric confidence factor obtained in the step S3 to the multi-source covariance elastic reconstruction module,  according to the geometric confidence factor,  respectively performing dynamic reconstruction on the observation noise covariance of the laser radar and the leg constraint,  realizing the self-adaptive adjustment of the degree of participation of the two in each degree of freedom direction,  obtaining the reconstructed laser radar observation constraint and leg contact observation constraint; A human-shaped robot action tracking control method,  wherein the method comprises :  according to the high dynamic action tracking task reward function and the high dynamic action safety recovery task reward function,  constructing the target optimization problem function;  modelling the target optimization problem function as a Markov decision process;  training an initial humanoid robot action tracking control model based on off-strategy strengthening learning algorithm,  so as to solve the Markov decision process,  obtaining the trained humanoid robot action tracking control model,  wherein the humanoid robot action tracking control model is used for obtaining the high dynamic action tracking safety decision of the humanoid robot,  the humanoid robot action tracking control model is composed of a strategy network and a value network.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot upper limb remote operation method based on reinforcement learning and optimization algorithm,  which includes remote operation of arms and remote operation of dexterous hands; during the remote operation of the arms,  the movements of the human motion data set are redirected to the arms of the humanoid robot to obtain the redirected robot motion data set; based on the redirected robot motion data set,  the robot motion learning training is carried out,  the output is the robot target joint position,  and then the robot target joint position is converted into the target joint torque; in the remote operation of the dexterous hand,  the key point position of each finger end is calculated by using the forward kinematics method according to each joint position at the current moment,  the joint angle difference between two time steps is minimized,  and the optimized finger joint angle is output; taking the real-time posture as input,  based on the remote operation of the arm and the remote operation of the dexterous hand,  the control instructions of all joints of the upper limb of the robot are synchronously output. The invention has low dependency on hardware and stable remote operation control 1. A remote operation method for upper limb of humanoid robot based on enhanced learning and optimization algorithm,  wherein it comprises remote operation of arm and remote operation of smart hand;  in the remote operation of the arm,  the action of the human movement data set is redirected to the two arms of the human-shaped robot to obtain the redirected robot movement data set;  performing robot action learning training based on the redirected robot motion data set,  specifically comprising :  converting the robot motion learning task into Markov decision process;  training based on near-end strategy optimization algorithm and teacher-student training frame;  the input of the teacher strategy is the sensing state of the robot main body,  the reference movement state and the difference between the two,  the output is the target joint position of the robot,  and then the target joint position of the robot is converted into the target joint moment;  the input of the student strategy comprises the key point position and speed of the reference motion,  the key point position difference value of the robot and the reference motion,  and the historical joint position,  the joint speed,  the previous action,  the output is the robot target joint position,  then the robot target joint position is converted into the target joint moment;  in the remote operation of the dexterous hand,  according to each joint position of the current moment,  using the forward kinematics method to calculate the key point position of each finger end,  minimizing the joint angle difference between two time steps,  outputting the optimized finger joint angle;  based on the remote operation of the arm and the remote operation of the dexterous hand,  the control instructions of all joints of the upper limb of the robot are synchronously output.

The invention realizes lightweight,  high integration and flexible safe interaction of humanoid robot joints,  and is suitable for lower limb knee joints of humanoid robots. 1. A tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven human knee joint,  comprising a knee joint fixing end (3) and a knee joint moving end (6),  wherein the lower end of the knee joint fixing end (3) is provided with an upper quarter arc vertical plate (17),  the upper end of the knee joint moving end (6) is correspondingly provided with a lower quarter arc vertical plate (18),  the upper quarter arc vertical plate (17) and the lower quarter arc vertical plate (18) form a rotating pair through a double-end connecting piece (4),  the two are rotatably opened and closed at one side,  a joint rope driving component with amplified tension and constant torque is set between the knee joint fixing end (3) and the knee joint moving end (6),  for driving the knee joint moving end (6) relative to the knee joint fixed end (3),  the knee joint fixed end (3) is provided with a fixed end big pulley (11) for reversing;  the joint rope driving component comprises a joint module (15),  two sets of steel wire ropes and a plurality of moving end guide wheels (5) set on the knee joint moving end (6);  wherein the two sets of steel wire ropes are led out from the joint module (15) and then arranged in a diagonal mirror image at the knee joint fixing end (3),  and the tension is amplified after passing through the multiple moving end guide wheels (5) on the knee joint moving end (6).

A hierarchical path planning method and system for quadruped robot considering electric safety potential energy and gait switching cost is disclosed. Firstly,  a comprehensive three-dimensional cost map containing ground geometric characteristics and three-dimensional electric field safety potential energy field is constructed,  and the spatial electric shock risk is mapped into potential energy. Cost value; secondly,  define the combined state including position and gait modality,  and construct a global search criterion that integrates movement cost,  risk cost and gait modality switching cost; then,  a joint path search is performed to automatically force the robot to switch to a low-attitude creeping mode in the high electric field potential energy area to increase the vertical safety distance; finally,  the virtual straight corridor is used to check the suitability of the foot end landing points of the path,  and redundant nodes are eliminated based on the terrain elevation dispersion and normal inclination. The invention solves the problems that the quadruped robot is easy to enter the high-voltage area by mistake,  the gait switching is frequent and consumes energy,  and the smooth path is easy to cause the foot end to slip during the substation inspection,  and realizes safe,  efficient and stable autonomous inspection. 1. A four-legged robot hierarchical path planning method considering power safety potential energy and gait switching cost,  wherein it comprises :  S1 :  obtaining the laser point cloud data and digital twinning model information of the substation operation area,  constructing a grid map reflecting the ground geometrical characteristic;  at the same time,  according to the voltage level and space position of the electrified device in the digital twin model,  constructing a three-dimensional electric field safe potential energy field,  and mapping the potential energy field to the upper space of the grid map,  forming a comprehensive three-dimensional cost map with the ground surface passing impedance and space electric shock risk;  S2 :  defining the path planning state of the four-foot robot as the combined state including the position coordinate,  the course angle and the gait mode;  setting the cost rule of the global search,  wherein the cost rule is composed of a moving distance cost,  a space safety risk cost and a gait mode switching cost;  S3 :  searching the optimal path from the starting point to the end point based on the cost rule in the comprehensive three-dimensional cost map,  and outputting the initial planning path including the position sequence and the corresponding gait mode sequence;  in the searching process,  when the planning path enters the high electric field potential energy region,  the algorithm automatically restricts the gait mode as the low attitude mode so as to increase the safe distance in the vertical direction;  and S4 :  extracting the key turning node in the initial planning path,  performing foot end falling point suitability check on the linear path between the non-adjacent nodes;  only when the terrain flatness of the linear path covering area satisfies the foot end skid-proof requirement of the four-foot robot,  removing the middle redundant node,  generating the final execution path.

The invention provides a legged robot adaptive navigation method for ship three-dimensional space inspection operations,  and relates to the technical field of mobile robot autonomous navigation. The method includes the steps of obtaining three-dimensional point cloud data of the ship's internal environment and preprocessing it to obtain global point cloud; performing ground segmentation and fitting on the global point cloud to obtain a ground point cloud,  performing bearing plane inversion and point cloud completion to generate an enhanced point cloud with credibility weight,  constructing a passability evaluation function,  and extracting a three-dimensional passable area; generate an initial three-dimensional global path over the three-dimensional passable area; based on the existing a priori mapping path,  adaptively adjust the guidance weight of the a priori mapping path,  and correct and optimize the initial three-dimensional global path to obtain an optimized global path; generate a candidate trajectory cluster according to the current position of the robot,  comprehensively evaluate the fit between the candidate trajectory and the optimized global path and the safety with real-time local obstacles,  and select the optimal trajectory and issue it for execution. 1. A foot-type robot self-adaptive navigation method for ship three-dimensional space inspection operation,  wherein the steps comprise :  obtaining the three-dimensional point cloud data of the internal environment of the ship through the multi-line laser radar,  and pre-processing to obtain the uniform global point cloud;  performing ground segmentation on the global point cloud,  and obtaining the ground point cloud through plane fitting,  using stair vertical surface geometric prior constraint,  extracting vertical surface structure point cloud from the ground point cloud,  and performing bearing plane inversion and point cloud compensation,  generating enhanced point cloud with reliability weight,  to characterize the bearing area for the foot-type robot to stably fall foot and the machine body to pass,  performing terrain geometric characteristic evaluation on the enhanced point cloud,  and based on the evaluation result,  constructing a passable evaluation function suitable for foot-type robot machine body to pass and foot end stably fall foot constraint,  to extract three-dimensional passable area;  on the three-dimensional passable area,  based on the multi-feature homogeneous constraint of voxel,  performing area growth clustering,  constructing a plurality of passable area clusters,  and using the passable area cluster as a high-level search space,  using the path length,  the terrain safety penalty value suitable for the foot-type robot traffic stability and the barrier distance are used as the transfer cost to perform heuristic search to generate an initial three-dimensional global path;  based on the existing priori mapping path,  according to the scale measurement parameter of each of the passable area cluster,  self-adaptively adjusting the guide weight of the priori mapping path,  and fusing the adjusted guide weight with the transfer cost,  performing correction and optimization on the initial three-dimensional global path,  obtaining the optimized global path;  according to the current position of the robot,  performing local track planning under the foot-type robot kinematics constraint and dynamic window constraint,  obtaining a plurality of candidate tracks,  comprehensively evaluating the fit degree of the candidate track and the global path from the optimized and the safety of the real-time local obstacle,  the optimal track of the evaluation result is selected and sent to the foot robot bottom controller for execution.

The invention discloses a bionic flexible tactile sensor based on pressure pain and a robot active protection method,  and relates to the field of bionic robot flexible sensing and safety protection The sensor adopts a DIW integrated printing process and includes a flexible silicone substrate,  cross-row conductive grids and spherical crown-shaped slightly convex piezoresistive sensing units. It is non-layered,  fully flexible,  and can be adapted to the complex curved surface of the robot's whole body. According to the invention,  a three-level progressive quantitative bionic pain sensing system is constructed by taking the critical pressure of sensor material damage as a benchmark,  a robot is driven by a pain sensing value to execute hierarchical protection actions,  and structural risks are eliminated from the root by expanding a stressed area; at the same time,  a whole-body partitioned density bionic skin system was constructed,  and the plantar pressure and gyroscope data were integrated to achieve walking balance adjustment. The invention takes into account both perception accuracy and engineering cost,  and greatly improves the bionic perception ability,  operation safety and structural life of the humanoid robot. 1. An active protection method of robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  through the bionic flexible touch sensor carried by the robot,  collecting the stress data of each sensing unit in real time,  calculating the single point or area real-time pressure intensity based on the unit area stress,  and calculating the robot pain sensing value according to the real-time pressure intensity;  the robot pain feeling value is the quantification technical parameter for representing the damage risk of the robot body structure;  S2,  according to the structure characteristic of the robot body,  pre-setting a three-level progressive threshold value for the pain feeling value of the robot,  which are respectively a pre-trigger threshold value,  a trigger threshold value and a damage value;  S3,  according to the matching relation between the real-time calculated robot pain value and the corresponding threshold value,  judging the structure damage risk level of the corresponding part,  and executing the corresponding grading protection action :  when the pain feeling value of the robot reaches the pre-triggering threshold value,  judging that the corresponding part has the potential risk of structure damage,  and executing the pre-warning protection action;  when the pain value of the robot reaches the trigger threshold value,  judging that the corresponding part structure is nearly damaged,  and executing the core active protection action;  when the pain value of the robot reaches the damage value,  judging that the corresponding part structure is irreversibly damaged,  and executing the emergency stop protection action.

The invention discloses a method for detecting the gravity center position of a humanoid robot Foot force sensors are respectively arranged in the heel area,  the inner side of the front plantar area and the outer side of the front plantar area of each elastic foot plate of both feet Form a triangular arrangement,  and set no less than 1 foot force sensor around each of the three foot force sensors. By analyzing and calculating the stress data relationship between each foot force sensor,  it is judged whether the foot force sensor is working normally and whether the humanoid robot body is in an unstable state. Based on the relative position of the feet measured by the device that monitors the relative position of the feet in real time The humanoid robot control center establishes a unified plane coordinate system for both feet The method comprises the following steps of :  determining the coordinate range of the optimal stable zone by experiments and analysis; determining that the foot force sensors work normally and the body is not unstable; calculating the gravity center coordinate position of the humanoid robot according to the coordinate position and stress data of each foot force sensor; and judging whether the gravity center is in the optimal stable zone or not according to the calculation result 1. A method for detecting centre-of-gravity position of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a human-shaped robot control centre,  a device for monitoring relative position of feet in real time,  an elastic foot plate (1),  a foot force sensor A (4),  a foot force sensor AN (7),  a foot force sensor B (5),  a foot force sensor BN (8),  a foot force sensor C (6) and a foot force sensor CN (9);  the human-shaped robot control centre collects the data in real time and analyzes and calculates the relative position relation of the feet;  and the heel area of each elastic foot plate (1) of two feet,  the inner side of the front metatarsal area and the outer side of the front metatarsal area are respectively provided with a foot force sensor A (4),  a foot force sensor B (5),  a foot force sensor C (6),  the periphery of the foot force sensor A (4) is provided with at least one foot force sensor AN (7),  the periphery of the foot force sensor B (5) is provided with at least one foot force sensor BN (8),  the periphery of the foot force sensor C (6) is provided with at least one foot force sensor CN (9);  and establishing a single foot plate bottom plane coordinate system,  determining the central point coordinate value of each foot force sensor,  the humanoid robot control centre according to the relative position of the two feet,  establishing the uniform coordinate system of the two feet,  and determining the central point coordinate value of each foot force sensor of the two feet;  and on the basis of the experiment and considering the calculation simplification,  determining the optimal stable area coordinate range of the single foot standing;  the human-shaped robot control centre analyzes,  calculates and determines the optimal stable area coordinate range of the standing feet according to the relative position of the feet and the optimal stable area coordinate range of the standing feet;  and when the foot is subjected to the gravity action,  the human-shaped robot control centre analyzes and judges whether the foot force sensor works normally according to the stress data relation between the foot force sensors at each position of the foot plate,  if the foot force sensor is in an abnormal working state,  the human-shaped robot control centre sends the foot force sensor fault information;  and when the foot is under the gravity action,  the human-shaped robot control centre analyzes the body instability according to the stress data relation between the foot force sensors at each position of the foot plate,  if the body is in the unstable state,  the human-shaped robot control centre sends the body unstable information;  and when the foot is subjected to the gravity action,  the humanoid robot control centre analyzes and calculates the gravity centre (10) position according to the coordinate position and stress data of each foot force sensor after determining that the foot force sensor works normally and the body is not unstable,  judging whether the gravity centre (10) position is in the best stable area,  if the gravity centre (10) is in the best stable area,  sending the standing stable information,  if the gravity centre (10) is not in the best stable area,  sending the information that the gravity centre (10) position is not in the best stable area.

The invention discloses an intelligent security inspection system based on edge computing and humanoid robots,  which relates to artificial intelligence and is proposed to solve the problem of independent case robot information in the prior art. Humanoid robots at the hardware layer handle real-time tasks as edge computing nodes; the server serves as the system's non-real-time data center; the perception layer is used to fully digitize the environment,  people and items; the decision-making layer is deployed in the onboard edge computing unit of the humanoid robot; the interactive layer serves as a human-machine interface. The advantage is that humanoid robots are used as mobile edge computing nodes to deeply integrate other case sensor data through heterogeneous network architecture. The invention covers an anti-occlusion visual perception algorithm based on human body key points,  a risk assessment method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a real-time task collaborative scheduling technology based on priorities,  and solves the problems of equipment information islands and manual operation efficiency bottlenecks existing in security inspections in places with high human flow such as subways and airports. 1. An intelligent security inspection system based on edge computing and humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises a hardware layer,  a sensing layer,  a decision layer and an interaction layer;  the hardware layer comprises a human-shaped robot main body,  an X-ray security inspection machine,  a metal detection door and a server;  wherein the humanoid robot is used as the edge computing node to process the real-time task;  the server is used as the non-real-time data centre of the system and is connected with the edge computing node through the TCP/IP protocol for storing the history security check log,  the long-period data analysis and the cluster management of multiple humanoid robots;  the sensing layer is used for completely digitizing the environment,  personnel and articles;  the decision layer is arranged in the airborne edge calculating unit of the humanoid robot;  it comprises a multi-source data fusion module,  a cooperative task distribution model and a finite state machine;  the interaction layer is used as a man-machine interface for realizing physical and information interaction with the passenger through voice synthesis,  voice identification and visual warning.

A robot control model training method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the first state information of the simulation robot at the first time,  the first terrain environment information and each history state information and each history action information at each history time of the first time;  encoding the first terrain environment information by the target environment encoder in the pre-training teacher model to obtain the first encoding information;  using the target pulse neural network in the pre-training teacher model to obtain the first action information of the simulation robot at the first time according to the first coding information,  the first state information and the history action information at the target history time;  encoding each piece of history state information and each piece of history action information by an initial self-adaptive module to obtain second encoding information;  using the target pulse neural network to obtain the second action information of the simulation robot at the first time according to the second coding information,  the first state information and the history action information at the target history time;  training the initial adaptive module according to the first action information and the second action information to obtain a target adaptive module,  wherein the robot control model comprises :  and the target adaptive module and the target pulse neural network.

The invention discloses an adaptive control method for a four-wheeled legged robot based on reinforcement learning and NMPC-WBC Through the combination of gradient descent method and joint soft restraint,  it realizes the autonomous starting and leg posture alignment of the robot in any initial posture There is no need for foot force sensors and external sensing equipment Only through ontology multi-source state data,  combined with reinforcement learning network to achieve implicit contact perception and terrain parameter estimation,  reduce hardware costs,  the NMPC optimization module with dynamic soft constraints cooperates with the time-event hybrid triggering mechanism Adjust gait phase and foot trajectory in real time Adapt to complex terrain changes,  to improve motion stability,  the wheel-step switching WBC control model realizes adaptive switching between pure wheel mode and leg-raising wheel-step mode. The WBC hierarchical force distribution strategy based on task priority gives priority to ensuring the stability of the fuselage posture and center of mass,  and improves control accuracy. With system robustness,  it can be applied to various four-wheeled legged robot inspection and detection scenarios. 1. A four-wheel foot type robot adaptive control method based on enhanced learning and NMPC-WBC,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  self-adaptive starting track planning and leg posture alignment :  initializing the system parameter,  collecting the robot initial joint angle and the machine body posture,  defining the target starting posture,  constructing the joint angle error function,  adopting the gradient descent method to iteratively update the joint angle,  introducing the joint soft constraint and emergency adjusting mechanism,  realizing self-starting under any initial posture and aligning the leg posture;  S2 :  main body sensory state collecting and pre-processing :  collecting the multi-source state data through the robot main body sensor,  constructing a time sequence state sequence,  using z-score normalization pre-processing to eliminate dimension difference,  outputting a standardized time sequence state sequence;  S3 :  reinforcement learning implicit contact perception and terrain parameter estimation :  inputting the standard time sequence state sequence into the preset strengthening learning network,  outputting the foot end contact confidence degree,  the contact time sequence correction amount and the terrain rigidity estimation value,  realizing the implicit contact sensing without external sensor and the terrain parameter identification;  S4 :  NMPC adaptive optimization and gait scheduling :  based on the contact sensing result and the terrain parameter,  constructing the NMPC optimization problem containing dynamic soft constraint,  using the sequence secondary planning algorithm to solve,  combining with the time-event mixed trigger mechanism,  realizing the gait phase self-adaptive scheduling;  S5 :  rotation switching WBC control and moment optimization :  constructing a step switching WBC control model,  realizing the self-adaptive switching between the pure wheel mode and the leg lifting wheel step mode,  performing layered force distribution based on the task priority management strategy,  introducing a compliance control mechanism to compensate disturbance,  outputting an optimal joint moment instruction;  S6 :  closed loop feedback execution :  the joint moment instruction is sent to the executing mechanism through the communication bus,  the main body state data is collected in real time and fed back to the pre-processing module to form a complete closed loop of collection-perception-optimization-control-feedback.

The invention provides a method and a device for intelligently evaluating and training gait naturalness of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a corresponding reference force application opportunity record from a historical force application opportunity database according to a working condition label,  and determining a feasible range of force application opportunity; when the pace change amplitude exceeds the preset safety threshold and the friction resistance level is lower than the preset stable level,  adjust the delay amount of the force application timing; updating the initial force application time by using the adjusted force application time delay amount,  and iteratively comparing and correcting the initial force application time with the feasible range of the force application time to obtain the optimal force application time; based on the comparison between the optimal kick-off moment and the peak moment of plantar flexion moment,  a dynamic adjustment plan for the moment of force application is generated; carry out propulsion force and slip risk assessment on the dynamic adjustment plan of force-exerting timing,  and output the verified force-exerting timing plan after confirming that it meets the requirements. 1. An intelligent evaluation training method for gait naturalness of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  collecting the plantar bending moment,  the plantar pressure and the forward acceleration of the swinging leg,  determining the change amplitude of the step speed and the friction resistance level;  according to the step speed change amplitude and the friction resistance level,  obtaining the working condition label through the support vector machine classification,  and according to the working condition label and the forward acceleration of the swinging leg,  determining the initial force moment;  aiming at the working condition label,  obtaining the corresponding reference force moment record from the historical force moment database,  determining the feasible range of the force moment;  when the step speed change amplitude exceeds the preset safety threshold value and the friction resistance level is lower than the preset stable level,  adjusting the force moment delay amount;  updating the initial force application time by the adjusted force application time delay amount,  and iteratively comparing and correcting with the feasible range of the force application time to obtain the optimal force application time;  according to the comparison between the optimal pedal force moment and the plantar bending moment peak value moment,  generating a force moment dynamic adjusting solution;  evaluating the propelling force and the slipping risk of the dynamic adjusting solution of the force moment,  and outputting the verified force moment solution after confirming that the requirement is satisfied.

The invention discloses a design method and a control device of a humanoid walking stability controller based on model reference self-adaptation. The design method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  establishing a dynamic equation of a biped robot in a continuous swing stage and a mapping model of a discrete collision stage; step S2 :  Design a virtual constraint function y = h (q) to couple the motion of the bipedal robot's driven joints and underactuated joints; step S3 :  Perform input/output feedback linearization processing on the virtual constraint function; step S4 :  Design a PD tracking controller for the linear subsystem; step S5 :  Establish an adaptive reference model; step S6 :  Optimize the parameters of the expected joint trajectory of the biped robot based on the energy minimization criterion and combined with the Bezier polynomial fitting method to generate an energy-saving periodic expected trajectory; step S7 :  Use the control Lyapunov function and Poincaré mapping to prove the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system to ensure the periodic stable walking of the system. 1. A design method of humanoid walking stable controller based on model reference self-adaptive,  wherein the design method comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  establishing the dynamic equation of the continuous swinging stage of the biped robot and the mapping model of the discrete collision stage,  constructing the biped robot walking system as a hybrid system;  step S2 :  designing a virtual constraint function y = h (q) so as to couple the motion of the biped robot driving joint and the under-actuated joint;  step S3 :  performing input/output feedback linearization processing on the virtual constraint function so as to decompose the non-linear system of the biped robot into linear sub-system and zero dynamic state;  step S4 :  designing PD tracking controller for the linear sub-system;  step S5 :  establishing a self-adaptive reference model,  designing the parameter self-adaptive law based on the joint track tracking error,  adjusting the controller parameter online in real time to compensate the uncertainty of the system model;
