A curing degree regulating method of corona-resistant enamelled copper flat wire for humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the real-time monitoring data of the corona-resistant enamelled copper flat wire in the production process,  wherein the real-time monitoring data comprises the paint film thickness distribution,  the temperature field in the curing furnace and the solvent volatilization rate;  through analyzing the real-time monitoring data,  identifying the unbalanced area and lag stage of the curing degree development in the current production batch,  obtaining the initial characteristic set of the curing defect;  integrating the primary characteristic set of the curing defect and the preset process knowledge base,  constructing a dynamic temperature compensation path aiming at the current unbalanced zone and a time strengthening strategy aiming at the lag stage,  forming a primary regulating solution;  according to the initial control solution,  the power output curve of the heater in the curing oven and the feeding speed of the transmission chain are cooperatively distributed to generate a detailed execution instruction set containing time and space dimension;  sending the detailed execution instruction set to the production device for execution,  and synchronously collecting the feedback process parameter in the execution cycle,  comparing the feedback process parameter with the expected parameter track,  obtaining the execution deviation map;  according to the execution deviation map,  iteratively modifying the key parameter in the dynamic temperature compensation path and the time strengthening strategy,  until the execution deviation map is converged in the allowable threshold range,  outputting the stable curing process parameter packet;  The step of obtaining the preliminary feature set of the curing defect is specifically as follows :  performing area division on the paint film thickness distribution data,  calculating the thickness average value and variance of each divided area,  marking the area where the variance exceeds the preset thickness fluctuation limit value as the thickness imbalance area;  in the temperature field data in the curing oven,  locating the temperature area corresponding to the space coordinate of the thickness imbalance area,  analyzing the change curve of the temperature of the temperature area along with the time,  identifying the time period that the slope of the temperature curve is lower than the preset heating rate threshold,  and marking the time period as the temperature lag stage;  associating the solvent volatilization speed data with the time point of the temperature lag stage,  calculating the solvent volatilization speed of the time point,  if the solvent volatilization speed is lower than the preset volatilization speed threshold value,  confirming that the temperature lag stage is accompanied with the solvent volatilization lag stage;  summarizing all the thickness imbalance regions,  the temperature lag stage and the accompanying solvent volatilization lag information to obtain the initial characteristic set of the curing defect.

The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent obstacle avoidance,  and specifically discloses a humanoid robot dynamic obstacle avoidance method and system based on image segmentation. The method includes :  performing pixel-level semantic segmentation on the original environmental data in the robot's traveling direction to obtain an environmental mask. code map; tracking the contour centroid of the obstacle in the traveling direction,  and mapping the tracked centroid position to the three-dimensional coordinate system to obtain the motion state vector of the obstacle; analyze the raster terrain of the environment mask map to construct a two-dimensional passable area map; incremental path search is performed on the two-dimensional passable area map to obtain the local obstacle avoidance path,  and combined with the motion state vector,  the safety distance threshold between the local obstacle avoidance path and the obstacle is adjusted; program the gait phase of the robot and generate the joint space trajectory instructions of the robot; the invention can improve the efficiency of dynamic obstacle avoidance of a humanoid robot based on image segmentation. 1. A humanoid robot dynamic obstacle avoidance method based on image segmentation,  wherein the method comprises :  performing pixel-level semantic segmentation to the environment original data in the advancing direction of the robot to obtain an environment mask image of the environment original data;  based on the environment mask image,  performing contour centroid tracking on the obstacle in the travelling direction,  and mapping the tracked centroid position to the three-dimensional coordinate system,  so as to obtain the motion state vector of the obstacle,  comprising :  based on the connectivity of the environment mask image,  performing the neighbourhood attribution division to the environment mask image to obtain the barrier pixel cluster of the environment mask image;  analyzing the central point of the barrier pixel cluster to obtain the two-dimensional centroid coordinate of the barrier pixel cluster;  performing multi-frame correlation matching to the two-dimensional centroid coordinate to obtain the continuous centroid coordinate of the barrier;  performing recursion average filtering to the continuous centroid coordinate to obtain the centroid position of the barrier;  The step of mapping the tracked centroid position to a three-dimensional coordinate system to obtain a motion state vector of an obstacle comprises :  performing bilinear interpolation reading on the centroid position to obtain a sub-pixel depth sequence of the centroid position;  converting the centroid position and the sub-pixel depth sequence to a three-dimensional coordinate system using the hip joint centre of the robot as the origin to obtain the three-dimensional space position sequence of the barrier;  performing time sequence smooth estimation to the three-dimensional space position sequence to obtain the instantaneous speed vector and the instantaneous acceleration vector of the obstacle;  integrating the instantaneous speed vector and the instantaneous acceleration vector into the motion state vector of the barrier;  performing grid terrain analysis on the environment mask image,  constructing a two-dimensional passable area map in the travelling direction,  comprising :  taking the current position of the robot as the origin,  performing space discrete projection on the environment mask image to obtain the initial semantic grid image in the travelling direction;  performing neighbourhood elevation difference analysis on the ground area grid in the initial semantic grid pattern to obtain the terrain gradient amplitude of the initial semantic grid pattern;  performing Euclidean distance conversion on the non-ground barrier area grid in the initial semantic grid graph to obtain the barrier distance field of the initial semantic grid graph;  based on the terrain gradient amplitude and the barrier distance field,  calculating the passing confidence degree of the grid in the initial semantic grid graph;  judging the grid whose pass confidence is higher than the preset confidence as the passable area of the initial semantic grid graph,  generating a two-dimensional passable area map in the travelling direction;  The calculation formula of the pass confidence is as follows :  ;  In the formula,  A representation grid passing confidence,  A representation grid the distance value in the obstacle distance field,  A representation grid gradient amplitude value,  representing the preset obstacle influence scale factor,  represents a preset terrain sensitivity factor,  The expression is natural constant is an exponential function of the base;  taking the current pose of the robot as the starting point,  performing incremental path search on the two-dimensional passable area map to obtain the local obstacle-avoiding path of the robot,  and combining the motion state vector to adjust the safe distance threshold between the local obstacle-avoiding path and the obstacle;  based on the local obstacle-avoiding path and the safe distance threshold,  performing gait phase planning to the robot,  generating the joint space track instruction of the robot.

Smooth picking motion planning methods,  systems,  products,  equipment and storage media,  the invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid flexible picking of a mechanical arm,  and solves the technical problems that in the prior art,  when aiming at a single fruit with different positions and postures,  the picking planning of flexible trajectory adjustment and posture control cannot be carried out,  so that the pose requirement and joint execution conflict in the picking scene and the adaptability to complex trajectories is weak Collect demonstration data; construct a strategy function,  input the current robot arm end pose state,  obtain the robot arm action probability distribution,  and generate the current execution action; construct a multi-dimensional perceptual neural reward network and calculate the current total reward; construct a value function and combine it with the current total reward to obtain the value advantage of the current execution action; calculate the value loss and strategy loss,  and after updating the strategy function and value function,  use the robotic arm to perform the current action. The invention is used for realizing soft picking of fresh fruits 1. A flexible picking motion planning method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  initializing the execution environment and execution parameter of the mechanical arm,  and loading the demonstration data;  step 2,  constructing strategy function,  input current mechanical arm end pose state,  to obtain mechanical arm action probability distribution,  based on mechanical arm action probability distribution generate current execution action;  step 3,  constructing a multi-dimensional perceptual nerve reward network,  calculating the current total reward,  specifically is :  step 31,  obtaining the current state of the mechanical arm end actuator;  step 32,  calculating the demonstration quaternionic number corresponding to the normal vector of two continuous frames of the picking target in the demonstration data,  inputting the current state,  the demonstration data and the demonstration quaternionic number into the demonstration reward branch of the multi-dimensional perception neural reward network,  obtaining the demonstration reward;  step 33,  calculating the actual posture quaternion under the current state of the mechanical arm end actuator and the next state normal vector of the mechanical arm end actuator,  obtaining the corresponding predicted quaternion,  the intelligent body action reward branch of the current execution action and prediction quaternion input multi-dimensional perception neural reward network to obtain the intelligent body action reward;  step 34,  performing weighted fusion on the demonstration reward and the intelligent agent action reward,  obtaining the current total reward;  step 4,  constructing a value function,  calculating the state value,  combining the current total reward,  obtaining the value advantage of the current execution action;  step 5,  based on the value advantage of the current execution action and the mechanical arm action probability distribution,  calculating the value loss and the strategy loss,  using the strategy loss and the value loss to update the corresponding strategy function and the value function,  using the mechanical arm to execute the current action;  step 6,  judging whether the current action reaches the target position,  if so,  outputting the optimal strategy,  if not,  re-executing the steps 2 to 5.

The invention provides a boxing simulation training method and an intelligent training pile,  and relates to the technical field of boxing training The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring limb movement track data of a trainer through a non-contact human body posture tracking unit; analyze the trainer's action intention in real time based on the motion trajectory data through the built-in AI action recognition model of the control unit; according to the action intention,  the control unit controls the motion drive unit to drive the pile body to perform a predetermined countermeasure response action. Wherein,  the sensing module also includes an acceleration sensor arranged inside the hit part of the pile body for collecting hit data. The invention solves the problem that the prior art is difficult to accurately obtain the movement trajectory of the trainer and then identify the action intention,  resulting in the inability to simulate real confrontation and poor training experience. 1. A boxing simulation training method,  applied to an intelligent training pile,  wherein the intelligent training pile comprises a pile body,  a motion drive unit,  a sensing module and a control unit,  wherein the pile body is a humanoid structure,  comprising a head part,  a body part,  an upper limb part and a lower limb part;  the motion driving unit is set at the inner joint of the pile body,  for driving each hit part of the pile body to perform a predetermined counteraction response action;  the sensing module comprises a non-contact human body posture tracking unit and an acceleration sensor arranged in each hit part of the pile body;  the control unit is arranged in the pile body and is electrically connected with the sensing module and the motion driving unit,  respectively;  The method comprises the following steps :  the non-contact human body posture tracking unit is used for collecting the limb movement track data of the trainer;  analyzing the action intention of the trainer in real time based on the motion track data by the AI action identification model built in the control unit;  according to the action intention,  the control unit controls the motion drive unit to drive the pile body to execute a predetermined countermeasure response action.

The invention discloses a tension-amplified constant-torque constant-stiffness rope-driven humanoid elbow joint,  and belongs to the technical field of robots The elbow joint comprises an elbow joint fixed end and an elbow joint moving end,  wherein the fixed end is provided with an upper meshing plate with a quarter arc,  the moving end is provided with a lower meshing plate with a quarter arc,  the fixed end and the moving end keep single-side rotation through a coupling rope,  and a rope drive component with amplified tension and constant torque is arranged between the fixed end and the moving end Through the movable pulley block mechanism in which the stepped double-layer pulley at the movable end is matched with the multi-stage pulley at the fixed end,  the tension is amplified in a limited radial space; the double-layer pulley differential rope winding arrangement makes the rope length change have a linear relationship with the joint angle,  and cooperates with the absolute encoder to achieve constant torque output and precise control; the rope drive structure isolates the motor impact,  and the rolling meshing motion constrained by the coupling rope ensures the safety of human-computer interaction. The invention has compact structure and high flexibility,  and is suitable for upper limb elbow joints of humanoid robots 1. A tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven human elbow joint,  comprising an elbow joint fixing end (3),  an elbow joint moving end (6),  wherein the elbow joint fixing end (3) is integrally formed with a quarter circular arc upper engagement plate (19),  the elbow joint moving end (6) is integrally formed with a quarter circular arc lower engagement plate (20),  a quarter circular arc upper engagement plate (19),  a coupling rope (17) for keeping the single-side rotation of the two is set between the lower meshing plate (20) with quarter arc,  the elbow joint fixing end (3),  between the elbow joint moving end (6) is provided with a tension amplifying and constant torque constant rigidity of the rope driving component,  for driving the elbow joint moving end (6) relative to the elbow joint fixed end (3); The invention provides a training method of a robot control model,  a robot control method and a robot,  and relates to the technical field of machine learning The method comprises obtaining global observation information; perform reinforcement learning training on the preset teacher model according to the global observation information to obtain a privileged teacher model; obtain the ontology perception state sequence,  reference state sequence and global observation information of the simulation robot in the preset simulation environment According to the ontology perception state sequence,  reference state sequence and global observation information,  the privileged teacher model is used to distill and train the preset student model,  and the target student model is obtained as the robot control model. The control model of this application can still have implicit global perception capabilities even if only part of the observation information is used,  effectively alleviating the problems of attitude drift and trajectory deviation,  and significantly improving the global consistency,  accuracy and reliability of robot motion tracking. 1. A training method of robot control model,  wherein it comprises :  according to the motion data set of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the main body sensing state,  the corresponding reference state and the corresponding privilege state information of the corresponding simulation robot in the preset simulation environment;  obtaining the global observation information according to the main body sensing state,  the corresponding reference state and the corresponding privilege state information;  performing intensive learning training on the preset teacher model according to the global observation information to obtain a privileged teacher model;  obtaining a main body sensing state sequence,  a reference state sequence and the global observation information of the simulation robot in the preset simulation environment according to the motion data set of the human-shaped robot,  wherein the main body sensing state sequence comprises :  the global observation information corresponds to a history state sequence before the moment,  and the reference state sequence comprises :  a future state sequence after the corresponding time;  according to the main body sensing state sequence,  the reference state sequence and the global observation information,  using the privileged teacher model to perform distillation training on the preset student model,  obtaining the target student model as the robot control model.

This application relates to the field of robot technology and provides robot obstacle avoidance planning methods,  humanoid robots,  equipment,  media and products. The method includes :  obtaining environmental status information; processing based on the end-to-end dual-arm obstacle avoidance planning model according to the environment state information,  the current configuration information and the target state information to obtain candidate action planning information; performing a first collision detection process according to the environment state information and the candidate action planning information; when it is determined that there is a collision risk,  new candidate action planning information is obtained; when it is determined that there is no collision risk,  the candidate action planning information is used as the execution action planning information. The end-to-end dual-arm obstacle avoidance planning model realizes the end-to-end output mode based on the mapping relationship,  can quickly obtain candidate action planning information,  adapt to the dynamic scene of environmental obstacle changes,  enhance the real-time performance of robot obstacle avoidance planning,  and verify whether there is a collision risk through the first collision detection process,  improving the safety of robot movement. 1. A robot obstacle avoidance planning method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining environment state information,  wherein the environment state information represents the barrier condition of the surrounding environment;  according to the environment state information,  the current configuration information and the target state information,  processing based on the end-to-end double-arm obstacle avoidance planning model,  obtaining the candidate action planning information;  performing a first collision detection process according to the environment state information and the candidate action planning information to obtain a first collision detection result;  according to the first collision detection result,  when it is determined that there is collision risk,  obtaining new candidate action planning information;  determining that there is no collision risk according to the first collision detection result,  taking the candidate action planning information as the execution action planning information;  wherein the current configuration information represents the current pose and joint state of the robot,  the target state information represents the target pose of the robot,  the end-to-end double-arm obstacle avoidance planning model is used for making the environment state according to the learned mapping relationship,  The current configuration and the target state are mapped as candidate action sequences.

The embodiment of the invention provides a full-attitude control method and a full-attitude control device for a liquid metal magnetorheological driven humanoid robot. The full-attitude control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an attitude data stream of the humanoid robot in a motion process at a preset frequency in real time,  and generating an expected joint track in a future time period through inverse kinematics real-time calculation; determine the current motion scene and determine the total expected support force and total expected support force moment,  and use the support force of all flexible micro-support capsules as optimization variables to solve to obtain the target support force of each flexible micro-support capsule; input the data into the improved BP neural network,  output the feedforward target magnetic field intensity corresponding to each flexible micro-support capsule,  calculate the feedback magnetic field correction amount and generate the final target magnetic field intensity; generating a magnetic field of corresponding strength based on the final target magnetic field strength adjusts the actual support force generated by the flexible micro-support capsule. The invention provides a method for stably controlling the motion posture of a humanoid robot with high maneuverability and high accuracy 1. A full-attitude control method of human-shaped robot driven by liquid metal magnetorheological fluid,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the posture data stream of the human-shaped robot in the motion process in real time at a preset frequency,  generating the expected joint track in the future time period through inverse kinematics real time calculation,  wherein the posture data stream comprises the joint motion speed and joint motion acceleration representing each joint motion state,  representing the action track deviation of the action execution precision,  representing the gravity centre three-dimensional offset and trunk pitching inclination angle deviation of the machine body posture stability,  representing the target approaching distance of the external interaction process and representing the actual supporting force of the current stress state of each flexible micro-supporting bag body;  performing fusion processing on the posture data stream,  calculating to obtain a comprehensive posture deviation according to the gravity centre three-dimensional deviation amount and the trunk pitching inclination angle deviation,  and according to the comprehensive posture deviation and the target proximity distance,  judging the current motion scene and determining the total expected support resultant force and the total expected support resultant moment,  solving to obtain the target supporting force of each flexible micro-supporting capsule based on the total expected supporting composite force and the total expected supporting composite force;  the comprehensive posture deviation,  the target proximity distance,  the joint movement speed,  the actual supporting force and the expected joint track are used as the input of the improved BP neural network of pre-training,  the feedforward target magnetic field intensity corresponding to each flexible micro-supporting capsule body is output,  according to the deviation of the actual supporting force and the target supporting force,  calculating to obtain the feedback magnetic field correction amount,  superposing the feed-forward target magnetic field intensity with the feedback magnetic field correction amount to generate a final target magnetic field intensity;  based on the final target magnetic field strength,  applying a control current to the corresponding electromagnetic coil mounted on the outer side of each flexible micro-supporting bag body to generate a magnetic field of the corresponding strength,  and adjusting the actual supporting force generated by the flexible micro-supporting bag body,  repeatedly adjusting until the comprehensive posture deviation is converged within a preset threshold value.

The present application relates to the field of humanoid robot intelligent control technology,  and in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot collaborative motion planning method and system in a dynamic environment. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environment information,  robot body parameters and task semantic instructions,  constructing a general kinematics model,  combining a visual language action model and a world model to realize semantic analysis and global path planning,  and generating an initial space-time trajectory; on this basis,  conflict detection and priority re-planning are carried out to obtain conflict-free collaborative trajectories; further,  the full joint motion trajectory is obtained through optimization and solution,  and converted into joint control instructions for execution. At the same time,  combined with real-time environmental information,  local re-planning is triggered to realize dynamic trajectory correction and improve the safety and adaptability of multi-robot coordinated motion. The invention realizes efficient,  safe and robust cooperative motion control of multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robots in complex dynamic environments. 1. A multi-degree-of-freedom human-shaped robot collaborative motion planning method under dynamic environment,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining environment information,  robot main body parameter and task semantic instruction;  establishing a universal kinematics model based on the degree-of-freedom adaptation coefficient in combination with the robot body parameter;  combining the environment information,  the task semantic instruction and the universal kinematics model,  based on the visual language action model and the world model,  performing semantic task analysis and global feasible path search for each robot,  generating the initial space-time track result under uniform motion of each humanoid robot;  performing conflict detection based on the initial space-time track result,  constructing a space-time constraint set,  and performing re-planning on the conflict robot based on the priority policy,  obtaining a non-conflict cooperative track;  taking the non-conflict cooperative track as the initial solution,  constructing an optimized target function,  and combining the pre-set constraint to solve,  obtaining the full-joint motion track;  converting the full-joint motion track into the joint control instruction for execution,  and triggering the local replanning based on the real-time environment information,  realizing the track dynamic correction.

The invention provides a foot robot control method and system for a long-term task,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a long-term task instruction of a foot robot,  analyzing the instruction,  and generating a structured task request; retrieval enhancement is performed based on structured task requests,  and planning prompts containing physical priors and skill constraints are constructed; generating a hierarchical task graph according to the planning prompt,  and verifying the consistency of the hierarchical task graph to obtain an executable task graph; compile the executable task graph to obtain the executable control logic of the legged robot; perform parameter instantiation and safe projection on executable control logic,  generate joint-level control instructions,  and control the legged robot to perform long-term tasks. The invention ensures the rationality,  safety and feasibility of task execution layer by layer through full-process closed-loop optimization,  and effectively solves the pain point that traditional solutions cannot provide execution guarantee for long-term tasks of legged robots. 1. A foot-type robot control method for long-time task,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the task instruction aiming at the long-time task of the foot-type robot;  analyzing the task instruction to generate a structured task request for the foot robot;  performing search enhancement based on the structured task request,  constructing a planning prompt containing physical prior and skill constraint corresponding to the long-time task;  according to the planning prompt,  generating a layered task graph of the long-time task,  and performing consistency check on the layered task graph to obtain an executable task graph;  compiling the executable task diagram to obtain the executable control logic of the foot robot;  performing parameter instantiation and safe projection to the executable control logic to generate joint level control instruction of foot robot;  Specifically,  the method includes :  obtaining the current environment state,  the self position and the load parameter of the foot-type robot;  according to the current environment state,  the self position and the load parameter,  assigning the executable control logic to obtain the instantiated control parameter;  performing safe projection on the instantiated control parameter according to the physical movement boundary,  the safe moment threshold and the environment obstacle-avoiding constraint of the foot robot to obtain the compliance parameter after the safe projection;  performing motion calculation according to the compliance parameter to generate a joint level control instruction of the foot robot;  and controlling the foot robot to execute the long-time task according to the joint level control instruction.

The invention discloses a high-precision position control method for a single-leg actuator of a heavy-load hydraulic multi-legged robot. The high-precision position control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the current position and the current speed of a hydraulic driving unit,  constructing a second-order nonlinear state space model,  and equivalently converting various disturbances into lumped disturbance items; actual measurement of electro-hydraulic proportional valve parameters and establishment of asymmetric dead zone inverse model; defining the current position error and designing a second-order sliding mode surface function containing the current position error and the current speed error; based on this function,  the second-order sliding mode control law is designed,  and the saturation function is used to weaken the chattering and calculate the expected effective control quantity,  which is input into the asymmetric dead zone inverse model for feedforward compensation,  and the final control quantity is generated to act on the electro-hydraulic proportional valve. The invention can eliminate reversing "flat top" lag,  improve dynamic response and trajectory smoothness,  maintain high tracking accuracy under heavy load and variable load conditions,  enhance system robustness,  suppress buffeting,  extend the service life of hydraulic components,  and meet the requirements of Engineering safety and reliable operation requirements 1. A high-precision position control method of heavy-load hydraulic multi-foot robot single-leg actuator,  wherein it is suitable for track tracking control of heavy-load hydraulic multi-foot robot single-leg actuator driven by electro-hydraulic proportional valve control cylinder or valve control motor,  comprising the following steps :  S1,  collecting the current position and the current speed of the hydraulic driving unit,  constructing a second-order non-linear state space model,  unifying the unmodelled pressure dynamic fluctuation,  the external load disturbance and the model uncertainty as lumped disturbance items;  S2,  actually measuring the control median value of the electro-hydraulic proportional valve,  the forward dead zone boundary and the reverse dead zone boundary,  establishing an asymmetric dead zone inverse model;  S3,  defining the current position error of the hydraulic driving unit,  designing a second-order sliding mode surface function including the current position error and the current speed error;  S4,  designing the second-order sliding mode control law based on the second-order sliding mode surface function,  calculating the expected effective control quantity;  wherein the boundary layer is established by using the saturation function to weaken the vibration of the control signal near the sliding mode surface;  inhibiting the lumped disturbance term through the robust compensation term;  S5,  inputting the expected effective control quantity into the asymmetric dead area inverse model to perform the asymmetric dead area feedforward compensation,  generating the final control quantity to act on the electro-hydraulic proportional valve,  realizing the high-precision position tracking of the hydraulic driving unit.

This application discloses a text and trajectory joint constraint humanoid robot motion control method,  which relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control. The method first obtains the text description and motion trajectory corresponding to the preset control action,  and combines the motion of the text and trajectory joint constraint.,  generate a SMPL digital human pose sequence that conforms to dual constraints; the optimization strategy combining stochastic gradient descent method and momentum method is used to complete motion redirection,  and the pose data of the humanoid robot adapted to the target is obtained; construct a teacher-student model based on the near-end strategy optimization algorithm,  use the redirected pose data as a priori guidance,  complete the strategy distillation through the data aggregation algorithm,  and train to obtain the motion control model; finally,  the model is deployed to the robot,  and the joint target angle output by the model is used as the driving signal to realize motion control. This application provides high-quality prior guidance through double constraints,  effectively improves the semantic consistency,  trajectory accuracy,  anthropomorphism degree and scene robustness of humanoid robot movements,  greatly reduces training costs,  and has excellent engineering implementation value. 1. A motion control method of human-shaped robot jointly restricted by text and track,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining text description and motion track corresponding to several preset control actions,  generating SMPL digital gesture sequence satisfying text description and motion track at the same time by motion synthesis method restricted by text and track;  using the optimization strategy combined with the random gradient descent method and the momentum method to perform the motion redirection processing on the SMPL digital human pose sequence to obtain the robot pose data corresponding to each preset control action;  constructing a teacher-student model based on the near-end strategy optimization algorithm,  distilling the motion skill of the teacher model to the student model by using the data set polymerization algorithm,  taking the robot pose data corresponding to each preset control action obtained after the motion redirection as a priori guide,  training to obtain the human-shaped robot motion control model;  obtaining the text description and the motion track corresponding to the current expected control action,  orderly processing by the motion synthesis method and the motion redirection method based on the joint constraint of the text and the track,  obtaining the robot position corresponding to the current expected control action;  inputting the robot pose corresponding to the current expected control action to the human-shaped robot movement control model,  taking the joint target angle position output by the human-shaped robot movement control model as the driving signal,  controlling the movement of the target human-shaped robot;  The humanoid robot motion control model is deployed to a target humanoid robot.

The invention discloses an AI humanoid robot motion control method and system based on digital twins Relates to the technical field of intelligent control and human-computer interaction of humanoid robots The method includes first building an emotional-ethical joint twin model that is synchronized with the physical humanoid robot in real time Collect multi-modal information and environmental information of interactive objects through the multi-modal sensing module deployed on the physical humanoid robot The emotional computing and mapping module generates the user's emotional state of the interactive object,  the ethical constraint formal expression module generates an ethical constraint parameter set,  and then generates the robot target emotional state and the whole body joint movement trajectory that meet the ethical constraints,  and finally the physical humanoid robot executes the corresponding trajectory. An AI humanoid robot motion control method based on digital twin,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step one,  constructing an emotion-ethics combined twin model synchronous with the physical humanoid robot in real time,  wherein the emotion-ethics combined twin model comprises an ethics constraint formalized expression module and an emotion calculation and mapping module;  step ,  collecting the multi-mode information and environment information of the interactive object by the multi-mode sensing module arranged on the physical humanoid robot;  step ,  the emotion calculating and mapping module generates the user emotion state of the interactive object according to the multimodal information and the environment information;  step four,  the ethical constraint form expression module according to the environment information and the preset cultural characteristic information generating ethical constraint parameter set,  the ethical constraint parameter set comprises space forbidden area parameter,  taboo action parameter and emotion intensity feasible domain parameter;  step five,  the emotion calculating and mapping module according to the user emotion state,  the environment information,  the cultural characteristic information and the ethics constraint parameter set,  generating the robot target emotion state in the emotion intensity feasible domain parameter range;  step six,  the emotion-ethics combined twin model according to the robot target emotion state and the ethics constraint parameter set,  generating at the same time satisfy kinematics constraint,  dynamics constraint,  the space forbidden area parameter and the taboo action parameter of the whole joint motion track;  step ,  the physical humanoid robot executes the motion track of the whole body joint.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot terrain self-adaptive control method based on local virtual plane estimation,  and belongs to the technical field of quadruped robot motion control The method obtains the body state,  gait phase and foot end contact information,  and constructs a support contact set; the local virtual plane is estimated by weighting the contacts according to the contact confidence,  normal contact force,  and contact timeliness; extract the slope angle,  height difference and height dispersion and construct the terrain geometry index; based on this,  the body center of mass height,  body posture and swing leg foothold reference are adaptively adjusted,  and the priority or weight of the whole body control task is dynamically updated to achieve stable motion control under complex terrain. The invention can improve the robustness of local terrain estimation and the terrain adaptability of the quadruped robot. 1. A four-foot robot terrain self-adaptive control method based on local virtual plane estimation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  according to the gait phase information and the foot end contact observation information in the current control period of the four-foot robot,  fusing and determining the contact confidence degree of each foot end;  constructing a contact set for terrain estimation according to the current support state;  when the effective supporting contact number is not less than three,  adopting the current supporting foot contact point to form the contact set;  when the number of the effective supporting contacts is less than three,  the nearest stable contact point recorded by the swinging leg at the swinging start time is introduced as the supplementary contact point;  according to the contact confidence,  normal contact force and contact timeliness corresponding to each contact,  performing weighted local virtual plane estimation on the contact set to obtain local virtual plane parameter;  extracting a local gradient angle,  a height difference and a height dispersion degree based on the local virtual plane,  and constructing a terrain geometric degree index;  according to the local virtual plane and the terrain geometric index,  self-adaptively adjusting the body mass centre height reference,  the body posture reference and the swinging leg foot point reference,  generating the whole body reference track;  according to the gait phase,  the contact confidence degree of each foot end and the terrain geometric index,  performing dynamic priority distribution or weight updating on a plurality of control tasks in the whole body control,  the control task at least comprises a support stable task,  an organism posture tracking task,  a centroid adjusting task,  the swinging leg track follows the task and solves the control quantity and outputs it to the executing mechanism.

The invention relates to the technical field of self-adaptive control of robots,  and provides a method for terrain processing and multi-terrain gait control of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  planning an inspection route,  and segmenting walking segments according to spatial positions and functional regions; the multi-source environment sensing unit is used to collect and obtain multi-source data,  fuse each walking segment,  and extract terrain features; according to the preset discrimination rules,  the terrain features of each walking segment are mapped into terrain labels with road surface type identifiers and safety risk levels,  and the safety risk levels are converted into gait levels; automatically selecting target gait mode according to gait level,  and sending gait control parameter matched with said gait mode to each joint controller; monitor plantar contact status and posture changes in real time,  compare them with the terrain labels and gait levels of the corresponding walking segments,  dynamically adjust the corresponding walking segments and their subsequent gait levels,  and update gait control parameters. 1. A humanoid robot terrain processing and multi-terrain gait control method,  wherein it comprises :  planning the inspection route according to the field station plan and the inspection task,  and discretely dividing the inspection route into multiple walking segments according to the space position and the function region;  when the humanoid robot moves along the inspection route,  the multi-source environment sensing unit is used for collecting and obtaining the multi-source data;  according to the preset judging rule,  mapping the terrain feature of each walking segment into terrain label with road surface type mark and safety risk level,  and converting the safety risk level into gait level,  forming the mapping relation among the walking segment,  the terrain label and the gait level;  automatically selecting the target gait mode from the gait mode library according to the gait level of the walking segment of the current position,  and sending the gait control parameters matched with the gait mode to each joint controller,  and adaptively switching the gait between different walking segments;  monitoring the sole contact state and posture change in real time,  comparing the monitoring result with the terrain label and gait level of the corresponding walking segment,  when the walking safety is detected to be abnormal,  dynamically adjusting the corresponding walking segment and the subsequent gait level and updating the gait control parameter.

The invention discloses a hierarchical reinforcement learning motion planning and control method for a legged robot oriented to sparse terrain Based on the multi-scale perceptual encoder,  the terrain features rich in semantic information in the elevation map are extracted. The terrain features,  the real-time status of the robot and the target instructions are used as the input of the conditional denoising network. The conditional denoising network models the foothold planning as a parallel and progressive denoising process to generate the foothold sequence of the robot In the process of the foothold sequence,  the kinematics accessibility of the candidate foothold is evaluated in real time through the inverse kinematics feasibility check layer,  so as to determine the planned foothold sequence; by planning the foothold sequence and the real-time status of the robot,  robust joint motion instructions are output based on reinforcement learning to control the movement of the legged robot. The invention effectively solves the problems of short-sighted planning,  low calculation efficiency and poor robustness in discontinuous and high-drop sparse terrain by traditional methods,  and realizes high dynamic and stable movement of the legged robot in complex environments. 1. A foot-type robot layered strengthening learning motion planning and control method for sparse terrain,  wherein The upper-layer drop point generation network :  based on the multi-scale sensing encoder,  extracting the terrain feature rich in semantic information in the high range graph,  the terrain feature and the robot real-time state and the target instruction are used as the input of the conditional de-noising network,  the conditional de-noising network plans and models the landing point as a parallel progressive de-noising process,  generating a robot landing point sequence;  in the process of the landing point sequence,  the kinematics reachability of the candidate landing point is evaluated in real time by the inverse kinematics feasibility check layer,  so as to determine the planning landing point sequence;  the lower layer motion control network receives the planning pin point sequence and the real-time state of the robot,  and outputs the robust joint motion instruction based on the strengthening learning to control the foot type robot to act.

The invention relates to the technical field of visual inspection,  and discloses a humanoid robot clothing fold detection and posture fine adjustment method and a humanoid robot clothing fold detection and posture fine adjustment system The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a multi-view display image of clothes worn by the humanoid robot and tension data of each body region; extract the visual fold features and tension distribution features of each body area,  and align and fuse the visual fold features and tension distribution features to obtain the fold state vector of each body area; classify each body area into normal draping folds,  slightly accumulated folds,  significantly pulled folds,  and severely skewed folds and identify areas to be adjusted; calculate the joint posture fine adjustment amount of the area to be adjusted and perform the adjustment until all body areas are normal draping folds or slightly accumulated folds,  and output the shooting ready signal. ABSTRACT The present invention discloses an Intelligent Human Emotion Recognition and Response Computing Platform designed to identify,  interpret,  predict,  and respond to human emotions through a multi-modal artificial intelligence framework. The proposed platform integrates facial expression analysis,  speech emotion recognition,  physiological signal monitoring,  behavioural pattern detection,  and contextual sentiment analytics to achieve highly accurate real-time emotional state assessment. The system gives advanced deep learning architectures,  adaptive neural networks,  and cognitive computing algorithms to process data collected from cameras,  microphones,  wearable sensors,  smart devices,  and digital communication interfaces. Unlike conventional emotion recognition systems,  the proposed invention introduces a dynamic emotional intelligence engine capable of continuously learning individual emotional behavior patterns and generating personalized adaptive responses. The platform further incorporates a hybrid affective computing module with predictive emotional modeling that anticipates stress,  anxiety,  aggression,  confusion,  fatigue,  and psychological discomfort before visible manifestation. An intelligent response generation subsystem automatically delivers customized voice responses,  environmental adjustments,  virtual assistant interactions,  mental wellness recommendations,  emergency alerts,  or automated machine actions based on the detected emotional state. Additionally,  the invention introduces a decentralized privacy-preserving emotional data processing mechanism using edge computing and encrypted emotional data storage to ensure secure and ethical handling of sensitive user information. The proposed platform can be deployed in healthcare monitoring systems,  smart classrooms,  autonomous vehicles,  human-robot interaction systems,  industrial safety monitoring,  customer experience platforms,  defense applications,  and next-generation smart environments. The novelty of this invention lies in its self-adaptive emotional learning capability,  predictive emotional response ,  multi-sensory fusion framework,  and privacy-aware intelligent computing architecture that collectively enable proactive and human-centric emotional interaction between humans and intelligent machines. nan

A mechanical arm operation diffusion strategy domain adapting method for specific intelligent operation and maintenance based on world model,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 :  in the controlled laboratory source domain environment,  collecting the expert demonstration data of the mechanical arm executing the high-end equipment operation and maintenance operation task,  constructing the source domain data set;  Step 5 :  Fine tuning world model by target domain applying incremental disturbance to the initial state of the target domain,  generating multiple pseudo tracks by forward unfolding of the world model,  and constructing a pseudo track data set; A real-time evaluation method for coordination of trunk and limb end of human-shaped robot,  wherein the method comprises :  collecting the lumbar vertebra proclination angle signal and the shoulder joint proclination angle signal,  obtaining the lumbar vertebra proclination angle starting time stamp,  the shoulder joint proclination angle starting time stamp,  the real time pressure ratio of the front sole and the back sole and the arm target extending distance set by the current movement task;  using Kalman filtering algorithm to process the lumbar vertebra proclination angle signal and the shoulder joint proclination angle signal,  and removing the noise to obtain the accurate lead value between the smooth lumbar vertebra proclination starting time and the shoulder joint proclination starting time;  according to the evaluation result of the anti-falling reflection trigger risk,  analyzing the pressure ratio when entering into the sharp rising interval and the arm target extending distance,  calculating the adjusted lead amount allowable upper limit; The present invention belongs to the field of robot motion control and intelligent learning technology A humanoid robot control method and system based on anchor representation and skill transition are provided. Through stability adjustment and sample amplification based on the projection distance between the center of mass and the center of pressure,  the coverage ability and robustness of skill learning for actions with different stability levels are improved. Through local coordinate representation with pelvis as anchor,  yaw decoupling and plane registration,  the strategy can still keep the relative action consistent in the presence of random disturbance and domain randomization,  and reduce the influence of global drift on tracking and switching; through the high-level skill transition strategy network,  the activation code or transition state motor angle sequence is output,  which avoids the discontinuity and mutation caused by hard switching,  and realizes the continuous,  smooth and stable transition of multiple skills. 1. A humanoid robot control method based on anchoring representation and skill transition,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining human reference motion sequence data;  determining the estimated centroid and the pressure centre in the reference motion sequence;  determining the stability index according to the distance between the estimated centroid and the projection of the pressure centre on the ground;  performing stability adjustment on the reference motion according to the stability index to generate an amplification sample;  according to the generated amplification sample,  taking the pelvis as anchor point to establish local coordinate expression,  and constructing plane registration transformation compensation translation and yaw difference,  realizing yaw decoupling and rotary amplification;  according to the sample after yaw decoupling and rotary amplification,  aiming at different motion skills,  adopting the optimization mode of combining strengthening learning and simulating learning,  obtaining the low-layer technical energy sub-strategy;  freezing the low-level sub-strategy parameter,  when the switching condition is satisfied and the difference between the source skill and the target skill meets the preset condition,  determining the activation code of the target skill through the preset high-level network to trigger the corresponding sub-strategy;  otherwise,  determining the target motor angle sequence as the transition state through the preset high layer network,  and adaptively determining the transition duration according to the difference between the source skill and the target skill.

A multi-posture tumble recovery method for biped robot,  wherein The enhanced learning is combined with the multi-expert hybrid MoE architecture,  the expert selection is guided by the height estimator,  and combined with the reward function,  curriculum program training and self-adaptive track tracking of the optimal design,  so as to realize stable and natural lifting action,  specifically comprising the following steps :  step 1,  strengthening learning training model modelling :  constructing a motion control training frame based on intensive learning,  modelling the tumble recovery task of the biped robot as a decision process;  Step 2,  the identity stage design and the multi-expert network design :  designing a multi-expert hybrid network architecture,  the multi-expert hybrid network architecture comprises a height estimator for estimating the height of the robot body and a gating network,  the gating network adaptively integrates the output of a plurality of expert networks according to the height estimation value output by the height estimator,  so as to generate the joint action of the robot;  said multiple expert networks are respectively trained to be motion control of different recovery stages of the robot;  Step 3 :  Simulation verification and real machine deployment :  the motion strategy obtained by training in the simulation environment is arranged on the entity biped robot after being verified in simulation.

Improve the functional stability and task smoothness of mobile-operated quadruped robots when performing tasks 1. A four-foot robot movement operation control system,  wherein it comprises :  a four-foot platform;  a mechanical arm mounted on the four-foot platform;  a first visual sensor installed on the four-foot platform and used for obtaining the first position information of the target;  a second visual sensor installed at the tail end of the mechanical arm and used for obtaining the second position information of the target;  a positioning navigation component for obtaining the pose information of the four-foot platform;  a mobile operation controller,  the mobile operation controller is respectively connected with the four-foot platform,  the mechanical arm,  the first visual sensor,  the second visual sensor and the positioning navigation assembly in communication;  The mobile operation controller is configured to perform hierarchical control,  the hierarchical control comprises :  a first layer control for controlling the four-foot platform to the task appointed space based on the task instruction and the pose information;  a second layer control,  based on the first position information,  controlling the four-foot platform to perform fine adjustment maneuver,  so as to make the four-foot platform reach the working space;  a third layer of control,  based on the second position information,  cooperatively controlling the mechanical arm to execute the operation to the target,  and controlling the four-foot platform to perform matching adjustment,  so as to assist the mechanical arm to finish the operation task;  wherein the mobile operation controller realizes the three-layer control by constructing and scheduling four closed-loop control loops,  the four closed-loop control loops comprise a four-foot platform mobile control loop,  a four-foot platform fine adjustment mobile control loop,  a mechanical arm operation control loop and a mechanical arm and a four-foot platform cooperative control loop.

The invention discloses an unstructured environment-oriented energy-saving planning and control collaborative optimization method and equipment for a quadruped robot and a robot thereof. The method comprises the following steps of :  establishing an instantaneous power model of the quadruped robot,  wherein the instantaneous power model comprises the mechanical power of a joint motor and the Joule heat loss; based on deep reinforcement learning,  the lower local motion controller is trained in the simulation environment,  and the power penalty term is introduced into the reward function,  so that the controller can learn an energy-saving gait suitable for complex terrain; import environmental elevation information,  combine it with the energy consumption characteristic calibration of the lower controller,  and generate a global energy cost map offline; during operation,  the improved A * algorithm is used for global path planning on the energy cost map,  and the energy optimal path and corresponding speed command sequence are generated to drive the robot movement. Through the energy consumption coupling of the planning layer and the control layer,  the present invention solves the problem of disconnection between traditional path planning and actual energy consumption,  reduces the transportation cost of the robot in unstructured terrain,  and improves the operation endurance of the robot. 1. An energy-saving planning and control cooperative optimization method of four-foot robot facing to unstructured environment,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 :  extracting the terrain characteristic parameter of the grid and combining the energy consumption weight coefficient pre-calibrated by the lower layer controller to construct a static global energy cost map;  Step 2 :  based on the global energy cost map,  defining an evaluation function comprising an accumulated energy consumption cost and a heuristic pre-estimated cost,  searching a global energy optimal path by an improved A* algorithm,  and generating a corresponding speed instruction sequence;  Step 3 :  constructing an instantaneous power model of the four-foot robot,  and introducing the instantaneous power model as a negative reward item into a deep strengthening learning frame,  training a lower layer local motion controller in a simulation environment,  so as to obtain a motion gait with optimal energy;  Step 4 :  based on the training finished lower layer local motion controller,  receiving the speed instruction sequence generated in the step 2,  driving the robot to move along the planned energy optimal path.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot formation obstacle avoidance path optimization method and a quadruped robot formation obstacle avoidance path optimization device,  which relate to the technical field of robots and achieve efficient collaborative formation and obstacle avoidance. The obstacle avoidance penalty term based on ROG _ MAP and ESDF can quickly respond to obstacle position changes. Combined with the reciprocal obstacle avoidance mechanism between robots,  the success rate of obstacle avoidance in dense obstacle scenes is high. At the same time,  it has trajectory executability and integrates the dynamic constraints of the quadruped robot. The generated trajectory is smooth and consistent with the movement ability,  avoiding execution failure. It also saves the energy of the quadruped robot and improves operating efficiency through a variety of constraint costs. In addition,  it adopts a distributed architecture without the need for central node coordination. Each robot independently solves the optimization problem and shares key information only through broadcast. It has strong scalability and supports large-scale quadruped robot formations. 1. A four-foot robot formation obstacle avoiding path optimization method,  wherein it comprises :  each four-foot robot obtains local environment information through an airborne sensor,  and constructs a local Euclidean symbol distance field based on the information;  each four-foot robot broadcasts the real-time state information of itself through the distributed communication network,  and receives the state information of the adjacent robot,  so as to update the formation global state cognition;  based on the formation global state cognition,  constructing a formation undirected graph model,  calculating a symmetrical normalization Laplace matrix of the formation,  and defining a microformation similarity measurement index;  the MINCO polynomial track representing method is used for performing multi-section five-degree polynomial modelling to the track of each four-foot robot,  and applying the speed,  acceleration and impact force restriction based on the kinematics characteristic of the four-foot robot;  constructing a multi-target distributed optimization function,  wherein the target distributed optimization function comprises a control quantity cost item,  a total time cost item,  a barrier obstacle avoiding penalty item,  a formation similarity error item,  a robot mutual benefit obstacle avoiding penalty item,  a dynamic feasibility constraint cost item and a constraint point uniform distribution cost item;  each four-foot robot independently solves the multi-target optimization function based on LBFGS optimization algorithm to generate a local feasible track;  converting the local feasible track into a joint space control instruction,  and sending the joint space control instruction to a four-foot robot bottom layer controller for execution;  periodically triggering the track updating,  and re-executing the track optimizing and generating steps according to the latest environment and the formation state.

The invention discloses a machine learning automatic design method for a fractal buffer structure of a foot robot,  and belongs to the technical field of design of core components of the foot robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  determining the geometric form of an isolation unit,  defining key geometric characteristics as independent variables,  and writing a parameterization script to construct a design sample library; screen key design-driven parameters through univariate sensitivity analysis,  conduct multivariate analysis combined with Latin hypercube experimental design and collect parameter-performance data sets; the random forest regression model was used to fit the nonlinear mapping relationship between buffering performance and key parameters; taking minimizing the isolation ratio as the core goal,  the optimal parameter combination is found on the high-dimensional response surface through grid search. This method constructs a data-driven intelligent design closed loop It achieves the optimal balance of lightweight,  high strength and high buffering efficiency,  greatly improves the design efficiency,  reliability and performance upper limit of the buffering structure,  provides core tools and methodological support for the design of the next generation of legged robot buffering structures,  and is suitable for Automated design of fractal buffer structures for various types of legged robots. 1. A machine learning automatic design method of foot robot fractal buffer structure,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  determining the geometric form of the partition unit of the foot-type robot fractal buffer structure,  the large aperture size,  the small aperture size,  the hole centre distance,  the thickness is used as the key geometrical characteristic and defined as the variable capable of being independently controlled,  the parameterized script is compiled to generate the configuration variant controlled by multiple groups of parameters,  and the design sample base of the fractal buffer structure is constructed;  S2,  developing the single variable sensitivity analysis to the design sample base,  fixing all the parameters except the single target variable,  through simplifying the independent influence trend of the simulation evaluation target variable to the shock ratio buffer performance index,  screening the key design driving parameter with obvious influence to the shock ratio;  S3,  based on the key design driving parameter obtained by screening,  performing multi-variable analysis,  adopting Latin hypercube experiment design method to arrange parameter combination simulation,  collecting the parameter-performance data set covering the design space and having representative;  S4,  using the random forest regression model to train the parameter-performance data set,  fitting the complex nonlinear function relation between the buffer performance index and the key design driving parameter;  S5,  taking the minimum shock ratio as the core optimizing target,  traversing the discretized parameter space on the high-dimensional response surface constructed by the random forest regression model by using the grid searching method,  finding the parameter combination of the global minimum value of the shock ratio,  determining the optimal fractal configuration parameter of the fractal buffer structure.

 the mobile patrol system patrol the area to be cruise according to the preset route,  during the patrol process,  the video image,  infrared image and position information of the scene are collected and transmitted to the central control system,  and according to the instruction of the central control system close to the target and obtain the target video image; The invention provides a semantic annotation method,  a model training method,  a model training device,  an electronic device and a storage medium,  and relates to the technical field of automatic annotation The method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  acquiring images and point cloud data synchronously acquired by an image acquisition unit and a laser radar carried by a rail train,  and acquiring a train pose obtained by synchronous calculation; generating at least one track mask and at least one humanoid mask based on the image; then based on the train pose and each track mask map,  determine the current track area and each adjacent track area in the image; and determining each pedestrian area in the image based on the point cloud data and each humanoid mask map; finally,  based on the current track area,  each adjacent track area and each pedestrian area,  the image and point cloud data are semantically annotated respectively. The present invention relates to a mechanical-pneumatic hybrid robot drive module,  fail-safe valve,  and AI tension control device for wire-driven humanoid joints. The drive motor is placed on the body and the wire is placed along the inner joint guide pulley to reduce terminal mass and inertia,  and to prevent external protrusion and interference. By parallel combining a pneumatic tube composed of an inner joint chamber,  an outer second chamber,  and a non-inflatable mesh structure,  it compensates for the low rigidity issues of tendon drives and provides strong variable rigidity with 110%~130% constraint. Additionally,  depending on the standing/swing mode,  the base pressure is adjusted through a variable initial booster pump and a backflow prevention valve to enhance self-support stability,  and a fail-safe latch valve circulates fluid within 500ms during power off,  preventing joint stiffness. Furthermore,  an AI deep learning physics engine capable of temperature sensors (PV=nRT compensation) and fatigue learning directly controls the motor driver's PWM and command values to hardware self-correct physical errors in wires and tubes,  modularizing mechanical and fluid elements into replaceable 'joint cartridges' separated from sensor/control units,  maximizing innovation in humanoid mass production costs and maintainability. nan

The invention discloses an indoor positioning method under a shielding condition. The indoor positioning method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  obtaining circumscribed rectangular coordinates of a human body by passing an image acquired by a high-definition monitoring camera through a humanoid detection model,  and deducting a human body image from the camera image according to the circumscribed rectangular coordinates of the human body to obtain a humanoid image frame; the detection model of humanoid detection model is YOLO detection model; it is common for pedestrians' feet and legs to be blocked in actual camera scenes The present invention effectively solves the problem that existing visual methods using top-sole point pairs cannot be positioned correctly when the sole points are blocked Compared with the visual method of fixed approximation of height (such as 165cm),  when a person is in non-upright postures such as bending,  sitting,  kneeling,  etc.,  the error of the fixed approximate height method will be larger. However,  the present invention effectively estimates the humanoid frame. The actual height of the lower edge can maintain the accuracy of humanoid positioning in the above-mentioned diverse postures. 1. An indoor positioning method under shielding condition,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  step one :  obtaining the external rectangular coordinate of the human body by the image collected by the high definition monitoring camera through the human shape detection model,  buckling the human body image in the camera image according to the external rectangular coordinate of the human body to obtain the human shape image frame;  step two :  sending the human-shaped image frame into the human body skeleton point model to obtain the coordinates of the human-shaped head,  shoulder,  hip,  knee and foot;  step three :  the human-shaped image frame is sent into the human-shaped lower edge part estimation model,  the model is based on the image content of the human-shaped image frame,  the human-shaped lower edge part is estimated,  that is,  the human-shaped lower edge is shoulder,  hip,  knee,  the probability of the foot is estimated to output two human body parts P1 and P2 at the lower edge of the human-shaped frame with the highest possibility;  step four :  taking the longitudinal coordinate value of the bone point estimation coordinate corresponding to the P1 part as Y1,  the longitudinal coordinate value of the bone point estimation coordinate corresponding to the P2 part as Y2,  when the difference value of Y1 and Y2 is less than 15 pixels,  taking the part close to the lower part in P1 and P2 as the lower edge part of the human-shaped frame,  otherwise,  the part with the highest output possibility of the human-shaped lower edge part estimation model is the lower edge part of the human-shaped frame,  recorded as Pmin;  step five :  according to different parts of Pmin,  giving different height values to the lower edge of the human-shaped frame,  specifically,  when Pmin = foot,  the height value of the lower edge of the human-shaped frame is 10 cm,  when Pmin = knee,  the height value of the lower edge of the human-shaped frame is 50 cm,  when Pmin = hip,  the height of the lower edge of the human-shaped frame is equal to 90 cm,  when Pmin is equal to shoulder,  the height of the lower edge of the human-shaped frame is equal to 140 cm;  step six :  according to the height of the lower edge of the human-shaped image frame,  calculating the distance between the corresponding pedestrian and the camera,  firstly according to the known camera internal parameter and external parameter,  namely the height is 0,  can calculate the intersection point K between the light passing through the middle point E of the lower edge of the human-shaped image frame and the camera optical centre C and the ground,  Because the camera mounting height AC is known,  the height BE of the lower edge of the human-shaped image frame has been obtained in step five,  then there is AK/AC=BK/BE,  it can be known that BK = AK* BE/AC,  then the distance AB=AK-BK between the human-shaped image frame and the camera,  so as to finish the location of the human-shaped frame with shielding in the space.

The trajectory adjustment strategy based on the capture point can dynamically adjust the position of the foothold and center of mass of the bipedal robot during walking. By mapping the position of the foothold and the center of mass into virtual constraints,  the stable walking of the bipedal robot under disturbance can be achieved by accurately tracking the trajectory of the adjusted center of mass and foothold. The invention can adapt to different external disturbances,  so it has strong robustness. 1.  Because the biped robot is an under-actuated system,  in order to realize the track tracking of the biped robot,  the concept of virtual constraint is introduced to establish an output function of the biped robot,  and the steps are as follows :  S4.1 Analysis of the Active DOF of the Biped Robot and passive degree of freedom determining the virtual constraint number of the biped robot ,  is the number of active degrees of freedom of the biped robot :  Wherein,  it is the control parameter to be tracked of the biped robot;
