 S4.2 in order to ensure that the biped robot can recover the stability walk through the adjustment of the centroid and the landing point under the external disturbance,  the landing point position and the centroid position are used as the control parameters to be accurately tracked to participate in the design of virtual constraint,  and the control parameters of the biped robot are designed as follows :  Wherein,  is the position of the mass center,  is the position of the foot point;  representing the front a-2 active degree of freedom of the biped robot,  designed as the joint angle according to the requirement;  S4.3 Ideal evolution track of control parameter The design is in the form of Bessel polynomial :  Wherein,  is the virtual constraint coefficient to be optimized;  is a normalized independent variable;  and respectively an initial value and an end value;  N is the item number of the Bessel curve;  S5,  using the mixed zero dynamic theory,  based on the virtual constraint coefficient to be optimized,  designing the feedback controller through the linear feedback control method,  converting the control problem into the non-linear planning problem,  solving to obtain the virtual constraint coefficient;  S6,  according to the virtual constraint coefficient obtained in S5,  substituting into the complete dynamic model of the biped robot containing the action effect of the external disturbance,  realizing the stable walking of the biped robot under the external disturbance through the inverse dynamic method.

The invention belongs to the field of robot navigation,  and discloses a quadruped robot trajectory planning method for unknown rugged terrain. The method comprises the following steps of :  obtaining a two-dimensional plane pose through multi-orientation discrete sampling,  solving a three-dimensional space pose through elliptical ring analysis iteration,  and extracting characteristics such as curvature,  gradient and the like to construct a global trafficability map Generate exploration paths and retain nodes that meet spatial distribution constraints,  construct and dynamically maintain a global footprint graph based on node risk levels,  and achieve structured reuse of historical path information; according to the spatial relationship between the target point and the footprint map,  the exploration planning strategy is switched,  and the light projection mechanism is introduced to detect the accessibility of the line of sight to dynamically update the sub-target and solve the problem of local occlusion and stagnation; construct a nonlinear trajectory optimization model including motion anisotropy and terrain risk constraints to generate a feasible smooth trajectory. It accurately assesses three-dimensional terrain risks,  improves re-planning efficiency and the smoothness and safety of motion in complex terrain. 1. A four-foot robot track planning method for unknown rugged terrain,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a global accessible map :  obtaining the state information and environment point cloud of the robot in real time,  performing multi-directional discrete sampling with the robot as the centre,  performing elliptical ring terrain analysis on the sampled two-dimensional plane pose,  calculating to obtain the accessible evaluation value,  and fusing and updating the accessible evaluation value,  outputting a global accessible map;  S2,  maintaining global footprint :  running the fast expansion random tree algorithm based on elliptical ring terrain analysis to generate path nodes,  inquiring the global accessible map output by S1 to obtain the accessible evaluation value corresponding to the path nodes,  selecting the node satisfying the spatial distribution constraint as the vertex to construct a weighted undirected graph,  outputting a global footprint;  S3,  generating a front end path :  receiving the navigation target point,  calculating the current position of the robot,  the spatial distance relation between the navigation target point and the global footprint image output by S2,  dynamically selecting the planning strategy according to the spatial distance relation,  generating the front end path from the current position of the robot to the navigation target point;  S4,  track optimization :  taking the front end path output by S3 as the initial value,  and combining the terrain information in the global communication map output by S1 and the motion anisotropy constraint of the four-foot robot,  constructing the nonlinear optimization problem and solving,  and outputting the executable control track.

An arm structure of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises a first structure piece,  the first structure piece is provided with four first arm units,  each side of the first structure piece is symmetrically provided with two first arm units,  each of the first arm units comprises a plurality of structural members connected in turn,  and motors are respectively arranged between the first arm unit and the first structural member and between the plurality of structural members in the first arm unit.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot-based household cleaning and article homing method and storage medium,  and belongs to the field of robots The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  constructing a family space three-dimensional model based on family space point cloud data; s2. Distinguish fixed furniture from movable items according to form factor and bounding box volume; s3. A method for household cleaning and article homing based on humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  the robot collects the family space point cloud data,  constructing a family space three-dimensional model based on the family space point cloud data;  S2,  calculating the shape factor and the surrounding box volume of the object based on the family space point cloud data,  and distinguishing the fixed furniture and the movable object according to the shape factor and the surrounding box volume;  S3,  performing cluster analysis on the point cloud of the fixed furniture,  obtaining functional area division;  S4,  based on the preset article standard storage position database,  identifying the scattered article in the movable article;  S5,  collecting the image of the functional area,  calculating the grey value deviation,  the local height difference and the edge gradient based on the image of the functional area,  and identifying the pollution type based on the grey value deviation,  the local height difference and the edge gradient;  S6,  according to the pollution type matching cleaning mode and cleaning parameter,  starting the cleaning flow,  at the same time,  identifying the article type of the scattered article,  and calling the preset homing database and the preset homing rule,  starting the homing flow.

The invention provides a robot control model training method,  a motion control method,  a motion control device and equipment,  and relates to the technical field of robot control The method includes :  using a simulation robot deployed with a teacher model to move in a preset simulation environment,  and obtaining first brightness change event data,  first proprioceptive information,  and prediction results output by the teacher model. The prediction results include :  a first predicted joint action and a first predicted yaw angle command; using the student model to be trained to output the second predicted joint action and the second predicted yaw angle command according to the first brightness change event data and the first proprioceptive information; calculating a first loss value based on the first predicted joint motion,  the second predicted joint motion,  the first predicted yaw angle command,  and the second predicted yaw angle command; the student model is trained according to the first loss value to obtain the robot control model. This application can reduce the energy consumption of the robot while improving environmental adaptability and action agility. 1. A robot control model training method based on event camera,  wherein the method comprises :  using the simulation robot deployed with pre-trained teacher model to move in the pre-set simulation environment,  obtaining the first brightness change event data of the pre-set simulation environment collected by the event camera simulation model,  the first main body feeling information of the simulation robot,  and a prediction result output by the teacher model,  wherein the prediction result is output by the teacher model according to the terrain scanning point information,  the first ontology experience information and the target yaw angle,  the prediction result comprises :  a first predicted joint action and a first predicted yaw angle instruction;  using the student model to be trained to output a second predicted joint action and a second predicted yaw angle instruction according to the first brightness change event data and the first main body feeling information;  according to the first predicted joint action and the second predicted joint action,  the first predicted yaw angle instruction and the second predicted yaw angle instruction,  calculating a first loss value;  training the student model according to the first loss value to obtain a robot control model.

The invention discloses a robot self-adaptive control method integrating a multi-modal driving model and physical parameters,  and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control The method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  acquiring existing control model parameters,  operating arm physical parameters and task description data,  and constructing a standardized data set; then through the meta-learning framework training to obtain a generalized meta-model that can quickly adjust parameters; extract the characteristics of the physical parameters of the target robot's operating arm and the task description of the target robot and input them into the meta-model to obtain the initial control strategy; construct a physical security constraint model based on the control obstacle function to obtain a control strategy model adapted to the new scenario. Finally,  verify the performance of the model and return the adapted data with up to standard performance to the data set. The invention solves the problems of high binding and poor mobility between the traditional control model and specific equipment and tasks,  improves the generalization ability of the model and the utilization rate of historical parameters,  and realizes the continuous learning and evolution of the control system. 1. A robot self-adaptive control method for multi-mode driving model and physical parameter fusion,  wherein the steps are as follows :  step S1,  obtaining the parameter data of the existing robot control model,  the physical parameter data corresponding to the operating arm,  the task description data,  and respectively performing the feature extraction and standardization processing on the three types of data,  constructing a standardized data set;  step S2,  based on the meta-learning frame,  constructing the meta-training task based on the standardized data set as the training base,  training to obtain the generalization meta-model capable of fast adjusting the parameter according to the operation arm main body characteristic and the task characteristic;  step S3,  extracting the characteristic of the physical parameter of the target robot operating arm and the task description of the target robot,  inputting the extracted characteristic into the meta-model to obtain the initial skill characteristic and instantiation as the initial control strategy;  step S4,  using the physical parameter of the operation arm of the target robot to construct the physical safety constraint model based on the control obstacle function,  finely adjusting and refining the interactive data of the target robot,  obtaining the control strategy model of the adaptive new scene;  step S5,  verifying the performance of the control strategy model in the simulation or real environment,  refluxing the adaptive data with standard performance to the data set in the step S1,  finishing the updating of the data set.

The invention provides a legged robot control method,  device,  electronic equipment and storage medium The invention relates to the technical field of robot control. The control method of the foot type robot comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a state vector,  a morphological parameter code and a control condition of the foot type robot,  inputting the state vector,  the morphological parameter code and the control condition into a trained generative motion prior model,  and generating a plurality of candidate action sequences; then substitute the candidate action sequence into the pre-constructed dynamic model to obtain the corresponding predicted state; then combining the candidate action sequence and the predicted state to carry out risk assessment to obtain the assessment value of each sequence,  and selecting the one with the smallest assessment value as the optimal action sequence; then output the action residual correction amount through the trained residual reinforcement learning model,  and correct the optimal action sequence to obtain the corrected action sequence; finally,  through the projection processing of the preset projection constraint module,  the executable action sequence of the robot is obtained. The invention can effectively improve the control efficiency of the foot robot 1. A foot-type robot control method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the state vector,  form parameter code and control condition of the foot robot;  inputting the state vector,  the form parameter code and the control condition to the trained generated motion prior model to obtain multiple candidate action sequences;  inputting the candidate action sequence into a pre-constructed dynamics model to obtain a prediction state corresponding to the candidate action sequence;  according to the candidate action sequence and the corresponding prediction state,  obtaining the evaluation value corresponding to the candidate action sequence through risk evaluation;  determining the candidate action sequence corresponding to the minimum evaluation value as the optimal action sequence;  according to the optimal action sequence,  obtaining the corresponding action residual error correction amount through the trained residual error strengthening learning model;  correcting the optimal motion sequence according to the motion residual error correction amount to obtain a correction motion sequence;  according to the correction action sequence through the preset projection constraint module to project to obtain the executable action sequence of the foot-type robot.

The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control method and system based on stability constraints,  and relates to the field of robot motion control. The humanoid robot motion control method and system based on stability constraints includes :  obtaining proprioceptive observation data of the humanoid robot and constructing an augmented confidence state; input the augmented confidence state into the strategy network to generate joint control instructions,  and at the same time input the neural Lyapunov evaluation network to calculate the Lyapunov energy value of the current state-action pair; calculate the difference between the expected energy and the current energy at the next moment based on the exponential stability condition,  and anchor the current energy as a constant through a gradient separation strategy to construct a constraint violation that is not disturbed by parameter updates; generating a stability penalty term according to the constraint violation amount to construct a stability constraint,  jointly constructing a total optimization target to update strategy network parameters,  and generating an optimal joint control instruction; the invention integrates the neural Lyapunov stability control theory and representation learning to realize the stable motion control of the humanoid robot. 1. A humanoid robot motion control method based on stability constraint,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the main body feeling observation data of the humanoid robot,  and extracting the explicit speed estimation and implicit environment characterization through the mixed internal model,  constructing an augmented confidence state;  generating a joint control instruction by the augmented confidence state input strategy network,  at the same time,  inputting the neural lyapunov evaluation network to calculate the lyapunov energy value of the current state-action pair;  based on the exponential stability condition,  calculating the difference between the expected energy and the current energy at the next moment,  and anchoring the current energy to a constant through a gradient separation strategy,  so as to construct a constraint violation amount not interfered by parameter update;  generating a stability penalty item according to the constraint violation amount,  so as to construct the stability constraint,  combining the PPO cutting target and the lyapunov fitting error,  jointly constructing a total optimization target,  so as to update the policy network parameter,  generating the optimal joint control instruction.

The invention relates to the technical field of electronic and mechanical control,  and discloses a time-division control humanoid robot joint system with separated driving and braking,  which includes :  a low reduction ratio mechanical drive module,  used to provide the driving force of the humanoid robot joint movement,  and is connected to the joint output shaft through a direct drive mode or a low reduction ratio transmission mechanism; high reduction ratio mechanical braking module,  used to maintain the joint posture of the humanoid robot during the non-driving period; high-capacity electrolytic capacitor energy storage module,  connected in parallel with the battery of the low reduction ratio mechanical drive module,  for instantaneous discharge during the drive cycle to provide peak drive current; the time-division hybrid control module is used to adopt the time-division control strategy to realize the decoupling control of the driving function and the braking function in the time domain. By dynamically adjusting the drive output and braking force,  the present invention maximizes the instantaneous explosive force and response time of the joint while ensuring the smoothness of movement. 1. A time-division control humanoid robot joint system for driving brake separation,  wherein it comprises :  a low reduction ratio mechanical driving module for providing the driving force of the human-shaped robot joint movement,  comprising a driving motor and a battery,  the low reduction ratio mechanical driving module is connected to the joint output shaft through a direct driving mode or a low reduction ratio transmission mechanism;  a high reduction ratio mechanical brake module,  for maintaining the joint posture of the human-shaped robot in the non-driving period,  comprising a brake motor,  a high reduction ratio transmission mechanism and a disc brake assembly,  the high reduction ratio transmission mechanism is a screw thread reduction mechanism,  the disc brake assembly comprises a friction plate fixed on the trunk of the human-shaped robot and a friction plate moving along with the screw thread moving seat;  a large capacity electrolytic capacitor energy storage module,  which is connected with the battery of the low reduction ratio mechanical driving module in parallel,  and is used for instantaneously discharging in the driving period to provide the peak value driving current;  a time division mixing control module,  comprising a main control microprocessor,  for using the time division control strategy,  dividing the joint working period into a driving period,  a capacitor charging period and a braking period,  and according to the received angular speed and acceleration instruction,  dynamically adjusting the time length of each working period,  the PWM duty ratio of the driving motor and the braking force of the braking motor;  the brake period is arranged in the capacitor charging period for realizing the decoupling control of the drive function and the brake function in the time domain.

The invention provides a honeycomb lightweight industrial humanoid robot arm structure,  which belongs to the field of robot technology; the honeycomb lightweight industrial humanoid robot arm rod structure comprises an arm rod body,  wherein a hollow groove is formed in the arm rod body; and the hollow groove is of a structure with a wide upper part and a narrow lower part In the above scheme,  the upper honeycomb net column is used as the upper high stress area It adopts small grid and thick side wall design Strengthen the ability to resist torsion and bending Can stably bear the large load transmitted by the joint The middle honeycomb network column serves as a lightweight core area It adopts large grid and thin side wall design Without affecting the overall stiffness,  the ultimate weight reduction is achieved,  and the movement inertia of the arm and the energy consumption of the equipment are reduced. A honeycomb light industrial humanoid robot arm rod structure,  comprising an arm rod main body (1),  wherein the inner part of the arm rod main body (1) is provided with a hollow groove (2),  the hollow groove (2) is a structure with wide upper part and narrow lower part. the inner part of the hollow groove (2) is fixedly connected with a honeycomb net column main body (3),  the honeycomb net column main body (3) is composed of an upper honeycomb net column (301),  a middle honeycomb net column (302),  a lower honeycomb net column (303),  the honeycomb net column main body (3) is internally provided with a butting mechanism (4),  one side of the honeycomb net column main body (3) far away from the butting mechanism (4) is provided with a cable guide mechanism (5),  two sides of the honeycomb net column main body (3) are provided with a blocking mechanism (7),  one side of the sealing mechanism (7) is fixedly connected with a transmission joint (6);  the two sides of the upper honeycomb net column (301) are fixedly connected with a first connecting ring (3011),  the two sides of the middle honeycomb net column (302) are fixedly connected with a second connecting ring (3021),  the two sides of the lower honeycomb net column (303) are fixedly connected with a third connecting ring (3031),  the first connecting ring (3011),  the second connecting ring (3021),  the third connecting ring (3031) are fixedly connected through the butting mechanism (4),  the butting mechanism (4) comprises a splicing groove (401),  the inserting groove (401) is respectively opened on the two sides of the end part of the second connecting ring (3021) and the two sides of the end part of the third connecting ring (3031),  the two sides of the end part of one of the first connecting ring (3011) and the two sides of the end part of the other one of the second connecting ring (3021) are fixedly connected with inserting blocks (404),  the inserting block (404) is inserted with the inserting groove (401).

The invention relates to the field of robot control,  and provides a humanoid robot double-driving-wheel movement control method,  a humanoid robot double-driving-wheel movement control system and a humanoid robot,  which solve the problems of sensitive response at a low speed and instability at a high speed due to the fact that a single adjustment strategy is mostly adopted in the prior art The method is applied to a humanoid robot chassis including two driving wheels,  auxiliary wheels and a suspension structure. The rotation speed information of the two driving wheels and the attitude information output by the attitude sensor are obtained According to the relation between the rotation speed of two driving wheels and preset speed threshold value,  the correspondent driving command regulation strategy is selected; according to the adjusted driving instruction and combined with the attitude information,  the attitude correction is performed on the driving instruction to realize the movement control of the humanoid robot. This application adjusts the driving command according to the rotation speed of the driving wheel,  realizes fast response at low speed,  and maintains stable operation at high speed,  thereby improving the posture stability of the robot's movement. 1. A double-driving wheel movement control method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method is applied to a humanoid robot chassis comprising two driving wheels,  an auxiliary wheel and a suspension structure,  the method comprises :  obtaining the rotating speed information of the two driving wheels and the attitude information output by the attitude sensor;  according to the relationship between the rotating speed of the two driving wheels and the preset speed threshold value,  selecting the corresponding driving instruction adjusting strategy,  the preset speed threshold value comprises a first preset speed threshold value and a second preset speed threshold value,  the second preset speed threshold value is greater than or equal to the first preset speed threshold value;  when the rotating speed of the two driving wheels is less than the first preset speed threshold value,  dynamically adjusting the driving instruction according to the rotating speed difference of the two driving wheels;  when the rotating speed of the two driving wheels is greater than or equal to the second preset speed threshold value,  smoothly adjusting the driving instruction according to the average rotating speed of the two driving wheels;  according to the dynamically adjusted or smoothly adjusted driving instruction,  and combining the posture information,  performing posture correction on the driving instruction,  so as to realize the movement control of the humanoid robot.

A super-flexible stretchable conductive material,  wherein the super-flexible stretchable conductive material is prepared by the following raw materials according to parts by weight :  100 parts of poly (4-vinyl pyridine) - b-dimethyl silicone polymer,  1-ethyl-3-methyl imidazole bis (trifluoromethanesulfonyl) imine salt 10-20 parts,  good solvent 50-80 parts,  crosslinking agent 1-3 parts,  nanometre filler 0.5-2 parts,  photoinitiator 1-2 parts and silane coupling agent 1-2 parts.

This application relates to a control method and system for heat treatment forming of humanoid robot parts,  and relates to the technical field of part heat treatment. It includes collecting heat treatment parameters,  part size parameters and part thermal characteristic parameters of humanoid robot parts; calculate the heat treatment parameters,  part size parameters and part thermal characteristic parameters based on the preset single-part heat treatment model to generate the heat treatment affected part gap; calculate part size parameters and part thermal characteristic parameters based on the preset part occlusion model to generate occlusion-affected part gaps; comparing the heat treatment affected part clearance with the occlusion affected part clearance to determine the optimal heat treatment part clearance; place the humanoid robot parts on the preset heating tooling according to the optimal heat treatment part gap,  and transport the heating tooling to the preset vacuum furnace for heat treatment. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of heat treatment forming of humanoid robot parts 1. A control method for heat treatment and moulding of human-shaped robot parts,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the heat treatment parameter,  the part size parameter and the part thermal characteristic parameter of the human-shaped robot part;  calculating the heat treatment parameter,  the part size parameter and the part heat characteristic parameter based on the pre-set single part heat treatment model so as to generate the heat treatment influencing the part gap;  calculating the part size parameter and the part thermal characteristic parameter based on the preset part shielding model to generate the shielding effect part gap;  comparing the gap of the heat treatment affected part with the gap of the shielding affected part so as to determine the best gap of the heat treatment affected part;  according to the best heat treatment part gap,  placing the humanoid robot part on the pre-set heating tool,  and conveying the heating tool to the pre-set vacuum furnace for heat treatment.

The invention relates to the technical field of force sensors,  in particular to a non-linear elastic beam structure and a six-dimensional force sensor adopting the same It mainly aims at the existing force sensor to sensitively measure force through bending deformation A sheet-type flexible hinge is provided at the root to reduce the tension and compression stiffness However,  the overload capacity of the sensor is greatly reduced It is difficult to apply to impact load scenarios such as humanoid robots The invention provides the following technical scheme :  a first cross beam and a connecting beam are arranged in an L shape,  both the first cross beam and the connecting beam are of a constant-section structure and are integrally formed,  one ends of the first cross beam and the connecting beam which are far away from each other are respectively a stress end and a connecting end,  and a fixed included angle is formed between the first cross beam and the connecting beam The invention ensures the bending force measurement sensitivity of the force sensor while improving its overload capacity,  so that it can adapt to impact load scenes such as humanoid robots,  expand the scope of application and enhance practicality. 1. A non-linear type elastic beam structure,  wherein the elastic beam structure is non-linear type,  the elastic beam structure is provided with at least two strain detection areas arranged at intervals;  when the elastic beam structure bears the external force,  at least part of the axial force or the transverse force exerted on the elastic beam structure is converted into the bending moment acting on the strain detection area;  The strain detection area is used for detecting the strain generated by the bending moment and/or directly acted tension and compression load.

The invention provides a robot squat jump load performance testing equipment and method,  which includes :  an assembly mechanism,  which includes a load bracket and a lifting bracket; the loading mechanism comprises an adjusting module,  a movable carrier plate and a plurality of loading sheets The lifting mechanism includes a moving assembly and a transmission connecting column. A robot deep squatting jump load performance testing device,  wherein Including :  an assembling mechanism,  the assembling mechanism comprises a load bracket and a lifting bracket;  a loading mechanism,  the loading mechanism comprises an adjusting module,  a movable carrier plate and a plurality of load sheets,  the adjusting module can be connected to the load bracket around the first rotating central line,  the movable carrier plate is slidingly connected to the adjusting module,  a plurality of the load sheets are detachably connected to the movable carrier plate;  a lifting mechanism,  the lifting mechanism comprises a moving component and a transmission connecting column,  the moving component comprises a guide column,  a sliding frame and a robot connecting piece,  the guide column is set on the load bracket,  and extends along the vertical direction,  the sliding frame is slidingly connected to the guide column,  the robot connecting piece is set on the sliding frame,  and is detachably connected to the robot to be tested,  one end of the transmission connecting column is connected to the sliding frame,  and the other end can be connected to the end part of the adjusting module around the second rotating central line.

The invention discloses a space thermal gradient searching method for a quadruped robot under complex terrain,  and belongs to the technical field of automatic control. The space thermal gradient searching method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-source sensing data and calculating target field data,  environment geometric field data and body dynamic field data; generating a body motion trajectory through a first planner according to the environment geometric field data and the body dynamic field data; generating a desired pointing trajectory of the sensor by a second planner based on the target field data and the body dynamic field data; based on the confidence evaluation value in the target field data,  the synthetic weight of the body motion trajectory and the sensor's expected pointing trajectory is adjusted to generate a behavioral intention trajectory; decompose the behavioral intent trajectory into multiple control subtasks with priorities and execute. By dynamically synthesizing the body motion and sensor pointing trajectory according to the confidence of the target field,  and then executing it through hierarchical whole-body collaborative control,  the movement and detection tasks can be intelligently balanced,  and efficient search of space heat sources can be achieved. 1. A space thermal gradient searching method under complex terrain of four-legged robot,  wherein it comprises :  synchronously obtaining the multi-source sensing data of the environment where the four-foot robot is located,  wherein the multi-source sensing data comprises temperature distribution data,  three-dimensional geometric point cloud data and main body state data;  based on the multi-source sensing data,  calculating in parallel to generate target field data,  environmental geometric field data and main body power field data,  wherein the target field data comprises a dynamic thermal attraction vector derived from the temperature distribution data and an associated confidence evaluation value;  according to the environmental geometric field data and the main body power field data,  generating a body motion track through a preset first planner;  according to the target field data and the main body power field data,  generating a desired pointing track of the sensor through a preset second planner;  based on the confidence evaluation value in the target field data,  dynamically adjusting the synthetic weight of the body motion track and the expected pointing track of the sensor,  generating a behavioural intention track;  decomposing the action intention track into multiple control sub-tasks with priority,  and executing the control sub-task through the coordinated movement of the whole body joint of the four-foot robot.

The invention relates to an adaptive anti-roll method and system for a wheel-legged robot based on visual inertia fusion,  and belongs to the technical field of robot motion control The method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  fusing visual pavement semantics,  IMU acceleration and angular velocity information,  estimating a ground adhesion coefficient on line in real time,  and dynamically calibrating a theoretical roll angle calculated by visual path curvature according to the ground adhesion coefficient Secondly,  the system dynamically adjusts the weight ratio of visual feedforward control and IMU feedback control according to the confidence of visual path recognition,  so as to realize the adaptive fusion of radical prediction and robust anti-disturbance. Finally,  the final roll command after fusion is accurately mapped to the angle control command for driving the joint servo through the inverse kinematics analytical solution of the five-link mechanism based on spatial geometry and cosine theorem,  realizing error-free conversion from macro attitude to bottom execution. An autonomous obstacle avoidance control method for a foot robot under safety constraints,  which belongs to the technical field of motion control of foot robots. The invention solves the problem of poor stability and safety of the legged robot based on the traditional RL method decision-making in complex environments By introducing the constraint optimization technology of IPO and adding clear motion constraints on the basis of RL,  the present invention ensures that the robot can not only learn efficient control strategies,  but also meet physical constraints during the optimization process. This is different from the soft constraints implemented by traditional RL through reward functions. In the present invention,  through hard constraint optimization,  the robot must abide by physical restrictions during the optimization process,  thereby ensuring a stronger constraint effect. This approach significantly improves the interpretability and reliability of the strategy,  enabling the robot to perform tasks stably and safely in complex environments,  while avoiding the risk of violating physical laws due to the pursuit of high rewards. The invention can be applied to autonomous obstacle avoidance control of legged robots 1. A foot-type robot autonomous obstacle-avoiding control method under safety constraint,  wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps :  step one,  using the camera carried on the foot-type robot to collect the surrounding environment image in real time,  then taking the collected image as the input of the obstacle sensing model,  outputting the distance between the foot-type robot and the obstacle through the obstacle sensing model;  step ,  taking the distance between the foot robot and the barrier as the input of the strategy switching model,  outputting the speed safety evaluation value through the strategy switching model,  judging whether the current speed is safe according to the speed safety evaluation value;  if the current speed is safe,  executing the step three,  if the current speed is not safe,  executing the step four;  step three,  taking the observation quantity as the input of the basic gait control model,  outputting the action executed by the next step of the foot-type robot through the basic gait control model,  converting the action into the expected joint moment,  controlling the foot-type robot according to the expected joint moment and returning to execute the step one;  step four,  constructing the input vector of the obstacle-avoiding model according to the desired speed,  taking the constructed input vector as the input of the obstacle-avoiding model,  outputting the action executed by the foot-type robot in the next step through the obstacle-avoiding model,  converting the action into the desired joint torque,  controlling the foot-type robot according to the expected joint moment,  and then returning to execute the step one.

Inference optimization and physical post-processing. A stable-driven double-person cooperative object operation motion generation method,  wherein it specifically comprises the following steps :  S1,  preparing human body motion capture data and object motion and geometric data :  respectively collecting the motion capturing data interacted by single person and double person and object;  S2,  operation strategy generation of maneuverability guidance :  aiming at the given object,  training a diffusion model,  under the condition of the object operability probability and the base point set characteristic,  generating the contact strategy from the noise;  the contact strategy comprises a contact anchor point position,  a normal line,  a local offset and a validity mark;  the strategy generation process is limited by the anchor point position loss,  the normal line alignment loss and the operability guide loss;  S3,  constructing an adversarial prior model and a flow matching model :  the adversarial priori model is used for improving the nature of the movement,  respectively constructing a single adversarial priori model and a double adversarial priori model;  S4,  joint optimization countermeasure priori model and flow matching model :  according to the action generated by the flow matching model and the action extracted from the reference data,  optimizing two antagonistic prior models to ensure the accuracy of the model; The system realizes the autonomous perception,  intelligent planning and cooperative control of multi-module resources of robot in dynamic environment. 1. This application provides a dual-scene adaptive humanoid robot collaborative control method and related equipment,  belonging to the technical field of humanoid robot motion collaborative control. The method comprises the following steps of :  judging a target scene according to environment sensing data and a user instruction,  and acquiring action requirements and joint load characteristics of the robot in the target scene; allocate dynamic computing power to each edge joint control unit according to the action complexity of the action requirements,  the scene weight of the target scene and the joint load characteristics; based on dynamic computing power,  according to semantic alignment and physical constraints of the world model,  joint collaborative control instructions adapted to the target scene are generated; based on joint collaborative control instructions,  control the corresponding joints to perform action tasks to obtain joint motion data and multi-modal sensing data; the joint motion data and multi-modal perception data are fused to complete the closed-loop optimization of control instructions. This application can improve the cross-scene versatility,  high degree of freedom collaboration and data utilization efficiency of humanoid robots. 1. A double-scene self-adaptive humanoid robot cooperative control method,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  according to the environment sensing data and the user instruction,  judging the target scene,  and obtaining the action requirement and joint load characteristic of the robot under the target scene;  according to the action complexity of the action requirement,  the scene weight of the target scene and the joint load characteristic,  distributing dynamic calculation force to each edge end joint control unit;  based on the dynamic calculation force,  according to the semantic alignment and the world model physical constraint,  generating a joint cooperative control instruction adapted to the target scene;  based on the joint cooperative control instruction,  controlling the corresponding joint to execute the action task,  obtaining the joint motion data and multi-mode sensing data;  and fusing the joint motion data and the multi-mode sensing data to finish the closed loop optimization of the control instruction.

This application belongs to the field of robot control technology and discloses a hierarchical control method and system for humanoid robots based on reinforcement learning. By obtaining characteristic information of different ground areas and matching corresponding control strategy parameters accordingly,  the robot's motion state can be refined. adjust; at the junction of ground areas,  by determining transition state parameters and calculating fusion weights,  the control strategy parameters of different areas are weighted and fused to generate transition control instructions,  thereby ensuring the stability of the robot's movement when crossing different ground areas; in addition,  combined with the reinforcement learning algorithm,  the behavioral strategy library and fusion weight calculation logic are iteratively updated according to the actual performance parameters of the robot,  thereby continuously optimizing the robot's motion stability and energy consumption,  and significantly improving its adaptability and robustness in complex environments. 1. A hierarchical control method of humanoid robot based on intensive learning,  for controlling the humanoid robot to move between different ground areas,  wherein the method comprises :  A1. obtaining the first ground feature information of the area where the humanoid robot is currently located and the second ground feature information of the area to be entered;  A2,  matching the corresponding first control strategy parameter from the preset action strategy base according to the first ground characteristic information,  and matching the corresponding second control strategy parameter from the action strategy base according to the second ground characteristic information;  A3,  determining the transition state parameter of the human-shaped robot relative to the boundary of the first ground area and the second ground area;  A4,  calculating fusion weight based on the transition state parameter,  and performing weighting calculation to the first control strategy parameter and the second control strategy parameter by the fusion weight to generate a transition control instruction;  A5,  sending the transition control instruction to the executing mechanism of the humanoid robot so as to adjust the movement state of the humanoid robot in the crossing process;  A6,  based on the actual expression parameter of the humanoid robot in the crossing process,  using the reinforced learning algorithm to optimize the motion stability and energy consumption as the target,  iteratively updating the strategy parameter in the behaviour strategy base and the calculation logic of the fusion weight.

Communication,  in which the real person output is used as the perception spectrum and the robot output is used as the deduction spectrum. Both the perception spectrum and the deduction spectrum are based on the emotional beat mode of the emotional multimodal VEM ‑ Token Segmentation synthesis and alignment,  the lexical logical perception is calculated by LLM ‑ Token decomposition of large language models,  and the emotional perceived micro-expressions of multi-modal emotional components are calculated by VEM ‑ Token decomposition. The right brain model supports the emotional micro-expression communication between the robot and the real person,  just like the Turing test,  which is expected to distinguish whether the emotional tester is a robot or a real person. 1. A method for constructing VEM-robot emotional right brain model,  wherein The robot for simulating the emulator performs emotional communication with more than one communication person comprising a real person or a robot,  the emotional characteristics of the emulator and the communication person are recorded and distinguished by an emotional characteristic library,  the robot comprises an emotional right brain,  wherein :  the emotion right brain model divides the perception spectrum sent by the communication person and sensed by the robot into emotion perception and logic perception,  including logic expression;  the emotion right brain model according to emotion perception,  an emotion characteristic library,  using emotion operation to generate emotion expression,  aligning with the logic expression through rhythm synthesis,  generating an evolutionary spectrum,  the evolutionary spectrum is output to the cranial surface of the robot to form emotion communication of facial expression and voice expression,  and/or the score is output to the limbs of the robot to form the emotion communication of the action.

The invention discloses a real-time speed estimation method and system for a humanoid robot based on time sequence feature fusion,  which relates to the field of robot technology and includes :  collecting the ontological sensory data of the robot's random walk; construct LSTM + MLP tandem hybrid neural network architecture,  and obtain the hybrid neural network model after training and optimization; collect the original data stream of ontology sensory through sensors to obtain standardized characteristic data; deploy the hybrid neural network model to the embedded main control platform for reasoning operation and output the three-dimensional linear velocity prediction value; the three-dimensional linear velocity prediction value is processed by trapezoidal numerical integration,  and the displacement odometer information is generated and distributed to the robot system bus The present invention is equipped with an LSTM + MLP tandem hybrid neural network architecture,  which enables rapid capture of motion physical characteristics. Experimental data shows that the model can achieve rapid reduction of mean square error and achieve stable convergence in a short training period,  reducing The migration cost and data dependence of the algorithm between different robot platforms. 1. A real-time speed estimation method of humanoid robot based on time sequence characteristic fusion,  wherein it specifically comprises the following steps :  step S1,  constructing a human-shaped robot digital twinning model in the physical simulation environment,  collecting the main body sensory data in the random walking movement process of the robot,  and extracting the world system linear speed true value,  generating a movement data set;  step S2,  constructing LSTM + MLP serial mixed neural network framework,  taking the filtered 49-dimensional main body sensory data as input,  the world system linear speed true value as label,  training and optimizing the LSTM + MLP serial mixed neural network framework,  obtaining the mixed neural network model;  step S3,  in the human-shaped robot real machine operation stage,  through human-shaped robot inside several sensors real-time collecting main body sensory original data stream,  and according to 49 dimensional main body sensory data of the characteristic format of the main body sensory original data stream proceed synchronous arrangement and time sequence alignment,  to obtain standardized characteristic data;  step S4,  deploying the optimized mixed neural network model to the embedded main control platform,  inputting the standard characteristic data to the pre-training model for reasoning operation,  outputting the three-dimensional linear speed predicted value of the humanoid robot under the world coordinate system;  step S5,  performing trapezoidal numerical integral processing on the output three-dimensional linear speed predicted value,  generating continuous robot displacement odometer information and distributing to the human-shaped robot system bus.

The invention discloses a flexible three-dimensional force capacitance sensor for a humanoid robot force feedback scene,  mainly relates to a tactile sensing technology,  and aims to solve the problems of low sensitivity,  non-linear output and the like of a tactile sensor The sensor includes an elastomeric bump contact on the top layer,  an air cavity layer and an elastomeric layer on the middle layer,  a printed circuit board on the bottom layer,  and a cell capacitor Through the electrode layout and multi-layer elastomer design,  the detection and decoupling of normal force and shear force are realized. The sensor fabrication adopts 3D printing manufacturing technology and rapid prototyping technology,  which has high sensitivity,  low hysteresis and good repeatability,  and can be applied to the force feedback scenario of robots. 1. A flexible three-dimensional force capacitance sensor for human-shaped robot manpower feedback scene,  wherein it comprises a top layer structure,  a middle layer structure and a bottom layer structure which are orderly arranged from top to bottom;  the top layer structure comprises an elastic body bump contact;  the middle layer structure comprises an air chamber layer and an elastic body layer;  the elastic body layer is located above the air chamber layer;  the bottom structure comprises a printed circuit board,  the printed circuit board is provided with multiple unit capacitors;  wherein,  the air cavity layer and the elastic body layer are used as the dielectric medium of a plurality of unit capacitors together,  when under the action of an external force,  the thickness change of the air cavity layer causes the dielectric constant to change,  so as to make the capacitance of the unit capacitor to change,  the normal force is realized by detecting the capacitance change,  The shearing force is measured and decoupled.

Accurate judgment and high-precision positioning 1. A sound sensing and locating method of humanoid robot,  wherein the sound sensing and locating method of humanoid robot comprises the following steps :  S1,  scientific layout of microphone array and sound basic collection design;  S2,  pre-processing the humanoid acoustic signal based on A weighted sound level;  S3,  calculating the sound source three-dimensional position of the point sound source radiation sound field algorithm;  S4,  multi-dimensional sound source positioning precision optimization strategy.

This application discloses a motion control method,  device,  equipment and storage medium for a quadruped and legged wheeled robot,  which relates to the technical field of robot motion control and includes :  obtaining navigation instructions,  environmental image information and camera internal parameter information; constructing a corresponding local depth map based on the environment image information and the camera internal parameter information; analyze the corresponding obstacle position and landing position based on the local depth map to determine the obstacle position analysis result and the landing position analysis result; updating the navigation instruction based on the obstacle position analysis result and the landing position analysis result to generate a robot movement instruction; control the robot's travel,  obstacle avoidance or gait adjustment based on the robot motion instructions. This application constructs a local depth map to synchronously analyze obstacles and landing areas,  thereby generating motion instructions with both obstacle avoidance and gait adjustment,  so that the robot can independently select efficient and stable movement strategies in various terrains. 1. A motion control method of four-foot and leg wheel type robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining navigation instruction,  environment image information and camera internal reference information;  constructing a corresponding local depth map based on the environment image information and the camera internal reference information;  based on the local depth map,  analyzing the corresponding obstacle position and foot position,  determining the obstacle position analysis result and foot position analysis result;  updating the navigation instruction based on the obstacle position analysis result and the foot position analysis result,  generating a robot motion instruction;  controlling the robot to travel,  avoid obstacle or adjust gait based on the robot movement instruction.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot reinforcement learning control method for migration from simulation to reality,  and belongs to the technical field of intelligent control The invention constructs the time series observation of the historical sliding window,  and only adopts the non-privileged state information of the robot body sensor as the strategy network input; dynamically adjust the complexity of the simulated terrain based on the evaluation results of the robot's horizontal traveling ability,  and inject seven types of multi-source uncertainties into the parallel simulation environment; calculate discount cumulative returns and advantage estimates using state transition data from parallel environments,  and iteratively update strategies and value network parameters through deep reinforcement learning; during the deployment phase,  the convergence network is loaded to generate control instructions,  and the operating data is recorded for subsequent optimization. The invention integrates non-privileged observation modeling,  course learning and multi-source disturbance injection,  significantly improves the stability,  robustness and simulation-to-reality migration performance of the quadruped robot in non-ideal environments,  reduces deployment costs,  and enhances long-term operation feasibility. 1. A four-foot robot reinforcement learning control method for simulating to real migration,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the non-privileged observation information output by the four-foot robot main body sensor,  the non-privileged observation information comprises a machine body linear speed,  a machine body angular speed,  each joint position,  caching and splicing the non-privileged observation quantity of each joint speed and the joint control instruction of the last control period according to the preset history sliding window to form the time sequence state input;  S2,  in the simulation environment,  based on the displacement of the four-foot robot body on the horizontal plane in the preset evaluation time window,  calculating the horizontal travelling ability evaluation result,  and adjusting the terrain complexity level of the simulation environment according to this,  generating course terrain parameter;  S3,  in the simulation environment,  synchronously injecting the multi-source disturbance according to the preset random rule,  so as to construct the multi-source uncertainty model covering the control link,  the dynamic parameter and the external interference;  S4,  constructing a plurality of parallel simulation environments,  using the time sequence state input in each parallel simulation environment,  the course terrain parameter and the multi-source disturbance are interactively sampled,  the state and control related data are collected,  and based on the data,  the strategy network is iterated and updated by the depth strengthening learning algorithm,  so as to obtain the strategy network for four-foot robot control;  S5,  in the actual operation stage of the four-foot robot,  loading the strategy network of training convergence,  using the non-privileged time sequence state input consistent with the training stage as the network input to generate the joint control instruction,  at the same time,  recording the non-privileged observation information,  the control instruction and the key feedback data in the operation process.

The invention provides a posture self-adaptive method and a posture self-adaptive device for a humanoid robot in a loading state. The posture self-adaptive method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring actual landing center point coordinates of a left foot and a right foot,  a hip joint side swing angle and a load eccentric distance as input data,  filtering the input data,  and determining a geometric boundary of a supporting polygon; combining the obtained current angle of each joint and the load eccentric distance after filtering to calculate the comprehensive center of gravity coordinate of the robot; comparing the current boundary margin with a preset safety threshold to evaluate the risk level of roll instability and determine the corresponding adjustment amount of the lateral distance between the feet; calculate the hip joint side swing angle change according to the adjustment amount of the lateral distance between the two feet,  and drive the leg movements to adjust the lateral distance between the two feet based on the hip joint side swing angle change; obtain the width of the support polygon based on the adjusted lateral distance between the feet,  accommodate the coordinates of the center of gravity projection point through the width of the support polygon,  and output the robot posture adaptive balance result. 1. A posture self-adaptive method under loading state of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the actual landing centre point coordinate of the left and right feet,  the hip joint side swinging angle and the load eccentric distance as the input data,  filtering the input data,  determining the geometric boundary of the supporting polygon;  combining the obtained current angle of each joint and the filtered load eccentric distance,  calculating the comprehensive gravity centre coordinate of the robot;  projecting the comprehensive gravity centre coordinate to the ground support surface along the gravity direction to obtain the gravity centre projection point coordinate,  and calculating the distance from the gravity centre projection point coordinate to the geometric boundary of the support polygon,  determining the current boundary margin;  according to the current boundary margin and the preset safety threshold value,  evaluating the risk level of side-tipping instability,  determining the corresponding double-foot transverse distance adjusting amount;  calculating the lateral swinging angle variation of the hip joint according to the lateral distance adjusting amount of the two feet,  driving the leg part to act to adjust the lateral distance of the two feet based on the lateral swinging angle variation of the hip joint;  obtaining the width of the supporting polygon based on the adjusted transverse distance of the two feet,  and outputting the self-adaptive balance result of the robot posture by containing the gravity centre projection point coordinate through the width of the supporting polygon.

A robotic vehicle-treatment system includes a robotic platform configured to autonomously position within a constrained vehicle service environment. A sensing system having at least one camera and depth sensor generates a three-dimensional digital model of a vehicle region and surrounding operational space. An artificial-intelligence control system processes the digital model to determine adaptive control commands for robotic motion and tool interaction. A controller coupled to one or more robotic actuators executes the adaptive control commands to manipulate at least one vehicle component associated with a vehicle lighting system. The adaptive control commands dynamically adjust robotic posture,  motion path,  and operational parameters in response to sensed environmental conditions. The system enables autonomous removal,  installation,  alignment,  restoration,  or inspection of vehicle lighting components within interior or exterior vehicle regions under varying environmental conditions.

The invention provides a legged robot task planning control method and system,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method includes :  obtaining the robot's task instructions and multi-source sensing data; extract task instructions to obtain semantic features,  and construct a structured environment representation based on multi-source sensing data; based on semantic features,  search from the preset historical task library to obtain historical task experience fragments corresponding to task instructions; through the language model,  according to the historical task experience fragment,  combined with the structured environment representation,  the hierarchical task plan of the robot is generated,  and the feasibility and safety verification is carried out to obtain the target skill sequence of the robot,  and the skill arrangement is carried out to generate a skill execution scheduling strategy,  and drive the robot to execute skills; at the same time,  when the robot executes skills,  real-time closed-loop correction of the skill execution scheduling strategy is performed based on the robot's real-time sensing data. The invention improves the execution effect of the legged robot in complex long-term tasks. 1. A foot-type robot task planning control method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the task instruction and multi-source sensing data of the foot-type robot;  extracting the task instruction to obtain the semantic feature of the task instruction,  and identifying the environment object according to the multi-source sensing data,  the terrain can pass through the analysis and dynamic obstacle tracking,  constructing the structured environment representation of the foot robot;  wherein the step of extracting the task instruction to obtain the semantic feature of the task instruction comprises :  pre-processing the text of the task instruction to obtain the pre-processed text of the task instruction;  through semantic feature extraction model,  performing feature analysis on the pre-processed text,  determining task target,  operation object,  action requirement and constraint information in the task instruction;  performing vectorization coding on the task target,  the operation object,  the action requirement and the constraint information to generate a semantic feature vector;  obtaining the semantic feature of the task instruction according to the semantic feature vector;  the step of performing environment object identification according to the multi-source sensing data,  terrain can pass through sexual analysis and dynamic obstacle tracking,  constructing the structured environment representation of the foot-type robot,  comprising :  performing time synchronization and external parameter calibration processing on the multi-source sensing data to obtain standard sensing data with consistent time and space;  performing environment object identification based on the standardized sensing data,  generating an object attribute set of the foot-type robot,  wherein the object attribute set comprises a type,  a position and a grabbing parameter of the operation object;  determining the terrain gradient,  step height,  ground friction coefficient and sliding risk parameter in the preset area range between the foot robot and the operation object according to the standardized sensing data and combined with the operation object for terrain passing analysis;  generating a semantic map of the preset area range based on the terrain gradient,  the step height,  the ground friction coefficient and the sliding risk parameter;  detecting and tracking the dynamic obstacle according to the time sequence of the standardized sensing data to generate a dynamic obstacle state sequence;  fusing the object attribute set,  the semantic map and the dynamic obstacle state sequence to obtain the structured environment representation in the preset area range of the foot robot;  based on the semantic feature,  searching from the preset history task library,  obtaining the history task experience segment corresponding to the task instruction;  generating a hierarchical task plan of the foot-type robot according to the historical task experience segment by a language model in combination with the structured environment representation;  performing feasibility and safety verification on the hierarchical task plan to obtain a target skill sequence of the foot-type robot;  performing skill arrangement according to the target skill sequence,  generating the skill execution scheduling strategy of the foot robot;  driving the foot robot to execute the skill according to the skill execution scheduling strategy;  at the same time,  when the foot-type robot executes the skill,  according to the real-time sensing data of the foot-type robot,  performing real-time closed loop correction on the skill execution scheduling strategy.

This application relates to the technical field of robot equipment,  and specifically discloses a high load-bearing humanoid robot leg exoskeleton structure and its processing method. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  preparing and optimizing in the early stage :  adopting a titanium alloy ingot as a raw material,  carrying out topology optimization and lightweight design on the leg outer framework structure on the basis of CAE finite element analysis,  and generating an optimized processing model; forging or rolling the titanium alloy ingot to obtain titanium alloy blank; s2. Precision machining :  The titanium alloy blank is clamped,  and based on the optimized processing model,  rough machining,  semi-finishing and finishing are performed in sequence to obtain the workpiece; s3. Heat treatment and stress control; s4. Post-processing and detection. The humanoid robot leg exoskeleton structure of the present application can be used in highly dynamic and high-load humanoid robots,  and has the advantages of light structural weight,  high load-bearing efficiency,  fast dynamic response,  and long fatigue life. 1. A processing method of high bearing humanoid robot leg outer frame structure,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  preliminary preparation and optimization :  using titanium alloy cast ingot as raw material,  based on CAE finite element analysis,  performing topology optimization and light weight design to the leg outer skeleton structure,  generating an optimized processing model;  then forging or rolling the titanium alloy ingot to obtain the titanium alloy blank;  S2,  precise mechanical processing :  clamping the titanium alloy blank,  and based on the optimized processing model,  orderly performing rough processing,  semi-fine processing and fine processing to obtain the processed piece;  S3,  heat treatment and stress control :  performing stress-removing annealing and solution aging treatment to the workpiece to obtain the stress-removing piece;  S4,  post-processing and detection :  performing deburring and surface treatment on the stress removing piece,  then performing precise detection to obtain the high-bearing humanoid robot leg outer skeleton structure.
