A motor drive control system,  wherein it comprises :  a first control module,  the first control module comprises a first control unit (20),  a signal gating control unit (30) and a motor unit (40),  the first control unit (20) is configured to generate a first control signal through a vector control algorithm according to the operation feedback signal of the motor unit (40);  a second control unit (10),  the second control unit (10) is electrically connected with the signal gating control unit (30),  the second control unit (10) is configured to operate in parallel with the first control unit (20),  and according to the operation feedback signal of the motor unit (40) through strengthening learning algorithm to generate the second control signal;  wherein the signal gating control unit (30) is configured to select the first control signal or the second control signal as the target control signal according to the operation feedback signal of the motor unit (40) and the second control signal,  and controlling operation of the motor unit (40) based on the target control signal.

This application provides a limb coordination planning method and device when a humanoid robot crosses obstacles,  including :  obtaining the torso roll angle,  load distribution and holding height of the humanoid robot as input parameters; calculate the lateral offset distance of the load center of mass according to the load distribution amount and the torso roll angle,  and determine the center of mass height linkage amount based on the holding height and the lateral offset distance of the load center of mass; judging the load state according to the centroid height linkage amount,  and calculating the dynamic torque magnification under the high-position holding condition; adjust the allowable range of roll angle according to the dynamic torque magnification,  and fuse the load distribution to determine the roll amplitude boundary; constructing constraint conditions according to the roll amplitude boundaries,  and using inverse kinematics to solve to generate limb joint trajectories that satisfy the constraints; the coordination is evaluated through dynamic simulation of the limb joint trajectory,  and a limb coordination planning plan of the humanoid robot is generated based on the evaluation results. 1. A limb coordination planning method when human-shaped robot strides over obstacles,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the inclination angle of the trunk of the human-shaped robot,  the load distribution quantity and the holding height as the input parameter;  according to the load distribution amount and the torso side inclination angle,  calculating the load mass centre transverse offset distance,  and combining the holding height with the load mass centre transverse offset distance to determine the mass centre height linkage amount;  judging the load state according to the mass centre height linkage amount,  and calculating the dynamic moment amplifying multiplying power when holding at the high position;  according to the dynamic moment amplification multiplying power,  adjusting the allowed range of the roll angle,  fusing the load distribution quantity to determine the roll amplitude boundary;  constructing a constraint condition according to the heeling amplitude boundary,  using inverse kinematics to solve to generate a limb joint track satisfying the constraint;  according to the dynamic simulation evaluation coordination of the limb joint track,  generating the limb coordination planning solution of the human-shaped robot according to the evaluation result.

The invention belongs to the relevant technical field of robots,  and discloses a control method for anthropomorphic walking and running of a humanoid robot The method comprises the following steps :  Preprocess the preset expected walking speed of the robot The preprocessed data is input into the strategy network of Actor-critic network as observation data,  and the joint action that controls the movement of the robot is output. The controller is used to convert the joint action into the joint driving torque that controls the robot,  and the joint driving torque is used to control the robot. Carry out simulation control; calculate the total loss function and adjust the policy network to minimize the total loss function to achieve training of the Actor ‑ critical network. The invention solves the problem that the anthropomorphism of the motion form,  the rationality of the whole body dynamics and the continuous evolution characteristics of the gait in different speed intervals are difficult to simultaneously take into account in the existing control method 1. A training method of an Actor-critic network for anthropomorphic robot anthropomorphic walking learning control,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  pre-processing the preset robot running expected speed,  the pre-processed data is input into the strategy network of the Actor-critic network as the observation data,  outputting the joint action for controlling the movement of the robot,  using the controller to convert the joint action into the joint driving moment for controlling the robot,  using the joint driving moment to perform simulation control to the robot;  obtaining the real-time movement state,  joint position and speed in the robot simulation control process and calculating the total reward function of the Actor-critic network;  obtaining the linear velocity of the robot body and the force of the foot end in the robot simulation control process,  inputting the linear velocity and the force of the foot end and the observation data into the value network of the Actor-critic network,  obtaining the state value of the current state of the robot;  the arbiter judges whether the joint position and speed obtained in the robot simulation control process are from the motion data set of the pre-constructed robot model,  and calculates the arbiter loss function according to the motion data set;  calculating the total loss function of the Actor-critic network by the total reward function,  the state value and the discriminator loss function,  adjusting the strategy network to minimize the total loss function so as to train the Actor-critic network.

This application relates to a low-latency force-controlled action control method and related devices for a humanoid robot used in construction. The method includes :  collecting multi-modal sensor data of the humanoid robot's whole body; input the multi-modal sensor data into the high-frequency torque inner loop and the low-frequency planning outer loop respectively; solve the whole body dynamics model according to the multi-modal sensor data in the low-frequency planning outer ring to obtain the reference torque value of each joint; in the high-frequency torque inner loop,  the reference torque value is used as the feedforward amount,  and the torque compensation amount calculated based on the multi-modal sensor data is superimposed to generate the target torque command of each joint; output the target torque command to each joint actuator This application separates the control loop into a high-frequency torque inner loop and a low-frequency planning outer loop with different control cycles,  so that the update frequency of torque compensation is separated from the time-consuming solution of whole-body dynamics,  and the correction torque is continuously output at high frequency under load mutation and external force impact conditions,  reducing the risk of instability caused by the delay of torque response. 1. A low-delay force control action control method of humanoid robot for construction,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  collecting the multi-mode sensor data of the whole body of the human-shaped robot,  wherein the multi-mode sensor data comprises joint moment data,  joint angular velocity data,  inertia measuring data,  foot pressure distribution data and end load data;  S2,  respectively inputting the multi-mode sensor data into a high-frequency moment inner ring and a low-frequency planning outer ring,  wherein the control period of the high-frequency moment inner ring is less than that of the low-frequency planning outer ring;  S3,  in the low-frequency planning outer ring,  solving the systemic dynamic model according to the multimodal sensor data to obtain the reference moment value of each joint of the humanoid robot;  S4,  in the high-frequency moment inner ring,  taking the reference moment value as the feed-forward amount,  superposing the moment compensation amount calculated according to the multi-mode sensor data,  generating the target moment instruction of each joint of the humanoid robot;  S5,  outputting the target moment instruction to each joint executor of the humanoid robot.

The invention relates to the technical field of machine control,  and provides a humanoid robot impedance adjusting method and a humanoid robot impedance adjusting system. The humanoid robot impedance adjusting method comprises the following steps of :  extracting a joint angle sequence and a joint angular velocity sequence of a contact force change curve,  performing extreme point detection on the contact force change curve,  and acquiring contact transient characteristic parameters Based on the joint angle sequence,  forward kinematics analysis is carried out to obtain the displacement change,  the real-time contact stiffness value is determined by combining the displacement change and the contact force change curve,  and the real-time contact stiffness value and the contact transient characteristic parameters are superimposed to obtain the stiffness adjustment amount; acquires the position deviation and speed deviation of the current control period in real time,  linearly maps the position deviation and the stiffness adjustment amount to obtain the stiffness compensation torque,  gains the speed deviation and the contact transient characteristic parameters to obtain the damping compensation torque,  and finally updates the original compensation torque according to the two compensation torques. Torque command to generate optimized torque command; the present invention can raise the impedance regulating efficiency of humanoid robot 1. A humanoid robot impedance adjusting method,  wherein the method comprises :  A,  recording the contact force change curve generated when the terminal actuator of the human-shaped robot contacts the external environment in real time,  and extracting the joint angle sequence and the joint angle speed sequence of the contact force change curve;  B,  detecting the extreme point of the contact force change curve,  extracting the force change rate and the contact force change duration of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the contact transient characteristic parameter of the humanoid robot;  C,  according to the joint angle sequence,  performing forward kinematics analysis to the humanoid robot,  obtaining the displacement variation of the humanoid robot,  and according to the displacement variation and the contact force variation curve,  determining the real-time contact rigidity value of the humanoid robot;  D,  superposing the real-time contact rigidity value and the contact transient state characteristic parameter to obtain the rigidity adjusting quantity of the humanoid robot;  E,  collecting the position deviation between the actual position and the expected position of the humanoid robot in the current control period and the speed deviation between the actual speed and the expected speed in real time;  F,  linearly mapping the position deviation and the rigidity adjusting quantity to obtain the rigidity compensation moment of the humanoid robot,  and performing gain modulation to the speed deviation and the contact transient state characteristic parameter to obtain the damping compensation moment of the humanoid robot;  G,  updating the original moment instruction of the humanoid robot according to the rigidity compensation moment and the damping compensation moment to obtain the optimized moment instruction of the humanoid robot.

Suitable for humanoid robots,  prosthetics and precision automation equipment. 1. A manipulator,  comprising a palm base (1) and at least one finger (2),  wherein the finger (2) comprises multiple telescopic power devices (3);  the telescopic power devices (3) are orderly arranged end to end in series,  and each telescopic power device (3) is simultaneously used as the main body component or the main body component of the corresponding knuckle,  which not only is used for outputting telescopic driving force,  but also is used for bearing external load,  at the same time,  one side of the telescopic power device (3) is provided with a measuring device,  or integrated with the measuring device to form a measuring telescopic power device;  the measuring end of the front-stage telescopic power device (3) is connected with the moving end of the back-stage telescopic power device (3),  the joint movement close to the front side is driven by the telescopic power device (3) close to the back side,  the multi-stage telescopic power device (3) is orderly telescopic,  finishing the bending and extending action of the finger (2).

This application discloses a steering control method,  device,  equipment and storage medium for a wheel-legged robot,  which relates to the field of robot control technology. It discloses a steering control method for a wheel-legged robot,  which includes :  obtaining environmental perception information and the current status of the wheel-legged robot. information; determining a terrain complexity index based on the environment sensing information; input the terrain complexity index and the current state information into the target reinforcement learning network to obtain pattern interpolation control variables and steering control information; determining a target steering mode from a wheel differential steering mode,  a foot-lift steering mode,  and a hybrid steering mode based on the mode interpolation control variable; controlling the wheel-legged robot to steer in a target steering mode based on the steering control information According to the scheme,  the problem that the efficiency and the stability of the traditional single steering mode are difficult to balance can be overcome,  and the maneuverability and the environment adaptability of the wheel-footed robot are improved 1. The invention discloses a stair traffic control method for a quadruped robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a dynamic stable area in a horizontal supporting plane based on a supporting state formed by the quadruped robot and stair steps through a moving actuating mechanism; obtaining the centroid position of the whole body formed by the main body structure and the mechanical arm; calculating a positional deviation between a vertical projection point of the centroid position on the horizontal support plane and the geometric center of the dynamic stability region; when the position deviation exceeds the preset safe range,  the robotic arm is controlled to adjust its posture,  so that the overall center of mass position moves into the dynamic stability area,  and the quadruped robot is maintained in complex dynamic terrain such as stairs. Movement stability 1. A four-foot robot stair passage control method,  the four-foot robot comprises a main body structure,  a movement executing mechanism connected to the main body structure,  and a mechanical arm carried on the main body structure,  wherein the method comprises :  constructing a dynamic stable area in the horizontal supporting plane based on the supporting state formed by the four-foot robot and the stair step through the moving executing mechanism;  obtaining the mass centre position of the whole body formed by the main body structure and the mechanical arm;  calculating the position deviation between the vertical projection point of said centroid position on said horizontal supporting plane and the geometric centre of said dynamic stable region;  when the position deviation exceeds the preset safety range,  controlling the mechanical arm to adjust its posture,  so that the mass centre position of the whole body moves into the dynamic stable area.

The invention discloses a biped robot form optimization method based on metric index identification variable additive grouping,  which includes an additive structure grouping stage and a Bayesian optimization stage based on additive decomposition; in the additive structure grouping stage,  firstly,  the interaction intensity between two variables is calculated through the designed interaction measurement index,  and the interaction intensity is converted into a distance matrix; subsequently,  using this distance matrix,  the K-Means clustering algorithm with capacity limitation is used to cluster the high-dimensional variables to obtain the grouping,  thus obtaining the additive grouping structure; in the Bayesian optimization stage based on additive decomposition,  an additive kernel GP surrogate model is constructed with the obtained additive grouping structure,  the next evaluation point is obtained by maximizing the acquisition function,  and the morphological parameters of the evaluation point are used as the final applied bipedal robot initial morphological parameters. Compared with existing methods,  this invention is more concise and robust,  and balances optimization efficiency and group recognition accuracy by limiting the maximum dimension of each subgroup. 1. A two-foot robot form optimization method based on measurement index identification additive grouping structure,  wherein it comprises additive structure grouping stage and Bayesian optimization stage based on additive decomposition;  in the additive structure grouping stage,  firstly calculating the interaction intensity between every two variables according to the designed interaction metric index between variables,  and converting the interaction intensity into a distance matrix;  then,  using the distance matrix,  using K-Means clustering algorithm with capacity limit to cluster the high-dimensional variable to obtain grouping,  so as to obtain additive grouping structure;  in the Bayesian optimization stage based on additive decomposition,  the additive grouping structure is used for constructing an additive core GP proxy model,  the next evaluation point is obtained by maximizing the function,  and the form parameter of the evaluation point is used as the final applied initial form parameter of the biped robot.

The invention discloses a gesture recognition mapping method and system based on robot vision. The method includes :  collecting two-dimensional coordinates of each key point of the hand; calculate the angle of each finger joint based on vector geometry to obtain the continuous curvature values of the five fingers,  and introduce a dynamic calibration mechanism to eliminate individual hand size differences; then,  combining the preset logic rules and dynamic threshold adjustment mechanism,  the curvature vector is determined as the specific gesture semantics; finally,  the curvature value is converted into the target control parameters of the robot actuator through the calibrated mapping function to achieve a continuous and smooth mapping of gestures to manipulator actions. The invention realizes real-time gesture recognition and accurate reproduction with low computing power and high robustness without relying on a depth camera,  effectively overcomes the problems of high hardware cost,  poor individual adaptability and stiff action mapping in the prior art,  and can be widely used in humanoid robots,  virtual reality and other fields that require fine gesture interaction. 1. A gesture recognition mapping method based on robot vision,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  collecting the hand image of the user through the monocular 2D colour camera,  using the hand key point detection algorithm to obtain a two-dimensional coordinate set of a plurality of key feature points of the hand in real time;  S2,  based on the two-dimensional coordinate set,  calculating to obtain the bending angle of each finger joint,  and accumulating the bending angles of multiple joints contained by each finger to obtain the total bending angle of the finger;  then mapping the total bending angle to the pre-set standard interval by linear normalization,  outputting the continuous bending degree value representing the bending degree of the finger;  S3,  according to the preset gesture logic rule,  combining and judging the continuous bending degree values of the five fingers,  and outputting the corresponding gesture semanteme;  S4 :  converting the continuous bending degree value into the target control parameter of the robot executing mechanism by pre-demarcating the established mapping relation,  driving the robot executing mechanism to smoothly reappear the user gesture in real time.

ABSTRACT :  The present invention discloses an Eye Vision-Controlled Robotic Arm System that enables completely non-contact,  hands-free manipulation of a multi- degree-of-freedom (DOF) robotic arm using only the natural movements of the human eye. The system integrates a standard USB webcam or Raspberry Pi camera module with a real-time computer vision processing unit executing the MediaPipe FaceMesh neural network and OpenCV libraries to detect,  track,  and interpret iris landmark positions and eyelid movement patterns. The present invention relates to an AI-Enabled Adaptive Emotional State Light Panel System for Social Robots designed to improve emotional communication and human–robot interaction through intelligent adaptive visual expression. The system integrates artificial intelligence,  machine learning algorithms,  programmable LED light panels,  environmental sensors,  and emotion recognition mechanisms to detect and interpret human emotions in real time. Emotional states are identified using facial expression analysis,  speech processing,  gesture recognition,  and contextual environmental monitoring. Based on the analyzed emotional conditions,  the system dynamically generates adaptive lighting effects through variations in color,  brightness,  intensity,  pulse frequency,  and animation patterns. The invention further incorporates adaptive learning capabilities for personalized emotional interaction based on user behavior and historical communication patterns. The proposed system enhances emotional transparency,  engagement,  empathy,  and social acceptance of robots in healthcare,  education,  elderly care,  rehabilitation,  hospitality,  and companion robotics applications while providing an energy-efficient and scalable emotional communication framework.

The invention discloses a method,  a device,  equipment and a medium for pouring water by a humanoid robot based on visual servo,  and relates to the technical field of industrial visual intelligence. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring first attitude information of a target object in a working environment; determining a water pouring target position above the water cup based on the preset height and the water cup position; based on the position deviation between the spout position and the pouring target position,  through the first visual servo control algorithm,  iteratively adjust the end posture of the robotic arm of the humanoid robot to reduce the position deviation; when the position deviation meets the first preset condition,  control the robotic arm to perform a dumping action; during the execution of the pouring action,  the updated spout position is obtained in real time,  and based on the real-time deviation between the updated spout position and the pouring target position,  the end posture of the robotic arm is compensated and adjusted through the second visual servo control algorithm. This application improves the precise alignment and real-time control of the robot's water pouring action,  and has stronger stability and adaptability. 1. The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on ground touch detection,  which is applied to a bipedal humanoid robot with a floating base structure,  and includes :  constructing a model predictive controller based on a center-of-mass dynamics model; construct a touchdown probability model; adaptively adjust the current gait phase based on the touchdown detection results; an inverse dynamic quadratic programming problem including generalized acceleration,  foot end contact force and joint driving torque is constructed,  and the joint torque command is obtained by solving it under the conditions of satisfying the dynamic constraints,  foot end contact non-slip constraints and friction cone constraints. The present invention introduces touchdown detection into a nonlinear model predictive controller A reasonable centroid dynamics model is designed,  and necessary equality constraints and inequality constraints are added to realize the adaptive adjustment of the humanoid robot in the unknown foot-end contact state scenario,  and improve the humanoid robot's walking stability and robustness under complex terrain conditions. 1. A humanoid robot motion control method based on touchdown detection,  wherein it is applied to a biped humanoid robot with floating base structure,  the method comprises the following steps :  (1) constructing a humanoid robot model prediction controller based on centroid dynamics model :  constructing a floating base joint space of the humanoid robot,  introducing a centroid momentum matrix under the centroid dynamics model frame,  establishing a relation between the centroid momentum vector and the generalized speed of the humanoid robot,  realizing the centroid dynamics modelling;  defining the state vector and control input of the model prediction control,  finishing the definition of the humanoid robot model prediction control problem based on the centroid dynamics model;  (2) foot end touchdown state estimation based on gait phase and foot bottom force probability fusion :  constructing a corresponding touchdown probability model aiming at the gait phase information and the normal foot bottom force information,  based on Bayesian probability fusion,  giving a final foot end touchdown probability; The invention discloses a quadruped robot target tracking method based on a twin network aiming at the field of single target tracking First,  data preprocessing is performed on the video,  and then an image alignment module is constructed to perform preliminary positioning before image feature extraction,  so that the target is always in the search area and the number of target losses by the tracker is reduced. Then,  a feature extraction sub-network is used to extract features,  and the extracted convolutional features are hierarchically aggregated. After that,  a scale adaptive sub-network is used to adapt to the scale change of the target during the tracking process,  and the regression sub-network updated online is used to adapt to the changes of illumination and target shape. Finally get the position of the target in the current frame. 1. A four-foot robot target tracking method based on twin network,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  data pre-processing,  step 2,  constructing an image aligning module,  before the image is input into the feature extracting sub-network,  obtaining the estimated position of the target in the current frame,  firstly aligning and registering the two images of the initial frame and the current frame after the pre-processing,  then mapping the position in the initial frame to the current frame by the calculated conversion matrix to obtain the estimated position of the target in the current frame;  step 3,  using the estimated position of the target obtained in the step 2 in the current frame,  cutting the image,  firstly cutting the initial frame through the position of the target in the first frame,  obtaining a template image with a square shape with the target position as the centre,  cutting the current frame by the target estimation position calculated in the step 2,  and obtaining a square search pattern with the target estimation position as the central shape;  step 4,  constructing a feature extraction sub-network,  sending the template image and the search image obtained in the step 3 into the trained feature extraction sub-network,  passing the template image and the search image through the conv3_3 of the feature extraction sub-network,  the conv4_6 and conv5_3 convolution layer output characteristics are spliced and polymerized,  the polymerized characteristics are used for the subsequent scale adaptive sub-network to perform scale prediction;  the Resnet-50 is used as the feature extraction sub-network,  the feature extraction sub-network performs off-line training;  step 5,  constructing a scale self-adaptive sub-network,  sending the spliced feature to the scale self-adaptive sub-network for prediction,  the scale self-adaptive sub-network comprises a feature adjusting layer,  a depth correlation layer and a monitoring layer,  the depth correlation layer is used for obtaining the similarity response diagram of the template feature and the search area feature,  the monitoring layer has two branches,  one is used for the classification of foreground and background,  the other is used for the regression of target tracking frame length and width,  and position,  and finally outputs multiple candidate tracking frames;  step 6,  constructing a regression sub-network,  after the feature extraction network in the deep twin network,  the regression sub-network uses the initial frame to perform training through the output feature of the conv5-3 convolution layer in the feature extraction sub-network,  outputting a two-dimensional Gaussian response diagram with the target position as the centre,  inputting the output characteristic of the conv5_3 convolution layer in the current frame through the characteristic extraction sub-network into the regression sub-network,  obtaining the Gaussian response diagram of the current search area,  then selecting the multiple candidate tracking frames obtained in the step 5,  obtaining the final tracking result.

The invention relates to a negative pressure cooling device,  a humanoid robot and an aircraft. The suction part can extract the gaseous working fluid in the cooling chamber. The negative pressure cooling device,  humanoid robot and aircraft provided by this application solve the problem of difficulty in synchronous heat dissipation of multiple heating elements,  and the liquid level of the coolant is easy to change,  making the coolant unable to effectively immerse in the heating surface of the motor,  thereby causing the motor to The problem of overheating damage 1. A negative pressure cooling device,  wherein it comprises :  a cooling chamber (100),  provided with a cooling cavity (110),  the cooling cavity (110) is used for mounting one or more heating elements (200),  the heating element (200) has a heating surface for radiating,  the heating surface is set in the cooling cavity (110);  a liquid supply part (300),  capable of conveying liquid working medium to the cooling cavity (110) through the liquid supply pipe (320);  a spraying mechanism (400),  which is set on the liquid outlet end of the liquid supply part (300),  the liquid working medium can be sprayed on the corresponding heating surface through the spraying mechanism (400),  and the liquid working medium can absorb heat and gasify into gaseous working medium on the heating surface;  and,  a suction part (500),  installed on one end of the cooling chamber (100) and connected with the cooling chamber (110),  the suction part (500) can extract the gaseous working medium in the cooling chamber (110);  the liquid supply part (300) comprises a liquid storage tank (310),  a liquid supply pipe (320) and a liquid pump,  the liquid storage tank (310) is used for storing liquid working medium,  one end of the liquid supply pipe (320) is connected with the liquid storage tank (310) through the liquid pump,  the other end is connected with the spraying mechanism (400);  the liquid supply pipe (320) passes through the heating end of the suction part (500) and is in heat-conducting contact with the heating end of the suction part (500),  so that the heating end of the suction part (500) can pre-heat the liquid working medium in the liquid supply pipe (320); A terrain recognition method of foot-type robot,  wherein the terrain recognition method comprises :  when the target foot-type robot walks on the current ground,  obtaining the pose data collected by the main body sensor of the target foot-type robot,  and inputting the pose data to the dynamic parameter calculation model,  calculating the state parameter of the target foot-type robot;  wherein the state parameter comprises Jacobian matrix,  inertia matrix,  Coriolis force matrix and generalized gravity;  inputting the pose data and the state parameter to a foot-ground contact force model,  determining a three-dimensional foot-ground contact force of the target foot-type robot;  generating a contact mask sequence representing the touchdown state of the foot end of the target foot-type robot based on the three-dimensional touchdown force,  and dividing the pose data by using the contact mask sequence to obtain a divided pose data set;  inputting the pose data set into a pre-trained terrain classification model,  determining the confidence vector of the current ground under multiple terrain attributes,  and determining the terrain type of the current ground according to multiple confidence vectors;  wherein the terrain classification model comprises a convolutional neural network sub-module and a cyclic neural network sub-module connected in turn.

The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for acquiring a motion path of a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises a mechanical arm and a dexterous hand at the tail end of the mechanical arm. The method comprises the following steps of :  determining a distance constraint under a spatial model of a piano keyboard on the basis of upper limb structural parameters of the humanoid robot; determine the amount of operating time based on the upper limb operating performance parameters of the humanoid robot; obtain a mathematical programming model,  the decision variables of the mathematical programming model are the operation events of the humanoid robot at each operation time point,  the constraints are distance constraints and operation running time,  and the optimization goal is to minimize the movement distance of the robotic arm at adjacent operation time points. sum; determine the joint motion path of the robotic arm according to the mathematical programming model. A motion path obtaining method of human-shaped robot,  wherein the human-shaped robot comprises a mechanical arm and a smart hand at the tail end of the mechanical arm,  the method comprises :  based on the upper limb structure parameter of the human-shaped robot,  determining the distance constraint coordinated by the mechanical arm and the dexterous hand under the space model of the piano keyboard;  based on the upper limb operation performance parameter of the humanoid robot,  determining the operation operation time amount;  the operation running time amount comprises the total operation time of the single keystroke whole flow and the time constraint of the adjacent keystroke event;  obtaining a mathematical planning model,  the decision variable of the mathematical planning model is the operation event of the humanoid robot at each operation time point,  the constraint condition is the distance constraint and the operation operation time amount,  the optimization target is the sum of the moving distance of the mechanical arm at the adjacent operation time point;  according to the mathematical planning model,  combining the distance constraint and operation operation time amount,  determining the joint movement path of the mechanical arm.

The invention discloses a predictive thermal management method and system for the dynamic posture of a humanoid robot Aiming at the problem that the thermal load of robot joints changes rapidly under high dynamic motion conditions and the response of traditional temperature control strategies lags behind,  the present invention aims to reduce the information isolation between thermal management and motion planning subsystems by introducing future motion trajectory sequences in the motion planning stage. The control lag improves the pertinence of cooling resource allocation The technical scheme comprises the following steps of :  acquiring current state information of a robot and a joint prediction motion track in a future set time domain; calculate future joint thermal disturbance sequences based on motor parameters combined with predicted trajectories; on this basis,  a thermal management control optimization model is constructed,  and the optimal control quantity used to adjust the flow rate of the liquid pump and proportional regulating valve is calculated and output on a rolling basis. The invention can effectively eliminate temperature overshoot,  significantly improve the adaptability and overall energy efficiency of the thermal management system under high dynamic motion conditions,  and ensure the thermal safety and operational stability of the humanoid robot. 1. A predictive thermal management method for dynamic posture of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the current state information of the humanoid robot,  the current state information comprises real-time temperature data and real-time kinematics data of each joint;  S2,  according to the motion planning module of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the joint prediction motion track sequence in the future set prediction time domain;  S3,  based on the joint prediction motion track sequence and the dynamic model of the robot,  calculating the joint thermal disturbance prediction sequence in the future corresponding time domain;  S4,  inputting the current state information and the joint thermal disturbance prediction sequence into a pre-constructed thermal dynamic prediction model,  through solving the rolling optimization problem,  calculating to obtain the optimal control sequence for adjusting the cooling execution mechanism;  S5,  extracting the current time control instruction in the optimal control sequence and outputting to the cooling executing mechanism,  adjusting the flow rate of the cooling medium flowing to each joint radiating structure;  S6,  entering the next control period,  repeatedly executing S1 to S5.

By introducing positive demonstration trajectories and negative demonstration trajectories in the process of maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning,  the present invention can effectively improve the safety of autonomous driving planning and decision-making while ensuring humanoid nature. 1. A reverse strengthening learning automatic driving decision planning method based on front and back demonstration,  wherein it specifically comprises the following steps :  the combined cost function is designed based on the safety cost,  the passing cost and the comfortable cost;  the combined reward function is obtained by processing the opposite number of the combined cost function;  using the inverse strengthening learning method based on the front and back demonstration to train the combined reward function,  in the process of training the combined reward function,  introducing the front demonstration track and the back demonstration track,  until the combined reward function is converged;  wherein the front demonstration track is safe driving action data,  the back demonstration track is dangerous driving action data;  according to the state of the vehicle and the interactive vehicle,  sampling the candidate combined track to form the candidate combined track set,  inputting each candidate combined track in the candidate combined track set into the converged combined reward network,  calculating the reward value of each candidate combined track;  selecting the candidate joint track with the maximum reward value as the planning result to output.

A four-legged robot complex terrain autonomous navigation method based on intensive learning,  wherein the method comprises :  step 1,  obtaining the multi-mode sensing data of the robot when walking in the complex terrain environment,  after processing,  generating the terrain semantic image and the terrain elevation image,  and extracting the geometric feature image from the terrain elevation image,  and extracting the semantic feature image from the terrain semantic image;  step 2,  projecting the semantic feature image and the geometric feature image to the same overlook grid space with the robot as the centre,  constructing a plurality of grid image layers with different resolutions,  combining the semantic feature and the geometric feature under the same resolution aiming at each grid position,  forming the fusion feature unit under the resolution;  step 3,  calculating the local terrain complexity according to the change rate of the geometric feature in each grid position neighbourhood and the distribution mixing degree of the semantic feature,  dynamically adjusting the contribution weights of the fusion feature units with different resolutions according to the complexity,  and generating a comprehensive environment state diagram after weighting and integrating;  step 4,  on the continuous time sequence to obtain a plurality of time comprehensive environment state map,  through comparing the semantic change and geometric height change of the same space position at the adjacent time,  analyzing the terrain dynamic evolution trend,  and according to the prediction of the terrain state of the front area,  forming an enhanced space-time state map; The present invention relates to an Emergency Humanoid System (EHS) designed to detect emergency situations and automatically transmit distress alerts to nearby individuals or registered contacts. The system integrates a mobile application platform with multiple sensor modules including accelerometers,  gyroscopes,  and microphones for monitoring motion patterns,  device orientation,  and surrounding audio signals. When abnormal sensor readings indicative of accidents,  falls,  or distress events are detected,  the system automatically generates emergency alerts and communicates them to nearby individuals within a predefined geographical radius. The system further includes a manual SOS activation mechanism allowing users to trigger emergency notifications when facing dangerous situations. By combining sensor- based monitoring with automated communication capabilities,  the proposed system enhances personal safety and improves the effectiveness of emergency response in scenarios where users may be unable to seek help manually.

ABSTRACT VISION BASED INTELLIGENT HUMAN ROBOT INTERACTION SYSTEM WITH VOICE CONTROLLED AUTOMATION FOR ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based automation system for additive manufacturing,  particularly for repair-oriented 3D printing in a multi-machine environment. The system comprises a portable computing device configured as a centralized control unit integrating multimodal human- computer interaction,  including vision-based component recognition,  gesture-based selection,  and voice command processing. A local artificial intelligence engine processes real-time input data to identify a parent mechanical component and retrieve associated child components from a locally stored database. Upon user validation,  the system autonomously generates manufacturing instructions by converting digital models into machine-readable code using an integrated slicing module. A key feature of the invention is a time-based printer selection mechanism that analyzes real-time telemetry data from multiple additive manufacturing machines to identify an optimal printer based on minimum remaining job completion time. The system further incorporates spatial mapping and closed-loop monitoring to dynamically allocate tasks,  detect errors,  and reassign jobs when necessary. The entire workflow is executed locally without reliance on cloud infrastructure,  enabling low-latency,  secure,  and efficient automation of additive manufacturing processes with minimal human intervention. This application belongs to the field of industrial robot control technology,  and discloses a real-time planning method and system for multi-joint collaboration and path optimization of industrial humanoid robots. A foot-type robot autonomous navigation method based on terrain passable weight,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1),  configuring the visual-inertial subsystem VIS :  a monocular camera and an inertia measuring unit IMU are configured for extracting image characteristic points,  providing a short-time motion prior through IMU pre-integration,  and performing non-linear optimization through a joint cost function of minimizing visual re-projection error and IMU pre-integration residual error in a sliding window,  obtaining local high frequency pose estimation;  the visual-inertial subsystem encapsulates the relative pose constraint between the adjacent key frames obtained by the nonlinear optimization solution at each key frame into a visual inertial odometer factor including a rotation matrix,  a velocity vector and a displacement vector,  and transmits the visual inertial odometer factor to the factor graph fusion module;  (2),  configuring LAR-Inertial Subsystem LIS :  a laser radar sensor and an inertia measuring unit are configured,  for performing voxel down-sampling and feature classification on the original point cloud,  the point cloud is divided into two types of edge feature and plane feature,  minimizing the weighted sum of the distance residual error from the edge feature point to the corresponding edge line and the distance residual error from the plane feature point to the corresponding plane through scan-to-map matching,  solving the residual error sum to obtain the 6-degree-of-freedom pose transformation matrix of the minimum value,  and outputting the laser radar odometer factor;  (3) Fusion of factor graph :  connecting the vision-inertia sub-system and the laser radar-inertia sub-system,  the odometer factor output by the two sub-systems,  the odometer factor is uniformly modelled as the factor node in the factor graph,  the global joint optimization is performed by iSAM2 increment smoothing and graph building algorithm,  the global consistent robot state estimation and three-dimensional point cloud map including six-degree-of-freedom pose,  three-dimensional speed and IMU bias of the three-dimensional position and three-dimensional pose are output;  (4),  topographical analysis TAM :  receiving the three-dimensional point cloud map output by the factor image fusion step,  constructing a 2.5D elevation grid,  wherein the elevation grid projects the three-dimensional point cloud to the two-dimensional uniform grid on the horizontal plane,  the grid resolution is the grid line index is recorded as the column index is recorded as each grid unit is recorded as ;  the step height is extracted for each grid unit,  local gradient and roughness three terrain features,  calculating the passable sub-weight corresponding to each feature through the cosine soft threshold mapping function,  and using the probability or fusion strategy to calculate the comprehensive passable weight,  then combining the visual semantic segmentation result to perform semantic-geometric joint correction,  finally outputting the accessible cost map;  (5) Path planning :  based on the passable cost map output by the terrain analysis step,  using TTW-A* path planning algorithm,  * the cost function of the algorithm is introduced with landform passable weight as penalty item,  the cost accumulation formula is wherein is the Euclidean distance between the current node and the father node,  is the comprehensive passable weight of the grid corresponding to the current node,  for the terrain penalty coefficient,  generating a path with the smallest total weighting cost considering the terrain through performance,  wherein the total weighting cost is defined as the edge cost between all adjacent nodes on the path the accumulated sum value to ensure that the foot-type robot can select the passing route with the minimum total weighting cost in the complex terrain environment including the step,  the slow slope and the rough ground.

The invention discloses a terrain-guided gait generation method,  which includes :  1. Obtaining terrain data through lidar and visual cameras,  and using a deep learning network to fuse and process point clouds and image data to extract slope and roughness feature information of the terrain; 2. Based on the extracted terrain feature information,  dynamically calculate and output the recommended step length and step frequency suitable for the current terrain by integrating the slope influence factor,  roughness influence factor and load quality influence; 3. Detect obstacles ahead by fusing sensing data,  sample and evaluate candidate trajectories within the speed dynamic window,  and plan the optimal obstacle avoidance path; 4 When the topographic features change significantly,  re-extract the topographic features and generate matching gait parameters to achieve a smooth transition. The invention guides gait generation and adjustment in real time through terrain characteristics,  and combines accurate obstacle detection to improve the autonomous movement ability,  stability and environmental adaptability of the legged robot in dynamic and complex off-road environments. 1. A method for generating gait guided by terrain,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining terrain data of the environment where the foot-type robot is located,  performing feature extraction on the terrain data,  obtaining terrain feature information representing terrain gradient and roughness;  S2,  based on the terrain characteristic information,  dynamically calculating and adjusting the step length and step frequency of the foot-type robot;  S3,  detecting the obstacle in the walking direction of the foot-type robot in real time,  and planning the obstacle avoiding track according to the detection result;  S4,  when the foot robot enters the new terrain area,  repeating the steps S1 and S2 to generate the step length and step frequency suitable for the new terrain area.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method adapted to walking in complex terrain and a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the field of robot motion control In order to solve the problems of poor adaptability and easy instability in strategy switching in the existing technology under complex terrain,  the present invention proposes a control framework that combines offline and online. In the offline stage,  by integrating the composite reward function of energy consumption,  balance and foot end stress indicators,  reinforcement learning is used to train a variety of walking strategies for different terrains and build a strategy library. In the online stage,  terrain categories are identified in real time through multi-modal sensing data such as foot front and rear end torque sensors,  IMU,  etc.,  and the optimal strategy is selected from the strategy library based on the identification results. A smooth switching mechanism with timing constraints and output interpolation is used for strategy transition. The invention significantly improves the walking stability,  energy efficiency and adaptive capacity of the humanoid robot under complex unknown terrain such as slopes,  gravels,  and slippery terrain. 1. A humanoid robot motion control method suitable for complex terrain walking,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  off-line training stage :  in the simulation environment,  multiple walking strategies are trained on different types of terrains by strengthening learning algorithm,  and a strategy base is constructed;  wherein the composite reward function used in the training at least comprises an energy consumption reward item,  a posture balance reward item and a foot end stress smooth reward item;  an online operation stage,  comprising :  a real-time sensing step :  through the moment sensor,  IMU and joint feedback set at the front end and the back end of the robot foot,  collecting the multi-mode data of the robot and the environment interaction in real time;  a terrain recognition step :  based on the data collected in the real-time sensing step,  extracting the feature vector,  and inputting to a lightweight terrain classifier,  judging the current terrain type of the robot in real time;  a policy selection and smooth switching step :  according to the terrain type identified in the terrain identifying step,  selecting the corresponding optimal walking strategy from the strategy base,  and transitioning the current execution strategy to the optimal walking strategy through the smooth switching mechanism.

The invention relates to a foot-type robot cooperative control method based on environment and cluster interaction force,  belongs to the technical field of foot-type robot control,  and solves one of the problems that the existing foot-type robot cluster has poor adaptability to complex terrain,  unstable dynamic motion control and weak multi-robot cluster cooperative capability The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring individual state information and neighbor state information of each legged robot in a cluster at the current moment,  and constructing a state space of each legged robot; based on the state space of each legged robot,  the trained control models of each legged robot are used to generate the joint torque instructions of each legged robot at the next moment to control the movement of each legged robot; among them,  the legged robot control model is a strategy network obtained through reinforcement learning training; during training,  the global state space is constructed by aggregating the state spaces of all legged robots in the cluster,  and the value of the action strategies of all legged robots in the cluster is evaluated and optimized. 1. A foot-type robot cooperative control method based on environment and cluster interaction force,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining individual state information and neighbour state information of each foot-type robot in the cluster at the current time;  wherein the individual state information comprises attitude information,  position information,  speed information and foot pressure information of each foot;  said neighbour state information comprises the posture information and position information of each neighbour foot type robot;  constructing a state space of each foot robot based on the individual state information and the neighbour state information;  based on the state space of each foot-type robot,  respectively using the trained each foot-type robot control model,  generating each joint moment instruction of each foot-type robot at the next moment to control the movement of each foot-type robot;  wherein the foot-type robot control model is a strategy network obtained by intensive learning training;  when training the strategy network,  the global state space is constructed by the state space of all foot-type robots in the aggregation cluster,  and the value of the action strategy of all foot-type robots in the cluster is evaluated and optimized.

The invention discloses a heterogeneous multi-agent collaborative navigation method Based on the three-zero path planning TZPP paradigm,  satisfies the constraints of zero training,  zero prior knowledge,  and zero simulation,  adopting the coordinator-explorer heterogeneous agent architecture,  using humanoid robots as coordinators and quadruped robots as explorers,  autonomous exploration and path planning can be achieved in unknown complex environments,  getting rid of the dependence of existing methods on training,  a priori maps,  and simulation environments,  significantly reducing the deployment and application of robot systems. cost,  improve the robustness of the system in real dynamic environments; realize the professional division of tasks between humanoid robots and quadruped robots Humanoid robots are responsible for high-level task coordination and navigation decision-making,  and quadruped robots take advantage of their flexible mobility to undertake environmental exploration and feasible path identification,  giving full play to the complementary advantages of robots of different forms and solving the problems of chaotic planning and resource waste of homogeneous multi-agent collaboration. 1. A cooperative navigation method of heterogeneous multi-intelligent agent,  wherein the method is based on three-zero path planning TZPP model,  satisfies the constraint of zero training,  zero priori knowledge,  zero simulation,  adopts coordinator-explorer heterogeneous intelligent agent structure,  uses humanoid robot as coordinator,  The four-foot robot is used as a explorer,  realizing autonomous exploration and path planning in an unknown complex environment,  comprising the following steps :  s1. Determining the position of the task target the humanoid robot is used as the coordinator for the global target sensing information with its own environment performing path evaluation,  judging whether the path condition is good;  S2,  if the path condition is good,  the humanoid robot directly executes the navigation task,  gradually approaching the target position until reaching;  If the path condition is not good,  the humanoid robot starts the lead search stage,  and distributes the position of the path point described by the natural language. to the four-foot robot,  driving the four-foot robot to carry out environment exploration;  s3. Four-legged robot receiving transit point position after that,  based on the self-environment sensing information performing the environment detection,  matching the searching strategy of the few reference object mode X or the non-direct reachable mode Y,  executing the corresponding searching flow;  s4,  the four-foot robot returns the environment sensing information in the exploring process to the human-shaped robot in real time,  the human-shaped robot continuously collects feedback and evaluates the navigation benefit of the arrived navigation point,  only the navigation point with navigation benefit is included in the path reference;  s5. The human-shaped robot combines the effective search information of the four-foot robot,  updates the navigation path and executes the task until reaching the target position. and finishing the cooperative navigation.

This application belongs to the field of robot control technology A risk prediction and safety control method and system for industrial humanoid robots oriented to complex industrial environments are disclosed The method comprises the following steps of :  dividing a sensing region of a robot hand,  setting a region sensing confidence parameter,  and acquiring and preprocessing multi-modal tactile time series data of normal force,  shearing force,  micro-vibration and temperature output by an electronic skin in real time during operation; recognizing the contact event and the contact area based on the data,  and extracting the time sequence feature set of the contact state; then,  the feature set is modulated by the regional perception confidence parameter,  and the risk of contact instability is predicted based on the modulated feature set. Finally,  the prediction result and the regional perception confidence parameter are combined to generate a safety control strategy. The invention realizes differentiated early identification and safety control of potential dangers in different contact areas,  and improves the safety,  stability and operating efficiency of the robot in complex industrial scenes. 1. An industrial humanoid robot risk prediction and safety control method for complex industrial environment,  wherein the robot hand is configured with flexible electronic skin,  comprising :  dividing the sensing area of the hand part of the robot,  and setting area sensing confidence parameter for each sensing area;  in the robot operation process,  collecting the multi-mode touch time sequence data output by the electronic skin in real time and pre-processing it;  The multimodal haptic time sequence data at least comprises :  a normal force signal,  a shearing force signal,  a micro-vibration signal and a temperature signal;  based on the multimodal haptic timing data,  identifying a contact event and identifying a perceived region where contact occurs;  extracting the contact state time sequence characteristic set from the corresponding multi-mode touch time sequence data according to the determined contact sensing area;  based on the area sensing confidence parameter of the sensing area where the contact is confirmed,  modulating the contact state time sequence characteristic set to obtain the contact state time sequence characteristic set under the area confidence constraint;  predicting the destabilization risk of the contact event based on the set of contact state timing characteristics under the regional confidence constraint;  generating a security control strategy according to the prediction result of the destabilization risk and the region sensing confidence parameter of the sensing region where the contact is confirmed.

The invention provides a negative obstacle risk map construction method and system The invention relates to the technical field of robot environment sensing. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-modal sensing data of a legged robot in the current operating environment,  and acquiring the type of a negative obstacle in the current operating environment,  a plurality of candidate regions,  and the confidence and uncertainty corresponding to the candidate regions; through the risk diffusion algorithm,  ink stains are processed according to the type,  confidence and uncertainty to generate a continuous risk field corresponding to the candidate area; divide the continuous risk field and generate the continuous risk gradient distribution corresponding to each candidate area; based on laser point cloud,  terrain modeling is carried out,  and the continuous risk gradient distribution is updated through Bayesian fusion to obtain a multi-level grid map,  and then tactile closed-loop correction is performed on the multi-level grid map to generate a risk-cost map. The invention improves the construction accuracy of the negative obstacle risk map. 1. A negative obstacle risk map construction method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the multi-mode sensing data of the foot-type robot in the current working environment,  wherein the multi-mode sensing data comprises the visual image of the current working environment,  the laser point cloud and the contact sensing data of the foot-type robot;  performing semantic segmentation based on the visual image to obtain the type of the negative obstacle in the current working environment,  multiple candidate areas of the negative obstacle and the confidence level and uncertainty corresponding to each candidate area;  through the risk diffusion algorithm,  according to the type of the negative barrier and the confidence degree and uncertainty of each candidate area,  performing the ink mark corona treatment,  generating the continuous risk field corresponding to each candidate area;  dividing the continuous risk field,  generating the continuous risk gradient distribution corresponding to each candidate region;  performing terrain modelling based on the laser point cloud,  obtaining geometric risk clues indicating the presence of the negative obstacle in the current working environment;  through Bayesian fusion mode,  updating the continuous risk gradient distribution according to the geometric risk clue,  obtaining a multi-level grid map;  performing touch closed-loop correction on the multi-level grid map based on the touch sensing data to generate a risk cost map under the current operation environment.

The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot or active power artificial limb joint angle prediction device and method The present invention fuses electromyographic signals carrying neural information and inertial motion unit data carrying kinematic information Utilize the information and speed information transmitted by spinal cord nerves in multi-modal data,  and perform feature fusion and decoding,  and finally output it for controlling intelligent rehabilitation equipment such as lower limb exoskeleton robots and active prosthetics. According to the invention,  the speed adaptability of the existing lower limb movement angle prediction based on the human body surface electromyographic signal is obviously improved,  and the engineering practical performance of the method is obviously improved 1. An exoskeleton robot or active power artificial limb joint angle prediction device,  wherein it comprises :  a signal collecting unit for synchronously obtaining the surface myoelectric signal,  the inertia measuring signal and the joint angle true value signal of the limb movement of the human body;  a data pre-processing unit connected with the signal collecting unit and used for filtering the surface electromyographic signal,  calculating the attitude of the inertia measuring signal,  and synchronizing the time and aligning the frequency of all the signals;  a gait phase analyzing unit connected with the data pre-processing unit and used for identifying the gait period and normalizing the time in the period into the gait phase based on the foot motion track in the joint angle true value signal;  a training data set constructing module for performing sample segmentation and organization to the signal processed by the data pre-processing unit and the gait phase analyzing unit through a sliding window to generate a training data set;  a multimodal neural network model for predicting gait phase and joint angle according to the input multimodal signal.

The invention provides a humanoid robot remote operation grasping control method It belongs to the field of robot teleoperation control technology,  and can at least partially solve the problems in the existing technology that the teleoperation system lacks action intention prediction,  resulting in network delay amplification trajectory errors,  insufficient tactile feedback,  resulting in overshoot of force control switching,  and unstable joint redundancy solution,  resulting in posture jitter. The invention includes :  collecting the wrist speed data,  joint angular acceleration data and pose trajectory data of the operator,  and constructing a multi-modal time sequence coding sequence; output predicted action instructions; acquisition of haptic array pressure distribution data,  calculation of haptic deviation and generation of torque compensation instructions based on compliance control law; output whole body joint speed commands; estimate the physical attribute parameters of the grasped object online based on the tactile data and force feedback data,  and adaptively adjust the grasping control parameters. The invention realizes remote operation grabbing control with low delay,  high flexibility and high stability,  and is suitable for fine operation scenarios such as glassware grabbing. 1. A remote operation grabbing control method for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the wrist speed data,  the joint angle acceleration data and the pose track data of the operator,  performing time sequence splicing to construct a multi-mode time sequence coding sequence,  and performing characteristic extraction and action intention prediction to the multi-mode time sequence coding sequence,  outputting a prediction action instruction;  collecting the pressure distribution data of the robot hand touch array,  converting the pressure distribution data into the contact force data according to the calibration model,  calculating the touch deviation between the contact force data and the target contact force,  and processing the touch deviation based on the compliance control law,  generating a moment compensation instruction;  constructing a whole body coordination control model based on zero space projection,  defining an optimized target function including gravity centre stability,  trunk upright property and collision avoidance,  fusing an upper limb task instruction with a redundant degree of freedom optimized target corresponding to the optimized target function,  and outputting a whole body joint speed instruction;  and according to the pressure distribution data and the end force feedback data,  calculating the quality parameter and the elastic modulus parameter of the grabbing object,  according to the quality parameter and the elastic modulus parameter self-adaptively adjusting the grabbing force threshold value and the force control sensitivity parameter.

The invention discloses a configuration multi-stage grabbing and placement planning method Involving the field of intelligent manufacturing technology,  through technological innovations such as configured parameter management,  multi-stage seamless trajectory planning,  independent configuration of arms,  and waist-arm trajectory decoupling and splitting,  it effectively solves the core problems of the existing dual-arm robot grasping planning method such as parameter hard coding,  inflexible stage connection,  and lack of whole-body collaboration mechanism It has significantly improved the deployment efficiency and operational reliability of robots in scenarios such as flexible manufacturing,  multi-task switching,  and heterogeneous collaboration,  laying a solid foundation for the rapid deployment and task adaptation of next-generation collaborative robots,  humanoid robots,  and special operation robots. Technical foundation 1. A configuration multi-stage grabbing and placing planning method,  wherein the method comprises :  a grabbing stage :  Step 1 (S1) :  obtaining the six-dimensional pose of the target grabbing point under the robot base coordinate system;  step S2 :  loading an external configuration file,  analyzing and obtaining six-dimensional pose offset parameters at least comprising an approach offset,  a capture offset and a retreat offset;  step S3 :  according to the target grabbing point and the six-dimensional pose offset parameter,  dynamically calculating and executing multi-stage grabbing plan,  specifically comprising :  Stage 1 :  superposing the six-dimensional pose of the target grabbing point and the approaching offset according to the component,  obtaining the approaching stage target pose,  taking the current mechanical arm end pose as the starting point,  planning to the first section approaching track of the approaching stage target pose;  Stage 2 :  superposing the six-dimensional pose of the target grabbing point and the grabbing offset according to the component,  obtaining the target pose of the grabbing stage,  taking the end point of the first section close to the track as the starting point,  planning to the second section grabbing track of the target pose of the grabbing stage;  Stage three :  overlapping the six-dimensional pose of the target grabbing point and the withdrawing offset according to the component to obtain the target pose of the withdrawing stage,  taking the end point of the second grabbing track as the starting point,  planning to the third withdrawing track of the target pose of the withdrawing stage;  step S4 :  joining the first section of approaching track,  the second section of grabbing track and the third section of withdrawing track end to end according to the time sequence to generate a complete grabbing execution track;  placing stage :  Step P1 :  loading the external configuration file,  analyzing and obtaining the placing joint position in the placing stage or close to the placing joint position;  Step P2 :  taking the current joint configuration after the grabbing stage as the starting point,  taking the placing joint position or close to the placing joint position as the target,  planning the first section close to the placing track;  step P3 :  taking the end point of the first section close to the placing track as the starting point,  taking the configured pre-placing joint position as the target,  planning the second section placing track;  step P4 :  orderly executing the first section of approaching placing track and the second section of placing track,  and sending the jaw opening instruction when reaching the placing point;  wherein,  the starting point of each stage track is the end point of the last stage track,  realizing the seamless connection from end to end.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot control,  in particular to a predictive control humanoid robot anti-falling method and system. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a robot real-time motion state and environment perception data set,  and performing inversion by taking a centroid and a joint angle as initial states to obtain a zero-moment point trajectory prediction sequence; coupling the terrain slope,  height and friction distribution parameters to generate a pre-contact surface state parameter set; the trajectory sequence and parameter set are combined to evaluate the stability boundary to generate anti-fall pre-adjustment instructions; extracting trajectory deviation point and prediction time,  reversely deriving centroid adjustment vector and trunk attitude compensation amount,  generating cooperative motion and attitude compensation sequence and correcting original gait trajectory; drive the servo motor to perform anti-fall action and adjust the angle of the plantar joint according to the slope; the invention can improve the anti-falling efficiency of the humanoid robot 1. A human-shaped robot anti-tumble method for predictive control,  wherein the method comprises :  A1,  obtaining a real-time motion state data set and an environment sensing data set of the human-shaped robot,  the real-time motion state data set comprises a joint angle vector,  a trunk attitude angle vector,  a zero moment point position vector and a centroid position vector,  the environment sensing data set comprises a terrain depth map and a friction coefficient distribution map;  A2,  taking the centroid position vector and the joint angle vector as the initial state,  performing zero moment point inversion to the future centroid discrete position,  obtaining the zero moment point track prediction sequence of the humanoid robot;  A3,  coupling the gradient and height curve in the terrain depth map with the friction distribution in the friction coefficient distribution map to obtain the pre-contact surface state parameter set of the humanoid robot;  A4,  jointly evaluating the zero moment point track prediction sequence and the pre-contact surface state parameter set and the pre-set stable boundary to obtain the anti-falling pre-adjusting instruction of the humanoid robot;  A5,  in response to the anti-falling pre-adjusting instruction,  extracting the first deviation point and prediction time exceeding the stable boundary from the zero moment point track prediction sequence,  taking the prediction time as the constraint,  reversely deducing the centroid position adjusting vector and trunk attitude angle compensation amount of the humanoid robot,  and generating a cooperative motion displacement sequence and a posture compensation angle pair of the human-shaped robot;  A6,  superposing the cooperative motion displacement sequence and the attitude compensation angle pair to the original gait planning track of the human-shaped robot,  so as to obtain the anti-falling correction track of the human-shaped robot;  A7,  sending the anti-falling correction track to the servo motor controller of the humanoid robot to perform anti-falling preparation action,  and adjusting the thenar joint angle of the humanoid robot according to the gradient.

The invention relates to the field of computer vision technology,  specifically a humanoid target shooting calibration and identification method based on SIFT image registration technology,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Use the SIFT feature extraction algorithm to calculate the global feature points of the template image obtained in step S2. S4. Obtain a frame of the target paper after target shooting in real time as the target image to be identified; s5. A human target shooting calibration identification method based on SIFT image registration technology,  wherein It comprises the following steps :  S1,  setting a camera on the target field;  adjusting the camera to align the target paper,  obtaining the target paper image S2 by the camera in real time,  identifying the target paper picture of the former frame as the template picture by the camera;  S3,  using the SIFT feature extraction algorithm to calculate the global feature point of the template picture obtained in the step S2,  storing the global feature point of the template picture,  and then not repeatedly extracting the template picture;  S4,  obtaining a frame of picture of the target paper after shooting in real time by the camera as the target picture to be identified;  S5,  using the SIFT feature extraction algorithm to calculate the feature point of the target picture to be identified;  S6,  performing violent K neighbour matching to the feature point of the target picture to be identified obtained in the step S5 and the global feature point of the template picture stored in the step S3,  calculating the similarity value between multiple matching point pairs,  selecting the feature point pair with the similarity value less than 0.75 to perform the homography matrix calculation;
