The present invention relates to the field of lubricating grease. Specifically,  it relates to a lubricating grease composition with excellent heat resistance and stability and its preparation method and application,  which is used to solve the problem that although the existing lubricating grease products have good performance in daily applications,  their lubricating effect is still not ideal under high temperature and high-speed operation,  thereby affecting the reliability and life of the equipment. The lubricating grease composition comprises the following components :  base oil,  an organic phosphorus nitrogen polyfluorine modifier,  a thickening agent,  an antioxidant,  an antirust agent and nano tungsten disulfide The preparation method can significantly improve the lubricating performance and heat resistance of the grease composition by adding an organic phosphorus nitrogen polyfluorine modifier to the grease composition It maintains efficient lubrication performance under high temperature conditions,  ensures that the grease composition can continue to provide effective lubrication protection under high temperature and harsh environments,  and ensures long service life under extreme working conditions such as high-speed bearings and humanoid robot joints. 1. A lubricating grease composition with excellent heat-resistant stability,  wherein it comprises the following components in parts by weight :  base oil 78-86 parts,  organic phosphorus nitrogen multi-fluorine modifying agent 1-9 parts,  thickening agent 12-16 parts,  antioxidant 0. 8-1. 6 parts,  antirust 0. 7 to 1. 5 parts and nanometre tungsten disulfide 0. 6 to 1. 2 parts;  wherein the organic phosphorus-nitrogen polyfluoro modifier is prepared by the following steps :  step a1 :  2,  5-dibromobenzene-1, 4-dicarboxaldehyde,  4-trifluoromethylphenylboronic acid,  tetrakis (triphenylphosphine) palladium,  sodium carbonate,  toluene and de-ionized water were stirred for reaction,  after the reaction was completed,  the reaction product was cooled,  then extracted with ethyl acetate,  the extracts were combined and washed,  drying,  vacuum filtering,  rotating and evaporating the filtrate to obtain the dialdehyde-based polyfluoride compound;  Step a2 :  after the reaction is finished,  cooling the reaction product,  then vacuum filtering,  washing the filter cake,  drying to obtain Schiff base polyfluoride compound;  Step a3 :  The Schiff base multi-fluorine compound,  DOPO and ethanol are stirred to react,  after the reaction is finished,  the reaction product is cooled,  then vacuum filtering,  the filter cake is re-crystallized by N,  N-dimethyl formamide to obtain the organic phosphorus nitrogen multi-fluorine modifier.

Real-Time Locating System (RTLS) enabled human to automated vehicle interaction apparatus and methods. Systems may include a control system configured to communicate with RTLS transceivers and anchors within an environment,  and autonomous vehicles (AVs) equipped with sensors and RTLS communication transceivers. A control system determines a real-time location of RTLS transceivers (“Tags”) and provides navigation,  task,  and behavioral instructions to AVs based on location data. RTLS transceivers can be worn by humans or attached to objects,  machines,  equipment,  floorspace,  storage bins,  or other destination,  thereby enabling AVs to locate and travel to humans,  objects,  or other destination points,  perform tasks based on location data,  and dynamically alter actions and behaviors. Locating and traveling to destination points may include dynamic destination points based upon movement of a destination human or item. User interactions via RTLS tags may trigger specific actions,  enhancing human-automated vehicle collaboration and operational efficiency in diverse environments.

The application discloses a humanoid robot control method based on model reasoning and related equipment. The method includes :  dynamically collecting multi-modal data through the target robot end,  transforming the multi-modal data,  and generating multi-modal transformed data; dynamically monitoring the network communication status of the target robot,  reasoning the multi-modal transformation data through a lightweight reasoning service model according to the network communication status and the data sensitivity of the multi-modal transformation data,  and outputting the reasoning result; the lightweight inference service model is obtained through full-layer parameter transformation and federated learning collaborative training; performing inverse transformation on the reasoning result through the target robot end to obtain an action control instruction,  and controlling the target humanoid robot according to the action control instruction According to the embodiment of the invention,  automatic control of the robot based on multi-modal data input can be realized,  and the control efficiency and accuracy of the robot are improved This application can be widely used in the field of robot control technology. 1. A humanoid robot control method based on model reasoning,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  dynamically collecting the multimodal data through the target robot end,  converting the multimodal data to generate the multimodal conversion data;  dynamically monitoring the network communication state of the target robot end,  according to the network communication state and the data sensitivity of the multimodal transformation data,  reasoning the multimodal transformation data through a lightweight reasoning service model,  outputting the reasoning result;  the light weight reasoning service model is obtained by full-layer parameter conversion and federated learning cooperative training;  performing inverse transformation on the reasoning result by the target robot end to obtain an action control instruction,  and controlling the target humanoid robot according to the action control instruction;  the step of dynamically monitoring the network communication state of the target robot end,  according to the network communication state and the data sensitivity of the multimodal transformation data,  reasoning the multimodal transformation data through a lightweight reasoning service model,  outputting the reasoning result,  comprising :  when the network communication state is networking state,  through the public light reasoning service model and the local reasoning service model of the target robot end,  according to the data sensitivity of the multimodal transformation data,  performing cooperative reasoning analysis on the multimodal transformation data,  generating the reasoning result;  when the network communication state is the off-network state,  reasoning the multi-mode conversion data through the local reasoning service model of the target robot end,  generating the reasoning result;  when the network communication state is a networking state,  through the public lightweight reasoning service model and the local reasoning service model of the target robot end,  according to the data sensitivity of the multimodal transformation data,  performing cooperative reasoning analysis on the multimodal transformation data,  generating the reasoning result,  comprising :  performing data sensitivity detection on the multimodal transformation data,  and splitting the multimodal transformation data into sensitive data and non-sensitive data;  reasoning the sensitive data by the local reasoning service model of the target robot end to generate a first reasoning result;  encrypting and uploading the non-sensitive data to the public cloud node by the target robot end,  decrypting the encrypted non-sensitive data by the public cloud node,  reasoning the decrypted non-sensitive data by the public light reasoning service model,  generating a second reasoning result;  encrypting the second inference result to the target robot end by the public cloud node,  decrypting the encrypted second inference result by the target robot end,  obtaining the decrypted second inference result;  determining the reasoning result according to the first reasoning result and the decrypted second reasoning result.

The invention provides a neck structure and a humanoid robot. The neck structure is used to drive a robot head to move relative to the robot body. The neck structure includes a first driving unit,  a second driving unit and a third driving unit. The first driving unit is arranged in the head of the robot and is used for driving the head of the robot to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the first direction when the head of the robot rotates The second driving unit is used to drive the first driving unit to rotate around an axial direction parallel to the second direction when rotating,  so as to drive the robot head to rotate around an axial direction parallel to the second direction. The third driving unit is partially arranged in the robot main body,  and is used for driving the second driving unit and the first driving unit to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the third direction when rotating,  so as to drive the robot head to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the third direction This application can realize the three-degree-of-freedom movement of the robot head in a limited space. 1. A neck structure,  wherein it is used for driving a robot head to move relative to the robot main body,  the neck structure comprises :  a first driving unit arranged in the head of the robot,  wherein the first driving unit is used for driving the head of the robot to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the first direction when rotating;  a second driving unit connected with the first driving unit,  the second driving unit is used for driving the first driving unit to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the second direction when rotating,  so as to drive the robot head to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the second direction;  a third drive unit,  for partially set in the robot main body,  and connected with the second drive unit,  the third drive unit is used for driving the second drive unit and the first drive unit to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the third direction when rotating,  so as to drive the robot head to rotate around the axial direction parallel to the third direction;  wherein the first direction,  the second direction and the third direction are perpendicular to each other;  the third drive unit comprises a third rotating wheel,  a third transmission piece and a transmission rod assembly,  the third rotary wheel is set in the robot main body,  the third rotary wheel has a third rotary part and a third connecting part,  the third rotary part is connected with one end of the transmission rod assembly,  the other end of the transmission rod assembly is connected with the third transmission piece,  the third transmission piece is connected with the second driving unit;  the third connection part is connected with the robot main body;  wherein the neck structure further comprises a control unit and a first supporting rod assembly,  the first supporting rod assembly is telescopic,  one end of the first supporting rod assembly is connected with the other end of the transmission rod assembly,  the other end of the supporting rod assembly is connected with the robot main body,  the control unit is used for controlling the shortest telescopic length of the first supporting rod assembly to be greater than the first length threshold value so as to control and adjust the third preset angle range of the third transmission piece in the axial direction parallel to the third direction.

The invention discloses a training method of a humanoid robot task planning model and a task planning method. The method comprises the following steps of :  inputting first multi-modal training data into a first neural network for model training to obtain the trained first neural network; input the second multi-modal training data into the trained first neural network to obtain the first predicted task action; optimize the parameters of the trained first neural network according to the task trajectory data corresponding to the first predicted task action to obtain the second neural network; input the task trajectory data and the third multi-modal training data into the second neural network for model training to obtain a trained humanoid robot task planning model. This training method can provide a humanoid robot task planning model,  which can better adapt to the dynamic changes of the task scene,  and is conducive to improving the humanoid robot's scene adaptability and work generalization ability. The present invention relates to humanoid robot technology 1. A training method of humanoid robot task planning model,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a first multimodal training data,  a second multimodal training data and a third multimodal training data,  the task scenes of the first multimodal training data and the second multimodal training data are the same,  the task scenes of the first multimodal training data and the third multimodal training data are different;  inputting the first multimodal training data into a first neural network for model training to obtain a trained first neural network;  inputting the second multimodal training data to the trained first neural network to obtain a first predictive task action;  according to the task track data,  performing parameter optimization on the action output layer in the trained first neural network,  obtaining a second neural network;  the task track data is the track data formed by the human-shaped robot executing the first predicted task action;  inputting the task track data and the third multimodal training data into the second neural network for model training to obtain a trained humanoid robot task planning model;  according to the task track data,  performing parameter optimization on the action output layer in the trained first neural network,  obtaining a second neural network,  comprising :  obtaining the target loss function,  and obtaining the track sample data according to the task track data;  performing sample advantage analysis on the track sample data to obtain sample advantage data;  performing loss analysis on the sample advantage data according to the target loss function to obtain a second target loss value;  according to the second target loss value,  performing parameter optimization on the action output layer in the trained first neural network,  obtaining the second neural network.

The present disclosure provides a method,  device,  equipment and medium for target following of a legged robot. The method includes :  performing bounding box representation on a following target to obtain a real-time bounding box; match the coordinates of the center point of the real-time detection frame with the coordinates of the center point of the real-time bounding box to obtain the coordinates of the following point; coordinate transformation of the following point coordinates to obtain the point cloud center coordinates; each point in the point cloud in the passable area is used as a vertex,  and the weight of the edges between the vertices is set to construct a passing point cloud image; the point corresponding to the center coordinate of the point cloud is used as the source point,  the preset background point is used as the sink point,  and the minimum cut is identified from the traffic point cloud image to obtain the point cloud cluster; control the legged robot to follow the following target in real time through the point cloud clustering cluster corresponding to the following target. So that the robot can not only accurately lock the following target,  but also autonomously avoid obstacles in a dynamically changing environment,  ensuring the stability and safety of the following process. 1. A foot-type robot target following method,  wherein it comprises :  performing boundary frame representation to the following target in the previous video frame collected by the foot-type robot to obtain the real-time boundary frame of the following target;  matching the central point coordinate of the real-time detecting frame of the current video frame and the central point coordinate of the real-time boundary frame to obtain the following point coordinate corresponding to the current video frame;  performing coordinate transformation on the following point coordinate to convert the following point coordinate to the radar coordinate system to obtain the point cloud central coordinate of the following point coordinate corresponding to the radar coordinate system;  obtaining the passable area corresponding to the foot-type robot under the current video frame;  taking each point in the point cloud in the passable area as the top point,  and setting the weight of the edges between the top points,  constructing to obtain the passing point cloud image;  taking the point corresponding to the central coordinate of the point cloud as the source point,  taking the preset background point as the sink point,  identifying the minimum cut from the passing point cloud picture to divide the target of the passing point cloud picture to obtain the point cloud cluster corresponding to the following target;  through the point cloud cluster corresponding to the following target,  controlling the foot type robot to follow the following target in real time.

A human-like variable impedance control method based on human-machine stiffness mapping,  including :  constructing an extended DMP frame on a two-dimensional spherical manifold,  and uniformly modeling the motion trajectory,  end stiffness and contact force information in human multi-modal demonstration; based on spinor theory,  the kinematics model of human upper body is established,  and a hierarchical task control strategy is adopted,  with end pose tracking as the main task and chassis movement and arm configuration coordination as the secondary tasks Combining the difference between demonstration force and human-machine operation,  a humanoid variable impedance control law is designed to achieve closed-loop tracking of the desired force/torque; when working,  the system learns movement and interaction strategies from human body demonstrations,  and generates coordinated and compliant vehicle-arm coordinated actions. The beneficial effects are :  no singularity in the direction trajectory,  integrated reproduction of motion-stiffness-force,  strong coupling coordination of the vehicle arm,  compliant interaction and adaptability,  which significantly improves the robot's humanoid performance and environmental adaptability in tasks such as handling. 1. A humanoid variable impedance control method based on man-machine rigidity mapping,  for controlling the vehicle arm cooperative robot to perform compliant operation task,  wherein it specifically comprises the following steps :  step S1. establishing a uniform model of the human multi-mode demonstration information under the two-dimensional spherical manifold expanding DMP frame,  wherein the tail end position track of the human demonstration is modelled in the Euclidean space,  and the tail end posture track is modelled on the two-dimensional spherical manifold;  step S2. combining the two-dimensional spherical manifold expansion DMP frame modelling in the step S1 and establishing the human upper half body kinematics model based on the rotation amount theory,  using the layered task control strategy to perform the motion adjusting method of human-computer physical interaction,  so that the robot can adapt to the dynamic change of the environment;  step S3. under the motion adjusting method of the step S2,  obtaining the rigidity of the upper limb end of the human body through disturbance method or sEMG estimation method,  generating the expected rigidity matrix of the robot through the mapping relation constructing a human-like variable impedance model based on the expanded DMP frame and the rigidity of the tail end of the human upper limb;  step S4. obtaining the robot multi-mode demonstration information based on the humanoid variable impedance model of step S3,  designing the robot humanoid variable impedance controller,  dynamically adjusting the expected position and posture to accurately track the expected contact force/moment.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot control,  and discloses a dual-arm cooperative control method of a wheeled humanoid robot. The method first obtains the environment,  task and robot's own global data and establishes a dual-arm DH model; decompose the task through the hierarchical task network algorithm,  and combine the deep learning algorithm to select the master arm plus slave arm or double arm collaboration mode; the corresponding master-slave or parallel cooperative control method is adopted for different modes. The invention realizes accurate matching between control strategies and operation modes,  improves operation accuracy,  collaborative efficiency and scene adaptability,  ensures operation stability and reliability,  and is suitable for complex operation scenes. 1. A double-arm cooperative control method for wheel-type humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  obtaining the environment state,  the task information and the global data of the robot self state,  establishing a robot double-arm DH model;  S2 :  based on the global data obtained by S1,  decomposing the task through layered task network algorithm;  S3 :  performing behaviour mode selection of two arms according to deep learning algorithm based on task decomposition result,  wherein the behaviour mode is divided into a master arm and a slave arm mode and a two-arm cooperative mode;  S4 :  The control method comprises a master-slave cooperative control method and a parallel cooperative control method,  which are respectively corresponding to the master-slave arm mode and the double-arm cooperative mode.

A robot motion learning method assisted by multi-stage courses belongs to the technical field of robot motion control The invention solves the problems that the existing method is still difficult to realize the accurate control of the jump distance and the landing point,  has poor real-time performance and has poor generalization ability among multiple types of jump targets Combining the staged reward shaping and whole-body coordination guidance mechanism,  the humanoid robot can form a stable angular momentum management and body coordination mode at each key stage,  which not only improves the jump performance and landing point accuracy,  but also significantly enhances the posture recovery ability and anti-disturbance performance in high-impact scenarios. Two core technologies of torque control domain optimization and friction identification compensation are proposed,  so that the training strategy is subject to dynamic constraints consistent with real hardware during the simulation stage. The feasibility of the strategy is greatly improved by constructing a continuously differentiable moment-angular velocity feasible region model and identifying friction parameters based on the improved Stribeck model. The method of the present invention can be applied to robot motion control 1. A multi-stage course-assisted robot action learning method,  wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps :  step one,  respectively constructing the input state vectors of the Actor network and the Critic network in the Actor-Critic architecture,  wherein the input state vector of the Actor network is the observation quantity obtained by the main body sensing,  and the input state vector of the Critic network is the privilege information;  step ,  the Actor network and Critic network in the Actor-Critic architecture are trained in three stages of mastering,  expanding and deploying;  Firstly,  the training in the mastering stage is performed,  and the switching condition from the mastering stage to the extension stage is as follows :  in the mastering stage,  the average survival time length of the humanoid robot in the environment reaches the set threshold value;  The switching condition from the extension stage to the deployment stage is :  both the terrain course and the instruction course in the expansion stage have been converged stably;  after the deployment stage is executed,  returning to the expansion stage again to continue the training,  after the training is converged,  obtaining the trained Actor network;  step three,  taking the actual state vector of the humanoid robot as the input of the trained Actor network,  outputting the action through the trained Actor network,  and then converting the output action into the control instruction of the humanoid robot.

The invention provides a humanoid robot control method and system based on reinforcement learning The method comprises the following steps of :  planning a path of a humanoid robot by adopting a robot control model according to the current position of the humanoid robot,  a palletizing task and residual energy to obtain an optimal path,  and performing control processing of the humanoid robot in a target palletizing area according to the optimal path; the robot control model is trained through GNN graph neural network,  reinforcement learning and Monte Carlo tree search methods. The beneficial effects of the invention are :  improving the handling efficiency of humanoid robots,  reducing energy consumption and enhancing the flexibility of path planning. 1. A humanoid robot control method based on intensive learning,  wherein it comprises :  according to the current position,  the stacking task and the residual energy of the humanoid robot,  using the robot control model to plan the path of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the optimal path,  according to the optimal path,  executing the control processing of the humanoid robot in the target stacking area;  The robot control model is obtained by the following steps :  determining the conveying constraint of the robot according to the height constraint of the classified stacking point,  the task finishing time constraint and the path conflict constraint,  and determining the target function according to the conveying constraint;  obtaining the training data,  constructing the node characteristic and side characteristic of the GNN graph neural network through the training data,  performing graph convolution processing to the node characteristic and side characteristic through the GNN graph neural network to obtain the embedded representation;  performing reinforcement learning training according to the embedded representation and the target function to obtain a first optimal prediction path;  reasoning the optimal carrying path of the first prediction path by Monte Carlo tree searching method to obtain a second optimal prediction path;  executing the training of the preset times to obtain the robot control model.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot control,  and provides a control method,  system,  equipment,  medium and program for a humanoid robot. The control method includes :  controlling an environment sensing unit to scan an operating area and generate first environment point cloud data representing a static map; control the visual perception unit to collect and obtain the pose data of the target object; control the force feedback unit integrated at the end of the robotic arm actuator to detect the force feedback data of the robotic arm actuator during the process of contacting the target object; generate the motion trajectory of the robotic arm actuator according to the pose data,  the first environmental point cloud data and the preset operation strategy library; control the environment sensing unit to scan the operating area in real time and generate second environment point cloud data representing the distribution of dynamic obstacles; correct the motion trajectory in real time according to the second environment point cloud data to obtain the obstacle avoidance path. The invention is used to solve the problem of safe operation and high-precision operation of humanoid robots in dynamically changing environments. 1. A control method of humanoid robot,  applied to a humanoid robot system comprising a visual sensing unit,  an environment sensing unit,  a mechanical arm executing mechanism and a force sense feedback unit,  wherein the control method comprises :  controlling the environment sensing unit to scan the working region and generate the first environment point cloud data representing the static map;  controlling the visual sensing unit to collect and obtain the pose data of the target object;  a force sense feedback unit integrated at the tail end of the mechanical arm executing mechanism for detecting the force sense feedback data of the mechanical arm executing mechanism in the process of contacting the target object;  judging whether the abnormal state is triggered according to the pose data and the force sense feedback data;  when the abnormal state is not triggered,  identifying the arrangement type of the target material frame in the work area according to the pose data;  matching the unstacking strategy or stacking strategy corresponding to the material frame arrangement type from the preset operation strategy base as the current execution strategy;  when triggering the abnormal state,  selecting the abnormal processing strategy as the current execution strategy;  based on the current execution strategy,  combining the space coordinate and attitude angle of the target material frame in the attitude data,  and the first environment point cloud data,  calculating the tail end actuator path and joint motion sequence of the mechanical arm,  generating the motion track of the mechanical arm execution mechanism;  in the process of driving the mechanical arm executing mechanism to perform the pose movement,  controlling the environment sensing unit to scan the working area in real time and generate the second environment point cloud data representing the dynamic obstacle distribution;  correcting the motion track in real time according to the second environmental point cloud data to obtain an obstacle avoiding path;  controlling the mechanical arm executing mechanism to continuously execute the pose movement along the real-time obstacle-avoiding path;  according to the force sense feedback data,  dynamically adjusting the operation force of the mechanical arm executing mechanism relative to the target object.

The present application relates to the field of robot control technology,  specifically,  to an adaptive joint control method and system for humanoid robots. Including :  obtaining relative motion information,  motion state information and internal mechanical state information to form comprehensive sensing data; based on comprehensive sensing data,  contact prediction is performed to complete contact risk judgment and determine potential contact areas; in response to the contact prediction result,  a compliance control command is sent to the joint driver in the potential contact area through a fast command channel independent of the conventional trajectory position control process,  so that the joint is adjusted from a high stiffness state to a low stiffness state within a preset response time. It solves the safety risk and equipment damage problems that may be caused by accidental contact with the outside when the humanoid robot performs high-precision assembly tasks in a high-stiffness control state,  as well as the technical problems of lagging response of the existing safety protection mechanism. 1. A self-adaptive joint control method for humanoid robot,  wherein it is applied to the scene where the humanoid robot performs sub-millimetre level high-precision assembly task and at least part of the joint is in high rigidity control state,  the method comprises :  obtaining the relative movement information between the external object and the human-shaped robot,  the movement state information of the human-shaped robot and the internal mechanical state information of the joint driving device to form the comprehensive sensing data;  wherein the relative movement information at least comprises distance information and relative speed information between the external object and the human-shaped robot,  the movement state information at least comprises joint speed information and joint acceleration information,  the internal mechanical state information at least comprises joint motor current information and joint moment information;  performing contact prediction based on the comprehensive sensing data to obtain a contact prediction result;  wherein the contact prediction comprises :  and determining a potential contact area,  the contact risk determination is based on one or more of the following conditions :  the distance information is less than a preset safe distance threshold,  and the relative speed information is greater than a preset approaching speed threshold;  in the preset time window,  the joint motor current information and/or joint moment information appears abnormal fast fluctuation exceeding the preset change threshold value,  wherein the potential contact area is determined according to the joint satisfying the condition of the contact risk and/or the joint closest to the external object;  in response to the contact prediction result,  through the fast instruction channel independent from the normal track position control flow,  sending a compliance control instruction to the joint driver in the potential contact area,  so that the joint in the potential contact area is adjusted from a high rigidity state to a low rigidity state within a preset response time,  Wherein,  the compliance control instruction comprises :  The joint control mode is switched from position control to torque control or impedance control,  and/or the maximum output torque of the joint is limited to a predetermined safety torque upper limit.

This application provides a method and device for predicting distance and attitude planning before grasping a humanoid robot The method comprises the following steps of :  setting a torque monitoring parameter of each joint of two arms on the basis of the initial bearing torque and monitoring,  wherein the maximum deviation between an actual monitored torque value of the joint near the center of mass and a preset initial bearing torque reference value is taken as a torque peak value difference of the joint near the center of mass; adjust the torque distribution according to the torque peak difference to reduce the vertical support torque on the near center of mass side and increase the compensation torque on the far center of mass side,  determine the target torque value of each joint,  and generate a joint torque distribution plan; execute the joint torque distribution scheme and verify the contact state of the near-center-of-mass side contact point,  compare the local deformation amount on the near-center-of-mass side with the preset slip instability limit,  and output the torque peak control result including the current torque balance state of both arms. 1. A pre-judging distance and posture planning method before human-shaped robot grabbing,  wherein the method comprises :  collecting the initial grabbing data of the object contact point,  obtaining the mass centre longitudinal offset distance of the object and the elastic modulus of the near mass centre side surface,  according to the mass centre longitudinal offset distance and the elastic modulus of the near mass centre side surface,  determining the initial bearing moment of the near mass centre side arm;  setting the moment monitoring parameter of each joint of two arms based on the initial bearing moment and monitoring it,  wherein the maximum deviation between the actual monitoring moment value of the joint close to the mass centre side and the preset initial bearing moment reference value is used as the moment peak value difference of the joint close to the mass centre side;  adjusting the moment distribution according to the moment peak value difference so as to reduce the near centroid side vertical supporting moment and increase the far centroid side compensating moment,  determining the joint target moment value and generating the joint moment distribution solution.

The present application relates to the field of color paste,  and in particular to a color paste for humanoid robot skin and a preparation method thereof. A multi-modal cognitive large model anthropomorphic interactive optimization method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the user text,  the user voice and the human face video during the interaction,  forming multi-mode interaction segment sequence data with the time stamp according to the session turn;  S2,  inputting the multi-modal interactive segment sequence data into the common-situation clue synchronous fusion model,  determining the turn segmentation time according to the dialog turn,  determining the voice rhythm time according to the voice pause and the emphasizing sound,  and intercepting the human face frame according to the voice rhythm time to form the synchronous segment sequence,  orderly extracting semantic feature from the synchronous segment sequence,  calculating a shielding index,  a noise index and a contradiction index to obtain a reliability parameter set,  fusing based on the reliability parameter set to obtain an emotional cognitive state result,  wherein the emotional cognitive state result comprises an emotional cognitive state vector,  an uncertainty and a reliability parameter set;  S3,  searching the user portrait library according to the emotion cognition state result to obtain the user cognition state,  combining the user cognition state and the emotion cognition state result to form a common condition decision state;  S4,  inputting the common situation decision state into the common situation policy control model,  based on the emotion cognitive state result in the common situation decision state,  judging the common situation requirement level and determining the common situation target,  under the constraint of the reliability parameter set,  calculating the language intensity,  the speech rhythm intensity and the image action intensity form a common expression intensity parameter,  calculating the risk score based on the negative emotion intensity and the uncertainty,  comparing with the risk threshold value to obtain the safety control mark,  outputting the common strategy sequence arranged according to the dialog turn,  the common strategy sequence comprises the common demand level,  a common condition target,  a common condition expression intensity parameter,  a personality restriction and a safety control mark;  S5,  based on the common policy sequence and emotion cognitive state result,  the multi-mode cognitive large model generates multi-mode anthropomorphic response,  according to safety control mark output safety template or common response; The invention discloses a humanoid robot action redirection optimization method based on physical constraints,  and belongs to the field of humanoid robot imitation learning Existing action redirection technology does not fully consider the dynamic constraints and physical characteristics of the robot,  and is prone to problems such as non-physical floating,  ground penetration and insufficient dynamic stability when migrating highly dynamic actions. The invention obtains human motion data through motion capture and converts it into parameterized parameters. The redirection process introduces three types of physical constraint modules :  motion stability,  fuselage height,  and joint motion range. It uses a gradient descent algorithm to collaboratively optimize the constraint loss and task reconstruction loss.,  output robot joint trajectories that conform to physical laws The invention can eliminate non-physical movement phenomena,  improve dynamic stability and physical rationality of movements,  provide guarantee for accurate transfer of high dynamic movements,  and is suitable for humanoid robot imitation learning scenes. 1. A humanoid robot action redirection optimization method based on physical constraint,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining human body complex motion data,  converting the human body complex motion data into parameterized motion key parameter by human body model calculation,  the motion key parameter at least comprises human body motion follow-up coordinate system and space position posture of each joint;  S2,  converting the parameterized motion key parameter into the initial motion parameter suitable for the robot model through the redirection process,  generating the initial motion track of the robot joint space;  S3,  introducing three types of physical constraint modules in the redirection process,  wherein the three types of physical constraint modules are respectively a motion stability constraint module,  a machine body height constraint module and a joint motion range constraint module;  S4,  using gradient descent algorithm to cooperatively optimize the constraint loss corresponding to the three physical constraint modules and the task reconstruction loss,  adjusting the initial motion track,  and outputting the target motion track in accordance with the dynamic characteristic and physical rule of the robot.

The present invention overcomes the existing multi-legged robot by moving long distances by running and walking,  or by jumping on its legs when there is an obstacle,  and grabbing,  pulling,  or pushing with rotating pincer-type legs. When there is an obstacle,  the drone performs its mission by flying diagonally or upward,  down,  left,  right,  and backward. When robots and drones approach obstacles that correspond to the limit of each obstacle situation,  they cannot move and move forward,  and the main problem is that they cannot move long distances in a short time. Drones do not move forward by removing and damaging obstacles,  but only by flying,  avoiding obstacles and moving to perform their missions. By moving the robot over a long distance in a short time and the drone folding its wings or performing the tasks imposed according to the obstacles of the pre-identified terrain,  the robot has the advantage of being able to quickly escape when the robot is hindered by high obstacles and unexpected ground animals and vines due to the movement of the robot,  or by emergency in swamps and underwater. Due to the fine adjustment of the drone,  the operation environment of the drone is greatly hindered by the surrounding weather and terrain features,  and the maintenance of the state that does not require accurate position and movement is solved by the functions of the multi-legged robot in the walking and driving stationary state.

The invention discloses an anthropomorphic motion planning method,  an anthropomorphic motion planning device and an anthropomorphic motion planning medium based on action primitives. The anthropomorphic motion planning method,  the anthropomorphic motion planning device and the anthropomorphic motion planning medium based on the action primitives comprise the following steps of :  dividing a task to be executed into sub-tasks,  and planning an execution sequence of the sub-tasks according to task requirements; capturing the motion data of the human arm when executing each subtask,  and extracting and fitting the action primitives under each task to construct the action primitive library of each subtask; the action primitive library of each subtask is used as a carrier to transfer the motion skills of the human arm to the anthropomorphic arm to realize the anthropomorphic motion planning of the redundant robotic arm. The invention can greatly reduce the amount of data while improving the robot's adaptability to tasks. 1. A humanoid motion planning method based on motion primitive,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) performing sub-task division on the task to be executed,  and planning the execution order of the sub-task according to the task requirement;  (2) capturing the movement data of the human arm when executing each sub-task,  and extracting and fitting and quantizing the action basic element under each task,  constructing the action basic element library of each sub-task;  the action primitive extraction is specifically :  (2.1) Calculating the position of each frame of motion from the motion data of the human arm posture and an elbow rotation angle ;  (2.2) Position of motion for each frame posture and an elbow rotation angle performing smoothing treatment by filtering algorithm;  (2.3) screening the effective motion segment by judging the value of the hand speed;  if the speed is not zero,  it is effective motion;  (2.4) identifying an action element for each frame of valid motion,  the action element comprising a rate of position change,  a rate of attitude change,  and a rate of elbow rotation angle change;  (2.5) combining the adjacent frame number and the action unit with the same type,  obtaining the whole action unit of the whole effective motion segment;  the action element with the same type is that the elements contained in the action element are the same;  the element comprises a position change rate,  a posture change rate and an elbow rotation angle change rate;  (3) transferring the movement skill of the human arm to the anthropomorphic arm by using the movement base of each sub-task as the carrier.

The invention discloses a building model reconstruction method and system based on a quadruped robot and machine vision. Based on the quadruped robot equipped with a laser scanner,  a global map of an area to be reconstructed is generated by using synchronous positioning and map construction technology. Combine three-dimensional ray tracing and A * path search algorithm to determine the target scanning point and perform global path planning. Based on the high-precision sensor carried by the quadruped robot,  the adaptive Monte Carlo positioning and improved dynamic window method algorithm are used to achieve the precise positioning and obstacle avoidance of the quadruped robot in complex environments. After moving to the target scanning point,  the robot stops and starts the laser scanner to collect high-precision point cloud data until all sampling is completed. After preprocessing the collected point cloud data,  a 3D building model is generated through point cloud registration and Poisson surface reconstruction technology. The invention can realize comprehensive,  efficient and accurate three-dimensional reconstruction in a complex building environment 1. A building model reconstruction method based on four-foot robot and machine vision,  wherein Specifically,  the method includes :  Step 1 (S1) :  obtaining the three-dimensional point cloud data of the reconstruction area and the IMU pose data of the four-legged robot,  using synchronous positioning and map construction algorithm,  performing environment sensing and mapping on the reconstruction area,  obtaining a global map;  step S2 :  based on the global map,  combining the three-dimensional light tracing algorithm and A* path searching algorithm,  determining the target scanning point and the corresponding scanning path,  and generating the global path plan;  step S3 :  planning the four-foot robot to start to walk according to the generated global path,  in the walking process of the four-foot robot,  realizing the real-time global positioning of the four-foot robot based on the self-adaptive Monte Carlo positioning algorithm and combined with the sensor data;  using the improved DWA algorithm to plan the local path;  step S4 :  the four-foot robot stops after reaching the target scanning point,  and starts the laser scanner to collect the point cloud data and RGB data;  after the collection is finished,  the four-foot robot plans according to the global path in the step S2 and repeats the step S3 to move to the next target scanning point until all original point cloud data collection is finished;  step S5 :  pre-processing all collected original point cloud data to obtain pre-processed point cloud data;  step S6 :  using the multi-mode data fusion registration method to the pre-processed point cloud data to obtain the reconstructed three-dimensional building model;  The step S2 specifically comprises :  extracting the geometric centre line of the navigable space from the global map of the two-dimensional grid to generate the topological skeleton map,  and converting the discretized geometric centre line node Vj into the three-dimensional candidate scanning point set Pj by the improved centre line transformation algorithm;  initializing the target point set T as an empty set,  and selecting a point Pmax covering the maximum value of the score from the candidate scanning point set Pj to add T;  setting the minimum distance dmin between two adjacent target scanning points to avoid the redundancy of the scanning data;  obtaining a target scanning point set T;  after determining the target scanning point set T,  using the A* algorithm to plan the path,  calculating the shortest path and avoiding the collision with the barrier,  generating the primary path;  after generating the primary path,  considering the kinematics restriction of the robot,  optimizing the path,  obtaining the global path plan.

The invention provides a visual perception and control method suitable for wheel-legged robot inspection,  and belongs to the technical field of image processing Collecting raw low-light images of industrial equipment; input the original low-light image into the low-light image enhancement model for image enhancement; the low-light image enhancement model processing process includes :  inputting the image into the U-net network to predict noise; denoising the original image based on the predicted noise to obtain a reconstructed image as an enhanced image; map the reconstructed image from the spatial domain to the frequency domain to obtain a frequency domain representation; frequency division is performed on the frequency domain representation,  and learnable weights are assigned to each frequency band,  and frequency domain constraint terms are constructed based on the weighted results. This method introduces uncertainty network in the inversion stage of the diffusion model,  adaptively adjusts the weight of the noise branch and residual branch according to the pixel-level uncertainty and time steps,  strengthens denoising in the high-noise area,  and retains the structure in the detail area; enhance the balance between image details and brightness,  and the output is natural and smooth; achieve dynamic balance in different regions and stages. 1. The invention discloses a quadruped robot fire inspection,  judgment and disposal closed-loop method,  system and medium,  which relate to the technical field of fire safety. The method includes :  obtaining multi-modal data to identify abnormal signs,  and extracting and generating multiple event nodes to construct an event map; generating structured retrieval request,  obtaining retrieval result related to current inspection scene,  and constructing scene constraint condition set; using the event map,  the set of scene constraints and the resource status of the quadruped robot as inputs,  using a large language model to generate structured research and judgment conclusions and domain action languages; consistency verification is performed on the domain action language,  and when the consistency verification is passed,  the quadruped robot is driven to execute the atomic skill instruction sequence and obtain multi-modal feedback data; perform status write-back updates on the event map based on the generated execution evidence chain. This method can realize the structured closed-loop execution of fire inspection research,  judgment and disposal,  and improve the reliability and traceability of the system in complex scenarios. 1. A closed-loop method for four-legged robot fire inspection,  inspection,  judgment and treatment,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the multi-mode data collected by the four-foot robot in the inspecting process of the area to be inspected,  identifying the abnormal symptom in the multi-mode data,  extracting and generating multiple event nodes based on the abnormal symptom,  constructing the event map dynamically updated along with the inspecting process;  generating a structured search request based on the event map,  obtaining a search result related to the current inspection scene from the knowledge base according to the structured search request,  and constructing a scene constraint condition set based on the search result;  using the event map,  the scene constraint condition set and the resource state of the four-foot robot as the input,  using the large language model to generate the structured judging conclusion and the corresponding field action language;  performing consistency check on the generated field action language,  when the consistency check is passed,  driving the four-foot robot to execute the atomic skill instruction sequence corresponding to the field action language,  and obtaining the multimodal feedback data in the process of executing the atomic skill instruction sequence;  according to the multimodal feedback data and the event map,  generating an execution certificate chain,  and performing state write-back updating on the event map based on the execution certificate chain.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot whole-body interactive control method and system based on physical perception redirection and space-time decoupling strategies This method first converts large-scale human-human interaction data into a human-humanoid robot interaction trajectory that maintains contact semantics and physical consistency through the physical perception interaction redirection module,  which achieves precise contact maintenance through multi-constraint objective functions and two-stage optimization; reconstructing a structured dataset with stage annotations; then use the space-time decoupling action reasoning network to integrate long and short time series coding,  phase attention and multi-scale space coding to generate high-level action anchor points; finally,  it is converted into executable commands by the whole body controller The invention solves the problems of contact semantic destruction,  insufficient spatio-temporal reasoning,  difficult migration of simulated real machines and the like in traditional methods,  significantly improves the naturalness,  robustness and implementability of interaction,  and is suitable for various social interaction scenes such as hugs and handshakes. 1. A human-shaped robot systemic interactive control method based on physical sensing redirection and space-time decoupling strategy,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining large-scale human-human interaction data,  converting the human-human interaction data into a human-human robot interaction track keeping contact semanteme and physical consistency by a physical sensing interaction redirection module;  the physical sensing interaction redirection module through constructing comprises kinematics similarity loss,  contact semantic maintenance loss,  human side action fidelity loss and posture regular term of the total target function,  and adopt two stage optimization strategy solving,  to obtain the human-human robot interaction track;  performing task division and stage marking on the obtained human-human robot interaction track,  the stage of marking comprises a preparation stage,  an execution stage and a ending stage,  constructing a structured interaction data set for strategy learning;  based on the structured interaction data set,  using space-time decoupling action reasoning network to learn multi-task systemic interaction strategy;  the space-time decoupling action reasoning network obtains the time characteristic through the long and short time sequence encoder coding history observation,  generates the stage sensing characteristic through the phase attention module,  codes the human-machine geometric relation through the multi-scale space module to obtain the space characteristic,  fuses the time characteristic,  the stage sensing characteristic,  the space characteristic and the text task instruction are embedded in the vector,  the diffusion type planning head is input to generate the high layer action anchor point sequence;  the high-layer action anchor point sequence is densified into the reference track,  and is converted into the executable control command of the simulation or real human-shaped robot by the whole body controller so as to realize the human-human-shaped robot whole body interaction.

The present invention provides an interactive robotic head system and method for synchronized multimodal human-machine interaction. The system comprises a modular humanoid enclosure housing a vision acquisition unit,  a digital audio interface,  and an actuation control unit. A central processing unit executes a multi-threaded framework using shared memory and direct memory access to asynchronously process image frames and audio signals. The system extracts positional attributes for real-time head tracking and generates multimodal payloads,  combining text and synchronized visual data for remote computational processing. An actuation control unit,  featuring an independent pulse generation controller,  drives a plurality of rotary actuators for neck and mandible movement. To ensure stability,  a dual-rail power architecture isolates logic circuitry from actuator-induced transients. The method specifically synchronizes mechanical jaw movement with audio playback progression. The invention ensures non-blocking execution,  reduced computational overhead,  and contextual coherence between linguistic input and visual perception for realistic interaction.

The present disclosure provides a method for controlling a humanoid robot using a hierarchical bipedal action model (BAM),  the method comprising obtaining a base controller by training in simulation with reinforcement learning,  instantiating an initial BAM including a Gamma model configured to generate intermediate goals,  a Beta model configured to translate the intermediate goals into task-space actions,  and an Alpha model configured to translate the task-space actions and robot state into motor commands,  deploying the initial BAM such that at least the Alpha model executes on-board the humanoid robot,  causing the humanoid robot to perform an initial task and logging sensor and control data to form a first dataset,  based on the first dataset,  training at least one policy of the BAM to generate a refined BAM,  and deploying the refined BAM to control the humanoid robot autonomously.

The present disclosure provides a control system for a humanoid robot comprising a bipedal action model (BAM) with hierarchical architecture including a beta model executing cognitive tasks at lower frequency,  ingesting multimodal sensory inputs including visual data and natural language instructions,  and an alpha model executing reactive tasks at higher frequency,  communicatively coupled to the beta model. The BAM is trained on retargeted robot training data derived from robot-free training data. At runtime,  the BAM outputs continuous control commands as parallel-generated action chunks controlling at least 18 degrees of freedom. The system includes a wearable collection apparatus capturing movement data from a human operator without physical connection to the robot,  and a retargeting module translating robot-free training data into robot training data by solving embodiment mismatches between human and robot kinematic structures.

The upper arm assembly includes an upper arm,  a shoulder joint motor and an elbow joint motor. The upper arm includes an elbow joint end and a shoulder joint end. The elbow joint motor includes a second housing and a second rotating shaft. The second housing is connected to the elbow joint end of the upper arm. At least one of the first housing and the second housing is integrated with the upper arm. An integrated design of the upper arm meets lightweight and low-cost needs of the humanoid robot,  and thus meets requirements of industrial applications.

The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot system comprising a mechanical structure with at least 30 degrees of freedom across torso,  arms,  and legs,  actuators driving the degrees of freedom,  sensors including cameras and proprioceptive sensors,  and a computing system implementing a hierarchical bipedal action model (BAM). The BAM includes :  a Delta model processing sensor data and user input to generate latent representations at a first frequency;  a Gamma model receiving latent representations to generate human task actions at a higher second frequency;  a Beta model translating task actions into joint configurations at a higher third frequency;  and an Alpha model converting joint configurations into actuator control signals at a higher fourth frequency.

The present disclosure relates to a humanoid robot self-collision avoidance method,  robot,  equipment and program product The method comprises determining a self-collision avoidance control torque and a joint control torque of a corresponding link based on any link in a target link pair,  and determining a self-collision avoidance control torque and a joint control torque of a front link that affect the movement of the corresponding link; using a zero space projection matrix,  the joint control torque of the corresponding link and the joint control torque of the front link of the corresponding link are respectively projected into the zero space of the task corresponding to the self-collision avoidance control torque,  and the joint control torque of the corresponding link after projection and the joint control torque of the front link of the corresponding link after projection are obtained According to the first superimposed torque and the second superimposed torque,  the motion of the corresponding joint motor is controlled respectively. 1. A humanoid robot self-collision avoidance method,  wherein it comprises :  based on any connecting rod in the target connecting rod pair,  determining the self-collision avoidance control torque of the corresponding connecting rod and the self-collision avoidance control torque of the front connecting rod influencing the movement of the corresponding connecting rod,  and determining the joint control torque of the corresponding connecting rod and the joint control torque of the front connecting rod corresponding to the connecting rod,  wherein the target connecting rod pair is a connecting rod pair with collision risk;  using the zero space projection matrix,  respectively projecting the joint control moment of the corresponding connecting rod and the joint control moment of the front connecting rod of the corresponding connecting rod to the zero space of the task corresponding to the self-collision avoidance control moment,  obtaining the joint control moment corresponding to the connecting rod after projection and the joint control moment of the front connecting rod corresponding to the connecting rod after projection;  according to the first superposition moment,  controlling the movement of the corresponding joint motor,  and according to the second superposition moment,  controlling the movement of the corresponding joint motor,  wherein the first superposition moment is the moment obtained by superposing the projected joint control moment of the corresponding connecting rod and the self-collision avoidance control moment of the corresponding connecting rod,  the second superposition moment is the moment obtained by superposing the joint control moment of the front connecting rod of the corresponding connecting rod after projection and the self-collision avoidance control moment of the front connecting rod of the corresponding connecting rod.
