The invention discloses an intelligent planning method and an intelligent planning system for autonomous rising actions of a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring and fusing internal state and external environment information of the robot in real time to construct a mixed state vector; a deep reinforcement learning strategy network trained offline is used to output high-level action sequences based on mixed state vectors; a real-time optimizer based on model predictive control is used to convert behavioral semantic instructions into optimal state trajectories and optimal control trajectories; execute the first control quantity of the optimal control trajectory,  continuously monitor the actual state and compare the actual state with the predicted state of the real-time optimizer based on model predictive control,  calculate the deviation between the actual state and the predicted state,  and trigger If it is a small deviation,  local correction will be triggered,  and if it is a large deviation,  global replanning will be triggered The invention enables the robot to adaptively cope with various unknown falling postures through a hierarchical intelligent planning architecture,  quickly generates a safe,  stable and efficient getting-up trajectory,  and improves its autonomy and robustness. 1. An intelligent planning method for self-lifting action of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one,  collecting and fusing the internal state and the external environment information of the robot in real time,  constructing a mixed state vector S;  step two,  adopting the deep strengthening learning strategy network of off-line training to output the high-level action sequence according to the mixed state vector S;  step three,  using the real-time optimizer based on the model prediction control to convert the behaviour semantic instruction into the optimal state track and the optimal control track;  step four,  executing the first control amount of the optimal control track,  at the same time,  continuously monitoring the actual state and comparing the actual state with the prediction state of the real-time optimizer based on the model prediction control,  calculating the deviation between the actual state and the prediction state,  if it is small deviation,  then triggering the local correction,  if it is large deviation,  if so,  triggering the global re-planning.

A humanoid robot hierarchical skill fusion control method and system based on an attention mechanism relate to the field of humanoid robot control The method solves the problems of poor skill fusion weight adaptability,  unstable control and high energy consumption of the existing SkillBlender method. The method comprises the following steps of :  pre-training to obtain basic skill strategies of a plurality of humanoid robots,  and freezing parameters of all basic skills after the training is finished; construct a high-level controller to collect the status information and task target information of the humanoid robot at the current moment,  and perform feature coding through the status coding module to obtain a high-level status representation; generate learnable skill embedding vectors for each basic skill through the skill embedding module,  and generate attention fusion weights corresponding to each basic skill through the attention weight calculation module; the sub-target generation module generates a corresponding sub-target for each basic skill based on high-level state representation,  and inputs the current state and sub-target into the corresponding basic skill strategy to obtain the action output of each basic skill. 1. A humanoid robot hierarchical skill fusion control method based on attention mechanism,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one,  pre-training the basic skill to obtain a plurality of human-shaped robot basic skill strategies,  freezing the parameters of all basic skills after the training is finished;  step two,  based on the parameters of all basic skills after the training in the step one,  constructing a high layer controller,  the high layer controller comprises a state coding module,  a skill embedding module,  an attention weight calculating module,  a sub-target generating module and an action fusion module,  and using PPO algorithm to train the high layer controller;  step three,  collecting the state information and task target information of the humanoid robot at the current moment,  performing the characteristic coding by the state coding module in the step two to obtain the high-level state representation;  step four,  generating the learnable skill embedding vector for each basic skill through the skill embedding module,  combining the high-level state expression obtained in the step three,  generating the attention fusion weight corresponding to each basic skill through the attention weight calculating module;  step five,  through step two the sub-target generating module based on high layer state for each basic skill generating the corresponding sub-target,  the current state with sub-target input corresponding basic skill strategy,  to obtain each basic skill of the action output;  step ,  weighting and fusing the action output of each basic skill based on the attention fusion weight by the action fusion module in step to generate the final control instruction of the humanoid robot.

This application provides a multi-degree-of-freedom joint linkage control method and device for a humanoid robot The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a real-time moment value of an ankle joint,  inertia absorption sharing amount of knee joints,  hip joints and ankle joints and front and back acceleration data of a head; comparing the real-time moment value of the ankle joint with a preset rated range to judge the degree of the moment of the ankle part approaching the rated range; evaluating ankle moment saturation trends and determining saturation intervals based on the degree of approach to the nominal range; adjust the inertia absorption sharing ratio of the knee,  hip and ankle joints according to the saturation interval; calculating the residual inertia according to the adjusted inertia absorption sharing ratio of knee,  hip and ankle joints,  determining the transferred inertia sharing amount,  monitoring the acceleration response on the front and rear axes of the head based on the transferred inertia sharing amount to obtain the filtered front and rear acceleration peak of the head; fine-tune the inertia absorption sharing ratio of the three joints of the knee,  hip and ankle according to the degree of the filtered front and rear acceleration peak of the head exceeding the preset threshold. 1. A multi-degree-of-freedom joint linkage control method for humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the ankle joint real-time moment value,  the inertia absorption sharing amount of knee,  hip and ankle three joints and the head front and back acceleration data,  according to the ankle joint real-time moment value and the preset rated range to compare,  judging the degree of the ankle part moment approaching to the rated range;  evaluating the ankle joint moment saturation trend according to the degree approaching to the rated range and determining the saturation interval;  adjusting the inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee-hip-ankle three-joint according to the saturation interval;  according to the adjusted inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee,  hip and ankle three joints,  calculating the residual inertia amount,  determining the transferred inertia sharing amount,  based on the transferred inertia sharing amount,  monitoring the acceleration response on the front and back axial lines of the head part to obtain the front and back acceleration peak value of the filtered head part;  according to the degree that the front and back acceleration peak value of the filtered head exceeds the preset threshold value,  finely adjusting the inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee,  hip and ankle;  the inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee,  hip and ankle three joints after fine adjustment is applied to the joint driving assembly to obtain the ankle joint real-time moment value in the deceleration process,  the joint linkage control parameters are updated by the iterative optimization method,  and the head shaking amplitude of the trunk point in the deceleration switching process is confirmed to be inhibited.

The invention provides a humanoid robot adaptive grabbing system and method for mixed-flow assembly of industrial parts Belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence,  precision instruments,  and component assembly logistics The system comprises a material attribute analysis module and a visual feedback adjustment module which run on a built-in computer of the robot,  an image acquisition module fixed on the head of the robot,  and a self-adaptive grabbing module positioned on the hand of the robot,  wherein the image acquisition module and the self-adaptive grabbing module are both connected with the built-in computer of the robot Obtain the optical image of the target parts on the assembly line,  classify the material attributes and evaluate the vulnerability of multiple heterogeneous target parts,  and dynamically generate robot hand control parameters that match the material. The invention solves the problems of subfissure,  scratch or deformation of parts caused by single control parameter when the traditional manipulator faces fragile,  flexible and rigid mixed industrial parts on the assembly line,  and realizes low-cost,  high-precision flexible self-adaptive grabbing. 1. A human-shaped robot self-adaptive grabbing system for mixed-flow assembly of industrial parts,  the system is applied to the assembly line of different material parts,  it comprises a material attribute analysis module and a visual feedback adjusting module running on the robot built-in computer,  an image collecting module fixed on the head part of the robot,  and a self-adaptive grabbing module located on the hand part of the robot,  and the image collecting module and the self-adaptive grabbing module are connected with the robot built-in computer,  wherein The image collecting module is used for collecting the image of the target component on the assembly line,  which comprises :  an optical image sensing camera,  a buffer register,  a data transmission interface,  wherein :  the optical image sensing camera is used for shooting the target part image on the assembly line in the visual angle range,  and converting the light signal of the target part image into the first digital image;  the buffer register is used for storing the first digital image;  the data transmission interface is used for transmitting the first digital image registered by the buffer register to the robot internal computer;  The robot built-in computer is used for performing core algorithm calculation and processing the first digital image from the image collecting module,  on which :  a material attribute analysis module,  for performing deep feature analysis on the first digital image of the image collecting module,  and quantizing and outputting the material type and vulnerable risk index of the target component,  which comprises :  an image pre-processing unit,  a feature fusion unit,  a vulnerability evaluation unit,  wherein the image pre-processing unit is used for performing standard processing to the first digital image of the image collecting module,  the operation comprises Gaussian filtering de-noising and histogram equalization enhancement,  so as to eliminate the light uneven on the assembly line and sensor bottom noise interference,  forming a standard image;  the feature fusion unit is used for extracting the texture feature and the colour feature from the standard image Iraw,  and calculating the material type and the material confidence grade of the target part by the weighted fusion algorithm,  the texture feature is used for distinguishing the target part with smooth surface and rough surface;  the vulnerability evaluation unit is used for combining the material confidence score output by the characteristic fusion unit and the preset industrial component hardness coefficient,  calculating and outputting the vulnerability risk index representing the target component vulnerability degree through weighted summation ;  a visual feedback adjusting module,  which is used for monitoring the state of the target component in real time during the grabbing and executing process,  and triggering a closed-loop correction when an abnormality is detected,  which comprises :  a sliding detection unit,  a dynamic supplement unit,  wherein the sliding detection unit is used for calculating the light flow displacement vector of the target part area in the grabbing and lifting stage,  when the vertical displacement component exceeds the preset threshold value,  judging as the sliding state;  the dynamic supplementing unit is used for dynamically calculating the angle increment according to the sliding speed after receiving the sliding state signal,  and generating a secondary clamping correction control signal;  the self-adaptive grabbing module is used for receiving the vulnerability risk index from the vulnerability evaluation unit in the material attribute analysis module,  and the correction control signal of the secondary clamping in the dynamic supplement unit of the visual feedback adjusting module,  and driving the robot hand to perform grabbing action according to it,  it comprises :  a speed planning unit,  an angle limiting unit,  wherein a speed planning unit for calculating the closed target speed of the robot hand joint according to the vulnerable risk index,  generating a low-speed instruction for the target component with high vulnerable risk,  reducing the contact impact,  and generating a standard speed instruction for the rigid target component with low vulnerable risk;  an angle limiting unit,  for calculating the maximum allowable closing angle of the robot hand joint according to the vulnerable risk index,  generating an angle control signal allowing a larger interference stroke for the flexible target component,  generating an angle control signal limiting the extrusion stroke for the fragile target component,  so as to realize the flexible self-adaptive grabbing of different material parts.

The invention relates to the field of robots,  and provides a material box holding and clamping device,  a humanoid robot and a material conveying system The material box holding and clamping device is used for grabbing the material box. Limiting grooves are symmetrically formed in two side walls of the material box. The material box holding and clamping device comprises at least one pair of symmetrically arranged connecting modules used for being installed at a preset position A claw module arranged corresponding to the connecting module,  the claw module comprises a connecting frame,  a supporting block and a pressing plate,  and the connecting frame is used to connect with the connecting module; the supporting block is connected with the connecting frame and forms a limiting protrusion,  and the limiting protrusion is used for being inserted into the limiting groove The pressure plate is used to limit and fix the material box to limit the limit protrusion from coming out of the limit groove. This application proposes a material box holding and clamping device,  which reduces the accuracy requirements when transporting material boxes and improves material transfer efficiency. 1. A material box clamping device,  wherein it is used for grabbing material box (5),  two side walls of the material box (5) are symmetrically provided with a limiting groove (51),  comprising :  at least one pair of symmetrically arranged connecting modules (1) for mounting to a preset position;  a claw module (2) corresponding to the connecting module (1),  the claw module (2) comprises a connecting frame (21),  a supporting block (22) and a pressing plate (23),  the connecting frame (21) is used for connecting with the connecting module (1);  the supporting block (22) is connected with the connecting frame (21),  and is formed with a limiting bulge (221),  the limiting bulge (221) is used for inserting into the limiting groove (51);  the pressing plate (23) is used for limiting and fixing with the material box (5),  so as to limit the limiting bulge (221) from the limiting groove (51).

The invention provides a humanoid robot motion test platform,  which includes a base,  a belt motion mechanism,  a height adjustment device and a control system. The height adjustment device includes :  a linear drive mechanism,  the bottom of which is hinged to the base; the first sliding mechanism is connected to the output end of the linear driving mechanism; the second sliding mechanism is in sliding fit with the first sliding mechanism and is connected with the test platform; braking mechanism,  used to limit the relative movement of the two When changing slope,  the two sliding mechanisms slide relative to each other to automatically compensate for the spatial horizontal displacement difference and eliminate lateral force interference; after it is in place,  the braking mechanism laterally locks the sliding gap to form a rigid support. The invention can effectively resist the high-frequency and large-load trampling impact of the robot,  prevent the system from losing steps,  and realize the unity of smooth slope change and high-rigidity and high-precision testing. 1. A height adjusting device for humanoid robot motion test platform,  adjusting the gradient of the test platform (200),  wherein the device comprises :  a linear driving mechanism (110),  the bottom of which is connected with the base (100) in a hinged manner;  a first sliding mechanism (120) connected with the power output end of the linear driving mechanism (110);  a second sliding mechanism (130),  which is matched with the first sliding mechanism (120) to ensure that the two move in parallel,  and the second sliding mechanism (130) is connected with the test platform (200);  a brake mechanism (140) for limiting the relative movement of the first sliding mechanism (120) and the second sliding mechanism (130).

The invention discloses a high dynamic motion control method and system for a four-wheeled foot robot The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the state of a robot system in real time through a sensor; subsequently,  the adaptive time-varying model predictive control algorithm fused with affine compensation is used to dynamically update the linear prediction model and compensate for the nonlinear error,  and the expected foot end force is solved online; then,  based on the closed-chain Jacobian mapping,  the foot end force is simultaneously mapped into the hub driving torque and the leg joint torque including the structural stiffening torque,  so as to synergistically suppress the leg shear deformation caused by high dynamic motion; finally,  the calculated torque command is output to each execution motor Through the innovation of the algorithm level,  on the premise of not changing the hardware,  the invention effectively solves the problem that it is difficult to balance the control accuracy,  system stability and algorithm real-time performance of the wheel-legged robot in a high dynamic scene,  and significantly improves the robot's performance in rapid acceleration and large acceleration. Movement performance under extreme working conditions such as slope climbing 1. A high dynamic motion control method of four-wheeled foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  a state sensing step for obtaining the state estimation value of the robot system in the current control period;  a model prediction control step,  based on the system state estimation value,  calculating and obtaining the expected foot end force vector of the current period through the adaptive time-varying model prediction control algorithm fused with affine compensation;  a moment cooperative mapping and compensating step for mapping the expected foot end force vector as the driving moment of the hub motor and the joint moment of the leg joint motor;  wherein the joint moment comprises a structural stiffening moment for resisting the leg shearing deformation caused by the driving force of the wheel body;  a control output step of respectively outputting the driving moment and the joint moment to the corresponding motor executor;  circulating step,  entering the next control period,  repeating said steps.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot positioning and mapping method,  device,  terminal and medium in a complex terrain environment The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a laser radar point cloud,  inertial measurement data and leg motor data of the quadruped robot,  constructing a state estimation observation model of the quadruped robot,  and estimating the motion state of the quadruped robot to obtain a state estimation result; compensating the motion of the point cloud based on the state estimation result,  realizing point cloud registration and point cloud state estimation based on the state estimation result,  the compensated lidar point cloud and the global map of the adaptive voxel structure,  and outputting a three-dimensional voxel map; the plane-constrained foot end update mechanism based on confidence perception uses the 3D voxel map as a constraint to update the foot end elevation to optimize the subsequent state estimation process of the quadruped robot. The invention can effectively solve the problems of positioning drift,  matching loss,  fuzzy mapping and registration failure caused by the flexible motion state of the quadruped robot under complex terrain. 1. A four-foot robot positioning and mapping method in complex terrain environment,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining laser radar point cloud,  inertia measurement data,  a leg motor data of the four-foot robot,  constructing a state estimation observation model of the four-foot robot based on the inertia measurement data and the leg motor data,  and based on the state estimation observation model,  realizing the estimation of the motion state of the four-foot robot,  obtaining the state estimation result,  The leg motor data comprises :  the joint angle data and the foot end contact detection data,  the state estimation observation model comprises :  a foot end position observation equation,  a foot end speed observation equation and a rotation drift correction observation equation of inertia measurement data;  based on the state estimation result,  compensating the point cloud motion,  obtaining the compensated laser radar point cloud,  and based on the state estimation result,  the compensated laser radar point cloud and the global map of self-adaptive voxel structure,  realizing point cloud registration and point cloud state estimation,  outputting three-dimensional voxel map;  based on the plane constraint foot end updating mechanism sensed by the confidence level,  taking the three-dimensional voxel map as the constraint updating foot end height to optimize the subsequent state estimation flow of the four-foot robot.

The invention relates to a path planning method for a wheel-legged robot,  which includes :  obtaining three-dimensional environmental data in the working space of the wheel-legged robot,  using the three-dimensional environmental data to set a four-state two-dimensional grid map,  and setting the four-state two-dimensional grid map. The forbidden grids in the grid map are subject to obstacle expansion; set a unified path cost function,  and use the improved A algorithm to conduct global path search with obstacle avoidance and obstacle surmounting constraints on a four-state two-dimensional raster map to generate a continuous global reference path; the improved A algorithm is obtained by introducing the neighborhood expansion rule that supports obstacle surmounting on the basis of the traditional 8 neighborhoods; among them,  the neighborhood expansion rule that supports obstacle surmounting is used to express the obstacle surmounting ability of the wheel-legged robot during the global path search process. The invention can take into account the passability of complex terrain and the comprehensive cost of the path,  and generate a wheel-legged robot path plan. 1. A route planning method for wheel-leg type robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the three-dimensional environment data in the working space of the wheel-leg type robot,  setting a four-state two-dimensional grid map by using the three-dimensional environment data,  and performing obstacle expansion on the forbidden grid in the four-state two-dimensional grid map;  setting uniform path cost function,  and adopting improved A performing global path search of obstacle avoidance and obstacle crossing restriction on the four-state two-dimensional grid map by an algorithm to generate a continuous global reference path;  the improved A the algorithm is obtained by introducing a neighbourhood expansion rule supporting obstacle crossing based on the traditional 8 neighbourhood;  wherein the neighbourhood expansion rule supporting obstacle crossing is used for representing obstacle crossing ability of the wheel-leg robot in the global path searching process.

This application discloses a static obstacle avoidance method,  device,  medium,  equipment and vehicle for unstructured roads. The method includes :  obtaining unstructured road hard boundaries and static obstacle boundaries; determine the central axis of the drivable area enclosed by the unstructured road hard boundary and the static obstacle boundary; according to the heuristic search algorithm,  the drivable area and the central axis,  the heuristic search path of the left obstacle avoidance and the heuristic search path of the right obstacle avoidance are obtained,  and the obstacle avoidance direction corresponding to the heuristic search path with the smallest total cost of all nodes is determined as the target obstacle avoidance direction; according to the vehicle kinematics constraints,  system control quantity constraints,  unstructured road hard boundary constraints,  and the penalty term for unstructured road soft boundaries,  a vehicle path planning model is established,  and the optimal solution of the vehicle path planning model is determined as the target planned path. Through the above scheme,  the safety and comfort of the planned path can be improved while improving humanoid decision-making. 1. An unstructured road static obstacle bypassing method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining an unstructured road hard boundary and a static barrier boundary,  wherein the area surrounded by the unstructured road hard boundary comprises a static barrier boundary;  determining the central axis of the drivable area surrounded by the unstructured road hard boundary and the static barrier boundary;  according to the heuristic search algorithm,  the drivable area and the central axis,  obtaining the heuristic search path of the left side bypass barrier and the heuristic search path of the right side bypass barrier,  and determining the bypass barrier direction corresponding to the heuristic search path with the minimum total cost of all nodes as the target bypass barrier direction;  according to the vehicle kinematics constraint,  the system control quantity constraint,  an unstructured road hard boundary constraint,  and a penalty item related to an unstructured road soft boundary,  establishing a vehicle path planning model,  and determining the optimal solution of the vehicle path planning model as a target planning path,  wherein the unstructured road soft boundary is determined according to the unstructured road hard boundary,  The penalty item for the soft boundary of the unstructured road is a penalty item set according to a minimum distance from a path planning point to the soft boundary of the unstructured road.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot walking stability control method,  system and readable medium based on nonlinear model predictive control The walking stability control method for the humanoid robot comprises the following steps :  S1,  carrying out gait planning based on current parameters of the humanoid robot,  wherein the gait planning comprises a feasible area for defining a foothold and a ZMP reference value; step S2 :  NMPC optimization is performed on gait planning and compliance control is added to output new walking parameters to control the walking trajectory of the humanoid robot and achieve stable walking of the humanoid robot; among them,  the walking parameters include the position of the final foothold,  optimized walking trajectory,  speed and/or acceleration. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention,  the problem of robust and efficient walking of the humanoid robot is solved,  a spring damping model is optimized,  and a theoretical basis is provided for flexibility and stability of humanoid walking 1. A humanoid robot walking stability control method based on nonlinear model predictive control,  wherein the humanoid robot walking stability control method comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  performing gait planning based on the current parameter of the humanoid robot,  wherein the gait planning comprises defining the feasible area of the landing point and ZMP reference value;  step S2 :  performing NMPC optimization to the gait plan and adding soft control,  so as to output new walking parameter to control the walking track of the humanoid robot,  realizing the walking stability of the humanoid robot;  wherein the walking parameter comprises the position of the final landing point,  the optimized walking track,  speed and/or acceleration;  The compliance control comprises the following steps :  establishing a virtual centroid model;  the virtual force controller obtains the virtual force through the virtual centroid model,  the virtual force resists the influence of the external force,  so as to reach the soft control.

The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  in particular to a track contact network fault positioning device integrating a humanoid robot and a multi-source sensor. The system comprises an obstacle crossing execution module,  a component identification module,  a positioning coupling module,  an abnormality tracking module and a target verification module In the present invention,  through the combination of gait instructions,  autonomous obstacle crossing in a structural occlusion environment is achieved and crossing behavior information is recorded The image acquisition link introduces attitude guidance alignment control and angle segmentation capture strategies Complete the clear extraction of structural contour boundaries and the output of image numbers Establish a position mapping relationship between the direction of the image line segment and the orbital coordinate system Dynamically build multi-view path fragments,  the image edge fracture area and thermal imaging spatial point data are overlapped and verified,  the spatial position coordinates of abnormal components are extracted,  the component identification names are aligned with the path trajectory files,  and the execution action index is formed in chronological order to improve the integrity of structure identification,  path matching accuracy and fault location response efficiency. 1. A rail contact net fault locating device combined with humanoid robot and multi-source sensor,  wherein the system comprises :  the obstacle-crossing execution module reads the distance in front of the human-shaped robot and the travel interruption information,  judges whether the path is shielded,  identifies the shielding object by combining with the image collected by the visual sensor,  controls the left leg to lift and the right leg to move forwards,  executes the crossing action,  records the coordinate of the falling point and the position of the sole,  and generates the crossing record table;  the component identification module starts the forearm shooting according to the spanning record table,  adjusts the hand posture to align to the contact net,  collects the image in batches,  extracts the edge and the outline,  analyzes the consistency of the line group,  marks the component and outputs the image number to generate the shooting picture group;  the positioning coupling module transfers the head visual angle sequence based on the shooting image group,  extracts the image edge direction,  maps it as the track angle,  combines the image displacement and the coordinate deviation,  divides it into the forward visual angle and the lateral visual angle,  and generates the visual angle positioning segment;  the abnormal tracking module analyzes the visual angle positioning segment,  screens the edge fracture line segment,  positions the thermal sensing central point,  compares the coordinates,  marks the superposition component and outputs the image breakpoint list;  based on the image breakpoint list,  the target verification module extracts the component number and name,  the binding operation number and the path description,  aligns the track points and orders to form the fault locating information of the track contact network.

The invention provides a lightweight humanoid detection method,  device,  medium and product based on improved RTDETR. The method includes :  obtaining a data set for humanoid detection,  and dividing the data set into a training set,  a verification set and a test set; construct an improved RTDETR model. In the improved RTDETR model,  ES Block is used to replace the Basic Block in the RTDETR feature extraction network before the improvement. The ES Block includes :  EfficientVIT Block and SimAM attention module connected in sequence; using NWD Loss as the loss function of the improved RTDETR model; obtaining a trained improved RTDETR model after training the improved RTDETR model with the training set,  verifying the improved RTDETR model with the validation set,  and testing the improved RTDETR model with the test set; input the image to be detected into the trained improved RTDETR model for reasoning,  and obtain the humanoid detection result of the image to be detected. By utilizing the technical scheme,  the humanoid detection accuracy and the detection of small target humanoid in the security monitoring complex scene can be improved 1. A lightweight human shape detection method based on improved RTDETR,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a data set for human shape detection,  and dividing the data set into a training set,  a verification set and a test set;  constructing an improved RTDETR model,  wherein the improved RTDETR model comprises an improved RTDETR feature extraction network,  In the improved RTDETR feature extraction network,  ES Block is used to replace Basic Block in the improved RTDETR feature extraction network,  and the ES Block comprises :  orderly connected Eeffect VIT Block and SimAM attention module;  using NWD Loss as a loss function of the improved RTDETR model;  after the improved RTDETR model is trained by the training set,  the verification set and the test set,  obtaining the trained improved RTDETR model;  the image to be detected is input to the improved RTDETR model after training for reasoning to obtain the human shape detection result of the image to be detected.

The invention provides a passenger flow statistical method,  a passenger flow statistical device,  a computer device and a readable storage medium. Personnel trajectory data containing multi-frame detection results of the same target are obtained Based on the space-time relationship between the preset geometric conditions and the adjacent detection results,  the multi-frame detection results are preliminarily screened to obtain the preliminary screening detection results; calculate quality scores for the preliminary screening test results and sort them,  and select a predetermined number of target test results based on the sorting results; based on the continuous static detection results in different trajectories,  a static humanoid area is accumulated,  and the target detection results are filtered according to the static humanoid area to obtain the image of the person to be identified; extracting the feature vector of the image of the person to be identified,  and re-identifying and matching the feature vector in the corresponding feature matching space according to the behavior type of the person trajectory; generate passenger flow statistics based on the re-identification matching results and personnel attribute information. By adopting the method,  the accuracy and the stability of passenger flow statistics can be greatly improved 1. A passenger flow statistical method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the staff track data including the same target multi-frame detection result;  primarily screening the multi-frame detecting result based on the space-time relation between the preset geometric condition and the adjacent detecting result to obtain the primary screening detecting result;  calculating the quality score for the primary screening detection result and sequencing,  and selecting the target detection result with predetermined number according to the sequencing result;  accumulating to form a static humanoid area based on the continuous static detection result in different tracks,  filtering the target detection result according to the static humanoid area to obtain the image of the person to be identified;  extracting the feature vector of the image of the person to be identified,  according to the behaviour type of the person track,  in the corresponding feature matching space,  re-identifying and matching the feature vector;  generating passenger flow statistical result based on the re-identification matching result and the personnel attribute information.

The invention discloses a double-link intelligent control system based on a home computer and a data backup method. The system uses the home computer as a central control node,  and through the redundant design of a local WiFi link and an independent 4G/5G link,  it can ensure the normal operation of remote control and local linkage functions of access control,  lamps,  KTV speakers and other equipment when the home network is interrupted. The system is equipped with both vehicle-mounted and home data synchronization modules Supports dual backup storage of video data from car cameras and home cameras locally on the device and on home computers At the same time,  it supports synchronous backup of photos and files on mobile phones and tablets,  and also reserves extended access interfaces for humanoid robots and holographic projection equipment,  which can greatly improve the reliability,  data security and functional scalability of smart home systems,  and provide a basis for the future of the whole house. Intelligent ecology provides an integrated solution. 1. A dual-link intelligent control and data dual-backup system based on household computer,  wherein it comprises :  the central host computer is a common household computer;  the household device comprises a camera,  an entrance guard,  a lamp,  a socket,  a sound box,  a KTV device and a water pump controller;  the vehicle-mounted device comprises a vehicle-mounted camera and a travelling recorder;  the mobile terminal is an intelligent mobile phone and a flat computer;  the computer terminal comprises a desktop computer and a notebook computer,  wherein the computer terminal has data storage and operation processing capability and can be used as the central control node of the system;  The system comprises two independent communication links :  a local local area network link and an independent remote link independent of the home broadband;  the video and mobile phone,  flat plate and computer data can be stored between the local device and the central host computer of the household computer;  The local control and the mobile phone remote control can work normally when the home broadband is cut off without external network.

The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots And discloses a large-thrust miniature planetary roller screw rod linear humanoid robot joint The forearm linear joint used in humanoid robot arm Aims to solve the problem of insufficient accuracy and stability of existing humanoid robot joints when bearing large thrust The joint includes a planetary roller screw mechanism,  a drive motor and a housing The planetary roller screw mechanism is composed of a central screw rod,  multiple planetary rollers and an annular nut Realize high-precision linear motion through the rolling of planetary rollers The driving motor is connected with the central screw rod through a nut to provide large thrust output,  and the shell is made of high-strength material to ensure the rigidity and stability of the structure. Through the design of the planetary roller screw rod mechanism,  the utility model significantly improves the joint load capacity and accuracy,  is suitable for the field of humanoid robots,  and has broad application prospects. 1. A large-thrust miniature planetary roller screw rod linear humanoid robot joint,  comprising a planetary roller screw rod structure,  a motor and a driving structure and a mechanical shell structure,  wherein the planetary roller screw rod structure is a core structure of the joint,  composed of a central screw rod,  a plurality of planetary rollers and annular nuts,  the motor and the driving structure comprise a module for supplying power,  communicating,  detecting and controlling the joint,  the mechanical shell structure correspondingly provides a standard interface to realize the connection between the joint and the mechanical arm rod;  the planet roller screw rod structure comprises a locking nut (5),  a double-row angular contact bearing (6),  a nut (10),  a push rod (11),  a bearing mounting seat (12) and a cylindrical roller bearing (13),  the nut (10) is provided with a screw thread,  through the screw thread on the roller or roller is connected with the push rod (11),  the double-row angular contact bearing (6) is concentrically matched and connected with one shaft end of the nut (10),  and the double-row angular contact bearing (6) is fixedly connected with the locking nut (5),  the nut (10) deviates from the double-row angular contact bearing (6) and is correspondingly and concentrically connected with the cylindrical roller bearing (13),  and the nut (10) is fixedly adhered with the inner ring of the cylindrical roller bearing (13) through glue water,  the outer ring of the cylindrical roller bearing (13) is concentrically and fixedly connected with the bearing mounting seat (12).

The present disclosure discloses a self-adaptive mechanical foot for the legged robot. The mechanical foot has a piston disposed inside a piston cylinder. The piston is connected to one end of each humeral plate,  and the piston cylinder is connected to the other end of each humeral plate. The humeral plates perform opening and closing movement through the up-down movement of the piston in the piston cylinder. The humeral plates are connected to toes on the foot and drive the toes to open and close through the up-down movement. The mechanical foot provided by the present disclosure has higher standing stability and fast interaction response speed when interacting with the terrain. It can realize arbitrary and fast switching between a point-like foot and a planar foot,  and meanwhile avoids collision between a support leg and a swing leg.

The present invention overcomes the existing multi-legged robot by moving long distances by running and walking,  or by jumping on its legs when there is an obstacle,  and grabbing,  pulling,  or pushing with rotating pincer-type legs. When there is an obstacle,  the drone performs its mission by flying diagonally or upward,  down,  left,  right,  and backward. When robots and drones approach obstacles that correspond to the limit of each obstacle situation,  they cannot move and move forward,  and the main problem is that they cannot move long distances in a short time. Drones do not move forward by removing and damaging obstacles,  but only by flying,  avoiding obstacles and moving to perform their missions. By moving the robot over a long distance in a short time and the drone folding its wings or performing the tasks imposed according to the obstacles of the pre-identified terrain,  the robot has the advantage of being able to quickly escape when the robot is hindered by high obstacles and unexpected ground animals and vines due to the movement of the robot,  or by emergency in swamps and underwater. Due to the fine adjustment of the drone,  the operation environment of the drone is greatly hindered by the surrounding weather and terrain features,  and the maintenance of the state that does not require accurate position and movement is solved by the functions of the multi-legged robot in the walking and driving stationary state.

The invention relates to a foot structure of a multifunctional bipedal robot capable of adapting to different working states The entire foot structure is functionally modular designed When you need to walk,  the foot structure obtains the information of the foot sole sensor in real time and realizes the self-adaptive posture adjustment of the biped robot on the uneven and smooth ground through two stages. The two stages include the preliminary fine adjustment of the anti-slip air cushion and the torsion springs on both sides and the pneumatic drive mechanism to control the five toe joints. Toe joints and two foot side plates are fully adjusted; when the bipedal robot is in a state where the foot structure needs to be fixed,  such as grabbing,  multiple pneumatic driving devices are driven to lift the toes and side foot plates,  and the vacuum generator is driven to extract the gas in the adaptive suction cup mechanism,  so that the foot structure of the bipedal robot is firmly adsorbed on the ground. The invention utilizes torsion spring characteristics and pneumatic control technology to cooperatively control mechanisms such as toes and side foot plates,  thereby realizing the adaptability of the robot foot to the ground under different working conditions. 1. A multifunctional biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to different working states,  wherein The foot structure comprises a sole plate (1),  five toe joints (2) connected on the sole plate (1),  a pneumatic driving mechanism (3),  two foot side plates (4),  a flexible passive connecting piece (6) and a sole array FSR pressure sensor (15);  the sole array FSR pressure sensor (15) is installed in the bottom circular opening (152) at the four corners of the sole plate (1),  the sensor wiring harness is connected to the main control upper computer of the robot from the micro cylindrical pipeline (151) on the bottom circular opening (152),  transmitting the pressure of the robot foot and the ground to the upper computer of the robot to analyze and obtain the foot state;  each toe joint (2) is independently controlled by a pneumatic driving mechanism (3),  according to the information collected by the sole array FSR pressure sensor (15),  respectively controlling five toe joints (2) to adjust the foot falling posture,  realizing stable landing;  when the robot walks on the rugged road surface is unstable forwards,  the pneumatic driving mechanism (3) is adjusted to press the toes on the ground and adjust the position of the mass centre of the robot;  the foot bottom board (1) comprises five first pneumatic driving mechanism connectors (11),  two second pneumatic driving mechanism connectors (12),  two third pneumatic driving mechanism connectors (13),  five toe joint connectors (14),  four sole array FSR pressure sensors (15) and a sucker assembly mounting circular opening (16);  each toe joint connector (14) is provided with a toe joint (2),  the toe joint (2) through pneumatic driving mechanism (3) is connected with the first pneumatic driving mechanism connector (11);  each second pneumatic driving mechanism connector (12) through the pneumatic driving mechanism (3) is connected with the front end of the foot side plate (4) on the corresponding side;
