 comprising two torsion spring shaft fixing pieces (61),  three torsion springs (62),  four torsion spring rod fixing pieces (63) and a central torsion spring shaft (64);  the central torsion spring shaft (64) orderly passes through the torsion spring shaft fixing piece (61) and three torsion springs (62),  so that the torsion spring shaft fixing piece (61) and the torsion spring (62) are coaxial;  the central torsion spring shaft (64) is fixedly connected with the torsion spring shaft fixing piece (61) through the shaft shoulder to prevent relative rotation;  the torsion spring (62) is fixed on the foot bottom plate (1) and the foot side plate (4) at the same time through the torsion spring rod fixing piece (63),  the torsion spring (62) is fixed on the foot side plate (4) through the torsion spring shaft fixing piece (61) at the front end,  the torsion spring (62) is fixed on the foot bottom plate (1) through the torsion spring shaft fixing piece (61) at the rear end;  when the robot walks on the rugged road,  the self-adaptive passive adjustment can be realized through the torque flexible rotation of the torsion spring (62).

The invention provides a cleaning control method,  a cleaning control device,  a medium and an electronic device of a cleaning device The method comprises the following steps of :  determining the relevance degree of a following instruction relevance characteristic and a following trigger instruction based on the following instruction relevance characteristic of a candidate leader; and/or determine the confidence of the biometric based on the biometric; and/or determine the action feature sequence based on the action features; determine the target leader based on the correlation between the candidate leader's following instruction association characteristics and the following trigger instruction,  the confidence of the biometric characteristics and/or the action feature sequence; obtaining the dynamic tracking data of the target leader in real time,  and controlling the cleaning equipment to follow the target leader based on the dynamic tracking data; when a cleaning instruction issued by the target leader is detected,  a cleaning task corresponding to the cleaning instruction is performed This application guides the cleaning equipment to the area to be cleaned through humanoid following. 1. A cleaning control method of cleaning device,  wherein the method comprises :  in response to the following trigger instruction,  searching the candidate guide in the target scene,  and extracting the following instruction associated feature,  biological feature and/or action feature of each candidate guide;  based on the following instruction association characteristic of the candidate guide,  determining the association degree of the following instruction association characteristic and the following trigger instruction;  and/or determining a confidence level of the biological feature based on the biological feature;  and/or determining the sequence of motion characteristics based on the motion characteristics;  determining a target leader based on a degree of association of the following instruction-related feature of the candidate leader with the following trigger instruction,  a degree of confidence of the biological feature,  and/or the sequence of action features;  obtaining the dynamic tracking data of the target guider in real time,  controlling the cleaning device to move along with the target guider based on the dynamic tracking data;  wherein the dynamic tracking data includes biological characteristics and/or non-biological characteristics of the target leader;  when detecting the cleaning instruction sent by the target guider,  executing the cleaning task corresponding to the cleaning instruction.

The invention discloses a self-recovery method and a self-recovery device for a robot falling down,  and relates to the technical field of robots The method includes :  detecting a current posture of the robot; determining the current parameter sequence of the robot according to the current posture and obtaining the preset parameter sequence of the robot when the current posture meets the preset conditions; input the current parameter sequence and the preset parameter sequence into the fall recovery model,  and output the self-recovery strategy of the robot,  wherein the fall recovery model is obtained by pre-training through imitation learning and reinforcement learning; executing a self-recovery strategy to restore the robot to a standing posture solves the obvious limitations of existing traditional robot fall recovery methods and improves the autonomous,  stable,  robust and anthropomorphic fall recovery capabilities of humanoid robots. 1. A robot tumble self-recovery method,  wherein it comprises :  detecting the current posture of the robot;  under the condition that the current posture satisfies the preset condition,  determining the current parameter sequence of the robot according to the current posture,  and obtaining the preset parameter sequence of the robot;  inputting the current parameter sequence and the preset parameter sequence into a tumble recovery model,  and outputting a self-recovery strategy of the robot,  wherein the tumble recovery model is obtained by pre-training by simulating learning and strengthening learning;  executing the self-restoring strategy to restore the robot to the standing posture;  The pre-training is performed by simulating learning and intensive learning,  including :  obtaining a robot simulation model,  a plurality of non-standing postures,  and obtaining a human body motion data sequence and a robot initial parameter sequence corresponding to each of the non-standing postures according to the plurality of non-standing postures;  pre-processing a plurality of human body motion data sequences to obtain a plurality of reference fall recovery tracks;  according to the robot simulation model,  a plurality of the robot initial parameter sequences and a plurality of the reference tumble recovery track,  through simulating learning to perform iteration training on the initial tumble recovery model,  to obtain the reference tumble recovery model;  according to the robot simulation model,  a plurality of the robot initial parameter sequence and a plurality of the reference tumble recovery track,  through strengthening learning to the reference tumble recovery model for iterative training,  to obtain the tumble recovery model.

The invention relates to an AI-based low-power intelligent bird repelling device and a bird repelling method. The bird repelling device includes a multi-modal fusion detection module,  an AI bird identification and decision-making module,  a collaborative bird repelling execution module,  an effect feedback and strategy optimization module,  power and energy management module and remote monitoring and management module. The intelligent bird repellent device of the present invention combines multi-modal fusion detection with a lightweight AI model. It has a high accuracy in bird identification and can distinguish birds from interfering objects and identify high-risk bird species. Humanoid detection ensures personnel safety and false triggering. The rate is low Combining adaptive strategic decision-making with multi-means collaborative bird repelling,  the bird repelling method can be dynamically adjusted according to bird species and environmental scenes,  and the strategy can be optimized by combining effect feedback and reinforcement learning to avoid bird adaptability. It has a sleep-wake-up mechanism,  can operate for a long time with low power consumption,  supports remote monitoring,  control,  data viewing and model upgrades,  reduces on-site operation and maintenance workload,  and adapts to large-scale deployment requirements in power scenarios. 1. A low power consumption intelligent bird expelling device based on AI,  wherein it comprises :  a multimodal fusion detection module for detecting the bird activity information,  wherein the module comprises a motion pre-detection unit,  a visual sensing unit and an illumination and environment sensing unit;  and an AI bird identification and decision module,  for performing intelligent processing on the information collected by the multimodal fusion detection module,  and outputting a bird repelling decision instruction according to the processed data,  the module comprises a multimodal data fusion and pre-processing unit,  a bird identification and feature extraction unit,  a nest-building behaviour analysis and pre-warning unit,  a context sensing and environment modelling unit,  a self-adaptive strategy decision unit and a model management and edge cloud cooperation unit;  and a cooperative bird-driving execution module for activating the corresponding bird-driving means according to the bird decision instruction output by the AI bird identification and decision module,  wherein the module comprises an ultrasonic bird-driving unit,  an ultrasonic bird-driving unit and a laser bird-driving unit;  and an effect feedback and strategy optimizing module for monitoring the bird-driving effect and optimizing the bird-driving parameter according to the bird-driving effect;  and a power supply and energy management module,  comprising a main power supply module and an intelligent power consumption module;  and a remote monitoring and managing module comprising a communication unit,  a data reporting unit,  a remote managing and controlling unit and an intelligent analyzing unit.

The invention provides a multi-motor power-assisted connecting device and system for a pull-wire type humanoid robot. A plurality of motors are centrally arranged on the trunk to reduce the inertia of the execution end and improve the impact resistance. The control logic of the present invention is based on the current humanoid robot control by dynamically or statically adding a power-assisted motor to realize the call of the joint motor in an idle state to support the joints requiring power-assisted,  so that the joints and motors of ordinary size can maintain a compact size and at the same time Output torque above 500Nm,  greatly reducing the volume For dexterous hands,  multiple small motors work together with the bus large motor to converge multiple power into the same joint to achieve a grasping force of over 100 Nm and precise operation capabilities. A variety of mechanical self-locking structures are built into the connection point device,  which can still maintain a 10, 000-N pulling force after power outage. The control system adopts a hierarchical distributed architecture to achieve microsecond-level synchronization accuracy. The invention completely solves the core contradiction of "small joint space and high torque requirements" of humanoid robots,  and is suitable for the application of whole body joints and dexterous hands. 1. A multi-motor cooperative power-assisted system,  wherein it comprises • multiple motor units;  • power switching device configured to switch different power transmission paths;  • at least one power transmission cable,  forming a power resource pool,  and is reversibly connected with one or more of the power switching device;  • connecting point device,  configured to realize the reversible connection between the power transmission cable and the stress unit;  the • control system is configured to manage the distribution and cooperative output of the power resource according to the power assisting requirement.

The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  in particular to a full-size humanoid robot quick stand-up strategy training method,  which comprises the following steps of :  constructing a stand-up task model based on a partially observable Markov decision-making process; introduce a multi-evaluator structure to optimize task completion,  action style and energy efficiency respectively; explore strategies through curriculum learning; introducing domain randomization to improve the migration ability from simulation to reality. According to the invention,  by constructing a reinforcement learning stand-up control framework and combining a multi-evaluator structure and a course learning method,  the robot has efficient and stable stand-up ability under diversified initial postures,  and can quickly stand up under various falling situations,  so that the action is natural and stable,  and the joint oscillation is obviously inhibited; it still maintains a high success rate in complex environments and external disturbances. According to domain randomization and course learning strategies,  the trained strategies can be smoothly transferred to real full-scale humanoid robots,  achieving efficient deployment from simulation to real machines. 1. A full-size humanoid robot quick body-building strategy training method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  establishing the dynamics and kinematics model of the rapid self-lifting process of the humanoid robot,  the process modelling is partial Markov decision process;  S2 :  constructing a strengthening learning strategy based on the strength course,  applying a vertical auxiliary force on the robot base and gradually reducing along with the training,  at the same time,  tightening the action boundary,  realizing gradual learning from simple to complex;  S3 :  the motion constraint mechanism is introduced in the training,  the moment and speed of the joint are limited by motion zooming and smooth regularization,  the motion oscillation is inhibited;  S4 :  designing the staged reward function,  gradually converging the guiding strategy,  dividing the lifting process into three stages of body turning,  lifting and standing according to the height of the base,  and activating the corresponding reward in each stage;  S5 :  constructing a multi-evaluator structure to improve learning stability,  setting independent value networks for different types of reward signals,  and realizing multi-target balance optimization through advantage function aggregation;  S6 :  using the domain randomization method to transfer the simulation training strategy to the real robot verification,  improving the robustness and generalization ability of the strategy through the randomization model parameter.

This application relates to a method and system for measuring and optimizing the feasible region of humanoid robot constraint dexterity The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a joint angular velocity hyperpolyhedron feasible region based on analyzed joint and environment joint constraints; obtaining a humanoid robot dexterity feasible region through affine transformation; and measuring the humanoid robot constrained dexterity feasible region based on a velocity polyhedron Then,  the task direction dexterity is constructed based on the dexterity feasible region,  and the optimization index is constructed. By integrating the task requirements,  joint constraints and optimization indicators of the humanoid robot through dynamic programming,  the recurrent neural network is used for optimization control analysis,  and the joint angular velocity control instructions are obtained to control the humanoid robot,  which effectively improves the control accuracy of the humanoid robot's dexterous operation control task. 1. A robot constraint flexibility feasible domain measurement and optimization control method,  wherein it comprises :  based on the analyzed joint parameter and environment parameter of the humanoid robot,  establishing joint constraint;  according to the joint constraint,  constructing joint angular velocity hyperpolyhedron feasible domain,  through performing affine transformation to the polyhedron vertex,  generating the dexterous degree feasible domain of the humanoid robot in the working space;  based on the flexible degree feasible domain,  establishing the flexible degree of the human-shaped robot in the task direction under the constraint state,  and analyzing the flexible degree optimization index based on the joint angular speed control instruction through the secondary gradient;  establishing an outer ring controller based on the operation task requirement of the humanoid robot,  and combining the dexterous degree optimization index and the joint constraint to perform dynamic planning processing to obtain dynamic planning information;  analyzing the dynamic planning information based on the inner ring controller of the recursive neural network to obtain the joint angular speed control instruction;  and controlling the humanoid robot through the joint angular velocity control instruction.

This application discloses a full-body control method,  device,  electronic equipment and storage medium for a humanoid robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot motion control. The method includes establishing a single rigid body dynamic model of a humanoid robot based on model uncertainty and external disturbance mechanisms; during the operation of the humanoid robot,  based on the single rigid body dynamic model of the humanoid robot,  the current initial control quantity is obtained through a model adaptive predictive controller,  which includes an adaptive neural network model; based on the current initial control quantity,  fine-tuning the adjustable parameters in the adaptive neural network model to dynamically correct the control quantity output by the humanoid robot single rigid body dynamics model to obtain the current corrected control quantity; according to the current corrected control quantity,  the whole body control optimization calculation is carried out to generate joint control instructions. This application enables humanoid robots to quickly adapt to unknown disturbances in complex unstructured environments,  improving their robustness and dynamic performance. 1. A whole body control method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  establishing a single rigid body dynamics model of the humanoid robot according to the model uncertainty and the external disturbance mechanism;  in the running process of the humanoid robot,  based on the single rigid body dynamics model of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the current initial control quantity through the model self-adaptive prediction controller,  wherein the model self-adaptive prediction controller comprises a self-adaptive neural network model;  based on the current initial control quantity,  fine adjusting the adjustable parameter in the self-adaptive neural network model,  so as to dynamically correct the control quantity output by the single rigid body dynamics model of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the current corrected control quantity;  performing the whole body control optimization calculation according to the currently corrected control quantity to generate the joint control instruction.

The invention provides a whole-body posture linkage method and a whole-body posture linkage device when a humanoid robot reaches an object. The whole-body posture linkage method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an arm swinging angular velocity,  a gait phase angle and an azimuth deviation angle between the tail end of an arm and a target object of the humanoid robot in a walking state,  and determining a freezing switching judgment threshold according to the azimuth deviation angle and the arm swinging angular velocity; screening a preliminary candidate point set according to the comparison between the freeze switching determination threshold and the preset threshold; updating the correction value of the freezing switching determination threshold in the next step period according to the evaluation result of the suppression result of the trunk pitch oscillation amplitude,  mapping the correction value to the phase offset compensation value in gait phase synchronization,  and determining the starting timing of the reaching action; integrate the starting timing of the reaching action and the freezing moment of the swing arm,  and evaluate the shortening amount of the overall action time and the degree of compliance with the preset time optimization threshold to determine the whole body posture linkage parameters. 1. A whole-body posture linkage method for human-shaped robot stretching enough objects,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the swinging arm angular speed,  the gait phase angle and the direction deviation angle between the arm tail end and the target object under the walking state of the human-shaped robot,  determining the freezing switching judging threshold according to the direction deviation angle and the swinging arm angular speed;  screening the primary candidate point set according to the comparison between the freezing switch judging threshold and the preset threshold;  obtaining the shoulder joint moment mutation of each candidate point in the initial candidate point set and the length of the tail end actuator winding track,  calculating the comprehensive value of each candidate point according to the shoulder joint moment mutation of each candidate point and the length of the tail end actuator winding track,  searching the swinging arm freezing time with the lowest comprehensive value;  obtaining the trunk attitude data corresponding to the freezing time of the swinging arm with the lowest comprehensive generation value,  evaluating the suppression result of the trunk pitching oscillation amplitude,  so as to analyze the hand stretching action starting time of the robot,  so as to determine the whole body attitude linkage parameter satisfying the preset requirement.

The invention discloses a balance and stability control system and method for a ship bipedal robot under complex sea conditions. The system includes two magnetic balancing devices; the magnetic balancing device comprises a control processing module,  a foot connecting mechanism,  a stable adjusting mechanism,  a sole magnetic mechanism and a power supply module According to the balance and stability control system and method,  the levelness of the foot connecting mechanism can be correspondingly adjusted according to the ship data acquired by the control processing module by using the stability adjusting mechanism,  so that the biped robot can balance the shaking of the ship and enhance the stability of the foot in the walking process; the foot sole magnetic force mechanism can perform magnetic attraction when the foot steps on the deck during walking,  further enhancing the stability during walking; the foot connection mechanism can be detachably installed on the foot of a bipedal robot,  which has strong adaptability. 1. A balance stability control system of complex marine vessel biped robot,  wherein it comprises two magnetic balance devices;  the magnetic balance device comprises a control processing module,  a foot connecting mechanism,  a stable adjusting mechanism,  a sole magnetic force mechanism and a power supply module;  the foot connecting mechanism is mounted on the stable adjusting mechanism,  the sole magnetic mechanism is mounted at the bottom of the stable adjusting mechanism,  the control processing module and the power supply module are set in the stable adjusting mechanism;  the two magnetic attraction balancing devices are detachably installed on the two feet of the biped robot through the foot connecting mechanism,  the levelness of the foot connecting mechanism is adjusted by the stable adjusting mechanism,  the foot magnetic force mechanism controls the magnetic attraction on the ship deck,  the stable adjusting mechanism and the sole magnetic mechanism are driven and controlled by the control processing module;  the power supply module supplies power for the control processing module,  the stable adjusting mechanism and the sole magnetic mechanism.

The invention relates to a path planning method and device for a wheel-legged robot and a wheel-legged robot,  including :  S1. Configure the robot; s2. Rasterize a flat map,  mark the initial position,  target position,  boundary,  and obstacle,  and construct a rasterized map data set; s3. Identify the height of obstacles and switch the movement mode compared with the threshold; s4. Divide quadrants with the center of mass of the robot as the origin,  improve the joint array configuration based on the eight-array diagram,  and adjust the wheel leg posture based on the sinusoidal trigonometric function; s5. Use the center of mass of the whole machine and the two perspectives of the four-wheel ankle joint to plan the global path,  synchronously calibrate the attitude of the junction point,  and output the optimal path according to the shortest distance; s6. Execute local obstacle avoidance and crossing strategies,  establish obstacle database classification management,  introduce neural network experience pool to accumulate scene experience,  and reverse feedback optimizes mode switching,  attitude adjustment and path optimization logic to form a closed loop. The invention can realize global path optimization and local obstacle avoidance of the robot. 1. A path planning method of wheel-leg robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  configuring a wheel leg type robot,  the wheel leg type robot is configured to have four wheel legs,  the hip joint and knee joint of each wheel leg are respectively configured with a joint motor,  the ankle joint of each wheel leg is configured with a driving motor and a steering motor;  the moving mode of the wheel leg type robot at least comprises a pure wheel type moving mode,  a pure leg type moving mode and a wheel leg conversion mode;  S2,  rasterizing the plane map,  marking the initial position,  target position,  walking area boundary,  barrier position and occupied grid of the wheel-leg robot on the processed plane map,  constructing rasterized map data set;  S3,  identifying the height of the obstacle based on the position of the obstacle marked by S2,  comparing the height of the obstacle with the preset minimum threshold value and the maximum threshold value,  and switching to the corresponding moving mode according to the comparison result;  S4,  improving the joint position configuration strategy based on the eight-array image,  taking the mass centre of the wheel leg type robot as the coordinate origin to divide the quadrant,  restricting the rotation postures of the hip joint and the knee joint,  and combining the sine trigonometric function mode to adjust the wheel leg posture;  S5,  adopting a dual-view dual-path thinking mode to plan a global path,  the dual-view are respectively the centroid view of the whole machine and the four-wheel ankle joint view,  based on the rasterized map data set of S2,  synchronously using the wheel leg posture adjusting strategy of S4 to perform the intersection point posture calibration,  and combining the shortest distance optimization strategy,  outputting a global optimal path;  S6,  based on the global optimal path of S5 planning,  executing local obstacle crossing and obstacle avoiding strategy,  combining the obstacle height identified by S3 and the switched moving mode,  establishing a structured obstacle database and classifying into obstacles that can be crossed and cannot be crossed,  and according to the type of the obstacle,  using the corresponding obstacle avoidance and crossing strategy,  introducing a neural network experience pool and a classification hierarchical management mechanism to accumulate scene experience,  reversely feeding back the scene experience data to the mode switching logic of S3,  the attitude adjusting parameter of S4 and the path optimizing strategy of S5 form a closed loop optimizing system.

The invention relates to an improved reinforcement learning multi-legged robot injury gait adaptive generation method,  which includes the following steps :  Step 1. Determine the injury state identifier according to the type of broken leg injury,  and then determine the state space of the multi-legged robot after injury,  And make adaptive adjustments to its action space; step 2. Establish a multi-legged robot injured gait adaptive generation reinforcement learning training interactive environment and network model; step 3. Iterative training is performed on the established multi-legged robot injury gait adaptive generation reinforcement learning network model to generate trained improved reinforcement learning network model parameters; step 4. Deploy the trained improved multi-legged robot injury gait adaptive generation reinforcement learning network model to the real multi-legged robot motion controller to realize the adaptive generation of the multi-legged robot's adjusted gait corresponding to broken leg injuries. The invention can realize the rapid generation and dynamic optimization of the robot's stable gait under various broken leg injury scenarios. 1. A multi-foot robot damage gait self-adaptive generation method for improving intensive learning,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  step 1,  according to the broken leg damage type determining damage state identification,  so as to determine the damaged multi-foot robot state space,  and self-adaptively adjusting the action space;  step 2,  based on the damage state of the multi-foot robot determined in the step 1,  establishing multi-foot robot damage gait self-adaptive generating strengthening learning training interaction environment and network model;  step 3,  using the training interaction environment established in step 2,  performing iterative training on the multi-foot robot damage gait self-adaptive generation reinforced learning network model established in step 2,  generating the trained improved reinforced learning network model parameter;  step 4,  the step 3 training the improved multi-foot robot damage gait self-adaptive generation strengthening learning network model is deployed to the real multi-foot robot motion controller,  to realize multi-foot robot corresponding broken leg damage under the condition of adjusting gait self-adaptive generation.

The embodiment of the invention provides an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array)-based humanoid robot control system,  an FPGA-based humanoid robot control method and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control The system includes :  FPGA main control unit; sensing-executing communication bridging unit,  the input end of the perception-execution communication bridge unit is connected to multiple types of sensors of the humanoid robot The output end is connected to multiple types of actuators of the humanoid robot,  and the sensing-execution communication bridge unit is connected to the FPGA main control unit for two-way communication,  which is used to realize sensor data between the FPGA main control unit and the sensing-execution communication bridge unit,  or control instructions Forwarding between FPGA main control unit and sensing-execution communication bridge unit. The invention replaces the traditional MCU through FPGA,  solves the problems of insufficient computing power,  high communication delay and poor scene adaptability of humanoid robots in multiple scenarios,  reduces hardware reconstruction costs,  improves system real-time performance and reliability,  and can be widely used in different application scenarios. 1. A humanoid robot control system based on FPGA,  wherein the system comprises :  an FPGA main control unit,  the FPGA main control unit is integrated with a hardware acceleration module,  the hardware acceleration module comprises a motion control IP core and a multi-sensor data fusion IP core;  a sensing-executing communication bridging unit,  the input end of the sensing-executing communication bridging unit is connected with the multi-type sensor of the human-shaped robot,  the output end is connected with the multi-type actuator of the human-shaped robot,  and the sensing-executing communication bridging unit is in bidirectional communication connection with the FPGA main control unit,  for realizing the forwarding of the sensor data between the FPGA main control unit and the sensing-executing communication bridging unit,  or the control instruction between the FPGA main control unit and the sensing-executing communication bridging unit.

The invention discloses a control method for switching sitting and standing postures of a wheel-legged robot. The control method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  initial modeling; S2,  setting a strategy network and a value network; S3,  optimizing the strategy network; and S4,  deploying and realizing The invention provides a control method for switching sitting and standing postures of a wheel-footed robot,  which gives consideration to stability,  smoothness and generalization capability 1. A control method for switching sitting posture of wheel-foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  initial modelling step :  the model parameter comprises a state space,  an observing space,  an action space,  an initial state distribution,  a state transition probability,  a reward function and a discount factor;  S2,  the step of setting the policy network and the value network :  the optimal mapping strategy from the observing space to the action space is realized by setting the strategy network and the value network;  wherein the strategy network outputs the action according to the observation information of the main body sensor of the wheel-foot robot,  the value network estimates the state value according to the state information of the wheel-foot robot;  S3,  the strategy network optimization step :  in the simulation environment,  introducing the domain randomization training,  and using the near-end strategy optimization method to perform the optimization training to the strategy network and the value network,  until the strategy is converged,  obtaining the optimized strategy network;  The optimization training includes guiding through a reward function and a discount factor;  S4,  deployment implementation steps :  the optimized strategy network is arranged in the control system of the wheel-foot robot,  the strategy network receives the sensor observation information of the wheel-foot robot with fixed frequency,  and outputs the action,  the output action is converted into the joint moment through the proportion-differential controller,  so as to control the wheel-foot robot to finish the posture switching in real time.

The invention discloses a multi-source data processing method,  a multi-source data processing system,  multi-source data processing equipment and a multi-source data processing product of a humanoid robot. A multi-source data processing method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method is applied to the humanoid robot,  comprising the following steps :  classifying the multi-source data of the humanoid robot and setting the corresponding priority to obtain the target data;  establishing a storage list and a reading list corresponding to the target data;  the storage list and the reading list are respectively corresponding to the storage unit group of the humanoid robot;  in response to the data storage instruction of the humanoid robot,  combining the storage list according to the priority scheduling strategy to store the target data to the target storage unit;  in response to the data reading instruction of the humanoid robot,  invoking the reading list positioning target reading unit based on the service requirement,  obtaining the target data;  monitoring the utilization rate of the storage unit group and the data aging,  and executing erasing operation to the corresponding data area in the storage unit group according to the monitoring result.

The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot-oriented dialogue arrangement method and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of robots and artificial intelligence The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an operation instruction input oriented to a target robot and constructing a semantic track,  wherein the semantic track indicates an action sequence to be executed and an execution condition to be met when each action in the action sequence to be executed is executed; acquiring multi-source constraint data of a manufacturing site where the target robot is located and constructing a manufacturing state track; the manufacturing state track indicates the operational constraints and safety constraints on the manufacturing site; according to the manufacturing state track,  each action in the action sequence to be executed indicated by the semantic track is registered step by step to generate a candidate executable action sequence; logical rehearsal is performed based on the candidate executable action sequence,  and the actual executed action sequence of the target robot is determined based on the result of the logical rehearsal. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the safety risk caused when the semantic reasonableness and the manufacturing state reasonableness cannot be satisfied at the same time during instruction execution can be effectively reduced 1. A dialogue arranging method for humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining an operation instruction input facing to the target robot,  constructing a semantic rail based on the operation instruction input;  the semantic track indicates the action sequence to be executed and the execution condition to be satisfied when executing each action in the action sequence to be executed;  obtaining the multi-source constraint data of the manufacturing field of the target robot,  constructing a manufacturing state rail based on the multi-source constraint data;  the manufacturing state track indicates the operation constraint and safety constraint of the manufacturing field;  according to the manufacturing state track,  gradually registering each action in the action sequence to be executed indicated by the semantic track,  determining the action satisfying the preset requirement in the action sequence to be executed,  so as to generate a candidate executable action sequence;  performing logic pre-calculation based on the candidate executable action sequence,  determining the actual execution action sequence of the target robot according to the result of the logic pre-calculation;  the logic pre-calculation is performed aiming at the interlocking trigger condition,  time sequence correctness and resource occupation condition of each action in the executable action sequence.

The embodiment of the invention provides a method for determining action parameters of a humanoid robot and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control In this application,  by extracting input features of multiple modalities; in the bird's-eye view space,  obtain the characteristics to be observed generated by the fusion of multi-modal input characteristics,  and determine the static parameters of the static objects and the dynamic parameters of the dynamic objects around the humanoid robot; generating a first motion parameter of the humanoid robot based on the characteristic to be observed; determining a motion correction value using the motion residual value,  and modifying the first motion parameter using the motion correction value to obtain the second motion parameter The technical solution of this application obtains the characteristic information around the humanoid robot in real time Decoupling determines the dynamic parameters of the dynamic object and the static parameters of the static object,  determines the movable space of the robotic arm,  reduces dependence on positioning data,  improves the obstacle avoidance success rate of the humanoid robot,  and effectively improves the industrial operation efficiency of the humanoid robot and home interaction safety. 1. A method for determining action parameter of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  extracting a multimodal input feature including a surrounding image feature of the humanoid robot,  a real-time speed feature of at least one joint,  and a scene navigation feature;  in the bird ' s-eye view space,  obtaining the to-be-observed feature generated by the multi-mode input feature fusion,  determining the static parameter of the static object and the dynamic parameter of the dynamic object around the human-shaped robot;  generating a first motion parameter of the humanoid robot based on the feature to be observed;  determining a motion correction value by using the motion residual value,  and modifying the first motion parameter by using the motion correction value to obtain a second motion parameter,  wherein the second motion parameter is used for controlling the motion of the humanoid robot.

This application provides an end-to-side adaptation method,  device,  equipment and medium for a humanoid robot,  and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. Obtain the current task requirements and environmental characteristic parameters,  and determine the simulation objectives and constraints accordingly,  and clarify the optimization direction and boundaries. Predict the simulated behavioral parameters of the robot in the current environment through the digital twin model Guided by simulation objectives and constraints,  the end-side configuration parameters are iteratively optimized to generate a configuration scheme adapted to the current task requirements,  which improves the adaptation accuracy of the end-side configuration parameters of the humanoid robot and enhances the robot's ability to perform tasks and adapt to the environment in different scenarios in the financial and medical fields. 1. An end side adapting method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  when receiving the end side adapting signal,  scanning the end side hardware component of the target robot through the hardware feature sensing algorithm to obtain the hardware performance parameter of the target robot;  based on the hardware performance parameters,  performing structure simulation on the target robot through a digital twin model,  generating a three-dimensional reconstruction model of the target robot;  obtaining the current task requirement of the target robot,  and collecting the environment characteristic parameter of the current environment of the target robot;  based on the current task requirement and the environment characteristic parameter,  determining a simulation target and a constraint condition;  predicting the simulation behaviour parameter of the three-dimensional reconstruction model of the target robot in the current environment by the digital twin model;  taking the simulation target and the constraint condition as reward function,  based on the simulation behaviour parameter,  performing iteration optimization to the current end side configuration parameter of the three-dimensional reconstruction model,  generating the end side parameter configuration scheme adapted to the current task requirement.

Emotionally-Aware Multi-Agent AI Systems Abstract In the evolving landscape of artificial intelligence,  the integration of emotional intelligence within multi-agent systems (MAS) represents a transformative leap toward human-like cognition and interaction. Emotionally-aware multi-agent AI systems aim to simulate,  recognize,  and respond to affective states,  enabling agents to collaborate,  negotiate,  and make context-sensitive decisions with empathy and social awareness. This research explores a novel architecture that embeds affective computing models into agent-based frameworks using hybrid deep learning and reinforcement learning techniques. The proposed system dynamically adjusts agent behaviors based on emotional cues derived from textual,  visual,  and physiological data,  enhancing adaptability in complex environments such as healthcare,  education,  and human–robot interaction. Affective reasoning mechanisms,  inspired by psychological theories like the OCC model and cognitive appraisal theory,  are integrated to ensure realistic emotion modeling and propagation across agents. Information to construct a feature vector; using expert trajectory as sample and candidate trajectory as decision space,  applying maximum entropy principle and feature matching mechanism to learn human-like lane-changing reward function to reproduce expert behavior preference and select the best candidate trajectory; finally,  a multi-objective optimization function is constructed,  trajectory parameters are optimized through piecewise nonlinear programming in the spatiotemporal dimension,  and the optimal trajectory is generated and output to the vehicle controller to perform lane change. A vehicle anthropogenic lane-changing control method of fusion prediction track,  wherein it comprises :  constructing a vehicle lane-changing expert track set based on the historical vehicle track data,  and generating a vehicle lane-changing candidate track set by perturbation expert track end state and polynomial interpolation;  extracting the track characteristics of the vehicle lane changing expert track set and the vehicle lane changing candidate track set,  and combining the future track information of the environment vehicle to construct the track characteristic vector;  the expert track set is used as the real sample,  the candidate track set is used as the decision space,  the track characteristic vector is used as the characteristic input,  the anthropotropic track-changing reward function is obtained by learning through the maximum entropy principle and the characteristic matching mechanism;  selecting the candidate track with the highest reward value from the vehicle lane-changing candidate track set as the anthropoid lane-changing track based on the anthropoid lane-changing reward function;  wherein the human-like lane-changing reward function is used for reappearing the expert behaviour preference;  constructing a multi-target optimization function based on the anthropogenic track-changing track,  optimizing the track parameter of the multi-target optimization function in the space-time dimension through the segmented non-linear planning,  generating the optimal anthropogenic track-changing track;  wherein the optimization target of the multi-target optimization function comprises humanoid,  comfort,  lane changing efficiency and safety;  taking the optimal anthropoid lane-changing track as the tracking track to output to the vehicle transverse and longitudinal controller,  so that the vehicle transverse and longitudinal controller can finish the vehicle anthropoid lane-changing control process according to the tracking track.

The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning A humanoid robot indoor path planning method,  system,  electronic device and storage medium based on surface passability estimation are provided The method comprises the following steps of :  surface type map generation,  texture feature extraction,  equivalent friction coefficient prediction,  flatness index calculation,  passability probability map prediction,  candidate path generation,  safety audit screening,  comprehensive cost screening and optimal motion strategy generation; and the method comprises the following steps of :  generating a surface type map,  extracting texture features,  predicting an equivalent friction coefficient,  calculating a flatness index,  predicting a passability probability map,  generating a candidate path,  and performing safety audit screening and comprehensive cost screening By introducing the physical characteristics of the surface into the decision-making process,  the present invention realizes the planning level improvement from geometric obstacle avoidance to physical quality and efficiency; by actively identifying and avoiding specific risks,  major accident hazards such as slips and trips are eliminated directly from the source of decision-making,  improving reliability. 1. A human-shaped robot indoor path planning method based on surface availability estimation,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the RGB image and the depth point cloud,  and using the YOLO11-seg model to perform instance division on the RGB image,  obtaining the surface type map;  performing block division on the depth point cloud according to the ground surface type map,  obtaining block point cloud,  performing feature extraction on each block point cloud by using pre-constructed texture extraction formula,  obtaining texture feature;  inputting the surface type map and the texture feature into a pre-fitted regression function for mapping to obtain an equivalent friction coefficient;  performing local elevation variance mean calculation on the block point cloud to obtain a flatness index;  inputting the equivalent friction coefficient and the flatness index into a pre-trained passable probability prediction model for prediction to obtain a passable probability map;  generating multiple candidate paths by a planner according to the ground surface type map based on the preset starting point and the end point;  performing safety audit screening and comprehensive cost screening to each candidate path according to the passing probability map to obtain the optimal path;  using the gait strategy mapping mechanism based on the physical parameter to convert the optimal path into the optimal motion strategy,  and using the optimal motion strategy to control the target humanoid robot to move.

The invention can integrate real-time gait prediction,  admittance parameter adaptive adjustment and interactive force error dynamic compensation to achieve human-machine collaborative rehabilitation training with high flexibility and high safety. 1. A gait prediction compensation admittance control method for lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the multi-source motion information in real time,  filtering and aligning the time to obtain the uniform multi-dimensional motion vector;  inputting the multi-dimensional motion vector into the pre-trained temporal prediction model,  and outputting the prediction result of the gait phase at the future time;  if the maximum probability output by the temporal prediction model is lower than the preset threshold value,  automatically switching to the pre-constructed rule criterion to perform gait phase identification;  retrieving the admittance control parameter matched with the gait phase prediction result from the pre-constructed admittance parameter mapping list,  and calculating the primary control torque based on the transferred admittance control parameter;  calculating the compensation torque based on the deviation between the actual human–robot interaction force and the expected interaction force;  the primary control torque is overlapped with the compensation torque as the final torque drive command of the exoskeleton motor.

The invention provides an intelligent control method for a humanoid robot single-hand and double-hand grabbing task. The intelligent control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring interlayer connection strength distribution and gap width data of a nested object,  and constructing an initial connection strength distribution map and a gap width recording table; identifying a boundary between a continuously accessible region and a discrete isolated region based on the connection strength profile and the gap width record table,  and evaluating a degree of deviation of a gap transition amplitude from a critical threshold; adjust the prioritization of the grasping level based on the degree of deviation,  determine the target level and plan the finger insertion path; the finger insertion path is combined with the real-time contact force distribution to evaluate the contact degree,  and the path offset distance is dynamically adjusted to generate a proposed grasping path; determine the final grasping level and grasping path based on the weak position coordinates to guide the humanoid robot to perform grasping actions. 1. An intelligent control method for single-hand and double-hand grabbing task of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the inter-layer connection strength distribution and gap width data of the nested object,  constructing an initial connection strength distribution diagram and a gap width recording table;  according to the connection intensity distribution map and the gap width recording table,  identifying the boundary of the continuous reachable region and the discrete isolated region,  evaluating the deviation degree of the gap transition amplitude and the critical threshold value;  adjusting the priority order of the grabbing level based on the deviation degree,  determining the target level and planning the finger insertion path;  evaluating the contact degree by combining the finger insertion path with the real-time contact force distribution,  dynamically adjusting the path offset distance to generate a quasi-grabbing path;  evaluating the deviation degree between the real-time opening size and the initial opening size according to the grabbing path,  after updating the hierarchical priority order according to the deviation degree between the real-time opening size and the initial opening size,  identifying the coordinate of the weak position to be grasped;  determining the final grabbing level and the grabbing path based on the weak position coordinate,  guiding the humanoid robot to execute the grabbing action.

An action track planning and evaluation method based on humanoid robot world model,  wherein it is applied to humanoid robot,  the action track planning and evaluation method comprises :  obtaining the multi-mode sensor data of the current operation scene through the sensor group of the humanoid robot,  and generating the global visual angle state real-time information according to the multi-mode sensor data;  inputting the global visual angle state real-time information to the trained strategy network to process,  obtaining multiple action track anchor points,  and generating multiple real-time state-action pairs according to the global visual angle state real-time information and each action track anchor point;  respectively inputting each of the real-time state-action pair into the trained humanoid robot world model for processing,  obtaining the prediction state-action pair corresponding to each of the real-time state-action pair,  inputting the real-time state-action pair and the corresponding prediction state-action pair to a preset score prediction network to process,  obtaining the evaluation result of the prediction state-action pair corresponding to the prediction action track;  determining the target action track in each predicted action track according to the evaluation result,  converting the target action track into the control instruction,  and executing the control instruction by the executing mechanism of the humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a multi-shaft cooperative compensation processing method and a multi-shaft cooperative compensation processing device for a gear based on spinor error mapping The method comprises collecting measured data and calculating dynamic transmission error; establish a gear contact analysis model and dynamic model,  and invert the equivalent tooth profile error including tooth profile/pitch error under manufacturing achievable constraints; based on the spinor theory,  a machining kinematic chain model consistent with the actual gear grinding machine structure is established,  various machine tool errors are characterized as spinor/displacement parameter disturbances,  a linear mapping relationship is constructed,  and an error propagation model is established; calculate the sensitivity matrix to identify the key machine tool error sources and corresponding motion axes that have the most significant impact on tooth profile errors; the synchronous correction amount of each key axis is calculated and executed in real time during machining to achieve active compensation. The invention realizes the active compensation and precise control of the manufacturing error of the humanoid robot joint reducer,  effectively reduces the DTE amplitude of the reducer,  reduces the risk of local wear and improves the positioning accuracy. 1. A gear multi-axis cooperative compensation processing method based on rotation error mapping,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  collecting the actual measurement data of the robot joint planetary speed reducer under multiple working conditions,  calculating to obtain the dynamic transmission error;  S2 :  based on the actual measurement data,  establishing a gear contact analysis model for performing static meshing characteristic analysis and a dynamic model for performing time domain/frequency domain simulation,  and comparing the simulation result of the dynamic transmission error with the actual measurement result,  the equivalent tooth-shaped error including tooth profile/tooth distance error obtained by inversion under constraint can be manufactured;  S3 :  based on the rotation amount theory,  establishing a processing motion chain model consistent with the actual gear grinding machine structure,  representing each type of machine tool error as the disturbance to the rotation amount/displacement parameter,  and using the accompanying conversion and linearization method,  constructing the linear mapping relation of the tooth profile/tooth distance error relative to each axis error,  establishing an error propagation model;  S4 :  based on the error propagation model,  calculating a sensitivity matrix,  identifying a key machine tool error source and a corresponding moving shaft which have the most obvious influence on the tooth-shaped error;  S5 :  according to the identification result,  calculating the synchronous correction of each key shaft and executing in real time in the processing,  so as to realize the active compensation of the tooth profile/tooth distance error.

The invention discloses a method,  a device and equipment for navigating and positioning a bionic joint humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  monitoring a robot landing shock wave signal and reflection echo data,  performing time domain expansion on the shock wave signal to form a pulse characteristic spectrum,  extracting multipath propagation components,  and performing time difference correlation to generate an environment response value The environmental response value is used to screen the direct wave component,  locate the sound wave propagation trajectory,  and detect the impedance mutation to construct an acoustic matrix. The strong reflection zone is identified by node analysis,  the obstacle boundary is determined by extracting the sound pressure gradient field,  and the landmark feature bit is determined by combining the environmental response value. The dynamic stride interval is adjusted based on the landmark feature bits to form an adaptive detection sequence and sparsely process the path configuration. The mechanical vibration component of the shock wave signal is used to perform piezoelectric conversion to generate recovered electricity,  which matches the path configuration power to determine the sensing cycle,  performs intermittent sensing to obtain detection data to construct a detection convergence field,  and finally determines the precise positioning window and converts it into position coordinates. 1. A bionic joint humanoid robot navigation positioning method,  wherein it comprises :  monitoring the impact wave signal and the reflected echo data of the robot landing,  performing time domain expansion on the impact wave signal to form a pulse characteristic spectrum,  extracting the multi-path propagation component in the reflected echo data,  performing time difference correlation on the pulse characteristic spectrum and the multi-path propagation component to generate an environment response value,  comprising :  performing envelope extraction to the pulse characteristic spectrum to identify the main pulse boundary;  calibrating an emission reference time based on the main pulse boundary;  using the transmission reference time to perform time delay mark on the multi-path transmission component to generate a transmission time delay table;  forming an environment response value according to the transmission time delay table mapping;  using the environment response value to screen the direct wave component,  locating the sound wave propagation track through the direct wave component,  detecting the impedance mutation along the propagation track to form the reflection interface data,  constructing the acoustic matrix based on the reflection interface data;  performing node analysis on the acoustic matrix to identify a strong reflection zone,  comprising :  constructing a sound pressure distribution curved surface based on the acoustic matrix to determine the analysis precision;  performing gradient tracking on the sound pressure distribution curved surface according to the analysis precision;  extracting the zero position from the gradient tracking result to form a wave node set;  marking the region with the density exceeding the threshold value in the node set as the strong reflection zone;  extracting the sound pressure gradient field of the strong reflection zone,  determining the boundary position of the barrier based on the sound pressure gradient field,  comparing the boundary position of the barrier with the environment response value to determine the landmark feature bit;  adjusting a dynamic step frequency interval based on the landmark feature bit,  using the dynamic step frequency interval to form a self-adaptive detection sequence,  thinning the self-adaptive detection sequence to extract a key detection set,  and constructing a path configuration based on the key detection set;  using the mechanical vibration component in the shock wave signal to perform the piezoelectric conversion to generate the recycled electric quantity,  determining the sensing period based on the matching of the recycled electric quantity and the path configuration power,  executing the intermittent sensing operation according to the sensing period to obtain the detection data,  constructing the detection gathering field based on the detection data;  determining an accurate positioning window by using the detection convergence field,  and converting the path configuration into a final position coordinate based on the accurate positioning window.
