The present invention discloses a high-strength nylon for humanoid robot and its preparation method The composite material uses MXD6 nylon and PA66 nylon as the composite matrix,  chopped carbon fiber as the main reinforcement,  and adds toughening agent,  antioxidant,  lubricant and nucleating agent The preparation method includes :  after vacuum drying each raw material,  place it in a twin-screw extruder according to a specific ratio,  and perform melt blending and granulation at a precisely controlled temperature range (240-285 °C) and screw speed; after the obtained particles are dried,  they are formed into the required structural parts by injection molding machine under specific technological parameters The present invention uses the synergistic effect of MXD6 and PA66 And optimized the processing technology,  successfully prepared a composite material with high strength,  high rigidity,  high fatigue resistance,  excellent impact toughness and extremely low water absorption,  which perfectly solved the technical problem of material performance imbalance of existing humanoid robot structural parts,  and significantly improved the robot's movement accuracy,  load capacity and long-term reliability. 1. A preparation method of high strength nylon for human-shaped robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) pre-drying the raw materials :  The following raw materials according to parts by weight at 80-100 ℃ vacuum drying for 6-8 hours,  the water content is less than 0. 05 % :  MXD6 nylon resin 50-70 parts;  PA66 nylon resin 10-20 parts;  chopped carbon fibre 15 -25 parts;  toughening agent 3-8 parts;  0.3-1.0 part of antioxidant;  0.5-1.5 parts of lubricant;  0.2-0.8 parts of nucleating agent;  (2) melting and blending :  adding all the dried raw materials into a double-screw extruder,  melting,  mixing,  extruding,  cooling,  pulling and cutting to obtain nylon composite material particles;  wherein the processing temperature of the twin-screw extruder is :  the first area is 240-250 degrees centigrade,  the second area is 250-260 degrees centigrade,  the third area is 260-270 degrees centigrade,  the fourth area is 265-275 degrees centigrade,  the machine head is 270-275 degrees centigrade;  the rotating speed of the screw rod is 300-400 r/min;  (3) injection molding :  the obtained nylon composite material particles are dried at 100-120 degrees centigrade for 4-6 hours,  then placed in an injection moulding machine,  the temperature of the material cylinder is 265-285 degrees centigrade,  the injection pressure is 70-100 MPa,  the mould temperature is 80-100 degrees centigrade,  injection moulding is human-shaped robot structure.

The invention discloses a method and system for precise spatial positioning of a quadruped robot based on deep learning,  which specifically includes :  S1. Align the lidar data stream and the inertial measurement unit data stream to uniformly generate a synchronous sensing data sequence; s2. The output poses of the offline point cloud registration algorithm pool are determined through consistency evaluation to determine the mapping pose sequence; s3. Parallel loopback detection generates a unified loopback constraint set; s4. The mapping pose sequence,  loop constraint set,  and pre-integration constraint are written into the factor graph model to generate a three-dimensional point cloud benchmark map; s5. Register the local point cloud frame with the three-dimensional point cloud reference map to output the map matching pose; s6. The map matching pose and pre-integration results are written into the factor graph model to continuously solve and output the continuous-time six-degree-of-freedom pose results; s7. Output the continuous-time six-degree-of-freedom pose result. The invention introduces direction constraint consistency point cloud registration and dual-channel loop optimization to achieve stable and high-precision positioning in a closed space. 1. A four-foot robot space precise positioning method and system based on deep learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  accessing the laser radar data stream and the inertia measuring unit data stream,  performing time stamp alignment on each data stream and unifying with the coordinate system,  forming a synchronous sensing data sequence;  S2,  in the off-line mapping stage,  inputting the synchronous sensing data sequence into the point cloud registration algorithm pool,  the point cloud registration algorithm pool comprises different kinds of point cloud registration algorithms,  performing consistency evaluation on the pose result output by each algorithm at the same time position,  determining the mapping pose sequence under the consistency evaluation constraint;  S3,  performing loop-back detection in parallel in the off-line graph-building stage,  the loop-back detection comprises loop-back candidate generation based on Euclidean distance and loop-back candidate generation based on scene feature descriptor,  any loop-back candidate is written into the uniform loop-back constraint set after consistency verification;  S4,  writing the image position sequence,  the uniform loop constraint set and the pre-integral constraint of the inertia measuring unit into the factor graph model,  performing global consistency optimization in the factor graph model,  generating a three-dimensional point cloud reference map;  S5,  loading the three-dimensional point cloud reference map in the operation stage,  inputting the real-time obtained local point cloud frame into the point cloud registration algorithm pool,  outputting the map matching pose under the same consistency evaluation restriction in the off-line mapping stage;  S6,  writing the map matching pose and the inertial measurement unit pre-integral result as the observation factor into the factor graph model,  performing the continuous solution through the nonlinear optimization library,  and outputting the continuous time six-degree-of-freedom pose result;  S7,  taking the continuous time six-degree-of-freedom pose result as the four-foot robot navigation positioning result to output.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot navigation and control,  and in particular to a quadruped robot autonomous navigation method and system based on multi-sensor deep fusion. Through deep fusion of multiple sensors (lidar,  vision,  IMU) and 3D SLAM mapping,  the robot has acquired all-round,  high-precision,  and movable environmental perception and map construction capabilities that surpass humans and fixed cameras. This enables it to systematically cover all accessible areas without visual blind spots. Autonomous global path planning ensures the systematicness and optimality of patrol paths,  and avoids the randomness and inefficiency of manual patrol; local real-time obstacle avoidance ensures that dynamic changes can be flexibly responded to during the process of covering the entire area,  and tasks will not be interrupted due to temporary obstacles. It realizes high-precision,  high-efficiency,  and automatic inspections of substation reconstruction and expansion areas without blind spots,  fundamentally It solves the inherent defects in coverage and flexibility of manual and fixed monitoring methods. 1. A four-foot robot autonomous navigation method based on multi-sensor deep fusion,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  the environment data is collected by the laser radar,  the visual sensor and the IMU;  step S2 :  constructing a multi-sensor fusion model based on Bayesian estimation frame,  realizing data space-time synchronization and semantic fusion;  step S3 :  constructing a three-dimensional environment map based on the fused data,  comprising an occupation map,  a semantic map and a topology map;  step S4 :  performing global path planning according to the task target and the map information;  step S5 :  the local obstacle avoidance and path adjustment are performed according to the real-time sensor data in the travelling process;  step S6 :  analyzing the history path data by the reinforcement learning algorithm,  optimizing the subsequent path strategy;  Step S6 specifically comprises :  S61 :  constructing an experience playback buffer area,  for storing the experience data generated by the robot in the historical inspection task,  the experience data is stored in the form of tuple (s-t,  a-t,  r-t,  s - (t + 1)),  wherein s-t represents the state of t time,  a-t represents the action of execution,  r-t represents the obtained instant reward,  s - (t + 1) represents the next state;  s-t comprises one or more of the following information :  the current position and posture of the robot,  the residual electric quantity of the battery,  the obstacle feature vector of the local cost map and the relative position of the current task target point;  r-t is calculated by the weighted reward function,  the formula is as follows :  r_t=w_1 (-.DELTA.d) + w_2 (-.DELTA.e) + w_3V + w_4 (-P);  wherein delta d is the moving distance,  delta e is energy consumption,  V is the positive reward when reaching the key inspection point,  P is the penalty value close to the barrier or the movement is not stable,  w-1,  w-2,  w-3,  w-4 are the preset weight coefficient;  S62 :  using the data sampled from the experience playback buffer area to train the depth Q network so as to learn the optimal action strategy;  wherein when training the depth Q network,  the target Q value is calculated by using the target network,  and the calculation formula of the target Q value is as follows :  y-t = r-t + ymax-a Q-target (s - (t + 1),  a -);  wherein y is the discount factor,  Q-target is the target network,  theta-is the parameter of the target network,  and the updating frequency is lower than the online Q network;  S63 :  based on the trained deep Q network,  generating an optimized action sequence in the subsequent inspection task;  step S7 :  dynamically deciding according to the energy state,  task priority and environment change;  step S8 :  controlling the robot to execute the motion instruction according to the decision result.

The invention discloses an autonomous exploration method,  system,  terminal and storage medium for a quadruped robot based on hierarchical planning. The method includes :  unifying the data of the lidar and inertial measurement unit of the quadruped robot to obtain a calibrated sensor data stream; calculate the sensor data stream and output the real-time pose of the quadruped robot in the global coordinate system; based on the real-time pose,  the sensor data stream is registered and fused with the existing point cloud map,  a global point cloud map is constructed and updated in an incremental manner,  and a local occupancy map is generated and updated in the coordinate system of the quadruped robot body; make macroscopic decisions based on the global point cloud map to generate a target viewpoint,  perform local viewpoint evaluation and path planning based on the local occupancy map and the target viewpoint,  and generate path points leading to the target viewpoint; generate motion commands based on waypoints to drive quadruped robots for autonomous exploration. The invention ensures the stable operation of the quadruped robot in a complex environment 1. A four-foot robot autonomous search method based on hierarchical planning,  wherein the four-foot robot autonomous search method based on hierarchical planning comprises :  performing time synchronization and space coordinate system unification to the laser radar carried by the four-foot robot and the data of the inertia measuring unit to obtain the calibrated sensor data stream;  using the laser radar inertia odometer to calculate the sensor data stream,  and outputting the real-time pose of the four-foot robot under the global coordinate system;  based on the real-time pose,  registering and fusing the sensor data stream with the existing point cloud map,  constructing and updating the global point cloud map in an incremental manner,  and generating and updating the local occupying map under the coordinate system of the four-foot robot main body;  performing macro decision according to the global point cloud map,  generating a target viewpoint,  performing local viewpoint evaluation and path planning according to the local occupied map and the target viewpoint,  generating a path point to the target viewpoint;  based on the path point,  generating a motion instruction in accordance with the kinematics of the four-foot robot,  driving the four-foot robot to perform autonomous search according to the motion instruction.

The invention discloses a bipedal humanoid robot control method and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environment original data through a multi-modal sensor; input the original environment data into the generative environment model to obtain effective scene information; input the effective scene information into the brain-like decision-making network to obtain control data and execute it; among them,  the generative environment is constructed with a variational autoencoder architecture; the brain-inspired decision-making network is constructed with a hierarchical structure of C. elegans neurons; generative environments and brain-inspired decision-making networks are trained by reinforcement learning algorithms. This application uniformly processes multi-modal data through a generative environment model Then,  by drawing lessons from the hierarchical structure of Caenorhabditis elegans neurons,  a brain-inspired decision-making network model is constructed to generate robot control data,  and combined with reinforcement learning algorithms,  the generative environment model and brain-inspired decision-making network are collaboratively trained to effectively improve the control strategy accuracy and safety of humanoid robots in complex scenes. 1. A double-foot humanoid robot control method,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the environment original data of the biped humanoid robot through the multi-mode sensor;  the multi-modal sensor comprises a depth camera,  a six-dimensional force sensor and a touch sensor;  inputting the environment original data to the generated environment model,  obtaining the scene effective information extracted by the generated environment model;  inputting the scene effective information to the brain-like decision network model,  obtaining and executing the control data of the biped robot output by the brain-like decision network model;  wherein the generated environment model is constructed based on the variable self-encoder architecture;  the brain-like decision network model is constructed based on the camouflage hidden rod nematode neuron layered structure;  the generated environment model and the brain-like decision network model are cooperatively trained by introducing entropy regularization reinforced learning algorithm.

The invention discloses a frameless outer rotor permanent magnet motor integrated in a robot joint module Comprises a stator,  a rotor radially arranged on the outer side of the stator and carrying a permanent magnet,  and a housing,  wherein a cylindrical sleeve for receiving the stator is arranged on the inner wall of the housing,  has a small wall thickness,  and is provided with a plurality of axial grooves penetrating through the wall thickness of the sleeve so as to provide flexibility; so that in the initial debugging process of the motor,  the stator can move radially relative to the shell under the action of electromagnetic force to realize the self-alignment of the air gap between the stator and the rotor; after self-alignment is completed,  the stator is locked relative to the housing To prevent further relative displacement during normal operation,  through the self-alignment of the stator after installation,  without increasing the number of sensors or control complexity,  the torque stability is improved,  vibration and acoustic noise are reduced,  and The force control accuracy required for collaborative robots,  industrial robotic arms and humanoid robot joints is improved. 1. A frameless outer rotor permanent magnet motor integrated on robot joint module,  comprising a stator (2),  a rotor (6) radially set on the outer side of the stator (2) and carrying a permanent magnet (5) and a shell (1),  wherein the inner wall of the shell (1) is provided with a cylindrical sleeve (9) for bearing the stator (2),  the sleeve (9) has smaller wall thickness,  and is provided with a plurality of axial grooves (11) passing through the wall thickness,  so as to provide flexibility;  so that in the initial debugging process of the motor,  the stator (2) can move radially relative to the shell (1) under the action of the electromagnetic force,  realizing the self-alignment of the air gap (10) between the stator (2) and the rotor (6);  After the self-alignment is completed,  the stator (2) is locked relative to the housing (1) to prevent further relative displacement during normal operation.

The invention provides a composite high-frequency multi-modal tactile sensing system and a signal acquisition method. The system includes :  a composite high-frequency multi-modal tactile sensor,  including :  a composite high-frequency multi-modal sensing unit,  an image acquisition unit,  a programmable light strip and an integrated housing,  a processing circuit and a host computer. The sensing system can simultaneously collect visual and tactile image signals and electrical signals,  and interpolate and fuse the results of high-frequency electrical signals and low-frequency visual and tactile image signals in the time domain through interpolation algorithm,  which significantly improves the sampling rate of visual and tactile image signals. The system has higher tactile perception ability,  is suitable for high-frequency tactile signal monitoring and complex mechanical information capture,  shows better performance in the fields of humanoid robot perception and precision operation,  and greatly expands the application scenarios and reliability of the system. 1. A composite high-frequency multi-modal touch sensing system,  wherein it comprises :  a composite high-frequency multi-mode tactile sensor for collecting the visual tactile image signal and the electrical signal at the same time,  wherein the sampling ratio of the electrical signal is greater than the sampling ratio of the visual tactile image signal;  a processing circuit for transmitting the control signal,  controlling the collection of the composite high-frequency multi-mode touch sensor to the visual touch image signal,  processing and integrating the electric signals,  integrating the electric signals of multiple channels at the same time and transmitting the electric signals to the upper computer;  an upper computer,  using the interpolation algorithm to interpolate the high-frequency electrical signal to the low-frequency visual touch image signal in the time domain,  and displaying the interpolated high-frequency visual touch image signal,  wherein the interpolation algorithm is used for training the visual touch image signal and the electrical signal at the time of superposition,  It can generate the corresponding visual tactile image signal through the electrical signal,  specifically comprising :  a training module for training the interpolation algorithm :  using the interpolation algorithm based on U-Net structure to realize the interpolation of the visual tactile image signal on the time domain,  in the pre-training of the algorithm,  inputting two frames of adjacent visual tactile image signal,  after multiple times of down-sampling,  adding electrical signal in the middle signal of the algorithm through cross-attention method for training,  then comparing the generated visual touch image signal with the existing visual touch image signal at the same time,  repeatedly training to make the output visual touch image signal more similar to the real visual touch image signal;  inputting the visual touch image signal of two adjacent frames and the electrical signal of the corresponding time and the time to be generated to the pre-trained interpolation algorithm to obtain the new visual touch image signal of the time to be generated;  if there is the visual touch image signal collected by the image collecting unit at the moment to be generated,  taking the visual touch image signal obtained by the image collecting unit at the sampling time point as the standard;  through the interpolation operation,  the sampling rate of the visual touch image signal is improved from fv to fe through time domain interpolation,  and finally the high frequency visual touch image signal is displayed on the upper computer.

Embodiments of the present application provide a collision detection method and device for a humanoid robot. The method includes :  Including obtaining the resultant force at the end of the robotic arm collected by the force sensor Derive the resultant force in time,  obtain the first force change rate data of the resultant force in the time domain,  based on the preset frequency threshold,  low-pass filtering the first force rate of change data Obtain the second force change rate data of the resultant force in the time domain,  the preset frequency threshold is determined based on the conversion of historical force change rate data into data in the frequency domain. The historical force change rate data is obtained by deriving the resultant force obtained during the operation where there is a collision in time. The collision detection result is determined based on the second force change rate data and the preset threshold. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention,  the calculation process is simple and efficient,  and the efficiency and the accuracy of target object screening are improved 1. A collision detection method for humanoid robot,  wherein it is applied to the humanoid robot,  the mechanical arm end of the humanoid robot is provided with a force sensor,  the method comprises :  in the working process,  obtaining the resultant force of the mechanical arm tail end collected by the force sensor;  obtaining the first force change rate data of the resultant force on the time domain;  performing low-pass filtering on the first force change rate data based on the preset frequency threshold to obtain the second force change rate data of the resultant force in the time domain;  the preset frequency threshold is determined by converting the historical force change rate data into the data on the frequency domain;  the historical force change rate data is obtained by the resultant force obtained in the collision operation process in time;  determining the collision detection result according to the second force change rate data and the preset threshold;  The method for determining the preset frequency threshold comprises :  in the first history operation process,  obtaining the first history resultant force of the mechanical arm end collected by the force sensor;  the first historical operation process comprises multiple collisions;  obtaining the first historical force change rate data of the historical resultant force on the time domain by deriving the first historical resultant force on the time;  converting the first historical force change rate data from the time domain to the frequency domain to obtain the first frequency domain data;  determining the preset frequency threshold according to the first frequency domain data;  obtaining the historical resultant force data under the condition of no collision and collision in the comparison group,  performing frequency domain comparison,  determining the preset frequency threshold value.

The invention discloses a multi-finger dexterous hand operation reinforcement learning method based on a human action prediction model,  and belongs to the field of dexterous hand body operation of a humanoid robot A human action prediction model is trained using data with 3D pose annotations of human hands and objects for generalizably generating 3D trajectories of human hands and object interactions. Use this trajectory to construct a general reward function for training dexterous hand reinforcement learning strategies in simulations. Then,  the migration ability of the strategy from simulation to reality is improved through simulation parameter domain randomization and course learning,  and the trained reinforcement learning strategy is deployed on the real-world robot. This scheme predicts the interaction process of human hands and objects as a whole by introducing understanding of the future posture of the operated object,  and builds a unified,  concise and efficient reward function based on this,  which is suitable for different operating tasks and different types of dexterous hands. It has the advantages of strong generalization,  high success rate,  and strong versatility of reward functions. 1. A multi-finger dexterous hand operation strengthening learning method based on human action prediction model,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  using the human operation data with three-dimensional pose label to train a human action prediction model,  the human action prediction model can synchronously predict the human hand pose and the object pose of the future time step in an auto-regression manner according to the input human hand pose,  the object pose and the object geometric feature;  step 2 :  in the physical simulation environment,  obtaining the current object pose and the dexterous hand state,  converting the dexterous hand state into the human hand MANO parameter representation,  and performing the coordinate space standardization and rotation representation continuous processing together with the object pose and the object geometric feature,  forming the input format consistent with the training data;  invoking the pre-trained human action prediction model,  synchronously generating the human hand pose and the operated object pose of the future time step,  and then mapping the predicted human hand pose to the joint angle and wrist pose of the dexterous hand suitable for robot control;  step 3 :  based on the joint angle and wrist position of the dexterous hand predicted in step 2,  and the position of the operated object,  constructing a universal reward function for strengthening learning,  the universal reward function comprises a wrist following reward function,  an object following reward function and a contact reward function;  and taking the current observation state as the input,  based on the universal reward function,  guiding the strengthening learning algorithm to train an operation strategy network,  in the training process,  introducing the simulation environment domain randomization technology and the course learning technology aiming at the initial pose of the object;  step 4 :  deploying the trained operation strategy network to the real robot platform.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot path planning,  and in particular relates to a robot local path planning method and system based on transition target guidance. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the current position and the original global target position of the robot; judging whether there is an obstacle on the straight path between the robot and the original global target,  if not,  determining the transition target position through direct mapping,  and recording it as the first transition target position; if yes,  determine the transition target position through candidate node evaluation and screening,  and record it as the second transition target position; the first transition target position or the second transition target position is used as the target position of the robot's next movement,  and the robot is guided until the robot reaches the original global target position to complete the local path planning of the robot. The invention effectively reduces the maintenance burden of the grid map,  expands the navigation range,  and realizes real-time multi-target navigation of the legged robot in complex environments. 1. A robot local path planning method based on transition target guidance,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the current position of the robot and the original global target position;  judging whether there is an obstacle on the straight line path between the robot and the original global target,  if not,  determining the position of the transition target in a direct mapping manner,  and recording the position of the first transition target;  if so,  determining the transition target position by the candidate node evaluation screening mode,  recording as the second transition target position;  taking the first transition target position or the second transition target position as the target position of the robot moving in the next step,  guiding the robot until the robot reaches the original global target position,  finishing the local path planning of the robot;  The transition target position is determined by direct mapping,  and the specific formula is as follows :  ;  Wherein,  representing the maximum navigation range in the grid map range;  representing the position of the first transition target;  representing the distance of the original global target relative to the robot;  representing the position vector of the original global target relative to the robot;  The method further comprises :  determining the location of the candidate node,  specifically comprising :  The method comprises the following steps :  firstly,  determining the first transition target position by the direct mapping mode,  at this time,  the first transition target position is located in the barrier area;  then,  taking the first transition target position in the barrier area as the starting point to expand outwards,  searching the node with the grid value of 0 as the candidate node;  determining the transition target position by means of candidate node evaluation screening,  specifically comprising :  calculating the comprehensive score of each candidate node,  the comprehensive score is determined by three factors :  the distance with the original global target,  the safety of the surrounding area and the distribution condition of the grid map boundary;  selecting the candidate node with the highest comprehensive score from all candidate nodes as the second transition target.

The invention belongs to the field of humanoid robots and discloses a humanoid robot tension control method and device based on an improved contact model This method constructs a four-layer hierarchical control architecture,  proposes an improved contact force model,  and adopts a smooth continuous function instead of the traditional rigid complementary constraints,  in which the first term is the sigmoid-based repulsive force and the second term is the Gaussian-type attraction force,  allowing the generation of tensile force (negative normal force) at the contact point. The upper-level heuristic gait planner quickly generates landing positions through dead-zone feedback; middle-layer CIMPC is used to simplify the single rigid body model to jointly optimize the centroid trajectory and contact force sequence; the whole body controller maps to joint commands by task priority; underlayer PD Servo Controller High Frequency Drive Joint. The invention enables the humanoid robot to use adsorption tension to assist walking in complex environments such as low-friction slopes and narrow channels,  significantly improving movement ability and robustness. 1. A human-shaped robot tension control method based on improved contact model,  wherein the method constructs a closed-loop control mechanism based on prediction and contact cooperation,  comprising the following steps :  step 1,  collecting the centroid state and contact state of the robot,  the centroid state comprises position,  speed and posture,  the contact state comprises the signed distance of each contact point and adsorption pressure;  step 2,  based on linear inverted pendulum (LIP) dynamics and dead area feedback mechanism,  according to the mass centre state and expected movement requirement generating foot target and hand end contact target;  step 3,  in the prediction window,  the robot dynamics is simplified into a single rigid body model,  and the generalized coordinate track q (0 :  N),  the generalized speed track v (0 :  N) and the joint moment tau (0 :  N-1) are optimization variables,  under the condition of satisfying the dynamic constraint and friction constraint,  jointly optimizing the mass centre track and the contact force sequence;  step 4,  in the prediction process,  the contact force is calculated by the improved smooth continuous function :  the first item is repulsive force item based on sigmoid,  the second item is gauss type attraction item;  when the contact distance when the suction force is about 0,  the suction force item generates a pull force to simulate the suction effect of the suction disc;  when the contact point is a common foot support,  k=0,  the contact force function is degraded to be a traditional model only excluding;  step 5,  based on the optimized centroid track and contact force,  according to the task priority,  mapping it as the whole joint target and the adsorption tension target;  step 6,  sending the joint target and the adsorption tension target to the execution layer to drive the robot to act;  The actual state is fed back to the prediction layer to form a closed loop update.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot behavior monitoring and safety intervention device based on power supply ripple spectrum identification,  and discloses a safety monitoring device for preventing a malicious attacker from controlling a humanoid robot to execute malicious operations (such as robot attack) The device comprises an independent microprocessor,  a current ripple acquisition unit,  an independent power supply unit and a physical intervention unit,  wherein the current ripple acquisition unit is used for extracting instantaneous current ripples of a power supply rail of a main control CPU; the independent microprocessor determines anomalies based on the offset of the energy spectrum entropy value (continuous energy spectrum entropy value offset > 10% and duration > 5ms); the physical intervention unit cuts off the power supply of the actuator (such as the robot joint motor) to achieve millisecond-level intervention of ≤ 10 ms,  effectively blocking the physical operation of malicious attackers (such as waving a fist/extending a robotic arm),  and millisecond-level intervention endangers safety. 1. A safety monitoring device,  for preventing a malicious attacker from controlling a humanoid robot to perform malicious operation,  wherein it comprises :  a current ripple collecting unit connected to the power supply rail of the human-shaped robot main control unit for extracting the instantaneous current ripple generated when the main control unit executes the instruction;  an independent microprocessor completely isolated from the main control unit of the humanoid robot on the physical layer,  the time sequence layer and the power supply logic,  and calculating the energy spectrum entropy value of the current frequency spectrum based on the current ripple;  a physical interference unit for triggering the electronic fuse to cut off or the physical switch to cut off when the energy spectrum entropy value exceeds the predetermined threshold.

The present invention relates to the field of production safety technology More specifically,  it is a production safety monitoring system based on the Internet of Things Comprises a central processing module,  a weight detection module,  a production module,  a protection module and a person capturing module The weight detection module is used to detect weight changes in both the production module and the protection module Upload the weight change to the central processing module The central processing module can set and record the weight variation range of both the production module and the protection module in real time When the weight changes beyond the preset range,  the protection module is activated,  or when the person capture module detects that humanoid activities occur within the production module and the protection module,  the protection module is activated to prevent damage to objects entering the production module and the protection module. 1. A production safety monitoring system based on internet of things,  comprising a central processing module,  a weight detection module,  a production module,  a protection module and a character capturing module,  the weight detection module is used for detecting the weight change of the production module and the protection module,  the weight change is uploaded to the central processing module,  the central processing module can set and record the weight change range of the production module and the protection module in real time,  when the change range of the weight exceeds the pre-set range,  the protection module is started,  or when the character capturing module detects that the human-shaped movement appears in the production module and the protection module,  the protection module is started.

The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control method and related equipment based on an attention mechanism,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring task instructions and current environment sensing data of the humanoid robot; fusion of the dynamic attention code with the current state information of the humanoid robot to generate the state input of the reinforcement learning model; based on state input,  the action strategy of the robot is output through the pre-trained reinforcement learning model to control the humanoid robot to perform movement or task operations; if it is detected that the humanoid robot is in the task execution process,  the environmental feedback and execution result data are collected in real time,  and the reinforcement learning model is optimized online based on this. If it is detected that the humanoid robot has completed the task,  the key experience information of this task execution is extracted,  encoded as gene fragments and stored in the group experience gene bank. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the humanoid robot can quickly make a stable decision in an unknown environment 1. A humanoid robot control method based on attention mechanism,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the task instruction of the humanoid robot and the current environment sensing data collected by the multi-mode sensor;  processing the environment sensing data based on the attention mechanism,  generating a dynamic attention code for representing the future feasible falling point area;  fusing the dynamic attention code with the current state information of the humanoid robot to generate a state input of a reinforced learning model;  based on the state input,  outputting the action strategy of the robot through the pre-trained strengthening learning model,  controlling the humanoid robot to perform movement or task operation;  if it is detected that the humanoid robot is in the task execution process,  then collecting environment feedback and execution result data in real time,  and based on this,  performing online optimization on the enhanced learning model,  if it is detected that the humanoid robot finishes the task,  then extracting the key experience information of this task execution,  coding the gene segment and storing the gene segment to the group experience gene library,  and performing evolution optimization to the gene segment in the group experience gene library,  and synchronizing the optimized gene strategy to the reinforced learning model of each humanoid robot.

The embodiment of the invention provides a walking control method and related equipment of a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the technical field of robots The method includes :  receiving a production work order from a manufacturing execution system; obtain real-time environmental data,  and build an environmental model containing ground status,  obstacles,  robot's own status and task target area based on the real-time environmental data; based on the environment model and the task nodes assigned to the current humanoid robot,  the model predictive control algorithm is used to perform multi-objective optimization to generate an optimal control strategy including walking path and gait; controlling the current foot humanoid robot to execute the optimal control strategy,  and dynamically adjusting the optimal control strategy according to the environment model through the task execution dynamic adjustment model; through the feedback learning model,  the evolved experience fragments are synchronously updated to all humanoid robots. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the humanoid robot can achieve a stable,  flexible and intelligent execution effect in variable production scenes 1. A walking control method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  receiving the production work order from the production execution system,  and analyzing the production work order to obtain a plurality of task nodes,  and based on the task nodes,  according to the current state and task priority of each humanoid robot,  performing task bidding and dynamic distribution among multiple humanoid robots;  obtaining the real-time environment data,  and constructing the environment model including the ground state,  the obstacle,  the robot self state and the task target area according to the real-time environment data;  based on the environment model and the task node distributed to the current humanoid robot,  using the model prediction control algorithm to perform multi-target optimization,  generating the optimal control strategy containing walking path and gait;  wherein the multi-objective optimization takes into account at least task priority and environmental uncertainty;  controlling the current foot-type humanoid robot to execute the optimal control strategy,  and dynamically adjusting the optimal control strategy according to the environment model by the task executing dynamic adjusting model;  through the feedback learning model,  the key data in the task execution process is extracted as an empirical segment,  and after gene coding is performed,  stored into a population gene library,  and through the gene evolution model,  the empirical segment in the population gene library is screened,  cross and variation operation,  and synchronously updating the evolved experience segment to all humanoid robots.

The invention discloses a method,  a device,  equipment and a storage medium for controlling gait of a biped robot The technical solution of the present invention,  via offline gait control datasets,  train the preset gait vector generation model,  get the target gait vector generation model,  this training method does not rely on online interaction in a reinforcement learning environment The model training process is stable,  the convergence is fast,  and the interpretability is strong Through the reinforcement learning algorithm,  based on the current state vector and the joint motion trajectory of the current gait cycle,  output current control parameters,  adapt to the current gait rhythm,  ensure the movement stability of the bipedal robot By decoupling the two processes of gait vector generation and control parameter generation,  the problem that the model is difficult to train after putting the stride frequency into the state vector is solved,  and at the same time,  the autonomous adjustment of the stride frequency of the biped robot is realized,  the energy efficiency of the full speed domain is optimized,  the robustness of the robot's gait control is enhanced,  and the humanoid natural gait is generated. 1. A gait control method of biped robot,  wherein it comprises :  determining the current state vector of the biped robot at the current control time;  inputting the current state vector to a pre-trained target gait vector generation model,  and outputting the current gait vector;  according to the current gait vector,  determining the joint motion track of each joint of the biped robot in the current gait period;  determining the current control parameter of the biped robot according to the current state vector and the joint motion track of the current gait period;  driving the biped robot joint to move into the next state according to the current control parameter so as to control the gait of the biped robot.

The invention discloses a method for simultaneously realizing communication and man-machine communication of an intelligent humanoid robot using dual-core heterogeneous cores :  Add a dynamic computing power scheduling abstraction layer between the ARM architecture communication core and the x86 architecture intelligent core of the humanoid robot To build a unified computing power pool,  the dual-core load status is monitored in real time through this abstraction layer When either core load is too high,  dynamically migrate non-real-time tasks to the idle computing power area of another kernel At the same time,  based on the human-computer interaction scenario predicted by visual recognition,  differentiated computing power weights are pre-assigned to the dual cores. Finally,  through the coordination of this abstraction layer,  the communication core is responsible for instruction reception and preliminary analysis,  and the intelligent core is responsible for combining the body perception Data is used for decision-making and planning to achieve efficient collaborative response between the two. By adding a dynamic computing power scheduling abstraction layer,  the present invention abstracts the computing resources of dual-core heterogeneous cores into a unified computing power pool,  breaks through the thinking limitations of traditional static task allocation,  and realizes dynamic reallocation of computing power. 1. A method for simultaneously realizing communication and human-machine communication of intelligent human-shaped robot with dual-core heterogeneous kernel,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  a dynamic calculation force scheduling abstract layer is added between the dual-core heterogeneous inner cores of the human-shaped robot,  the calculation resources of the communication core and the intelligent core are abstracted as a uniform calculation force pool,  the communication core uses ARM framework,  the intelligent core uses x86 framework;  S2 :  monitoring the operation parameters of the communication core and the intelligent core in real time by the dynamic calculation force scheduling abstract layer,  wherein the operation parameters comprise CPU occupancy rate,  task response delay and memory utilization rate;  S3 :  judging the core load state based on the operation parameter,  when the communication core load exceeds the preset threshold value,  transferring the low priority communication task to the idle calculation area of the intelligent core;  when the intelligent core load exceeds the preset threshold value,  transferring the non-real-time human-computer interaction pre-processing task to the communication core,  realizing the task context synchronization through the PCIe high-speed channel;  S4 :  the human-computer interaction scene is pre-judged by the visual identification module of the human-computer robot,  the calculation force weight is distributed for the communication core and the intelligent core according to the scene type,  the calculation force pre-distribution is realized;  S5 :  The communication core receives the human-computer interaction instruction and finishes the initial analysis,  the intelligent core combines the specific sensing data to execute the decision and the action plan,  and realizes the cooperative response through the dynamic calculation force scheduling abstract layer.

A scene complexity quantification characterization method for automatic driving automobile test,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S1,  based on the data-mechanism mixed modelling method,  establishing an automatic driving driving environment scene model and a rare object model;  S2,  through at least one physical simulation technology of video injection,  echo simulation,  channel simulation,  controllable radiation field,  realizing the controllable reproduction of automatic driving automobile driving complex scene;  S3,  establishing a complex scene element library based on large model technology,  and establishing a high-dimensional characteristic characterization method of scene element coupling process through a causal graph structure;  S4,  embedding the scene feature into the natural driving high-dimensional time sequence data processing process,  through unsupervised clustering,  generating at least one of antagonistic network,  optimizing search algorithm,  establishing scene self-adaptive extraction,  high coverage derivation and accelerating generalization model;  S5,  developing a scene data conversion algorithm,  automatically generating a generalized complex environment key test scene library;  S6,  analyzing the complexity mapping relation between the scene element and the sensing,  deciding and executing system through the real-time interaction between the element and the automatic driving each level system,  establishing the scene complexity quantification representation;  S7,  combining the complex environment scene characteristic,  establishing a multi-dimensional quantitative evaluation index system of intelligent level of automatic driving automobile with fusion safety and humanoid,  and establishing a coupling method of evaluation index of fusion scene complexity based on multi-dimensional scale analysis method,  realizing the multi-dimensional performance integrated evaluation of automatic driving automobile.

This application discloses a method,  device,  equipment and storage medium for analyzing the posture of children in a car that integrates multi-modal information,  and relates to the technical field of vehicle safety. It includes :  extracting humanoid area images based on rear row image data collected by cameras; extract skeletal key points from the humanoid area image and determine the occupant type based on the skeletal key points; when the occupant is a child,  tracking a first key point,  a second key point and a third key point in the skeletal key points,  obtaining a body forward detection index according to the first key point and the second key point,  and obtaining a reach touch index according to the third key point; posture analysis was performed based on the body forward detection index and reach touch index to obtain the child's in-car posture,  which achieved continuous and quantitative recognition and risk assessment of specific postures,  improved the robustness and accuracy of child occupant recognition and posture analysis,  and provided a reliable technical basis for subsequent hierarchical safety control based on risk levels. 1. A child vehicle attitude analysis method combined with multimodal information,  wherein the method comprises :  extracting the human-shaped area image based on the back row image data collected by the camera;  extracting a bone key point from the human-shaped area image,  and determining an occupant type based on the bone key point;  when the passenger type is children,  tracking the first key point,  the second key point and the third key point in the bone key point,  obtaining the body probe index according to the first key point and the second key point,  and obtaining the hand extension touch index according to the third key point;  analyzing the posture based on the body probed index and the hand-stretching touch index to obtain the posture in the child vehicle.

The invention discloses an air conditioning system controlled by artificial intelligence,  which comprises :  an air conditioning unit;  and an artificial intelligent control unit coupled to the air conditioning unit to make the air conditioning unit operate under the dynamic control of the artificial intelligent control unit and maintain the power usage efficiency value of the air conditioning system at a lower predetermined value to achieve energy saving and carbon reduction.; ---.- An artificial intelligence-controlled air conditioning system includes :  
An air conditioning unit comprises N air conditioning units,  where N is a natural number;  and 
An artificial intelligence control unit is coupled to the air conditioning unit,  enabling the air conditioning unit to operate under the dynamic control of the artificial intelligence control unit;  
The artificial intelligence control unit includes :  
An environmental parameter collection module includes multiple environmental parameter collection devices,  which are used to collect various environmental parameters inside and outside the data center. 
A deep learning module coupled to the environment parameter collection module;  
A temperature prediction correction module is coupled to the deep learning module;  
An AI-powered human detection module is coupled to the temperature prediction correction module and the environmental parameter collection module,  respectively. The AI-powered human detection module includes a camera lens and an embedded AI humanoid algorithm. 
An air conditioning unit temperature setting module is coupled to the artificial intelligence human detection module and the air conditioning unit,  respectively,  and the air conditioning unit temperature setting module is preset with a temperature threshold value Tg;  and 
The integrated body temperature detection module is coupled to the temperature setting module of the air conditioning unit and the environmental parameter collection module respectively. The body temperature detection module includes a thermal imaging lens and an embedded body temperature algorithm. 
The AI-controlled air conditioning system executes the following steps in sequence :  
(A) First,  set an initial operating temperature T0 for each of the N air conditioning units in the air conditioning unit;  
(B) When the N air conditioning units are running at the initial operating temperature T0,  the environmental parameter collection module starts to collect various environmental parameters inside and outside the data center every predetermined time X,  and continues to collect them for a predetermined time Y,  0 <  X <  Y. 
(C) The environmental parameters collected by the environmental parameter collection module are transmitted to the deep learning module,  so that the deep learning module can use the environmental parameters to perform deep learning,  and after deep learning,  N predicted air conditioning temperature values Tp are generated every predetermined time Z,  Z> 0. 
(D) The predicted air conditioning temperature value Tp is transmitted to the temperature prediction value correction module,  so that the temperature prediction value correction module corrects the N predicted air conditioning temperature values Tp and produces N corrected air conditioning temperature setpoints Tc. 
(E) The N corrected air conditioning temperature setpoints Tc are transmitted to the artificial intelligence personnel detection module. The artificial intelligence personnel detection module detects the presence of personnel at set time intervals t and generates a number P of personnel present. The number P of personnel present is transmitted to the air conditioning unit temperature setting module and the environmental parameter collection module respectively,  where t >  0 and P 0. 
When the number of people P=0,  the temperature setting module of the air conditioning unit sends a shutdown signal to the air conditioning unit,  causing the air conditioning unit to stop operating. 
When the number of people P >  0,  the AI-powered personnel detection module transmits the N corrected air conditioning temperature setpoints Tc to the air conditioning unit temperature setting module for storage. The thermal imaging lens of the body temperature detection module detects the body temperature Tf of the present person and the ambient temperature Ts in the space. It then transmits these two values to the environmental parameter collection module. The embedded body temperature algorithm calculates a temperature value T based on the body temperature Tf of the present person and transmits this temperature value T to the air conditioning unit temperature setting module. The air conditioning unit temperature setting module then compares this temperature value T with a pre-set temperature threshold value Tg. 
When T >  Tg,  the air conditioning unit temperature setting module transmits the N corrected air conditioning temperature setting values Tc to the air conditioning unit,  so that the N air conditioning units of the air conditioning unit operate according to the N corrected air conditioning temperature setting values Tc respectively. 
Wherein,  when T <  Tg,  the air conditioning unit temperature setting module does not transmit the N corrected air conditioning temperature setting values Tc to the air conditioning unit,  so that the N air conditioning units of the air conditioning unit continue to operate according to the previous settings;  and 
(F) Repeat steps (B) to (E).

The invention provides a single robot dynamic manipulation method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning,  and relates to the technical field of single robots The method of the present invention constructs the dynamic manipulation of a single quadruped robot with an arm into a collaborative multi-agent reinforcement learning MARL problem. Specifically,  the method is based on the multi-agent near-end strategy optimization algorithm MAPPO,  the four legs are respectively regarded as four independent isomorphic agents,  and efficient motion collaboration is achieved by sharing the same set of network parameters,  while the robotic arm is modeled as another independent heterogeneous agent,  adopting another set of parameters to focus on the manipulation task. Through this collaborative modeling method of heterogeneous agents,  close cooperation between movement and manipulation can be achieved under a unified reinforcement learning framework,  thereby significantly improving the task completion efficiency and robustness of quadruped robots with arms in unstructured environments. 1.  the strategy reasoning module divides the four-foot robot with arm into a four-foot motion system and a mechanical arm operating system,  wherein the four-foot motion system is composed of four isomorphic intelligent bodies,  and receives the local series observation of the four leg intelligent bodies in the four-foot motion system through the first Actor network sharing the same set of parameters,  the mechanical arm operation system is used as an independent heterogeneous intelligent agent,  using the second Actor network of another set of parameter to process the special operation observation of the mechanical arm intelligent body,  so as to realize the cooperative reasoning of motion and operation under the uniform reinforced learning frame,  specifically based on multi-agent near-end strategy optimization algorithm MAPPO,  it is realized by centralized value function evaluation and distributed strategy execution mechanism;  step 4 :  establishing a layered decoupling reward mechanism,  specifically introducing a terminal actuator speed tracking reward,  and a terminal actuator posture tracking reward;  step 5 :  the two-stage training flow realizes dynamic operation;  through establishing a multi-agent reinforcement learning frame in the CTDE model,  the state sensing module,  the policy reasoning module is uniformly integrated with the layered decoupling reward mechanism,  under the framework,  a two-stage training flow is used,  the first stage only trains the four-foot motion system to obtain stable walking basic strategy,  the second stage introduces the local observation and special reward of the mechanical arm intelligent body on the basis of keeping the walking basic strategy,  It makes the four feet and the mechanical arm realize the cooperative optimization under the uniform frame and realizes the dynamic operation of the single robot.

A lower limb component,  comprising a shank,  a sole,  a connecting piece,  a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism;  the connecting piece comprises a first shaft part and a second shaft part connected with the first shaft part,  the centre axis of the first shaft part is vertically crossed with the centre axis of the second shaft part,  the bottom of the shank is pivoted to the first shaft part,  the sole is pivoted to the second shaft part;  the sole is provided with a connecting seat,  a pivot shaft coaxial with the first shaft part and a rotating shaft parallel to the second shaft part and staggered with the second shaft part;  the first driving mechanism comprises a first swinging arm,  a first connecting rod,  a first driving piece,  one end of the first swinging arm is pivoted on the lower leg and connected to the output end of the first driving piece,  so that the first driving piece drives the first swinging arm to swing relative to the lower leg,  the upper end part of the first connecting rod is hinged on the other end of the first swinging arm,  the lower end part is pivoted with the pivot shaft,  the first connecting rod extends along the first straight line,  the first straight line and the central axis of the first shaft part define a first plane;  the second driving mechanism comprises a second swinging arm,  a second connecting rod,  a second driving piece,  one end of the second swinging arm is pivoted on the lower leg and is connected to the output end of the second driving piece,  so that the second driving piece drives the second swinging arm to swing relative to the lower leg,  the upper end part of the second connecting rod is hinged on the other end of the second swinging arm,  the lower end part is pivoted with the second shaft part,  the second connecting rod extends along the second straight line,  the second straight line and the central axis of the second shaft part define the second plane.

The invention provides a jump planning method of a biped robot,  and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots The invention captures jump data based on human body movements Establish a human kinematics model of the hinge structure According to the motion trajectory curve of human hip and ankle joints and combined with the kinematic parameters of the robot,  parameterized trajectory planning of the robot hip and ankle joints is carried out According to the planned parametric motion trajectory,  the humanoid robot is subject to ground friction,  joint limit constraints,  take-off joint energy constraints and stability constraints respectively to obtain the motion trajectory of the optimized take-off stage and complete the entire action jump plan. The invention ensures that the planning method for imitating human jumping is obtained by optimizing the trajectory parameters and analyzing the similarity between the planning data and the simulation data,  and maintains the stability of the humanoid robot during the process,  so that the robot jumping has more humanoid characteristics. 1. A jumping planning method of biped robot,  wherein The simulation human body action planning method respectively formulates performance evaluation index from the two aspects of the stability degree of the horizontal direction and the vertical direction force,  through optimizing the relationship between the simulation human robot jumping parameter and the performance evaluation index,  analyzing the similarity of the planning data and the simulation data to obtain the planning method simulating human jumping,  and the stability of the humanoid robot is kept in the process so that the robot jumping has humanoid characteristic.

The embodiment of the invention provides an adaptive motion control method of a humanoid robot and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of robots The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-modal input data,  wherein the multi-modal input data comprises state data of the humanoid robot and surrounding environment data; extract the features of multi-modal input data to obtain multi-modal fusion features; perform feature recognition on multi-modal fusion features to obtain recognition results that characterize the motion interaction logic between the humanoid robot and the environment; according to the recognition results,  the degree of freedom coefficients of different joints are adaptively adjusted to generate robot motion control instructions. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the adaptability of the humanoid robot to different scenes can be improved,  and the motion control precision of the robot can be improved 1. A self-adaptive motion control method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining multi-mode input data,  the multi-mode input data comprises the state data of the humanoid robot itself and the surrounding environment data;  extracting the characteristic of the multimodal input data to obtain the multimodal fusion characteristic;  performing characteristic identification on the multi-modal fusion characteristic,  obtaining an identification result representing the motion interaction logic of the humanoid robot and the environment;  performing self-adaptive adjustment on the degree-of-freedom coefficients of different joints according to the identification result to generate a robot motion control command.

The invention provides a DAMP-based humanoid robot complex terrain motion control method and system The invention belongs to the field of robot motion control. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a DAMP reinforcement learning control framework integrating a denoising world model module,  an adversarial motion prior module,  a dynamic reward interpolation mechanism and a Lipschitz continuity penalty module,  wherein a robust potential state representation is extracted by using the denoising world model and a real state is reconstructed; secondly,  generating diversified human-like actions based on human motion capture data; then through the dynamic reward interpolation mechanism,  the weight of the imitation reward and the task reward is adaptively adjusted,  the learning strategy is optimized,  the smoothness of the Lipschitz continuity penalty control strategy is applied,  and the jitter of the control output is reduced; finally,  the overall training is carried out based on the unified training objective function to improve the autonomous movement ability of the humanoid robot in complex terrain,  thereby improving the movement stability and naturalness of the robot in complex terrain. 1. A complex terrain movement control method of humanoid robot based on DAMP,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  constructing a DAMP strengthening learning control frame fused with a de-noising world model module,  an antagonistic motion prior module,  a dynamic reward interpolation mechanism,  a Lipschitz continuity penalty module and a uniform training target function module;  based on the DAMP reinforced learning control frame,  obtaining the historical observation data and real-time observation data of the human-shaped robot,  extracting the potential state representation of robust and reconstructing the real state through the de-noising world model module;  generating various and natural human-like actions by combining the antagonistic motion prior module with the human body motion capture data;  utilizing the dynamic reward interpolation mechanism to self-adaptively adjust the weight distribution of the imitation reward and the task reward according to the task reward;  a Lipschitz continuity penalty module applies a smooth constraint to the strategy gradient to reduce the control output jitter;  training the DAMP reinforced learning control frame based on the uniform training target function module fusion de-noising loss,  strategy gradient loss,  value function error,  entropy regularization and LCP gradient penalty;  the trained DAMP strengthening learning control frame is arranged on the human-shaped robot,  and the joint moment control signal is output to realize the autonomous movement control of the human-shaped robot under the complex terrain.

The invention provides a hierarchical intelligent judgment method and device for grasping strength of a humanoid robot. The hierarchical intelligent judgment method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the contact area ratio of two foot soles and the inclination angle of a trunk in real time,  identifying the current gait phase and estimating the transverse shaking amplitude of the trunk in the current gait period; determining the high-stability or low-stability state of the current phase according to the transverse shaking amplitude of the trunk,  identifying the continuous high-stability state as a bipedal support period,  and fusing the target motion information during the bipedal support period to calculate the remaining reachable distance; dynamically adjust the grip strength level according to the remaining reachable distance and the target movement speed; determine the grip stability boundary conditions corresponding to the grip strength level,  and analyze the degree of satisfaction of the collaborative boundary of grip execution under the current conditions; determine the feasibility of grasping according to the degree of satisfaction of the collaborative boundary,  and determine the optimal grasping execution opportunity under feasible conditions; input the optimal execution timing and grip strength level into the grip controller to generate a grip execution plan. 1. An intelligent judging method for grading of gripping strength of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  collecting the ratio of the contact area of the double thenar and the inclination angle of the trunk in real time,  identifying the current gait phase and estimating the transverse shaking amplitude of the trunk in the current gait period;  judging the high or low stable state of the current phase according to the transverse shaking amplitude of the trunk,  and identifying the continuous high stable state as the biped supporting period,  fusing the target motion information in the biped supporting period to calculate the residual reachable distance;  according to the remaining reachable distance and the target moving speed,  dynamically adjusting the gripping force level;  determining the grasping stability boundary condition corresponding to the grasping strength level,  analyzing the cooperative boundary satisfaction degree of the grasping execution under the current condition;  determining the grasping feasibility according to the satisfaction degree of the cooperative boundary,  and determining the optimal grasping execution time under the feasible condition;  and inputting the optimal execution time and the grabbing strength level into a grabbing controller to generate a grabbing execution plan.

This application relates to the technical field of building construction intelligent equipment,  and in particular to an intelligent robot for construction lifting,  which includes :  a robot body,  a robot control device,  and an intelligent management platform. The robot body adopts a humanoid bionic design and includes a support structure,  Hollow joints,  bionic arms,  operating robotic arms; the robot control device is used to install cameras and sensors to sense data,  realize dialect recognition,  intelligent obstacle avoidance,  risk prediction and intelligent supervision through deep learning algorithms,  and control the robot body to complete construction lifting and supervision operations; the intelligent management platform is used to provide remote monitoring,  remote control and data analysis functions. The remote control includes remote layer selection and remote shutdown. The data analysis module is used to perform multi-dimensional correlation analysis on various data and automatically generate standardized daily and weekly reports. As a result,  problems such as the limitations of manual operations,  the passivity of safety supervision,  and the inefficiency of operation and maintenance management are solved. 1. An intelligent robot for construction lifting,  wherein it comprises :  a robot main body,  a robot control device,  an intelligent management platform,  wherein the robot main body adopts a human-shaped bionic design,  comprising a supporting structure,  a hollow joint,  a bionic arm,  an operating mechanical arm,  wherein the hollow joint is distributed at the position similar to the human joint and is made of magneto-rheological elastic material;  the bionic arm simulates the action logic and shape of the human arm,  the surface is covered with flexible touch sensing material,  supporting voice wake-up;  the operation mechanical arm carries a high-precision servo motor and a quick-change interface for adapting various actions under the construction lifting scene;  the robot control device is used for mounting camera and sensor sensing data,  realizing dialect identification,  intelligent obstacle avoidance,  risk pre-judgment and intelligent supervision through deep learning algorithm,  controlling the robot main body to finish construction lifting and supervision work;  the intelligent management platform is used for providing remote monitoring,  remote control and data analysis function,  based on 5G and edge computing technology,  real-time synchronizing cloud data,  wherein the remote control comprises a remote selection layer,  a remote shutdown,  the data analysis module is used for performing multi-dimensional correlation analysis on multiple data through a large data analysis engine,  automatically generating a standardized daily newspaper and weekly newspaper.

The invention provides a method for detecting stall of a humanoid robot joint bearing based on current signals The invention relates to robot fault diagnosis,  which comprises the following steps of :  arranging a piezoelectric sensing array at a joint bearing,  combining the multi-modal fusion of a current signal and a piezoelectric signal to acquire the dynamic characteristics of the bearing in the running process,  and accurately identifying the locked-rotor state of the bearing by using a spiral transformation reconstruction technology and a recursive quantitative entropy analysis method In this way,  the accuracy and robustness of locked-rotor detection can be improved,  which helps to detect abnormal bearing locked-rotor in real time,  thereby outputting alarm signals in time,  effectively reducing the impact of locked-rotor faults on the operating performance of the humanoid robot,  and improving its work efficiency and safety. 1. A human-shaped robot joint bearing locked rotor detection method based on current signal,  wherein it comprises :  the joint bearing of the humanoid robot is provided with a piezoelectric sensing array,  the piezoelectric sensing array is uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction of the bearing,  collecting the current signal and the piezoelectric signal of the bearing in the moving process,  obtaining the phase difference sequence of the current signal and the piezoelectric signal;  performing spiral transformation reconstruction on the phase difference sequence,  mapping the phase difference sequence to the polar coordinate space,  extracting the angle distribution feature and the radial density feature in the polar coordinate space,  generating the polarization feature map of the bearing;  constructing a resonant frequency band mapping matrix based on the polarization characteristic map,  obtaining an abnormal pre-warning index of the bearing by calculating the energy leakage rate of the adjacent frequency band in the resonant frequency band mapping matrix;  processing the abnormal pre-warning index by a recursive entropy analysis method,  calculating an entropy evolution path of the abnormal pre-warning index,  identifying a locked-rotor characteristic according to the branched characteristic of the entropy evolution path,  and outputting a locked-rotor alarm signal when detecting that the branched characteristic has topology mutation.
