A humanoid robot flexible mechanical leg structure of ankle joint bionic linkage,  wherein it comprises :  an upper platform (1),  for connecting the shank part,  the upper platform (1) is a disc structure,  the bottom surface is provided with an upper pit part (14);  a lower platform (4),  used for connecting the sole part,  the lower platform (4) is disc-shaped,  the top surface is provided with a lower pit part (44),  the central position of the top surface of the lower platform (4) is provided with a lower through hole (41),  the lower through hole (41) is located in the lower pit part (44);  a ball head (3),  for bearing the upper platform (1) and the lower platform (4),  the ball head (3) comprises a ball part (31) and a splicing part (32) set on the outer circumferential surface,  one surface of the outer circumferential surface of the ball head (3) far away from the splicing part (32) is provided with an oil collecting groove (34);  a driving component (2),  at least two groups of the driving component (2) are set on the periphery of the upper platform (1) and the lower platform (4) and respectively hinged with the two ends of the driving component (2) of the upper platform (1) and the lower platform (4).

The embodiment of the invention provides a navigation synchronization method of a humanoid robot and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of data processing The method comprises the following steps of :  correcting the system time of the humanoid robot through a double-reference time calibration model according to a time reference signal and a sampling trigger signal so as to realize the time reference synchronization of a satellite navigation system and an inertial navigation system; the positioning observation value prediction strategy is dynamically adjusted according to the motion state and scene type,  and the positioning observation value of the satellite receiver is predicted through adaptive extrapolation algorithm by combining the historical motion trajectory and real-time sensor data; obtain the solution data of the inertial navigation system,  introduce the scene feature weight factor to construct an optimized Kalman filter model,  and input the positioning observation value and the inertial navigation solution data into the optimized Kalman filter model for fusion solution to obtain synchronized integrated navigation data. According to the embodiment of the invention,  reliable space state support can be provided for stable movement and precise control of the humanoid robot 1. A navigation synchronization method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the time reference signal output by the satellite navigation system and the sampling trigger signal output by the inertia measuring unit,  and according to the time reference signal and the sampling trigger signal,  correcting the system time of the humanoid robot through the double-reference time calibration model,  realizing the time reference synchronization of the satellite navigation system and the inertial navigation system;  collecting the motion state data and the scene environment data of the human-shaped robot,  and dynamically adjusting the location observation value prediction strategy according to the motion state and the scene type,  combining the history motion track and the real-time sensor data,  predicting through the self-adaptive extrapolation algorithm to obtain the location observation value of the satellite receiver;  obtaining the resolving data of the inertial navigation system,  introducing the scene characteristic weight factor to construct an optimized Kalman filter model,  inputting the positioning observation value and the inertial navigation resolving data into the optimized Kalman filter model for fusion resolving,  obtaining the synchronized combined navigation data.

This application discloses a humanoid robot control method and related equipment methods based on generative models and reinforcement learning The method comprises the following steps of :  uniformly coding multi-modal data and multi-source heterogeneous data including different scenes to obtain input data,  and predicting the input data by using a scene reasoning model to obtain future scene information; based on future scene information and preset cross-scene task data,  offline training is performed to obtain the optimal action strategy network; performing Monte Carlo search according to the optimal action network and the obtained future scene information,  and outputting the optimal action sequence; control the robot according to the obtained optimal action sequence. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the adaptability of different scenes can be improved,  and the control precision of the robot can be improved This application can be widely used in the field of robot control technology. 1. A humanoid robot control method based on generated model and enhanced learning,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the multi-source heterogeneous data,  uniformly coding the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain the input data,  predicting the input data according to the trained scene reasoning model and outputting the future scene information;  wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data comprises multi-mode data of different scenes;  performing off-line training on the deep learning model according to the future scene information and the preset cross-scene task data,  determining an optimal action strategy network;  performing Monte Carlo search according to the optimal action strategy network and the future scene information,  outputting an optimal action sequence,  and controlling the humanoid robot according to the optimal action sequence.

The present invention relates to the field of robot control technology The humanoid robot gait generating system based on hierarchical control includes multi-layer control systems running at different refresh frequencies,  including :  high-level gait and trajectory planning layer running at lower frequency for generating macroscopic motion instructions; the middle-level whole-body motion optimization layer running at medium frequency serves as a bridge between high-level planning and low-level control,  and is used to convert the desired plantar and torso trajectories into reference movements of all joints of the whole body; the bottom joint servo control layer running at the highest frequency is responsible for accurately tracking the joint-level instructions output by the whole body motion optimization layer; and a state sensing and feedback closed-loop layer,  which feeds back the state information of the robot's body state obtained in real time to the above layers,  providing a basis for the high-level trajectory re-planning and providing the real-time state initial value for the middle-level optimization; provides feedback signals for the underlying servo control. 1. A humanoid robot gait generating system based on layered control,  wherein The system comprises a multi-layer control system operating at different refresh frequencies,  which are respectively :  a high-layer gait and track planning layer running at a lower frequency for generating a macro motion instruction;  the middle-layer whole-body movement optimizing layer running in the middle frequency is used as the bridge of the high-layer planning and the bottom-layer control for converting the expected sole and trunk track into the reference movement of each joint of the whole-body;  a bottom layer joint servo control layer running at the highest frequency and in charge of precisely tracking the joint level instruction output by the whole body motion optimizing layer;  and a state sensing and feedback closed-loop layer for feeding back each state information of the main body state of the robot obtained in real time to each layer so as to provide basis for re-planning the track of the high layer and provide real-time state initial value for optimization of the middle layer;  A feedback signal is provided for the servo control of the bottom layer.

This application discloses a humanoid robot collaborative simulation control method and related equipment for industrial scenes. The method includes :  determining the functional modules of the humanoid robot; constructing a simulation unit corresponding to the functional module; allocate containers to the virtual modules in each simulation unit according to the container allocation algorithm,  and allocate corresponding container resources to each container; collecting simulation performance data corresponding to each simulation unit; when the simulation unit performs functional simulation,  data transmission is performed based on a differentiated transmission channel. The differentiated transmission channel includes a first network and a second network. The first network is used to achieve low-latency communication between virtual modules in the same simulation unit,  and the second network is used to achieve low-latency communication between virtual modules across simulation units Based on the simulation performance data,  a feedback optimization operation is performed on the functional simulation of each simulation unit According to the invention,  the precision,  the stability and the real-time performance of the multi-module cooperative control of the humanoid robot can be improved,  and the humanoid robot multi-module cooperative control system can be widely applied to the technical field of computers 1. An industrial scene-oriented humanoid robot cooperative simulation control method,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  determining the functional module of the humanoid robot;  wherein the function module comprises a motion control module,  an environment sensing module,  a task execution module and a human-computer interaction module;  constructing a simulation unit corresponding to the function module;  wherein each simulation unit comprises at least one virtual module;  distributing the container for the virtual module in each simulation unit according to the container distribution algorithm,  and distributing the corresponding container resource for each container;  each virtual module is correspondingly distributed with a container for simulating the corresponding functional unit in the functional module;  collecting the simulation performance data corresponding to each simulation unit;  wherein when the simulation unit performs functional simulation,  data transmission is performed based on a differential transmission channel,  the differential transmission channel comprises a first network and a second network,  the first network is used for realizing low-delay communication between virtual modules in the same simulation unit,  the second network is used for realizing the cooperative communication between the virtual modules of the cross-simulation unit;  according to the simulation performance data,  performing feedback optimization operation on the function simulation of each simulation unit,  so as to realize the cooperative control optimization of the humanoid robot.

The invention provides a control method for stable motion of a quadruped robot. The control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring current state data of the quadruped robot through a sampling time interval; substituting the current state data into the pre-designed quadruped robot MPC controller to obtain the expected foot end force value of the sampling point in the predicted time domain; substituting the first expected value of foot end force in the predicted sequence into Jacobian matrix of quadruped robot to obtain the expected value of joint motor torque by inverse operation; feedback the expected value of the joint motor torque to the quadruped robot controller,  and the controller controls the operation of the joint motor of the quadruped robot according to the expected value of the joint motor torque. The invention significantly enhances the robustness of the quadruped robot in dealing with complex dynamic environments,  so that it can still maintain the stability of movement under harsh conditions such as sudden slipping,  sudden load changes,  or emergency obstacle avoidance maneuvers. 1. A control method for stable movement of four-legged robot,  wherein it comprises :  S100,  collecting the current state data of the four-foot robot according to the sampling time interval;  S200,  substituting the current state data into the pre-designed four-foot robot MPC controller to obtain the foot end force expected value of the sampling point in the predicted time domain;  S300,  substituting the first foot end force expected value in the prediction sequence into the Jacobian matrix of the four-foot robot to perform inverse operation to obtain the expected value of the joint motor moment;  S400,  feeding back the expected value of the joint motor moment to the four-foot robot controller,  wherein the controller controls the operation of the joint motor of the four-foot robot according to the expected value of the joint motor moment.

The invention discloses a multi-sensor fusion attitude control method for a wheeled humanoid robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot motion control It can at least partially solve the problems of separation of posture perception between the chassis and the upper body and insufficient coordination of the whole body in the existing technology. The invention includes :  establishing a whole body state vector including chassis,  upper body and head postures; collecting the data of each inertial measurement unit and generating self-adaptive fusion weight based on topographic features; through extended Kalman filtering,  multi-source data fusion is performed to obtain the whole body posture estimation value; calculate the terrain compensation moment based on the terrain inclination and curvature; based on quaternion error,  a hierarchical control law is constructed to generate control instructions for each part; predict the center of gravity shift caused by upper limb movement and calculate the feedforward compensation torque; perform residual monitoring and bias calibration on the sensor. The invention realizes the whole body posture coordination control of the chassis,  upper body,  head and arms,  and has terrain adaptive capabilities and anti-disturbance capabilities. 1. A multi-sensor fusion attitude control method for wheeled humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  establishing a state vector comprising a chassis,  an upper body and a head posture quaternion,  an angular velocity and a joint angle;  collecting the acceleration and angular velocity data of each inertia measurement unit and the angle data of the joint encoder;  calculating the terrain inclination angle according to the acceleration data of the chassis inertia measuring unit in the inertia measuring unit,  calculating the terrain curvature according to the wheel speed difference,  generating the terrain self-adaptive fusion weight;  based on the fusion weight,  weighting and fusing each attitude data by using extended Kalman filter to obtain the whole body attitude estimation value;  constructing a disturbance vector according to the terrain inclination angle,  the terrain curvature and the change rate thereof,  and calculating a terrain compensation moment;  calculating the quaternion attitude error of the chassis,  the upper body and the head part,  self-adaptively adjusting the control gain based on the disturbance amplitude,  and combining with the terrain compensation moment to generate the control moment instruction;  according to the joint angle prediction upper limb gravity centre offset,  calculating feedforward compensation moment overlapped to the chassis control instruction;  performing residual error monitoring and weight reduction processing to the inertia measuring unit,  periodically updating the zero offset compensation value.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot arm-leg cooperative obstacle avoidance method and system based on a visual language large model and a diffusion strategy. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-source sensor data,  and constructing a semantic risk potential energy field containing operation safety rules by using a laser radar and the visual language large model; input the geometric occupancy information,  semantic risk potential energy field and the whole body state of the robot into the pre-trained conditional diffusion strategy model,  and generate a full-dimensional state reference trajectory cluster through the reverse diffusion process; based on the selected optimal trajectory,  the arm-leg cooperative nonlinear model predictive control problem is constructed,  and the zero-moment point constraint and angular momentum balance constraint are introduced to solve the whole-body control law; drive the legs to avoid obstacles and use the robotic arm to perform inertia compensation. The invention realizes joint obstacle avoidance through semantic understanding,  uses generative strategies to solve high-dimensional planning problems,  and improves dynamic stability through arm and leg dynamics coupling,  and is suitable for intelligent supervision and operation in complex environments such as substations. 1. A four-legged robot arm and leg cooperative obstacle avoidance method based on visual language large model and diffusion strategy,  wherein it comprises :  S1 :  obtaining the multi-source sensor data of the four-foot robot,  using the laser radar to construct the geometric occupying grid map,  at the same time,  using the visual language large model to perform the open vocabulary understanding to the environment image,  extracting the semantic risk entity in the scene and the corresponding operation safety rule,  constructing the semantic risk potential energy field;  S2 :  inputting the current geometric occupation information,  semantic risk potential energy field slice and the current whole body state of the robot into the pre-trained condition diffusion strategy model;  generating multiple full-dimensional state reference track clusters satisfying the environment constraint through the reverse diffusion de-noising process;  S3 :  screening the optimal track from the reference track cluster as the initial value,  constructing an arm-leg cooperative non-linear model prediction control problem;  introducing the zero moment point stability constraint and the angular momentum balance constraint in the optimized target function,  solving to obtain the whole body control law at the current time;  S4 :  according to the whole body control law,  driving the leg joint of the four-foot robot to perform movement obstacle avoidance,  at the same time,  driving the mechanical arm joint to perform inertia compensation action.

The invention belongs to the field of robot control,  and specifically relates to a precise gait control method for a quadruped robot based on dynamic optimization. The invention includes :  judging the phase states of four legs of the quadruped robot,  calculating the support phase foot end force for the legs in the support phase according to the real-time motion state and the expected motion state,  and calculating the swing phase correction force for the legs in the swing phase; based on the Cartesian spatial dynamics model of the legs,  an expanded state observer is constructed,  and the total disturbance term of the four legs of the quadruped robot is observed in real time using the expanded state observer; based on the total disturbance term,  the disturbance value to be compensated is calculated,  the uncompensated joint torque is obtained based on the support phase foot end force or the swing phase correction force,  and the joint torque command is obtained by superimposing; driving a quadruped robot according to joint moment commands. By introducing advanced observation and compensation mechanisms into the bottom execution link,  the method of the present invention ensures the precise realization of the upper optimization target and ultimately achieves precise gait control. 1. A precise gait control method of four-foot robot based on dynamic optimization,  wherein the precise gait control method of four-foot robot based on dynamic optimization comprises :  establishing a single rigid body dynamic model and a leg kinematics model of the four-foot robot,  obtaining the real-time motion state of the four-foot robot through a sensor;  judging the phase state of the four legs of the four-foot robot,  wherein the phase state comprises a supporting phase and a swinging phase;  calculating the foot end force of the supporting phase for the leg in the supporting phase according to the real-time moving state and the expected moving state,  and calculating the swinging phase correcting force for the leg in the swinging phase;  constructing an expansion state observer based on the leg Cartesian space dynamics model,  using the expansion state observer to observe the total disturbance item of the four legs of the four-foot robot in real time;  calculating to obtain the disturbance value to be compensated based on the total disturbance item,  obtaining the uncompensated joint torque based on the support foot end force or the swing phase correction force,  superposing the disturbance value to be compensated and the uncompensated joint torque to obtain the joint torque instruction;  and driving the four-foot robot according to the joint torque command.

The present invention relates to the field of flexible electronic technology,  and in particular to a tactile sensing humanoid glove used in multiple scenes and a method of using the same. The glove comprises a glove body,  a flexible sensing unit,  a signal transmission module and an MCU module The flexible sensing unit is arranged on the palm side and/or each finger pulp side of the glove body. The flexible sensing unit includes a capacitive sensing layer,  a pressure sensing layer,  and a capacitive sensing layer and a pressure sensing layer placed on the capacitive sensing layer and the pressure sensing layer. Common circuit layers between sensing layers. According to the invention,  the structure is simple,  the integration level is high,  the three-layer core structure of the capacitance sensing layer,  the common line layer and the pressure sensing layer is adopted to replace the complex structure above the middle layer in the prior art,  the processing procedure is simplified,  the processing difficulty and the production cost are reduced,  and the risk of peeling and falling off of each layer is reduced; the common circuit layer realizes the sharing of capacitive sensing and pressure sensing,  further improving integration,  reducing glove thickness,  improving wearing comfort,  and adapting to the flexible movement needs of human hands. 1. A tactile sensing human-shaped glove applied to multiple scenes,  wherein It comprises a glove main body,  a flexible sensing unit,  a signal conveying module and an MCU module;  the covering range of the flexible sensing unit comprises a palm area of the glove main body and each finger abdomen area,  the signal conveying module is electrically connected with the flexible sensing unit or through wiring harness,  the MCU module is electrically connected with the signal conveying module;  the signal transmission module is used for transmitting the capacitance change signal and the pressure sensing signal collected by the flexible sensing unit to the MCU module,  the signal representation is the approaching,  suspending,  contacting and pressing state between the finger or the outer object and the glove;  the MCU module is used for performing baseline correction,  threshold judgment,  coordinate calculation,  pressure conversion and distance calibration analysis on the received signal,  outputting the corresponding position instruction,  pressure level instruction or distance control instruction according to the analysis result,  realizing suspension pre-control,  contact identification of the peripheral device,  force grading and feedback control of self-adaptive action;  the flexible sensing unit comprises a capacitance sensing layer,  a pressure sensing layer and a common circuit layer between the capacitance sensing layer and the pressure sensing layer;  the capacitance induction layer comprises an upper base material and an upper silver paste electrode layer arranged on the lower surface of the upper base material;  the upper silver paste electrode layer is arranged with multiple groups of parallel electrode circuits along the Y-axis direction;  the common circuit layer is arranged with multiple parallel electrode circuits along the X axis direction; An autonomous warehouse robotics system integrates a multi-sensor platform,  adaptive payload handling,  dynamic task reallocation,  advanced navigation,  energy management,  and comprehensive safety features into one mobile robot chassis. The system utilizes LiDAR,  stereo vision,  ultrasonic sensors,  mmWave radar,  thermal cameras,  and event cameras to perform complete environmental sensing and obstacle detection. Sensor fusion combines adaptive weighting,  multi-modal data integration,  and statistical filtering to create high-confidence maps for reactive path planning and collision avoidance. The robot's payload system features machine vision for item recognition,  telescopic lifts,  variable-width grippers,  and real-time toolhead verification to handle a variety of goods. Fleet management is achieved through dynamic task reallocation that considers robot location,  battery level,  and operational delays,  all coordinated by a cross-platform middleware architecture that ensures standardized communication,  remote monitoring,  and over-the-air updates among diverse robot brands. Energy management optimizes power usage via predictive routing,  autonomous return-to-charge,  and auction-based scheduling. Safety is maintained through proximity detection,  behavior-based intervention,  and human-robot cohabitation protocols while advanced localization is enhanced by fusing ultra-wideband positioning with visual landmark alignment,  inertial sensing,  and machine learning to deliver high accuracy in non-line-of-sight conditions. An onboard edge AI module further refines navigation and task prioritization through neural network inference,  ensuring robust,  adaptive operation in dynamic,  unstructured warehouse environments.

 Wherein,  the step of constructing and dynamically updating the structure empirical reachable state space specifically comprises :  constructing a structure state vector,  the structure state vector uniformly describes the current joint angle,  joint angular speed,  joint driving load,  joint coupling relation and whole posture state of the robot;  based on the structure state vector,  constructing a uniform structure stable margin function from three dimensions of the joint travel safe distance,  the driving load safe margin and the robot whole posture safe distance,  and continuously quantizing the safe margin of the current state distance structure unstable boundary by the structure stable margin function value;  introducing a structure experience weight evolving along with time for each structure state,  updating the function through an experience weight,  performing reliability accumulation for the structure state according to the long-term execution feedback,  so as to distinguish the reachable state of the theoretical calculation and the reliable state of the actual long-term verification;  screening the structure state according to the preset lowest stable margin threshold and the lowest empirical weight threshold to form a structure empirical reachable state space,  and dynamically correcting the boundary of the structure empirical reachable state space in the running process of the robot;  S2,  generating a basic control track based on the structure empirical type reachable state space,  preferentially ensuring the structure safety,  motion continuity and state restorability of the action of the humanoid robot,  through screening task related posture,  constructing a state level track frame,  introducing the time parameterization mechanism of the structure margin modulation and performing the restorability verification to form a long-term executable basic control track;  S3,  performing reinforced learning local action correction based on the basic control track,  the action correction of the reinforced learning is limited in the safe neighbourhood defined by the structure empirical type reachable state space,  the reward function is designed by fusing the structure stable margin and the action correction amplitude to guide the learning process,  so that the optimized search of the reinforced learning is restricted in the safe neighbourhood,  the output local performance is optimized and the control track of the whole stability is not damaged;  S4,  sensing the execution state and environment information of the robot in real time through the multi-source sensor,  combining task error evaluation and environment constraint,  performing online closed-loop feedback correction on the control track after reinforced learning correction,  at the same time,  using the data feedback collected in the execution process to update the structure experience weight and reinforced learning strategy,  It realizes the long-term self-adaptive optimization of the system.

The invention discloses a multi-modal perception and action playback control method for a wheeled humanoid robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot control and man-machine interaction It can at least partially solve the problems of insufficient multi-modal perception fusion accuracy and mismatch between action playback timing and dynamics in the existing technology. The invention includes :  collecting and synchronizing multi-source sensing data of virtual reality equipment,  inertial measurement unit and joint encoder; based on real-time credibility coefficient,  each sensor data is dynamically weighted and fused to generate a unified state vector; storing the fusion state data to form a sequence in recording mode; generating a target trajectory based on energy consistency constraints in playback mode; adaptively adjust the control gain according to the disturbance intensity to generate a control torque command; predicting the shift of the center of gravity of the upper limb and calculating the chassis feedforward compensation; multi-mode switching and security protection via state machine. The invention realizes high-precision action reproduction and stable posture maintenance,  and has adaptive capabilities and safety protection mechanisms. 1. A multi-mode sensing and action playback control method for wheeled humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the pose data of the virtual reality device,  the pose data of the inertia measuring unit and the angle data of the joint encoder,  and aligning the time stamp of each sensor data;  calculating a real-time reliability coefficient according to the measurement error of each sensor,  dynamically weighting and fusing each sensor data based on the reliability coefficient,  generating a uniform state vector;  under the recording mode,  storing the uniform state vector according to the time sequence to form the action sequence data;  in the playback mode,  performing time sequence alignment on the action sequence data,  dynamically adjusting the interpolation coefficient according to the energy difference between the recording action and the playback action,  generating a target track;  calculating the attitude error between the current attitude and the target attitude,  self-adaptively adjusting the control gain according to the disturbance intensity,  generating a control moment instruction;  according to the angle of the upper limb joint,  predicting the gravity centre offset,  calculating the chassis feed-forward compensation speed and overlapping to the chassis control instruction;  The switching between recording,  playback,  remote operation and self-balancing mode is managed by the state machine,  and the safety protection is triggered when the abnormal state is detected.

The industrial application control method and system of the humanoid robot of the present invention includes :  S1 :  Collect environmental image signals,  end force signals and contact pressure distribution signals through visual sensors,  force sensors and tactile sensors respectively; s2 :  Input the environment image signal,  end force signal and task instruction signal to the AI task understanding module to generate a task analysis signal; s3 :  Based on task analysis signal and contact pressure distribution signal; s4 :  Input the collaborative control signal to the whole body dynamics controller,  which calculates the joint torque distribution in real time; s5 :  Execute joint control instructions to complete industrial tasks,  and at the same time dynamically adjust the control strategy through real-time monitoring of environmental change signals and body status signals. The industrial application control method and system of the humanoid robot of the present invention can solve the problem of poor adaptability of existing humanoid robots in complex industrial scenes due to isolation of sensing information and separation of decision-making and motion control. 1. An industrial application control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  S1 :  respectively collecting an environment image signal,  a tail end stress signal and a contact pressure distribution signal through a visual sensor,  a force sense sensor and a touch sensor;  S2,  inputting the environment image signal,  the end stress signal and the task instruction signal to the AI task understanding module to generate a task analysis signal containing semantic environment information and operation restriction;  S3,  based on the task analysis signal and the contact pressure distribution signal,  generating a cooperative control signal with the whole body motion track and fine operation sequence through the motion planning module;  S4,  inputting the cooperative control signal to the systemic dynamics controller,  the controller calculates the joint moment distribution in real time and combines the touch feedback correction signal to form the final joint control instruction;  S5,  executing the joint control instruction to finish the industrial task,  at the same time,  dynamically adjusting the control strategy by monitoring the environment change signal and the main body state signal in real time.

The invention discloses an elderly care system and method based on a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the field of robots The elderly care method includes :  S1,  after the robot system is started,  an environment map is constructed,  and the functions of face recognition and voiceprint recognition are authorized to be activated; s2. The robot collects visual data,  auditory data,  tactile data and health sign data,  and performs feature fusion and timing misalignment correction on the above data; s3. Based on visual data,  perform human posture recognition through the GCN model,  and combine auditory data,  tactile data and health sign data to determine whether there is a risk. If so,  classify the risk levels; s4. Start the hierarchical response mechanism based on risk level classification. An elderly care method based on humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  after the robot system is started,  constructing an environment map,  and authorizing and activating the functions of face recognition and voiceprint recognition;  S2,  the robot collects the visual data,  the hearing data,  the touch data and the health physical sign data,  and performs the feature fusion and time sequence dislocation correction to the data;  S3,  based on the visual data,  performing the human body posture identification through the GCN model,  at the same time,  combining the hearing data,  the touch data and the health sign data to judge whether there is risk,  if so,  performing the risk level division;  S4,  starting the hierarchical response mechanism based on risk level division.

The invention discloses an arm assembly of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. An arm assembly of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises an upper arm,  a lower arm,  a first actuator,  a second actuator and a connecting seat;  the bottom of the upper arm is formed with a containing space,  the transverse outer side of the containing space is provided with a first flange,  the first actuator is transversely placed in the containing space,  the shell of the first actuator is fixed with the first flange,  the output end of the first actuator is opposite to the middle hole of the first flange;  the inner part of the lower arm is formed with a mounting space,  the top part of the lower arm is provided with a second flange located above the mounting space,  the second actuator is vertically arranged in the mounting space,  the shell of the second actuator is connected with the second flange,  the output end of the second actuator is right opposite to the middle hole of the second flange;  the connecting seat comprises a vertical connecting arm placed at the outer side of the first flange,  a transverse connecting arm bent from the bottom part of the vertical connecting arm towards the inner side,  the inner side surface of the vertical connecting arm is provided with a first connecting part passing through the middle hole of the first flange and connected with the output end of the first actuator,  the lower surface of the transverse connecting arm is provided with a second connecting part passing through the middle hole of the second flange and connected with the output end of the second actuator.

The invention discloses a low-energy consumption six-legged wheel-leg robot based on elastic bands,  which includes :  wheel-leg modules located at the corners of the body module,  and ordinary leg modules located on both sides of the body module; the first section of the wheel leg module is movably connected with the second section of the wheel leg module,  the second section of the wheel leg module is movably connected with the third section of the wheel leg module through the wheel leg joint connecting module,  and the third section of the wheel leg module is movably connected with the wheel driving module In the common leg modules,  the first common leg module is movably connected with the second common leg module,  the second common leg module is movably connected with the third common leg module,  and the third common leg module is connected with the foot pad Both the wheel leg module and the common leg module are provided with elastic bands to form a pre-tightening connection The invention can realize the flexible switching between wheeled motion and gait motion,  improve the adaptability to complex terrain,  and use the deformation characteristics of the elastic belt to share the joint load and reduce the burden on the steering gear. 1. A low energy consumption six-foot wheel leg robot based on elastic belt,  wherein it comprises :  a wheel leg module,  a common leg module and a body module;  said wheel leg module is set at the corner of the body module,  the common leg module is set at the two sides of the body module;  the wheel leg module comprises a wheel leg module first section,  a wheel leg driving module,  a wheel leg module second section,  a wheel leg joint connecting module,  a wheel leg module third section and a wheel driving module;  the first section of the wheel leg module is movably connected with the second section of the wheel leg module,  the second section of the wheel leg module is movably connected with the third section of the wheel leg module through the wheel leg joint connecting module,  the third section of the wheel leg module is movably connected with the wheel driving module;  the common leg module comprises a common leg first section module,  a common leg second section module,  a common leg third section module and a foot pad;  the first section module of the common leg is movably connected with the second section module of the common leg,  the second section module of the common leg is movably connected with the third section module of the common leg,  the third section module of the common leg is connected with the foot pad;  the wheel leg module,  the common leg module is provided with an elastic belt,  one end of the wheel leg elastic belt is connected with the second section of the wheel leg module,  the other end of the wheel leg elastic belt is connected with the wheel driving module through the third section of the wheel leg module,  one end of the common leg elastic belt is connected with the first section of the common leg module,  the other end of the common leg elastic belt is connected with the common leg third section module.

The invention discloses a wheel-legged robot leg device based on a reinforcement learning algorithm,  and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and electromechanical integration The device comprises a frame component,  a lower leg motor component,  a thigh plate component,  a clutch component,  a rotating wheel component,  a shifting fork component,  a clutch driving component,  a suspension floating component,  a thigh motor component and a lower leg component Wherein,  the lower leg motor assembly runs through the frame assembly,  the thigh plate assembly and the clutch assembly; the rotating wheel assembly is installed between the lower leg assemblies; the shifting fork assembly is mounted on the clutch assembly The clutch drive assembly is mounted above the frame assembly; the suspension floating assembly is installed at the rear lower part of the frame assembly; the thigh motor assembly is installed on the side of the frame assembly; the lower leg component and the clutch component together form a crank-rocker mechanism The invention can realize three movement modes :  wheel-foot switching,  wheel-type movement and foot-type movement,  and combines the reinforcement learning algorithm to realize adaptive switching of movement modes according to different terrain environments,  thereby improving the movement flexibility and flexibility of the robot in complex terrain. Environmental adaptive capabilities 1. A wheel-foot type robot leg device based on enhanced learning algorithm,  wherein It comprises a frame assembly (1),  a shank motor assembly (2),  a thigh plate assembly (3),  a clutch assembly (4),  a rotating wheel assembly (5),  a shifting fork assembly (6),  a clutch driving assembly (7),  a suspension floating assembly (8),  a thigh motor assembly (9) and a shank assembly (10);  the shank motor assembly (2),  the clutch driving assembly (7),  the suspension floating assembly (8),  the thigh motor assembly (9) are installed on the frame assembly (1),  and the shank motor assembly (2) passes through the frame assembly (1),  the thigh plate assembly (3) is connected with the clutch assembly (4),  one end of the shank assembly (10) is connected with the clutch assembly (4) through a pin shaft to form a crank rocker mechanism;  the rotating wheel assembly (5) is installed on two sides of the middle part of the shank assembly (10),  the shifting fork assembly (6) is installed on the first sliding shaft joint (4-3) in the clutch assembly (4),  the other end of the shank assembly (10) is matched with the suspension floating assembly (8).

The present invention discloses an underwater humanoid operation robot design and its underwater operation method The underwater humanoid robot includes a head module,  a trunk module,  an upper limb module and a lower limb module The upper end of the trunk module is connected to the head module Two upper limb modules are symmetrically connected with two sides of the trunk module,  the lower end of the trunk module is connected with the lower limb module,  a gravity center adjusting module is arranged in the trunk module and is used for adjusting and keeping a target pose of the underwater humanoid operation robot,  and the upper limb modules and the lower limb modules are respectively provided with a docking port and are used for connecting different underwater execution units and anchoring tools During underwater operation,  the robot cruises to the operation target using the propeller,  is anchored to the target wall through the anchoring module,  and uses the operation tool to complete underwater operations such as cutting and drilling. The invention can reduce the energy consumption of the robot propeller,  is suitable for long-term underwater residence operation in complex environments,  and greatly improves the operation stability of the robot in complex underwater environments such as strong currents. 1. An underwater humanoid working robot,  wherein It comprises a head module (1),  a trunk module (2),  an upper limb module (3) and a lower limb module (4);  the upper end of the trunk module (2) is connected with the head module (1),  two sides of the trunk module (2) are symmetrically connected with two upper limb modules (3),  the lower end of the trunk module (2) is connected with the lower limb module (4),  the trunk module (2) is internally provided with a gravity centre adjusting module (26),  the upper limb module (3) and the lower limb module (4) are provided with abutting ports for connecting different underwater executing units and anchoring tools;  when the trunk module (2) cannot satisfy the working need,  the underwater humanoid robot carries a vector pushing backpack (5),  the vector pushing backpack (5) is carried on the reverse surface of the trunk module (2).

The invention discloses a multi-leg force and position collaborative control method for a wheel-legged robot based on complex environment road spectrum estimation. The method includes :  determining the system matrix and input matrix of the wheel-legged robot,  and constructing a state space model of a pose state observer; constructing an event trigger model to obtain the real output value of the system; solve the state space model based on the system matrix,  input matrix and parameter values corresponding to the parameter group to obtain the output of the pose state observer and the estimated value of the pose of the wheel-footed robot,  and generate a road spectrum; establish a virtual compliance model,  and solve the displacement adjustment factor in the virtual compliance model based on the expected position and expected output force of the wheel-legged robot movement; based on the virtual compliance model,  road spectrum and system state equation,  the control signals for controlling the wheel-legged robot are determined. The invention effectively isolates the body vibration caused by road excitation,  thereby improving the posture stability of the robot in complex terrain. 1. A multi-leg force position cooperative control method of wheel-foot robot for complex environment road spectrum estimation,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 (S1) :  constructing the dynamic equation of the wheel-foot robot,  determining the parameter group influencing the posture balance of the wheel-foot robot;  System matrix for determining wheel-foot robot based on discretization dynamic equation and an input matrix constructing a state space model of the pose state observer;  step S2 :  constructing event trigger model,  when the measured value of the sensor of the wheel-foot robot at k moment Transmission data transmitted to a wheel-foot robot with respect to time k-1 when the change amplitude exceeds the preset range,  performing k time measuring information sending;  Measuring value and measuring matrix based on each sensor obtaining the system output real value ;  step S3 :  Based on ,  and the parameter value corresponding to the parameter group solving the state space model to obtain the pose state observer output,  namely the system output estimation value the estimated value of the pose of the wheel foot robot ;  the pose state observer is closed-loop controlled,  the parameter value corresponding to the parameter group is and obtaining the online optimization solution;  step S4 :  Based on and performing feature extraction,  target matching and road spectrum estimation to generate road spectrum ;  step S5 :  establishing a virtual soft model,  solving the displacement adjusting factor in the virtual soft model based on the expected position of the wheel-foot robot movement and the expected output force value;  Road spectrum based on virtual soft model and a system state equation for determining the control input of the control wheel-foot robot.

The foot type robot is provided with a depth camera and an inertial measurement unit (IMU). The mobile control method comprises the following steps of :  in the walking process of the foot type robot,  acquiring point cloud data,  IMU attitude data,  remote control command data and motor state data acquired by the depth camera; generate elevation map data based on point cloud data and IMU attitude data; input the elevation map data,  remote control command data,  IMU attitude data and motor status data into the pre-trained reinforcement learning model to generate motor control instructions; the reinforcement learning model is obtained by configuring a variety of terrain scenes in the simulation training environment and using priority sampling strategy training; the priority sampling strategy determines the sampling frequency of different learning action sequences according to the difficulty priority of different learning action sequences; the motor control instruction is sent to the motor control system of the foot type robot to drive the foot type robot to execute corresponding actions 1. A foot-type robot movement control method,  wherein the foot-type robot is loaded with a depth camera and an inertia measuring unit IMU,  comprising :  in the walking process of the foot-type robot,  obtaining the point cloud data collected by the depth camera,  and obtaining IMU attitude data,  remote control instruction data and motor state data;  generating altitude map data based on the point cloud data and the IMU attitude data;  inputting the altitude map data,  the remote control command data,  the IMU gesture data and the motor state data into a pre-trained enhanced learning model to generate a motor control command;  the reinforcement learning model is obtained by configuring multiple terrain scenes in the simulation training environment and training by using the priority sampling strategy;  the priority sampling strategy determines the sampling frequency of different learning action sequences according to the difficulty priority of different learning action sequences;  the motor control instruction is sent to the motor control system of the foot-type robot to drive the foot-type robot to execute corresponding action.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot operation skill learning and deployment,  and specifically relates to a virtual and real transfer learning method for humanoid robot operation skills based on knowledge distillation and meta-skill learning. The method first constructs a multi-task simulation training environment containing typical operation tasks,  and trains a teacher strategy model through a reinforcement learning algorithm to obtain the operation trajectory data of each task; map the multi-task operation trajectory data to a low-dimensional skill space using a trajectory coding function,  and identify and generate multiple general meta-skill sets in the low-dimensional skill space through a clustering algorithm; compress and migrate the strategy model summarized by the teacher strategy model to the lightweight student strategy model to form a meta-skill conditional strategy model that can be reused across tasks; the meta-skill conditional strategy model is optimized through an adversarial domain discriminator and skill embedding comparison mechanism. The invention significantly improves the deployment reliability and execution robustness of the strategy in the real physical environment. 1. A humanoid robot operation skill virtual migration learning method based on knowledge distillation and meta-skill learning,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  constructing a multi-task simulation training environment containing a typical operation task,  training a teacher strategy model through an enhanced learning algorithm to obtain the operation track data of each task;  S2,  using the track coding function to map the multi-task operation track data to the low-dimensional skill space,  and identifying and generating multiple universal meta-skill sets in the low-dimensional skill space through clustering algorithm;  S3,  compressing and transferring the strategy model gathered by the teacher strategy model to the lightweight student strategy model,  forming a meta-skill condition strategy model capable of cross-task multiplexing;  S4,  optimizing the meta-skill condition strategy model by the anti-domain discriminator and the skill embedding comparison mechanism,  so that the model realizes state distribution alignment and skill expression consistency between the simulation environment and the real physical environment.

The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel defect detection,  and in particular to a quadruped robot tunnel defect detection method and system based on machine vision. A quadruped robot tunnel defect detection method based on machine vision,  including the following steps :  S1 :  Construct a digital twin model of the cable tunnel based on the cable tunnel design data and the cable tunnel structural data; s2 :  Obtain the key detection area sequence through historical inspection data,  and construct a key detection area topology map based on the key detection area sequence and the digital twin model; s3 :  Determine a target detection position map according to the key detection area topology map,  and plan a detection path for the quadruped robot based on the target detection position map; s4 :  Perform defect detection on the cable tunnel based on the detection path to obtain defect detection data. The invention can cope with obstacles,  steps and slopes in the tunnel,  and realize comprehensive,  intelligent and high-precision tunnel defect detection. 1. A four-foot robot tunnel defect detection method based on machine vision,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  constructing a digital twin model of the cable tunnel according to the cable tunnel design data and the cable tunnel structure data;  S2 :  obtaining the key detection area sequence through the historical inspection data,  and constructing the key detection area topological diagram according to the key detection area sequence and the digital twin model;  S3 :  determining a target detection position graph according to the key detection area topological graph,  and planning a detection path for a four-foot robot based on the target detection position graph;  S4 :  detecting the defect of the cable tunnel based on the detecting path to obtain the defect detecting data;  S5 :  integrating the defect detection data to the digital twin model,  and assisting the maintenance personnel to decide.

This application discloses a multi-sensor fusion full-state estimation method and device for wheel-legged robots Specifically,  it relates to the field of wheel-legged robot perception technology. The estimation method includes the following steps :  S1 :  synchronously collecting IMU data,  visual data,  point cloud data,  foot end force data,  wheel speed data and satellite positioning data of the wheel-legged robot through a sensor array; s2 :  Time synchronization,  spatial calibration,  and noise suppression preprocessing are performed on the collected data; s3 :  Use YOLOv7 target detection network combined with depth map to segment dynamic areas; s4 :  Recognize robot motion patterns based on fused features; s5 :  Implement fusion computing; s6 :  Correct the estimation error through the feedback mechanism and update the model parameters and sensor confidence; compared with the prior art,  the multi-sensor fusion full-state estimation method and device for the wheel-footed robot have remarkably improved dynamic scene robustness The motion model is more adaptable; fusion accuracy is balanced with real-time performance. 1. A multi-sensor fusion full-state estimation method for wheel-foot robot,  wherein The estimation method comprises the following steps :  S1 :  synchronously collecting the IMU data,  the visual data,  the point cloud data,  the foot end force data,  the wheel speed data and the satellite positioning data of the wheel foot robot through the sensor array;  S2 :  performing time synchronization,  space calibration and noise suppression pre-treatment to the collected data,  wherein the space calibration uses an online calibration model,  and uses the time delay of the sensor as the variable to be optimized;  S3 :  using the YOLOv7 target detection network to combine the depth map to divide the dynamic area,  extracting the cross-mode characteristic through the mask visual system,  the voxel network and the dilation causal convolution;  S4 :  based on the fusion characteristic,  identifying the motion mode of the robot,  invoking the corresponding self-adaptive sub-model,  wherein the self-adaptive sub-model comprises a motion sub-model,  a dynamic sub-model and a simplified dynamic sub-mode;  S5 :  the fusion calculation is realized through the " data layer-characteristic layer-decision layer " cross-level structure,  the data layer adopts Kalman filter coupling IMU and wheel tachometer data,  the characteristic layer fuses the visual and point cloud characteristic through the cross-attention mechanism,  the decision layer combines the sensor confidence evaluation and the improved particle filter to output the full-state estimation result;  S6 :  The estimation error is corrected by the feedback mechanism,  and the model parameter and the sensor confidence are updated.

STRUCTURAL TRANSFER FUNCTION FINGERPRINTING FOR INFRASTRUCTURE-FREE KINEMATIC LOCALIZATION DEVOID OF OPTICAL RECEPTORS Optical and radio-frequency localization systems fail in environments with visual occlusion or signal denial. A structural transfer function fingerprinting apparatus executes infrastructure-free localization utilizing active mechanical impulses. A legged robot (110) traversing a physical floor structure (120) generates an active mechanical impulse excitation (140). A motor current observer (150) quantifies applied input force,  while an inertial measurement unit (170) captures a structural vibration response (160). A digital signal processing block executes spectral deconvolution (210) to extract an isolated structural resonance (220),  establishing a spatial fingerprint (230). A spectral distance comparator (350) computes a minimum spectral distance between the spatial fingerprint and entries in a map database (360) to yield an absolute spatial coordinate (370). This provides continuous spatial localization utilizing internal electromechanical hardware independent of external infrastructure. (Ref FIG. 3) nan

FAILURE-IMPEDANCE MORPHOLOGICAL COMPUTATION APPARATUS FOR KINEMATIC GAIT ADAPTATION EXPLOITING PARASITIC ACTUATOR DEGRADATION Conventional fault-tolerant robotic control relies on energy-intensive compensatory torque to overcome actuator failure. A failure- impedance morphological computation apparatus utilizes the inherent mechanical dynamics of a failed actuator as a passive functional element. A multi-jointed legged robot (110) includes electromechanical joint actuators (120) and a failure detection module (130). Upon detecting a fault,  a terminal reconfiguration network (140) electrically isolates the motor. An impedance characterization module quantifies the failure-induced impedance (210),  mapping shorted windings to a viscous damper (220),  open circuits to a passive pendulum (240),  and seized bearings to a rigid link (230). A central locomotion controller (150) queries a pre-computed failure-gait library (310) indexed by these parameters to instantiate a kinematic joint command (430) optimized for the passive element. This apparatus reduces global energy consumption by executing kinematic gait adaptation exploiting parasitic actuator degradation. (Ref FIG. 1) nan

STRUCTURAL RESONANCE GAIT APPARATUS FOR KINEMATIC ENERGY RECYCLING EXPLOITING RESONANCE-TUNED LINK COMPLIANCE Legged robots require heavy mechanical springs for energy efficiency. A structural resonance gait apparatus distributes elastic energy reclamation natively utilizing resonance-tuned structural links (120). By executing flexural rigidity attenuation (210),  a wall thickness is selectively reduced such that a structural bending mode curve (230) overlaps an operational target gait frequency at a scaling crossover point (220). During stance,  a ground reaction force (140) induces a macroscopic lateral link deflection (310),  functioning as a distributed series elastic actuator (320) storing elastic potential energy (330). A centralized locomotion controller synchronizes an active motor torque profile (350) with a rebound propulsion phase (340). A variable-thickness manufacturing profile (410) maximizes compliance at an attenuated mid- span section (430) while preserving strength at proximal joint interfaces (420). This reduces the cost of transport without discrete mechanical springs. (Ref FIG. 1) nan

The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  in particular to a humanoid robot motion control learning method,  a chip and electronic equipment The technical scheme comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environmental parameters in real time Generate the current environment feature vector and the initial running vector Retrieve and match from the cloud motion database to obtain the optimized running vector. Integrate the successfully executed environmental parameters,  environmental feature vectors,  and optimal running vectors and upload them. The invention significantly improves the environmental adaptability of the robot,  improves the movement stability in complex scenes,  greatly improves the learning efficiency,  shortens the learning cycle,  enhances the control accuracy and safety,  improves the operation safety of the robot in complex environments,  has strong scalability,  and can adapt to the needs of humanoid robots of different specifications. 1. A human-shaped robot motion control learning method,  wherein the human-shaped robot motion control learning method comprises :  S1,  performing data collection on the currently located environment in real time to obtain environment parameters;  S2,  generating the current environment characteristic vector through the environment parameter,  and generating the initial operation vector through the current environment characteristic vector;  S3,  searching and matching from the cloud end motion database according to the current environment characteristic vector,  so as to obtain the optimized operation vector;  S4,  judging whether the matching degree of the optimized operation vector is greater than a preset standard matching degree threshold,  if so,  executing S5,  if not,  marking the initial operation vector as the optimal operation vector,  and executing S6;  S5,  dynamically correcting the initial operation vector according to the optimized operation vector so as to obtain the optimal operation vector;  S6,  sending the instruction corresponding to the optimal operation vector to the driving module of each motion component,  executing the corresponding motion action;  at the same time,  the state parameter in the motion process is monitored in real time by the multi-sensor to judge whether the motion is successful,  if not,  the motion is not stored;  S7,  if the motion is executed successfully,  integrating the environment parameter,  the environment characteristic vector and the optimal operation vector of the motion,  adding the successful identification and the scene label,  and uploading the blocks to the cloud motion database.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot brain decision-making and scheduling method and system based on a large model. The method includes :  obtaining visual images,  voice instructions and ontology status data of the humanoid robot; map the visual image and ontology state data to a unified semantic vector space using a pre-trained multi-modal encoder to generate a current scene description containing environmental topological relationships and its own joint state; input voice commands and current scene descriptions into the large model; decompose natural language instructions into atomic task sequences by triggering thought chain reasoning through prompt engineering; the task scheduler receives the structured task list and constructs a dynamic task queue; the scheduler distributes control instructions to the corresponding execution Agent; each execution Agent converts the semantic level control instructions into the bottom motor control signals and drives the human robot to execute; at the same time,  the status monitoring module collects the intermediate status data during the execution process in real time and writes it back to the context window of the large model or the external memory library. 1. A human-shaped robot brain decision scheduling method based on large model,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the visual image,  the voice instruction and the main body state data of the human-shaped robot;  mapping the visual image and the main body state data to a uniform semantic vector space by a pre-trained multi-mode coder to generate a current scene description including the environment topological relation and the self-joint state;  inputting the voice instruction and the current scene description to a large model;  the natural language instruction is decomposed into the atomic task sequence by prompting the engineering trigger thinking chain reasoning;  wherein,  in the process of generating the atomic task sequence,  through the physical feasibility verification mechanism,  according to the kinematics model parameter of the humanoid robot,  each generated atomic task is pre-judged,  removing the action exceeding the mechanical arm working space or causing zero moment point instability,  outputting the checked structured task list;  the task scheduler receives the structured task list and analyzes the resource type needed by each atom task;  constructing a dynamic task queue according to the real-time occupation state and priority weight of each execution Agent;  the scheduler distributes the control instruction to the corresponding execution Agent;  each execution Agent converts the control instruction of semantic level into the motor control signal of the bottom layer and drives the human robot to execute;  at the same time,  the state monitoring module collects the middle state data in the execution process in real time,  and writes it back to the context window or external memory base of the large model.

The invention includes :  collecting soil,  crop and environment multi-source data and converting them into a unified feature vector; attention-weighted fusion of various types of data based on dynamic modal weights; kalman filtering and outlier detection were used for noise filtering; predicting future crop demand by improved time series prediction model and correcting error; determining a job execution order based on a demand priority function; the reinforcement learning algorithm is used to dynamically optimize the operation parameters according to the real-time environment; balancing operation accuracy,  efficiency and environmental protection through multi-objective reward functions. A multi-modal fusion strengthening learning control method of humanoid robot agrochemical operation,  wherein it comprises :  collecting soil data,  crop data and environment data,  and respectively converting the soil data,  crop data and environment data into characteristic vectors;  determining each modal weight according to the soil type,  the crop growth stage and the environmental stability,  performing weighted fusion to each characteristic vector based on the modal weight to generate a fusion characteristic value;  smoothing the fusion characteristic value by Kalman filtering,  and removing the data exceeding the preset range by abnormal value detection;  inputting the filtered fusion characteristic value into a time sequence prediction model,  outputting a crop demand prediction value,  and correcting by a sliding window error correction mechanism;  calculating the priority score based on the demand gap,  the crop sensitivity and the environment influence,  and determining the job execution order according to the priority score;  constructing a state space including the fusion characteristic,  the demand predicted value and the operation parameters,  defining an action space including the spraying pressure,  the walking speed and the nozzle angle,  and optimizing the operation parameters according to the reward function by a reinforcement learning algorithm;  performing the humanoid robot agrochemical operation action based on the operation parameter and calculating the reward value,  updating the action value function,  when the change amount of the action value function is less than the preset threshold value,  judging convergence.

A robot motion control method based on multimodal reinforcement learning,  wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps :  constructing an Actor-Critic network composed of an Actor network and a Critic network in the training stage,  wherein the Actor network comprises an LSTM model and an MLP;  and constructing the input state vector of the Actor network and the input of the Critic network;  the input state vector of the Actor network comprises the human-shaped robot main body observation quantity,  the latent variable output by the coder in the privilege observation estimation module and the feedforward characteristic vector output by the F-CNN model,  the output of the Actor network is the expected action of each joint;  the input of the Critic network comprises a prerogative observation quantity and a feedforward characteristic vector output by the F-CNN model,  the output of the Critic network is the value estimation result;  In the actual application process :  using the depth camera carried on the humanoid robot to obtain the colour image and the depth map,  taking the obtained colour image and the depth map as the input of the visual language model,  outputting the elevation map,  the ground friction coefficient map and the hardness map of the surrounding environment of the humanoid robot through the visual language model;  the height map,  the ground friction coefficient map and the hardness map of the surrounding environment of the humanoid robot are used as the input of the F-CNN model to obtain the output of the F-CNN model;  and then the human-shaped robot main body observation quantity,  the latent variable output by the coder in the privilege observation estimation module and the output of the F-CNN model are used as the input of the Actor network,  the action of the human-shaped robot is output through the Actor network.
