The invention discloses a foot humanoid robot control method based on point cloud clustering Involving the field of robot technology,  this invention performs pedestrian clustering,  cross-frame association and merging non-ground point clouds into motion groups Construct a motion trend flow field containing average motion vectors and spatial density distribution,  so that the control decision-making changes from sensitive prediction of individual trajectories to structured expression of group flow direction and density boundaries,  thereby reducing the dependence on the future precise position of a single pedestrian and improving the traffic continuity and decision-making stability at the bottleneck intersection; through the time window and hysteresis judgment of flow field confidence,  the short-term abnormal fluctuation and continuous distortion are distinguished and processed; when the confidence decreases or the association failure persists,  switching the corresponding group to quasi-static obstacles and reducing the trend compliance weight enables the controller to automatically converge to a more conservative,  explainable and implementable obstacle avoidance mode under low trusted information conditions,  reducing abrupt interspersion or repeated correction due to false trends. 1. A foot-type humanoid robot control method based on point cloud clustering,  the robot is carried with a depth sensor,  an inertia measuring unit and a sole pressure sensor,  wherein it comprises :  step S1,  obtaining the environment point cloud of the depth sensor and filtering the ground point cloud according to the ground dividing rule;  step S2,  determining clustering and segmenting the non-ground point cloud and obtaining a pedestrian clustering set according to the pedestrian screening rule;  step S3,  calculating the data correlation of the pedestrian clustering of continuous multiple frames to obtain the motion vector of each clustering,  the motion vector is the speed vector representing the pedestrian clustering motion speed and motion direction;  step S4,  generating the pedestrian clustering as the motion group according to the distance threshold and the motion similarity threshold,  and generating the motion trend flow field comprising the average motion vector and the space density distribution for each motion group,  wherein the motion similarity threshold comprises a speed included angle threshold and a speed difference threshold;  step S5,  determining the flow field confidence degree of each motion group based on the motion trend flow field,  wherein the flow field confidence degree is the confidence degree index representing the motion group motion consistency and space aggregation degree;  and when the confidence degree of the flow field is lower than the confidence degree threshold value or the continuous times of the association failure exceeds the times threshold value,  switching the corresponding group to the quasi-static obstacle processing,  the quasi-static obstacle processing is as follows :  taking the occupied area of the corresponding group as the obstacle-avoiding constraint input model prediction controller;  and reducing the trend compliance weight,  the trend compliance weight is the weight of the trend compliance cost item in the comprehensive cost;  step S6,  outputting the motion trend flow field,  the robot main body state obtained by the inertia measuring unit and the global navigation target input model prediction controller,  in the prediction time domain,  solving the control sequence satisfying dynamic constraint and obstacle-avoiding constraint and minimizing comprehensive cost;  the control sequence is a robot motion reference quantity sequence or a joint control input sequence;  step S7,  sending the first control instruction for executing the control sequence,  wherein the control instruction is a motion reference instruction or a joint control input instruction;  step S8,  rolling and updating the main body state based on the contact feedback of the sole pressure sensor,  and repeating the steps S1 to S7.

This application discloses an industrial safety monitoring method,  system,  equipment and medium based on multi-source sensing. It mainly relates to the field of safety monitoring technology and is used to solve the limitations of existing solutions in terms of sensing stability,  real-time decision-making and interaction efficiency. The problem that a monitoring system for dynamic human-robot interaction has not yet been formed. The method comprises the following steps of :  detecting whether a marker and a robot have preset abnormal behaviors or not,  and detecting whether an execution action sequence of the marker triggers a robot scheduling instruction or not; when detecting that the robot has preset abnormal behavior,  determining whether the preset abnormal behavior has a preset adjustment instruction,  and triggering the corresponding preset adjustment instruction; when there is no preset adjustment command,  send a power cut-off command to the corresponding robot; when it is detected that the marked person has preset abnormal behavior,  the robot that triggers the language alarm is determined based on the real-time location of the marked person,  and the preset person warning voice is issued to the voice alarm terminal of the corresponding robot. 1. An industrial safety monitoring method based on multi-source sensing,  wherein the method comprises :  accessing various monitoring devices configured in the work station to the data collecting terminal;  collecting the multi-source monitoring data through the data collecting end,  obtaining the man-machine fusion dynamic map of the marker and the robot,  wherein the dynamic map comprises a real-time position,  an execution action sequence and a position sequence;  using the real-time position of the marker and the robot,  executing the action sequence and the position sequence,  based on the safety rule base and the large language model,  detecting whether the marker and the robot have the preset abnormal behaviour,  and detecting whether the executing action sequence of the marker triggers the robot scheduling instruction;  when detecting that the robot has the preset abnormal action,  determining whether the preset abnormal action has the preset adjusting instruction,  and triggering the corresponding preset adjusting instruction;  when there is no preset adjusting instruction,  sending a power-off instruction to the corresponding robot;  determining the robot for triggering the language alarm according to the real-time position of the marker when detecting that the marker has the pre-set abnormal behaviour,  and sending the pre-set staff alarm voice to the voice alarm terminal of the corresponding robot.

The invention discloses a driving control method of a wheel-footed robot and the wheel-footed robot,  belongs to the technical field of wheel-footed robots,  and is used for solving one of the problems that the wheel-footed robot receives larger impact force,  poor stability and is difficult to control steering in the process of high-speed driving or cornering The driving control method of the wheel-footed robot of the present invention includes :  the state sensing unit sends the real-time acquired environmental information and robot motion state information to the central control unit; the central control unit generates motion instructions based on the information fed back by the state sensing unit; the wheel leg actuator executes the movement instructions of the central control unit The invention can effectively improve the stability of the wheel-legged robot during high-speed driving or cornering. 1. A driving control method of wheel-foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S100 state sensing unit real-time obtains the environment information and robot motion state information to the central control unit;  S200,  the central control unit generates a motion instruction according to the information fed back by the state sensing unit;  S300 wheel leg executing mechanism executes the motion instruction of the central control unit.

This application discloses an environmental interaction method,  system,  equipment and product for a humanoid robot. The method includes :  obtaining multi-modal sensing data of the humanoid robot; performing feature extraction processing on the multi-modal sensing data to obtain global environment features; extracting environmental dynamics information from the global environmental features based on the temporal features of the humanoid robot; input the environmental dynamics information into the brain-like neural circuit network,  and output the interactive control instructions; the interactive control instruction is analyzed into a control signal to drive the humanoid robot to complete environmental interactive actions According to the embodiment of the invention,  the working efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved,  and the humanoid robot can be widely applied to the technical field of robots 1. An environment interaction method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the multi-mode sensing data of the humanoid robot;  extracting the characteristic of the multimodal sensing data to obtain the global environment characteristic;  extracting the environmental dynamics information from the global environmental characteristics based on the time sequence characteristics of the humanoid robot;  inputting the environmental dynamic information into a brain-like neural loop network,  and outputting the information to obtain an interactive control instruction;  analyzing the interaction control instruction into a control signal to drive the humanoid robot to finish the environment interaction action.

The present application relates to the technical field of model training,  and in particular to a humanoid detection model training method,  a humanoid detection method and an electronic device. The model training method includes :  training a complex training model through a training data set. The training data set includes multiple training images with humanoid annotations. The complex training model includes multiple multi-branch convolutional layers. In the process of training the complex training model,  the complex training model is synchronously transformed into structural re-parameterization to obtain the target simplified model. The target simplified model includes multi-layer single-branch convolutional layers,  and multi-layer multi-branch convolutional layers and multi-layer single-branch convolutional layers are in one-to-one correspondence. Determine the number of quantized bits according to the weights of multiple convolutional layers corresponding to the multi-layer single-branch convolutional layer. According to the number of quantization bits,  pseudo-quantization processing is performed on multiple convolutional layer weights respectively to obtain multiple single-branch weights. Obtain a humanoid detection model with both high accuracy and high reasoning efficiency. 1. A human shape detection model training method,  wherein the method comprises :  the complex training model is trained by a training data set,  the training data set comprises a plurality of training images with humanoid marks,  the complex training model comprises multiple layers of multi-branch convolution layers;  in the process of training the complex training model,  synchronously performing structure re-parameterization conversion on the complex training model to obtain a target simplified model,  the target simplified model comprises a multi-layer single-branch convolution layer,  the multi-layer multi-branch convolution layer is corresponding to the multi-layer single-branch convolution layer one by one;  determining multiple quantization bit numbers according to multiple convolution layer weights corresponding to the multi-layer single-branch convolution layer;  according to the plurality of quantization bit number,  respectively performing pseudo-quantization processing on the plurality of convolution layer weights,  to obtain a plurality of single branch weights;  updating the model parameter in the complex training model based on the multiple single branch weights to obtain a human shape detection model.

The invention provides a data compression and transmission method for an electronic skin of a humanoid robot,  belongs to the field of intelligent humanoid robots with bodies,  and aims to solve the problems of large data transmission quantity,  low communication speed and incapability of meeting on-site environment requirements when large-area electronic skin is applied to the humanoid robot The present invention uses steps such as electronic skin dynamic scanning and acquisition based on the touch area,  data preprocessing,  data stroke compression,  data differential coding of non-zero reference values,  and feature extraction of the touch area It realizes the high compression ratio of the electronic skin terminal to data,  and can dynamically adjust the data transmission form,  realizing the rapid transmission of electronic skin data,  realizing the edge computing capability of the electronic skin,  and improving the perception ability of the robot body. 1. A data compression and transmission method for electronic skin of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  performing dynamic data collection based on the touch area of the electronic skin,  and pre-processing the collected initial data;  step 2 :  performing data stroke compression on the pre-processed collected data;  step 3 :  based on the distribution of the non-zero data after the data stroke compression,  through the connection domain analysis,  dividing the touch area;  step 4 :  performing spatial differential coding to the data of each touch zone;  step 5 :  extracting the characteristic of the data in the area divided by the touch area to obtain the area characteristic of the characteristic area information;  step 6 :  data transmission,  when in static monitoring or single mode operation,  transmitting the data containing space difference coding;  When moving at a high speed,  the region features containing the extracted features are transmitted.

It is conducive to speeding up the recognition of the target person by the recognition device 1. A monitoring method,  wherein it is applied to a monitoring device,  the method comprises :  using the human shape detection model to perform the first identification process on the monitoring video,  screening the video frame including the human shape in the monitoring video,  obtaining the first video frame sequence;  wherein the human shape detection model is determined according to the hardware configuration of the monitoring device;  extracting a human contour image from each video frame in the first video frame sequence to obtain a gait energy map;  determining a target region human-shaped image sequence according to the target video frame sequence,  wherein the target region human-shaped image sequence comprises a region possibly comprising a target person in at least one target video frame in the multiple target video frames;  the human-shaped image sequence of the target area is uploaded to the identification device,  the human-shaped image sequence of the target area is used for the identification device to determine whether the human-shaped image sequence of the target area comprises the target person through the second identification,  the identification accuracy of the second identification is greater than the identification accuracy of the first identification,  the second identification is combined with at least one gait identification mode of dimensional feature;  wherein the second identification incorporates at least one kind of gait identification mode of the dimensional feature,  comprising :  in the feature extraction stage,  the same convolutional neural network is used for extracting the common bottom layer feature,  the extracted common bottom layer feature is respectively input to a plurality of independent feature extraction modules,  a plurality of different dimensional features are respectively obtained,  A gait recognition algorithm for a plurality of different dimensional features is executed,  respectively,  to perform weighted average on the similarity corresponding to each feature.

The invention discloses a multi-modal perception fusion method for a humanoid robot based on dynamic sparsification activation,  which relates to the technical field of multi-modal perception fusion and includes :  obtaining a multi-modal data stream of the robot and generating a modal availability mapping based on the real-time operating status of the robot; using the sparse gating strategy to dynamically select the perceptual modalities to be activated and constructing an activated modality set based on the selection results; the Kalman filter algorithm is used to evaluate the state of the activated modal set to obtain the state evaluation set and identify the modal switching state; constructing a state evaluation window based on task complexity and progress change when modal switching is identified,  and dynamically adjusting the robot state space dimension within the state evaluation window to obtain a multi-modal state set; generate robot task execution instructions and control the robot's behavioral actions based on multi-modal state sets to solve the problem of robot state space dimension mismatch caused by modal switching when the sparse gating strategy is used to dynamically select activated perceptual modalities. 1. A multi-modal sensing fusion method of humanoid robot based on dynamic sparse activation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the multi-modal data stream of the robot,  and generating a modal availability mapping based on the real-time operation state of the robot,  specifically :  obtaining the multi-mode data stream of the robot,  and extracting the mode characteristic vector of each mode data;  obtaining the real-time operation state of the robot,  and calculating the data quality evaluation value of the modal characteristic vector of the modal data based on the real-time operation state;  distributing modal usability value for each modal characteristic vector according to the data quality evaluation value,  and generating modal usability mapping based on the modal usability value;  Based on the modal availability mapping,  the sparse gating policy is adopted to dynamically select the perceptual modal to be activated and construct an activated modal set according to the selection result,  specifically :  extracting the modal usability values of all the modalities from the modal usability mapping,  and generating the modal usability sequence according to the modal usability value sequence;  using threshold value segmentation algorithm to perform initial segmentation on the modal usability sequence,  obtaining several modal usability intervals;  performing several times of recursive processing for each modal usability interval,  and calculating the variance and distribution density of the modal usability value in the modal usability interval at each recursive processing;  dynamically adjusting the boundary of the interval according to the variance and distribution density of the modal availability value in the modal availability interval to obtain the recursive modal availability interval;  dynamically selecting a core activation mode and an auxiliary mode from the recursive mode availability interval by using a sparse gating strategy;  performing conflict detection on the core activation mode and the auxiliary mode,  and combining the core activation mode and the auxiliary mode according to the conflict detection result to obtain an activation mode set;  performing state evaluation on the activated modal set by Kalman filtering algorithm to obtain a state evaluation set and identifying the modal switching state according to the state evaluation set;  when the mode switching is identified,  constructing a state evaluation window based on the task complexity and the progress change,  and dynamically adjusting the robot state space dimension in the state evaluation window to obtain a multi-mode state set;  generating a robot task execution instruction based on the multimodal state set and controlling the action of the robot.

A welding quality control method of humanoid robot based on double-arm cooperation,  wherein it is applied to the control system of humanoid robot,  the humanoid robot comprises a driving arm and a driven arm,  the driving arm is used for executing the welding task,  the driven arm is used for monitoring the execution of the welding task,  The method comprises :  obtaining the molten pool image collected by the driving arm in real time in the welding task executing process,  and the welding seam image and welding seam outline collected by the driven arm under the condition that the welding task part is executed;  performing welding seam defect detection based on the molten pool image and the welding seam image,  obtaining welding seam defect detection result,  and performing welding seam size detection based on the welding seam outline,  obtaining welding seam size detection result,  and based on the welding seam defect detection result and the welding seam size detection result,  performing the welding quality evaluation to obtain the welding quality evaluation result;  based on the welding quality evaluation result,  and the optimal welding process parameter,  performing parameter adjustment on the current welding process parameter in the welding task execution process,  based on the optimized welding process parameter obtained by parameter adjustment,  controlling to execute the welding task;  The optimal welding process parameter is determined based on the welding line size detection result.

A bionic humanoid robot upper limb structure driven by electro-hydraulic integration,  wherein it comprises :  an artificial human skeleton structure,  the configuration of which is constructed by referring to the anatomical structure of the upper limb of the human body,  comprising ulna,  radius,  humerus,  scapula,  clavicle,  multiple wrist bones and each phalanx of the finger,  wherein the skeleton component is connected by a mechanical joint to form shoulder,  elbow,  wrist and finger joint;  an electro-hydraulic integrated driving system,  comprising a plurality of hydraulic artificial muscle units and a pressure source device,  the pressure source device conveys the liquid to the hydraulic artificial muscle unit through the soft catheter,  such that the hydraulic artificial muscle unit radially expands under the action of the pressure source device and generates axial contraction,  so as to generate traction force to drive bone structure to realize joint movement;  each hydraulic artificial muscle unit is respectively connected with a corresponding pressure source device fluid,  the corresponding pressure source device supplies liquid to the hydraulic artificial muscle unit and provides driving force,  the liquid supply loops between different hydraulic artificial muscle units are independent;  a tendon muscle system,  the hydraulic artificial muscle unit is connected with the target skeleton through the artificial tendon muscle,  forming an artificial muscle,  tendon force conduction path,  driving the related joint to realize flexion,  extension,  abduction and rotation movement,  so as to realize multi-degree-of-freedom linkage artificial action.

A robot agent evaluation system for lower limb exoskeleton,  wherein it comprises a human-shaped robot exoskeleton detection device,  the detection device comprises :  a human-shaped robot (1),  an exoskeleton (2),  an auxiliary device (3) and a detecting element (4),  the exoskeleton (2) is connected with the human-shaped robot (1) through the auxiliary device (3),  the detecting element (4) is installed on the sole of the human-shaped robot (1);  the robot agent evaluation system of lower limb exoskeleton comprises the following steps :  step one :  system building;  Firstly,  the detection element (4) is installed on the sole of the human-shaped robot (1),  the exoskeleton (2) to be evaluated is installed on the human-shaped robot (1) through the auxiliary device (3),  and ensures that the joint axis of the exoskeleton (2) is substantially aligned with the lower limb joint axis corresponding to the humanoid robot (1),  and establishes the detection element (4),  the exoskeleton (2) controller is connected with the human-shaped robot (1) of the main control system between the communication connection,  development data collecting system real-time collecting the data of the three;  step two :  gait strategy training;  training different walking strategies of the humanoid robot according to the evaluation content;  if the walking strategy of the normal person is tested,  the walking track training model of the normal person is used as the standard strategy; The invention discloses an loT-enabled edge-cloud framework that improves energy efficiency of autonomous legged robots while preserving high-fidelity trajectory tracking and stability across diverse terrains through a tightly integrated control-learning stack. At the edge,  an energy-aware model predictive controller (MPC) runs in real time,  minimizing a multi-objective cost comprising state- tracking error and instantaneous power modeled from actuator current-torque relations and thermal losses,  under hard constraints on center-ofmass dynamics,  friction cones,  actuator limits and foot placement feasibility to guarantee stability. The nonlinear problem is locally linearized to a sparse quadratic program solved at 50-100 Hz with warm starts,  horizon truncation,  sparse factorization and fixed-point arithmetic to fit 10-30 W embedded budgets alongside perception and safety monitors. A low-latency sensor fusion pipeline combines IMU,  joint encoder/torque sensing with slidingmode wrench observers and vision-based terrain estimation to produce terrain-aware state estimates that modulate gait timing,  impedance and foothold selection before touchdown. Fleet-level learning employs federated learning to aggregate local energy-aware gait models without sharing raw data,  optionally augmented with meta-learning for rapid crossterrain adaptation,  yielding global policies redistributed to robots for continual improvement. Cloud- trained,  terrain-specific policies are deployed over-the-air as containerized services or quantized binaries with encrypted,  delta-coded updates and hot-swap integration;  onboard parameter morphing blends MPC weights and model coefficients to integrate new policies safely without destabilizing transients. Fault tolerance includes local policy caching and degraded energy-safe baselines,  enabling sustained operation under connectivity loss while maintaining energy-per-meter and tracking performance gains fleet-wide nan

This invention discloses a sophisticated humanoid robotic ecosystem,  identified as "Dwarapala" (The Heir),  specifically architected for the autonomous guardianship and rehabilitation of geriatric users. The system is governed by the UYRMEY framework,  a dual- process control philosophy that bifurcates robotic functionality into two interdependent layers :  Uyir (Socio-Emotional/Cognitive) and Mey (Physical/Reflexive). The Uyir Layer utilizes an Edge-Al Biometric Estimation engine,  termed Nadi-Vision,  which performs non-contact remote Photoplethysmography (rPPG) and 24GHz Radar sensing to monitor cardiovascular vitals and stress levels. These physiological control variables are fed into a Bio-Resonant Acoustic-Vibrational Synchronizer (Laya-Sync). This module comprises an Acoustic Generator that composes real-time therapeutic music (Ragas) phase-locked to a vibro-tactile generator within the humanoid limbs. This synchronization ensures a "Mother’s Patted Feel" through haptic-acoustic resonance,  facilitating neuro-sensory grounding and anxiety reduction. The Mey Layer provides physical safety through a 12-Point Kirikai-Karakuri Matrix. While the Kirikai logic manages active bipedal stability and exoskeleton-assisted rehabilitation using a PI Control Law,  the Karakuri .mechanism provides an energyindependent safety bypass. This Gravity-Actuated Mechanical Interlock utilizes the user’s own downward force during a collapse to trigger a physical friction-lock in the humanoid joints. This mechanism bypasses all electronic processing loops,  achieving a Vajra-Stambha (Immovable Pillar) state in 50ms to prevent falls. The ecosystem effectively bridges the gap between high-level emotional care and low-level physical safety,  providing a "Zero-Burden" assistive solution that functions as a dedicated digital heir for aging populations. The present invention provides a dynamic environment positioning method based on lidar and an IMU,  comprising step 1 :  obtaining a current environment point cloud by means of a front-end odometer of a robot;  step 2 :  matching the current environment point cloud with an offline map,  and determining the degree of difference therebetween;  step 3 :  determining whether a difference value exceeds a preset threshold;  if the degree of difference does not exceed the preset threshold,  considering a current scene to be basically consistent with the environment and a great change not to have occurred,  and transferring the environment point cloud to a robot coordinate system and storing same in a real-time incremental voxelization-based local map;  and if the degree of difference exceeds the preset threshold,  considering the current scene to have changed greatly from the environment,  matching the environment point cloud with the real-time local map,  and obtaining positioning information at this time on the basis of an initial pose obtained by IMU pre-integration. The method of the present invention can achieve accurate positioning in a dynamic environment,  improve the positioning stability of an autonomous platform,  and prevent the occurrence of positioning jumps.

 calculating the first angle of the first driving motor based on the third coordinate,  the fifth coordinate and the first length;  and calculating the second angle of the second driving motor based on the fourth coordinate,  the sixth coordinate and the second length.

The present disclosure provides a motion control strategy network training method and device for a legged robot with a floating substrate based on reinforcement learning,  and relates to the field of robot technology. The method comprises :  obtaining the positions of each joint and each sole of the foot robot before and after the foot robot executes the target action; calculate the position change amount of each joint based on the position change of each sole before and after the execution of the target action; calculate the reference value of the position of each joint after the execution of the target action based on the position of each joint before the execution of the target action and the position change of the joint; construct a reward item based on the reference value and the position of each joint after the target action is executed,  and use the reward item to train the base posture control model. The present disclosure can realize that through the trained base posture control model,  the legged robot can generate coordinated joint actions that are more in line with kinematic constraints when adjusting the base posture,  thereby improving its terrain adaptability,  dynamic balance performance and execution reliability of high maneuvering actions. 1. A motion control strategy network training method of foot-type robot with floating substrate based on intensive learning,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the position of each joint and the position of each sole of the foot-type robot before and after executing the target action;  calculating the position variation of each joint according to the position variation of each sole before and after the execution of the target action;  calculating the reference value of the position of each joint after the execution of the target action according to the position of each joint before the execution of the target action and the position variation of the joint;  constructing a reward item according to the reference value and the position of each joint after the target action is executed,  and using the reward item to train the base posture control model.

Embodiments of the present application relate to the field of information technology and disclose a method,  device,  medium and product for integrating a body-based intelligent data set. A tool body intelligent data set synthesis method,  wherein the tool body intelligent data set synthesis method comprises :  collecting artificial demonstration data,  and converting the artificial demonstration data into structured data;  extracting the task description in the manual demonstration data,  and representing the task description by the task semantic slot structure and the action logic frame;  the task semantic slot structure comprises a target object,  an operation mode and a space position;  automatically generating a first scene instance based on the task semantic slot structure and the preset task;  based on the structured data,  generating an action track according to the first scene instance and the preset task,  and optimizing the action track through a first loss function;  and combining the action track,  the preset task and the first scene instance into a triple training sample to form a specific intelligent data set.

The present disclosure provides a robot motion control model training method,  device,  equipment,  robot and medium based on deep reinforcement learning,  and relates to the field of robot technology. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a first latent vector obtained by encoding robot body observation data by a student encoder and a second latent vector obtained by encoding privilege observation data by a teacher encoder; calculate a sampling probability for controlling the fusion ratio of the first latent vector and the second latent vector based on the current number of training steps and a preset probability function; fusion of the first latent vector and the second latent vector based on the sampling probability to generate a third latent vector,  and input to the policy network; update the parameters of the policy network based on the value estimate of the current state output by the value network and the action policy output by the policy network. According to the method and the system disclosed by the invention,  the updating oscillation caused by the sudden change of input distribution in the training process of the policy network can be avoided,  the training efficiency is improved,  and the training cost is reduced 1. A robot motion control model training method based on deep reinforcement learning,  applied to a teacher-student model training frame,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining a first potential vector obtained by coding the robot main body observation data by the student coder,  and a second potential vector obtained by coding the privileged observation data by the teacher coder;  based on the current training step number and the preset probability function,  calculating the sampling probability for controlling the fusion proportion of the first potential vector and the second potential vector;  based on the sampling probability,  performing weighted fusion on the first potential vector and the second potential vector,  generating a third potential vector,  and inputting the third potential vector to a policy network;  based on the value estimation of the current state output by the value network and the action strategy output by the strategy network,  updating the parameter of the strategy network by the strategy gradient method.

The present disclosure provides a deep reinforcement learning-based robot motion control strategy network training method,  robot motion control method,  device,  equipment,  robot and storage medium,  and relates to the field of robot technology. This disclosure predicts future hidden states by utilizing ontology perception data and terrain perception data in the robot's historical state data This enables the motion control strategy network to learn the timing rules of the robot's ontology perception data and terrain perception data Based on this timing law,  the motion control strategy network can combine the current terrain status that has been sensed and processed Probabilistic estimation of the terrain state ahead that has not yet been observed Therefore,  in the follow-up movement process,  the gait parameters,  body posture and other control quantities can be dynamically adjusted in advance,  the continuity and stability of the whole movement trajectory can be improved,  problems such as wrestling can be avoided,  and the control performance of the robot in high-difficulty tasks such as running and climbing can be significantly improved. 1. A robot motion control strategy network training method based on deep reinforcement learning,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the historical state data of the robot and inputting the historical state data to the coder to obtain the historical hidden state,  wherein the historical state data comprises the main body sensing data and the terrain sensing data of the robot;  inputting the history hidden state to a motion control strategy network to generate an action strategy,  and inputting the history hidden state to a dynamic transfer model to generate prediction hidden states of multiple future time steps;  calculating a first loss based on the difference between the predicted hidden state and the real hidden state of the plurality of future time steps,  and calculating a second loss based on the action strategy output by the motion control strategy network,  and updating the encoder according to the first loss and the second loss,  the motion control strategy network and the parameter of the dynamic transfer model;  wherein the real hidden state is the hidden state of the target history time step corresponding to the future time step in the history hidden state.

The embodiment of the invention provides a control method and a control device of a wheel-legged robot and the wheel-legged robot The wheel-footed robot comprises a leg unit consisting of thighs and shanks. The control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an initialization instruction; in response to the initialization instruction,  the angle between the thigh and the calf is adjusted to the first target angle,  and the first target angle is when the center of gravity of the robot falls into the support polygon. In the embodiment of the present application,  the static equilibrium state is set as a posture in which the thigh and calf form a first target angle,  and the center of gravity of the robot is located in the support polygon; in this posture,  the center of gravity of the robot is lower,  making it easier to maintain balance and less likely to tip over spontaneously. Moreover,  from this static balance posture to dynamic movement,  the joint adjustment amplitude and time required for the transition from static to dynamic are reduced,  allowing the robot to respond to movement instructions with lower energy consumption and shorter delay,  achieving static stability. Unification of dynamic agility 1. A control method of wheel-foot robot,  the wheel-foot robot comprises a leg unit composed of thigh and calf,  wherein the control method comprises :  obtaining an initialization instruction;  in response to the initialization instruction,  adjusting the included angle between the thigh and the shank as a first target included angle,  wherein the first target included angle is that the gravity centre of the robot falls into a supporting polygon,  and the supporting polygon is formed by connecting multiple supporting nodes of the leg unit.

The invention provides a humanoid robot chassis wheel train self-locking control method and a chassis wheel train structure,  and belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control The invention comprises a plurality of steering wheels,  a rear swing axle,  a motion controller and a chassis main controller Multiple steering wheels are distributed at the corners of the chassis body,  the two front steering wheels are fixedly installed,  and the two rear steering wheels are connected through a rear swing axle; each steering wheel includes a drive-control integrated joint motor with a brake and a direct-drive hub motor without a brake. The drive-control integrated joint motor is used for steering control and angle locking,  and the direct-drive hub motor is used to provide walking torque. The self-locking control method comprises the following steps of :  when the static time of the chassis reaches a preset threshold value,  controlling the steering motors of all steering wheels to rotate so that the axial extension lines of the traveling wheels intersect in a preset area of the chassis; and controlling the contracting brake of the steering motors and enabling the traveling motors to enter a dormant state The invention realizes mechanical self-locking through the gear train geometric self-locking mechanism,  and has the technical advantages of compact structure and reduced energy consumption. 1. A self-locking control method for chassis wheel train of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the chassis state signal of the humanoid robot,  wherein the chassis state signal comprises a motion state signal and a stop state signal;  when receiving the stop state signal,  obtaining the continuous time that the position of the chassis is not changed;  judging whether the duration reaches the preset resting threshold time;  when the duration reaches the preset resting threshold time,  executing a wheel train self-locking program,  the wheel train self-locking program comprises :  controlling the steering motor of each steering wheel in the multiple steering wheels of the chassis to rotate so that the axial direction of the travelling wheel of each steering wheel is adjusted to a preset self-locking angle,  wherein the preset self-locking angle makes the axial extension lines of the travelling wheel of the multiple steering wheels intersect in the preset area of the chassis;  when the steering wheel reaches the preset self-locking angle,  controlling the steering motor to execute the contracting brake action,  and controlling the walking motor of the steering wheel to enable;  the heartbeat communication frequency between the chassis controller and the human-shaped robot main controller is reduced,  so that the chassis is in dormant state;  when receiving the wake-up signal,  controlling the steering motor to release the contracting brake,  controlling the walking motor to re-enable,  and recovering the heartbeat communication frequency to the normal operation frequency.

The invention discloses a six-dimensional force measurement matrix system and method for analyzing multi-terrain gait of a humanoid robot. The system includes a modular terrain simulation platform,  a six-dimensional force measurement matrix module,  a data acquisition and synchronization module,  and a robot gait performance analysis software. The modular terrain simulation platform includes rigid leveling module,  slope module and step module; the six-dimensional force measuring matrix module comprises a plurality of six-dimensional force measuring plates; the data acquisition and synchronization module obtains the synchronous matrix data of each six-dimensional force measuring plate; robot gait performance analysis software calculates key dynamic parameters and spatiotemporal parameters and generates a comprehensive report. The invention can simulate three terrains of rigid flat ground,  slope and step Through the measurement matrix,  the force and moment of the humanoid robot when walking on these terrains are continuously and synchronously collected,  so as to realize the comprehensive,  real and accurate evaluation of gait function,  and provide high-precision and multi-dimensional quantitative evaluation data for the development of gait control algorithm,  dynamic performance calibration and mechanical foot design of the robot 1. A six-dimensional force measuring matrix system for human-shaped robot multi-terrain gait analysis,  comprising a modularized terrain simulation platform,  a six-dimensional force measuring matrix module,  a data collecting and synchronizing module,  a robot gait performance analysis software;  wherein the modular terrain simulation platform comprises three rigid levelling modules,  a slope module and a step module which can be independently placed or combined;  a six-dimensional force measuring matrix module composed of multiple six-dimensional force measuring plates;  a plurality of six-dimensional force measuring plates are paved on the flat area of the rigid flat module,  or paved on the rigid frame of the slope module or the step module,  when paving,  each six-dimensional force measuring plate is parallel or parallel to the walking surface,  a plurality of six-dimensional force measuring plates are freely combined for forming the distributed six-dimensional force measuring plate matrix;  a data collecting and synchronizing module for integrating each six-dimensional force measuring plate to the central data processing unit through the wired or wireless network to synchronously obtain the data of the six-dimensional force measuring plate matrix;  the robot gait performance analysis software is used for receiving,  processing and visually and synchronously obtaining the data of the six-dimensional force-measuring plate matrix,  automatically dividing the gait period of the robot walking on the six-dimensional force-measuring plate matrix,  calculating the key dynamic parameter and the space-time parameter in the gait period,  and generating the comprehensive report.

The invention relates to a humanoid robot bionic spine flexible driving structure and a control system thereof. The system comprises a state sensing module for acquiring dynamic motion signals of a bionic spine structure in real time; the reflection control module receives dynamic motion signals and generates emergency coordination signals through preset bionic reflection rules; the advanced decision module receives the emergency coordination signal from the reflection control module and generates a multi-dimensional motion control signal through the motion planning algorithm; the unified strategy library module is connected to the reflection control module and the advanced decision-making module respectively,  and provides the strategy configuration signal of the reflection rule to the reflection control module; the dynamic execution module connects the advanced decision-making module and the state sensing module,  receives the multi-dimensional motion control signal and the dynamic motion signal,  and generates the torque distribution signal of the driving unit. The humanoid robot bionic spine flexible driving structure and its control system of the present invention can solve the problems of rigid movement,  poor impact resistance,  high energy consumption and complex control of the existing humanoid robot waist structure. 1. A bionic spinal flexible driving structure of humanoid robot and control system thereof,  wherein it comprises :  a state sensing module,  the state sensing module collects the dynamic motion signal of the bionic spinal structure in real time,  the dynamic motion signal at least comprises joint angle information,  multi-dimensional moment data,  machine body posture change and external impact vibration characteristic;  a reflection control module,  the reflection control module receives the dynamic motion signal,  through the preset bionic reflection rule to generate emergency coordination signal,  the bionic reflection rule based on critical threshold value judging and fast response mechanism output joint flexible adjusting instruction;  a high-level decision module for receiving the emergency coordination signal of the reflection control module and generating a multi-dimensional movement control signal by a movement planning algorithm;  a uniform strategy base module,  the uniform strategy base module is respectively connected with the reflection control module and the high-level decision module,  providing the strategy configuration signal of the reflection rule to the reflection control module,  and providing the motion constraint parameter signal to the high-level decision module;  a dynamic execution module,  the dynamic execution module is connected with the high-level decision module and the state sensing module,  for receiving the multi-dimensional motion control signal and the dynamic motion signal,  generating a driving unit moment distribution signal and transmitting to the flexible execution mechanism of the bionic spine.

An AI humanoid robot interaction method based on multimodal biological characteristic,  wherein the specific steps of the method are as follows :  main body posture collection :  obtaining the global pose data of the machine body through the built-in inertia measurement unit of the human-shaped robot,  obtaining the corresponding joint angle and angular velocity data through the built-in encoder of each joint,  finishing the synchronous collection and pre-processing of the main body motion pose data;  Spatial mapping :  based on the main body motion posture data and the initial mounting posture parameter of the collecting module,  constructing a conversion matrix of the human-shaped robot main body and the world coordinate system,  locating and interacting the user through the visual collecting module,  obtaining the space coordinate of the world coordinate system of the user,  calculating the relative space parameter of the user and each multi-mode collecting module;  collection linkage control :  based on the relative space parameter,  through the posture linkage collecting parameter matching formula,  calculating the optimal operation parameter of each collecting module,  sending the hardware level synchronous trigger signal,  synchronously adjusting the operation parameter of each module,  collecting the user multi-modal biological characteristic original data and marking the uniform microsecond level time stamp;  space-time alignment :  based on the uniform time stamp,  finishing the time dimension alignment of the multi-modal original data,  based on the mounting pose of the collecting module and the real-time pose data of the humanoid robot,  constructing a space coordinate mapping model,  finishing the space sampling point level alignment of the multi-modal original data; The invention provides a humanoid robot-based switch cabinet live detection method and a humanoid robot-based switch cabinet live detection system,  and relates to the technical field of power grids The invention automatically obtains the target position and detection items by analyzing the detection task instructions,  and fuses multi-sensor data to perform real-time path planning and obstacle avoidance,  so that the robot can move autonomously and optimally to the operating point,  avoiding the time consumption of personnel's reciprocating walking and positioning; by controlling the humanoid robotic arm to automatically switch probes according to detection types and execute standardized detection actions,  it completely replaces the tedious operations of manual holding,  moving,  and replacing instruments,  and avoids repeated measurements caused by improper operations; the real-time fusion analysis and cross-validation of multi-source data are carried out through the built-in algorithm,  and the detection result containing the fault mode is automatically generated,  so that the real-time intelligent live detection of the switch cabinet is realized,  the technical problem of low efficiency of the live detection of the switch cabinet is solved,  and the detection efficiency of the live detection of the switch cabinet is improved 1. A switch cabinet electrification detection method based on humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  receiving the detection task instruction of the switch cabinet to be detected;  and analyzing the detection task instruction,  obtaining the position information and detection item type of the switch cabinet to be detected,  the detection item type comprises at least one of the following :  transient ground voltage detection,  ultrasonic detection,  infrared thermal image detection and ultra-high frequency detection;  based on the position information of the switch cabinet to be detected and the position information of the humanoid robot,  performing real-time path planning and obstacle avoiding,  moving to the preset working position of the switch cabinet to be detected;  after reaching the preset operation position,  based on the type of the detection item,  controlling the humanoid mechanical arm of the humanoid robot to switch the detection head,  detecting the switch cabinet to be detected,  obtaining the detection data of each detection item;  based on the detection data of each detection item,  performing fusion analysis and cross verification,  determining the detection result of the switch cabinet to be detected,  wherein the detection result comprises a working state,  a fault mode and a fault position.

The invention discloses a circuit monitoring system using a substrate technology. Devices are sealed and connected through a bare DIE sealing process. The sealed chip adopts traditional plastic packaging and bonding packaging processes. Each device is a lead bonding type bare core. Insulating glue is used to bond the device to the substrate,  and the internal resistor and capacitor are connected to the substrate using a surface mounting SMT process; each device in the system is connected through the substrate wiring,  and the external pins of the circuit monitoring system are led out from the pins of the sealed chip; the BGA pins of the sealed chip are directly connected to the external pins and configurable pins through the BGA layout to form a standardized package module. The closed chip of the circuit monitoring system of the present invention is easy to be applied to miniaturized occasions such as unmanned aerial vehicles and humanoid robots; the circuit system under test and the circuit monitoring system are connected through substrate technology,  and the entire control system is installed as a module,  which greatly simplifies the installation process and significantly improves the yield rate. 1. A circuit monitoring system using substrate technology,  wherein it comprises the following devices :  a sensor,  a data collecting module,  a data processing module and an alarming module;  The device is sealed and connected by the bare DIE sealing technique,  the sealing chip adopts the traditional plastic sealing and bonding sealing technique,  each device is the lead bonding bare core,  the device is bonded with the substrate by the insulating glue,  the internal resistance-capacitance is connected with the substrate by the surface mounting SMT technique;  the connection between each device in the system is connected by the substrate wiring,  the pin of the circuit monitoring system is led out by the pin of the sealing chip;  the BGA pin of the sealed chip is directly connected with each external pin and the configurable pin through BGA layout to form a standard sealed module.

The invention provides a switch cabinet detection robot navigation method based on laser radar and vision fusion,  and relates to the technical field of power grids By introducing visual semantic tags,  the present invention enables the robot to have the ability to understand the scene function,  can uniquely identify different target switch cabinets with similar appearances,  realizes the span from geometric positioning to semantic recognition,  and ensures the accuracy of navigation targets. The generated enhanced environment map provides a unified information source with both geometric constraints and semantic constraints for path planning,  so that the planned path can not only safely avoid obstacles,  but also actively guide the operable area of the target cabinet,  improving the intelligence of the navigation path and the fit of the task. Through tightly coupled multi-sensor information fusion,  the present invention effectively improves the overall robustness and reliability of the substation in a complex lighting environment,  solves the problem of inaccurate navigation and positioning existing in the current robot navigation solution,  and improves the accuracy of robot navigation and positioning. 1. A switch cabinet detection robot navigation method based on laser radar and visual fusion,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the laser point cloud data collected by the laser radar sensor carried by the robot,  and the visual image data collected by the visual sensor;  based on the laser point cloud data,  performing synchronous location and map construction,  generating a geometric map;  based on the visual image data,  performing the visual characteristic identification and semantic segmentation,  determining the pixel level semantic label;  performing characteristic layer fusion on the pixel-level semantic tag and the geometric map,  and generating an enhanced environment map having both geometric information and semantic information through coordinate transformation and data association;  based on the enhanced environment map,  and the detection instruction of the target switch cabinet received in real time,  performing global path planning,  obtaining the optimal path to the target switch cabinet,  realizing robot navigation.

The invention relates to a quadruped robot autonomous inspection method and device for rail transit station halls and platforms. The method includes :  S1,  constructing a task management module,  including constructing a task scheduling center and an execution link,  and supporting task priority management,  status feedback and abnormal retry; s2,  build hardware sensing module; s3,  construct an environment mapping and fusion positioning module,  and adopt a fusion positioning algorithm that combines three-dimensional point cloud mapping and ICP point cloud registration; s4,  construct a path planning and motion control module,  and integrate the global path planning algorithm and the convex optimization local path planning algorithm; s5,  build a target recognition and environment detection module; s6,  build a software interaction and visualization module to display robot status,  sensor data and alarm information in real time. Compared with the prior art,  the invention has the advantages of realizing automation,  standardization and traceability of inspection tasks,  reducing manual intervention,  and significantly improving operation and maintenance efficiency and safety guarantee level. 1. A four-foot robot autonomous inspection method for railway traffic station hall platform,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step S1,  constructing a task management module,  comprising constructing a task scheduling centre and an execution link,  and supporting task priority management,  state feedback and abnormal retry;  step S2,  constructing a hardware sensing module,  comprising a laser radar,  an inertia measuring unit,  an RGB-D camera and a gas sensor;  step S3,  constructing an environment building map and fusion locating module,  using the fusion locating algorithm combined with the three-dimensional point cloud building map and ICP point cloud registration;  step S4,  constructing a path planning and motion control module,  integrating a global path planning algorithm and a convex optimization local path planning algorithm;  step S5,  constructing a target identification and environment detection module,  using deep learning target detection model,  realizing identification of station door,  PIS screen,  indicator light and foreign matter,  and combining gas or temperature and humidity threshold trigger mechanism to perform environment detection;  step S6,  constructing a software interaction and visualization module,  displaying the robot state,  sensor data and alarm information in real time.

The invention provides a method,  a system and electronic equipment for segmenting an action reference video object under a noise label,  and belongs to the technical field of computer vision On the basis of the traditional action reference video object segmentation model,  the present invention additionally introduces an auxiliary segmentation head connected to the feature decoder and arranged in parallel with the traditional segmentation head Generate preliminary predictions through traditional segmentation headers,  identify pixels with uncertain predictions,  on uncertain pixels,  calculate the consistency loss using the prediction results of the traditional segmentation head and the auxiliary segmentation head And combined with pixel-level classification loss for model training Effectively alleviate the problem of boundary blur caused by inaccurate labeling It improves the segmentation robustness of the model in noisy environments,  while avoiding the high GPU memory burden caused by dual models or storage history predictions,  and only uses traditional segmentation heads in the inference stage without increasing inference overhead,  making it suitable for human-computer interaction.,  robot operation and embodied intelligence and other practical application scenarios 1. An action under noise label refers to a video object segmentation method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step S1,  additionally introducing an auxiliary dividing head connected to the feature decoder and arranged in parallel with the traditional dividing head to form an improved model on the basis of the traditional action representing the video object dividing model;  step S2,  training the improved model by using the data set,  respectively processing the characteristics output by the characteristic decoder by the auxiliary dividing head and the traditional dividing head and outputting the dividing prediction result;  step S3,  based on the segmentation prediction result of the traditional segmentation head,  dividing all pixels into an uncertain pixel set and a confidence pixel set,  wherein the element in the uncertain pixel set comprises a low confidence pixel and a boundary pixel,  and the element in the confidence pixel set is other pixels except the element in the uncertain pixel set;  step S4,  for determining the element in the pixel set,  calculating the standard segmentation loss based on the same method of the traditional action index video object segmentation model;  for the element in the uncertain pixel set,  calculating the consistency loss of the prediction result of the traditional segmentation head and the auxiliary segmentation head,  constructing the final total segmentation loss by the standard segmentation loss and the consistency loss,  and monitoring the training of the improved model;  step S5,  after finishing training,  for any one action,  indicating the video object segmentation task,  in the reasoning stage,  no assistant segmentation head is called any more,  only the output of the characteristic decoder is input to the traditional segmentation head,  adopting the traditional segmentation head to independently output the segmentation prediction result.

The present invention proposes a humanoid detection method and device based on artificial intelligence By obtaining real-time surveillance images of the surveillance area,  extract suspected human body outline images from the real-time monitoring images,  the suspected human body outline image is the outline image of the suspected human body object that matches the shape of the human body on the real-time monitoring image,  determine whether the human body posture on the suspected human body outline image matches the reference human body posture,  when the human body posture on the suspected human body outline image matches the reference human body posture,  extract a first partial image corresponding to the suspected human body outline image from the real-time monitoring image,  input the first partial image into a local humanoid detection model to perform human body structure recognition to obtain human body structure data of the first partial image. The local humanoid detection model is an artificial intelligence model with low parameters,  which can achieve high-precision humanoid detection while ensuring the stability of the monitoring system. 1. A human shape detection method based on artificial intelligence,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the real-time monitoring image of the monitoring area;  extracting the suspected human body outline image on the real-time monitoring image,  wherein the suspected human body outline image is the outline image of the suspected human body object matched with the human body shape on the real-time monitoring image;  judging whether the human body gesture on the suspected human body outline image is matched with the reference human body gesture;  when the human body gesture on the suspected human body outline image is matched with the reference human body gesture,  extracting a first local image corresponding to the suspected human body outline image from the real-time monitoring image;  inputting the first local image into a local human shape detection model to perform human structure identification to obtain human structure data of the first local image,  wherein the local human shape detection model is an artificial intelligent model with low parameter quantity.

The utility model discloses a fire-fighting emergency rescue hexapod robot Comprises a robot main body,  multiple sets of foot assemblies are installed on the main body of the robot The foot assembly includes a second connecting arm A mounting block is installed on one end of the second connecting arm The mounting block is mounted on the second connecting arm The mounting block has multiple mounting surfaces,  the mounting block is provided with a first threaded hole that matches the mounting surface. A fire-fighting emergency rescue six-foot robot,  comprising a robot main body,  wherein the robot main body is provided with multiple groups of foot components;  the foot component comprises a second connecting arm,  one end of the second connecting arm is installed with a mounting block,  the mounting block is installed on the second connecting arm;  the mounting block is provided with a plurality of mounting surfaces,  the mounting block is provided with a first screw hole matched with the mounting surface,  the mounting block is connected with a second screw rod matched with the first screw hole,  one end of the second screw rod far away from the mounting block is provided with a sole.

This application relates to the field of image detection technology and provides a humanoid target detection method,  electronic equipment and storage medium. The humanoid target detection method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an image frame from a video stream; using mixed Gaussian background model to extract foreground image of image frame; extract the outline of the foreground image; calculate the area of the smallest circumscribed rectangle of the contour; judging whether the area of the smallest circumscribed rectangle of the outline is greater than or equal to the preset area threshold; if the area of the minimum circumscribed rectangle of the outline is greater than or equal to the preset area threshold,  the single-shot multi-frame detection SSD model is used to detect humanoid targets on the image frames. The method and the device can effectively reduce the calculation of the image frame of the anthropomorphic target in the video stream detection task,  and improve the detection speed of the anthropomorphic target 1. A human shape target detection method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining an image frame from the video stream;  establishing a mixed Gaussian background model,  comprising :  obtaining a plurality of image frames from the video stream;  taking one image frame in the plurality of image frames as a first sample,  establishing a mixed Gaussian model for each pixel point of the first sample,  using the first sample to initialize the mixed Gaussian model,  obtaining the mixed Gaussian background model,  wherein the mixed Gaussian model comprises a plurality of Gaussian distributions;  using other image frames in the multiple image frames as the second sample,  using the second sample to update the parameter of the mixed Gaussian background model;  using the mixed Gaussian background model to extract the foreground image of the image frame;  extracting the outline of the foreground image;  calculating the area of the minimum circumscribed rectangle of the outline;  judging whether the area of the minimum external rectangle of the outline is greater than or equal to the preset area threshold;  if the area of the minimum external rectangle of the outline is greater than or equal to the preset area threshold,  recording the first time;  obtaining a second image frame from the video stream,  recording a second time for obtaining the second image frame,  and performing human-shaped target detection on the second image frame by using a single-transmission multi-frame detection SSD model;  if the human shape target is not detected from the second image frame,  judging whether the time difference between the second time and the first time is less than the time threshold;  if so,  using the single-shot multi-frame detection SSD model to perform human shape target detection;  if not,  using the mixed Gaussian background model to detect the human shape target.
