The invention provides a robot support method and system based on visual information pairs,  which relates to the field of computer vision technology and is applied to robot equipment; the method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring three-dimensional image data of a target area to be acquired; determine the time information of the current collection time of the stereoscopic image data,  and store the stereoscopic image data and the corresponding time information to obtain a spatio-temporal associated visual information pair; calculate the visual information pairs to obtain visual spatio-temporal information; convert the visual spatio-temporal information into action instructions for instructing the execution module to execute the corresponding support task actions,  and update and dynamically correct the action instructions in real time based on the visual spatio-temporal information; according to the action instruction,  the corresponding working parts are guided to the target operating point through the execution module,  and the support task action is executed. The invention can provide efficient and accurate support operation process in complex coal mine tunnel environment,  reduce manual intervention and improve construction safety and operation efficiency. 1. A robot supporting method based on visual information pair,  wherein it is applied to the robot device,  the robot device at least comprises an execution module;  The method comprises :  obtaining the three-dimensional image data of the target area to be collected,  the three-dimensional image data comprises grid format data and vector format data,  the three-dimensional image data is paired binocular focusing data,  the target area comprises a target working point;  determining the time information of the current collecting time of the stereoscopic image data,  and storing the stereoscopic image data and the corresponding time information to obtain the visual information pair related to the space time;  resolving the visual information pair to obtain the visual space-time information,  wherein the visual space-time information is used for representing the time and space relation between the execution module and the target operation point;  converting the visual space-time information into an action instruction for indicating the execution module to execute the corresponding supporting task action,  and updating and dynamically correcting the action instruction in real time according to the visual space-time information;  according to the action instruction,  guiding the corresponding working component to the target working point through the execution module,  and executing the supporting task action,  the working component is the operation terminal of the execution module;  the target working point comprises a locating hole position;  the step of resolving the pair of visual information to obtain visual space-time information comprises :  through the image processing technology,  extracting the key visual characteristic in the three-dimensional image data,  the key visual characteristic comprises the locating hole position and the texture characteristic,  shape characteristic and edge characteristic of the working component;  resolving the depth of field information based on the binocular parallax of the stereoscopic image data;  combining the depth of field information,  performing three-dimensional spatial positioning on the target working point and the spatial position information and time information of the working component,  to obtain the visual space-time information further comprises :  performing vectorization on the key visual characteristic in the stereoscopic image data to generate a multi-dimensional characteristic vector of the key visual characteristic,  wherein the multi-dimensional characteristic vector at least comprises a texture characteristic vector,  a shape characteristic vector and an edge characteristic vector;  mapping the multi-dimensional characteristic vector of the key visual characteristic and the preset drilling template data to generate the characteristic coding information,  wherein the drilling template data comprises the depth of field information,  the texture characteristic,  the shape characteristic and the edge characteristic of the standard drilling;  comparing and matching the multi-dimensional feature vector with the drilling template data;  according to the comparison matching result,  determining the space position of the locating hole position;  according to the space position of the locating hole position,  generating the visual space-time information for representing the space relation between the executing module and the locating hole position.

This application discloses a humanoid robot multi-modal data processing method,  system,  equipment and medium Methods include :  Multi-modal data sets are collected through humanoid robots The multi-modal data set is preprocessed to obtain a preprocessed data set,  multi-layer prompt information is generated according to the industrial scene of the humanoid robot,  and the preprocessed data set and multi-layer prompt information are input into the pre-trained multi-modal model for collaborative reasoning processing and output. Obtain industrial task processing results According to the embodiment of the invention,  the data processing efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved,  and the humanoid robot can be widely applied to the technical field of intelligent robots 1. A multi-modal data processing method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  acquiring the multi-mode data set by the human-shaped robot;  pre-processing the multimodal data set to obtain a pre-processed data set;  generating multi-layer prompting information according to the industrial scene of the humanoid robot;  inputting the pre-processing data set and the multi-layer prompting information into a pre-trained multi-mode model for cooperative reasoning processing,  and outputting to obtain an industrial task processing result;  the multimodal data set comprises a visual image,  a haptic signal and an operation instruction text,  the multimodal data set is pre-processed to obtain a pre-processed data set,  comprising :  extracting the outline characteristic of the visual image,  identifying the outline of the parts by an edge detection operator,  and optimizing the outline continuity by morphological operation to obtain the outline characteristic;  performing defect detection and vector generation processing on the visual image according to the profile feature,  generating a multi-dimensional feature vector for the potential defect area through a feature extraction network,  obtaining the visual feature;  performing time-frequency domain conversion and frequency-band characteristic extraction processing on the touch signal,  decomposing the time-domain signal into characteristic components of different frequency bands by wavelet conversion,  extracting impact characteristic of high frequency band and trend characteristic of low frequency band to obtain touch characteristic;  performing semantic enhancement processing on the operation instruction text according to the preset industrial field word stock to obtain the semantic enhancement text;  performing semantic vector conversion and constraint feature additional processing on the semantic enhanced text to obtain text feature;  obtaining the pre-processing data set according to the visual characteristic,  the touch characteristic and the text characteristic;  The step of generating multi-layer prompt information according to the industrial scene of the humanoid robot comprises :  performing prompt generation processing on the character attribute of the humanoid robot according to the industrial scene to obtain basic layer prompt information;  prompting and generating the industrial task of the humanoid robot according to the industrial scene to obtain the task layer prompting information;  according to the industrial scene,  performing prompt generation processing on the task constraint of the humanoid robot,  obtaining constraint layer prompt information;  obtaining the multi-layer prompting information according to the basic layer prompting information,  the task layer prompting information and the constraint layer prompting information.

The invention discloses a control method,  system,  equipment and medium for a humanoid robot. The method obtains a control decision-making model and multi-source environment perception data of the humanoid robot in a task scene,  as well as the EEG of a target user in the task scene. data; input the multi-source environment sensing data and the EEG data into a trained state analysis model for analysis to obtain a state evaluation result output by the trained state analysis model,  and the state evaluation result is used to indicate the The current emotion category and fatigue level of the target user; input the state evaluation results and the multi-source environment sensing data into the control decision model for decision generation to obtain the action control instructions of the humanoid robot; performing coordinated action control on the humanoid robot according to the action control instruction The control method can effectively improve the safety and efficiency of man-machine collaboration. The invention relates to the technical field of man-machine cooperation 1. A control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the control decision model and the multi-source environment sensing data of the humanoid robot in the task scene,  and the brain wave data of the target user in the task scene;  inputting the multi-source environment sensing data and the brain wave data to the trained state analysis model to analyze,  obtaining the state evaluation result output by the trained state analysis model,  the state evaluation result is used for indicating the current emotion type and fatigue level of the target user;  inputting the state evaluation result and the multi-source environment sensing data to the control decision model for decision generation to obtain the action control instruction of the humanoid robot;  according to the action control instruction,  performing cooperative action control on the humanoid robot;  the multi-source environment sensing data and the brain wave data are input to the trained state analysis model for analysis,  obtaining the state evaluation result output by the trained state analysis model,  comprising :  obtaining an environment noise characteristic matrix;  cooperatively filtering the brain wave data according to the environment noise characteristic matrix to obtain brain wave modal data;  standardizing the data of the multi-source environment sensing data to obtain the environment mode data;  performing time alignment on the electroencephalogram mode data and the environmental mode data to obtain multi-mode data;  inputting the multimodal data into the trained state analysis model for analysis to obtain the state evaluation result;  the multi-modal data is input into the trained state analysis model for analysis,  obtaining the state evaluation result,  comprising :  extracting the space characteristic of the multimode data to obtain the brain wave space topology characteristic and the environment space topology characteristic;  extracting the time sequence feature of the brain wave space topology feature to obtain the brain wave space feature,  and extracting the time sequence feature of the environment space topology feature to obtain the environment space feature;  performing characteristic attention fusion to the brain wave space-time characteristic and the environment space-time characteristic to obtain a fusion characteristic;  performing double-branch characteristic analysis to the fusion characteristic to obtain the state evaluation result;  performing time sequence feature extraction on the target space topology feature to obtain the target space-time feature,  comprising :  obtaining a first task weight matrix;  dynamically scheduling the target space topology feature according to the first task weight matrix to obtain the feature scheduling strategy corresponding to the target space topology feature;  according to the feature scheduling strategy,  extracting the strategy feature of the target space topology feature to obtain the target space-time feature;  wherein if the target space topology feature is brain wave space topology feature,  the target space-time feature is brain wave space-time feature;  or if the target space topology feature is an environment space topology feature,  the target space-time feature is an environment space-time feature.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot instruction understanding method and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The humanoid robot instruction understanding method comprises the following steps of :  receiving industrial operation instruction information and detecting whether the industrial operation instruction information belongs to an industrial scene; input to the industrial scene semantic understanding model to obtain the output target operation parameter results; based on the industrial safety rule base,  the safety verification is carried out,  and the control instruction is generated by using the target operation parameter result to drive the humanoid robot; among them,  the industrial scene semantic understanding model is constructed based on the large language model; the target operation parameter results include operation object identification,  action type,  execution accuracy and safety boundary value. This application detects whether the industrial operation instruction information conforms to the industrial scenario Improve scene relevance,  and use the industrial scene semantic understanding model to improve the parsing accuracy of professional terms and operating parameters. By introducing the industrial safety rule base for safety verification,  we can reduce the risk of super-threshold operation and improve safety,  thereby effectively improving the user experience. 1. A human-shaped robot instruction understanding method,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  receiving the industrial operation instruction information in response to the instruction issuing request;  detecting whether the industrial operation instruction information belongs to the preset industrial scene;  under the condition that the industrial operation instruction information belongs to the preset industrial scene,  inputting the industrial operation instruction information to the industrial scene semantic understanding model,  so as to obtain the target operation parameter result output by the industrial scene semantic understanding model;  based on the preset industrial safety rule base,  performing safety verification on the target operation parameter result;  under the condition that the target operation parameter result passes the security verification,  using the target operation parameter result to generate a control instruction,  and driving the human-shaped robot to execute the control instruction;  wherein the industrial scene semantic understanding model is constructed based on a large language model;  said target operation parameter result comprises operation object identification,  action type,  execution precision and safety boundary value.

This application discloses a foot-ground interaction trajectory planning method and system,  which relates to the technical field of foot robot trajectory planning. The method includes constructing a foot-ground interaction expert trajectory library based on the DMPs imitation learning method; the residual reinforcement learning method is used to adaptively correct the foot-ground interaction expert trajectory in the foot-ground interaction expert trajectory library; utilize the adaptive trajectory iterative selection mechanism based on interactive feedback to dynamically select the optimal reference trajectory from the foot-ground interactive expert trajectory library; construct a multi-terrain contact-legged robot simulation environment,  and conduct simulation tests and verifications on the trajectory adaptive correction process and the process of dynamically selecting the optimal reference trajectory,  and obtain simulation test verification results. This application can improve the accuracy of foot-ground interaction trajectory planning and improve the stability of foot-ground interaction of legged robots in complex terrain. 1. A foot-ground interaction track planning method,  wherein the foot-ground interaction track planning method comprises :  S1 :  constructing a foot-ground interaction expert track base based on DMPs simulation learning method;  the foot-ground interaction expert track library comprises foot-ground interaction expert track adapted to multiple different terrains;  S2 :  performing track self-adaptive correction on the foot-ground interaction expert track in the foot-ground interaction expert track base by using residual error strengthening learning method,  obtaining the corrected foot-ground interaction expert track;  S3 :  according to the corrected foot-ground interaction expert track,  using the self-adaptive track iteration selection mechanism based on interaction feedback,  dynamically selecting the optimal reference track from the foot-ground interaction expert track library,  obtaining the updated reference track;  S4 :  constructing multi-terrain contact foot type robot simulation environment;  S5 :  based on the multi-terrain contact foot-type robot simulation environment,  the updated reference track and the corrected foot-ground interaction expert track,  performing simulation test verification on the self-adaptive correction process of the step S2 track and the process of dynamically selecting the optimal reference track in the step S3,  obtaining the simulation test verification result;  The simulation test verification result comprises foot-ground interaction task success rate,  track compliance degree and training efficiency verification result.

The invention discloses a stranger face recognition system,  a stranger face recognition method,  a foot-type humanoid robot and a stranger face recognition medium. The stranger face recognition system and the stranger face recognition method are applied to the technical field of image processing. A multi-task face recognition model is adopted,  face bounding box prediction and face key point extraction are carried out on an environment image,  and a face key point set in each face bounding box is obtained Align the face key point set in each face bounding box to the standard template face image to obtain a non-deformed face image; extract the face feature vector of the face to be recognized from each non-deformed face image; calculate the similarity between the face feature vector of each face to be recognized and the face feature vector of each temporary reference face in the lightweight face database; determine whether the face to be recognized is a stranger face based on similarity. In this way,  stranger face recognition can be realized on the footed humanoid robot,  avoiding network delays caused by cloud comparison,  realizing real-time interactive responses in public environments,  and improving human-computer interaction efficiency. 1. A stranger face recognition system,  wherein it is deployed on the foot-type humanoid robot,  comprising a video stream collecting module,  an image quality optimizing module,  a face feature extracting module and a face identity judging module;  the video stream collecting module is integrated on the main body of the foot-type humanoid robot and used for collecting the environment video stream in the public environment;  the image quality optimizing module is connected with the video stream collecting module and used for repairing the quality of the environment image in the environment video stream by the lightweight quality repairing model to obtain the target environment image;  the human face feature extraction module is connected with the image quality optimization module,  for using a multi-task human face identification model,  performing face boundary frame prediction and face key point extraction on the target environment image to obtain a face boundary frame set and a face key point set in each face boundary frame in the face boundary frame set;  based on the standard template key point set,  respectively aligning the human face key point set in each human face boundary frame to the standard template human face image to obtain the non-deformed human face image corresponding to each human face boundary frame;  using the multi-task characteristic extracting model,  respectively extracting the global human face visual characteristic vector and multi-dimensional human face attribute characteristic vector of the human face to be identified from the non-deformed human face image corresponding to each human face boundary frame as the human face characteristic vector;  wherein the multi-task face recognition model comprises a first feature image extraction branch and a three-level detection head connected with the first feature image extraction branch in parallel;  the three-level detection head is a face two-classification detection branch,  a face boundary frame regression branch and a face key point regression branch;  the multi-task feature extraction model comprises a second feature image extraction branch and a secondary detection head connected with the second feature image extraction branch in parallel;  the secondary detection head is a global visual characteristic extraction branch and a multi-attribute characteristic extraction branch;  the human face identity judging module is connected with the human face feature extracting module,  for respectively calculating the similarity between the human face feature vector of the human face to be identified in each human face boundary frame and the human face feature vector of each temporary reference human face dynamically stored in the local lightweight human face database,  and determining whether the face to be identified in each face boundary frame is a stranger face based on the similarity; The invention discloses a behavior testing method and related equipment for a multi-modal sensing humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-modal sensing data and current joint state data,  splicing the multi-modal sensing data and the current joint state data,  and determining a current state vector; sampling actions according to the current state vector and the trained processing model to obtain several sampled actions; calculate according to several sampling actions,  the current state vector and the preset operation model to determine several candidate action states from the sampling actions; performing identification calculation on candidate action states according to a preset neural network model to obtain a total identification score,  and determining a target action state according to the total identification score; simulate and evaluate the humanoid robot according to the preset scenario test cases and target action states,  and generate corresponding test reports. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the action adaptability and the scene adaptability can be improved The application can be widely applied to the technical field of humanoid robots 1. A behaviour test method of multi-modal sensing humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining multi-mode sensing data and current joint state data,  splicing according to the multi-mode sensing data and the joint state data,  determining the current state vector;  performing action sampling according to the current state vector and the trained processing model,  determining multiple sampling actions,  and performing calculation according to the multiple sampling actions,  the current state vector and the preset motion model,  determining multiple candidate action states;  identifying and calculating according to the multiple candidate action states and the preset neural network model,  determining multiple total identification scores,  and analyzing according to the multiple total identification scores and the multiple candidate action states,  determining the target action state;  performing test evaluation according to the target behaviour state and the preset scene test case,  determining a test report.

This application discloses a harmonic reducer performance adaptation method and device for humanoid robots Relates to the field of robot joint transmission technology The method includes :  Construct a multi-dimensional performance index database of harmonic reducers based on the static performance parameters and dynamic performance parameters of various types of harmonic reducers Based on the performance requirement vector of humanoid robot target joints in application scenarios,  construct a load condition model,  adaptation calculations are performed based on the multi-dimensional performance index database and load condition model Obtain the comprehensive matching degree score and load prediction results of each candidate harmonic reducer model and the performance demand vector. According to the comprehensive matching degree score and load prediction results,  obtain the adaptation recommendation list of the target harmonic reducer model,  and based on the adaptation recommendation List for harmonic reducer performance adaptation. Through the above method,  the technical problem of improper type selection caused by single dimension adaptation in the existing technology is solved. 1. A harmonic speed reducer performance adaptation method for humanoid robot,  wherein the harmonic speed reducer performance adaptation method for humanoid robot comprises :  constructing a multi-dimensional performance index database of the harmonic speed reducer according to the static performance parameter and the dynamic performance parameter of the harmonic speed reducer with multiple types;  constructing a load working condition model based on the performance requirement vector of the human-shaped robot target joint in the application scene;  performing adaptive calculation based on the multidimensional performance index database and the load working condition model,  obtaining comprehensive matching degree score and load prediction result of the model number of each candidate harmonic speed reducer and the performance requirement vector;  according to the comprehensive matching degree score and the load prediction result,  obtaining an adaptation recommendation list of the target harmonic speed reducer model number,  and performing harmonic speed reducer performance adaptation based on the adaptation recommendation list;  after the step of obtaining the adaptive recommendation list of the target harmonic speed reducer model number according to the comprehensive matching degree score and the load prediction result,  and performing harmonic speed reducer performance adaptation based on the adaptive recommendation list,  further comprising :  determining the preferred model in the adaptive recommendation list,  respectively predicting the expected operation temperature and the expected system total energy consumption of the preferred model in the application scene of the target joint in the load working condition;  respectively comparing the expected operation temperature and the expected system total energy consumption with a preset performance threshold value to obtain a decision result;  when the decision result does not satisfy the preset condition,  determining the performance difference value,  and optimizing the performance index weight according to the performance difference value;  performing adaptive calculation according to the performance index weight,  the multidimensional performance index database and the load working condition model to generate an optimized adaptive recommendation list.

The present invention belongs to the field of intelligent robot technology And discloses a remote operation data acquisition and data closed-loop system of intelligent humanoid robot Through the timing coordination module,  the ternary timing synchronization mechanism of instructions,  actions and acquisition is built,  and the dynamic coordination of the three is realized by using time-sensitive network technology,  which effectively reduces the timing deviation. At the same time,  combined with the spatio-temporal alignment algorithm of the data processing module,  the consistency of multi-modal data in time and space dimensions is guaranteed; make the collected data accurately fit the human operation logic and robot action status,  improve the optimization efficiency of the data closed loop,  and successfully adapt to the needs of high-precision operation scenarios such as complex assembly and flexible material processing; relying on the evaluation module to establish a quantitative correlation system between data quality and control effect,  it can screen invalid data such as sensor faults and fuzzy actions in real time,  and reduce the occupation of redundant storage and computing resources. 1. A remote operation data collection and data closed loop system of intelligent humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises a time sequence cooperation module,  a data processing module,  a transmission module,  an evaluation module,  a driving module,  an optimization module and a fault-tolerant self-adaptive module;  a time sequence coordination module :  the multi-mode instruction fusion and the robot dynamics identification adaptation technology are used for establishing an instruction,  an action and a collecting ternary time sequence synchronization mechanism,  realizing the time sequence alignment of the remote operation instruction conversion and transmission,  the action execution and the data collection,  and synchronizing the time sequence synchronization signal to the data processing module;  a data processing module :  receiving the time sequence synchronous signal,  constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data collection network based on the multi-type sensor,  realizing the data synchronous collection through the space-time alignment and dynamic frequency adjustment,  screening the effective data through the quality pre-evaluation and standardizing,  and outputting the structured data to the transmission module;  a transmission module :  constructing a transmission link based on the edge computing framework,  checking the instruction and the data validity through the bidirectional intelligent checking mechanism,  monitoring the link state in real time and realizing the redundancy switching;  an evaluation module :  receiving the checked multi-source data,  using the cross-modal fusion mechanism to excavate the data association feature to generate the job state description information,  optimizing the data quality and establishing the quantification association relation of the data quality and the control effect,  outputting the grading data and the evaluation result;  a driving module :  establishing a dynamic weight distribution model based on the operation state information and the data quality evaluation result,  optimizing the control strategy by the reinforced learning and prediction control algorithm,  realizing the adaptation of remote operation and autonomous control,  improving the control precision by real-time deviation correction,  and feeding back the control effect data to the optimizing module;  an optimization module :  finishing the model increment training based on the good quality data,  feeding the optimized parameter back to the time sequence cooperation module and the driving module,  analyzing the reason of the bad quality data and outputting the collected parameter adjusting suggestion,  dynamically optimizing the closed loop operation parameter;  a fault-tolerant adaptive module :  using the fault prediction model to realize the potential fault early warning,  triggering the hierarchical fault-tolerant strategy based on the fault level,  recording the fault data and the fault-tolerant adjusting process and generating the analysis report.

The invention discloses a robot head and neck structure and a robot,  belonging to the field of robot technology. It is connected to the robot head and the robot body part,  and includes a side swing mechanism,  a horizontal rotation mechanism and a pitching mechanism connected in sequence from top to bottom; the side swing mechanism is connected to the head of the robot to drive the head of the robot to perform side swing motion; the horizontal rotation mechanism is used to drive the side swing mechanism and the robot head to rotate horizontally; the pitching mechanism is connected to the robot body part and is used to drive the horizontal rotation mechanism,  the side swing mechanism and the robot head to perform pitching motion. A robot head and neck structure,  connected with the robot head and the robot body part,  wherein It comprises a side swinging mechanism (1),  a horizontal rotating mechanism (2) and a pitching mechanism (3) which are orderly connected from top to bottom;  the side swinging mechanism (1) is connected with the robot head,  driving the robot head to do side swinging movement;  the horizontal rotating mechanism (2) is used for driving the side swing mechanism (1) and the robot head to horizontally rotate;  the pitching mechanism (3) is connected with the robot body part,  for driving the horizontal rotating mechanism (2),  the side swinging mechanism (1) and the robot head to do pitching movement.

The invention discloses a self-adaptive force control method for a wheel-legged robot facing contact-intensive tasks The robot status sensor collects robot status information in real time The user inputs motion instructions and end effector posture instructions through the operating device The neural momentum hybrid estimator receives state information and user instructions and outputs an estimated value of the external force applied to the end effector. The force-aware whole-body controller is trained based on dual-agent game reinforcement learning and integrates the state information,  user instructions and the end effector. The estimated value of the external force to generate joint control instructions; based on the joint control instructions,  the bottom actuator drives each joint movement of the robot to achieve coordinated control of the whole body. The invention has faster response speed,  significantly reduced lag,  and no continuous error,  so that the robot can achieve agile motion control in a dynamic environment with rich contact. 1. A self-adaptive stress control method of wheel leg robot facing contact intensive task,  wherein the robot state sensor collects the robot state information in real time;  a user inputs a motion instruction and an end actuator pose instruction through an operating device;  the nerve momentum mixing estimator receives the state information and the user instruction,  and outputs the estimated value of the external force of the terminal actuator;  the neural momentum mixed estimator comprises a fast variable force sensing network and a slow variable force momentum observer,  the fast variable force sensing network is used for obtaining the predicted value of the external force received by the end actuator,  the slow variable force momentum observer constructs a robot dynamic equation,  determining generalized momentum,  using the extended Kalman filter to fuse the predicted value of the external force of the end actuator and the generalized momentum,  iteratively solving to obtain the estimated value of the external force of the end actuator;  the force sensing whole body controller is used for training based on the double-agent game strengthening learning,  and synthesizing the state information,  the user instruction and the estimation value of the external force received by the end executor to generate the joint control instruction;  based on the joint control instruction,  the bottom actuator drives each joint of the robot to move so as to realize coordinated control of the whole body.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot travel path selection method and system based on Kalman filtering,  and belongs to the technical field of robot movement control It is used to solve the technical problem that the sudden change of foot-end contact force of quadruped robot or the change of terrain slope will lead to model mismatch,  which will lead to filter divergence or estimation deviation; correct the kinematic model in real time through slope angle,  make the system state prediction more suitable for the actual terrain When the contact stiffness suddenly changes,  noise covariance dynamic enhancement,  avoid small probability of large mutations being excessively suppressed by filtering By utilizing a time-varying state transition matrix and an adaptive noise covariance matrix It can dynamically adapt to changes in terrain slope and contact stiffness. According to the output filtered optimal state estimation,  combined with the preset foot end foothold stability evaluation function,  a traveling foothold that satisfies the force-pose constraints is generated and the robot is driven to execute.,  allowing the quadruped robot to autonomously select a stable foothold in unknown complex terrain. 1. A four-foot robot travel path selection method based on Kalman filtering,  wherein it comprises :  based on the contact force mutation sequence obtained by the foot end six-dimensional force sensor collecting and processing,  the attitude angle of the inertia measuring unit and the terrain texture characteristic of the visual sensor,  real-time estimating the terrain gradient angle and the contact rigidity mutation coefficient through the multi-mode weighted fusion algorithm;  constructing a time-varying state transfer matrix and a noise covariance self-adaptive adjusting law based on the final terrain gradient angle estimation value and the contact rigidity mutation coefficient obtained by processing,  dynamically correcting the filter gain matrix to inhibit the model mismatch error,  and outputting the filter optimal state estimation;  according to the output filter optimal state estimation,  combining with the preset foot end falling foot point stability evaluation function,  generating the advancing falling foot point satisfying the force-posture constraint and driving the robot to execute.

This application discloses a humanoid robot balance control method,  system,  equipment and medium,  and relates to the field of robot balance control. The method includes :  obtaining the current operating parameters of each target direction of the humanoid robot,  and constructing a dynamic model based on the current operating parameters.; for any target direction,  based on the current operating parameters of the target direction and using the Kalman filter to determine the prediction parameters at the next moment of the target direction; determine the control signal of the target direction based on the operating parameters at the previous moment,  the current operating parameters and the predicted parameters at the next moment of the target direction; the balance control of the robot is realized based on the dynamic model and the control signals in each target direction. This application solves the technical problem that the center of gravity is easily offset or even unstable when the humanoid robot quickly adjusts its posture. 1. A balance control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the current operation parameter of each target direction of the humanoid robot,  and constructing a dynamic model based on the current operation parameter;  for any target direction,  based on the current operation parameter of the target direction and using Kalman filter to determine the prediction parameter of the next time of the target direction;  determining the control signal of the target direction based on the operation parameter at the last time of the target direction,  the current operation parameter and the prediction parameter at the next time;  realizing the balance control of the robot based on the dynamic model and the control signal of each target direction.

An intelligent quadruped robot paddy field subsidence condition equivalent test method and system belong to the technical field of robot performance test and evaluation Including :  determining the rheological characteristic parameters of the target paddy field soil and the standard gait parameters of the robot to be tested; measure the real-time compression amount and driving torque of the foot end when the robot is placed on the elastic test pad in the laboratory to perform walking movements; construct the stiffness mapping relationship between the linear stiffness of laboratory elastic medium and the nonlinear pressure model of real paddy field soil; determining the virtual unrecoverable subsidence depth of the tested robot in the target paddy field soil; calculating the equivalent operating energy consumption of the robot under real paddy field conditions. The invention does not need to construct a real paddy field test environment filled with mud,  and can convert the recoverable compression data on the laboratory elastic medium into the unrecoverable subsidence depth and dynamic operation resistance under the real paddy field rheological environment,  thereby improving the reproducibility and efficiency of the test. 1. An intelligent four-legged robot paddy field sinking condition equivalent test method and system,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  determining the rheological characteristic parameter of the target paddy field soil as the Beckel soil bearing model parameter of the target paddy field environment to be simulated,  and setting the motion parameter of the tested robot as the motion speed of the tested robot during the rice inter-row inspection;  step 2 :  collecting the real-time vertical compression amount data of the foot end to the test pad when the tested robot performs the movement speed walking set in the step 1 on the laboratory elastic test pad with known rigidity coefficient,  and synchronously collecting the real-time output moment of the joint motor;  step 3 :  based on the force balance principle,  establishing an equivalent equation between the elastic reaction force of the test pad and the soil bearing force of the target paddy field,  generating a non-linear rigidity mapping model;  step 4 :  substituting the real-time vertical compression amount data collected in the step 2 into the non-linear rigidity mapping model in the step 3,  calculating the equivalent sinking depth of the tested robot in the sinking working condition of the target paddy field,  which is the virtual unrecoverable sinking depth ;  step 5 :  calculating the equivalent operation energy consumption of the robot to be tested under the sinking condition of the target paddy field is equal to the actual electric energy consumption of the motor in the walking test distance of the robot to be tested on the laboratory elastic test pad,  the energy consumption compensation item of the virtual elastic test pad and the sum of the lateral mud discharging resistance working calculated according to the virtual unrecoverable sinking depth in the step 4.

The invention discloses a universal cognitive architecture of a robot based on a world model and a control method thereof,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control Aiming at the industrial pain points of fuzzy responsibility boundaries and difficult traceability of decision-making processes in large-scale application of robots,  the present invention proposes a robot cognitive system constructed with the world as the center,  including eight functional modules :  the first module is used to store the physical world knowledge base; the second module is used to store the robot's own ontology model; the third module is used to obtain multi-modal sensing data; the fourth module is used to store the cognitive model of the living body; the fifth module is used to store the life-physical interaction rule base; the sixth module is used to store the human-specific knowledge base; the seventh module is used to store behavioral norms and ethical constraint engines; the eighth module is used for behavior execution and interactive control. Each module forms a functionally coupled whole,  forming a complete closed loop from world understanding to behavior generation. The seventh module is independent and priority,  and performs compliance verification on all actions; the system is equipped with a traceable recording mechanism to ensure that key decisions are traced throughout the entire process. The invention uses responsibility as the main line to run through the design,  so that the robot has the core capabilities of interpretability,  traceability and responsibility on the basis of understanding the physical world,  living bodies and human society,  and provides technical support for humanoid robots to enter families and industrial scenes. 1. A universal cognitive framework of robot based on world model and control method thereof,  wherein it comprises :  the first module is used for storing the physical world knowledge base,  comprising physical rule,  material attribute and object knowledge;  a second module for storing the main body model of the robot,  comprising a body parameter,  a capability boundary and a self-state sensing,  wherein the capability boundary is defined by the physical rule of the first module;  a third module for obtaining multi-mode sensing data,  comprising vision,  hearing,  touch/force sense and main body sense,  wherein the sensing range and precision are limited by the ability boundary of the second module;  a fourth module for storing the life body cognitive model,  comprising the life body identification,  the life body requirement and the interaction rule between the life bodies,  which identifies the type,  state and interaction relation of the life body in the environment based on the physical rule of the first module and the sensing data of the third module;  a fifth module for storing the life-physical interaction rule base,  comprising an action model of the life body to the physical world,  an action model of the physical world to the life body and an interaction result prediction model,  which predicts the result of the specific action according to the output of the first and fourth modules;  a sixth module for storing the human exclusive knowledge base,  including the human basic demand,  the cultural standard and the human special interaction mode,  which combines the output of the fourth and fifth modules to understand the human demand under the current scene;  a seventh module,  for storing behaviour specification and ethics constraint engine,  comprising non-harm principle,  instruction processing rule and privacy protection rule,  which is independent from the sixth module,  the check standard has normative rather than descriptive,  the input comprises a first,  a second,  the output of the six modules performs compliance check to all possible actions,  and the output thereof is prior to the output of the sixth module;  an eighth module,  for behaviour execution and interaction control,  which receives the verified action intention output by the seventh module,  combines the self-ability boundary of the second module and the real-time sensing data of the third module,  generates a specific motion control instruction,  drives the robot to execute and physical world,  interaction between life body and human;  wherein the first to the eighth modules form a function coupling body,  and the dependence relationship among the modules is the logic dependence on the function,  but not the sequence on the time.

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots,  and in particular to a suction cup structure at the end of a robotic arm of a humanoid robot. Obtain the first positioning data according to the image and depth data of the surrounding environment of the legged robot,  IMU inertial measurement data and odometer data; the longitude,  latitude and altitude data observed by the Beidou satellite are used as the second positioning data; s3. The invention relates to the field of robot technology,  and specifically discloses a humanoid robot high-precision map construction method that integrates ontology perception and external semantics,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Multi-source data collection and preprocessing; s2. Feature extraction and pose estimation; s3. Multi-source data fusion and semantic association; s4. Space-vision-language fusion; s5. Multi-resolution semantic map construction; s6. Dynamic target elimination and map consistency maintenance; s7. VLM assisted verification and false positive correction; s8. The present disclosure provides a robot motion control strategy network training method and device based on state representation learning,  and relates to the field of robot technology. The method includes :  acquiring a privileged state and an ontology-aware state in a training phase,  and performing zero-masking processing on the privileged state to construct a masked state The privilege state and its mask state are respectively input into the policy encoder sharing the weight,  and the prediction vector is further generated through the predictor. On this basis,  a contrast loss function is constructed based on the prediction vector and the peer representation vector,  and the parameters of the policy encoder are updated according to the contrast loss function. This disclosure can promote the ontology perception state to form a more discriminative and task-related distribution in the embedding space,  improve the ability to express key dynamic changes,  and thereby improve the accuracy and stability of the action strategy generated by the control strategy network. 1. A robot motion control strategy network training method based on state representation learning,  wherein the state representation learning model frame comprises a strategy encoder and a predictor;  The method comprises :  obtaining the main body sensing state and privilege state of the robot in the current time step;  performing zero mask processing on the privileged state to obtain a mask state corresponding to the privileged state,  wherein the zero mask processing comprises setting at least part of the privileged state not belonging to the main body sensing state as zero;  respectively inputting the privilege state and the mask state into the strategy encoder of the shared weight to generate corresponding first representation vector and second representation vector;  respectively inputting the first representation vector and the second representation vector to the predictor to obtain corresponding first prediction vector and second prediction vector;  calculating a contrast loss function based on the first prediction vector and the second representation vector and the second prediction vector and the first representation vector,  and updating a parameter of the policy encoder based on the contrast loss function.

The present disclosure provides a robot motion control strategy network training method,  robot motion control method,  device,  equipment,  robot and storage medium based on imitation learning,  and relates to the field of robot technology. The present disclosure builds multiple independent style discriminators Use targeted reference action data for training separately It effectively decouples the dependencies of different action styles in the feature space,  thereby avoiding the feature competition problem caused by the use of shared networks in related technologies,  allowing the discriminator to focus on feature extraction of a single style and accurately distinguish action details even in highly coincident task spaces. The target style discriminator is dynamically locked according to the current state,  and the score of the target discriminator is used as the only imitation learning reward value,  so that a single and clear optimization gradient with single directivity can be provided for the policy network during the training process,  so that the policy network can learn clear style switching boundaries. 1. A robot motion control strategy network training method based on simulation learning,  wherein it comprises :  constructing multiple style discriminators,  each of which is obtained by training based on the reference action data of the corresponding target style and used for evaluating the consistency between the output action of the motion control strategy network and the target style;  determining the target style discriminator corresponding to the current state of the robot,  taking the scoring result of the target style discriminator to the current state and the current action of the robot as the simulation learning reward value at the current time;  updating the parameter of the motion control strategy network based on the simulated learning reward value so as to guide the motion control strategy network to learn the action characteristic of the corresponding style.

The invention discloses a robust adaptive multi-skill learning method for a quadruped robot based on key frame guidance,  which includes :  determining a target key frame set for multi-skill learning. In a flat terrain environment,  the key frames are probabilistically sampled according to the skill task value to generate skill instructions,  and the quadruped robot is controlled to perform actions,  and the training trajectories are collected and stored in the strategy learning and self-imitation learning experience playback pools respectively. Training the policy network and the value function network through the policy learning loop; a self-imitation learning discriminator network is trained through a self-imitation learning loop to extract high-quality trajectories. After completing the flat terrain training,  enter the complex terrain environment,  and conduct adaptive training under the guidance of the trained strategy network and the self-imitation learning discriminator network to realize the migration of skill primitives to the complex environment. This method can effectively take into account multi-skill learning and terrain adaptability,  and improve the robustness,  flexibility and multi-task execution performance of quadruped robots. 1. A four-foot robot robust adaptive multi-skill learning method based on key frame guide,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  determining the target key frame set of multi-skill learning,  and initializing the network parameter,  the strategy learning experience playback pool and the self-simulation learning experience playback pool;  under the flat terrain environment,  based on the target key frame set,  performing probability sampling according to the skill task value,  generating the skill instruction;  based on the generated skill instruction,  controlling the four-foot robot to interact with the flat terrain environment,  collecting the training track,  and respectively storing in the strategy learning experience playback pool and the self-simulation learning experience playback pool;  executing strategy learning circulation based on the strategy learning experience playback pool,  training the strategy network and the value function network of the four-foot robot,  and learning various skills in the single strategy;  the value function network comprises a task evaluator network and a simulation evaluator network;  based on the self-imitation learning experience playback pool,  executing the learning circulation of the self-imitation learning discriminator,  training the network of the self-imitation learning discriminator;  after finishing the pre-set training under the flat terrain environment,  entering the training stage under the complex terrain environment,  in the complex terrain environment,  based on the trained strategy network and the self-simulating learning discriminator network,  performing self-adaptive training on the four-foot robot.

The invention provides a humanoid robot vision system automatic calibration method,  system and medium. An automatic calibration method of human-shaped robot vision system,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 (S1) :  obtaining a CSV configuration file,  wherein the CSV configuration file comprises pre-defined multiple groups of joint angle sequences satisfying the preset requirement;  wherein each group of joint angle sequence is corresponding to a calibration position;  step S2 :  performing integrity verification on the obtained CSV configuration file;  step S3 :  controlling the target mechanical arm to move to the corresponding calibration position according to the pre-defined joint angle sequence satisfying the pre-set requirement in the verified CSV configuration file;  step S4 :  synchronously collecting the camera image,  the end actuator pose and the joint angle data at each pose,  realizing the full-automatic batch collection of the hand-eye calibration data;  step S5 :  Based on the camera image collected on each pose and the pose of the end actuator,  the transformation matrix of the camera and the end of the mechanical arm is calculated by hand-eye calibration algorithm.

The invention relates to a control method for a deformable multi-modal motion intelligent robot. The control method includes :  the robot collects front and surrounding environment data in real time through a distributed sensing system,  performs fusion processing on the collected data,  and outputs the terrain category label of the current area. and key set parameters; select the optimal motion mode based on the preset terrain-mode mapping rule base combined with task priority and energy consumption model; the controller calls the form configuration protocol corresponding to the movement mode,  sequentially drives each joint unit in the movement mode to adjust the angle,  stiffness and connection state,  and synchronously activates the corresponding power unit to complete the smooth transition from the current movement mode to the optimal movement mode. A control method of deformable multimodal motion intelligent robot,  wherein the controlling method comprises :  step one,  the robot collects the front and surrounding environment data in real time through the distributed sensing system,  and performs fusion processing on the collected data,  and outputs the terrain type label and key set parameter of the current area;  step ,  selecting the optimal motion mode based on the preset terrain-mode mapping rule base combined with the task priority and the energy consumption model;  step three,  the controller invokes the form configuration protocol corresponding to the motion mode,  orderly drives each joint unit to adjust angle,  rigidity and connection state under the motion mode,  synchronously activates the corresponding power unit,  and finishes the smooth transition from the current motion mode to the optimal motion mode.

An intelligent human-shaped robot for tendon driving tool body,  comprising :  A human-shaped robot main body,  wherein the human-shaped robot main body is composed of a head (1),  an upper body (2),  a shoulder joint (3),  an elbow joint (4),  a wrist joint (5),  a waist joint (6),  a thigh (7),  a knee joint (8),  a shank (9),  an ankle joint (10) and a foot (11),  the wrist joint (5) is connected with the palm (12),  the shoulder joint (3),  the elbow joint (4),  the wrist joint (5),  the waist joint (6),  the knee joint (8),  the ankle joint (10) and the palm (12) are provided with multiple tendon units,  the tendon unit is composed of an artificial tendon (13) driver (14) and a tendon tension sensor (15),  configured to simulate the mechanical performance of the real tendon through the artificial tendon (13);  the driver (14) controls the contraction and expansion of the artificial tendon (13),  driving the joint of the palm (12) to move in multiple directions;  the tendon tension sensor (15) is used for monitoring the tension and extension parameter of the artificial tendon (13) in real time.

A ubiquitous humanoid robot motion controller capable of quickly deploying,  wherein it comprises :  and a controller hardware and a control software,  wherein the control software comprises :  a model training system for abutting with the strengthening learning training platform and the simulation platform,  so as to utilize the strengthening learning training platform to perform strengthening learning training on the motion decision model of the human-shaped robot,  and utilize the simulation platform to perform simulation verification on the trained motion decision model;  a motor parameter self-adaptive setting part for self-setting the motor control parameter of the joint motor of the solid joint of the human-shaped robot so as to obtain the optimal motor control parameter;  a real-time communication part for setting the communication interface of the motion controller;  and a control software programming interface for introducing the related parameters of the humanoid robot and outputting the control frame software with the trained motion decision model to deploy the humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot autonomous power swapping system and a power swapping method,  which realize unmanned automatic power swapping based on the robot and the mobile power swapping cabinet; the robot comprises a humanoid robot main body and a mobile chassis,  the battery is arranged in the mobile chassis,  the humanoid robot main body is arranged on the mobile chassis,  the mobile power exchange cabinet comprises a power exchange cabinet main body and a mechanical arm,  and the mechanical arm is arranged on the power exchange cabinet main body The invention realizes fully autonomous battery replacement and energy management of the robot in complex environments,  and improves the intelligence,  adaptability and continuous operation capabilities of the system. 1. An autonomous power changing method of humanoid robot,  wherein the unmanned automatic power changing is realized based on the robot and the mobile power changing cabinet;  wherein the robot comprises a human-shaped robot main body and a movable chassis,  the battery is located in the movable chassis,  the human-shaped robot main body is set on the movable chassis,  the movable power changing cabinet comprises a power changing cabinet main body and a mechanical arm,  the mechanical arm is set on the power changing cabinet main body;  The autonomous power exchange method for humanoid robot comprises robot side control and power exchange cabinet side control,  as follows :  The robot side control process comprises :  the battery state is detected by the mobile chassis,  and the energy evaluation and power exchange decision are assisted;  when detecting that the electric quantity of the battery is not enough,  the robot determines the position posture of itself and the mobile power changing cabinet based on the sensing system of itself,  after sending the power changing request,  the mobile chassis automatically executes the power-off and releasing action,  the power-loss battery in the mobile chassis is pushed out to the mobile power changing cabinet,  after the mobile chassis receives the full-electric battery,  electrifying again and monitoring the state of the battery,  and completely containing the full-electric battery in the mobile chassis;  the side control process of the power exchange cabinet comprises :  a grabbing control,  the grabbing control comprises a self-adaptive closed-loop control of battery pose estimation and target location,  dynamic grabbing strategy generation,  vision-force sense fusion;  The battery pose estimation and target positioning process comprises :  based on the camera of the mechanical arm and the camera of the power exchange cabinet main body,  constructing a multi-view visual link,  realizing the high robustness posture estimation of the mobile chassis and the battery of the power exchange cabinet main body;  The dynamic grabbing policy generation process comprises :  in the process of forming the grabbing plan,  the generated grabbing pose sampling method based on the diffusion model is used,  the grabbing candidate pose is generated by iterating in the high-dimensional grabbing space,  and the optimal grabbing pose is automatically selected by combining the geometric constraint of the adsorption actuator at the tail end of the mechanical arm to the adsorption surface and the camera observation consistency;  The adaptive closed-loop control process of vision-force sense fusion comprises :  when the adsorption actuator is contacted with the battery,  a double-closed loop track tracking strategy of fusion visual servo and force sense impedance control is used;  when the battery alignment is finished,  the mobile chassis at the robot side automatically detects the alignment condition of the interface,  the mobile chassis starts the adsorption locking and the upper electric operation,  finishes the connection of the machine and the electric interface,  and performs real-time check on the electric quantity state,  the power changing cabinet side releases the full electric battery,  the full electric battery enters into the robot,  finishing the power changing operation.

The invention provides a humanoid robot with wiring harness protection and a motion mode switching method thereof,  which belongs to the technical field of bionic robots and includes a robot body,  a movable base,  a robotic arm,  a multi-modal sensor and a controller; the movable base is located at the bottom of the robot body,  the mechanical arms are symmetrically arranged on both sides of the robot body,  the multi-modal sensor is assembled on the movable base,  and the controller is communicatively connected to the mechanical arms and the multi-modal sensor; the mechanical arm has built-in wiring harness for power supply and signal transmission. The controller is configured to adapt to the movement mode of the robot. Switch to maintain the wiring harness protection state The invention reduces the stress damage during the movement of the wiring harness,  extends the service life of the wiring harness,  realizes the cooperative adaptation of mobile mode switching and wiring harness protection,  and improves the movement stability of the robotic arm and the long-term operation reliability of the robot. 1. A humanoid robot with wiring harness protection,  wherein it comprises a robot main body,  a movable base,  a mechanical arm,  a multi-mode sensor and a controller;  the movable base is set at the bottom of the robot main body,  the mechanical arm is symmetrically arranged at two sides of the robot main body,  the multi-mode sensor is assembled on the movable base,  the controller is in communication connection with the mechanical arm and the multi-mode sensor;  the mechanical arm is internally provided with a wiring harness for supplying power and transmitting signal,  the wiring harness is reserved with redundant length and forms a bending part,  the minimum curvature radius of the bending part is not less than the minimum safe bending radius allowed by the wiring harness,  the controller is configured to adapt the moving mode switching of the robot to maintain the wiring harness protection state.

The invention relates to a method and a system for diagnosing slump failure of a humanoid robot,  and relates to the field of robot fault diagnosis. The method comprises the following steps of :  determining a current abnormal action combination in response to a robot slump signal; the exception combination number found based on the current exception combination; cumulative number of anomalies; when the abnormal times exceed the reliable abnormal times threshold,  determine the suspected abnormal state of the power board; execute the PCBA test method based on the suspected abnormal state of the power board and output the verification completion signal; when there is no verification completion signal,  the current robot action combination is collected in real time; determining an expected abnormal action combination based on the current robot action combination and the abnormal combination number; determine the expected risk time; when the expected risk time is less than the minimum processing time threshold,  determine the robot action adjustment parameters; perform robot motion adjustment operations. The invention has high diagnostic accuracy and efficiency,  and can avoid unnecessary diagnosis 1. A human-shaped robot paralysis failure diagnosis method,  wherein it comprises :  step 1 :  determining the current abnormal action combination in response to the robot tumble signal;  step 2 :  searching the abnormal combination number corresponding to the preset abnormal combination record base based on the current abnormal combination;  step 3 :  accumulating the abnormal times corresponding to the abnormal combination number;  step 4 :  when the abnormal times exceeds the preset reliable abnormal times threshold,  determining the abnormal state of the suspected power board;  step 5 :  executing the pre-set PCBA test method based on the abnormal state of the suspected power supply board,  and outputting the pre-set check finishing signal;  step 6 :  when there is no check finishing signal,  collecting the current robot action combination in real time;  step 7 :  determining the predicted abnormal action combination based on the current robot action combination and the abnormal combination number;  step 8 :  determining the predicted risk time based on the current robot action combination and the predicted abnormal action combination;  Step 9 :  when the predicted risk time is less than the preset shortest processing time threshold value,  determining the robot action adjusting parameter based on the current robot action combination and the predicted abnormal action combination;  Step 10 :  executing the robot action adjusting operation based on the robot action adjusting parameter.

A geological radar detection device based on crab-shaped leg robot,  comprising a radar scanning device,  wherein further comprising a folding telescopic arm and a crab-shaped leg robot,  the crab-shaped leg robot comprises a vehicle body and a crab-shaped leg for supporting and fixing the vehicle body,  the two sides of the vehicle body in the length direction are provided with a plurality of crab-shaped legs at intervals;  the radar scanning device is rotatably connected with one end of the folding telescopic arm,  and the other end of the folding telescopic arm is rotatably connected with the vehicle body.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot maneuver control system and method with unknown interference adaptability,  and belongs to the technical field of quadruped robots. The method includes :  establishing a quadruped robot dynamics model; design of joint state interference observer combined with quadruped robot dynamics model; the joint state interference observer is a nonlinear interference observer; integrate the joint state basic controller and the joint state interference observer to form a joint state anti-interference controller; conduct joint state interference observer Lyapunov stability proof. The present invention uses current information to construct a feedforward term and add it to the basic controller to actively compensate for the impact of unknown linear and nonlinear interference,  and can solve the impact of unknown interference on the dynamic system from the root. 1. A four-foot robot maneuvering control system with unknown interference adaptability,  wherein it comprises :  a joint state basic controller,  an executing mechanism,  a four-foot robot platform,  a joint sensor,  a gyroscope and an accelerometer,  a joint state interference observer,  a desired joint angle generating module and a communication unit;  wherein the joint state basic controller,  the joint state interference observer and the expected joint angle generating module form the joint state interference resisting controller;  the four-foot robot platform is used for simulating the real four-foot robot in the experiment and storing the historical joint angle information and the command information as the input signal of the expected joint angle generating module;  the joint sensor is used for measuring the actually measured joint angle information of the four-foot robot;  the gyroscope and the accelerometer are used for measuring the attitude information of the four-foot robot;  the joint state interference observer is used for observing the external interference and internal interference caused by the angle deviation of the four-foot robot joint;  the output of the non-linear joint state interference observer is added to the joint state base controller in the form of a feed-forward item;  the expected joint angle generating module takes the actual measurement posture information,  the actual measurement joint angle information,  the history joint angle information and the command information of the four-foot robot as the input,  and takes the expected joint angle information as the output;  the joint state basic controller obtains the joint motor control moment through the deviation information of the expected joint angle information and the actually measured joint angle information;  the communication unit sends the actually measured joint angle information to the joint state anti-interference controller,  and converts the joint motor control moment into the instruction motor voltage signal,  and then distributes to the four-foot robot platform through the executing mechanism.

The invention discloses a man-machine interaction virtual try-on method for a humanoid robot The method comprises the following steps of :  naturally interacting with a user through a humanoid robot; firstly,  acquiring a human body image of the user under a voice prompt,  and guiding the user to select a target garment; then pose estimation and semantic segmentation are used to generate the user's pose key point information and human body-independent area mask map. For open jackets,  a MaskNet model is constructed to predict the area of the jacket,  and a combined garment image is generated based on garment geometric alignment and background fusion technology. Further constructing a virtual fitting model,  performing feature coding and diffusion generation on the input combined garment image,  mask image and human posture image,  and outputting a realistic virtual fitting image from the model Eventually,  the humanoid robot presents the try-on result on its display screen The invention can realize natural and coherent fitting experience in entity interaction scenes,  and has higher adaptability and generation quality when dealing with complex clothing structures such as open jackets. 1. A human-computer interaction virtual try-on method for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  the user is guided by the humanoid robot to finish shooting so as to obtain the human body image of the user;  S2 :  presenting selectable clothes to the user through the humanoid robot,  and guiding the user to select the target clothes to be tried;  S3 :  obtaining the gesture key point information and the human body segmentation image of the user through the gesture estimation model and the semantic segmentation model,  thereby generating the mask image of the human body unrelated region;  S4 :  constructing a MaskNet model for garment region prediction,  generating a corresponding garment independent region mask pattern according to the geometric alignment result of the selected open overcoat image;  S5 :  based on the geometric alignment result of the open coat image and the user human body image,  and combining the background fusion technology,  combining and processing the clothes;  S6 :  constructing and training a virtual try-through model for generating a personalized virtual fitting image,  realizing diffusion de-noising generation of the virtual fitting image;  S7 :  taking the combined clothes image,  the combined mask image and the human body posture image as the condition to input to the virtual fitting model,  gradually generating the de-noised virtual fitting result image from the pure noise through the model,  and displaying the virtual fitting result on the display screen of the humanoid robot.

The invention constructs a full-process monitoring chain from data collection to risk warning through multi-module collaboration,  realizes full-cycle and multi-dimensional dynamic control of the construction of the human-shaped tower column high lateral support system,  and ensures timely perception and overall control of potential risks. 1. The invention discloses a method for controlling a humanoid robot to sit down and the humanoid robot,  which are used for enabling the humanoid robot to sit down flexibly,  safely and autonomously with basic fault tolerance The methods of this application include :  When it is detected that the humanoid robot is in a standing posture and meets the sitting trigger conditions,  call the sitting control program,  control the humanoid robot to perform the sitting action sequence Transitioning the humanoid robot from a standing posture to a sitting and supporting posture,  wherein the sitting action sequence includes multiple stages of sitting actions,  and the corresponding sitting control subroutine controls the centroid of the humanoid robot and multiple end effectors to move according to their respective preset sitting reference trajectories for each stage of sitting action; after detecting that the humanoid robot reaches the sitting support posture,  the humanoid robot is controlled to adjust from the sitting support posture to a preset stable sitting posture.
