The invention discloses a robot collaborative evolution method and a robot collaborative evolution system based on a subvariant graph neural network,  and belongs to the technical field of body intelligence and reinforcement learning The method constructs a collaborative evolution framework including three stages :  structural transformation,  attribute adjustment and behavior control; introduce subisovariate graph neural network,  dynamically generate local reference system (LRF),  and project vector state in 3D environment to geometrically invariant space; the symmetric group constrained network structure is used to ensure that the strategy maintains consistency under rotation and translation; joint optimization of morphological evolution and behavioral strategies via PPO algorithm. The invention significantly improves sample efficiency,  generalization ability and form-task adaptability in 3D complex tasks,  and is suitable for reconfigurable robot platforms such as quadruped and humanoid. 1. A robot collaborative evolution method based on sub-isograph neural network,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  the shape of the robot is represented as a topological diagram,  the state of the robot is represented as a sub-isovariable diagram,  the sub-isovariable diagram comprises a scalar characteristic,  a vector characteristic and a gravity direction vector,  and the vector characteristic comprises a position,  a speed,  at least one of the angular velocities,  the position has been converted to a translation invariant representation by subtracting the root node position;  S2,  orderly executing in each training period :  S21,  structure transformation stage :  modifying the node and side of the topological graph through the first graph neural network to change the robot form structure;  S22,  attribute adjustment stage :  modifying the node attribute of the topological graph by the second graph neural network to adjust the limb parameter of the robot,  wherein the limb parameter comprises at least one of limb length,  quality and joint torque limitation;  S23,  behavioural control stage :  the partial reference system is predicted by the sub-isovariable graph neural network,  the sub-isovariable graph is projected as the geometric invariant graph,  and the control action is output by the third graph neural network based on the geometric invariant graph;  S3,  using the near-end strategy optimization (PPO) algorithm,  jointly updating the first,  second and third graph neural networks according to the environment reward,  and the value function is estimated based on the geometric unchanged graph.

Joint state sequence and foot end contact mask; based on the joint state sequence and the foot end contact mask,  rolling optimization is performed on the centroid momentum dynamic model by using a model predictive control method to obtain a high-level motion command including joint angle and contact force; a whole-body controller is used to process the high-level motion instructions to obtain joint torque instructions that meet the whole-body dynamics and physical constraints,  and the robot is driven to perform anthropomorphic walking based on the joint torque instructions. A humanoid robot scene adaptive task planning method based on multimodal-motion coupled world model,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  after receiving the task instruction and collecting the multimodal data,  uniformly coding to obtain the multimodal fusion embedded data;  performing feature correlation to the multimodal fusion embedded data through the improved multimodal-motion coupling world model to obtain a text action instruction and a multimodal feature vector;  performing the characteristic mapping of the motion constraint guide according to the multi-modal characteristic vector to obtain the condition characteristic vector;  generating the fusion graph according to the condition feature vector and the improved scene self-adaptive diffusion model to obtain the fusion graph of the coupling environment state and the limb movement;  taking the text action instruction as the new task instruction,  taking the fusion graph as the new multimodal data,  returning to the step of receiving the task instruction,  collecting the multimodal data and uniformly coding to obtain the multimodal fusion embedded data until the output fusion graph meets the preset condition.

A four-foot robot path optimization method for explosion accident field sensing,  wherein the method comprises :  at the first position,  scanning the accident area in full view according to the carrying device group,  generating an Euclidean symbol distance field,  wherein the Euclidean symbol distance field is marked with a key track point based on a layer of planning of the data collecting target guide;  according to the Euclidean symbol distance field,  determining the first temporary target,  activating the path planning module,  taking the grid step length as single planning,  executing the grid iteration planning from the first position to the first temporary target,  determining the first stage path planning,  wherein the planning constraint condition and the first semantic condition are used for planning constraint;  according to the first stage path planning,  performing robot driving,  updating the first position and the first temporary target to perform round-robin planning and data acquisition driving,  until finishing the data acquisition of the accident area.

The invention discloses an adaptive compression method for a three-dimensional map of a quadruped robot under complex terrain. The adaptive compression method comprises the following steps of :  extracting Z-axis height information of each key frame in a three-dimensional point cloud map to obtain an original height sequence; filtering and smoothing the original height sequence; dividing the key frame into a plurality of compression units based on the smooth height sequence; for each compression unit,  the initial ground points are identified by RANSAC plane fitting method,  non-ground points are eliminated by combining normal vector constraints and height thresholds,  and the reference ground height is determined according to the optimized ground points; set a compressed height range based on the reference ground height,  and use the three-dimensional point cloud within the compressed height range as the point set to be projected; performing ortho-projection on the point set to be projected to generate a two-dimensional local subgraph; splice each two-dimensional local subgraph to generate a global two-dimensional occupied raster map. The present invention flattens the complex three-dimensional space into a two-dimensional map in segments while maintaining local topological relationships and navigation availability. 1. A three-dimensional map self-adaptive compression method of four-foot robot under complex terrain,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the three-dimensional point cloud map,  extracting the Z-axis height information of each key frame in the three-dimensional point cloud map,  obtaining the original height sequence;  filtering and smoothing the original height sequence to obtain a smooth height sequence;  based on the smooth height sequence,  dividing the key frame into multiple compression units with the same internal height by the dynamic planning method;  for each compression unit,  identifying the initial ground point by RANSAC plane fitting method,  eliminating the non-ground point by combining the normal vector constraint and the height threshold value,  obtaining the optimized ground point,  determining the reference ground height of each compression unit according to the optimized ground point;  based on the reference ground height,  setting a compression height range,  and taking the three-dimensional point cloud in the compression height range as a point set to be projected;  performing orthographic projection to the point set to be projected,  generating a two-dimensional partial sub-graph corresponding to each compression unit;  splicing each two-dimensional partial sub-graph to generate global two-dimensional occupied grid map.

Title :  Adaptive Soft-Robotic Exosleeve with Multimodal Biofeedback,  Neuro-Muscular Digital Twin,  and Learning-Based Personalized Rehabilitation Control An adaptive robotic ExoSleeve for neuromuscular rehabilitation is disclosed. The system comprises a wearable soft-robotic sleeve integrated with multimodal biosensors configured to acquire real-time physiological and biomechanical signals indicative of muscle activation,  joint kinematics,  force interaction,  and fatigue state. An edge- based adaptive control module executes a reinforcement-learning policy in cooperation with a personalized neuromuscular digital twin that predicts expected muscle activation,  joint dynamics,  and fatigue progression for prescribed rehabilitation tasks. Actuator torque,  stiffness,  damping,  and motion trajectory are dynamically modulated based on fused biofeedback and predictive outputs to provide patient-specific,  fatigue-aware assistance or resistance. The system operates in a closed-loop,  low-latency manner with integrated safety supervision and autonomously transitions between assistive,  adaptive,  and resistive rehabilitation phases. The invention enables personalized,  safe,  and scalable neuromuscular rehabilitation suitable for clinical and home-based use.

The present invention relates to an Autonomous Multi-Functional Robotic Assistant (AMFRA) designed to operate adaptively across multiple environments,  including industrial,  healthcare,  domestic,  and service sectors. This invention integrates artificial intelligence (AI),  machine learning (ML),  computer vision (CV),  and sensor fusion technologies to create a highly versatile and intelligent robotic system capable of performing complex tasks autonomously. The system features a modular hardware architecture comprising a high-performance microcontroller,  a multi-sensor array—including ultrasonic,  infrared,  LIDAR,  and camera modules—and a four- channel relay system for motion and control.The invention makes use of a layered software framework built upon ROS,  while AI-driven decision-making algorithms enable it to achieve autonomous navigation,  real-time object recognition,  and intelligent human interaction using natural language processing. The capabilities for adaptability of the robot range from such modular designs that can be reconfigured rapidly for specific use cases,  be it in material handling at factories,  assistive patient services within healthcare,  or even delivery and service operations within hospitality settings.Connectivity to the cloud allows the system to learn continuously and operate remotely with certainty that the system adapts with user feedback and environmental changes. Safety and efficiency are provided through intelligent obstacle detection,  predictive maintenance,  and response mechanisms during an emergency. The core novelty of the invention is self-learning,  self-optimization,  and self- adaptation with limited re-programming,  which sets this apart from any domain-specific robotic systems mentioned so far.The combination of intelligence with flexibility through modular design should allow the Autonomous Multi-Functional Robotic Assistant to offer a cost-effective,  scalable,  and efficient solution for automation while improving productivity,  reducing human intervention,  and allowing seamless human-robot collaboration. The invention is a major step towards autonomous robotics and offers a platform for next-generation adaptive automation and intelligent assistance in diverse real-world applications.

A system may simulate human motion for human-robot interactions,  such as may involve a handover of an object. Motion capture can be performed for a hand grasping and moving an object to a location and orientation appropriate for a handover,  without a need for a robot to be present or an actual handover to occur. This motion data can be used to separately model the hand and the object for use in a handover simulation,  where a component such as a physics engine may be used to ensure realistic modeling of the motion or behavior. During a simulation,  a robot control model or algorithm can predict an optimal location and orientation to grasp an object,  and an optimal path to move to that location and orientation,  using a control model or algorithm trained,  based at least in part,  using the motion models for the hand and object.

The invention discloses a field operator identity feature fusion identification method and a field operator identity feature fusion identification system. The method comprises the following steps of :  decoding and extracting frames of a monitoring video file or a real-time monitoring video stream to obtain sequence frames; perform pedestrian detection,  pedestrian re-identification and pedestrian tracking on the obtained sequence frames,  and extract the gait image sequence and gait contour sequence of the object to be identified to form a target feature set; match the target feature set of the object to be identified with the target feature set in the pre-constructed target library to identify the identity of the object to be identified; in the present invention,  an operator identity is pre-bound to each target feature set in the target library. The invention can effectively solve the problem of difficult identification of unified dressing operators in scenes such as difficulty in obtaining faces and inability to capture complete gait cycles,  realize identification of on-site operators covering the entire scene,  and effectively improve the safety management and control level of factories and stations. 1. A fusion identification method of field operator identity and characteristic,  wherein it comprises :  decoding and extracting the frame of the monitored video file or the real-time monitored video stream to obtain the sequence frame;  performing pedestrian detection,  pedestrian re-identification and pedestrian tracking on the sequence frame,  extracting gait image sequence and gait outline sequence of the object to be identified,  forming a target feature set;  matching the target feature set of the object to be identified with the pre-constructed target library,  identifying the identity of the object to be identified,  comprising :  extracting the human face from the gait image sequence of the target feature set of the object to be identified through the human face detection algorithm;  taking the face library in the target library as the base library,  calculating the similarity between the face of the object to be identified and the face of all the operators in the target library,  if the maximum similarity is greater than the preset threshold Thf,  identifying the object to be identified as the operator with the maximum similarity;  if the human face cannot be extracted or the similarity calculated by the human face does not exist the operator greater than the preset threshold Thf,  then the gait profile sequence in the target library is used as the bottom library,  calculating the similarity between the gait feature of the object to be identified and the gait feature of all the operator in the target library,  if the maximum similarity is greater than the preset threshold Thg,  identifying the object to be identified as the operator with the maximum similarity;  if the identity of the object to be identified is not identified through the human face and the gait feature,  then the pedestrian re-identification feature extracted from the gait image sequence in the target library is used as the base library,  the similarity between the pedestrian re-identification feature of the object to be identified and the pedestrian re-identification feature of all operators in the target library is calculated and sorted,  for the first five of the similarity ranking,  according to the ranking order,  assigning different weights,  and adding the similarity of the same target library operator,  finally obtaining the comparison result,  taking the first target library operator as the identification result of the object to be identified; This application provides a multi-joint collaborative motion control method and system for a humanoid robot,  which relates to the field of robot control technology. This application obtains gait phase data of the humanoid robot in different motion states. The motion states include walking state,  running state and emergency state. stop state; generating a gait phase shift matrix according to the gait phase data to determine the motion mode switching point,  further determining the hysteresis compensation timing of the pneumatic artificial muscle,  and performing hysteresis compensation processing on the pneumatic artificial muscle of each lower limb joint of the humanoid robot to obtain the joint motion state; analyze the angle change rate and motion acceleration parameters in the joint motion state to generate biologically inspired electrical signals; according to the joint coordination angle threshold and motion trigger moment of biologically inspired electrical signals,  each lower limb joint of the humanoid robot is driven to perform coordinated motion to achieve seamless switching of multi-modal motion and improve motion flexibility and stability. 1. A multi-joint cooperative motion control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining gait phase data of the humanoid robot in different motion states,  wherein the motion state comprises a walking state,  a running state and an emergency stop state;  generating a gait phase transfer matrix according to the gait phase data to determine a motion mode switching point;  according to the motion mode switching point,  determining the delay compensation time of the pneumatic artificial muscle,  so as to perform delay compensation processing on the pneumatic artificial muscle of each lower limb joint of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the joint motion state;  analyzing the angle change rate and the motion acceleration parameter in the motion state of the joint to generate a biological enlightening signal;  driving each lower limb joint of the human-shaped robot to perform cooperative motion according to the joint cooperative angle threshold value and motion triggering time of the biological enlightening signal,  so as to realize multi-mode motion seamless switching;  according to the gait phase data,  generating a gait phase migration matrix to determine a motion mode switching point,  comprising :  extracting the first phase characteristic value corresponding to the walking state,  the second phase characteristic value corresponding to the running state and the third phase characteristic value corresponding to the emergency stop state from the gait phase data;  counting the occurrence frequency of the first phase characteristic value,  the second phase characteristic value and the third phase characteristic value so as to calculate the conversion probability between every two motion states;  writing all conversion probabilities into an initial matrix structure of a preset dimension to form a gait phase transfer matrix,  wherein the row dimension of the initial matrix structure corresponds to the initial motion state,  and the column dimension corresponds to the target motion state;  traversing the gait phase migration matrix,  determining the ending time of the initial motion state corresponding to the conversion probability exceeding the preset probability threshold as the motion mode switching point;  analyzing the angle change rate and the motion acceleration parameter in the motion state of the joint,  generating a biological enlightening signal,  comprising :  according to the motion state of the joint,  calculating the angle change rate and motion acceleration of each lower limb joint;  comparing the angle change rates of different lower limb joints at the same time to calculate the angle change difference value between the adjacent lower limb joints so as to determine the motion association degree between the lower limb joints;  respectively carrying out product operation to all motion relevance degrees and the pre-set angle proportion coefficient to obtain corresponding joint cooperative angle threshold;  taking the motion acceleration with the most occurrence times under the same motion relevance as the reference acceleration,  respectively performing product operation on all the reference accelerations and the preset time coefficient to obtain the time interval parameter of the corresponding motion trigger time,  and combining the corresponding joint cooperation angle threshold to form a signal characteristic group;  according to the motion transmission sequence of each lower limb joint,  arraying all signal characteristic groups to form a biological enlightening signal,  wherein the pulse amplitude of the biological enlightening signal is the corresponding joint cooperative angle threshold,  the pulse interval is the corresponding motion triggering time;  driving each lower limb joint of the humanoid robot to perform cooperative motion according to the joint cooperative angle threshold value and motion trigger time of the biological enlightening signal,  so as to realize multi-mode motion seamless switching,  comprising :  according to the motion transmission sequence of each lower limb joint,  taking the motion triggering time of the biological enlightening signal as the reference,  distributing the corresponding motion execution time period for each lower limb joint,  the motion execution time period is the preset motion window before and after the motion triggering time;  calculating the rotation angle amplitude based on the joint cooperation angle threshold of each lower limb joint and the corresponding transmission ratio parameter;  determining the rotation direction of each lower limb joint according to the motion relevance between the lower limb joints,  wherein the rotation direction is in cooperative relationship with the motion direction of the adjacent joint;  combining the rotation angle amplitude and rotation direction corresponding to each lower limb joint as a target rotation angle instruction;  in the action execution time period,  according to the target rotating angle instruction to drive the corresponding lower limb joint to move,  so as to collect the third rotating angle of each lower limb joint;  calculating the angle deviation value of the third rotating angle and the target rotating angle instruction,  comparing the angle deviation value with the preset deviation threshold value,  so as to drive all lower limb joints to cooperatively move according to the comparison result,  until finishing the switching of different moving states,  so as to realize multi-mode motion seamless switching.

The invention relates to the technical field of industrial robots,  and proposes an adaptive clamping claw grabbing device for a humanoid robot based on visual feedback. The invention provides a humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization method and a humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization system based on a task potential field,  and relates to the field of robot control. The humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization method and the humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization system based on the task potential field comprise the following steps of :  acquiring an end effector instruction input by a user,  wherein the end effector instruction comprises a reference Cartesian pose of a robot arm end effector in a world coordinate system; construct multiple optimization tasks based on the potential field change rate according to the current state of the robot and the end effector instructions; layering the constructed multiple optimization tasks according to the preset priority,  and constructing a quadratic programming problem together with the joint position and speed constraints of the robot; solve the quadratic programming problem and output the optimal joint position change; based on the joint position variation and the current joint position,  the joint position command of the next control cycle is generated and sent to the robot joint to realize position control; the invention expands the operating range of the humanoid robot and realizes the optimal kinematics planning of the maximum operating range of the robot in a stationary state. 1. A humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization method based on task potential field,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the terminal actuator instruction input by the user,  the terminal actuator instruction comprises the reference Cartesian pose of the robot arm terminal actuator in the world coordinate system;  according to the current state of the robot and the end actuator instruction,  based on the potential field change rate,  constructing a plurality of optimization tasks,  the optimization task comprises a centroid tracking task,  a singular point evasion task,  a machine body and a limb tracking task;  layering the constructed multiple optimization tasks according to the preset priority,  and constructing a secondary planning problem together with the joint position and speed restriction of the robot;  solving the secondary planning problem and outputting the optimal joint position variation;  based on the joint position variation and the current joint position,  generating the joint position instruction of the next control period,  and sending to the robot joint to realize position control.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot voice interaction method and a quadruped robot voice interaction system based on double large model collaboration,  and belongs to the technical field of voice signal processing and man-machine interaction Convert the user's voice input into natural language text,  which is input into the general large model and the domain-specific large model in parallel to generate candidate response text and confidence; the dynamic semantic decision-making engine is used to make fusion decision-making :  if the difference between the two confidence levels is greater than or equal to the preset threshold,  the candidate response text with higher confidence level is selected as the final response text; if the difference between the two confidence levels is less than the preset threshold,  trigger semantic consistency evaluation,  if it reaches the standard,  generate the final response through intention fusion,  otherwise clarify the interaction; the final response text is output through emotional speech synthesis,  and synchronously analyzed into structured instructions,  which control the quadruped robot to execute actions after passing the execution-level safety gate control verification. The invention improves the semantic recognition accuracy and domain adaptability of the quadruped robot in domain-specific tasks. 1. A four-foot robot voice interaction method based on dual-large model collaboration,  wherein it comprises :  converting the user voice input into natural language text;  inputting the natural language text in parallel to the general large model and the field special large model,  respectively generating a first candidate response text and confidence thereof,  a second candidate response text and confidence thereof;  the field special large model is obtained by performing supervised fine tuning training on the universal large model,  the supervised fine tuning training data comprises the following types of samples :  an instruction-action pair sample for mapping the natural language instruction in the multi-target field to the structured command;  a negative sample and a ambiguous sample;  a compliance sample containing a denial of power or a dangerous instruction;  performing fusion decision on the two candidate response texts through the dynamic semantic decision engine :  if the difference value of the two confidence levels is greater than or equal to the preset threshold value,  selecting the candidate response text with higher confidence level as the final response text;  if the difference value of two confidence levels is less than the preset threshold value,  calculating the semantic consistency score,  when the score is greater than or equal to the consistency threshold value,  using the intention fusion mechanism to generate the final response text; This application discloses a harmonic reducer performance calibration and verification method and device for humanoid robots,  which relates to the field of robot technology. By comparing the real-time performance parameters with the benchmark parameters,  the efficiency attenuation rate curve and gap growth are obtained,  and then the performance health index is comprehensively evaluated to form the final verification result. This method realizes multi-dimensional and periodic quantitative monitoring of the performance degradation of harmonic reducers,  effectively solves the problems of performance attenuation and gap increase caused by long-term operation,  thereby improving the motion accuracy and life prediction accuracy of humanoid robots. 1. A method for calibrating and verifying performance of harmonic speed reducer for humanoid robot,  wherein the method for calibrating and verifying performance of harmonic speed reducer for humanoid robot comprises :  when the humanoid robot is in the calibration posture,  obtaining the multi-source signal under the running state of the harmonic speed reducer,  and determining the initial efficiency-torque curve and the initial reverse transmission gap based on the multi-source signal,  obtaining the reference performance parameter according to the initial efficiency-torque curve and the initial reverse transmission gap;  based on the preset check period,  reproducing the calibration attitude to obtain a real-time multi-source signal,  determining a real-time efficiency-torque curve and a real-time reverse transmission gap based on the real-time multi-source signal,  obtaining a real-time performance parameter according to the real-time efficiency-torque curve and the real-time reverse transmission gap;  comparing the reference performance parameter with the real-time performance parameter to obtain an efficiency attenuation rate curve and a gap increasing amount;  obtaining the performance health degree index according to the efficiency attenuation rate curve and the gap increasing amount,  and obtaining the performance checking result based on the performance health degree index.

The present invention relates to the technical field of motor drive control,  and in particular to a method and system for constructing a dynamic control model of motor drive. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring operation data of the electrolytic capacitor-free motor driving system under different control parameters to form a full-power section operation data set; perform multi-scale analysis and high-dimensional compressed feature decoupling on the full-power segment operating data set to obtain multi-scale dynamic feature vectors; construct a nonlinear regression model that can be used for real-time control quantity prediction based on multi-scale dynamic feature vectors; deploying a nonlinear regression model in the controller of an electrolytic capacitor-free motor drive system; the predicted control quantity output by the nonlinear regression model is used to perform motor drive control,  thereby forming an electrolytic capacitor-free motor drive strategy. According to the invention,  through high-dimensional dynamic coupling compression representation learning,  an electrolytic capacitor-free motor driving strategy with intelligent voltage stabilization regulation is constructed so as to support the humanoid robot to operate efficiently and steadily 1. A construction method of dynamic control model driven by motor,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  collecting the operation data of the non-electrolytic capacitor motor driving system under different control parameters,  obtaining the state observation quantity including bus voltage,  stator current,  rotating speed and torque and the corresponding control quantity,  forming the full power section operation data set;  step S2 :  constructing bus voltage stability constraint,  then performing multi-scale analysis and high-dimensional compression characteristic decoupling to the full power section operation data set,  so as to obtain multi-scale dynamic characteristic vector;  step S3 :  constructing a nonlinear regression training data set according to the multi-scale dynamic feature vector,  and constructing a nonlinear regression model capable of being used for real-time control quantity prediction under the bus voltage stability constraint;  step S4 :  deploying a non-linear regression model in the controller of the non-electrolytic capacitor motor driving system;  the state observation quantity is obtained in real time as the nonlinear regression model input,  and the prediction control quantity output by the nonlinear regression model is used for executing the motor drive control so as to form the non-electrolytic capacitor motor drive strategy.

This application relates to the field of robotics technology A method for actively avoiding behavior conflicts of quadruped robots in a man-machine shared environment is disclosed,  which includes the following steps :  first constructing an anisotropic action flow field potential function that represents the directionality of human movement intentions by defining an anisotropic permeability tensor whose longitudinal permeability is greater than transverse permeability. Subsequently,  the flow field physical quantities are derived from this potential function,  including the action flow pressure field,  action flow velocity field and shear stress tensor. The invention adopts a dual avoidance strategy :  on the one hand,  topology reconstruction is performed on the support domain of the quadruped robot based on the action flow pressure field; on the other hand,  non-planar trajectory planning is performed on the swing leg based on the action flow velocity field and shear stress tensor In addition,  the present invention also constructs an anisotropic damping matrix based on the pressure gradient of the flow field to achieve compliant force relief when touching the ground. Improved forward-looking,  flexibility,  and safety of evasive actions. 1. A method for actively evading action conflict of four-legged robot under human-computer shared environment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing an anisotropic action flow field potential function for describing human motion intention and space occupation,  establishing a conflict potential model of human-computer interaction space;  S2,  deriving a flow field physical quantity for quantifying the conflict risk from the anisotropy action flow field potential function,  wherein the flow field physical quantity at least comprises an action flow pressure field,  an action flow speed field and a shear stress tensor;  S3,  based on the action flow pressure field,  performing topology reconstruction on the supporting domain of the four-foot robot,  avoiding the static space occupation of the high flow field pressure area;  S4,  obtaining the standard swinging track of the four-foot robot,  based on the action flow speed field and the shear stress tensor,  performing non-planar track planning on the swinging leg of the four-foot robot,  for actively avoiding the dynamic phase conflict with the human limb.

This application provides an AI humanoid recognition method and system based on multi-eye vision fusion. By collecting multi-view image sequences containing the target human body,  and identifying the initial human body key points in the three-dimensional space corresponding to each single-view image; using the initial human body key points as space guidance,  non-rigidly aligning the preset parameterized human body model with the initial human body surface point cloud generated by the multi-view image sequence to obtain an initialized three-dimensional human body model; project the initialized three-dimensional human body model to the imaging plane of each viewing angle,  generate the projected outline map of the target human body at each viewing angle,  and determine the multi-view outline difference of the target human body based on the projected outline map at each viewing angle and the corresponding actual human body outline; taking the multi-view contour difference as the optimization target,  the parameterized human body model is driven for iterative optimization,  and then the effective three-dimensional model of the target human body is output. The technical solution provided by this application can accurately restore the true body outline of the target human body under multi-eye stereoscopic vision. 1. An AI human shape identification method based on multi-objective vision fusion,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  collecting a multi-view image sequence including a target human body,  and determining a human body area mask corresponding to each single-view image in the multi-view image sequence;  identifying the human body gesture key point corresponding to each single visual angle image based on all human body area masks,  and converting the human body gesture key point into the initial human body key point in the three-dimensional space;  performing three-dimensional matching on each single-view image in the multi-view image sequence,  generating an initial human body surface point cloud,  taking the initial human body key point as space guide,  performing non-rigid alignment on the preset parameterized human body model and the initial human body surface point cloud,  so as to obtain the initialized three-dimensional human body model;  projecting the initialized three-dimensional human body model to the imaging plane of each visual angle,  generating the projection outline of the target human body under each visual angle,  comparing and analyzing the projection outline under each visual angle with the actual human body outline extracted from the corresponding single visual angle image,  so as to obtain the multi-visual angle outline difference of the target human body;  driving the attitude parameter and the shape parameter of the parameterized human body model to perform iteration optimization until the iteration optimization convergence,  and outputting the effective three-dimensional model of the target human body.

The present invention is intended to ensure the operational safety of drones and urban air mobility (UAM),  and the most important goal is to block hacking (GPS spoofing,  jamming) in the sky at the source,  and to realize a precise spatio-temporal map covering the ground,  underground,  and skyscrapers. The invention provides a robot foot contact and sliding detection method and device based on fuzzy logic,  which includes :  using a proprioceptive inertial measurement unit installed on the foot of a humanoid robot to collect the foot three-axis acceleration and foot of the humanoid robot. Triaxial angular velocity; performing Kalman filtering on foot triaxial acceleration and foot triaxial angular velocity of the humanoid robot to obtain foot linear acceleration,  foot linear velocity and foot angular velocity of the humanoid robot in a world coordinate system; hierarchical fuzzy logic is used to detect the foot state of the humanoid robot. The first layer uses a generalized Type 2 fuzzy C-means algorithm to calculate the contact probability between the foot and the outside world based on the three-axis acceleration and three-axis angular velocity of the foot,  and detects the contact event that ensures the foot to stand The second layer uses an interval type 2 fuzzy reasoning system to detect foot lateral sliding events based on the foot contact probability with the outside world,  foot linear velocity and foot linear acceleration. 1. A robot foot contact and sliding detection method based on fuzzy logic,  wherein it comprises :  the main body feeling inertia measuring unit IMU mounted on the foot of the humanoid robot is used for collecting the foot three-axis acceleration and foot three-axis angular velocity of the humanoid robot;  performing Kalman filtering on the foot three-axis acceleration and foot three-axis angular velocity of the humanoid robot to obtain the foot linear acceleration,  foot linear velocity and foot angular velocity of the humanoid robot under the world coordinate system;  using layered fuzzy logic to detect the foot state of the humanoid robot,  the first layer uses generalized 2 type fuzzy C mean algorithm GT2FCM,  according to the foot three-axis acceleration and foot three-axis angular speed calculating foot with external contact probability,  detecting to ensure foot standing contact event;  the second layer adopts interval 2 type fuzzy reasoning system IT2FIS,  according to the foot with external contact probability,  foot linear speed and foot linear acceleration,  detecting foot transverse sliding event.

The invention discloses a stacking type humanoid robot waist structure integrating stretching,  swinging and rotating In the bottom of the trunk,  a driving connecting rod and a circular arc spring are installed on the slewing support bearing; in the trunk main body,  the bottom mounting plate is connected to the slewing support bearing,  and between the bottom mounting plate and the top mounting plate,  the driving motor drives the sliding end of the scissor mechanism through the slider guide rail mechanism; in the top of the trunk,  the harmonic reducer is mounted on the top mounting plate and is drivingly connected to the top trunk; the measuring unit includes absolute value encoder,  pull wire height displacement sensor and tilt angle sensor,  which are used to monitor the rotation angle,  telescopic displacement and swing amplitude of the waist structure in real time respectively; the absolute encoder is connected to the drive link The invention optimizes the motion performance and load capacity through the integration of moving,  swinging and rotating structures,  and at the same time greatly improves the palletizing efficiency and reliability by combining sensors. 1. A stacking type humanoid robot waist structure integrated with telescopic swinging and rotation,  wherein it comprises :  a trunk bottom (1),  comprising a rotary supporting bearing (7),  a driving connecting rod (6) and an arc spring (33),  the rotary supporting bearing (7) is used for realizing rotary movement,  the arc spring (33) is used for driving the rotary supporting bearing (7) to return and stably swing,  the driving connecting rod (6) is connected with the rotating part of the rotary supporting bearing (7);  a trunk main body (2),  comprising a bottom mounting plate (15),  a scissors mechanism,  a sliding block guide rail mechanism,  a driving motor (11) and a top mounting plate (24),  the bottom mounting plate (15) is connected with the rotating part of the rotary supporting bearing (7),  the driving motor (11) drives the sliding end of the scissors mechanism through the sliding block guide rail mechanism,  so as to realize telescopic movement;  a trunk top (3),  comprising a harmonic speed reducer (27) and a top trunk (29),  the harmonic speed reducer (27) is installed on the top mounting plate (24),  the harmonic speed reducer (27) is in transmission connection with the top trunk (29),  for realizing swinging movement;  a measuring unit,  comprising an absolute value encoder (12),  a pull wire height displacement sensor (14) and an inclination angle sensor (30),  which are respectively installed at the bottom of the trunk (1),  the trunk main body (2) and the trunk top (3),  respectively used for monitoring the rotation angle of the waist structure in real time,  telescopic displacement and swing amplitude;  the absolute value encoder (12) is connected with the driving connecting rod (6).

The invention belongs to the technical field of robots,  and provides a whole-body coordination control method of a mobile humanoid robot based on multi-target optimization. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring pose information of an operation target,  and planning an expected motion trajectory of the tail ends of two arms according to the target pose; establishing the whole body kinematics model and motion controller of mobile humanoid robot; the objective function terms include :  quadratic terms,  which introduce a hierarchical weight distribution strategy to coordinate the motion priorities of the chassis,  trunk and arms; the linear term introduces the operation degree of both arms and the operation degree of the chassis to improve the coordination of both arms; the constraint terms include :  equality constraints and inequality constraints; input the motion controller into the solver to solve,  and generate the optimal joint speed command,  which is used for whole-body coordination control. The invention coordinates the movement of the chassis,  trunk and arms through a unified optimization frame,  realizes coordinated planning of actions,  and improves the coordination and smoothness of the whole body movement of the mobile humanoid robot. 1. A system coordination control method of mobile humanoid robot based on multi-objective optimization,  wherein comprising the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the job target pose information,  according to the target pose,  planning the expected motion track at the tail end of the two arms;  S2,  establishing a whole body kinematics model of the mobile humanoid robot;  S3,  on the basis of the systemic kinematics model,  taking the secondary planning as the frame,  designing the systemic kinematics controller containing the target function item and the constraint condition item;  the target function item comprises :  a secondary item,  introducing a hierarchical weight distribution strategy,  coordinating the movement priorities of the chassis,  the trunk and the double arms;  linear item,  introducing double-arm operation degree and chassis operation degree,  improving double-arm coordination;  The constraint condition item comprises :  Equation constraint condition :  introducing the position of the tail end to ensure that the tail ends of the two arms move according to the expected track;  The inequality constraint condition :  the joint position dodging limit is introduced to prevent from exceeding the limit;  S4,  inputting the whole body motion controller of S3 to the solver to solve,  generating an optimal joint speed instruction for the whole body coordination control.

The invention provides a low-power-consumption intelligent anti-theft system,  a control method,  a storage medium and electronic equipment,  which are applied to the technical field of automotive electronics The invention monitors the voltage and acceleration information of the vehicle battery in real time through the single-chip microcomputer,  and accurately determines whether the vehicle is switched to a flameout static state. After the flameout is determined,  the microcontroller controls the main control system chip to promptly report the vehicle status and location to the remote management platform through the communication module. The microcontroller turns off the enable signal of the second power supply unit and cuts off the power supply to the high-power positioning module,  communication module and storage unit. The main control system chip enters a low-power sleep state and starts the AOV mode at the same time,  driving the image acquisition unit to capture images at a low frame rate,  realizing black light imaging and humanoid recognition,  and ensuring the continuous operation of key monitoring functions. Through hierarchical power supply and intelligent control,  the invention effectively takes into account energy management and efficient video monitoring in the vehicle flameout state,  and realizes long-term,  stable and accurate anti-theft monitoring. 1. A low power consumption intelligent anti-theft system,  wherein it comprises :  a main control system chip (U1),  a single chip (U2),  an IO comparator (U3),  an acceleration sensor (U4),  a locating module (U5),  a communication module (U6),  a storage unit (U7),  an image collecting unit (U8),  a first power supply unit (U10) and a second power supply unit (U11);  the first power supply unit (U10) is used for accessing the vehicle power supply to supply power to the single chip (U2);  the second power supply unit (U11) is the locating module (U5),  the communication module (U6),  the storage unit (U7) and the main control system chip (U1) provides working voltage,  the enabling signal is controlled by the single chip (U2);  the single chip (U2) is in communication connection with the main control system chip (U1),  the acceleration sensor (U4),  the locating module (U5),  the communication module (U6) and the IO comparator (U3) for executing low power consumption control and mode switching;  the main control system chip (U1) is in communication connection with the image collecting unit (U8),  the storage unit (U7) and the communication module (U6) for executing video coding,  human shape identification,  AOV mode control and black light imaging processing.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot SLAM method based on D435i and RTAB-MAP algorithms,  which relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The method includes receiving RGB images,  depth images and IMU data output by the D435i depth camera on the head of the humanoid robot,  and at the same time receiving the joint angle acquisition device. Joint angle data output; performing a time stamp synchronization alignment operation on the multi-source data; extracting visual features from the processed RGB image,  completing odometer optimization by combining IMU pre-integration results,  and outputting initial poses and pre-integration residuals of adjacent frames; judging vibration state based on IMU data,  screening key frame and constructing or updating pose relation graph; execute pose optimization by combining joint angle data and pose relationship map,  and output key frame pose; finally,  based on the optimized key frame pose and depth image,  a three-dimensional environment map with semantic labels is generated. The invention is adapted to the motion characteristics of humanoid robots,  effectively alleviates vibration interference,  improves the reliability and accuracy of pose estimation and map construction,  and provides strong support for autonomous navigation of robots. 1. A human-shaped robot SLAM method based on D435i and RTAB-MAP algorithm,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  receiving the RGB image data,  depth image data and IMU data output by the human-shaped robot head D435i depth camera,  receiving the joint angle data output by the human-shaped robot joint angle collecting device;  step 2,  performing time stamp synchronous alignment operation on RGB image data,  depth image data,  IMU data and joint angle data;  step 3,  extracting the visual characteristic data from the RGB image data processed in the step 2,  calculating the pre-integration result data based on the IMU data processed in the step 2,  combining the visual characteristic data and the pre-integration result data to perform the odometer optimization operation,  outputting the adjacent frame initial position data and pre-integral residual data;  step 4,  executing the vibration state judging operation based on the IMU data processed in the step 2,  combining the initial pose data to execute the key frame screening and pose relation graph construction or updating operation;  step 5,  based on the joint angle data processed in the step 2 and the pose relation image data processed in the step 4,  executing the pose optimization operation,  outputting the key frame pose data;  step 6,  based on the key frame pose data processed in the step 5 and the depth image data processed in the step 2,  executing the three-dimensional environment map generating operation with semantic label,  and outputting the three-dimensional environment map data.

This application discloses an outdoor wide-area RTK positioning method suitable for quadruped robots In view of a series of problems caused by the insufficient adaptability of existing GNSS RTK positioning solutions to quadruped robots,  this application receives satellite original data through the main antenna and slave antenna of the GNSS receiver installed on the quadruped robot,  accesses the network differential data server through the built-in 4G mobile network receiver of the GNSS receiver with the NTRIP network protocol,  and attempts to obtain RTCM3.2 differential data; in the GNSS receiver,  if the RTCM3.2 differential data is successfully received,  RTK solution is performed by combining the original satellite data and the RTCM3.2 differential data to generate RTK positioning data; output the generated positioning data to the quadruped robot main controller through the communication interface of the GNSS receiver. 1. An outdoor wide area RTK locating method suitable for four-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  receiving satellite original data by a primary antenna and a secondary antenna of a GNSS receiver mounted on a four-legged robot,  respectively,  wherein the primary antenna is used for positioning and the secondary antenna is used for orientation;  through the built-in 4G mobile network receiver of the GNSS receiver,  accessing the network differential data server by the NTRIP network protocol,  and attempting to obtain the RTCM3.2 differential data;  in the GNSS receiver,  judging whether the RTCM3.2 differential data is successfully received;  if successfully receiving the RTCM3.2 differential data,  combining the satellite original data and the RTCM3.2 differential data to perform RTK calculation to generate RTK positioning data;  if the RTCM3.2 differential data is not successfully received,  performing single-point positioning calculation based on the satellite original data to generate single-point positioning data;  outputting the generated positioning data to the four-foot robot main controller through the communication interface of the GNSS receiver.

The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent surveying and mapping and robots,  and discloses a global collaborative intelligent surveying and mapping system and method. The system includes :  an intelligent surveying and mapping vehicle,  an intelligent surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle and an intelligent surveying and mapping wheel-legged robot; the intelligent surveying and mapping vehicle serves as a mobile bearing platform and an energy supply base; the intelligent surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle can autonomously take off and land from the intelligent surveying and mapping vehicle and perform tasks; the intelligent surveying and mapping wheel-legged robot adopts a moving mechanism with tandem legs and is capable of autonomously separating and returning from the wheel-legged robot cabin and performing tasks. The invention realizes seamless connection and all-round automated surveying and mapping from the air to the ground,  from macro to micro,  and from outdoor to indoor through the organic collaboration of intelligent surveying and mapping vehicles,  intelligent surveying and mapping drones and intelligent surveying and mapping wheel-legged robots. 1. An intelligent mapping system of global collaboration,  wherein the system comprises :  an intelligent mapping vehicle,  an intelligent mapping unmanned aerial vehicle and an intelligent mapping wheel leg robot;  the intelligent surveying and mapping vehicle is used as a mobile bearing platform and an energy supply base;  the intelligent surveying unmanned aerial vehicle can take off and land from the intelligent surveying vehicle and execute the task;  The intelligent surveying wheel leg robot adopts the moving mechanism of the series leg,  which can automatically separate and return from the wheel leg robot cabin,  and execute the task.

The invention discloses a dual-drive self-switching strong adaptive quadruped robot motion control method Use sensing signals such as fuselage status feedback,  IMU and plantar force to estimate the current terrain characteristics Predict the probability of falling based on terrain characteristics,  enable the quadruped robot to intelligently switch between the two drive modes of "MPC individual control" and "MPC ‑ DRL collaborative control" By introducing dynamic behavioral parameters to influence the gait and step height of the robot's movement,  the optimization efficiency and smoothness of MPC and the disturbance adaptability of DRL are efficiently integrated,  which enhances the high robustness,  high efficiency and adaptive movement ability of quadruped robot in various terrains without relying on external sensing information 1. A double-drive self-switching strong adaptive four-foot robot motion control method,  wherein it comprises :  step 1,  obtaining joint motor,  IMU,  foot bottom force data of the four-foot robot;  step 2,  pre-integrating the IMU data to obtain the centroid posture of the robot at the current time;  inputting the joint data and IMU data into the state estimator to obtain the mass centre position and mass centre line speed of the robot under the world coordinate system and the three-axis rotation angular speed of the robot under the machine body coordinate system;  step 3,  the robot mass centre posture mass centre position,  mass centre line speed,  rotating angle speed and foot bottom force form a one-dimensional vector,  defined as the state in the Markov decision process;  step 4,  inputting the state of the current time into the terrain characteristic extracting module,  obtaining the characteristic vector of the four-foot robot stable margin;  step 5,  inputting the current characteristic vector into the behaviour parameter adjusting strategy module,  obtaining the behaviour parameter adjusting amount,  comprising the expected foot end contact and the increment of the step height of the four-foot robot;  step 6,  inputting the current characteristic vector into the overturning risk evaluation module,  obtaining the current robot tumble probability;  step 7,  inputting the falling probability into a switch function,  using the switch function to control the switching between the MPC independent control and MPC-DRL cooperative control;  step 8,  the user speed instruction and behaviour parameter adjusting quantity input model prediction controller,  according to user speed instruction,  based on spring load inverted pendulum model generate reference mass centre position,  reference mass centre speed,  reference mass centre attitude angle and reference mass centre angle speed,  to form mass centre reference track;  step 9,  according to the reference mass centre speed calculating with the preset step to obtain the step frequency,  establishing a gait period table according to the gait period,  obtaining the reference leg state at the current moment by means of looking up the table,  and obtaining the final foot end contact state by performing the OR operation between the co-position elements with the behaviour parameters;  step 10,  according to the contact state of the mass centre reference track and the final foot end,  using MPC solver to calculate the expected foot bottom force of the supporting leg;  step 11,  according to the expected foot bottom force of the supporting leg calculated by the MPC solver,  converting the foot bottom force of each supporting leg into the joint moment of each joint of the supporting leg through the Jacobi matrix;  step 12,  according to the final foot end contact state increment with step height constructing the foot end track of the swinging leg,  obtaining the foot end of the swinging item under the world coordinate system Shaft and a position component in the axial direction;  step 13,  according to the foot end of the swinging item in the world coordinate system Shaft and the position component in the axial direction obtains the joint position and the joint angular speed of the thigh joint and the shank joint of the swinging item through the inverse kinematics calculation;  Step 14,  the four-foot robot moves along with the user speed instruction under the driving of the supporting item joint moment and the swinging item joint position.

The invention discloses an intelligent pilotage system and method based on a humanoid robot and a posture mapping technology The system includes shore-side control center,  5G communication subsystem and ship-side execution system. The shore end captures the whole body attitude information of the pilot through the multi-view attitude capture subsystem,  and converts the whole body attitude information into robot control instructions by the attitude mapping and control subsystem using a hierarchical mapping strategy; robot control instructions are transmitted to the ship end with low latency through the 5G network,  and the humanoid robot performs pilotage operations; the robot's first-view video is transmitted back to the shore-side VR display subsystem,  forming a hand-eye coordinated closed-loop control. It can be seen that by using the solution provided by the embodiment of the present invention,  the safety risk of pilots boarding and leaving the wheel is completely eliminated,  all-weather and uninterrupted piloting operations are realized,  and the hierarchical mapping strategy is used to maintain a natural operating experience,  which significantly improves the safety,  continuity and efficiency of port piloting. 1. An intelligent navigation system based on humanoid robot and attitude mapping technology,  wherein it comprises :  a shore end control centre,  a 5G communication subsystem and a ship end execution system;  the shore end control centre comprises a multi-view posture capturing sub-system,  a VR display sub-system and a posture mapping and control sub-system,  the boat end execution system comprises a human-shaped robot,  a sensing system and a control and calculation system integrated in the human-shaped robot;  a multi-view attitude capturing sub-system for synchronously capturing the whole body attitude information of the navigator from different view angles;  a posture mapping and control sub-system for converting the whole body posture information into a robot control instruction by a layered mapping strategy,  wherein the layered mapping strategy at least comprises an accurate mapping to the head,  an inverse kinematics mapping to the upper limb and an identification and discrete instruction mapping to the walking intention of the lower limb;  the 5G communication subsystem is used for establishing a low-delay bidirectional data transmission link between the shore end control centre and the ship end execution system,  and transmitting the robot control instruction uplink to the ship end execution system;  the control and calculation system is used for receiving and analyzing the robot control instruction,  and driving each joint of the humanoid robot to execute corresponding action;  the humanoid robot is used for executing the navigation operation under the driving of the control and calculation system;  the sensing system is used for collecting the first visual angle video of the humanoid robot;  the 5G communication sub-system is used for transmitting the first visual angle video to the shore end control centre;  the VR display sub-system is used for displaying the first visual angle video in real time.

The invention discloses an intelligent man-machine safety active early warning system of a loader,  and relates to the technical field of loaders. The intelligent man-machine safety active early warning system of the loader comprises an alarm display integrated host installed in a cab of the loader An outdoor controller mounted outside the cab of the loader; aI humanoid cameras installed under the car body and bucket,  and multiple AI humanoid cameras are installed; the present invention is configured by an alarm display integrated host,  an outdoor controller,  and an AI humanoid camera Can realize accurate analysis and calculation of human shape,  limb parts,  wearing characteristics and quantities It also has the advantages of high-intensity identification,  sensitive response and timely alarm At the same time,  the warning area can be set according to any shape,  and the personnel induction sensitivity can be adjusted,  which can simultaneously remind the loader driver and the personnel entering the warning area,  which is suitable for a variety of operations,  meets the needs of different users,  and effectively reduces the risk of accidents when the loader is operating. The risk of accidents ensures the safety of personnel within the safety warning range 1. An intelligent man-machine safety active early warning system of loader,  wherein it comprises :  an alarm display integrated host installed in the cab of the loader;  an outdoor controller installed outside the cab of the loader;  an AI human-shaped camera mounted under the vehicle body and the digging bucket,  and there are multiple AI human-shaped cameras;  the AI human-shaped camera is connected with the outdoor controller through the network wire.

The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a photoelectric composite cable,  and relates to the technical field of cables The method sequentially comprises the following steps of :  selecting and pre-treating raw materials,  untwisting and stranding conductors,  insulating and extruding,  prefabricating optical fiber units,  synchronously untwisting and cabling,  applying a shielding layer,  extruding and forming a double-layer sheath and the like According to the invention,  an on-line optical state monitoring mechanism is introduced in a synchronous untwisting cabling process,  a monitoring-judging-adjusting closed-loop control system is constructed by acquiring optical fiber light attenuation change data in real time,  and key parameters such as optical fiber pay-off tension,  untwisting ratio,  twisting pitch and the like are subjected to automatic linkage adjustment In addition,  the cable core structure uses compression-resistant gaskets to achieve physical isolation of the units,  and cooperates with reverse double-layer stranding and zoned temperature-controlled extrusion processes. The method effectively solves the problems of signal loss fluctuation and structural instability of the humanoid robot cable under severe dynamic working conditions,  and significantly improves the bending resistance life,  torsion resistance and manufacturing consistency of the finished product. 1. A manufacturing method of photoelectric composite cable,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  selecting oxygen-free copper wire as conductor material,  and selecting insulating material,  sheath material and optical fibre (242) for pre-processing; The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint motor control method with model predictive control,  and relates to the technical field of robot motion control It is used to solve the problems of infeasible control instructions and model disturbance caused by voltage saturation during high-speed motion. Establish an error state space model of the joint motor system,  and strip nonlinear terms such as gravity as nominal feedforward quantities; subsequently,  the motor speed and driver bus voltage are collected in real time,  the back electromotive force is calculated,  and the voltage margin is mapped to the physical limit value of the dynamic torque at the current moment; meanwhile,  the expanded state observer is used to estimate the lumped disturbance values that are not modeled by the model. Finally,  the dynamic limit is taken as the real-time inequality constraint,  and the disturbance value correction prediction equation is introduced,  the quadratic programming problem is constructed and solved,  the optimal compensation torque is extracted,  and superimposed with the inverse dynamic feedforward torque,  which is converted into a current signal drive motor,  realizing robust control with high dynamics and high precision under the constraints of physical boundaries 1. A humanoid robot joint motor control method with model prediction control,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  establishing the error state space model of the joint motor system,  defining the joint position tracking error and its derivative as the state variable,  the gravity item in the joint dynamics,  the Coriolis force item and the centrifugal force item are used as the known nominal feed-forward quantity,  and the state transfer matrix and the input control matrix for describing the dynamic characteristic of the system are analyzed by the linearization process;  S2,  collecting the real-time rotating speed of the motor and the bus voltage of the driver,  calculating the back electromotive force at the current rotating speed according to the motor voltage equation,  calculating the difference value between the bus voltage and the back electromotive force and mapping it as the dynamic moment physical limit value at the current moment,  at the same time,  using the expanding state observer to estimate the aggregate disturbance value including the model non-modelling error;  S3,  introducing the aggregate disturbance value into the prediction equation constructed based on the state transfer matrix and the input control matrix,  predicting the system state track in the future time domain,  and using the dynamic moment physical limit value as the real-time inequality constraint condition for controlling the input amount,  constructing and solving the secondary planning problem,  extracting the first item of the optimal control sequence as the model prediction compensation moment;  S4,  superposing the model predictive compensation moment with the feedforward moment calculated based on the inverse dynamic model,  generating the final moment instruction and converting the final moment instruction into the current control signal to drive the joint motor.
