A variant multi-foot robot,  wherein It is composed of a main body frame (1) and the same front,  back pitching suspension assembly (2,  3);  the front and back pitching suspension assemblies (2,  3) are rotatably connected with the main body frame (1) at intervals along the y-axis direction;  the mechanical structure of the front and back pitching suspension assembly (2,  3),  the composition and assembling mode are completely the same;  the front and back pitching suspension assemblies (2,  3) are symmetrically arranged relative to the xoz surface;  the front pitching suspension assembly (2) comprises a suspension module (2-1),  an electric push rod element (2-2) and a linkage mechanism (2-3);  the hanging module (2-1) is composed of a main hanging frame (2-1-1),  first and second fork arm type connecting frames (2-1-2,  2-1-3) and first and second four-foot movement modules (2-1-4,  2-1-5);  the first and second fork arm type connecting frames (2-1-2,  2-1-3) are symmetrically connected between the main hanging frame (2-1-1) and the first and second four-foot moving modules (2-1-4,  2-1-5) through ball pairs;  the mechanical structures of the first and second fork arm type connecting frames (2-1-2,  2-1-3) have the same composition and assembling manner;  the mechanical structure,  composition and assembling mode of the first and second four-foot movement modules (2-1-4,  2-1-5) are the same;  the first and second four-foot movement modules (2-1-4,  2-1-5) are symmetrically arranged about the yoz surface;  the linkage mechanism (2-3) is fixedly connected with the main hanging frame (2-1-1) and the first and second four-foot movement modules (2-1-4,  2-5),  so that the pitching suspension module (2) relative to the main body frame (1) to do pitching movement,  at the same time,  can mechanically linkage adjust the foot end position of the first and second four-foot movement module (2-1-4,  2-1-5).

The invention discloses a robot foot and ankle device with passive energy storage and active assistance,  which belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The device includes a shank connection part,  a compliant lever part,  a foot part,  a parallel spring,  a series elastic actuator and a state locking mechanism. The top end of the compliant lever part is rotationally connected with the shank connecting part,  and the bottom end of the compliant lever part is hinged with the foot part through a joint shaft The parallel spring is connected between the compliant lever part and the foot part and is used for passive energy storage in the early stage of standing phase The series elastic actuator includes an adjustment mechanism and a joint torque assist mechanism,  which are used to adjust the hinge angle and actively output torque during the push-off period; the state locking mechanism is arranged on the foot part and is used for locking the hinge angle of the compliant lever part and the foot part The invention combines passive energy storage and active assistance to achieve efficient energy management and compliant motion control,  and improves the adaptability and stability of the robot in complex terrain. 1. A robot ankle device with passive energy storage and active power assisting,  wherein it comprises :  a shank connecting part (1);  a compliant lever part (2),  the top end of which is rotatably connected with the shank connecting part (1);  a foot part (3),  which is hinged with the bottom end of the compliant lever part (2) through the joint shaft (4);  a parallel spring (5) connected between the compliant lever part (2) and the foot part (3) for passive energy storage in early standing phase;  a series elastic actuator,  comprising an adjusting mechanism (6) and a joint torque assisting mechanism (7) connected between the compliant lever part (2) and the foot part (3),  for adjusting the hinge angle of the compliant lever part (2) and the foot part (3),  and actively outputting torque during the pushing period;  a state locking mechanism (8),  set on the foot part (3),  realizing the locking of the hinge angle of the lever part (2) and the foot part (3).

The invention discloses a positioning method,  a positioning system,  a positioning device and a positioning medium of a humanoid robot. The positioning method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a building structure map and first accurate positioning information in the current moving process of the humanoid robot,  and acquiring initial positioning information and an environment feature set of the humanoid robot; according to the building structure map,  building environment matching is performed on the environment feature set to obtain reference positioning information; performing first condition verification on the first precise positioning information and the initial positioning information according to the positioning correction condition to obtain a first condition verification result; if the first condition verification result is that the positioning correction condition is met,  positioning correction is performed on the initial positioning information according to the reference positioning information to obtain the second precise positioning information of the humanoid robot during the current movement. This method can effectively improve the positioning accuracy of humanoid robots in complex architectural environments. The present invention relates to humanoid robot technology 1. A locating method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the building structure map and the first precise locating information in the current moving process of the humanoid robot,  and obtaining the initial locating information and the environment characteristic set of the humanoid robot;  the first accurate positioning information is the second accurate positioning information of the humanoid robot in the previous moving process;  according to the building structure map,  performing building environment matching on the environment characteristic set,  obtaining reference locating information;  according to the location correction condition,  performing a first condition verification on the first precise location information and the initial location information to obtain a first condition verification result;  if the first condition verification result satisfies the location correction condition,  according to the reference location information,  performing location correction on the initial location information,  obtaining the second accurate location information of the humanoid robot in the current moving process.

The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots,  and discloses a gait adjustment method,  device,  equipment and storage medium for robots. The method includes :  obtaining target sampling points of the feet of a humanoid robot,  as well as coordinate values and terrain elevation data corresponding to each target sampling point.; calculate the foothold return value of the humanoid robot based on the coordinate value corresponding to each target sampling point and the terrain elevation data; obtain the maximum value of terrain elevation data of each target sampling point within the preset radius,  and calculate the kick step return value of the humanoid robot based on the coordinate value and the maximum value of terrain elevation data; the gait of the humanoid robot is adjusted based on the foothold return value and the step kicking return value. According to the invention,  the target sampling point coordinates and the terrain elevation data are acquired,  and two types of return values of a foothold and a kicking step are calculated,  so that the humanoid robot is guided to carry out accurate gait adjustment,  and the autonomous motion adaptability and stability of the robot in complex terrains such as stairs are improved 1. A gait adjusting method of robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining multiple target sampling points of the foot part of the humanoid robot,  and coordinate value and terrain elevation data corresponding to each target sampling point;  according to the coordinate value and the terrain elevation data corresponding to each target sampling point,  determining the foot point return value of the humanoid robot;  obtaining the maximum value of the terrain elevation data of each target sampling point in the preset radius,  determining the kicking step return value of the humanoid robot according to the coordinate value and the maximum value of the terrain elevation data;  and performing gait adjustment on the humanoid robot according to the feedback value of the landing point and the feedback value of the kicking step.

This application discloses a humanoid robot dynamic formation control method,  system,  equipment,  medium and product,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method includes :  obtaining the current state quantity of the humanoid robot; encoding the current state quantity with liquid neural network to determine the encoded state quantity; input the encoded state quantity into the reinforcement learning network,  determine the control action command at the current moment,  execute the control action command,  and generate the state quantity at the next moment and the corresponding reward; based on the priority experience recovery mechanism,  update the network parameters of the reinforcement learning network according to the current state quantity,  the action at the current moment,  the reward and the state quantity at the next moment,  and determine the trained reinforcement learning network; dynamic formation control is performed on humanoid robots based on the trained reinforcement learning network. This application can improve the formation stability in a dynamic environment and the response speed to sudden obstacles,  and improve the flexibility of formation transformation. 1. A dynamic formation control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the current state quantity of the humanoid robot;  the current state quantity comprises the state of the humanoid robot,  the state of the teammate,  the environment information and the formation parameter;  encoding the current state quantity by using the liquid neural network,  and determining the encoded state quantity;  inputting the coded state quantity to the strengthening learning network,  determining the control action instruction at the current time,  and executing the control action instruction,  generating the state quantity at the next time and the corresponding reward;  the reinforced learning network is a human-shaped robot dynamic formation control network model;  based on the prior experience recycling mechanism,  according to the current state quantity,  the current time action,  the reward and the next time state quantity,  updating the network parameter of the reinforced learning network,  determining the trained reinforced learning network;  performing dynamic formation control to the humanoid robot according to the trained reinforcement learning network.

The invention discloses a multi-legged robot radiation source autonomous positioning method based on AI dynamic path optimization,  which belongs to the technical field of nuclear radiation monitoring and intelligent robots. It includes collecting space radiation intensity data and eliminating pseudo sources,  calculating the radiation gradient field,  and constructing the radiation field in real time; an improved social network search algorithm is used to solve the objective function of the optimal path. The objective function dynamically integrates the path length and the radiation gradient integral,  in which the path weight coefficient α and the radiation weight coefficient β are adjusted in real time according to the environmental complexity through the Sigmoid function; the multi-legged robot performs gait adaptive control according to the optimal path,  and the movement speed is adjusted according to the real-time radiation intensity. The invention integrates dynamic path optimization,  multi-modal perception and pseudo source elimination,  which is conducive to solving the problems of path disconnection,  data distortion,  pseudo source interference and insufficient dynamic adaptability in the existing technology,  and provides autonomous and credible radiation sources for nuclear leakage emergency. Positioning solutions 1. A multi-foot robot radiation source autonomous positioning method based on AI dynamic path optimization,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  S1,  collecting the spatial radiation intensity data through the anti-interference sensor array,  and removing the pseudo source based on the environment three-dimensional geometric model,  calculating the radiation gradient field,  constructing the radiation field in real time,  the updating frequency is not less than 1 times per second;  the environment three-dimensional geometric model is obtained by reconstructing point cloud data obtained by laser radar LiDAR scanning environment;  S2,  using the improved social network search algorithm to solve the target function of the optimal path,  the target function dynamically fuses the path length and the radiation gradient integral,  wherein the path weight coefficient alpha and the radiation weight coefficient beta are adjusted in real time according to the environment complexity through the Sigmoid function;  S3,  the multi-foot robot performs the gait self-adaptive control according to the optimal path,  wherein the motion speed controller receives the real-time radiation intensity data as the input,  the output speed instruction value is reduced according to the negative index rule along with the increase of the radiation intensity,  and the high radiation area is automatically switched to the low-speed stable gait.

The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots In order to solve the problems of bipedal robots such as difficulty in training,  unnatural gait,  and poor adaptability,  a control method for step-by-step gait strategy fusion of biped robots is proposed :  S1. According to the motion state data of biped robots on various terrain categories,  various terrain categories are trained through imitation learning and reinforcement learning algorithms to obtain gait strategy models; s2. Carry out gait strategy switching with pairwise fusion between gait strategy models corresponding to various terrain categories; s3. Identify the terrain category of the current position in real time according to the information collection unit of the bipedal robot,  obtain the corresponding gait strategy model through the strategy execution control unit,  and control the bipedal robot to walk in the corresponding motion state; s4. When the terrain category of the bipedal robot changes,  the smooth transition between the two gait strategy models is realized through gait strategy switching,  and the control of the gait strategy fusion of the bipedal robot is completed. 1. A control method of biped robot stepping gait strategy fusion,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  according to the motion state data of the biped robot on various different terrain types,  respectively training various different terrain types by simulating learning and strengthening learning algorithm,  obtaining the gait strategy model adapted by various different terrain types,  and storing to the strategy execution control unit;  S2,  switching the gait policy models corresponding to different terrain types,  and storing the gait policy models in a policy execution control unit;  S3,  identifying the terrain type of the current position in real time according to the information collecting unit of the biped robot,  obtaining the gait strategy model corresponding to the terrain type of the current position through the strategy execution control unit,  and controlling the biped robot to walk by using the motion state corresponding to the gait strategy model;  S4,  when the terrain type collected by the biped robot in real time is changed,  finishing the smooth transition between two adjacent gait strategy models through the corresponding gait strategy switching;  S5,  returning to the step S3,  until the biped robot finishes walking,  finishing the control of the biped robot gait strategy fusion.

A legged bionic robot cluster collaborative round-up system based on the characteristics of the wolf pack's visual system The system simulates the wide-angle vision and multi-modal perception mechanism of wolves Constructing bionic vision sensor array,  and perform collaborative fusion of sensory data Combining reinforcement learning with Apollonis circle theory to design a round-up strategy Realize the efficient tracking and autonomous round-up of moving targets by legged robot clusters in complex dynamic environments,  while reducing dependence on a single sensor,  effectively improving the formation's collaborative response speed and obstacle avoidance capabilities,  and providing support for military reconnaissance,  disaster rescue and other scenarios. Provide technical support for multi-robot collaboration 1. A foot-type bionic robot cluster cooperative entrapment system based on wolf group visual system characteristic,  wherein it comprises :  a bionic visual sensing module,  comprising a sensor array installed at multiple parts of the foot-type robot and towards multiple directions;  The invention Claims a multi-mode sensing data cooperative fusion module,  which uses a fusion frame based on multi-scale characteristic pyramid network to fuse the data characteristic obtained by each sensor array in the sensing module to capture the irregular moving target and realize wide area environment sensing;  the cluster cooperative entrapment control module uses the multi-foot robot entrapment strategy based on Arboronis circle and reinforced learning algorithm,  for dividing the advantage area of the target,  and controlling the foot bionic robot cooperative entrapment target.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot bionic skin heating temperature control control method,  which belongs to the technical field of automatic control of robots. It includes obtaining real-time temperature distribution data on the surface of the bionic skin,  performing time domain differential processing to generate temperature change rate data,  and combining the obtained real-time pressure distribution data. Construct contact surface heat conduction characteristics; based on the steady-state components in the heat conduction characteristics of the contact surface,  a basic heat energy supply strategy is generated,  and dynamically weighted fusion is performed with the instantaneous heat flow disturbance compensation amount calculated based on the instantaneous dynamic components in the heat conduction characteristics of the contact surface to generate a regulatory heating instruction to drive the bionic The heating unit in the skin performs the heating action By integrating real-time pressure and temperature change rates to construct contact surface heat conduction characteristics,  and decomposing this characteristics into steady-state components and instantaneous dynamic components for feedforward compensation control,  it can predictably compensate for external thermal disturbances and achieve bionic skin temperature. Fast and stable control 1. A bionic skin heating temperature control method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the real-time temperature distribution data and real-time pressure distribution data of the bionic skin surface,  and performing time domain differential processing on the real-time temperature distribution data,  generating temperature change rate data;  integrating the real-time pressure distribution data and the temperature change rate data,  constructing a contact surface heat conduction characteristic representing the heat exchange dynamic characteristic of the skin and the external contact interface;  generating a base heat energy supply strategy for maintaining a base heat balance of the skin based on a steady-state component representing slow and sustained heat exchange in the contact surface heat transfer feature;  based on the instantaneous dynamic component representing fast and burst heat exchange in the contact surface heat conduction characteristic,  calculating the instantaneous heat flow disturbance compensation amount for fast counteracting the change of the burst heat;  dynamically weighting and fusing the basic heat energy supply strategy and the instantaneous heat flow disturbance compensation amount to generate a regulation and control heating instruction;  according to the control heating instruction,  driving the heating unit in the bionic skin to perform heating action.

The invention discloses a low-voltage wire defect detection method and system based on a quadruped robot Relates to the technical field of low-voltage conductor monitoring Get multiple training wire images,  preprocess each training wire image,  generate a wire feature set,  use the wire feature set to train the preset initial wire defect detection model Obtain the corresponding target wire defect detection model,  among them,  the target conductor defect detection model includes a conductor feature enhanced backbone network and a detection network The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an image of a low-voltage conductor to be tested through a quadruped robot; performing feature enhancement processing on the image of the low-voltage conductor to be tested through a conductor feature enhancement backbone network to obtain a plurality of conductor feature maps; and performing defect detection on each conductor feature map through a detection network to obtain a corresponding defect detection result It solves the technical problem that traditional low-voltage conductor defect detection mainly relies on manual inspection mode,  but there are inherent disadvantages such as low operating efficiency,  which reduces the reliability of distribution network operation. 1. A low-voltage lead defect detection method based on four-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a plurality of training lead images,  pre-processing each training lead image,  generating a lead characteristic set;  using the lead characteristic set to train the preset initial lead defect detection model to obtain the corresponding target lead defect detection model,  wherein the target lead defect detection model comprises a lead characteristic enhanced backbone network and a detection network;  obtaining the low-voltage lead image to be tested through the four-foot robot,  performing the feature enhancement processing to the low-voltage lead image to be tested through the lead feature enhancement backbone network,  obtaining multiple lead feature images;  performing defect detection to each lead characteristic graph through the detection network to obtain the corresponding defect detection result.

The invention provides an AI humanoid recognition and perception system and method based on binocular vision. When a doorbell button is triggered,  a binocular camera is used for real-time acquisition,  and an original image acquired in real time is preprocessed Coarse parallax estimation is performed on real-time image rectification to obtain a full-field coarse depth map,  a humanoid candidate area list is determined by combining the full-field coarse depth map with a heat source interest area,  and fine parallax estimation is performed on the humanoid candidate area list to obtain a fine depth patch Convert the corresponding fine depth patch into a three-dimensional point cloud set according to the pose information,  and perform scale a priori screening based on the corresponding three-dimensional point cloud set to obtain multiple human shape candidate retention areas; fusion recognition is performed according to the extracted multi-modal features to obtain the humanoid recognition result. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention,  layered parallax estimation and three-dimensional scale prior screening can be carried out on the real-time image so as to realize high-reliability humanoid recognition under the condition of low power consumption,  thereby improving the recognition reliability of a perception system 1. An AI human shape identification sensing method based on binocular vision,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the binocular camera is used for collecting in real time when the doorbell key is triggered to pre-process the collected original image in real time so as to obtain the real-time image rectification;  performing rough parallax estimation on the left and right images in the real-time image rectification,  obtaining a full-field rough depth map,  using the full-field rough depth map in combination with the heat source interest area in the triggering stage to determine a human-shaped candidate area list,  respectively performing fine parallax estimation to each human shape candidate area in the human shape candidate area list,  so as to obtain the fine depth patch corresponding to each human shape candidate area;  obtaining the pose information of the binocular camera,  converting the corresponding fine depth patch into the three-dimensional point cloud set of each human shape candidate area according to the pose information,  respectively performing scale prior screening on each human shape candidate area based on the corresponding three-dimensional point cloud set,  so as to obtain multiple human shape candidate reserved areas;  respectively performing multi-mode feature extraction to each human shape candidate reserved area,  further performing fusion identification according to the extracted multi-mode feature,  obtaining the human shape identification result.

The utility model discloses a humanoid shooting robot,  the overall appearance structure of which is designed by imitating ergonomics,  including legs,  waist,  trunk,  big arm,  forearm,  hand and head,  so as to fit the visual perception and viewing habit of the human body. The main frame of the robot is made of new high-strength carbon fiber composite materials,  which greatly reduces its own weight and significantly improves the robot's movement flexibility while effectively ensuring the structural strength. By adopting the bionic grasping technology and the bionic material,  the utility model realizes the stable grasping of the basketball,  the grasping stability under various complex conditions is greatly improved,  the shooting accuracy is obviously enhanced through the multi-joint cooperative control strategy,  and the shooting action performance of human basketball players is better simulated. At the same time,  the rich intelligent interactive functions make the robot not only competent for basketball training and performance tasks,  but also play an active role in the field of popular science education. 1. A humanoid shooting robot,  comprising a leg part,  a waist part,  a trunk,  a big arm,  a small arm,  a hand part and a head part;  the waist part is internally provided with a waist part forward servo motor,  the output shaft of the waist part forward servo motor is respectively connected with the waist leg connecting blocks at the two sides of the waist part,  the extending part of the waist leg connecting block is fixedly connected with the leg part;  the upper part of the waist part is provided with a trunk for supporting the upper limb,  and is provided with a trunk rotating servo motor for realizing the trunk rotation;  said big arm is connected with the trunk,  the big arm lifting servo motor for lifting and falling the big arm is set in the shoulder of the trunk;  the output shaft of the large arm lifting servo motor is fixedly connected with one end of the shoulder connecting block;  the other end of the shoulder connecting block is connected with the large arm;  the small arm is connected with the big arm through the small arm lifting servo motor;  the hand part is connected with the tail end of the small arm through a wrist servo motor,  the hand part comprises a palm and multiple fingers hinged with the palm,  the fingers are fixedly connected with the output shaft of the finger servo motor in the palm through a connecting rod;  the head is provided with a visual sensor,  a voice interaction module and a central processing module.

This application discloses a humanoid robot joint module performance testing method,  device and equipment,  which relates to the field of robot technology. It includes :  obtaining the identity of the joint module under test,  and loading the corresponding standard test procedures and digital twins from the cloud based on the identity. model; control the test platform to execute automated test sequences based on standard test procedures,  synchronously collect multi-modal performance data of the joint module under test through multiple sensors,  and record the corresponding timestamps; run the lightweight AI model in real time through the edge computing unit,  conduct preliminary analysis of multi-modal performance data,  and adjust the test strategy according to the preliminary analysis results; upload the multi-modal performance data with identity and timestamp to the cloud data lake,  and conduct in-depth analysis of the multi-modal performance data through the cloud AI analysis engine to generate a test report. This application realizes intelligent testing by building an "end-edge-cloud" collaborative intelligent testing system. 1. A method for testing performance of humanoid robot joint module,  wherein the method for testing performance of humanoid robot joint module comprises :  obtaining the identity mark of the tested joint module,  loading the corresponding standard test rule and digital twin model from the cloud end based on the identity mark;  controlling the test platform to execute an automatic test sequence based on the standard test procedure,  synchronously collecting the multi-modal performance data of the tested joint module through the multi-sensor,  and recording the corresponding time stamp,  specifically comprising :  synchronously measuring the current harmonic wave data of the tested joint module by a high-precision electric parameter analyzer;  measuring the positioning error data of the tested joint module by a high-resolution optical encoder;  collecting the vibration signal of the shell of the tested joint module through the high-frequency vibration accelerometer;  collecting the audio signal when the tested joint module is operated by an acoustic microphone or an ultrasonic sensor;  collecting the temperature field distribution data of the tested joint module in a non-contact manner by a thermal imaging camera;  performing a preliminary analysis on the multi-modal performance data by operating the lightweight AI model in real time through the edge computing unit,  and adjusting the test strategy according to the preliminary analysis result,  specifically comprising :  performing time alignment to the synchronously collected current harmonic data,  positioning error data,  vibration signal,  audio signal and temperature field distribution data;  using the lightweight AI model based on the attention mechanism to dynamically distribute the weight to the multi-modal performance data,  fusing to generate the real-time health state vector;  comparing and learning the real-time health state vector with the standard health state vector space of the digital twin model,  calculating the relative distance or likelihood probability of the real-time health state vector in the standard health state vector space;  if the relative distance exceeds the preset distance threshold value or the likelihood probability is lower than the preset probability threshold value,  judging that there is an abnormality,  and based on the deviation condition of each component in the real-time health state vector,  generating one or more primary hypothetical diagnostics;  inputting the preliminary hypothesis diagnosis and the current test procedure context to the test strategy generator based on the meta-learning framework pre-training;  based on the test strategy generator,  dynamically selecting and combining from the parameterized atomic test instruction base to obtain the verification test sequence;  inserting the verifiable test sequence into the current test procedure and executing it,  and verifying whether the preliminary hypothetical diagnosis is satisfied;  if the preliminary hypothetical diagnosis is true,  generating a high priority alarm,  triggering a convergence test strategy,  and constructing a triad uploading to the cloud based on the preliminary hypothetical diagnosis,  the executed verification test sequence and the verification result,  so as to optimize and update the test strategy generator;  if the initial hypothesis diagnosis is not tenable,  returning to the standard test rule to continue executing;  uploading the multi-mode performance data with identity mark and time stamp to the cloud data lake,  deeply analyzing the multi-mode performance data through the AI analysis engine of the cloud to generate a test report.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot modules,  and discloses a compact dual-encoder integrated joint module,  which includes a shell,  a motor assembly,  a harmonic reducer,  a dual-encoder assembly and a braking assembly arranged along the same axis.,  the motor rotor of the motor assembly is fixedly connected to the motor shaft and rotates synchronously; the wave generator of the harmonic reducer is coaxially sleeved on the end of the motor shaft and realizes torque transmission through detachable fasteners; the input side detection element of the double encoder assembly rotates synchronously with the motor shaft,  and the output side detection element rotates synchronously with the output end of the harmonic reducer Through the "axial stacking + spatial multiplexing" design,  this invention integrates core functions into the same axial section,  greatly shortening the axial length of the module,  while reducing weight,  avoiding interference with cables,  sensors and other components,  and adapting Compact installation scenarios such as humanoid robot trunk joints and collaborative robotic arm ends greatly improve equipment layout flexibility. 1. A compact double-encoder integrated joint module,  comprising a shell body,  a motor assembly,  a harmonic speed reducer,  a double-encoder assembly and a brake assembly arranged along the same axis,  wherein the motor rotor (52) of the motor assembly is fixedly connected with the motor shaft (14) and rotates synchronously;  the wave generator (17) of the harmonic speed reducer is coaxially sleeved on the end part of the motor shaft (14) and realizes torque transmission through a detachable fastener;  the input side detecting element of the double-encoder assembly is synchronously rotated with the motor shaft (14),  the output side detecting element is synchronously rotated with the output end of the harmonic speed reducer,  and the two side detecting elements are at least partially overlapped in the axial direction;  the rotating part of the brake assembly is circumferentially fixed with the motor shaft (14) and at least partially extends into the inner hole of the shell,  forming axial space multiplexing with the static part of the shell.

The present application relates to the field of wheeled humanoid robot control technology,  and in particular to a task-adaptive whole-body variable impedance control method for a wheeled humanoid robot,  which includes multi-source signal fusion estimation,  task-dependent impedance scheduling,  upper body impedance control,  chassis virtual force admittance mapping and 1kHz real-time closed-loop execution. This application can adjust the upper body stiffness and chassis damping in real time based on slip rate,  contact stiffness and attitude disturbance. On the premise of ensuring the passivity and stability of the system,  it realizes the unity of assembly flexibility and handling stability,  and supports the operation while moving. Mixed tasks 1. A task self-adaptive systemic variable impedance control method of wheeled humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  multi-source heterogeneous signal real-time fusion estimation;  S2,  task dependent impedance parameter self-adaptive scheduling;  S3,  realizing upper body impedance control;  S4,  virtual force admittance mapping of chassis;  S5,  real-time closed loop execution;  wherein the step S1 synchronously processes the original data from the wheel speed encoder,  the joint moment sensor and the six-axis IMU by the three-signal fusion estimator to generate three types of state signals of sliding rate,  contact rigidity and posture disturbance;  the step S2 generates time-varying upper body rigidity,  chassis damping and chassis rigidity through the task dependent impedance scheduler based on the three types of state signals,  and applies parameter change rate limitation,  critical damping constraint and virtual damping injection triple stability guarantee;  the step S3 of performing impedance control in the upper body operation space,  mapping the expected interaction force into the joint torque instruction through the Jacobian transpose mapping module;  step S4,  constructing a virtual force in the chassis movement space and mapping the virtual force into a speed instruction by the admittance model module,  and then generating a wheel speed instruction by the omni-directional wheel inverse kinematics resolving module;  the S5 step on the x86 real-time computing platform with 1kHz control period circularly executing all control logic.

The invention provides a lightweight humanoid inspection robot leg support structure,  which belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots; the leg supporting structure comprises an upper connecting frame component,  a central inserting rod component and a spinning locking component,  wherein the leg supporting structure is axially inserted into a linear upper inserting groove through an inserting block at the upper end of the central inserting rod component,  then is rotated into an annular upper rotating groove,  and is automatically clamped into an upper clamping groove through an elastic upper clamping column,  so that quick preliminary connection is realized Further screwing the pre-sleeved spinning sleeve can axially compress the upper crimping sleeve,  and at the same time,  the locking groove at its bottom surrounds the clamping column,  so that the clamping connection is converted into rigid locking; the locking gear ring of the outer ring of the spinning sleeve forms elastic engagement with the locking teeth in the locking groove at the final stage of screwing,  providing in-place feedback and achieving mechanical anti-loosening; it realizes the quick tool-free disassembly and assembly of the leg support structure,  and through the three-level cooperation of elastic clamping,  rigid locking and anti-loosening locking,  it significantly improves the reliability and vibration resistance of the connection node while ensuring lightweight. 1. This application provides a humanoid robot interaction system based on big data,  which relates to the field of robot intelligent interaction and control technology. Cross-modal spatio-temporal alignment is performed on the command audio stream of the target user and the depth image sequence of the current interaction scene to obtain interactive environment data; extract the dynamic preference characteristics of the target user from the historical interaction log between the target user and the humanoid robot,  and then construct an implicit user portrait of the target user on interaction habits and preferences; generating personalized interaction strategy of humanoid robot in next interaction period based on interaction environment data and implicit user portrait; control the humanoid robot to execute interactive behavior that matches the current interactive environment and the user's historical preferences based on the personalized interaction strategy,  and feed back the interactive process to the historical interaction log to form a closed-loop learning. This application can build a robot interaction system that realizes cross-modal environment perception,  continuous learning of user preferences,  and has long-term personalized adaptability. 1. A humanoid robot interaction system based on large data,  wherein the interaction system comprises :  a data fusion module,  collecting the instruction audio stream of the target user through the double-microphone array of the head part of the human-shaped robot,  obtaining the depth image sequence of the current interactive scene through the stereoscopic vision camera of the human-shaped robot eye,  performing cross-modal space-time alignment on the instruction audio stream and the depth image sequence,  obtaining the interactive environment data of the humanoid robot and the target user under the current interactive scene;  a preference modelling module for obtaining the history interaction log between the target user and the humanoid robot,  performing time sequence mode mining on the history interaction log,  extracting the dynamic preference characteristic of the target user,  and further constructing the implicit user portrait of the target user on the interaction habit and preference based on the dynamic preference characteristic;  a reinforced decision module,  based on the interaction environment data and the implicit user portrait,  performing the context sensing combined reasoning,  generating the personalized interaction strategy of the humanoid robot in the next interaction period;  an interaction execution module,  the whole body motion planner of the humanoid robot generates the joint space track for interaction based on the personalized interaction strategy,  so as to control the humanoid robot to execute the interaction action matched with the current interaction environment and the user history preference according to the joint space track,  and feeding back the interaction process to the history interaction log to form closed-loop learning.

The present disclosure provides a system for managing operational modes of a humanoid robot. The system comprises stateless controllers,  each associated with a predefined operational domain defining a subset of robot state-space where the controller is valid. The system comprises composable modes with composable structures of stateless controllers arranged from highest to lowest priority. The system comprises a mode manager communicatively coupled to the stateless controllers and configured to,  for each control cycle :  iterate through the composable structure of an active composable mode from the highest-priority controller;  select the first controller whose predefined operational domain includes the current robot state;  and execute only the selected controller to control the humanoid robot for the control cycle duration.

The invention provides a point cloud-based humanoid three-dimensional scanning motion control method and device. The method of the invention realizes continuous scanning of a plurality of components or structures,  improves scanning efficiency and accuracy,  can meet complex industrial environments and actual task requirements,  is more suitable for multi-component discrete manufacturing scenes,  and has broad industrial application prospects and objective economic benefits. 1. A human-like three-dimensional scanning motion control method based on point cloud,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the camera viewpoint track of the object to be detected and the actuator track at the tail end of the mechanical arm;  based on the camera viewpoint track and the mechanical arm end actuator track,  obtaining a track curved surface and a deformation energy function of the track curved surface,  the deformation energy function is used for optimizing the smoothness of the track curved surface;  optimizing the track curved surface based on the deformation energy function and the distance deviation function to obtain the motion planning track curve of the object to be detected,  wherein the distance deviation function is used for reducing the deviation degree of the track curved surface in the optimizing process;  inputting the motion planning track curve of the object to be detected into a multi-target motion control model for solving to obtain the mechanical arm motion control optimal solution corresponding to the motion planning track,  wherein the multi-target motion control model is obtained based on mathematical modelling of multiple optimized targets of the object to be detected.

Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose humanoid robot foot-lifting movement training methods,  devices,  electronic equipment and media. This embodiment controls the humanoid robot to perform foot-lifting movement training on rough ground through the motor position control network and joint response controller,  which can improve the movement stability of the humanoid robot and the performance and pertinence of the motor position control network. 1. A human-shaped robot foot-lifting movement training method,  comprising :  obtaining the current observation sample information of the human-shaped robot,  wherein the human-shaped robot is a biped human-shaped robot with a clog type sole,  the current observation sample information comprises at least one of the following :  the joint position,  the joint speed,  the joint angle and the ground coupling pressure information of the feet of the human-shaped robot;  generating simulated elevation terrain information for the humanoid robot;  inputting the current observation sample information to an action network included in the motor position control network to obtain an action probability distribution numerical value set;  inputting the current observation sample information to the strategy network included in the motor position control network to obtain the action evaluation value set corresponding to the action probability distribution value set;  generating a target joint position set of the humanoid robot according to the action probability distribution numerical value set and the action evaluation value set;  inputting the target joint position set to a joint response controller to generate a joint moment set for the humanoid robot;  according to the joint moment set,  controlling the humanoid robot to perform foot lifting and moving training on the simulated elevation terrain corresponding to the simulated elevation terrain information;  in response to determining that the set of motion probability distribution values and the set of motion evaluation values satisfy a preset loss condition,  ending training of the motor position control network.

This application provides a dynamic scene 4D semantic map generation method,  device and processing equipment By designing the first feedforward framework for 4D semantic map generation,  the combined processing of geometric perception and semantic alignment is realized in a single architecture The framework contains two core components,  a streaming visual geometry transformer that captures the spatio-temporal geometric features of dynamic scenes,  and a semantic bridging decoder that maps spatio-temporal geometric features to language-aligned semantic spaces,  which both maintains structural integrity and improves semantic interpretability Different from the traditional method that relies on time-consuming scenario-level optimization,  it can effectively support multi-dynamic scenario merging training,  which can be directly applied during reasoning,  with high computational efficiency and strong generalization ability. This design significantly improves the practicality of its large-scale deployment,  opens up new ideas for open vocabulary 4D scenario understanding,  and can provide good data support for scenario understanding tasks for applications such as embodied intelligence,  metaverse,  and digital twins. Better application prospects. 1. A dynamic scene 4D semantic map generating method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the current video sequence of the corresponding 4D semantic map to be generated;  inputting the current video sequence into a 4D semantic map generation network,  wherein the 4D semantic map generation network comprises a streaming visual geometric converter,  a semantic bridging decoder and a point cloud rendering module,  the streaming vision geometric converter comprises a streaming vision geometric conversion encoder and a streaming vision geometric conversion decoder,  the streaming vision geometric conversion encoder is used for processing the video sequence input by the network into a camera token sequence and a geometric token sequence,  the streaming visual geometric decoder processes the camera token sequence and the geometric token sequence into a reconstructed point cloud sequence,  the semantic bridging decoder processes the geometric token sequence into a time sequence independent prediction semantic sequence and a time sequence dependent prediction semantic sequence,  the point cloud colouring module uses the time sequence independent prediction semantic sequence and the time sequence related prediction semantic sequence to colour the reconstructed point cloud sequence to obtain a dynamic scene time sequence independent 4D semantic map and a dynamic scene time sequence related 4D semantic map;  extracting and outputting the dynamic scene time sequence independent 4D semantic map and the dynamic scene time sequence dependent 4D semantic map.

The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot industrial task scene generation method and a humanoid robot industrial task scene generation system based on a large language model,  and belongs to the technical field of industrial automation and artificial intelligence The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an industrial task database; extracting and converting the task parameters according to the industrial task database to obtain the first task prompt information; decompose the industrial task by thinking chain task to obtain sub-task sequence information; train the large language model to obtain the initial task execution strategy; perform multi-dimensional evaluation on the initial task execution strategy to obtain the evaluation results; optimizing the first task prompt information according to the evaluation result to obtain the second task prompt information; adjust the large language model according to the second task prompt information to obtain the target task execution strategy. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the task adaptability and the strategy reliability of the humanoid robot in a complex industrial scene can be improved,  and the flexibility and the efficiency of industrial automatic production can be obviously improved 1. A humanoid robot industrial task scene generation method based on large language model,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining an industrial task database;  extracting and converting the task parameter according to the industrial task database to obtain the first task prompt information;  performing thinking chain task decomposition to the industrial task according to the first task prompt information to obtain sub-task sequence information;  training the large language model according to the sub-task sequence information to obtain an initial task execution strategy;  performing multi-dimensional evaluation on the initial task execution strategy to obtain an evaluation result;  optimizing the first task prompt information according to the evaluation result,  to obtain a second task prompt information,  comprising :  setting fraction threshold;  comparing the fraction threshold value with the evaluation result,  if the evaluation result is greater than or equal to the fraction threshold value,  prompting that the evaluation reaches the standard;  if the evaluation result is less than the score threshold value,  generating constraint information;  performing supplementary optimization on the first task prompt information according to the constraint information to obtain a second task prompt information;  adjusting the large language model according to the second task prompt information to obtain a target task execution strategy.

The invention discloses a method,  a system,  equipment and a medium for selecting a skeleton of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a process hard constraint condition,  a plurality of voxel grid units of a humanoid robot skeleton and a high-frequency load slice of each voxel grid unit; according to the process hard constraints,  all the voxel grid units and the high-frequency load slices,  multi-mode semantic vector generation processing is performed to obtain a semantic vector matrix; performing material matching on the semantic vector matrix to obtain a grid material table,  wherein the grid material table records a plurality of target candidate materials corresponding to each voxel grid unit; according to the grid material table,  voxel optimization is performed on all the voxel grid units to obtain the skeleton material selection result of the humanoid robot. This method can effectively improve the material screening efficiency of skeleton material selection,  reduce the time-consuming material selection and improve the skeleton material selection effect The present invention relates to humanoid robot technology 1. A framework material selecting method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the technical hard constraint condition,  multiple voxel grid units of the human-shaped robot framework and the high-frequency load slice of each voxel grid unit;  according to the process hard constraint condition,  all the voxel grid units and the high frequency load slice,  performing multi-mode semantic vector generation processing,  obtaining semantic vector matrix,  each matrix row of the semantic vector matrix is corresponding to one voxel grid unit;  performing material matching on the semantic vector matrix to obtain a grid material table,  the grid material table is recorded with a plurality of target candidate materials corresponding to each voxel grid unit;  according to the grid material table,  performing voxel optimization on all voxel grid units,  obtaining the skeleton material selection result of the human-shaped robot;  according to the grid material table,  performing voxel optimization on all voxel grid units,  obtaining the skeleton material selection result of the human-shaped robot,  comprising :  according to the grid material table,  performing double-gene coding on all the voxel grid units,  obtaining the first coding gene and the second coding gene of each voxel grid unit,  the first coding gene is used for characterizing the material index corresponding to the voxel grid unit,  the second coding gene is used for representing the wall thickness index corresponding to the first coding gene;  according to all the first coding gene and the second coding gene,  performing population parallel optimization on all the voxel grid units,  obtaining the population optimization of each voxel grid unit;  according to all the population optimization,  obtaining the framework material selection result of the humanoid robot.

This application discloses a safe communication method and related equipment for humanoid robots in industrial scenarios,  and relates to the field of robot technology. The method includes :  generating the corresponding robot private key and robot public key from the robot end,  and distributing the corresponding robot private key and robot public key to the control end through the industrial certification center. Robot certificate for robot public key; receive the control terminal certificate distributed through the industrial certification center through the robot terminal,  wherein the control terminal certificate is generated based on the control terminal public key; the robot terminal presents the three-dimensional graphic code of the first signature information about the control terminal certificate,  and the three-dimensional graphic code is used for the control terminal to read and verify; the robot end signs the test data through the robot private key and encrypts the control end certificate to generate test information and sends it to the control end; the session key is generated based on key negotiation between the two parties This application strengthens the physical layer verification security through three-dimensional graphic codes,  and combines the end-to-end encryption mechanism to solve the communication security problem of multi-robot collaboration in industrial scenarios. 1. A safe communication method of humanoid robot in industrial scene,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  generating the corresponding robot private key and the robot public key through the robot end,  and submitting the robot public key and the device unique identifier to the industrial authentication centre to apply for the robot certificate;  encrypting and distributing the robot certificate to the control end after passing the verification by the industrial authentication centre;  receiving the control end certificate distributed by the industrial authentication centre through the robot end;  wherein the control end certificate is generated based on the control end public key,  the control end public key and the corresponding control end private key are generated by the control end;  displaying a three-dimensional graphic code related to the first signature information of the control end certificate through the robot end;  reading the three-dimensional graphic code through the control end to obtain the first signature information,  and verifying the read first signature information according to the control end public key;  the robot end signs the test data according to the robot private key to generate the second signature information,  and encrypts the second signature information according to the control end certificate to generate the test information,  and sends the test information to the control end;  decrypting the test information by the control end according to the private key of the control end,  and verifying the data obtained after decrypting the test information based on the robot certificate;  after the data obtained by decrypting the first signature information and the test information are verified,  the robot end negotiates with the control end to generate a session key based on the robot private key,  the robot public key,  the control end public key and the control end private key;  wherein the first signature information comprises the spatial depth information and a dynamic colour code of the three-dimensional graphic code,  the spatial depth information is bound with an industrial scene identification through a preset threshold range,  the dynamic colour code is generated based on a random number of AES encryption and is updated once every set period,  The dynamic colour code is used for dynamically updating colour.

The invention relates to a humanoid robot lower limb walking control method and a humanoid robot lower limb walking control device,  belonging to the technical field of robot control. The humanoid robot lower limb walking control method and the humanoid robot lower limb walking control device comprise the following steps of :  acquiring state information and environment information of a robot; input state information and environmental information into a strategy network based on a self-attention structure,  output future multi-step joint action sequences,  and perform weighted fusion on the candidate actions of the output overlapping action sequences at the same future moment to generate smooth and coherent control instructions; input the state transition fragment of the robot into the adversarial prior network,  output the style score and map it into the style reward; combining the task completion degree reward and the style reward to construct a comprehensive reward function to optimize the policy network; deploy the optimized strategy network to the robot controller to achieve lower limb walking control. This application can effectively improve the naturalness,  stability and environmental adaptability of walking. 1. A lower limb walking control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the state information and environment information of the robot;  S2,  inputting the state information and the environment information to the strategy network based on the self-attention structure,  and outputting the joint action sequence of multiple steps in the future;  S3,  performing weighted fusion on the candidate actions of the joint action sequence output in the step S2 at the same future time :  the joint action sequence predicted by the adjacent time step generates multiple candidate actions at the same future time;  S4,  inputting the state transfer segment of the robot to the antagonistic priori network,  outputting the style score and mapping to the style reward;  S5,  combining the task completion degree reward and the style reward to construct a comprehensive reward function,  optimizing the strategy network;  S6,  deploying the optimized strategy network to the robot controller to realize the lower limb walking control.

The invention provides an emergency shutdown control method of a wheeled humanoid robot in an industrial scene,  which is applied to a robot including a wheeled drive unit,  leg joints and an attitude sensor. When receiving the emergency stop signal,  collect the state information such as wheel speed,  center of mass position and attitude,  leg joint angle,  etc.,  and determine the emergency braking parameters including the maximum deceleration of the wheel and attitude stability margin constraints by combining the ground attachment conditions and driving capabilities; under the constraints of this parameter,  the wheel braking trajectory from the current motion state to the stationary state is obtained Get the speed curve of the wheel drive unit,  and predict the centroid trajectory and support polygon changes,  generate a leg joint angle sequence at discrete moments,  collaboratively control wheel braking and leg posture adjustment,  and complete emergency shutdown when the wheel speed drops below the preset threshold and the posture stability margin meets the safety threshold. The present invention can achieve limited braking within a limited braking distance. Reduce the risk of instability and secondary accidents of the robot 1. An emergency shutdown control method of wheel-foot humanoid robot in industrial scene,  wherein it is applied to the wheel-foot humanoid robot comprising a wheel-type driving unit,  a leg joint,  a posture sensor and an execution control module,  when receiving the emergency shutdown signal,  comprising the following steps :  S1 :  collecting any one or more state information at least comprising each wheel type driving unit speed,  robot centroid position and posture,  leg joint angle;  S2 :  based on the state information,  in combination with the ground attachment condition and the driving capability,  determining an emergency brake constraint parameter including wheel maximum deceleration and attitude stability margin constraint;  S3 :  according to the emergency brake constraint parameter,  calculating the wheel brake track from the current motion state to the static state,  obtaining the reference curve of the target speed of each wheel drive unit along with the time change;  S4 :  based on the wheel type brake track and the reference curve of the target speed of each wheel type driving unit along with the time change,  predicting the change of the centroid track and the supporting polygon,  generating the target joint angle sequence of each leg joint at multiple discrete moments,  the target joint angle sequence is used for keeping the centroid projection in the supporting polygon and/or moving towards the central area of the supporting polygon;  S5 :  sending the reference curve of the target speed of each wheel driving unit along with the time change and the target joint angle sequence to the execution control module,  cooperatively controlling each wheel driving unit and the leg joint to make the robot decelerate and stop;  S6 :  when the speed of each wheel type driving unit is reduced below the preset threshold value,  the mechanical brake is triggered,  and the emergency stop is finished under the condition that the posture stability margin satisfies the preset safety threshold value.

This application discloses a training method,  control method and device for humanoid robot controllers. It adopts a two-stage training framework :  in the first stage,  a reinforcement learning algorithm is used to independently train multiple single-behavior controllers specializing in different motor skills (such as walking and standing); subsequently,  the capabilities of these single-behavioral controllers were integrated into a unified multi-behavioral controller through the behavioral distillation method,  giving it the ability to autonomously switch skills according to the state. In the second stage,  in order to improve the robustness of the multi-behavior controller in complex environments,  a task environment that simulates a variety of use terrains is constructed,  and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the controller is performed in parallel in such environments,  so as to finally obtain a controller that can adapt to complex terrains and achieve smooth switching of multiple skills. The application can improve the adaptive capacity of the humanoid robot controller and the reliability of practical application This application can be widely used in the field of robot technology. 1. A training method of humanoid robot controller,  wherein the method comprises :  multiple single-action controllers for realizing different movement skills of the humanoid robot are independently trained by the reinforced learning algorithm;  through the behaviour distillation method,  integrating the capabilities of the multiple single-behaviour controllers to obtain the corresponding multi-behaviour controller;  wherein the multi-action controller is used for controlling the human-shaped robot to switch between different movement skills;  establishing a plurality of task environments according to a plurality of use terrains preset for the humanoid robot;  and performing intensive learning fine adjustment on the multi-behaviour controller in parallel in multiple task environments to obtain the trained multi-behaviour controller.

The invention discloses a whole-body collaborative jump control method for a quadruped robot with a mechanical arm,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control By integrating the strong coupling effects of the fuselage,  robotic arm,  air phase and impact phase into the same model,  the real-time influence of the robotic arm action on the center of mass and inertia of the whole machine is quantified; by implementing impact buffering and posture maintenance,  the risk of imbalance when landing is reduced; by implementing coupling compensation,  dynamic conflicts are reduced; the whole-body collaborative jump control strategy builds a complete jump control closed loop from precise guidance in the air to smooth buffering on the ground and then to global collaborative compensation; through feedforward compensation to offset the coupling disturbance and feedback to correct the real-time error,  the trajectory tracking accuracy can be effectively improved; through the adaptive feedback gain adjustment of the landing impact phase,  the attitude oscillation amplitude can be effectively reduced and the robot can be prevented from toppling; composite control combines the predictability of feedforward with the fault tolerance of feedback. 1. A jumping control method for systemic cooperation of four-foot robot with mechanical arm,  wherein it comprises :  based on the strong coupling effect of the machine body,  the mechanical arm,  the air phase and the floor impact phase,  defining the extension state vector for describing the mass centre position,  the attitude angle,  the joint position and the speed of the whole machine;  based on the established uniform full system dynamics model,  designing a systemic cooperative jump control strategy :  in the jumping air phase,  dynamically adjusting the centroid track of the whole machine through the movement of the mechanical arm joint so as to correct the jumping track deviation;  in the floor impact phase,  the buffer impact load is adjusted by the mechanical arm posture to maintain the posture stability,  the coupling effect of the mechanical arm action to the whole machine mass centre deviation and inertia distribution is calculated in real time and compensated;  Based on the unified overall system dynamics model and the systemic cooperative jump control strategy,  the feedforward-feedback composite control law is designed :  The model feedforward compensates the coupling disturbance of the mechanical arm and the machine body,  combines the feedback control to dynamically adjust the control input of the four-foot joint and the mechanical arm joint,  inhibits the attitude oscillation of the landing impact phase,  and ensures the tracking precision of the jumping track and the landing safety.

The embodiment of the invention provides a method for dynamically adjusting a humanoid robot and related equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of data processing The method includes :  performing multi-modal fusion processing on input data to obtain interactive object features and self-action features corresponding to the humanoid robot; input the interactive object features and the robot's own action features into the dual-intention prediction neural network for processing to obtain the first output data and the second output data; according to the first output data and the second output data,  combined with the real-time feedback data,  the action control parameters and action planning parameters of the humanoid robot are dynamically adjusted,  and the humanoid robot is controlled to execute the adjusted action according to the adjusted action control parameters and the adjusted action planning parameters. The embodiments of this application can solve the strict requirements of industrial environments on accuracy and the core concerns of home environments on security,  and achieve cross-scene universal adaptability and robustness. 1. A dynamic adjusting method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the input data of the environment,  the interactive object and the self-state of the humanoid robot in the target scene;  performing multi-mode fusion processing on the input data to obtain the interactive object characteristic and the self-action characteristic corresponding to the humanoid robot;  respectively inputting the interactive object characteristic and the action characteristic of the robot to the double-intention prediction neural network for processing to obtain a first output data and a second output data;  the first output data comprises a first confidence fraction and a first prediction track of the robot executing the corresponding action intention,  the second output data comprises a second confidence fraction and a second prediction state of the interactive object presenting the corresponding state intention;  according to the first output data and the second output data,  combining the real-time feedback data,  dynamically adjusting the action control parameter and the action planning parameter of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the adjusted action control parameter and the adjusted action planning parameter,  and controlling the humanoid robot to execute the adjusted action according to the adjusted action control parameter and the adjusted action planning parameter.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on bionic joints and multi-modal perception,  and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots,  including a robot trunk; the invention realizes dynamic self-adaptive and multi-objective collaborative intelligent energy consumption management through the energy consumption management module :  its threshold analysis unit generates a dynamic sleep threshold in real time based on the four-dimensional status of energy,  environment,  tasks and system,  so that the energy saving strategy can be accurately adapted to variable working conditions; the energy consumption management unit performs intelligent sleep and wake-up scheduling based on the threshold,  and avoids invalid start-stop losses by introducing minimum effective time determination; at the same time,  the weight self-optimization mechanism based on policy gradient reinforcement learning enables the system to automatically balance multi-objective requirements and continue to evolve based on comprehensive feedback on energy-saving effects,  task performance and equipment safety. Ultimately,  on the premise of ensuring robot motion performance and operational safety,  it can significantly Improve endurance and improve personalized energy efficiency optimization. 1. A humanoid robot based on bionic joint and multimodal sensing,  comprising an upper arm (1) and a thigh (5) symmetrically connected at the upper and lower ends of the robot trunk,  wherein one end of the upper arm (1) is connected with a front arm (2),  and the middle part of the upper end of the robot trunk between the upper arm (1) is installed with a robot head,  the robot head is installed with a sensing interaction component,  and one end of the thigh (5) at two sides of the robot trunk connected with the lower end of the robot head is connected with a shank (6),  the thigh (5),  crus (6),  an adjusting mechanism and a stabilizing mechanism are arranged between the upper arm (1) and the front arm (2),  a laser radar (14) and an inertial navigation sensor (17) are installed on the robot trunk,  a controller (18) is installed in the robot trunk above the laser radar (14) and the inertial navigation sensor (17);  the controller (18) is internally provided with an energy consumption management module,  the energy consumption management module comprises an energy consumption management unit and a threshold value analysis unit;  an energy consumption management unit,  based on the sensing interaction component,  the multi-modal sensing data provided by the laser radar (14) and the inertial navigation sensor (17),  identifying the current scene in real time and obtaining the real-time energy consumption data of the corresponding type,  comparing the real-time energy consumption data with the dynamic preset threshold value provided by the threshold value analysis unit,  if it is lower than the threshold value,  judging as the sleep time,  sending a sleep instruction;  at the same time,  predicting the wake-up time of the structure according to the energy consumption data change rule;  a threshold value analysis unit for classifying,  dividing and pre-processing the historical energy consumption data to calculate the standard dormancy threshold value of each energy consumption structure and analyze the change rule;  based on the real-time data collected by the sensing interaction component,  the laser radar (14) and the inertial navigation sensor (17),  calculating the influence factors of four dimensions of energy,  environment,  task and system in real time;  further fusing each influence factor with the reference threshold value to generate a dynamic dormancy threshold value;  adopting the strategy gradient strengthening learning frame,  taking the four-dimensional observation value as the state,  taking the weight coefficient as the action,  taking the comprehensive reward as the target,  learning online and continuously optimizing each weight coefficient.
