The invention relates to the technical field of robot navigation,  and discloses an industrial scene-oriented wheel-footed humanoid robot path planning and navigation method,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Obtain the robot's environmental information and its own status information; s2. The collected environmental information and its own status information are aligned in time sequence and coordinate transformed; s3. Identify dynamic obstacles based on time series to obtain a fusion environment map; s4. Dynamic obstacle avoidance and path re-planning based on local dynamic programming algorithm; s5. Determine whether to enable wheel mode or foot mode based on environmental information terrain flatness and ground gradient parameters; s6. At the same time,  feedback based on errors and energy consumption during navigation execution. In the present invention,  by adopting an optimization strategy that combines dynamic path re-planning and reinforcement learning,  it not only improves the flexibility of path planning and the ability to cope with complex environments,  but also effectively reduces energy consumption and obstacle avoidance distance,  allowing the robot to operate in a wider range of scenarios. 1. An industrial scene-oriented wheel-foot humanoid robot path planning and navigation method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  mounting a laser radar,  a visual camera,  an inertia measuring unit and a odometer sensor on the wheel-foot humanoid robot,  for obtaining the environment information and self state information of the robot;  S2,  then performing time sequence alignment and coordinate conversion on the collected environment information and self-state information,  obtaining pose estimation of the robot through extended Kalman filtering or factor graph optimization algorithm;  S3,  generating a geometric map based on the laser radar data,  generating a semantic map based on the visual information,  and identifying a dynamic obstacle according to the time sequence,  obtaining a fusion environment map;  S4,  using the global path planning algorithm to obtain the initial path from the starting point to the target point,  and based on the local dynamic planning algorithm to dynamically avoid the barrier and re-plan the path;  S5,  judging whether the wheel mode or foot mode is started according to the terrain flatness of the environment information and the ground gradient parameter,  and controlling the robot to execute the corresponding movement;  S6,  based on the control instruction,  driving the robot to move,  and performing path tracking error feedback adjustment according to the real-time positioning result,  at the same time,  according to the error and energy consumption feedback in the navigation execution process,  adopting enhanced learning algorithm to dynamically adjust the path planning parameter.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot fall protection and fall recovery method based on a state-triggered hybrid strategy Through staged training and hierarchical reinforcement learning architecture,  fall protection and standing recovery are trained separately as two independent skill networks,  and the high-level state trigger strategy realizes autonomous switching and smooth transition between the two. The fall protection strategy network focuses on impact minimization and safe ground contact,  and reduces collision damage through joint variable stiffness and compliance control; the fall recovery strategy network combines the reference trajectory generated by the inverse kinematic solution based on bone binding and animation to achieve natural and efficient standing actions. The invention introduces an AI-powered autonomous robot,  termed Sensobot,  designed to interact intelligently with its environment using an array of sensors and machine learning algorithms. It combines hardware components such as ultrasonic sensors,  camera modules,  microcontrollers,  displays,  batteries,  and connectivity modules with software intelligence that processes sensory data to make real-time decisions. At the heart of its mechanism,  Sensobot has a sensor fusion mechanism that incorporates data from motion,  temperature,  humidity,  touch,  and vision to provide a holistic map of the environment. This allows for the detection of obstacles,  recognition of humans,  and adaptation of the environment by the robot on its own without any external guidance. Unlike traditional robots programmed with rigid instructions,  the algorithms of Sensobot allow for context-aware behavior. The basic module for human-robot interaction in Sensobot integrates voice and gesture recognition for easily understanding natural commands. Further,  IoT integration makes it possible to control it remotely using a smartphone or cloud dashboard,  which is suitable for distributed environments. The novelty of this invention lies in integrating various sensors with AI learning and IoT communication into one unified robotic framework,  which is capable of real-time adaptability. While it performs tasks,  it evolves behaviorally-a feature absent in prior art. Thus,  Sensobot lays the foundation for the next generation of autonomous robots,  intelligently bridging the gap between human needs and machine capabilities.

HUMANOIDSYNC discloses an end-to-end humanoid robotics architecture that delivers full-scale,  biomechanically accurate,  self-repairing robots capable of performing industrial,  domestic,  medical,  defense,  and extraterrestrial tasks. The system integrates a skeletal meta-alloy chassis,  modular electro-hydraulic muscles,  and bio-synthetic soft-tissue overlays coordinated by a symbolic AI kernel that enforces consent,  ethics,  and mission-bound constraints in real time. Swappable powerpacks (solid-state batteries,  hydrogen fuel,  or micro-reactor pods) enable >24-hour untethered operation,  while an on-board nanofactory performs autonomous spare part printing and tissue healing. Multi-sensor fusion (LiDAR,  event-camera,  tactile mesh,  chem sniffer) feeds a closed-loop whole-body control stack achieving <5 ms reflex latency. All firmware and hardware modules register on a treaty-aware ledger using zero-knowledge proofs to validate safety,  export compliance,  and battlefield Rules-of-Engagement. HUMANOIDSYNC solves design,  production,  deployment,  and lifecycle hurdles—providing a universal,  regulation ready platform for humanoid robots across terrestrial and off-world environments.

The invention discloses a radiographic inspection on-site warning inspection robot and a method of use The robot is modularized and humanoid and comprises a robot head,  a robot trunk and a robot chassis,  wherein the robot head comprises a head shell and a head integrated interface; the head shell is hemispherical; and the cylindrical head integrated interface is arranged at the lower part of the head shell The head integrated interface is inserted into the connecting hole on the upper part of the robot trunk,  and the head casing can rotate along the central axis of the head integrated interface; the robot body includes a body casing,  which is a hyperbolic structure with a central processing unit inside. A ray detection field warning patrol robot,  wherein the robot is a modularized and humanoid design,  comprising a robot head (1),  a robot trunk (2) and a robot chassis (3),  the robot head (1) comprises a head shell (11) and a head integrated interface (13),  the head shell (11) is a semi-spherical structure,  the cylindrical head integrated interface (13) is set on the lower part of the head shell (11);  the head integrated interface (13) is inserted into the upper part connecting hole of the robot trunk (2),  so that the robot head (1) and the robot trunk (2) are integrally connected,  the head shell (11) can rotate along the central axis of the head integrated interface (13),  driving each sensor module of the robot head (1) to realize 360-degree rotation;  the robot trunk (2) comprises a trunk shell (21),  the main body of the robot trunk (2) is a hyperbolic structure,  a central processing unit is set in the main body shell (21),  the lower end face is provided with a cylindrical cavity for connecting the robot head (1) and the robot chassis (3),  the inner part of the cavity is provided with a special data interface for realizing the power transmission and data communication between each part;  the robot chassis (3) comprises a chassis shell (31) whose main body is a cuboid,  the chassis shell (31) is internally provided with a power supply module and a driving module,  the robot system is provided with power through a lithium battery and a power supply sub-controller,  the robot chassis (3) is provided with power through a speed reducing motor system;  the robot head (1),  the robot trunk (2) and the robot chassis (3) are capable of freely rotating along the central axis.

The invention discloses a motion control method and a motion control system for a two-wheeled-leg robot based on automatic course reinforcement learning The method first parameterizes the training task to construct a course space containing multiple difficulty parameters; then dynamically sampling and generating training tasks that match the current capabilities of the robot through automated course generation strategies; a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is used to train the sports strategy network,  and a multi-objective reward function that integrates task completion,  balance maintenance,  energy consumption,  smoothness and fall penalty is used for evaluation; adjust the difficulty of the course in real time according to the training performance,  and form a closed-loop adaptive optimization system. The invention effectively solves the problems of sparse rewards and low training efficiency,  significantly improves the robustness,  adaptability and final performance of motion strategies,  does not require manual design of courses,  and can be widely used in high dynamic balance control scenarios. 1. A double-wheel leg robot motion control method based on automatic course reinforcement learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  constructing the simulation environment of the double-wheel leg robot and defining the course space,  the course space parameterize the training task through the parameter at least comprising the initial posture disturbance,  the target speed and the terrain gradient;  step 2 :  based on the automatic course generation strategy,  dynamically sampling in the course space to generate the current training task,  wherein the automatic course generation strategy adopts the generation countermeasure network,  wherein the input of the generator comprises the performance index of the current strategy and the random noise,  and the output is the new task parameter in the course space;  the input of the discriminator is the initial performance data of the task parameter and the strategy on the task,  and the output is the adaptive score of the task relative to the current strategy;  the curriculum difficulty distribution is dynamically close to and maintained near the optimal learning boundary of the strategy by the confrontation training;  step 3 :  on the current training task,  the motion strategy network is trained by the deep strengthening learning algorithm,  and the robot performance is evaluated by the multi-target reward function combined with the task finishing reward,  balance keeping reward,  energy consumption punishment and falling punishment;  step 4 :  according to the evaluation result,  calculating a course quality evaluation index Q,  the index is the weighted sum of task success rate,  motion efficiency,  strategy generality and safety,  and based on the value of the index Q,  feeding back and adjusting the difficulty distribution of the course space in real time,  forming a closed-loop self-adaptive optimization system;  step 5 :  transferring the motion strategy network trained in the simulation environment to the entity double-wheel leg robot for deployment and control.

The invention discloses an object positioning method based on centroid estimation. Aiming at the problem of insufficient positioning accuracy of a robot object in an unstructured scene,  the invention provides the object positioning method based on the centroid estimation. The method is realized through a four-step collaborative technology :  firstly,  a bounding box is reduced to focus on a target area so as to eliminate background noise; converting the object information into gray-scale image and binarizing to strengthen the contour feature; identify the effective target area through connected component annotation and calculate the centroid coordinates; finally,  a closed loop is formed by combining the inverted binary image and centroid visual verification Compared with traditional machine learning and 3D point cloud reconstruction methods,  the present invention performs better in complex scenes such as overlapping objects and different viewing angles,  effectively solves the problem of low positioning accuracy in unstructured scenes,  and is suitable for industrial detection and automatic driving. And high-precision scenes such as humanoid robot operation provide reliable support for flexible and accurate operation of robots. 1. An object locating method based on centroid estimation,  wherein It comprises the following steps :  S1,  placing the robot moving platform entity configured with the depth camera D435 and the six-degree-of-freedom light type mechanical arm into the actual unstructured scene for information collection,  using the depth camera to respectively obtain the color image and depth image information of the target object;  S2,  sending the colour image information obtained by S1 into the YOLOv4 model,  and outputting to obtain the boundary frame of the target object the four values are respectively corresponding to the coordinate,  frame width and frame height of the central point of the boundary frame;  taking the central point coordinate of the frame as the grabbing central point of the object;  S3,  obtaining the object information in the reduced boundary frame;  converting the object information into a grey image,  and then converting the grey image into a binary image by using binaryzation;  marking the connection component in the two-dimensional binary image,  and recording the horizontal and vertical coordinates of the mass centre position;  displaying the inverted binary image,  and marking the centroid position on the image;  S4,  obtaining the clustering centre point coordinate obtained in the S3 and the depth information for eliminating the abnormal point according to the corresponding operation to obtain the grabbing coordinate in the real world;  S5,  using CAN communication to send the grabbing coordinate obtained by S4 into our mobile robot platform,  so as to realize accurate grabbing of the target object.

The invention discloses a sensor data acquisition method,  and relates to the field of humanoid robots In order to solve the problems of difficult wiring,  vulnerable wiring harness,  poor data synchronization and transmission packet loss existing in the existing multi-sensor wired connection,  a wireless architecture of main node and sub-node is adopted :  the main node generates and issues a synchronization signal to calibrate the sub-node clock,  and the sub-node collects sensor data and generates a double serial number identifier,  which is packaged and reported wirelessly; the master node triggers retransmission through double sequence number verification,  and calls the corresponding protocol to parse the data according to the sensor type. The core algorithm ensures time synchronization and data reliability,  and the modular design adapts to multiple types of sensors. The invention completely solves the wiring problem,  improves the stability and adaptation flexibility of data collection,  is easy to implement and maintain,  and is suitable for robot multi-sensor collaborative collection scenes. 1. A sensor data collecting method,  used for robot multi-sensor cooperative data collecting,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one,  the main node generates and sends the synchronous signal,  the synchronous signal is used for calibrating the collecting clock of each sub-node;  step two,  after each sub-node receives the synchronous signal,  collecting the target data of the corresponding sensor,  at the same time generating a double-serial number mark,  the double-serial number mark comprises a message serial number and a pulse serial number;  step ,  the sub-node packs the target data and the double-serial number mark into the data frame,  and reports to the main node by the short-distance wireless communication mode;  step ,  after the main node receives said data frame,  the integrity of the data frame is checked based on the double serial number mark,  if the check is passed,  the target data is analyzed,  if the check is not passed,  the retransmission mechanism is triggered;  step five,  the main node adapts the corresponding analysis protocol according to the sensor type to finish the analysis and output of the target data;  Wherein,  the core algorithm comprises :  a) Time Synchronous Calibration Algorithm :  ,  is the acquisition time stamp after the node calibration,  is the reference time stamp of the master node synchronization signal,  is the synchronization signal transmission delay,  is the initial deviation of the sub-node and the main node clock;  b) Double-sequence number check retransmission algorithm :  ,  or ,  time-triggered retransmission.

A robot system for human-robot collaboration is disclosed that includes one or more proximity sensing elements disposed on the movable parts of the robot,  joint position sensing sensors,  and a safety control module connects the proximity sensing element and joint position sensing sensors and monitors the speed of the robot and the proximity distance to the objects and stop the robot safely when speed exceed the set limit. The safety control module switches the safety status of the robot when a set proximity distance threshold is triggered. Then,  multiple embodiments of the safety status triggered by proximity sensing are introduced for different processes of the human-robot collaboration,  includes separation monitoring,  force limiting for bumping,  and manipulation of the robot. Furthermore,  embodiments of utilizing different types of sensors to implement the proximity sensing elements are also disclosed.

Systems and methods for passive robot-mediated physical human-human interaction using hierarchical constraints. The system enforces constraints on both sides of a bilateral physical interaction with different priorities on each side in the presence of time-varying destabilizing factors such as control system limitations,  human variability,  hard contacts,  relaxed user grasps,  stiff control settings,  and/or communication delays. A hierarchical optimization framework is provided to satisfy these constraints. A back-up passivity control may also be included to ensure optimization at both sides.

A bone animation generating method of digital role suitable for Unity development,  wherein the method is executed when Unity operation,  comprising the following steps :  obtaining the action requirement information of the digital role and packaging the action requirement information into the skeleton animation generating instruction of the special data structure,  wherein the skeleton animation generating instruction comprises an instruction type,  an instruction content,  a role ID,  an interactive object,  an instruction priority and a time stamp;  converting the skeleton animation generating instruction into a structured skeleton animation generating prompt word data packet;  generating a prompting word data packet according to the skeleton animation to generate a skeleton animation file in BVH format;  analyzing the skeleton animation file in BVH format to obtain skeleton structure and animation data;  performing T-Pose difference compensation between T-Pose and Unity Avatar standard T-Pose of BVH format file,  matching the skeleton structure of BVH format skeleton animation file with the skeleton structure of digital role VRM model,  and generating an AnimationClip object of the digital character VRM model according to the adaptation result and the animation data;  controlling the skeleton animation to play on the digital role VRM model according to the AnimationClip object of the generated digital role VRM model,  and converting the skeleton application rotation compensation matrix of each frame animation in the animation playing process;  The step of obtaining the action requirement information of the digital character comprises :  obtaining the action requirement information of the digital role through the user voice input and the user text input;  The step of obtaining the action requirement information of the digital role generated by the system interaction logic specifically comprises :  monitoring the action requirement information of the digital role generated by the internal event of the system,  generating the action requirement information of the digital role based on the current context and the interaction object attribute,  mapping the interaction action defined by the scene script to the action requirement information of the digital role;  converting the bone animation generating instruction into a structured bone animation generating prompt word data packet,  comprising :  if the skeleton animation generation instruction is a composite action instruction,  decomposing the composite action into a basic action unit capable of being independently generated;  invoking the large language model to extract the action key word from the instruction content corresponding to the basic action unit,  and performing semantic complement to the action key word;  filling the extracted action key word as the template parameter to the preset action generating prompt word template to obtain the bone animation generating prompt word data packet; The invention discloses an operation control method and system for a wheel-legged humanoid robot based on maneuverability optimization,  and relates to the technical field of intelligent control of robots. According to the trajectory tracking task of the end of the robotic arm and the motion constraints of the robotic arm joints,  the state vector of the base and the robotic arm joint is used Adaptively calculate the weight matrix; construct a robot dynamics model and estimate the contact force at the end of the robotic arm based on the disturbance observer; determine the direction of the control force based on its estimation results,  and then increase the maneuverability of the development force; get the speed command of the end effector,  the expected base speed and the joint speed of the robotic arm are obtained through the weight matrix. Based on the integrated dynamics model,  a hierarchical control framework of the model predictive controller and the whole body controller is constructed,  and the optimal wheel-leg interaction force spinor and optimal joint torque are obtained by solving,  so as to drive the whole body motion control of the robot. Enhance the robot's motion stability and operating efficiency through the organic combination of disturbance compensation and force maneuverability optimization. 1. A wheel-foot humanoid robot operation control method based on maneuverability optimization,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the sensor data of the robot,  and obtaining the state vectors of the base and the tail end of the mechanical arm through the state estimator;  according to the track tracking task at the tail end of the mechanical arm and the motion restriction of the mechanical arm joint,  the state vector of the base and the mechanical arm joint is used for self-adaptively calculating the weight matrix to realize the coordinated motion distribution of the base and the mechanical arm joint;  constructing a robot dynamic model by considering the interaction force between the robot and the environment,  and estimating the contact force at the tail end of the mechanical arm based on the disturbance observer of the generalized dynamic quantity;  according to the estimation result of the contact force at the tail end of the mechanical arm,  determining the operating force direction,  and developing the force maneuverability enhancement based on the operating force direction;  obtaining the speed instruction of the end actuator,  realizing the coordinated motion distribution of the base and the mechanical arm through the weight matrix to obtain the expected base speed and the mechanical arm joint speed,  then,  based on the integrated dynamic model,  constructing the model prediction controller and the layered control frame of the whole body controller,  solving to obtain the mutual acting force rotation amount of the optimal wheel legs and the optimal joint torque so as to drive the whole body movement control of the robot.

The invention relates to a humanoid robot three-dimensional complex environment navigation method and a humanoid robot three-dimensional complex environment navigation system,  and belongs to the technical field of robot navigation Includes :  obtaining random path nodes; constructing a collision detection model according to the gait cycle of the robot; using the collision detection model to detect whether the random path node passes the collision detection; if not,  delete the random path node and reacquire the random path node; otherwise,  add random path nodes to the random tree; for each node added to the random tree,  collision detection and plane size detection at the node are performed,  and when detection is passed,  candidate nodes are added to the global waypoint sequence; according to the complexity of the current plane,  the sequence is screened to obtain complex area path nodes and flat area path nodes; according to the operation requirements of the robot on the path nodes in different areas,  the corresponding motion instructions are generated. The invention reduces the calculation cost of dynamic envelope space and improves the accuracy of global path planning 1. A three-dimensional complex environment navigation method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  obtaining a random path node;  S2,  constructing a collision detection model according to the gait period of the robot;  using the collision detection model to detect whether the random path node passes the collision detection;  if not,  deleting the random path node and returning to the S1;  if so,  adding the random path node to the random tree;  for each node added to the random tree,  performing the collision detection at the node,  if the collision detection is passed,  taking the node as the candidate node,  otherwise,  returning to the S1;  detecting the plane size of each candidate node,  if the detection is passed,  adding the candidate node to the global path point sequence,  or returning to the S1;  S3,  according to the complexity degree of the current plane,  screening the global path point sequence,  obtaining the complex area path node and the flat area path node;  S4,  when the robot operates along the complex area path node,  obtaining the first pose data of the robot,  generating a motion instruction according to the first pose data;  when the robot operates along the flat area path node,  obtaining the second pose data of the robot;  generating a motion instruction according to the second pose data and a preset threshold.

The invention relates to a reinforcement learning-based dual-arm body operation method of a humanoid robot,  which belongs to the field of robot collaborative control. It uses a strategy of trajectory block prediction + time integration and fusion for dual-arm coordinated control,  which improves the continuity of dual-arm operation. and stability; in reinforcement learning control,  by introducing the three-dimensional pose trajectory generation and correction module,  the three-dimensional space condition generation and denoising correction are carried out at the trajectory block level to ensure the geometric consistency and naturalness of the generated trajectory; the present invention also provides a reinforcement learning optimization framework and a simulation-reality migration process,  which ensures policy deployability and security through the system integration of reward + value guidance + migration process; compared with the prior art,  the invention can significantly improve the naturalness,  synergy and success rate of double-arm operation,  has strong generalization ability,  and has good migration ability from simulation to reality. 1. A double-arm tool body operation method of humanoid robot based on intensive learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) obtaining the multi-mode observation information of the robot,  including visual data,  joint state,  force sense signal and target object pose;  (2) Track generation and optimization :  (2.1) constructing an action generating structure :  adopting the neural network based on the sequence modelling,  through inputting the robot multi-mode sequence of several steps of history,  predicting the future several steps of double-arm end track block,  and in the reasoning stage,  performing weighted fusion to the overlapped predicted track block to generate smooth track;  (2.2) performing condition generation and de-noising correction on the double-arm end track block in the three-dimensional space,  ensuring that the track is in accordance with the geometric constraint and has nature;  (2.3) projecting the generated tail end track as the joint command,  combining the inverse kinematics and constraint optimization method,  satisfying the joint limiting,  speed,  acceleration and collision condition;  (3) strengthening learning training :  (3. 1) constructing comprehensive reward function,  the comprehensive reward function comprises task finish degree reward,  double-arm cooperative consistency reward and action smooth reward;  (3.2) training the action generation structure by the enhanced learning strategy optimization method so as to maximize the expected return;  in the interactive sampling stage of reinforcement learning,  the value function is used for value weighting the strategy output action,  and the sampling distribution is guided to deviate to the high value area;  (4) Secure Enforcement and Deployment :  (4.1) using course learning and/or domain randomization for training in simulation environment;  (4.2) performing system identification and parameter correction before deployment,  and performing strategy distillation and delay compensation;  (4.3) deploying the optimized strategy to the real robot,  and ensuring the execution safety through the safety constraint layer and the recovery mechanism.

The invention provides a vector entanglement-based humanoid robot control method,  a vector entanglement-based humanoid robot control device and a vector entanglement-based humanoid robot control device Constructing a basic action vector and generating a spiral entangled action vector chain by partially overlapping entanglement; use dynamic semantic mapping to construct an action semantic map and generate a deviation prediction path; identify non-integral periodic actions through deviation feature vectors,  extract overlapping nodes from the entanglement vector chain for borrowing fusion to generate a complete execution sequence; construct a deviation propagation network to analyze the deviation diffusion path,  identify deviation amplification nodes and convergence nodes,  and extract available components to generate action enhancement factors; the enhancement factor and entanglement vector chain are collaboratively optimized to generate an enhancement control sequence,  which realizes the transformation of deviation from passive elimination to active utilization,  and improves the continuity and energy efficiency of humanoid robot actions. 1. A humanoid robot control method based on vector entanglement,  wherein it comprises :  receiving the control task of the humanoid robot,  performing frequency statistical analysis to the control task to extract a core action sequence,  constructing a basic action vector according to the core action sequence,  using the basic action vector to generate a entanglement action vector chain in a partially overlapping entanglement manner;  using the entanglement motion vector chain to perform dynamic semantic mapping to construct an initial motion semantic map,  performing evolution updating on the initial motion semantic map according to real-time execution feedback,  generating a deviation prediction path through the updated motion semantic map;  performing the human-shaped robot action according to the deviation prediction path to generate the actual execution deviation data,  comparing and analyzing the actual execution deviation data and the deviation prediction path to generate the deviation characteristic vector;  using the deviation characteristic vector to identify the non-whole period action,  extracting the entanglement action vector overlapped with the non-whole period action from the entanglement action vector chain,  performing bit fusion to the entanglement action vector to generate the complete execution sequence;  combining the complete execution sequence and the deviation characteristic vector to construct a deviation propagation network,  analyzing the diffusion path of the deviation in the action chain through the deviation propagation network to obtain a deviation amplification node and a deviation convergence node,  performing deviation regulation analysis aiming at the deviation amplification node and the deviation convergence node to obtain usable component,  generating action enhancement factor according to the usable component;  the action enhancement factor and the entanglement action vector chain are cooperatively optimized to generate an enhancement control sequence,  and the enhancement control sequence is used to finish the driving of the humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation method,  device and equipment based on defect complementation,  which identifies and measures defect points and data hole areas through multi-sensor defect feature extraction to generate a defect feature map; establish a confidence decrement verification mechanism based on defect mutual exclusion analysis,  determine sensor weight allocation,  and generate navigation gain parameters from the negative error feature set; reverse analyzing navigation data to extract back information,  reconstructing environment implicit features and constructing reverse navigation field; analyze the spatial distribution density of data void areas to generate a void density map,  divide the path phase change areas and generate a phase change rule set; fusion curve path parameters,  three-dimensional path parameters and navigation gain parameters generate adaptive navigation sequences to drive humanoid robots to achieve intelligent navigation control. The invention converts sensor defects into navigation resources and improves navigation performance in complex environments 1. A humanoid robot navigation method based on defect complementation,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the human-shaped robot navigation data,  extracting and identifying the measuring defect point and the data hollow area according to the defect characteristic of the navigation data,  and analyzing the space distribution based on the measuring defect point and the data hollow area to generate the defect characteristic map;  using the defect characteristic map to establish confidence degree descending verification to obtain a multi-level sensing result,  according to the multi-level sensing result,  determining the sensor weight distribution,  based on the sensor weight distribution,  extracting the negative error value of each sensor from the defect characteristic map to generate a negative error characteristic set,  generating a navigation gain parameter using the negative error feature set;  performing reverse analysis to the navigation data through the navigation gain parameter to extract the data back information,  reconstructing the environment implicit feature based on the data back information,  combining the environment implicit feature and the navigation gain parameter to construct a reverse navigation field;  analyzing the spatial distribution density of the data cavity area based on the reverse navigation field to generate a cavity density map,  extracting cavity clustering feature and cavity connection mode from the cavity density map,  setting a density threshold value according to the cavity density map to divide a path phase change area,  based on the path phase change area,  generating a path phase change rule set by the cavity clustering feature and the cavity connection mode;  generating an initial navigation path according to the path phase change rule set and the reverse navigation field,  performing morphological transformation on the initial navigation path to generate a curve path parameter and a three-dimensional path parameter,  and fusing the curve path parameter,  the three-dimensional path parameter and the navigation gain parameter to generate an adaptive navigation sequence.
