The invention relates to the technical field of coal gangue identification,  in particular to a coal gangue identification and inspection equipment and a coal gangue identification method. The coal gangue identification and inspection equipment includes a wheel-legged robot,  a connecting mechanism and a coal gangue identification assembly connected in sequence. The foot robot moves between the hydraulic support and the scraper conveyor; the wheel-legged robot includes a robot main body,  a wheel-legged moving mechanism and a camera assembly installed on it; the coal gangue identification assembly includes a housing and a coal gangue identification camera for monitoring the content and proportion of the coal gangue mixture on the scraper conveyor. The coal gangue identification camera is slidably installed on the housing,  and the coal gangue identification camera monitors the coal gangue mixture on the scraper conveyor. The moving direction and moving speed of the coal gangue mixture are the same The invention realizes the synchronous movement of the coal gangue identification camera and the coal gangue mixture,  performs coal gangue image shooting and proportion identification in a relatively stationary state,  and improves the accuracy of coal gangue identification; shorten the control process of coal gangue identification-feedback-end coal discharge,  and improve the separation efficiency. 1. A coal gangue identification polling device,  wherein it comprises a wheel foot type robot (1),  a connecting mechanism (2) and a coal gangue identifying assembly (3),  the wheel foot type robot (1) is set between the hydraulic bracket (4) and the scraper conveyor (6),  and moves along the arrangement direction of multiple hydraulic brackets (4);  the wheel-foot type robot (1) comprises a robot main body and a wheel-foot moving mechanism and a camera assembly mounted thereon,  the camera assembly comprises a monocular camera (131) and a binocular camera (132),  the monocular camera (131) is used for identifying the distance between the wheel foot type robot (1) and the traction chain (5),  the binocular camera (132) is used for identifying the distance between the wheel foot type robot (1) and the coal placing mechanism (41) in the coal placing stage;  the coal gangue identification assembly (3) comprises a shell (31) and a coal gangue identification camera (341) for monitoring the content and proportion of the coal gangue mixture on the scraper conveyor (6),  the coal gangue identification camera (341) is slidingly installed on the shell (31),  the coal gangue identification camera (341) monitors the same moving direction of the coal gangue mixture on the scraper conveyor (5),  and the moving speed is the same;  the shell (31) is further provided with an inspection camera (32) for monitoring the large coal rock on the coal wall.

The invention discloses a robot humanoid impedance control method and system based on multi-modal signal fusion,  which relates to the field of robot technology and includes a control center connected to a signal acquisition module,  a signal processing module,  a signal fusion module and an execution decision-making module; the signal acquisition module is used for acquiring the environmental information of the position of the robot and the state information of the robot itself; the signal processing module is used to process the environmental information obtained by each signal acquisition terminal and the robot's own status information to obtain corresponding signal timing characteristics; the signal fusion module is used to fuse the obtained signal timing characteristics to obtain a corresponding signal fusion characteristic matrix; the execution decision-making module is used to generate corresponding robot execution instructions according to the signal fusion feature matrix,  and execute corresponding action decisions according to the robot execution instructions,  which solves the possible imbalance problem in the robot deceleration process. 1. A robot human impedance control system based on multimodal signal fusion,  comprising a control centre,  wherein the control centre is connected with a signal collecting module,  a signal processing module,  a signal fusion module and an execution decision module;  the signal collecting module is composed of multiple signal collecting terminals for obtaining the environment information of the position of the robot and the state information of the robot;  the signal processing module is used for processing the environment information obtained by each signal collecting terminal and the state information of the robot to obtain the corresponding signal time sequence characteristic;  the signal fusion module is used for fusing the obtained each signal time sequence characteristic to obtain the corresponding signal fusion characteristic matrix;  the execution decision module is used for generating the corresponding robot execution instruction according to the signal fusion characteristic matrix,  and executing the corresponding action decision according to the robot execution instruction.

The embodiment of the invention provides a task execution method and related equipment of a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the technical field of intelligent control The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring initial environment characteristics and a target environment category set; the target environment category set contains the environment categories required by the humanoid robot when performing tasks; performing integrity detection on the initial environment characteristics,  and if the initial environment characteristics are determined to be incomplete,  controlling the sensors included in the humanoid robot to collect real-time environment information according to the target environment category set; fusion of the initial environment features and real-time environment information to obtain the target environment features,  and perform the current task according to the target environment features. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the completeness of the sensing result and the accuracy of task execution can be improved,  and the computing power load caused by dependence on local real-time calculation in the whole process is effectively reduced,  so that the efficiency of the humanoid robot for sensing the current environment is improved 1. A task execution method of humanoid robot,  wherein it is applied to the humanoid robot,  the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining an initial environment feature and a target environment class set;  the target environment type set comprises the environment type needed by the human-shaped robot when executing the task;  performing integrity detection on the initial environment feature,  if the initial environment feature is determined to be incomplete,  then controlling a sensor included in the humanoid robot to collect real-time environment information according to the target environment class set;  fusing the initial environment characteristic with the real-time environment information to obtain the target environment characteristic,  and executing the current task according to the target environment characteristic.

The invention discloses a dynamic control method for an electro-hydraulic bipedal humanoid robot with position servo as priority and force as observation correction The ideal mapping of time,  displacement,  and force is verified through ADAMS simulation Construct the robot's stress main body model and hydraulic system model Uniform calibration of the performance parameters of the single-degree-of-freedom spring damping mass model of the mechanical system and the hydraulic system model Construct a control structure including controller PID,  digital-to-analog converter DA,  pilot valve,  and main valve,  perform position-first force observation and correction,  compare position and force deviations,  and drive the valve group through digital-to-analog converter DA and signal amplifier to control the hydraulic cylinder. When the threshold value is exceeded,  dynamic adjustment is performed to reduce the dimensionless deviation The invention improves the safety,  environmental adaptability and motion flexibility of the robot,  reduces energy consumption and has high control accuracy,  and is suitable for electro-hydraulic biped robot control in complex scenes. 1. A dynamic control method of electro-hydraulic double-foot humanoid robot position servo as priority force for observation and correction,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  performing dynamic simulation on the electro-hydraulic double-foot humanoid robot system,  analyzing the motion characteristic thereof,  obtaining the time-displacement curve and time-force curve of the hydraulic cylinder under any stable working condition,  verifying the one-to-one mapping relation of the time,  displacement and force under the ideal stable state,  determining the ideal reference target of the control;  S2,  based on the ideal mapping relationship of the step S1,  at the same time,  constructing a robot stress main body model and a hydraulic system model,  uniformly calibrating the performance parameters of the single-degree-of-freedom spring damping quality model of the mechanical system and the hydraulic system model,  eliminating the parameter dimension difference,  and establishing a model equation based on the force balance principle;  S3,  constructing a desired position input unit,  a desired force input unit,  a controller PID,  a digital-to-analogue converter DA,  a signal amplifier,  a pilot valve,  a main valve,  a valve control lever,  a control structure of the displacement sensor and the force sensor,  the feedback signals of the displacement sensor and the force sensor are connected to the controller PID;  S4,  performing the force observation and correction dynamic control of position priority,  comprising the following steps :  S4.1,  setting the control priority as the position servo,  taking the ideal mapping relation of the step S1 as the reference,  collecting the actual position of the hydraulic cylinder by the displacement sensor and comparing with the track planning target position to obtain the position deviation,  collecting the actual contact force by the force sensor and comparing with the expected force to obtain the force deviation;  S4.2,  inputting the position deviation and the force deviation into the controller PID to generate the digital control signal,  converting by the digital-to-analogue converter DA,  amplifying by the signal amplifier,  driving the pilot valve,  driving the main valve by the pilot valve to control the extension of the hydraulic cylinder,  realizing the position tracking;  S4.3,  monitoring the force deviation under the non-ideal working condition in real time,  if the actual contact force exceeds the preset safety threshold value,  the controller PID generates the correction signal,  through the digital-to-analogue converter DA,  the signal amplifier,  the pilot valve driving the main valve to adjust the position of the hydraulic cylinder,  reducing the contact force to the safety range;  S4.4,  circulating the steps S4.1 to S4.3,  reducing the dimensionless force deviation and dimensionless displacement deviation under the non-ideal working condition.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot collision detection method,  a humanoid robot collision detection system,  humanoid robot collision detection equipment and a storage medium,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control The method includes :  establishing a simplified dynamic model including gravity and friction; through experimental calibration,  the error function used to compensate for the inherent error of the model is obtained; during operation,  the joint angle and current are obtained in real time,  and the expected torque without external force is calculated by using the model and error function,  and compared with the actual torque to obtain the external torque estimate; when the external moment estimate exceeds the preset threshold calibrated through the force application experiment,  it is determined that a collision has occurred. This invention significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of collision detection based on joint current through the method of "theoretical model + experimental calibration error". It does not require additional force sensors or electronic skin,  reduces cost and complexity,  and has the ability to adapt through recalibration. Ability to change parameters. 1. A humanoid robot collision detection method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  dynamic modelling step :  obtaining the dynamic model of the human-shaped robot,  the dynamic model at least comprises the relation between the gravity item and the friction item and the joint angle,  expressed as tau model (theta) = G (theta) + F (theta),  wherein theta is the joint angle vector,  G (theta) is the gravity item,  F (theta) is the friction item,  tau model (theta) is the model calculation moment for maintaining the static or uniform motion of the joint when there is no external force;  error calibration step :  under the non-collision normal operation state of the humanoid robot,  an error function ferr (theta),  the error function is used for representing the deviation between the calculated moment tau model (theta) of the dynamic model and the moment tau real (theta) needed by the actual joint,  namely satisfying the relation :  [tau] real ([theta]) = [tau] model ([theta]) + ferr ([theta]);  a moment obtaining step :  in the working process,  obtaining the actual driving current Iactual of each joint of the human-shaped robot in real time,  and converting the actual driving current Iactual of each joint of the human-shaped robot into the actual joint driving moment Tactual according to the torque constant of the motor;  a collision judgment step :  calculating a model moment tau model (theta cur) and an error compensation value ferr (theta cur) based on the current joint angle theta cur;  calculating the external moment estimation value Text = Tactual - [Tmodel (theta cur) + ferr (theta cur)];  if the absolute value of the external moment estimation value Text of any joint exceeds the corresponding preset collision threshold Tth,  judging that the collision occurs.

The invention relates to a method for adjusting arc motion of a damaged multi-legged robot based on bionic gait space clustering The method comprises the following steps of :  establishing a gait acquisition experiment environment of the multi-legged organism,  and acquiring arc motion video data of the multi-legged organism with limb injury under different curvature conditions; use deep learning key point detection algorithm to construct key point time series data set and preprocess it; construct a gait state modeling framework through principal component analysis dimensionality reduction and autoregressive hidden Markov model; based on two-layer K-means clustering,  the gait space is condensed,  and a sports gait library of "curvature conditions-damage types-sports gait center" is constructed; gait characteristic parameters are extracted and mapped to Kuramoto oscillator network control parameters,  and stable phase coordination oscillation signals are generated to realize arc motion gait adjustment. The invention combines the bionic gait space clustering and the oscillator network to realize the gait adaptive adjustment of the injured multi-legged robot under different damage states and curvature conditions. 1. An arc motion adjusting method for bionic gait clustering damaged multi-foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the first step,  constructing gait data set based on multi-foot biological motion collection and key point detection technology;  (1) building a multi-foot biological gait collecting experiment environment,  under the preset different curvature condition,  guiding the multi-foot biological with limb damage to perform continuous arc motion,  through the high speed camera collecting the motion video data under different curvature condition and different damage condition;  (2) selecting the limb main key point and the foot tip position key point of the multi-foot organism,  adopting deep learning key point detection algorithm to construct the key point multi-element time sequence data set under different curvature and damage condition,  the data set comprises the space coordinate and confidence information of the key point in each time frame;  (3) pre-processing the key point time sequence :  performing interpolation compensation on the low-confidence coordinate,  introducing random disturbance to avoid fitting degradation,  performing translation processing with the centroid as the centre,  performing rotation alignment based on the body orientation,  obtaining a two-dimensional key point representation under a self-reference coordinate system;  the second step,  constructing attitude dimension reduction and gait state modelling frame;  (1) performing dimension reduction processing on the pre-processed key point coordinate sequence to obtain a low-dimensional continuous posture representation sequence;  expanding the aligned two-dimensional key point representation of each frame as attitude vector to form attitude data matrix;  performing main component analysis dimensionality reduction to the attitude data matrix and performing whitening conversion,  selecting the main component number whose accumulated interpretation variance reaches a preset threshold value,  and outputting a low-dimensional continuous attitude representation sequence;  (2) constructing and training self-regression hidden Markov model,  outputting discrete gait state label and continuous potential representation;  constructing an autoregressive hidden Markov model by taking the low-dimensional posture sequence as observation;  setting autoregressive order,  hidden state number and viscosity parameter;  performing iteration sampling or iteration deducing to the autoregressive hidden Markov model,  alternately updating the discrete gait state sequence corresponding to each time frame and the autoregressive dynamic parameter and state transfer parameter corresponding to each gait state;  after the model is converged,  outputting a discrete gait state label corresponding to each time frame,  a continuous potential representation corresponding to the discrete gait state,  and a state transfer matrix and a dynamic parameter set;  the third step,  based on the two-layer clustering to the gait space,  constructing a motion gait library;  stacking the continuous potential characterization according to the time frame to form a uniform low-dimensional posture sample set,  and grouping the low-dimensional posture sample set based on the arc motion curvature condition and the damage type label corresponding to the sample;  combining the discrete gait state label,  determining the representative motion gait centre corresponding to the curvature condition and the damage type through two layers of K mean clustering,  constructing a motion gait library of curvature condition-damage type-motion gait centre;  step ,  extracting the gait characteristic parameter based on the motion gait base and mapping it as the oscillator network control parameter;  (1) aiming at the motion gait centre corresponding to each curvature condition and damage type in the motion gait library,  based on the characterization of the motion gait centre in the low-dimensional attitude space,  extracting gait characteristic parameter for describing the motion gait rhythm and coordination relationship,  mapping as the control parameter of Kuramoto oscillator network,  constructing a parameter base of curvature-damage-oscillator control parameter covering high,  middle and low curvatures;  (2) when the curvature of the target arc track is non-preset curvature condition,  according to the target curvature and high curvature,  middle curvature,  performing interpolation or function fitting processing to the oscillator control parameter of the same damage type under the adjacent curvature condition to obtain the oscillator control parameter corresponding to the target curvature;  the fifth step,  using the oscillator network to generate the period control instruction,  realizing the damage multi-foot robot arc motion gait adjusting;  using the Kuramoto oscillator as the unit model of the central mode generator,  using the determined oscillator control parameter to construct the Kuramoto oscillator network,  generating the stable phase coordination oscillation signal corresponding to the target curvature and the target damage type;  converting the stable phase coordinated oscillation signal into a periodic control instruction of each leg actuator of the damage multi-foot robot,  so as to realize arc motion gait adjustment of the damage multi-foot robot under different damage states and different curvature arc tracks;  when the curvature of the arc track changes along with the time,  updating the control parameter of the oscillator according to the real-time curvature so as to realize the smooth gait transition between different curvature conditions.

The invention discloses a deceleration module for an intelligent robot with a body and a humanoid robot,  and relates to the field of intelligent technology with a body. The deceleration module for an intelligent robot with a body includes a housing,  a stator,  a reduction wheel set and a rotor. The housing is provided with There is a driving cavity and a first air outlet and a second air outlet connected to the driving cavity; the stator is fixed in the driving cavity; the reduction wheel set is installed on the housing; the rotor is installed in the driving cavity. The rotor includes a swivel ring and a connecting frame. The swivel ring is rotatably sleeved on the outer periphery of the stator. The connecting frame includes an inner disk and an outer ring. The inner disk is drivingly connected to the reduction wheel set,  and the outer ring is connected to the swivel ring.,  there are multiple guide blades distributed at intervals along the circumferential direction between the inner disk and the outer ring,  and the guide blades are arranged opposite to the stator in the axial direction. The technical solution provided by the present invention aims to improve the heat dissipation capacity of the deceleration module. 1. A deceleration module for intelligent robot with body,  wherein it comprises :  a shell,  wherein the shell is provided with a driving cavity and a first air port and a second air port connected with the driving cavity;  a stator fixed in the driving cavity;  a speed reducing wheel group,  the speed reducing wheel group is installed on the shell;  and a rotor,  the rotor is installed in the driving cavity,  the rotor comprises a rotating ring and a connecting frame,  the rotating ring is rotatably sleeved on the periphery of the stator,  the connecting frame comprises an inner disc and an outer ring,  the inner disc is in transmission connection with the speed reducing wheel group,  the outer ring is connected with the rotating ring,  a plurality of air guide blades distributed at intervals along the circumferential direction are arranged between the inner disc and the outer ring,  and the air guide blades are arranged opposite to the stator in the axial direction.

The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot and its leg structure The leg structure includes :  a hip joint module,  including a hip joint pitch drive module and a hip joint turnover drive module; the thigh module comprises a thigh body; knee joint module,  including knee joint pitch drive module; the calf module includes a calf body,  a first ankle joint driving module,  a second ankle joint driving module,  a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod; ankle-foot module,  including ankle support,  ankle cross,  and sole. 1. A leg structure of humanoid robot,  wherein the leg structure comprises :  a hip joint module (10),  comprising a hip joint pitching driving module (101) and a hip joint turnover driving module (102);  a thigh module (20),  comprising a thigh main body (201);  a knee joint module (30),  comprising a knee joint pitching driving module (301);  a shank module (40),  comprising a shank main body (401),  a first ankle joint driving module (402),  a second ankle joint driving module (403),  a first connecting rod (404) and a second connecting rod (405);  an ankle-foot module (50),  comprising an ankle supporting seat (501),  an ankle cross shaft piece (502) and a sole (503);  wherein,  the first mounting end (4041) of the first connecting rod (404) is connected with the first output end (4021) of the first ankle joint driving module (402) through the first swinging piece (60),  and the second mounting end (4042) of the first connecting rod (404) is connected with the ankle supporting seat (501);  the third mounting end (4051) of the second connecting rod (405) is connected with the second output end (4031) of the second ankle joint driving module (403) through the second swinging piece (70),  and the fourth mounting end (4052) of the second connecting rod (405) is connected with the ankle supporting seat (501);  and the first connecting rod (404) and the second connecting rod (405) are respectively provided with a first bending part (4043) and a second bending part (4053),  the first bending part (4043) and the second bending part (4053) are set close to the knee joint module (30),  and the first bending part (4043) and the second bending part (4053) are protruding towards the outer side of the shank main body (401).

The invention discloses a non-lethal disposal upper load suitable for a legged robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot application. The load has high remote safety. By controlling the robot dog,  the operator can complete the disposal from dozens of meters to hundreds of meters. Multi-module integration,  non-lethal disposal execution modules such as net gun,  strong light,  strong sound,  etc. are deployed collaboratively,  and the disposal method is flexible. Intelligent assisted aiming,  based on the target information (relative distance,  coordinates) output by the edge computing module and the crosshair of the control software,  greatly improves the launch accuracy. Reliable safety control,  software insurance,  mechanical insurance and emergency stop multi-level protection; it has wide applicability and is suitable for non-lethal disposal tasks in security,  fire protection and other fields. 1. A non-fatal treatment loading load suitable for foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises several non-fatal treatment execution modules,  a tripod head and an annular camera module,  an edge calculation module,  a communication module and a control module,  the structure unit is used for connecting with the self-carrying tool;  the tripod head and the surrounding camera module are used for realizing image collection;  the edge computing module is used for at least operating the target identification algorithm,  the target tracking algorithm,  the image splicing and classification identification algorithm;  and based on the image information and the target identification information provided by the tripod head and the environment camera module,  performing intelligent analysis and auxiliary decision to obtain auxiliary decision information;  said communication module is used for realizing the internal communication of the device,  the communication with the main body of the self-carrying tool and the communication with the control terminal;  The control module is configured to perform the following operations :  after receiving the control command entering the non-fatal load control mode sent by the control terminal,  detecting the air pressure and the insurance state and judging whether the module is normal;  determining that the state is normal,  starting the insurance and activating several non-fatal treatment execution modules;  receiving the treatment instruction sent by the operator through the operation terminal,  the treatment instruction at least comprises a target treatment mode,  the target treatment mode is any one of the treatment modes which can be realized by the non-fatal treatment execution module;  sending the treatment instruction to the corresponding non-fatal treatment execution module so that the corresponding non-fatal treatment execution module executes the non-fatal treatment action according to the treatment instruction and/or the auxiliary decision information.

The invention discloses an ROS Navigation-based wheel-legged robot dog navigation method and system The method and system combine high-precision odometer information provided by FastLIO and a newly added sensing layer in Costmap2D to identify the passable area using a sensing algorithm,  and use the Theta * algorithm as a global path planner to generate a smooth path. According to the invention,  through the integration of the technologies,  the problems of adaptability,  positioning stability and planning efficiency of the robot dog in a complex environment are effectively solved,  so that the high-efficiency and accurate navigation of the robot dog is realized,  and the reliability and the overall performance of the system are obviously improved 1. A wheel-foot robot dog navigation method based on ROS navigation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  inputting the high-frequency odometer information output by the FastLIO algorithm and the prior environment map of the robot dog to the self-adaptive Monte Carlo positioning algorithm,  obtaining the robot dog global pose estimation result with high precision after map matching correction;  step 2,  integrating the environment passable area information identified by the sensing algorithm in real time into the Costmap2D frame of the ROS Navigation,  obtaining the enhanced local cost map result fused with the obstacle information and passable area information;  step 3,  inputting the global pose estimation result and the pre-established static environment map to the global path planner,  searching the global path through Theta * algorithm,  obtaining a smooth global path result from the current position to the target point appointed by the user;  step 4,  the enhanced local cost map result and the smooth global path result are input to the local path planner,  through time elastic belt algorithm local track optimization and real-time obstacle avoidance,  finally output robot dog each joint actuator needed by the motion control instruction result.

The invention provides a sound source positioning method for a humanoid robot The invention relates to the technical field of data transmission,  and comprises a hardware module and a software module,  wherein the hardware module comprises a microphone array,  an acquisition unit and a signal processing board; and the software module comprises a voice signal preprocessing unit,  a microphone array time delay estimation unit and a microphone array position estimation unit The microphone array in the sound source localization module picks up the speech signal in the space and converts the speech signal into an electrical signal; the acquisition module converts the electrical signal into a digital signal and transmits it as an input signal to the signal processing board; the signal processing board processes and calculates the speech signal,  and transmits the obtained sound source position information to the host computer; the upper computer displays the position information of the sound source in real time 1. A sound source locating device for human-shaped robot,  wherein it comprises a hardware module and a software module,  the hardware module comprises :  a microphone for converting the picked voice signal into an electric signal;  a collecting unit connected with the electric signal of the microphone and used for converting the electric signal converted by the microphone into digital signal;  a signal processing board,  the software module is integrated on the signal processing board,  the software module comprises a voice signal pre-processing unit and a microphone array position estimation unit,  wherein :  a voice signal pre-processing unit connected with the electric signal of the collecting unit and used for pre-filtering the digital signal input by the collecting unit,  framing and windowing and detecting the end point;  a microphone array position estimation unit,  which is electrically connected with the voice signal pre-processing unit,  the information pre-processed by the voice signal pre-processing unit estimates the position of the sound source,  obtaining the position information of the sound source,  an upper computer,  which is electrically connected with the microphone array position estimation unit,  It is used for displaying the obtained sound source position information in real time.

The invention discloses an efficient intelligent network-connected inspection robot dog cluster collaborative control method,  and relates to the technical field of intelligent network-connected inspection robot dog cluster collaborative control; the method comprises the following steps :  constructing a network-connected inspection robot dog cluster system dynamic model composed of several quadruped robot dog single rigid body dynamic models affected by uncertain disturbances; based on the dynamic model of the network-connected inspection robot dog cluster system,  the equivalent motion tracking error system model is established; according to the equivalent motion tracking error system model,  an event-triggered distributed model predictive control method that adaptively adjusts the prediction time domain is designed; verify the recursive feasibility and closed-loop system stability of the control method. The method of the invention realizes the safe and stable control of the intelligent network-connected inspection robot dog cluster,  not only maintains the collaborative consistency of the robot dog cluster,  but also significantly reduces the communication and calculation load of the overall network,  and significantly improves the efficiency of complex inspection tasks. Operation efficiency,  system robustness and scene adaptability 1. A high-efficiency intelligent network inspection robot dog cluster cooperative control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a network patrol robot dog cluster system dynamics model,  the network patrol robot dog cluster system dynamics model is composed of several four-foot robot dog single rigid body dynamics models influenced by undetermined disturbance;  S2,  establishing an equivalent motion tracking error system model and a corresponding nominal tracking error system model based on the network patrol robot dog cluster system dynamics model;  S3,  according to the equivalent motion tracking error system model,  designing the optimization control problem of the four-foot robot dog control system based on the prediction time domain and the trigger time,  solving the optimization control problem as the model prediction controller;  designing an event triggering distributed model prediction control method for self-adaptively adjusting the prediction time domain based on the prediction time domain adjustment strategy and the event triggering mechanism;  and S4,  verifying the recursive feasibility and the closed-loop system stability of the event trigger distributed model prediction control method of the self-adaptive adjustment prediction time domain.

The invention discloses a composite anti-interference and anti-slip motion control method of a quadruped inspection robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot control; the method comprises the following steps :  establishing a quadruped robot single rigid body dynamic model influenced by uncertain disturbance and constrained by coulomb friction cone,  and correspondingly establishing a tracking error system model of quadruped robot equivalent motion; design an interference observer based on the tracking error system model to actively aggregate estimate and compensate for the interference caused by the external environment and internal uncertainty of the system; the predictive control method of composite disturbance rejection model is designed according to the tracking error model of quadruped robot's equivalent motion; to verify the recursive feasibility and closed-loop system stability of the composite disturbance rejection model predictive control method. The control method of the present invention can alleviate the adverse effects of multi-source uncertain interference on robot motion control,  improve the control accuracy of the robot,  and at the same time limit the foot end force within the feasible range of anti-slip,  and better maintain the posture stability of the robot. 1. A composite anti-interference and anti-skid movement control method of four-foot inspection robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  establishing a four-foot robot single rigid body dynamics model influenced by uncertain disturbance and limited by Coulomb friction cone,  and according to the four-foot robot single rigid body dynamics model,  establishing a tracking error system model of four-foot robot equivalent movement;  S2,  designing an interference observer based on the tracking error system model,  performing active lumped estimation and compensation on the interference caused by the external environment and the internal uncertainty of the system;  S3,  solving the design optimization control problem to obtain a model prediction controller,  based on the error design between the actual state and the nominal state affected by the interference,  obtaining an auxiliary controller,  based on the interference observer,  the model prediction controller and the auxiliary controller are used as the composite control input of the tracking error system model to design the composite anti-interference model prediction control method;  and S4,  verifying the recursive feasibility and the stability of the closed loop system of the prediction control method of the composite anti-interference model.

The invention relates to a four-legged robot weld crack detection method based on knowledge distillation and transfer learning,  which includes constructing a weld image data set by collecting weld images; build and train teacher models based on RT ‑ DETR architecture in the cloud; construct a lightweight student model based on the teacher model at the edge; introducing a channel projection operator to map the multi-scale intermediate features and multi-scale fusion intermediate features extracted by the teacher model to the same dimension as the multi-scale features and multi-scale fusion output feature maps extracted by the lightweight student model; establish the feature alignment loss and comprehensive distillation loss of the student model based on the distance between features,  and train the lightweight student model in combination with the student detection loss; design transfer learning based on feature alignment and adversarial training for student models; perform model deployment and incremental optimization. The invention realizes the lightweight deployment and continuous optimization of high-precision detection models,  and improves the detection reliability of quadruped robots in complex industrial environments. 1. A four-legged robot welding seam crack detection method based on knowledge distillation and migration learning,  wherein it comprises :  using the industrial camera carried by the four-foot robot to collect the welding line image,  pre-processing the collected welding line image,  constructing the welding line image data set by the pre-processed welding line image;  using the constructed welding line image data set,  constructing and training a target detection model as a teacher model based on RT-DETR framework at the cloud end;  the teacher model,  based on the Hungarian algorithm,  constructs the detection monitoring loss as the teacher prediction loss,  performing the training of the teacher model;  the teacher model uses the pre-processed welding line image as the input,  extracts the multi-scale middle feature through the convolution backbone network,  sends the multi-scale middle feature to the teacher coder to generate the multi-scale fusion middle feature,  inquires the vector,  sends the two to the teacher decoder to output the teacher prediction data;  at the same time,  the teacher attention matrix generated by the teacher encoder and the teacher decoder is fused to obtain the teacher attention matrix;  The teacher prediction data comprises :  prediction frame coordinate,  prediction type probability;  constructing a light weight student model at the edge end based on the teacher model;  the lightweight student model receives the pre-processed welding line image,  the multi-scale feature is extracted by the backbone network and sent to the student encoder,  the student attention matrix is extracted and the multi-scale fusion output feature image is generated,  a single polymerization feature image is constructed,  the information fusion module is used to process the single polymerization feature image,  at the same time,  respectively performing information fusion on the third layer characteristic and the fourth layer characteristic in the multi-scale characteristic and the single aggregation characteristic graph,  respectively sending the three characteristic graphs processed by the information fusion module to a student decoder,  generating student detecting data;  the information fusion module comprises multiple rolling layers,  an upper sampling layer,  a characteristic splicing layer and a RepC3 module;  The multi-scale feature comprises :  a third layer characteristic,  a fourth layer characteristic and a fifth layer characteristic;  The student detection data comprises :  detecting frame coordinate,  detecting type probability;  introducing a channel projection operator inside the light weight student model,  mapping the multi-scale intermediate feature to the same feature dimension as the multi-scale feature,  minimizing the L2 distance between the multi-scale feature and the mapped multi-scale intermediate feature,  at the same time,  introducing a feature alignment coefficient for each scale layer,  constructing characteristic alignment loss;  constructing characteristic distillation loss based on multi-scale fusion intermediate characteristic and multi-scale fusion output characteristic graph,  constructing attention distillation loss based on teacher attention matrix and student attention matrix,  constructing output layer distillation loss based on teacher prediction data and student detection data;  the characteristic distillation loss,  the attention distillation loss and the output layer distillation loss are combined to form a comprehensive distillation loss;  constructing an overall target function of the light weight student model based on the student detection loss,  characteristic alignment loss and comprehensive distillation loss,  primarily training the light weight student model;  performing migration learning based on cross-scene feature alignment and countermeasure training on the light weight student model after preliminary training;  the light weight student model after migration learning is led out and deployed to the four-foot robot,  realizing real-time online welding seam crack detection,  at the same time,  the four-foot robot returns data to perform incremental optimization to the teacher model,  so as to realize continuous optimization of the light weight student model.

The invention discloses a track updating method,  a track updating device,  an electronic device and a computer program product The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring detection frame groups and prediction frame groups of a to-be-tracked video,  wherein each detection frame group comprises a combined face and humanoid detection frame,  a non-combined humanoid detection frame or a non-combined face detection frame; and each prediction frame group comprises a combined face and humanoid prediction frame,  a non-combined humanoid prediction frame or a non-combined face prediction frame Calculate the joint loss of each detection frame group and each prediction frame group respectively to obtain the first joint loss matrix; based on the first joint loss matrix,  Hungarian matching is performed on each detection frame group and each prediction frame group to obtain matching results. The matching results include :  matching detection frame groups and prediction frame groups,  unmatched detection frame groups and/or unmatched detection frame groups. 7. ABSTRACT OF THE INVENTION The patent disclosure covers System,  Design and Method of Development of Human following Robot Using Arduino and Ultrasonic Sensors. The development of autonomous robots capable of following a human has numerous ap plications,  ranging from personal assistance to security and entertainment. This project of cusses on the design and implementation of a human-following robot using Arduino as the main control unit and ultrasonic sensors for distance measurement. The primary objective is to build a robot that can detect and track a human target by maintaining a consistent and safe following distance. The robot integrates multiple ultrasonic sensors to continuously measure the distance between itself and the person in front of it. Ultrasonic sensors open ate by emitting high-frequency sound waves and measuring the time taken for the waves to reflect back from an object. This information is used to calculate the precise distance between the robot and the human target. The Arduino microcontroller processes the sensor data and controls the robot's motors accordingly,  adjusting speed and direction to. follow the person smoothly. The system uses simple algorithms to interpret sensor readings,  filter noise,  and make real-time decisions for navigation. When the human moves forward,  the robot increases its speed to maintain proximity;  when the human stops or moves backward,  the robot slows down or halts to avoid collision. The robot is equipped with differential drive motors to allow smooth turns and maneuvering in various environments. This project highlights the challenges of human detection and tracking using basic sensors and micro controllers,  including dealing with environmental noise,  sensor inaccuracies,  and obstacle avoidance. Despite these challenges,  the prototype demonstrates effective human following in controlled indoor settings. The use of Arduino makes the design cost-effective and accessible for hobbyists and educational purposes. Overall,  the human-following robot project showcases the integration of sensor technology,  microcontroller programming,  and robotics to create an autonomous system that interacts dynamically with a human subject. This technology can be further enhanced with advanced sensors and artificial intelligence to improve reliability and adaptability for real-world applications such as personal assistance for the elderly or disabled,  automated delivery systems,  and interactive robotic companions

The invention provides a navigation control method,  a navigation control device,  navigation control equipment and a navigation control medium for a foot robot. The navigation control method comprises the following steps of :  carrying out passing judgment on a scanning field of view area of the foot robot to obtain a passable area and an inpassable area; rasterizing the passable domain to obtain multiple passable grid units; generate a local cost map based on the cost value corresponding to each passable grid unit; through the local cost map,  global trajectory planning is carried out based on the current position point and the target position point to obtain a collision-free planned path; performing three-dimensional environment scanning on the impassable area to obtain original area point cloud; and performing point cloud screening on the original regional point cloud to obtain an obstacle point cloud; through the obstacle point cloud,  global speed planning is carried out based on the current position point and the target position point to obtain moving speed information; based on the moving speed information,  the legged robot is controlled to move from the current position point to the target position point according to the collision-free planned path. So as to effectively improve the robot navigation accuracy. 1. A foot-type robot navigation control method,  wherein it comprises :  judging the passing of the scanning visual field of the foot-type robot,  obtaining the passing field and non-passing field of the foot-type robot corresponding to the scanning visual field;  rasterizing the passable area in the scanning view area to obtain a plurality of passable grid units;  and generating a local cost map based on the cost value corresponding to each passable grid unit;  according to the local cost map,  based on the current position point and the target position point of the foot-type robot,  performing global track planning on the foot-type robot,  obtaining the non-collision planning path of the foot-type robot from the current position point to the target position point;  performing three-dimensional environment scanning to the non-passable area in the scanning visual field area to obtain the original area point cloud containing terrain feature;  and performing point cloud screening on the point cloud of the original area based on a preset non-passable policy,  obtaining an obstacle point cloud in the scanning field of view area;  through the obstacle point cloud,  based on the current position point and the target position point of the foot-type robot,  performing global speed planning on the foot-type robot,  obtaining the moving speed information of the foot-type robot from the current position point to the target position point;  controlling the foot robot to move from the current position point to the target position point according to the non-collision planning path based on the moving speed information.

The present invention belongs to the field of robot technology A method and system for autonomous following of leg-foot robots are proposed The legged robot equipped with lidar communicates with the mobile terminal to be followed Both the leg-foot robot and the mobile terminal carried by the patrol personnel are equipped with UWB modules. First,  the target points of the mobile terminal are converted to the robot coordinate system,  and the voxels of the lidar three-dimensional point cloud are downsampled and the near-field points are screened. After filtering the height,  it is projected into a two-dimensional obstacle boundary point set,  and the obstacle points are expanded; combining the lateral and co-directional safety thresholds,  the minimum value is taken to obtain the effective safety distance,  and the accessibility of the target point is judged. When safe,  the optimal intermediate point is selected from the obstacle gap to generate the trajectory. The invention improves the stability and safety of autonomous following of the leg-foot robot in a complex environment,  reduces the calculation load,  and enhances the rationality of path planning. 1. An autonomous following method of leg and foot robot,  wherein the leg and foot robot is configured with a laser radar sensor,  the control terminal of the leg and foot robot is in communication connection with the mobile terminal to be followed,  comprising the following steps :  obtaining the target signal of the mobile terminal,  converting the target point represented by the target signal to the coordinate system of the leg-foot robot;  obtaining the three-dimensional point cloud data of the laser radar sensor and pre-processing it;  representing the pre-processed three-dimensional point cloud data as a two-dimensional obstacle boundary point set,  expanding each obstacle point in the two-dimensional obstacle boundary point set to obtain an expanded obstacle point;  determining the effective safety distance of the expansion obstacle point in the target direction,  if the distance between a certain expansion obstacle point and the centre of the leg-foot robot is less than the effective safety distance,  then considering that the obstacle corresponding to the expansion obstacle point is located in the dangerous area between the leg-foot robot and the target point,  so as to judge that the target point cannot be directly reached;  if all the expansion obstacle points are greater than or equal to the effective safe distance,  the target point is regarded as safe and reachable;  when the target point is regarded as safe and reachable,  searching the gap between the adjacent points in the boundary point of the two-dimensional barrier,  obtaining the optimal middle point in the gap,  and generating the following motion track of the leg robot according to the starting point,  the middle point and the target point of the robot.

The invention discloses an optimization-based robot variable stiffness vision-impedance control method and system Establish the coordinate conversion relationship between the camera,  the six-dimensional force sensor and the end of the robot Calibrate the six-dimensional force sensor,  analyze the interactive dynamic relationship between the robot and the environment,  and construct a mathematical model of the robot-environment interaction. A robot variable stiffness vision-impedance control method based on optimization,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S100 :  establishing the coordinate conversion relationship between the camera and the six-dimensional force sensor and the robot end,  at the same time,  calibrating the six-dimensional force sensor,  through the force calibration algorithm,  compensating the zero drift of the sensor itself and the tool gravity;  S200 :  considering the dynamics characteristic of the robot under the stress state,  comprising the guiding force exerted by the human and the reaction force of the environment,  and combining the kinematics and dynamics equation of the robot,  and the visual servo acceleration equation,  constructing the human-robot-environment interaction dynamics model in the complete characteristic space;  S300 :  based on the dynamic model,  a human guide force model is established in the characteristic space,  the visual characteristic is associated with the robot motion and a reference track is generated,  a variable stiffness visual impedance controller is designed,  the stiffness matrix is optimized online through QP to ensure that the contact force is constant and the moment constraint is satisfied,  deducing system equation to realize external force convergence,  constructing energy function analysis stability;  S400 :  according to the stability analysis result,  introducing online optimization based on energy tank enhanced rigidity,  constructing energy tank state equation and upper and lower limit constraint to limit active energy injection,  establishing secondary planning QP model,  under the passive constraint,  optimizing the rigidity parameter in real time and ensuring that the total energy is bounded,  performing the non-source analysis by constructing the system storage function; Arm and humanoid robot collaborative assembly scenarios 1. A compliant control method based on impedance parameter dynamic reconstruction,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  based on the impedance control of the position,  constructing the dynamic association relation between the actual position of the assembling device and the force tracking error,  combining the robot position tracking precision,  quantifying the interaction relation between the assembling device and the environment;  S2 :  obtaining a steady-state force tracking error based on the dynamic correlation,  and optimizing the obtained steady-state force tracking error;  S3 :  based on the change of the environment parameter,  dynamically updating the impedance parameter,  and generating the parameter adjusting signal through the force error feedback,  using the bounded function to limit the parameter change range,  realizing the flexible control of the whole scene of the complex part assembly.

The invention provides an auditory-visual collaborative humanoid robot head orientation method,  and relates to the technical field of robots. S1,  an environmental sound signal is collected through a microphone array distributed on the robot head,  and the initial orientation of a sound source is estimated; s2. Obtain target image information through the visual sensor installed on the robot head and extract candidate target areas; s3. A human-shaped robot head orientation method with visual cooperation,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  collecting the environmental sound signal through the microphone array distributed on the head of the robot,  and estimating the initial orientation of the sound source;  S2,  obtaining the target image information through the visual sensor installed on the head of the robot,  and extracting the candidate target area;  S3,  jointly processing the sound source orientation and the visual information based on the hearing visual fusion algorithm of the time sequence modelling to obtain the target direction;  S4,  when the confidence of the fusion result is insufficient,  controlling the robot head to perform active detection to enhance the positioning reliability;  S5,  according to the target direction,  driving the multi-degree-of-freedom executing mechanism of the robot head to finish natural and stable steering.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot control,  and specifically discloses a household intelligent humanoid service robot control system,  which includes :  an environment sensing module collects children's asymptotic approach trajectories,  contact positions,  pressure changes and robot operating status data to establish an environment sensing stream; the evolutionary analysis module performs spatiotemporal coupling evolutionary analysis on the environment perception flow,  extracts the contact representation vector and determines whether there is intention-oriented feature evolution; the intent inference module generates interactive intent labels and dynamic confidence through irreversibility verification; the compliance control module determines the target compliance parameters through linear interpolation based on the intent label and confidence. A household intelligent humanoid service robot control system,  wherein it comprises the following modules :  an environment sensing module :  based on the interactive scene of the robot and the children,  collecting the environment interactive data of the children gradually approaching to the robot,  establishing the interactive environment sensing flow;  an evolution analysis module :  it is used for performing space-time coupling evolution analysis to the environment sensing flow and extracting the asymptotic contact characterization vector;  performing intention guide type evolution analysis on the contact characterization vector,  judging whether there is intention guide type characteristic evolution;  an intention deducing module :  if so,  performing the irreversible check processing of the intention guide result to the contact characterization vector,  performing the fusion inference processing to the robot main body state and the child contact action based on the check result,  generating the interactive intention tag and the dynamic confidence degree;  a compliance control module :  based on the interactive intention label and the dynamic confidence,  outputting the dynamic compliance instruction and self-adaptively adjusting the robot.

A humanoid robot motion control method based on intensive learning and Sim2Real migration,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S01 :  constructing a robot model based on physical engine,  comprising terrain friction,  inertia,  noise and collision characteristics,  and setting joint angle and speed upper limit;  SO.SUB. 2 :  adopting PPO algorithm to learn motion strategy in simulation environment;  S03 :  designing a reward function for guiding strategy learning stable and efficient gait;  SO.SUB. 4 :  the parameter disturbance is introduced in the training so as to reduce the actual difference;  S05 :  deploying the simulation strategy to the real robot,  and integrating the safety mechanism.

The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid robot task planning method,  a humanoid robot and a storage medium The method comprises the following steps of :  matching a pre-constructed behavior tree according to an acquired task instruction; control the humanoid robot to execute the task action sequence of the task instruction according to the behavior tree; when the working condition information obtained in real time meets the preset abnormal conditions,  the execution of the behavior tree is suspended and the state machine corresponding to the abnormal conditions is started; control the humanoid robot based on the state machine; when the abnormal state is removed and the recovery conditions are met,  exit the state machine and resume the execution of the behavior tree until the entire action sequence of the task instruction is completed. Therefore,  this application can effectively improve the working efficiency of humanoid robots in dealing with daily work and abnormal scenes. 1. A human-shaped robot task planning method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  matching the pre-constructed behaviour tree according to the obtained task instruction;  controlling the human-shaped robot to execute the task action sequence of the task instruction according to the behaviour tree;  when the real-time obtained working condition information satisfies the preset abnormal condition,  pausing the execution of the behaviour tree,  starting the state machine corresponding to the abnormal condition;  controlling the humanoid robot based on the state machine;  when the abnormal state is relieved and the recovery condition is satisfied,  the state machine is exited and the execution of the behaviour tree is recovered until all action sequences of the task instruction are finished.

A method for quickly generating non-speech teaching behaviour of cross-platform humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S1,  performing discretization modelling on the non-speech teaching behaviour in the typical teaching scene,  decomposing the continuous action parameter in the video image into discrete action basic elements,  and constructing an action dictionary based on the action basic elements;  S2,  using a language synthesizer to generate a voice sequence for the teaching content text,  using a synthesizing module to generate an action sequence for the voice sequence,  and mapping the action sequence into an action joint parameter according to the action dictionary;  S3,  mapping the motion joint parameters to motion parameter spaces supported by different platform robots to generate motion parameters supporting cross-platform robots;  S4,  mapping the robot action parameter to the robot kinematics parameter of the teaching scene based on the reinforcement learning.

A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PREDICTIVE AND ADAPTIVE CONTROL OF A HUMANOID PLATFORM The present invention provides a Predictive Adaptive Humanoid Control System designed to enable highly stable,  responsive,  and intelligent locomotion and interaction in humanoid platforms. The system integrates multi-modal sensor data,  including proximity,  joint-position,  pressure,  visual,  auditory,  and gesture inputs,  to generate a synchronized real-time state estimate of the humanoid. A model-predictive control module computes future locomotion trajectories,  while a heuristic path-optimization engine determines efficient navigation paths,  even in dynamic or obstacle-filled environments. The system further employs adaptive state-updating logic to maintain balance,  minimize path deviation,  and ensure smooth joint actuation. Experimental results demonstrate 0% overshoot,  1.8-second settling time,  improved path accuracy,  and fast perceptual responses including gesture,  speech,  and face recognition. Overall,  the invention delivers a computationally efficient,  real-time control framework that significantly enhances the stability,  adaptability,  and autonomy of humanoid robotic platforms. The invention discloses a humanoid robot flexible power cable anti-fatigue design simulation system and a humanoid robot flexible power cable anti-fatigue design simulation method,  and relates to the technical field of robots The humanoid robot flexible power cable anti-fatigue design simulation system and method can accurately predict the fatigue damage of the cable in a complex working environment through multi-field coupling simulation,  cross-scale damage modeling,  multi-objective optimization and virtual verification,  and provide an efficient simulation platform for the anti-fatigue design of the cable. It specifically includes :  multi-field coupling and critical positioning module,  cross-scale damage modeling module,  multi-objective optimization module,  virtual verification and iteration module. The multi-modal data of cable deformation,  frictional heat generation and resistivity change are dynamically generated through multi-physics coupling simulation,  the evolution process of cable damage is analyzed,  and the design parameters are optimized to improve the fatigue durability of the cable. 1. An anti-fatigue design simulation method for flexible power cable of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the time sequence data of the joint movement of the human-shaped robot,  constructing a cable dynamic coupling simulation model,  dynamically generating a cable deformation field through finite element simulation,  friction heat field and multi-mode associated data set of conductor resistivity change field,  and locating the energy gathering critical area coordinate of the cable twisting gap and the sheath bending part;  S2,  inputting the multi-modal associated data set and the critical area coordinate to the pre-trained cross-scale damage analysis model,  analyzing the space-time mapping relation between the macroscopic strain energy density gradient distribution of the cable critical area and the microcosmic crack expansion characteristic,  generating the cable damage weight distribution map;  S3,  based on the cable damage weight distribution map,  performing multi-scale cooperative optimization to the cable stranded pitch gradient distribution,  the thickness non-uniform design at the bending part of the sheath and the interlayer friction coefficient through multi-target dynamic optimization algorithm,  and outputting the cable structure parameter set with optimal fatigue resistance;  S4,  inputting the anti-fatigue optimal cable structure parameter set into the cable dynamic coupling simulation model to perform virtual acceleration life test,  evaluating the anti-fatigue index of the cable,  if the anti-fatigue index of the cable is greater than or equal to the preset threshold value,  triggering the parameter correction of the cross-scale damage analysis model and re-iterating,  until the anti-fatigue index of the cable is less than the preset threshold;  The specific process of obtaining the time sequence data of the joint movement of the human-shaped robot and constructing the cable dynamic coupling simulation model is as follows :  the angular displacement,  angular speed and time sequence load spectrum of the motion track are collected in real time by the human-shaped robot joint sensor,  and the joint motion mode is established based on the time sequence analysis;  according to the cable geometrical topology and the material non-linear property,  combining the cable assembling path and the motion freedom degree to construct the cable dynamic coupling simulation model,  simulating the mechanical response of the cable under the joint high dynamic working condition;  applying the variable load boundary condition in the simulation model,  simulating the influence of different working conditions to the cable deformation and stress distribution,  defining the interlayer dynamic contact boundary condition and the friction thermal coupling equation,  outputting the primary simulation data set;  The specific process of analyzing the space-time mapping relationship between the macroscopic strain energy density gradient distribution in the critical area of the cable and the microcosmic crack propagation characteristics is as follows :  embedding the crystal plasticity sub-model in the finite element model,  simulating the copper conductor grain dislocation movement and micro-crack initiation in the critical area;  extracting macroscopic strain energy density gradient field,  and establishing nonlinear mapping of microcosmic crack expansion rate through migration learning algorithm;  defining the space-time correlation weight function,  quantizing the contribution degree of the microcosmic defect to the macroscopic damage accumulation;  the specific process of performing multi-scale cooperative optimization on the cable stranding pitch gradient distribution,  the thickness non-uniform design at the bending part of the sheath and the interlayer friction coefficient through the multi-target dynamic optimization algorithm is as follows :  constructing a multi-target game optimization frame with anti-fatigue performance,  light weight and electrical stability;  searching Pareto optimal solution in twisting pitch gradient,  sheath thickness distribution and friction coefficient space through self-adaptive non-dominated sequencing genetic algorithm;  avoiding the local inferior solution by the dynamic constraint condition,  generating a design parameter set satisfying multiple targets in balance.

According to the embodiment of the invention,  the working efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved,  and the humanoid robot can be widely applied to the technical field of robots 1. A method for generating dynamic behaviour of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  performing dynamic modelling processing on the multi-joint dynamic characteristic of the humanoid robot to obtain a multi-joint dynamic model;  obtaining the robot state of the human-shaped robot,  operating the operation state and environment task information of the operator of the human-shaped robot,  and fusing the multi-joint dynamic model to construct a state parameter set;  constructing according to the multi-joint dynamics model to obtain the multi-dimensional reward function of the humanoid robot;  performing strategy optimization processing on the humanoid robot according to the multi-joint dynamic model and the multi-dimensional reward function,  outputting to obtain the dynamic game action in accordance with the physical rule;  controlling the motion of the joint of the humanoid robot according to the dynamic game action;  the multi-dimensional reward function of the humanoid robot is constructed according to the multi-joint dynamics model,  comprising :  calculating and processing the position deviation between the tail end of the humanoid robot and the target part according to the multi-joint dynamic model to obtain the task completion degree reward;  quantifying the distance between the humanoid robot and the operator according to the multi-joint dynamic model to obtain a safety reward;  calculating the ratio of the external contact force of the human-shaped robot to the preset threshold value according to the multi-joint dynamic model to obtain the contact force comfort reward;  quantifying the action response time of the humanoid robot according to the multi-joint dynamic model to obtain game adaptability reward;  weighting and summing the task completion degree reward,  the security reward,  the contact force comfort reward and the game adaptability reward to obtain the multi-dimensional reward function.

The invention discloses a reinforcement learning-based leg and arm multiplexing control method and a reinforcement learning-based leg and arm multiplexing control device for a hexapod robot,  and relates to the field of motion control The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring observation information of a target hexapod robot; input the observation information into the control strategy model to obtain the expected joint angle of the target hexapod robot; the control strategy model is obtained according to the constructed multi-task training environment,  using reinforcement learning method,  and updating the training architecture strategy based on the value network; the training architecture is determined based on teacher-student privilege learning; the value network includes a shared feature layer and a multi-task header connected in sequence; the training architecture includes :  state estimation encoder,  terrain information encoder,  privilege information encoder,  historical information encoder and ontology network; the PD control method is used to determine the joint moment based on the desired joint angle to control the leg-arm multiplexing of the target hexapod robot. A leg-arm multiplexing control method of six-foot robot based on intensive learning,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the observation information of the target six-foot robot;  the observation information is input to the control strategy model to obtain the expected joint angle of the target six-foot robot;  the control strategy model is obtained by updating the strategy of the training framework based on the value network by the reinforced learning method according to the constructed multi-task training environment;  the dynamic motion coupling operation task mode is used for synchronously executing the joint track tracking of the base speed instruction and the appointed foot end executor;  the robust training mechanism is used for simulating the external disturbance environment by applying any direction impulse to the root of the target six-foot robot in the base movement training; The present disclosure provides a deep reinforcement learning-based robot arm motion control strategy network training method and device,  which relates to the field of sensor and robot technology. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a Jacobian submatrix corresponding to a robot arm in a deep reinforcement learning training environment; calculate the operability index in the current pose based on the product between the Jacobian submatrix and the transpose matrix of the Jacobian submatrix; enter the operability index into the activation function to obtain the penalty factor; scaling the difference between the current action output by the policy network and the action at the previous moment based on the penalty factor to obtain the penalty term,  and using the penalty term as part of the reward function to train the policy network. This disclosure enables the policy network to identify and actively avoid singular postures during the training process by introducing an adaptive penalty mechanism based on operability,  thereby improving the stability of robot arm motion control. 1. A robot arm motion control strategy network training method based on deep reinforcement learning,  wherein it comprises :  in the deep strengthening learning training environment,  obtaining the Jacobian sub-matrix corresponding to the robot arm;  based on the product between the Jacobian sub-matrix and the transposed matrix of the Jacobian sub-matrix,  calculating the operability index under the current posture;  inputting the operable degree index into an activation function to obtain a penalty factor;  wherein when the operability index is less than a preset operability threshold,  the activation function has a mapping segment that increases the penalty factor as the operability index decreases;  scaling the difference between the current action output by the strategy network and the last action based on the penalty factor to obtain a penalty item,  and using the penalty item as a part of the reward function for training the strategy network.
