The invention discloses a self-adaptive gait control method,  system,  equipment and medium of a quadruped robot in a limited space,  and belongs to the technical field of gait control. The self-adaptive gait control method comprises the following steps of :  extracting a terrain feature vector; identify terrain categories through classifiers and obtain initial gait parameters from the gait library; adjust the gait parameters according to the terrain slope and roughness to obtain optimized gait parameters; calculate stability metrics and fuse scores; determine an adjustment strategy to modify gait parameters based on the instability pattern when the score is below the threshold; generate foot end trajectories and perform control; feedback the post-execution information to terrain awareness to form a closed loop The present invention improves the accuracy of terrain recognition through multi-modal information fusion The adaptive mapping from terrain to gait is established to realize automatic gait switching and parameter optimization. Multi-index fusion is used to evaluate stability and a targeted adjustment strategy is selected according to the instability mode,  which solves the problem of adaptive gait control in complex terrain in limited space and improves movement efficiency and stability. 1. A self-adaptive gait control method of four-foot robot in limited space,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  collecting the reaction force information of each leg,  the attitude angle information of the machine body and the depth image information of the front terrain;  respectively extracting the contact force distribution characteristic,  the posture change characteristic and the space structure characteristic from the supporting reaction force information,  the posture angle information and the depth image information,  and combining them into a terrain characteristic vector;  inputting the terrain feature vector to a classifier to obtain terrain type;  obtaining the corresponding basic gait mode from the gait base according to the terrain type,  obtaining the initial gait parameter in the basic gait mode;  extracting the terrain gradient value and the terrain roughness value from the terrain feature vector,  adjusting the stepping parameter in the initial gait parameter according to the terrain gradient value,  adjusting the ground parameter in the initial gait parameter according to the terrain roughness value,  obtaining the optimized gait parameter;  calculating a stability index based on the optimized gait parameter,  fusing the stability index to obtain a comprehensive stability score;  when the comprehensive stability score is lower than the safety threshold,  determining an adjusting strategy according to the numerical value of the stability index,  and correcting the optimized gait parameter according to the adjusting strategy;  generating foot end track of each leg according to the modified optimized gait parameter,  converting the foot end track into joint angle instruction through inverse kinematics and executing control;  and feeding back the measured reaction force information and attitude angle information to the extraction process of the terrain feature vector.

The invention provides a global path planning method and system for a wheel-legged robot in multiple motion modes,  and relates to the technical field of robot path planning. The method includes :  obtaining multi-source data of the wheel-legged robot; calculate the actual value of the motion cost of the wheel-legged robot under various motion modes in different terrains; build a deep learning network model; through the deep learning network model,  the predicted value of motion cost is output; construct a loss function and optimize the deep learning network model with the goal of minimizing the function value of the loss function; through path planning algorithm,  the global map is sampled to generate an undirected graph; through the optimized deep learning network model,  the predicted value of motion cost between each sampling point in the undirected graph under different motion modes is output; determining a plurality of intermediate sampling points through a heuristic search algorithm; the initial sampling point,  each intermediate sampling point and the target sampling point are connected in sequence to obtain the global path of the wheel-legged robot in various motion modes. 1. A global path planning method under multi-motion mode of wheel-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  S1 :  obtaining the state data of the wheel-foot robot,  the local height map around the machine body and the motion command from the starting position to the target position under multiple motion modes in different terrains;  S2 :  according to the state data,  calculating the actual value of the motion cost of the wheel-foot robot in multiple motion modes in different terrains;  S3 :  constructing a deep learning network model;  S4 :  respectively inputting the local altitude map around the machine body,  various motion modes and motion command to the deep learning network model,  and outputting the motion cost predicted value of the wheel-foot robot under multiple motion modes in different terrains;  S5 :  according to the motion cost actual value and the motion cost predicted value,  constructing a loss function,  and taking the minimum function value of the loss function as the target,  optimizing the deep learning network model;  S6 :  sampling the global map by the path planning algorithm to generate an undirected graph;  S7 :  through the optimized deep learning network model,  outputting the motion cost predicted value between each sampling point in the non-directed graph under different motion modes;  S8 :  according to the motion cost predicted value of each sampling point under different motion modes,  determining multiple intermediate sampling points through heuristic search algorithm,  and recording the motion mode corresponding to each intermediate sampling point into the intermediate sampling point attribute;  S9 :  connecting the initial sampling point,  each intermediate sampling point and the target sampling point in sequence to obtain the global path of the wheel-foot robot in multiple motion modes.

 in the cross-ditch mode,  based on the topographic map,  generating a wheel foot rotation propulsion instruction,  the front wheel field angle expansion,  the wheel foot rotation propulsion crossing obstacle in turn;  S4 :  dynamic stability checking and correction pre-processing :  according to the current gravity centre position of the robot,  evaluating the obstacle crossing stability,  if there is overturning risk,  automatically adjusting and setting;  the S1 further comprises performing multi-source data fusion on the obstacle height distribution extracted by the laser radar,  the gradient change parameter,  the surface roughness calculated by the foot end pressure sensor,  and the step height or groove width measured by the visual sensor,  generating the height,  roughness,  the three-dimensional grid map of the obstacle type is used as the topographic map;  The parameter setting in the climbing mode comprises :  according to the step height H in the topographic map,  generating a wheel foot lifting pushing instruction,  controlling the hydraulic cylinder to ,  In order to lift the margin,  lift the supporting height of the front wheel,  at the same time,  based on the projection position of the robot mass centre,  plan the lifting time sequence of the back wheel foot,  make the wheel foot climb over the step by the action sequence of front wheel lifting-front wheel extending-back wheel following.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot navigation,  and specifically relates to a humanoid robot navigation method based on visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection. A visual sensor is used to synchronously obtain the RGB map and depth map of the current environment of the humanoid robot,  and a laser radar is used to collect point cloud data.; semantically segmenting the pre-processed RGB image; radar point cloud obstacle detection; the semantic segmentation graph and laser point cloud graph are fused,  Bayesian decision-making is introduced to determine whether it is passable,  and then the fusion cost value is calculated to obtain the fusion cost map; the RRT */TEB algorithm is used to output the optimal path; use a nonlinear optimization solver to generate a foothold sequence accurate to each step; this invention constructs a "semantic-geometric" two-dimensional navigation cost model; deep binding of Bayesian reasoning and navigation scenarios improves navigation adaptability in unstructured environments; the navigation method is suitable for humanoid robots,  has low energy consumption,  low navigation deviation and high safety. 1. A humanoid robot navigation method based on visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection,  wherein the specific steps comprise :  Step 1 :  the environment sensing data collection uses the visual sensor to synchronously obtain the RGB image and depth image of the current environment of the humanoid robot,  and uses the laser radar to collect the point cloud data;  Step 2 :  Data pre-processing and feature extraction 1) visual data pre-processing and feature extraction to the RGB image distortion correction and de-noising;  performing cavity filling and scale conversion on the depth map,  converting the pixel distance into the actual physical distance;  extracting the nearest barrier point of each line in the depth map,  keeping the height characteristic of the barrier;  2) laser point cloud pre-processing point cloud de-noising :  the collected point cloud data is filtered by the voxel to reduce the redundant point and keep the key geometrical characteristic;  then performing ground segmentation and barrier clustering on the key geometrical characteristic,  extracting the external rectangular parameter of the barrier;  Step 3 :  Visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection 1) visual semantic segmentation :  using the SegFormer-B2 network model based on the converter and the known material attribute to perform semantic segmentation on the pre-processed RGB image to obtain the semantic segmentation image with the material attribute;  2) radar point cloud obstacle detection :  according to the external rectangular parameter and IMU data of the obstacle obtained in the step 2,  realizing laser-inertial navigation tight coupling through LIO-SAM algorithm,  optimizing the point cloud pose precision,  generating a laser point cloud map,  then performing obstacle judgment,  marking "tranleasable barrier" or "non-tranleasable barrier";  Step 4 :  multi-source information fusion and cost map construction :  firstly dividing the RGB image obtained by the visual sensor and the point cloud data collected by the radar into grid units of 0.1m * 0.1m;  then fusing the visual semantic segmentation image and the laser point cloud image of the radar,  introducing Bayesian decision to judge whether each grid can pass,  marking " safe path ",  " cautious path " then calculating the fusion cost value of each grid marked with the safe path and the cautious path to obtain the fusion cost map;  Step 5 :  the path planning uses the RRT* algorithm to plan the global path planning and the TEB algorithm to plan the local path planning,  and the optimal path is cooperatively output by combining the differential barrier judging logic with the semantic label and the fusion cost;  step 6 :  The footprint sequence generation uses non-linear optimization solver to combine ground material characteristic and barrier geometric information on the basis of local path to generate footprint sequence which is accurate to each step,  so that the robot can keep stable in complex environment and can advance with high efficiency;  Specifically :  The method comprises the following steps :  firstly,  according to the step length corresponding to the current ground material,  equidistantly dividing the local path into multiple sections,  wherein the end point of each section is used as the candidate landing point;  then checking the obstacle information corresponding to each candidate point,  if there is a crossing obstacle in the front,  adjusting the position of the foot falling point of the step and setting the corresponding foot lifting height;  if the barrier cannot be crossed,  the mark is that it needs to be crossed,  the upper layer path is used for planning and re-calculating the local path;  after determining the position of the landing point,  calculating the direction of the tiptoe according to the steering curvature of the local path,  the range is generally between 0 degree and 30 degrees,  so as to ensure the stability when turning or crossing;  the output result is a group of falling foot point information arranged according to the time sequence,  comprising the three-dimensional coordinate of each step and the direction angle of the tiptoe,  the result is directly transmitted to the gait control module of the humanoid robot,  realizing the closed-loop control from the path planning to the actual walking.

The present disclosure provides a robot arm motion control method,  device,  equipment,  robot and medium,  and relates to the field of sensor and robot technology. The method includes :  predicting the singular value decomposition result of the Jacobian matrix through a deep learning model to obtain a direction vector set and a corresponding singular value sequence; based on the singular value sequence and the sensitivity threshold,  the direction vector is divided into two subsets corresponding to the non-near singular direction and the near singular direction respectively; decompose the input vector of the expected velocity on two subsets respectively to obtain the first direction component and the second direction component; a scaling process is performed on the second direction component,  and a velocity of each joint in the joint space is calculated based on the first direction component and the scaled second direction component The present disclosure can achieve stable and precise motion control when the robot arm is close to a singular configuration,  and reduce computational complexity while ensuring the control effect,  thereby reducing resource occupation and improving computing efficiency. 1. A robot arm motion control method,  wherein it is applied to the main controller of the robot,  the method comprises :  predicting the singular value decomposition result of the original Jacobi matrix representing the mapping relation between the joint space and the task space of the robot arm through the deep learning model,  obtaining the direction vector set and the singular value sequence related to each direction vector in the direction vector set;  based on the singular value sequence and the sensitivity threshold,  determining a first subset of the set of directional vectors corresponding to non-adjacent singular directions and a second subset corresponding to adjacent singular directions;  decomposing the input vector representing the expected speed in the task space on the first sub-set and the second sub-set to obtain the first direction component and the second direction component;  performing scaling processing on the second directional component,  and obtaining the speed of each joint in the joint space based on the first directional component and the scaled second directional component.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control,  and specifically relates to a humanoid robot motion control method based on footprint planning. The present disclosure provides a training method and device for a humanoid robot walking control model,  and relates to the field of sensor and robot technology. The method includes :  predicting the expected foot position at the next moment based on the foot position corresponding to the current training sample and the motion control instruction; determining a plurality of candidate landing locations within a sampling neighborhood of the expected landing location; obtaining terrain feature data in the coverage area of each candidate landing position,  and calculating the flatness index of each candidate landing position based on the terrain feature data; the candidate landing position with the optimal flatness index is determined as the target landing position of the current training sample,  which is used to train the humanoid robot walking control model. The invention discloses a wheel-legged robot climbing control method and system based on attitude and torque optimization Relates to the field of robot control technology. The method includes :  using the center of gravity of the robot trunk as the centroid,  constructing a static model of the wheel-legged robot on the slope,  and quantitatively analyzing the impact of the robot's center of gravity projection,  wheelbase and station height on the torque distribution of the front and rear wheels.,  establish a torque distribution ratio formula; to achieve torque balance,  determine the optimal center of gravity projection distance ratio,  wheelbase and station height; during the actual climbing process of the wheel-legged robot,  the projection position of the center of gravity of the robot's trunk is obtained in real time,  and the posture of the wheel-legged robot is adjusted according to the projection position,  so that the projection position always falls within the safe area of the supporting polygon. At the same time,  according to the projection position,  combined with the optimal center of gravity projection distance ratio,  wheelbase and station height,  the output of the torque of the front and rear wheels of the wheel-legged robot is adjusted to achieve stable climbing. The invention can solve the problems of rollover and slipping of wheel-legged robots that often occur during the process of traveling on slopes. 1. A wheel-foot robot climbing control method based on posture and torque optimization,  wherein it comprises :  taking the gravity centre of the robot body as the rectangular centre,  constructing the static mechanical model of the wheel-foot robot on the slope surface,  quantitatively analyzing the gravity centre projection of the robot,  the influence of the shaft distance and the station height to the torque distribution of the front and back wheels,  and establishing the torque distribution ratio formula;  based on the torque distribution ratio formula,  taking the torque balance as the target,  determining the optimal gravity centre projection distance ratio,  the wheelbase and the station height;  in the actual climbing process of the wheel-foot robot,  the projection position of the gravity centre of the robot trunk is obtained in real time,  the posture of the wheel-foot robot is adjusted and controlled according to the projection position,  such that the projection position always falls in the safety area supporting the polygon,  at the same time,  according to the projection position combined with the optimal gravity centre projection distance ratio,  the wheelbase and the station are high,  the output of the torque of the front and back wheels of the wheel-foot robot is regulated to realize stable climbing.

The invention relates to a legged robot body sensing odometer method based on factor graph optimization,  which is applied to the field of motion sensing and positioning of legged robots Legged robots can use body sensors to estimate their own motion status The present invention uses multiple sensors of the body to jointly estimate its own state The relative pose factor of the body is obtained through pre-integration of the torso inertial measurement unit IMU The INS factor of the hybrid foot inertial navigation system is obtained by pre-integration of the foot IMU,  the positive kinematics model factor and the pre-integrated hybrid hinge contact model factor are obtained by using the joint angle sensor,  and the sensor factors are fused under the factor graph optimization framework and the optimal motion state estimate is obtained through distance constraints. A leg-type robot main body sensing odometer method based on factor graph optimization,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  establishing a world coordinate system (w) and a motion odometer state variable xi,  installing an industrial-level IMU on the back trunk of the leg-type robot,  the trunk IMU coordinate system is overlapped with the robot main body coordinate system to establish a coordinate system (b),  installing the consumption-level IMU on the leg connecting rod of the robot contacted with the ground,  establishing a coordinate system (c) at the foot end contacted with the ground;  step two :  collecting the main body sensing data,  and obtaining the posture,  speed and position state of the leg-type robot by using the strap-down inertial navigation algorithm and positive kinematics algorithm;  at the same time,  according to the key frame of the last time and the data of the key frame of the current time,  performing the pre-integral calculation to obtain the relative pose factor of the machine body,  the mixed foot INS pose factor and the mixed hinge contact model pose factor;  step three :  deleting the earliest added key frame node in the graph optimization node,  adding the current key frame state into the graph optimization node,  connecting a one-element positive motion pose factor and a distance constraint factor on the new node,  connecting a two-element body relative pose factor between the last key frame node and the new node,  mixing the foot INS pose factor,  mixing the hinged contact model pose factor and then optimally estimating the state of each node.

The invention relates to the field of robot control and intelligent algorithms,  in particular to a multi-perception intelligent humanoid five-finger dexterous hand,  which comprises a multi-modal perception module,  a path generation module,  a control module and a response optimization module The multi-modal sensing module collects object characteristics,  generates fine three-dimensional contours and matches the database to obtain multi-modal data; the path generation module discrete contour screening candidate contact points,  embedded sequence quadratic programming to solve the optimal contact point,  combined with differential geometric path planning to generate an initial grabbing path curve; the control module adjusts the joint angle based on the finger motion model and Newton-Raphson method,  and cooperates with the reinforcement learning and force-position hybrid control algorithm to output the optimal control torque; the response optimization module iteratively outputs the time compensation of each link through the chaotic gray wolf optimization algorithm to optimize the response time. The invention improves grasping stability,  accuracy and real-time performance,  and is suitable for industrial precision assembly or human-machine cooperation and other scenes. 1. A multi-sensing intelligent humanoid five-finger smart hand,  comprising a multi-mode sensing module,  a path generating module,  a control module and a response optimizing module,  wherein the multi-mode sensing module collects the object characteristic and location through the sensor,  generates the object fine three-dimensional outline and matches with the preset outline of the database to obtain the object multi-mode data;  the path generating module selects the candidate contact point of the contact area based on the fine three-dimensional outline of the object,  obtains the constraint parameter and embeds the optimal contact point of the sequence secondary planning solving object,  and generates the initial grabbing path curve by the constraint parameter and the object multi-mode data through the differential geometric path planning algorithm;  the control module adjusts the finger joint of the five-finger dexterous hand through the finger motion model and Newton Lavson numerical method,  outputs the optimal joint angle sequence,  generates a grabbing instruction based on the initial grabbing path curve and the optimal joint angle sequence,  the initial grabbing moment is adjusted by the reinforced learning and force position mixing control algorithm to obtain the optimal control moment;  the response optimizing module calculates the initial adaptation degree and updates the different wolf group positions by the chaotic initialization wolf group,  disturbs the position and iteratively outputs the time compensation of each link and optimizes the response time.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot adaptive anti-interference recovery method based on reinforcement learning enhanced hierarchical model predictive control The reinforcement learning decision-making module receives user instructions,  robot status and model predictive control parameters The first-layer MPC parameters and the second-layer MPC parameters enhanced by the output strategy after training,  the first layer of MPC combined with kinetic constraints,  the multi-step foothold sequence is optimized and updated by the first-layer MPC parameters enhanced by the output strategy and the event trigger signal. The second-layer MPC combines the first-layer model to predict and control the optimized robot state,  the optimized and updated multi-step foothold sequence and the output strategy. Enhanced second-layer MPC parameters optimize the contact wrench of the multi-step foothold sequence. The invention can improve the walking disturbance recovery agility and adaptive balance ability of the humanoid robot in complex terrain and external disturbances. 1. A humanoid robot motion self-adaptive disturbance rejection recovery method based on hierarchical model predictive control of enhanced learning enhancement,  wherein the reinforced learning decision module receives the user instruction,  the robot state and the model prediction control parameter,  and outputs the first layer of model prediction control parameter and the second layer of model prediction control parameter reinforced by the strategy after training;  prediction control of the first layer model :  combining the dynamic constraint,  optimizing and updating the multi-step landing point sequence by the first layer model predictive control parameter and event trigger signal enhanced by the output strategy;  prediction control of the second layer model :  combining the multi-step landing point sequence and the robot state after the first layer model predictive control optimization update,  outputting the second layer model predictive control parameter with enhanced strategy,  optimizing the contact spanner of the multi-step landing point sequence.

The invention discloses an electric power inspection device and method based on a humanoid robot. The device includes a humanoid robot and a terminal host computer. The humanoid robot includes an upper limb module,  a lower limb module,  a head module and a control module; the upper limb module is equipped with a partial discharge sensor,  a vibration sensor,  a distance sensor and a pressure sensor; the head module includes at least a binocular camera,  lidar and near field communication module; the control module is configured to obtain the data of each sensor and transmit it to the terminal host computer through communication,  and is configured to receive the control signal from the terminal host computer,  and control each module to perform inspection on the optimal path according to the control signal. According to the invention,  the humanoid robot is utilized to realize the mobile self-adaptive polling and predictive polling capabilities of the power equipment,  and a high-cost fixed monitoring system is replaced 1. A power polling device based on humanoid robot,  comprising a humanoid robot and a terminal upper computer,  wherein the humanoid robot comprises an upper limb module,  a lower limb module,  a head module and a control module;  the upper limb module is provided with a partial discharge sensor,  a vibration sensor,  a distance measuring sensor and a pressure sensor;  the partial discharge sensor collects the partial discharge data of the preset partial discharge monitoring point position in the preset area,  the vibration sensor collects the vibration data of the preset partial discharge monitoring point position,  the distance measuring sensor measures the distance between the reference position of the upper limb module and the preset partial discharge monitoring point position,  the pressure sensor measures the acting force when the upper limb module is contacted with the preset partial discharge monitoring point;  the head module at least comprises a binocular camera,  a laser radar and a near field communication module,  the laser radar is configured to obtain an electronic map of the preset area,  the binocular camera is configured to obtain image data and perform target identification and ranging,  the near field communication module is configured to sense a near field signal of a monitoring point bit and read and write a near field communication tag;  The control module is configured to acquire the data of each sensor and transmit the data to the terminal upper computer in communication,  and is configured to receive the control signal from the terminal upper computer,  and control each module to perform polling by the optimal path according to the control signal.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot collaborative control Specifically,  it is a humanoid robot body intelligent collaborative control system based on multi-modal perception fusion The system includes a multi-modal perception fusion module to identify target boundary positions,  analyze pressure changes,  and combine posture extraction of audio features to generate an environment perception map The dynamic timing adjustment module optimizes the action rhythm adjustment details to generate an execution plan,  the cross-modal behavior correction module corrects the offset optimization trajectory to generate a coordination sequence,  the task priority allocation module analyzes the task allocation to generate an execution list,  and the timing conflict correction module optimizes the path adjustment conflict to generate a coordination path The present invention constructs an environment perception map through multi-source perception data matching and fusion Dynamically adjust the action sequence and interval to optimize the execution chain,  correct trajectory offset to improve action accuracy,  real-time task allocation to achieve nearby response and load balancing,  path rearrangement and timing coordination to reduce conflicts and congestion,  form a closed loop of perception decision-making execution,  and improve recognition accuracy and collaboration efficiency. 1. A humanoid robot body intelligent cooperative control system based on multimodal sensing fusion,  wherein the system comprises :  a multi-modal sensing fusion module,  through visually identifying the boundary and position of the target object,  extracting the force sense pressure change characteristic,  combining the attitude information to analyze the inclination angle and the rotation amplitude,  extracting the frequency wave point and amplitude value change in the audio,  integrating the time and space distribution of the multi-modal data,  generating an environment sensing image;  a dynamic time sequence adjusting module,  based on the environment sensing image,  analyzing the state change track of the target object,  extracting the execution time node and sequence of the robot action,  optimizing the time distribution and execution rhythm between the actions,  adjusting the execution priority and modifying the robot action chain,  generating an optimized action execution plan;  a cross-modal action correction module,  invoking the optimized action execution plan,  extracting the offset value and action amplitude in the robot action track,  analyzing the target object dynamic position and track difference,  adjusting the offset direction and amplitude,  optimizing the track precision,  correcting the abnormal action,  generating action coordination action sequence;  a task priority distribution module,  based on the behavior coordination action sequence,  extracting the current task state and position distribution of the robot,  analyzing the distance between the robot and the task target object and the task matching condition,  preferentially distributing the key task to the robot with the highest matching degree,  adjusting the task content and order of the robot,  generating a robot task execution list.

A robot screw hole assembly method and system based on force feedback and displacement detection belongs to the field of robot automatic assembly The method comprises the following steps of :  controlling the tail end of the robot to move to a coarse positioning position of the screw hole; control the tip to perform contact movement in the assembly direction; obtaining the force component of the end six-dimensional force sensor in the assembly direction and the actual displacement of the end in real time; judging the contact state between the assembling tool and the screw hole based on the logical combination of the force component and the actual displacement; if it is judged that the tool only contacts the surface of the workpiece but does not enter the hole,  control the end to return and reposition; if it is determined that the tool has entered the screw hole,  the tool is controlled to perform tightening operations. The invention does not rely on high-precision visual positioning,  uses force and displacement information to intelligently determine the contact state,  solves the problem of assembly failure caused by robot positioning errors and visual errors,  and has the advantages of strong robustness,  good versatility,  simple implementation and low cost.,  especially suitable for precise assembly tasks of humanoid robots and industrial mechanical arms 1. A robot screw hole assembling method based on force feedback and displacement detection,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  controlling the tail end of the robot to carry the assembling tool to move to the pre-set rough locating position above the target screw hole;  S2 :  controlling the tail end of the robot to perform contact movement to the position where the screw hole is along the direction vertical to the surface of the workpiece;  S3 :  in the contact moving process,  obtaining the first direction force component detected by the six-dimensional force sensor installed at the tail end of the robot in real time,  and the actual displacement of the tail end of the robot;  wherein the first direction is the direction of the contact movement;  S4 :  based on the first direction force component and the actual displacement,  judging the contact state of the assembly tool and the screw hole;  S5 :  according to the judging result of the contact state,  executing the corresponding assembly control strategy;  wherein if it is judged that the assembly tool has entered the screw hole,  the assembly tool is controlled to perform a tightening operation;  if it is judged that the assembling tool only contacts with the surface of the workpiece and does not enter the screw hole,  controlling the tail end of the robot to retract and re-executing the step S1.

The invention belongs to the technical field related to medical robots,  and discloses a rigid-flexible coupling pneumatic humanoid dexterous finger and dexterous hand The dexterous finger includes a segmented bellows actuator,  a rigid cover plate,  a rigid base plate,  a flexible finger pulp patch,  and a unidirectional stretchable fabric; a cooperative structure of "rigid support-flexible drive-contact adaptation" is formed through preset assembly relationships; by designing the wave number of the bellows at each joint of the pneumatic dexterous finger,  it is ensured that the bending ratio of each joint conforms to the movement law of the human hand; unidirectional stretchable fabrics can suppress ineffective bulges at joints and improve energy conversion efficiency. The dexterous hand can integrate five dexterous fingers of anthropomorphic size. The angle of the palm notch,  the angle of the thumb rotation direction and the flexible palm patch all reproduce the physiological characteristics and structure of the human hand. The invention realizes the anthropomorphism of the pneumatic dexterous hand in appearance and movement mode,  takes into account flexibility and load-bearing stability,  and can adapt to the needs of multiple scenarios such as medical care and industrial assembly. 1. A rigid-flexible coupling pneumatic humanoid dexterous finger,  wherein comprising a segmented bellows actuator (1),  a rigid cover plate (2),  a rigid bottom plate (3),  a flexible finger abdomen patch (4),  a one-way stretchable fabric (10),  the straight pipe section of the segmented bellows actuator (1) is clamped and fixed on the rigid cover plate (2),  between the rigid bottom plate (3),  the corrugated pipe section of the segmental corrugated pipe actuator (1) is arranged at the joint corresponding position of the flexible finger;  adjacent rigid bottom plates (3) are hinged;  the one-way stretchable fabric (10) is coupled to the back side of the rigid bottom plate (3);  the one-way stretchable fabric (10) can be stretched along the axial direction of the finger and cannot be stretched along the radial direction of the finger;  The flexible finger abdomen patch (4) is coupled to the contact side of the rigid bottom plate (3).

The invention discloses an anti-electromagnetic interference design method for a wheel-legged humanoid robot in an industrial scene,  and specifically relates to the field of robot technology. It includes :  S1. Constructing a dynamic following electromagnetic shielding structure; s2. Establish a hybrid-driven heterogeneous spectrum filtering system; s3. Implement cross-level electromagnetic compatibility collaborative design; s4. Optimize the cable wiring and grounding system of the whole machine Adopt layered bundling and directional wiring strategies And apply the hybrid grounding model,  among them,  the low-frequency circuit is grounded at a single point,  and the high-frequency circuit is grounded at multiple points The subsystem is connected to the central grounding point through a low-impedance grounding bus. This method can effectively improve the robot's anti-electromagnetic interference ability,  avoid electromagnetic leakage,  enhance the overall electromagnetic compatibility of the system,  and reduce common mode interference and ground loop effects,  thereby ensuring control accuracy and operational stability. 1. An anti-electromagnetic interference design method of wheel-foot humanoid robot in industrial scene,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a dynamic following electromagnetic shielding structure,  the dynamic following electromagnetic shielding structure is configured as a stepped shielding cover set for the encoder magnetic ring in the robot rotating joint,  through the stepped shielding cover to form a Faraday cage;  S2,  establishing a mixed driving heterogeneous map filtering system,  performing independent power supply and filtering design on the wheel type driving system and the foot type joint driving system of the robot;  S3,  implementing cross-level electromagnetic compatibility collaborative design,  establishing a three-level electromagnetic compatibility model,  respectively performing electromagnetic compatibility collaborative design on the element level,  the sub-system level and the whole machine level three-level layer of the robot;  S4,  performing complete machine cable wiring and grounding system optimization,  the robot internal wiring strategy adopts layered binding and directional wiring,  the robot internal further has a mixed grounding model,  the mixed grounding model comprises a low frequency circuit and a high frequency circuit,  the low frequency circuit adopts single point grounding,  the high frequency circuit adopts multi-point grounding,  and the sub-system of the robot is connected to the central grounding point through the low-impedance grounding bus.

The invention discloses a shank structure of a humanoid robot,  which comprises a knee joint module,  an ankle joint module and a frame,  wherein the modules are connected in sequence according to the position sequence of human joints and have three degrees of freedom; each joint is driven by a direct current motor; and a mechanical limit is arranged to ensure safety The frame is presented in the form of a humanoid robot thigh shell; the knee joint module includes a first knee joint link,  a second knee joint link,  a gear set and a DC motor; the ankle module includes a calf link,  an ankle left transmission link,  an ankle right transmission link,  a first left motor link,  a second left motor link,  a first right motor link,  a second right motor link,  an ankle universal joint,  a gear set,  and two DC motors 1. A shank structure of humanoid robot,  wherein It comprises a knee joint module,  an ankle joint module and a machine frame,  each module is connected in turn according to the position of the human body joint,  it has three degrees of freedom,  each joint is driven by a direct current motor,  and a mechanical limit is set to ensure safety. the machine frame is presented in the form of a human-shaped robot thigh shell (1);  the knee joint module comprises a first knee joint connecting rod (5),  a second knee joint connecting rod (6),  a gear set and a direct current motor;  the ankle joint module comprises a first left motor connecting rod (10),  a second left motor connecting rod (11),  a first right motor connecting rod (12),  a second right motor connecting rod (13),  an ankle joint left driving connecting rod (14),  an ankle joint right driving connecting rod (15),  a shank connecting rod (16),  an ankle joint universal joint (17),  a gear set and two direct current motors.

The invention belongs to the cross-technical field of robot intelligent control and energy management. Specifically,  it is an adaptive energy-saving control method for a robot servo system based on a task power spectrum. It includes the following steps :  establishing a task power spectrum model based on multi-modal sensor data fusion,  and quantifying the robot task. dynamic characteristics; establish a multi-physical field coupling loss model including the motor loss model and the power device loss model. Based on the power spectrum model and the loss model,  the bus voltage and PWM switching frequency are collaboratively optimized to determine the optimal operating point parameter combination; the variable parameter adaptive predictive control algorithm is used to realize smooth parameter switching; through a three-layer control architecture including cognitive layer,  decision-making layer and execution layer,  as well as a four-domain collaborative optimization mechanism in time domain,  frequency domain,  energy domain and thermal domain,  the global energy efficiency optimization and control performance guarantee of the system are realized. The present invention adopts multi-physics coupling modeling to improve the prediction accuracy under extreme working conditions,  avoids performance degradation of traditional methods,  and improves the robust performance of the system. 1. A self-adaptive energy-saving control method of robot servo system based on task power spectrum,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  establishing a task power spectrum model T (omega) based on the multi-mode sensor data fusion so as to quantize the dynamic characteristic of the robot task;  step S2 :  establishing a multi-physical field coupling loss model including a motor loss model and a power device loss model,  based on the task power spectrum model and the multi-physical field coupling loss model,  cooperatively optimizing the bus voltage V and the PWM switching frequency f,  determining the optimal working point parameter combination ;  step S3 :  through the variable parameter self-adaptive prediction control algorithm,  based on the optimal working point parameter combination (V,  f) and the system real-time state,  determining the system time-variable parameter vector theta (k),  and establishing the parameter change state space model,  so as to solve the control input vector u (k);  step S4 :  based on the output of the steps S1 to S3,  executing the four-domain cooperative optimization through the three-layer control framework,  executing the dynamic self-adaptive energy-saving control circulation.

A design method of a hexapod robot belongs to the field of robot design In order to solve the problems of instability,  slipping or failure to overcome obstacles of existing robots in complex terrain such as slopes,  cross slopes,  ravines,  etc. The lack of systematic size-terrain constraint analysis cannot guarantee the passability of the robot under extreme working conditions. The invention is based on the spatial layout of the body and supporting legs of the hexapod robot to be designed,  the geometric size parameters of the hexapod robot and the working space of the supporting legs According to the walking conditions of the hexapod robot,  the analytical constraint relationship between the geometric size parameters and terrain parameters of the hexapod robot is established respectively,  and then the geometric size parameters of the hexapod robot are designed based on the analytical constraint relationship. Ensure that the hexapod robot has stable movement passability in complex terrain. The six-legged robot designed based on this method can significantly enhance its terrain adaptability to complex field environments while maintaining structural strength and overall stability. 1. A design method of six-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  a spatial layout of the machine body and the supporting leg based on the six-foot robot to be designed,  the geometric size parameter of the six-foot robot and the working space of the supporting leg,  aiming at the walking working condition of the six-foot robot,  respectively establishing the analysis constraint relation between the geometric size parameter of the six-foot robot and the terrain parameter,  so as to design the geometric size parameter of the six-foot robot based on the analysis constraint relation;  the walking working condition comprises one or more of slope climbing,  horizontal slope walking,  ravine crossing,  obstacle crossing,  slope steering and ravine-obstacle combination working condition;  aiming at the slope climbing working condition,  the transverse slope walking working condition and the slope steering working condition,  determining the analytic constraint relation through the stable margin;  aiming at the working condition of crossing the ravine and the working condition of crossing the obstacle,  respectively determining the analytic constraint relation through the width of the limit ravine and the height of the limit obstacle;  aiming at the combined working condition of ravine-obstacle,  determining the analytic constraint relation through the width of the limit ravine and the height of the limit obstacle.

A multi-objective optimization design method of a hexapod robot based on multi-constraint aims to solve the problem that the foot robot optimization method fails to consider real field terrain conditions,  so that the foot robot may fail due to driving overload,  structural interference or foot end slipping when moving in the field environment This invention uses terrain passability constraints combined with the terrain conditions,  terrain indicators and geometric parameters to be optimized of the hexapod robot to be executed to calculate the optimal body size of the hexapod robot that satisfies the terrain passability constraints Then according to the leg size constraints of the hexapod robot,  taking the minimum value of the joint peak force and joint peak power under the leg size constraints as the optimization goal,  the non-dominated sorting algorithm is used to obtain the optimal leg size. In this way,  the optimal structure of the hexapod robot is obtained. The invention optimizes the body size and leg structure size of a hexapod robot through terrain adaptability constraints and multiple real physical constraints,  and belongs to the field of robot design. 1. A multi-target optimization design method of six-foot robot based on multi-constraint,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  determining the geometric parameter to be optimized of the six-foot robot;  S2,  determining the kinematics relationship between the foot end and the leg joint of the six-foot robot;  S3,  constructing terrain passing constraint,  setting the terrain condition to be executed by the six-foot robot,  terrain index and geometric parameter range value to be optimized,  combining S2 to calculate the optimal body size of the six-foot robot under the terrain passing constraint;  S4,  setting the leg size constraint of the six-foot robot based on S1 and S3,  so as to satisfy the minimum value of the joint peak stress and the joint peak power under the leg size constraint as the optimization target,  using the non-dominated sequencing algorithm to obtain the optimal leg size;  and obtaining the optimal size structure of the six-foot robot according to S3 and S4.

A humanoid robot motion control method based on gait planning and reinforcement learning,  which belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot motion control. The invention solves the problems of slow convergence speed in the training process of the existing reinforcement learning method,  and poor stability and reliability of the trained model. The invention enables the reinforcement learning model to run in parallel under multiple environment instances. During the operation process,  the target foothold is generated in real time based on the fed-back state information,  and the generated reference foothold and the centroid trajectory are used as the action reference or reward target of the controller. Combined with gait phase information,  a continuous and dynamically adjusted foot end trajectory is constructed After training the reinforcement learning model using all the collected trajectory data,  the motion control of the humanoid robot can be carried out through the trained reinforcement learning model,  so that the robot can achieve stable walking similar to humans without relying on predefined templates. The method of the invention can be applied to the motion control of humanoid robots 1.  step one,  initializing training algebra ;  step ,  initializing training steps ;  step ,  obtaining the state information of the humanoid robot under the current environment example,  and calculating the expected landing point of the current swinging leg of the humanoid robot according to the obtained state information;  step ,  constructing the observation quantity of the actor network and critic network in the reinforced learning model according to the expected landing point of the swinging leg;  step ,  the actor network outputs the action according to the observation quantity and calculates the expected moment output by the controller according to the action output by the actor network;  step ,  the humanoid robot reaches a new state under the action of the expected moment output by the controller;  calculating the reward value according to the updated state information;  step 17,  judging whether it reaches the first a total number of training steps of the generation;  if it reaches the first The total number of training steps to be taken in the generation shall be based on calculating the accumulated return and advantage function value by the reward value of each training step of the generation,  updating the parameters of the actor network and the critic network according to the calculated accumulated return and advantage function value,  and then executing the step ;  if not if the environment is terminated,  initializing the terminated environment,  and determining whether the environment is terminated;  returning to execute step ,  if the environment is not terminated,  executing step ;  step ,  judging whether it is necessary to re-plan the landing point;  If there is a need to replan the landing point,  returning to execute step ;  If there is no need to replan the landing point,  directly returning to step ;  step ,  judging whether the total training algebra is reached;  if reaching the total training algebra,  obtaining all track data in each generation training process,  and continuing to execute step two;  If the total training algebra is not reached,  returning to execute step one and step two;  step two,  randomly scrambling all the track data collected in the step one,  dividing the randomly scrambled track data into several batches,  training the reinforced learning model by using the divided track data;  when the total loss function value of the reinforced learning model is converged,  stopping training,  obtaining the trained reinforced learning model,  using the trained reinforced learning model to perform motion control on the humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a positioning anomaly capturing method for an intelligent humanoid robot with a body. The positioning anomaly capturing method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring visual information of scenes around the robot; input the obtained visual information into a pre-trained model,  extract several features in the scene,  and construct a scene semantic map based on the extracted several feature information. The scene semantic map includes each feature and its pose in the map; obtain the current positioning pose of the robot,  and determine the target characteristics that the robot should theoretically recognize at the current position from the scene semantic map; judging whether there are some features that should not be recognized at the current positioning pose of the robot,  or those that should be recognized at this time but not at the current positioning pose of the robot; if yes,  it is determined that the positioning is abnormal and the positioning correction process is executed; if not,  the positioning is determined to be normal. The robot can quickly and accurately capture and locate anomalies,  and can cope with complex and changeable scenes with high dynamics. 1. A locating abnormality capturing method of intelligent humanoid robot with body,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the visual information of the scene around the robot;  inputting the obtained visual information into a pre-trained model,  extracting multiple features in the scene,  constructing a scene semantic map according to the extracted multiple feature information,  wherein the scene semantic map comprises each feature and the position in the map;  obtaining the current positioning pose of the robot,  determining the target feature to be identified by the robot in the current position theoretically from the scene semantic map;  judging whether there is a certain number of features which should not be identified at the current positioning pose of the robot,  or which should be identified at the current positioning pose of the robot but not at this time;  if so,  judging that the location is abnormal and executing the location correction flow;  if not,  judging the location is normal.

The invention discloses an intelligent mobile robot television. The utility model discloses a magnetoelectric encoder circuit with a protection function Including a power supply and protection module,  a signal acquisition and coding module,  and a signal conditioning and protection module The power supply and protection module are electrically connected to the external DC power supply Carry out input protection and step-down processing on the voltage from the external DC power supply To obtain the processed voltage,  and the processed voltage is transferred to the signal acquisition and coding module and the signal conditioning and protection module to supply power to both The signal acquisition and coding module is electrically connected to the external permanent magnet Collecting the magnetic field signal of the permanent magnet,  coding the magnetic field signal to obtain coded electric signal,  transmitting the coded electric signal to the signal conditioning and protection module,  and performing differential processing and anti-static processing on the coded electric signal successively The utility model can solve the technical problem that the volume of the existing encoder is too large and it is difficult to be applied to the application scene of the humanoid robot. 1. A magneto-electric encoder circuit with protection function,  comprising a power supply and protection module,  a signal collecting and encoding module,  and a signal conditioning and protection module,  wherein the power supply and the protection module are electrically connected with the external direct current power supply,  performing input protection and voltage reduction processing on the voltage from the external direct current power supply,  so as to obtain the processed voltage,  and transmitting the processed voltage to the signal collecting and coding module and the signal conditioning and protecting module to supply power for the two;  the signal collecting and coding module is electrically connected with the external permanent magnet for collecting the magnetic field signal of the permanent magnet and coding the magnetic field signal to obtain the coded electric signal and transmitting the coded electric signal to the signal regulating and protecting module;  the signal conditioning and protecting module performs differential processing and anti-static processing on the coded electric signal from the signal collecting and coding module to obtain the processed electric signal.

A robot motion control model training method and a robot motion control method. The robot motion control model training method comprises :  on the basis of the state of a training robot at the current moment,  making a decision by using a policy network of a motion control model to be trained,  so as to obtain training control instructions and training hidden variables of a future preset number of frames,  wherein the preset number of frames is greater than 1,  and the training hidden variables are random variables that are unobservable but play a role in the decision-making and prediction of said model (S101);  on the basis of the training hidden variables,  using a decoding network of said model to perform prediction,  so as to obtain a predicted state of the robot at a future preset moment,  wherein the preset moment is determined on the basis of a parameter update period of said model (S102);  using a simulation engine to sequentially execute the training control instructions of the preset number of frames,  so as to obtain the actual state of the robot (S103);  and on the basis of the predicted state of the robot at the preset moment and the actual state of the robot,  updating parameters of the policy network and the decoding network of said model,  so as to obtain a trained motion control model (S104). The model predicts future robot states that are closer to actual robot states,  thereby improving the stability of robot control.

The invention aims to perform faster and more effective interventions with the cooperation of humanoid robots,  flying vehicles and expert personnel for intervention.

At the same time,  the modular design facilitates integration,  which improves the operability,  adaptability and intelligence level of the humanoid dexterous hand. 1. The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots,  and provides a hollow bionic neck structure of a simulated humanoid robot and an implementation method thereof. The structure includes a bionic neck component,  and the bionic neck component is composed of multiple vertebrae bionic units connected in series through flexible connectors Wherein,  the vertebral bionic unit imitates the human cervical vertebra structure,  and its interior is a hollow structure; the outer side of the bionic neck component is sleeved with an epidermal bionic layer for providing temperature and pressure touch feedback. The invention simulates human cervical vertebrae through segmented vertebral bionic units and flexible connectors,  realizes multi-degree-of-freedom compliant movement,  and overcomes the stiff feeling of traditional robot driving. Moreover,  the vertebral bionic units are made of lightweight materials and are integrally formed. The internal hollow structure design realizes the lightweight design purpose of the bionic neck; at the same time,  through the temperature feedback and pressure feedback of the bionic neck,  the naturalness and security of human-computer interaction are greatly improved. 1. A hollow bionic neck structure of simulation humanoid robot,  wherein It comprises a bionic neck component,  the bionic neck component is composed of multi-section vertebra bionic unit (1) through flexible connecting piece (2) are connected in series;  wherein,  the vertebra bionic unit (1) imitates human cervical vertebra structure,  its inner part is hollow structure;  the outer side of the bionic neck component is sleeved with an epidermal bionic layer (3) for providing temperature and pressure touch feedback.

The invention discloses a multi-sensor fusion recognition method for wheel-legged humanoid robots in industrial scenarios Specifically related to the field of robotics technology,  the time alignment of sensor units is achieved by constructing a multi-modal sensing system and establishing a synchronous triggering mechanism Multivariate external parameter calibration and real-time motion compensation are used to unify multi-source data into the basic coordinate system Then,  based on the hierarchical fusion architecture,  data-level,  feature-level and decision-making-level fusion is carried out And dynamically adjust the fusion weight according to the robot's moving status and scene characteristics Finally,  the navigation path planning,  operation instructions and safety warnings are output in real time The problems of data delay and coordinate system deviation are solved through high-precision time synchronization and motion compensation mechanisms The hierarchical fusion and weight adaptive strategy are used to improve the recognition accuracy and stability in complex scenes,  effectively overcome challenges such as illumination changes,  dust interference and body shaking,  and ensure the efficient perception and intelligent decision-making ability of wheel-legged humanoid robots in dynamic industrial tasks. 1. A multi-sensor fusion identification method of wheel-foot humanoid robot in industrial scene,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a sensor system :  a multi-mode sensing system composed of a sensor unit is arranged on the wheel-foot humanoid robot body,  a synchronous triggering mechanism is established by the multi-mode sensing system,  the time of the sensor unit is aligned;  S2,  data pre-processing and aligning :  the original data collected by the multi-mode sensing system is pre-processed by the image processing technology,  the pre-processing comprises two-stage optimization of combining bilateral filtering and Kalman filtering to the depth image,  and the pre-processed multi-source data is unified to the basic coordinate system of the wheel-foot humanoid robot;  S3,  dynamic fusion identification :  constructing a hierarchical fusion framework,  the hierarchical fusion framework adjusts the fusion weight of the sensor unit according to the current wheel-type movement or gait movement state of the wheel-foot humanoid robot and the characteristic of the industrial scene,  realizing the identification and location of the environment object and the obstacle;  S4,  adaptive output :  according to the result of the identification and location,  outputting the navigation path planning,  the operation instruction and the safety early warning of the wheel-foot humanoid robot in real time.

The invention discloses a fluid dynamics simulation test system and method for erosion protection of offshore wind power pile foundations under a human-shaped submersible embankment under reciprocating flow Including :  the present invention collects environmental and reciprocating flow data Hydrodynamics is used to establish a numerical model of the influence of reciprocating flow on pile foundation Numerical simulation is carried out through the numerical model,  the humanoid submerged embankment and the offshore wind power pile foundation model,  experimental verification is carried out,  the numerical model is optimized,  and the optimal angle,  length and width of the humanoid submerged embankment and the distance between the humanoid submerged embankment and the pile foundation are optimized to effectively reduce the erosion of the pile foundation and improve the durability and protection effect of the humanoid submerged embankment; by establishing a numerical model of the impact of reciprocating flow on pile foundations based on S1 data and using fluid dynamics principles in S2,  and at the same time establishing a physical model of offshore wind power pile foundations and humanoid submersible embankments in S3; provides a numerical model and a physical model under reciprocating flow conditions 1. A fluid dynamics simulation test method for erosion protection of offshore wind power pile foundation of reciprocating flow herringbone embankment,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  collecting the environment data of the pile foundation and the reciprocating flow data of the located area;  Wherein,  the environment data comprises :  seabed gradient,  seabed landform characteristic and silt characteristic data in the sea area;  the reciprocating flow data comprises flow speed and flow direction data;  S2,  based on the data of S1,  establishing a numerical model of the influence of the reciprocating flow to the pile foundation by using the fluid dynamics principle;  S3,  constructing the offshore wind power pile foundation and the physical scale model of the human-shaped dike;  in step S3,  the angle of the human-shaped dike is 10-20 degrees,  the length is 1-3 times of the diameter of the pile foundation,  the distance between the human-shaped dike and the pile foundation is 1-4 times of the diameter of the pile foundation and the width is 1-2 times of the diameter of the pile foundation;  S4,  setting the experiment condition according to the data of S1,  and using the physical scale model of S3 to perform the water tank experiment to obtain the experiment data;  S5,  using the numerical model established by S2,  performing numerical simulation on the numerical geometric model containing the pile foundation and the human-shaped dike,  simulating the scouring process of the offshore wind power pile foundation and the human-shaped dike under the action of reciprocating flow,  obtaining the simulation data;  S6,  comparing the experiment data obtained by S4 with the simulation data obtained by S5,  optimizing the numerical model in S2.

The invention discloses a movement control method,  device,  terminal equipment and storage medium for a humanoid robot Belonging to the field of robot control technology,  the method trains the movement control model of the humanoid robot through teacher-student distillation training,  and constructs a simulation model of the humanoid robot and several simulated terrain point clouds in the simulation environment to train the teacher network. Conduct training. Then compress the input data input into the student network With the goal of minimizing the difference between the second joint drive instruction output by the student network and the first joint drive instruction,  the compressed training data set is used to perform distillation training on the student network,  so that the trained student network not only maintains the powerful ability of the teacher model to cope with complex terrain,  but also meets the real-time requirements of the humanoid robot on the control strategy,  and overcomes the problem of poor movement stability of the humanoid robot in the existing technology. 1. A movement control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the main body posture data and the terrain point cloud data of the humanoid robot;  compressing the terrain point cloud data,  generating a target terrain feature vector,  and inputting the body posture data and the target terrain feature vector into a preset movement control model,  so that the movement control model outputs a joint driving instruction of the humanoid robot;  controlling the movement of the humanoid robot according to the joint driving instruction;  wherein the construction of the movement control model comprises :  constructing a teacher network and a student network,  wherein the student network is a lightweight network model;  in the preset simulator,  constructing the simulation model of the humanoid robot,  several simulation postures of the simulation model and several simulation topogram point clouds;  the moving stability and moving efficiency of the humanoid robot are maximized as the target,  and the teacher network is trained through the simulation gesture and the simulation terrain point cloud;  randomly combining the simulation gesture and the simulation topologic point cloud into multiple groups of initial data groups one by one,  and inputting the initial data groups into the trained teacher network so that the teacher network outputs multiple first joint driving instructions;  deleting the simulation gesture in each initial data group,  and compressing the simulation terrain point cloud,  constructing a training data group;  wherein the data dimension of the deleted simulation gesture is the same as the data dimension of the main body gesture data;  the difference between the second joint driving instruction output by the student network and the first joint driving instruction is minimized as the target,  the student network is distilled and trained by the training data group,  and the trained student network is used as the mobile control model.

The invention provides a method for improving humanoid dynamic detection performance. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  moving detection :  detecting a moving object in a video stream,  and outputting the position of the moving object,  namely upper left coordinates and lower right coordinates; the method is to make frame difference between two adjacent frames of pictures; s2. Merge the movement detection results :  Merge the moving frames. In order to reduce the number of detections and the number of repeated detections,  assuming that two moving targets are close to each other,  merge the two moving frames together and do one humanoid detection. There is no need to buckle each moving frame once for humanoid detection; moreover,  merged movement detection can be divided into two situations :  one is close range,  and the humanoid target is within 3m; one is a long distance,  the humanoid target is 3m away; s3,  cutout :  For the maximum width and height of the detected image,  scale the deducted image to 256 according to the long side and scale the short side proportionally; s4,  humanoid detection :  Perform humanoid detection on the deducted moving pictures. Without compressing the model,  the humanoid dynamic detection performance is reduced and the detection efficiency is improved. 1. A method for improving human shape motion detection performance,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S1,  mobile detection :  detecting the moving object in the video stream,  and outputting the position of the moving object,  namely the left upper and right lower coordinates;  The specific method is to make a frame difference between two adjacent frames of pictures,  and the formula is as follows :  supposing the last frame picture is A,  the frame picture is B,  the frame difference is diffimg = A-B;  S2,  combining the movement detection result :  The combination of the moving frames is to reduce the number of detections and the number of repeated detections,  assuming that the two moving targets are close to each other,  the distance between the two moving targets is not close to each other,  at this time,  the two moving frames are combined together to perform a humanoid detection,  there is no need to buckle each movable frame for human shape detection;  In addition,  the combined movement detection is divided into two situations :  one is close distance,  the human-shaped target is within 3m;  one is long distance,  the human-shaped target is 3 m;  the condition of moving and detecting in short distance and long distance is different,  the human-shaped target moves in short distance,  that is,  the moving and detecting frame will have the condition that the whole human-shaped frame is not complete when moving and detecting in short distance so as to change into multiple local small frames;  when the remote human-shaped object moves,  the human-shaped object can be accurately framed;  S3,  matting :  the mobile frame combined in the step S2 is deducted from the original picture as the input of the human shape detection,  the detection resolution of the short distance is equal to 256,  the resolution of the long distance is less than or equal to 256,  the resolution of the mobile frame with the resolution less than 256,  the resolution of the mobile frame with the resolution more than 256;  That is,  the maximum value of the width and height of the picture to be detected is the maximum value of the width and height of the picture to be detected,  that is,  the picture to be deducted is zoomed to 256 according to the long side and zoomed in the short side in equal ratio,  so that it is unnecessary to detect the whole picture,  and it only needs to detect the part of the moving object;  S4,  human shape detection :  detecting the human shape of the mobile picture deduced in the step S3,  and outputting when there is human shape result.

 the main control module (52) according to the task decision and the selected control mode,  finishing the corresponding motion control operation.

The invention relates to a humanoid robot whole-body motion control method and system based on guided learning and remapping data This method adopts guided learning as the motion control algorithm framework of humanoid robots; firstly,  the mapping data of human body weight is collected,  and the coordinate conversion is carried out on the mapping data,  which is used as the feedforward action in the guided learning Constructing a neural network,  inputting the observation vector of the robot to the neural network,  performing reinforcement learning on the neural network,  outputting the rotation angle data of each joint of the robot that needs fine adjustment,  performing exponential smoothing on the rotation angle data,  and outputting the smoothed signal as a feedback signal; the feedforward action and feedback signal are combined through PD control to generate the final rotation angle of each joint of the robot,  which is then converted into the output torque of the motor and output to complete the whole body motion control of the humanoid robot. Compared with the prior art,  the invention has the advantages of taking into account the accuracy of action and real-time fine-tuning requirements,  and high control robustness. 1. A human-shaped robot body motion control method based on guiding learning and remapping data,  wherein the method uses guiding learning as the motion control algorithm frame of the human-shaped robot,  the method comprises the following steps :  capturing the data set from the human body action,  collecting the human body weight mapping data,  and converting the coordinate as the feed-forward action in the guiding learning;  constructing a neural network,  inputting the observation vector of the robot to the neural network,  performing reinforcement learning to the neural network,  outputting the rotation angle data to be finely adjusted by each joint of the robot,  performing exponential smoothing processing to the rotation angle data,  and outputting the smoothed signal as a feedback signal;  the feed-forward action and the feedback signal are combined by PD control to generate the needed rotating angle of each joint of the final robot;  the needed rotating angle of each joint is converted into the output moment of the motor and output so as to finish the whole body movement control of the humanoid robot.

The invention relates to an olfactory perception monitoring method and an olfactory perception monitoring system for a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of :  when a preset trigger condition is met,  detecting an odor obtained by current olfactory sampling,  and outputting an odor detection result; according to the smell detection result,  all the suspected scenes where the current robot is located are deduced,  and combined with the detection results obtained by other detection modules except smell,  the scene where the current robot is located is screened out from all the suspected scenes; other detection modules at least include a visual detection module for detecting image information of the environment in which the robot is located; determining the odor coverage according to the odor detection result and the current scene of the robot; according to the real-time status of the robot,  it is determined in real time whether the robot is within the odor coverage range. If not,  it is considered to meet the preset trigger conditions. This application has the effect of reducing the redundant detection behavior of odor by robots in the same environment and reducing energy consumption. 1. An olfactory perception monitoring method for human-shaped robot,  wherein it comprises :  when the pre-set trigger condition is satisfied,  detecting the smell obtained by the current olfaction sampling and outputting the smell detecting result;  according to the smell detection result,  deducing all suspected scenes of the current robot,  and combining the detection result obtained by the corresponding detection of other detection modules except the smell,  screening the scene of the current robot from all suspected scenes;  wherein the other detection module at least comprises a visual detection module for detecting the image information of the environment where the robot is located;  determining the odour covering range according to the odour detecting result and the scene of the current robot;  according to the real-time state of the robot,  determining whether the robot is in the odour covering range in real time,  if not,  considering that the preset trigger condition is satisfied.
