The invention is used in the technical field of special engineering plastic modification,  and discloses a preparation method of high-strength and high-thermal conductivity CF-PEEK particles,  which includes the following steps :  S1,  carbon fiber surface treatment; s2,  carbon fiber chopped; s3. PEEK resin pretreatment; s4. Nanomaterial pretreatment; s5. Mixing nano material and PEEK; s6,  mixing carbon fiber with resin; s7. Granulation. The preparation method of the high-strength and high-thermal conductivity CF ‑ PEEK particles In view of the key pain point that existing chopped CF/PEEK composite materials cannot meet the requirements of high stiffness (low deformation) and high thermal conductivity (heat dissipation) at the same time,  through the precise introduction of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and optimization of process parameters,  this method successfully achieves coordinated performance improvement,  effectively solves the problem of heat accumulation in high-speed rotation and friction scenarios,  and fully adapts to high-end application requirements such as humanoid robot joints and transmission parts. 1. A preparation method of high-strength high-thermal conductivity CF-PEEK particle,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  carbon fibre surface treatment :  the surface of the carbon fibre is treated by sizing agent;  S2,  carbon fibre chopping :  cutting the carbon fibre processed in the step S1 at 15-25 degrees centigrade,  controlling the cutting length to be 2.5-4.0 mm;  S3,  PEEK resin pre-treatment :  grinding the PEEK coarse powder by one of mechanical grinding,  liquid nitrogen cooling grinding or airflow grinding,  wherein the grinding mesh number is 300-800 meshes;  S4,  pre-processing the nanometre material :  selecting one or mixture of single-wall carbon nanometre tube and multi-wall carbon nanometre tube to grind;  S5,  mixing the nano-material with PEEK :  mixing the PEEK grinding powder in the step S3 and the nanometre material in the step S4 according to the mass ratio of CNT :  PEEK=0.5 %-5 %,  stirring paddle linear speed is 10-50m/min,  mixing time is 10-20min;  S6,  mixing the carbon fibre with the resin :  mixing the chopped carbon fibre of step S2 with the mixture of step S5 according to the mass ratio of 3 :  7-5.5 :  4.5;  S7,  granulating :  putting the mixture in the step S6 into a double-screw extruder to extrude and granulate,  wherein the temperature of the mould is 350-400 degrees centigrade to obtain the CF-PEEK particle.

The invention provides a method for controlling the jumping and flying posture of a bipedal wheel-legged robot,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Simplify the bipedal wheel-legged robot. A control method for jumping empty posture of double-foot wheel leg robot,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  S1,  simplifying the double-foot wheel leg robot,  the simplified structure comprises a machine body,  a driving wheel and a swinging rod,  the machine body is connected with the driving wheel through the swinging rod;  S2,  determining the parameter of the double-foot wheel leg robot,  including the moment of inertia of the machine body,  the driving wheel and the swinging rod;  S3,  determining the dynamic equation of the double-foot wheel leg robot based on the parameter of the double-foot wheel leg robot;  S4,  linearizing the dynamic equation,  and controlling the jumping vacating posture of the double-foot wheel leg robot according to the linearized result.

The invention discloses an obstacle calculation task processing method and system for an industrial humanoid inspection robot,  which includes :  obtaining the target scene when the industrial humanoid inspection robot encounters an obstacle; generate obstacle calculation tasks according to the target scene,  and divide the obstacle calculation tasks to obtain several sub-tasks; assigning a number of subtasks to corresponding devices in a set of devices associated with the industrial humanoid inspection robot; receive the calculation information returned by each device,  integrate the calculation information,  and generate the obstacle avoidance path of the industrial humanoid inspection robot. Mobilize the equipment collection associated with the scene where the industrial humanoid inspection robot is located,  divide the obstacle calculation task into sub-tasks and assign them to the equipment collection,  realize distributed collaborative computing,  avoid the computing power bottleneck of the industrial humanoid inspection robot,  shorten the obstacle avoidance decision-making time,  and improve computing efficiency. Through the task segmentation and dynamic allocation mechanism,  the computing load can be flexibly adjusted according to the real-time status of the equipment,  and the robustness of the system can be improved. 1. A computing task processing method for industrial humanoid inspection robot meeting obstacle,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the target scene when the industrial human-shaped inspection robot meets the barrier;  generating a meeting-barrier calculation task according to the target scene,  and dividing the meeting-barrier calculation task to obtain several sub-tasks;  distributing several sub-tasks to the corresponding device in the device set related to the industrial human-shaped inspection robot;  receiving the calculation information returned by each device,  integrating the calculation information,  and generating the obstacle avoiding path of the industrial human-shaped inspection robot.

The invention discloses a task dynamic distribution method and system for an edge computing server,  and belongs to the field of edge computing This application obtains the pressure distribution data sequence of the humanoid robot's plantar,  the computing load data of the edge computing server and the candidate task allocation decision sequence. Posture stability data is generated by integrating and time-differentiating the pressure distribution data sequence. For each task allocation decision,  the prediction model is used and combined with attitude stability data and computational load data to generate its corresponding predicted instruction delay sequence and predicted attitude stability sequence. While ensuring that the time series resource occupancy rate and predicted attitude stability meet the preset threshold conditions,  the task allocation score of each decision is calculated based on the predicted sequence through the cost function. Selecting the decision with the smallest score as the target task allocation decision and generating task allocation instructions based on its task execution sequence information can effectively control physical entities in a timely manner while ensuring computational efficiency. 1. A task dynamic distribution method for edge computing server,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the pressure distribution data sequence of the thenar of the humanoid robot at a plurality of continuous moments within the target time period,  and the calculation load data and task distribution decision sequence serving the edge calculation server of the humanoid robot,  each task distribution decision in the task distribution decision sequence comprises task execution sequence information and time sequence resource occupancy rate;  based on the pressure distribution data sequence,  calculating the pressure centre position of each pressure distribution data by integral operation to generate the pressure centre sequence,  and performing time difference processing to the pressure centre sequence,  generating the posture stable data representing the posture shaking trend;  the posture stability data,  the calculation load data and each of the task distribution decision are input into the constructed prediction model,  generating a prediction instruction delay sequence and a prediction posture stability sequence corresponding to each of the task distribution decision,  the prediction instruction delay sequence comprises the delay execution time of the control instruction of the joint motor in a plurality of control periods,  the predicted attitude stabilization sequence comprises a quantized value of the robot attitude stabilization in a plurality of control periods;  under the condition that the time sequence resource occupancy rate is less than a preset resource occupancy rate threshold value and all the quantization values in the prediction posture stabilization sequence are less than a preset stabilization threshold value,  based on the prediction instruction delay sequence and the prediction posture stabilization sequence,  calculating a task allocation score for each of the task allocation decisions by a preset cost function including a first penalty term and a second penalty term;  determining the task distribution decision with the minimum task distribution score as the target task distribution decision,  and generating the task distribution instruction of the edge computing server according to the task execution sequence information corresponding to the target task distribution decision.

The invention provides an emotion recognition method for a humanoid robot,  which relates to the field of artificial intelligence and robot technology. The method includes :  obtaining the user's voice,  facial image and physiological signal through a multi-modal sensor; analyze data based on deep learning models and extract multi-modal features; the emotion classification model is trained according to the historical interaction data,  and the emotion probability distribution is output Calculate the emotion recognition value based on probability distribution weighted fusion,  where the weight is dynamically adjusted according to the confidence of each modality; adjust the robot dialogue response strategy according to the emotional value. The invention realizes high-precision and real-time multi-modal emotion recognition,  can effectively capture complex emotion changes,  and generates natural and personalized interactive responses according to context,  significantly improving the authenticity and adaptability of human-computer interaction experience. 1. An emotion recognition method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  S10 :  obtaining the interactive data of the user through the multi-mode sensor,  wherein the interactive data comprises a voice signal,  a face image and a physiological signal;  S20 :  analyzing the interactive data based on the deep learning model,  extracting multimodal feature;  S30 :  training the emotion classification model according to the history interactive data,  outputting the emotion probability distribution;  S40 :  based on the emotion probability distribution,  calculating the emotion identification value of the current interaction;  S50 :  adjusting the conversation response strategy of the robot according to the emotion identification value.

The invention belongs to the field of robot technology,  and specifically relates to a standing wireless charging method and system for a humanoid robot,  which includes :  the humanoid robot autonomously positions and moves to the center of the charging area of the charging base station with a natural gait,  and establishes a communication link with the charging base station; the charging base station receives the charging request of the humanoid robot,  starts low-power trial to perform initial coupling detection,  determines the optimal charging frequency,  and starts charging; monitor the charging status in real time,  dynamically adjust the charging power according to the charging status,  and adjust the charging strategy based on the safety protection detection results; when the remaining battery power of the humanoid robot meets the preset threshold or triggers a departure signal,  a departure request is sent to the charging base station to stop charging and disconnect the communication link with the charging base station. 1. A standing wireless charging method for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  the humanoid robot automatically locates and moves to the centre of the charging area of the charging base station in natural gait,  and establishes a communication link with the charging base station;  the charging base station receives the charging request of the humanoid robot,  starts the low-power probing to perform the initial coupling detection,  determines the optimal charging frequency and starts the charging;  monitoring the charging state in real time,  dynamically adjusting the charging power according to the charging state,  and adjusting the charging strategy according to the safety protection detection result;  when the residual electric quantity of the battery of the humanoid robot satisfies the preset threshold or triggers the leaving signal,  sending the leaving request to the charging base station,  stopping charging and cutting off the communication link with the charging base station.

The invention relates to the technical field of joint motors,  and discloses an integrated joint motor of a hollow inner wiring reducer,  which includes :  a spliced shell; an internal wiring motor mechanism arranged in the spliced shell,  the internal wiring motor mechanism includes a hollow transmission component movably connected inside the spliced shell and a motor module arranged between the hollow transmission component and the spliced shell; a deceleration output mechanism located in the spliced shell. Compared with the traditional external wiring scheme,  the axial size is shortened by 15% and the radial size is reduced by 8%. The cable is zero exposed and the appearance is simple. It can be widely used in high integration scenarios such as collaborative robots,  humanoid robot joints,  and robotic arm ends. 1. An integrated joint motor of hollow inner routing speed reducer,  wherein it comprises :  splicing shell;  an inner routing motor mechanism set in the splicing type shell,  the inner routing motor mechanism comprises a hollow transmission component movably connected in the splicing type shell and a motor module set between the hollow transmission component and the splicing type shell,  the motor module is used for driving the hollow transmission component to set the rotating speed,  setting torque rotation;  a speed reduction output mechanism set in the spliced shell,  the speed reduction output mechanism comprises a power output mechanism movably connected on the spliced shell and a speed reduction mechanism set between the power output mechanism and the hollow transmission component.

The invention relates to a multi-camera module overlapping field of view configuration and close-up picture acquisition method and device,  and belongs to the technical field of video signal processing The method comprises the following steps of :  sequentially arranging a plurality of camera modules along a preset direction; obtaining the decoding stream of each camera module and using it to perform humanoid detection to obtain the candidate image coordinates corresponding to each decoding stream; de-duplicating all image coordinates; according to the audio and video angle mapping table,  the image coordinates after deduplication are converted into corresponding image angles to obtain an image angle set; comparing the audio angle with the image angle set according to the matching rule to determine the target object angle; calculate the boundary distance of the target object angle in the field of view of each camera module and screen the maximum boundary distance; extract the output picture corresponding to the maximum boundary distance to obtain the close-up picture. The invention realizes the acquisition of high-definition close-up pictures without seams,  and solves the problem that it is difficult to give consideration to panoramic coverage and high-definition close-up. 1. A multi-camera module overlapping visual field configuration and close-up picture obtaining method,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  orderly arranging the multiple camera modules along the preset direction and the preset visual field overlapping area;  obtaining the decoding stream output by each camera module,  respectively performing the human shape detection by using the decoding stream to obtain the candidate image coordinate corresponding to each decoding stream;  performing detection target de-reprocessing on all candidate image coordinates;  S2,  according to the audio/video angle mapping table,  converting the repeated candidate image coordinate into the corresponding image angle to obtain the image angle set;  S3,  obtaining the audio angle;  comparing the audio angle with the image angle set according to a preset matching rule to obtain a matching combination;  determining the angle of the target object according to the matching combination;  S4,  calculating the boundary distance of the target object angle in the field of view of each camera module,  obtaining a boundary distance set;  S5,  screening the maximum value in the boundary distance set,  according to the maximum value,  obtaining a matched camera module;  extracting the output picture of the matched camera module and obtaining the close-up picture of the target object according to the output picture.

A parking method,  device and vehicle,  the method includes :  obtaining a first planned path (S910); in the process of controlling the vehicle to park to the target parking space along the first planned path,  determine the second planned path according to the first planned path (S920); control the display device of the vehicle to switch from displaying the first planned path to displaying the second planned path,  and control the vehicle to continue parking in the target parking space along the second planned path (S930) In addition,  when determining the second planned path based on the first planned path,  path planning can be performed in segments. RoboPet Companion is a modular,  AI-powered robotic pet that uses an ESP32 microcontroller as a voice assistant and an Arduino Uno for movement,  sensor control,  and gesture functions. The ESP32 receives voice commands through an INMP441 digital microphone,  processes them with cloud-based AI,  and outputs clear speech using a MAX98357A amplifier and a 3 W speaker. The Arduino Uno handles the robot's movement using motor driver modules (such as L293D/L298N/Adafruit Motor Shield),  multiple DC motors,  an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor for detecting obstacles,  and IR sensors for edge and line tracking. An SG90 servo motor controls the head and ear movements,  giving the robot expressive features and emotional responses. The ESP32 and Arduino Uno work together but independently,  sharing a regulated power supply to ensure stable performance. The design is fully modular,  allowing users to add sensors like temperature,  cameras,  or gas sensors,  include communication modules like Bluetooth or wireless bridges,  or add new actuators for future research or use. This makes RoboPet reliable for long-term use,  highly expandable for educational and experimental purposes,  and suitable for research,  demos,  and real-world personal robotics applications.

Methods and apparatus for navigating a robot along a route through an environment,  the route being associated with a mission,  are provided. The method comprises identifying,  based on sensor data received by one or more sensors of the robot,  a set of potential obstacles in the environment,  determining,  based at least in part on stored data indicating a set of footfall locations of the robot during a previous execution of the mission,  that at least one of the potential obstacles in the set is an obstacle,  and navigating the robot to avoid stepping on the obstacle.

This invention discloses a compact,  wearable symbolic AI processor integrating neuromorphic EEG decoding,  symbolic execution,  and intention-aware ethics enforcement. The chip enables ultra-low-latency interpretation of biometric and environmental data into symbolic primitives,  supporting AGI-level reasoning and lawful autonomy in real-time. Architected with embedded sovereign firewalls,  zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) memory zones,  and transformer-aligned symbolic cores,  the chip facilitates embodied intelligence within wearable devices such as AI pins,  glasses,  or headsets. Symbolic input/output lanes fuse EEG,  gesture,  and speech,  while cryptographic trust cores verify behavioral signatures to prevent manipulation. This invention forms the hardware anchor of sovereign wearable AGI,  eliminating dependency on cloud control or opaque neural networks,  and instead operates entirely within an ethics-verified symbolic runtime. It defines the physical foundation for the first fully sovereign cognitive wearable ecosystem.

An electronic device and a method for situational-context based control of user-assistive actuators using multi-modal neural language (MMNL) model,  is provided. The electronic device monitors first sensor data associated with a first user. The electronic device determines a world-view model of environment corresponding to the first user. The electronic device applies a MMNL model on the determined world-view model and the monitored first sensor data,  and determines a situational context associated with the environment and the first user,  based on the application of the MMNL model. The electronic device receives a first user-input based on the determined situational context,  and further selects,  from a set of tasks,  a first task based on the received first user-input. The electronic device further controls a first user-assistive actuator associated with the first user to execute at least partially the selected first task.

The invention discloses a method for planning a foothold of a biped robot based on a NURBS curve,  a computer-readable storage medium and a foot device The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a foot starting point,  a foot falling point and a leg swinging height of the biped robot as control points of a NURBS curve; generating an initial landing point trajectory curve based on the control points,  and obtaining a first-order derivative of the initial landing point trajectory curve to obtain the speed of the actual landing point; comparing the speed of the actual landing point with the expected landing point speed,  when the absolute value of the error between the speed of the actual landing point and the expected landing point speed is less than or equal to the preset value,  obtaining the control landing point trajectory curve; control the swing of the swing legs of the bipedal robot according to the control foothold trajectory curve The speed of the foothold relative to the ground is matched with the speed of the robot relative to the ground,  and the swing state and support state of the foot-type robot movement are combined to make the switching of the movement state smoother,  thereby improving the walking speed of the robot. 1. A foot point planning method of biped robot based on NURBS curve,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the foot starting point,  foot falling point and leg swinging height of the biped robot as the control point of the NURBS curve;  generating an initial foot-falling point track curve based on the control point,  calculating a first-order guide for the initial foot-falling point track curve,  obtaining the speed of the actual foot-falling point;  comparing the speed of the actual foot-falling point with the expected foot-falling point speed,  when the error absolute value of the speed of the actual foot-falling point and the expected foot-falling point speed is less than or equal to the preset value,  obtaining the track curve of the control foot-falling point;  controlling the swinging of the swinging leg of the biped robot according to the track curve of the foot falling point;  The method for obtaining the desired drop point speed comprises :  using the state estimation module of the biped robot to obtain the state estimation of the biped robot;  according to the state estimation to obtain the world coordinate and speed of the robot at the starting foot point,  the expected walking speed and walking period time prediction to obtain the world coordinate position and speed of the robot at the falling foot point,  the moving speed of the horizontal plane of the machine body is reversed,  the speed of the longitudinal shaft is zero,  and obtaining the expected speed of the foot falling point.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg structure based on a planetary roller screw,  and aims to provide a mechanical structure scheme for converting rotary motion into linear motion,  which can improve the adaptability and motion stability of the robot in complex terrain. The structure adopts a planetary roller lead screw as the main transmission element,  and drives the lead screw nut through a motor to achieve high-precision push-pull movement to drive the robot leg joint movement. Compared with traditional gear,  hydraulic or linear motor driving modes,  the present invention has high transmission efficiency,  low reverse clearance,  low energy consumption and excellent torque transmission characteristics The structure is capable of realizing humanoid linear joint motion of the legs,  so that the robot can more stably complete complex actions such as walking,  standing,  jumping and the like,  meanwhile,  the maintenance cost is reduced,  and the system reliability is improved. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of humanoid robots,  rescue robots,  special operation robots and the like 1. A humanoid robot control method,  system,  storage medium and program product. in the method,  weighted calculation is performed on pressure distribution data to obtain the pressure center of gravity coordinates of cooperative contact points; a time window sequence is constructed based on the coordinates of the pressure center of gravity,  and the instantaneous velocity and acceleration of the pressure center of gravity are obtained through differential operation; calculate the magnitude and direction of the resultant force exerted by the human operator at the cooperative contact point based on the instantaneous velocity and acceleration; transferring the resultant force magnitude and direction along the joint chain of the humanoid robot to obtain the instantaneous stress state of each joint of the humanoid robot; calculate the corresponding joint output torque according to the instantaneous stress state of each joint; control each joint of humanoid robot to move cooperatively according to the joint output torque This application is used to accurately identify and predict human collaboration intentions,  achieve precise matching of strength and natural synchronization of actions during human-machine collaboration,  thereby improving the safety and efficiency of collaborative tasks. 1. A humanoid robot control method,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the pressure distribution data of the cooperative contact point of the humanoid robot and the human operator;  performing weighted calculation on the pressure distribution data to obtain the pressure gravity centre coordinate of the cooperative contact point;  constructing a time window sequence based on the pressure gravity centre coordinate,  and obtaining the instantaneous speed and acceleration of the pressure gravity centre through differential operation;  calculating a resultant force magnitude and a resultant force direction applied by the human operator at the cooperative contact point based on the instantaneous speed and the acceleration;  transmitting the resultant force and the resultant force direction along the joint chain of the humanoid robot,  converting to obtain the instantaneous stress state of each joint of the humanoid robot;  calculating the corresponding joint output moment according to the instantaneous stress state of each joint;  controlling each joint of the humanoid robot to move cooperatively according to the joint output moment.

The invention discloses a power management method,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Receive collected detection data; s2. Compare the current data and voltage data with the normal operating threshold range,  and mark the data that exceeds the range; s3. When a preset number of consecutive sampling periods detect that the current data is greater than the normal operating threshold range,  or a preset number of consecutive sampling periods detect that the voltage data is lower than the normal operating threshold range,  an abnormal signal is generated; s4. The invention relates to a TIG welding molten drop transition closed-loop control method for humanoid robot welding,  and belongs to the field of robot technology It aims to solve the problems that the constant speed wire feeding of traditional robot TIG welding cannot adapt to complex working conditions,  the coordination of humanoid robot double-arm welding is difficult,  and the open-loop control of molten droplet transition is unstable. A TIG welding molten drop transition closed-loop control method for humanoid robot welding,  the wire feeder controls the conveying state of the welding wire,  so that the welding wire (5) is matched with the workpiece (6),  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  the two ends of the voltage sensor (4) are respectively connected with the welding wire (5) and the workpiece (6),  through the voltage signal change,  judging whether the welding wire (5) is contacted with the molten pool;  when the voltage signal is greater than or equal to 8V,  judging that the welding wire (5) is separated from the molten pool,  and controlling the feeding of the welding wire;  when the voltage signal is less than 0.5V,  judging that the welding wire (5) is in contact with the molten pool,  controlling the welding wire to stop feeding or pumping back;  the voltage threshold value is calibrated by TIG welding technique pre-experiment :  Taking Q235 steel as work piece (thickness 5mm),  ER50-6 welding wire (diameter 1. 2mm),  the welding current is 120-150A,  under the arc voltage 10-12V parameter,  testing the voltage value of 10 groups of contact/separation state,  taking the maximum voltage when contacting,  taking the minimum voltage when separating as the threshold value.

This application discloses a planning method and related devices for feasible contact sequences of multi-legged robots The invention relates to the technical field of robot motion planning. The method comprises the following steps of :  based on an initial position,  a target position,  topographic physical parameters of an environment and a preset necessary condition for the multi-legged robot to be in contact with each other,  carrying out guiding path planning on the multi-legged robot by using a guiding path planning method to obtain a guiding path; constructing multiple constraints for multi-legged robots; performing iterative operation on the root node by using Monte Carlo tree search method to obtain multiple child nodes corresponding to the root node; determine whether the termination conditions are met; if so,  gradually select the optimal node from all sub-nodes,  output the optimal feasible contact sequence corresponding to the initial contact state to the target contact state,  and input it into the trajectory planner to control the movement of the multi-legged robot. According to the invention,  the planning efficiency of the feasible contact sequence can be improved,  and the multi-legged robot can stably move under the complex terrain 1. A planning method of feasible contact sequence of multi-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  step S1,  obtaining the initial position,  the target position and the terrain physical parameter of the environment where the multi-foot robot is located,  and based on the initial position,  the target position,  the landform physical parameter of the environment and the pre-set necessary condition of the multi-foot robot can be contacted,  the multi-foot robot is guided by the guiding path planning method to obtain the guiding path;  step S2,  constructing the multi-constraint condition of the multi-foot robot;  the multi-constraint condition comprises static stable constraint,  kinematics constraint,  joint torque constraint and collision constraint;  step S3,  using Monte Carlo tree searching method to perform iteration operation on the root node,  obtaining multiple sub-nodes corresponding to the root node;  the root node is the node corresponding to the initial contact state;  the sub-node is the node corresponding to any feasible contact state from the initial contact state to the target contact state;  the node comprises a feasible supporting state of the multi-foot robot,  a feasible mass centre position and a feasible foot falling point;  step S4,  judging whether the termination condition is satisfied;  if so,  gradually selecting the optimal node from all sub-nodes,  and outputting to obtain the optimal feasible contact sequence corresponding to the initial contact state to the target contact state;  if not,  continuing the iteration operation;  the optimal node is the sub-node with the highest value;  the optimal feasible contact sequence is used for inputting to the track planner to control the movement of the multi-foot robot;  Wherein,  the iterative operation is specifically as follows :  starting from the root node,  recursively selecting the expandable sub-node by using the tree strategy;  based on the guide path and the multi-constraint condition,  processing the expandable sub-node to obtain the corresponding feasible candidate node set,  and selecting a feasible contact state from the feasible candidate node set as the new sub-node;  starting from the new sub-node,  using the simulation strategy to perform fast random simulation until reaching the target contact state,  obtaining the reward value;  reversely spreading the reward value along the search path from the new sub-node to the root node,  updating the access times and value of all sub-nodes on the search path,  obtaining the updated access times and updated value.

This application ensures efficiency and balance stability through global task planning,  and then improves safety and accuracy correction through local dynamic adjustment,  effectively breaking through the performance bottlenecks of global efficiency and local safety,  and effectively improving the balance stability,  task execution efficiency and human-computer interaction safety of humanoid robots in complex scenes. 1. A layered planning method for humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  in response to the task planning requirement,  collecting the environment sensing data and the task target data in real time;  constructing a constraint condition and a cost function based on the environment sensing data and the task target data,  obtaining an off-line constraint optimal control model of a global task plan,  and solving to obtain a global reference track;  based on the global reference track,  constructing tracking error cost function and obstacle avoiding constraint condition,  obtaining online constraint optimal control model of local dynamic adjustment,  and solving to obtain local dynamic track;  outputting and executing the local dynamic track to finish the task planning requirement.

The invention provides a method,  a device,  a medium and a program product for recording and playing back the motion trail of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  scanning the actual length of each limb segment of a source robot and the length of the corresponding limb segment of a target robot,  capturing three-dimensional coordinate point cloud data,  and generating a source-target length ratio data table; extracting the proportion mismatch area according to the source-target length ratio data table,  combining the current rotatable angle and limit position of each joint to determine the joint range limited data list; analyze the interaction between the source-target length ratio data table and the joint range-limited data list based on the joint range-limited data list to determine the action accessibility conflict area; verify the matching degree between the points in the preliminary adaptive trajectory point set and the range-limited data list to determine a conflict-free trajectory subset; generate an adaptive source trajectory based on the conflict-free trajectory subset,  input the adaptive trajectory into the playback system,  and output the source robot motion trajectory record playback result. 1. A method for recording and playing back motion track of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  scanning the length of each limb section of the source robot and the target robot,  obtaining the three-dimensional coordinate point cloud data,  generating a source target length ratio data table;  extracting the proportion unmatched area of each limb section according to the source target length ratio data table,  combining the current angle and the limit position of each joint to generate the joint range limited data list;  according to the source target length ratio data table and the joint range limited data list,  identifying the action reachable conflict area;  adjusting the scale proportion of the source track in the mapping point of the target robot coordinate system according to the action reachable conflict region,  generating a primary adaptive track point position set;  verifying the matching degree of the point position of the initial adaptive track point position set and the joint range limited data list,  generating a non-conflict track subset;  generating an adaptive track according to the conflict-free track subset,  inputting the adaptive track into a playback system,  and outputting the motion track record playback result of the source robot.

This application provides a control method for a humanoid robot,  a humanoid robot and a storage medium. Through the above method,  the movements of humanoid robots can be made more anthropomorphic and avoid making unnatural movements. 1. A control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the current state and speed instruction of the humanoid robot;  according to the current state and the speed instruction,  searching from a preset database to obtain a reference motion segment,  wherein the database comprises a plurality of motion segments,  the motion segment is obtained according to human motion data;  inputting the current state,  the speed instruction and the reference motion segment into an action generation model to obtain the target state of the humanoid robot at the next time;  inputting the current state into the strategy network to obtain the target action output by the strategy network,  and controlling the humanoid robot to execute the target action;  updating the parameter of the strategy network according to the new state of the humanoid robot after executing the target action and the target state.

The present invention relates to the field of robot interaction technology,  and in particular to a humanoid robot operation control system and method based on tactile recognition of hand postures. The method comprises the following steps of :  controlling each finger driving motor of the humanoid robot to output basic gripping force,  driving the fingers to move towards an object to be gripped,  and enabling finger pulp touch sensors of the fingers to be in contact with the object so as to obtain a gripping force signal; monitor the grip value of the corresponding finger in real time through the tactile sensor to determine whether there is a finger whose grip exceeds the preset threshold; when it is detected that the grip strength of any finger exceeds the threshold value,  the tactile conductive member corresponding to the finger moves toward the force diverting member under the action of the grip strength,  pushing the force diverting member to slide in the axial direction. The invention realizes the precise cooperative control and dynamic balance of multi-finger grip strength,  thereby enhancing the grasping stability of complex objects and improving the success rate of grasping tasks. 1. A humanoid robot operation control method based on touch identification hand posture,  wherein the palm of the humanoid robot is configured with a touch trigger type tendon shunting structure,  the structure comprises a touch conduction piece corresponding to each finger one by one,  a force shunt piece capable of sliding axially and a multi-directional force conduction piece for connecting the force shunt piece and each finger joint,  and one end of the touch conduction piece is connected with the finger abdomen touch sensor of the finger,  and the other end is propped against the force shunt piece;  the method comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  controlling each finger driving motor of the human-shaped robot to output basic grabbing force,  driving the finger to move to the object to be grasped,  making the finger abdomen touch sensor of the finger contact with the object to obtain grabbing force signal;  step S2 :  the touch sensor monitors the holding force value of the corresponding finger in real time,  and judges whether there is a finger whose holding force exceeds the preset threshold value;  step S3 :  when any finger holding force exceeds the threshold value,  the touch conduction piece corresponding to the finger moves to the force shunting piece under the action of the holding force and pushes the force shunting piece to slide along the axial direction;  in the sliding process of the force dividing piece,  the acting force is transmitted to other finger joints through the multi-directional force conducting piece,  so as to drive other fingers to increase the holding force;  step S4 :  maintaining the basic gripping force output of each finger driving motor until the gripping force of each finger reaches the dynamic balance,  finishing the stable gripping of the object,  so as to realize the hand posture operation control based on tactile identification.

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot joint modules Specifically,  it relates to a floating disk type hollow cycloid joint module with a new structure Comprises an inner rotor motor,  the inner rotor motor includes a motor housing The rotor drives the rotor seat in the installation cavity to rotate coaxially A coaxial rotary eccentric shaft is connected to the rotor seat A fourth bearing and a cycloidal wheel are sequentially sleeved outside the eccentric shaft There is also an output flange outside the cycloid wheel and a fit gap is formed. The invention relates to a human body multi-cycle gait trajectory prediction method based on small sample space-time decoupling Firstly,  single-cycle gait samples are obtained through kinematic modeling and cycle segmentation,  and parameters such as stride length and stride frequency are extracted,  expanded and normalized; secondly,  Gaussian mixture model and Gaussian mixture regression are used to establish a joint distribution model of gait parameters,  and the gait parameters are predicted according to the target speed; subsequently,  spatial and temporal decoupling reconstruction is performed. The present invention relates to the field of intelligent detection technology,  and in particular to a humanoid detection method,  electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium. First,  based on motion compensation technology,  the inter-frame difference between the real-time frame and the reference frame is calculated to generate a detection frame. Subsequently,  image segmentation technology is combined to segment the image in the humanoid detection frame in the detection frame to accurately locate the humanoid candidate area. Then,  the humanoid candidate areas are screened according to the preset confidence threshold to ensure that only high-confidence valid humanoid targets are included in the final humanoid detection results. A verification method of generalizing visual solution suitable for human-shaped robot,  wherein it is carried out according to the matched adjustable bracket,  the adjustable bracket comprises a main frame,  a moving mechanism and a plurality of camera fixing devices,  the main frame comprises a long connecting rod (1),  an optical axis cross clamp fixing seat (2),  a middle connecting rod (3),  a cross universal joint (5) and a chassis (9),  the moving mechanism comprises a universal wheel (10),  the verification method comprises the following steps :  S1 :  environmental construction :  using the main frame to build a test space covering a height of 0-2000 mm and adjusted at an angle of +/ - 180 degrees,  through the universal wheel (10) to deploy the bracket to a static laboratory,  a dynamic interference area and an outdoor scene,  constructing a multi-environment verification matrix;  based on the structure size parameter of different machine types,  adjusting the length of the bracket connecting rod,  switching the universal joint,  simulating the camera mounting position of each machine type,  using the optical axis cross clamp fixing seat (2) to reproduce the mounting hole position deviation between the machine type,  verifying the visual solution cross machine type suitability;  S2 :  solution deployment :  the multi-camera layout of fish eye,  depth,  RGB camera and reappear target model is installed by the camera fixing device,  based on the camera internal reference and external reference,  the multi-camera cooperative calibration is finished by Chang Cheng-you calibration method;  deploying the visual solution to be verified,  linking the motion control module of the humanoid robot,  constructing a closed-loop verification system of visual perception-algorithm decision-motion execution; The present invention relates to a a Hybrid Attention-Infused CNN-BiLSTM-GRU system for Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) that accurately maps audio signals to emotion classes. The system integrates feature fusion of multiple acoustic features (MFCC,  Chroma,  Spectral Contrast,  Tonnetz),  convolutional neural networks for local feature extraction,  bidirectional recurrent networks for temporal dependency learning,  and a hybrid attention mechanism combining self-attention and contextual attention to emphasize emotionally salient speech segments. By leveraging this architecture,  the system achieves unprecedented accuracy in recognizing human emotions in real-time,  enabling emotion-aware human-computer interaction. The invention is applicable across healthcare,  telehealth,  customer service,  virtual assistants,  and human-robot interaction,  offering real-time emotion detection and contextual understanding to improve decision-making,  personalized responses,  and user experience.

ABSTRACT INTERACTIVE HUMANOID ROBOT WITH VOICE-CONTROLLED MOTION ACTUATION An interactive humanoid robot for voice-controlled upper body motion replication is disclosed. The system comprises a controller having a processor and memory storing executable instructions,  a humanoid mechanical structure with articulated joints and linkages configured to replicate human upper body movements,  and servo motors operatively coupled to the joints and communicatively coupled to the controller. The system further comprises a voice input module receiving voice commands from users and a voice output module providing audio responses. The controller executes instructions to process voice command data using natural language processing algorithms including GPT-based artificial intelligence models,  determine corresponding action commands,  generate coordinated control signals for the servo motors based on action commands,  actuate the mechanical structure to perform upper body motions,  and generate contextually appropriate audio responses. The system achieves response times of fifteen seconds or less while maintaining synchronized multi-joint motion coordination through integrated voice processing and electromechanical control,  enabling natural human-robot interaction without requiring specialized operator training or external computational resources. Modern hospital environments are in need of intelligent and agile solutions that can handle the complicated logistics of dynamic and high-stake medical settings. This invention embodies a contextual robotic system which combines Adaptive Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Semantic Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) to navigate and respond reactively to the changing workflows in hospitals. The proposed system precedes the capabilities of conventional delivery robots,  which have limited routing and fixed task schedules,  as it can understand the context of medical settings,  respond to real-time changes and safely communicate with medical staff. The system offers semantic zone mapping,  dynamic task prioritization,  environmental adaptation,  human-aware obstacle avoidance,  intelligent path re-planning,  and autonomous fault recovery. The robot develops its knowledge of traffic pattern,  environmental constraint and delivery crisis through the use of multi-modal sensing and intelligent decision-making powered by Natural Language Processing (NLP) models. The proposed approach deals with the severe shortcomings of present-day hospital robotics including the lack of context-semantics and autonomous reaction to dynamic obstacles as it permits resilient,  adaptive,  and secure operations. The system presents a robust cognitive framework and offers a scalable model of smart automation in medical logistics.

The present disclosure relates to a gesture and audio controlled human assistive robot configured to provide expressive,  human-like interactions in public,  commercial and service environments. The robot comprises a sensing unit for detecting human presence,  a microcontroller-based control unit for processing sensing data,  a display unit for rendering AI-generated facial expressions and greeting animations,  a gesture actuation unit including servo motors and high-torque gear motors for performing arm and wrist movements,  and an audio output unit for producing synchronized greeting audio. Upon detecting a human within a predefined threshold,  the control unit initiates a coordinated interaction sequence involving displaying visual expressions,  activating gesture movements and playing corresponding audio. The system may be powered through a portable power bank and may operate autonomously through continuous scanning and interaction cycles. The invention provides a cost-effective,  modular,  and expressive humanoid platform suitable for assistive,  reception,  educational and public-engagement applications.

The present invention relates to an intelligent humanoid agent system designed to automate key processes in the insurance claim lifecycle. The system integrates artificial intelligence modules including natural language processing,  optical character recognition,  decision-rule engines,  and machine learning models to perform automated form extraction,  claim verification,  and personalised user assistance. The humanoid agent interacts with consumers through multimodal communication channels such as voice and text,  enabling real-time guidance in filing claims,  selecting policies,  and resolving queries. The invention reduces manual intervention,  minimises processing delays,  and improves overall transparency and accuracy in insurance operations by providing an end-to-end automation framework suitable for deployment in both physical humanoid embodiments and virtual interfaces.

ABSTRACT :  Title :  Emotion-Aware Conversational AI for Personalized Virtual Assistance The invention discloses an emotion-aware conversational AI system that detects and responds to user emotions in real time using multimodal machine learning models. Emotional cues are extracted from text input using natural language processing,  from speech through acoustic feature analysis,  and from facial expressions through computer vision-based expression recognition. A fusion algorithm integrates these signals to generate a unified emotional state classification. The system dynamically adapts its tone,  linguistic style,  response depth,  and recommendations based on detected emotional context. A reinforcement learning module monitors user reaction and updates the emotional model for improved future interaction. The system includes context memory for long-term personalization and operates across digital assistants,  mental health tools,  customer support bots,  and humanoid robots. The invention enhances human-computer interaction by enabling empathetic,  personalized,  and emotionally aligned communication.

The present invention relates to the development of advanced humanoid robots and human exoskeleton systems aimed at significantly enhancing human physical capabilities through the integration of robotics,  artificial intelligence,  and biomechanical design. The humanoid robot is engineered to closely mimic human anatomy and motion by employing articulated limbs,  intelligent sensors,  and AI-driven control systems,  enabling efficient task performance in domains such as healthcare services,  customer interaction,  and operation within hazardous or high-risk environments. The human exoskeleton is designed as a wearable assistive system that enhances human strength,  mobility,  and endurance,  providing substantial support for medical rehabilitation,  industrial labor,  and defense-related applications. Both the humanoid robot and exoskeleton incorporate real-time sensory feedback,  adaptive control mechanisms,  and lightweight structural materials to ensure improved performance,  operational efficiency,  and user safety. Together,  these technologies represent a powerful and transformative approach to physical assistance,  human–machine collaboration,  and automated task execution across multiple sectors.

A hotel delivery robot having a horizontal mechanism,  the hotel delivery robot comprising a lower support plate (1),  wherein a bearing plate (4) is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the lower support plate (1);  a battery (2) is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the lower support plate (1) and located below the bearing plate (4);  electric wheels (11) are rotatably connected to side surfaces of the lower support plate (1);  a sliding groove (5) is provided on the upper surface of the bearing plate (4);  a box support plate (6) is slidably connected to the upper surface of the bearing plate (4);  a magnet (7) is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the box support plate (6);  a damping block (20) is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the box support plate (6);  storage boxes (8) are provided on the upper surface of the box support plate (6);  and a second distance sensor (21) is fixedly connected to the inner surface of each storage box (8). A LiDAR having a protective support (2),  and a quadruped robot applying same,  related to the technical field of LiDAR. A LiDAR having a protective support (2) :  assembling a securing portion (11) of the LiDAR in a base (21) of the protective support (2),  and providing an elastic member (3) between the securing portion (11) and the base (21);  assembling a protective cover (22) of the protective support (2) on the outside of a rotating portion (12) of the LiDAR;  when the LiDAR collides with an external object,  the protective cover (22) is impacted first,  then the rotating portion (12) drives the securing portion (11) to move towards the bottom of the base (21),  the elastic member (3) is compressed,  absorbing external impact energy,  and thereby protecting the protective cover (22) and internal components of the LiDAR. The present application relates to the technical field of target recognition,  and in particular to a pedestrian re-identification method,  device,  intelligent device and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps of :  preprocessing a surveillance video acquired at the current moment to obtain a target image and a target audio frequency corresponding to the target image; performing humanoid recognition on the target image to obtain a target humanoid; extract footstep features from the target audio to obtain target footstep features; match the target humanoid and the target footstep features with the historical humanoid and historical footstep features in the historical feature database,  and perform pedestrian re-identification based on the matching results. This method can improve the recognition accuracy of pedestrian re-recognition and reduce misjudgments. 1. A pedestrian re-identification method,  wherein the method comprises :  pre-processing the monitoring video collected at the current time to obtain the target image and the target audio frequency corresponding to the target image;  identifying the human shape of the target image to obtain the target human shape;  extracting the step sound characteristic of the target audio frequency to obtain the target step sound characteristic;  pre-processing the history monitoring video to obtain a history image sequence and a history audio sequence,  wherein the history monitoring video is the monitoring video with preset time length before the current time;  identifying the human shape feature of the history images in the history image sequence to obtain the history human shape of each history image in the history image sequence;  extracting the footstep feature of the historical audio sequence to obtain the historical footstep feature of each historical audio in the historical audio sequence;  establishing the corresponding relationship between the historical human shape and the historical footstep feature,  comprising :  obtaining the key point feature of the history human shape in each history image of the history image sequence;  according to the key point characteristic,  determining the human body posture characteristic corresponding to the history human shape;  based on the human body posture characteristic corresponding to each history human shape in the history image sequence,  determining the human body posture change characteristic corresponding to the history image sequence;  calculating the historical characteristic distance value between the historical footstep sound characteristic and each human body posture characteristic in the human body posture change characteristic,  and determining the minimum historical characteristic distance value corresponding to the historical footstep sound characteristic;  if the minimum historical feature distance value is less than or equal to the preset historical distance threshold value,  determining that the historical footstep sound feature is matched with the human body gesture feature corresponding to the minimum historical feature distance value;  establishing the corresponding relation between the historical footstep feature and the historical human shape corresponding to the matched human body posture feature;  establishing the historical feature database based on the historical human shape,  the historical footstep feature and the corresponding relationship;  matching the target human shape and the target footsound characteristic with the historical human shape and the historical footsound characteristic in the historical characteristic database,  and re-identifying the pedestrian according to the matching result.

The invention discloses a real-time whole-body remote operation control system of a humanoid robot,  which comprises a motion instruction generation subsystem,  wherein the motion instruction generation subsystem is positioned at an operation end and is used for receiving and analyzing input instructions of multiple modes and uniformly converting and completing the input instructions into a set of whole-body joint motion instructions suitable for a target humanoid robot framework structure; the body motion control subsystem is located at the end of the robot and is used for receiving the whole body motion instructions,  combining the robot's own state and environmental information,  adaptively generating coordinated whole body motion control signals that can ensure the stability of the robot,  and driving execution; through the cooperation of the two subsystems,  the system provides a dual guarantee path for realizing whole-body remote operation :  it can not only generate a complete whole-body command based on the command generation subsystem,  but also generate a whole-body movement adaptively by the body movement control system according to the received local command; the robustness,  flexibility and reliability of the system under different conditions are ensured. 1. A real-time systemic remote remote operation control system for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a motion instruction generation sub-system for receiving and processing multiple forms of source motion instructions,  and mapping and complementing the source motion instructions to the whole body joint motion instruction of the target robot;  a main body motion control sub-system for converting the received whole body joint motion instruction into the joint motor control instruction of the bottom layer;  wherein the motion instruction generation subsystem supports multiple input forms including operator handle input,  visual motion capture data,  inertial motion capture data,  predefined human body joint motion data,  pre-recorded human body motion video data,  animation data of human body joint and high-level language command;  outputting the motion control instruction of the whole body motion joint,  comprising an inverse motion calculation module,  a depth learning remapping model and a whole body motion generation module;  The main body movement control sub-system is the human-shaped robot whole body movement control sub-system based on the deep strengthening learning development design,  which is arranged in the human-shaped robot main body.

This application discloses a humanoid robot fall prediction method,  device,  equipment and storage medium,  and relates to the field of robot control technology. It includes :  during the execution of tasks of the target humanoid robot,  real-time acquisition of target status information and target status information corresponding to the target humanoid robot. Capture point location; judging whether the target humanoid robot can reach the target capture point position based on the target state information,  if so,  determining the predicted falling time of the target humanoid robot,  and determining the target movement time when the target humanoid robot reaches the target capture point position; if the predicted fall time is greater than or equal to the target movement time,  the ZMP sequence of the target humanoid robot is generated through the model predictive control algorithm,  and based on the ZMP sequence and the target capture point position,  it is predicted whether the target humanoid robot will fall,  so as to protect the target humanoid robot from falling. According to the method and the device,  the dynamics and the timeliness of the human-shaped robot fall prediction can be improved,  and the safety protection can be carried out when the human-shaped robot falls 1. A human-shaped robot tumble prediction method,  wherein it comprises :  determining the target humanoid robot to be monitored,  and in the execution task process of the target humanoid robot,  obtaining the target state information and target capturing point position corresponding to the target humanoid robot in real time;  the position of the target capturing point represents the position where the target humanoid robot can stand stably when the foot of the target humanoid robot falls at the target capturing point;  judging whether the target humanoid robot can reach the target capturing point position based on the target state information,  if so,  determining the predicted falling time of the target humanoid robot,  and determining the target moving time of the target humanoid robot reaching the target capturing point position;  if the predicted falling time is greater than or equal to the target moving time,  then generating the ZMP sequence corresponding to the target humanoid robot through the model prediction control algorithm,  and based on the ZMP sequence and the target capturing point position,  predicting whether the target humanoid robot will fall,  so as to perform tumble protection on the target humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot traversing method for a complex soft obstacle environment. The quadruped robot traversing method for the complex soft obstacle environment comprises the following steps of S1,  actively interacting with terrain under the condition of no prior environment perception,  and acquiring terrain mechanical characteristic information; s2. Based on the obtained terrain mechanical characteristics information,  conduct in-depth analysis of the terrain,  evaluate the risk of the robot traveling on the terrain,  and adjust its gait accordingly; s3. Conduct a comprehensive assessment of the safety of the robot traveling on the current terrain,  and decide whether to pass safely or take recovery measures based on the risk level. The invention gets rid of the dependence of traditional technology on geometric contour sensing of optical sensors,  and can directly obtain key mechanical parameters such as subsidence and shear of soft terrains such as silt and thick snow on-line; at the same time,  combined with the parameter estimation method of the simplified Bekker model,  the perceptual deviation problem of "large differences in mechanical properties in visually similar areas" is solved,  which provides reliable environmental data support for subsequent planning and control. 1. A four-foot robot traversing and travelling method for complex soft obstacle environment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  under the condition that there is no prior environment sensing,  actively interacting with the terrain,  obtaining the terrain mechanics characteristic information;  S2,  based on the obtained terrain mechanics characteristic information,  deeply analyzing the terrain,  evaluating the risk of the robot travelling in the terrain,  and adjusting the gait according to this;  S3,  comprehensively evaluating the safety of the robot travelling in the current terrain,  deciding whether to safely pass or adopt the recovery measure according to the risk level;  S4,  integrating the terrain parameter,  risk evaluation and so on into the model prediction control,  realizing the precise and real-time control of the robot movement,  making the robot stably and efficiently move towards the target point in the unknown soft environment.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot scheduling,  in particular to a humanoid robot scheduling method in a humanoid robot training ground. A humanoid robot scheduling method in humanoid robot training field,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  using the multi-modal sensor array to collect the global environment data in the training field in real time,  and fusing with the obtained robot real-time pose information to generate a dynamic passing map;  analyzing the obtained training task queue into atom operation data,  and associating with the constructed training field resource table to obtain resource constraint operation chain;  dynamically distributing the resource constraint operation chain based on the dynamic passing map and the training field resource table,  and generating a scheduling path after space-time joint path planning;  transmitting the generated distribution task and the dispatching path to the corresponding humanoid robot,  and updating the dynamic traffic map and the training field resource table based on the obtained execution data.

The invention provides a humanoid robot data set quality evaluation method and a humanoid robot data set quality evaluation system based on multi-dimensional evaluation,  and provides a systematic and standardized evaluation process aiming at the quality problems existing in the conventional robot multi-modal data set in the aspects of standardization,  completeness,  accuracy,  consistency,  timeliness,  accessibility,  usability and the like This method combines automated tools with manual auditing to comprehensively detect the structure,  metadata,  annotated content,  data format and multi-modal alignment of the data set,  and introduces deep learning algorithms to achieve pornographic pictures and sensitive words of visual content. The practical application shows that this method can significantly improve the overall quality of robot data set,  and provide reliable data foundation and technical support for robot intelligent training and application. 1. A humanoid robot data set quality evaluation method based on multi-dimensional evaluation,  for evaluating the robot data set containing multi-mode data to judge the data set quality level,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step S1,  respectively performing corresponding pre-processing and classification to each type of original data in the robot data set,  at least comprising data structure analysis,  data type identification classification,  file format and naming normative detection,  so as to obtain pre-processing data set; The invention solves the problem that the traditional rigid model or constant parameter model is difficult to reflect the deformation characteristics under the combined action of heat-lubrication-load in real time,  making it difficult for the control loop to eliminate the flexibility error. 1. A full-closed-loop control method of humanoid robot joint module based on FPGA,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  S1,  performing second-order active low-pass filtering and programmable gain amplification on the analog signal of the encoder,  the gyroscope and the force sensor,  and converting the processed signal into digital signal through ADC;  S2,  constructing multi-dimensional characteristic sequence,  comprising calculating signal residual noise variance,  signal power,  signal-to-noise ratio,  joint speed,  acceleration,  error and error change rate,  and detecting mechanical resonance frequency;  S3,  collecting the temperature signals of the joint driver and the encoder through the temperature sensor interface,  and constructing a temperature drift model,  obtaining a zero-position drift compensation parameter;  S4,  after obtaining the driving torque,  constructing an elastic deformation model to obtain the joint elastic deformation error;  S5,  applying the zero-position drift compensation parameter and the elastic deformation error to the encoder signal for online offset correction;  S6,  taking the joint angle after the multi-dimensional characteristic sequence and the zero position drift compensation and the compensation angle of the flexible influence as the input,  based on the light weight neural network,  outputting the filter cut-off frequency,  FIR window length,  Kalman filter covariance matrix and reconfiguration area selection signal;  S7,  triggering the local refresh of the bit stream corresponding to PR Region according to the region selection signal output by the light weight neural network.

The invention discloses a high-strength sensing fiber for humanoid robots,  which includes a high-strength viscose fiber substrate and a conductive sensing layer that statically grows in situ on the surface of the substrate; the high-strength viscose fiber substrate is prepared from wood pulp cellulose through alkalization-porosity,  low-temperature dissolution,  spinning and post-treatment processes; the high-strength sensing fiber has a breaking strength of ≥ 8 cN/dtex and a conductivity of ≥ 50 S/cm. It can be used to prepare flexible tactile sensors. It has a sensitivity of ≥ 35 kPa ‑ 1,  a response time of ≤ 80 ms,  and a recovery time of ≤ 100 ms in the pressure range of 0 ‑ 1. 3 kPa. The conductivity retention rate is ≥ 90% after 2000 cycles of bending. High-strength sensing fibers can be integrated into the dexterous hands,  joints and electronic skin systems of humanoid robots to accurately sense three-dimensional force,  deformation and temperature signals. It solves the technical problem of traditional sensing fibers that it is difficult to balance the mechanical properties and sensing properties,  and has broad industrial application prospects. 1. A high-strength sensing fibre for humanoid robot,  comprising a high-strength viscose fibre substrate and a conductive sensing layer grown on the surface of the substrate in situ;  the conductive sensing layer is a conductive polymer layer grown on the surface of the fibre substrate through electrostatic in-situ polymerization reaction;  The breaking strength of the high strength sensing fibre is not less than 8cN/dtex,  and the conductivity is not less than 50S/cm.

The invention discloses a flow transfer and energy conduction system and method based on high power density ratio and low energy consumption,  and relates to the technical field of electro-hydraulic servo control. It includes :  a constant pressure source,  an oil replenishment valve,  at least three actuators,  a reversing valve,  a pressure reducing valve,  an overflow valve,  and a servo valve; the actuators,  reversing valves,  pressure reducing valves,  and servo valves are connected in series to form an oil circulation path. The return oil from the first actuator flows through the corresponding reversing valve,  pressure reducing valve,  and servo valve and then flows into the next actuator adjacent to it. The return oil from the final actuator flows back to the oil tank through the corresponding servo valve This invention realizes the cascade utilization of braking energy through the constructed oil-energy circulation system,  and uses the medium and high-pressure return oil during braking of the driving joint directly as the driving oil source of the following joint,  avoiding the pressure potential energy in the traditional system from passing through throttling. The problem of heat waste greatly reduces the driving power of the constant pressure source and the energy consumption of the whole machine. 1. A flow transfer and energy conduction system based on high power density ratio and low energy consumption,  wherein it comprises :  a constant voltage source for providing an initial oil source of the system;  an oil supply valve matched with the constant pressure source and used for supplying the flow loss caused by the leakage of the system;  an executing element at least comprising three executing elements for driving the joints of the electro-hydraulic double-foot humanoid robot,  wherein the executing element is a hydraulic cylinder or a bidirectional quantitative motor;  a reversing valve,  each of which is correspondingly provided with a reversing valve for controlling the oil flow direction;  a pressure reducing valve arranged on the oil liquid flowing channel between the executing elements for stabilizing the pressure of the flowing oil liquid;  an overflow valve for discharging the redundant oil liquid in the oil liquid circulation;  a servo valve for controlling the on-off and flow direction of the oil liquid;  the executing element,  the reversing valve,  the pressure reducing valve and the servo valve are orderly connected in series to form an oil liquid circulation path,  the oil return of the first executing element passes through the corresponding reversing valve,  the pressure reducing valve,  the servo valve flows into the oil inlet of the next executing element adjacent to it,  the oil return of the last executing element flows back to the oil tank through the corresponding servo valve;  The system is used for driving the joint of the electro-hydraulic double-foot humanoid robot,  adapting the follow-up between the joints or the master-slave movement logic,  the output flow of the constant voltage source only needs to match the flow requirement of the first execution element.
