This patent proposes a humanoid robot monocular pose estimation method based on lightweight HRNet,  including target detection network,  key point extraction network,  and PnP pose calculation. The target detection network consists of an image super-resolution network branch based on edge enhancement and a multi-scale FRCNN target detection network branch. The image super-resolution network branch based on edge enhancement belongs to the GAN structure. The image super-resolution network and FRCNN are jointly optimized to output the target. ROI area; adding five layers of scale feature detection modules in FRCNN can enhance the detection ability of small targets. The key point extraction network uses HRNet as the backbone,  and performs shrinkage analysis on the deep branch and width branch of HRNet to obtain redundant HRNet; two HRNets are connected in series,  and the characteristics of the second and third stages corresponding to the two HRNets are added to finally output the key points of the humanoid robot; extract the 2D key points of the target,  and use the known 3D structure to perform PnP pose calculation to obtain the pose results of the humanoid robot. 1. A monocular pose estimation method of humanoid robot based on lightweight HRNet,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  pose estimation network model design,  adopting the three-stage pose estimation network to execute the pose estimation task of the humanoid robot,  the network model comprises :  a human-shaped robot target detection network,  a key point extraction network,  PInP pose calculation,  a monocular camera is installed in the environment where the human-shaped robot works,  the obtained monocular image is input to the target detection network,  the target detection network firstly performs super-resolution reconstruction on the image,  then outputs the ROI area of the target,  the key point extraction network performs key point extraction on the ROI,  The output 2D key point is combined with the 3D to perform the PInP pose calculation,  and the 6D pose is output. S2,  a target detection network design,  the target detection network is composed of an image super-resolution network branch based on edge enhancement and a multi-scale FRCNN target detection network branch,  wherein the image super-resolution network branch based on edge enhancement is designed as a GAN structure,  five layers of scale feature detection modules are added in the FRCNN,  finally,  jointly optimizing the image super-resolution network and FRCNN,  wherein the output of the image super-resolution network is the input of FRCNN,  the output of the FRCNN is the two-dimensional detection frame of the target in the super-resolution image,  and cutting the ROI interval. S3,  a key point extraction network design,  taking the ROI area of the two-dimensional detection frame as input,  eliminating the image outside the ROI area,  only reserving the ROI area containing the target,  performing redundancy analysis on each stage of the HRNet network,  the key point extraction network uses HRNet as backbone,  The depth branch and the width branch of the HRNet are performed with gradual contraction analysis,  and the branch with high redundancy is cut to obtain the redundancy-removed HRNet. S4,  HRNet series design,  using two de-redundant HRNet to perform series connection,  the output of the first HRNet is the input of the second HRNet,  and the two de-redundant HRNet are respectively corresponding to the second,  the third stage performs feature addition,  based on ResNeXt,  designs a light weight module to replace the basic module of the HRNet,  and finally outputs the 2D key point of the humanoid robot. S5,  PInP pose calculation network,  the step S4 in HRNet in series after the output of the 2D key point with known 3D structure proceed 2D-3D PInP pose calculation,  output humanoid robot of 6 degree of freedom (6-DoF) pose.

The invention relates to the technical field of digital human faces,  and discloses a digital human face binding generation method based on expression capture The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring facial expression data of a target object in real time through an expression capturing device,  and acquiring fine facial motion information; extracting features from the collected data,  filtering out redundant information to obtain expression feature vector set reflecting the key features of facial motion; fitting the continuous motion track of face according to the set to generate initial binding rule conforming to the real motion rule of human body; map it to the face topology of the digital human model to generate initial face binding data of the adaptive model; systematically optimize the initial data,  correct the motion parameter problem,  and obtain optimized face binding data; driving digital human model facial movements with optimized data. This method can make digital human expressions more natural and move more smoothly,  reduce manual operations,  improve binding efficiency,  and is suitable for movies,  virtual live broadcasts,  interactive games and other scenes. 1. A digital human face binding generation method based on expression capture,  wherein it comprises :  collecting the real-time facial expression data of the target object in real time by the expression capturing device;  performing feature extraction on the real-time facial expression data to obtain an expression feature vector set;  performing face motion track fitting according to the expression feature vector set to generate an initial binding rule;  mapping to a face topology structure of a digital human model based on the initial binding rule to generate initial face binding data;  performing binding optimization processing on the initial face binding data to generate optimized face binding data;  using the optimized face binding data to drive the digital human model face to move.

The invention relates to an intelligent power supply system for a humanoid robot using two parallel battery buses,  enabling continuous power supply and hot-swappable batteries without system interruption. The invention provides a motion control method and a motion control system for an intelligent robot. The motion control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environment and state data through a humanoid robot intelligent sensor group,  inputting a pre-trained first neural network model,  and obtaining motion prediction data and an environment analysis result; based on this,  the motion planning model is constructed,  and the preset first algorithm is used to optimize the energy consumption-stability multi-objective optimization of the joint motion trajectory; the central controller generates joint position,  speed and moment reference tracks based on the optimized result; the local second controller of each joint locally adjusts the reference trajectory in the prediction time domain based on real-time feedback. According to the invention,  the intelligent perception of the environment and the self state is realized by combining the multiple sensors with the hybrid attention neural network,  and the problem of time sequence dependence of the data fusion of the multiple sensors is solved Energy consumption-stability multi-objective optimization significantly improves the efficiency of motion in complex environments; the central controller works together with the local controller,  combined with the edge computing architecture,  to reduce communication latency and improve system response speed. 1. A motion control method for intelligent robot,  wherein it comprises :  the environment data and the robot state data are collected by the intelligent sensor group arranged on the human-shaped robot;  inputting the environment data and the robot state data to a pre-trained first neural network model to obtain motion prediction data and environment analysis result of the robot;  according to the motion prediction data and the environmental analysis result,  constructing a motion planning model,  the motion planning model comprises :  a first sub-model for generating global path and behaviour sequence according to the task target and environment analysis result;  using a preset first algorithm to perform energy consumption-stability multi-target optimization on the joint motion trajectory in the motion planning model,  specifically comprising :  constructing a composite target function including an energy consumption term,  a motion stability term and a task completion term;  the quantum annealing mechanism is used for fast searching in the solution space so as to realize the optimal motion control parameter in the complex terrain and dynamic environment;  dynamically adjusting the joint rigidity and the damping parameter according to the optimizing result so that the robot can minimize the energy consumption while keeping the stability;  the central controller generates the reference track of the joint position,  speed and moment based on the optimization result;  the second controller configured in the local of each joint adjusts the reference track locally in the predicted time domain according to the real-time feedback data.

The invention discloses a system and a method for intelligently inserting and self-checking a line sequence of a humanoid robot. The system comprises a mechanical arm,  an end effector,  a laser projection system,  a mobile vision system and a six-dimensional force sensor The system adopts laser guidance and SIFT feature recognition to realize the sub-millimeter automatic pre-alignment of the robotic arm and the actuator; during the plugging process,  the six-dimensional force and torque data,  combined with the standard curve and DTW algorithm,  are used to monitor the process and detect plugging abnormalities in real time. After the plugging is completed,  a frequency sweep signal is injected,  the poor contact point is accurately detected by impedance phase shift and amplitude analysis,  and the defect position is located through signal reflection delay. For poor contact points,  the system adopts a compensation path based on Hausdorf distance,  and drives the shape memory alloy to automatically repair,  realizing high-precision line sequence self-test and fault repair. The system greatly improves the assembly accuracy and efficiency,  reduces the rework rate and manufacturing cost,  and significantly enhances the intelligence and reliability of the humanoid robot production process 1. A system for intelligently inserting and self-checking line sequence of humanoid robot,  comprising a mechanical arm,  a tail end executor and a computer,  wherein the computer is connected with the robot,  the robot is connected with the mechanical arm,  the mechanical arm is connected with the end actuator,  the computer is connected with a modulator,  the end actuator is connected with a demodulator,  the computer sends a frequency sweeping signal to the demodulator through the modulator to detect whether there is a poor contact point between the mechanical arm and the end effector,  the impedance of the poor contact point will cause the phase movement and amplitude attenuation of the frequency sweeping signal,  The computer judges whether there is a bad contact point by detecting the phase and amplitude change of the frequency sweeping signal.

The invention provides a humanoid robot multi-modal visual calibration system and an operating method The humanoid robot multi-modal vision calibration system builds a closed-loop control system that integrates synchronous collection,  data alignment,  feature fusion,  online correction,  hand-eye relationship calculation and quality assessment feedback It achieves efficient collaboration of multi-modal visual sensing information and automatic maintenance and optimization of hand-eye relationships Therefore,  the problem of accuracy attenuation caused by the misalignment of the relationship between sensors in the prior art is effectively overcome,  and the accuracy,  consistency and long-term reliability of perception and operation of the humanoid robot based on multi-modal vision in complex and changeable environments are significantly improved 1. A multi-modal vision calibration system for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a multi-mode vision sensing and synchronous collecting unit for synchronously collecting the image data of the target through multiple rigidly mounted heterogeneous vision sensors;  a multi-source data pre-processing and characteristic aligning unit for receiving the image data and performing coordinate uniform and data enhancement processing to generate aligned multi-source data;  a multi-mode profile fusion extracting unit for receiving the aligned multi-source data and generating the high-precision target profile information and the three-dimensional space coordinate by fusing the characteristic information;  a multi-sensor cooperative calibration and online correction unit for calculating and maintaining the space geometric relationship among the multiple heterogeneous vision sensors based on the robot movement and the target outline information,  and correcting the space geometric relationship in real time;  a hand-eye calibration resolving unit for constructing and resolving the hand-eye transformation relation by a weighted least square algorithm based on the target outline information and the three-dimensional space coordinate thereof,  the robot motion information and the space geometric relation;  a calibration quality evaluation and feedback unit,  for evaluating the quality of the hand-eye transformation relationship,  and generating a feedback signal according to the evaluation result to optimize the data collecting strategy,  wherein the feedback signal is transmitted to the multi-modal visual sensing and synchronous collecting unit,  so as to adjust the collecting process,  forming a closed loop control.

The invention belongs to the field of robot control,  and particularly relates to a bionic skin heating self-adaptive power distribution method of a humanoid robot,  aiming at solving the problem that the humanoid robot is difficult to reasonably heat and control when executing complex dynamic tasks in the related technology The method provided by the invention comprises the following steps of :  acquiring target data; input the target data into a pre-built digital twin model to predict the thermal state change trend of each skin area within a preset period in the future,  and combine it with the predicted motion state to identify key areas that are preferentially heated; using the heating power assigned to each skin area as the decision variable to construct and solve a multi-objective optimization model; determine the heating control instructions for each skin area based on the power distribution value obtained by solving. The present invention uses digital twin models and predictive motion states to foresee in advance the thermal state trends caused by future movements of the robot and environmental changes,  effectively improving the heating control effect of the robot under complex working conditions. 1. A humanoid robot bionic skin heating self-adaptive power distribution method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the target data,  wherein the target data comprises the surface temperature of each skin area of the robot,  the environment parameter of the located environment,  and the real-time and predictive motion state of the robot;  inputting the target data to a pre-constructed digital twinning model to predict the thermal state change trend of each skin area in the future pre-set period,  and combining the predictive motion state to identify the key area of preferential heating;  taking the heating power distributed to each skin area as the decision variable,  constructing and solving the multi-target optimization model;  wherein the multi-target optimization model takes the power distribution value of each skin area as the decision variable,  takes the temperature of the key area not less than the preset threshold value as the core constraint,  at the same time,  takes the total energy consumption minimization and the temperature field uniformity maximization of the whole surface of the robot as the optimization target,  the optimized restriction is the total power upper limit of each skin area and the power limit of each skin area corresponding to the heating unit;  according to the obtained power distribution value,  determining the heating control instruction of each skin area.

The invention provides a climbing balance control method suitable for a multi-legged robot. The multi-legged robot comprises a robot body and a plurality of foot components. The method comprises the following steps of :  S101,  lifting the height of the robot body through the foot components until the bottom of the robot body is higher than the height of a tea ridge to be climbed; s102. Move the robot body close to the foot components that need to cross the near side of the tea ridge in sequence to the far side that needs to cross the tea ridge; s103. Through the coordinated action of all foot components,  move the robot body laterally in the direction of the tea ridge that needs to be crossed,  until the robot body moves directly above the tea ridge that needs to be crossed; s104. Move the foot components on the other side of the robot body to the proximal side where the tea ridge needs to be climbed. The method can keep the center of gravity of the robot body stable,  prevent rollover,  adapt to tea ridges of different heights and widths,  enable the multi-legged robot to climb over the tea ridges efficiently and safely,  and at the same time ensure that the tea leaves are not damaged. 1. A climbing balance control method suitable for multi-foot robot,  the multi-foot robot comprises a robot main body and a plurality of foot components respectively set on two sides of the robot main body,  wherein the method comprises :  S101,  lifting the height of the robot main body through the foot component until the bottom of the robot main body is higher than the height of the tea ridge to be turned over;  S102,  orderly moving the foot component of the robot main body close to the near side of the tea ridge to be turned over to the far side of the tea ridge to be turned over;  S103,  through all foot components cooperating action,  transversely moving the robot main body towards the direction of the tea ridge to be turned over,  until the robot main body moves to the right upper part of the tea ridge to be turned over;  S104,  orderly moving the foot component close to the other side of the robot main body to the near side of the tea ridge to be overturned.

The off-road environment has ambiguous environmental semantics,  ambiguous boundaries,  and random scene structure In order to solve the defects of sudden obstacles and the like,  the current control method is difficult to meet the safety needs of emergency avoidance. The piston cylinder at the bottom of the sliding column forms a micro pump in the suction cavity,  which continuously pumps the lubricating oil deposited at the bottom of the cavity to the top end. The present disclosure provides a leg assembly (100) design for medium-sized robot dogs,  prioritizing ease of assembly and disassembly. The leg assembly (100) incorporates a unique knee joint mechanism with a shaft design featuring flange bearings and no external screws,  enhancing flexibility and simplifying construction. Utilizing a flange bearing arrangement and standoffs enables the independent movement of thigh and shank links,  resulting in a lightweight,  easily manufacturable design with a high strength-to-weight ratio. The symmetric sagittal plane design ensures even load distribution,  while the lightweight nature of the leg enhances control due to low inertial effects. Efficiency in energy delivery and torque transparency is achieved through a belt transmission system with double staging. Additionally,  the strategic bend in the shank link optimizes foot-ground contact during gait,  improving propulsion and stability,  complemented by a viscoelastic foot design. Cost- effective optimization is underscored without compromising strength in the specified torque range.

This paper introduces an innovative,  low-cost collaborative robot (cobot) system for precision soldering,  leveraging a Raspberry Pi for control,  an APDS-9960 sensor for gesture and proximity-based interaction,  and a camera for real-time PCB monitoring. Designed to democratize advanced manufacturing,  the system enables intuitive gesture-driven control,  allowing operators to initiate,  pause,  or adjust soldering tasks while ensuring safety through proximity detection. The integrated camera enhances precision by providing visual feedback for PCB alignment and automated solder joint inspection,  achieving soldering accuracy of ±0.15 mm. The cobot,  equipped with a 4-DOF robotic arm and a temperature-controlled soldering module,  reduces soldering time by 25% and defect rates by 35% compared to manual methods,  as validated on standard PCBs. Costing under $750,  this solution combines affordable hardware with vision-guided automation,  addressing Industry 4.0 demands for flexible,  human-centric manufacturing.

The present application relates to the field of automatic driving technology,  and specifically relates to a method,  device,  equipment and medium for processing automatic driving tasks. This application first obtains navigation guidance information and directly incorporates over-the-horizon content (such as remote steering,  distance,  etc.),  breaking through the limitation of the sensing range of vehicle-mounted sensors and solving the problem of lack of over-the-horizon information in existing systems. Secondly,  semantic analysis is performed based on navigation information and multi-view visual data to obtain text probability distribution,  realizing the correlation between global navigation context and real-time scenes,  and providing semantic basis for humanoid planning. Then,  the bird's-eye view features and text probability features are integrated across modalities to deeply couple global navigation logic with real-time environment perception,  ensuring that decision-making takes into account both short-term environment and long-term planning. Finally,  the fusion features are input into the task network to make perception,  prediction,  and planning more suitable for actual scenarios,  improve the ability to utilize beyond visual range information in complex scenarios,  and enhance system adaptability and reasoning capabilities. 1. A processing method of automatic driving task,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the multi-view visual data collected by the vehicle in the driving process,  and obtaining the navigation guide information of the vehicle;  generating an overview angle feature based on the visual feature in the multi-view angle visual data,  and performing a driving scene semantic analysis based on the navigation guide information and the multi-view angle visual data to obtain a text probability distribution;  performing cross-mode fusion based on the bird ' s-eye angle characteristic and the processed text probability characteristic to obtain the fusion characteristic,  and inputting the fusion characteristic into multiple automatic driving task networks to obtain the automatic driving decision information output by each automatic driving task network.

The invention belongs to the technical field of ball screw pairs and discloses a time-varying dynamics modeling method for a ball screw feed driver,  which includes the following steps :  S1 :  determine the real-time position of the moving nut and the time-varying spatial position of the recirculating ball; s2 :  Establish a time-varying contact force model of recirculating balls; s3 :  Establish and solve the time-varying dynamics model. High-precision modeling of the time-varying dynamic characteristics of the ball screw feed driver is achieved by using the variable-length Timoshenko beam model and the shape function interpolation method,  combined with the idea of equal circumference transformation of the nut pair composite raceway,  Hertz contact and multi-rigid body dynamics theory This method is suitable for high-precision nonlinear dynamics modeling and vibration response calculation of precision motion platforms such as high-end machine tools,  semiconductor equipment,  humanoid robot joints,  etc.,  and can effectively predict vibration deformation,  dynamic accuracy and stability problems during nut movement. 1. A time-varying dynamics modelling method of ball screw feeding driver,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  determining the real-time position of the moving nut and the time-varying spatial position of the recirculation ball :  discretizing the wire lever based on the finite unit beam model,  defining the length of the beam unit as a function of the nut feeding speed and time;  the composite raceway of the nut is equivalent to a circular raceway based on the equal perimeter principle,  and the spatial position of the re-circulating ball in the composite raceway and the circular raceway is determined according to the lead screw structure and the ball distribution parameter;  S2 :  establishing a re-circulating ball time-varying contact force model :  based on the displacement vector of the beam unit node and the unit shape function matrix,  calculating the displacement of the ball-screw contact point;  the real-time contact deformation of the re-circulating ball is determined by tracking the change of the curvature centre distance of the raceway groove under the effect of the load;  at the same time,  the transient contact impact force generated when the ball in the returning device enters the spiral raceway is considered;  applying the Hertz contact theory to establish a re-circulating ball time-varying contact force model to obtain the ball contact force;  S3 :  establishing and solving the time-varying kinetic model :  distributing the ball contact force obtained in the step S2 to the beam unit node by using the inverse matrix of the shape function,  superposing the contribution of all the balls to form the node load;  based on the beam unit assembly,  establishing a screw rod dynamic equation;  taking the nut as a rigid body,  considering the contact damping effect,  establishing a system time-varying non-linear dynamic model comprising a lead screw node displacement and a nut displacement as a degree-of-freedom variable;  solving the dynamic model to obtain the displacement response under the combined working condition of constant-speed feeding and pre-tightening force.

The invention discloses a training method and device for a large language automatic driving model driven by humanoid thinking. First,  at least four levels of training data sets are constructed,  including :  driving knowledge data set,  driving space reasoning data set,  driving behavior prediction data set and driving path planning data set; then,  the LLM is pre-trained with pure language data to enable it to master driving knowledge and text reasoning ability; then,  the pre-trained LLM and the visual module are jointly trained to train the MLLM,  so that it can master the multi-modal thinking ability. In the training stage,  a training strategy combining supervised fine-tuning,  offline reinforcement learning and online reinforcement learning is adopted. The invention enables the model to have human-like thinking,  improves the understanding and generalization capabilities of complex scenes,  enhances the robustness of end-to-end decision-making planning,  and effectively copes with rare scenes. 1. A training method of large language automatic driving model driven by humanoid thinking,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 (S1) :  constructing a training data set of at least four levels,  wherein the training data set of each level comprises a humanoid thinking chain data,  and the humanoid thinking chain data comprises an reasoning step and a final answer;  wherein the training data sets of at least four levels comprise :  a driving knowledge data set,  a driving space reasoning data set,  a driving behaviour prediction data set and a driving path planning data set;  the driving knowledge data set is used for enabling the model to learn the common knowledge and professional knowledge of the driving field;  the driving space reasoning data set is used for enabling the model to learn the geometric reasoning ability under the driving scene static model 3D model space;  the driving behaviour prediction data set is used for enabling the model to learn the prediction ability of the potential intention,  the target and the psychological state of other traffic participants;  the driving path planning data set is used for enabling the model to learn the mode of interaction among multiple targets of the road,  the potential influence caused by the behaviour of other traffic participants to the vehicle and the planning ability of the vehicle to the future driving path;  step S2 :  carrying out two-stage training :  LLM model pre-training stage :  pre-training the large language automatic driving model by using the pure language question and answer data in the training data set,  so that the large language automatic driving model understands various knowledge of the driving scene,  and learns the pure text reasoning ability;  end-to-end training stage of MLLM model :  performing joint end-to-end training on the pre-trained large language automatic driving model and the visual module,  using the multi-mode question and answer data in the training data set,  enabling the large language automatic driving model to master the multi-mode thinking ability;  the model LLM model pre-training stage and the model MLLM model end-to-end training stage adopt the training strategy of the combination of monitoring fine adjustment,  off-line strengthening learning,  online strengthening learning;  wherein the monitoring fine adjustment is based on the training data set of at least four levels,  in turn using four-section cascade fine adjustment of driving knowledge,  space reasoning,  behaviour prediction and path planning;  the off-line strengthening learning uses the human driving preference data to train the driving quality evaluation model to guide the strategy optimization;  the online reinforcement learning obtains the real feedback and updates the strategy through the active interaction between the large language automatic driving model and the environment.

The invention discloses a petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robot trajectory planning method,  device and equipment. The petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robot trajectory planning method,  device and equipment collects petrochemical environment gas concentration data,  robot joint motion parameters and target position information,  performs dangerous area calibration on the gas concentration data to generate a no-travel map,  and determines safety nodes and joint motion range; constructing an initial path skeleton based on target location information and safety node distribution,  identifying local dangerous sections and major dangerous sections,  and generating motion constraints and poison avoidance paths; generating action primitive library based on motion constraint condition and joint motion range,  performing stability filtering to generate stable action primitive,  and forming travel scheme set; obtaining joint load peak value to construct dynamic envelope,  judging execution fitness to form execution probability field; construct a three-dimensional decision-making space based on the poison avoidance path,  travel plan set and execution probability field,  find the optimal convergence point to generate the final planned trajectory,  and provide a safe and efficient trajectory planning plan for petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robots. 1. A petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robot trajectory planning method,  wherein it comprises :  collecting petrochemical environment gas concentration data,  robot joint motion parameter and target position information,  performing dangerous area calibration on the gas concentration data to generate forbidden map,  determining safety node from the forbidden map,  determining joint motion range based on the joint motion parameter;  performing path search based on the target position information and the safety node distribution to construct an initial path skeleton,  performing safety analysis on the initial path skeleton to identify a local dangerous section,  generating a motion constraint condition and a posture balance requirement based on the local dangerous section;  according to the initial path framework,  identifying a major dangerous section,  performing threat level evaluation on the major dangerous section to generate a risk weight,  using the risk weight to perform path replanning to generate a poison evasion path;  generating an action basic element base based on the motion constraint condition and the joint activity range,  performing stability filtering on the action basic element base according to the posture balance requirement to generate a stable action basic element,  performing path knitting on the stable action basic element between the safety nodes to form a travelling solution set;  obtaining the joint load peak value in the travelling solution set,  constructing a dynamic envelope based on the joint load peak value,  judging the execution fitness according to the dynamic envelope,  performing spatial coordinate projection on the execution fitness to form an execution probability field;  constructing a three-dimensional decision space based on the poison evasion path,  the travelling solution set and the execution probability field,  searching an optimal convergence point in the three-dimensional decision space,  and generating a final planning track based on the optimal convergence point.

 the robot needs to change the direction of the line of sight to be related to the target tracking,  the task requirement and the environmental change factor,  the target tracking :  a deviation of the target position detected by the visual sensor from the intended or planned path;  Task requirements :  when navigating,  avoiding obstacle or interacting with people,  it needs to change sight line to adapt to the change of environment or focus;  Environmental Change :  The changes occurring in the environment may require the robot to adjust the line of sight to obtain more information,  specifically comprising the following steps :  Step B1 :  determining the target position; The invention relates to a motion redirection method and a motion redirection device for a full humanoid robot based on motion capture equipment. The motion redirection method comprises the following steps of :  converting human posture quaternions collected by the motion capture equipment into a rotation matrix,  and combining an Euler angle decomposition strategy to realize accurate mapping from Cartesian space to robot joint space; taking the joint angle disassembled by quaternions as the initial solution,  a variety of physical constraints are introduced in real time based on the actual support status of the robot By constructing and solving the inverse kinematics problem with multi-class constraints,  the lower limb joint angle is corrected online,  so that the robot can strictly meet the requirements of joint limit,  self-collision avoidance and dynamic balance while reproducing the operator's actions,  so as to achieve effective unity between the accuracy of motion imitation and system stability. 1. A full-humanoid robot motion redirection method based on motion capture device,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the rotation posture data of each joint of the human body collected by the dynamic capturing device,  wherein the rotation posture data is represented in the form of quaternion;  each joint of the human body comprises a single-degree-of-freedom joint and a multi-degree-of-freedom joint;  according to the rotation posture data of each joint of the human body,  determining the joint angle of each joint of the robot;  for the single-degree-of-freedom joint,  according to the quaternion,  determining the rotating angle of the quaternion around the rotating shaft,  taking the angle as the joint angle;  for the multi-degree-of-freedom joint,  determining multiple joints of the robot decomposed by the multi-degree-of-freedom joint and the rotating direction corresponding to each joint,  and calculating the joint angle of each joint of the robot obtained by decomposing according to the quaternion;  each joint of the robot comprises an upper half body joint and a lower half body joint;  for the single-degree-of-freedom joint of the upper body joint,  making the difference between the joint angle at the current moment and the joint angle initial value,  taking the obtained difference as the incremental control instruction of the corresponding joint;  for the multi-degree-of-freedom joint of the upper body joint,  taking the joint angle at the current moment as the incremental control instruction of the corresponding joint;  for the joint of the lower half body,  the distance between the centroid of the robot and the supporting point is calculated by the positive kinematics according to the joint angle;  determining the support state of the robot according to the distance and the support state determining rule of the robot;  the supporting state of the robot comprises a double-foot supporting state,  a single-foot supporting state and a transition state;  according to the supporting state of the robot,  applying the corresponding constraint condition to the robot,  using reverse kinematics to calculate to obtain the corrected joint angle;  taking the corrected joint angle as the incremental control instruction of the corresponding joint.

A human-shaped robot active protection method,  wherein it is applied to the central control unit of the active protection system,  the active protection system further comprises :  an infrared moving capturing unit and a track protecting unit,  wherein the infrared moving capturing unit is a space locating unit for arranging multiple infrared cameras,  for collecting the real-time pose data of the humanoid robot through the multiple infrared cameras and sending to the central control unit;  the track protection unit is used for executing the preset active protection strategy;  The method comprises :  obtaining the real-time pose data of the human-shaped robot;  calculating the motion trend of the humanoid robot based on the real-time pose data,  and actively protecting and judging based on the motion trend to obtain the judging result;  and controlling the track protection unit to execute the active protection strategy under the condition that the judgement result indicates that the human-shaped robot is in the tumble pre-warning state.

The invention relates to the cross technical field of robot control,  computer graphics and motion capture processing Specifically,  it is a humanoid robot motion migration method and system based on motion capture Includes the following steps :  S1 :  Collect human body movement data and convert it into a general format. Specifically,  record the movement trajectory of human body mark points through the motion capture system,  generate a. bvh file containing bone levels and motion parameters,  and then convert the. bvh file into a file containing translation and posture. An NPZ format file of parameters,  which is processed based on the SMPL-X human body model. Through scale optimization and joint matching,  the invention solves the problem of scale difference between the SMPL human body model and the robot model,  improves the matching accuracy of joint positions,  and effectively prevents the robot joint angle from exceeding the limit by combining the optimization strategy of main loss and regularization terms and physical constraints to ensure the physical feasibility of the action. 1. A humanoid robot motion migration method based on motion capture,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  collecting human body action data and converting into universal format,  specifically is through action capturing system recording human body mark point motion track,  generating .bvh file containing bone hierarchy and motion parameter,  then converting the .bvh file into NPZ format file containing translation and posture parameter,  the NPZ format file is processed based on the SMPL-X human body model;  S2 :  establishing a matching relationship between the human body model and the robot model,  comprising :  the SMPL shape parameter and the scaling factor are defined as the optimization parameter,  the sum of the square of the position error of the robot joint and the SMPL joint is used as the loss function,  the Adam optimizer iteratively optimizes 1000 times,  matching the SMPL model with the robot model scale and storing the optimized result as pk1 format;  S3 :  moving the human body action data to the robot model,  comprising :  loading SMPL format action data and converting into 3D joint position,  fitting to the robot model through gradient optimization algorithm,  the gradient optimization algorithm at the same time optimizes the joint angle,  the root node rotates and offsets,  taking the joint position error L2 norm and the joint angle square sum regularization term as the loss function,  and restricting the joint angle in the physical feasible range;  S4 :  performing post-processing on the robot action data,  comprising :  The method comprises the following steps :  smoothing the joint angle by Gaussian filtering,  processing the rotation transition by spherical linear interpolation,  processing the transition of the position of the linear interpolation and the joint angle,  removing the high-frequency vibration by a Butterworth low-pass filter,  and optimizing the contact restriction between the foot sliding and the ground;  S5 :  The motion data format is converted to .pkl format and verified to ensure that the joint angle is within the mechanical limit range to generate motion data that can be used for robot control.

The present invention relates to the field of robot vision technology A humanoid robot calibration path planning method and system based on joint tracking are disclosed Methods include :  Obtain the first joint strain data and first joint jitter data of the humanoid robot palm within the undisturbed condition time interval,  and the second joint strain data and the second joint jitter data in the time interval of the actual disturbance condition,  calculate the difference factor of the joint strain data and the difference factor of the joint jitter data,  and perform weighted summation to obtain the comprehensive difference factor of the calibration path in each time interval Construct a comprehensive difference factor curve of the calibration path Determine the calibration path planning coefficient,  set the calibration path planning strategy of the humanoid robot palm,  comprehensively evaluate the joint error and jitter differences under different conditions,  and realize adaptive path planning through quantitative analysis,  so as to improve the movement stability and accuracy of the humanoid robot palm in complex environments. 1. A humanoid robot calibration path planning method based on joint tracking,  wherein it comprises :  pre-setting multiple time intervals,  obtaining the first joint strain data and the first joint vibration data of the human-shaped robot palm in the non-disturbance condition time interval,  and the second joint strain data and the second joint vibration data in the actual disturbance condition time interval;  calculating the joint strain data difference factor and the joint vibration data difference factor corresponding to each time interval according to the first joint strain data,  the first joint vibration data,  the second joint strain data and the second joint vibration data;  weighting and summing the joint strain data difference factor and the joint jitter data difference factor to obtain the calibration path comprehensive difference factor corresponding to each time interval;  constructing a calibration path comprehensive difference factor curve according to all calibration path comprehensive difference factors,  determining the calibration path planning coefficient of the human-shaped robot palm,  and setting the calibration path planning strategy of the human-shaped robot palm based on the calibration path planning coefficient.

A control method of four-foot robot integrated mechanical arm system,  wherein it is used for controlling the four-foot robot integrated mechanical arm system to finish the moving operation task in the unstructured environment,  comprising :  step 1,  using the track optimization algorithm based on single rigid body model,  through the artificially defined moving operation track,  obtaining the four-foot robot moving operation motion priori of the four-foot robot integrated mechanical arm system,  inputting the mobile operation movement prior to the resistance movement prior to the strengthening learning network for strengthening learning training to obtain the strengthening learning strategy capable of finishing the mobile operation task;  step 2,  using the track planner based on the model prediction path integral to generate the mechanical arm feasible track of the four-foot robot integrated mechanical arm system,  through the track follower based on the vector field to execute the track command;  step 3,  the four-foot robot integrated mechanical arm system of the main body sensing,  history observation and information of the target point is input to the training in step 1 in the strengthening learning network,  obtaining mobile operation track,  through the obtained mobile operation track control four-foot robot integrated mechanical arm system of the mobile operation.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot reinforcement learning gait control method and system,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control Including :  constructing a model predictive control optimization problem based on a linear inverted pendulum model,  and generating a robot centroid trajectory and a foothold sequence; collect state-action pair data for model predictive control,  and use supervised learning to train the neural network model; design a reinforcement learning strategy network,  use the output of the neural network model as a physical guidance reference,  calculate the training reward based on the constructed composite reward function,  use the near-end strategy optimization algorithm to train the strategy network in a high-concurrency simulation environment,  and output joint action instructions; the trained strategy and its output joint action instructions are verified in multiple simulation environments and deployed to the real machine for dynamic gait control. The present invention improves the stability and adaptability of the gait control of the humanoid robot through the method of combining model predictive control and reinforcement learning. 1. A gait control method for reinforced learning of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  constructing a model prediction control optimization problem based on a linear inverted pendulum model,  performing mathematical conversion on the model prediction control optimization problem to obtain a mixed integer secondary planning problem,  generating a robot mass centre track and a foot point sequence by solving the mixed integer secondary planning problem;  collecting the state-action pair data of the model prediction control,  adopting the monitoring learning training neural network model;  designing a reinforced learning strategy network,  taking the output of the neural network model as a physical guide reference,  constructing a composite reward function including gait tracking,  stability guarantee and action smoothness;  calculating the training reward based on the obtained compound reward function,  training the strategy network in the highly concurrent simulation environment by using the near-end strategy optimization algorithm,  and outputting the joint action instruction;  the trained strategy and the output joint action instruction are orderly verified in multiple simulation environments and then deployed to the real machine for dynamic gait control.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot self-supervised state estimation method based on a variational autoencoder,  which relates to the technical field of robot perception and control. The method constructs a state estimation model of an encoder-decoder architecture and performs training based on a self-supervised learning method. By inputting the historical observation information of the robot,  the state encoding module extracts the latent feature representation in the observation sequence and combines the privileged information for supervised training,  where the encoded latent space vector is divided into explicit variables and implicit variables. The explicit variable is used to calculate the loss function with the privileged information,  and the implicit variable is used as the input of the state decoding module to reconstruct the original observation data and realize the accurate prediction of the floating base speed,  position,  attitude and foot contact state of the robot. In the inference stage,  the model uses real-time observation information for state estimation to provide state feedback for downstream motion control modules,  thereby achieving closed-loop control. 1. A human-shaped robot self-monitoring state estimation method based on variable self-encoder,  wherein the steps comprise :  defining a local coordinate system and a global coordinate system of the robot;  wherein the point in the middle of the two feet of the robot is set as the coordinate origin,  the forward moving direction of the robot is set as the positive direction of the x-axis,  the left direction is the positive direction of the y-axis,  the vertical upward direction is the positive direction of the z-axis,  the xy-axis coordinate of the initial standing position of the robot is set as 0,  the rotating direction follows the right hand rule;  constructing a state estimation model based on neural network based on the defined local coordinate system and global coordinate system;  The state estimation model comprises :  a state coding module,  a state estimation module and a state decoding module;  using the state estimation model to complete the state estimation of the robot,  the steps comprise :  inputting the historical observation sequence at the front h moments of the robot into the state estimation model;  the state coding module is used for extracting the feature in the history observation sequence and mapping the input data to a potential vector;  dividing the potential vector into an explicit variable and an implicit variable;  based on the explicit variable and the implicit variable,  respectively performing state estimation and observation data reconstruction,  realizing prediction of floating base speed,  position,  posture and foot end contact state of the robot.

ABSTRACT A System and Method for Adaptive Robotic Arm with Force Feedback for Precision Manufacturing The present invention provides a system and method for an adaptive robotic arm with multi-modal force feedback,  and AI-based precision control for intelligent,  self-learning manufacturing operations. The system includes an assembly featuring a robotic arm with tactile,  piezoelectric,  and acoustic sensors interfaced to sense real-time,  multi-axial forces and vibrations. An AI- based adaptive control processor interprets multimodal data including predicted torque deviations and actively modulates actuator stiffness and damping in real-time. A digital twin synchronization module replicates real-time operation to perform predictive error correction,  and a self-calibrating actuation module is used to ensure autonomous alignment without manual positioning. An operational ledger uses blockchain technology to ensure secure calibration and performance data for verification of compliance,  and a force-haptic feedback interface for tactile and visual feedback to the operator to ensure safe collaborative work activities. The system and method reported offer intelligent,  predictive,  and traceable robotic control,  while providing significant improvements in precision,  adaptability and reliability over existing robotic systems

An Intelligent Predictive Model for Real-Time Decision Making Using Adaptive Neural Networks ABSTRACT :  The rising complexity and dynamism of real-world systems need the creation of adaptive predictive models that can manage non-linearity,  uncertainty,  and evolving environments. The swift advancement of urban mobility and smart city requirements need an intelligent transportation system capable of making real-time judgments through lightweight and adaptive AI models. In the current dynamic corporate environment,  the capacity to utilize data efficiently has emerged as a fundamental element of competitive advantage. Business Intelligence (BI) is advancing swiftly,  including innovative technologies such as predictive analytics,  artificial intelligence (AI),  and real-time data processing to provide actionable insights. This study examines recent advancements in AI-driven predictive maintenance,  emphasizing essential elements,  reliability,  and prospective trends. An analysis of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) methodologies,  difficulties,  and prospects related to AI-based predictive maintenance (PdM) is conducted initially. The subsequent discussion encompasses the incorporation of AI technologies into predictive maintenance in practical applications,  human-robot interaction,  the ethical dilemmas arising from AI utilization,  and the testing and validation capabilities of the established regulations.

This application provides a humanoid robot fall control method,  device,  equipment and storage medium,  and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring state data of the humanoid robot in real time; predicting the current state of the humanoid robot based on the state data; if the current state is a high-risk fall state,  control the humanoid robot to perform fall protection actions. The humanoid robot fall control method of the present application improves the accuracy of fall prediction by monitoring the center of gravity position,  movement speed and acceleration in real time. The method can quickly start the protection action under high-risk conditions,  reduce the risk of injury,  and protect the safety of surrounding personnel. It enhances the adaptability and autonomy of the robot,  improves stability and safety,  reduces maintenance costs,  and extends service life,  thereby enhancing the practicality and market competitiveness of the robot and broadening the scope of application. 1. A fall control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the state data of the humanoid robot in real time;  the state data comprises a gravity centre position,  a moving speed and an acceleration;  predicting the current state of the humanoid robot according to the state data;  if the current state is a high-risk tumble state,  controlling the humanoid robot to perform tumble protection action;  the tumble protection action comprises :  confirming the falling direction and the current robot key protection area corresponding to the falling direction,  comprising :  using the inertia measuring unit to monitor the attitude angle data of the humanoid robot in real time;  the attitude angle data comprises an absolute value of an elevation angle and/or a turning angle;  if the attitude angle reaches 0. 5 radian,  then judging the humanoid robot is currently in unstable state,  and the leg and/or fragile joint as the current robot key protection area;  if the attitude angle reaches 1.05 radian,  judging that the humanoid robot is in an inclined state currently,  and taking the collision joint as the current robot key protection area.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot control,  in particular to a limb balance control method and a limb balance control system for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an advancing path range of the humanoid robot and recording the advancing path range as an alternative path set; transmitting preset first near-infrared light,  receiving reflected near-infrared light as second near-infrared light,  capturing scattered near-infrared light as third near-infrared light; calculate the reflectivity,  scattering rate and ground smoothness within the alternative path set; searching to obtain the path with the lowest ground smoothness,  calculating to obtain the optimal center of gravity height of the humanoid robot,  and recording it as the first height; set the forward path of the humanoid robot as the optimal path; set the average height of the center of gravity during the advancement of the humanoid robot based on the first height According to the invention,  the path with the lowest ground smoothness degree is searched,  and the height of the gravity center is adjusted according to the ground smoothness degree,  so that the probability that the humanoid robot slips on the smooth ground is reduced 1. A limb balance control method for humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the forward path range of the humanoid robot,  recording as an alternative path set;  S2,  through the near-infrared light transmitting and receiving device installed on the forehead bracket of the humanoid robot,  transmitting the preset first near-infrared light to the candidate path set,  and receiving the reflected near-infrared light,  recorded as the second near-infrared light,  capturing the scattered near-infrared light by a near-infrared light scattering receiving device mounted at a preset position,  and recording the near-infrared light as a third near-infrared light;  S3,  according to the first near-infrared light,  the second near-infrared light and the third near-infrared light,  calculating to obtain the reflectivity and the scattering rate,  according to the reflectivity and the scattering rate,  calculating to obtain the smooth degree of the inner surface of the candidate path set;  S4,  according to the smooth degree of the inner surface of the candidate path set,  searching to obtain the path with the lowest smooth degree of the ground,  recording as the optimal path;  recording the ground smoothness corresponding to the optimal path,  recording the ground smoothness as the optimal path smoothness;  calculating the optimal gravity centre height of the humanoid robot according to the smooth degree of the optimal path,  and recording the optimal gravity centre height as the first height;  setting the forward path of the humanoid robot as the optimal path; The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  in particular to a neural field-guided humanoid robot self-adaptive door opening control method. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring point cloud information of a door opening area,  constructing a neural field and detecting a door handle pose,  wherein the neural field is formed by boundary information and normal information of a door body structure; use boundary information,  normal information and door handle pose to generate a collision-free approach path,  and use quadratic programming to control the robot to approach and grasp the door handle; using the normal information,  the initial pulling force is applied through the preset admittance control strategy,  and the door shaft position is estimated in combination with modeling optimization; based on the position of the door shaft,  the boundary information and normal information are combined to construct a structurally consistent arc path; combined with the boundary information,  weighted quadratic programming is used to control the robot's whole body to perform actions according to the collision-free approach path and the structural consistency arc path. The present invention embeds the neural field into the key control link to realize task-level dynamic optimization driven by perception. 1. A human-shaped robot self-adaptive door opening control method guided by nerve field,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the point cloud information of the door opening area;  constructing a nerve field based on the point cloud information,  wherein the nerve field is formed by boundary information and normal information of the door body structure output by the nerve symbol distance function;  based on the point cloud information,  using the pre-trained PoseCNN algorithm to detect the position of the door handle;  using the boundary information,  the normal information and the position of the door handle to generate a collision-free approach path,  and using the secondary planning to control the robot to approach and grasp the door handle;  using the normal information,  applying the initial tension through the preset admittance control strategy,  and combining with the modelling optimization to estimate the door shaft position;  based on the position of the door shaft,  combining the boundary information and the normal information to construct a circular arc path with consistent structure;  combining the boundary information,  using the weighted secondary planning to control the whole robot to execute the action according to the non-collision approach path and the circular arc path with consistent structure so as to finish the self-adaptive door opening control of the humanoid robot.

 The accidental uncertainty in a second operating branch is determined by calculating an abnormal fraction of any other vehicle in the surrounding area of the main motor vehicle that is located in a lane that may potentially conflict with the planned route of the main motor vehicle,  wherein the accidental uncertainty is defined along two axes of opposite behaviour :  a reward seeking behaviour including a speed of preference and a response to a nearby agent,  and a risk aversion including a willingness to wait for uncertainty to decrease from a first uncertainty value to a second value below the first uncertainty value prior to continuing the expected host motor vehicle motion;  starting corresponding number of leg-foot type robots,  respectively executing detection to the corresponding target detection device set in turn according to the routing inspection path,  and returning to the starting point,  finishing a routing inspection task;  according to the time used by the polling station,  calculating the ideal polling progress of each leg-and-foot robot;  For any one leg-foot type robot,  if the actual inspection progress does not reach the ideal inspection progress and the progress deviation exceeds the preset deviation threshold,  the emergency detection measure is triggered.

The invention belongs to the field of automatic driving technology,  and specifically relates to an unmanned vehicle-like lane changing method and system based on DRF model and adaptive preview,  which includes :  the vehicle senses the surrounding environment and obtains sensing information; obtain driver perception information and uncertainty of driver behavior,  and construct driver risk field model; input the perceptual information into the driver risk field model to obtain the quantitative value of driving risk; establish an adaptive preview method based on the vehicle's kinematics and two-degree-of-freedom dynamic model; construct a human-like lane-changing decision-making model,  calculate the risk threshold based on the perceived information,  compare the calculated driving risk quantification value with the perceived risk threshold,  and make lane-changing decisions for unmanned vehicles; by establishing a risk field model and combining it with an adaptive preview method,  the present invention can effectively solve the problems of difficult expansion of autonomous driving decision-making and planning scenes,  unsmooth switching of different scenes,  and low degree of anthropomorphism. 1. An unmanned vehicle type human-driving lane-changing method based on DRF model and self-adaptive pre-aiming,  wherein it comprises :  the vehicle senses the surrounding environment to obtain the sensing information;  obtaining the driver sensing information and the uncertainty of the driver behaviour,  and constructing a driver risk field model;  inputting the sensing information to the driver risk field model to obtain the driving risk quantification value;  establishing a self-adaptive pre-aiming method based on the kinematics of the vehicle and the two-degree-of-freedom dynamic model,  setting the evaluation function to be optimized by the self-adaptive pre-aiming method,  and extracting the optimal pre-aiming time according to the evaluation function to be optimized;  constructing a humanoid lane changing decision model,  calculating a sensing risk threshold value according to the historical sensing information,  comparing the calculated driving risk quantification value with the sensing risk threshold value,  and using the humanoid lane changing decision model to perform the humanoid lane changing to the unmanned vehicle according to the comparison result and the optimal pre-aiming time.

A variable stiffness buffer structure and a bionic biped robot relate to the technical field of robots The current stage of legged robots have the problems of poor impact resistance and poor terrain adaptability. The invention includes a buffer elastic member,  a tendon and a steering support assembly. The steering support assembly is installed on the leg of the robot and can deflect. The buffer elastic member is installed on the steering support assembly and can deflect with the steering support assembly; the tendon connects the buffer elastic member and the foot of the robot and tightens it; when the foot of the robot contacts the ground,  the foot of the robot turns around the ankle joint and pulls the tendon. The buffer elastic member is deformed by the stretching of the tendon. When the foot of the robot is lifted,  the foot of the robot is in the buffer elastic member. The rebound of the piece resets With the deflection of the steering support assembly,  the angle between the buffer elastic member and the tendon changes while deflecting,  and the resultant force along the direction of the tendon changes,  realizing the change of the stiffness of the variable stiffness buffer structure. The present invention is mainly used in the design of robot 1. A variable rigidity buffer structure,  wherein It comprises a buffer elastic piece and a tendon,  the buffer elastic piece and the tendon are arranged on the back side of the leg part,  the buffer elastic piece is installed on the leg part of the robot,  the tendon is connected with the buffer elastic piece and the foot part of the robot and tensioned;  when the foot part of the robot is contacted with the ground,  the foot part of the robot turns around the ankle joint and pulls the tendon,  the buffer elastic piece is deformed by the stretching of the tendon;  when the foot part of the robot is lifted,  the foot part of the robot is reset under the rebound of the buffer elastic piece;  further comprising a steering supporting component,  the steering supporting component is installed on the leg part of the robot and can be deflected,  the buffer elastic piece is installed on the steering supporting component and can be deflected along with the steering supporting component;  with the deflection of the steering supporting component and the deflection of the buffering elastic piece,  the included angle between the buffering elastic piece and the tendon is changed,  and the resultant force along the tendon direction is changed,  so the rigidity of the buffering structure with variable rigidity is changed;  the steering support component comprises a steering motor and a support sleeve for supporting the buffer elastic piece,  the support sleeve is connected to the motor shaft of the steering motor and can be rotated along with the motor shaft,  the buffer elastic piece is arranged in the support sleeve;  the steering motor is started,  and the supporting sleeve rotates along with the motor shaft of the steering motor so as to deflect the buffer elastic piece.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot simulation environment based on Isaac Sim and its implementation method Relates to the field of robot simulation technology,  suitable for the construction and verification of industrial inspection laboratory scenarios By collecting detailed parameters of equipment and obstacles in industrial scenarios,  use 3D modeling tools to accurately build equipment,  obstacles and scene layout models And topology optimization and material detail processing are carried out,  and then the humanoid robot model is deployed into the simulation environment. Through the integrated control system and high-precision physical engine,  the robot's movement,  interaction and experimental operation in the laboratory are simulated,  and ROS2 and MoveIt2 are combined to realize the real-time motion control of the robot in the simulation. The invention improves the accuracy and reliability of the robot's task execution in the laboratory environment,  and provides effective verification and support for the robot's application in actual industrial experimental scenarios. 1. An implementation method of humanoid robot simulation based on Isaac Sim,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  step S1,  using a professional modelling tool to perform detailed design and construction on the device and obstacle in the industrial environment,  forming a primary scene model;  step S2,  expanding the material of the device and the barrier constructed in the primary scene model,  and using the texture drawing tool with high quality to finely process it to obtain the simulation model;  step S3,  according to the actual factory scene requirement,  using the simulation model obtained in the step S2 to build the industrial scene,  comprising the whole layout of the scene,  light source setting and physical characteristic configuration,  finishing the layout of the simulation environment;  step S4,  using the 3D modelling tool to construct the humanoid robot model,  ensuring that the framework and the joint structure of the model are consistent with the actual robot;  step S5,  deploying the humanoid robot model to the designed simulation environment,  realizing the precise control of the robot through the integrated control system,  simulating the movement,  interaction and execution process of the working task of the robot in the industrial environment.
