A humanoid robot intelligent scheduling system under multi-task processing,  wherein the system comprises an analysis module,  a control module,  a sequencing module and a scheduling module;  the analyzing module is used for analyzing and obtaining the information related to the task,  and transmitting the information to the control module;  the control module obtains the task factor according to the information related to the task and transmits the task factor to the sequencing module;  the sorting module sorts the multiple different task factors according to the numerical value sorting mode,  and transmits the sorted multiple task factors to the dispatching module;  the dispatching module dispatches the task corresponding to the task factor with the largest numerical value after sequencing,  and transmits the dispatching information to the robot;  the analysis module comprises a data setting sub-module,  a data storage sub-module and a detecting sub-module;  the data setting sub-module is used for setting the task priority index and transmitting to the control module;  the data storage sub-module is used for storing the task stopping time,  the total time length of the task allowing delay,  the ideal value of the environment temperature where the task is located,  the ideal value of the environment humidity where the task is located and the ideal value of the environment barrier density where the task is located,  and transmitting to the control module;  the detection sub-module is used for detecting and obtaining the length of the queue where the task is located,  the current time,  the actual value of the environment temperature where the task is located,  the actual value of the environment humidity where the task is located and the actual value of the environment barrier density where the task is located,  and transmitting to the control module;  the control module according to the actual value of the environment temperature where the task is located,  the actual value of the environment humidity where the task is located,  the actual value of the environment barrier density where the task is located,  the ideal value of the environment temperature where the task is located,  the ideal value of the environment humidity where the task is located and the ideal value of the environment barrier density where the task is located are the environment adaptive index needed by the task,  according to the task cut-off time,  the current time and the total time length of the task allowable delay,  obtaining the task emergency index,  according to the task priority index,  the task emergency index,  the environment adaptation index needed by the task and the length of the queue where the task is located obtain the task factor.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot obstacle avoidance control method and system based on path planning Relates to the technical field of quadruped robot obstacle avoidance control The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring environment point cloud data,  image data and quadruped robot movement speed data,  generating semantic point cloud data by carrying out terrain semantic segmentation and semantic pixel back projection on the image data,  and combining the semantic point cloud data with the environment point cloud data subjected to motion compensation to construct a semantic annotation raster map; perform global path search on semantically annotated raster maps to generate global smooth paths; when the quadruped robot travels along the global smooth path,  it extracts the path nodes on the global smooth path with a fixed step distance,  and determines the terrain category and grid occupancy status of each path node based on the semantic annotation grid map to generate a local reference path Execute a multi-level obstacle avoidance strategy on the local reference path and generate a foot-end trajectory sequence. 1. A four-foot robot obstacle avoidance control method based on path planning,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  obtaining environmental point cloud data,  image data and motion speed data of a four-foot robot,  generating semantic point cloud data by performing terrain semantic segmentation and semantic pixel back projection on the image data,  and combining the semantic point cloud data with the motion compensated environmental point cloud data to construct a semantic marking grid map;  performing global path search on the semantic annotation grid map to generate a global smooth path;  when the four-foot robot travels along the global smooth path,  the path node on the global smooth path is extracted with a fixed step distance,  and the terrain type and the grid occupied state at each path node are judged according to the semantic marking grid map to generate a local reference path;  executing multi-level obstacle-avoiding strategy to the local reference path,  and generating foot end track sequence;  executing foot end track tracking through joint drive,  and monitoring foot end track tracking error and grid occupation state in real time,  at the same time,  monitoring multi-level obstacle-avoiding strategy trigger frequency sequence,  and executing global smooth path re-planning,  local reference path re-planning and foot end track sequence re-generating according to trigger frequency sequence;  the step of generating semantic point cloud data comprises the following steps :  performing terrain semantic segmentation to the image data,  classifying the colour image pixels into four types of semantic labels such as ground,  low barrier,  high barrier and crossing barrier,  and performing semantic pixel back projection to the semantic label and the depth image to generate semantic point cloud data;  the step of constructing the semantic annotation grid map comprises :  performing motion compensation on the environment point cloud data based on the motion speed data of the four-foot robot,  and combining the semantic point cloud data with the motion compensated environment point cloud data,  constructing the semantic annotation grid map;  the step of combining the semantic point cloud data with the motion-compensated environmental point cloud data comprises :  inserting the motion-compensated environmental point cloud data and the semantic point cloud data under the four-legged robot body coordinate system into a three-dimensional eight-fork tree grid,  for each voxel,  updating the logarithm probability by observing the hit logarithm probability and observing the lost logarithm probability,  and calculating the voxel occupying probability by combining the prior logarithm probability;  specifically,  the calibration experiment records the real state of each voxel in the scene including the real occupied area and the real idle area;  continuously collecting multi-frame environmental point cloud data,  and counting the ratio of the number of times each real occupied voxel is determined to be occupied and the total number of times it is detected,  defined as hit probability,  counting the ratio of the number of times each real idle voxel is wrongly determined to be idle and the total number of times it is detected,  defined as loss probability,  By combining the complementary items of the hit probability and the loss probability,  and performing normalization processing on the combined result,  the occupancy threshold value is calculated,  which is expressed as :  ;  Wherein,  represents the occupation threshold,  represents the hit probability,  represents a loss probability;  obtaining the idle threshold value through the complementary calculation of the occupied threshold value;  when the voxel occupying probability is higher than the occupying threshold value,  the mark is occupied,  when the voxel occupying probability is lower than the idle threshold value,  the mark is idle,  the rest are unknown;  after marking the voxel occupying state,  counting the stored semantic label in each voxel,  and taking the most counting as the semantic label of the voxel,  finally constructing the semantic label grid map comprising the occupying state and the ground,  low barrier,  high barrier and the semantic label capable of crossing the barrier.

The invention provides a three-dimensional Gaussian digital human generation system,  method and electronic device,  and relates to the field of augmented reality technology. It includes :  a data acquisition unit used to acquire visual depth data,  dynamic behavior data and environmental perception data,  and generate point cloud data accordingly. and multi-modal data; the rendering adjustment unit is used to monitor the gaze area in real time and determine the rendering strategy; determine rendering specifications based on real-time computing power parameters; the driving unit is used to extract features from multi-modal data,  obtain multi-modal features,  and generate facial driving parameters and limb driving parameters of the digital human model; the modeling unit is used to generate the basic grid of the digital human model based on the point cloud data and the initial digital human model,  and perform expression rendering and action rendering on the basic grid based on the rendering strategy and rendering specifications,  combined with the facial drive parameters and limb drive parameters,  to obtain the rendered digital human model. The invention improves the fluency,  authenticity and naturalness of the display effect 1. A three-dimensional Gaussian digital human generation system,  wherein it comprises :  a data obtaining unit for obtaining the visual depth data,  the dynamic behaviour data and the environment sensing data of the user;  generating point cloud data and multi-mode data according to the visual depth data,  the dynamic behaviour data and the environment sensing data;  a rendering adjusting unit for monitoring the gaze area of the user in real time through the eye movement tracking technology and determining the rendering strategy according to the gaze area;  determining the rendering specification according to the real-time calculation force parameter of the augmented reality device of the user;  a driving unit for extracting the characteristic of the multimodal data to obtain the multimodal characteristic,  wherein the multimodal characteristic comprises a voice characteristic,  an expression characteristic and a posture characteristic;  according to the voice characteristic,  the expression characteristic and the posture characteristic,  respectively generating the face driving parameter and the limb driving parameter of the digital humanoid model;  Specifically,  the method includes :  extracting the multimodal data by a lightweight speech encoder to obtain a Meel spectral characteristic and fundamental frequency information,  and determining the speech characteristic according to the Meel spectral characteristic and the fundamental frequency information;  extracting the multimodal data through MobileFaceNet to obtain a facial key point and a FACS expression coefficient,  and determining the expression feature according to the facial key point and the FACS expression coefficient;  calculating the multimodal data to obtain a limb skeleton rotation matrix,  and then determining the posture feature according to the limb skeleton rotation matrix;  fusing the voice characteristic,  the expression characteristic and the posture characteristic to obtain a fusion characteristic vector,  and inputting the fusion characteristic vector into an emotion fusion network to obtain an emotion state vector of the multimodal data,  and then obtaining the face driving parameter according to the emotion state vector;  determining the joint operation angle of the digital human model according to the posture feature by the inverse kinematics algorithm,  and then obtaining the limb driving parameter according to the joint operation angle;  a modelling unit,  for according to the point cloud data and the initial digital human model,  generating a basic grid of the digital human model,  and according to the rendering strategy and the rendering specification,  combining the face driving parameter and the limb driving parameter,  performing plot rendering and action rendering on the basic grid,  obtaining the rendered digital human model;  Specifically,  the method includes :  updating the initial digital human model according to the point cloud data through the grid generation algorithm,  generating the base grid of the digital human model;  initializing one or more Gaussian points at each vertex of the base grid,  and establishing a mapping relationship between the vertex of the base grid and the Gaussian point;  according to the rendering strategy and the rendering specification,  combining the mapping relationship,  respectively rendering the face and limb of the digital humanoid model,  obtaining the rendered digital humanoid model.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot structure with a balanced folding and unfolding parasitic mechanism,  which includes a head,  arms,  a trunk,  buttocks,  legs and feet. It is characterized by that the hip portion and leg portion adopt the combination of double X-shaped parasitic branch chains,  said two X-shaped branch chains are parallelly arranged,  and the centre of said two X-shaped branch chains are respectively equipped with electric drive module,  and their axle centers are misplaced so as to avoid the problem of singular point The electric drive module drives the branch chains to open and close synchronously to realize folding and unfolding actions,  and the movement range can reach 360 °. The legs are inclined at a 10-degree angle with the horizontal plane,  and cooperate with the crotch expansion and contraction ability to achieve front-to-back,  left-to-right self-balancing,  significantly reducing the motor driving torque and dependence on the algorithm. The foot is connected to the sole of the foot through an electric drive module to adapt to complex terrain. The invention solves the problem that the traditional folding and unfolding mechanism is stuck or out of control at singular points,  improves the dynamic stability and running ability of the robot,  and the stepping distance can reach 4 times that of ordinary designs. 1. A humanoid robot structure of balance folding parasitic mechanism,  comprising a head part,  an arm part,  a trunk part,  a hip part,  a leg part and a foot part,  the head part is connected to the upper part of the trunk,  the upper part of the trunk is provided with a shoulder part,  the shoulder part is connected with the arm part,  the lower part of the trunk is connected with the buttocks,  the two sides of the buttocks are respectively connected with the leg part,  the lower part of the leg part is connected to the foot part;  the second X-type parasitic branch chain is composed of a seventh connecting rod,  an eighth connecting rod,  a ninth connecting rod,  a tenth connecting rod,  an eleventh connecting rod and a twelfth connecting rod;  the centre of the first X type parasitic branch chain and the centre of the second X type parasitic branch chain are respectively provided with an electric drive module,  and the axes of the two electric drive modules are not on the same straight line;  the lower end of the leg supporting plate is connected to the centre of the X-shaped parasitic branch chain at the inner side of the leg folding and unfolding mechanism through the electric driving module;  the lower end of the leg folding and unfolding mechanism is connected with the foot part.

This application relates to an active compliance control method for quadruped robots based on hierarchical reinforcement learning. The method includes :  a bottom motion policy network and an upper compliant control policy network; the underlying motion strategy network includes :  a basic encoder,  a force estimation head,  a speed estimation head,  and a basic strategy network module; the basic encoder is used to output low-dimensional feature vectors; the force estimation head is used to estimate the external force currently experienced by the quadruped robot; the speed estimation head is used to estimate the current torso speed of the quadruped robot; the basic strategy network module is used to generate the current expected joint position of the quadruped robot; the upper-layer compliance control policy network is used to generate a current residual speed command,  and to add the current residual speed command and the current torso speed command to obtain a modified current torso speed command. By adopting the method,  the high coupling of the disturbance estimation and the compliance control module can be realized,  and the active compliance adaptive to the continuous disturbance can be achieved 1. An active compliance control model,  wherein the model comprises :  a bottom layer motion strategy network and an upper layer flexible control strategy network;  The underlying motion policy network comprises :  a basic encoder,  a force estimation head,  a speed estimation head and a basic strategy network module,  the basic encoder is respectively connected with the force estimation head and the speed estimation head,  the force estimation head and the speed estimation head are respectively connected with the basic strategy network module;  the basic encoder is used for encoding the current and historical first observation data into a low-dimensional feature vector;  the first observation data comprises the main body sensor feedback data of the four-foot robot,  the trunk speed instruction and the expected joint position at the last time;  the force estimation head is used for estimating the current external force of the four-foot robot from the low-dimensional feature vector;  the speed estimation head is used for estimating the current trunk speed of the four-foot robot from the low-dimensional feature vector;  the basic strategy network module is used for generating the current expected joint position of the four-foot robot based on the low-dimensional characteristic vector at the current moment,  the estimated potential characteristic obtained by fusion of the current external force and the current trunk speed and the first observation data at the current moment;  the upper layer flexible control strategy network is used for generating the current residual speed instruction based on the second observation data,  and is used for adding the current residual speed instruction and the current trunk speed instruction to obtain the corrected current trunk speed instruction;  the second observation data comprises :  the current main body sensor feedback data,  the current trunk speed instruction,  the expected joint position at the last moment,  the residual speed instruction at the last moment,  and the low-dimensional characteristic vector at the last moment,  the estimated current external force and the current trunk speed are fused to obtain the potential characteristic.

The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent robot control,  and specifically relates to a quadruped robot model predictive control method that integrates an extended state observer. First,  a dynamic model of the quadruped robot system is established,  and the position ESO is designed to estimate the disturbance in the translation direction in real time.,  design attitude ESO to estimate the disturbance in the rotation direction in real time; secondly,  the disturbance estimator output by ESO is used to construct a discrete state space model containing disturbance compensation terms,  and on this basis,  a constrained MPC optimization problem is designed,  including considering friction cone constraints,  swing leg force constraints,  upper and lower joint moment constraints,  etc.; finally,  the MPC optimization problem is solved by online rolling,  and the ground reaction force and joint torque are output to realize the trajectory tracking control of quadruped robot under unknown disturbance conditions. The invention can effectively suppress system uncertainty caused by unmodeled loads,  external disturbances or uneven ground,  and improve the stability and adaptability of the robot in complex environments. 1. A four-foot robot model prediction control method of fusion expansion state observer,  wherein comprising the following steps :  step 1 :  constructing a four-foot robot dynamic model,  establishing a single rigid kinematics equation with the mass centre as the reference point,  introducing a system disturbance item,  forming a state space model containing disturbance;  step 2 :  A dual extended state observer (ESO) is designed,  including :  a position ESO for estimating the unknown disturbance force in the translation direction of the robot in real time;  a posture ESO for estimating the disturbance moment around the transverse rolling shaft,  the pitching shaft and the yawing shaft in real time;  step 3 :  embedding the disturbance estimator output by the ESO as the feed-forward compensation item in the constructed discrete time state space model to form a model predictive control (MPC) system containing disturbance compensation;  step 4 :  constructing a finite time domain linear MPC optimization problem,  taking the minimum track tracking error as a cost function,  at the same time considering the following constraint :  the ground counterforce meets the constraint of the friction cone;  the contact force of the swinging leg is zero;  the foot end force and the joint moment are in the range of the upper limit and the lower limit;  the state variable satisfies the physical boundary condition;  step 5 :  the optimal foot end reaction force and joint moment are obtained and acted on the four-foot robot system to finish the robust track tracking control under the disturbance environment.

The invention provides a four-legged robot dog patrol control method and system,  and belongs to the technical field of safety protection The method comprises the following steps of :  marking static obstacles and passing areas on a point cloud map of a fortified area,  and writing the static obstacles and the passing areas into the quadruped robot dog; the four-legged robot dog regularly performs global patrol tasks,  constructs patrol paths,  and patrols all traffic areas; when performing a global patrol mission,  quadruped robot dogs also identify people within their field of view If it is a non-certified person,  the global patrol mission will be interrupted Track and drive away non-certified personnel Until non-certified personnel leave the boundaries of the fortified area,  after confirming the departure,  the quadruped robot dog returns to perform the full-area patrol mission The quadruped robot dog also responds to the certifier's auxiliary task request,  dynamically plans a temporary path according to the auxiliary task requirements and target position,  reaches the certifier's position,  and after completing the auxiliary task request,  the quadruped robot dog returns to the starting position and status before the auxiliary task request. 1. A four-footed robot dog inspection control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  for the point cloud map of the defence area,  the point cloud map is marked with a static barrier and a passing area,  and written into a four-foot robot dog;  S2 :  the four-foot robot dog regularly executes the global patrolling task,  constructs the patrolling path,  and patrolling all the passing areas;  S3 :  when executing the global patrol task,  the four-foot robot dog also identifies the identity of the personnel within the visual field range,  if it is the authentication personnel,  then ignoring,  if it is the non-authentication personnel,  then interrupting the global patrol task,  performing tracking and driving-away operation on the non-authentication personnel,  until the non-authentication personnel leaves the boundary of the security area,  confirming that the four-foot robot dog returns to execute the global patrol task after leaving;  S4 :  when the four-foot robot dog is in a state other than tracking and driving-off operation,  further responding to the auxiliary task request of the authenticator,  according to the auxiliary task requirement and the target position,  dynamically planning the temporary path,  reaching the position of the authenticator,  after finishing the auxiliary task request,  The four-legged robot dog returns the initial position and state before the auxiliary task request.

Embodiments of the present invention provide a commercial vehicle automatic emergency braking system testing system and method. The testing system includes a pedestrian target,  a positioning device,  a driving device and an information processing device. According to the technical scheme,  the preset motion mode and collision position of the pedestrian target object,  namely the speed,  acceleration and other parameters of the collision object under different conditions,  are set to meet simulation of different conditions,  so that whether the automatic emergency braking system of the commercial vehicle is qualified under different conditions or not is tested,  and the automatic emergency braking system is more in line with driving emergencies in reality At the same time,  according to the preset pedestrian target movement mode and collision position,  get the preset driving position of the commercial vehicle,  and when the commercial vehicle reaches the preset driving position,  it sends a driving command to the driving device to control the driving device to pull the pedestrian target to the collision position through the traction belt,  so that the pedestrian target and the commercial vehicle can accurately meet at the preset collision position.,  further improving the accuracy of the test. 1. A commercial vehicle automatic emergency brake system test system,  wherein it comprises :  a pedestrian object,  a positioning device,  a driving device and an information processing device;  the driving device is connected with the pedestrian object through a traction belt,  the driving device is respectively connected with the locating device and the information processing device in communication;  the driving device is used for obtaining the preset driving position of the commercial vehicle according to the preset pedestrian target movement mode and collision position;  the locating device is used for detecting the real-time position of the commercial vehicle,  and when the commercial vehicle reaches the preset driving position,  sending a driving instruction to the driving device,  so as to control the driving device to pull the pedestrian object to move to the collision position through the traction belt;  the information processing device is used for collecting the real-time distance from the commercial vehicle to the collision position and the vehicle speed,  drawing a distance-speed curve,  and using the distance-speed curve to judge whether the commercial vehicle automatic emergency braking system is qualified.

The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot joint motor driving performance model training method,  a humanoid robot joint motor driving performance model prediction method and equipment,  and belongs to the technical field of robots The invention comprises :  obtaining multi-source data; the multi-source data includes static parameter sample data,  dynamic parameter sample data,  driving performance sample data,  and joint motion mode parameter sample data of the joint motor; establishing a multi-dimensional data set associated with joint motion patterns based on multi-source data; set up a regression model; training the regression model according to the multi-dimensional data set to obtain driving performance prediction data; the parameters of the regression model are adjusted according to the driving performance sample data and the driving performance prediction data to obtain the target model. According to the embodiment of the invention,  the problems of low driving performance measurement efficiency,  poor dynamic adaptability and high maintenance cost of the humanoid robot joint motor can be solved,  and accurate performance prediction and optimal control based on data driving can be realized 1. A method for training driving performance model of joint motor of humanoid robot,  wherein the method for training driving performance model of joint motor of humanoid robot comprises the following steps :  obtaining multi-source data;  the multi-source data comprises a static parameter sample data,  a dynamic parameter sample data,  a drive performance sample data and a joint motion mode parameter sample data of the joint motor;  establishing a multi-dimensional data set associated with the joint motion mode according to the multi-source data;  setting regression model;  training the regression model according to the multi-dimensional data set to obtain the driving performance prediction data;  adjusting the parameter of the regression model according to the driving performance sample data and the driving performance prediction data to obtain the target model.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot reliability evaluation method and a quadruped robot reliability evaluation device,  and relates to the technical field of reliability evaluation. According to the method,  a quadruped robot-oriented reliability model is adopted,  so that weak links or potential fault points of the quadruped robot can be mastered in advance By clarifying the reliability level of each component module,  it is helpful to select appropriate devices,  optimize the design of quadruped robots,  and improve the overall quality and performance of quadruped robots; by mastering the reliability evaluation results of quadruped robots,  we can systematically formulate maintenance plans and maintenance strategies and reduce maintenance costs. 1. A four-foot robot reliability evaluation method,  wherein it comprises :  determining a component unit of the four-foot robot to be evaluated in reliability,  wherein the component unit to be evaluated in reliability comprises one or combination of several of a base platform,  a task load and a control terminal;  obtaining the failure rate of the component unit to be evaluated in reliability,  wherein the failure rate comprises the sum of the failure rate of each maintainable device included in the component unit to be evaluated in reliability;  inputting the failure rate of the component unit to be reliability evaluated into the reliability model so that the reliability model outputs the reliability evaluation result corresponding to the component unit to be reliability evaluated;  The reliability model comprises the reliability function of the base platform,  the reliability function of the task load and the reliability function of the operation terminal.

The invention discloses a method for generating crowd evacuation and escape actions in a three-dimensional scene,  and relates to the fields of crowd simulation,  action control and action generation The invention provides a real-time online,  personalized,  dynamic sensing and multi-agent parallel three-dimensional crowd evacuation simulation framework for the first time,  which is suitable for various scenes and a hundred-person scale This method designs a "perception-decision-action" cycle process to simulate human brain behavior,  proposes a 3D adaptive social force model to avoid falls and collisions in the 3D environment,  and achieves individual evacuation speed control that can be updated online; a personalized gait controller is designed,  which can generate personalized movements according to attributes such as age and physical condition; to improve the explanability of evacuation behavior,  a site-level force visualization module was designed to analyze individual contact forces. This method supports online dynamic path planning and individual behavior simulation under irregular terrain,  and can generate more realistic and credible evacuation effects. 1. A method for generating crowd evacuation and escape action in three-dimensional scene,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a three-dimensional real-time evacuation simulation frame for simulating human brain sensing-decision-action flow,  the frame is composed of a sensing module,  a decision module and an action module;  S2,  in each time step,  using the sensing module to obtain the self state of each intelligent body,  other observable intelligent body state and environment state;  S3,  based on the state information obtained by the sensing module in S2,  online calculating the escape speed of each intelligent body by using the three-dimensional self-adaptive social force model,  wherein the social force model is combined with the attribute of the intelligent body to introduce the personalized coefficient;  S4,  the escape speed obtained in S3 is good for each intelligent body sampling local path,  using the pedestrian action control method based on intensive learning,  taking the local path as condition to obtain the non-personalized escape action frame corresponding to the escape speed;  S5,  based on the non-personalized escape action frame obtained in S4,  adopting the personalized gait converter to generate the personalized action matched with each intelligent agent attribute,  executing the action simulation in the physical engine,  and visualizing the part level stress,  using the simulation result for the sensing module input of the next time step.

This application relates to the technical field of humanoid detection Specifically,  it discloses a self-adaptive range humanoid detection method and system The method comprises the following steps of :  after the equipment is started,  initializing equipment operation basic parameters,  humanoid algorithm parameters and humanoid detection range parameters to acquire a monitoring video stream,  performing humanoid target detection on a first monitoring image,  and continuously performing humanoid detection on a next monitoring image frame if the humanoid target is not detected; if a humanoid target is detected,  the area of the humanoid target is calculated and compared with the preset humanoid detection range parameters to determine the distance range of the humanoid target and trigger the corresponding humanoid event,  and adaptively adjust the detection strategy; if the area of the humanoid target is not within the humanoid detection range,  ignore the humanoid target and continue to detect the next monitoring image frame. This method can realize intelligent recognition and distance range determination of humanoid targets in the monitoring scene,  and adaptively adjust the detection strategy to optimize resource consumption. 1. A self-adaptive range human shape detection method,  wherein it comprises :  step 1 :  after the device is started,  initializing the device parameter,  wherein the device parameter comprises a device operation basic parameter,  a humanoid algorithm parameter and a humanoid detection range parameter;  step 2 :  after the initialization is finished,  the video stream is collected and monitored by the device;  step 3 :  inputting the first monitoring image frame in the monitoring video stream to the trained human shape detection model to obtain the human shape detection result;  step 4 :  in response to the human shape detection result that the human shape target exists in the first monitoring image frame,  calculating the area of the human shape target and determining whether to perform the human shape detection of the second monitoring image frame based on the comparison between the area of the human shape target and the human shape detection range parameter;  step 5 :  performing the human shape detection of the second monitoring image frame in response to the human shape detection result that there is no human shape target in the first monitoring image frame.

The invention discloses a humanoid chewing robot Belongs to the field of bionic robot technology,  includes 6 branched chains,  the 6 branched chains are installed on the base,  and are divided into 3 groups. The 3 groups of branched chains are respectively connected to the masseter muscle group,  temporalis muscle group and pterygoid muscle group of the jaw. Set up,  and the driving end of the branch chain is connected to the masseter muscle group,  temporalis muscle group and pterygoid muscle group set corresponding to it,  used to simulate the six main opening and closing muscle groups in chewing; two restraint components,  two of which are arranged at the condyles on both sides of the jaw,  and are used to simulate the restraint of the temporomandibular joint on the condyles of the jaw. The invention can truly simulate the test of chewing conditions and obtain more accurate parameters. 1. A human-like chewing robot,  comprising a base and an oral cavity model set on the base,  wherein the oral cavity model comprises an upper jaw and a lower jaw,  wherein it further comprises :  6 branched chains,  6 branched chains are installed on the base,  6 branched chains are uniformly divided into 3 groups,  3 groups of the branched chains are respectively corresponding to the biting muscle group,  temporal muscle group and wing muscle group of the lower jaw,  and the driving end of the branched chain is corresponding to the biting muscle group,  the temporal muscle group and the wing muscle group are in driving connection for simulating the main six open-close muscle groups in the chewing;  2 restriction components,  2 of the restriction components are set on the condylar of the two sides of the lower jaw,  for simulating the lower jaw condylar is restricted by the temporal mandibular joint;  the branched chain comprises a rotating motor,  a crank and a connecting rod;  the rotating motor is fixed on the base,  the output end of the rotating motor is connected with the crank,  one end of the crank far away from the rotating motor is connected with the first end of the connecting rod through the first driven ball pair,  the second end of the connecting rod is connected with the lower jaw through the second driven ball pair;  the limiting component comprises a limiting block and a limiting rod;  the limiting rod is set on the condylar of the lower jaw,  one end of the limiting rod far away from the lower jaw is provided with a ball;  the limiting block is set on the base,  the limiting block is provided with a groove matched with the ball body of the limiting rod;  the inner wall of the groove is provided with a silicon sheet for simulating condylar flexible joint disc,  the ball body is set in the groove;  the lower jaw is further provided with a detection control mechanism,  the detection control mechanism comprises a plurality of pressure sensors installed on the teeth of the lower jaw,  the pressure sensors are connected with an upper computer,  the upper computer sends instructions to control 6 branched chains to complete chewing movement,  the pressure sensor receives the pressure information and then returns to the upper computer,  and outputs the chewing force curve diagram of the chewing force along with the time change through the upper computer.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot interaction,  and discloses a humanoid robot interaction system The system includes :  interaction perception,  intention analysis,  action generation and feedback calibration modules The interaction sensing module collects a first interaction signal within a first preset time period,  and converts the first interaction signal into a sensing feature through preprocessing The intention parsing module identifies the behavior entity of the object to be interacted,  uses its semantic set as the benchmark label,  and combines the benchmark sample and perceptual features to train the parsing network model; the action generation module collects the second interaction signal within the second preset time period,  extracts the encoder and decoder of the analytical network model,  generates instructions based on the encoder,  constructs a rule mapping execution unit and reversely optimizes the mapping relationship through the decoder; the feedback calibration module collects the third interactive signal within the third preset time period,  classifies it into regular signals and irregular signals,  and performs calibration or encoder generation processing through the mapping execution unit respectively. 1. A humanoid robot interaction system,  wherein it comprises :  an interaction sensing module for collecting a first interaction signal within a first preset time length;  pre-processing the first interactive signal and converting it into a characteristic space to obtain a sensing characteristic;  an intention analyzing module for identifying the action entity of the object to be interacted and taking the semantic set corresponding to the action entity as the reference label;  training to obtain an analytic network model based on the reference sample and the sensing feature;  an action generating module,  configured to collect a second interaction signal within a second preset time period,  and perform a generation operation on the second interaction signal,  comprising :  extracting an encoder and a decoder for analyzing the network model;  coding the target interaction signal based on the coder to obtain the generation instruction of the interaction system;  constructing a rule mapping execution unit based on the second interaction signal and the generated semantic set;  mapping the mapping relation of the execution unit based on the reverse optimization rule of the decoder;  a feedback calibration module,  configured to acquire a third interaction signal within a third preset time period,  and perform calibration operation on the third interaction signal,  comprising :  The classification processing for the third interactive signal is as follows :  a regular signal and an irregular signal;  if it is a regular signal,  calibrating the third interactive signal based on the mapping execution unit;  if it is the irregular signal,  generating the third interactive signal based on the encoder.

The invention discloses a biped robot gait network training method,  which constructs a dual-channel deep reinforcement learning architecture; collecting the running states of X bipedal robots in the simple terrain of the simulation environment; obtaining current reward according to current running state,  combining each information with Markov decision-making process and storing it in experience playback area; when the number of Markov decision-making processes in the experience playback area is greater than the preset threshold n,  randomly select the preset number of Markov decision-making processes from it,  and update the parameters of the main network and opponent network; perturbing the parameters of the main network and simulating the human memory curve to continuously adjust the hyperparameter clip of the main network; move the bipedal robot whose stable walking time reaches the preset time to the terrain with higher difficulty level,  and repeat the updating process of each network parameter; continue to study the course until the cumulative reward information and stable walking time of all bipedal robots reach the preset value. 1. A biped robot gait network training method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a dual-channel deep strengthening learning framework based on the same strategy deep strengthening learning PPO algorithm as a dual-foot robot gait network,  comprising a main network and an opponent network with the same network structure and different initial parameters;  the network structures of the main network and the opponent network both comprise a policy sub-network and a value sub-network,  wherein the policy sub-network and the value sub-network of the main network are respectively recorded as a first policy network and a first value network,  and the policy sub-network and the value sub-network of the opponent network are respectively recorded as a second policy network and a second value network;  the first strategy network is used for interacting with the parallel simulation environment,  receiving the operation state after the reduction and normalization,  and outputting the probability distribution of the motor control action according to the current operation state,  and generating the control instruction according to the probability distribution;  the first value network is used for estimating the expected return of the operation state,  participating in the calculation of the dominance function and constructing the PPO loss so as to realize the optimization of the main network strategy;  the second strategy network receives the same running state with the first strategy network under the premise of not directly interacting with the simulation environment,  the second strategy network independently generates the action probability distribution;  calculating the KL divergence between the first policy network and the second policy network by comparing the probability distribution output by the first policy network and the second policy network,  and using the KL divergence as the loss item for updating the parameter of the second policy network;  the first strategy network and the first value network are combined with the PPO algorithm loss and KL divergence for joint gradient updating in the optimizing process;  S2,  collecting the operation state of X biped robots in the simple terrain of the simulation environment,  and training the main network and the opponent network according to the operation state;  The details of the training include :  constructing Markov decision process,  obtaining N samples from it,  inputting the samples into the main network and the opponent network,  calculating the KL divergence between the main network and the opponent network,  constructing the composite loss function of the main network based on the mean square error between the output action value and the target action value and the KL divergence;  updating the parameter of the main network according to the composite loss function;  according to the KL divergence,  constructing the loss function of the opponent network to update the parameter of the opponent network;  applying disturbance to the main network,  updating the super-parameter clip value in the main network according to the forgetting curve;  S3,  when the preset performance index is satisfied,  simply switching to the complex terrain,  further training the main network and the opponent network,  until the accumulated reward information and the stable walking time length of all the biped robots reach the preset network performance index,  obtaining the trained biped robot gait network.

The invention provides a full-automatic humanoid robot hand-eye calibration method. A mechanical arm moves to a plurality of visual angles according to a preset track,  so that nine characteristic points of a calibration plate completely appear in the visual field of a camera The depth camera synchronously collects RGB images and depth maps,  extracts two-dimensional coordinates of feature points through visual algorithms,  and combines depth information to generate a three-dimensional point cloud. Based on the two-dimensional-three-dimensional correspondence relationship,  calculate the camera internal parameters,  external parameters and coordinate transformation matrix. The system automatically evaluates the calibration error,  intelligently adjusts the robot arm posture and repeatedly collects data,  and iteratively optimizes parameters until it meets the accuracy requirements. This method innovatively constructs a closed-loop calibration system of "motion-acquisition-calculation-evaluation-adjustment" and achieves unattended high-precision calibration. Compared with traditional methods,  it has the advantages of high degree of automation,  strong adaptability,  and good stability. It significantly improves the calibration efficiency and accuracy,  and provides reliable technical support for the large-scale application of humanoid robots. 1. An automated hand-eye calibration method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1) the mechanical arm drives the depth camera to move to a plurality of visual angles according to the preset track,  ensuring that nine characteristic points on the calibration plate are completely covered in the camera view;  step 2) the depth camera collects the RGB image and depth map of the calibration plate at each visual angle;  step 3),  automatically detecting the two-dimensional image coordinates of nine characteristic points by the computer visual algorithm,  and combining the depth data to generate the three-dimensional point cloud coordinate;  step 4) based on the two-dimensional-three-dimensional corresponding point pair of all nine characteristic points,  calculating the coordinate transformation relation of the inner reference,  outer reference of the depth camera and the camera and the mechanical arm base;  step 5) according to the calibration error evaluation result,  controlling the mechanical arm to automatically adjust the visual angle and repeating step 2) to step 4),  iteratively optimizing the calibration parameter until the precision threshold value is satisfied.

The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  in particular to a configuration-variable wheel-legged robot mobile platform,  which includes :  a platform base,  the platform base is decoupled from the upper robot trunk,  and the two ends of the platform base are respectively connected to the left and right legs. structure; a single leg structure includes a hip joint assembly driveably connected to the platform base,  a thigh assembly driveably connected to the hip joint assembly,  a calf assembly driveably connected to the thigh assembly,  a sole assembly driveably connected to the calf assembly,  and a wheel assembly disposed at an outer end of the leg structure The invention relates to a variable-configuration wheel-foot type robot mobile platform,  which has the functions of foot-type movement,  wheel-type movement,  wheel-foot switching and the like according to the movement requirements of different terrains Both the foot-type moving configuration and the wheel-type moving configuration can meet the in-situ steering function. Different configurations can achieve high matching adaptability of mobility,  passability,  carrying capacity and escape ability in different scenarios. 1. A variable-configuration wheel-foot type robot moving platform,  wherein it comprises :  a platform base,  the platform base is decoupled from the upper robot body,  the two ends of the platform base are respectively connected with the left and right supporting leg structures;  The single leg structure comprises a hip joint component drivingly connected with the platform base,  a thigh component drivingly connected with the hip joint component,  a shank component drivingly connected with the thigh component,  a sole component connected with the shank component in a driving manner and a wheel component arranged on the outer side end of the supporting leg structure.

The invention discloses a wheel-track deformation five-legged robot and a control method thereof,  and relates to the technical field of robots The wheel-track deformation five-legged robot includes a vehicle body,  a front walking unit,  a middle walking unit and a rear walking unit; the front end of the vehicle body is equipped with a front walking unit,  and two groups of rear walking units are symmetrically arranged on both sides of the vehicle body close to the rear end; the front running unit and the rear running unit each include a wheel track deformation assembly,  the middle running unit includes a running wheel,  and the wheel track deformation assembly can be switched between a circular wheel structure and a triangular track structure; in the first mode,  the wheel shoe deformation component is in a circular wheel structure,  and all the wheel shoe deformation components and the walking wheels are in contact with the ground; in the second mode,  the wheel track deformation components have a triangular track structure,  and all wheel track deformation components are in contact with the ground,  and the running wheels are out of contact with the ground. The invention can efficiently pass through all terrain and is suitable for hilly and mountainous environments 1. A wheel-shoe deformation five-foot robot,  wherein it comprises a vehicle body,  a front walking unit,  a middle walking unit and a rear walking unit;  the front end of the vehicle body is provided with the front walking unit,  the two sides of the vehicle body close to the front end are symmetrically provided with two groups of the middle walking unit,  the two sides of the vehicle body close to the rear end are symmetrically provided with two groups of the rear walking unit;  the front walking unit and the rear walking unit both comprise a wheel crawler deformation component,  the middle walking unit comprises a walking wheel,  and the wheel crawler deformation component can be switched between the circular wheel type structure and the triangular crawler structure;  in the first mode,  the wheel track deformation assembly is circular wheel type structure,  and all the wheel track deformation assembly and the walking wheel are contacted with the ground;  in the second mode,  the wheel track deformation component is triangular track structure,  and all the wheel track deformation components are contacted with the ground,  the walking wheel is separated from the ground.

The legged robot landing stability test system for simulating thrust plume aftereffect is used for evaluating and verifying the buffering stability performance of the legged robot influenced by the plume aftereffect in the landing process,  and belongs to the technical field of robot design verification. In the invention,  an inclined air floating plane,  a landing surface,  a horizontal speed starting device,  a constant force device and a three-degree-of-freedom ball bearing are flexibly combined It solves the problems of traditional landing stability test that requires a lot of site,  is greatly affected by the environment,  and can only simulate fixed acceleration,  ensures that it can simulate thrust plume aftereffect and long-stroke low-gravity environmental impact with high precision,  and supports the landing stability test of legged robots. 1. A leg-type robot landing stability test system for simulating thrust plume back effect,  wherein it comprises :  an inclined air floating plane,  fixed on the ground,  through the continuous adjustment of the inclined angle,  realizing the equivalent simulation of the back effect of the leg type robot thrust plume and the long stroke low gravity acceleration environment construction;  a constant-force device mounted on the inclined air floating plane for providing constant supporting force for the leg-type robot so as to realize the passive following movement along with the movement of the mass centre of the leg-type robot main body;  a three-degree-of-freedom ball bearing installed at the joint of the constant force device and the leg-type robot and converting the leg-type robot and the constant force device into a ball hinge in an air floating manner so as to realize the posture change of the leg-type robot in any direction;  the landing surface is simulated and installed at the expected landing position of the leg-type robot,  the inclination angle can be continuously adjusted for simulating the landing terrain gradient;  a horizontal speed starting device mounted on the constant force device for driving the constant force device and the leg robot to move to reach the preset landing horizontal speed;  a leg-type robot,  which is integrally installed on the three-degree-of-freedom ball bearing,  through the support of the constant force device and the three-degree-of-freedom ball bearing,  the six-degree-of-freedom free movement on the inclined air floating plane is realized,  the landing vertical speed is simulated by the free falling height along the inclined air floating plane,  The landing horizontal speed is simulated by the horizontal starting device,  and the parameters including the landing slope angle and the friction coefficient are simulated by the simulated landing surface.

The invention relates to the technical field of back electromotive force testing Specifically,  it is a humanoid robot frameless torque motor cogging back electromotive force testing device Including a composite protection transmission mechanism between the servo motor and the torque sensor The composite protection transmission mechanism is used for transmitting power between a servo motor and a torque sensor and realizing overspeed break,  overload break and axial play compensation,  and comprises a main transmission disc,  a transmission block assembly,  an adjustable driven disc assembly and a play compensation coupling assembly This invention achieves double safety protection through the "ultracentrifugal break + overload shear break" of the composite protection transmission mechanism. It uses the adjustable driven plate assembly to flexibly adjust the abnormal overspeed threshold to adapt to multi-speed detection scenarios,  and relies on the movement compensation coupling. The invention provides a humanoid machine control method and system based on model prediction Firstly,  the joint sensing data (hip joint motion angle sequence,  knee joint force signal) and environment interaction data (depth image stream data,  foot contact pressure data) of the humanoid machine are obtained,  and the dynamic state feature set is generated through feature correlation processing,  including joint collaboration feature vector and environment constraint feature matrix; then call the pre-trained model to perform spatiotemporal joint prediction on the feature set,  and output the future motion control sequence containing gait cycle features; based on this,  a joint synchronization control model is constructed to generate a drive control instruction set with time coordination constraints; finally,  the drive control instruction set is transmitted to the distributed execution unit,  and the joint status feedback data is collected for the next round of processing,  thereby improving the motion control performance of the humanoid machine in complex environments. 1. A humanoid machine control method based on model prediction,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the joint sensing data and the environment interaction data of the human-shaped machine,  wherein the joint sensing data comprises a hip joint movement angle sequence and a knee joint stress signal,  the environment interaction data comprises a depth image stream data and a sole contact pressure data;  performing characteristic association processing on the joint sensing data and the environment interaction data,  generating a dynamic state characteristic set of the human-shaped machine,  the dynamic state characteristic set comprises a joint cooperation characteristic vector and an environment constraint characteristic matrix;  invoking a pre-trained motion sequence prediction model to perform space-time joint prediction processing on the dynamic state feature set,  and outputting a future motion control sequence including gait period features,  wherein the future motion control sequence includes an angular change trajectory of each joint and a force adjustment parameter of an actuator;  constructing a joint synchronous control model based on the future motion control sequence,  generating a drive control instruction set containing time coordination constraint,  wherein the drive control instruction set comprises a position drive signal and a force feedback adjusting parameter of each joint;  transmitting the driving control instruction set to the distributed execution unit of the human-shaped machine,  executing the driving control instruction set and collecting the joint state feedback data in the movement process,  taking the joint state feedback data as the input data of the next round of feature association processing;  the characteristic correlation processing is performed on the joint sensing data and the environmental interaction data,  generating a dynamic state characteristic set of the human-shaped machine,  comprising :  extracting the time domain fluctuation characteristic of the hip joint moving angle sequence in the joint sensing data,  capturing the periodic change characteristic of the angle sequence through the sliding time window,  extracting the main peak period characteristic and fluctuation amplitude characteristic of the angle fluctuation as the hip joint dynamic characteristic;  performing frequency band component analysis on the knee joint stress signal,  decomposing the stress signal into component signals in different frequency ranges,  extracting energy ratio characteristic and waveform distortion characteristic of each component signal as knee joint load characteristic;  performing characteristic dimension splicing on the hip joint dynamic characteristic and the knee joint load characteristic,  generating a joint cooperation characteristic vector,  the dimension of the joint cooperation characteristic vector is equal to the sum of the hip joint dynamic characteristic dimension and the knee joint load characteristic dimension,  the coupling characterization of the movement state of the lower limb joint is realized by the characteristic splicing;  performing space structure analysis on the depth image stream data in the environment interaction data,  generating scene depth information through three-dimensional matching,  extracting space position distribution characteristic and ground gradient change characteristic of the obstacle,  constructing environment space characteristic matrix;  performing area pressure characteristic extraction on the sole contact pressure data,  dividing the sole into a forefoot area,  a midfoot area and a heel area,  extracting pressure peak value characteristic and pressure centre offset characteristic of each area as sole interaction characteristic;  performing tensor dimension fusion on the environment space feature matrix and the sole interaction feature to generate an environment constraint feature matrix,  wherein the row dimension of the environment constraint feature matrix is corresponding to the space position distribution,  and the column dimension is corresponding to the pressure interaction feature;  aligning and correlating the joint cooperation feature vector and the environment constraint feature matrix according to the time collecting sequence,  establishing the correlation between the joint motion feature and the environment constraint feature through the non-linear mapping function,  generating a dynamic state feature set comprising kinematics and environment interaction relationship,  each characteristic element of the dynamic state characteristic set comprises a joint motion parameter and a corresponding environment constraint parameter;  the invoking the pre-trained motion sequence prediction model to perform space-time joint prediction processing on the dynamic state feature set,  outputting a future motion control sequence containing gait period features,  comprising :  inputting the dynamic state feature set into the space-time feature coding module of the motion sequence prediction model,  mining the key space position feature in the environment constraint feature matrix through the space attention mechanism,  capturing the time sequence dependency relationship in the joint cooperation feature vector through the time attention mechanism,  generating spatio-temporal associated feature tensor;  the space attention mechanism is realized by calculating the influence weight of each space position in the environment constraint feature matrix to the joint movement,  the time attention mechanism is realized by calculating the associated weight of different time point features in the joint cooperation feature vector;  inputting the spatio-temporal correlation characteristic tensor into the graph structure modelling layer of the motion sequence prediction model,  constructing a human-shaped machine joint connection topological graph,  calculating the motion coupling relationship between the joints through the graph node characteristic propagation,  generating the graph structure motion characteristic,  the node of the joint connection topological graph represents each joint,  the side represents the motion transmission relation between the joints;  inputting the picture structure motion characteristic into the time sequence prediction layer of the motion sequence prediction model,  generating the joint motion state prediction value of multiple future time steps by recursion prediction mode,  wherein the joint motion state prediction value comprises the angle prediction value of each joint and the force prediction parameter of the actuator;  performing kinematics feasibility check on the joint motion state predicted value,  so that the predicted angle is in the joint motion range limit,  and the predicted force parameter is in the actuator rated load range,  generating a primary motion sequence;  performing gait period division on the preliminary motion sequence,  determining gait period characteristic by analyzing the periodic change characteristic of the sole contact pressure,  the gait period characteristic comprises a supporting phase continuous characteristic and a swinging phase continuous characteristic,  embedding the gait period feature in the primary motion sequence to generate a future motion control sequence containing the gait period feature,  wherein the time step length of the future motion control sequence is consistent with the time division of the gait period feature;  constructing a joint synchronization control model based on the future motion control sequence,  generating a drive control instruction set comprising time coordination constraint,  comprising :  analyzing each joint angle change track in the future motion control sequence,  extracting the target angle characteristic and angle change rate characteristic of each joint in each time step length,  constructing joint kinematics constraint relation,  the joint kinematics constraint relation reflects the relevance of the adjacent joint angle change;  based on the joint kinematics constraint relation and the limb connecting rod structure characteristic of the human-shaped machine,  calculating the position driving parameter of each joint through inverse kinematics analysis,  the position driving parameter comprises a joint rotation angle parameter and a rotation direction parameter;  analyzing the actuator force adjusting parameter in the future motion control sequence,  combining the current load state characteristic of the joint,  calculating the force feedback adjusting parameter of the actuator through the force feedback adjusting mechanism,  the force feedback adjusting parameter is used for compensating the external load change influence in the motion process;  inputting the position driving parameter and the force feedback adjusting parameter into the time coordination layer of the joint synchronous control model,  establishing the action time synchronous relation between multiple joints,  generating the time coordination constraint condition;  based on the time coordination constraint condition,  performing time calibration processing on the position driving parameter and the force feedback adjusting parameter,  making the control parameter of each joint keep synchronous on the time axis,  generating the calibrated joint control parameter;  converting the calibrated joint control parameter into a driving signal format which can be identified by the actuator,  generating a driving control instruction set comprising each joint position driving signal and a force feedback adjusting parameter,  the driving control instruction set is arranged according to the joint number sequence and the time step length sequence,  The driving control instruction of each joint comprises a time mark,  a position driving signal and a corresponding force feedback adjusting parameter.

 step S4,  the main controller of the humanoid robot controls the outer side ends of the two soles to tilt upwards for a set angle at the same time,  the outer side end of the sole is propped against the blocking block,  the inner side end of the sole is propped against the supporting chassis,  the sole is mechanically locked on the vehicle body,  at the same time,  the first anode electrode sheet is in pressure contact with the second anode electrode sheet,  The first negative electrode plate is in pressure contact with the second negative electrode plate,  the first signal electrode plate is in pressure contact with the second signal electrode plate,  and the motor driver can drive the electric wheel to rotate by receiving the control signal and electric energy from the humanoid robot.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot handling,  and discloses a humanoid robot compliant collaborative handling method and system based on a virtual safety mechanism. The method includes the steps of :  automatically identifying and accurately positioning the spatial position of the object to be transported; based on the recognition and positioning results of the object to be transported,  the position of the optimal spatial contact point where the dual-arm end effector of the humanoid robot performs the transporting action is calculated; fine-tune the position of the optimal space contact point dynamically,  generate the motion trajectory of the humanoid robot from the initial state to the completion of the handling task,  and construct a virtual space constraint domain; continuously perceive the interactive force feedback information between the humanoid robot and the environment and the object to be transported,  and dynamically adjust the movement posture and action force of the humanoid robot's arms in real time. According to the invention,  through visual and force sense cross-modal perception fusion and high-reliability and low-delay communication guarantee,  soft and anti-collision control in the carrying process is realized,  and synchronous optimization of safety and operation efficiency is achieved 1. A flexible cooperative conveying method of humanoid robot based on virtual safety mechanism,  wherein the method is executed by the virtual clamp system to form the remote operation platform end of the main remote control system and the humanoid robot;  wherein,  the method is performed at the remote operation platform end,  comprising the following steps :  the remote operation platform end starts a multi-viewpoint cooperative scanning mode before the beginning of the conveying stage,  using a plurality of depth visual sensors integrated by the human-shaped robot main body to perform omni-directional three-dimensional data collection on the object to be conveyed,  fusing the collected point cloud data and performing spatial posture calculation,  finishing the automatic identification of the object to be carried and the precise location of the space position;  the remote operation platform end based on the identification and locating result of the object to be carried,  combining the preset safety and operation rule,  calculating the position of the optimal space contact point of the double-arm end actuator of the humanoid robot for executing the carrying action;  the operator of the remote operation platform end performs dynamic posture fine adjustment to the position of the optimal space contact point through the screen in the capsule cabin according to the real-time operation condition,  generates the motion track of the humanoid robot from the initial state to the carrying task,  and constructs a virtual space constraint domain for the remote operation arm;  the remote operation platform end continuously senses the interaction force feedback information of the human-shaped robot and the environment and the object to be carried in the track execution process of the human-shaped robot,  and dynamically adjusts the motion posture and action force of the double arms of the human-shaped robot in real time according to the interaction force feedback information.

The invention belongs to the technical field of gait control of a legged robot,  and particularly discloses a gait control method of an alligator-like robot. The gait control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring state data and terrain depth map data of the alligator-like robot; input the obtained data into the gait control model to obtain the predicted gait; control the crocodile robot to perform gait motion based on the predicted gait and record its motion trajectory; sampling trajectory data to iteratively update gait control model parameters; among them,  the gait control model outputs the diffusion strategy gait through the diffusion actor-critic network,  generates a priori gait through the central pattern generator,  and then fuses the diffusion strategy gait and the priori gait through the weight network to obtain Predicted gait; the invention effectively solves the problems of insufficient action exploration ability,  slow convergence speed and insufficient strategy generalization ability of the traditional reinforcement learning-based crocodile robot gait control algorithm under complex terrain. 1. A crocodile-simulating robot gait control method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining crocodile-simulated robot state data and terrain depth map data;  inputting the crocodile-simulated robot state data and the terrain depth map data into a gait control model to obtain a predicted gait;  wherein the gait control model comprises a diffusion actor-commentator network,  a weight network and a central mode generator;  the gait control model outputs a diffusion strategy gait through a diffusion actor-commentator network,  generates a priori gait through a central mode generator,  and then fuses the diffusion strategy gait and the priori gait by a weight network to obtain a predicted gait;  the diffusion actor-commentator network takes the diffusion model as the actor network of the diffusion actor-commentator network;  the diffusion strategy gait comprises the diffusion strategy rotation angle of the hip joint of the crocodile-imitating robot and the diffusion strategy rotation angle of the knee joint;  the priori gait comprises a priori rotation angle of the hip joint of the crocodile-imitating robot and a priori rotation angle of the knee joint;  the predicted gait comprises the predicted rotation angle of the hip joint of the crocodile-simulating robot and the predicted rotation angle of the knee joint;  based on the predicted gait,  controlling the crocodile-imitating robot to perform gait movement,  collecting the track data of the crocodile-imitating robot,  iteratively updating the gait control model parameter;  the track data comprises the state data of the current time,  the action of the current time predicting gait,  the action reward of the current time and the state data of the next time.

The present invention relates to the technical field of target detection,  and specifically to a fluorescent clothing detection method based on image pedestrian attributes. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  capturing a real-time video stream by using a camera,  decoding the video stream by using an H264 decoder combined with GPU hardware acceleration processing,  and detecting a pedestrian from the video stream by using an SSD humanoid detection algorithm; s2. Perform attribute detection on the detected pedestrian pictures to obtain all attribute data of pedestrians; s3. Find the fluorescent clothing attributes in the attribute data and calculate the confidence of the fluorescent clothing attributes; s4. Determine whether the worker has fluorescent clothing attributes based on the confidence of fluorescent clothing attributes; s5. Integrate the results through the GstPlugin interface,  load the pedestrian attribute model accelerated and optimized by TensorRT through the nvinfer interface of DeepStream,  display the detection frame and detection area in combination with OSD,  and finally display it on the desktop through EGLSink. 1. A fluorescent coating detection method based on image pedestrian attribute,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  S1,  using the camera to capture the real-time video stream,  using H264 decoder combined with GPU hardware acceleration processing to decode the video stream,  using SSD humanoid detection algorithm to detect the pedestrian from the video stream;  S2,  performing attribute detection on the detected pedestrian picture,  obtaining all attribute data of the pedestrian;  S3,  searching the fluorescent coat attribute in the attribute data,  and calculating the confidence of the fluorescent coat attribute;  wherein the attribute of the fluorescent coat comprises whether the fluorescent strip is worn and whether the fluorescent coat is worn;  S4,  judging whether the worker has the fluorescence coat attribute according to the confidence of the fluorescence coat attribute;  S5,  performing result integration through the GstPlugin interface,  and loading the pedestrian attribute model after TensorRT accelerated optimization through the nvinfer interface of the DeepStream,  and combining OSD display detection frame,  the detection area is finally displayed on the table surface by EGLSink.

A computer-implemented method when executed by data processing hardware causes the data processing hardware to perform operations. The operations include detecting a candidate support surface at an elevation less than a current surface supporting a legged robot. A determination is made on whether the candidate support surface includes an area of missing terrain data within a portion of an environment surrounding the legged robot,  where the area is large enough to receive a touchdown placement for a leg of the legged robot. If missing terrain data is determined,  at least a portion of the area of missing terrain data is classified as a no-step region of the candidate support surface. The no-step region indicates a region where the legged robot should avoid touching down a leg of the legged robot.
