The present invention discloses a humanoid mechanical foot for humanoid robot Comprises a foot frame for connecting the lower leg of the humanoid robot and other foot components,  a split-type foot arch,  an elastic buffer component forming a three-connecting rod with the foot arch,  a heel,  an elastic buffer component forming a three-connecting rod with the heel,  and a two-degree-of-freedom toe and ground-touching detection sensor with an automatic reset function According to the invention,  by designing toes with pitch freedom degree,  the front sole of the robot integrally rotates relative to the foot part,  so that a human-like gait can be realized; by designing toes,  arch elastic buffer components,  and heel elastic buffer components with roll degrees of freedom,  the robot's foot's ability to adapt to different terrains is enhanced; by designing a contact sensor on the foot,  the robot's foot-to-ground perception ability is increased,  resulting in the ability to achieve a static gait. The invention can make the robot realize more energy-saving,  less noise,  more human-like straight knee,  heel-toe gait; has the ability to buffer the impact of sufficient ground and adapt to unstructured ground. 1. A humanoid foot mechanical foot for humanoid robot,  wherein It comprises foot frame,  heel elastic buffering component,  heel component,  arch elastic buffering component,  arch component and toe component;  the front part and the rear part of the foot frame are respectively provided with an arch component and a heel component;  at the same time,  the middle part and the back end of the foot frame are respectively provided with a bearing hole and a through hole,  which are respectively used for connecting the lower leg and the ankle joint driving component of the robot;  there are two sets of arch components,  which are respectively arranged on the left and right sides of the foot frame;  the middle parts of the two sets of arch components are connected with the foot frame to form a rotating pair;  the top part of the foot arch component is connected with the foot frame through the foot arch elastic buffer component,  the bottom part of the foot arch component is used for connecting the toe component;  the toe component comprises a toe main body and a cross shaft;  wherein the bottom surface of the toe main body is a plane,  the front and back opposite connecting shafts of the cross shaft are respectively connected with the supporting seats fixedly mounted on the front and back positions of the toe main body to form a rotating pair;  when the toe component is under the positive pressure from the ground,  the arch elastic buffer component is compressed;  the energy of impact and vibration is absorbed by the compression spring;  the two toe components of said structure are connected with the bottom of the foot arch component through the left and right opposite connecting shafts of the cross shaft to form a rotating pair;  roll and pitch free degree rotation are provided for the toe component by the cross shaft;  the roll freedom degree and the pitch freedom degree rotation are reset by two roll freedom degree torsion springs and a pitch freedom degree torsion spring;  wherein the two roll degree of freedom torsion springs are sleeved on the rotating shaft in the front and back directions of the cross shaft,  the two roll degree of freedom torsion springs have opposite rotating directions;  under the condition of no external force,  the bottom surface of the toe main body is horizontal through the action of two roll freedom torsion springs,  and the reset of the roll freedom rotation of the toe component is provided with torque;  the front joint is connected with the foot frame to form a rotating pair,  and the back joint is connected with the foot frame through the heel elastic buffer component;  when the heel component is pressed by the pressure from the ground,  the heel component rotates around the rotating shaft connected with the foot frame so that the two heel elastic buffer components are pressed to generate elastic force for buffering.

The invention discloses a landing planning method of a quadruped robot based on scene decoupling and risk avoidance,  which aims to solve the problems of poor perception and insufficient obstacle avoidance ability in complex environments in the prior art The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring and fusing multi-source sensor data,  and segmenting an original point cloud; generating a scene-decoupled elevation map of a multi-layer structure using segmented point clouds; based on the elevation map,  a multi-objective optimization problem with risk avoidance as the core is constructed,  including a comprehensive cost function and strict obstacle avoidance constraints; use the reactive adjustment module that can capture area theory to deal with the risk of dynamic instability; the hierarchical solution strategy is used to solve the multi-objective and multi-constraint optimization problem in real time,  and finally the optimal foot-end landing point that takes into account both safety and stability is generated. The present invention significantly improves the terrain adaptability,  motion stability and decision-making intelligence of the quadruped robot in an unstructured environment through fine decoupling of scenes and quantitative avoidance of multi-source risks. 1. A four-foot robot foot-falling planning method based on scene decoupling and risk avoidance,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step S100 :  obtaining and fusing multi-source sensor data such as a depth camera,  an RGB camera,  an inertia measuring unit and a joint encoder,  wherein :  the depth camera provides partial high-resolution original depth information and converts it into original three-dimensional environment point cloud information,  the RGB camera provides colour image information,  the inertia measuring unit provides robot posture and motion state information,  the joint encoder provides robot joint angle and angular velocity information;  Step S200 :  dividing the original three-dimensional environment point cloud based on the mapping relation of the pixel and the original depth information so as to distinguish and identify the barrier and generate the divided point cloud;  Step S300 :  based on the divided point cloud and the inertia measuring unit,  providing robot posture and motion state information,  generating a multi-layer scene decoupling height map,  wherein the multi-layer structure can finely represent terrain information of different dimensions such as terrain height and obstacle and so on,  and the scene decoupling can decompose the complex scene into an independent modelling component;  Step S400 :  constructing a multi-target optimization problem with risk avoidance as the core based on the multi-layer scene decoupling altitude map;  The optimization problem includes :  The comprehensive cost function :  the invention quantifies the cost of gait efficiency,  foot end stability,  expected speed tracking and path deviation so as to balance the motion stability,  task target and safety;  Strict obstacle avoidance constraints :  ensuring the minimum safe distance between the planed foot end foot point and the identified obstacle,  avoiding collision;  Step S500 :  the hierarchical solving strategy is used for solving the multi-target optimizing problem in real time,  wherein the hierarchical solving strategy is used for decomposing the complex problem into sub-problem cooperative solving of different levels so as to efficiently obtain the final optimizing result;  outputting the optimal foot end foot falling point which is safe,  stable and task target,  namely the nominal foot falling point,  the foot falling point guides the foot part placing position of the next step of the four-foot robot;  Step S600 :  adjusting the multi-target optimization problem in real time by using the reaction type adjusting module of the capturing area theory;  the adjusting module self-adaptively corrects and optimizes the nominal foot point according to the current centroid motion state of the robot and the potential dynamic instability risk,  and obtains the final adjusted foot point so as to enhance the robustness of the robot motion.

The invention belongs to the field of automotive technology and provides a door control method,  device,  storage medium and equipment,  which includes :  obtaining an image to be recognized; performing humanoid detection,  facial recognition and facial feature extraction on the image to be recognized in sequence,  and comparing the extracted facial features with the pre-stored facial information of the person; if the comparison results are consistent,  the luggage size is recognized based on the image to be recognized,  and the trunk opening instruction is obtained; judging the number of persons in the image to be recognized and the authority of each person according to the comparison result; if the comparison results are consistent,  the voice,  gesture and/or human body distance are obtained,  and the door opening command and/or trunk opening command are recognized; and subdivide the door opening instructions according to the number of people,  the authority of each person,  the distance between the door and the obstacle,  and the location of the person. It realizes automatic opening and closing of the car door and trunk,  improving the convenience and safety of entering and exiting the car. 1. A vehicle door control method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the image to be identified;  orderly performing human shape detection,  face identification and face feature extraction to the image to be identified,  comparing the extracted face feature with the pre-stored face information of the person;  if the comparison result is consistent,  based on the image to be identified,  identifying the luggage size,  and when the luggage size exceeds the preset value,  obtaining the trunk opening instruction;  according to the comparison result,  judging the number of the persons in the image to be identified and the authority of each person;  if the comparison result is consistent,  obtaining the voice,  gesture and/or human body distance,  identifying to obtain the vehicle door opening instruction and/or trunk opening instruction;  and judging the vehicle door to be opened according to the number of people and the authority of each person;  for the vehicle door to be opened,  the vehicle door opening instruction is subdivided according to the distance between the vehicle door and the barrier and the position of the person;  The step of subdividing the vehicle door opening instruction comprises :  when the distance between the vehicle door and the barrier is less than the first threshold value,  the vehicle door opening instruction is kept closed,  and voice prompts that the vehicle door cannot be opened;  when the distance between the vehicle door and the barrier is greater than the first threshold value and less than the second threshold value,  judging whether the position of the person is located at the appointed position;  if not,  opening the vehicle door instruction to keep closed,  until the position of the person is detected to be located at the appointed position;  when the distance between the vehicle door and the barrier is greater than the second threshold value and less than the third threshold value,  judging whether the position of the person is located at the appointed position;  if not,  opening the vehicle door instruction to keep closed,  until the position of the person is detected to be located at the appointed position;  when the distance between the vehicle door and the barrier is greater than the third threshold value,  the vehicle door opening instruction is full door opening;  if the human body distance of multiple continuous time points is less than the set value,  obtaining the vehicle door opening instruction;  if the human body distance is less than the set value at a certain time point of the time period of the vehicle owner habitual vehicle,  the vehicle door opening instruction is obtained.

The invention relates to an object three-dimensional information reconstruction method based on humanoid robot body perception,  which includes :  step 1. Input the initial object surface point cloud into the visual-touch fusion object reconstruction network to obtain the initial object shape estimation result; step 3. Use the double-arm active tactile exploration strategy to actively explore the object Obtain tactile data and further refined object surface point clouds And add the further refined object surface point cloud to the initial object shape estimation result,  and input it together with the tactile data into the visual-touch fusion object reconstruction network for further object reconstruction to obtain a further refined object shape estimation result. Repeat step 3 until the reconstruction is completed. Compared with the prior art,  the invention has the advantages that the refined shape reconstruction of the object can be realized under the condition of a single visual angle of the robot in a complex scene,  and the like 1. An object three-dimensional information reconstruction method based on humanoid robot body perception,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  obtaining the single visual angle depth image collected by the anthropomorphic robot body,  pre-processing to obtain the single visual angle three-dimensional point cloud of the object,  as the initial object surface point cloud;  step 2,  inputting the point cloud on the surface of the initial object into the visual contact fusion object reconstruction network to obtain an initial object shape estimation result;  step 3,  based on the initial object shape estimation result,  using a double-arm active touch search strategy to actively search the object,  obtaining touch data and further refined object surface point cloud,  and adding the further refined object surface point cloud into the initial object shape estimation result,  together with the touch data input in the visual touch fusion object reconstruction network in the step 2 for further object reconstruction,  obtaining the further refined object shape estimation result,  repeating the step 3,  until the reconstruction is finished;  the visual contact fusion object reconstruction network comprises a point cloud channel encoder,  a tactile channel encoder,  a fusion module and a decoder based on self-attention,  the point cloud channel encoder is used for extracting point cloud characteristic,  the tactile channel encoder is used for extracting tactile characteristic,  the fusion module is used for fusing the point cloud characteristic and the tactile characteristic to obtain point-tactile fusion characteristic,  the self-attention-based decoder is used for decoding the point-touch fusion feature to realize the object shape estimation;  In step 2,  the step of obtaining the initial object shape estimation result comprises :  inputting the point cloud on the surface of the initial object into the point cloud channel encoder,  extracting the point cloud feature;  inputting the point cloud feature into the self-attention-based decoder for decoding to obtain an initial object shape estimation result;  In step 3,  the performing step of the visual contact fusion object reconstruction network comprises :  inputting the further refined object surface point cloud into the point cloud channel encoder,  extracting the point cloud feature;  inputting the haptic data into a haptic channel encoder to extract haptic features;  splicing the point cloud feature and the touch feature,  and inputting the point cloud feature and the touch feature into the fusion module to obtain a point-touch fusion feature;  according to the determined mode,  actively exploring under the touch exploring design rule to obtain the exploring position and generate the touch data;  based on the touch data,  using a position calibration network to obtain a further refined object surface point cloud;  The design criteria include a curvature criteria and a safety criteria,  the curvature criteria being expressed as :  in the formula,  U1 (.) is curvature standard,  pi,  pj is point i and j,  lambda is the characteristic value of Kcur,  Kcur is curvature covariance matrix,  wherein the curvature covariance according to the distance between the current point cloud adjacent to the n point cloud to calculate,  single arm mode only calculating the curvature of one point;  The safety criteria are as follows :  U2 (pi,  pj) = d (pi,  pj) + (zi + zj),  in the formula,  U2 (.) is the safety standard,  pi,  pj is point i and j,  d (.) is the first item,  representing the distance between the two points to be explored under the two-arm mode,  zi + zj is the second item,  representing the distance from the ground,  zi,  zj are the height from the ground of point i and j,  respectively,  under the single-arm mode only calculating the second item.

This application relates to a data-driven switching gain estimation technology for bipedal walking race robots. The technique utilizes the behavioral theory of linear systems The data interpretation system of unknown dynamic hybrid system is constructed,  and the global exponential stability criterion is established by combining the linear matrix inequality based on data. Under mild conditions,  the global exponential stability of bipedal robot system is guaranteed,  so that bipedal walking robot can realize normal operation without relying on the model At the same time,  the data-driven hybrid estimation scheme proposed in this application eliminates the system model identification step and reduces the consumption of resources. 1. A data-driven switching gain estimation technology of biped walking robot,  wherein the technology comprises :  constructing the state space model of the biped robot system based on the model by using the hybrid system frame,  and constructing the equivalent system model of the biped robot system based on the data according to the state space model;  wherein the state space model and the equivalent system model both comprise an unknown system matrix;  constructing the prior knowledge of the noise in the biped walking robot system;  according to the equivalent system model and the prior knowledge of the noise,  obtaining the set of the unknown system matrix;  wherein the expression of the set of unknown system matrix comprises peeling off the first matrix of the unknown system matrix;  obtaining a second matrix related to the first matrix;  constructing a gain observer based on the state space model,  and obtaining an augmented system according to the gain observer and the equivalent system model;  constructing a first stability criterion of the biped robot system based on the model according to the augmented system;  using S citation to process the first stability criterion,  and substituting the second matrix,  obtaining the second stability criterion based on data;  obtaining the gain estimation according to the second stability criterion.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot walking controller training method and a quadruped robot walking controller training system,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The quadruped robot walking controller training method and the quadruped robot walking controller training system specifically comprise the following steps of :  acquiring motion data of a plurality of quadruped robots in various walking scenes,  extracting common features related to walking control in the motion data,  and storing the common features into a common feature library; based on the common feature library,  the existing adaptive walking controller for specific quadruped robot training is analyzed,  and the control parameters and control strategies in the controller are separated; according to the differences of the body characteristics of different quadruped robots,  key body characteristic parameters are selected and a control parameter mapping model is established; based on the common features in the common feature library and the separated control strategies,  a control strategy migration model is constructed; integrate the initial control parameter values of the new quadruped robot generated by the control parameter mapping model with the control strategy adapted by the control strategy migration model to form a walking controller for the new quadruped robot. 1. A four-foot robot walking controller training method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  collecting the motion data of multiple four-foot robots under various walking scenes,  extracting the common feature related to the walking control,  including gait period feature,  joint motion track feature,  body posture balance feature,  and storing the common feature in the common feature base;  S2 :  based on the common characteristic base,  analyzing the self-adaptive walking controller of the current special four-foot robot training,  separating the control parameter from the control strategy in the controller;  S3 :  aiming at the main body characteristic difference of different four-footed robots,  selecting the key main body characteristic parameter,  including leg length,  weight and motor torque,  establishing a control parameter mapping model by analyzing the corresponding relation between the key main body characteristic parameter and the control parameter;  S4 :  constructing a control strategy migration model based on the common characteristic in the common characteristic base and the separated control strategy,  and training the control strategy migration model by using the walking data of multiple four-foot robots;  The method for constructing the control policy migration model is as follows :  constructing a strategy feature coding module,  converting the gait period feature,  joint motion track feature and body posture balance feature in the common feature library into a feature matrix with fixed dimension;  building a strategy logic conversion layer,  using the gating circulation unit structure,  inputting the symbolized sequence of the separated control strategy logic expression;  setting main body characteristic modulation layer,  receiving leg length,  weight,  motor torque parameter and generating modulation coefficient;  constructing a strategy output decoding layer,  converting the processed signal into an executable control strategy instruction set,  each module is connected in turn according to the data flow direction to form a complete control strategy migration model framework;  The process of training the control strategy migration model by using the walking data of a plurality of four-foot robots is as follows :  when preparing the training data set,  collecting the walking data of multiple four-foot robots under flat ground,  slope,  ladder scene,  extracting the common characteristic matrix corresponding to each data,  the main body characteristic parameter and the actually executed control strategy instruction set,  designing joint loss function,  through editing distance constructing strategy logic deviation loss item,  using cosine similarity constructing common characteristic consistency loss item,  according to 1 :  1 weight to form joint loss function;  performing staged training,  firstly using gradient descent algorithm to train the flat ground scene data in the training data set,  the iteration times are preset basic times,  then adding slope and ladder scene data to continue training,  the iteration times are half of the basic times,  each iteration uses the verification data set to calculate the loss value and record the model parameter;  performing model suitability fine adjustment,  selecting the model parameter with the smallest loss value in the verification data set as the initial parameter,  aiming at each robot sample individual fine adjustment,  inputting the main body characteristic parameter and the common characteristic matrix,  taking the deviation between the output and the actual control strategy instruction set as the fine adjustment loss,  updating the parameter of the main body characteristic modulation layer by single iteration to finish the model training;  S5 :  the control parameter initial value of the new four-foot robot generated by the control parameter mapping model is integrated with the control strategy adapted by the control strategy transferring model to form the walking controller aiming at the new four-foot robot.

The invention discloses a laser composite additive manufacturing method and application of high-strength and tough TiAl-based alloy. The method includes :  using laser melting deposition technology to form TiAl4822 powder to form a pre-alloy layer of the TiAl-based alloy; after the deposited pre-alloy layer is cooled and solidified,  Nb powder is laid on its surface,  and transparent quartz glass is pressed on the Nb powder. Then a single high peak intensity pulse laser is used to penetrate the quartz glass and the Nb powder is mechanically embedded into the pre-alloy layer through laser impact,  so that Nb is dispersed in the TiAl matrix in the form of simple substance Repeating the laser shock process to improve the content and distribution uniformity of elemental Nb in the TiAl matrix; the laser melting deposition and pulsed laser impact processes are interacted layer by layer and reciprocate in sequence until the size of the prepared high-strength and tough TiAl-based alloy meets the requirements. The high-toughness TiAl-based alloy prepared by the invention has good toughness and high-temperature performance 1. A laser composite reinforcement manufacturing method of high-toughness TiAl-based alloy,  wherein the method comprises :  S1 :  respectively placing the TiAl4822 powder and Nb powder in a vacuum drying box for drying;  the purity of the TiAl4822 powder and the Nb powder is more than 99.9 %;  the average grain diameter of TiAl4822 powder particle is 40 to 150 μ m;  The chemical components of TiAl4822 powder are :  Al is 32.4 to 33.6 wt. %,  Cr is 2.4 to 2.8 wt. %,  Nb is 4.5 to 5.1 wt. %,  O is less than or equal to 0.08 wt. %,  C is less than or equal to 0.02 wt. %,  N is less than or equal to 0.02 wt. %,  H is less than or equal to 0.005 wt. %,  Fe is less than or equal to 0.10 wt. %,  Ni is less than or equal to 0.05 wt. %,  and the rest is Ti;  the average particle diameter of the Nb powder particle is 0. 5 to 1 μ m;  The chemical components of the Nb powder are :  Nb is not less than 99.9 wt %,  O is not more than 0.065 wt %,  C is not more than 0.02 wt %,  N is not more than 0.01 wt %,  H is not more than 0.005 wt %;  S2 :  the distance between the heating induction coil and the base material is adjusted to ensure that the base material is efficiently heated by the surface skin effect;  respectively putting the dried TiAl4822 powder and the high-purity Nb powder into a coaxial powder feeding system;  wherein the heating temperature of the base material is 300-600 degrees centigrade;  the base material is TC4 alloy plate;  S3 :  using laser melting deposition technology to melt and deposit the dried TiAl4822 powder on the surface of the base material according to the preset track so as to form multiple single-layer melting coating as the preposed alloy layer of TiAl-based alloy;  continuously introducing inert gas in the whole preparation process to form positive pressure protection environment;  S4 :  after the single-layer cladding coating is cooled and solidified,  the Nb powder is paved on the surface;  using a three-axis mechanical arm to press a transparent quartz glass on the Nb powder,  then using a single high peak intensity pulse laser to penetrate through the quartz glass to mechanically and uniformly embed the Nb powder into the preposed alloy layer of TiAl-based alloy through laser impact reinforcement,  the Nb element is ensured to be dispersed in the TiAl-based alloy in the form of simple substance but not solid solution;  the laser impact process is repeated for multiple times to improve the content of the elemental Nb in the TiAl-based alloy and the distribution uniformity thereof;  S5 :  repeating the steps S3 and S4 so as to realize the layer-by-layer interaction of the laser melting deposition and the pulse laser impact process,  so as to reciprocate until the size of the prepared high-toughness TiAl-based alloy meets the requirement.

The invention relates to the field of intelligent identification More specifically,  it relates to a virtual human intelligent motion control method for complex maintenance scenarios Perform virtual human physical modeling,  based on the GB10000 human body size standard and ergonomic standard,  establish a virtual human model,  the model includes a kinematic architecture and a skin profile The kinematic architecture divides the virtual human into an upper body and a lower body The upper body includes a total of 8 joints including the spine,  neck,  left/right shoulder,  left/right elbow and left/right wrist,  and the lower body includes a total of 6 joints including the root of the left/right thigh,  left/right knee and left/right ankle. Each joint is abstracted into a ball hinge,  hinge or universal joint kinematic mechanism,  and joint angle constraints are set; it solves the technical problem that action methods based on state machines,  behavior trees,  etc. adopt pre-designed animations and combine prefabricated animations,  which are usually oriented to the calculation and analysis of conventional maintenance tasks and are difficult to meet special and complex maintenance scenarios. 1. A virtual person intelligent movement control method for complex maintenance scene,  wherein it comprises :  step 1,  performing virtual human physical modelling,  based on GB10000 human body size standard and human-machine engineering efficiency standard,  establishing virtual human model,  the model comprises a kinematics framework and a skin shape,  wherein the kinematics framework divides the virtual human into an upper half body and a lower half body,  the upper half body comprises a spine,  the neck,  left/right shoulder,  left/right elbow and left/right wrist are 8 joints,  the lower half body comprises left/right thigh root,  left/right knee and left/right ankle are 6 joints,  each joint is respectively abstracted as ball hinge,  hinge or universal joint kinematics mechanism,  and set joint angle constraint;  the skin shape is based on the kinematics structure,  in the 3D software,  constructing head,  chest,  buttocks,  left/right upper arm,  left/right lower arm,  left/right hand,  left/right thigh,  left/right leg and left/right foot;  step 2,  based on the virtual human physical model,  realizing human body intelligent motion posture control,  comprising :  in the Unity environment,  using the AnimationRig plug-in to convert the virtual human model into simulation model,  binding the skeleton and adding position constraint and rotation angle constraint,  at the same time,  constructing a 128 * 128 pixel visual camera,  binding to the virtual human model to provide visual perceptual input;  using Cyclic Coordinate Descent inverse kinematics algorithm,  the virtual human arm is converted into 7 degree of freedom motion chain,  comprising shoulder joint 3 degree of freedom,  elbow joint 1 degree of freedom,  wrist joint 2 degree of freedom and palm end actuator 1 degree of freedom;  the leg part is converted into 6 degrees of freedom motion chain,  comprising hip joint 3 degrees of freedom,  knee joint 1 degrees of freedom and ankle joint 2 degrees of freedom;  by iteratively calculating the vector,  rotation angle and rotation matrix from the end actuator to the target point,  updating the joint position until the distance between the end actuator and the target point is less than 0.01 m or the number of iterations is 8;  based on the Rapidly-revolution Random Tree track planning algorithm,  the arm end actuator is used as the starting point,  the maintenance scene operation area is used as the target point,  combining the virtual human skin shape and the scene obstacle constraint,  generating obstacle avoiding track,  dividing the track discretization into multiple nodes;  based on the Proximal Policy Optimization deep reinforcement learning algorithm,  constructing a virtual human motion control strategy model,  comprising a lower limb motion control strategy model and an upper limb motion control strategy model,  wherein the lower limb model uses discrete action,  comprising forward,  retreating,  left turning,  right turning,  squat and rest,  controlling leg movement,  upper limb model uses continuous action and discrete action to control arm and spinal movement,  and introducing Rapidly-random Tree track planning algorithm obstacle avoiding track as constraint;  the model is realized by PyTorch library,  the input comprises visual camera RGB image and joint pose information,  the output action distribution,  and through reward function optimization strategy,  reward function considering target arrival,  collision avoidance,  moving efficiency and posture comfort factor;  step 3,  based on the step 1 and the step 2,  under the complex maintenance scene,  the device accessibility and operation space quantitative evaluation are realized,  through detecting the accessibility of the maintenance channel and the operation area,  and combining the human-computer work efficiency analysis,  outputting the availability and comfort value of the reachable solution,  so as to guide the maintenance space layout optimization.

The invention belongs to the field of robot technology,  and specifically relates to an integral casting structure of a humanoid robot skeleton,  which includes a load-bearing mechanism,  a potential energy storage and release mechanism,  a bionic gait mechanism and a dynamic balancing mechanism. The load-bearing mechanism includes a main shell,  a vertical beam,  a cross beam and a bottom plate; when the bearing mechanism inclines forward,  the potential energy storing and releasing mechanism breaks and stores gravitational potential energy and converts the potential energy into initial mechanical power to start walking When the potential energy storage and release mechanism starts to release the initial mechanical power,  it automatically drives the bionic gait mechanism to work,  driving the two bottom plates to mimic the human gait to walk alternately; when the bionic gait mechanism works and drives the two bottom plates to walk alternately,  it automatically drives the dynamic balancing mechanism to work and balance and restore the overall structure during alternating walking,  which solves its high energy consumption,  poor environmental adaptability and poor balance performance,  which in turn leads to the problem of insufficient reliability of its continuous walking. 1. An integral casting structure of human-shaped robot framework,  wherein it comprises :  a bearing mechanism (100),  comprising a main shell (110),  a vertical beam (120) located at the top part of the main shell (110),  a cross beam (130) located at the top part of the vertical beam (120) and a bottom plate (140) located at two sides of the lower part of the main shell (110);  a potential energy storage and release mechanism (200),  which is installed in the main shell (110),  wherein,  when the bearing mechanism (100) is inclined forwards,  the potential energy storage and release mechanism (200) breaks,  stores the gravity potential energy,  and converts the potential energy into the initial mechanical power for starting walking;  a bionic gait mechanism (300),  which is installed on the two sides of the bottom of the main shell (110) and respectively connected with the two bottom plates (140),  wherein,  when the potential energy storage and release mechanism (200) starts to release the initial mechanical power,  automatically driving the bionic gait mechanism (300) to work,  driving the two bottom plates (140) bionic human body gait to alternately walk;  a dynamic balance mechanism (400),  which is installed on the left and right sides of the beam (130),  wherein,  when the bionic gait mechanism (300) works,  drives the two bottom plates (140) to alternately walk,  automatically drives the dynamic balance mechanism (400) to work,  balancing and recovering the whole structure when walking alternately.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot motion control,  and particularly relates to a quadruped robot control method based on error symbol robust integral feedback,  which combines an RISE control mechanism with a constraint-based optimization method to realize high-precision trajectory tracking and strong robust control under the condition that a system model has large uncertainty In this method,  RISE controllers are respectively designed in the position and attitude subsystems,  and the quadratic programming (QP) optimization distribution of ground contact force is integrated. This method dynamically adjusts the control input while ensuring the physical feasibility of the foot end force. Closed-loop stable control of the whole-body movement of a quadruped robot is achieved This control strategy has asymptotic error convergence characteristics and can be widely used in quadruped robot motion tasks with drastic load changes and frequent interference. 1. A four-foot robot control method based on error symbol robust integral feedback,  wherein a four-foot robot platform applied to uncertainty interference,  the method comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  establishing a single rigid body dynamics model considering the gravity centre position,  the angular speed,  the contact force and the disturbance item,  for describing the stress and rotation state of the four-foot robot main body and the load combination system;  step 2 :  according to the expected position and the posture track,  respectively constructing the error states of the position sub-system and the posture sub-system,  including the position error,  the posture error and the first-order derivative and the second-order derivative thereof,  and introducing the filter error to enhance the visibility and astringency of the controller;  step 3 :  the RISE control law of the position sub-system is designed,  the robust inhibition of the undetermined external force interference is realized by the state feedback,  the error integral compensation item and the non-linear symbol function,  and the position error of the system is gradually converged;  step 4 :  designing the RISE control law of the attitude sub-system,  defining the attitude error by using the rotating matrix logarithm mapping form,  and combining the angular speed feedback,  the angular acceleration filter error and the integral compensation term,  realizing the robust stable control of the external moment disturbance;  step 5 :  combining the RISE controller of the position sub-system and the RISE controller of the attitude sub-system to obtain the total RISE controller,  the RISE controller of the position sub-system and the RISE controller of the attitude sub-system are the target acceleration and angular acceleration output by the position and attitude controller,  establishing a secondary planning optimization problem with friction cone constraint and contact condition,  for solving the optimal distribution of the ground reaction force of each foot of the four-foot robot;  step 6 :  the foot end ground reaction force obtained by the secondary planning solution is used as the force closed-loop control input,  combined with the RISE feedback output to commonly drive the robot joint actuator,  realizing the expected track tracking task.

The invention relates to a control method for dynamically optimizing contact force distribution of a foot-type robot,  belongs to the technical field of foot-type robots,  and solves the problem that foot ends of the foot-type robot in the prior art are easy to sink when the foot-type robot travels in soft terrain The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring real-time ground reaction force of each foot of the foot type robot in a current gait cycle support phase and joint control information of a previous gait cycle support phase; based on the joint control information of each foot in the support phase of the previous gait cycle and the standard ground reaction force time curve,  the expected ground reaction force time curve of each foot in the support phase of the current gait cycle is obtained; based on the expected ground reaction force time curve of each foot in the support phase of the current gait cycle and the corresponding real-time ground reaction force,  the PID controller is used to obtain the control torque of each foot at each moment and apply it to each joint motor of each foot to optimize the contact force distribution of each foot. The walking stability of the legged robot in unstructured terrain was achieved. 1. A control method for dynamically optimizing contact force distribution of foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the real-time ground counterforce of each foot of the foot-type robot in the current gait period supporting phase and the joint control information of the previous gait period supporting phase;  wherein the joint control information is the control torque of each joint at each moment of the supporting phase in the previous gait period;  based on the joint control information and the standard ground reaction force time curve of each foot in the previous step period supporting phase,  obtaining the expected ground reaction force time curve of each foot in the current step period supporting phase;  based on the expected ground counterforce time curve and corresponding real-time ground counterforce of each foot supporting phase in the current gait period,  using PID controller to obtain the control torque of each foot at each time and applying to each joint motor of each foot,  optimizing the contact force distribution of each foot.

The invention provides a method for non-confocal non-view field three-dimensional human body posture estimation,  which includes :  step 1,  constructing a human body hidden scene depth map data set; step 2 :  Simulate the interposer simulation photon histogram corresponding to each depth map; step 3. Modeling the human body joint relationship within each frame and the time correlation between frames; step 4. Establish a multi-scale time domain and frequency domain joint analysis framework to output transient characteristics; step 5,  optimize the model training process; step 6,  using a humanoid strategy conditioned on transient features to control the humanoid within the physical simulator and generate a sequence of poses. This method models the complete information flow from non-confocal non-view photon-level transient measurement histograms to advanced cognitive tasks of three-dimensional human posture estimation,  quantitatively and accurately estimates three-dimensional human posture time series,  and can still maintain millimeter-level posture reconstruction accuracy in challenging scenarios with strong noise and data compression 1. A method for non-confocal non-visual field three-dimensional human body posture estimation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  using multi-view depth sensing device to capture human body three-dimensional geometric information,  constructing human body hidden scene depth map data set,  for simulating transient photon data;  step 2,  simulating the middle interface simulation photon histogram corresponding to each depth map according to the middle interface light field distribution model under the non-confocal condition,  for simulating the photon space-time distribution measurement result obtained by the real non-confocal non-visual field imaging system;  step 3,  in the space dimension,  designing a kind of building structure,  in the high-dimensional characteristic space,  adopting the hierarchical position coding strategy,  completely modelling the human body joint relation in each frame and the time correlation between the frames;  step 4,  establishing a multi-scale time domain and frequency domain joint analysis frame,  extracting the frequency spectrum feature of the photon data in parallel through 3D discrete cosine transform operation on different scales,  finally weighting and fusing,  realizing the frequency domain cross-scale feature complementation,  and introducing the improved Non-local non-local module,  capturing the long-distance dependence of the transient photon data in the frequency domain,  realizing the global feature extraction,  finally fusing the time domain and the frequency domain feature through the cross-attention mechanism,  outputting the transient feature;  step 5,  in order to optimize the model training process,  establishing a composite loss function,  comprising attitude precision loss based on joint coordinate error,  combining the discriminant loss and the space-time smooth loss of the classification supervision,  optimizing the model training process and improving the precision and robustness of the human body posture estimation under the non-view scene through the dynamic weighting fusion loss item;  step 6,  controlling the human shape in the physical simulator MuJoCo and generating the gesture sequence by using the human shape strategy taking the transient state characteristic as the condition.

The embodiment of this specification discloses an intelligent identification method and system for UAV pilots. The intelligent identification method includes :  obtaining a video stream including multiple consecutive image frames; identify all corresponding humanoid targets in each image frame; obtaining the number of occurrences of homologous human-shaped targets in different image frames based on all human-shaped targets in all image frames,  and screening out concerned objects; sequentially extracting the skeleton poses corresponding to the object of interest in each image frame in which the object of interest appears to obtain a skeleton pose sequence; obtain the behavior action information of the object of interest based on the skeleton posture sequence; determine whether the object of interest is a drone pilot based on the behavioral action information of the object of interest,  and output the judgment result. By performing image recognition and processing on video sources such as surveillance,  drone pilots can be found with high accuracy,  achieving the effect of intelligent and automated pilot identification in the field of drone supervision. 1. An intelligent identification method of unmanned aerial vehicle flying hand,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a video stream including a continuous plurality of image frames;  identifying all corresponding human-shaped objects in each image frame;  based on all human-shaped objects in all image frames,  obtaining the times that each homologous human-shaped object appears in different image frames,  and screening the concerned object;  orderly extracting the corresponding skeleton gesture of the concerned object in each image frame to obtain the skeleton gesture sequence;  obtaining the action information of the concerned object based on the frame posture sequence;  judging whether it is the unmanned aerial vehicle flying hand based on the action information of the concerned object,  and outputting the judging result.

As digital twins and the metaverse gain prominence,  the importance of remote operation in mixed reality is growing. Despite various studies on intuitive human-robot interaction,  research on remote manipulation in virtual reality/mixed reality is still a challenge that needs to be addressed. In particular,  real-time remote operation using bare hands has the following problems. 1) There are many studies based on controllers,  including portable controllers. 2) Most remote control using hand gestures requires both hands or too many gestures to give commands. This requires training time for workers or increases work fatigue. 3) Despite the powerful hand posture tracking sensor,  Leap Motion (LM) causes the robot's erratic motion due to detection errors caused by covering the fingers in head-mounted mode. To solve the above problems,  the present invention proposes 1) remote operation using only three movements of the hand and wrist rotation without a controller,  2) intuitive remote operation through small movements to reduce the workload of the operator,  and 3) fingertip position. To create mixed reality,  the hand using LM is superimposed on the RGB image and displayed on the headset gear. The present invention is designed to show how a commercial or industrial robot (6-degree-of-freedom robot arm,  2-finger gripper) is used to grasp overlapping objects and settle them at a target position on a wall. You can stack it on top of a desk and grab an object that cannot be picked up to reach the target location on the wall. The present invention can be strongly controlled with a time delay of less than 0.5 seconds. These results are expected to expand beyond mixed reality to extended reality,  contributing to digital twin management.

The invention is notably directed to a computer-implemented method of operating a legged robot. The method repeatedly performs algorithmic cycles at the robot. Each cycle comprises updating a state of the robot as well as heterogeneous representations (321,  322,  323) of an environment of the robot based on signals from a set of sensors. The heterogeneous representations are of different kinds and/or dimensions and,  therefore,  represent different contents or,  at the very least,  represent them in different ways. They include a first representation (321),  such as a spherical ego-centric map,  and a second representation (322),  such as an obstacle map. Next,  the method generates an initial trajectory that avoids obstacles in the first representation. The initial trajectory is generated through a first model (2061) based on the first representation (321) and the robot's state as updated last,  where the first model is a computational model that has been trained in reinforcement learning. The method subsequently executes a second model (2062) based on the initial trajectory,  as well as the state of the robot and the second representation as updated last,  to obtain a collision-free trajectory. A third representation (323),  such as an elevation map,  may be used by a low-level policy (208) to generate low-level commands. The robot is eventually controlled according to the low-level commands generated to cause a legged locomotion of the robot. The invention is further directed to related systems and computer program products.

This application provides a jump control method,  device and storage medium for a single-legged robot,  and relates to the field of robot technology. The method comprises :  if it is detected that the state of the single-legged robot is switched from a jumping state to a landing state,  controlling the trunk of the single-legged robot to perform deceleration motion according to a preset deceleration algorithm; if it is determined that the speed of the trunk of the single-legged robot is zero,  control the knee joint of the single-legged robot to maintain at the current position,  and obtain the position of the trunk and knee joint of the single-legged robot respectively; according to the position of the trunk and the position of the knee joint in the single-legged robot,  compensate the position of the landing foot of a single-legged robot According to the invention,  the landing control of the single-legged robot can be realized without planning a jump track in advance,  so that the control process of the single-legged robot can be simplified; and the method has the characteristics of simple control method and high control efficiency 1. A jumping control method of single-leg robot,  wherein it comprises :  if the state of the single-leg robot is switched from the jumping state to the landing state,  controlling the trunk of the single-leg robot to perform the deceleration movement according to the preset deceleration algorithm;  if the speed of the trunk in the single-leg robot is determined to be zero,  controlling the knee joint of the single-leg robot to be kept at the current position,  and respectively obtaining the position of the trunk in the single-leg robot and the position of the knee joint;  according to the position of the trunk and the position of the knee joint in the single-leg robot,  performing position compensation on the landing foot of the single-leg robot,  so that the straight line determined based on the sole central point and the trunk central point of the single-leg robot is vertical to the landing ground;  according to the position of the trunk and knee joint in the single-leg robot,  performing position compensation on the landing foot of the single-leg robot,  comprising :  according to the position of the trunk and the position of the knee joint in the single-leg robot,  performing position compensation on the hip joint position and/or ankle joint position of the landing foot.

An unmanned vehicle decision method,  wherein it comprises :  detecting the obstacle in the running direction of the unmanned vehicle;  under the condition of detecting the key obstacle,  identifying the type of the key obstacle;  wherein the key obstacles include obstacles that may interact with the unmanned vehicle;  generating a sampling path in a preset area range in the driving direction of the unmanned vehicle,  and performing collision detection on the sampling path based on a key obstacle of a first preset type,  selecting a first sampling path,  comprising :  generating a sampling point in the pre-set area range in the running direction of the unmanned vehicle,  and performing a first collision detection on the sampling point based on a key obstacle of a first pre-set type,  and selecting a first sampling point;  generating multiple sampling paths based on the first sampling point,  performing a second collision detection on the multiple sampling paths based on a key obstacle of a first preset type,  and screening the first sampling path;  according to the first dynamic intention of the key obstacle of the second preset type,  and the second dynamic intention of the unmanned vehicle when driving in the first sampling path,  determining the interaction intention of the unmanned vehicle and the key obstacle of the second preset type;  evaluating the interactive intention,  and generating the driving strategy of the unmanned vehicle according to the evaluation result.

ABSTRACT System and Method for Establishing Robot-Inclusive Environments The invention relates to systems and methods for establishing robot-inclusive built environments. Rather than designing robots to adapt to human-centric facilities,  the invention provides environmental modifications that allow robots to navigate and operate efficiently in schools,  hospitals,  offices,  and similar public or private spaces. The system includes :  (i) a retrofit kit enabling existing elevators,  doors,  and access points to be robot-accessible through standardized interfaces;  (ii) navigation assistance infrastructure employing fiducial patterns or coded markers to provide low-cost localization and pathfinding;  (iii) a scheduling controller to coordinate multiple robots’ use of shared resources such as lifts and corridors;  and (iv) safety modules implementing proximity-based speed adjustment,  emergency stop mechanisms,  and corridor zone definitions for safe human-robot coexistence. The invention reduces the cost and complexity of robotic platforms,  supports scalable deployment,  and ensures effective human-robot collaboration in both new and retrofitted facilities.

The invention discloses a layered gait planning method for a foot-type robot in a complex environment,  which is divided into outer-layer planning and inner-layer planning. The outer-layer planning determines the stepping direction of each leg,  and the inner-layer planning determines the foot end movement trajectory according to the stepping direction. At the same time,  the inner and outer planning consists of two parts :  empirical planning and learning planning. Empirical planning plans corresponding actions according to the system model,  and learning planning uses reinforcement learning methods to make plans. Weighted fusion of empirical planning and learning planning results as the final planning result. Fusion weights gradually shift toward learning planning with the training of reinforcement learning. The outer empirical planning uses the ZMP method to increase the stability margin by changing the position of the supporting legs. The inner layer planning uses the cycloid as the foot end motion trajectory,  and determines the parameters of the elliptical trajectory according to the ZMP stability margin and the motion direction. 1. A hierarchical gait planning method of foot-type robot in complex environment,  wherein the random gait facing to the complex terrain does not pre-set the leg-stepping sequence of each leg,  but independently determines the leg-stepping direction of the next step of each leg according to the robot state and the environment state;  the whole gait planning adopts the layered planning mode,  the outer layer planning is used for determining the direction of the leg,  the inner layer planning is used for generating the foot end movement track;  the outer layer planning and the inner layer planning are composed of an experience planning and a learning planning,  and then they are combined;  after initializing the robot,  observing the state,  and determining whether to plan the outer layer according to the observing result;  The outer layer planning is performed only when there is a swinging leg entering the supporting phase,  specifically comprising the following steps :  step one :  obtaining the robot and the environment state by the sensor,  judging whether the touchdown state of the foot end is changed,  if the touchdown state of the foot end is changed or the four legs of the robot are in touchdown state,  jumping to the step two,  or jumping to the step three;  step two :  according to the obtained environment state and the robot state,  planning the outer layer,  selecting the foot end needing to change the position and planning the leg direction,  specifically as follows;  2-1) according to the motion command and the current state,  determining the leg and the leg direction of the foot end position to be changed,  so that the center of the supporting polygon moves towards the motion direction of the robot;  2-2) according to the current state,  through discrete strengthening learning algorithm,  determining the leg direction of each leg;  2-3) the front two step determining the leg direction,  proceed fusion,  determining final each leg of the leg direction;  then jump to step three;  step three :  according to the change condition of the touchdown state of the foot end and the outer layer planning result,  performing the inner layer planning,  generating the motion track of the foot end,  the specific steps are as follows :  3-1) determining the foot end track according to the leg direction of each leg planned by the outer layer and the current position of the foot end;  if the foot end is in the touchdown state currently and does not need to be lifted up,  the foot end track parameter is planned,  if the foot end is in the swinging state,  the current track is continuously executed;  3-2) through continuous strengthening learning algorithm,  determining the position of the next time point of the foot end;  3-3) adopting progressive fusion strategy to fuse the foot end position determined in the first two steps,  determining the final foot end position;  step four :  according to the planed foot end motion track,  adopting the inverse kinematics method to determine the joint motion track,  and finishing the action through the executing mechanism;  step five :  and updating the fusion coefficient of the experience planning and learning planning of the inner and outer layer planning.

A biped humanoid robot stepping time control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  using the equivalent step-reducing model to simulate the movement of the double-foot humanoid robot,  establishing the equivalent step-reducing model based on the foot end Cartesian coordinate system;  calculating the actual position of the mass centre relative to the landing foot and the actual system angular momentum according to the current state of the system;  based on the motion path of the robot,  obtaining the expected forward speed and the expected lateral speed at the current moment,  and calculating the expected angular momentum according to the equivalent descending model;  solving the residual stepping time according to the actual angular momentum and the expected angular momentum numerical value;  determining the final stepping time according to the system stepping time constraint,  analyzing and calculating the final stepping point position according to the final stepping time.

This application provides an anti-fall control method and device for a quadruped robot in a tunnel scene. This method is based on point cloud depth data obtained by lidar,  and then inputs the first motion strategy model trained using the DQN algorithm and the second motion strategy model including the SLAM positioning and navigation module to obtain the quadruped robot's travel strategy. It solves the problem in the existing technology that in the power cable tunnel scene,  the quadruped robot cannot work after falling due to tunnels and high platforms. 1. An anti-falling control method of four-foot robot in tunnel scene,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the point cloud data with the four-foot robot as the centre through the laser radar to obtain the point cloud depth data;  inputting the point cloud depth data into a first motion strategy model,  obtaining a first travelling strategy,  the first travelling strategy at least comprises the travelling angular speed and the travelling linear speed of the four-foot robot,  the first motion strategy model is a model based on DQN algorithm training and based on the four-foot robot surrounding environment generating travelling mode;  inputting the point cloud depth data into a second motion strategy model to obtain a second travelling strategy,  wherein the second travelling strategy at least comprises the travelling angular speed and the travelling linear speed of the four-foot robot,  and the second motion strategy model comprises a SLAM positioning module and a navigation module;  performing weighted average operation based on the first travelling strategy and the second travelling strategy to obtain a target control strategy,  controlling the movement of the four-foot robot according to the target control strategy;  Before inputting the point cloud depth data into the first motion strategy model,  the method comprises :  obtaining the tunnel width,  the tunnel width and the distance between the four-foot robot and the tunnel wall at one side of the tunnel,  obtaining a first target distance,  a second target distance and a third target distance,  obtaining the initial position of the four-foot robot,  obtaining a first position,  obtaining the end position of the four-foot robot,  obtaining a second position;  inputting the point cloud depth data into a first motion strategy model to obtain a first travel strategy,  comprising :  updating the first target distance,  the second target distance and the third target distance based on the point cloud depth data;  determining the first position and the second position based on the point cloud depth data;  determining the first target distance,  the second target distance,  the third target distance,  the first position and the second position as the current state;  randomly generating the travelling angular speed and the travelling linear speed of the four-foot robot based on the current state to obtain multiple alternative travelling strategies;  determining the corresponding prediction state based on the current state and each candidate travelling strategy,  and determining the state reward corresponding to the prediction state,  obtaining the candidate strategy score;  determining the candidate travelling strategy corresponding to the candidate strategy score maximum value as the first travelling strategy;  inputting the point cloud depth data into a second motion strategy model,  to obtain a second travel strategy,  comprising :  inputting the point cloud depth data into the SLAM positioning module to obtain the current position of the four-foot robot and a target map constructed based on the point cloud depth data;  inputting the current position and the target map into the navigation module for predicting the travelling angular speed and the travelling linear speed of the four-foot robot within the preset time length to obtain the second travelling strategy.

The invention belongs to the field of robot control technology and discloses a robust walking control method and system for a high gear ratio humanoid robot based on latent dynamics adaptation,  including :  designing a control strategy training framework based on deep reinforcement learning and adopting an Actor-Critic structure and PPO algorithm for optimization; construct a latent dynamics adaptive network LDAN,  and extract environment and ontology dynamics parameters through variational autoencoders; design multi-dimensional reward functions; constructing a periodic gait library using von Mises distribution and motion capture data; gradually introduce terrain disturbances and dynamic changes through course-based simulation training; the training strategy and LDAN module are deployed on the humanoid robot driven by the high gear ratio. The invention solves the problems of poor movement stability,  weak adaptability and insufficient action expression of the high gear ratio humanoid robot in changeable environments,  and has the advantages of strong robustness,  high natural expression and strong migration ability. 1. A robust walking control method of high gear ratio humanoid robot based on potential dynamic self-adaptation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  The deep reinforcement learning training framework of the design control strategy :  constructing a control strategy based on deep reinforcement learning,  using Actor-Critic structure,  and using near-end strategy to optimize PPO algorithm for training optimization;  step 2 :  Potential Dynamic Adaptive Network (LDAN) design :  constructing a coder-decoder network of variable self-coder VAE structure,  inputting robot observation history data,  outputting a group of potential vectors,  representing environment and main body dynamics parameter,  the potential vector is used as additional input of control strategy,  realizing implicit dynamics compensation;  step 3 :  Reward function design :  constructing a multi-dimensional reward function,  ensuring that the strategy has good expressiveness at the same time of stability;  step 4 :  periodical gait library construction :  using the von Mises distribution to construct the periodic guide signal,  combining the motion capture data to generate the natural upper limb action,  using the inverse kinematics resolver to synchronously generate the foot end track,  finally generating the whole body gait as the reference,  guiding strategy learning;  step 5 :  Curriculum simulation training :  gradually introducing terrain disturbance and dynamics parameter change in the simulation platform,  improving strategy generalizing ability;  after finishing training,  the strategy and LDAN module are directly arranged in the real robot system;  step 6 :  Deployment of hardware :  It is suitable for the humanoid robot driven by the high gear ratio,  the control frequency is 30Hz,  real-time reasoning the potential vector of the LDAN module,  for dynamically adjusting the control strategy.

Therefore,  this technical solution makes the three-dimensional force field detection accuracy of the humanoid robot foot higher and the data in dynamic motion more complete. 1. A method for detecting foot force information of human-shaped robot foot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the foot arch ligament layer of the foot part of the human-shaped robot is embedded with a strain sensing yarn,  and the sole of the foot part of the human-shaped robot is arranged with a six-dimensional force sensor and a flexible piezoresistive film to construct a multi-mode sensing system;  dynamically adjusting the sampling frequency according to the motion state of the human-shaped robot,  and filtering and pre-processing the collected sensor data;  based on the data collected by the sensor,  establishing a biomechanics conduction graph model,  and calculating the full-foot three-dimensional force field distribution through the graph convolution network;  matching the real-time force field data with the pre-stored mechanical fingerprint base,  predicting the future stress state and generating the control parameter,  realizing the movement stability control.

The invention relates to a non-rhythmic gait balance compensation method of a foot-type robot,  belongs to the technical field of foot-type robots,  and solves the problem that the rhythmic gait of the existing foot-type robot is easy to lose stability or even fall when facing unexpected obstacles or requiring rapid steering. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the state information of the foot type robot at the current moment; based on the status information at the current moment,  the step length,  step frequency and zero moment point position of the legged robot are obtained; based on the foot end position of each support leg of the foot robot at the current moment,  the center position of the support polygon of the foot robot at the current moment is obtained; based on the step length and step frequency of the foot robot and the center position of the supporting polygon at the current moment,  the expected zero moment point position at the current moment is obtained; adjust the torso joint angle of the legged robot based on the expected zero moment point position and zero moment point position at the current moment. Improved the ability of legged robots to maintain dynamic balance in complex environments and emergencies. 1. A non-rhythmic gait balance compensation method of foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the state information of the foot-type robot at the current moment;  wherein the state information comprises the machine body position of the foot-type robot,  the foot end position,  speed,  acceleration,  angular speed and yaw angle of each supporting leg;  based on the state information of the current time,  obtaining the step length,  step frequency and zero moment point position of the foot-type robot at the current time;  based on the foot end position of each supporting leg of the foot-type robot at the current moment,  obtaining the central position of the supporting polygon of the foot-type robot at the current moment;  based on the step length and step frequency of the foot-type robot at the current moment and the central position of the supporting polygon,  obtaining the expected zero moment point position at the current moment;  and adjusting the trunk joint angle of the foot robot based on the expected zero moment point position and the zero moment point position at the current moment.

The present application relates to a multi-legged robot,  and relates to the field of robot technology. When the multi-legged robot is turned on,  the current output by the power supply module is used to supply power to at least one drive motor and at least one encoder in the mechanical leg; when the multi-legged robot is in a power-off state,  the current output by the power supply module is used to power at least one encoder in the mechanical leg. In this way,  the power supply module is installed on the robot body,  and the power supply module is used to supply power to the drive motor and encoder in the power-on state,  and to supply power to the encoder in the power-off state,  which reduces the number of backup batteries required in the multi-legged robot. The number of backup batteries can reduce the production cost of the multi-legged robot; moreover,  the power supply module is installed in the robot body to prevent the power supply module from being affected by the heat generated by the drive motor,  avoid damage to the power supply module,  extend the service life,  and also facilitate the compact structural design of the mechanical leg. 1. A multi-foot robot,  comprising a robot body and a plurality of mechanical legs movably connected with the robot body;  each mechanical leg is provided with at least two driving motors and at least two encoders;  each driving motor is correspondingly and electrically connected with at least one encoder;  the robot body is provided with a power supply module;  when the multi-foot robot is in the starting state,  the current output by the power supply module is used for supplying power to at least one driving motor and at least one coder in the mechanical leg;  when the multi-foot robot is in power-off state,  the current output by the power supply module is used for supplying power to at least one encoder in the mechanical leg.

The invention relates to a foot robot cluster collaborative control method integrating ground force perception,  belongs to the technical field of robot decision and control,  and solves the problems of poor adaptability,  unstable dynamic motion control and weak multi-robot cluster collaborative ability of the existing foot robot control method in complex terrains The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring state information and environment sensing information of each foot type robot and constructing a state space of each foot type robot; based on the state space,  using the trained foot robot control model to generate motion control instructions for each foot robot at the next moment to control the movement of each foot robot; among them,  the legged robot control model is a trained actor network; when training the actor network,  the critic network is used to evaluate the action of the legged robots in the cluster by using the global state space constructed by aggregating the state spaces of all legged robots in the cluster and the action strategies of all legged robots in the cluster as input. Joint value 1. A foot-type robot cluster cooperative control method combined with ground acting force sensing,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the state information and environment sensing information of each foot type robot at the current time;  the state information comprises position information,  speed information and foot pressure information of each foot;  constructing a state space of each foot robot based on the state information and the environment sensing information;  based on the state space of each foot-type robot,  using the trained each foot-type robot control model,  generating the motion control instruction of each foot-type robot at the next time to control the motion of each foot-type robot;  wherein the foot-type robot control model is trained actor network;  the actor network takes the state space of each foot type robot as the input and outputs the corresponding action strategy;  when training the actor network,  the commentator network is used for taking the global state space constructed by the state space of all foot-type robots in the aggregation cluster and the action strategy of all foot-type robots in the cluster as the input to evaluate the combined value of the action of the foot-type robot in the cluster.

The invention provides a system and a method for automatically tracking a human figure on a camera picture,  wherein the technical realization of the method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  obtaining a tracking target by utilizing NPU processing through software and hardware matching; and then,  cutting,  zooming and reprocessing the camera picture through fcrop and mscaler modules in a chip,  so as to realize the tracking and zooming of the human figure on the camera picture The invention solves the problems that in the prior art,  a motor is required to be matched to control a camera to track a human shape,  and an optical zoom lens is required to be matched to realize the zooming of the image of the camera; solve in the prior art through the motor control camera will cause the camera jitter and jamming,  and the optical zoom lens in the zoom process will cause the picture blurred,  overall customer perception experience is poor; solve the problem in the prior art that when the camera physically tracks the target,  when the direction deviates,  it will cause the personnel on the other side to stay on the edge or not enter,  and the meeting communication effect is poor. 1. A system for automatically tracking human shape by camera picture,  wherein the system comprises :  an image sensor Sensor for obtaining the original image and transmitting the original image to the SoC chip;  an output display module for displaying the tracking target image output by the SoC chip;  The SoC chip further comprises :  an image signal processing unit ISP in the chip;  a neural network processor NPUin the chip;  an image pre-cutting fcrop and an image zooming cutting mscaler module in the chip;  the software logic module in the chip is in charge of controlling the realizing flow of the whole function,  comprising the following steps :  giving the image output by the ISP to the NPU for algorithm processing,  controlling the ISP to zoom and cut the picture after obtaining the human face information,  so as to track the human-shaped area;  wherein the ISP receives the data of the original image transmitted by the Sensor;  the original image data is divided into two paths,  one path of the original image data is distributed to the NPU to obtain the human shape information,  the human shape information is sent to the software logic module to obtain the zooming/cutting attribute of the target picture,  and sent to the mscaler and fcrop module;  the other path of original image data is distributed to the mscaler and fcrop module,  combining the obtained attribute to obtain the tracking target image.
