 a mechanical arm arranged on the movable base;  a sensing device arranged on the movable base and used for detecting the tea fermentation environment in the fermentation material box and the filling degree of the material box;  a spraying device arranged on the mechanical arm for generating spray;  a control system,  in which at least one kind of fermentation process information comprising at least two process flows and one fermentation time axis state information are set,  based on the detection result of the sensing device,  judging the process flow of the tea in the fermentation material box or the fermentation material box,  controlling the movable base,  the material box translation mechanism,  the lifting mechanism,  the mechanical arm and the spraying device make the tea in the fermentation material box or the fermentation material box gradually execute the fermentation process based on the process flow,  monitoring whether the tea fermentation satisfies the fermentation time shaft state; The invention discloses a fiber-type acceleration sensor based on a gradient spiral structure and its application,  including a packaging layer,  a spiral body,  a lead and a dielectric layer; the encapsulation layer is located on the outermost side of the fiber acceleration sensor,  and both sides of the encapsulation layer are closed and connected to the two endpoints of the spiral body respectively; the spiral main body includes a matrix skeleton,  an electrode layer,  and an insulating layer; one end of the lead is connected to the electrode layer at the end of the spiral body,  and the other end passes through the packaging layer and is exposed to the outside of the fiber acceleration sensor; the dielectric layer fills the remaining space within the fiber acceleration sensor The sensor provided by the invention can generate capacitance changes under acceleration and is not interfered by axial tension and normal pressure,  thereby realizing highly reliable acceleration detection; by weaving the sensor of the present invention,  a wearable acceleration sensing fabric can be further obtained. The sensor of the present invention is also suitable for human-computer interaction,  humanoid robots,  intelligent prosthetics and other application scenarios. 1. A fibre type acceleration sensor based on gradient spiral structure,  wherein it comprises a packaging layer (1),  a spiral main body (2),  a lead (3) and a dielectric layer (4);  the packaging layer (1) is located at the outermost side of the fibre type acceleration sensor,  two sides of the packaging layer (1) are closed,  and respectively connected with two end points of the spiral main body (2);  the spiral main body (2) comprises a base frame (21),  an electrode layer (22) and an insulating layer (23);  the spiral main body (2) is divided into a compact area,  a small thread pitch area and a large thread pitch area according to the different thread pitches;  one end of the lead (3) is connected with the electrode layer (22) at the end point of the spiral main body (2),  and the other end passes through the packaging layer (1) and is exposed at the outer side of the fibre type acceleration sensor;  the dielectric layer (4) fills the residual space in the fibre type acceleration sensor.

This application provides a motion control method,  device,  equipment and computer-readable storage medium for a legged robot; the foot type robot comprises at least two foot ends. The method comprises the following steps of :  when all the foot ends of the foot type robot stand in the same initial unit area and are gathered in the initial unit area,  receiving a jumping instruction for the foot type robot; the jump instruction is used to instruct the legged robot to jump from the initial unit area where it is currently located to the independent target unit area. There is a one-to-one correspondence between the foot end and the target unit area; the distance between any two foot ends when the foot robot is in the target unit area is greater than the distance between the corresponding two foot ends when the foot robot is in the initial unit area; in response to the jump command,  the legged robot is controlled to jump to each target unit area Through this application,  the dynamics,  difficulty and ornamental value of the foot robot movement can be improved,  and the diversity of the foot robot movement can be expanded. 1. A motion control method of foot-type robot,  wherein the foot-type robot comprises at least two foot ends,  the method comprises :  when each foot end of the foot-type robot stands in the same initial unit area,  and each foot end is folded in the initial unit area,  receiving the jumping instruction aiming at the foot-type robot;  wherein the jumping instruction is used for indicating the foot-type robot to jump from the current initial unit area to the independent target unit area,  the foot end and the target unit area have one-to-one correspondence relationship,  the unit area and the target unit area are the end face area of the single pile in the plum blossom pile,  the shape and size of the unit area and the target unit area are the same;  the distance between any two foot ends when the foot-type robot is located in the target unit area is greater than the distance between the corresponding two foot ends when the foot-type robot is located in the initial unit area;  in response to the jump instruction,  controlling the foot robot to jump to each of the target unit areas,  comprising :  predicting the jumping track of the foot-type robot to obtain a reference jumping track;  obtaining the constraint condition corresponding to the jumping instruction,  the constraint condition is used for constraint the jumping of the foot-type robot;  determining state parameters of at least two key points of the reference jumping track based on the reference jumping track and the constraint condition;  in response to the jump instruction,  based on the state parameter of each key point,  controlling the foot robot to jump to each target unit area;  or,  when the target unit area is located in front of the foot-type robot,  in response to the jump instruction,  controlling the foot-type robot to jump forward to each of the target unit areas through a jump stage,  an empty stage and a landing stage;  wherein,  in the jumping stage,  the foot-type robot orderly executes the operation of foot end stepping ground,  front foot end ground;  in the vacating phase,  the foot-type robot performs a hindfoot-end-to-ground operation;  in the landing stage,  the foot-type robot orderly performs foot end landing,  leg bending buffer and body balance operation;  in the process of the foot type robot stepping on the ground,  the foot type robot reduces the joint angle of the back leg knee joint,  and increases the joint angle of the front leg knee joint,  so that the back thigh and the trunk are in the same straight line,  the trunk is raised by the target pitching angle,  the mass centre moves forwards and upwards;  in the process of the foot-type robot performing the front foot end from the ground,  the foot-type robot reduces the joint angle of the front leg knee joint of the foot-type robot to the first target angle,  and increases the joint angle of the back leg knee joint to the second target angle,  so as to increase the height of each knee joint and the height of the centre of mass;  wherein the height of the front leg knee joint is higher than the height of the centre of mass,  the height of the rear leg knee joint is lower than the height of the centre of mass;  the first target angle is used for representing the angle of the front leg knee joint when the front thigh of the foot type robot and the trunk are on the same straight line;  the second target angle is used for representing the angle of the rear leg knee joint when the rear leg of the foot-type robot is vertical to the contact surface and the rear thigh is in straight line with the trunk;  or,  when the initial unit area is located at the centre of each target unit area,  in response to the jump instruction,  controlling the foot robot to jump upwards to land on each target unit area through the jump stage,  the vacation stage and the landing stage;  in the jumping stage,  the foot-type robot orderly executes the operation of squatting and storing force and starting to empty;  in the vacating stage,  the foot-type robot performs an operation of extending the foot in the air;  in the landing stage,  the foot-type robot orderly performs foot end landing,  leg bending buffer and body balance operation;  in the process of the foot-type robot performing the squat force storage,  the leg part of the foot-type robot is bent,  so as to reduce the mass centre of the foot-type robot from the initial height to the jumping height;  in the process that the foot-type robot starts to vacate,  the foot-type robot bounces upwards to increase the height of the knee joint and the height of the centroid,  the height of the centroid is higher than the initial height;  in the process of the foot-type robot extending the foot in the air,  each leg part of the foot-type robot drives the corresponding foot end to extend outwards and downwards to the lower part of the corresponding hip joint;  when the foot-type robot comprises a tail part,  after the foot-type robot is controlled to jump to each of the target unit areas,  the foot-type robot is controlled to continuously perform at least one of the following operations within the target unit area based on at least one degree of freedom :  head-shaking action,  tail-shaking action;  wherein the degree of freedom comprises at least one of rolling and pitching.

The invention discloses a step terrain walking method of a humanoid robot based on a whole body dynamics model Including :  designing nonlinear model predictive control problems for humanoid robot walking,  among them,  the system state,  input and reference trajectory of the foot end are reasonably planned,  the equality constraints and inequality constraints necessary for the robot to walk are designed,  and the constraint that the robot's foothold needs to fall in the foothold area is regarded as one of the inequality constraints,  so that the humanoid robot can walk on the stepped terrain; finally,  the nonlinear model predictive control problem is solved in real time by using the solver,  and the joint torque of the robot is issued according to the inverse dynamic equation of the whole body dynamics model and the PD combined with the feedforward controller,  so that the robot control effect is better and the walking is more stable 1. A step terrain walking method of humanoid robot based on systemic dynamics model,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  drawing a gray scale image for representing the step terrain,  processing the gray scale image to generate a grid map,  then generating a convex plane,  a directed distance field and a terrain in the simulation software by the grid map;  wherein the convex plane generated by the grid map is used as the set of the foot-falling area;  S2,  designing robot system state,  system input,  system dynamic equation and jump function according to the whole body dynamics model;  S21,  designing the state quantity in the nonlinear model predictive control according to the systemic dynamics model :  using the Euler-Lagrange method to represent the dynamic equation of the humanoid robot so as to determine the system state x composed of six items of mass centre position,  mass centre Euler angle,  joint angle,  mass centre line speed,  mass centre Euler angle change rate and joint speed;  S22,  deducing the system dynamic equation according to the system state quantity and the whole body dynamics model,  dividing the whole body dynamics equation into under-actuated and full-actuated two parts,  so as to obtain the body acceleration;  the selection system input u is composed of joint acceleration and end contact force-moment;  S23,  deducing the jump function according to the system state quantity and the systemic dynamics model :  combining the dynamic equation when the system state is suddenly changed and supposing the position quantity is not suddenly changed,  solving the jumping function of the speed quantity by using the Schuler compensation method;  S3,  according to the information of the foot-falling area obtained in the step S1 and the system dynamic equation and jumping function obtained in the step S2,  designing and solving the nonlinear model prediction control problem facing the step terrain walking of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the system expected state and the input track;  S4,  based on the result calculated in the step S3,  calculating the robot joint moment according to the whole body dynamics model,  and using PD combined with the feedforward controller to send the moment to the robot joint,  realizing the control effect.

The invention relates to a complex terrain adaptive gait planning method for a biped robot and the biped robot,  and belongs to the field of robot technology. The method includes the steps of :  constructing a fractional-order PID controller,  which includes a multi-sensor network module,  an adaptive module and a fractional-order calculus control module; construct a reinforcement learning model for gait planning of bipedal robot,  set the state,  action,  decision-making and reinforcement learning reward function of reinforcement learning,  and use the strategy gradient method to continuously iterate and optimize the reinforcement learning model,  update the strategy parameters,  and output the control parameters of bipedal robot; the control parameters output by the fractional-order PID controller and the reinforcement learning model are decision-made and fused through the comprehensive loss function to obtain the globally optimal control parameters of the bipedal robot. The invention can provide more accurate gait planning for biped robots in complex terrain and achieve better walking flexibility and adaptability. 1. A double-foot robot complex terrain self-adaptive gait planning method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  constructing a fractional order PID controller,  the fractional order PID controller comprises a multi-sensor network module,  an adaptive module and a fractional order micro-integral control module,  the multi-sensor network module performs fusion and coding compression on the external environment data collected by a plurality of sensor nodes on the biped robot,  generating an external vector and transmitting into the adaptive module,  the self-adaptive module online estimates the current external vector according to the historical state sequence and the historical action sequence sensed from the main body,  outputs the corresponding control component,  the fractional order micro-integral control module performs fine adjustment on the control component obtained by the self-adaptive module,  finally outputting the control parameter of the biped robot;  step S2 :  constructing a reinforced learning model for biped robot gait planning,  setting the state and action of reinforced learning,  determining and strengthening the learning reward function,  and using the strategy gradient method to perform continuous iteration and optimization adjustment on the strengthening learning model,  updating the strategy parameter,  outputting the control parameter of the biped robot,  the expression of the strengthening learning reward function is as follows :  = Rstability + Renergy + Rspeed + Rgovernment + Rfall (18),  wherein Rstability is the walking stability reward function,  Renergy is the energy efficiency reward function,  Rspeed is the walking speed reward function,  Rsmos is the gait smooth reward function,  Rfall is the falling penalty function;  step S3 :  performing weighted fusion on the fractional-order PID controller and the biped robot control parameter output by the enhanced learning model,  the control signal after fusion is :  u (t) = β 1-ufraction (t) + β 2-uRL (t) (22) wherein,  ufraction (t) is the control parameter output by the fractional order PID controller,  uRL (t) is the control parameter output by the enhanced learning model,  beta1 and beta2 are weight parameters;  setting a comprehensive loss function L,  performing decision fusion on the control parameter output by the fractional order PID controller and the enhanced learning model through the comprehensive loss function,  obtaining the global optimal biped robot control parameter,  the expression of the comprehensive loss function L is as follows :  L = [alpha] 1-ufraction (t) + [alpha] 2-ufraction (t) + [alpha] 3-u (t) (23) where [alpha] 1,  [alpha] 2 and [alpha] 3 are weight coefficients.

A humanoid robot remote control method based on wireless communication,  wherein it comprises :  receiving a remote control instruction of an operator,  performing semantic analysis on the remote control instruction to generate control intention data,  establishing a bidirectional expected calibration channel based on the control intention data,  and generating an expected consistency parameter and a deviation tolerance threshold based on the bidirectional expected calibration channel;  obtaining a desired execution result based on the desired consistency parameter,  inversely deducing an optimal control sequence according to the desired execution result,  performing negative space analysis on the optimal control sequence to identify a set of prohibited execution actions;  combining the optimal control sequence and the inhibition execution action set to construct a paradox verification scene,  performing a paradox conflict test through the paradox verification scene to generate a control boundary parameter;  establishing an interlocking verification condition based on the control boundary parameter and the deviation tolerance threshold,  and generating a safety unlocking sequence based on the interlocking verification condition; ABSTRACT A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTEXTUAL DECISION-MAKING USING MULTI-LAYERED INTELLIGENCE IN AUTONOMOUS AND SEMI-AUTONOMOUS SYSTEMS The present invention relates to a system and method for integrating multi-layered intelligence decision making engines with contextual analytics for autonomous or semi-autonomous systems. It comprises a physical unit with sensors,  actuators,  controllers,  and dependents,  along with an intelligence unit having inherent (existential,  emotional,  creative) and acquired (pre-fed,  learned) intelligence layers. A relevance engine processes sensor data,  evaluates safety metrics,  determines stakeholder roles,  and selects real-time actions or deliberate inactions based on intelligence layers. Decisions are securely logged in a tamper-resistant blockchain for auditability. The system dynamically prioritizes existential safety,  stakeholder sensitivity,  and predictive optimization,  adapting operational parameters through reinforcement learning,  ensuring responsive,  ethical,  and contextually appropriate interactions.

This invention relates to Greet Robo,  an intelligent humanoid robot designed for autonomous movement,  human interaction,  and contextual information delivery in public-facing environments such as educational institutions,  reception areas,  and administrative facilities. The robot operates on a mobile wheeled platform managed by an Arduino microcontroller for navigation. At the same time,  a Jetson Nano processor handles real-time human detection,  chatbot-driven dialogue,  and expression display through a front-mounted LED panel. The system integrates wireless Bluetooth communication between control and processing modules,  enabling seamless coordination of locomotion and interaction subsystems. Upon detecting a nearby person,  the robot initiates a greeting sequence,  engages the user in verbal interaction,  and responds to queries regarding the specific environment—such as campus layout,  course schedules,  or administrative procedures. Expressive facial animations enhance engagement by simulating human-like emotions. The architecture is modular,  scalable,  and adaptable for multiple domains. Stakeholders benefiting from the invention include institutional administrators who reduce staff load through automation;  end users such as students and visitors who receive quick and reliable assistance;  developers who can update chatbot logic for new contexts;  hardware engineers responsible for system maintenance;  and data analysts who can study user interaction patterns to improve service quality further.

The invention presents a Smart Robotic Arm that integrates real-time image recognition and adaptive control algorithms to replicate human arm movements with high precision. Key innovations include low-latency motion tracking,  sensor fusion for adaptive feedback,  and AI-powered speech recognition for gesture activation. The system ensures seamless human-robot collaboration by processing visual data locally,  reducing dependency on centralized systems,  and enabling real-time responsiveness.

Techniques for the use of verbal commands in human-robot communication. The number of tasks the robot can perform is limited to a specific set,  while providing syntactic flexibility to users. The present invention proposes a predictive control method and system for a state feedback model for legged robots,  which belongs to the field of robot control technology;  Firstly,  the closed-loop state observer is used to dynamically track the disturbance information in the single rigid body dynamics model of the legged robot. The present invention discloses a gait control method and system for humanoid robots based on imitation and inverse reinforcement learning,  collects the walking data of human or simulated robots to construct a high-quality training dataset,  and then calculates the similarity between robot and expert data through graph convolutional structure. Based on the task objective,  a multi-dimensional linear reward function is designed,  and four indicators of stability,  gait periodicity,  trajectory similarity and energy efficiency are synthesized,  and multi-objective optimization is realized through weight allocation. The neural network is used to construct the policy model,  combined with the proximal strategy optimization algorithm for training,  and the strategy ratio clipping technology is used to constrain the update amplitude to improve the learning stability. At the same time,  the maximum entropy principle is introduced to dynamically update the reward function to enhance the adaptability to expert strategies. Finally,  the MuJoCo physics engine is used to verify the visual analysis and performance evaluation of high-imitation human gait. The present invention solves the problem of insufficient adaptability and robustness of robot gait in complex dynamic environments. 1. A humanoid robot gait control method based on simulation and inverse reinforcement learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  collecting the walking node and the inertia data of the human and simulated humanoid robot and pre-processing them,  wherein the node represents the body part or joint of the robot;  S2,  representing the joint data of the robot and the joint data of the person as the graph structure,  in the graph structure,  each node represents the body part or joint of the robot or the person,  the side represents the connection relation between the joints;  calculating the gait simulation similarity through the graph convolution network;  at the same time,  calculating the stability,  gait periodicity and energy efficiency of the robot;  wherein the step of calculating the gait simulation similarity comprises :  S2-1,  representing the joint data of the robot and the joint data of the human as the graph structure;  S2-2,  collecting the IMU to the sensor time sequence data,  cutting according to the time segment,  and splicing according to the human acceleration data G human,  robot acceleration data G machine,  human gyroscope data A human,  robot gyroscope data A machine;  S2-3,  inputting the image structure in S2-1 into the convolution layer,  and outputting the feature vector;  S2-4,  the feature vector is input into the controller model;  S2-5,  the S2-2 splicing data input LSTM;  S2-6,  splicing the output of the B model and the LSTM model,  and then inputting the whole connecting layer to obtain the splicing characteristic vector;  S2-7,  performing regression on the splicing feature vector,  obtaining the similarity of the robot and the human gait data;  S3,  designing a reward function including walking stability,  gait periodicity,  simulation similarity and energy efficiency,  wherein the reward function is a linear reward function;  S4,  using the neural network as the strategy model,  inputting the robot state,  outputting the gait control action;  S5,  initializing the reward function;  S6,  using the PPO algorithm to train the strategy model,  combining the cut probability ratio with the strategy loss,  the value function loss and the entropy regular term to construct the optimized target,  calculating the optimized target gradient and updating the strategy model parameter;  S7,  using the maximum entropy inverse strengthening learning,  updating the reward function;  S8,  simulating and verifying the effect of the gait control strategy.

The invention discloses a battery protection system for a quadruped robot Involving the field of robot technology,  the system can utilize the real-time monitoring function of the temperature sensor In order to obtain the current temperature data of the battery and the environment in real time,  and cooperate with the transfer pump to transfer the heat-conducting fluid and the heat-insulating fluid accordingly,  and use the return pump to transfer the heat-conducting fluid and the heat-insulating fluid,  so as to achieve the purpose of insulating the battery in a low-temperature environment.,  the purpose of conducting heat and dissipating heat to the battery when the battery is overheated By monitoring the temperature of the robot's operating environment and insulating or cooling the battery,  the battery's endurance is increased and battery overheating is avoided. And can combine the real-time monitoring of power and temperature,  and feedback alarm device,  when the battery has an unexpected situation,  it can be fed back to the background terminal or staff for processing; when a quadruped robot accidentally operates in a complex area with no signal coverage,  the physical positioning component can be used to facilitate staff tracking and retrieval. 1. A four-foot robot battery protection system,  wherein it comprises :  a shell,  the inner part of the shell is provided with a battery groove,  a first containing cavity and a second containing cavity;  the battery groove is used for placing the battery and forming a hollow temperature control layer between the battery and the shell,  the first containing cavity is used for containing the heat insulating fluid,  the second containing cavity is used for containing the heat conducting fluid;  the first containing cavity is connected with the temperature control layer through the first pipeline and the second pipeline;  the second containing cavity is connected with the temperature control layer through the third pipeline and the fourth pipeline;  the first pipeline is provided with a first transfer pump,  the second pipeline is provided with a first reflux pump,  the second pipeline is provided with a second transfer pump,  the fourth pipeline is provided with a second reflux pump;  a detection module,  the detection module comprises a first temperature sensor,  the first temperature sensor is set between the temperature control layer and the shell,  the first temperature sensor is used for detecting the environment temperature;  a control module in communication connection with the first transfer pump,  the second transfer pump,  the first reflux pump,  the second reflux pump and the first temperature sensor;  The control module is configured to perform the following operations :  receiving the real-time environment temperature value collected by the first temperature sensor,  judging the size relation between the real-time environment temperature value and the preset environment temperature value;  after determining that the real-time environmental temperature value is less than the preset environmental temperature value,  controlling the opening of the first transfer pump to make the heat insulating fluid to fill the temperature control layer through the first pipeline to achieve the purpose of heat insulation,  and after the heat insulation is finished,  controlling the first reflux pump to open to make the heat insulation fluid flow back to the first containing cavity through the second pipeline;  after determining that the real-time environmental temperature value is greater than the preset environmental temperature value,  controlling the opening of the second transfer pump so that the heat-conducting fluid fills the temperature control layer to achieve the purpose of heat conduction,  and controlling the second reflux pump to be opened after the heat conduction is finished to make the heat conduction fluid flow back to the second containing cavity through the fourth pipeline.

A large model training method for wiring harness operation of humanoid robot based on meta-motion space,  wherein the method comprises :  constructing wiring harness operation element action based on human wiring harness operation;  obtaining the wiring harness operation action of the humanoid robot,  and constructing the wiring harness operation element action data set based on the wiring harness operation element action;  based on the wiring harness operation element action data set,  utilizing the reinforced learning training human-shaped robot wiring harness operation large model,  and based on the output of the human-shaped robot wiring harness operation large model,  defining the reward function of the reinforced learning;  obtaining the input data,  using the trained human-shaped robot wiring harness to operate the large model to output the joint motor parameter and updating the input data in real time based on the joint motor parameter;  the input data comprises text instruction,  visual observation and robot sensing data;  obtaining a basic strategy based on the joint motor parameter,  and training the human-shaped robot wiring harness operation large model to obtain a residual strategy based on the basic strategy in a human behaviour intervention lifelong learning mode;  and performing the humanoid robot wiring harness operation based on the basic strategy and the residual strategy.

The invention discloses a method,  system,  equipment and medium for analyzing the cooling capacity of a humanoid robot. The method includes :  obtaining the ambient temperature,  the first temperature and working current of the heating component,  and the second temperature of the cooling structure; performing temperature rise mixed calibration on the first temperature and the second temperature according to the ambient temperature and the working current to obtain calibrated temperature rise data; obtaining the actual temperature rise data of the heating component,  the time window of the actual temperature rise data is the same as the time window of the calibrated temperature rise data; perform cooling analysis on the actual temperature rise data according to the calibrated temperature rise data to obtain the cooling capacity analysis result of the humanoid robot. This method can effectively improve the accuracy of the cooling capacity obtained by analysis,  and is conducive to improving the reliability and stability of the humanoid robot in the working process. The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots 1. An analysis method of cooling ability of humanoid robot,  wherein it is applied to the humanoid robot,  the humanoid robot comprises a heating component and a cooling structure,  the method comprises :  obtaining an ambient temperature,  a first temperature and a working current of the heat generating component,  and a second temperature of the cooling structure;  according to the environment temperature and the working current,  performing temperature rise mixing calibration to the first temperature and the second temperature,  obtaining calibration temperature rise data;  obtaining the actual temperature rise data of the heating component,  the time window of the actual temperature rise data is the same as the time window of the calibration temperature rise data;  performing cooling analysis on the actual temperature rise data according to the calibration temperature rise data to obtain a cooling capacity analysis result of the humanoid robot;  according to the ambient temperature and the working current,  performing temperature rise mixing calibration on the first temperature and the second temperature to obtain calibration temperature rise data,  comprising :  calculating the temperature difference of the second temperature according to the first temperature to obtain the intermediate temperature difference data;  according to the environment temperature,  correcting the temperature difference of the intermediate temperature difference data to obtain the target temperature difference data;  according to the working current,  performing temperature rise mixing analysis on the target temperature difference data to obtain the calibration temperature rise data;  according to the working current,  performing temperature rise mixing analysis on the target temperature difference data,  to obtain the calibration temperature rise data,  comprising :  obtaining a theoretical temperature rise model,  a mapping relation data table and a quantification neural network;  inputting the working current and the target temperature difference data to the theoretical temperature rise model to perform theoretical temperature rise calculation to obtain a first temperature rise data;  performing empirical temperature rise mapping to the working current and the target temperature difference data according to the mapping relation data table to obtain a second temperature rise data;  inputting the working current and the target temperature difference data to the quantification neural network to perform quantification temperature rise prediction to obtain a third temperature rise data;  performing self-adaptive fusion on the first temperature rise data,  the second temperature rise data and the third temperature rise data to obtain the calibration temperature rise data.

The invention relates to the technical field of welding,  and provides a welding program generating method of a humanoid robot and related equipment. The welding program generating method of the humanoid robot comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a first workpiece image of a workpiece to be welded,  and determining a segmentation mask of the workpiece to be welded and a welding seam based on the first workpiece image; determining the three-dimensional contour points of the weld seam according to the three-dimensional point cloud of the workpiece to be welded and the segmentation mask; obtaining welding task information and reasoning welding steps based on the welding task information and three-dimensional contour points; determining the welding process parameters according to the welding steps,  the segmentation mask,  the three-dimensional contour points and the initial operation skills of the humanoid robot,  and writing the welding process parameters into the welding initial program; test the initial welding program in the simulation environment corresponding to the workpiece to be welded to obtain the target welding program of the humanoid robot. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention,  the safe and automatic generation of the humanoid robot welding program is realized 1. A welding program generating method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a first workpiece image of the workpiece to be welded,  and determining a division mask of the workpiece to be welded and the welding seam based on the first workpiece image;  determining the three-dimensional outline point of the welding line according to the three-dimensional point cloud of the workpiece to be welded and the division mask;  obtaining the welding task information,  and according to the welding task information and the three-dimensional outline point,  reasoning the welding step;  according to the welding step,  the cutting mask,  the three-dimensional outline point and the initial working skill of the human-shaped robot,  determining the welding process parameter,  and writing the welding process parameter into the welding initial program;  testing the welding initial program in the simulation environment corresponding to the workpiece to be welded to obtain the target welding program of the humanoid robot;  The step of determining the division mask of the workpiece to be welded and the welding seam based on the first workpiece image comprises :  detecting the directed boundary frame of the workpiece to be welded through the multi-mode large model;  inputting the directed boundary frame and the first workpiece image into a visual basic model to obtain the segmentation mask;  wherein the visual basic model comprises a boundary frame prompt encoder,  an image encoder and a mask decoder;  the boundary frame prompt coder is used for coding the directed boundary frame;  the image encoder is used for extracting the image embedding feature in the first workpiece image;  the mask decoder is used for processing the coded directed boundary frame and the image embedding feature to obtain the division mask;  the boundary frame prompt coder codes the position and rotation through the multi-layer sensing machine and the high frequency Fourier characteristic mapping,  introduces the self-adaptive Gaussian position coding and direction correction embedding,  and outputs the boundary frame prompt embedding vector;  the mask decoder comprises an embedded fusion and focus attention module,  a mask prediction module,  wherein the embedded fusion and Tranformer attention module adds the image embedded feature and the boundary frame prompt embedded vector and inputs the image embedded feature and the boundary frame prompt embedded vector to the bounding box attention module to form a global context representation,  The mask prediction module extracts the intermediate mask representation for the context representation using the multi-layer perceptron,  and generates a segmentation mask by matrix multiplication with the up-sampling feature of the over-attention module.

The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  and discloses a posture generation method,  device,  robot,  medium and product of a humanoid robot. The method includes :  obtaining first voice data to be output,  first special action markers,  Gaussian noise and time steps; determining a first Mel spectrum and a first deep semantic feature according to the first speech data,  the first deep semantic feature being the first speech data processed by the self-supervised speech representation learning model; input the first Mel spectrum,  the first deep semantic feature,  the first special action marker,  the Gaussian noise and the time step into a posture generation model,  and determine the first action data according to the output of the posture generation model,  wherein the posture generation model is a diffusion model that has completed training; when the first voice data is output,  the humanoid robot is synchronously controlled to generate gesture actions represented by the first action data. The invention can generate more diverse actions within the distribution and improve the naturalness and intimacy of human-computer interaction. 1. A posture generating method of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining a first voice data to be output,  a first special action mark,  a Gaussian noise and a time step,  wherein the first special action mark is used for representing the style of the generated gesture action or a preset special action;  determining a first Meyer spectrum and a first depth semantic feature according to the first voice data,  wherein the first depth semantic feature is a first voice data processed by a self-monitoring voice representation learning model;  inputting the first Meel spectrum,  the first depth semantic feature,  the first special action mark,  the Gaussian noise and the time step into a gesture generation model,  and determining first action data according to the output of the gesture generation model,  wherein the gesture generation model is a diffusion model after training;  when outputting the first voice data,  synchronously controlling the human-shaped robot to generate the gesture action represented by the first action data.

The present invention relates to PEEK material for humanoid robot,  and belongs to the field of polymer composite material technology The components of this PEEK material are :  chopped carbon fiber 8.5-11wt%,  anti-crack modifier 3.7-4.4 wt%,  lubricant 1.5-2.1 wt% and antioxidant 0.35-0.4 wt%,  and the balance is PEEK resin; the anti-cracking modifier is made from the active primary amine substitution reaction of 3-bromopropyltrimethoxysilane and N-(3-aminopropyl) diethanolamine to make an intermediate,  and then 1,  3-adamantane dicarboxylic acid Activated with thionyl chloride and then esterified with the intermediate to form a chain polyester compound; the crack-resistant modifier significantly reduces the cracking risk of materials used in humanoid robots through rigid gradient transition layer design and multiple interface anchoring mechanisms,  and breaks through the application bottleneck of existing carbon fiber composite PEEK materials under thermal cycle conditions. 1. PEEK material applied to humanoid robot,  wherein the specific components are as follows :  chopped carbon fibre 8.5-11 wt %,  anti-cracking modifier 3.7-4.4 wt %,  lubricant 1.5-2.1 wt % and antioxidant 0.35-0.4 wt %,  the rest is PEEK resin;  The crack-resistant modifier is prepared by the following method :  step A1 :  pre-mixing N - (3-aminopropyl) diethanol amine,  3-bromopropyl trimethoxy silane and anhydrous tetrahydrofuran,  introducing dry nitrogen to protect,  controlling the temperature in water bath at 40-50 degrees centigrade,  slowly adding triethylamine to stir and react for 6-8 h,  preparing intermediate;  step A2 :  mixing the 1,  3-adamantane dicarboxylic acid with DMF,  introducing dry nitrogen to protect,  adding thionyl chloride to mix uniformly and raising the temperature to 85-90 degrees centigrade,  stirring and reacting for 1.5-2h,  then adding intermediate and decompressing to 0.1 kPa,  raising the temperature to 120-140 degrees centigrade and continuously reacting for 4.5-5.8 h to prepare the anti-cracking modifier.

The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot with an arrangement of components that allows the robot to mimic the movements,  functionality and capabilities of a human being. Provided in the embodiments of the present application are a method,  apparatus and device for controlling a legged robot,  a legged robot,  a computer-readable storage medium and a computer program product The legged robot comprises a base and at least two mechanical legs,  wherein each mechanical leg comprises at least one joint. The method comprises :  in response to determining that each mechanical leg of the legged robot descends to contact a flat surface,  determining a first expected path and a second expected path corresponding to the legged robot,  wherein the first expected path indicates an expected path of movement of the center of mass of the legged robot in the gravity direction and an expected path of variation of an inclination angle of the legged robot,  and the second expected path indicates an expected path of a foot end of each mechanical leg;  and controlling,  on the basis of a dynamics model corresponding to the legged robot,  the first expected path and the second expected path,  the action of each joint after the legged robot contacts the flat surface.

A two-stage deceleration rotary power unit,  comprising a base (1) and a motor unit and a speed reducer unit arranged inside of the base. The motor unit comprises a motor rotor (41). The speed reducer unit comprises a first-stage planetary deceleration mechanism (2) and a second-stage planetary deceleration mechanism (3). The second-stage planetary deceleration mechanism comprises a second-stage sun gear (31),  a second-stage planetary gear (32),  a second-stage planet carrier (33),  and a second-stage inner ring gear (34). The second-stage planet carrier is coaxially and fixedly connected to a hollow output angle rotation transmission member (5). The output angle rotation transmission member extends towards the motor rotor. The rotary power unit is provided with the output angle rotation transmission member so as to consolidate status monitoring of the second-stage planet carrier and motor rotor in one place,  thereby simplifying the wiring of an electronic control system of the rotary power unit and resulting in high reliability and low costs. In addition,  two-stage planetary deceleration is further used,  providing a high reduction ratio,  and the output-stage speed ratio may be flexibly adjusted according to different working usage conditions thereof,  such as different positions of hip joints or knee joints of a robot. The present invention further relates to a rotary power unit and a robot.

The present invention pertains to a method for a quadruped robot to navigate through granular media,  such as deep sand and for providing improvements in the walking performance over various types of granular media. In particular,  the present invention proposes reducing the assumed coefficient of friction about the ground,  impacting the ground harder than nominal in the vertical direction at touchdown,  and forcing a toe lift off into swing if a knee joint extends beyond a threshold stance to help increase the robustness of a quadruped robot's locomotive abilities on challenging terrains and provide an improvement in the field of biomechanics and robotic navigation.

A movement trajectory determining method and apparatus,  a computer device,  and a storage medium are disclosed,  and belong to the field of computer technologies. The method includes :  creating first relational data,  second relational data,  and third relational data,  the first relational data indicating a relationship between a torso location of a legged robot and movement duration,  the second relational data indicating a relationship between the movement duration and a force applied to a foot of the legged robot in contact with a ground,  and the third relational data indicating a relationship between the force and a predicted rotational angle of the legged robot in a case that the legged robot moves to a target location after target movement duration elapses;  creating fourth relational data based on the third relational data;  and determining,  based on the second relational data and the fourth relational data,  a value of a constant C in a case that a target value J is a minimum value,  and obtaining first relational data with the determined value of the constant C. This application provides a manner of determining a movement trajectory,  to ensure feasibility and accuracy of a determined movement trajectory.

The invention provides a control method,  device,  electronic equipment and storage medium for a laser rangefinder,  which includes the steps of :  collecting image data of a target area of the laser rangefinder; preprocessing the image data to obtain humanoid image data; identifying the humanoid image data; judging whether human eye image data exists in the human shape image data according to a preset rule and starting the laser range finder to emit laser; it avoids harm to human eyes,  and can also effectively perform laser ranging. It is highly safe,  has good user experience,  and is easy to use. The invention has good ranging control effect,  high safety and wide adaptability 1. A control method of laser range finder,  wherein the control method comprises the following steps :  collecting the image data of the target area of the laser range finder;  pre-processing the image data to obtain the human-shaped image data;  identifying the human-shaped image data;  according to the preset rule,  judging whether there is human eye image data in the human image data and starting the laser range finder to emit laser;  The step of pre-processing the image data to obtain the human-shaped image data further comprises :  sharpening the image data to obtain clear target original image;  separating the target original image by a difference technology to obtain a human-shaped image and a human-shaped peripheral image;  performing convolution operation to the human-shaped image to find out the boundary outline of the human-shaped front surface,  the reverse surface or the side surface;  according to the continuity and the sealing property of the boundary outline,  separating the independent face image of the front face,  the back face or the side face;  the step of judging whether there is human eye image data in the human image data according to the preset rule and starting the laser range finder to emit the laser,  further comprising :  performing real-time location tracking according to the human face image to obtain a human eye image area;  Specifically,  the method includes :  obtaining a target human eye image area,  in the first frame of the target human eye image area,  marking a plurality of human face front surfaces,  a plurality of target frames are obtained by the base target on the opposite surface or the side surface,  a tracking address is assigned to each of the target frames,  and all the base targets identified in the first frame and marked by the selected frame are used as target frames for multi-target tracking;  marking multiple current targets including the front face,  the back face or the side face of the human face in the current frame after the first frame of the target human eye image region to obtain multiple current frames;  predicting the occurrence position of the basic target corresponding to each target frame in the current frame to obtain multiple prediction frames;  calculating the optimal matching result between the plurality of current frames and the plurality of prediction frames;  updating the tracking address according to the optimal matching result.

The invention discloses a control method,  equipment and medium for realizing independent walking of a quadruped robot,  and relates to the field of robot control methods. The method includes :  1) establishing a coordinate system of the quadruped robot and describing the posture of the quadruped robot in a three-dimensional space.,  translation speed and rotation speed; 2) Design a velocity state estimator,  filter the velocity value obtained by the sensor through a sliding window filter,  and use the Kahan algorithm to improve the calculation accuracy; 3) Design a gait generator to obtain the diagonal trotting gait of the quadruped robot at a certain moment; 4) Use Raibert's three-channel decoupling algorithm to calculate the neutral point position,  and use the neutral point as the symmetry point to find the foothold position; 5) Use the quadratic parabolic interpolation method to plan the swing phase trajectory; 6) Conduct force analysis on the quadruped robot rigid body model and construct the discrete state equation and prediction equation of the rigid body; 7) Construct a standard quadratic programming equation to obtain the optimal solution of joint torque and control the robot. 1. A control method for realizing independent walking of four-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  establishing the main body coordinate system,  the joint coordinate system and the sole coordinate system of the four-foot robot,  and respectively describing the translation speed and the rotation speed of the four-foot robot in the three-dimensional space by the differential coefficient and the rotation matrix of the position vector;  obtaining the real-time speed of the four-foot robot and pre-processing the speed data;  establishing a relational expression of the diagonal small running gait of the four-foot robot at a certain time;  using the three-channel decoupling algorithm of Raibert to calculate the neutral point position of the four-foot robot,  using the neutral point as the symmetrical point,  using the linear function of the speed error to perform position compensation,  using the component of the expected swinging height and the safety margin in the z-axis direction,  calculating the foot-falling point position of the four-foot robot,  wherein the three-channel decoupling algorithm of Raibert is used to calculate the neutral point position of the four-foot robot,  specifically :  wherein represents the position of the neutral point,  represents the coordinate of the mass centre of the touchdown moment,  psi touch represents the yaw angle of the touchdown moment,  Rz (.) represents the rotation matrix rotating a certain angle around the z axis,  represents the position of the neutral point at the last time;  planning a wobble phase trajectory of the four-legged robot using a quadratic parabolic interpolation method;  constructing the continuous state equation of the rigid body of the four-foot robot and performing discretization to obtain the discrete state equation,  then introducing the ground reaction vector to obtain the prediction equation of the four-foot robot;  establishing inequality constraint according to the friction force suffered by the sole of the four-foot robot,  constructing the standard secondary planning equation of the prediction equation of the four-foot robot,  then solving to obtain the optimal solution of the joint torque,  outputting the optimal solution of the joint torque of the four-foot robot to control.

Straightening force The device integrates a welding gun,  a wire feeder and a welding wire straightening mechanism into a whole,  is mounted at the execution end of a mechanical arm of a humanoid welding robot for use,  and performs self-adaptive welding wire straightening adjustment along with the reduction of the residual welding wire amount in the welding operation process 1. A wire feeding and straightening integrated welding gun device for humanoid welding robot,  wherein It comprises a welding gun main body,  a welding wire tray frame,  a wire feeding mechanism assembly for conveying the welding wire forwards,  a straightening mechanism assembly for straightening the welding wire,  and a main controller;  the straightening driving wheel and the straightening driven wheel are located in the straightening inner cavity,  and the straightening driving wheel and the straightening driven wheel are staggered to form a welding wire straightening channel;  the straightening driven wheel is rotatably connected with the straightening inner chamber wall;  the straightening driving wheel can be rotatably set on the driving wheel position adjusting module,  the driving wheel position adjusting module is connected with the straightening mechanism shell,  so as to realize the position adjustment of the straightening driving wheel;  adjusting the position of the straightening driving wheel by the driving wheel position adjusting module so as to adjust the distance between the straightening driving wheel and the straightening driven wheel so as to adjust the straightening force of the welding wire; The invention discloses a human eye-imitating three-dimensional point cloud data compression method,  which includes :  obtaining original point cloud data,  and performing Gaussian filtering and denoising processing on the original point cloud data; extract the area of interest from the denoised point cloud using the human eye-like target extraction algorithm; the extracted interested region is retained with high resolution and the non-interested region is non-uniformly compressed by using the human eye-like interested target compression algorithm; finally,  a display program is used to display the compression result The present invention obtains the area of interest based on the retinal attention perception mechanism of the human eye Then perform high resolution on the area of interest And perform non-uniform redundancy compression on non-interest areas,  it solves the inefficiency of the current point cloud data processing algorithm that the resolution is fixed when processing areas of interest and non-interest areas,  and reduces the amount of data participating in non-interest areas,  thereby effectively improving the quality of three-dimensional point cloud data and improving The recognition accuracy and speed in the field of three-dimensional target recognition 1. A three-dimensional point cloud data compression method of humanoid eye,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the automatic driving original three-dimensional point cloud data,  performing Gaussian filter de-noising processing on the original three-dimensional point cloud data;  extracting the interested region of the de-noised three-dimensional point cloud data by using the interesting target extracting algorithm of human eyes;  the simulated human eye interesting target extracting algorithm uses the encoder decoder structure,  through the three-dimensional point cloud context attention change module encoder and scene context attention change change decoder,  simulating the context information of the point cloud;  performing high resolution reservation to the extracted interested area by using the human-eye-like interested target compression algorithm,  performing non-uniform compression to the non-interested area;  Specifically,  the method includes :  converting the point cloud data from the Cartesian coordinate system to the polar coordinate system by using the three-dimensional retinal variable resolution positive variation model,  and changing the logarithmic polar coordinate;  using the three-dimensional retinal variable resolution compression model,  realizing the uniform density distribution of the point cloud data through the voxel compression point cloud method;  converting the point cloud under the logarithmic polar coordinate back to the point cloud under the Cartesian coordinate system by using the three-dimensional retinal variable resolution inverse change model;  using the three-dimensional retinal variable resolution point cloud fusion model to fuse the point cloud;  converting the point cloud data from the Cartesian coordinate system to the polar coordinate system,  and the formula of the logarithmic polar coordinate change comprises :  Theta=arctan2 (y-y0,  x-x0) wherein r is the distance from the point to the original point,  theta is the included angle between the projection of the point on the XY plane and the X axis,  phi is the included angle between the point and the Z axis,  (x,  y,  z) is the coordinate under the Cartesian coordinate system,  (x0,  y0,  z0) is the central point of the interested area;  The calculation formula of the point cloud under the logarithmic polar coordinate is as follows :  logr=log (r + epsilon),  wherein epsilon is a constant.

The invention relates to the technical field of flexible electronic sensors,  in particular to a high-stability impedance modulation flexible strain sensor and a preparation method thereof. The high-stability impedance modulation flexible strain sensor comprises a strain-sensitive liquid metal resistor,  a capacitor,  an inductor,  two electrodes,  an elastomer encapsulation layer,  two strain isolation fabrics and two signal wires A strain-sensitive liquid metal resistor is connected in series with the inductor,  and the series branch is connected in parallel with the capacitor; the two electrodes are respectively connected with the two electric connection ends of the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor in a one-to-one correspondence manner; two strain isolation fabrics are respectively placed at both ends of the strain-sensitive liquid metal resistor in the length direction; the strain-sensitive liquid metal resistor,  capacitor,  inductor,  two electrodes,  and two strain isolation fabrics are all encapsulated by an elastomer encapsulation layer; the two signal wires are connected to the two electrodes in one-to-one correspondence; solves the problem that the existing flexible strain sensor has poor stability and is susceptible to electromagnetic interference in the limited built-in space of the humanoid robot. 1. A high stability impedance modulation flexible strain sensor,  wherein It comprises strain sensitive liquid metal resistor (1),  capacitor (2),  inductor (3),  two electrodes (4),  elastic body packaging layer (5),  two strain isolation fabric (6),  two signal wires (7);  the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor (1) is connected with the inductor (3) in series,  the series branch is connected with the capacitor (2) in parallel;  two electrodes (4) are respectively connected with two electric connecting ends of the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor (1) one by one;  two strain isolation fabrics (6) are respectively arranged at two ends of the length direction of the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor (1);  the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor (1),  the capacitor (2),  the inductor (3),  the two electrodes (4) and the two strain isolation fabrics (6) are packaged by the elastic body packaging layer (5);  two signal leads (7) are connected with two electrodes (4) one by one;  the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor (1) is liquid metal lead structure,  and the liquid metal lead structure is made of oxide eutectic gallium indium.

The invention provides a method and a system for detecting boundaries in a humanoid robot relay race,  and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps of :  performing gradient ascending optimization on a smooth image,  and generating a binary image after dynamic threshold segmentation; use Canny edge detection algorithm to process binary images to obtain edge feature maps; performing closed operation morphological processing on the edge feature map to generate a continuous edge map; processing continuous edge graph based on statistical probabilistic Hough transform algorithm to generate effective boundary straight line set; classify the straight lines into left and right boundary lines and final lines according to their spatial positions,  select the longest straight line in each category to calculate the angle with the horizontal direction,  and obtain the robot motion control system to adjust the walking direction in real time. According to the invention,  the reliability of the detection result is improved 1. A method for detecting boundary in humanoid robot relay game,  wherein the method comprises :  step 1,  real-time collecting the track RGB image through the head camera of the humanoid robot;  step 2,  extracting the blue channel grey scale image of the RGB image,  obtaining the middle image for enhancing the contrast between the green race and the white boundary;  step 3,  performing Gaussian blur processing according to the blue channel grey scale image,  generating a smooth image for inhibiting illumination noise and detail interference;  step 4,  performing gradient rising optimization on the smooth image,  generating a binary image after the dynamic threshold value is divided;  step 5,  using the Canny edge detection algorithm to process the binary image,  so as to obtain the edge characteristic image;  step 6,  performing closed operation morphological processing on the edge feature image to generate continuous edge image;  step 7,  processing the continuous edge map based on the statistical probability Hough transformation algorithm,  generating an effective boundary straight line set;  step 8,  classifying the straight line into left and right boundary lines and the final point line according to the space position,  selecting the longest straight line in each type to calculate the included angle with the horizontal direction,  obtaining the robot motion control system to adjust the walking direction in real time.

This application discloses a multi-dimensional dynamic stability collaborative control method and device for a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot,  and relates to the field of robot control technology. The method includes :  establishing a dynamic model; the dynamic models include trunk pitch model,  trunk roll model,  hip joint swing model,  knee joint flexion and extension model and ankle joint rotation model; determine the comprehensive evaluation index of the stability of the humanoid robot in the dimensions of longitudinal slip,  sideslip and roll; the hip joint swing model and knee joint flexion and extension model correspond to the lower limb swing dimension,  the trunk pitch model and trunk roll model correspond to the trunk balance dimension,  and the ankle joint rotation model corresponds to the plantar contact dimension; obtaining the dynamic dynamic parameters of each joint of humanoid robot,  and determining the expected control quantity according to the comprehensive evaluation index of stability; cooperative control is performed on the actuator of the humanoid robot according to the expected control amount. This application can achieve full-dimensional stability control in complex environments by establishing a multi-dimensional stability collaborative control scheme. 1. A multi-dimensional dynamic stability cooperative control method of multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  establishing a dynamic model including multiple degrees of freedom;  wherein the dynamic model comprises a trunk pitching model,  a trunk rolling model,  a hip joint swinging model,  a knee joint flexion and extension model and an ankle joint rotating model of the human-shaped robot;  determining the stability comprehensive evaluation index of the human-shaped robot under the longitudinal sliding,  lateral sliding and lateral tilting dimensions according to the dynamic model with multiple degrees of freedom;  wherein the hip joint swinging model and the knee joint flexion and extension model are corresponding to the lower limb swinging dimension,  the trunk pitching model and the trunk rolling model are corresponding to the trunk balance dimension,  the ankle joint rotating model is corresponding to the sole contact dimension;  obtaining the dynamic dynamic parameter of each joint of the humanoid robot;  according to the dynamic dynamic parameter and the stability comprehensive evaluation index,  determining the expected control amount of the dynamic control of the humanoid robot in different dimensions;  cooperatively controlling the executing mechanism of the humanoid robot according to the expected control quantity under different dimensions;  the step of determining the stability comprehensive evaluation index of the human-shaped robot under the longitudinal sliding,  side sliding and side tilting dimensions according to the dynamic model with multiple degrees of freedom,  comprising the following steps :  constructing a Jacobian matrix based on the dynamic model,  and dividing a stability boundary according to the Jacobian matrix;  using non-linear numerical method and linearization analysis method to fit the stability boundary,  determining the stable domain of the humanoid robot in different dimensions;  wherein the stable domain comprises an absolute stable domain and a relative stable domain;  performing coordinated coupling on the stable domains in different dimensions,  establishing the stability comprehensive evaluation index;  The construction of a Jacobian matrix based on the kinetic model comprises the following steps :  constructing the Jacobian matrix including joint angle,  angular velocity and plantar contact force;  wherein the Jacobian matrix comprises the kinetic parameters of the kinetic model;  The step of dividing the stability boundary according to the Jacobian matrix comprises the following steps :  solving the characteristic value of the Jacobian matrix;  wherein the Jacobian matrix comprises the kinetic parameters of the kinetic model;  determining the bifurcation value of each dynamic parameter of the dynamic model when the different dimensions are unstable according to the characteristic value;  dividing the stability boundary according to the branch value;  the according to the dynamic dynamics parameter and the stability comprehensive evaluation index to determine the desired control amount of the human-shaped robot dynamics control in different dimensions,  comprising the following steps :  determining the destabilization phase sequence under different dimensions according to the dynamics parameter of the destabilization of the humanoid robot;  according to the phase sequence,  simulating the destabilization working condition under the single dimension,  collecting the dynamics parameter corresponding to the other dimensions,  determining the weight proportion of the different dynamics parameter to the stable state influence of the humanoid robot;  combining the stability comprehensive evaluation index and the weight proportion,  calculating the expected control moment of each joint as the expected control quantity.

The invention relates to the technical field of AI dialogue generation,  and discloses a children AI dialogue generation method,  system and storage medium based on IP role personality. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring IP role personality data and constructing a personality feature sub-vector,  a style feature sub-vector and a knowledge feature sub-vector; performing weighted attention calculation on the text input by the user to obtain an attention weight distribution matrix; through the joint optimization of the multi-objective personality constraint loss function,  the intermediate dialogue content that meets the IP role personality constraint conditions is obtained; based on the intermediate dialogue content,  educational content adaptation and role identity consistency verification are performed to obtain the pre-generated dialogue text,  and real-time personality deviation correction is performed to obtain the target dialogue generation result. The invention can continuously monitor and correct the personality deviation phenomenon during the dialogue generation process,  ensure that the generated content always conforms to the IP role setting,  and effectively solve the technical problem of role identity drift in multiple rounds of dialogue. 1. A children AI conversation generation method based on IP role human setting,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining IP angle colour human setting data and constructing IP angle colour human setting constraint matrix;  performing three-element decoupling to the IP angular-colour human-setting constraint matrix to obtain a character feature sub-vector,  a style feature sub-vector and a knowledge feature sub-vector;  based on the character feature sub-vector,  the style feature sub-vector and the knowledge feature sub-vector,  performing human weight attention calculation on the user input text to obtain an attention weight distribution matrix;  inputting the attention weight distribution matrix into the multi-target human-set constraint loss function for joint optimization,  obtaining the intermediate session content satisfying the IP horned human-set constraint condition,  comprising :  constructing a multi-target human constraint loss function including a personality constraint loss component,  a style constraint loss component and a knowledge constraint loss component based on the attention weight distribution matrix;  calculating the constraint deviation degree of the emotion vector,  language style characteristic and knowledge field information of the generated text according to the multi-target set constraint loss function to obtain a character constraint loss value,  a style constraint loss value and a knowledge constraint loss value;  based on the character constraint loss value,  the style constraint loss value and the knowledge constraint loss value,  performing weighted linear combination and AdamW optimizer iteration processing,  obtaining comprehensive optimization loss value;  inputting the comprehensive optimized loss value into a dialog generating decoder to perform gradient reverse propagation and constraint instruction generation,  obtaining an intermediate dialog content satisfying the IP horns human setting constraint condition;  performing education content adaptation and role identity consistency verification based on the intermediate dialog content,  obtaining a pre-generated dialog text,  and performing real-time human setting deviation correction on the pre-generated dialog text,  obtaining a target dialog generation result,  comprising :  inputting the pre-generated dialog text to the candidate generation layer for beam search and diversification expansion to obtain a candidate dialog text set including multiple candidate replies;  performing character consistency score calculation,  style matching degree score calculation and knowledge accuracy score calculation on the basis of the candidate dialog text set,  obtaining the person set matching degree evaluation result and deviation degree detection value corresponding to each candidate reply;  according to the deviation degree detection value,  comparing and judging the human setting deviation threshold value and adjusting the self-adaptive correction intensity,  obtaining the screening candidate reply set satisfying the human setting constraint condition or re-generating the trigger command;  and inputting the screening candidate reply set to the human fidelity evaluation algorithm for quality evaluation and optimal reply selection to obtain the target conversation generation result.

The invention provides a humanoid robot inertial navigation and vision fusion positioning method,  a humanoid robot inertial navigation and vision fusion positioning device and equipment The method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  pre-evaluating the quality of IMU inertial data and visual SLAM data to generate a data credibility identifier; establish a causal relationship chain between data sources through time series correlation analysis; construct a multi-strategy superposition state based on data credibility,  and determine the adaptive fusion strategy through collapse determination; use causal relationship to construct data evolution path,  and generate expected behavior characteristics and causal deviation characteristics; optimize the fusion parameters according to the deviation features to generate multiple fusion positioning estimates with different weights; through spatial aggregation analysis and confidence weight calculation,  the optimal positioning estimate is selected and the high-precision fusion positioning result is output. The method realizes deep understanding of sensor data,  intelligent selection of fusion strategies,  robust output of positioning results,  and improves the positioning performance of humanoid robots in complex environments. 1. A human-shaped robot inertial navigation and visual fusion positioning method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining IMU inertia data and visual SLAM data as data source,  pre-evaluating data quality of said data source,  generating data reliability mark;  analyzing the time sequence relevance of the data source to establish the causal relationship chain between the data sources,  determining the causal strength and the causal direction of the data source according to the causal relationship chain;  generating a policy probability distribution based on the data reliability identifier,  constructing a multi-policy superposition state based on the policy probability distribution,  performing collapse determination based on the data reliability identifier and the multi-policy superposition state to determine an adaptive fusion policy;  constructing a data evolution path based on the causal intensity and the causal direction,  generating a desired behaviour characteristic based on the data evolution path,  and generating a causal deviation characteristic based on the difference between the desired behaviour characteristic and the data source;  setting a basic inter-layer parameter according to the causal deviation characteristic and the adaptive fusion strategy,  optimizing and adjusting the basic inter-layer parameter based on the causal intensity and the causal direction to generate an optimized inter-layer parameter,  and generating multiple fusion location estimates based on the optimized inter-layer parameter;  performing spatial aggregation characteristic analysis on the plurality of fusion location estimates to obtain a high confidence region,  performing joint processing on the high confidence region and the data reliability identification to generate a region confidence weight,  performing weighted fusion on the plurality of fusion location estimates based on the region confidence weight to obtain a fusion location centroid,  determining an optimal location estimate based on the fusion location centroid;  according to the optimal location estimation,  outputting the high-precision fusion location result,  finishing the inertial navigation and visual fusion location of the humanoid robot.

The present invention relates to an automated fruit damage detection system. The system employs deep learning models such as ResNet-50 and VGG-16 to analyze real-time images of fruits,  categorizing them as ripe,  unripe,  or damaged based on features like shape,  texture,  and color. The bipedal robot autonomously navigates the farm,  capturing images from multiple angles and under various environmental conditions,  ensuring high detection accuracy. The system utilizes a secure data storage module to encrypt and store fruit quality data,  ensuring data integrity. Farmers interact with the system via a web-based interface,  where they can monitor real-time results,  upload images,  and access detailed reports. The solution reduces manual labor,  enhances operational efficiency,  and is scalable for large or small farms. This innovation modernizes traditional farming practices,  improving fruit quality monitoring and decision-making for farmers.
