The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control,  and specifically relates to a humanoid robot double-arm adaptive force control operation method and system,  which includes :  establishing a world coordinate system and a left arm base coordinate system,  a right arm base coordinate system,  a left arm end coordinate system,  The coordinate conversion algorithm between the right arm end coordinate system and the operating target coordinate system; obtain the six-dimensional force data and torque data collected by the six-dimensional force sensors at the ends of the left and right robotic arms,  and perform gravity compensation and conversion; define the grip matrix to decompose the six-dimensional force data and moment data into internal forces and external forces; divide the collaborative task into free motion stage,  constraint establishment stage and constraint motion stage,  and generate corresponding control instructions in each stage; the generated control instructions are input into the dual-arm robot system to realize the coordinated motion control of the dual-arm robot at different stages. The invention can complete the coordination work and has the ability to resist interference 1. A double-arm self-adaptive stress control operation method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  according to the preset coordinate system relationship,  establishing the coordinate conversion algorithm between the world coordinate system and the left arm base coordinate system,  the right arm base coordinate system,  the left arm end coordinate system,  the right arm end coordinate system and the operation target coordinate system;  S2,  obtaining the six-dimensional force data and moment data collected by the six-dimensional force sensor at the tail end of the left and right mechanical arms,  performing gravity compensation on the six-dimensional force data and moment data and converting into the six-dimensional force data and moment data under the world coordinate system through the coordinate conversion algorithm;  S3,  defining a gripping matrix for the relative movement between the actuator at the end of the left and right mechanical arms and the operating target,  using the gripping matrix to decompose the six-dimensional force data and the moment data under the world coordinate system into the internal force and the external force;  S4,  dividing the left and right mechanical arm cooperation task into a free movement stage,  a constraint establishment stage and a constraint movement stage,  and executing the corresponding control strategy in each stage :  in the free movement stage,  inputting the difference between the actual force data and the expected force data into the self-adaptive variable admittance controller,  the output result of the self-adaptive variable admittance controller is added with the expected track to obtain the actual movement track and generate the corresponding control instruction;  in the constraint establishing stage,  estimating the environmental rigidity and position parameter based on the BFGS learning algorithm,  obtaining the self-adaptive reference track according to the estimated environmental rigidity and position parameter and generating the corresponding control instruction;  in the constraint movement stage,  the inner and outer ring self-adaptive admittance controllers are used for respectively controlling the inner force and the outer force of the left and right arms,  keeping the expected distance between the tail end position and the operation target,  performing the closed chain constraint,  so as to obtain the movement track of the left and right mechanical arms and generate the corresponding control instruction;  S5,  inputting the generated control instruction into the double-arm robot system,  realizing coordinated movement control of the double-arm robot at different stages.

The invention belongs to the technical field related to wearable exoskeletons. It discloses a knee joint exoskeleton anthropomorphic balance assist control method and equipment. The steps are :  (1) Calculate the speed and position of the human body's center of mass and the human body's balance reference point. Deviation,  and then obtain the relative offset speed and displacement of the human body's center of mass; (2) Obtain the predicted value of human knee joint torque based on the relative offset velocity and displacement of the human body's center of mass and the knee joint torque prediction model; (3) Dynamically set the auxiliary gain to dynamically control the size of the auxiliary torque; (4) Determine the output auxiliary torque based on the current relative offset of the human body's center of mass and the auxiliary torque; (5) Convert the auxiliary torque into the corresponding expected value of the motor current,  and then track and control the current input to the motor based on the obtained current error to achieve real-time control of the motor. The invention solves the problem that the existing balance assistance mode is not anthropomorphic and cannot meet the needs of real-time response 1. A humanoid balance control method of knee joint exoskeleton,  wherein the control method comprises the following steps :  (1) based on the kinematics data of the human body mass centre and the human body balance reference point under the global coordinate system,  calculating to obtain the deviation of the speed and position of the human body mass centre and the human body balance reference point,  so as to obtain the relative deviation speed and displacement of the human body mass centre;  (2) the human body mass centre relative offset speed and displacement input to knee joint torque prediction model,  the knee joint torque prediction model output human body knee joint torque prediction value;  wherein,  the mathematical expression of the knee joint torque prediction model is :  In the formula,  is the human body knee joint moment prediction value after the current time t through human body nerve delay T time,  delta CoM (t) and Kp and Kv are fitting proportion coefficients obtained by binary one-off regression of the human body knee joint moment variation and the human body centroid position and speed variation in the human body balance recovery data;  (3) according to the human body mass centre acceleration detection value at the disturbance start time to dynamically set the auxiliary gain,  so as to dynamically obtain the auxiliary torque based on the human body knee joint torque prediction value and the auxiliary gain;  at the same time,  according to the human body nerve delay time,  delaying the applying time of the auxiliary moment by designing the delay queue;  (4) judging whether the relative deviation of the current mass centre of the human body exceeds the preset serious unbalance threshold value,  if so,  not providing the auxiliary moment,  and outputting the auxiliary moment to be zero;  or else,  judging whether the auxiliary moment exceeds the preset maximum auxiliary moment,  if so,  replacing the auxiliary moment at the current moment with the maximum auxiliary moment and outputting it,  otherwise,  directly outputting the auxiliary moment at the current moment;  (5) according to the characteristics of the motor and the speed reducer of the knee joint exoskeleton,  converting the auxiliary moment into the corresponding motor current expected value,  and performing difference between the expected motor current and the motor actual current to obtain the current error,  so as to perform tracking control on the current input to the motor according to the current error,  The invention realizes the real-time control of the motor.

The present invention designs a nonlinear model predictive control problem for the whole body coordination control of humanoid robots,  reasonably plans the system state,  arm end state,  foot end state and reference trajectory of control input,  and designs the necessary equation constraints and inequality constraints for the whole body coordination movement of the robot Added task trajectory constraints and momentum conservation constraints on the end of the arm,  making the arm's ability to assist movement balance more prominent. 1. A human-shaped robot systemic coordination control method based on centroid dynamics model,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  establishing a centroid dynamics model of the humanoid robot,  selecting the state,  system input and system output of the robot system,  obtaining a nonlinear system state equation;  S2,  based on the general kinematics and momentum conservation principle,  establishing a model around two scenes of operation and coordinated movement of the robot arm;  comprising the relationship between the arm momentum and the centroid momentum,  the task track at the end of the arm is tracked;  obtaining the task track tracking constraint and the angular momentum constraint of the arm end speed;  S3,  constructing nonlinear model prediction optimal control problem,  which is composed of cost function,  system state equation and constraint three parts;  using the solver to solve to obtain the output track of the optimized system;  S4,  establishing the whole body dynamics equation of the humanoid robot,  obtaining the robot feedforward joint moment according to the inverse dynamics equation,  combining with the joint PD control to obtain the output moment finally sent to the robot.

The present invention relates to the field of intelligent robot control technology Specifically,  the invention relates to a humanoid robot multi-modal environment perception and adaptive chassis control method The invention monitors the contact force vector and sliding trend in real time through multi-dimensional tactile sensors The spatiotemporal synchronization layer based on Lie group constraints maps pose drift to the chassis coordinate system,  generate compensation vectors,  a three-level tactile response layer is used to dynamically switch the force/position mixed impedance mode. Combined with the reverse translation of the omnidirectional chassis to offset drift,  and optimize the compensation parameters through the deep deterministic strategy gradient algorithm,  the system ensures the timing alignment of control instructions through a spatiotemporal stamp synchronization engine The inertial measurement unit is used to suppress the attitude oscillation during the compensation process,  the obstacle avoidance interference domain is constructed based on the kinematic chain of the operating arm,  and the B-spline curve is used to smooth the compensation trajectory,  which improves the accuracy,  stability and safety of the humanoid robot in complex contact operations,  and provides an efficient and reliable solution for human-machine collaboration scenarios. 1. A multi-modal environment sensing and self-adaptive chassis control method for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  real-time monitoring the contact force vector and the sliding trend at the tail end of the operating mechanism through the multi-dimensional touch sensor,  when the contact force vector exceeds the preset safety threshold value or the axial offset rate of the sliding trend is greater than 5 mm per second,  activating the cooperative compensation mechanism;  S2,  the cooperative compensation mechanism based on the space-time synchronous layer of the Li group constraint maps the positional posture drift amount generated by the contact force disturbance at the tail end of the operation mechanism to the chassis motion coordinate system,  generating the direction and amplitude of the chassis compensation vector;  S3,  performing double-system cooperative compensation execution based on the chassis compensation vector,  the double-system cooperative compensation execution comprises an operation mechanism control and a chassis motion control,  the operation mechanism control dynamically switches the force/bit mixed impedance mode according to the sliding trend,  that is,  the position dominant impedance control is used in the stable contact stage,  the force tracking impedance control is switched in the critical sliding stage,  the movement of the chassis controls the omni-directional moving chassis to translate along the direction opposite to the movement direction of the operating mechanism so as to counteract the positional drift in real time and maintain the positioning error of the tail end in the working coordinate system;  S4,  optimizing the mapping relation between the sliding trend judging threshold and the chassis compensation vector amplitude coefficient by the depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm.

This application discloses a method,  device and storage medium for controlling falling and turning over of a legged robot. First,  the falling posture information of the legged robot is obtained; then call the action selection model to perform multi-stage iterative turning action prediction based on the fall posture information Obtain the optimal turning action for each iteration stage,  and in each iteration stage,  control the foot robot to execute the optimal turning action of the current iteration stage. After executing each optimal turning action,  the foot robot will be in a stable posture,  and after executing the optimal turning action of the last iteration stage,  the foot robot will turn over successfully; among them,  when the action selection model is called to predict the multi-stage iterative turning action based on the falling posture information,  the action selection model predicts the optimal turning action in the next iteration stage based on the stable posture of the legged robot in the current iteration stage. This embodiment can reduce manual design costs and has high applicability. 1. A falling and turning over control method of foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the falling posture information of the foot-type robot;  invoking the action selection model to perform multi-stage iterative turning-over action prediction based on the falling posture information,  obtaining the optimal turning-over action of each iteration stage,  and in each iteration stage,  controlling the foot-type robot to perform the optimal turning-over action of the current iteration stage,  wherein the foot-type robot is in a stable posture after executing the optimal turning-over action of each iteration stage,  the foot-type robot is successfully turned over after executing the optimal turning-over action of the last iteration stage;  wherein when the action selection model is invoked to perform the multi-stage iterative turning-over action prediction based on the falling posture information,  the action selection model predicts the optimal turning-over action of the next iteration stage according to the stable posture of the foot robot in the current iteration stage.

The invention discloses a robot autonomous assembly method,  system,  storage medium and computer equipment based on imitation learning. This method constructs a universal expert strategy suitable for polygonal shaft hole assembly by analyzing and summarizing expert polygonal shaft hole assembly experience; according to this strategy,  task type images and human assembly demonstration data are collected,  including assembly force/torque and assembly actions; modeling human assembly skills as a common assembly skills model based on shared knowledge versus specific knowledge; use the loss function to guide the algorithm to train and optimize the general assembly model; deploy the optimized general assembly model into the robot's control system to drive the robot to perform humanoid assembly movements. The invention can overcome the problems of poor generalization performance,  slow convergence and high cost of the end-to-end learning method existing in the imitation learning method,  and can realize rapid learning of human skills and realize humanoid robot autonomous assembly. 1. A robot autonomous assembly method based on simulation learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  analyzing and summarizing expert polygon shaft hole assembling experience,  constructing universal expert strategy for polygon shaft hole assembling;  S2,  based on the universal expert strategy,  performing data collection through demonstration mode,  so as to construct a database;  S3,  constructing a universal assembly model based on shared knowledge and specific task knowledge production :  [Wv,  Fw] T = p - [Wf-Wfd,  F-F-d] T + z,  wherein p,  z represent skill control parameters associated with the assembly task;  Wfd,  Ftau d represent the threshold value of each assembly contact state;  S4,  based on the database,  adopting the loss function guide algorithm to train and optimize the universal assembly model;  S5,  deploying the optimized universal assembly model to the control system of the robot,  so as to drive the robot to perform humanoid assembly.

The invention discloses an interactive test method for human-shaped robot gait simulation,  which is applied to a test platform The method comprises the following steps of :  controlling a current gait simulation model corresponding to a virtual robot to perform a gait simulation test in a virtual test environment in a current preset time period; and sending the virtual test data to the physical robot; control the physical robot to perform corresponding gait operations in the actual test environment based on the virtual test data,  and send the real test data to the virtual robot; updating the current gait simulation model based on the virtual test data and the real test data; continue the above gait simulation test based on the updated gait simulation model,  and do not end the update operation until the end of the gait simulation test to generate a complete gait plan. Therefore,  by constructing a closed-loop interaction mechanism between virtual and physical robots,  it not only realizes the dynamic adjustment of the gait simulation model,  but also restores the gait of the physical robot and improves the stability and accuracy of the gait of the physical robot. 1. An interactive test method of humanoid robot gait simulation,  wherein it is applied to test platform;  the test platform comprises a physical robot and a virtual robot;  the physical robot is in communication connection with the virtual robot;  controlling the current gait simulation model corresponding to the virtual robot to perform gait simulation test in the current preset time period in the virtual test environment to generate the current virtual test data;  and sending the current virtual test data to the physical robot;  controlling the physical robot to execute the corresponding gait operation according to the current virtual test data in the actual test environment corresponding to the virtual test environment to generate the current real test data;  and sending the current real test data to the virtual robot;  based on the current virtual test data and the current real test data,  performing an updating operation on the current gait simulation model,  generating an updated gait simulation model;  taking the updated gait simulation model as the next gait simulation model corresponding to the next preset time period adjacent to the current preset time period,  continuing the gait simulation test in the next preset time period,  until the gait simulation test process is executed,  ending the updating operation of the gait simulation model,  generating a complete gait solution corresponding to the virtual test environment.

The invention relates to a multi-source emergency stop control system of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The multi-source emergency stop control system comprises a power management board,  a first interface and a second interface,  wherein the power management board is integrated with an MCU (Microprogrammed Control Unit) controller and an emergency stop relay which are connected with each other,  the first interface is connected with the emergency stop relay and is used for being connected with a power module,  and the second interface is connected with the MCU controller and is used for being connected with an emergency stop switch The edge computer is connected to the MCU controller through the third interface. The edge computer integrates a network module for remotely or remotely receiving external information and controlling the on and off of the emergency stop relay through the MCU controller. When the humanoid robot is abnormal,  the user can control the emergency stop by pressing the emergency stop switch,  and can also remotely control the network module through the remote control handle to achieve emergency stop control. The network module can be remotely controlled through electronic devices such as mobile phones to achieve emergency stop control. This application realizes the ability to control the emergency stop of the robot in various application scenarios,  and greatly improves the reliability of controlling the emergency stop of the humanoid robot. 1. This project proposes a complete Virtual Classroom system that uses networked audio communication,  simultaneous study material sharing,  and real-time 3D avatar animation to deliver immersive,  interactive,  and scalable remote learning. To create dynamically animated teacher and student avatars,  the system records user motion data using pose estimation in Python and sends it to Unity. For enhanced interaction,  study materials,  including PowerPoint presentations,  are shown in real time on both the student's personal interface and the virtual classroom wall. The system uses Netcode for GameObjects in Unity to facilitate interactive communication,  giving the teacher control over classroom interactions and student audio streams in a synchronized multiplayer setting. The smooth transfer of data between Python and Unity with responsiveness and real-time behavior is ensured by a lightweight socket-based bridge.The proposed architecture is a rich substitute for conventional video-based platforms and demonstrates flexibility,  extensibility,  and high relevance to remote education,  virtual training,  and collaborative learning.

An electronic device and a method for safety and control enhancement in tele-operated physical human-robot interactions. The electronic device receives robot capability parameters,  touch parameters,  and control parameters to control physical interaction of the human machine interactions (HMI) device. The electronic device controls the physical interaction of the HMI device based on the robot capability parameters,  the touch parameters,  and the control parameters. The electronic device determines a physical response of the user,  based on the control of the physical interaction of the HMI device and determines safety metrics of the user,  based on the physical response,  the robot capability parameters,  and the touch parameters. The electronic device determines control metrics associated with an operator,  based on the robot capability parameters,  and the control parameters. The electronic device controls the physical interaction of the HMI device further based on the control metrics and the safety metrics.

Methods and systems are provided for controlling wheel-legged quadrupedal robots using pose optimization and force control according to quadratic programming (QP) are disclosed. An example robotic system leverages the whole-body motion and the wheel actuation to roll over high obstacles while keeping the wheel torques to navigate the terrain. Wheel traction and balancing is employed for the robot body. Linear rigid body dynamics with wheels are used for real-time balancing control of wheel-legged robots. Further,  an effective pose optimization method is implemented for locomotion over steep ramp and stair terrains. The pose optimization solves for optimal poses to enhance stability and enforce collision-fee constraints for the rolling motion over stair terrain.

The present invention relates to a foot robot fault detection method based on a spatiotemporal graph convolutional network,  which adopts a deep learning model based on a spatiotemporal graph convolutional network. The deep learning model includes a time series gated convolution module and a spatial graph convolution module. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a joint diagram according to the joint connection relation of the robot; long-sequence feature extraction of joint maps using a time-series gated convolution module; the features obtained by the sequential gating convolution module are used as the input of the spatial graph convolution module. The spatial graph convolution layer performs convolution operations on node features through the adjacency matrix to capture the spatial dependency between nodes Feature extraction was performed multiple times through time-series gated convolution gating and spatial graph convolution modules to obtain the fault detection results of the legged robot during operation. The invention can improve the accuracy of foot robot fault detection and the generalization performance of the algorithm. 1. A foot-type robot fault detection method based on space-time graph convolution network,  wherein the deep learning model based on space-time graph convolution network is adopted,  the deep learning model comprises a time sequence gating convolution module and a space graph convolution module;  the method comprises the following steps :  S100,  constructing a joint diagram according to the joint connection relationship of the robot;  S200,  using the time sequence gating convolution module to extract the long sequence characteristic of the joint image;  S300,  using the characteristic obtained by the sequence gating convolution module as the input of the spatial graph convolution module,  wherein the spatial graph convolution layer performs convolution operation to the node characteristic through the adjacent matrix,  and captures the spatial dependency relationship between the nodes;  S400,  performing feature extraction through the time sequence gating volume gating and the spatial diagram convolution module for multiple times,  obtaining the foot robot fault detection result in the operation process.

The present invention pertains to a system method for using depth sensors on the fore,  aft and bottom sides of a legged robot for stair climbing. The method uses real-time depth information to help with a legged robot's navigation on a variety of leveled terrains. Sensing methods are employed in addition to generating a composite field of view stretching from the front to the back of the legged robot. Downward facing depth cameras positioned at a particular angle enable the system to guide a legged robot over an environment which is being navigated by offering a persistent view of the environment. Other tools such as heightmap filling gradient map calculation,  and strategic foothold selection are also implemented.

The present invention belongs to the field of humanoid robot valve control technology Specifically,  it relates to a humanoid robot global automatic screwing valve system and a control method The robot comprises a mobile chassis,  a lifting module,  a waist pitching module,  a robot body,  a tail end tool,  a sensor assembly and a control system,  wherein the robot body is provided with human-shaped double arms; the tail end tool is arranged at the tail ends of the human-shaped double arms; and the sensor assembly is used for environment sensing,  collecting valve height and attitude information and collecting operating torque information The control system is used to realize the rough positioning of the target valve,  automatically plan and control the mobile chassis to approach the valve according to the rough positioning result,  and adjust the height based on the collected valve height information; and control the humanoid arms and end tools to complete the screwing operation based on the recognized valve posture. The invention can automatically identify and operate different types of valves through an intelligent control system,  thereby reducing the time and cost of manual operation. 1. A control method of global automatic screwing valve system of humanoid robot,  wherein the global automatic screwing valve system comprises :  a mobile chassis configured with a multi-wheel drive system for moving and navigating;  a lifting module connected with the movable chassis and the robot body and configured to automatically adjust the working position of the robot body based on the sensed valve height information;  a waist pitching module linked with the lifting module and configured to support the pitching adjustment and left-right rotation of the robot body so as to adjust the working posture;  a robot body,  which is configured with a human-shaped double-arm,  the human-shaped double-arm has a plurality of degree-of-freedom joints;  a tail end tool,  configured at the tail end of the herringbone double-arm,  for grabbing and screwing the valve,  and capable of automatically adjusting grabbing force and clamping angle according to the shape and size of the valve;  a sensor component for sensing the environment,  collecting the valve height and attitude information and collecting the operation moment information;  The sensor assembly comprises :  a head depth camera arranged at the head of the robot and used for scanning the environment and roughly locating the valve;  a chest depth camera arranged on the chest of the robot and used for short-distance identification and precise location of the target valve;  a laser radar arranged on the movable chassis and the robot body for detecting the annular obstacle;  an ultrasonic sensor arranged at the front and back sides of the movable chassis for detecting the obstacles in the front and back directions;  a torque sensor configured on the human-shaped double-arm joint and the tail end tool for monitoring the torque and the stress condition in the operation in real time;  a control system,  comprising :  a valve identification module for performing environment sensing identification based on YOLO deep learning algorithm to realize rough location of the target valve;  a path planning module for automatically planning and controlling the movable chassis to approach the valve according to the rough locating result;  a height adjusting module for controlling the lifting module to adjust the height in real time based on the collected valve height information;  and a screwing operation module for identifying the valve posture,  controlling the human-shaped double arms based on the identified valve posture,  and finishing the screwing operation by the end tool;  The control method comprises the following steps :  S101 :  valve coarse positioning :  based on the YOLO deep learning algorithm,  performing real-time image identification and processing on the image obtained by the sensor assembly,  realizing the rough positioning result of the target valve;  S102,  close to the valve :  according to the rough locating result,  automatically planning and controlling the movable chassis to approach the valve;  S103,  real-time height adjustment :  in the process of approaching the valve,  the height information of the valve is continuously collected to control the lifting module to adjust the height so as to ensure that the humanoid double arms of the robot are in the proper height range;  S104,  posture identification and screwing execution :  when the robot is close to the valve,  the posture of the valve is precisely identified,  and the posture and the force of the two arms are adjusted according to the identification result to finish the screwing operation;  The S102 close to the valve comprises the following steps :  S301,  obtaining the spatial layout data of the target area,  constructing a three-dimensional map of the environment,  and dynamically updating the obstacle information,  wherein the spatial layout data comprises the position,  size and shape of the obstacle,  the distance between the valve and the obstacle and the ground condition;  S302,  according to the spatial layout data,  based on the laser SLAM and multi-sensor fusion technology,  combining the path planning algorithm,  generating the path from the current position to the valve,  the path planning considers the physical limitation of avoiding the obstacle and the robot;  S303,  controlling the humanoid robot to move along the path plan,  and monitoring the motion state through the real-time feedback system and adjusting;  The real-time height adjustment in S103 comprises the following steps :  S401,  collecting the real-time vertical distance information between the valve and the robot end tool in real time by the depth camera,  the laser radar and the ultrasonic sensor,  and obtaining the position of the target valve and the current relative height data;  S402,  calculating the difference between the current valve height and the preset target grabbing height of the robot,  obtaining the height adjusting amount,  and synchronously calculating the waist pitching angle adjusting amount,  so as to keep the waist vertical state;  S403,  controlling the lifting module to adjust the height according to the height adjusting amount,  and synchronously controlling the waist pitching module to adjust the pitching angle;  The step S104 of identifying the valve attitude comprises the following steps :  S601,  obtaining the image data set of the target valve from different visual angles through the mobile depth camera,  and recording the depth information;  S602,  recording the camera inner and outer parameter information of each image,  and performing camera calibration and pose estimation;  S603,  dividing the valve image by the Mask R-CNN algorithm to obtain the mark mask;  S604,  registering the multi-view image data with the depth information to generate the point cloud data of the scene;  S605,  using BundleSDF algorithm to perform three-dimensional reconstruction on the point cloud data,  constructing a valve three-dimensional model;  S606,  inputting the valve three-dimensional model into the FoundationPose algorithm,  obtaining the valve 6D attitude estimation under the camera visual angle;  S607,  combining the hand eye calibration result,  obtaining the posture conversion relationship between the camera and the mechanical arm,  calculating and recording the relative posture of the current mechanical arm end tool and the valve,  as the valve grabbing posture.

ABSTRACT Self-balancing robots are a fascinating combination of mechanical design,  sensor technology,  and control theory. These robots maintain dynamic stability by constantly monitoring their orientation and making real-time modifications to their actuators. Typically,  inertial measurement units (!MUs) with gyroscopes and accelerometers offer critical information on the robot's tilt and angular velocity. This data is then analyzed by a microcontroller,  which uses complex control algorithms like Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) or state-space control to generate the appropriate motor orders. These commands activate the robot's wheels or other actuators,  efficiently correcting any identified imbalances and maintaining an upright position.Developing a self-balancing robot requires overcoming a number of hurdles,  including sensor noise,  actuator limits,  and the inherent instability of the inverted pendulum system. Robust control algorithms must be developed to address these issues while ensuring steady and responsive functioning. Beyond the fundamental concepts of dynamic stability,  these robots are useful platforms for investigating sophisticated control techniques like Kalman filtering for sensor fusion and model predictive control for peak performance. The attitude control method for thermal failure of local joints includes :  when the internal temperature t ≥ t of any local joint motor on the humanoid robot is warned,  the humanoid robot executes The time t for pausing the execution of work task instructions in situ; if after the end of time T,  the internal temperature of all local joint motors on the humanoid robot is T < T warning,  the humanoid robot will continue to execute the work task instructions; if after the end of time T,  the internal temperature T of any local joint motor on the humanoid robot meets the T warning < T < T safety upper limit,  the humanoid robot stops the work task command and enters the humanoid robot cooling posture. A posture control method for handling overheating failure of local joint motor on humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the safety upper limit of the failure safety protection temperature T of each local joint motor on the humanoid robot;  setting the pre-warning temperature T of each local joint motor on the humanoid robot,  and the T pre-warning is less than the T safety upper limit;  obtaining the internal temperature T of each local joint motor on the humanoid robot in real time;  when the internal temperature T of any local joint motor of the humanoid robot is not less than T for early warning,  the humanoid robot executes the in-situ suspension execution of the working task instruction,  the suspension execution of the working task instruction duration is t,  after the time t is finished,  the humanoid robot executes the following tasks :  if the time t is over,  the internal temperature T of all local joint motors on the humanoid robot is less than T early warning,  the humanoid robot continues to execute the working task instruction;  if the time t is over,  the internal temperature T of any local joint motor on the humanoid robot meets the condition that T is less than T pre-warning and T is less than T safety upper limit,  the humanoid robot stops the working task instruction and enters the cooling posture of the humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control reinforcement learning method,  which includes :  constructing an agent architecture containing perception,  reinforcement learning,  decision-making and communication modules; through hierarchical reinforcement learning model,  the hierarchical action control of generating tactical-level sub-targets at the high level and generating specific action instructions at the bottom level is realized; in the adversarial environment,  the adversarial behavior is predicted through the adversarial modeling network and the reward function is embedded,  and the shared attention mechanism is adopted to optimize the collaborative strategy; during policy exploration and parameter update,  the policy entropy regularization term is superimposed and buffer update parameters are played back based on experience; the signal is broadcast asynchronously through the communication module,  and the receiver dynamically adjusts the strategy. This method enhances the versatility and adaptability of the humanoid robot system,  improves the learning efficiency and strategy optimization ability of the humanoid robot agent,  improves the performance of the humanoid robot in a non-cooperative environment,  enhances the robustness and stability of the system,  and can adapt to complex dynamic environments. 1. A strengthening learning method for motion control of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a robot intelligent agent framework :  each intelligent body is provided with a sensing module,  a strengthening learning module,  a decision module and a communication module;  S2,  realizing hierarchical action control through hierarchical reinforcement learning model :  the high level strategy receives the global state to generate the war level sub-target;  the bottom policy combines the global state and the sub-target to generate the specific action instruction;  S3. Confronting Environment Collaborative Optimization :  the countermeasure action is predicted by the countermeasure modelling network,  and the predicted result is embedded in the reward function;  adopting the shared attention mechanism to calculate the state association weight between the intelligent agents,  weighting and optimizing the cooperative strategy;  S4. strategy search and parameter update :  superposing strategy entropy regularization term in strategy optimization target function,  and balancing exploration and utilization;  iteratively updating the policy network parameters based on the historical data of the empirical playback buffer;  S5,  dynamic environment adaptation :  asynchronously broadcasting the local state or intention signal through the communication module;  the receiver deduces the environment information according to the strengthening learning module and dynamically adjusts the action strategy.

The invention relates to a high-leg robot for collecting tunnel lining and road surface disease images at one time. The leg structure of the robot adopts four vertical telescopic columns to adapt to tunnels of different heights. It can realize full coverage of the inner wall of the tunnel and the road surface at one time.,  high-resolution disease image collection also saves costs It uses a wide-angle camera and a line scan camera combined with a multi-angle adjustable rotating pan/tilt to ensure one-time collection of tunnel images in various complex environments. The data processing module is capable of stitching the acquired images and 4D modeling based on BIM technology. The 4D model not only records the coordinates of the robot's walking path in the spatial dimension,  but also records the detection time points through the time dimension t to record the crack conditions in different periods in the same model to achieve dynamic monitoring. By comparing the development of cracks in different periods,  we can clearly see the expansion trend,  thereby predicting the direction,  accurately formulating maintenance plans,  and reducing unnecessary repairs. 1. A high-leg robot for one-off collection of tunnel lining and road surface disease image,  wherein it comprises :  the main control module,  the image collecting module,  the data storing and transmitting module,  the data processing module,  the motion control module,  the auxiliary lighting module and the power supply management module are connected with other modules to ensure the integral cooperative work of the device.

The invention provides an interaction method and system of a space intelligent flying robot in a microgravity environment,  and belongs to the field of artificial interaction In order to solve the problems of large task understanding deviation and low execution efficiency in the existing robot interaction system in the microgravity environment due to its complex hardware equipment and software management system The invention includes a standby mode,  an autonomous flight mode,  an autonomous mapping mode and a pan/tilt shooting mode,  and integrates three interactive methods :  touch screen interface,  voice interaction and fuselage light language; the touch screen interface can receive complex task instructions and feedback interactive information in real time; voice interaction enables operators to quickly issue instructions in a contactless manner; the body lights can provide real-time feedback on the robot's motion status,  effectively improving safety and reliability; the three interaction modes complement each other,  which not only significantly improves the efficiency of human-computer interaction,  but also enhances the convenience of operation and the reliability of task execution. 1. An interaction method of space intelligent flying robot under microgravity environment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S100,  when the flying robot is in the standby mode,  the data information is collected by the image data collecting module,  and the emergency braking of the robot is realized by the emergency control module,  including braking and emergency stopping;  S200. when the flying robot is in the autonomous flying mode,  the target point execution instruction and the set machine body posture sent by the user are obtained through the multifunctional interaction module,  the flying robot performs autonomous planning and avoids obstacles to reach the target point according to the data collected by the image data collecting module and the surrounding environment data collected by the airborne sensor,  and switching to the set machine body posture;  S300,  when the flying robot is in the drawing mode,  the flying robot maintains the current position or the set position,  performs the initial location by scanning the visual label,  and then performs the drawing,  and displays on the display module by the multifunctional interaction module;  S400,  when the flying robot is in the tripod head shooting mode,  comprising a wall-sticking shooting mode and a human-shaped tracking mode,  in the wall-sticking shooting mode,  using the image data collecting module to detect whether there is a wall around the flying robot body,  if there is no wall,  performing wall-free warning,  when there is a wall,  performing wall-sticking action,  the shooting and recording functions of the image data collecting module are started to realize the fixed-point shooting and recording under the state of absorbing and fixing the wall surface;  in the human shape tracking mode,  starting the human shape tracking function,  continuously sending the tracking information and the target characteristic point position to the conveying module,  obtaining the posture control instruction after calculating and sending to the moving module,  changing the posture of the machine body by the moving module to keep the tracking object in the centre of the shooting picture.

The invention discloses a method for generating gait of a biped robot based on an enhanced confrontation motion prior,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control Including :  building enhanced PPO ‑ AMP networks; establish action network model,  evaluation network model and AMP module; establish a motion model of the biped robot and select a simulation experimental environment; based on the simulation experiment environment,  use the reward function that combines task reward and style reward,  and the improved PPO ‑ Clip mechanism and KL divergence constraints to perform reinforcement learning on the enhanced PPO ‑ AMP network to obtain optimized network parameters; generating a bipedal robot gait that satisfies actual walking tasks using an optimized enhanced PPO ‑ AMP network. According to the invention,  by optimizing the environment perception capability,  deepening the network structure,  improving the reward mechanism and the training strategy,  the control method for the biped robot to simultaneously have high robustness and high natural gait on various complex terrains is realized 1. A biped robot gait generating method based on enhanced confrontation movement prior,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) constructing an enhanced PPO-AMP network;  establishing an action network model,  an evaluation network model and an AMP module,  wherein the AMP module introduces the priori data of the antagonistic motion,  and generates a style reward by judging the network;  (2) establishing biped robot motion model,  selecting simulation experiment environment;  (3) based on the simulation experiment environment,  using the reward function combined with the task reward and the style reward,  and combining the improved PPO-Clip mechanism with the KL divergence constraint to perform reinforcement learning on the enhanced PPO-AMP network,  obtaining the optimized network parameter;  (4) using the optimized enhanced PPO-AMP network to generate the biped robot gait satisfying the actual walking task.

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control,  and discloses a humanoid robot real-time control performance evaluation method,  which includes :  calculating the control output of the humanoid robot's obstacle-crossing gait control under the set standard state; then control the humanoid robot over obstacles under different terrain and obstacles to obtain the standard value of control deviation; setting a plurality of centroid heights of the humanoid robot when facing different obstacles to surmount obstacles,  and using them as the standard fluctuation range of centroid heights; establish a control comparison table to monitor the control deviation and center of mass height of the humanoid robot in real time when it surpasses obstacles,  and compare it with the corresponding standard values in the control comparison table to determine the real-time control performance of the humanoid robot. The invention evaluates the control performance of the humanoid robot when crossing obstacles,  and can promptly understand the stability problem of the humanoid robot when crossing obstacles,  so as to promptly adjust the control of the humanoid robot and ensure the stable gait of the humanoid robot when crossing obstacles. 1. A real-time control performance evaluation method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  according to the posture information of the humanoid robot,  calculating the control output amount of the obstacle-crossing gait control of the humanoid robot under the set standard state;  according to the control output quantity,  performing obstacle crossing control on the human-shaped robot under different terrain and different obstacles,  so as to obtain the control deviation standard value;  the method comprises the following steps :  measuring by an inclined platform method to set multiple centroid heights of the human-shaped robot when the human-shaped robot faces different obstacles to cross the obstacle,  and setting the multiple centroid heights as the standard fluctuation range of the centroid height;  forming a unique mapping relation between the control deviation standard value,  the centroid height standard fluctuation range and the corresponding terrain and obstacle,  and establishing a control comparison table;  real-time monitoring the control deviation and the mass centre height of the human-shaped robot when crossing the obstacle,  and comparing the real-time monitored control deviation and the mass centre height with the corresponding standard value in the control comparison table according to the terrain and the obstacle;  determining the real-time control performance of the humanoid robot according to the comparison result;  wherein the real-time control performance comprises good,  middle and bad.

The present invention relates to a Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) system that utilizes machine learning to accurately detect and classify emotions from speech signals. The system processes raw speech data through preprocessing to remove noise and enhance the quality of the signal. Key emotional features,  including pitch,  tone,  and prosody,  are extracted and analyzed using advanced deep learning algorithms like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs). These models classify the speech into predefined emotional states such as happiness,  sadness,  and anger. A post-processing unit ensures stable and consistent emotion detection over time. The system is adaptable to different speakers,  accents,  and noisy environments,  improving robustness and accuracy. This invention has applications in virtual assistants,  healthcare,  customer service,  and human-robot interaction,  offering enhanced emotional intelligence for more responsive and intuitive interactions.

SELF-HEALING,  SHAPE-SHIFTING SOFT ROBOT WITH ADAPTIVE MATERIALS AND AI CONTROL FOR HAZARDOUS ENVIRONMENTS. The present invention discloses an autonomous robotic system comprising a robotic chassis formed at least in part from smart materials including phase-change alloys or biodegradable hydrogels,  the smart materials configured to self-heal upon detection of structural damage;  at least one shape-memory alloy (SMA) actuator configured to facilitate morphological adaptation of the robotic chassis in real-time;  a sensor array comprising optical sensors,  fiber-optic strain gauges,  and environmental detectors for monitoring damage and environmental conditions;  and a control unit configured to execute Evolutionary Algorithm Reinforcement Learning (EARL) in combination with dynamic neuro-fuzzy systems (DNFS),  wherein the control unit optimizes robotic behaviour for self-repair and shape-shifting based on real-time environmental feedback.

Disclosed in the present invention are a multi-modal shared teleoperation system and method for a three-arm space robot. The system at least comprises a master-side teleoperation system,  a communication module and a slave-side robot system,  wherein the master-side teleoperation system at least comprises two force feedback hand controllers,  a microphone array and upper computer software,  and the slave-side robot system comprises two operating arms each equipped with a gripper at the end,  an observation arm having a binocular camera mounted at the end,  a vision unit,  a force sensor and lower computer software. The method comprises :  an operator controlling two operating arms of an extravehicular robot to execute a task,  and controlling an observation arm to acquire a better local field of view. In the method,  a multi-modal teleoperation method comprising pose control,  voice control and force control is fused with autonomous control of a robot by means of a shared control algorithm,  and thus,  human-robot collaborative control over the position,  orientation and contact force of a robotic arm can be realized on the basis of the requirements of the operator,  and the robot autonomously executes other relatively simple tasks,  thereby reducing the operation burden of operators,  and improving the control efficiency.

The invention discloses a method for optimizing the walking stability of a bipedal robot based on an improved PPO algorithm Specifically,  by introducing long and short-term memory into the neural network,  selectively retain the previous stage sample information to fit the predictions of subsequent samples And add an attention mechanism to the action network to dynamically and adaptively weight the input features Fitting the variable weight dependence of state information at different time steps on subsequent actions,  an improved PPO algorithm is obtained,  which can solve the walking control problems of bipedal robots in different environments,  including the parameter adjustment of simulation training and the stability of walking motion. The simulated robot walking environment used adopts the Bipedalwalker-v3 environment in Gym developed by Open AI; the pre-training control parameters are trained and adjusted using a modified PPO algorithm; the stability of the walking motion of the biped robot is realized by a trained controller 1. A method for optimizing walking stability of biped robot based on improved PPO algorithm,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  building the improved PPO algorithm neural network model;  establishing an action network model and an evaluation network model,  the action network adopts a layer of full connection layer,  a layer of LSTM layer and a layer of MHSA,  the evaluation network adopts two layers of full connection layer and a layer of LSTM layer;  step two :  establishing biped robot motion model,  selecting simulation experiment environment;  the overall structure of the biped robot is simplified,  which is simplified to include a waist part,  two thighs,  a simple structure of two crus,  the simple structure comprises two hip joints and two knee joints,  the four joints are rotary joints,  a four-degree-of-freedom biped robot motion model is established,  a tool bag in OpenAI Gym is selected as simulation experiment environment; The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage equipment detection,  and discloses a temperature detection control method and system for an electric power energy storage module. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring infrared image data of the energy storage module from a first acquisition point,  and identifying a first target and a second target If only the first target is recognized and the matching value is low,  control the acquisition point to move in the first direction until the matching value reaches the standard,  update the image and continue recognition; at this time,  if there is still only the first target,  calculate its temperature value and combine the temperature value obtained by the proximity temperature measurement module to calculate the comprehensive temperature value as the detection temperature value. If two targets are recognized and the distance is too close,  the acquisition point is controlled to move in the second direction,  and the first target temperature value is calculated as the detection temperature value after updating the image. Finally,  an alarm is given when the detected temperature value exceeds the preset alarm value. By flexibly adjusting the location of the collection point and measuring temperature in multiple ways,  interference is effectively eliminated,  the temperature of the energy storage module is accurately detected,  and abnormalities are warned in a timely manner,  which improves the accuracy of detection. 1. A temperature detection control method of power energy storage module,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the initial infrared image data corresponding to the energy storage module in real time based on the first collecting point;  identifying a first target and a second target from the initial infrared image data;  if the first target is identified and the second target is not identified,  calculating the matching value of the initial infrared image data and the first target;  if the matching value is less than the preset first reference value,  controlling the first collecting point to move a preset distance in the first direction until the matching value is greater than the preset second reference value;  updating the initial infrared image data as the updated infrared image data,  and continuously identifying the first target and the second target;  wherein the first reference value is less than the second reference value;  the matching value comprehensively consider the definition,  integrity and characteristic fit degree of the target in the image,  endow the three calculation results with different weights,  and obtain the matching value through weighted summation;  if the updated infrared image data still identifies the first target and does not identify the second target,  calculating the first temperature value of the first target according to the infrared image data;  controlling the proximity temperature measuring module to be close to the first target,  and measuring the temperature of the first target to obtain a second temperature value;  calculating according to the first temperature value and the second temperature value to obtain a comprehensive temperature value,  and outputting the comprehensive temperature value as a first target detection temperature value;  The proximity temperature measuring module is a device capable of performing non-contact near-distance temperature measurement close to the first target,  comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a temperature measuring sensor,  a humanoid robot,  an unmanned trolley or a mechanical arm;  otherwise,  if the first target and the second target are identified,  calculating the distance between the first target and the second target as the target distance;  if the target distance is less than the preset first reference distance,  controlling the first collecting point to move in the second direction for a preset distance until the target distance is greater than the preset second reference distance;  wherein the first direction and the second direction have a set included angle;  updating the initial infrared image data,  calculating the third temperature value of said first target according to the updated infrared image data,  and outputting said third temperature value as the first target detection temperature value;  when the target distance is less than the preset first reference distance,  the first target and the second target are overlapped or adjacent to each other in the image;  if the output first target detection temperature value is greater than the preset alarm temperature value,  performing the alarm prompt.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot real-time collaborative decision-making method based on multi-modal perception fusion The method comprises the following steps of :  dynamically deploying a sensor array,  acquiring multi-modal original sensing data of the humanoid robot through the deployed sensor array,  and performing physiological signal fusion processing and multi-modal feature enhancement processing on the multi-modal original sensing data to obtain a multi-level feature set; using a cross-modal semantic reasoning system supported by a large model,  cross-modal semantic mapping and intention reasoning are performed on the multi-level feature set to obtain collaborative execution instructions containing target actions and force control parameters; based on the collaborative execution instructions,  a dual-buffer collaborative distributed incremental learning mechanism is used to dynamically update the behavioral decision-making model of the humanoid robot,  and based on the behavioral decision-making model,  a real-time collaborative decision-making of the humanoid robot is obtained. A humanoid robot automatically measures an average walking speed of human workers using a group of sensors. The humanoid robot is moved at a speed equivalent to the measured walking speed. The moving speeds in the entire working environment can be synchronized (first-stage synchronization). A speaker plays a rhythm that can be heard by both the human workers and the humanoid robots at the same time. By playing this rhythmic music on a floor,  all of the human workers and the humanoid robots are synchronized to the same rhythm (second-stage synchronization). If the music is played at 1.2x speed 1.2 to the walking speed A (A×1.2) of the human workers,  the entire flow of movement can be synchronized to a 1.2 times faster rhythm with fewer accidents (e.g.,  contacts,  collisions,  etc.) (third-stage synchronization).

A deep strengthening learning type tool body intelligent method for hybrid electric vehicle,  wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps :  S1 :  self-defining off-line training and modelling online test solution; Compared with the existing technology,  the robot's strategy of escorting pets based on the preset escort routes,  actions and audio sent by the wireless terminal,  according to the scheme,  the interaction between the humanoid robot and the user in the unstructured environment is more coherent,  the response speed of the humanoid robot to the user instruction or the environment in the humanoid service process is improved,  and the intelligence of the humanoid robot is improved 1. A non-structured environment monitored tool body task data processing method,  wherein it is applied to the controller of the human-shaped robot with the monitored task control system,  the monitored task control system further comprises a server and a user interaction terminal,  the method comprises :  determining a target task mode based on the network connection state,  the target task mode is used for restricting the selection of the target device,  the target device is the device for the controller of the humanoid robot to send data in real time,  the target device comprises the server,  the network connection state comprises that it is connected with the user interaction terminal through the wide area network;  obtaining the visual sensing picture information of the external environment,  and sending the visual sensing picture information to the target device,  wherein the external environment comprises an unstructured environment;  receiving a target object and an operation instruction from the server,  the operation instruction is an instruction generated by the server based on the target object for controlling the humanoid robot,  the target object is the appointed object represented by the image region obtained by the target device based on the visual perception picture information and the image video segmentation model,  the image video segmentation model is used for performing image segmentation to the visual perception picture information to obtain the image region;  controlling the humanoid robot to reach a target gesture based on the operation instruction and to initiate a target operation to the target object,  the target operation including interacting based on interaction information from the server or from the user interaction terminal,  the target gesture including a gesture facing the target object.

This application discloses an AED first aid method and related products based on humanoid robots. The method includes :  obtaining a target surveillance video,  and determining the target person to be first aided based on the target surveillance video; obtain the location,  identity information and abnormal starting time of the target personnel to be rescued; control the humanoid robot to obtain the target AED device and obtain the attribute information of the target device; obtain the target position of the humanoid robot at the current moment; generate a target first aid route between the target location and the person location; estimate the target time consumption based on the target first aid route; determine the target first aid strategy based on the target device attribute information,  personnel identity information and target time consumption; control the humanoid robot to go to the person's position,  and control the humanoid robot to use the target AED device to provide first aid to the target person waiting for first aid according to the target first aid strategy. By adopting the embodiment of the application,  the first aid efficiency of the AED equipment is improved 1. An AED first-aid method based on humanoid robot,  wherein it is applied to the control module of the humanoid robot,  the humanoid robot is in communication connection with the target monitoring system in the target public area,  the method comprises :  obtaining the target monitoring video collected by the target monitoring system,  and determining the person to be first aid in the target public area according to the target monitoring video,  obtaining the target person to be first aid;  obtaining the personnel position,  personnel identity information and abnormal starting time of the object to-be-first-aid personnel;  controlling the humanoid robot to obtain the target AED device and obtain the target device attribute information of the target AED device;  obtaining the target position of the humanoid robot at the current time;  generating a target emergency route between the target position and the person position;  estimating the arrival time of the humanoid robot to the position of the person according to the target first-aid route;  determining the target consumption time length between the abnormal starting time and the reaching time;  determining a target first aid strategy according to the target device attribute information,  the personnel identity information and the target consumption time length;  controlling the human-shaped robot to advance according to the target first-aid route,  when reaching the position of the person,  according to the target first-aid strategy,  controlling the human-shaped robot to use the target AED device to perform first-aid to the target person to be first-aid,  so as to save the target person to be first-aid;  Wherein,  the personnel identity information comprises :  a target age,  a target muscle type parameter;  The target muscle type parameter comprises at least one of the following :  muscle mass,  muscle strength,  muscle density;  determining a target first aid policy according to the target device attribute information,  the personnel identity information and the target consumption time length,  comprising :  obtaining an initial working parameter set corresponding to the attribute information of the target device,  wherein the initial working parameter set comprises multiple initial working parameters,  each initial working parameter is corresponding to an age range;  Each initial working parameter includes :  defibrillation energy,  duration;  determining the target initial working parameter corresponding to the target age in the initial working parameter set;  The target initial working parameter comprises :  a first defibrillation energy,  a first duration;  determining a first adjusting parameter corresponding to the target muscle type parameter,  specifically,  pre-storing a preset mapping relationship between the muscle type parameter and the adjusting parameter,  and determining the first adjusting parameter corresponding to the target muscle type parameter based on the mapping relationship;  adjusting the first defibrillation energy according to the first adjusting parameters to obtain a second defibrillation energy;  determining a second adjusting parameter corresponding to the target consumption time length;  adjusting the first duration according to the second adjusting parameter to obtain a second duration;  determining the target defibrillation times and the target defibrillation time interval corresponding to the target consumption time length;  generating the target first aid strategy according to the target defibrillation times,  the target defibrillation time interval,  the second defibrillation energy and the second duration.

The invention discloses a biped robot task navigation method based on image segmentation and a related device. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a plurality of characteristic objects obtained by performing image segmentation on panoramic image information acquired by a sensing module based on a target place; determine whether there is a target idle position in the target location based on the spatial characteristics of the plurality of characteristic objects,  the spatial characteristics of the biped robot and the spatial characteristics of the target location; detect the existence of a target idle location in the target location,  and determine a target behavior strategy based on the person recognition results of the multiple characteristic objects; controlling the bipedal robot to execute the target behavior strategy The characteristic objects obtained after image segmentation of the collected panoramic images are detected multiple times,  the target behavior strategy of the robot is determined based on the detection results,  and the elevator delivery task is completed by self-service decision-making according to the conditions,  without the need for other elevator passengers to provide help,  which is conducive to improving The intelligence of robots in performing elevator delivery tasks 1. A biped robot task navigation method based on image segmentation,  wherein it is applied to the control module of the biped robot,  the biped robot comprises the control module and a sensing module in communication connection with the control module,  the method comprises :  obtaining a plurality of characteristic objects obtained by the sensing module based on the panoramic image information collected by the target place;  determining whether there is a target idle position in the target place according to the space characteristic of the multiple characteristic objects,  the space characteristic of the biped robot and the space characteristic of the target place;  performing character recognition on the plurality of characteristic objects to obtain a character recognition result;  detecting that the character identification result is that there is character object in the multiple characteristic objects,  determining the target action strategy is outputting the first voice,  navigating to the target idle position,  determining the first action strategy according to the obtained elevator floor control plate image collected by the sensing module;  detecting that the character identification result is that there is no character object in the multiple characteristic objects,  determining the target action strategy as navigation to the target idle position,  pressing the target floor key of the elevator floor control plate;  controlling the biped robot to execute the target behaviour strategy.

A humanoid robot manipulator component,  wherein it comprises several carriers and clamping bodies installed on each carrier;  the multiple clamping bodies are linearly arranged,  annularly arranged or oppositely arranged,  and the multiple clamping bodies can be matched with each other or matched with the carrier to clamp the object.

The invention provides a method for monitoring the joint life of a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the technical field of life monitoring The method comprises the following steps of :  1,  constructing a multi-modal sensor array to acquire original joint motion data of a target robot; step 2 :  Standardize the original joint motion data according to feature types to obtain standard feature data of all parameter types; step 3 :  Establish a joint degradation model of the target robot based on standard feature data; step 4 :  Input the real-time motion data of the target robot into the joint degradation model and output the joint remaining life index; step 5 :  When the remaining life index of the joint is lower than the preset threshold,  trigger the adaptive maintenance strategy. Improve robot reliability by monitoring joint health in real time,  providing early warning and optimizing maintenance. 1. A method for monitoring joint life of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  step 1 :  constructing a multi-modal sensor array to collect the original joint motion data of the target robot;  step 2 :  standardizing the original joint motion data according to the characteristic type to obtain the standard characteristic data of all parameter types;  step 3 :  establishing a joint degradation model of the target robot based on the standard characteristic data;  step 4 :  inputting the real-time motion data of the target robot into the joint degeneration model and outputting the joint residual life index;  step 5 :  when the residual life index of the joint is lower than the preset threshold value,  triggering the self-adaptive maintenance strategy.
