The invention relates to a foot mechanism of a flying humanoid robot and the flying humanoid robot. The foot mechanism comprises a leg connecting structure,  an ankle joint structure and a toe structure,  wherein the ankle joint structure is movably connected with the leg connecting structure and the toe structure respectively The ankle joint structure comprises a supporting part,  a driving unit and a thrust mechanism,  the toe structure and the leg connecting structure are movably arranged on the supporting part,  and the thrust mechanism is partially embedded in the supporting part The invention aims to overcome the defect that the flying robot in the prior art can not give consideration to walking stability and air maneuverability,  and the thrust mechanism of the invention adopts an embedded design,  so that the landing stability and the air maneuverability of the robot can be met at the same time The central axis of the thrust mechanism is located on the annular plane of the annular outer track,  that is,  it adopts a semi-enclosed design,  which can not only reduce the space occupied by all inlays,  but also avoid the thrust deviation caused by all exposures,  so that the robot can have higher landing stability and air maneuverability. 1. A foot mechanism of flying humanoid robot,  comprising a leg connecting structure (100),  an ankle joint structure (200),  and a toe structure (300),  wherein the ankle joint structure (200) is respectively movably connected with the leg connecting structure (100) and the toe structure (300);  wherein the ankle joint structure (200) comprises a supporting component (210),  a driving unit (220),  a thrust mechanism (230),  the toe structure (300) and the leg connecting structure (100) are movably installed on the supporting component (210),  the thrust mechanism (230) is partially embedded in the supporting component (210),  The driving unit (220) is located beside the thrust mechanism (230) and is connected with the supporting part (210),  and can drive the supporting part (210) relative to the leg connecting structure (100).

This application discloses a robot gait test optimization method,  device,  equipment and storage medium. By expanding the interval of historical gait parameters and randomly generating new virtual gait parameters,  this application can break through the limitation of fixed parameter intervals in the traditional gait optimization process and improve the diversity and environmental adaptability of gait parameter sampling; by determining the friction coefficient in the current test environment and inputting it together with the virtual gait parameters into the simulation model,  the obtained simulation test results will be evaluated by a weighted fusion objective function composed of stability,  energy efficiency and anthropomorphism,  so that subsequent dynamic trade-offs and collaborative optimization among multiple performance indicators can be achieved According to the error between the simulation test result and the actual test result,  the value interval of the virtual gait parameter,  the friction coefficient learning rate and the objective function weight coefficient are dynamically adjusted,  so that the simulation and actual test results can be quickly converged,  and the iteration efficiency of the gait optimization process and the comprehensive performance of the final gait can be improved 1. A robot gait test optimization method,  wherein it comprises :  performing interval expansion to the value range of the existing multi-group gait parameter in history,  obtaining the virtual gait parameter value interval,  and randomly generating multi-group virtual gait parameter in the virtual gait parameter value interval;  wherein said gait parameter comprises joint angle and angular velocity;  determining the friction coefficient under the current test environment,  inputting the friction coefficient and multiple groups of virtual gait parameter into the gait simulation model to calculate the simulation test result corresponding to each group of virtual gait parameter;  the simulation test result comprises simulation stability,  simulation energy efficiency and simulation humanoid;  weighting and fusing the simulation test result corresponding to each group of virtual gait parameters based on the preset target function to obtain the simulation evaluation value corresponding to each group of virtual gait parameters;  sequencing the simulation score values from small to big,  inputting the virtual gait parameters corresponding to the former alpha simulation score values to the robot for gait test,  and calculating to obtain the actual test result;  the actual test result comprises actual stability,  actual energy efficiency and actual anthropomorphic property;  calculating the simulation error between the simulation test result and the actual test result,  and readjusting at least one of the following parameters according to the simulation error :  the virtual gait parameter value interval is used for determining the learning rate of the friction coefficient or the weighting coefficient for weighting in the target function;  based on the updated parameter,  re-executing the step of performing interval expansion on the value range of the historical existing multi-group gait parameter,  obtaining the virtual gait parameter value interval,  and randomly generating multi-group virtual gait parameter in the virtual gait parameter value interval and updating the iteration times,  until the simulation error satisfies the preset condition or reaches the maximum iteration times.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot action generation method based on a cognitive feedback mechanism. The humanoid robot action generation method based on the cognitive feedback mechanism comprises the following steps of S1,  acquiring and preprocessing multi-modal sensing data S2. Intent recognition and cognitive feedback based on standardized perceptual feature vectors; s3. Retrieve candidate actions based on intention tags and construct an action parameter space; s4. The beetle search algorithm globally optimizes the action parameters and obtains the optimal action sequence; s5. Issue and execute the optimal action sequence and collect real-time feedback information; s6. Adjust the intention confidence and cognitive reasoning results based on the feedback,  and determine whether to re-execute or output the final result. The invention realizes the intelligent perception,  adaptive action generation and dynamic optimization of the humanoid robot to complex environments and user intentions,  and improves the intelligence and safety of human-computer interaction. 1. A humanoid robot action generating method based on cognitive feedback mechanism,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  collecting the multi-mode sensing data in the environment where the human-shaped robot is located,  pre-processing the multi-mode sensing data,  generating a standard sensing characteristic vector;  S2,  based on the standardized sensing feature vector,  using the method of intention identification and cognitive feedback,  through multi-modal depth neural network fusion analysis,  identifying the current intention and intention confidence degree of the user,  generating the intention tag,  and outputting the cognitive feedback signal;  S3,  transferring the candidate action sequence corresponding to the identified intention from the action database according to the intention label,  and constructing an action parameter space based on the current environment information;  S4,  performing global optimization on the action parameter space by using the celestial beard search algorithm,  taking the current candidate action solution as the search individual,  performing optimization on the action parameter based on the celestial beard search mechanism,  obtaining the optimal action sequence;  S5,  sending the optimal action sequence to the humanoid robot for execution,  collecting the real-time feedback information in the action execution process,  as feedback input to the intention identification and cognitive feedback link;  S6,  according to the real-time feedback information,  adjusting the intention confidence level and the cognitive reasoning result,  if it is detected that the action does not completely satisfy the identification intention or the environment has obvious change,  then returning to step S2,  re-executing the intention identification and the action optimization process,  until the action completion level satisfies the set requirement,  if the action completion level satisfies the set requirement,  and outputting the final action execution result.

The invention provides a freight inquiry task distribution method,  equipment and a medium. A task allocation method for freight interrogation disc,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the departure place,  the destination and the expected arrival time corresponding to the inquiry task;  determining each alternative flight between the departure place and the destination,  and destination airport information corresponding to the destination;  obtaining the carrying robot information corresponding to the target airport;  determining the target conveying time length corresponding to the target airport according to the conveying robot information and the goods information to be conveyed corresponding to the disc inquiring task;  according to the target carrying time length and the flight time length corresponding to each alternative flight,  determining the estimated transportation time length corresponding to each alternative flight;  determining a target flight from the candidate flights according to the expected arrival time and the predicted transportation time length corresponding to each of the candidate flights;  obtaining the service personnel corresponding to the target flight as the target service personnel,  and distributing the inquiry task to the task queue corresponding to the target service personnel.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot reinforcement learning motion planning method and system based on depth vision,  and relates to the technical field of quadruped robot motion planning The method comprises the following steps of :  building a simulation environment,  and modeling stair topography with different slopes and robot dynamic parameters,  wherein the stair topography model comprises stair topography with different difficulty differences; load the robot model to move in the stair terrain model,  track the robot's movement status,  and obtain the speed tracking effect. The speed tracking effect is obtained by strategic evaluation of the joint torque value output by the teacher's strategy network and the corresponding movement linear speed of the robot during the movement process; evaluate the speed tracking effect and adaptively adjust the environmental parameters in the stair terrain model based on the evaluation results. Through the reinforcement learning framework based on depth visual information,  the present invention can effectively learn irregular stair terrain,  so that the quadruped robot can adaptively operate stably in complex environments. 1. A four-legged robot intensive learning movement planning method based on deep vision,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  building a simulation environment,  modelling the staircase terrains with different gradients,  obtaining a staircase terrains model,  modelling the robot dynamics parameter,  obtaining a robot model,  wherein the staircase terrains model comprises staircase terrains with different difficulty differences;  loading the robot model to move in the stair terrain model,  tracking the moving condition of the robot to obtain the speed tracking effect,  wherein the robot performs strategy evaluation on the joint torque value output by the teacher strategy network and the corresponding moving linear speed in the moving process to obtain the speed tracking effect;  Specifically,  it comprises the teacher strategy network training process of the first stage and the student strategy network training process of the second stage;  in the first stage,  using the local height map,  and combining the robot main body sensing information and other privilege information,  inputting to the teacher strategy network,  through GRU and MLP processing strategy input,  extracting the terrain characteristic and motion state,  outputting the robot leg joint torque;  wherein the privileged information comprises terrain friction coefficient,  target path point,  machine body inertia,  machine body quality,  motor strength,  motor torque output ratio and communication delay time;  in the second stage,  using the CNN-GRU network to extract the travelling direction and speed from the depth image obtained from the depth camera,  combining the robot main body sensing information as input,  setting the initialization parameter of the student strategy network as the depth copy from the first stage,  the output of the first stage is used for monitoring and learning to obtain the output action;  obtaining the initial three-dimensional point cloud data,  after filtering and coordinate conversion processing the initial three-dimensional point cloud data,  generating a local two-dimensional height map as a local height map through projection and bilinear interpolation algorithm;  evaluating the speed tracking effect,  and adaptively adjusting the environment parameter in the stair terrain model according to the evaluation result.

The invention belongs to the technical field of upper limb auxiliary training,  and discloses an upper limb auxiliary training device based on early hemiplegia,  which includes :  an analysis module,  a design module,  a training module,  and an optimization module; the training device of the present invention transmits the feeling input to the patient in real time through the integrated circuit and the pressure sensor,  and adjusts the stimulation intensity and auxiliary strength according to the patient's feedback. Through clinical practice verification,  it is proved that the active movement induction training of upper limb extensor muscles in the early stage of hemiplegia has a significant effect in promoting movement recovery and improving upper limb function. The invention provides a new technical solution for early hemiplegia rehabilitation treatment,  reduces the workload of grassroots therapists,  and promotes the development of early rehabilitation It is of great significance to promote the functional recovery of hemiplegic patients,  improve the quality of life of patients,  and reduce the burden on families and society. 1. An upper limb auxiliary training device based on early hemiplegy,  wherein it comprises :  a fixed supporting platform,  a multi-joint mechanical arm,  a flexible binding module,  a control and programming system,  a feedback and data collecting system;  the fixed supporting platform is provided with a multi-angle adjusting mechanism and a buffer pad for supporting the upper limb of the patient;  the multi-joint mechanical arm comprises a shoulder joint component,  an elbow joint component,  a wrist joint component and a finger component which are hinged in turn,  each component is controlled by an independent driving unit;  the flexible binding module is arranged at each joint part and embedded with a pressure sensor;  the control and programming system is used for setting a preset training action sequence;  the feedback and data collecting system is used for collecting angle data,  motor load,  training time and muscle reaction parameter.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot multi-modal instruction analysis system Including speech input module,  visual input module,  voiceprint feature extraction module,  object recognition and pose estimation module,  multi-modal alignment network based on spatiotemporal attention mechanism,  scene semantic tree construction module,  instruction node mapping module,  confidence evaluation module and decision-making module The system realizes the precise alignment of speech and visual information through the spatiotemporal attention mechanism,  and combines the scene semantic tree structure to represent environmental information to improve the accuracy of command parsing. The fuzzy instruction backtracking algorithm is used to dynamically evaluate the confidence. If it is lower than the threshold,  multiple rounds of dialogue clarification are started to reduce misoperation. The invention integrates multi-modal data,  optimizes historical interactive learning ability,  significantly improves the understanding efficiency and interactive robustness of complex instructions,  is suitable for home services,  logistics warehousing and other scenarios,  and enhances the intelligent level of human-machine collaboration. 1. A multi-modal instruction analysis system of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a voice input module for receiving the voice instruction of the user;  a visual input module for obtaining the environmental visual information;  a voiceprint feature extracting module for extracting the user voiceprint feature from the voice instruction;  an object identification and position estimation module for identifying the object from the visual information and estimating the position;  a multi-modal alignment network based on space-time attention mechanism,  for performing space-time alignment and feature fusion on the voice instruction and the visual information;  a scene semantic tree constructing module for constructing the semantic representation of the scene according to the multimodal alignment result;  an instruction node mapping module for mapping the voice instruction to the corresponding node of the scene semantic tree;  a confidence degree evaluation module for evaluating the confidence degree of the instruction analysis by the fuzzy instruction backtracking algorithm;  and a decision module for generating an action sequence when the confidence level is greater than the pre-set threshold,  and starting a multi-turn dialogue clarification mechanism when the confidence level is less than the pre-set threshold.

The invention discloses a local boar remote semen collection training method based on simulated human interaction Specifically,  it relates to the field of artificial assisted reproduction technology Including obtaining environmental parameters and calculating situational interaction adaptation index When the situational interaction adaptation index meets the preset conditions,  executing humanoid behavior path and collecting boar response data to construct behavior-cognitive connection index,  inputting the two indexes into training model to output cognitive transition prediction score,  if the score is lower than threshold value,  reconstructing behavior path and re-evaluating,  if the score is higher than threshold value continuously m times and the fluctuation of connection index is less than set range,  triggering real-person intervention process; the invention realizes the quantitative evaluation of the environmental adaptability of the pig house and the dynamic perception of the behavioral response of the target boar And the closed-loop control of training decision-making based on double exponential and machine learning models ensures that semen collection training can be efficiently promoted under the conditions of strong environmental adaptability,  sufficient individual response and stable cognitive trust,  and improves the training success rate and intelligence level. 1. A local boar remote semen collection training method based on simulation human interaction,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  before the first intervention of the simulation person,  the environmental illumination intensity of the pig house is obtained through illumination measurement,  space structure modelling and air flow field analysis,  the visual shielding degree and the smell transmission trend,  calculating the situation interaction adaptation index,  judging the environment condition adaptation degree for executing the training action,  if the environment is mutated in the training process,  re-evaluating the index;  when the situation interaction adaptive index satisfies the precondition of humanoid behavior triggering,  executing the simulation human initial behavior path,  comprising posture change,  voice output and smell release,  at the same time,  obtaining the response behavior data of the target boar,  according to the behavior approach frequency,  physiological stress reduction amplitude and residence time,  constructing behaviour cognitive joining index,  reflecting the degree of cognitive acceptance of the human-like behaviour by the target individual;  inputting the situation interaction adaptive index and the behaviour cognitive joining index into the machine learning model constructed based on the historical training data,  outputting the cognitive transition prediction score,  and comparing with the set transition threshold value,  judging whether there is the behaviour trust base for finishing the semen collection preparation;  when the cognitive transition prediction score is lower than the transition threshold value,  combining the relative offset direction and feedback characteristic of the context interaction adaptation index and the behaviour cognitive convergence index,  performing the behaviour path reconstruction,  comprising action amplitude adjustment,  voice rhythm conversion and smell releasing rhythm optimization,  generating the interaction behaviour sequence matched with the current individual response characteristic,  after executing,  re-collecting feedback and re-calculating the behaviour cognitive connection index;  when the cognitive transition prediction score is not lower than the transition threshold for continuous m times,  and the fluctuation of the behaviour cognitive joining index in the evaluation window is not more than the set stability threshold,  starting the real human intervention handover flow.

This solution belongs to the field of intelligent control positioning and navigation,  and specifically relates to an indoor high-precision positioning and navigation method for intelligent wheelchairs. The humanoid contour features also include facial features.; the wheelchair identity code is constructed according to the humanoid contour characteristics of the wheelchair-riding patient,  and different wheelchairs are distinguished by the humanoid contour characteristics of the wheelchair-riding patient. This solution realizes accurate identification and personalized adjustment of wheelchairs through image processing,  predicts pedestrian avoidance behavior,  and dynamically plans paths. It solves the problem of frequent deviation of smart wheelchairs during local obstacle avoidance,  resulting in low experience for patients riding wheelchairs. It also reduces the risk of collision and improves navigation efficiency. 1. An indoor high-precision positioning navigation method for intelligent wheelchair,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S10 :  obtaining the multi-view environment image of the hospital camera,  extracting the wheelchair profile characteristic and the human profile characteristic through the semantic segmentation network,  wherein the human profile characteristic further comprises the human face characteristic;  constructing a wheelchair identity code according to the human profile characteristic of the wheelchair on the patient,  and distinguishing different wheelchairs according to the human profile characteristic of the wheelchair on the patient;  S20 :  extracting the face orientation characteristic of the pedestrian near the wheelchair as the pedestrian characteristic,  obtaining the geometric mapping relation between the pedestrian characteristic and the wheelchair,  calculating the coverage region of the pedestrian visual attention according to the space-time relation between the pedestrian characteristic and the wheelchair,  and distinguishing the avoidance priority of the pedestrian according to the calculated result;  S30 :  through the space-time track prediction algorithm,  calculating the motion envelope intersection probability of the wheelchair and the pedestrian in the preset avoidance time,  and combining the avoidance priority to generate the dynamic navigation strategy;  S40 :  The invention adopts the hierarchical response strategy driven by the attention mechanism,  combines the wheelchair dynamic constraint and the comfort threshold of the wheelchair for the patient to regulate the speed and direction of the wheelchair.

The present invention provides a method for eliminating false positives in target detection,  which includes :  S1. Set target detection model training; s2. Set false alarm scenarios; s3. Set the humanoid alarm process; s4. Eliminate false alarms and alarm process :  For the situation of step S2,  due to dynamic false alarms,  that is,  false alarms from non-stationary targets and the number of frames that trigger false alarms is discontinuous,  when a false alarm is detected in one frame,  the alarm will not be issued immediately,  but The alarm will be issued when enough humanoid figures are detected within N frames,  the N ≥ 3,  the number of frames with enough humanoid figures is M,  and the 2 ≤ M < N; this enables dynamic false positives 1. A method for eliminating target detection misinformation,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S1,  setting target detection model training :  the network of the model adopts yolov5s,  the training data is coco data set,  the training type is person type namely human shape detection model,  the output result is human shape position information box namely left upper right lower coordinate,  the running time of the upper plate of the model is 100ms;  S2,  setting false alarm scene :  aiming at the humanoid application scene,  setting a misinformation situation,  the misinformation situation comprises :  the dynamic misinformation means that the moving non-target is identified as the target type,  that is,  the non-target object intruded in the video and the irregular trace is left,  and the human shape misinformation is triggered;  S3,  setting the human shape alarm flow :  the human shape alarm flow is as follows :  the camera sends the video stream to the human shape model for human shape detection,  when the human shape detection model detects that the current video frame has human shape result,  the human shape alarm is triggered;  S4,  eliminating the false alarm flow :  aiming at the condition of step S2,  because the dynamic false alarm,  namely the non-static target false alarm and the frame number of the triggered false alarm is discontinuous,  so when detecting a frame false alarm,  it does not alarm immediately,  but it alarms again when detecting enough human shape in N frame,  the N is more than or equal to 3,  the enough human shape is M,  M is more than or equal to 2 and less than N;  In this way,  the dynamic misinformation can be avoided.

In the modern healthcare environment,  robotics is playing an increasingly vital role in improving patient care and medical operations. This project presents the design and development of a hexaleg robot intended for medical purposes. The six-legged (hexapod) structure provides enhanced stability,  mobility,  and adaptability over various terrains,  making it highly suitable for use in hospitals,  rehabilitation centers,  and emergency scenarios. The robot is designed to perform tasks such as assisting patients with limited mobility,  transporting medical supplies,  and navigating through complex hospital environments where wheeled robots may face challenges. Equipped with sensors,  cameras,  and autonomous navigation algorithms,  the hexaleg robot ensures safe and precise movement,  avoiding obstacles and interacting effectively with the environment. The six-legged design also allows the robot to maintain balance even if one or more legs encounter a fault,  making it reliable for sensitive medical applications. Future improvements can include integration with AI-driven diagnostics,  remote control by healthcare staff,  and patient monitoring systems. This project highlights the potential of multi-legged robots in transforming medical support systems,  offering enhanced safety,  efficiency,  and patient-centered care. The integration of robotics into the medical field is opening new frontiers in patient care,  rehabilitation,  and hospital logistics. This project focuses on the design and development of a hexaleg robot (six-legged robot) specifically for medical applications. Unlike traditional wheeled robots,  the hexaleg configuration offers superior stability,  agility,  and adaptability to different surfaces and obstacles commonly found in healthcare environments. The robot is engineered to perform critical tasks such as assisting patients with mobility challenges,  delivering medical supplies,  monitoring patient health remotely,  and supporting rehabilitation exercises. Its six-legged structure ensures that the robot can maintain balance even in case of partial leg failure,  making it a reliable assistant in sensitive and dynamic hospital settings. Advanced features such as proximity sensors,  cameras,  and autonomous navigation algorithms are incorporated to enable safe obstacle avoidance,  path planning,  and interactive support with medical staff and patients. The modular design allows for future upgrades,  such as integrating AI-based diagnostics,  telemedicine functionalities,  and vital signs monitoring.

The Keyboard Playing Robo Arm is an innovative robotic system designed to replicate the motions of a human hand while playing a musical keyboard. This system combines advanced robotics,  artificial intelligence (AI),  and precise motor control to simulate realistic finger movements and key presses. The arm is equipped with high-precision actuators and sensors to detect the keyboard's layout and dynamically adjust to different playing techniques,  tempos,  and musical pieces. The primary objective is to enhance musical performance through automation,  providing both . educational tools for learning piano and a potential aid for musicians with physical disabilities. The robot can be programmed to play complex compositions,  providing a unique platform for experimentation in music and robotics. Its potential applications extend to music therapy,  interactive installations,  and as a means to assist in the development of novel musical interfaces. By merging technology with art,  this robotic arm aims to push the boundaries of performance and accessibility in the realm of music. Integration with AI composers to create completely autonomous music systems. Development of multi-arm systems for more complex performances or simultaneous instrument handling. Improved human-robot collaboration,  where robots support live human musicians dynamically. This invention is designed to replicate the intricate movements and dynamic precision required for playing musical keyboards,  such as pianos and synthesizers. Equipped with advanced mechanical systems for fine motor control,  sensors for tactile feedback,  and AI algorithms for real-time music interpretation,  the robotic arm can perform a wide range of musical tasks. These include replicating human performances,  improvising in collaboration with musicians,  or playing pre-composed piec'es with flawless accuracy.Robotic joints with multiple degrees of freedom enable human-like dexterity. Soft-touch actuators replicate the sensitivity required for expressive playing. Deep learning models for sheet music interpretation and style analysis.Force sensors to control key dynamics. Proximity sensors to prevent mechanical errors during fast-paced pieces. Modular design for various keyboard sizes and layouts. Compatibility with traditional pianos,  electric keyboards,  and custom interfaces.

A computer implemented system to assist a user includes a cognitive computation module which can speak to,  listen to and/or see. The system can assist in patient care delivery,  driving,  providing security,  customer support and identity verification. It may be configured in a processor of the computing device which receives text data input after converting speech into text. The received text data is analysed by the module using an artificial intelligence and/or decision rules modules. The modules may create a response of text output which is converted to speech data using text to speech module and sent to the communication module to speak out. It identifies posture of human body,  or the face of a human or a user using computer connected camera and also receives input from other sensors or devices connected to the computer and sends input to the cognitive communication module for analysis and response.

The present disclosure provides a method and device for training a robot ground-off state detection model,  and relates to the field of sensor and robot technology. The method comprises the following steps of :  respectively applying a vertical external force and a transverse external force to a robot in a training environment to obtain two types of training sample data; and inputting simulated motion sensing data in the training sample data into a neural network model to be trained to obtain a predicted robot ground-off state and category Finally,  a joint loss function is constructed based on the model prediction results and the real labels,  and the neural network parameters are optimized based on this,  so as to train a detection model that can simultaneously determine the off-ground state and off-ground category. The present disclosure can realize the joint identification of the robot's off-ground status and off-ground category,  thereby supporting the robot's rapid judgment and response decision-making in various off-ground scenes. 1. A robot ground state detection model training method,  wherein it comprises :  in the training environment,  applying the vertical external force to the robot to obtain the first training sample data;  wherein the first training sample data comprises simulated motion sensing data and a first type robot ground state;  in the training environment,  applying a transverse external force to the robot to obtain second training sample data;  wherein the second training sample data comprises simulated motion sensing data and a second type robot ground state;  inputting the simulated motion sensing data to the neural network model to be trained so that the neural network model to be trained outputs the predicted robot ground state and type;  calculating joint loss according to the predicted robot ground state and type and the robot ground state and type in each training sample data,  and updating the neural network model to be trained according to the joint loss to obtain the robot ground state detection model.

The invention has the advantages that :  through the composite structure and intelligent temperature control technology,  the human body temperature simulation is realized,  the problem that the existing robot lacks temperature feedback is solved,  and the naturalness and functionality of human-computer interaction are improved 1. A humanoid robot simulation skin,  wherein it comprises :  the outer soft material (1) is used for simulating the touch and flexibility of the human skin;  an inner temperature control layer (2),  set on the inner side of the outer soft material (1);  a temperature sensor (3),  integrated in the inner temperature control layer (2) or outer soft material (1),  for real-time monitoring skin surface temperature;  a heating module (4),  electrically connected with the temperature sensor (3),  for heating the skin surface according to the temperature monitoring result;  a liquid circulating system,  comprising a heat-conducting liquid (5) and a circulating pipeline (6),  the circulating pipeline (6) is distributed in the inner temperature control layer (2),  through the circulation of the heat-conducting liquid (5) to realize uniform heat dissipation or heating of the skin surface;  a phase change material (7),  filled around the liquid circulation system in the internal temperature control layer (2),  absorbing or releasing heat through the phase change process to maintain the skin surface temperature stable.

The invention relates to the technical field of rubber materials,  in particular to a rubber material for humanoid robot protection and a preparation method thereof. The rubber material uses ethylene-propylene-diene rubber,  hydrogenated nitrile rubber and fluorine rubber as substrates,  and is compounded with modified nano-silicon dioxide,  carbon nanotubes and other fillers,  and added with flame retardant,  antistatic and other functional additives; through ultrasonic-assisted dispersion,  segmented gradient vulcanization and other processes to ensure uniform material properties; the protective assembly adopts a multi-layer composite structure of a base fabric reinforcement layer,  a buffer layer and a functional surface layer. Chemical bonding between layers is achieved through plasma treatment,  and the functional surface layer obtains self-lubricating and lyophobic properties through laser micro-texture treatment. The material of the invention has a tensile strength of ≥ 18 MPa,  a flame retardancy of UL94 V-0 level,  and a surface resistivity of ≤ 1 × 109 Ω. It has excellent mechanical properties,  environmental tolerance and multi-functional integration,  and can be widely used in industry,  medical care,  etc. Humanoid robot protection in the field effectively improves robot reliability and service life. 1. A rubber material for human-shaped robot protection application,  wherein comprising the following components in parts by weight :  ethylene propylene diene rubber EPDM40-60 parts,  hydrogenated nitrile rubber HNBR20-35 parts,  fluorine rubber FKM 10-20 parts,  modified nano-silicon dioxide 15 -25 parts,  carbon nano-tube 3-8 parts,  zinc oxide 2-5 parts,  stearic acid 1-3 parts,  anti-aging agent RD1-4 parts,  vulcanizing agent di-tert-butyl peroxide isopropyl benzene BIPB 0.5-2 parts,  plasticizer dioctyl adipate DOA 5-10 parts,  flame retardant decabromodiphenylethane 8-15 parts,  antistatic agent quaternary ammonium salt compound 2-5 parts;  the modified nano-silicon dioxide is the nano-silicon dioxide modified by the silane coupling agent KH-570 surface,  the grain diameter is 20-50nm;  The carbon nano-tube is multi-wall carbon nano-tube,  the length-diameter ratio is not less than 1000,  and the surface is processed by plasma to enhance the dispersibility.

The invention discloses a built-in cycloid speed reducer and a joint module of a humanoid robot joint pin type output structure,  aiming at solving the problems that the existing robot joint module is large in size,  complex in structure,  insufficient in transmission reliability and bearing capacity and the like According to the invention,  the frameless torque motor and the cycloidal pinwheel speed reducer are integrally designed in a built-in manner,  so that the structure is highly compact; the output mechanism of the cycloid speed reducer adopts a pin type output structure,  the planetary motion of the cycloid wheel is accurately converted into the pure rotary motion of the output flange through the direct engagement of the plurality of transmission pin shafts arranged on the output flange and the pin holes on the cycloid wheel,  and the structure has the advantages of simple structure,  reliable transmission and strong bearing capacity. In addition,  the present invention adopts a parabolic modification method for the cycloidal gear tooth profile,  which optimizes the gear meshing characteristics,  improves transmission stability and reduces noise. The joint module provided by the invention has the advantages of high integration level,  high torque density,  high rigidity,  strong impact resistance and the like,  and is particularly suitable for humanoid robot joints with strict requirements on space and performance 1. A built-in cycloid speed reducer and joint module of human-shaped robot joint pin type output structure,  comprising a motor and a cycloid speed reducer set in the motor,  the two form an integrated joint module;  the cycloid speed reducer comprises an input crankshaft (10),  a cycloid wheel (7),  a needle tooth shell (8) and an output mechanism (5);  the input crankshaft (10) drives the cycloid wheel (7) to do planetary motion relative to the needle tooth shell (8);  the output mechanism (5) is used for converting the planetary motion of the cycloidal wheel (7) into pure rotary motion and outputting,  wherein the output mechanism is a column pin type output structure.

The invention discloses a method for estimating the tiny change of a target pose of a humanoid robot monocular vision. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  applying tiny and accurate displacement and inclination to an object,  and acquiring images of the object before and after the object changes by using a monocular camera; step S2 :  Perform feature point detection on each grid object image; step S3 :  then divide into two situations :  known grid point coordinates and unknown grid point coordinates for perspective projection transformation respectively; step S4 :  Unknown grid point coordinates introduce multivariate nonlinear optimization problems,  this invention can obtain high-precision 6-degree-of-freedom changing parameters of objects And the estimation algorithm is improved so that the origin of the attitude change is the center of gravity of the point cloud. In addition,  the convergence speed of the iterative calculation is also improved. The experimental measurement is carried out using a simple and cheap monocular optical system,  which can measure the displacement change of about 0.25 mm and the inclination angle change of 0.1 degree with high accuracy. 1. A method for estimating micro-change of target pose of monocular vision of human-shaped robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  Step 1 (S1) :  The method comprises the following steps :  firstly,  applying tiny and accurate displacement and inclination to the object,  and obtaining the image before and after the change of the object by a monocular camera;  step S2 :  detecting the characteristic point of each grid object image,  and detecting the angular point by Harris algorithm;  step S3 :  then dividing the known grid point coordinate and the unknown grid point coordinate to respectively perform perspective projection conversion,  introducing the known grid point coordinate to solve the nonlinear optimization problem,  and introducing the unknown grid point coordinate to the multi-element nonlinear optimization problem;  step S4 :  the unknown grid point coordinate introduces the multi-element non-linear optimization problem;  step S5 :  The numerical estimation 6 degree-of-freedom parameter is used as the optimal solution of the problem,  and the estimation algorithm is improved so that the original point of the posture change is the center of gravity of the point cloud.

The attraction function scans the surrounding environment and adaptively adjusts the attraction amplitude,  which improves the search efficiency of the random tree and prevents random expansion around obstacles,  thereby ensuring the quality and adaptability of path planning. 1. As the number of nearby obstacles increases,  the expansion step size decreases,  and when three obstacles are exceeded,  half of the original step size is expanded to balance the expansion speed and efficiency. The traditional P-RRT algorithm mainly uses the gravitation of the target point to provide the guide,  the repulsive force field of the barrier only prohibits the improvement of the sampling strategy in the small range near the barrier,  so as to avoid the problem of increasing the path length and reducing the planning efficiency. The specific improvement is to optimize the calculation of the gravitational field :  wherein Ua is gravity field,  lambda is gravity coefficient,  D (q,  qtarget) is the distance to the target point. By attenuating the gravitational field Ua when the biped robot enters the dangerous area of the obstacle,  the guidance property can be maintained and the local minimum point of the obstacle can be avoided.  Step S3.2 :  The strategy optimization process adopts the composite loss function based on the periodic reward (including the state reconstruction error,  the strategy gradient loss and the value estimation loss) to realize the end-to-end strategy learning. step S4 :  closed-loop motion control,  combining the motion instruction generated in the step S3 with the real-time feedback of the robot to perform closed-loop control,  so as to ensure the posture adjustment and gait balance of the robot. step S5 :  The online policy adjustment includes the following steps :  Step S5.1 :  according to the real-time feedback of the sensor (such as joint position error,  foot touchdown state and external disturbance information),  using the self-adaptive online optimization algorithm to adjust the strategy parameter;  Step S5.2 :  The invention realizes the instant response to the dynamic environment change and further improves the robustness and adaptability.

The present invention provides a humanoid segmentation method based on deep learning. Input the image into the backbone part of the deep neural network to generate high-order features corresponding to the image Then,  multiple parallel branches are connected to the feature output end of the neural network to predict the center position,  width and height of the humanoid's circumscribed rectangular frame in the image,  and the coordinate offset of the dividing line for dividing the humanoid relative to the center position of the humanoid's circumscribed rectangular frame in the vertical direction. The horizontal dividing line can be drawn by adding the above predicted coordinate offset and the coordinates of the center position in the vertical direction Divide the humanoid frame into three pieces Each block corresponds to the head of the human shape upper and lower body,  compared with the traditional humanoid segmentation method that separates detection and segmentation and divides areas through manually constructed features,  the method of the present invention has simple steps,  is easy to implement,  has higher segmentation accuracy,  and has great advantages in execution efficiency.,  which is more conducive to subsequent analysis of various appearance attributes of the humanoid. 1. A humanoid segmentation method based on deep learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  pre-processing the original image and inputting it into the trunk part of the neural network;  step two :  extracting the high-order feature graphs of various sizes generated by the neural network main part to form a feature pyramid,  and then fusing from the top to the bottom;  step three :  inputting the fused feature to the prediction block of the neural network,  obtaining the two-dimensional coordinate and confidence degree of the centre of the human-shaped frame and the coordinate of the human-shaped head,  the upper half body and the upper half body boundary in the frame in the vertical direction according to the prediction result of the four parallel convolution layers at the tail end of the prediction block;  step four :  using diou-nms filtering redundant rectangular frame,  for the reserved human-shaped frame according to the vertical coordinate of the two boundary lines corresponding to the human-shaped frame to make the boundary line to divide the detected human-shaped frame into three blocks,  each block respectively comprises a target human-shaped head,  an upper half body and a lower half body;  Wherein,  the pre-processing of the original image specifically comprises :  the original image is zoomed to 640x480 by bilinear interpolation,  and the pixel value is zoomed to the floating point number in the interval of 0 to 1 from the integer in the interval of 0 to 255 by linear zooming;  the prediction block comprises a main path and a residual bypass,  the main path is composed of three 1x1 convolution layers connected in series,  the residual bypass is the convolution layer with the core size of 1x1;  passing the fused features through the main path and the residual error bypass,  and adding the output features,  and then respectively passing through four parallel 1x1 convolution layers,  for predicting the confidence degree of each point on the feature map as the centre of the human-shaped frame,  and the offset of the actual centre,  the width and height and the coordinates of the upper and lower boundary lines in the vertical direction are offset relative to the current point.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot face friendliness evaluation and a design method thereof The method comprises :  (1) simulating and generating a humanoid robot face based on different facial features; (2) Collect EEG signals and eye movement signals generated by participants on the humanoid robot's face during the friendliness assessment experiment,  and record participants' preference feedback; (3) Combined with participants' preference feedback,  conduct preference assessment on the collected EEG signals and eye movement signals,  and obtain preference rankings based on EEG signals and eye movement signals; (4) Obtain facial feature preference ranking based on the preference ranking results of EEG signals and eye movement signals,  and then select friendly facial features to combine into a humanoid robot face. A humanoid robot facial friendliness evaluation and design method thereof,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) based on different facial features,  simulating and generating a plurality of humanoid robot faces;  (2) collecting the EEG signal and eye movement signal generated by the tester to the face of the humanoid robot in the friendly evaluation experiment process,  and recording the preference feedback of the tester,  for verifying the accuracy of the preference obtained by the physiological signal;  (3) combining the preference feedback of the tester,  for the collected brain electrical signal,  using the forehead asymmetric theory,  potency,  selection index and power spectrum density index to perform preference evaluation,  for the collected eye movement signal,  based on gaze,  scanning and pupil information extracting eye movement characteristic to perform preference evaluation,  obtaining the human-like robot face preference rank based on brain wave signal and eye movement signal;  (4) based on brain wave signal and eye movement signal of human-like robot face preference ranking result to obtain face characteristic preference ranking,  so as to select the friendly face characteristic combined into human-like robot face;  wherein :  in step (2),  friendly evaluation experiment process comprises drift detection,  resting state and human-like robot face stimulation presenting part;  the drift detection is used for re-calibrating the pupil position,  the resting state lasts for 2 seconds to capture the electroencephalogram baseline; The invention discloses a humanoid robot dynamic jump and balance control method,  an electronic device and a medium. The humanoid robot dynamic jump and balance control method comprises the following steps of :  planning a centroid and a plantar track in a humanoid robot jumping process; the humanoid robot is modeled as a single rigid body,  the position of the center of mass,  angular offset,  linear velocity,  and angular velocity of the robot are taken as state variables,  and the ground contact force and ground contact torque are taken as control variables. A model predictive control problem is constructed and converted into a standard QP problem for solution to obtain the optimal ground reaction force and action torque Constructing a whole-body motion control model,  using the desired end state and optimal ground reaction force to obtain joint position,  speed and feedforward joint torque; control the humanoid robot to perform jumping motion according to the joint position,  speed and joint torque; the joint torque is the sum of feedforward torque and feedback torque,  and the feedback torque is calculated through proportional differential control; after the humanoid robot lands,  the stepping strategy is adopted to realize the landing stability of the robot. 1. A human-like robot dynamic jumping and balance control method,  wherein the method comprises :  planning the centroid and the track of the sole in the jumping process of the humanoid robot by setting the centroid jumping height,  the sole ascending height,  the step height and the distance of the centroid jumping forwards as the control quantity;  the humanoid robot is modelled as a single rigid body,  the planned track is used as the reference track of the model prediction control,  the position,  angular deviation,  linear speed,  the angular speed is used as the state variable,  the ground contact force and the ground contact moment are used as the control quantity,  a model prediction control problem is constructed,  and the model prediction control problem is converted into the standard QP problem to be solved,  the optimal ground reaction force and the ground reaction moment are obtained;  constructing a whole body motion control model,  inputting the ground counterforce and the ground counterforce moment into the whole body motion control model,  using the expected end state and the optimal ground counterforce to obtain the joint position,  speed and feedforward joint moment;  controlling the humanoid robot to execute jumping movement according to the joint position,  speed and joint moment;  the joint moment is the sum of the feed-forward moment and the feedback moment,  the feedback moment is obtained by proportion differential control;  After the humanoid robot falls to the ground,  the robot is stably fallen to the ground by the step strategy.

Although the simplified model ignores leg dynamics,  it can still achieve the robust stability of the 12-degree-of-freedom system under the multi-body effect,  which improves the adaptability and real-time performance of the system. 1. The flat terrain walking experiment shows that the MPC controller can effectively maintain the robot walking balance and ensure the gait stability;  in the rugged terrain walking test,  the MPC controller can effectively track the target speed instruction. In comparison with the results of the flat terrain walking experiment,  it was found that the robot was significantly affected by terrain fluctuations at about 15 seconds,  but the MPC controller was still capable of maintaining the stability of the body. Compared with the flat terrain walking,  the torque needed by each joint is increased,  but it does not exceed the rated torque of the driving motor. The experiment data fully proves that the MPC controller can ensure the robust stable walking of the robot under rugged terrain under the external interference condition.

This application provides robot teleoperation methods and systems,  storage media,  equipment and program products. The method comprises receiving skeleton motion data of an operator,  selecting pose information of a part of skeleton nodes from the skeleton motion data,  and using the pose information as reference motion data; mapping the reference motion data to target motion information of the robot; solve based on the target motion information to generate control instructions for driving the robot joints. In this way,  the pose information of some skeletal nodes is selected from the skeletal motion data And using it as reference motion data can retain the core motion characteristics,  simplify the complexity of mapping from skeletal motion data to target motion information of the robot in related technologies,  reduce redundant data interference,  and then adapt to the limited joint freedom of the robot. 1. A remote operation method of robot,  wherein the method comprises :  receiving bone movement data of an operator,  the bone movement data including positional information of a plurality of bone nodes of the operator;  the pose information comprises position information and/or pose information;  selecting the pose information of a part of bone nodes from the bone motion data as the reference motion data;  mapping the reference motion data as the target motion information of the robot,  wherein the target motion information comprises the target pose information corresponding to at least one robot joint of the robot;  the target pose information comprises target position information and/or target pose information;  solving based on the target motion information to generate a control instruction for driving the robot joint.

The invention discloses a foot gait and shape co-evolution system integrating reinforcement learning and evolutionary computing,  and relates to the field of robot technology and artificial intelligence; the method comprises the following steps :  a real-time motion control strategy learning module is realized based on a dynamic mask integrated double-Q learning method; the gait and shape collaborative optimization module optimizes the key gait and shape parameters that affect the global motion performance of the legged robot based on evolutionary computing theory; the training environment adaptive enhancement module includes an automatic domain randomization module and a course learning module; the parametric trajectory generator module is used to provide a structured motion prior for the real-time motion control strategy learning module; the robot simulation environment is used to simulate the physical effects of the robot and the environment in the computer; the invention enables the foot robot to realize high-speed,  stable and efficient autonomous movement capabilities in complex and changeable unstructured environments. 1. A foot-type gait and shape cooperative evolution system for fusion strengthening learning and evolution calculation,  wherein it is used for automatically generating motion control strategy suitable for foot-type robot and shape evolution method suitable for foot-type robot,  the motion control strategy is further used for obtaining the foot-type gait suitable for the foot-type robot,  the shape cooperative evolution method is further used for obtaining the shape improvement basis suitable for the foot-type robot;  the specific form of the foot-type robot comprises a four-foot robot and a two-foot robot;  The foot-type gait and form collaborative evolution system of fusion enhanced learning and evolution calculation comprises :  a real-time motion control strategy learning module (1),  a gait and shape cooperative optimization module (2),  a training environment self-adaptive enhancement module (3),  a parameterized track generator module (4),  and a robot simulation environment (5);  wherein the real-time motion control strategy learning module (1) is realized based on the dynamic mask integrated double Q learning method;  the gait and shape cooperative optimization module (2) based on evolution calculation theory to influence the foot type robot global motion performance of the key gait and shape parameter;  the training environment self-adaptive enhancement module (3) comprises an automatic domain randomization module (31) and a course learning module (32),  for improving the robustness and generalization ability of the motion control strategy;  the parameterized track generator module (4) is used for providing structured motion priori for the real-time motion control strategy learning module (1);  the specific form of the robot simulation environment (5) is the physical interaction system built by using the disclosed physical simulation engine,  for simulating the physical effect of the robot and the environment in the computer,  comprising the robot simulation model constructed according to the foot-type robot and the task environment where the foot-type robot is located;  the real-time motion control strategy learning module (1) according to the principle of maximum entropy strengthening learning in strengthening learning,  through deep neural network learning to obtain the motion control strategy suitable for foot type robot;  the motion control strategy is finally aimed at maximizing the weighted sum of the accumulated expected reward and strategy entropy;  in order to monitor the training progress of the intensive learning and control the training time,  the preset total training time step number or total iteration times of the intensive learning training is recorded as stotal,  the training time step number or iteration times experienced from the beginning of the training to the current time is recorded as stotal;  the gait and shape cooperation optimizing module (2) adopts evolution algorithm,  in the overall to influence the foot type robot global motion performance of the gait modelling parameter,  gait phase parameter and robot morphological parameter for iteration optimization,  so as to search the optimal robot design and basic motion mode;  the training environment adaptive enhancement module (3) systematically expands the physical parameter range of the robot simulation environment (5) through the included automatic domain randomization module (31),  at the same time,  the training environment adaptive enhancement module (3) uses the course learning module (32) to gradually improve the task difficulty,  so as to jointly enhance the robustness and generalization ability of the motion control strategy;  The task difficulty refers to the degree of difficulty of the learning scenario defined by the quantifiable environmental parameters of the obstacles in the environment.

The invention discloses a robot swing arm trajectory optimization method based on dynamic programming,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Construct a central model generator model to generate a rhythmic swing arm trajectory; s2. Obtain the posture state data of the humanoid robot during running; s3. Convert the rhythmic swing arm trajectory and attitude state data into an attitude disturbance input vector; s4. Evaluate the track stability index and determine whether it exceeds the deviation threshold; s5. When it deviates from the threshold,  call the controllable periodic orbit adjustment algorithm to generate trajectory correction candidate parameters; s6. Construct a dynamic programming model with the attitude disturbance input as a state variable,  and search and output the optimal trajectory correction parameters; s7. Feedback the correction parameters to the central mode generator to generate the swing arm trajectory of the next cycle. The invention realizes the stability optimization and dynamic adaptive control of the swing arm action through disturbance modeling and trajectory feedback control. 1. A robot swinging arm track optimization method based on dynamic planning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a central mode generator model,  generating a rhythmic swinging arm track comprising a swinging arm frequency parameter,  a swinging arm amplitude parameter and a swinging arm phase parameter;  S2,  obtaining the posture state data in the running process of the humanoid robot;  S3,  converting the rhythmic swinging arm track and attitude state data into attitude disturbance input vector;  S4,  calculating the periodic track stability index based on the attitude disturbance input vector,  and judging whether it exceeds the preset deviation threshold value;  S5,  when the period track stability index exceeds the preset deviation threshold value,  invoking the energy control period track adjusting algorithm,  generating the track adjusting candidate parameter set;  S6,  constructing a dynamic planning model,  taking the posture disturbance input vector as the state variable,  taking the track adjusting candidate parameter set as the strategy space,  executing the track optimization strategy search,  and outputting the track correction parameter set;  S7,  inputting the track correction parameter set into the central mode generator model,  and outputting the correction rhythmic swinging arm track for driving the swinging arm to move in the next period of the humanoid robot.

The invention relates to a two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist joint driven by coiled fiber and a working method thereof Comprises a fixed platform and a movable platform A first branch chain is arranged between the fixed platform and the movable platform A second branch and a third branch,  the first branch chain and the third branch chain have the same structure Both are composed of two connecting rods and three rotating pairs The second branch chain is composed of two universal joints and a telescopic rod. The driving of the entire joint is realized by four groups of coiled fibers. The four groups of coiled fibers are respectively installed on the four end surfaces of the movable and fixed platforms. When the coiled fibers are heated by electricity,  the temperature changes,  and then they shrink themselves and generate driving force to move the movable platform. The invention has compact structure,  good symmetry,  high stiffness and load-bearing capacity,  and realizes flexible redundant driving through coiled fibers,  thereby making the mechanism have both high stiffness and high flexibility. The mechanism is suitable for industrial robot end wrist joints,  humanoid arm wrist joints,  intelligent prosthetics and other occasions. 1. A two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist joint driven by coiled fibre,  wherein comprising a fixed platform,  a movable platform,  a first branched chain,  a second branched chain and a third branched chain,  wherein one end of the first branched chain and one end of the third branched chain are connected with the top part of the fixed platform,  the other end of the first branched chain and the other end of the third branched chain are connected at the bottom part of the movable platform,  two ends of the second branched chain are respectively connected with the centre of the top part of the fixed platform and the centre of the bottom part of the movable platform,  The first branch chain and the third branch chain are installed at two sides of the second branch chain.

The invention belongs to the technical field of walking path planning and motion control of biped robots Specifically,  it relates to a 3-dimensional A * map bipedal robot path optimization method for classifying obstacles. The method improves the traditional A * method,  records and processes the height characteristics of obstacles,  and distinguishes them according to the robot's passing ability.,  classify obstacles into two types :  crossing and bypassing,  so as to design new maps more flexibly. Two types of obstacles are processed on the map. For obstacles that can be crossed,  these obstacles are marked as passable areas,  and for obstacles that can be bypassed,  these obstacles are marked as unpassable areas,  so as to establish The path planning is carried out on the new map to finally obtain an optimal path from the starting point to the end point. Compared with the path planning algorithm to avoid obstacles,  this method combines the structure and movement characteristics of bipedal robots and can obtain optimized traffic paths. 1. A three-dimensional A* map biped robot path optimization method for classifying obstacles,  wherein the method comprises :  step 1 :  constructing an initial environment grid map through the sensor information;  step 2 :  based on the biped robot structure,  establishing a size envelope model of the robot;  at the same time,  combining the human body motion parameter,  further analyzing the motion ability of the biped robot,  obtaining the corresponding determined relation between the lifting height and the stepping step length;  step 3 :  according to the corresponding relation between the lifting height and the stepping step length,  analyzing the envelope diagram of the foot end track changing along with the stepping height;  classifying and judging the size of the obstacle in the initial environment grid map,  determining the obstacle that the robot can span and the obstacle to be bypassed;  step 4 :  processing different types of obstacles on the initial environment grid map,  removing the obstacles that the robot can span,  at the same time,  aiming at the deletion grid of the position of the original obstacle,  setting according to the movement ability and structure size of the robot,  generating a new environment grid map;  step 5 :  aiming at the new environment grid map,  using the A* algorithm to plan the path on the new environment map to obtain the optimal path.

The invention discloses an excitation system and method for testing the dynamic characteristics of a pedestrian bridge. A shock excitation system for pedestrian bridge power characteristic test,  wherein it comprises :  a plurality of human-shaped robots,  wherein one of the human-shaped robots is provided with a data collecting and analyzing module;  wherein one or more of the humanoid robots are provided with a counterweight block;  a control terminal,  which is in communication connection with each human-shaped robot and the data collecting and analyzing module,  for controlling the step frequency,  step amplitude and moving path of each human-shaped robot;  a monitoring device,  comprising a plurality of monitoring units,  each monitoring unit is distributed on the pedestrian bridge,  for monitoring the vibration acceleration and vibration displacement of the pedestrian bridge;  each monitoring unit is in communication connection with the data collecting and analyzing module.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot gait control method and a quadruped robot gait control system based on complex terrain,  and relates to the technical field of robot control According to the invention,  based on the mechanism parameter characteristics of the quadruped robot,  a dynamics and kinematics mathematical model of the quadruped robot and a quantification mode of the terrain unevenness degree are established,  so that the estimation of the foot end contact state probability in the robot movement process is realized According to the robot movement under irregular terrain,  different gait types are designed and matched with irregular terrain,  and the stability and switching strategy of gait under different terrain are analyzed; based on the contact state probability of the foot end,  the contact state of the foot end is judged and the real-time optimization of the gait phase is realized,  so as to realize the dynamic balance control during the movement of the quadruped robot. 1. A four-foot robot gait control method based on complex terrain,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the mechanism parameter characteristic of the four-foot robot,  constructing a mechanical motion model of the four-foot robot;  simulating and operating the four-foot robot in the complex terrain,  and determining the motion state estimation result,  terrain estimation result and foot end contact estimation result of the four-foot robot based on the mechanical motion model of the four-foot robot;  based on the motion state estimation result,  the terrain estimation result and the foot end contact estimation result,  adjusting the gait of the four-foot robot in real time.

This application discloses a humanoid robot head orientation method and system based on audio-visual collaboration The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence,  and solves the technical problem that the number of available effective features for detecting images and voice data is reduced due to the lack of consideration of human face occlusion or poor environmental conditions in the prior art,  resulting in lower accuracy and efficiency of head orientation Generating time synchronization data based on the detected image and the detected sound source; generating orientation data after generating detection influence coefficient according to illumination intensity and detection data; generate a horizontal orientation adjustment error based on the adjusted detection image and then generate an alarm signal Use multi-source data at the same time for orientation Monitor the degree of suppression of multi-source data by the environment in real time,  and dynamically adjust the combination weight between multi-source data according to the correlation between the suppression degrees,  and orient the horizontal orientation accordingly,  and then adjust the orientation vertical direction,  which is implemented step by step,  so that the accuracy and efficiency of the final head orientation are improved. 1. A humanoid robot head orientation system based on audiovisual cooperation,  wherein it comprises :  a data collecting module and a data analyzing module which are connected with each other;  the data acquisition module :  obtaining the robot data,  the illumination intensity and the detection data through the data collecting device;  the detection data comprises a detection image and a detection sound source;  the data analysis module :  generating time synchronous data according to the detection image and the detection sound source;  generating a detection influence coefficient according to the illumination intensity and the detection data;  generating directional data according to the detection influence coefficient and the time synchronous data;  adjusting the head parameter of the robot according to the orientation data;  generating an alarm signal after generating a horizontal directional adjustment error according to the adjusted detection image.

The invention discloses a motion control method,  a motion control device,  a motion control device,  a motion control medium and a motion control product of a speed difference steering wheel leg type robot,  and relates to the field of motion control Carrying out mode switching according to the motion data of the target wheel-legged robot at the current moment to determine the mode at the current moment; the strategy model is adopted to determine the joint trajectory information at the current moment according to the motion data at the current moment; integrate the joint trajectory information at the current moment And optimize the integrated state trajectory information based on the predictive control model Obtain the optimized expected data at the current moment,  and determine the expected state quantity at the current moment based on the inverse dynamics method,  and then determine the feedback data at the next moment,  which is used as the motion data at the current moment,  and return to the mode switching step until the target wheel The motion trajectory of the legged robot is adjusted to the desired trajectory This application aims to improve steering accuracy,  energy efficiency ratio and dynamic stability. 1. A motion control method of speed difference steering wheel-leg type robot,  wherein it comprises :  performing mode switching according to the motion data of the target wheel-leg robot at the current time,  and determining the belonging mode at the current time;  the belonged mode is low speed and obstacle crossing mode,  or high speed and steering mode;  based on the belonging mode of the current time,  using the strategy model to determine the joint track information of the current time according to the motion data of the current time;  said strategy model is determined by the method of strengthening learning;  the joint track information comprises :  joint expected position and wheel expected speed;  integrating the joint track information at the current moment,  and optimizing the integrated state track information based on the prediction control model to obtain the expected data optimized at the current moment,  and determining the expected state quantity at the current moment based on the inverse dynamics method;  the expected state quantity is used for controlling the movement of the target wheel-leg robot;  The desired state quantity comprises :  wheel torque and joint torque;  the prediction control model is a mathematical model for representing track optimization determined based on dynamics characteristic constraint and cost function;  the joint track information at the current time,  the expected data optimized at the current time and the expected state quantity at the current time are determined as the feedback data at the next time,  and the feedback data at the next time is used as the motion data at the current time,  returning to " according to the motion data of the target wheel-leg robot at the current time to perform mode switching,  determining the belonging mode at the current moment,  until the motion track of the target wheel-leg robot is adjusted to the expected track.
