The invention relates to a humanoid posture recognition method and system based on image analysis,  which inputs the reference humanoid data of the monitoring object,  and collects multi-modal data including RGB images,  infrared images and inertial measurement data in the target scene in real time; space-time alignment processing is carried out,  and the corresponding features are fused; extracting image spatial features,  modeling inertial data in time series,  and realizing dynamic weighted fusion of two network outputs through gating mechanism; locating the basic joint points of human body and generating refined posture vector containing joint angle and relative position of limbs; based on the real-time collected attitude data and environmental information,  adaptively adjust the attitude classification threshold and similarity measurement standards to predict abnormal behaviors in the future time period; trigger the execution of preset safety measures when abnormal behavior is predicted Humanoid posture recognition that can efficiently fuse multi-modal data,  accurately extract posture features,  adaptively adjust recognition strategies,  and have behavioral trend prediction capabilities. 1. A human gesture recognition method based on image analysis,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  inputting the standard human-shape data of the monitored object,  collecting the multi-mode data including RGB image,  infrared image and inertia measurement data under the target scene in real time;  S2 :  performing space-time alignment processing on the multi-modal data,  extracting texture characteristics of RGB image,  thermal radiation characteristics of infrared image and motion trend characteristics of inertia measurement data,  and performing characteristic fusion;  S3 :  constructing a double-flow convolution neural network based on the attention mechanism,  wherein one network extracts the space characteristics of the RGB image and the infrared image,  the other network performs the time sequence modelling to the inertia measurement data,  the two network outputs realize the dynamic weighting fusion through the gating mechanism;  S4 :  through lightweight key point detecting network locating human body basic node,  then utilize the graph attention network to deeply excavate the topological relation between the basic node,  generate the refined posture vector containing joint angle,  limb relative position;  S5 :  establishing a dynamic posture model base,  self-adaptively adjusting the posture classification threshold and the similarity measurement standard according to the posture data and the environment information collected in real time;  S6 :  based on the real-time monitoring video,  combining the reference human shape data and the dynamic posture model base,  using the long-short time memory network and the time sequence prediction algorithm to analyze the behaviour trend of the monitored object,  predicting the abnormal behaviour in the future time period;  S7 :  when the abnormal behaviour is predicted,  triggering to execute the preset safety measure,  based on the attitude change rate and the scene semantic information,  performing risk level evaluation and early warning on the abnormal attitude.

The utility model discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot,  which comprises an upper half leg plate,  a lower half leg plate,  a lifting component and a magnetic induction component,  wherein the non-rotating shaft end of the upper half leg plate is in butt joint with the non-rotating shaft end of the lower half leg plate The utility model drives the rotation of the main gear,  the auxiliary gear,  the main threaded rod and the auxiliary threaded rod by starting the lifting motor,  and the main threaded rod and the auxiliary threaded rod make the lower half leg plate rotate or shrink according to the forward and reverse direction of the lifting motor rotation,  so that the length of the upper half leg plate and the lower half leg plate is elongated or shortened; the magnetic induction sliding rod on the lower leg plate slides out or in the sliding hole of the upper leg plate The magnetic induction sliding rod drives the magnetic sliding box and the magnetic column to move,  the induction coil inducts the position of the magnetic column in the induction coil,  the extension or shortening length of the lifting component is detected,  and the length of the leg of the humanoid robot is adaptively adjusted,  so that the robot can flexibly switch gait between high and low undulating,  soft or hard surfaces,  and the walking stability and efficiency are greatly improved 1. A leg structure of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises an upper half leg plate (1),  a lower half leg plate (2),  a lifting component (3) and a magnetic induction component (4),  wherein the non-rotating shaft end of the upper half leg plate (1) is butted with the non-rotating shaft end of the lower half leg plate (2),  the power end of the lifting component (3) is fixedly installed in the upper half leg plate (1),  the screw thread end of the lifting component (3) is installed in the lower half leg plate (2),  the end part of the magnetic induction component (4) is fixedly installed on the two sides of the non-rotating shaft end of the lower half leg plate (2),  the magnetic induction component (4) is located on the two sides of the inner part of the upper half leg plate (1).

 monitoring whether the position of the character frame is updated,  if the position of the character frame is updated,  determining the character starting point coordinate of the updated character frame in the video original image,  and detecting the size information of the character frame according to the character starting point coordinate;  if there is a character frame,  determining the edge position of each direction in the video original image,  and taking the character frame with the smallest distance from the edge position as the target character frame;  constructing a target display frame according to the size information of at least one target character frame corresponding to the edge position of each direction of the video original image;  wherein the starting point coordinate is determined based on the starting point coordinate of the video original image as the reference coordinate,  the target display frame is determined by using the size information of the target character frame,  the target display frame is not equal to the whole range displayed by the video display area;  the position existence update of the character frame refers to that the position movement amplitude of the character frame corresponding to the participator is larger when the participator in the field area moves after the participator in the field area displays the image at the remote end;  the step of constructing a target display frame according to the size information of at least one target character frame corresponding to the edge position of each direction of the video original image comprises :  if the position of the character frame is updated in the first preset time range and the target display frame is updated,  detecting whether the updated target display frame is continuously updated in the second preset time range;  if so,  determining the current target display image of the remote end,  and taking the history display frame in the current target display image as the target display frame;  if not,  executing the step of determining the character starting point coordinate of the character frame in the video original image according to the character frame whose position is changed,  and detecting the size information of the character frame according to the character starting point coordinate;  converting the target display frame into a target display image according to a preset resolution,  and pushing the target display image to a remote end.

The invention discloses an operation method of a humanoid agricultural robot based on path planning,  and relates to the relevant technical field of agricultural robots. The operation method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring multi-sensor data,  processing data and generating a map,  updating the map,  identifying and positioning a target crop image,  planning a global path,  avoiding obstacles on a local path and executing picking actions The invention also discloses an operating system of the humanoid agricultural robot based on path planning,  which includes a humanoid robot body,  a visual sensor,  a laser radar,  a depth camera,  an inertial measurement unit,  an auxiliary sensor,  an actuator module,  a control system,  a communication module and a power supply system. This inventor robot can use its keen visual perception system to identify the position and shape of tools in advance. It can skillfully cross or bypass these tools by its own flexibility,  and can accurately determine the position and distribution of crops in the three-dimensional space. The position and distribution of crops can be generated to generate a comprehensive picking environment map 1. An operation method of humanoid agricultural robot based on path planning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  multi-sensor data acquisition :  the human-shaped agricultural robot is provided with multiple sensors for collecting data,  comprising a visual sensor,  a laser radar,  a depth camera and an inertia measurement unit;  the human-shaped robot main body comprises a head part,  a body part,  two arms and two legs;  step two :  data processing and map generation :  pre-processing the data collected by different sensors and fusing the data to generate a picking environment map;  step three :  Map update :  continuously collecting new environment data and updating the map in real time;  step four :  identifying and locating the target crop image :  using convolution neural network algorithm to identify and classify the crop image collected by the visual sensor,  combining the map information to determine the position of the target crop;  step five :  global path planning :  based on the constructed picking environment map and the position information of the target crop,  adopting the A algorithm to plan the global path;  step six :  Partial path obstacle avoidance :  monitoring the environment information and adjusting the moving direction and speed of the robot to avoid the obstacle when meeting the sudden obstacle;  The local path obstacle avoidance further includes an obstacle identification and classification,  and the steps of the obstacle identification and classification are as follows :  data collection and labeling :  collecting several images,  point cloud data and corresponding sensor data containing various obstacles under different terrain backgrounds,  marking the type and key feature of the obstacle;  feature extraction and model training :  extracting the characteristic of the collected data by the deep learning algorithm,  taking the extracted characteristic as the input,  training the model by the support vector machine SVM,  classifying the different obstacles by the model;  output of the classification result :  in the practical application of the trained model,  the real-time collected sensor data is input into the model,  the classification result of the barrier is output,  the soil pile is divided into the soil pile with the height h less than 10 cm,  10 cm less than or equal to h less than or equal to 50 cm and h more than or equal to 50 cm by taking the height h as the unit;  for the hoe and iron shovel tool,  identifying the type,  size,  placing posture and whether the information is shielded by the crops or soil;  the local path obstacle avoidance further comprises a dynamic crossing strategy;  The steps of the dynamic spanning strategy for the soil stack are as follows :  balance control :  in the spanning process,  the inertia measuring unit is used for monitoring the body posture angular speed and acceleration information of the robot in real time,  and adjusting the mass centre position of the robot by the PID controller in combination with the foot pressure change condition fed back by the pressure sensor;  Body posture adjustment :  the robot firstly reduces the gravity centre of the body,  and is realized by adjusting the angle of the leg joint so that the gravity centre of the body moves downwards and is close to the supporting area of the feet;  obstacle avoidance and replanning :  in the process of walking along the planning path,  the robot continuously monitors the surrounding terrain change and other obstacles,  if the new obstacle or the original path is not feasible,  the robot will immediately stop the current action,  re-operate the path planning algorithm and search the new feasible path;  The steps of the dynamic crossing strategy for the hoe and the iron shovel tool are as follows :  grabbing and moving :  when the robot is 0.5 m away from the tool,  according to the type and size of the tool,  adjusting the moving track of the mechanical arm and the posture of the clamping claw or the sucking disc,  after grabbing the tool,  the mechanical arm lifts it upwards to make the tool separate from the ground,  the robot places the tool in the empty area according to the terrain condition;  cross-decision :  if the width of the tool is less than 0.5 m,  the robot selects to span,  when crossing,  the strategy of crossing the soil stack is adopted,  if the tool is more than 0.5 m,  the robot stops advancing,  evaluating the surrounding terrain and environment condition,  according to the situation,  selecting the bypassing tool or using the mechanical arm to move it to the safe place and then going forward;  step seven :  performing the picking action :  according to the position and posture of the target crop,  planning the motion track of the mechanical arm,  using the inverse kinematics algorithm to solve the angle value of each joint of the mechanical arm,  adjusting the action parameter of the picking tool,  realizing the fruit picking;  The execution mode of the picking action is as follows :  the camera imaging :  the crop is shot by the visual sensor;  image pre-processing :  pre-processing the original image;  feature extraction and target detection :  extracting the feature of the pre-processed image and detecting the target by the deep learning algorithm;  Mechanical arm motion planning :  the motion planning of the mechanical arm is based on the inverse kinematics algorithm,  the algorithm solves the angle value of each joint according to the target position and attitude of the actuator at the end of the mechanical arm,  monitors the actual position and speed by the sensor,  compares the actual position and speed with the planning track,  and corrects the error by the PID controller;  adjusting the action parameter of the picking tool according to the fruit information;  the mechanical arm end actuator is provided with a picking tool comprising a flexible clamping claw or a sucking disc;  the design of the picking tool should consider the factors of the size,  shape and maturity of the fruit;  according to the fruit information,  adjusting the action parameter of the picking tool,  comprising the opening and closing degree of the clamping claw,  the adsorption force of the sucker,  setting the fruit radius as r,  the maturity as m,  the value range of m is 0-1,  the opening and closing degree d of the clamping claw and the adsorption force F of the sucker are respectively represented as :  d is equal to d0 + kdrm,  F is equal to F0 + kfrm,  wherein d0 and F0 are initial opening and closing degree and adsorption force,  kd and kf are proportion coefficients.

Embodiments of the present application provide an equipment maintenance control method,  device,  equipment and medium for a robot training ground,  and belong to the technical field of industrial manufacturing equipment for humanoid robot training ground. The method includes :  collecting visual data,  text data and maintenance-related visual data of equipment to be repaired. and action data; training multimodal large models; generating an initial maintenance task corresponding to the sensed data through the maintenance control model; the initial maintenance task is adjusted and optimized according to the perceived data through the reinforcement learning model to generate the target maintenance task; maintenance control of equipment to be repaired for humanoid robots based on target maintenance tasks. This method is used to improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis while It improves the efficiency of equipment maintenance in the industrial field. In addition,  it has great application prospects in the industrial manufacturing field. It can help the industrial manufacturing industry improve production efficiency and production quality. It can also replace equipment maintenance personnel to complete some dangerous tasks in special operation scenarios. Reduce the risk factor 1. A device maintenance control method of robot training field,  wherein the method comprises :  collecting the visual data,  text data and action data related to the device to be maintained and the maintenance,  and obtaining the fault type according to the visual data,  text data and action data;  extracting a visual feature vector from the visual data based on a pre-built model frame,  extracting a text semantic vector from the text data,  and extracting an action state vector from the action data;  performing the feature fusion processing on the visual feature vector,  the text semantic vector and the motion state vector through the gating cross attention mechanism to obtain the modal fusion feature;  generating a positive sample pair and a negative sample pair according to the fault type and the modal fusion feature;  according to the preset training parameter,  the positive sample pair and the negative sample pair,  performing model training,  obtaining a maintenance control model;  defining the strengthening learning parameter,  and training the model according to the strengthening learning parameter and the strategy gradient algorithm to obtain the strengthening learning model;  obtaining the sensing data in real time,  generating the initial maintenance task corresponding to the sensing data through the maintenance control model;  adjusting and optimizing the initial maintenance task according to the sensing data by the reinforced learning model to generate a target maintenance task;  and maintaining and controlling the equipment to be maintained for the humanoid robot based on the target maintenance task.

This application provides an intelligent grabbing control method and system based on tactile perception The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a tactile feedback signal through a sensor array of the humanoid robot,  performing frequency domain decomposition on the signal by adopting a Fourier transform method,  analyzing pressure and deformation data of each contact point on the surface of an object to be grabbed,  and calculating to obtain the frequency characteristic distribution of the tactile feedback signal; if the preliminary estimated value of the object stiffness gradient exceeds the threshold value,  the finite element analysis of the object stiffness gradient is carried out,  and the time domain processing result of the tactile feedback signal is combined to obtain the object stiffness gradient distribution; according to the gradient distribution of object stiffness,  Bayesian inference method is used to model the deformation field probabilistically,  and iterative optimization is carried out according to the modeling results to obtain the dynamic update parameters of the deformation field mapping; according to the trigger conditions of grasping failure detection,  the action sequence of the humanoid robot end effector is regenerated based on the optimized strategy to determine the final grasping control parameters. 1. An intelligent grabbing control method based on tactile sensation,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the touch feedback signal through the sensor array of the human-shaped robot,  performing the frequency domain decomposition on the touch feedback signal by the Fourier transformation method,  combining the pressure of each contact point on the surface of the object to be captured and the deformation data analysis,  calculating to obtain the frequency characteristic distribution of the touch feedback signal;  according to the frequency characteristic distribution of the touch feedback signal,  capturing the local and global frequency characteristics of the touch feedback signal by the convolution kernel of different receptive fields,  performing layered classification to the rigidity gradient of the object to be captured,  determining the initial estimation value of the rigidity gradient of the object;  if the initial estimation value of the object rigidity gradient exceeds the threshold value,  calculating the object rigidity gradient distribution by combining the time domain processing result of the touch feedback signal and the geometrical outline of the surface of the object to be captured;  according to the object rigidity gradient distribution,  using Bayesian deducing method to perform probability modelling on the deformation field,  calculating the dynamic updating parameter of the deformation field mapping;  using the dynamic updating parameter of the deformation field mapping as the state input,  using the impedance parameter of each joint of the executor at the end of the humanoid robot as the action output,  if the adjusted impedance parameter satisfies the preset moment balance condition,  the joint angle of the executor at the tail end of the human-shaped robot is optimized to obtain the execution instruction of the moment balance control;  adopting the preset grabbing control strategy,  according to the execution instruction of the moment balance control,  correcting the grabbing action of the actuator at the tail end of the humanoid robot,  according to the corrected grabbing action,  judging the standard condition of the grabbing control precision,  if the grabbing control precision does not reach the standard,  constructing the triggering condition of the grabbing failure detection;  optimizing the grabbing control strategy according to the triggering condition of the grabbing failure detection,  regenerating the action sequence of the human-shaped robot end executor based on the optimized grabbing control strategy,  and determining the final grabbing control parameter of each joint of the human-shaped robot end executor.

The invention relates to the technical field of robot control,  and provides a robot real-time remote control method and system based on motion capture. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring joint motion information of an operator; correct the rotation offset of the difference between the joint action information collection coordinate system and the robot coordinate system Set a fixed offset for the elbow joint,  dynamically generate and update the link and joint information of the virtual human body,  update the topological relationship model between joints,  extract the target angle of each joint,  and gradually update each joint angle of the robot through smoothing processing,  so as to realize the following control of the robot action According to the invention,  coordinate correction,  topological modeling and proportional mapping are carried out on human joint motion information,  and smooth function processing is combined,  so that high-efficiency conversion from human body motion to robot motion is realized This method does not require accurate modeling or a large amount of training data,  has low latency,  high stability and good deployability,  and significantly improves the practicality and ease of remote control of humanoid robots. 1. A robot real-time remote control method based on motion capture,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the trunk section and the joint action information of the operator sending the control information;  based on the received joint action information,  determining the relative position of each joint according to the trunk section,  performing rotation offset correction on the difference between the joint action information collecting coordinate system and the robot coordinate system,  setting a fixed offset for the elbow joint,  dynamically generating and updating the connecting rod and the joint information of the virtual human body model to obtain the topological relation model between the updated joints;  based on the topology relation model between the updated joints,  extracting the target angle of each joint,  gradually updating each joint angle of the robot through smooth processing,  realizing the following control of the robot action.

The invention relates to a robot joint control method,  a robot joint control system and a humanoid robot The method comprises estimating the first rotation position information of the first joint motor based on the acceleration and angular velocity information measured by the robot's two-degree-of-freedom joint; calculating the second rotation position information of the first joint motor based on the robot visual signal; obtain the actual measured motor rotation position information measured by the motor encoder of the first joint; comparing the first rotation position information,  the second rotation position information and the actually measured rotation position information of the motor to diagnose the health state of the motor encoder of the first joint; if it is diagnosed that the health status of the motor encoder of the first joint is abnormal,  then the rotation position information of the first motor is used to realize the safety buffer control of the motor of the first joint,  which solves the safety control problem when the humanoid robot joint motor encoder fails,  and achieves the technical effect of significantly improving the safety and reliability of the humanoid robot. 1. A control method of robot joint,  wherein the robot joint has two orthogonal rotation degrees of freedom,  the robot joint comprises a first joint and a second joint,  and the first joint drives the second joint to rotate through its own rotation,  the control method comprises :  estimating the rotation angle of the second joint relative to the first joint based on the acceleration and angular speed information measured by the robot joint to obtain the first rotation position information of the first joint motor;  calculating the rotation angle of the second joint relative to the first joint based on the robot visual signal to obtain the second rotation position information of the first joint motor;  obtaining the actually measured motor rotation position information measured by the motor encoder of the first joint;  comparing the first rotation position information,  the second rotation position information and the measured motor rotation position information,  and diagnosing the health state of the motor encoder of the first joint;  if the health state of the motor encoder of the first joint is abnormal,  using the first rotation position information to perform safety buffer control on the motor of the first joint.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot uninterrupted work control method and device. The humanoid robot uninterrupted work control method includes real-time monitoring of the power of the first battery,  and when the power of the first battery is greater than the first preset threshold,  the first battery Provide power to the first load of the humanoid robot; when the power of the first battery is less than or equal to the first preset threshold,  the second battery supplies power to the second load of the humanoid robot,  so that the humanoid robot remains in a standing state or operates in a low-power state. The invention realizes the live-line power exchange of the humanoid robot and avoids the impact of shutdown operation on work efficiency. 1. A continuous working control method of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  monitoring the electric quantity of the first battery in real time,  when the electric quantity of the first battery is greater than the first preset threshold,  the first battery supplies power to the first load of the humanoid robot;  when the electric quantity of the first battery is less than or equal to the first preset threshold value,  the second battery supplies power to the second load of the human-shaped robot so that the human-shaped robot keeps standing state or runs in low power state;  wherein the second battery supplies power to the second load of the humanoid robot,  so that the humanoid robot operates in a low power state,  comprising :  obtaining a first load state of the humanoid robot when the first battery stops running;  determining a second load according to the first load state;  the second battery supplies power to the second load of the human-shaped robot so that the human-shaped robot is operated in low power state.

Safe,  efficient and autonomous movement 1. The invention discloses a double-arm humanoid robot,  which includes a head unit; chest unit; the arm unit is a multi-joint robotic arm; a hand unit; a chassis member having a plurality of omni-directional wheels; wherein,  the head unit,  the chest unit,  and the chassis are arranged in sequence from top to bottom,  and both sides of the chest unit are connected to arm units; the hand unit is assembled with one end of the arm unit facing away from the chest unit,  and the mechanical structures of the hand units of the two arm units are different According to the invention,  the omnidirectional wheel chassis is adopted to realize the global movement,  and the bilateral heterogeneous mechanical arms are combined for cooperative operation,  so that the space limitation of the traditional fixed-base mechanical arm is broken through,  the stability defect of the humanoid bipedal robot is also broken through,  the single machine integrates the moving and multifunctional operation capabilities,  and the humanoid bipedal robot has wider industrial application prospects 1. A double-arm humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a head unit;  a chest unit;  an arm unit,  which is a multi-joint mechanical arm;  a hand unit;  a chassis member having a plurality of omni-directional wheels;  wherein the head unit,  the chest unit and the chassis member are arranged in turn from top to bottom,  both sides of the chest unit are connected with arm units;  The hand unit is assembled with one end of the arm unit away from the chest unit,  and the mechanical structures of the hand units of the two arm units are different.

The invention discloses a hydraulic humanoid robot leg structure driven by a blade swing cylinder and a direct-drive valve group It includes a thigh structure,  a calf structure and a foot plate structure. The thigh structure is equipped with a direct-drive multi-way valve group. The end of the thigh structure is equipped with a hip joint blade swing cylinder actuator and a hip joint yaw axis piston cylinder actuator. ABSTRACT AI-Integrated Mechanical Gripper System for Human-Robot Collaboration in Industry 5.0 Environments The present invention discloses an advanced AI-integrated mechanical gripper system specifically designed for collaborative applications in Industry 5.0 environments. The system is engineered to facilitate safe,  efficient,  and intelligent interaction between industrial robots and human operators. By leveraging real-time sensor inputs and embedded artificial intelligence,  the gripper can autonomously identify,  classify,  and adapt to various objects,  adjusting its grip strength and orientation accordingly. This dynamic capability allows it to handle a wide range of objects with different sizes,  shapes,  and materials,  enhancing its applicability in manufacturing,  packaging,  and assembly lines. The gripper is equipped with a multi-modal sensor array including visual,  thermal,  tactile,  and proximity sensors. These sensors work in coordination with AI algorithms to recognize human presence,  detect object characteristics,  and adapt to changing environments in real time. Safety protocols are embedded within the AI logic,  enabling the system to halt or alter its behavior in response to human proximity or gestures,  thereby reducing the risk of workplace injuries. Additionally,  the system includes a feedback loop that uses reinforcement learning to improve gripping accuracy over time,  making the system progressively smarter and more reliable. This invention represents a significant advancement in robotic end-effector technology,  enabling robots to work alongside humans in a cooperative and context-aware manner. It bridges the gap between rigid automation and intelligent,  adaptive systems capable of operating in unstructured human-centric environments. The AI-integrated mechanical gripper not only boosts productivity and quality but also aligns with the core goals of Industry 5.0 — personalized manufacturing,  human-machine collaboration,  and sustainable industrial development.

Abstract The present invention discloses an adaptive machine learning framework designed for robust,  real-time multimodal human action recognition in dynamic and partially observable environments. Leveraging advances in deep learning,  the invention integrates multiple sensory modalities— including RGB video,  depth maps,  skeletal pose data,  audio signals,  and inertial motion unit (IMU) data—using a unified,  scalable architecture that addresses the limitations of existing unimodal or statically fused recognition systems. At the core of the invention is a set of modality-specific encoders,  each tailored to extract high-level spatiotemporal features from its respective input :  RGB data is processed using 2D/3D CNNs,  pose sequences via Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (ST-GCN),  audio signals through 1D/2D CNNs,  and IMU data using time-series convolutional models. To handle temporal asynchrony across modalities,  a temporal alignment layer performs differentiable interpolation and time-warping,  enabling end-to-end trainable synchronization. The aligned features are passed through context-aware fusion blocks employing cross-modal attention mechanisms,  allowing the system to dynamically weigh the contribution of each modality based on contextual relevance and signal strength. A key innovation is the Modality Gating Unit (MGU),  which continuously evaluates the reliability and availability of each input stream and adaptively includes,  excludes,  or down-weights modalities in real-time. This ensures robust operation even under partial sensor failure,  noise,  or occlusion. To model both short- and long-term dependencies inherent in human actions,  the system incorporates a temporal modeling stack composed of Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCNs) and Transformer-based encoders,  which collectively capture hierarchical temporal patterns across modalities. The final feature representation is then classified using fully connected layers to identify the most probable human action class. The framework is modular and supports dynamic scalability,  enabling real-time operation on both edge devices and cloud platforms. It is compatible with model compression techniques such as pruning and quantization,  facilitating efficient deployment in resource- constrained environments. This invention significantly improves the accuracy,  adaptability,  and robustness of human action recognition systems and is applicable in diverse domains such as intelligent surveillance,  healthcare monitoring,  virtual reality,  human-robot interaction,  and sports analytics.

Abstract The present invention discloses a novel deep learning-based system for multimodal human action recognition,  which integrates diverse sensory data—such as RGB video,  depth maps,  skeletal joint coordinates,  audio signals,  and inertial motion data—to accurately and robustly identify human actions in dynamic and uncertain environments. Existing human action recognition models typically rely on a single modality,  often visual data,  which makes them highly susceptible to occlusions,  lighting variations,  sensor noise,  and ambiguous actions. This invention addresses such limitations by introducing a comprehensive fusion architecture that leverages the complementary strengths of each modality through adaptive,  trainable mechanisms. The core innovation lies in the design of Align-and-Attend Fusion Blocks that temporally and spatially align input streams before applying a cross-modal attention mechanism to dynamically weigh the relevance of each modality. A novel Modality Gating Unit (MGU) allows the system to learn and modulate the contribution of each modality based on context,  input quality,  and data availability. This ensures consistent performance even when certain modalities are partially missing or corrupted. To synchronize asynchronous data (e.g.,  depth and audio streams captured at different rates),  the invention incorporates a Temporal Alignment Layer that performs differentiable time-warping and interpolation. The system also includes multi-scale temporal modeling using temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) and transformers,  enabling it to capture both short-term movements and long- range dependencies in human motion. The network is trained end-to-end using a combination of supervised classification loss,  contrastive alignment loss,  and modality-consistency regularizers. A key strength of the system is its flexibility and scalability. The architecture supports dynamic modality inclusion or exclusion,  allowing real-time operation on cloud-based infrastructure or edge devices with reduced sensor inputs. Furthermore,  it is compatible with model compression techniques such as quantization and pruning,  making it suitable for deployment in resource-constrained environments. Applications of the invention span across intelligent surveillance systems,  elderly care monitoring,  immersive gaming,  sports analytics,  wearable health devices,  and human– robot interaction. Experimental validations demonstrate substantial improvements in recognition accuracy,  robustness under modality failure,  and adaptability across various public datasets (e.g.,  NTU RGB+D,  Kinetics,  UTD-MHAD). This invention represents a significant step forward in robust multimodal action recognition,  providing a scalable,  intelligent,  and real-world-ready framework that intelligently integrates heterogeneous sensor data using deep learning,  enabling reliable understanding of human behavior in complex scenarios.

A double-arm humanoid robot clothes folding method based on clothes posture estimation,  wherein it comprises the following specific steps :  1) obtaining a clothes image,  dividing the clothes foreground and desktop background in the clothes image to obtain a divided image;  2) extracting the clothes outline of the divided image to obtain the outline pattern of the clothes,  wherein the outline pattern of the clothes has 500-5000 boundary points;  3) performing the fitting of the simplified polygon on the outline pattern of the clothes to obtain the simplified fitting polygon,  wherein the fitting polygon has 5-30 boundary points;  4) according to the geometrical characteristic of the clothes outline polygon,  using Gaussian model to perform modelling on different types of clothes and clothes folding operation steps to obtain a clothes polygon model database,  specifically comprising :  4.1) aiming at the outline polygon of the clothes of the same type,  the initial Gaussian model learns and trains the three geometric features of the known clothes outline polygon to obtain the trained Gaussian model to finish the Gaussian model modelling;  the three geometric features are the distance between two adjacent vertexes of the simplified fitting polygon corresponding to the known clothes outline polygon,  the proportion of the length of the line section between the vertexes relative to the perimeter of the whole polygon and the angle size of the included angle corresponding to each vertexes;  4.2) deleting or adding the Gaussian model vertex after training,  forming a next polygonal model;  4.3) gathering the trained Gaussian model and the next polygon model to form a clothes polygon model database;  5) appointing the specific clothes folding operation step from the clothes polygon model database according to the user requirement;  6) matching the simplified fitting polygon obtained in the step 3) with the specific clothes folding operation step obtained in the step 5) to obtain the polygon model corresponding to the clothes in the current image,  wherein the polygon model corresponding to the clothes in the current image represents the posture corresponding to the current clothes;  8) updating the parameter of the posture corresponding to the next clothes folding operation step obtained in step 7),  obtaining the updated posture;  9) the double-arm robot uses the obstacle-avoiding movement planning algorithm to finish the obstacle-avoiding movement planning of the updated posture in the step 8) from the posture operation corresponding to the current clothes in the step 6).

Provided herein are methods for Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor compensation utilizing deep neural network (DNN) technology. In some embodiments,  the methods involve receiving sensor values from gyroscopes,  accelerometers,  and non-motion sensors,  then loading these values into a deep learning algorithm alongside true sensor values. Unlike traditional calibration techniques that rely on complex parametric models,  this approach may utilize a neural network to directly process raw sensor data and enhance output signal accuracy. In some embodiments,  the training process employs ground truth data for approximately 70% of inputs,  with the remaining 30% dedicated to sensor compensation. The technique may be implemented in standalone IMUs,  augmented IMUs,  and navigation systems,  offering improved accuracy and reduced computational overhead across various technological applications.

The invention discloses a control method for a humanoid robot to fall to the ground and climb up based on force and position hybrid control The robot is in prostration at the beginning,  and after receiving the instruction of climbing up,  it starts to move,  and the angle of each joint reaches the corresponding angle calculated by inverse kinematics,  and then applies torque to each joint of the upper body,  and then makes the upper body leave the ground When the foot force enters the friction cone,  the state of the lower body is switched from position control to force control; after the state is switched to force control,  PD control of the ankle and linear secondary adjustment of the difference between the plantar forces of the two feet are carried out until the pitch angle,  roll angle and yaw angle of the upper body are all 0,  and the squatting state of the humanoid robot is completed Then the squatting state is converted to the final standing state. During the process,  virtual constraints are applied and the standing is completed through position control. Finally,  the humanoid robot can stand stably. The invention adopts a simplified model to greatly simplify the process of standing up,  designs a transition posture,  and well realizes the standing action of the robot. 1. A method for controlling human-like robot to climb down on the ground based on force-position hybrid control,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) enabling the humanoid robot to be in an initial posture of prone position,  and then sending a crawling action instruction to the humanoid robot through a computer;  (2) after the humanoid robot receives the climbing action instruction,  starting to move,  the angle of each joint reaches the corresponding angle calculated by the inverse kinematics,  at this time,  the humanoid robot is in the prostrate transition state;  (3) after the humanoid robot is in prostration transition state,  respectively applying moment to each joint of the upper body of the humanoid robot,  and then separating the upper body of the humanoid robot from the ground;  (4) when the foot bottom force of the humanoid robot enters the friction cone,  switching the state from the position control to the force control to the lower body of the humanoid robot;  (5) after the state is switched to the force control,  performing PD control on the ankle of the humanoid robot and performing linear secondary adjustment on the difference between the foot bottom forces of the two feet of the humanoid robot,  until the pitch angle of the upper body of the humanoid robot,  when the roll angle and yaw angle are 0,  finishing the implementation of the squatting state of the humanoid robot;  (6) then from squatting and standing state to the last standing state,  in the process applying virtual constraint and through position control finish standing,  finally imitating human robot can stably stand.

A humanoid robot flexible assembly method based on thinking chain,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the assembly task instruction provided by the user;  performing task analysis on the assembly task instruction through the thinking chain model,  and in the analysis process,  calculating the weight of each word in the assembly task instruction through the attention mechanism,  dynamically adjusting the analysis target related to the current task according to the weight,  decomposing the task layer by layer into multiple sub-tasks according to the analysis target to obtain a task tree structure;  traversing the task tree structure to determine an assembly plan,  wherein the assembly plan comprises an execution arrangement order,  a task path plan and an assembly action parameter;  controlling the humanoid robot to execute the assembling operation according to the assembling plan;  The step of obtaining the assembly task instruction provided by the user comprises the following steps :  obtaining the multimodal data provided by the user,  wherein the multimodal data comprises character,  voice and visual information,  the visual information comprises gesture;  using natural language processing technology to perform word segmentation,  part-of-speech marking and semantic analysis to the character and voice,  extracting the main content and intention of the task to obtain the text information;  extracting the shape and motion track of the gesture to obtain the gesture characteristic,  classifying and identifying the gesture characteristic,  and converting the gesture characteristic into the symbol information;  mapping the text information and the symbol information to a vector space to obtain the assembly task instruction;  the step of calculating the weight of each word in the assembly task instruction through the attention mechanism,  dynamically adjusting the analysis target related to the current task according to the weight,  comprising the following steps :  calculating the attention score of each word in the assembling task instruction based on the context information through the attention mechanism,  wherein the context information comprises the task history state of the last time step and the field knowledge related to the task;  normalizing the attention score to obtain the weight of the word;  determining the word with the weight greater than the preset threshold as the analysis target related to the present task;  Wherein,  the scoring function ei expression of the attention mechanism is as follows :  ei = Score (hi,  St-1) = vTtanh (Whhi + WsSt-1 + Wkki);  in the formula,  hi is the hidden state of the ith word in the input sequence;  St-1 represents the decoder state of the previous time step,  reflecting the historical context of the model,  ki is the domain knowledge vector,  representing the domain knowledge related to the task;  Wh,  Ws,  Wk represent a weight matrix,  which is a parameter to be optimized by learning;  v is a learnable weight vector for weighting and summarizing the output of the tanh function.

The invention relates to an analytical solution method,  device,  terminal and storage medium for regulating and controlling the stepping cycle and stepping position of a biped robot. Abstract The increasing demand for automated attendance systems in educational institutions has driven the development of intelligent robotic solutions for faculty management. This paper presents an AI-powered humanoid robot designed for facial recognition-based attendance tracking and interactive faculty greeting,  incorporating technologies such as OpenCV,  MediaPipe,  the face_recognition library,  and the Robot Operating System (ROS). A 120° wide-angle camera is used for real-time facial detection,  with MediaPipe efficiently detecting facial landmarks and face_recognition generating face encodings for accurate identification. Once a known individual is recognized,  the robot logs their attendance into an Excel sheet using pandas and greets them with a personalized voice message via Google Text-to-Speech (gTTS). Gestures such as waving or bowing are executed using AiNex SDK-controlled servo motors,  adding a natural human-robot interaction element. To avoid redundant logging,  the system records attendance only once per session per person and skips repeated greetings for the same individual. ROS ensures synchronized communication between the robot’s sensors,  actuators,  and software modules. A dedicated mobile application enhances usability,  offering real-time camera feeds,  system monitoring,  and remote control functionalities. By integrating AI-driven face recognition with robotics and natural language processing,  this system improves the accuracy,  efficiency,  and interactivity of faculty attendance processes. Future enhancements could include multi-face recognition,  cloud-based storage,  and gesture-based user input to further extend the system’s capabilities and scalability.

As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more embedded in daily life,  there is a critical need for autonomous systems that not only execute tasks efficiently but also reflect human values and intentions. Agentic AI refers to AI systems with decision-making autonomy that remain transparent,  explainable,  and accountable. This research introduces a novel framework for developing Agentic AI by embedding ethical principles,  human values,  and social norms into its decision-making processes. Drawing from cognitive architectures,  value alignment strategies,  and human- centered design,  the proposed approach fosters the creation of responsible and effective autonomous systems. A case study involving a humanoid robot assisting elderly individuals illustrates the framework’s practical application. The robot demonstrated decision-making aligned with core human values,  such as empathy and respect for personal autonomy,  while enhancing the overall well-being of its users. This research advances the development of trustworthy Agentic AI and has broad potential across domains like healthcare,  education,  and intelligent transportation systems.

This application provides a human-like machine action coordination method and system based on joint torque The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring original torque data of a humanoid robot joint through a sensor,  pre-processing the original torque data,  outputting stable torque data,  constructing an impedance control model by combining mechanical arm joint angle data of the humanoid robot,  and predicting a torque change trend to obtain a predicted torque sequence; perform adaptive threshold detection on the predicted torque sequence to identify torque peaks with different amplitudes; analyze the propagation velocity of the torque peak,  and calculate the velocity vector of the peak propagation based on the direction of the torque peak propagation; judging whether the speed vector of the peak propagation exceeds the preset threshold,  if so,  predicting the response trend of the joint torque controller to determine whether the humanoid robot joint control parameters need to be adjusted; if it is necessary to adjust the joint control parameters of the humanoid robot,  optimize the stiffness and damping parameters of the impedance control model to output a stable control signal. 1. A human-like machine action coordination method based on joint torque,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the original data of the joint moment of the humanoid robot through the sensor,  pre-processing the original data of the moment,  and outputting the stable moment data;  obtaining the mechanical arm joint angle data of the human-shaped robot through the sensor,  the mechanical arm joint angle data is combined with the stable torque data to construct an impedance control model,  and predicting the torque change trend,  obtaining a predicted torque sequence;  performing self-adaptive threshold detection to the predicted moment sequence,  and identifying moment peak values of different amplitudes;  analyzing the transmission speed of the moment peak value by a non-uniform sliding window method,  and calculating the speed vector of the peak value transmission by combining the transmission direction of the moment peak value;  judging whether the speed vector of the peak value transmission exceeds the preset threshold,  if so,  predicting the response trend of the joint moment controller by combining the size and direction of the peak value transmission speed and the peak value amplitude change rate so as to judge whether it is necessary to adjust the joint control parameter of the humanoid robot;  if it is necessary to adjust the joint control parameter of the humanoid robot,  optimizing the rigidity and damping parameter of the impedance control model according to the transmission speed vector and amplitude change rate of the moment peak value to obtain the optimized control parameter;  aiming at the optimized control parameter,  calculating the amplitude of the response signal output by the controller,  if the amplitude of the response signal output by the controller is in the preset range,  outputting the stable control signal.

A human-like robot systemic positive/negative dynamic modelling method with closed-loop constraint structure,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  establishing a world coordinate system of the robot,  the floating base and the local coordinate system of each joint,  the knee joint and the ankle joint of the robot are driven by a four-connecting rod mechanism,  the topological structure of the robot is a closed-loop structure,  the geometric constraint equation and the analytic expression of the corresponding first-order differential constraint equation are established,  the independent generalized speed is definite;  step two :  The topology structure of the robot is equivalent to an open-loop tree structure :  equivalent processing space inertia,  space acceleration,  gyro force vector,  rigid body transformation matrix,  hinge mapping matrix and Coriolis space acceleration,  the foot,  universal joint,  ankle outer motor,  ankle inner motor,  calf,  the knee joint connecting rod and the knee joint motor are combined to form a polymerization node,  at the same time,  the knee joint and ankle joint four-connecting rod transmission mechanism is cut off;  step three :  based on the recursion type hinge body algorithm,  according to the known each joint driving moment,  calculating the acceleration of the floating base and each joint,  obtaining the positive dynamic model of the constraint embedded form;  step four :  based on generalized hinge body algorithm of recursion form,  according to known each joint acceleration,  calculating floating base acceleration and each joint driving moment,  obtaining inverse dynamic model of constraint embedded form.

The invention relates to a low-power-consumption monitoring wake-up method,  a low-power-consumption monitoring wake-up device and equipment based on humanoid recognition The method comprises the following steps of :  performing down-sampling and background difference on an original image sequence acquired by low-power-consumption monitoring equipment to obtain a preliminary target mask; extracting humanoid features to obtain false labels of humanoid regions; training to obtain the initial humanoid recognition model and extracting multi-scale features to obtain the target feature vector; classifying to obtain preliminary humanoid recognition result and optimizing to obtain humanoid target tracking sequence; calculate scene activity indicators,  generate multi-mode adaptive monitoring strategies,  and adjust low-power work plans; perform incremental learning to obtain the target humanoid recognition model and generate a multi-level wake-up control strategy. The implementation of the invention improves the energy utilization efficiency of the monitoring equipment,  prolongs the service life of the battery,  and can also improve the accuracy and real-time performance of monitoring,  providing users with a more reliable and intelligent security solution. 1. A low power consumption monitoring wake-up method based on human shape identification,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  down-sampling and grey-scaling the original image sequence collected by the low power consumption monitoring device to obtain a pre-processed image and perform background difference to obtain a primary target mask;  extracting the human shape feature of the primary target mask to obtain the candidate shape region and calculating the shape descriptor to obtain the human shape region fake label;  obtaining an initial human-shape recognition model based on the human-shape region pseudo-label training and performing multi-scale feature extraction to obtain a local space depth feature graph and a target feature vector;  reading the current electric quantity information of the device,  obtaining the electric quantity percentage,  and setting the power consumption control level according to the electric quantity percentage,  obtaining the electric quantity self-adaptive control strategy;  generating a multi-mode self-adaptive monitoring strategy based on the scene activity index,  the illumination self-adaptive processing strategy and the electric quantity self-adaptive control strategy;  setting the image collecting frequency according to the multi-mode self-adaptive monitoring strategy to obtain the dynamic sampling solution,  and adjusting the working parameter of the image sensor based on the dynamic sampling solution to obtain the optimized image collecting strategy;  selecting image processing complexity according to the multi-mode self-adaptive monitoring strategy,  obtaining algorithm complexity control solution,  and based on the algorithm complexity control solution and the optimized image collecting strategy,  formulating the low power consumption working solution of the low power consumption monitoring device; The present invention relates to the field of robotic dogs,  and more specifically,  to a quadruped robotic dog dynamic grabbing method and system combined with 6D posture estimation. The method comprises the following steps of :  modeling and optimizing a quadruped robot dog with a mechanical arm to obtain a dynamic model of the quadruped robot dog,  and designing a quadruped robot dog controller according to the dynamic model of the quadruped robot dog; using the 6D attitude estimation method of CAD model to obtain the real-time position and attitude information of the object to be grasped; according to the position and posture information of the object to be grabbed,  the quadruped robot dog controller controls the movement of the quadruped robot dog with a robotic arm,  and realizes dynamic grabbing of the object to be grabbed. The method uses a 6D attitude estimation method of a CAD model to obtain real-time position and attitude information of an object to be grabbed; the quadruped robot dog controller controls the movement of the quadruped robot dog and performs real-time planning to achieve dynamic grabbing of the items to be grabbed. And the grabbing range can be customized to further improve the success rate of grabbing items. 1.  the whole body controller based on the layered optimization is designed to track the track generated by the model prediction controller;  the system controller sets different priorities for different control tasks by layering optimization,  when there is contradiction between the control tasks,  the execution of the task with high priority is ensured;  The nonlinear model predictive control is constructed as an optimal control problem :  s.t.G (x (t),  u (t),  t) = H (x (t),  u (t),  t) = 0 x (0) = x0,  wherein x (t) E Rn and u (t) E Rm are respectively state vector and input vector,  the cost function is composed of a terminal cost phi (x (T)) at T moment and a process cost L (x (t),  u (t),  t) from 0 to T moment,  the time period T defines the prediction range of the nonlinear model prediction control,  the second formula is the system model used in the optimization process,  establishing the mapping relation between the state x (t) and the input u (t) for describing and predicting the dynamic behaviour of the system;  In combination with the first equation,  the optimal solution xi * of the hierarchical optimization problem is transformed into a robot dog drive joint torque :  wherein for the mechanical arm end actuator space force track generated by the whole body planner,  and respectively is the control moment of each leg joint and each mechanical arm joint; The invention relates to the technical field of video splicing,  and discloses a splicing method,  device,  equipment and storage medium for surveillance videos. The method includes :  performing video framing on surveillance videos collected by a surveillance terminal to obtain multiple target video frames; performing humanoid detection to obtain humanoid detection result; aligning and cropping the human face area in the human face detection result to obtain standardized human face image and extracting human face feature vector; perform motion prediction and trajectory extrapolation to obtain multi-target humanoid tracking results; input the multi-target humanoid tracking results into the distributed computing framework for task allocation and cross-node feature matching to obtain the global humanoid tracking results; according to the global humanoid tracking results,  dual-stream network processing is performed on multiple target video frames,  video splicing parameters are calculated,  and splicing operations are performed on multiple target video frames to obtain spliced videos. The present invention effectively improves the quality and visual effects of spliced videos. 1. A splicing method of monitoring video,  wherein the method comprises :  performing video frame division to the monitoring video collected by the monitoring terminal to obtain multiple target video frames;  performing the human shape detection on the YOLOv5 model input by the multiple target video frames to obtain the human shape detection result;  Specifically,  the method includes :  performing multi-scale conversion on the plurality of target video frames,  generating three feature maps of different scales by a bilinear interpolation method,  which are 1/8,  1/16 and 1/32 of the original input size,  respectively,  to obtain a multi-scale input feature map;  orderly inputting the multi-scale input characteristic diagram into the backbone network of the improved YOLOv5 model,  the backbone network adds a space attention module behind each convolution block,  the space attention module emphasizes important space area by generating a two-dimensional attention weight diagram,  obtaining a preliminary feature map containing spatial attention information;  performing channel attention processing on the preliminary feature graph,  firstly calculating the global average pool value of each channel,  then inputting the pool result into a multi-layer perceptron composed of two layers of full connection layers,  wherein the neuron number of the first layer is 1/16 of the channel number,  the second layer is recovered to the original channel number,  finally,  obtaining the channel weight through the Sigmoid activation function,  multiplying the channel weight by the element-by-element of the primary feature image to obtain an enhanced feature image containing space and channel attention information at the same time;  inputting the enhanced feature image into a feature pyramid network,  performing feature fusion through a path from top to bottom and a transverse connection,  wherein the path from top to bottom uses 1*1 convolution to perform channel number adjustment and 2 times up-sampling,  the transverse connection uses 1*1 convolution to perform processing on the same layer feature,  finally obtaining the multi-scale fusion characteristic image;  applying 3 * 3 convolution kernel to the multi-scale fusion feature image to perform feature extraction,  keeping the size of the feature image unchanged,  then using 1 * 1 convolution kernel to compress the channel number into the sum of the preset anchor frame number multiplied by 5 and type number,  wherein 5 represents 4 coordinate values and 1 confidence value of the boundary frame,  obtaining the original prediction result;  decoding the original prediction result,  converting the predicted boundary frame coordinate from the offset relative to the grid into the image absolute coordinate,  specifically by multiplying the predicted relative coordinate by the step length of the feature map and adding the left upper angle coordinate of the corresponding grid,  at the same time,  applying Sigmoid function to process confidence and class probability,  mapping it to 0 to 1,  to obtain the decoded prediction result;  based on the decoded prediction result,  using non-maximum value suppression algorithm to screen the overlapped detection frame,  firstly arranging all the detection frames according to confidence degree descending order,  then comparing one by one,  calculating the intersection ratio of the overlapped frame,  when the intersection ratio is greater than the preset threshold value 0. 5,  keeping the frame with the highest confidence degree and deleting other overlapped frame,  obtaining the human shape detection result;  aligning and cutting the human face area in the human shape detection result to obtain standard human face image,  and extracting human face feature vector;  performing motion prediction and trajectory extrapolation based on the face feature vector and the human shape detection result to obtain a multi-target human shape tracking result;  inputting the multi-target humanoid tracking result into a distributed computing framework to perform task distribution and cross-node feature matching,  obtaining a global humanoid tracking result;  performing double-flow network processing to the multiple target video frames according to the global human shape tracking result,  calculating to obtain the video splicing parameter,  and performing splicing operation to the multiple target video frames to obtain the splicing video.

The present disclosure provides a method and device for controlling a two-wheeled foot robot through height obstacles based on deep reinforcement learning,  and a motion control model training method. The control method comprises the following steps of :  judging whether the robot encounters a height obstacle or not according to motion feedback data of the two-wheeled foot robot,  when the robot encounters the height obstacle,  controlling the two-wheeled foot robot to execute a take-off action,  and simultaneously controlling the two-wheeled foot structure to attach to the height obstacle to quickly rotate forwards until the motion feedback data does not meet a preset condition; among them,  the take-off action is output by the strategy network trained based on the deep reinforcement learning algorithm in highly obstructed terrain. Through the take-off action of the robot and the rapid forward rotation of the two-wheeled foot structure,  the present disclosure can improve the performance effect of the two-wheeled foot robot in passing through high obstacles,  thereby improving the robot's adaptability to complex environments. 1. A two-wheeled foot robot through height obstacle control method based on deep reinforcement learning,  wherein it comprises :  when the motion feedback data of the double-wheel foot robot meets the preset condition,  judging that the robot meets the height obstacle;  controlling the double-wheel-foot robot to perform a jumping action,  the jumping action comprises fast rising after the main body squatting,  and controlling the double-wheel-foot structure of the double-wheel-foot robot to attach the height obstacle so as to fast rotate positively higher than the normal driving rotating speed,  so as to generate effective friction to assist the double-wheel-foot robot to climb,  until the motion feedback data of the double-wheel foot robot does not meet the preset condition;  wherein the take-off action is output by the strategy network obtained by training based on the depth strengthening learning algorithm in the high-obstacle terrain.
