The invention pertains to a master-slave teleoperation robot system utilizing force mixed reality,  relevant to teleoperation robot technology. The system consists of a master robot linked to a mixed reality device,  which receives point cloud information to create a virtual environment. The slave robot features a depth camera that captures point cloud data from the real environment,  transmitting it to the master robot in real time. This point cloud information generates a virtual fixture,  which produces virtual force applied to the slave robot. The virtual force interacts with the actual environmental forces acting on the slave robot,  guiding the operator's behavior at the master side. The system addresses incorrect occlusion between the real dynamic robot and the virtual scene by blending virtual and real elements. Through mixed reality with force guidance and feedback,  it minimizes the risk of potentially harmful collisions during operations.

An intelligent splicing method for grid building measurement maps based on BIM and SLAM positioning,  including the following steps; the BIM model of the grid building is combined with the SLAM positioning algorithm to determine the posture of the quadruped robot and obtain its position information; obtain the horizontal positions of all grid node projections through the grid building BIM model; according to the position information,  use multi-line lidar to scan and plan the path to reach the initial point; reaching the projection position of the initial point,  measuring the distance between the grid node and its adjacent nodes,  comparing the measured data with the information of the nodes in the BIM model,  if there is an error,  marking the error,  if there is no error,  measuring the next node data,  and saving the currently measured map data and splicing; repeat the steps until all nodes have been measured and the map data is saved,  and the measurement evaluation report is output The invention not only efficiently and accurately realizes the health assessment of grid buildings,  but also can be adaptively applied to grid buildings in complex scenes. 1. An intelligent splicing method of grid building measurement map based on BIM and SLAM location,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  using the BIM model of the net frame building to combine with the SLAM positioning algorithm to determine the self posture of the four-foot robot,  obtaining the current position information of the four-foot robot in the building;  S2 :  obtaining the horizontal positions projected by all net frame nodes through the net frame building BIM model so as to obtain the horizontal plane coordinate point,  selecting the net frame node at the left upper corner as the measuring initial point;  S3 :  the four-foot robot uses the multi-line laser radar to scan and plan the path to reach the initial point obtained by S2 according to the position information obtained in the step S1;  S4 :  the four-foot robot reaches the projection position of the initial point,  measuring the distance between the net frame node and the adjacent node thereof,  comparing the measuring data with the information of the node in the BIM model,  if there is an error,  marking the error,  if there is no error,  measuring the next node data,  at the same time,  storing the currently measured map data and splicing them;  S5 :  repeating the step S4 until all nodes in the net frame building are measured and storing the map data,  and outputting the measurement evaluation report.

The invention relates to the technical field of point cloud map construction,  and in particular refers to a method and system for constructing a dense point cloud map of a humanoid robot,  which includes :  obtaining video images collected when the humanoid robot walks in real time; judging the gait phase of the humanoid robot in the current frame image in the video image; estimating the camera pose of the current frame image based on the gait phase of the humanoid robot of the current frame image; determining whether the current frame image is a key frame based on the camera pose of the current frame image; perform local mapping and loop detection based on key frames to obtain a global dense point cloud map. The invention effectively improves the blurring and shaking of the collected data when the humanoid robot builds a map,  can obtain a more accurate environmental map,  improves the accuracy of the operation when the robot executes tasks,  and reduces the risk of collision during the walking process of the humanoid robot. 1. A construction method of human-shaped robot dense point cloud map,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the video image collected when the humanoid robot walks in real time;  judging the gait phase of the current frame image humanoid robot in the video image,  comprising :  obtaining the sensor information when the humanoid robot is walking;  according to the sensor information,  using the gait phase model,  dividing the gait of the current frame image humanoid robot into translation motion and rotation motion,  and respectively clustering the translation motion and rotation motion into left/right foot single supporting stage and double supporting stage;  estimating the camera pose of the current frame image based on the gait phase of the current frame image humanoid robot,  comprising :  if the gait phase is the left/right foot single supporting stage of the translational motion,  then using the constant speed motion model to estimate the camera pose of the current frame image;  if the gait phase is the left/right foot single supporting stage of the rotary motion,  then using the violent matching model to estimate the camera pose of the current frame image;  if the gait phase is the double-supporting stage of the translation motion or the double-supporting stage of the rotation motion,  judging the gait phase of the next frame image humanoid robot in the video image;  judging whether the current frame image is a key frame based on the camera pose of the current frame image,  comprising :  the number of the inner points in the current frame image exceeds the preset inner point minimum threshold value,  and satisfies any one of the following conditions,  then it is the key frame;  wherein the first condition is that the frame number difference between the current frame image and the previous key frame is greater than the preset maximum frame number;  the second condition is that the frame number difference between the current frame image and the previous key frame is greater than the preset minimum frame number,  and the local drawing thread is in idle state;  the third condition is that the key frame number of the key frame queue in the local drawing thread is not more than three;  performing local mapping and loop-back detection according to the key frame to obtain a global dense point cloud map.

The embodiment of the invention provides a quality detection method and equipment for acquiring images of a humanoid robot The method includes :  Obtain the image collection data of the humanoid robot,  the image acquisition data includes a plurality of consecutive image frames According to the timestamps of multiple image frames,  determine the time difference corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames. If the multiple time differences are all less than the preset time length,  determine the similarity values corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames. Determine the quality inspection results of the image acquisition data based on the multiple similarity values and preset conditions. The preset conditions are related to the preset initial threshold and the incremental threshold corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames The method provided by this embodiment can reduce costs,  improve efficiency,  and ensure accuracy. 1. A quality detection method for image collection of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the image collecting data of the human-shaped robot;  said image collecting data comprises multiple continuous image frames;  determining the time difference corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames according to the time stamps of multiple image frames;  if the multiple time differences are less than the preset time length,  determining the similarity values corresponding to the multiple pairs of adjacent frames;  determining the quality detection result of the image collection data according to multiple similarity values and preset conditions;  the pre-set condition is related to the pre-set initial threshold and the increment threshold corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames;  The step of determining the similarity values respectively corresponding to the plurality of pairs of adjacent frames comprises :  calculating the similarity values corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames in turn according to the sequence of the time stamps of multiple image frames;  The step of determining the quality inspection result of the image acquisition data according to the plurality of similarity values and the preset condition comprises :  comparing the similarity value of the current adjacent frame with the first threshold;  the first threshold value is determined based on the preset initial threshold value and the increment threshold value corresponding to the last adjacent frame;  if the similarity value of the current adjacent frame is less than the first threshold value,  comparing the similarity value of the current adjacent frame with the preset initial threshold value;  if the similarity of the current adjacent frame is less than the preset initial threshold value,  then determining the current adjacent frame as an abnormal frame,  adding one to the total amount of the current abnormal frame,  obtaining a new total amount of the abnormal frame,  and adding the increment threshold value corresponding to the current adjacent frame with the total amount of the current abnormal increment threshold value,  obtaining new abnormal increment threshold total amount;  according to the new abnormal frame total amount and the new abnormal increment threshold total amount,  determining the quality detection result of the image collecting data;  The expression of the increment threshold value is :  Wherein,  is increment threshold value,  is a preset initial threshold value,  is the maximum threshold,  is the adjusting factor constant,  T is the total number of the image frame,  n is according to the time stamp sequence,  the previous frame of the adjacent frame in a plurality of image frame.

The invention discloses a humanoid orthopedic surgery robot and a control system thereof,  and relates to the technical field of surgery robots The humanoid orthopedic surgery robot and its control system The robot comprises a robot upper body and a moving part arranged at the bottom of the robot upper body,  wherein a robot head is arranged at the top of the robot upper body; functional arms are arranged on two sides of the robot upper body; a moving wheel set is arranged at the bottom of the moving part; and an auxiliary supporting component is arranged on the moving part in a staggered manner with the moving wheel set Can be moved flexibly and supported stably At the same time,  it has a robotic arm to assist manual surgical operations The robot also integrates lighting,  binocular stereo vision cameras,  touch displays and voice modules At the same time,  it provides the function of turning and pitching the head,  which can freely track lighting and shooting. It also integrates a voice interaction system to facilitate doctors to input instructions for operation. It also has additional storage space and tool storage space for medical staff to access. 1. A humanoid orthopaedic operation robot,  comprising a robot upper body and a moving part set at the bottom thereof,  the top part of the robot upper body is provided with a robot head part,  two sides of the robot upper body are provided with functional arms,  wherein the bottom part of the moving part is provided with a moving wheel group,  and the moving wheel group is composed of a pair of big-size wheel groups responsible for driving and moving and a pair of small-size wheel groups performing longitudinal elastic support;  the moving part and the moving wheel set are staggered with an auxiliary supporting component,  and the auxiliary supporting component adopts a swinging structure,  when using,  expanding towards the four sides to support,  and returning and containing when retracting;  the inner part of the upper body of the robot is provided with a storage space for sorting and storing consumables,  and the outside of the storage space is provided with a box door,  the functional arm is respectively an operation mechanical arm at one side and an operation arm at the other side,  the operation arm is provided with different operation tools,  and provides operation tool switching function,  the operation mechanical arm execution end is a mechanical arm for clamping the surgical instrument;  the robot head supports horizontal rotation and pitching rotation,  the robot head is integrated with display,  voice interaction,  illumination and image pickup functions,  the robot head captures operation mechanical arm operation position through the image pickup function and controls the rotation of the robot head through program to perform tracking illumination.

The soft humanoid robot provided by the invention solves the technical problems of high cost and low safety of humanoid robots in the prior art 1. A soft humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a charging mechanism,  a switching plate and two telescopic mechanisms (3);  the inflation mechanism comprises an inflation piece (1) and a first inflation driving piece,  the inflation piece (1) comprises a ball part and two branch parts connected with the ball part and respectively located at two sides of the ball part,  the branch part can be folded towards the direction close to the ball part;  the first charging driving piece is connected with the ball part,  and the bottom of the ball part and the first charging driving piece are installed on the top surface of the adapter plate;  two telescopic mechanisms (3) are arranged at intervals;  the telescopic mechanism (3) comprises a first telescopic air bag assembly and a second telescopic air bag assembly,  the first telescopic air bag assembly is rotatably connected with the bottom surface of the switching plate,  the other end is rotatably connected with the second telescopic air bag assembly,  the first telescopic air bag assembly and the second telescopic air bag assembly are provided with an air bag (41) and a second charging driving piece,  the second charging driving piece is connected with the air bag (41).

The invention belongs to the field of robot motion control,  and discloses a method,  a system,  a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for generating and controlling the whole body coordinated walking motion of a humanoid robot on line This method uses the whole body kinematics-centroid dynamics model to generate the whole body walking motion trajectory including the upper body joint motion information in real time in the walking motion generation; the model predictive control model is used to realize the organic combination of motion trajectory generation and real-time tracking control; solve the model predictive control model,  and use the optimal state x * and the corresponding control input u * as the input of the whole body control. In the planning stage,  the present invention includes the whole-body walking motion trajectory including the upper body joint motion information,  comprehensively considers the whole-body dynamic characteristics of arms,  waist,  etc.,  and combines a new method of long-time domain trajectory optimization and on-line control to fundamentally realize the true sense of the whole-body coordinated walking. 1. A method for online generation and control of systemic coordinated walking movement of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  using a systemic kinematics-centroid dynamics model to generate a systemic walking movement track including upper body joint movement information in real time;  adopting the model predictive control model to realize the organic combination of the motion track generation and the real-time tracking control;  wherein :  The systemic kinematics-centroid dynamics model is as follows :  Wherein,  T represents transposed;  rcom,  ci represents the coordinate of the contact point ci relative to the mass centre,  m represents the total mass of the robot,  g is the gravity acceleration,  fc is the three-dimensional contact force,  nc represents the number of the contact point,  i represents the contact point sequence number;  The model prediction control model is as follows :  Wherein,  represents a state variable,  is the mass heart momentum qb is the position of the floating base under the world coordinate system,  qj is the joint position,  representing a control input,  including a contact force and joint speed the upper mark T represents transposition,  Tm represents the total time of one foot lifting;  represents system state equation,  t represents time;  L (x,  u,  t) and phi (x (Tm)) represent the stage cost and the terminal cost,  respectively;  g (x,  u,  t) and h (x,  u,  t) represent an equation constraint and an inequality constraint,  respectively;  x (0) = x0 is the initial condition,  x0 represents the initial value of t = 0 time x;  the optimal solution of x obtained by the model predictive control model is the optimal state x *,  the corresponding u is the optimal control input u *,  the optimal state x * and the corresponding control input u * are used as the input of the whole body control.

The invention belongs to the field of robot technology,  and specifically relates to a humanoid ladder riding method and system based on machine vision and robotic arm interaction. The method includes :  S1,  the robot identifies the current floor information and calls the elevator; s2,  the robot enters the elevator using a humanization method; s3,  the robot presses the target floor after entering the elevator; s4,  after the robot determines that it has reached the target floor,  it intelligently leaves the elevator. The invention has the characteristics that the robot can take the elevator like an ordinary human,  can meet the needs of the robot to take the elevator autonomously,  and saves manpower and economic costs. 1. A humanoid ladder-riding method based on machine vision and mechanical arm interaction,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  the robot identifies the current floor information and calls the elevator;  S2,  the robot enters the elevator by the anthropomorphic method;  S3,  after the robot enters the elevator,  pressing the target floor;  S4,  intelligently leaving the elevator after the robot judges that it reaches the target floor.

The invention belongs to the field of robot control,  and discloses a reinforcement learning motion control method and system for the lower limbs of a linear joint humanoid robot. The control method includes structurally separating the physical coupling constraints of a linear motor and a rotating joint in a training environment; a reinforcement learning approach,  supplemented by an actor-critic approach and privileged observation variables,  was used to train multi-agents in parallel; deploy the trained strategy to the actual machine. The input and output of the strategy obtained by training are all information at the rotating joint. The actual robot control and collection data are information on the motor side of the linear joint. The simulation and reality can be overcome through the mapping relationship between force,  position,  and speed. The gap The present invention proposes to use the force control characteristics of linear joints,  which has stronger adaptability than traditional position control methods; at the same time,  the reinforcement learning method is used to train the linear joint humanoid robot,  which does not require accurate modeling and can realize the global and long-term motion simulation algorithm stage and deployment algorithm stage. 1. A reinforced learning motion control method for lower limb of linear joint humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises a simulation algorithm stage and a deployment algorithm stage :  S1 simulation algorithm stage,  comprising the following steps :  S11 :  the linear joint humanoid robot model obtains the rotary joint humanoid robot model through the physical decoupling closed chain method and guides in the simulation environment for training;  S12 :  using the reinforced learning algorithm to perform training on the rotary joint humanoid robot model obtained in the step S11 to obtain the reinforced learning model,  establishing a part of observable Markov decision process,  using the adjacent end strategy optimization algorithm to update the strategy gradient and optimize the strategy,  according to the simulation environment and the asymmetry of the observed variable in the real world,  using the actor-commentator algorithm to guide and generate the commentator and the actor strategy network;  S2 deployment algorithm stage,  comprising the following steps :  S21 :  based on the actor strategy obtained in step S12,  the network is deployed to the real machine controller,  the network input layer receives the position,  speed,  moment,  attitude sensor angle of the step action on the rotating joint,  an angular speed data,  which outputs the next action after passing through the hidden layer network to the output layer,  namely the rotation joint position increment,  and finally generates the joint moment data by the PD controller;  S22 :  for the joint torque data obtained in the step S21,  inputting the rotary joint torque data to the rotary motor controller;  for the joint moment data obtained in the step S21,  obtaining the motor moment to the linear motor controller through the positive kinematics and thrust-moment conversion formula;  S23 :  On the basis of step S22,  the rotary motor controller directly outputs the rotary joint position,  the speed,  the moment data,  the linear motor controller position,  the speed data generates the rotary joint position and speed data after the positive kinematics,  the moment data generates the rotary joint moment through the moment-thrust conversion and the positive dynamics of the closed chain mechanism;  S24 :  the rotating joint data generated by S23 and the posture sensor data are spliced into an observation vector,  and then input into the strategy network again,  so as to realize reinforced learning closed-loop control,  so as to formulate the complex environment dynamic motion strategy of the linear joint humanoid robot.

The invention discloses a human-like fingertip tactile sensor,  which includes :  a human-like phalanx; a bottom permanent magnet disposed on the anthropomorphic phalanx; a flexible circuit board overlying the bottom permanent magnet; setting separating fixing layer on the flexible circuit board,  setting mounting holes on the separating fixing layer; a piezoresistive film and a top permanent magnet mounted in the mounting holes of the partition fixing layer; a silica gel contact layer sleeved on the separation fixing layer The invention aims to overcome the technical problems of low sensitivity,  low array,  serious crosstalk between sensing units,  low integration level and the like of the fingertip touch sensor in the existing robot sensing technology According to the invention,  a plurality of sensing units are distributed on the fingertip of the humanoid,  so that the detection of the pressure magnitude and the action position of multiple contacts can be realized The humanoid fingertip sensor can be mounted to the end of the manipulator to provide the necessary tactile information for dexterous operation. 1. A human finger tip tactile sensor,  wherein it comprises :  imitating human phalanx;  a bottom permanent magnet arranged on the human-like phalanx;  a flexible circuit board covered on the bottom permanent magnet;  setting a separation fixing layer on the flexible circuit board,  wherein the separation fixing layer is provided with a mounting hole;  a piezoresistive film and a top permanent magnet mounted in the separation fixing layer mounting hole;  a silica gel contact layer sleeved on the separation fixing layer.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot finger magnetic tactile sensor system with dual-modal sensing function,  and relates to the technical field of tactile sensor systems; contains magnetic tactile sensing module,  and uses microstructure materials to realize dual-modal force sensing; the signal conditioning module optimizes the signal through the adaptive neural network; data acquisition and processing module,  multi-core heterogeneous processor and deep learning algorithm to extract feature and computing power information; communication and interface module,  using chaotic encryption and multi-protocol transmission data; mechanical structure module,  using bionic materials and variable stiffness joints; there are also functional modules such as self-calibration and temperature compensation. The invention accurately senses positive pressure and tangential force,  has efficient signal processing,  strong anti-environmental interference,  and safe and reliable data transmission; the mechanical structure is flexible to adapt to a variety of tasks,  fault diagnosis and energy management improve reliability and battery life,  and help the robot complete complex operations. 1. A human-like robot finger magnetic touch sensor system with bimodal sensing function,  wherein it comprises :  a magnetic touch sensing module :  the micro-structure magnetic elastic body material is used as the sensing medium,  the magnetic elastic body is macro-deformed under the action of the external force,  the micro-orientation and the distance of the internal magnetic sensitive fibre are changed,  and the magnetic field distribution is changed;  For positive pressure Fn,  electric signal variation and Fn satisfy relation wherein k1n is non-linear positive pressure sensitivity coefficient,  alpha n is positive pressure non-linear index,  b1n is positive pressure logarithm adjusting coefficient;  For tangential force Ft,  electric signal variation and Ft satisfy k2t is nonlinear tangential force sensitivity coefficient,  alpha t is tangential force nonlinear index,  b2t is tangential force sine adjusting coefficient,  omega t is tangential force angle frequency;  at the same time,  the positive pressure and the tangential force are sensed to realize the bimodal sensing and the dynamic change process of the sensing force;  a signal conditioning module :  The weak electric signal output by the magnetic touch sensing module is amplified,  filtered and linearized,  the neural network automatically adjusts the gain G according to the characteristic of the input signal,  the gain adjusting formula is as follows :  wherein G0 is initial gain,  Vref is reference voltage,  Vin is input signal voltage,  Vtarget is target signal voltage,  β is gain adjusting coefficient;  the noise of the frequency is filtered by the self-adaptive notch filter,  the signal is linearized by the polynomial fitting method controlled by the fuzzy logic,  and the order and coefficient of the polynomial are dynamically adjusted according to the dynamic range and noise level of the input signal;  a data acquisition and processing module :  the data collecting card is used for collecting the conditioned signal,  the sampling frequency fs satisfies fs=max (2fmax,  faynamic),  wherein fmax is the highest frequency component of the signal,  and fdynamic is the dynamic sampling frequency adjusted in real time according to the dynamic change rate of the force;  the collected data is transmitted to the microprocessor,  the data is processed by the feature extraction algorithm based on deep learning,  and the feature of the force signal is extracted from different time scales and space scales by combining the convolutional neural network CNN and the cyclic neural network RNN.

The invention relates to a rigid-flexible hybrid human-leg-imitating biped robot,  which comprises a horizontally arranged base; the driving modules are arranged at two ends of the base The middle platform is correspondingly arranged below the two ends of the base; the cable drive parallel mechanism is connected to the output end of the drive module and the middle platform; the foot ends are disposed below the corresponding intermediate platforms; the connecting rod transmission mechanism connects the foot end,  the middle platform and the SR connecting rod; driven by the cable-driven parallel mechanism,  the foot end of the robot has 6 degrees of freedom consistent with the leg,  and the flexibility is higher to meet the needs of complex scenes; the S-R-U branch chain in the robot is consistent with the actual human leg movement mode,  and the hybrid mechanism can adopt the solution method of series structure kinematics,  which greatly simplifies the gait planning process; it is driven by ropes,  has small inertia,  large load ratio and large working space to meet the requirements of lightweight and flexibility of robots; the driving and transmission parts are all designed in parallel,  and the robot as a whole has the advantages of high precision and good stability. 1. A rigid-flexible hybrid humanoid leg biped robot,  wherein it comprises :  a horizontally arranged base;  a driving module set at two ends of the base;  a middle platform correspondingly arranged under the two ends of the base;  a cable drive parallel mechanism,  which is connected with the output end of the driving module,  the middle platform,  which is suitable for driving the middle platform to move in six degrees of freedom;  a foot end,  which is set below the corresponding middle platform;  a connecting rod transmission mechanism connected with the foot end and the middle platform;  an SR connecting rod,  one end of the top part of which is connected with the bottom part of the middle platform through a ball pair,  one end of the bottom part of which is connected with one RR connecting rod in the connecting rod transmission mechanism through a rotating pair.

The invention also discloses a humanoid robot The beneficial effects of the invention :  through the coordinated work of multiple components,  the adaptability to different ground types is realized,  the impact force is effectively absorbed,  and the vibration generated when falling to the ground is reduced. 1. A mechanical foot imitating human foot,  comprising an ankle,  a main supporting component,  a heel,  an instep,  a toe,  a foot arch and a force sensor;  the ankle capable of axially rotating in multiple directions is connected with the top end of the force sensor,  the bottom end of the force sensor is connected with the first end of the main supporting component;  the heel main body of the heel is rotatably connected with the second end of the main supporting component,  and the heel main body is elastically connected with the main supporting component;  the instep main body of the instep is rotatably connected with the third end of the main supporting assembly,  and the instep main body is elastically connected with the main supporting assembly;  the instep main body is elastically connected with the toes;  the two ends of the arch are respectively connected with the heel main body and the instep main body.

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots,  and specifically relates to a leg and foot structure and a humanoid robot. The leg and foot structure includes a base,  and the base is connected with several leg components; the leg assembly includes a thigh piece and a calf piece. The upper end of the thigh piece cooperates with the base through a movable connection assembly and pitches longitudinally and swings laterally The lower leg member is connected to the lower end of the thigh member and deflects in a pitch direction in the longitudinal direction; a first driving component is arranged on the base and is used for driving the thigh piece to pitch and swing sideways,  and a second driving component is arranged at the thigh piece and is used for driving the calf piece to pitch The invention discloses a leg and foot structure and a humanoid robot By improving the leg and foot structure,  the first driving component drives the thigh piece to achieve pitch adjustment and side swing adjustment of the thigh piece. At the same time,  the second driving component drives the calf piece to cooperate with the leg and foot structure to achieve coordination and stability of the movement. After improvement,  the control and adjustment of the leg and foot structure is more flexible,  and more coordinated walking movements can be achieved. 1. A leg and foot structure,  wherein It comprises a base (1),  the base (1) is connected with multiple leg components;  the leg assembly comprises a thigh piece (7) and a shank piece (10),  the upper end of the thigh piece (7) is matched with the base (1) through a movable connecting assembly and is longitudinally pitching and transversely swinging;  the shank piece (10) is connected to the lower end of the thigh piece (7) and pitching deflects in the longitudinal direction;  the base (1) is provided with a first driving component (3) and is used for driving the thigh piece (7) to pitch and side swing,  the first driving component (3) comprises multiple drivers oppositely set on two sides of the thigh piece (7),  when the driver is synchronous,  the thigh piece (7) is driven to pitch,  when the driver acts asynchronously,  it drives the thigh piece (7) to side swing;  the thigh piece (7) is provided with a second driving component (12) and used for driving the shank piece (10) to pitch.

The invention discloses a rod end joint bearing which comprises a rod end body,  wherein an inner hole is formed in the rod end body; an inner ring is arranged in the inner hole in an adaptive manner; an annular limiting groove is formed in the outer spherical surface of the inner ring; and a limiting pin which is in limiting fit with the annular limiting groove so as to limit the swinging freedom degree of the inner ring in a specified direction is fixed on the rod end body In the present invention,  a limit pin is provided on the rod end body At the same time,  an annular limiting groove is provided on the outer spherical surface of the inner ring. In this way,  through the limiting cooperation between the inner end of the limiting pin and the annular limiting groove,  the swing freedom of the inner ring in the left and right directions can be limited. When applied to the ankles of humanoid robots,  it can effectively improve the walking stability of humanoid robots. 1. A rod end joint bearing,  comprising a rod end body (1),  the rod end body (1) is provided with an inner hole (11),  the inner hole (11) is adaptively installed with an inner ring (2),  wherein the outer spherical surface of the inner ring (2) is provided with an annular limiting groove (21),  the rod end body (1) is fixed with a limiting pin (3) for limiting and matching with the annular limiting groove (21) to limit the swinging freedom degree of the appointed direction of the inner ring (2).

The invention belongs to the technical field of linkage design algorithm,  and particularly relates to a design optimization method for a leg four-linkage mechanism of a humanoid robot. The design optimization method comprises the following steps of :  simplifying a leg mechanical structure and abstracting a mathematical model of the four-linkage mechanism; establish a kinematic model of the rotation of the four-bar linkage mechanism and calculate the rotation angle; analyze the kinematic characteristics of four-bar linkage mechanism during rotation; establish alternative schemes based on different combinations of design parameters,  and screen the optimal design scheme according to the constraints and dynamic characteristics. This method does not establish a mathematical model to solve the unique design parameters,  but adopts a semi-empirical method to analyze the dynamic characteristics one by one by traversing possible combinations,  so as to screen out the optimized design scheme. This kind of multi-parameter model based on four-bar linkage mechanism,  combined with experience to screen optimization schemes,  reduces the difficulty of building complex models,  improves the efficiency of the establishment of unified design process,  and increases the versatility of this method by introducing human analysis 1. A method for designing and optimizing four-bar linkage mechanism of human-shaped robot leg,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  simplifying the leg mechanical structure,  abstracting the mathematical model of the four-bar linkage mechanism;  step 2 :  establishing a kinematics model of the rotation of the four-bar linkage mechanism,  calculating the rotation angle;  step 3 :  analyzing the kinematics characteristic in the rotation process of the four-bar linkage mechanism;  step 4 :  establishing an alternative solution based on different combinations of design parameters,  and selecting the optimal design solution according to the constraint condition and the dynamic characteristic.

The invention provides a trafficability model building method of a wheeled legged robot The method comprises the following steps of :  establishing a multi-level index system aiming at comprehensive evaluation of the trafficability of the wheeled-legged robot; determining an index weight value based on an analytic hierarchy process (AHP); constructing an expert information quality evaluation model by using an entropy weight method; and obtaining an expert evaluation weight value which is used for correcting the index weight value to obtain a hierarchical total ranking weight value Finally,  the comprehensive evaluation function of the trafficability of the wheel-legged robot is constructed,  and the traveling mode of the wheel-legged robot in the detection area is determined. Compared with the traditional robot passability model establishment method,  the present invention effectively reduces subjective experience deviation and human judgment interference through the analytic hierarchy process-entropy weight method dual weight fusion mechanism,  so that the evaluation results have both empirical rationality and data objectivity. At the same time,  the innovative hierarchical index system can collaboratively evaluate the characteristics of different travel modes of the robot,  and provide a more reliable decision-making basis for motion planning. 1. A method for establishing passability model of wheeled leg robot,  wherein the method comprises :  analyzing the factors influencing the passing property of the wheel-leg robot,  constructing a multi-level index system,  establishing a hierarchical structure model for comprehensive evaluation of the passing property of the wheel-leg robot,  which is composed of a target layer,  a standard layer,  an index layer and a solution layer;  based on the analytic hierarchy process,  determining the index weight value of the rule layer to the target layer and the index weight value of the index layer to the rule layer;  based on entropy weight method,  establishing expert information quality evaluation model capable of evaluating expert given information quality,  obtaining expert evaluation weight value;  modifying the index weight value according to the expert evaluation weight value to obtain the index combination weight value;  according to the index combination weight value,  determining the level total ordering weight value of the index layer to the target layer;  according to the hierarchical total ordering weight value,  constructing a comprehensive evaluation function of the passing property of the wheel-crawler-leg robot,  establishing a passing property model of the wheel-crawler-leg robot,  obtaining the comprehensive evaluation value of the passing property of the wheel-crawler-leg robot;  according to the passing comprehensive evaluation value of the wheel and leg robot,  determining the travelling mode of the wheel and leg robot in the detection area.

A multimodal human-robot interaction system for compensation movement of a hemiplegic upper limb includes a compensation monitoring module,  a compensation evaluation module and a compensation reducing module. The compensation reducing module includes a robot and a virtual reality system. The robot assists the hemiplegic upper limb in performing rehabilitation training,  and adjusts a training action according to a compensation monitoring result and evaluation of compensation to realize passive reducing of compensation movement of the hemiplegic upper limb. The compensation monitoring module acquires data during a rehabilitation therapy. The compensation evaluation module processes and analyzes comprehensive data of the hemiplegic upper limb to obtain the evaluation of compensation. The virtual reality system displays a rehabilitation training scene,  a real-time movement posture of the hemiplegic upper limb and the evaluation of compensation and instructs a patient to reduce the compensation movement using visual display and voice feedback.

The invention discloses a robust visual servo control method for an anthropomorphic manipulator with field of view constraints,  which collects a two-dimensional code image on a workpiece through a camera sensor installed on the robot wrist and sends it to an industrial computer; the industrial computer recognizes the image characteristics in real time and generates 7DOF robot control signals,  and sends the control signals to the robot to complete the tracking of visual characteristic points; imitate the human 7-degree-of-freedom arm structure to define the shoulder,  elbow and wrist joints of the 7DOF anthropomorphic robotic arm,  and calculate the arm angle; the obstacle Lyapunov function is combined with the arm angle to design a visual servo field of view constraint controller with humanoid characteristics During the indirect constraint tracking process,  the feature point trajectory remains within the camera's field of view At the same time,  the robotic arm can realize humanoid motion based on arm angle rotation. A sliding mode torque controller is designed to drive the robot to reach the desired characteristic position. Finally,  the characteristic points are constrained not to exceed the camera's field of view,  which improves the success rate of visual servo tasks and realizes humanoid arm angle rotation. 1. A anthropomorphic mechanical hand robust visual servo control method with visual field constraint,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  Step S100 :  using N point method to calibrate the visual servo system to obtain the conversion relation between the camera and the end coordinate system;  Step S200 :  combining the mechanical arm dynamic model,  the vision system dynamic model and the conversion relation between the camera and the tail end coordinate system to establish the robot vision servo system integral dynamic model;  Step S300 :  the camera obtains the two-dimensional code image on the work piece in real time,  sends the two-dimensional code image to the industrial computer,  the industrial computer extracts four corner points of the two-dimensional code image as the current characteristic point,  obtains the characteristic point position error vector according to the current characteristic point and the preset expected characteristic point;  Step S400 :  The characteristics of the 7DOF human arm were simulated to select the shoulder joint of the mechanical arm,  an elbow joint and a wrist joint,  calculating the size of the arm angle,  using the zero space projection to project the arm angle to the mechanical arm zero space,  obtaining the zero space joint angle speed through the mapping relationship between the arm angle and the zero space joint angle speed,  according to the zero space joint angle speed and the characteristic point position error vector,  combining the obstacle lyapov function to design the visual servo visual field constraint controller with humanoid characteristic to obtain the expected joint angular velocity;  Step S500 :  obtaining the current joint angular velocity,  obtaining the current joint angular velocity error vector according to the expected joint angular velocity and the current joint angular velocity,  according to the expected joint angular velocity and the current joint angular velocity error vector,  combining the obstacle lyapunov function to design the robot torque controller,  and introducing the sliding mode control to compensate the unknown parameter variable of the robot model to obtain the control signal;  Step S600 :  sending the control signal to the robot,  driving the robot to reach the position of the expected characteristic point and ensuring that the track of the characteristic point does not exceed the visual field range of the camera;

This application discloses a motion planning method,  device,  equipment and storage medium for a wheel-legged robot,  and relates to the field of robot control technology. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a target motion task planned for the wheel-legged robot; obtain the constraint equations corresponding to the target motion task,  and the constraint equations are constructed based on the floating base dynamics model corresponding to the wheel-legged robot; the objective function corresponding to the target motion task is optimized based on the constraint equations to obtain the planned motion data sequence corresponding to the target motion task. This application uses a floating base dynamics model based on the wheel-legged robot Determine the set of constraint equations that the target motion task needs to satisfy,  and then realize the motion planning of the wheel-legged robot based on the set of constraint equations. By adopting the technical solution provided by the embodiment of the present application,  any movement of the wheel-legged robot (such as Sliding,  jumping motion,  etc.) planning,  thus enriching the movement ability of the wheel-legged robot. 1. A motion planning method of wheel-leg type robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the target motion task planned for the wheel-leg robot;  obtaining the constraint equation set corresponding to the target motion task,  the constraint equation set is constructed based on the floating base dynamics model corresponding to the wheel-leg type robot,  the constraint equation set comprises at least one constraint equation under constraint condition,  the constraint equation is used to constraint the wheel-leg robot to perform the target motion task,  the target motion task is divided into a plurality of stages,  the constraint equation set comprises the constraint equation corresponding to each of the plurality of stages and the continuity constraint equation between adjacent stages in the plurality of stages,  the constraint equation corresponding to each of the plurality of stages is determined according to the generalized coordinate,  the control quantity,  the bearing surface reaction force and the closed-loop reaction force of the floating base dynamics model,  or according to the generalized coordinate of the floating base dynamics model,  the control quantity and the bearing surface reaction force are determined,  the continuity constraint equation between the adjacent stages is determined according to the generalized coordinate of the floating dynamic model;  optimizing the target function corresponding to the target motion task based on the constraint equation set to obtain the planning motion data sequence corresponding to the target motion task;  wherein the planning motion data sequence comprises planning motion data of the wheel-leg robot at multiple time points.

The invention can assist the learning process of the humanoid robot,  so that the robot can anthropomorphize while completing the task,  and the training speed is improved. 1. A humanoid robot control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  pre-processing the expert action data,  and processing the expert action data into the expert data corresponding to the skeleton structure of the target robot;  in the simulation environment,  the humanoid structure is used for building the robot,  the joint parameter of the robot is configured,  the degree of freedom of each joint is controlled by an independent physical control module;  The multi-frame control mode includes :  Before the current state the historical states of the frames are spliced together to form a new feature vector as the input of the strategy network to capture the time sequence information between the actions;  The input of the policy network is characterized by :  ;  Wherein,  representing the current state a state vector formed by splicing frame history states;  the policy network comprises a full-connection network,  multiple LSTM modules and a linear layer network;  In each step of simulating the updating of the simulation environment,  the time sequence information is sent to the strategy network,  the strategy network outputs the action distribution average value,  and then samples from the action distribution to generate an action ;  the action distribution is characterized as :  ;  Wherein,  is motion value,  specifically meaning is joint rotation;  s is the robot state value returned by the simulation environment;  is a conditional probability distribution from state to action,  modelled as a Gaussian distribution;  the average value is the average value output by the network the variance is a fixed initial value ;  initializing the robot;  The invention minimizes the difference between the robot action and the expert action on each frame,  maximizes the reward function and drives the robot to learn.

The present invention belongs to the field of robot technology A four-legged robot navigation system based on hierarchical positioning strategy in a semi-dynamic environment is disclosed Including data acquisition module,  generate first point cloud data based on the first original point cloud data,  the first map building module,  construct a first map based on the first point cloud data and the first inertial measurement unit data,  the second map building module,  eliminate semi-dynamic objects from the first map to generate a second map Navigation control module,  plan the driving route of the quadruped robot based on the second map,  a relocation module that generates second point cloud data based on the second original point cloud data when a moving semi-dynamic object is detected,  and re-determines the position coordinates of the quadruped robot,  and an obstacle perception module that classifies the encounter status based on the first operating data and the second operating data,  and performs navigation control based on the classification results According to the technical scheme of the invention,  the positioning accuracy and stability of the robot can be improved,  and the robot can be guided to rapidly avoid obstacles 1. A four-foot robot navigation system under semi-dynamic environment based on hierarchical positioning strategy,  wherein it comprises :  a data obtaining module,  a first map constructing module,  a first map constructing module,  a second map constructing module,  a navigation control module,  a relocation module and an obstacle sensing module;  the data obtaining module is used for obtaining the first original point cloud data and the first inertia measuring unit data in the target area,  performing the first pre-processing to the first original point cloud data,  and obtaining the first point cloud data;  the first map constructing module,  based on the first point cloud data and the first inertia measuring unit data,  adopts graph optimization SLAM algorithm to construct the first map of the target area;  the second map constructing module,  using the target detection algorithm to detect and using the rectangular frame to select the semi-dynamic object in the first map,  determining the coordinate position of the semi-dynamic object,  and removing the semi-dynamic object from the first map based on the coordinate position,  generating a second map;  the navigation control module is used for planning a first driving route of the four-foot robot based on the second map and controlling the four-foot robot to drive according to the first driving route;  the re-locating module,  the four-foot robot performs obstacle detection in the driving process,  when detecting the moving semi-dynamic object,  obtaining the second original point cloud data and the second inertia measurement unit data collected when detecting the moving semi-dynamic object,  performing a second pre-processing on the second original point cloud data,  obtaining a second point cloud data,  then based on the second map,  the second point cloud data and the second inertia measuring unit data,  using the graph optimization SLAM algorithm to determine the position coordinate of the four-foot robot;  the obstacle sensing module,  obtaining the first operation data of the mobile semi-dynamic object and the second operation data of the four-foot robot,  based on the first operation data and the second operation data,  classifying the meeting state of the mobile semi-dynamic object and the four-foot robot,  performing navigation control according to the classification result,  wherein the first operation data and the second operation data respectively comprise current position,  driving speed,  angular speed and acceleration;  the second pre-processing comprises :  deleting the point cloud data corresponding to the semi-dynamic object from the second original point cloud data to obtain the fifth point cloud data;  obtaining the second coordinate point of the data collecting device when collecting the second original point cloud data,  and defining all laser measuring points in the fifth point cloud data whose distance from the second coordinate point is greater than the third preset value as the second point cloud data;  The meeting state comprises four types,  and the classification method is as follows :  step 21,  taking the first driving route as the central line,  setting the area of the two sides of the central line away from the central line for the second preset distance as the identification area,  wherein the identification area is located in the collecting range of the data collecting device;  step 22,  judging whether the moving semi-dynamic object is located in the identification area,  if so,  going to step 23,  if not,  going to step 25;  step 23,  calculating the first included angle between the moving direction of the four-foot robot and the moving direction of the moving semi-dynamic object,  judging whether the first included angle is in the first preset range,  if so,  setting the meeting state as the first type,  if not,  going to step 24;  step 24,  judging whether the first included angle is in the second preset range,  if so,  setting the meeting state as the second type,  if not,  going to step 25;  step 25,  obtaining the second travelling route of the moving semi-dynamic object,  judging whether the second travelling route and the first travelling route have intersection,  if so,  setting the meeting state as the third type,  if not,  setting the meeting state as the fourth type.

So as to improve the mapping accuracy of the network,  better learn the human control behavior,  and improve the stability of the planned trajectory. 1. An automatic steering driving humanoid track planning method,  wherein the method comprises :  S101,  collecting and processing the human operation data in the curve scene,  obtaining the relative distance information of the vehicle and the barrier at the two sides of the road and the vehicle kinematics information;  S102,  extracting the non-linear characteristic from the vehicle kinematics information based on the core main component analysis method KPCA;  S103,  establishing and training a multi-state cyclic prediction model;  the multi-state cyclic prediction model is based on LSTM network construction,  comprising cell state information for weighting attention to the key data of the long-term and short-term information;  The model comprises a state output gate,  the multi-state cyclic prediction model comprises :  (10) for the input gate,  is sigmoid activation function,  is a weight matrix,  for short-term memory output,  is a bias vector,  for input information (11) is sigmoid activation function,  is a weight matrix,  is the element product,  is a state cell,  for short-term memory output,  is a bias vector,  for the input of information,  for amnesia;  (12) for forgetting the door,  is the element product,  is a state cell,  for the output of the forgetting gate;  (13) is a non-linear transformation,  is a state cell,  is a weight matrix,  is an activation function,  is an element product;  (14) is a non-linear transformation,  is a state cell,  is the element product,  is an activation function,  is a weight matrix,  it is state transmission door;  (15) is an activation function,  is a weight matrix,  for short-term memory output,  is a bias vector,  for the input of information,  for the output of the forgetting gate;  (16) for the output of the forgetting gate,  is a state transmission gate,  for the input gate,  is the element product,  is the upper layer output;  (17) is sigmoid activation function,  is a weight matrix,  for short-term memory output,  for the input of information,  for the output of the forgetting gate,  is a bias vector,  is an output gate;  (18) is an activation function,  is a state cell;  S104,  inputting the nonlinear characteristic,  the relative distance information of the vehicle and the obstacles on the two sides of the road and the vehicle kinematics information to the multi-state circulation prediction model to predict the future driving track point.

The invention provides a multi-legged robot slope travel control method and system based on bimodal Gaussian fusion,  and belongs to the technical field of leg-legged robot control The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a foot end plane equation by using foot end three-dimensional coordinates of the multi-legged robot at two touchdown moments,  and acquiring a pitch angle and a roll angle; based on the plane angle memory update algorithm,  feedforward calculation is performed to obtain the feedforward pitch angle and feedforward roll angle; calculate the joint angle difference based on the joint angle feedback algorithm,  and then determine the real-time correction amount of the pitch angle; the final pitch angle of the multi-legged robot is determined by using the bimodal Gaussian fusion method; convert the final pitch angle and feedforward roll angle,  combined with the gait and speed instructions input by the user,  into joint torque,  desired joint position and desired joint speed to control the multi-legged robot to travel on the slope. The invention can quickly cope with sudden changes in terrain on the basis of ensuring the lightweight control structure,  so as to control the multi-legged robot to travel stably on rugged slopes. 1. A multi-foot robot slope travel control method based on bimodal Gaussian fusion,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the foot end three-dimensional coordinate of the multi-foot robot at two touchdown moments,  and constructing the foot end plane equation;  obtaining the pitch angle and roll angle of the multi-foot robot on the slope surface according to the foot end plane equation;  Wherein,  the two touchdown moments of the multi-foot robot are :  in a complete gait period T under the trot gait,  all legs of the multi-foot robot touch the ground at time 0 and time T/2;  based on the plane angle memory updating algorithm containing the attenuation coefficient,  performing feedforward calculation to the obtained pitching angle and the roll angle to obtain the feedforward pitching angle and the feedforward roll angle of the multi-foot robot on the slope surface;  calculating the joint angle difference value based on the joint angle feedback algorithm,  and determining the pitch angle real-time correction amount of the multi-foot robot on the slope surface according to the difference value calculation result;  The final pitch angle of the multi-foot robot is determined by using the bimodal Gaussian fusion method,  that is :  if the multi-foot robot is in any one of two grounding moments,  taking the feed-forward pitching angle as the final pitching angle;  or,  taking the value obtained by weighting and fusing the feed-forward pitching angle and pitching angle real-time correction amount as the final pitching angle;  converting the obtained final pitch angle and feed-forward roll angle into joint torque,  expected joint position and expected joint speed after being calculated by NMPC-WBC in combination with the gait and speed instruction input by the user so as to control the multi-foot robot to travel on the slope.

The invention provides a humanoid robot based on deep reinforcement learning,  a shooting method and a storage medium,  and relates to the fields of humanoid robots and deep reinforcement learning. The method includes :  dividing the humanoid robot shooting task into three sub-tasks :  approaching the ball,  picking up the ball,  and shooting,  using deep reinforcement learning training to obtain the decision-making model of each sub-task,  and the humanoid robot uses the trained model to make action decisions to complete the shooting task. The invention divides the shooting process of the humanoid robot into three modules :  perception,  decision-making and control. The perception module performs representation learning through the convolutional neural network and attention mechanism. The decision-making module performs action decision-making through the improved SAC algorithm. The control implements the execution of actions by executing predefined action groups. 1. A humanoid robot shooting method based on deep strengthening learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  a sub-task for the shooting task of the human-shaped robot;  S2 :  building a sub-task training scene in the simulation environment;  S3 :  designing and realizing robot sensing module;  S4 :  designing and realizing robot decision module;  S5 :  designing and realizing the robot control module;  S6 :  based on the shooting scene,  using the humanoid robot to perform training on the depth-strengthening learning network model,  taking the image obtained by the humanoid robot camera as input,  performing characteristic extraction through the sensing module,  performing action decision through the decision module,  performing action execution through the control module,  so as to accurately finish the shooting task of the humanoid robot.

The invention provides a rigid-flexible coupling humanoid operating hand Comprises a human-like rigid-flexible coupling hand mechanical body,  a hand body,  a driving control system,  a carpal tunnel connected with the hand body,  and a hand body driving control system The thumb-palm connecting piece drives the thumb to perform palm-to-palm motion,  the steering engine module is respectively in transmission connection with the fingers and the thumb through a plurality of driving ropes,  the fingers and the thumb can perform flexion or abduction motion,  and the fingers can perform lateral abduction motion The joints of fingers and thumb are connected with elastic ligaments The present invention uses autonomous variable stiffness metacarpophalangeal joints,  bionic interphalangeal joint systems and an artificial human hand movement system with an elastic envelope structure It realizes the dexterous movement and contact compliance of the manipulator in complex operation tasks,  meets the dynamic balance requirements of the manipulator between dexterous operation and rigidity maintenance,  and has the advantages of excellent movement performance,  strong environmental adaptability,  and low manufacturing cost. 1. A rigid-flexible coupling humanoid operating hand,  wherein it comprises :  a humanoid rigid-flexible coupling hand mechanical main body (1),  the hand main body and the driving control system are connected with the wrist pipe (2) and the hand main body driving control system (3),  the humanoid rigid-flexible coupling hand mechanical main body (1) comprises :  four fingers (11),  a thumb (12) and a palm structure (14),  the thumb (12) is installed at the palm centre of the palm structure (14) through a thumb palm connecting piece (13),  the thumb palm connecting piece (13) can drive the thumb (12) to perform palm movement,  one end of the palm structure (14) is respectively connected with four fingers (11),  the other end is connected with the wrist tube (2) and the hand main body driving control system (3) through the hand main body and the driving control system;  the inner part of the hand main body driving control system (3) is provided with a plurality of independent steering engine modules (31),  the steering engine modules (31) are respectively connected with four fingers (11) and a thumb (12) in transmission through a plurality of driving ropes,  the fingers (11),  the thumb (12) is driven by the driving rope to be capable of performing flexion or abduction movement,  the little finger (15) and the forefinger (16) in the finger (11) are driven by the driving rope to be capable of performing lateral deviation abduction movement;  the joints of the finger (11) and the thumb (12) are connected with elastic ligament for recovery.

The invention provides a biological blood vessel bionic liquid cooling network heat dissipation method for a humanoid robot,  and belongs to the technical field of robot heat dissipation The biological blood vessel bionic liquid cooling network heat dissipation method for the humanoid robot includes :  through biological bionic mapping and global partition cascade thermal control,  aiming at the aorta-level local high heat flow heat dissipation requirements of the chip located in the brain of the humanoid robot,  using the first heat dissipation unit to carry out Embedded near-node heat dissipation with driving source; according to the high dynamic multi-heat-source heat dissipation requirement of the joint motor located at the movable joint part of the humanoid robot,  the second heat dissipation unit is used to carry out indirect heat dissipation with a driving source; in response to the capillary-level low heat flux heat dissipation requirements of the power battery located on the chest of the humanoid robot,  the third heat dissipation unit is used to perform self-driven indirect heat dissipation through the capillary pump effect; for venous-level liquid cooling reflux,  large-area natural convection air cooling heat dissipation on the skin surface is simulated to discharge heat globally,  and finally a system-level humanoid robot bionic liquid cooling heat dissipation method is formed. 1. A biological blood vessel bionic liquid cooling network radiating method for human-shaped robot,  the method comprises :  the first radiating unit is used for radiating the embedded near node with driving source for the chip located at the brain of the human-shaped robot;  the second radiating unit is used for indirectly radiating the joint motor at the movable joint part of the human-shaped robot with a driving source;  the third radiating unit is used for radiating the power battery at the chest of the human-shaped robot in a self-driving indirect manner.

The invention relates to the technical field of force sensors,  in particular to a compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor It mainly aims at the problems of the existing six-dimensional force sensor that the overload capacity of the traditional cantilever beam structure is insufficient,  the new I-beam and II-beam structures are difficult to miniaturize,  and the needs of the humanoid robot for high overload capacity and compact structure cannot be met at the same time. The following technical solution is proposed :  including an outer frame; a cross beam mounted in the outer frame; a vertical beam vertically arranged at the center of the cross beam; a connecting block is arranged at one end of the vertical beam far away from the cross beam,  and the outer frame,  the cross beam,  the vertical beam and the connecting block are integrated; a mounting plate mounted on the connecting block The invention not only meets the installation requirements of space-limited scenes such as humanoid robot joints,  but also can withstand multiple rated load impacts,  improving robot movement safety and complex task execution capabilities. 1. A compact non-linear six-dimensional force sensor,  wherein it comprises :  an outer frame (1);  a cross beam (2) installed in the outer frame (1);  a vertical beam (3) vertically arranged in the centre of the cross beam (2);  a connecting block (4) arranged at one end of the vertical beam (3) far away from the cross beam (2);  the outer frame (1),  the cross beam (2),  the vertical beam (3) and the connecting block (4) are integrally designed;  a mounting plate (5) mounted on the connecting block (4).

The invention discloses a robot foot device integrating force and position sensing and a sensing method thereof,  and belongs to the technical field of force and position sensing The device comprises a wear-resistant body,  the surface of the wear-resistant body is provided with a clamping groove A sensing component is clamped on the top of the wear-resistant body A collection board is clamped on the top of the sensing component,  and a magnetic collection module is provided on the collection board. The sensing component includes a substrate,  an elastomer and a magnetic source. The substrate is located between the wear-resistant body and the collection board. The surface of the substrate is provided with an elastic body,  and the surface of the elastic body is fixedly connected to a magnetic source. The robot foot device integrates force-position sensing technology. By integrating magnetic sensing,  flexible sensing and neural network algorithms,  and combining the force-position sensing algorithm,  it can accurately sense the foot contact position and its force situation. This not only helps to realize the force position feedback control of the legged robot,  but also improves the stability and movement performance of the robot in complex environments. 1. A robot foot device for fusion force position sensing,  wherein It comprises a wearable body (1),  a sensing component (2),  a collecting plate (3) and a connecting piece (4);  the top of the wearable body (1) is provided with a clamping groove;  the sensing component (2) comprises a substrate,  an elastic body and a magnetic source,  the substrate is embedded with an elastic body,  the top surface of the elastic body is fixedly connected with a magnetic source,  and the top of the elastic body is clamped in the top clamping groove of the wearable body (1),  wherein the magnetic source is static relative to the wearable body,  the elastic body can generate deformation;  the collecting plate (3) is clamped on the top part of the substrate of the sensing component,  so that the collecting plate is static relative to the substrate,  the collecting plate is provided with a magnetic collecting module;  the connecting piece (4) is fixed with the collecting plate through the screw thread hole,  static relative to the collecting plate,  and along with the elastic deformation of the sensing component,  so that the connecting piece and the collecting plate move relative to the wearable body.

The invention relates to a foot-type robot terrain perception modeling method integrating vision and touch,  and belongs to the technical field of walking control of foot-type cross-country robots By integrating various sensor data,  the method realizes comprehensive perception of terrain geometric structure,  mechanical properties and material characteristics,  establishes a local terrain model on this basis,  and then predicts the passable characteristics of the unknown road ahead,  ultimately helping the legged robot to achieve autonomous selection of safe areas in complex environments. 1. A foot-type robot terrain sensing modelling method combined with vision and tactile sensation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one,  visual terrain sensing :  the optical sensor mounted on the robot is used for capturing the geometric information of the terrain colour RGB and each block forming the terrain in real time,  and rasterizing the sensing range,  and assigning the block visual semantic information to each grid;  one terrain is composed of one or more ground blocks,  the ground block is a two-dimensional plane;  assigning the plot visual semantic information as (xi,  yi,  Rij,  Gij,  Bij),  wherein xi,  yj represents the horizontal and vertical coordinates of the plot,  Rij,  Gij,  Bij represents the terrain colour RGB information,  the subscript i,  j is used for distinguishing the information on two dimensions of the two-dimensional plane of the ground block,  one ground block is corresponding to one foot point;  step two,  tactile terrain sensing :  based on the inertia measuring unit IMU installed on the robot,  calculating the position and posture information of the machine body,  through the pressure sensor installed on the foot end of the robot,  recording the pressure change process generated in the contact process of the foot end of the robot and the ground,  and representing as the touch semantic information of the ground block,  specifically comprising :  (1) calculating the position of the foot end in combination with the attitude of the fuselage :  according to the IMU of the mass centre of the machine body,  obtaining the absolute position of the mass centre of the machine body,  according to the size data of the machine body,  calculating the relative position of the foot end and the mass centre,  obtaining the absolute position of the foot end;  (2) recording the pressure change process generated in the contact process of the robot foot end and the ground :  from the beginning of the foot end stress to the beginning of the contact process,  the absolute position of the foot end does not change into the end of the contact process,  the change amount in the vertical direction of the absolute position of the foot end in the process is the foot end sinking amount cij,  the change amount in the forward direction of the absolute position of the foot end is the sliding amount sij,  the horizontal component force when sliding is the maximum friction force fij; A human-like robot tumble recovery control method based on multi-stage course learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a mixed internal model,  the mixed internal model combines conventional observation and privileged observation,  using historical observation data to estimate the speed and hidden variable of the robot main body;  S2,  decomposing the falling and climbing action of the robot into continuous key frames,  and gradually learning frame by frame;  S3,  introducing a reinforced learning framework combined with hybrid internal optimization and near-end strategy optimization,  the reinforced learning framework uses the conventional observation and privileged observation stored in the hybrid internal model,  the source encoder extracts the feature representation from the conventional observation,  the target encoder generates a contrast target to guide the representation learning,  these potential representations are used by the actuator network for generating actions,  performing the value estimation by the evaluator,  executing the action in the emulator,  and calculating the reward according to the similarity with the pre-defined key frame target;  S4,  adding a mirror image loss function,  for measuring the strategy symmetry of the robot before and after the mirror image mapping,  ensuring that the robot is consistent in the left and right symmetrical or up and down symmetrical movement;  S5,  designing a reward function,  and guiding the robot to learn the tumble recovery action from different aspects.
