This application proposes an interactive perception autonomous driving method based on dual-mode game and deep inverse reinforcement learning,  which belongs to the field of autonomous driving. Stackelberg game and Bayesian Stackelberg game are used to comprehensively judge whether V2V is available. The implementation leader first announces the intention of changing lanes,  and the follower responds to the leader's decision-making method according to his own driving style,  and then plans the humanoid trajectory through deep inverse reinforcement learning,  so as to achieve the purpose of being more realistic and improving safety and efficiency Based on the integrity of information,  decision-making is divided into two modes :  Stackelberg game and Bayesian Stackelberg game; if all relevant vehicles provide interactive intent through V2V,  Stackelberg game is adopted; if some vehicle intentions are opaque,  the opponent's behavior needs to be inferred through sensors and probabilistic models to trigger the Bayesian Stackelberg game. 1. An interactive perception automatic driving method based on dual-mode game and deep inverse strengthening learning,  wherein dividing the decision into two modes of Stackelberg game and Bayesian Stackelberg game based on the integrity of the information;  if all related vehicle through V2V provides interaction intention,  then adopt Stackelberg game;  if there is some vehicle intention non-transparent,  then it needs to speculate opponent action through sensor and probability model,  triggering Bayesian Stackelberg game;  It specifically comprises the following steps,  step (1) environment sensing and data collecting;  performing V2V communication detection,  receiving the BSM of the surrounding vehicle in real time,  extracting data,  and obtaining the state of the surrounding vehicle through multi-sensor fusion;  step (2) V2V availability determination;  step (3) selecting game mode;  if V2V is available,  namely the complete information scene,  selecting Stackelberg game,  executing the following step (3.1);  if V2V is unavailable,  that is,  the incomplete information scene,  then selecting Bayesian Stackelberg game,  executing the following step (3.2);  step (3.1) performing the Stackelberg game;  the vehicle trying to change the way is used as the leader,  the obstacle vehicle is the follower,  the decision process is carried out in stages,  the leader takes priority action,  the follower is optimized;  step (3.2) performing the selection of Bayesian Stackelberg game;  The autonomous vehicle acts as a leader first,  and the surrounding vehicle acts as a follower in response to the action of the leader,  while considering the type of the vehicle;  step (4) deep inverse strengthening learning planning;  learning the reward function of the human driver from the natural driving data,  using the reward function to evaluate the humanoid of the candidate track;  step (5) planning;  the double-mode game decision module selects the target gap,  the depth inverse strengthening learning planning module samples the candidate track in the target gap range,  for each candidate track,  using FIRL to predict the response track of FVTG,  the reward network calculates the combined reward of the candidate track and the FVTG response track,  selecting the track with the highest reward as the planning result,  if the planned joint track causes the conflict,  triggering the decision module to re-select the gap.

Problems,  significantly improve substation operation and maintenance efficiency and security. 1. The present invention pertains to a method for a quadruped robot to navigate through granular media,  such as deep sand and for providing improvements in the walking performance over various types of granular media. In particular,  the present invention proposes reducing the assumed coefficient of friction about the ground,  impacting the ground harder than nominal in the vertical direction at touchdown,  and forcing a toe lift off into swing if a knee joint extends beyond a threshold stance to help increase the robustness of a quadruped robot's locomotive abilities on challenging terrains and provide an improvement in the field of biomechanics and robotic navigation.

The invention discloses a method,  a related device and a storage medium for avoiding self-collision of a legged robot,  which are used for reducing the occurrence of collision between two legs of the robot when the robot is subjected to lateral disturbance and improving the stability of the robot in the traveling process The method includes :  updating the distance between the foot end of the first leg and the second leg of the robot; determining whether the distance is less than or equal to a first distance; if yes,  apply a repulsive force to the first leg through the power module of the first leg,  so that the distance between the foot end of the first leg and the second leg is greater than the second distance. 1. A method for avoiding self-collision by foot-type robot,  wherein the method comprises :  updating the distance between the foot end of the first leg of the robot and the second leg,  wherein the first leg is the leg in swinging state and the second leg is the leg in supporting state;  judging whether the distance is less than or equal to a first distance,  wherein the first distance is a preset safe distance;  if so,  the repulsion force is applied to the first leg by the power module of the first leg so that the distance between the foot end of the first leg and the second leg is greater than the second distance,  and the second distance is less than the first distance.

The embodiment of the invention provides a quality detection method and equipment for data acquisition of a humanoid robot The method includes :  Including obtaining the collected data of humanoid robot The collected data includes the expected value sequence and the actual value sequence of the target parameters of the humanoid robot. The invention provides a trajectory optimization method and a trajectory optimization system for realizing self-balancing when an empennage auxiliary wheel-footed robot falls. Aiming at the problem of insufficient self-balancing ability of the wheel-legged robot under complex high-dynamic drop scenes,  the present invention fully considers the auxiliary effect of the tail wing during the trajectory optimization process,  and optimizes the swing trajectory of the tail wing to effectively assist the robot in self-balancing. This gives full play to the potential of the tail-assisted wheel-footed robot in terms of drop self-balancing and improves the robot's self-balancing ability. 1. A track optimization method for empennage auxiliary wheel-foot robot to realize self-balance when falling,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  constructing the dynamic model of the tail wing wheel foot robot in the falling process,  using the dynamic model to calculate the current tail wing control input,  for calculating the tail wing swinging initial track;  based on the current initial track,  calculating the increment correction of the control input,  and obtaining a new control strategy;  updating the state track by applying the increment control calculated by the reverse transmission,  and verifying whether the target function is optimized;  if the optimization effect is good,  continuing to iterate;  otherwise,  re-adjusting or changing the initial track;  until convergence to an optimal solution;  wherein,  in the iteration process,  using multiple design frame to divide the long track into M shorter track sections,  each section length is L,  for each divided track section,  locally repeating the iteration process,  performing iteration optimization to each track,  until satisfying the termination condition;  calculating new intermediate state decision variable and matching constraint according to the current track and control strategy in each iteration,  and updating the track section and control strategy;  finally,  synthesizing each optimized track section to form a complete optimized track.

Abstract :  A novel framework for Intelligent English Language Processing QELP) designed for autonomous robots is presented in this research in an effort to provide more intuitive and natural human-robot interaction. Our approach combines emotion identification,  context-aware cognitive modelling,  and sophisticated natural language understanding to enable smooth,  sympathetic,  and situation-appropriate communication. The suggested architecture allows robots to understand not only the literal meaning of spoken English but also the speaker's emotional state and the subtleties of the conversation by fusing transformer-based language models with real- time sensory data processing. The robot can make contextually sound decisions,  flexibly adjust its behaviour,  and deduce user intent thanks to a cognitive reasoning module. Simultaneously,  an emotion recognition system uses multimodal inputs,  including textual sentiment,  facial expressions,  and speech tone,  to sympathetically adjust the robot's answers. Significant gains in answer relevance,  emotional its appropriateness,  and user pleasure are shown in experiments conducted in human-robot interaction scenarios. The findings highlight how IELP systems can develop socially intelligent robotics and open the door to more efficient and human-centered AI implementations.

The invention discloses a humanoid anti-skid control method and system for an unmanned mine card. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring path request information sent by the mine card and a predetermined cluster humanoid anti-skid rule; judging whether the corresponding target road section has historical slipping events according to the path request information; if not,  the task path is normally sent to the mining card,  and the mining card is controlled to run normally according to the task path; if yes,  obtain the current weather and road conditions,  and determine whether there are humanoid anti-slip rules corresponding to the current weather and road conditions; if it does not exist,  the task path is sent to the mining card normally,  and the mining card is controlled to run normally according to the task path; if it exists,  the mining card is controlled to drive autonomously through the slipped road section according to the corresponding humanoid anti-slip rules. The method has the advantages that targeted anti-skidding rules are established according to different road conditions and weather conditions,  the experience of manual driving is continuously learned,  various skidding conditions are effectively solved,  and the skidding risk caused by a single control method is avoided 1. A humanoid skid-proof control method for unmanned mineral card,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the path request information sent by the mine card and the pre-determined anti-skid rule of the cluster;  according to the path request information,  judging whether the corresponding target road section has history slipping event;  if not,  normally sending the task path to the mine card,  controlling the mine card to normally drive according to the task path;  if so,  obtaining the current weather and road condition,  according to the current weather and road condition and the pre-determined humanoid anti-skid rule of the cluster,  judging whether there is the humanoid anti-skid rule corresponding to the current weather and road condition;  if not,  normally sending the task path to the mine card,  controlling the mine card to normally drive according to the task path;  if so,  controlling the mine card according to the corresponding human-simulated skid-proof rule to pass through the road section where the skid occurs;  The predetermined human-like anti-skid rule comprises :  when the mine card identifies the slipping condition,  parking and reporting the fault to the cluster centre,  requesting the manual intervention to process the fault;  switching the mine card to the remote operation mode,  manually remotely driving at the remote operation end repeatedly until there is no skid condition,  recording the control information of the manual remote control driving under the condition of no skid condition,  and establishing the artificial skid-proof rule according to the control information;  the mine card is switched to the unmanned mode,  according to the established humanoid skid-proof rule,  through the skid-proof road section,  if the skid-proof condition still happens,  then continuously switching to the remote operation mode to repeat the action until there is no skid-proof condition under the unmanned mode;  uploading the humanoid skid-proof rule corresponding to the non-skid condition in the unmanned mode to the machine group centre;  according to the collected current road condition information and weather information,  combining the human-imitating skid-proof rule corresponding to the non-skid condition under the unmanned mode,  establishing the human-imitating skid-proof rule of the cluster.

The humanoid robot situational social behavior expression method comprises the following steps of :  sensing user behaviors by adopting a plurality of sensors,  constructing a multi-layer interactive situation sensing structure,  and establishing the association between a human-computer interaction situation and the user behaviors; using adaptive hierarchical isolated word recognition and speech emotion recognition based on optimized neural networks,  make full use of the user's voice characteristics,  construct the matching relationship between the user's emotions and the robot's situational social action emotions,  and propose the robot's situational social behavior expression decision-making that integrates emotions,  thereby realizing the humanoid robot's multi-modal social behavior expression that can express emotions while implementing interactive tasks. The invention not only constructs the relationship between user behavior and interactive situation,  and between interactive situation and humanoid robot social behavior It also solves the problem of less emotional interaction when humanoid robots perform social tasks in the existing technology,  fully considers environmental situations and user emotions,  and proposes a multi-situation social expression implementation path for humanoid robots. 1. A humanoid robot emotional social behaviour expression method,  wherein it comprises a user behaviour and emotion sensing step,  a humanoid robot emotional social behaviour decision step and a humanoid robot multi-mode social behaviour expression step;  The steps of user behavior and emotion perception include :  S101,  sensing the user position through the sensor,  and defining the interaction situation type;  S1011,  sensing the interactive area of the user in the physical environment by the sensor;  S1012,  sensing the distance between the user and the humanoid robot through the sensor,  and setting three threshold values,  which are respectively used as the identification conditions of different situations,  the three threshold values are respectively the first threshold value,  the second threshold value and the third threshold value from large to small;  S1013,  defining five interactive situation categories,  which are respectively attention,  welcome,  indication,  apology and blocking situation;  when the distance obtained in the step S1012 is between the first threshold value and the second threshold value,  the situation is the attention situation;  when the distance is between the second threshold value and the third threshold value,  the situation is welcome situation;  when the distance is less than the third threshold value,  the situation is an indication,  an apology or a blocking situation;  S102,  collecting the user voice signal and filtering;  S103,  extracting voice characteristic parameter,  constructing voice characteristic vector;  S104,  identifying the user voice instruction vocabulary;  S1041,  pre-defining the voice identification sample set,  dividing the indication,  apology and blocking three sample sets according to the situation,  each sample set comprises multiple vocabulary appearing in the situation;  S1042,  training the voice characteristic parameter template of the sample set according to the step S103;  S105,  performing time regulation on the user voice feature vector according to the reference template of S1042 and the user voice instruction,  obtaining the optimal regulation path,  obtaining the situation type to which the user voice instruction belongs;  S106,  constructing voice emotion characteristic and constructing voice emotion characteristic template;  S107,  using the data in the voice emotion characteristic template to train the neural network to obtain the trained neural network model;  S108,  after the user audio passes through S102,  S103 and S106,  obtaining the voice emotion characteristic corresponding to each frame of voice,  inputting the voice emotion characteristic corresponding to each frame of voice to the neural network model trained by S107,  obtaining the prediction of the emotion type of the user audio;  Wherein,  the step of determining the emotional social behavior of the humanoid robot comprises :  S201,  according to the output of the step S1013 and the output of the step S105,  generating an interactive situation type code;  S202,  pre-defining the situational social action data set of the humanoid robot,  the data set comprises five situational social task actions of the situational category,  which are respectively attention,  welcome,  indication,  apology and blocking the situational;  S203,  in each context social task type respectively defining social emotion action sub-type;  S204,  taking the emotion type obtained in step S108 as condition,  according to S201 output,  searching the social emotion action sub-type of the humanoid robot matched with the emotion type obtained in step S108;  and outputting the social emotion action code of the humanoid robot through the searching result;  S205,  pre-defining a voice template,  defining a voice tag and a lamp mode tag in the welcome,  indication,  apology and blocking situations;  according to step S105,  outputting and coding the voice tag under the situation type to which the user voice instruction belongs,  outputting the lamp mode tag under the situation type to which the user voice instruction belongs,  and coding the lamp mode;  S206,  fusing the codes in the steps S204 and S205,  and defining the codes as humanoid robot emotional social behaviour codes;  wherein the multimodal social behaviour expression step of the humanoid robot comprises :  S301,  according to the output of the step S206,  pre-defining the multi-mode social behaviour template of the humanoid robot;  S302,  adopting TCP/IP protocol,  the preset data packet fusion order is as follows :  the action data,  the lamp mode data and the voice data send the fused anthropomorphic social behaviour data packet of the anthropomorphic robot to the anthropomorphic robot;  S303,  the humanoid robot receives the data packet and decodes and extracts the interactive content;  S304,  invoking the predefined action library and voice library in the humanoid robot through API,  and executing the lamp mode switching,  finishing the multi-mode emotional social behaviour expression.

Disclosed is an artificial intelligence system based on space-time information pairs generated by integrated and paired equipment for collecting visual,  auditory and olfactory data. Devices for collecting data within 720 degrees in real time register multidimensional and continuous space-time information pairs containing data on the surrounding equipment environment or location,  shape,  dynamic state,  sounds and smells of the same spatial objects in the environment. The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing,  and particularly relates to a method,  a system and equipment for improving the recognition rate of infrared thermal imaging personnel,  aiming at solving the problem that the recognition rate of the infrared thermal imaging personnel is low due to the influence of a humanoid heating object in the prior art The invention includes :  collecting mine working condition video image,  and extracting high-level feature and low-level feature of each image; establish Gaussian pyramid and Laplacian pyramid of high-level features,  and fuse them with corresponding low-level features; calculating the feature space contrast based on the pixel value gradient of the fused features,  and using the connected domain with the contrast greater than the set threshold as the candidate target domain; generating a motion trajectory based on the position of the centroid of each candidate target domain in the video image and the image frame sequence; the candidate target domain corresponding to the irregular motion trajectory is used as the person recognition result. The invention can eliminate the false detection of personnel caused by the heating of humanoid equipment,  and can effectively improve the identification rate of infrared thermal imaging personnel. 1. A method for improving identification rate of infrared thermal imaging personnel,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S10 :  collecting the mine working condition video image by the thermal imager,  extracting the high layer characteristic and low layer characteristic of each image in the video image by the characteristic extracting network;  S20 :  establishing the Gaussian pyramid and Laplace pyramid of the high-layer characteristic,  fusing with the corresponding low-layer characteristic on the characteristic channel dimension,  obtaining the fused characteristic;  S30 :  based on the pixel value gradient of the fusion characteristic,  calculating the spatial contrast of the fusion characteristic,  taking the connected domain with the contrast greater than the set threshold as the candidate target domain;  The method for calculating the spatial contrast of the fusion feature based on the pixel value gradient of the fusion feature is as follows :  extracting the target area and the background area of the fusion characteristic,  and respectively calculating the information entropy of the target area and the background area;  taking the absolute value of the difference value of the information entropy in the set width range at the adjacent part of the target region and the background region as the space contrast of the fusion feature;  S40 :  respectively obtaining the position of the centroid of each candidate target domain in the video image,  and generating the motion track of the centroid of each candidate target domain based on the sequence of the image frame;  S50 :  taking the candidate target domain corresponding to the irregular motion track as the personnel identification result.

The invention discloses a control method and device for dual-arm collaboration of a humanoid robot. The method includes :  obtaining an action image sequence generated during the execution of a target task by both arms of the humanoid robot; determine the first feature vector sequence corresponding to the action image sequence,  the robot arm joint position vector sequence,  and the second feature vector sequence corresponding to the target mask image sequence; encode the first feature vector sequence,  the second feature vector sequence,  the robot arm joint position vector sequence,  and the target style variables corresponding to the action image sequence,  and output the feature key-value pair sequence; the feature key-value pair sequence and the position vector of the humanoid robot body are used as training samples; perform supervised imitation learning on several training samples to generate a motion control model for dual-arm collaboration. Therefore,  based on the motion control model,  the humanoid robot can complete more complex long action sequence tasks with both arms,  effectively improving the success rate of target task execution. 1. A control method for double-arm cooperation of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the motion image sequence generated in the process of executing the target task by the two arms of the human-shaped robot;  wherein the motion image sequence is used for indicating the set formed by arranging multiple original images according to the time sequence;  determining a first feature vector sequence corresponding to the motion image sequence,  a second feature vector sequence of the mask image sequence corresponding to the motion image sequence,  and a mechanical arm joint position vector sequence corresponding to the motion image sequence;  wherein the mask image sequence comprises a plurality of target mask images arranged according to time sequence,  the target mask image is used for indicating the image after mask processing the target object in the original image;  coding the first characteristic vector sequence,  the second characteristic vector sequence,  the mechanical arm joint position vector sequence and the target style variable corresponding to the motion image sequence by using a simple coder,  and outputting a characteristic key-value pair sequence;  taking the characteristic key-value pair sequence and the position vector of the humanoid robot main body as the training sample;  the motion control model for double-arm cooperation is generated by performing supervised simulation learning to multiple training samples based on the simple decoder.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on motion data analysis,  and belongs to the technical field of robot motion control This invention collects multi-modal action data during the movement of the humanoid robot Extract key motion features,  recognize the motion status of robot movements,  by analyzing the changing rules of key parameters of each motion state,  construct joint motion models under different motion states Control switching between different states Combining the current motion state and the target state,  generate and optimize robot motion trajectories,  calculate the energy consumption of different trajectory schemes based on energy consumption estimates,  and use the energy optimal control method to optimize the trajectory,  the robot can take into account both motion stability and energy efficiency when executing tasks. By collecting the feedback data during the robot's execution of motion in real time and calculating the motion error deviation,  the control signal is dynamically adjusted to ensure that the robot can still maintain an accurate motion trajectory in a complex environment. 1. A humanoid robot motion control method based on motion data analysis,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the multi-modal action data when the robot moves,  based on the multi-modal action data,  extracting the key motion characteristic and performing motion state identification on the robot action,  constructing a robot motion model,  combining the current motion state and the target state of the robot,  generating and optimizing the robot motion track,  generating the corresponding control instruction according to the motion track,  comparing the preset track,  calculating the error deviation and dynamically adjusting the control instruction based on the error deviation;  when extracting the key motion characteristic based on the multi-mode motion data and identifying the motion state of the robot motion,  extracting the characteristic of the multi-mode motion data,  wherein the key motion characteristic comprises a motion phase,  a joint angle change rate and an energy consumption estimation value;  based on the angle,  angular velocity and acceleration data of each joint of the robot,  calculating the phase information of the robot in the continuous motion process,  and extracting the key motion phase parameter;  calculating the joint angle change rate of each joint of the robot;  based on the joint torque and the angular speed data,  calculating the energy consumption estimation value of each joint in unit time;  constructing a multi-dimensional characteristic vector based on the key motion characteristic,  reducing the dimension of the multi-dimensional characteristic vector;  based on the key motion characteristic after dimension reduction,  classifying and identifying the motion state of the robot through hierarchical clustering,  and dividing into different motion state;  the motion state comprises starting,  accelerating,  steady state,  decelerating and stopping;  based on the joint torque and angular velocity data,  calculating the energy consumption estimation value of each joint in unit time,  comprising :  monitoring the joint torque and angular speed data of the joint node in real time;  taking the theoretical value of the joint torque corresponding to the sampling time of each node;  according to the torque data deviation between the actual value of the joint torque at the sampling time of each joint node and the theoretical value of the joint torque;  calling the theoretical value of the angular speed data corresponding to the sampling time of each node;  according to the angular speed data deviation between the actual numerical value of the angular speed data at the sampling moment of each node and the theoretical numerical value of the angular speed data;  when there is no torque data deviation and angular speed data deviation,  using the basic energy consumption estimation value model to obtain the energy consumption estimation value of each node;  when there is torque data deviation and angular speed data deviation,  transferring the appeared torque data deviation and angular speed data deviation;  obtaining an energy consumption estimation value by combining the torque data deviation and the angular speed data deviation with a basic energy consumption estimation value model;  When the motion state of the robot is identified,  the joint torque and the angular speed data are obtained,  the torque data deviation and the angular speed data deviation are calculated,  and the energy consumption estimation value of each joint in unit time is calculated by combining with the basic energy consumption estimation value model.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control and provides a self-recovery control method and system for a quadruped robot falling down under complex terrain The method comprises the following steps of :  extracting a fall self-recovery strategy feature from the privilege information subjected to normalization by using a teacher network so as to provide an optimization reference for a student network; the student network is used to learn the strategy characteristics that imitate the teacher network,  so as to process the normalized ontology state information and historical observation information; after the strategy converges,  the Actor network is used to process the output characteristics of the student network and the real-time observation information of the normalized ontology state information,  and through interaction with the simulation environment,  the next state observation information,  reward signal,  cost feedback and task end flag are obtained,  and the quadruped robot action is output; evaluate the value of taking specific actions in the current state; the Cost network is used to process the normalized privileged information to evaluate the Cost of the quadruped robot's current action. 1. A four-foot robot tumble self-recovery control method under complex terrain,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the real-time observing information of the main body state information of the four-foot robot,  the history observing information of the main body state information and the privilege information and performing the normalization processing;  the teacher network is used for extracting the falling self-recovery strategy characteristic from the normalized privilege information to provide the optimization reference for the student network;  the student network is used for learning the strategy characteristic of the simulated teacher network so as to process the normalized ontology state information history observation information;  after the policy is converged,  the Actor network is used to process the output characteristic of the student network and the real-time observation information of the normalized ontology state information,  by interacting with the simulation environment,  obtaining the next state observation information,  reward signal,  a cost feedback and task ending mark,  outputting the action of the four-foot robot;  using Critic network to process the prerogative information of normalization processing,  evaluating the value of special action under current state,  so as to guide the updating of Actor network;  the cost of the current action of the four-foot robot is evaluated by using the Cost network to process the prerogative information of the normalization process,  and the prerogative information is used for restricting the falling self-recovery strategy updating.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on sequence feature processing,  which comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  acquiring motion data of a robot in different task scenes,  and preprocessing the motion data to improve the data quality Subsequently,  a dynamic update mechanism is used to extract local motion features to enhance the ability to capture short-term motion changes. The autoregressive method is used to analyze the robot motion trend to improve the continuity and stability of control instructions. Based on the above processing results,  an adaptive control strategy is generated to enable the robot to optimize motion parameters in real time according to environmental changes. This method shows high gait stability,  energy consumption efficiency and motion adaptability in both simulation environments and actual robot platforms,  and can effectively improve the motion control level of humanoid robots in complex task scenarios. The invention is suitable for various humanoid robot motion control tasks,  especially for intelligent robot systems with high stability and real-time requirements. 1. A humanoid robot motion control method based on sequence characteristic processing,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  performing feature embedding processing on the motion data of the humanoid robot,  respectively mapping the state,  action,  reward and expected return to the hidden space in the same dimension,  forming a feature vector;  S2,  performing local time sequence feature extraction on the feature vectors through the gating mechanism,  and extracting the local time sequence information by using the dependence degree of the update gate and the reset gate dynamic adjustment on the history information;  S3,  inputting the feature extracted by the local time sequence feature to the global dependence modelling module based on the pole,  and performing the global dependence relation modelling by using the autoregressive feature;  S4,  refining the prediction characteristic of the output characteristic of the B module,  optimizing the prediction characteristic through the parameter sharing strategy,  finally generating an action control command;  S5,  driving the humanoid robot to execute the corresponding action according to the generated action control instruction.

This invention includes an innovative mechanical structure developed for autonomous cognitive social robots,  enhancing user interaction and adapting to environmental conditions. The robot can be adapted to different usage scenarios thanks to its telescopic rise and fall mechanism with rails that can adjust its own length on the vertical axis and its flexible body structure that can tilt forward at certain angles. This allows the robot to pick up objects from high shelves,  communicate at eye level with seated or wheelchair users,  access tight spaces,  and overcome various physical obstacles. The robot's ascent and descent mechanism consists of telescopic segments moving on linear actuators and guide rails. This mechanism allows the robot to move on a vertical axis,  while the body balance and center of gravity are constantly optimized to minimize the risk of tipping over. The forward tilt function is based on a flexible hinge or articulated connection system that allows for dynamic mobility. This structure makes it possible for the robot to tilt in a controlled manner at specific angles,  thereby maintaining stability on inclined surfaces and interacting more naturally with users. This movement mechanism,  integrated with cognitive systems,  allows the robot to automatically adjust the height and tilt angle based on the data it receives from environmental sensors and user commands. Through image processing and AI-based motion control algorithms,  the robot can detect surrounding objects and people and make optimal movement decisions. This offers significant advantages in terms of ease of use and adaptation,  especially in social robot applications that require human-robot interaction. This invention aims to expand the use of social robots in various areas such as guidance,  service,  telepresence and assistive robot technologies by improving mobility,  interaction and accessibility features. Thanks to its innovative telescopic motion system and forward tilting mechanism,  the robot offers a flexible and versatile solution that appeals to a wide range of users.

The invention belongs to the technical field of image recognition and understanding,  and specifically relates to a multi-modal feature fusion image classification method and its application in humanoid robots. The multi-modal feature fusion image classification method provided by the present invention performs blocking and filling preprocessing on depth images and radar images,  and then uses a depth image feature extraction module that combines three-dimensional convolution and heterogeneous kernel convolution,  and two-dimensional convolution to process the radar image; use cross-attention-based Transformer network to fuse the features of depth images and radar images; deep-level feature extraction and fusion through multi-scale Transformer network; enter the fused features into the classifier to complete object recognition. The invention effectively integrates the advantages of CNN and Transformer,  improves classification and recognition capabilities through multi-scale processing and cross-modal feature fusion,  and is further used to improve the environmental adaptability and navigation accuracy of humanoid robots. 1. A multimodal feature fusion image classification method,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  Step S101 :  collecting a depth image and a radar image,  and performing block processing and data alignment operation on the obtained depth image and the radar image;  Step S102 :  aiming at the depth image block and the radar image block after the block processing,  respectively using different convolution neural networks to perform the initial feature extraction,  capturing the space depth feature information of the depth image block and the abstract feature information of the radar image block,  and aligning the data dimension of the initial feature of the depth image block and the radar image block;  Step S103 :  fusing the primarily extracted depth image characteristic and the radar image characteristic through a cross-attention-based thin network,  realizing self-adaptive weight distribution and effective interaction of information between different modes,  and capturing cross-mode semantic relation;  step S104 :  applying multi-scale catalyst to the fused feature to further capture abstract and refined feature information;  Step S105 :  inputting the feature information processed by the multi-scale feature fusion process to the classification task head to finish the image classification;  In step S103,  the cross attention network adopts the Multi-Head attention structure,  including two Cross attention networks;  wherein the Query of the first Cross-Attention network is generated by the abstract characteristic tensor of the radar image,  and Key and Value are generated by the abstract characteristic tensor of the depth image;  the Query of the second Cross-Attention network is generated by the abstract characteristic tensor of the depth image,  Key and Value are generated by the abstract characteristic tensor of the radar image;  distributing weight through Softmax function,  self-adaptively emphasizing relativity and importance of different modal data,  realizing information interaction and semantic relation capturing between modal;  step S104 comprises :  Step S1041 :  using two-dimensional convolution to generate Query/Key/Value mark information for the fused feature,  keeping local space context structure;  Step S1042 :  by introducing multi-scale multi-head self-attention mechanism,  extracting and fusing features on different scales,  so as to adapt to the identification requirements of objects of different sizes;  in step S1041,  using two-dimensional convolution projection to generate Query/Key/Value for the fused feature,  using three independent two-dimensional convolution WQ,  WK,  WV to generate the mark information which is the same as the original feature dimension,  providing a basic representation for the subsequent multi-scale self-attention mechanism;  in the step S1042,  using the multi-scale multi-head self-attention mechanism,  constructing a pyramid structure in the self-attention module,  dynamically dividing the feature diagram according to the preset scale list,  forming a feature representation of a plurality of scales,  each scale is corresponding to a calculation head,  in each calculating head,  the characteristic tensor is divided according to the scale and then the attention is calculated,  and then the results of all the calculating heads are integrated by the cascade operation to form the multi-scale characteristic expression.

This application provides a camera occlusion detection method,  electronic equipment and computer program product; involve the technical field of computer vision. This application proposes a camera occlusion detection method,  which includes :  aiming at the first image frame collected by the camera,  when detecting that there is no one in the elevator,  saving the first image frame as an empty frame; for the second image frame collected by the camera,  when a person is detected in the elevator,  the humanoid area in the second image frame is replaced with the target area in the empty environment frame to obtain the third image frame; calculate the similarity between the third image frame and the empty environment frame,  and determine that the camera in the elevator is blocked when the similarity is lower than the preset similarity threshold; wherein,  the second image frame is acquired after the first image frame,  and the target area is the same area as the humanoid area in the empty environment frame Through the embodiments of the present application,  the accuracy of camera occlusion detection can be improved and the risk of false alarms or false alarms can be reduced. 1. A camera shielding detection method,  wherein the method comprises :  aiming at the first image frame collected by the camera,  under the condition that there is no person in the elevator,  storing the first image frame as an empty frame;  for the second image frame collected by the camera,  under the condition of detecting that there is person in the elevator,  replacing the human-shaped area in the second image frame with the target area in the empty frame,  obtaining the third image frame;  calculating the similarity between the third image frame and the empty frame,  and determining that the camera in the elevator is shielded under the condition that the similarity is lower than the preset similarity threshold;  wherein the second image frame is collected after the first image frame,  and the target area is the same area as the human-shaped area in the air frame.

Abstract The present invention relates to an AI-enhanced robotic arm system designed for high-precision industrial assembly tasks. The system integrates a multi- jointed robotic arm with modular end-effectors,  advanced sensory equipment,  and an artificial intelligence inference engine capable of real-time decision-making and adaptive control. By combining deep learning with reinforcement learning,  the robotic arm learns optimal motion strategies and continuously improves performance through online training. Embedded force-torque sensors,  stereo vision,  and tactile feedback allow for highly accurate component manipulation and insertion. The robotic control architecture includes closed-loop feedback,  predictive modeling,  and a robust fault-tolerance mechanism. Additionally,  the system supports human-robot collaboration via augmented reality interfaces and kinesthetic teaching. This invention significantly enhances precision,  speed,  and adaptability in complex industrial assembly environments,  reducing human intervention while improving manufacturing consistency and flexibility. The modular and interoperable design allows seamless integration into existing manufacturing execution systems and supports dynamic task reconfiguration on-the-fly.

The invention discloses a dynamic game interactive decision-making method for mixed traffic intelligent vehicles based on subjective cognition,  which includes :  sensing,  obtaining and exchanging driving information of each vehicle in mixed traffic; judge whether the K instantaneous game system is started according to the situation risk assessment; if it is started,  each vehicle participating in the game will first make decisions based on its own subjective cognition until the subjective cognition of each vehicle reaches a consensus; establish and optimize the expected utility dynamic equation of each vehicle participating in the game,  and output its own instantaneous acceleration at K based on this decision and execute it; updating the driving information and characteristic quantification index of each vehicle in mixed traffic instantaneously and synchronously at K+1; repeat the above steps until the potential mixed traffic conflict is completely resolved through continuous interactive decision-making This method fully simulates human decision-making logic,  improves the intelligence,  interactivity,  sustainability and integration of decision-making,  and realizes personalized driving and humanoid decision-making of intelligent vehicles. 1. A mixed traffic intelligent vehicle dynamic game interaction decision method based on subjective cognition,  wherein it comprises :  S1,  the intelligent vehicle in the mixed traffic obtains the driving information of the surrounding vehicle,  and sends its own driving information to the surrounding vehicle;  S2,  according to the driving information of the intelligent vehicle and the surrounding vehicle,  each vehicle in the mixed traffic calculates the time difference of the K instant vehicle and the surrounding vehicle respectively through the conflict area;  comparing the calculation result with the risk threshold value,  and judging whether the game system is started according to the comparison result;  if the game system is started,  executing the step S3;  S3,  each vehicle participating in the game firstly based on its own subjective cognition to proceed decision,  until the subjective cognition of each vehicle participating in the game is consistent;  S4,  respectively establishing the expected utility dynamic equation individually embedded by each vehicle participating in the game in the intelligent agent game,  taking the expected utility dynamic equation as the optimization target function of each vehicle in the rolling time-varying decision,  deciding and outputting the acceleration of the vehicle in the K moment;  S5,  the intelligent vehicle executes the acceleration of itself in K instant;  S6,  synchronously updating the driving information and characteristic quantization index of the intelligent vehicle and the surrounding vehicle in the mixed traffic at the moment of K + 1;  S7,  repeating the steps S1-S6 until the potential mixed traffic conflict is completely resolved by the persistent interaction decision;  the S3 specifically comprises :  each vehicle participating in the game defines itself as the occupancy of the leader,  and defines the participating vehicle of other mixed traffic around as the occupancy of the following person based on the subjective cognition of itself;  constructing a characteristic quantization index,  quantizing the driving characteristic of the vehicle through the external behaviour expression of the vehicle,  making the distributed decision gradually converge to the integrated cooperative decision,  reaching a stable multi-vehicle decision state;  constructing a sequential action MAP graph,  inquiring the instantaneously updated characteristic quantization index from the sequential action MAP graph in real time,  realizing the sequential action sequence of game in time-varying re-planning stage;  The feature quantization index is updated in real time along with the rolling decision process until the subjective cognition of each vehicle participating in the game is consistent.

Determine whether the captured image is a signal change triggered by the human body through the humanoid detection algorithm. If so,  start the residence detection and timer,  and enter step 4; otherwise,  end the process; 4. Determine whether the moving object leaves. If so,  the result process; otherwise go to step 5; 5. Determine whether the residence time threshold is reached; if so,  capture the picture; otherwise,  return to step 4; 6. Determine whether there is a human figure in the captured picture through the human figure detection algorithm,  and if so,  report the resident information; otherwise,  end the process. The invention solves the problems of high equipment power consumption caused by non-humanoid triggering residence alarm and no humanoid in captured images when the residence time threshold reaches 1. A resident alarm anti-error triggering method of intelligent door lock,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  detecting the movement of the object outside the door by the microwave radar;  step 2,  when the microwave radar detects the signal change,  starting the camera to capture the image;  step 3,  analyzing the captured image by the human shape detection algorithm,  judging whether it is the signal change triggered by the human body,  if so,  starting the resident detection and timer,  entering the step 4;  if not,  ending the flow;  step 4,  judging whether the moving object leaves,  if so,  the result flow;  if not,  going to step 5;  step 5,  judging whether the preset residence time threshold is reached;  if so,  capturing the set number of pictures;  if not,  returning to step 4;  step 6,  analyzing the captured picture by the human shape detection algorithm,  judging whether there is human shape in the picture,  if so,  reporting the resident information to the cloud end;  if not,  ending the flow.

An EEG-based control and annotation system enables hands-free,  real-time vertical maneuvering of an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) by interpreting noninvasive brainwave artifacts. It includes a graphical tool for efficiently labelling EEG segments to generate high-quality training data. For control,  a BioAMP EXG Pill electrode array connected to an Arduino Nano captures raw EEG from the user’s forehead,  digitises it at a high sampling rate,  and extracts sliding-window features (instantaneous amplitude,  sample-to-sample delta,  moving average). These features feed a lightweight LSTM network trained online with binary cross-entropy loss and Adam optimisation,  adapting in real time to individual neural baselines. Jaw clenches and eye blinks are detected and mapped to “ascend” and “descend” commands,  while inactivity maintains hover. Commands are sent via serial/Wi-Fi as PWM signals to a Primus V4 flight controller on a Pluto 1.2 drone. Complementing this is an EEG annotation tool built with PyQtGraph,  showing the full EEG time series and allowing drag-select labeling. Colour-coded plots,  a status bar,  and CSV export simplify and speed up manual segmentation,  making data generation more accessible. These labelled datasets help refine the LSTM classifier across sessions and users. Together,  the system offers a cost-effective,  non-contact,  brainwave-only UAV control platform—eliminating the need for joysticks or gestures—while providing an end-to-end solution for dataset creation and adaptive model tuning. Applications include assistive robotics,  neurorehabilitation,  and human-robot interaction,  advancing telepathic-style UAV control.

This project introduces Hexacrawl,  a six-legged robotic platform engineered to exhibit natural,  fluid movement and perform real-time facial recognition with precision. The robot leverages a robust mechanical architecture for terrain adaptability and integrates deep learning algorithms to detect and identify human faces. The locomotion is controlled by an Arduino Mega 2560 that operates 18 MG995 servo motors using inverse kinematics. For face recognition,  an Raspberry Pi 5 runs an extended MTCNN (Multi-task Cascaded Convolutional Neural Network) for facial landmark detection and FaceNet for generating facial embeddings. By blending steady walking capabilities with smart visual processing,  Hexacrawl operates effectively in tasks like surveillance,  search-andrescue,  and engaging with humans. Its modular and scalable design allows it to move through challenging environments while accurately identifying individuals. Extensive testing confirms its effectiveness in both indoor and outdoor scenarios,  laying the groundwork for future developments in autonomous robotics

The invention discloses a quick track replacement method for landing of a wheel-legged robot on sand or mud,  which includes the following steps :  step 1. Environmental detection and judgment; step 2. Prepare a new track; step 3. Release the old track; step 4. Install new track; step 5. Adjustment and testing Advantages of the invention :  Can complete the replacement of crawler tracks in a short time No manual intervention is required,  greatly improves replacement efficiency,  in emergency missions or field operations,  the advantages are more obvious,  suitable for various complex terrains such as sand and mud Improve the environmental adaptability of wheel-legged robots It is easy to operate through sensor detection and automatic program control The technical requirements for operators are reduced,  the time and labor cost for track replacement are reduced,  the working efficiency of the wheel-footed robot is improved,  the stable operation of the robot after track replacement is ensured through the real-time monitoring of the sensor and the precise adjustment of the control system,  and the accuracy and reliability of the replacement are ensured. 1. A quick changing method of crawler belt for landing of sand or mud wheel foot robot,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  Step 1,  environment detection and judgment :  the wheel-foot robot in the operation process,  through the pressure sensor installed at the bottom,  the humidity sensor and other multiple sensors monitor the ground condition in real time,  when the robot enters the special terrain such as sand or mud,  the sensor transmits the collected data to the control system,  the control system analyzes the received data,  the environment parameter is detected by the sensor,  the soft degree of the ground is judged,  the detection result shows that the crawler needs to be changed,  and the robot automatically starts the quick and automatic crawler changing program;  step 2,  preparing a new track :  the inner part of the robot is provided with a special track storage cabin,  the storage cabin is placed with pre-prepared track suitable for sand or mud,  when the control system sends the instruction of changing the track,  the mechanical device in the storage cabin starts to act,  the new track is pushed to the appointed position,  preparing to install;  step 3,  releasing the old track :  the robot firstly stops the current movement,  ensuring the stable state,  at the same time,  the control system starts the releasing program of the old crawler,  by controlling the motor or the hydraulic device,  loosening the bolt or buckle for fixing the old crawler,  and using the mechanical arm or other executing mechanism to gradually peel the old crawler from the walking mechanism,  ensuring that the old track is completely separated from the robot main body;  step 4,  installing a new track :  the mechanical arm or the special mounting device takes up the new track,  and is accurately placed on the walking mechanism of the robot,  and the locating device is used to ensure the gear of the new track and the walking mechanism,  at the same time,  the automatic screwing device is used for fixing the new track on the walking mechanism so as to ensure that the track is firmly mounted;  step 5,  adjusting and testing :  after the installation is finished,  the control system starts the adjusting program,  the tension degree of the new crawler is adjusted by adjusting the motor or the hydraulic device,  so as to make it reach the best working state,  and the installation condition of the new crawler is detected by using the sensor,  comprising the alignment degree of the crawler,  whether the tension degree is uniform and so on,  finally performing simple walking test,  making the robot walk for a distance under the safe environment,  observing the operation condition of the new crawler,  ensuring the stability and reliability,  if finding the problem,  adjusting in time,  until the crawler works normally.

A foot-type robot systemic control method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the planning path and the current state of the foot-type robot;  based on the planning path and the current state,  using the first task to construct the constraint condition,  using the second task and the weight coefficient to construct the secondary planning problem;  wherein the priority of the first task is higher than the priority of the second task;  the weight coefficient of the second task is positively correlated with the priority of the second task;  solving the secondary planning problem and obtaining the control instruction of the foot robot;  and controlling the whole body of the foot-type robot based on the control order.

This application relates to the field of personnel action monitoring and recognition,  and discloses an intelligent humanoid trajectory prediction and alarm system and method based on multi-modal video analysis,  including :  a video collection module for collecting video stream data of a monitoring scene; the data processing module is used to extract the motion status information of the target humanoid; the trajectory modeling module is used to construct the trajectory model of the target person; risk assessment module,  used to calculate behavioral risk values; an alarm module for triggering an alarm; optimization module to optimize the trajectory model. According to the invention,  the target motion state information is extracted through the data processing module,  high-precision input is provided for the trajectory modeling module,  and the trajectory modeling module is combined with a dynamic optimization algorithm to generate a predicted trajectory Compared with the existing technology that relies on coarse-grained detection or simple position tracking,  the present invention realizes refined modeling and dynamic prediction of motion states,  solves the problem that complex behaviors cannot be accurately reflected,  and at the same time improves trajectory prediction accuracy and system response capabilities. 1. An intelligent human-shaped track prediction and alarm system based on multimodal video analysis,  wherein it comprises :  a video collecting module for collecting the video stream data of the monitoring scene;  a data processing module for extracting the motion state information of the target human shape based on the video stream data,  wherein the motion state information comprises the node position,  speed and direction of the target human shape;  a track modelling module for constructing the track model of the target person based on the motion state of the target person and generating the predicted track of the target person by the dynamic optimization algorithm;  a risk evaluation module for calculating the behaviour risk value according to the prediction track of the target person and the scene environment characteristic;  an alarm module for comparing the behaviour risk value with the alarm valve value and triggering the alarm according to the comparison result;  an optimizing module for optimizing the feedback of the track model based on the deviation between the actual track and the predicted track after triggering the alarm.

The invention provides a robot compliant shaft hole assembly method based on a width learning model. The method includes :  obtaining contact information between an end effector and the environment through a torque sensor; performing initialization training on the width learning model in simulation training to obtain an initial hole position search model,  and performing dynamic generalization on the initial hole position search model through incremental learning so as to update to obtain the latest hole position search model; based on the contact information and the end position of the robot,  hole position search is performed through the latest hole position search model to obtain the optimal hole position; based on the optimal hole position,  and through the humanoid compliance control algorithm,  the robot is controlled to perform assembly operations to complete the shaft hole assembly task. Through this application,  the robot can automatically adjust its own parameters under different environments and force feedback conditions. The robot has humanoid and compliant interaction capabilities with the environment,  which is beneficial to improving the success rate of shaft hole assembly tasks. 1. A robot flexible shaft hole assembling method based on width learning model,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the contact information of the end actuator and the environment through the moment sensor;  performing initialization training on the width learning model in the simulation training to obtain an initial hole position searching model,  and dynamically generalizing the initial hole position searching model through increment learning to update to obtain the latest hole position searching model;  before initializing the width learning model in the simulation training,  the method further comprises :  collecting training data in the pre-designed grid space covering the hole boundary by the simulation robot,  wherein the training data is used for performing initialization training to the width learning model;  The step of dynamically generalizing the initial hole position search model through incremental learning comprises :  randomly generating an initial starting point,  starting based on the initial starting point,  performing N times of hole position search on the initial hole position search model,  wherein each hole position search operation outputs the corresponding output label,  and updating the network weight of the current hole position search model on line based on the corresponding output label,  wherein the current hole position search model is the hole position search model obtained after the previous hole position search; The invention provides a harmonic speed reducer with torque limitation,  and relates to the technical field of speed reducers. The harmonic speed reducer comprises a wave generator and a torque limiter,  wherein the wave generator is connected with a flexible gear; and the flexible gear is meshed with a rigid gear The torque limiter is composed of an inner hole shaft and a flexible gear connecting ring,  and the two are dynamically coupled through balls and meshing ball positions; when the torque exceeds the preset upper limit,  the ball is separated from the inner hole shaft,  realizing the mechanical decoupling of the flexspline and the connecting shaft. The advantage of the present invention is that When the harmonic reducer is abnormally overloaded or hit,  the torque limiter forces the flexible gear to disconnect from the connecting shaft Avoid mechanical damage such as permanent deformation of the flexible gear tooth shape caused by mechanical impact and jamming of the flexible gear bearing of the wave generator It also prevents the drive motor winding connected to the flexspline from being overloaded and burned,  and can also avoid the accumulation of impact loads through the instantaneous separation of the connecting parts,  thereby providing overload protection for mechanical equipment and increasing the safety of collaborative robots and humanoid robots. 1. A harmonic speed reducer with torque limitation,  comprising a wave generator (1) and a torque limiter (3),  the wave generator (1) is connected with a flexible wheel (4),  the flexible wheel (4) is engaged with a rigid wheel (2);  the torsion limiter (3) is composed of an inner hole shaft (301) and a flexible wheel connecting ring (302),  which are dynamically coupled through a ball (303) and a meshing ball position;  the flexible wheel (4) is connected with the flexible wheel connecting ring (302),  the inner hole shaft (301) is connected with the connecting shaft (6);  the inner hole shaft (301) is movably connected with the flexible wheel connecting ring (302);  when the torque exceeds the preset upper limit,  the ball (303) is separated from the inner hole shaft (301),  realizing the mechanical decoupling of the flexible wheel (4) and the connecting shaft (6).

The system combines cloud storage,  immediate alerting,  and automated scam reporting,  facilitating smooth cooperation with cybersecurity teams and law enforcement bodies. This invention signifies a major improvement in cybersecurity,  scam prevention,  and digital fraud protection with its automated,  intelligent,  and scalable fraud prevention strategy. FIG.4

The present disclosure discloses a system and a method for controlling a robot to perform a task. The robot is a legged robot that comprises a trunk and a plurality of legs for supporting the trunk above a ground. The system is configured to collect a reference trajectory defining a sequence of states of the robot to perform the task and execute a stance controller configured to compute and apply reaction forces of the plurality of legs of the robot in contact with the ground to push the trunk based on the reference trajectory. The system is further configured to execute a swing controller of a plurality of swing controllers to swing a leg in response to detecting a relative position between the trunk and a foot of the leg of the robot indicative of an imbalance of a support of the trunk of the robot above the ground.

The invention discloses a multi-dimensional code intelligent analysis method and system for processing results based on visual information,  which aims to simulate the rapid understanding and recognition process of human beings on complex scenes. The method encodes multi-dimensional scene grid information with depth of field information formed by processing results based on visual spatio-temporal information. The encoding process uses feature extraction,  multi-dimensional code generation and redundancy inspection multi-dimensional code encoding technology to convert complex scene information into efficient,  compressed coding forms,  and store these codes in a database; by fast encoding the scene and matching it with the stored multi-dimensional code information,  the scene can be quickly understood and accurately identified. The invention provides a new technical framework for intelligent and rapid scene processing through an efficient multi-dimensional code coding and processing method,  improves scene recognition and understanding capabilities for complex environments,  and provides powerful technical support for humanoid robots,  unmanned cars,  smart glasses,  and inspection equipment. 1. A multi-dimensional code intelligent analysis method based on visual information,  wherein the multi-dimensional code intelligent analysis method comprises :  performing efficient coding processing on the input visual space-time information with depth of field information,  generating and storing the scene multi-dimensional code information with space-time characteristic,  wherein the visual space-time information with depth of field information is multi-dimensional scene grid information;  Wherein,  the step of generating the scene multi-dimensional code information including the space-time characteristics comprises :  extracting key visual characteristic and depth of field information characteristic from the visual space-time information pair processing result;  according to the key visual characteristic and the depth-of-field information characteristic data,  constructing the scene multi-dimensional code information including the multi-dimensional code based on the visual and depth-of-field information;  embedding redundant check information in the scene multi-dimensional code information to ensure data integrity and data loss resistance;  comparing and matching the new scene multi-dimensional code information with the stored scene multi-dimensional code information,  so as to realize precise scene identification and understanding;  wherein,  according to the key visual characteristic and the depth of field information characteristic data,  constructing the scene multi-dimensional code information including the multi-dimensional code based on visual and depth of field information,  comprising :  mapping the key visual characteristic data and the depth of field information characteristic data to a multi-dimensional space coordinate system,  at the same time,  according to different visual characteristics and different depth of field characteristics,  constructing scene multi-dimensional code information of different dimensions;  embedding the weight information of the base point pixel block and the peripheral pixel block in the scene multi-dimensional code information,  the base point pixel block is the intersection point of the visual space-time information to the visual intersection line when observing the target,  if in the same section,  the peripheral pixel block is closer to the base point pixel block,  if on different sections,  along the direction from the base point pixel block to the middle point of the double-camera base line,  the closer to the base point pixel block,  the larger the assigned search weight coefficient is;  the retrieval weight coefficient is continuously increased as the distance from the base point pixel block is smaller,  until the base point pixel block reaches the maximum;  processing the scene or target in the space range based on the weight information of the base point pixel block and the peripheral pixel block,  enhancing the precision of the space processing and intelligent identification;  optimizing the structure and data layout of the scene multidimensional code to improve the coding efficiency and data compression rate;  using the compression algorithm to compress the characteristic data,  reducing the size of the scene multidimensional code,  at the same time,  controlling the redundant information proportion in the scene multidimensional code,  balancing the data integrity and coding efficiency;  the coding mode is dynamically adjusted according to the complexity of each characteristic data so as to realize high-efficiency coding;  verifying in real time in the scene multi-dimensional code generating process to ensure the correctness and stability of the code;  respectively performing real-time data verification,  integrity verification and damage resistance test to ensure that the generated scene multi-dimensional code can be correctly decoded under the condition of partial damage.

This application relates to the technical field of motion capture data processing,  and discloses a method for constructing a robot reinforcement learning model based on optical inertia fusion full-body motion capture,  which includes :  measuring and recording multiple key parameters of the target human body; initial calibration and recording of all inertial sensors worn on the target human body,  while calibrating all cameras arranged around; when the target human body executes the appointed action,  the action sampling data of the target human body is synchronously acquired; the motion sampling data includes motion data corresponding to the inertial sensor and camera image data corresponding to the camera; the motion data and camera image data are processed,  fused and optimized to obtain optimized joint posture quaternary data and human body action sequence data; input the human action sequence data into the reinforcement learning model of the humanoid robot,  and configure the preset reward function for reinforcement learning training,  which can improve the learning efficiency of the robot and the accuracy of action execution. 1. A robot enhanced learning model construction method based on photoinertia fusion systemic action capture,  wherein it comprises :  measuring and recording multiple key parameters of the target human body;  primarily calibrating and recording all inertia sensors worn on the target human body,  and calibrating all cameras arranged around the target human body;  in the process of the target human body executing the appointed action,  synchronously collecting and obtaining the action sampling data of the target human body;  the motion sampling data comprises motion data corresponding to the inertia sensor and camera image data corresponding to the camera;  after processing the motion data and the camera image data,  fusing and optimizing the motion data and the camera image data to obtain the optimized joint gesture four-element data and human body motion sequence data;  inputting the human body action sequence data into the reinforced learning model of the humanoid robot,  and configuring a preset reward function to perform reinforced learning training.

A method for remotely detecting wearing of safety helmet,  wherein it comprises :  using the PTZ tripod head camera based on the panoramic presetting position to collect the video stream of the target field;  using the frame picture in the video stream to detect the human shape,  when the human shape is detected,  adjusting the focal length of the tripod head to monitor the currently detected human shape in a short distance;  under the short-distance monitoring,  collecting the video stream containing the target human shape based on the PTZ tripod head camera,  and detecting the safety helmet based on the frame picture in the video stream containing the target human shape.
