The invention discloses an emotion behavior expression method of a humanoid robot,  which comprises the following steps of :  providing an emotion behavior decision-making method for matching the voice emotion of an interactive object with the behavior emotion of the humanoid robot,  and an emotion self-adaptive expression strategy of the humanoid robot,  so as to construct an interaction method for associating the emotion of a user with the emotion of the humanoid robot An interactive system is constructed that uses a microphone array to collect and locate the sound source of the interactive object,  trains an optimized random forest model to identify the voice emotion of the interactive object,  and makes decisions through the emotional behavior of the humanoid robot,  thereby realizing the expression of the emotional behavior of the humanoid robot The invention not only constructs the matching relationship between the user's voice emotion and the humanoid robot's behavior emotion,  but also solves the problem in the prior art that humanoid robots rarely directly construct the emotion relationship between humans and robots. At the same time,  it also fully demonstrates the advantages of making full use of the action and behavior elements of humanoid robots to express emotions,  which helps to further improve the human-machine interaction effect. 1. An emotional behaviour expression method of humanoid robot,  wherein It comprises a voice collecting and locating step,  a voice emotion identifying step,  a humanoid robot emotion behaviour decision step and a humanoid robot emotion behaviour self-adaptive expression step;  wherein the step of voice acquisition and positioning comprises :  S101,  collecting the voice signal through the separated microphone array;  S102,  amplifying and filtering the collected audio signal;  S103,  collecting and transmitting the amplified and filtered voice signal to the PC terminal in real time through the USB data collecting card;  S104,  pre-processing the audio signal at the PC end,  analyzing the signal-to-noise ratio of the audio signal,  selecting the audio signal with the optimal signal-to-noise ratio to perform the end point detection,  mapping the end point detection result of the single-channel audio signal to the other channel audio signals;  S105,  performing sound source positioning through TDOA algorithm,  solving the sound source distance,  azimuth angle and pitch angle;  S106,  coding the sound source distance,  azimuth angle and pitch angle of the voice;  wherein the step of speech emotion recognition comprises :  S201,  extracting the acoustic cepstrum characteristic of the audio;  S202,  extracting the fundamental tone frequency of the audio;  S203,  extracting the short-time energy of the audio;  S204,  extracting formant of audio frequency;  S205,  fusing the features extracted by S201,  S202,  S203 and S204 to form a voice emotion feature vector;  S206,  reducing dimension of the voice emotion feature vector by PCA main component analysis method;  S207,  adopting CASIA voice emotion database audio,  through the step of S201 to S206,  selecting random forest algorithm training CASIA voice emotion database audio through the step of S201 to S206 to obtain the emotion characteristic vector,  establishing emotion identification model;  the final prediction result of the emotion recognition model is the majority vote of all decision tree classification results;  S208,  selecting the single-channel signal with the optimal signal-to-noise ratio in the S104 multi-channel signal,  after the steps from S201 to S206,  inputting it into the emotion recognition model finished by S207 training,  the emotion recognition model outputs the corresponding emotion type,  the emotion type comprises anger,  fear,  pleasure,  sadness,  astonished and neutral,  through the majority voting mechanism selecting the most possible emotion type;  Wherein,  the step of determining the emotional behavior of the humanoid robot comprises :  S301,  generating the emotion action code of the humanoid robot matched with the emotion type output by the emotion recognition model in step S208 :  S302,  generating the emotion voice code of the humanoid robot matched with the emotion type output by the emotion recognition model in the step S208;  S303,  fusing the emotion action code and emotion voice code of the humanoid robot of S301 and S302,  and defining the fused code as the emotion action code of the humanoid robot;  wherein the emotion behaviour self-adaptive expression step of the humanoid robot,  comprising :  S401,  coding the pre-defined multi-mode emotion interaction template of the robot by the emotion behaviour of the humanoid robot obtained in S303;  S402,  according to the emotion behaviour code of the humanoid robot obtained by S303,  searching whether there is negative emotion behaviour;  S403,  if the negative affective action is included,  the humanoid robot firstly executes the voice and then executes the action;  S404,  if there is no negative affective action,  the humanoid robot firstly executes the action and then executes the voice;  S405,  the instruction head,  the emotion action data,  the emotion voice data,  the sound source distance data of the sound source location,  the azimuth angle data of the sound source location and the pitch angle data of the sound source location are fused according to the preset order to form a humanoid robot emotion behaviour data packet,  the humanoid robot emotion behaviour data packet is located in the robot multi-mode emotion interaction template;  S406,  the PC end sends the fused emotion behaviour data packet of the humanoid robot to the humanoid robot;  S407,  the humanoid robot receives the humanoid robot emotional behaviour data packet and decodes it,  so as to determine the corresponding interactive content; The present invention discloses an AI-driven adaptive control mechanism designed to facilitate seamless collaboration between human workers and robots in Industry 5.0 manufacturing environments. By integrating advanced artificial intelligence techniques such as deep learning,  reinforcement learning,  and real-time sensor fusion,  the system enables dynamic interaction,  where robotic operations are continually adjusted based on human behavior,  emotional states,  and environmental factors. This allows for a safer,  more efficient,  and context-aware manufacturing process that goes beyond traditional automation. The invention includes a multi-layered architecture comprising a central AI engine,  human physiological monitoring modules,  collaborative robots with adaptive control capabilities,  and environmental sensors. Through continuous real-time analysis of biometric data (e.g.,  fatigue,  stress,  engagement) and spatial awareness,  the system intelligently adapts robotic paths,  task roles,  and decision-making strategies. This adaptive intelligence ensures optimal role-sharing,  ergonomic compliance,  and human-centric task allocation,  reducing physical and cognitive strain on workers. Additionally,  the system is equipped with a learning mechanism that evolves from past interactions and feedback,  enabling continuous improvement in collaborative efficiency. The use of edge AI and low-latency communication ensures real-time responsiveness essential for critical manufacturing processes. This invention not only supports intelligent human-robot collaboration but also aligns with the goals of sustainable and personalized manufacturing in Industry 5.0,  making it a valuable innovation for the future of industrial automation.

The invention provides a behavior safety control method for a humanoid robot and an intelligent robot with a body,  and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the step of remarkably improving the path planning efficiency,  the flexibility and the safety of the robot and the cooperative capability of a multi-robot system through a mode of combining global obstacle avoidance and local obstacle avoidance This method can not only improve the behavioral safety control level of the robot,  but also optimize the performance and response speed of the overall system,  ensuring that the robot can operate efficiently and safely in the face of static and dynamic obstacles. At the same time,  by judging the behavior of the robot,  if abnormal behaviors are found,  including hardware and software failures,  abnormal operating paths,  special environments exceeding the set range,  etc.,  emergency braking is required,  and all power supplies to the robot are disconnected through the robot's built-in safety chip or special instructions. 1. A humanoid robot and behaviour safety control method of intelligent robot with body,  wherein it comprises :  receiving the shared information sent by multiple robots in the surrounding environment,  and collecting the environment information corresponding to the target robot;  establishing an environment model according to the shared information and the environment information to generate an environment map;  determining a global path according to the environment map and the starting point information of the target robot;  in the moving process based on the global path,  if the dynamic obstacle is detected,  partially avoiding the obstacle so as to avoid the dynamic obstacle;  if there is abnormal action in the driving process,  cutting off all power supply of the target robot based on the built-in safety chip or special instruction of the target robot.

The present disclosure provides a bipedal robot and its control method,  device,  and storage medium The control method includes obtaining the motion information of the motor at the parallel joint when the robot moves Input the motion information into the pre-trained parallel motion model to obtain plantar posture information According to the plantar posture information and the expected posture information of the robot,  the closed-loop control is carried out to obtain the first control torque. A control method of robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the motion information of the motor at the parallel joint when the robot moves;  inputting the motion information into a pre-trained parallel motion model to obtain the sole posture information of the robot output by the parallel motion model;  performing closed-loop control according to the sole posture information and the expected posture information of the robot sole plate to obtain the first control moment of the sole plate;  performing closed-loop control based on the first control moment of the plantar plate and the expected motion information of the parallel joint to obtain a second control moment of the parallel joint;  and controlling the motor at the parallel joint to work according to the second control moment.

A test method of network camera device,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  setting a display device,  and communicatively connecting the display device to a PC terminal;  the PC end is provided with a test video,  the test video comprises an alarm scene;  the PC end can control the display device to play the test video;  S2,  the camera device to be detected is connected to the exchanger in communication,  the exchanger network is connected to the application end,  so that the real-time image and alarm information of the camera device to be detected can be checked at the application end;  S3,  pointing the lens of the camera device to be tested to the display device so as to collect the test video played by the display device;  capturing the alarm scene in the test video,  obtaining the alarm information and transmitting to the application end,  so as to trigger the alarm;  S4,  recording the alarm information by the application end,  comparing the alarm information with the alarm scene of the test video,  and judging whether the alarm function of the camera device to be tested is normal.

The invention discloses a multi-modal target detection method for a tethered unmanned aerial vehicle Belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle identification technology,  it solves the problem that image recognition simply through visual assistance does not have a more accurate method to find disaster victims in messy ruins. Even if it is recognized,  it can be repeatedly recognized by disaster relief personnel,  which ultimately leads to the fact that it can only be used to output pictures for disaster relief. The personnel cooperate with manual monitoring,  so the recognition efficiency is poor It includes the following steps :  collecting regional ground images through the image acquisition module in the tethered drone. The invention realizes multi-modal target detection,  combines direct shooting,  thermal imaging,  ultrasonic images and sound source positioning to determine whether there are suspected disaster-stricken personnel in the area,  helps disaster relief personnel to rescue more efficiently,  and avoids blind search. At the same time,  there is no need to completely rely on manual monitoring of tethered drone images,  which greatly improves rescue efficiency and prevents rescuers from being repeatedly identified. 1. A multimodal target detection method for mooring unmanned aerial vehicle,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  through the image collecting module in the mooring unmanned aerial vehicle to collect the area ground picture,  synchronously through the thermal imaging collecting module in the mooring unmanned aerial vehicle to collect the area thermal imaging picture and transmit to the ground system;  after the ground system receives the area ground picture and the area thermal imaging picture,  the ground in the area is collected with the area hidden picture by the ultrasonic imaging collecting module,  and the sound source is synchronously located by the sound wave collecting module;  the area hidden picture and the area thermal imaging picture are combined to obtain the area life picture;  determining the humanoid shape for keeping the outline by the edge detection algorithm in the area life picture,  determining the human shape for keeping the outline by the edge detection algorithm in the area ground picture,  and filtering the human shape after comparing the humanoid shape with the human shape in the area life picture;  establishing a coordinate system for the area life picture,  and determining the coordinate area of the residual humanoid shape in the area life picture,  comparing whether the sound source is located in the coordinate area of the residual humanoid shape,  if so,  outputting the result as the suspected disaster-affected person,  if not,  not outputting the result.

The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots,  and in particular to an intelligent humanoid companion robot and its voice interaction system,  which includes :  a voice input collection and preprocessing module :  real-time collection of composite voice signals and voice triggers in the surrounding environment through a distributed microphone array instruction; multi-sound source speech separation module :  combines multiple potential sound source signals for independent processing and separates them into multiple independent sound source signals; target user sound source recognition and extraction module :  uses dynamic Bayesian network to predict the change of target sound source in continuous time frames,  and extracts the target user sound source signal; semantic analysis and output module :  generate natural and smooth speech response through speech synthesis technology; the invention solves the problem that the target user sound source is difficult to extract in noisy environment,  multi-sound source overlapping and voice switching scenes,  and greatly improves the robustness and adaptability of the system in complex voice environment. 1. A voice interaction system of intelligent human-type companion robot,  wherein it comprises :  a voice input collecting and pre-processing module :  the target user uses the voice triggering instruction to trigger the initial conversation with the robot;  a multi-sound source speech separation module :  performing time-frequency domain decomposition to the collected composite voice signal by sparse decomposition algorithm,  and representing the composite voice signal as multiple potential sound source signal combinations;  A time-frequency mask is generated by using a separation network,  and a plurality of potential sound source signals are combined for independent processing,  and are separated into a plurality of independent sound source signals,  specifically comprising :  a time-frequency domain decomposition sub-module :  performing short-time Fourier transform on the collected composite speech signal,  converting the signal from the time domain to the time frequency domain representation,  generating a time frequency spectrum of the signal,  applying a non-negative matrix decomposition algorithm based on sparse decomposition,  using the sparse characteristic of the signal to decompose the composite speech signal into a plurality of basic signal components,  mapping the decomposed basic signal component into multiple potential sound source signal combinations,  wherein each sound source signal is corresponding to a specific time frequency characteristic;  The separation network generates a time frequency mask sub-module :  using the separation network to analyze the time frequency spectrum,  extracting the characteristic weight of each potential sound source signal,  generating a time frequency mask based on the characteristic weight,  each time frequency mask is corresponding to the time frequency characteristic distribution of one potential sound source signal,  applying the generated time-frequency mask to reconstruct the signal of the composite voice signal,  and re-distributing each time-frequency unit of the composite voice signal to the original composite voice signal;  The sub-module of the independent sound source signal :  restoring the time frequency signal processed by the time frequency mask code to the time domain signal,  generating multiple independent sound source signals;  a target user sound source identification and extraction module :  based on the separated multiple sound source signals,  constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to model the time characteristic and frequency characteristic of the multiple sound source signals,  using the dynamic Bayesian network to predict the change of the target sound source in the continuous time frame,  extracting the target user sound source signal;  a semantic analysis and output module :  using the natural language processing technology to analyze the voice content of the target user sound source signal to extract the semantic information,  combining with the knowledge base to match;  according to the matching result,  generating natural and smooth voice response by voice synthesis technology;  Specifically,  the method includes :  analyzing the voice content of the target user;  The invention Claims a natural language processing technology based on pre-training language model,  comprising the following steps :  converting the sound source signal of the target user into the text content,  performing semantic labelling and dependence analysis to the text content,  extracting the key information unit,  including entity,  action,  time and place semantic component;  the knowledge base matching of the semantic information :  matching the extracted semantic information with the built-in knowledge base of the robot to identify the user intention,  wherein the knowledge base comprises a pre-defined dialogue template and context related information;  in the matching process,  matching or completing the fuzzy instruction by combining the semantic similarity calculation;  natural smooth voice response generation :  according to the matching result of the knowledge base,  using the voice synthesis technology to generate the voice response content.

The present application provides a control method,  equipment and medium for a humanoid robot,  and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The control method of the humanoid robot includes :  obtaining the current joint angle of the robotic arm and the current first position of the target object; input the joint angle and the first position into the pre-trained prediction model for processing to obtain the change value of the joint angle; control the joint angle of the robotic arm to adjust according to the change value,  and obtain the current second position of the end effector; determining whether a distance of the second location from the first location is less than a distance threshold; if yes,  control the end effector to grab the target object. If not,  perform the steps of obtaining the current joint angle of the robotic arm and the current first position of the target object,  so that the humanoid robot can be applied in a dynamic environment and accurately grab dynamic objects. 1. A control method of humanoid robot,  wherein the humanoid robot comprises :  a mechanical arm and an end effector,  the control method of the humanoid robot comprises :  obtaining the current joint angle of the mechanical arm and the current first position of the target object,  the current first position of the target object comprises :  capturing the target position needed by the target object,  the end effector is a smart hand,  the target position comprises :  at least one of a three-dimensional position and a three-dimensional orientation of the wrist of the dexterous hand,  and a three-dimensional position of the elbow joint of the dexterous hand;  obtaining the current third position of the obstacle object between the end effector and the target object;  inputting the joint angle,  the first position,  the third position and the change value threshold value into a pre-trained prediction model for processing to obtain the change value of the joint angle,  wherein the change value is less than the change value threshold value;  controlling the joint angle of the mechanical arm to be adjusted according to the change value,  and obtaining the current second position of the end effector;  determining whether the distance between the second position and the first position is less than a distance threshold;  if so,  controlling the end actuator to capture the target object,  if not,  executing the step of obtaining the current joint angle of the mechanical arm and the current first position of the target object;  the training process of the prediction model comprises :  based on the preset strategy optimization algorithm,  determining the reward value according to the sample first position and the sample second position;  according to the reward value,  adjusting the model parameter of the prediction model,  the reward value is used for enabling the prediction model to learn and output the prediction change value closer to the first position of the sample,  The learning output avoids the predicted change value of the obstacle object,  and the learning output makes the end actuator reach the predicted change value of the first position of the set sample.

The invention discloses a drinking water purification and disinfection non-human robot system,  and relates to the technical field of drinking water treatment. It includes :  a siphon water production module,  which pumps the raw water into the membrane tank through the raw water pump. The raw water flows from the outside of the ultrafiltration membrane filament to the inside of the membrane filament. It is converted into clean water,  flows through the water collection pipe to the water production pipe,  and the water production pipe transports the clean water to the clean water tank; the self-adaptive cleaning module triggers the gas washing operation when the membrane running flux is lower than the preset gas washing low threshold,  and triggers the water washing operation when the gas washing operation cannot restore the membrane running flux to the normal flux; cleaning optimization module,  calculate the membrane operating flux change rate and stability coefficient during the gas washing cycle The membrane operating flux model is constructed based on the linear regression model,  the minimum objective function and constraints are set,  the genetic optimization algorithm is used to determine the optimal gas washing duration and cycle,  and the gas washing is triggered when the optimal cycle is reached,  so as to realize the automatic cleaning and optimal maintenance of the membrane and improve the stability and operating efficiency of the system. 1. A non-human robot system for purifying and sterilizing drinking water,  wherein Including :  a siphon water producing module for pumping the raw water into the membrane tank by the raw water pump and producing water automatically by siphon effect,  wherein the raw water flows from the ultrafiltration membrane wire to the membrane wire to be converted into purified water,  and flows to the water producing tube by the water collecting tube,  and the purified water is conveyed to the clean water tank by the water producing tube;  a self-adaptive cleaning module for comparing the membrane operation flux of the ultrafiltration membrane with the preset gas washing low threshold value,  when the membrane operation flux is lower than the preset gas washing low threshold value,  triggering the gas washing operation,  when the gas washing operation cannot recover the membrane operation flux to the normal flux,  triggering the water washing operation;  a cleaning optimization module,  collecting historical operation data,  calculating the inner film operation flux change rate and stability coefficient of the gas washing period,  constructing a film operation flux model based on a linear regression model,  setting a minimum target function and constraint condition,  using genetic optimization algorithm to determine the optimal gas washing time length and period,  triggering the gas washing when the optimal period is reached.

Artificial Intelligence-Augmented Modular Robotic Dynamic Surface Maintenance and Infrastructure Monitoring is a standalone future system for maximum efficiency,  safety,  and accuracy in infrastructure maintenance. Computer vision,  artificial intelligence (AI),  modular robotic architecture,  and IoT sensors with predictive maintenance and automation of surface treatment of infrastructure such as bridges,  pipelines,  industrial buildings,  and skyscrapers are enabled via real-time inspection. The robot platform is equipped with adaptive mobility technology in the shape of omnidirectional wheels,  magnetic suspension,  and vacuum grip to move on any surface. The system has RGB-D high-resolution cameras,  LiDAR,  and deep learning to scan for structural defects such as cracks,  corrosion,  and deformation. A multi-function maintenance set of high-pressure cleaning sprays,  paint and coating automatic devices,  and surface treatment applicators is used for effective repair. And the system is using IoT connectivity and cloud analytics to remotely inspect,  obtain real-time data,  and provide predictive maintenance recommendations. A solar- battery hybrid power system provides self-sufficiency. AI-based motion planning accelerates autonomous decision-making,  collision avoidance,  and task accomplishment. This cutting-edge robot system reduces man's exposure to harm in hostile environments,  eradicates maintenance expense,  and increases infrastructure longevity. By innovative surface monitoring and maintenance,  this system provides the basis for automated industrial maintenance future-proofing and environmentally friendly asset management.

This robotic arm is designed to perform a wide range of tasks,  from precise material handling and assembly to complex machining and quality control,  all within a single automated system. By combining cutting-edge sensors,  AI-driven programming,  and flexible design,  the arm can adapt to different manufacturing requirements,  significantly reducing the need for multiple specialized machines. This versatility not only improves operational flexibility but also optimizes production time and costs. Equipped with high-precision actuators and a range of interchangeable tools,  the robotic arm can achieve micron-level accuracy,  making it ideal for industries that demand intricate assembly,  such as electronics,  aerospace,  and medical device manufacturing. The system’s modular design allows for easy reconfiguration,  enabling manufacturers to tailor the arm’s functions to specific production lines or product designs without extensive downtime or reprogramming. Moreover,  the robotic arm incorporates real-time data feedback and machine learning algorithms,  ensuring continuous performance improvement and predictive maintenance. This enhances operational uptime and reduces unexpected failures,  contributing to a more reliable and cost-effective manufacturing environment. Through seamless integration with existing automation infrastructure,  the robotic arm can elevate the overall efficiency of precision manufacturing processes. In essence,  this multi-functional robotic arm represents a paradigm shift in how manufacturing tasks are approached,  offering a scalable and adaptable solution that drives innovation,  reduces operational complexity,  and enhances the precision of production systems across industries. The successful implementation of this technology has the potential to shape the future of manufacturing by pushing the boundaries of automat ion and precision.

The invention provides a micro-terrain identification method based on an optimized sparrow search algorithm and a support vector machine. The micro-terrain identification method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  acquiring foot end pressure data of a hexapod robot in micro-terrain environments with different slopes so as to construct a micro-terrain data set; wherein the hexapod robot is controlled in a quadruped gait; s2. Use the micro-terrain data set to initialize the parameters of the support vector machine; s3. Update the penalty parameters and kernel functions of the support vector machine using the optimized sparrow search algorithm to obtain a micro-terrain recognition model; s4. Obtain the foot end pressure data of the hexapod robot during the task,  and use the micro-terrain recognition model to identify the micro-terrain. According to the method,  micro-terrain data acquisition is carried out through a hexapod robot,  and an optimized sparrow search algorithm is utilized,  that is,  parameters of a support vector machine are updated by increasing the diversity and global search capability of a sparrow population,  so that the accuracy,  the efficiency and the stability of a micro-terrain recognition model are improved 1. A micro-terrain identification method based on optimized sparrow search algorithm and support vector machine,  wherein the method comprises :  S1,  obtaining the foot end pressure data of the six-foot robot in the micro-terrain environment with different gradients,  so as to construct a micro-terrain data set;  wherein the six-foot robot is controlled in a four-foot gait;  S2,  using the micro-terrain data set,  initializing the parameter of the support vector machine;  S3,  using the optimized sparrow search algorithm,  updating the penalty parameter and kernel function of the support vector machine,  so as to obtain the micro-terrain identification model;  S4,  obtaining the foot end pressure data of the six-foot robot in the task process,  and using the micro-terrain identification model to identify the micro-terrain.

A method for estimating a pose of a humanoid robot includes :  processing obtained pose parameters of a waist of the humanoid robot and plantar motion parameters of the humanoid robot to obtain the measured pose parameters of a center point of the waist of the humanoid robot;  calculating predicted pose parameters of the center point of the waist according to the obtained pose parameters of the waist;  and fusing the measured pose parameters and the predicted pose parameters to obtain estimated pose parameters of the center point of the waist.

Embodiments of the invention are directed towards systems,  methods and computer program products for providing improved eye tests. Such tests improve upon current eye tests,  such as visual acuity tests,  by incorporating virtual reality,  software mediated guidance to the patient or practitioner such that more accurate results of the eye tests are obtained. Furthermore,  through the use of one or more trained machine learning or predictive analytic systems,  multiple signals obtained from sensors of a testing apparatus are evaluated to ensure that the eye test results are less error-prone and provide a more consistent evaluation of a user's vision status. As it will be appreciated,  such error reduction and user guidance systems represent technological improvements in eye tests and utilize non-routine and non-conventional approaches to the improvement and reliability of eye tests.

The invention guides the model to adapt to human targets in special scenes through boundary regression,  center weighting and adaptive focus loss,  thereby improving the accuracy and recall rate of detection in dense personnel meeting scenes,  and has good application prospects. 1. The integration of robotics in construction is revolutionizing the industry by bridging the gap between mechanical and civil engineering through the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). As construction projects become increasingly complex and demands for efficiency and precision rise,  robotics has emerged as a critical tool in transforming traditional construction methods. This paper explores the role of robotics in construction,  focusing on how these technologies enable seamless coordination between mechanical systems and civil engineering practices,  ultimately enhancing productivity,  safety,  and quality in construction projects. By leveraging AI and ML algorithms,  robots can autonomously perform tasks such as bricklaying,  welding,  surveying,  and material handling with remarkable accuracy and speed. The application of these technologies not only improves the precision of structural components but also reduces the risks associated with human labor in hazardous environments. AI-driven robots can adapt to changing construction site conditions,  learn from past experiences,  and optimize their performance over time,  offering solutions that were previously unachievable through traditional methods. Furthermore,  robotics in construction fosters collaboration between various engineering disciplines. Mechanical engineers focus on designing and developing robotic systems,  while civil engineers provide expertise on how these robots can be integrated into the construction process. Together,  they work to create systems that can address both the physical demands of construction and the complex requirements of structural integrity and safety. This paper also discusses the challenges and opportunities associated with the adoption of robotics in construction,  such as the need for specialized skills,  regulatory concerns,  and the high upfront costs of robotic systems. The study concludes that,  despite these challenges,  the continued development and integration of robotics,  AI,  and ML in construction will undoubtedly shape the future of the industry,  fostering greater efficiency,  safety,  and innovation.

ABSTRACT Fire emergencies in defence environments present significant challenges,  requiring innovative solutions for effective response and risk reduction. This invention introduces a firefighting humanoid robot designed with specialized systems for fire detection,  suppression,  and rescue tasks. Engineered for deployment in high-risk defence zones such as military bases and ammunition depots,  the robot is equipped with enhanced mobility to navigate complex terrains,  including confined spaces,  staircases,  and debris-filled areas. It features advanced fire suppression technology capable of tackling hazardous fires involving explosives and chemicals. Integrated with intelligent control algorithms,  the robot can autonomously assess fire conditions,  identify safe pathways,  and make critical real-time decisions. Its humanoid design allows for efficient manipulation of firefighting equipment,  ensuring adaptability in diverse defence infrastructures. This innovation aims to strengthen emergency response,  enhance operational efficiency,  and minimize human risk in high-threat defence environments.

By simulating tactile sensations such as pressure,  vibration, · and temperature,  the system provides real-time feedback,  enhancing precision,  satety,  and user experience in diverse applications. The haptic feedback system includes a robotic assistant equipped with multimodal sensors to detect environmental interactions and user commands,  paired with a user interface device such· as a wearable glove or handheld controller. Machine learning algorithms process sensor 'data to adapt feedback patterns to user preferences and· taskspecific requirements. The system also features safety mechanisms,  including collision detection and emergency stop functions,  ensuring secure operation in dynamic environments. Applications of this invention span multiple domains,  including healthcare,  where it enhances control and precision in surgical robotics;  manufacturing,  where it improve.s the manipulation of robotic arms in assembly tasks;  and assistive technology,  offering intuitive interfaces for individuals with disabilities. By bridging the gap between humans and robotic systems through realistic tactile communication,  this invention sets a new standard for seamless and efficient human-robot interaction.

Collision or potential collision hazard exists; in response to collision or potential collision danger,  corresponding warning information or corresponding operation instructions are sent to the robot. The invention discloses a humanoid robot action imitation method and device based on 3D human posture estimation. The human posture point cloud data of the teacher; human limb motion capture :  According to human posture point cloud data,  based on 3D human posture estimation network,  the three-dimensional coordinates of human joints are captured; action behavior mapping :  based on coordinate conversion and space vector calculation,  the obtained three-dimensional coordinates of human joints are converted into joint angles of human robot arms; mapping joint angle filtering :  smoothing the joint angles through Kalman filtering,  and limiting the output of the joint angles according to the range of motion of each joint of the robot,  so as to realize the imitation of the teach's arm movements by the humanoid robot. 1. A humanoid robot action simulation method based on 3D human body posture estimation,  wherein it comprises :  (1) Data acquisition and pre-processing :  using the colour-depth camera to collect the colour image and the depth image,  obtaining the human body posture point cloud data of the demonstrator under the world coordinate system through data pre-processing;  (2) human body limb motion capture :  according to the human body posture point cloud data obtained in step (1),  based on the 3D human body posture estimation network,  realizing the capture of the human body joint three-dimensional coordinate;  (3) action mapping :  based on the coordinate conversion and space vector calculation,  converting the human body joint three-dimensional coordinate obtained in the step (2) into the joint angle of the two arms of the human-shaped robot;  (4) mapping joint angle filtering :  smoothing the robot joint angle obtained in the step (3) by Kalman filtering,  and limiting and outputting the joint angle according to the moving range of each joint of the robot,  so that the humanoid robot realizes the simulation of the arm action of the demonstrator;  Wherein,  the step (2) comprises the following sub-steps :  (2.1) quantizing the human posture point cloud data;  (2.2) establishing a 3D human body posture estimation network,  wherein the 3D human body posture estimation network comprises a mask network and a posture estimation network;  Wherein,  the 3D human body posture estimation network comprises :  a mask network for roughly searching the point cloud around the joint of the human body,  and generating the mask characteristic representing the importance degree of the point cloud by taking the point cloud data in a certain range around the true value of the joint as the monitoring signal; When the lidar obstacle avoidance program fails due to large blind spots,  the robot will continue to walk until it appears in the detection range of the depth camera. Then it executes the depth camera obstacle avoidance method to avoid obstacles again. Judge obstacles and make choices According to the invention,  the laser radar and the depth camera are jointly used to realize obstacle avoidance,  and the depth camera is used as a blind filling means and a supplement of the laser obstacle avoidance,  so that the safety is further improved Processing depth data acquired by depth cameras using random forests; small amount of calculation and fast processing speed. 1. A four-foot robot obstacle-avoiding method coordinated by laser radar and depth camera,  wherein it comprises a laser radar obstacle-avoiding method :  starting the program,  obtaining the laser radar data,  using the laser radar as the sensor,  obtaining the laser radar data;  pre-filtering the laser radar data,  in the robot operating system ros,  the laser radar data is an array with a length of n,  each value in the array is a distance information;  traversing the array,  through the distance judging,  deleting the value with the distance more than 100 cm and less than 10 cm in the array,  keeping the data of the key area,  namely pre-filtering;  data cutting,  further screening the pre-filtered data;  The robot avoids obstacle,  only needs to obtain the right front HFOV horizontal field angle 60 degrees,  VFOV vertical field angle -16 to 15 degrees in the range of whether there is obstacle,  traversing the pre-filtered data,  through angle judging which value is in accordance with the range;  keeping the data in the obstacle-avoiding range;  judging whether there is an obstacle in front of the robot,  if not,  going forward until the program is over;  if there is an obstacle in the threshold value in front of the robot,  the robot stops and waits for 30 seconds,  then continues to judge whether the obstacle still exists,  if not,  continues to advance until the program is finished,  if the obstacle still exists,  returns and replans the route;  Depth camera obstacle avoidance method :  program starting;  the depth camera is used as the sensor to obtain the depth data of the four-foot robot right ahead and lower;  filtering the area which influences the passing;  uniformly taking out several point cloud data for the area;  judging whether it can pass through random forest terrain;  the uniform extracted several depth data is used as parameter to be transmitted to the random forest model,  the random forest model gives the classification result,  comprising barrier,  passable road surface and cliff;  if it is judged that the obstacle in front of the robot is a cliff,  the robot returns and replans the route to avoid the stop point;  if it is judged that the front of the robot is a passable road surface,  continuing to advance until the program is finished;  if judging that there is an obstacle in front of the robot,  the robot stops and waits for 30 seconds,  and then judges again,  if the obstacle still exists,  the robot returns to the previous stop point and replans the route,  if the obstacle disappears,  the robot continues to go forward until the program is finished;  A side shell fan heat dissipation mechanism,  comprising :  at least one cavity side shell fan located on the cavity side shell for radiating the cavity side shell component,  the cavity inner motor and the front motor; A humanoid manipulator grabbing system,  wherein comprising a 11-degree-of-freedom humanoid manipulator (12),  a 6-degree-of-freedom manipulator (13),  a grabbing rectangular detection module,  a grabbing gesture prediction module and a grabbing control module;  the 11-degree-of-freedom humanoid manipulator comprises a palm (1),  a wrist joint (2) and five fingers (3),  the palm (1) and the wrist joint (2) and the five fingers (3) are arranged and connected in a humanoid shape,  the wrist joint (2) and the arm are arranged and connected in a humanoid shape;  the finger (3) comprises a root finger joint (4),  a first finger joint (5),  a second finger joint (6) and a third finger joint (7),  which are connected in turn,  and is provided with three rotating joints,  wherein two joints are actively controlled by a motor (8),  and one joint realizes self-adaptive driven movement through a winding (9);  the motor (8) is set on the palm (1),  the palm (1) is further provided with a camera (10) and a servo motor (11) for controlling the wrist joint (2) to work.

The invention provides a humanoid robot single-leg gait transition action design and a control method thereof,  which can effectively solve the problems of center of gravity deviation and insufficient control accuracy of a biped robot during gait transition through an algorithm module of a finite state machine and the single-leg gait transition action design This method significantly improves the gait control ability of the robot in complex environments,  especially during the single-foot support and single-leg jumping stages,  where the robot can stably switch to the corresponding gait and reduce the possibility of tilt and imbalance. 1. A single-leg gait transition action of humanoid robot,  wherein single-leg gait control state design :  the robot can be switched between different states according to the triggering or transferring condition between the states when running so as to conveniently fuse different control modes and keep the relatively independent and position-controlled two-leg upright state between the modes;  the MPC and WBC are closed under the position-controlled two-leg vertical state,  each joint of the robot adopts position control,  the robot two-leg vertical state is maintained by PD control;  the standing state of the two legs is controlled by force;  the robot keeps the mass centre in the centre of the two-leg supporting domain according to the state estimator,  and the related parameters of the two-leg standing are effective;  single leg standing state;  the robot keeps the mass centre in the centre of the single-leg supporting domain according to the state estimator,  and the related parameter of the single-leg standing is effective;  single-leg jumping state;  under the single-leg jumping state,  MPC and WBC are opened,  the expected track generating module is closed,  the single-leg jumping related parameter is effective;  the design and control of the single-leg gait transition action :  the initial state of the robot is a position-controlled double-leg vertical state,  the initial state of the single-leg moving state is a force-controlled double-leg standing state,  the single-leg gait transition action is the switching between the initial state and the force-controlled double-leg standing state,  and the force-controlled double-leg standing state in the single-leg moving state,  The fast and stable transition action between the single-leg standing state and the single-leg jumping state,  the switching logic of the transition action takes each state mode as one state in the FSM,  so there is a total need to design the following four pairs of transition actions :  the standing state of recovering the standing state of the position control double-leg vertical state and the single-leg moving state of the force control double-leg standing state :  when the robot is in the position control two-leg vertical state under the state of recovering standing,  the height of the trunk and the floating base of the robot is higher,  the knee joint is about to reach the limit,  therefore,  when switching to the single-leg moving state,  the height of the robot body needs to be reduced,  the NMPC and WBC parameters under the single-leg moving state,  comprising the cost function weight in NMPC,  foot end position error feedback coefficient,  swinging foot end track parameter,  the expected joint state,  and the task weight parameter in the WBC are different from the parameter for recovering the standing state,  which needs to be switched along with the robot state,  under the recovering standing state,  there is only PD control of each joint,  when switching to the single-leg movement state,  the expected track generating module needs to be added,  and the centre of the supporting domain is set as the double-foot centre,  on the contrary,  when the single-leg movement state is switched to the recovery standing state,  the height of the default robot body needs to be restored,  the default robot body is switched to the default NMPC,  WBC parameter,  the expected track generation module is closed,  the force-controlled two-leg standing state and the single-leg standing state under the single-leg moving state :  the support domain centre is switched immediately,  the expected track generating module of the force-controlled double-leg standing state in the single-leg moving state takes the double-leg centre as the support domain centre,  when switching to the single-leg standing state,  it must be switched to the support leg centre immediately,  otherwise,  when the single-leg standing state is switched to the force-controlled double-leg standing state,  the centre of the supporting domain must be firstly switched to the preset fixed coordinate relative to the supporting foot,  and then switched to the double-foot centre after the empty foot falls to the ground,  the double-foot centre at the moment of the gait switching is too close to the centre of the supporting foot,  which cannot be used as the gravity centre reference position when the two legs stand,  and the real-time bipod center in the gait switching process is continuously changing,  so after the gait switching,  pre-setting a coordinate fixed relative to the centre of the supporting foot as the gravity centre coordinate reference value in the time interval before the empty foot falls to the ground,  delaying until the empty foot falls to the ground and then setting the centre of the supporting area as the real-time double-foot centre to keep balance;  The single-leg standing state and the single-leg jumping state under the single-leg moving state :  under the single-leg standing state,  the expected track generating module takes effect,  the expected machine body position instruction input by the user on the control panel is taken over by the mass centre controller,  so the position instruction is invalid,  but the user can still control the expected machine body posture through the instruction,  on the other hand,  under the single-leg jumping state,  the expected track generating module is disabled,  the expected machine body posture instruction of the user is disabled,  the expected machine body position allows the user to control through the position instruction,  in addition,  there is a deviation between the single-leg standing state and the robot machine body position in the single-leg jumping state,  which needs to be corrected through the preset expected posture offset,  the force control double-leg standing state and single-leg jumping state under the single-leg moving state;  when the force-controlled two-leg standing state is switched to the single-leg jumping state,  the expected track generating module,  the user machine body posture instruction is disabled,  the expected position offset is preset,  the user machine body position instruction takes effect,  the supporting domain centre is switched to the supporting foot centre so as to prepare for switching the single leg standing state,  and the preset expected position bias needs to be independently debugged;  on the other hand,  when the single-leg jumping state is switched to the force-controlled double-leg standing state,  the expected position offset is preset,  the user machine body position instruction is invalid,  the expected track generating module,  the user machine body posture instruction is effective,  and the supporting domain centre is switched to the double-leg centre.

The invention provides a device equipped with a position detection function,  a robot and a position detection method,  which include :  a control module,  a power supply module; permanent magnet synchronous motor,  motor output shaft and reducer; when the device is powered off,  the control module starts in response to the phase voltage generated by the permanent magnet synchronous motor,  and controls the power supply module to supply power to the control module and the absolute encoder for a certain period of time; determine the position of the output end of the reducer based on the position data reported by the absolute encoder and the latest number of turns. The invention can reduce the energy consumption of the power supply module to the greatest extent Extend the battery life of its internal battery Save energy as much as possible,  moreover,  the power supply opening opportunity is responded based on the phase voltage,  which is directly generated and output by the permanent magnet synchronous motor due to position changes and does not need to be processed by an intermediate logic circuit. Therefore,  its response speed is fast,  and there will be no power supply opening. The situation of position data loss caused by untimely start-up,  and the power supply stability and reliability are higher 1. A position detection method,  applied to a device comprising a control module,  a power supply module,  a permanent magnet synchronous motor,  a motor output shaft,  a speed reducer,  an absolute value encoder and a control module;  the rotor of the permanent magnet synchronous motor is fixedly connected with the output shaft of the motor,  the output shaft of the motor is in transmission connection with the input end of the speed reducer,  the absolute value encoder is used for detecting the position of the output shaft of the motor;  the control module is used for receiving the position data reported by the absolute value encoder,  and recording the latest number of turns when the zero-crossing position;  wherein the position detection method comprises :  when the device is in the power-off state,  the control module is started in response to the phase voltage generated by the permanent magnet synchronous motor,  the phase voltage is generated by the rotation of the stator induction rotor of the permanent magnet synchronous motor;  The control module performs the following functions when starting :  controlling the power supply module to supply power for the control module and the absolute value encoder for several times;  and determining the position of the output end of the speed reducer according to the position data reported by the absolute value encoder and the latest number of turns.

A legged robot control method and apparatus,  a medium,  and a legged robot. The method comprises :  acquiring motion data of a legged robot (11);  determining,  according to the motion data and a preset inverted pendulum model corresponding to the legged robot,  a body motion trajectory and foot-landing points of the legged robot (12);  and controlling the legged robot to perform lateral striding motion on the basis of the body motion trajectory,  so that foot ends of the legged robot move to the foot-landing points (13). The preset inverted pendulum model corresponding to the legged robot can be obtained by using the legged robot as an inverted pendulum;  and the body motion trajectory and the foot-landing points that meet a kinetic requirement of the legged robot may be generated in combination with the motion data of the legged robot and the preset inverted pendulum model,  so that the actual motion of the legged robot in the lateral striding motion is matched with the body motion trajectory,  and the stability of the lateral striding motion of the legged robot is improved.

This application provides a motor overload protection method and device,  a storage medium and an electronic device. The above method includes :  detecting a hot start of a target motor of a multi-legged robot; determining an initial temperature value of the target motor according to a temperature detected by a temperature sensor,  wherein the temperature sensor is disposed at a target position of the target motor; based on the initial temperature value,  overload protection is performed on the target motor By adopting the technical scheme,  the problem of motor burning caused by under-protection in the motor overload protection mode in the related technology when the motor is in hot start is solved 1. An overload protection method of motor,  wherein it comprises :  detecting the hot start of the target motor of the multi-foot robot,  wherein the hot start means that the target motor is powered off and electrified again when the target motor is over-heated;  according to the temperature detected by the temperature sensor,  determining the initial temperature value of the target motor,  wherein the temperature sensor is set on the target position of the target motor,  the target position comprises at least one of the following :  a motor shell of the target motor,  wherein the temperature sensor is a negative temperature coefficient thermistor near the internal winding of the target motor;  executing overload protection to the target motor based on the initial temperature value;  wherein,  after performing overload protection on the target motor based on the initial temperature value,  the method further comprises :  detecting that the target motor is in the radiating state at the target time,  wherein the heat value of the target motor is the second heat value at the target time;  based on the difference between the second heat value and the target heat value,  determining the current heat value of the target motor every unit time;  according to the corresponding relation between the heat value and the temperature value,  determining the temperature corresponding to the current heat value as the current temperature value of the target motor;  when the current temperature value is less than the temperature value detected by the temperature sensor,  updating the current heat value as the heat value corresponding to the temperature value detected by the temperature sensor.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot scene intelligent understanding method based on a laser point cloud. The humanoid robot scene intelligent understanding method comprises the following steps of :  autonomously navigating a humanoid robot and acquiring three-dimensional real scene data through a laser radar scanning system to obtain scene point cloud data; processing the obtained scene point cloud data by using an adaptive radius sampling module; perform point cloud semantic feature extraction based on RPV ‑ Net on the extracted effective point cloud data,  and obtain the 3D bounding box and semantic label of the point cloud data; the channel attention module is used to process the point cloud data,  the average pooling method is used to obtain the overall characteristics of the point cloud,  the maximum pooling method is used to extract individual characteristics,  and the characteristics are aggregated to obtain the global characteristics of the point cloud; construct a multi-modal hybrid model of the scene understanding Bert pre-trained model and the encoder-decoder model to process the global features of the point cloud. This method uses lidar technology to provide real-time,  highly accurate three-dimensional point cloud data for humanoid robots,  and can achieve depth perception and intelligent understanding of the environment. 1. An intelligent understanding method of humanoid robot scene based on laser point cloud,  wherein it comprises :  assembling a laser radar scanning system on the human-shaped robot,  the human-shaped robot automatically navigates and collects the three-dimensional live scene data through the laser radar scanning system to obtain the scene point cloud data;  using the self-adaptive radius sampling module to process the obtained scene point cloud data so as to extract enough effective point cloud data;  performing point cloud semantic feature extraction based on RPV-Net on the extracted effective point cloud data,  obtaining a 3D bounding box and a semantic tag of the point cloud data forming the building component in the scene;  using the channel attention module to process the point cloud data after the point cloud semantic feature extraction,  using the average pool method to obtain the integrity feature of the point cloud,  using the maximum pool method to extract the individual feature with differentiation,  performing feature aggregation on the integrity feature and the individual feature,  obtaining the global characteristic of the point cloud;  constructing a multi-modal mixed model of a scene understanding Bert pre-training model and an encoder-decoder model,  processing the obtained point cloud global characteristic,  through the scene understanding Bert pre-training model,  increasing the diversity of the training data,  through the encoder-decoder model,  the three-dimensional point cloud object is understood as the three-dimensional ground object and the parameter information of the three-dimensional ground object,  improving the understanding ability of the humanoid robot to the scene;  wherein the step of using the adaptive radius sampling module to process the obtained scene cloud data specifically comprises :  The method comprises the following steps :  firstly,  calculating the Euclidean distance between the sampling centre point and all points in the scene point cloud data,  marking the point exceeding the special threshold R as Q,  and keeping the original value of the other points;  then arranging the points in the spherical sampling radius according to the distance ascending order,  and extracting the nearest w points as the sampling points;  If the sampling point contains a Q value,  indicating that the number of effective points in the spherical sampling radius is less than w,  the sampling radius needs to be gradually increased until the condition of at least w effective points is satisfied,  so as to ensure that there are enough effective points for feature learning.

The invention discloses an attitude control method and an attitude control system for a tandem four-legged wheel-legged robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of :  synthesizing a centroid kinematics analysis model by using a pre-established wheel-legged robot,  and solving to obtain an expected joint angle according to expected attitude information; based on the actual joint angle and the expected joint angle,  the joint feedback torque is generated,  and the observed error disturbance is used to calculate the joint feedforward torque; and according to the actual joint angle,  actual wheel information and expected wheel information,  the wheel control torque is calculated; finally,  according to the joint control torque and the wheel control torque,  the posture change of the wheel-legged robot and the wheel travel are controlled. The above-mentioned attitude control method proposed in this application effectively ensures the stability of the quadruped robot in the driving state through the coordinated action of the wheels and leg joints,  and improves the robot's anti-interference ability and ability to control the movement attitude during driving. 1.  based on the joint feedback moment and the joint feed-forward moment,  obtaining the joint control moment,  and according to the joint control moment and the wheel control moment,  controlling the posture change of the wheel leg robot and the wheel travelling; The creation of robots that mimic human-like motion and balance depends heavily on humanoid robot legs. The goal of these robotic systems is to replicate the intricate biomechanics of human movement,  allowing robots to move through a variety of terrains,  ascend stairs,  and carry out activities in human-designed surroundings. Humanoid leg design incorporates kinematics,  dynamics,  and control theory concepts,  frequently utilizing sophisticated materials and actuators like electric motors,  hydraulic systems,  or artificial muscles. Gyroscopes,  accelerometers,  and force feedback systems are examples of sensors that offer real-time data for balance maintenance and force adaptation. Designing humanoid robot legs presents several issues,  such as ensuring energy efficiency,  stability during dynamic movements,  and reactivity to irregular or unpredictable surfaces. Natural and adaptive motion requires sophisticated control algorithms,  such as those based on machine learning and bio-inspired techniques. Applications for humanoid robot legs include space exploration,  disaster relief,  healthcare support,  and household or industrial maintenance duties. Sustained progress in this area could revolutionize human-robot interaction,  improve robot autonomy,  and meet a variety of social demands. The present developments,  difficulties,  and trends in the development of humanoid robot legs are examined in this study,  with a focus on their significance for the field's future.

The invention provides a humanoid robot-based tool changing method,  a humanoid robot-based tool changing device and related products of a shield tunneling machine. The method comprises the following steps of :  determining a first tool position and first attribute information of a first tool of a cutter head of the shield tunneling machine,  wherein the first tool needs to be changed; determining current position information of the humanoid robot; when the distance between the current position information and the cutterhead of the shield machine is within a preset distance range,  obtain a first image of the first tool position in the shield machine and the ground below the first tool position through the vision module; determining a first position by using the first image,  and controlling the humanoid robot to move to the first position; obtaining second attribute information of humanoid robot; determining a target attitude parameter of the humanoid robot according to the first attribute information and the second attribute information; the humanoid robot controls the trunk part and the robotic arm to complete the corresponding posture movements according to the target posture parameters,  and controls the robotic arm to replace the first tool according to the tool changing operation steps. 1.  The method comprises :  determining the first cutter position and the first attribute information of the first cutter needed to be changed by the cutter head of the shield machine;  The first attribute information includes at least one of the following :  the length of the first cutter position,  the weight of the first cutter,  the cutter changing operation step of the first cutter position;  using the first image to determine a first position,  and controlling the humanoid robot to move to the first position;  obtaining second attribute information of the humanoid robot,  the second attribute information comprises at least one of the following :  the height of the humanoid robot,  the length of the mechanical arm of the humanoid robot,  the stress parameter of the humanoid robot;  determining a target attitude parameter of the humanoid robot according to the first attribute information and the second attribute information;  the human-shaped robot controls the trunk part and the mechanical arm to finish the corresponding gesture action according to the target gesture parameter,  and controls the mechanical arm to change the first cutter according to the cutter changing operation step; The invention discloses a force impedance dynamic compliance control method of a humanoid robot,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The dynamic sliding mode surface is designed to be the combination of the expected contact force of the inner ring of the humanoid robot and its derivative; design the input control law of the expected contact force of the inner ring to minimize the error of the expected contact force of the inner ring of the humanoid robot; based on the dynamic sliding mode surface and the desired contact force input control law of the inner ring,  the force impedance control law of the outer ring is designed by approaching the force impedance characteristics to the desired force impedance characteristics; the outer loop force impedance control law includes the bearing capacity compensation parameter identification error number,  and the bearing capacity compensation parameter identification error converges to the bearing capacity compensation parameter identification error limit value,  thereby realizing the dynamic compliance control of the robot force impedance. The invention also discloses a force impedance dynamic compliance control system of the humanoid robot,  which can achieve the dynamic compliance of the posture operation of the humanoid robot,  effectively realize the force impedance control accuracy and have good adaptability to multiple working conditions. 1. A dynamic flexibility control method for force impedance of humanoid robot,  wherein the dynamic sliding surface is designed as the combination of the expected contact force of the inner ring of the humanoid robot and the derivative thereof;  based on the designed dynamic sliding mould surface,  the inner ring expected contact force input control law is designed so that the inner ring expected contact force error of the humanoid robot is minimum;  an outer ring force impedance control law is designed by approaching the force impedance characteristic to the force impedance expected characteristic based on the dynamic sliding mode surface and the inner ring expected contact force input control law;  the outer ring force impedance control law comprises a bearing force compensation parameter identification error,  the bearing force compensation parameter identification error is converged in the bearing force compensation parameter identification error limit value,  so that the error of the human-shaped robot contact target is minimized,  so as to realize the dynamic flexibility control of the robot impedance.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot grabbing method based on three-dimensional vision. The humanoid robot grabbing method based on the three-dimensional vision comprises the following specific steps of :  S1,  environment modeling and sensing :  carrying out three-dimensional scanning on a working environment and constructing a three-dimensional map of the environment; step S2,  object recognition and 6D attitude estimation :  identify the target object and estimate the position and attitude of the object in the camera coordinate system; step S3 :  Coordinate conversion and target positioning :  convert the attitude of the object from the camera coordinate system to the robot base coordinate system through TF transformation; step S4. Path planning and motion control :  Use the cumotion algorithm for path planning,  generate a grabbing path,  and drive the arms to move according to the planned trajectory to achieve grabbing. According to the invention,  through environment modeling and perception,  the robot can update environment information in real time,  perform three-dimensional scanning on the working environment,  generate a three-dimensional grid model of the environment in real time,  and use the model for obstacle detection and avoidance planning,  so as to improve the dynamic environment adaptability of the robot to grab objects 1. A human-shaped robot grabbing method based on three-dimensional vision,  wherein the specific steps are as follows :  step S1,  environment modelling and sensing :  using RGB-D camera to perform three-dimensional scanning on the working environment,  using nvblox octree map generation algorithm to construct the three-dimensional map of the environment;  step S2,  object identification and 6D posture estimation :  using the depth learning algorithm to identify the target object,  estimating the position and posture of the object in the camera coordinate system;  step S3,  coordinate conversion and target positioning :  converting the attitude of the object from the camera coordinate system to the robot base coordinate system by TF conversion;  step S4,  path planning and motion control :  using cumotion algorithm to perform path planning,  generating a grabbing path,  and driving two arms to move according to the planning track to realize grabbing.

The invention discloses a foot structure,  a control method and a humanoid robot. The foot structure comprises a shell,  a foot pad,  a sensor component,  an inertial measurement unit and a control device,  wherein a cavity is formed in the shell The foot pad is set in the cavity and at the bottom of the casing; at least two sensor components respectively measure the ground vertical reaction force at both ends of the foot pad in the length direction; the inertial measurement unit measures motion information of the foot structure; the control device is configured to be able to receive information from each sensor component and the inertial measurement unit to achieve closed-loop control of the motion. Through the combination of sensor components and inertial measurement units,  multi-dimensional sensor integration and high-level motion parameter monitoring It provides a more refined and intelligent walking control strategy for humanoid robots,  significantly improves the movement stability and adaptability of humanoid robots in complex environments,  reduces the problem of unstable walking caused by changes in ground conditions,  and promotes the application of technology in more scenarios. 1. A foot structure,  wherein it comprises :  a shell,  in which a cavity is set;  a foot pad arranged in the cavity and located at the bottom of the shell;  at least two sensor components for respectively measuring the ground vertical counterforce at the two ends of the foot pad in the length direction;  an inertia measuring unit for measuring motion information of the foot structure;  a control device configured to receive the information of each sensor component and the inertia measuring unit so as to realize the closed-loop control of the movement.

The invention provides a foot structure for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot,  which includes a sole,  a heel,  a direct drive motor and a flange bearing. The sole of the foot is in contact with the ground to rotate left and right; the heel is connected to the calf to achieve forward and backward rotation. The direct drive motor is installed at the front end of the sole of the foot,  and is connected to the heel through the motor rotor to control the left and right rotation. Flange bearings are installed on the upper end of the heel and connected to the calf to control forward and backward rotation. The single-double ankle conversion mechanism uses screws to fix or release the rotation through the through hole on the side of the sole of the foot and the threaded hole on the heel. When the soles and heels are released,  the motor drives the soles to rotate relative to the heels to achieve the function of both ankles; screw fixation is in single ankle state. This design not only simplifies the complexity of traditional two-ankle designs,  reducing production costs and time consumption,  but also improves foot adaptability and flexibility,  allowing the robot to better adapt to complex terrains and diverse environments. 1. A foot part structure for humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a sole for contacting with the ground and realizing the rotation degree of freedom in the left and right directions;  a heel for connecting with the lower leg of the robot and realizing the rotation degree of freedom in the front and back directions;  a direct-drive motor mounted at the front end of the sole,  wherein the motor shell is fixedly connected with the sole;  the motor rotor extends out of the sole and is connected with the heel so as to realize the rotation degree of freedom in the left and right directions of the foot;  a flange bearing mounted on the upper end of the heel and connected with the lower leg of the robot so as to realize the rotation degree of freedom in the front and back directions of the foot;  The invention Claims a single-double ankle conversion mechanism,  comprising a through hole on the side face of the sole and a threaded hole on the heel,  wherein the screw is screwed or loosened to fix or release the relative rotation between the sole and the heel;  when the sole and the heel are loosened,  the sole can rotate relative to the heel under the driving of the motor and is in the ankle state;  when the sole is fastened,  the sole cannot rotate relative to the heel and is in the ankle state.

A control method of operation type intelligent foot-type robot applied to power inspection,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  step 1,  based on the multi-modal sensor carried by the foot-type robot,  performing omni-directional scanning and detection on the surrounding environment,  so as to collect the environment data,  and performing fusion on the collected environment data,  wherein the multi-modal sensor comprises a front stereoscopic vision sensor,  a rear stereoscopic vision sensor and a three-dimensional solid-state laser radar;  step 2,  according to the combined environment data evaluation environment complexity,  judging whether there is extreme terrain or barrier,  and based on the environment complexity evaluation result and environment mapping result,  planning the optimal inspection path;  step 3,  according to the routing inspection path planning result and the routing inspection task requirement,  performing attitude adjustment on the mechanical arm and the foot-type robot,  and using SLAM technology to perform real-time positioning and environment mapping,  adapting to the current terrain and environment condition,  making the foot-type robot to autonomously navigate in an unknown environment,  wherein SLAM technology is realized based on synchronous location and map construction system,  namely SLAM system;  step 4,  executing the power inspection task of the foot robot and the mechanical arm,  and according to the real-time operation state and performance parameter of the foot robot and the mechanical arm,  dynamically adjusting;  step 5,  establishing a remote monitoring system,  monitoring the energy consumption condition of the foot-type robot in real time,  and dynamically adjusting the operation mode of the foot-type robot according to the energy consumption monitoring result.
