The present disclosure provides a smart door lock resident snapshot method,  device,  equipment and a readable storage medium. The method includes :  monitoring a preset area corresponding to a smart door lock in real time through a microwave radar,  and when the microwave radar detects a moving target,  activate an infrared recognition module to obtain a thermal imaging image through the infrared recognition module; when judging that the thermal imaging image contains a living object,  the camera module is activated,  and the captured image is obtained through the camera module; obtaining a first coordinate area of the moving target corresponding to the preset area,  and obtaining a second coordinate area of the living target corresponding to the thermal imaging image; judging whether a humanoid target exists according to the first coordinate area and the second coordinate area,  and storing and uploading the captured image if the humanoid target exists; the intelligent door lock is provided with the microwave radar,  the infrared identification module and the camera module 1. An intelligent door lock resident snapshot method,  wherein the method comprises :  through microwave radar real-time monitoring intelligent door lock corresponding to the preset area,  when the microwave radar detects the moving target,  activating infrared identification module,  through the infrared identification module obtaining thermal imaging image;  when judging that the thermal imaging image comprises the living object,  activating the camera module,  and obtaining the captured image through the camera module;  obtaining a first coordinate area of the moving target corresponding to the preset area,  and obtaining a second coordinate area of the living body target corresponding to the thermal imaging image;  according to the first coordinate area and the second coordinate area,  judging whether there is a human-shaped target,  if there is the human-shaped target,  storing and uploading the captured image;  the intelligent door lock is provided with the microwave radar,  the infrared identification module and the camera module.

This application discloses a human-machine collaboration method and system based on a cyber-physical production system and MQTT Relates to computer application technology,  including :  decomposing the industrial robot-based cyber-physical production system CPPS for human-robot collaboration HRC into basic functional blocks FBs to complete the welding task based on the FBs,  where each FB is executed by an algorithm,  and any FB uses the MQTT protocol to communicate with the robot controller,  and is compiled to send commands to the robot operating system (ROS) to control arm movement; the MQTT protocol was utilized for publishing and subscribing FBs,  and trajectory teaching control based on the KUKA robot arm kinematics model for human-machine collaboration. This application will be developed to use a safe and easy-to-program collaborative robot platform to perform repeated welding tasks,  realize trajectory teaching,  greatly improve user operability and system feasibility,  reduce delay,  and improve response time. 1. A human-computer cooperation method based on network physical production system and MQTT,  wherein it comprises :  The network physical production system CPPS based on industrial robot is used for human-robot cooperation HRC decomposition into basic function block FBs,  so as to complete welding task based on FBs,  wherein each FB is executed by algorithm,  any FB uses MQTT protocol to communicate with the robot controller,  and is programmed to send a command to a robot operating system (ROS) to control the movement of the arm;  using MQTT protocol to publish and subscribe FBs,  and based on KUKA robot arm kinematics model to perform track teaching control,  so as to realize man-machine cooperation.

A gain adjusting system based on human-shaped model picture proportion of monitoring picture,  applied to a network monitoring camera,  wherein it comprises :  a camera for capturing the monitoring picture;  a microphone pickup module for picking up the sound signal so as to realize the voice communication in the bidirectional talkback module;  a bidirectional talkback module for realizing the bidirectional voice communication between the network monitoring camera and the user;  an AI human shape detection module for detecting the human shape model in the monitoring picture;  a calculating module for calculating the distance with the camera according to the proportion of the human shape model in the monitoring picture;  a gain adjusting module for dynamically adjusting the gain of the microphone pickup module according to the distance obtained by the calculating module.

The planetary roller screw is small in size and has a large thrust,  making the wrist smaller in size and large in load capacity It includes :  forearm sleeve (1),  wrist base (2),  base end fixed shaft,  force sensor (4),  planetary roller screw (5),  planetary roller screw (6),  support shaft,  output end fixed shaft,  rotating base (8). 1. A wrist system of humanoid robot,  wherein It comprises :  a small arm sleeve (1),  a wrist base (2),  a base end fixing shaft,  a force sensor (4),  a planet roller screw rod (5),  a planet roller screw rod (6),  a supporting shaft,  an output end fixing shaft and a rotating base (8);  the small arm sleeve is connected with the small arm assembly through the spring thimble male end (11) in it,  the driver (12) is installed in the small arm sleeve,  the small arm sleeve is fixedly connected with the wrist base through the fastening bolt (14);  each of the two output end fixing shafts (32) passes through an output end joint ball bearing,  and passes through a main driving shaft (81) for fixing,  the central shaft part of the main driving shaft passes through two rolling bearings (83),  the other end passes through one of the rolling bearings by a secondary driving shaft (82),  the inner ring of the rolling bearing is locked by the end faces of the main driving shaft and the auxiliary driving shaft;  the outer ring of the rolling bearing is locked by the rotating base (8);  the driver controls the action of the main driving shaft,  the main supporting shaft and the secondary supporting shaft are at one corner of the frame of the wrist base,  one end of the rotating base is connected with the main driving shaft and the secondary driving shaft through two rolling bearings,  the other end is passed through by the main supporting shaft (71),  the main supporting shaft passes through two rolling bearings,  the rotating base,  two rolling bearings are embedded in the wrist base,  wherein the inner ring of one rolling bearing is jointed with the end face of the main supporting shaft,  and the inner ring of the other rolling bearing is jointed with the end face of the secondary supporting shaft; The invention relates to the technical field of quadruped robot equipment accessories In particular,  it relates to a multifunctional inspection quadruped robot,  method and system for high-altitude snow It can sense ground conditions through equipment Leg function switching is performed by transmitting the live situation in real time through the camera The invention relates to a multifunctional inspection quadruped robot,  a method and a system for high-altitude snowfield,  which are used for improving the adaptability of equipment in high-altitude areas. The multifunctional inspection quadruped robot,  the method and the system also comprise the following steps of :  carrying a temperature-sensing module and a camera module by the quadruped robot to scan the environment,  and mapping the road conditions and the altitude of a specific environment and an inspection route; function switching is performed through the mapped route and height,  using rollers and leg components for displacement in flat-bottomed and rugged positions,  and sliding components such as sleds for displacement in snow and snow-trekking positions,  with real-time switching with bottom rollers to achieve high altitude all-terrain displacement requirements. 1. A multifunctional four-foot robot inspection method for high altitude snowfield and system thereof;  wherein it further comprises :  S1 :  carrying the temperature sensing module and the camera module by the four-foot robot to scan the environment,  and measuring the concrete environment and the road condition and the altitude of the inspection route;  S2 :  performing function switching through the measured route and height,  using a roller (605) and a leg component to perform displacement at the flat bottom and rugged position,  using a sledge and other sliding components to perform displacement at the snowfield and snowfield crossing position,  matching with the bottom roller (605) to perform real-time switching,  so as to reach the high altitude all-terrain displacement requirement;  S3 :  The four-foot inspection robot is adaptively dismounted by matching with the modular device,  which is suitable for snowfield working scenes of different areas,  elevations and thicknesses.

The invention relates to the technical field of quadruped robot control,  and in particular to a quadruped robot control method based on auxiliary air injection. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a quadruped robot dynamic equation; collecting the posture data of the quadruped robot in real time through the sensor to calculate the posture of the quadruped robot; calculate the imbalance degree of the quadruped robot based on the posture to determine whether to start the jet device; when the jet device is started,  the PID adaptive control algorithm is used to control the jet angle,  jet time and jet force until the quadruped robot returns to stability. When a quadruped robot moves at high speed,  the robot easily loses balance due to inertia and external disturbances. The jet device can quickly generate a reaction force at the moment of imbalance,  helping the robot to restore balance and avoid falling or losing control. 1. A four-foot robot control method based on auxiliary air injection,  wherein a pair of air injection devices capable of adjusting air injection angle,  air injection time and air injection intensity are symmetrically installed at the central position of the two sides of the four-foot robot,  the specific control method is as follows :  constructing a four-foot robot dynamics equation;  collecting the posture data of the four-foot robot in real time by the sensor,  and calculating the posture of the four-foot robot;  according to the posture,  calculating the unbalance degree of the four-foot robot,  judging whether to start the air injection device;  when the air injection device is started,  the PID self-adaptive control algorithm is used for controlling the air injection angle,  the air injection time and the air injection force until the four-foot robot recovers stably.

The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving human-like driving,  and specifically discloses a method for evaluating and generating human-like driving trajectories,  which includes the following steps :  S1. Construct a driving trajectory data set THAD; s2. Construct a deep feature mapping between the vehicle state-trajectory and the corresponding humanoid level based on the comparison network,  and train a level evaluator that accurately evaluates the humanoid level of the state-trajectory; s3. Combine the level evaluator with reinforcement learning,  and use the driving reward signal provided by the level evaluator for reinforcement learning to train a trajectory generator that generates a safe,  human-like driving trajectory. By combining the comparison network,  the present invention can obtain the reward supervision signal of the human-like level transformation of the trajectory when training the reinforcement learning to generate the trajectory,  which not only avoids the fine adjustment of many parameters of the vehicle in the traditional reward function,  but also enables the trajectory generated by the reinforcement learning to move toward the human-like level 1. A human-like driving track evaluation and generation method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  constructing a driving track data set THAD;  S2,  constructing the deep characteristic mapping between the vehicle state-track and the corresponding human class based on the comparison network,  training the class evaluator for accurately evaluating the state-track human class degree;  S3,  combining the level evaluator with the enhanced learning,  using the level evaluator to train the driving reward signal provided for the enhanced learning to generate a track generator of safe and human-like driving track.

The invention provides an intelligent airflow precise control humanoid breathing platform,  which includes a shell,  a support frame,  a continuous air extraction component,  a humanoid breathing component,  an air filter element,  a controller and a control panel. The controller adopts a hybrid control algorithm of proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control and neural network optimization,  and is connected to the continuous air extraction component,  humanoid breathing component,  and control panel. The constant air flow,  maximum inspiratory flow,  maximum expiratory flow,  respiratory rate,  respiratory ratio can be flexibly set through the control panel. The air filter element includes a moisture absorption layer,  an air filter layer,  and a gas adsorption layer,  which is used to prevent particulate matter,  moisture,  toxic and harmful gases,  etc. from entering the system,  thereby extending the life of the instrument. The platform can accurately simulate the respiratory process,  has the advantages of high precision,  strong stability,  intelligent control and convenient use,  and can be widely used in the fields of respiratory protection equipment performance testing,  gas filtration performance evaluation,  human respiratory mechanism demonstration,  respiratory disease research,  and emergency rescue. 1. Based on the mapping point information,  node diffusion with variable step size is performed to obtain diffusion nodes.,  until it is connected to the end position; the initial value of the current node is the starting position; connect each diffusion node to get a smooth path The invention can effectively improve the environmental adaptability and rationality of path planning in complex environments. 1.  mapping the obtained starting point position and end point position to the manual driving vehicle track,  obtaining the corresponding starting point mapping point and end point mapping point,  so as to form road section track;  according to the manual driving vehicle track data and the road section track,  calculating the boundary information of the road section track and the value range of the preset driving parameter;  mapping the current node to the manual driving vehicle track,  generating the mapping point information,  taking the boundary information of the road section track and the value range of the preset driving parameter as the constraint condition,  performing the node diffusion with variable step length based on the mapping point information to obtain the diffusion node,  until connecting to the end point position; Flexible Manufacturing System automation cell optimization of chuck master jaw family The present invention relates to the design and development of a Flexible Manufacturing System (FMS) automation cell automation cell optimization of chuck master jaw family on CNC vertical machining centres. The FMS cell automates component loading,  unloading,  clamping,  and measurement processes,  enhancing productivity and accuracy. The cell incorporates optimization techniques such as poka-yoke for easy part setup and sequence and time studies for minimizing throughput time with the design for eight components of varying sizes. The system produces 84 of the largest Chuck Master Jaw components in 28 hours,  achieving substantial reduction in loading-unloading and total production time. This flexible design supports future expansion with minimal setup changes,  promoting intelligent coordination,  efficient material handling,  and enhanced quality control. The present invention specifically improves the FMS cell's design,  automation processes,  and operational improvements,  leading to cost reductions and productivity enhancements.

The invention provides an advanced Robot Voice Communication System capable of easy and adaptive as well as ethically harmonious interactions with humans and robots. Several innovative modules are developed under one system to create a human-centric communication framework aware of the context,  consisting of a Voice Recognition System,  a Mood Detection Module,  IoT Integration Layer,  and a Self-Learning Algorithm. Each module interplays effectively,  leading to providing real- time empathetic responses that are person-specific and context-aware to the user. One of the remarkable features is Single-Interaction User Identification,  a robot recognizes and personalizes interactions with the users in real-time following the very first encounter. Further enriching the engagement between users and the system,  Mood Detection Module monitors vocal tone,  pitch,  and rhythm for a recognition of states like happiness,  sadness,  or frustration and allows the robot to make dynamic changes in the way of communication,  hence promoting an absolutely natural and empathetic experience. The innovation has integrated an IoT Integration Layer that aggregates and processes real-time environmental data from temperature,  proximity,  and noise sensors. The contextual information makes the robot respond in accordance with its environment,  hence the system is highly adaptive for dynamic environments like smart homes,  healthcare facilities,  or educational settings. Moreover,  the Ethical Filter Module will detect and filter out inappropriate and abusive language during communication. A Response Generator generates outputs through a combining of mood detection data from the user,  IoT sensor data,  and user-preference data,  and its Multi-Threaded Communication Manager can manage several interactions of different users in parallel as well as handle conversations contextual to them. A Self-Learning Algorithm improves communication skills at all times due to frequent interaction with users and appropriate feedback. Invention also includes easy user friendly feaatures such as voice-controlled shut-down and reboot,  entertaining facilities including the playing of music or the telling of jokes,  and an ability to sense and escalate unanswerable queries. This system can be generally applied across all healthcare customer service,  educational and smart environments,  bringing transformative intuitive and intelligent human-robot interaction.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method,  a humanoid robot control system,  a humanoid robot and a medium The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring walking parameters of the humanoid robot; determining whether the humanoid robot resonates according to the walking parameters; if the humanoid robot resonates,  adjust the gait parameters of the humanoid robot; and obtain the motion state of the humanoid robot; if it is determined based on the motion state that the lateral stability of the humanoid robot cannot meet the requirements for safe walking,  update the gait parameters of the humanoid robot. A humanoid robot control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the walking parameter of the humanoid robot;  according to the walking parameter,  determining whether the humanoid robot resonates;  if the humanoid robot resonates,  adjusting the gait parameter of the humanoid robot;  and obtaining the motion state of the humanoid robot;  if it is determined that the lateral stability of the humanoid robot cannot satisfy the safe walking requirement based on the motion state,  updating the gait parameter of the humanoid robot;  the motion state comprises a foot gyroscope rotation angle,  if the lateral stability of the human-shaped robot based on the motion state is determined not to satisfy the safe walking requirement,  updating the gait parameter of the human-shaped robot,  comprising :  according to the rotation angle of the foot gyroscope,  determining the foot posture change frequency of the human-shaped robot,  so as to determine the difference of the double foot posture change frequency;  according to the motion state,  determining the change frequency of the contact force of the foot ground;  if the difference of the double-foot posture change frequency is greater than the first threshold value,  or the double-foot ground contact force change frequency is greater than the second threshold value,  determining that the lateral stability of the human-shaped robot cannot satisfy the safe walking requirement,  updating the gait parameter of the human-shaped robot;  wherein the first threshold value is used for evaluating the consistency of the posture change of the biped of the humanoid robot in the walking process,  and the second threshold value is used for evaluating the stability of the biped in contact with the ground.

Construct a mountain digital ground model and divide the mountain digital ground model according to the slope grading principle to define a safe area and a dangerous area; s2. Introduce the black hole principle to optimize and improve the artificial potential field method,  construct the global slope potential field,  and simplify the high-dimensional complex environment; s3. Introduce the slope safety domain and slope reward function to re-plan the real-time path; this path planning method,  which combines artificial potential field method and deep reinforcement learning,  allows the robot to plan an optimal path with both appropriate slope and short distance only based on the interactive data of the current and historical environments,  which can be used in complex mountainous environments. Rescuing disaster victims trapped under the rubble after an earthquake is a time-critical situation. In this invention,  it is aimed to quickly identify the disaster victims under the rubble,  monitor their health status and rescue them as soon as possible. In the first stage,  signs of life under the rubble are detected using drones (A) equipped with a bi-spectrum camera. Drones equipped with a bi-spectrum camera (1) detect temperature differences under the rubble and the body temperature of living things and determine the location of survivors. This technological step makes it possible to perform a quick scan,  especially in large areas,  and to identify priority search regions. In the second stage,  a multi-legged robot (B) using an electrode-integrated,  telemedicine system comes into play. These robots are used to measure the health status of disaster victims under the rubble and guide the rescue operation. Acoustic sensors (3) detect sounds in the disaster area and help detect the presence of disaster victims. Through the multi-legged robot integrated with a wired and wireless system (4) and microphone (5),  the disaster victim under the collapse is contacted to obtain information about the health status of the disaster victim and to provide psychological support to the disaster victim under the collapse. Bioacoustic sensors (6) enable the detection of survivors' vital signs and transmit this information to rescue teams. Thanks to the softening intravous needle (7) integrated into multi-legged robots,  medicine is supplied to the disaster victim under the rubble. Multi-legged robots use seismic sensors (8) to detect any collapse or hazard that may occur under the debris in advance. These sensors provide early warnings of areas at risk of collapse,  thus allowing robots to move safely. The thermal camera (9) in multi-legged robots detects the body temperature of the disaster victims under the rubble and allows them to be detected. Thanks to the active vacuum grippers (10) at the leg ends of the multi-legged robots,  the ability to climb in hard-to-reach places under the rubble has been gained. In addition,  with the ability to rotate 360 degrees from the joints of the robots,  multi-legged robots will be able to adapt to all kinds of conditions under the rubble. The Debris Diggers (C) are powered by advanced digger robots that include an Underground Radar System (GPR) (11). These robots detect underground structures,  hazards and map the debris while excavating while carefully scanning the environment to find disaster victims trapped under the rubble. The Underground Radar System (GPR) also prevents further collapse of the debris,  as the robot moves accurately by avoiding dangerous areas. The microprocessor system (12) enables the robots to move safely by providing distance control so that the debris digger does not harm the disaster victim. LoRa transmitters (13) located in the area allow for continuous communication with robots under the rubble. Thanks to LoRa technology,  data is transmitted between robots,  and the most up-to-date location information and environmental data are transmitted to the center. With the integration of artificial intelligence technology,  a detailed simulation of the wreckage will be made by combining GPR,  LoRa transmitter,  thermal cameras to be used in multi-legged robots and location data obtained from drones with bi-spectrum cameras. This simulation is used to locate disaster victims under the rubble,  dangerous areas and possible obstacles. By analyzing this data,  artificial intelligence determines the shortest and most reliable path to reach the disaster victim. At the same time,  a mapping process is carried out to ensure that the correct point is selected so that the debris can be removed. As a result,  these innovative robotic technologies enable rescue operations to be carried out faster,  safer and more efficiently,  while accelerating the life-saving interventions of rescue teams and minimizing dangers.

The Chatbot Robot Mascot Project is a paradigm effort integrating the findings of robotics,  artificial intelligence,  and human-computer interaction in the development of an interactive robot that may converse in natural language with users. The project with the ultimate goal of developing a responsive and autonomous mascot suitable for education,  events,  public spaces,  and customer service environments integrates an advanced Atdriven chathot into· a physical robotic figure. the project is based on NLP technology with which the robot can understand and output human-like dialogue. It uses current machine learning techniques like speech recognition and deep learning for an integration of a chatbot that can process user input and deliver personalized responses in interesting conversations. This robot also contains advanced sensory systems. It accommodates a camera and microphone system in it,  which helps identify facial features or the context of speech and emotion behind facial expression. Thus,  the responses are expected to adjust according to the user's emotional state and context for more natural and empathetic interaction. But that is not all;  multimodal interaction .is also brought whereby the robot incorporates facial expressions and physical gestures along with speech to make the presence more immersive and human-like. Its design features an L-model component so that it can learn over time;  its interactions are thus tailored to each user's preferences and history. Cloud- based analytics along with data processing enhance further its adaptability,  leading to continuous improvement in engagement and quality of interaction. The mascot of the chatbot can be quite flexible,  as it may be used as an educational tool for classes or even be used as a brand ambassador at marketing events or customer support staff in commercial places. This flexibility positions it as a powerful tool for improving user engagement,  brand interaction,  and customer support. The system’s modularity reduces initial costs and supports scalability,  making it accessible to manufacturers of all sizes. Collaborative safety features ensure safe human-robot interactions,  enhancing workplace productivity and safety. This innovative solution addresses key challenges in automotive manufacturing,  offering cost-effectiveness,  flexibility,  and operational efficiency.

Human-AI Interaction in Collaborative Robotics ABSTRACT The goal of the system covered by this invention is to improve human-artificial intelligence interaction in the context of collaborative robotics. This approach will make it feasible for robots to operate seamlessly alongside human operators in shared spaces. The technology incorporates sophisticated artificial intelligence techniques to enable flexible and intuitive human-robot communication. Among the methods that fit this description are computer vision,  machine learning,  and natural language processing (NLP). By using multimodal interaction channels like speech,  gestures,  and visual signals,  the robot can understand human inputs and react to them in real time. As a result,  the robot can interact with people. Furthermore,  it has the ability to adapt its behaviour to the challenges of the job,  environmental conditions,  and human goals. Additionally,  the system has real-time safety mechanisms in place during this time. These procedures guarantee that the robot can autonomously identify and steer clear of any possible risks,  maintaining the safety of the working environment. Additionally,  the robot's AI-driven adaptation and continuous learning capabilities allow it to improve its actions over time. It is able to increase its efficiency and collaborate with others as a result. This innovation aims to provide a more intuitive,  safe,  and user-friendly framework for human-robot collaboration than the one that is currently in place. Applications in a variety of sectors,  including as manufacturing,  logistics,  healthcare,  and personal support,  could be possible using this architecture.

The present invention relates to a tele-operated ground vehicle (TGV) designed for rescue operations in challenging environments. The TGV integrates a sensor system,  including a GNSS and an inertial measurement unit (IMU),  for precise location and orientation tracking. A stereo camera system generates a dense 3D point cloud for mapping and obstacle detection,  while laser range finders (LRFs) capture distance and obstacle data to generate Sectormap and Gridmap for navigation. The TGV’s mapping and navigation system analyzes this data to dynamically guide the vehicle to reach individuals in need of rescue. The system also facilitates real-time human-robot interaction (HRI),  collision avoidance,  and optimized route planning. Additionally,  live video transmission,  bidirectional communication,  and reliable data transfer via COFDM ensure continuous operator control. The TGV is suitable for performing rescue operations in complex and partially obstructed environments.

The Flying Drone Robot Dog represents a pioneering advancement in the field of robotics,  merging the capabilities of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with those of terrestrial robotic systems to address a variety of practical applications,  particularly in disaster management,  search and rescue operations,  surveillance,  and worker safety in hazardous environments. This innovative hybrid design allows for vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) capabilities,  enabling the device to navigate complex environments both in the air and on the ground. Equipped with a lightweight yet robust frame,  the Flying Drone Robot Dog features an advanced propulsion system comprised of four or more rotors that facilitate agile flight,  alongside four mechanically actuated limbs designed to mimic the natural movement of a canine. This unique combination of aerial and ground mobility empowers the robot to traverse uneven terrain,  fly over obstacles,  and efficiently perform task-oriented actions,  making it an invaluable asset in scenarios where human access is limited or dangerous. The Flying Drone Robot Dog is outfitted with an array of integrated sensors and multi-directional cameras that provide real-time monitoring and data collection,  allowing for enhanced situational awareness during critical operations. The onboard artificial intelligence system processes data inputs to autonomously navigate complex environments and respond to real-time commands,  facilitating smooth transitions between flight and ground modes. Additionally,  the robot is equipped with obstacle detection capabilities that adapt its movements based on environmental conditions,  ensuring safe navigation in challenging terrains. The design also includes robotic limbs that feature manipulators,  allowing for object interaction during rescue missions or surveillance tasks. This flexibility enables the Flying Drone Robot Dog to engage in a wide range of activities,  such as delivering supplies,  conducting inspections of collapsed structures,  and identifying survivors in disaster-stricken areas. The versatility of the Flying Drone Robot Dog extends beyond search and rescue missions,  as it can also be utilized for surveillance and monitoring in high-risk environments. By providing real-time data and feedback,  the robot assists in critical decision-making processes while minimizing risks to human operators. Its applications are further broadened by its potential use in infrastructure inspection,  environmental monitoring,  and wildlife conservation,  where it can gather crucial data while minimizing human interference in sensitive habitats. The Flying Drone Robot Dog’s innovative design prioritizes both stability in ground movement and aerodynamic efficiency during flight,  making it an ideal solution for various operational demands. As a pioneering solution in the competitive landscape of robotic technology,  this invention aims to enhance operational efficiency and safety across multiple sectors,  including civilian and military applications. By filing a patent for the Flying Drone Robot Dog,  the goal is to secure intellectual property rights that protect its unique combination of features and functionalities. This move is intended to foster ongoing innovation and development within the robotics field,  ultimately leading to advancements that can significantly improve response capabilities in emergencies and other critical situations. In summary,  the Flying Drone Robot Dog stands as a testament to the potential of combining aerial and terrestrial robotics. Its ability to operate effectively in complex environments,  coupled with its intelligent features and robust functionality,  positions it as a transformative tool for enhancing safety,  efficiency,  and effectiveness in various applications. The promise of this invention lies not only in its immediate capabilities but also in its ability to pave the way for future advancements in robotic technology.

The error corrector may include a correction planner and a facilitator. The correction planner may determine an error correction plan based on the detected error. The error correction plan may include corrective subtasks to control the cobot to correct the detected error. The facilitator may determine a facilitation plan based on the determined error correction plan. The error corrector may generate a control signal to control the cobot based on the correction plan and the facilitation plan.

An embedded real-time human-shaped target automatic monitoring and identifying method,  wherein the method comprises :  step one :  establishing an embedding solution base based on the operation requirement of the platform side,  wherein the embedding solution is used for storing various embedding solutions and the embedding classification set and device list corresponding to each embedding solution; The invention discloses a multi-legged robot gait control and adjustment method based on fuzzy control. First,  IMU data collection is performed to obtain quaternions; then the roll angle and pitch angle of the multi-legged robot are calculated through formulas as input variables; then fuzzify the input variables by determining the fuzzy control rule base Then,  by using fuzzy decision-making logical reasoning and defuzzification,  the fuselage height coefficient Kh,  step distance coefficient KI and leg lift height coefficient Kf are obtained. Through three coefficients,  the body height,  stepping distance and leg lifting height of the multi-legged robot in the motion state are changed in real time,  so as to realize the self-adaptive adjustment of gait of the multi-legged robot according to the environmental information and control the multi-legged robot to move. The method of the present invention sets artificial constraints on the key motion indicators of the hexapod robot without the need for additional sensing equipment other than the IMU. Therefore,  the cost of the robot and the complexity of its hardware components are lower,  which reduces the cost and hardware requirements. 1. A multi-foot robot gait control adjusting method based on fuzzy control,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  IMU data acquisition :  the inertia measuring unit IMU is used for reading the three-axis attitude angle of the multi-foot robot in the moving process in real time,  obtaining the environment information and obtaining the quaternion;  S2 :  input variable determination :  the quaternion is calculated by the formula to obtain the roll angle beta and pitch angle gamma of the multi-foot robot as the input variable of the control system;  S3 :  fuzzy control processing :  fuzzily processing the input variable by determining the fuzzy control rule base;  S4 :  output variable generation :  after fuzzification treatment,  using fuzzy decision logic reasoning and defuzzification,  obtaining the machine body height coefficient Kh,  stride distance coefficient KI and leg lifting height coefficient Kf needed by controlling the multi-foot robot gait;  S5 :  adjusting the movement of the multi-foot robot :  the height of the body of the multi-foot robot,  the stepping distance and the leg lifting height under the motion state are changed in real time through the three coefficients,  so that the multi-foot robot performs the self-adaptive adjustment of the gait according to the environment information and controls the multi-foot robot to move;  The specific method of step S1 is as follows :  Firstly,  in the motion process of the multi-foot robot,  the inertia measuring unit IMU mounted on the body monitors the three-axis attitude angle in real time,  and the quaternion q = [w,  v,  y,  z] is obtained by IMU,  wherein w is the real part,  v,  y,  z is the imaginary part;  The specific method of step S2 is as follows :  the attitude information including the roll angle beta and the pitch angle gamma is calculated by the formula;  these attitude information reflect the attitude change of the robot on the current terrain;  The calculation formula of the pitch angle is as follows :  y = atan2 (2 (wy + vz),  1-2 (y2 + z2)) roll angle calculation formula is as follows :  = atan2 (2 (wz + vy),  1-2 (v2 + y2),  wherein atan2 is an inverse trigonometric function;  taking the attitude information obtained by calculating the quaternion as the input variable,  wherein the roll angle beta reflects the degree of left and right side inclination of the multi-foot robot,  the pitch angle gamma reflects the degree of front and back inclination;  The specific method for determining the fuzzy control rule base is as follows :  The fuzzy rules are designed as follows :  when the beta and gamma are increased,  it shows that the ground is rugged at this time,  the height of the machine body needs to reduce the gravity centre,  at the same time,  the stepping distance is reduced so as to slow down the moving speed,  the height of the lifting leg is increased so as to improve the obstacle-crossing ability,  namely Kh is reduced,  KI is reduced,  Kf is increased;  when only one of beta or gamma is increased or decreased,  it shows that the rugged degree of the ground is stable,  so the gait control parameters of three multi-foot robots are stable;  when beta and gamma are reduced,  it shows that the ground is flat at this time,  so the height of the machine body is raised,  the stepping distance is increased,  the height of the leg is reduced,  namely Kh is increased,  KI is increased and Kf is reduced;  The specific fuzzy control rules are as follows :  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset NB :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  XS/XS/XB,  S/S/B,  MS/MS/MB,  M/M,  MS/MS/MB,  S/B,  XS/XS/SB;  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset NM :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  S/S/B,  MS/MS/MB,  M/M,  MB/MB/MS,  M/M,  MS/MS/MB,  S/S/B;  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset NS :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  MS/MS/MB,  M/M,  MB/MB/MS,  B/B/S,  MB/MB/MS,  M/M,  MS/MS/MB;  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset ZO :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  M/M/M,  MB/MB/MS,  B/B/S,  XB/XB/XS,  B/B/S,  MB/MB/MS,  M/M;  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset PS :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  MS/MS/MB,  M/M,  MB/MB/MS,  B/B/S,  MB/MB/MS,  M/M,  MS/MS/MB;  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset PM :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  S/S/B,  MS/MS/MB,  M/M,  MB/MB/MS,  M/M,  MS/MS/MB,  S/S/B;  When β belongs to the fuzzy subset NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM,  PB,  γ belong to the fuzzy subset PB :  Kh,  KI and Kf are :  XS/XS/XB,  S/S/B,  MS/MS/MB,  M/M,  MS/MS/MB,  S/B,  XS/XS/SB;  wherein NB represents negative large,  NM represents negative middle,  NS represents negative small,  ZO represents zero,  PS represents positive small,  PM represents positive middle,  PB represents positive large;  XS represents very small,  S represents small,  MS represents medium small,  M represents medium big,  MB represents medium big,  B represents big,  XB represents very big;  the Gaussian membership function is selected as the membership function of the fuzzy values of the input variable and the output variable;  Gaussian membership function :  wherein x is the value of the variable;  .sigma. =0.15,  which is a parameter for controlling the smoothness of the Gaussian curve;  c is the central point of the Gaussian function;  in the input membership function,  the value range of c is as follows :  c = [-1,  -0.6667,  -0.3333,  0,  0.3333,  0.6667,  1];  taking c=-1,  substituting the Gaussian membership function to calculate to obtain the fuzzy subset NB;  similarly obtaining the rest six subsets NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM and PB;  in the output Kh membership function,  the value range of c is c = [0.4,  0.5,  0.6,  0.7,  0.8,  0.9,  1];  c = 0.4,  substituting Gaussian membership function to calculate to obtain fuzzy subset XS;  The specific method for fuzzification processing the input variable is as follows :  fuzzily processing the input variable to obtain the fuzzy value of the input variable;  Specifically,  for the input variable,  the basic domain of the roll angle β is [-K1,  K1],  the quantization factor is 1/K1,  so that the fuzzy domain is [-1,  1];  the basic domain of the pitch angle gamma is [-K2,  K2],  the quantization factor is 1/K2,  so that the fuzzy domain is [-1,  1];  when K1 and K2 are adjusted without self-adaptive control,  the attitude angle range in the movement of the multi-foot robot is determined;  the seven fuzzy subsets are NB,  NM,  NS,  ZO,  PS,  PM and PB;  The specific method of step S4 is as follows :  performing fuzzy decision logic reasoning to the output variable according to the determined fuzzy control rule to obtain the fuzzy values of the machine body height coefficient Kh,  the stride distance coefficient KI and the leg lifting height coefficient Kf;  analyzing the working space of the actual robot,  setting the minimum value of the leg lifting height and the minimum value of the machine body height according to the rugged degree,  setting the minimum value of the stepping distance for keeping the continuous motion state,  specifically adjusting the minimum value of three coefficients according to the range allowed by the actual robot,  so as to determine the theoretical range;  the seven fuzzy subsets are respectively XS,  S,  MS,  M,  MB,  B and XB;  accurately calculating the output variable fuzzy value obtained by the fuzzy control base reasoning to obtain the accurate control value;  The principle is to take the gravity centre of the area surrounded by the fuzzy membership degree function curve and the abscissa as the fuzzy reasoning final output value,  that is :  wherein v0 is the final result of defuzzification,  namely the output coefficient value;  m is the number crossed with the membership function when x is equal to vk;  vk is a point in the fuzzy domain of the output membership function;  [mu] v (vk) is the membership function value of the point;  m vk values form the fuzzy domain of the output variable;  defuzzification processing the output variable fuzzy value to obtain the clear machine body height coefficient Kh,  step distance coefficient KI and leg lifting height coefficient Kf;  Step S5 is specifically as follows :  The supporting phase of the multi-foot robot refers to the phase that the leg of the robot contacts the ground in the gait period,  wherein the stable posture is needed to support the quality of the robot;  the swinging phase is the phase of the robot leg far away from the ground in the gait period,  the task is to lift the leg,  move the gravity centre so as to prepare for the next support;  the two phases form the gait of the multi-foot robot,  which ensures the stability and efficiency of the robot in the moving process;  adjusting the gait parameter of the multi-foot robot in real time according to the obtained machine body height coefficient Kh,  stride distance coefficient KI and leg lifting height coefficient Kf;  Specifically :  the machine body height coefficient Kh is used for adjusting the machine body height Z2 of the multi-foot robot;  adjusting the stepping distance Y2 of the multi-foot robot by the stepping distance coefficient KI;  adjusting the leg lifting height Z1 of the multi-foot robot by the leg lifting height coefficient Kf;  According to the above requirements,  the constraint conditions required for the trajectory planning of the multi-foot robot are as follows :  (1) the constraint parameter is an initial position; The invention discloses an eye structure of a bionic service type humanoid robot. Installed on the skull structure,  including sensory system and visual system The sensory system includes a sensing center,  a sensor network,  a signal processing unit and an execution unit The sensor network is connected to the signal processing unit The signal processing unit is connected to the perception center,  the perception center is connected to the execution unit,  and the execution unit is connected to the vision system. The invention uses the perception center,  sensor network,  signal processing unit and execution unit to form a sensory system that can provide timely and effective feedback on changes in the external environment.,  greatly improving the ability to interact with the outside world 1. A bionic service type human-shaped robot eye structure,  installed on the skull structure,  wherein the sensory system comprises a sensing centre,  a sensor network,  a signal processing unit and an executing unit,  the sensor network is connected with the signal processing unit,  the signal processing unit is connected with the sensing centre,  the sensing centre is connected with the executing unit,  the executing unit is connected with the visual system;  the sensor network comprises multiple visual sensors for capturing the visual information of the external environment;  the signal processing unit is used for receiving the original signal from the sensor network,  processing and pre-processing the signal,  and transmitting the processed signal to the sensing centre;  the sensing centre receives the processed signal,  analyzes and decides to obtain the state and needed response of the external environment;  the executing unit receives the trigger instruction of the sensing centre and executes the corresponding action or task;  The visual system receives the control signal sent by the executing unit to do corresponding movement.

The invention discloses a high-flux molecular detection method for mesozoa and/or helminth,  the method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps of :  designing 22 primer probes for detecting targets based on an OpenArray chip,  preparing a positive control plasmid,  extracting DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid) of an environmental sample to be detected,  preparing the added OpenArray chip,  performing real-time fluorescence PCR (polymerase chain reaction) detection,  and determining the types and concentrations of the mesozoa and the helminth contained in the environmental sample to be detected according to the Ct value of the detected species By adopting the method provided by the invention,  22 kinds of water-borne protozoa and worms can be simultaneously subjected to high-flux molecular screening,  and the detection efficiency is remarkably improved; the method provided by the invention can be used for detecting the types and concentrations of mesozoa and helminths contained in the environment,  and the detection result has high accuracy and high credibility Moreover,  the method of the present invention has high repeatability and stability to the detection target,  high detection sensitivity,  and good credibility of the detection results. 1. A high-throughput molecular detection method of water-based protozoal and/or helminthic,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  1) selecting the target gene according to the specific gene of the target species to be detected,  designing primers and probes by Primer;  2) based on the target gene of the target species selected when designing the primer and probe in the step 1),  intercepting the front 20bp of the forward primer of the corresponding target species as the starting position of the target gene prepared by the positive plasmid;  intercepting the back 20bp of the reverse primer as the end position of the target gene prepared by the positive plasmid,  obtaining the target gene prepared by the positive plasmid corresponding to each target species;  Next :  cloning the target gene,  16S rRNA gene and 18S rRNA gene prepared by the positive plasmid corresponding to each target species to the colon bacillus clone carrier to obtain the positive control plasmid;  3) extracting the DNA of the collected environment sample,  obtaining the DNA of the environment sample to be tested for further use;  4) preparing a sample-adding OpenArray chip 4-1) :  according to the format of the gene expression chip,  loading the name of the sample to be detected and the position information of each sample on the 96-hole plate in the downloaded Sample Tracker software;  Next :  then respectively corresponding the name and position information of the sample on the 96-hole plate to the 384-hole plate (OpenArray chip special 384-hole plate) through the Tracker software;  Then :  the sample Tracker software,  each sample to be detected in the 96-hole plate,  384-hole plate sample arrangement mode (namely sample typesetting mode) of the file,  and accurately recording;  4-2) respectively adding the sample to be detected to the corresponding small holes of the 96-hole plate according to the sample adding arrangement mode (sample typesetting mode) led out in the step 4-1);  4-3) adding Real-Time PCR Master Mix (OpenArray reaction pre-mixing liquid) to the special 384-hole plate of the OpenArray chip;  then respectively adding the sample DNA to be detected in the 96-hole plate to the corresponding small holes in the 384-hole plate according to the sample adding arrangement mode led out in the step 4-1);  sealing the film to obtain a sample 384-hole plate;  4-4) placing the sample 384 hole plate prepared in the step 4-3) on the 384 module of the AccuFill instrument,  placing the OpenArray chip on the Plate Holder of the AccuFill instrument,  wherein the bit face of the Open Array chip is upward and placed on the left of the PlateHolder;  starting the AccuFill instrument,  transferring the sample to be detected on the sample adding 384-hole plate to the OpenArray chip to obtain the sample adding OpenArray chip;  5) placing the sampling OpenArray chip prepared in step 4) in an Applied Biosystems QuantStudio 12KFlex System instrument,  performing real-time fluorescence quantitative PCR detection,  The Ct value of the target gene of each species contained in the sample is measured so as to obtain the species and content of the hydroplasmodium and helminth in the environmental sample.

The invention discloses a piston trapezoidal ring groove pitch diameter measuring mechanism and a measuring method thereof The measuring mechanism comprises a detection platform and two opposite measuring mechanisms,  wherein a positioning part for placing a piston to be measured is arranged between the two measuring mechanisms; the measuring mechanism comprises a measuring device; and the measuring device comprises a measuring needle component,  a rotary driving component,  a transverse driving component and a pneumatic inductance sensor The measuring needle assembly includes a measuring needle The rotary drive assembly is connected to the measuring needle assembly,  and the traverse drive assembly is connected to the rotary drive assembly Through the synergistic effect of the traverse drive assembly and the rotation drive assembly,  the measuring needle can accurately contact the middle position of the trapezoidal ring groove of the piston The humanoid measurement action is realized,  so that the consistency of the measurement process is ensured; and meanwhile,  the pneumatic inductance sensor is used for acquiring the pitch diameter value of the piston trapezoidal ring groove,  so that the accuracy of the measurement result is ensured,  the influence of human factors on the measurement result is effectively reduced,  and the reliability and the repeatability of the measurement are improved 1. A piston trapezoidal annular groove medium diameter measuring mechanism,  wherein it comprises a detecting table and two oppositely set measuring mechanisms,  between the two measuring mechanisms is provided with a locating part for placing the piston to be measured,  the measuring mechanism comprises a measuring device,  the measuring device comprises :  a measuring needle assembly,  comprising a measuring needle,  the measuring needle is used for propping against the middle position of the trapezoidal annular groove of the piston to be measured;  a rotation driving subassembly connected with the measuring needle subassembly for driving the measuring needle subassembly to rotate;  a transverse moving driving component connected with the rotary driving component and used for driving the measuring needle component to be transversely close to or far away from the piston to be measured;  a pneumatic inductance sensor for measuring the middle diameter value of the trapezoidal annular groove of the piston to be measured when the measuring needle is propped against the middle part of the trapezoidal annular groove of the piston to be measured.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot motion control method,  system,  equipment and storage medium Methods include :  Based on the target task information and robot positioning and navigation data obtained in real time,  dynamically select one of model predictive control and reinforcement learning reasoning as the effective mode to control the current trajectory of the robot,  and the other control mode executes and tracks the instructions output by the effective mode to achieve undisturbed switching between the two control modes; in the model predictive control,  the kinematics model of the quadruped robot is established and the Kalman filter is combined to estimate the state,  and the instructions of each joint position,  speed and torque are output Reinforcement learning reasoning trains the reasoning model based on the reward function of task and safety and energy efficiency,  and outputs instructions for each joint position. The invention can simultaneously meet the needs of the quadruped robot to adaptively pass through complex terrain and accurately reach the target position. The control mode switching process is automatically completed,  and mutual tracking is achieved without interference. 1. A motion control method of four-foot robot,  wherein the method comprises :  according to the target task information obtained in real time and the robot positioning navigation data,  dynamically selecting one control mode in the model prediction control and the intensified learning reasoning as the effective mode for controlling the current travelling track of the robot,  the other control mode executes the instruction output by tracking the effective mode,  so as to realize the undisturbed switching of two control modes,  finishing the motion control of the four-foot robot;  wherein,  when the model prediction control is selected as the effective mode of the current control,  according to the encoder,  the data collected by the inertia measuring instrument IMU and the robot speed instruction establish the kinematics model of the four-foot robot and combine the Kalman filtering to estimate the state to obtain the instruction for controlling the current joint position,  speed and moment of the four-foot robot;  when the enhanced learning reasoning is selected as the effective mode of the current control,  the encoder,  the data collected by the inertia measuring instrument IMU and the robot speed instruction are input to the reasoning model obtained by the reward function training based on the task and the safety energy efficiency for reasoning to obtain the instruction for controlling the current joint position of the four-foot robot.

This application discloses an inspection robot detection and identification method,  device,  equipment and storage medium,  and relates to the technical field of park inspection. The method comprises the following steps of :  starting a video stream decoding process when an initialization starting signal is detected,  and writing a video frame to be detected,  which is acquired by an inspection robot camera,  into a cache queue; take out the video frame to be detected,  convert the format,  and detect whether there is humanoid data information in the video frame to be detected; if yes,  calculate the first azimuth angle of the humanoid target in the humanoid data information to lock the humanoid target according to the first azimuth angle; perform face recognition detection on the humanoid target,  and push alarm data information to the monitoring background when the humanoid target is judged to be a stranger based on the detection results. By judging whether the video data collected by the park inspection robot during the inspection task contains humanoid data,  and by calculating the azimuth angle,  the camera is aligned with the humanoid target and then the face recognition judgment is re-performed to improve the accuracy of personnel recognition judgment. 1. A detection and identification method of inspection robot,  wherein the detection and identification method of inspection robot comprises :  starting the video stream decoding process when detecting the initialization starting signal,  writing the video frame to be detected collected by the inspection robot camera into the cache queue;  after taking out the video frame to be detected for format conversion,  detecting whether there is human-shaped data information in the video frame to be detected;  if so,  calculating the first azimuth angle of the human shape target in the human shape data information so as to lock the human shape target according to the first azimuth angle;  performing face recognition detection to the human-shaped target,  and pushing the alarm data information to the monitoring background when judging the human-shaped target is stranger according to the detection result.

This application proposes a method,  device and vehicle-mounted terminal for getting off the car behavior recognition. The method includes :  extracting behavior images to be recognized from consecutive frames; and input the behavior image to be recognized into the human-shaped area recognition model trained in advance or in real time,  and extract the human-shaped area in the behavior image to be recognized; calculate whether the target user has preliminary behavior of getting off the car through multiple humanoid areas If it is determined that the target user has preliminary behavior of getting off the car,  combined with the image data outside the vehicle to determine the final getting-off result of the target user,  by combining door status information with image processing,  it can more accurately identify whether passengers have got off the car and whether they have completed the getting off car,  thereby avoiding vehicle start caused by driver misoperation,  improving safety,  and improving user experience. 1. A method for identifying alighting behaviour,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the real-time video stream in the vehicle,  and extracting multiple continuous frame images from the real-time video stream in the vehicle as the action image to be identified;  inputting the to-be-identified behaviour image to the pre-trained or real-time trained humanoid area identification model,  extracting the humanoid area in the to-be-identified behaviour image;  identifying whether the target user has initial getting-off action through the human-shaped area,  and determining the final getting-off result of the target user by combining with the external image data when the target user has initial getting-off action.

A water supply monitoring system in connection with a supply line includes sensors configured to detect supply properties,  including a temperature,  flow rate,  and/or a pressure in the supply line. A controller receives the supply properties from the sensors and compares the supply properties to detection metrics. In response to a comparison of the supply properties relative to the detection metrics,  the controller identifies an anomaly of a fluid supply or a consumption device. In response to the anomaly,  the controller identifies a corrective action that may include a repair or installation of a conditioning device for the fluid supply and/or one of the consumption devices.

A walking support mechanism that helps bipedal walking robots to be able to walk,  squat,  and stand smoothly in various road conditions under weight-bearing conditions. The upper body of the robot is provided with a support mechanism that can be stretched forward or backward,  and the support mechanism can make the landing point of the gravitational action line of the robot when bearing weight be located between the landing point of the support mechanism and the landing point of the foot of the robot. The support mechanism automatically stretches forward or backward according to the load-bearing standing and walking conditions of the robot,  so that the robot can keep the center of gravity stable and not fall over when standing,  walking on flat ground,  climbing and climbing,  going up and down stairs,  squatting or standing up under the condition of load-bearing,  and the movement is stable and smooth. When the robot is not load-bearing and does not need to assist in supporting,  the robot control system controls the support mechanism to fold and retract and store close to the upper body,  so that the robot maintains the shape of the bipedal robot and reduces the occupation of space. 1. The invention relates to a quadruped robot stair detection method based on adaptive granularity tuning,  and belongs to the field of intelligent robots It at least includes :  obtaining environmental data through the camera and laser radar of the robot and preprocessing and granularity layering the environmental data; the adaptive granularity tuning strategy is used to extract features of different granularity,  and the features of different granularity are weighted and fused to obtain fused features; input the fusion features into the multi-task learning framework to estimate multiple key parameters of stairs,  in which the joint loss function and adaptive weighting mechanism are used to allocate the loss weight of each task,  and the gradient-based task correlation analysis method is used to measure the correlation between tasks,  and finally output the stair detection results; then the robot posture and stair parameter feedback model continuously feeds back and corrects the stair detection results. The invention adaptively adjusts the fusion mode of multi-granularity characteristics according to the environment and task requirements,  and corrects the detection results according to feedback,  which can adapt to complex stair detection environments. 1. A four-foot robot stair detection method based on adaptive granularity tuning,  wherein It at least comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining the environment data through the camera and the laser radar of the robot and pre-processing the environment data,  and then layering the granularity of the pre-processed environment data;  S2,  processing the characteristics with different granularities extracted from the image of the environment data and the three-dimensional point cloud by using the adaptive granularity tuning strategy,  weighting and fusing the characteristics with different granularities to obtain the fused characteristics;  S3,  inputting the fusion characteristic into a multi-task learning frame to estimate multiple key parameters of the stair,  wherein the loss weight of each task is distributed by a combined loss function and a self-adaptive weighting mechanism,  the correlation between the tasks is measured based on the gradient task correlation analysis method,  and the stair detection result is finally output;  S4,  according to the stair detection result,  planning the movement of the four-foot robot,  and analyzing the stair parameter corresponding to the current posture through the robot posture and stair parameter feedback model,  continuously feeding back the corrected stair detection result.

The present invention regards a reflex algorithm for a legged robot upon detecting an unexpected contact in order to reach a desired touchdown location using a leg stub re-swing. The proprioceptive leg-stub re-swing algorithm is a two-phase algorithm that is particularly beneficial in environments with unstructured terrain and wherein vision sensors may be damaged upon contact with protruding obstacles. The present invention pertains to a leg stub re-swing reflex algorithm for a robot,  such as a biped,  quadruped,  or other legged robot. A legged robot comprises of a robotic system with one or more appendages used for locomotion. Legged robots locomote through their environments by exerting reaction forces on the environment using forces generated by the leg wherein the leg is somehow in contact with environmental matter.

Abstract :  The integration of humanoid robots in healthcare represents a transformative innovation poised to augment patient well-being and redefine care delivery. This project investigates the multifaceted roles of humanoid robots,  focusing on their potential to enhance physical,  emotional,  and cognitive health outcomes across diverse patient populations. By leveraging advanced artificial intelligence (AI),  natural language processing (NLP),  and adaptive behavior modeling,  humanoid robots are emerging as companions,  caregivers,  and facilitators in both clinical and home settings. Key applications explored in this study include their use as interactive companions for elderly patients and individuals with chronic conditions,  rehabilitation aides for motor recovery,  and cognitive enhancers for dementia care. These robots also serve as stress-relief agents,  fostering emotional stability in long-term care scenarios,  and as educators,  providing patients with critical healthcare information in an engaging manner. Beyond patient interaction,  humanoid robots are alleviating the workload of healthcare professionals by automating repetitive tasks,  thus improving system efficiency and care quality. The benefits of humanoid robots extend beyond their functional contributions,  offering 24/7 availability,  personalized care through data-driven insights,  and consistent support unaffected by human limitations. However,  the adoption of such technology faces challenges,  including ethical considerations regarding privacy,  human interaction dynamics,  high implementation costs,  and varying cultural acceptance. This project delves into these dimensions,  proposing solutions to address barriers and foster seamless integration. By examining case studies,  technological advancements,  and patient outcomes,  this project aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the transformative potential of humanoid robots in healthcare. It also outlines future directions,  emphasizing the importance of collaborative research,  regulatory frameworks,  and public engagement to ensure that humanoid robots contribute meaningfully to a patient-centered care ecosystem. This research underscores the critical need for a balanced approach to innovation that harmonizes technology with human touch,  ensuring robots serve as a complement,  not a replacement,  to traditional caregiving.

The integration of robotics and machine learning (ML) into the construction and structural assembly industries promises to revolutionize traditional methods by introducing adaptive,  precise,  and scalable solutions. This paper presents the design,  development,  and evaluation of a Smart Robotic Arm (SRA) equipped with machine learning capabilities aimed at enhancing construction and structural assembly tasks. The proposed SRA leverages advanced sensor systems,  real-time data processing,  and adaptive control algorithms to perform complex,  dynamic tasks such as material handling,  welding,  and assembly with minimal human intervention. The key innovation lies in the application of machine learning algorithms that enable the robotic arm to learn and adapt to changing environmental conditions and task specifications. Through continuous feedback from sensors,  the arm can optimize its movements and adjust its behavior based on real-time inputs,  allowing it to handle variations in materials,  geometry,  and unforeseen obstacles. Additionally,  deep learning techniques,  such as reinforcement learning,  are employed to allow the robotic system to improve its efficiency over time by learning from past experiences. In the context of construction,  the SRA can be employed for tasks like prefabrication,  on-site assembly,  and even autonomous construction of modular structures. This adaptability enhances precision,  reduces waste,  and accelerates construction timelines,  ultimately leading to more sustainable practices. The robotic system’s ability to integrate with existing digital design tools (such as Building Information Modeling,  BIM) further improves its functionality,  ensuring seamless collaboration between design,  engineering,  and construction teams. This paper outlines the system architecture,  the ML algorithms used for task adaptation,  and the evaluation of the SRA in both controlled and real-world construction environments. Results show significant improvements in task accuracy,  speed,  and flexibility,  demonstrating the potential of machine learning-enabled robotic systems to transform the future of construction and structural assembly tasks.

The present invention relates to a movement-dependent stabilisation support system (100) for stabilising a moving body (200),  which comprises a plurality of sensors (110),  a plurality of actuators (120) and a control unit (130). The plurality of sensors (110) continuously detects movement parameters of the body (200),  on which basis the control unit (130) determines whether there is an instability of the body (200). If it is determined that there is an instability,  the control unit (130) selects a stabilisation strategy,  according to which the actuators (120) are controlled. When controlled,  the actuators (120) attached to the body (200) stiffen and limit the freedom of movement of the body (200),  such that a movement in the direction of the imminent unstable state is prevented or suppressed. In this way,  the body (200) is supported in its stabilisation and an imminent fall is prevented.

 each target area is corresponding to a target temperature data and a target smoke concentration data;  according to the n target temperature data and the n target smoke concentration data,  determining the rescue priority corresponding to each target area in the n target areas,  obtaining n target rescue priority; Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a wearable device,  a control method and a control device for a humanoid robot. The wearable device includes a covering and a pressure sensing module The covering may cover at least a portion of the body of the humanoid robot The pressure sensing module is arranged on the surface of the covering The pressure sensing module can be used when the humanoid robot wears a wearable device Collect multiple real-time pressure values in different areas of the body surface of the humanoid robot and transmit the multiple real-time pressure values to the humanoid robot,  so that the humanoid robot determines whether a collision is currently occurring based on the multiple real-time pressure values,  and stops moving when it is determined that a collision is currently occurring. In this way,  the humanoid robot can stop moving immediately when it collides,  thereby avoiding harm to people and improving the safety of the humanoid robot. 1. A wearing device of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  a cover for covering at least a part of the body of the human-shaped robot;  a pressure sensing module arranged on the surface of the covering;  the pressure sensing module is used for when the humanoid robot wears the wearing device,  collecting a plurality of real-time pressure values of different areas on the body surface of the humanoid robot,  and transmitting the plurality of real-time pressure values to the humanoid robot,  so that the humanoid robot determines whether there is a collision currently according to a plurality of the real-time pressure values,  and stops moving under the condition of determining that there is a collision currently.

This patent proposes a quadruped robot obstacle avoidance path planning method and system based on ESDF ‑ Free,  including :  Step 1. Generate a collision-Free path without considering obstacles based on control points and B-splines,  and determine the path on each path. Whether the control point is affected by the collision object,  if not,  go directly to step 3,  otherwise go to step 2; step 2 :  Add obstacle information and distance field,  use the A * algorithm to generate a collision-free path,  and optimize the collision-free path based on gradient; step 3 :  Determine whether the collision-free path is feasible. If it is feasible,  use this path as the final planned path. If it is not feasible,  optimize the collision path obtained in step 2 based on the time span path. This application introduces collision avoidance force estimation,  which reduces the complexity of the quadruped robot system and reduces the calculation and storage burden by simplifying the data requirements. 1. A four-legged robot obstacle avoidance path planning method based on ESDF-Free,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1,  based on the control point and the B spline curve,  generating the non-collision path without considering the obstacle,  judging whether the control point on each section of path is affected by the collision object,  if not,  directly entering step 3,  otherwise,  executing step 2;  step 2,  adding obstacle information and distance field,  adopting A* algorithm to generate non-collision path,  and based on gradient to non-collision path optimization;  step 3,  judging whether the collision-free path is feasible,  if so,  taking the path as the final planning path,  if not,  optimizing the collision path obtained in the step 2 based on the time span path.

The present invention relates to a drone having a battery charging device for transportation. According to the present invention,  the drone includes wings configured to generate lift according to Bernoulli's,  and to have solar panels attached on upper surface of the wings. The wings with the attached solar panels are configured to be foldable,  wherein the folding mechanism may be implemented such that each segment of the sing is connected by hinges to allow sequential unfolding form the root portion of the wing and folding back toward the root portion. A servo motor,  disposed on one side of the wing and serving as a driving means,  unfolds the wings having the solar panels on their upper surfaces when operated in a forward direction,  and folds the unfolded wings when rotated in the reverse direction. Electric power for driving the rotation motor integrated with the servo motor and a propeller is supplied by a secondary battery that is charged with electric energy generated by the solar panels. Thus,  the drone utilizes the solar-charged secondary battery as its power source.
