The present invention belongs to the field of foot-ground action mechanics technology The invention discloses a method for constructing a foot-to-ground contact model of a foot-type robot applied to muddy terrain It can improve the stability of the movement of the legged robot in mud terrain. The specific method is :  first,  according to the viscoplastic,  viscoelastic,  elastic and plastic deformation characteristics of the mud,  Burgers model,  nonlinear viscoplastic model and nonlinear spring model are connected in series to obtain discrete element models describing these deformation characteristics. Then,  based on the Moore-Coulomb theory in soil mechanics,  the influence of changes in soil bulk density,  water content and clay content on soil cohesion is considered from the perspective of soil mechanics,  and the relationship between these three and the viscosity coefficient in the mud discrete element model is proposed and established. Finally,  according to the magnitude and changing trend of the normal force and tangential force at the foot end,  the foot-to-ground contact process is divided into three stages :  foot drop,  foot lift and foot disengagement,  and the transition process from foot drop to foot lift is set as an independent stage Among them,  the two stages of foot drop and foot lift are further subdivided into two stages of elastic deformation and plastic deformation according to the deformation form of mud. The models describing the corresponding characteristics in the mud-ground discrete element model were applied at different stages to construct the foot-ground contact model. The invention can improve the modeling accuracy of the foot-to-ground contact model of the muddy terrain,  so that the foot-type robot has higher adaptability under the muddy terrain 1. A foot-and-ground contact model construction method for foot-and-ground contact model of foot-and-ground robot,  wherein the method comprises :  establishing a discrete element model for describing the terrain characteristic of the mud land,  establishing a relational expression between the soil volume weight,  the water content and the clay content of the mud land and the viscous coefficient in the non-linear viscous plastic model,  and establishing a foot-land contact model in a preset classification foot-land contact stage rule.

The invention provides a method for generating a smooth curve of a centroid of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the acceleration of the humanoid robot which changes along with time in the walking process; obtaining first position data of the humanoid robot by integral calculation according to the acceleration; discretize the first position data to obtain second position data corresponding to multiple equally spaced time points; define basic spline basis functions and obtain high-order basic spline basis functions through recursive calculation; fitting the high-order basic spline basis function with the second position data to obtain a basic spline function curve; according to the curve derivative of the basic spline function curve,  the second spline coefficient is obtained,  and the second spline coefficient is substituted into the basic spline curve to obtain the final centroid trajectory,  which ensures that the centroid trajectory of the humanoid robot is smooth and continuous during walking,  reduces the robot's ability to move on both feet. The impact force during the switching process improves the stability and reliability of the movement 1. A method for generating centroid smooth curve of humanoid robot,  wherein the generating method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the acceleration of the humanoid robot changing along with the time in the walking process;  according to the acceleration through integral calculation,  obtaining the first position data of the humanoid robot;  performing discretization processing on the first position data to obtain second position data corresponding to multiple time points at equal intervals;  defining the basic spline base function,  obtaining the high-order basic spline base function by recursion calculation;  fitting the high-order basic spline base function with the second position data to obtain a basic spline function curve;  according to the curve derivative of the basic spline function curve,  obtaining a second spline coefficient,  substituting the second spline coefficient into the basic spline curve,  obtaining the centroid track of the humanoid robot in the walking process.

The invention discloses a gait control method for a humanoid robot,  and relates to the technical field of adaptive control of robots. The gait control method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the lifting height of a front foot; control the rotation of each joint of the rear leg so that the rear foot is located directly below the center of gravity of the humanoid robot; after the forefoot is in contact with the object,  the pressure distribution of the forefoot is collected; judging whether the state of the forefoot is stable,  if not,  collecting the rotation angle of the forefoot; if the rotation angle is less than the angle threshold,  convert the front leg and the rear leg,  otherwise lift the front foot,  adjust the angle of each joint of the front leg to change the object contacted by the front foot,  and re-collect the pressure distribution of the front foot. This application uses inward rotation of the rear legs and reverse bending of the knee joints The walking stability is improved,  and the forefoot can feel the pressure distribution of the contact surface. When the environmental information detected by the sensing unit is not very accurate,  the adaptability of the gait to the environment is improved through the pressure sensing of the forefoot,  further improving the walking stability of the humanoid robot. 1. The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control,  and discloses a single-motor fault-tolerant control method of a quadruped robot based on reinforcement learning This invention introduces reinforcement learning into the unknown single-leg motor fault situation of the quadruped robot By cleverly integrating the teacher-student network,  reliability rewards,  and course learning mechanisms,  so that the robot can,  without any fault prior,  it can also quickly adapt to joint failure conditions Active avoidance of possible fall risks,  flexible adjustment of gait to maintain stable and reliable movement,  showing environmental adaptability,  reliability and deployment convenience far superior to traditional active fault-tolerant control and adaptive fault-tolerant control,  which can provide key technical support for quadruped robots to operate in unstructured environments for long-term autonomous operation. 1. A four-foot robot single-motor fault-tolerant control method based on intensive learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  off-line training :  S1 :  building a four-foot robot model in the simulation environment,  and setting multiple terrain environments with different types and difficulties;  designing a four-foot robot single-motor fault simulation mechanism,  based on the single motor corresponding to each motion degree of freedom of the leg part of the four-foot robot,  randomly setting the output moment of the single motor to be zero,  training in the simulation environment,  simulating the fault working condition that the single motor is completely disabled in the training bout;  S2 :  based on the fault working condition of the complete failure of the simulated single motor,  designing an enhanced learning algorithm,  constructing a teacher-student network frame,  wherein the teacher-student network frame comprises a teacher network and a student network;  the input of the teacher network comprises the privilege information representing the motor fault,  the sensing information of the four-foot robot main body and the expected speed command;  the input of the student network is the history sequence of the sensing information of the four-foot robot main body and the expected speed command;  the output of the teacher network and the student network are the position control instruction of the four-foot robot joint;  S3 :  training the teacher network by an enhanced learning algorithm;  introducing a reliability reward mechanism in the enhanced learning algorithm and designing a reward function :  the reliability reward mechanism is set as follows :  the leg foot end hanging height corresponding to the fault motor is not lower than the preset height;  designing a course learning mechanism,  enabling the four-foot robot to interact with different types and difficult terrains by large-scale parallel sampling,  for improving the ground passing property of the four-foot robot;  based on the reliability reward mechanism and the course learning mechanism,  obtaining the fault-tolerant control strategy of the teacher network through the enhanced learning algorithm;  S4 :  training the four-foot robot,  adopting the monitoring learning training student network to approach the fault-tolerant control strategy of the teacher network,  the trained student network is fault-tolerant control network,  the fault-tolerant control network is used for moving to the entity four-foot robot,  so as to control the movement of the entity four-foot robot;  online control :  collecting the history sequence and expected speed command of the main body sensing information of the main body four-foot robot,  inputting into the fault-tolerant control network,  so as to output the position control instruction of the four-foot robot joint,  realizing fault-tolerant control of single motor of the four-foot robot.

At the same time,  it also uses neural networks to predict and warn the user's health status in advance in different environments,  which is beneficial to the user's environment caused by travel or other situations. When changes occur,  you can prepare in advance to deal with abnormal health conditions. 1. A health management method based on AI digital human,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  according to the human shape data of the user,  modelling to generate the 3d twin body of the user,  and leading to the digital twin platform as the AI digital person of the user,  wherein the user transmits the medical record data and the real-time physical sign data to the AI digital person;  the digital twin platform obtains the environment information of the user location,  and the environment information of the user trip location,  using the medical record data through the neural network,  moving the real-time sign data of the AI digital person from the environment information of the location to the environment information of the trip location,  obtaining the travel physical sign data of AI digital person;  the digital twin platform visually displays the travel physical sign data at the corresponding body position of the AI digital person,  and pre-warns the travel abnormal physical sign to the user;  The construction method of the AI digital person of the user comprises :  step S1,  using the 3D modelling software to perform modelling according to the human shape data,  creating a 3d human shape model;  step S2,  using the image processing software to perform texture and mapping addition on the 3d humanoid model;  step S3,  using the bone insert to perform bone binding on the 3d human body model;  step S4,  using animation making software to make expression and action of 3d human body model;  orderly executing step S1 to step S4 to obtain 3d twin body of the user;  building a digital twin platform for the rendering engine,  and rendering the 3d twin body through the digital twin platform to obtain the AI digital person of the user;  The method for generating the travel feature data of the AI digital person comprises :  the environment information of the user location,  the environment information of the user trip location,  the environment information of the digital person location and the environment information of the trip location;  taking the real-time physical sign data and medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the location of the AI digital person as the input item of the first neural network,  taking the travel place physical sign data and medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the travel place of the AI digital person as the output item of the first neural network,  so that the first neural network is constructed as a conversion network for converting the AI digital person from the local environment to the trip environment;  using the physical sign data and medical record data of the trip place under the environmental information constraint of the trip place of the AI digital person as the input item of the second neural network,  using the real-time physical sign data and medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the location of the AI digital person as the output item of the second neural network,  so that the second neural network is constructed as a conversion network for converting the AI digital person from the trip environment to the local environment;  constructing a loss function for training the first neural network and the second neural network,  and training the first neural network and the second neural network based on the loss function,  obtaining an environment conversion model of sign data;  The environment conversion model is :  [(F + A) out,  (F + B2) out] = N_net1 [(D + A),  (D + B1)];  [(D + A) out,  (D + B1) out] = N_net2 [(F + A),  (F + B2)];  in the formula,  (F + A) out is the medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the trip place output by the first neural network,  (F + B2) out is the trip place sign data under the environmental information constraint of the trip place output by the first neural network,  (D + A) is the medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the location,  (D + B1) is the real-time physical sign data under the environmental information constraint of the location,  (D + A) out is the medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the location output by the second neural network,  (D + B1) out is the real-time sign data under the environmental information constraint of the location output by the second neural network,  (F + A) is the medical record data under the environmental information constraint of the trip place,  (F + B2) is the trip place sign data under the environmental information constraint of the trip place;  training the loss function of the first neural network and the second neural network as :  L=Lx + Ly + Lz;  Wherein,  Lx = | [(F + A) out-F]-[(D + A) out-D] | | 1;  Ly=| N-net2 ([(F + A) out,  (F + B2) out])-[(D + A),  (D + B1)] | | 1;  Lz=| | N_net1 ((D + A) out,  (D + B1) out)-[(F + A),  (F + B2)] | | 1;  in the formula,  L is a loss function,  Lx is a function of medical record data conversion loss in the environment conversion process of quantifying the first neural network and the second neural network,  Ly is a function of sign data conversion loss in the environment conversion process of quantifying the first neural network,  Lz is the function of the sign data conversion loss in the environment conversion process of the quantified second neural network,  F is the environment information of the trip place,  D is the environment information of the location,  and Lx,  Ly and Lz are L1 norm.

The invention is suitable for the field of cable safety monitoring,  and provides a cable tunnel status monitoring method and system. The method includes :  regularly collecting several tunnel target monitoring images; obtain several tunnel target monitoring images and generate profile analysis images; based on the profile analysis image,  smoke warning information is generated and the first push information is sent; based on the profile analysis image,  generating intrusion warning information and sending the second push information; timing acquisition of tunnel sensing index information; calculate tunnel sensing preparation information and generate environmental index discrimination instructions; identify instructions based on environmental indicators,  send the third push message,  the method and system can analyze and monitor tunnel smoke and invading personnel in time It prevents cable burning or unrelated personnel from entering to steal,  and at the same time can synchronously monitor the internal environment of the tunnel,  further improving the stability of cables inside the tunnel,  expanding the types of monitoring collection and feedback samples,  and improving the effectiveness of cable tunnel monitoring. 1. A cable tunnel state monitoring method,  wherein the method comprises :  collecting multiple tunnel target point monitoring images at fixed time;  obtaining a plurality of tunnel target monitoring images,  generating a profile analysis image;  based on the profile analysis image,  generating smoke sensing pre-warning information and sending the first pushing information;  based on the profile analysis image,  generating the intrusion pre-warning information and sending the second push information;  periodically collecting the tunnel sensing index information;  calculating the tunnel sensing index information and generating an environment index judging instruction;  based on the environment index judging instruction,  sending the third pushing information.

A system for use in consolidating items into orders and delivering items to a workstation is described herein. The system includes a plurality of workstations,  each workstation including an assembling area for assembling orders,  an assembly line system configured to deliver items to the plurality of workstations,  and a computing system to execute the steps of :  receiving an order notification indicating an order,  identifying items included in the order,  assigning a corresponding workstation to the order,  and operating the assembly line system to deliver the identified items included in the order to the corresponding workstation.

Disclosed is a method for controlling a quadruped robot,  which is able to avoid determining the walking stability on the basis of a static stability allowance or a dynamic stability allowance,  which have limitations in accordance with the walking methods,  and enable the more intuitive and comprehensive determination of the walking stability. The method for controlling a quadruped robot comprises :  a step of detecting the current status of the quadruped robot;  a step of generating an elliptical trajectory around the tip of the feet of the quadruped robot;  a step of modifying the center of the elliptical trajectory;  and a step of calculating the force (F),  position (X),  speed,  angle,  and angular velocity of the tip of the feet of the quadruped robot by the inverse kinematics.

The invention provides a state detection and standing planning method for a humanoid robot after it falls After the robot falls,  calculate the position and direction of each connecting rod from the direction of the robot and the motor angle value corresponding to the joint At the same time,  the motion capture suit obtains the position and direction of each link Compare the position and direction of each connecting rod respectively When the absolute value of the difference between the two is less than or equal to the set threshold,  the structure of the robot body is all normal. Detecting the external environment of the robot to judge whether the robot can stand; if the robot has the ability to stand,  calculating the distance between the real-time state value and the reference value corresponding to the state that the robot must experience in the standing process by using the Mahalanobis distance calculation method; and controlling the corresponding joint of the robot to reach the state corresponding to the minimum distance The invention solves the problems of state detection and standing planning of the robot in a complex environment,  and improves the adaptability of the robot 1. A state detection and standing planning method of humanoid robot after falling,  wherein when the robot falls down,  the industrial computer calculates the position and direction of each connecting rod according to the direction of the robot and the motor angle value corresponding to the joint,  and the position and direction are recorded as S1;  at the same time,  the action capturing clothes obtains the position and direction of each connecting rod,  recorded as S2,  and transmitted to the industrial computer;  if the absolute value of S1-S2 is less than or equal to E,  the structure of the robot main body is normal,  the external environment where the robot is located is detected,  and the robot is planned to stand;  if the absolute value of S1 to S2 is greater than E,  the robot main body is abnormal,  and the robot main body needs to be repaired immediately;  wherein E is a set threshold;  planning the robot standing,  specifically :  calculating the distance between the real-time state value of the robot and the reference value corresponding to the state must be experienced in the standing process,  and controlling the state corresponding to the minimum value of the joint arrival distance corresponding to the robot;  when controlling the corresponding joint of the robot to reach the state corresponding to the minimum distance value,  detecting the angle value of the joint motor,  the position and direction of the connecting rod,  the data collected by the inertia measuring unit,  the data collected by the force sensor,  whether the value of the key collision point is the set reference value,  if so,  continuing the next state transition,  otherwise,  repeating the state detection,  searching for the optimal state,  and controlling the corresponding joint to reach the optimal state.

The invention provides a rapid fire extinguishing method based on a humanoid robot and a related device.  the larger the fire degree is,  the faster the moving speed is;  determining a first adjusting parameter according to the target terrain complexity;  adjusting the first moving speed according to the first adjusting parameter to obtain a second moving speed; The invention provides a path planning method of an underwater multi-legged robot for a walking wall surface,  and belongs to the technical field of modular unit scheduling methods The specific content is a grilled environment map,  marking reachable grid nodes,  then creating an evaluation function that takes into account the influence of path length and ocean current energy consumption,  determining the current node based on the evaluation function value,  and selecting the reachable grid nodes around the current node to form a continuous path until reaching the end point. The effective path planned by this scheme fully considers the energy consumption impact caused by ocean currents,  and takes into account factors such as ocean current size,  safe distance from obstacles and walking walls. The effective path can effectively select the walking wall mesh as the grid node on the path,  and use this wall to resist the influence of ocean currents to improve the cross-flow resistance; choose to avoid in the area with high ocean current speed,  and keep a certain safe distance around general obstacles. 1. A path planning method of underwater multi-foot robot for walking wall surface,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  the environment map travelled by the underwater multi-foot robot is grilled to obtain the grilled map with grilled nodes;  S2 :  marking each reachable grid node and barrier,  updating grid map information;  S3 :  according to the grid map,  the starting point and the end point,  planning the effective path keeping the safe distance with the barrier;  adding the starting point into the open set,  checking whether the grid node in the current open set can reach the end point,  if so,  reversely pushing the effective path from the end point to the starting point;  if the destination cannot be reached,  executing the step S4;  S4 :  constructing an evaluation function;  obtaining the grid node with the minimum value of the evaluation function in the open set as the current node,  adding the current node to the closed set;  S5 :  traversing the non-obstacle adjacent node around the present node,  if some adjacent node belongs to the closed set,  giving up the adjacent node;  if a certain adjacent node does not belong to the closed set,  executing the step S6;  S6 :  checking whether the sea flow speed at the adjacent node is in accordance with the requirement,  if so,  executing step S7;  if the sea flow speed does not satisfy the requirement,  giving up the adjacent node,  and re-executing the step S5 to select the adjacent node;  S7 :  checking whether there is an obstacle in the given distance range of the adjacent node,  if there is an obstacle in the given distance range,  considering that the adjacent node does not keep a safe distance from the obstacle,  and giving up the adjacent node;  if there is no obstacle in the given distance range,  considering that the adjacent node keeps a safe distance from the obstacle,  keeping the adjacent node and executing step S8;  S8 :  checking whether the adjacent node is in the open set;  if the adjacent node does not belong to the open set,  the cost value and the evaluation function are updated and then the open set is put in;  if the adjacent node belongs to the open set,  updating the cost value and comparing with the original cost value,  keeping the smaller cost value,  adjusting and updating the father node of the adjacent node,  and placing the father node in the open set;  S9 :  returning to execute step S3 to circulate until the effective path reaching the end point is obtained.

Participation,  improve detection efficiency,  and improve the accuracy and traceability of detection results 1. An anti-seepage layer autonomous leakage detection method based on four-foot robot,  wherein the four-foot robot comprises a first path of diagonal foot end and a second path of diagonal foot end,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  receiving the inspection control instruction,  and analyzing the inspection control instruction to obtain the reference origin of the area to be detected,  a current cost map and a current routing inspection direction,  and obtaining a current routing inspection path and a current routing inspection speed according to the current cost map,  and performing routing inspection on the area to be detected based on the current routing inspection path and the current routing inspection speed;  according to the reference origin,  determining the coordinate position of each time,  and based on the current inspection direction,  collecting the first potential difference of the first path diagonal foot end of each time,  and the second potential difference of the second path diagonal foot end of each time;  determining the leakage point position according to the reference origin,  the first potential difference and the second potential difference.

Main content :  Establish the dynamic model of the quadruped robot according to the parameters of the physical prototype,  and establish the drive-energy consumption model based on the LuGre friction model; for each design parameter instance,  reinforcement learning was used to observe the rollover angle,  roll angle and pitch angle and posture of the quadruped robot body,  the error of the landing time,  position and expected time and position of the foot end,  and the torque output by each leg,  a total of 21 states were observed. A four-foot robot energy efficiency optimization method based on series elastic driver,  comprising the following steps :  step 1 :  setting the elastic element design parameter set of the series elastic driver :  D,  comprising joint rigidity k,  parameters a,  b and c of Archimedes spiral line,  determining rigidity range according to the output moment of the motor,  and taking the size of the motor as the constraint condition of the Archimedes spiral line;  step 2 :  establishing the dynamic model of the four-foot robot according to the parameter of the physical sample machine,  at the same time,  establishing the driving-energy consumption model based on LuGre friction model;  through the machine body track tracking,  joint moment tracking and foot end contact force tracking,  constructing the constraint and performance index controlled by the four-foot robot,  through setting the weight parameter in the motion planning controller based on MPC,  using the secondary planning to solve and optimize;  step 3 :  aiming at each design parameter example,  the design parameter and the weight parameter are jointly optimized by the strengthening learning,  the robot is encouraged to move forwards with the minimum energy consumption by the reward function,  and the action of hastily and inefficiently is punished;  by learning the basic strategy Pi,  taking the current state xt and the last action at-1 and R7 as the input to predict the next action at,  at is all optimized parameter set;  step 4 :  applying the parameter obtained after the reinforcement learning optimization to the controller,  inputting the expected gait and speed to the gait phase controller,  calculating the expected foot end touchdown time sequence table,  then the time sequence table,  the weight parameter,  the expected gait and speed are used as the input of MPC optimization,  the state information fed back by the secondary planning and the robot is used for solving the contact force of the foot end so as to solve the joint moment; A control method of smart hand control system of humanoid robot based on raspberry school,  wherein the control system framework based on the bramble building humanoid robot smart hand comprises a collecting layer (1),  a transmission layer (2),  a control layer (3),  an execution layer (4) and a physical layer (5);  The control method comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  the collecting layer (1) collects human arm myoelectric information,  and the human arm myoelectric information after data processing is transmitted to the transmission layer (2);  step 2 :  the transmission layer (2) receives the human arm myoelectricity information transmitted by the collecting layer (1),  and transmits the human arm myoelectricity information to the control layer (3) after data processing;  step 3 :  the control layer (3) receives the human arm myoelectricity information transmitted by the transmission layer (2),  analyzes the human arm myoelectricity information and selects the matched action model,  the control layer (3) transmits the action model to the execution layer (4);  the myoelectricity data analysis module (32) receives the feedback information output by the execution layer (4) through the data feedback analysis module (33) at the same time,  the myoelectricity data analysis module (32) combines the human body arm myoelectricity information and feedback information for high-order filtering and data screening,  obtaining the human body arm myoelectricity data;  the feedback information comprises the information whether the actions of the thumb,  the forefinger,  the middle finger,  the ring finger and the little finger are finished;  step 4 :  the execution layer (4) receives the action model transmitted by the control layer (3),  and outputs the action result corresponding to the action model to the physical layer (5),  at the same time,  outputs the data feedback information to the control layer (3);  step 5 :  the physical layer (5) receives the action result transmitted by the execution layer (4),  the physical layer (5) decomposes the action result and executes the action result,  at the same time,  the palm physical data is fed back to the execution layer (4); The invention relates to the technical field of face recognition,  and discloses a video stream face recognition reasoning acceleration method. The video stream face recognition reasoning acceleration method comprises the following steps :  S1,  acquiring video streams at different positions of a playground through a plurality of cameras of the playground; s2 :  decoding the captured video stream into a sequence of frames; s3 :  pre-process the frame sequence to make the data size of each frame the same,  and then perform humanoid intelligent frame skipping detection on the pre-processed frame sequence to obtain detection information and obtain the human trajectory based on the detection information; s4 :  Then perform face detection based on the detection information and crop the face; s5 :  Extract feature vectors from the cropped faces,  and apply a clustering algorithm combined with human body trajectory information to obtain face grouping pictures; s6 :  Group the generated face pictures and compare them with the face database for face identity recognition,  and finally obtain a more accurate play trajectory for tourists. It can optimize the layout of playground facilities in a timely manner based on the play trajectory and improve tourist satisfaction. 1. A video stream face recognition reasoning acceleration method,  wherein the acceleration method comprises the following steps :  S1 :  the video streams at different positions of the playground are collected by multiple cameras of the playground;  S2 :  decoding the captured video stream into a frame sequence;  S3 :  pre-processing the data of the frame sequence to make the data size of each frame be the same,  then performing human-shaped intelligent frame-hopping detection to the pre-processed frame sequence,  obtaining the detection information,  and obtaining the human track according to the detection information;  S4 :  then detecting the human face on the basis of the detection information,  reasoning and obtaining the position information of the human face in the video,  and cutting the human face;  S5 :  extracting the feature vector of the cut human face,  and combining the human body track information by the clustering algorithm to obtain the human face grouping picture;  S6 :  the generated face group picture is compared with the face database for face identity identification to finally obtain the playing track corresponding to the tourist.

The invention provides a quadruped robot motion control method based on reinforcement learning and position increment,  which relates to the field of quadruped robot control and obtains motion environment information,  quadruped robot posture information and plantar position information; based on the obtained information,  the plantar position in each preset time step when the quadruped robot moves is generated,  and the change amount of the plantar position in each time step is calculated; taking the maximum moving distance in a single time step as a constraint,  and accumulating time steps at the same time,  the plantar position trajectory is obtained; control the quadruped robot to execute corresponding actions based on the plantar position trajectory combined with the preset reward function to keep the quadruped robot in motion balance; aiming at the problem of motor damage caused by the large mutation of the motor position generated in the current quadruped robot motion control method,  by constraining the change of the plantar position of the quadruped robot in each time step,  the mutation of the control command is avoided,  and the ability of the quadruped robot to pass through complex terrain is enhanced. 1. A four-foot robot motion control method based on intensive learning and position increment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining movement environment information,  four-foot robot posture information and sole position information;  based on the obtained information,  generating the sole position in each preset time step length when the four-foot robot moves,  calculating the variation of the sole position in each time step length;  taking the maximum moving distance in the single time step length as the constraint,  at the same time,  accumulating the time step length to obtain the sole position track;  controlling the four-foot robot to execute the corresponding action based on the foot position track combined with the pre-set reward function so as to keep the four-foot robot in motion balance;  obtaining the historical information of the joint state of the four-foot robot and the leg phase information,  and processing the information as the control input of the four-foot robot,  obtaining the next action command to control the movement of the robot;  selecting a plantar position area based on the reinforcement learning strategy,  taking the area as the change area of the plantar position,  so as to restrict the maximum moving distance of the plantar in a single time step length;  each leg of the four-foot robot uses an independent track generator to output the plantar position in the Z-axis direction;  outputting the plantar position increment and the adjusting frequency of each leg based on the strengthening learning strategy,  accumulating the plantar position increment along the X axis and Y axis directions to obtain the plantar position along the X axis and Y axis directions,  superposing the plantar position increment along the Z axis direction and the prior value to obtain the plantar position along the Z axis direction.

The embodiment of the invention provides a fuzzy self-adaptive balance control algorithm for a wheel-legged robot,  which realizes the self-adaptive balance of the wheel-legged robot in the movement process. The algorithm comprises the following steps of :  obtaining the overall mass center coordinate of the robot according to the coordinates of the mass centers of a vehicle body,  an outer wheel and a swing arm of the wheel-legged robot in a vehicle body central coordinate system; based on the contact relationship between the outer wheel of the robot,  the track on the swing arm and the ground,  the projected stable cone model of the robot is established; according to the projected stable cone model of the wheel-legged robot,  the stability margin of the wheel-legged robot in the pitch direction and the roll direction is obtained; according to the stability margin of the wheel-legged robot in the pitch direction and roll direction,  the current posture of the wheel-legged robot is combined as the fuzzy input,  and the target angle of each swing arm joint is used as the fuzzy output to construct a fuzzy controller. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention,  the rapid autonomous balance recovery of the wheel-legged robot under the condition of tipping danger can be realized 1. A fuzzy self-adaptive balance control method of wheel leg robot,  wherein the method comprises :  according to the three-dimensional model of the wheel leg robot,  combining the connection orientation relation among the vehicle body,  the outer wheel and the swinging arm of the wheel leg robot,  establishing the vehicle body central coordinate system and the connection coordinate system among the outer wheel,  the swinging arm and the vehicle body;  according to the vehicle body central coordinate system and the connection coordinate system,  obtaining the uniform transformation matrix of the outer wheel,  the swinging arm and the vehicle body connection coordinate system under the vehicle body central coordinate system;  obtaining the whole mass centre coordinate of the wheel and leg robot according to the coordinates of the mass centre of each part of the wheel and leg robot body,  the outer wheel and the swinging arm under the central coordinate system of the vehicle body;  according to the contact relation between the track on the outer wheel and the swinging arm of the wheel and leg robot and the ground,  combining the whole mass centre distribution of the wheel and leg robot,  establishing the projection stable cone model of the wheel and leg robot;  according to the projection stable cone model of the wheel leg robot,  constructing a stability evaluation index,  obtaining a stable margin representing the pitching direction and the transverse rolling direction of the wheel leg robot;  according to the stable margin representing the pitching direction and the transverse rolling direction of the wheel leg robot,  combining the current posture of the wheel leg robot as the fuzzy input,  taking the target angle of each swinging arm joint as the fuzzy output,  constructing the fuzzy rule between the fuzzy input and the fuzzy output,  constructing the fuzzy controller.

ABSTRACT The use of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in agriculture has transformed conventional farming methods and provided cutting-edge approaches to controlling and monitoring crop growth factors. The goal of this project is to create an Internet of Things (IoT)-based agricultural system with a gear motor,  microcontroller,  IR sensor,  soil moisture sensor,  DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor,  and Liquid Crystal Touch (LCT) display. Farmers have control options and real-time data visualisation through the LCT display,  which also acts as the user interface. By precisely detecting obstructions or incursions in the field,  the IR sensor improves security and safeguards against trespassers and wildlife. The environmental factors that are essential for the best crop growth are constantly monitored by soil moisture sensors and DHT11 sensors. These factors include temperature,  humidity,  and soil moisture levels. The microcontroller coordinates data gathering,  analysis,  and control operations in its capacity as the central processing unit. Gear motors are used to operate mechanical parts such as irrigation systems. Lastly,  IoT connectivity makes it possible to remotely monitor and control the agricultural system. Farmers can use a smartphone or web interface to view real-time data,  receive alarms,  and change settings from any location. Through effective resource management,  enhanced decision-making skills,  and actionable insights,  this project seeks to equip farmers with the tools they need to improve crop output,  quality,  and sustainability in contemporary agriculture.

The invention provides a DRL-based quadruped robot path planning method First,  the environment is pre-scanned through the RGB ‑ D camera that comes with the quadruped robot The motion environment is modeled based on the grid method to obtain the environment map,  which is then decomposed into a series of grid units with binary information to obtain the initial state,  which is used as the input of the deep convolutional neural network,  and the attention mechanism is introduced to optimize the network structure to solve the problem that the deep reinforcement learning DQN algorithm fails to make good use of key local information; through end-to-end training,  the reward function is set by combining the motion characteristics of the quadruped robot,  and the neural network is trained by using the upper bound exploration strategy of the confidence interval to obtain the Q values of the eight actions that the quadruped robot can execute; finally,  artificial potential field algorithm is used to continuously detect dynamic obstacles in the environment and avoid them in real time,  so as to realize effective path planning of quadruped robot. 1. A four-foot robot path planning method based on DRL,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step S1,  pre-scanning the environment through the RGB-D camera of the four-foot robot,  modelling the moving environment based on the grid method to obtain the environment map,  representing the four-foot robot,  the obstacle and the target position through the grid coordinate to obtain the initial state;  step S2,  decomposing the motion environment of the four-foot robot into a series of grid units with binary information so as to be divided into a grid occupied by the barrier and a grid capable of passing freely;  step S3,  modelling based on Markov decision process,  and initializing the basic parameter,  specifically comprising the following steps :  Step S3.1 :  The motion environment of the four-foot robot is modelled based on the Markov decision process,  and the MDP definition is as follows :  (1) single intelligent agent :  a four-foot robot;  (4) reward function :  the intelligent agent evaluates the quality of the action through the feedback of the environment,  and selects the action with the maximum reward value after learning;  when the four-foot robot reaches the target point or obstacle,  giving a fixed reward value,  at the same time,  the path planning is finished;  when the four-foot robot is in other states,  the closer the robot is to the target point,  the larger the reward value is obtained in the movement of each step;  on the contrary,  the closer the robot is to the obstacle,  a negative reward will be obtained in the movement of each step;  The sum of the two reward values is taken as the final reward obtained after the four-foot robot performs one action,  and is calculated by the formula (2) :  The reward value function of the four-legged robot when performing the action is shown in formula (3) :  wherein,  if the four-foot robot reaches the target point,  the reward value is 200;  if the minimum distance between the four-foot robot and the obstacle is less than the set value,  it indicates that there is collision with the obstacle,  the reward value is -200,  under these two conditions,  the four-foot robot will stop training,  otherwise,  the reward value at this time is composed of two parts :  a negative reward value of the distance information between the four-foot robot and the nearest obstacle,  and a positive reward value of the distance information between the four-foot robot and the target point;  Step S3.2 :  initializing the basic parameter of the depth-strengthening learning model,  the basic parameter comprises :  reinforcement learning learning rate α belongs to (0,  1),  reward discount factor Gamma belongs to (0,  1),  greedy factor ε,  experience playback pool capacity L,  target value network weight updating step length C,  estimation value network random parameter θ,  target value network parameter θ,  iteration times N,  The updated expression of the Q value function is shown in formula (4) :  Q (st,  a) = Q (st,  at) + α (reward + γ maxQ (st + 1,  at + 1) -Q (st,  at)) (4) Step S3.3 :  randomly generating a starting point coordinate and a target point coordinate,  and ensuring that there is no obstacle at the starting point and the target point;  step S8,  repeating step S4,  step S5 and step S6,  determining an optimal global path.

The invention provides a quadruped robot swing leg obstacle avoidance method based on vision and path planning,  which performs path planning on the swing leg based on visual information,  and sets a prediction period to predict the swing leg in real time during the movement process to avoid encountering obstacles. The invention provides a quadruped robot swing leg obstacle avoidance method,  which provides a method that can dynamically adjust the swing leg trajectory during the movement of the quadruped robot,  which greatly enhances the traffic capacity of the quadruped robot under complex terrain; and the obstacle avoidance method is to plan the path of the swing leg. Before lifting the foot each time in the swing phase,  the path planning will be carried out once to avoid the situation that a certain swing leg is stuck by obstacles; in addition,  this obstacle avoidance method can avoid moving obstacles that suddenly appear in space. 1. A four-foot robot swinging leg obstacle avoiding method based on vision and path planning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the ground height map in real time by the RGB-D camera,  and recording the barrier information;  starting the swinging phase,  planning the global path according to the obtained ground height map,  obtaining the global path track of the swinging leg;  the motion parameter of the global path planning comprises position,  speed and acceleration;  judging whether it enters the prediction period,  if it enters the prediction period,  predicting whether there is collision;  the prediction period is selected according to the updating frequency of the ground height map and the control period of the control algorithm;  if the collision is predicted,  then the artificial potential field method is adopted to avoid the barrier,  obtaining the motion path track and motion parameter calculated by the artificial potential field method,  moving along the path,  and judging whether the swinging phase is finished or reaches the landing point,  if the swinging phase is finished or reaches the landing point,  and executing the step of ending the swinging phase.

The invention provides a humanoid robot leg autonomous motion planning method. The invention can expand the motor capability of the robot and reduce energy consumption 1. The present invention belongs to the field of motion control technology of foot-type robot The invention discloses a method for estimating and controlling the slip of a quadruped robot under low-attachment terrain The invention solves the problem that the motion efficiency and the motion stability of the quadruped robot are reduced after the foot end slip of the quadruped robot,  and the concrete method comprises the following steps of :  establishing a foot end slip estimator of the quadruped robot,  taking the sensing information of the quadruped robot body as input,  and training through a large amount of experimental data to estimate the parameters such as the foot-ground friction coefficient,  the slip state and the like of the quadruped robot And the output of the estimator is used as part of the input of the reinforcement learning state space. By training in low-attachment terrain,  the quadruped robot can finally switch smoothly and anti-slip considering speed,  stability,  energy consumption,  etc. According to the invention,  the quadruped robot can still keep high dynamic motion under the low-adhesion terrain according to the body sensor,  so that the motion capability and the practical applicability of the quadruped robot under the low-adhesion terrain are improved 1. A slippage estimation and control method for four-foot robot under low adhesion terrain,  wherein In order to solve the problem that the motion ability of the four-legged robot is reduced in a low adhesion environment,  the method comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  creating a four-foot robot slippage data set :  building a four-foot robot simulation environment with multiple low adhesion ground friction coefficients based on Isaac gym platform,  through simulation,  collecting the machine body posture,  linear speed,  angular speed,  joint angle,  joint angular velocity and joint moment data,  and taking these sensor data as input data. at the same time,  taking the privilege information which cannot be directly observed including the friction coefficient,  the sliding mark bit,  the foot end linear speed at the next moment and the machine body linear speed at the next moment as the label,  sorting and marking the time stamp of the data and the label,  establishing a four-foot robot sliding data set with time sequence;  step 2 :  Establishing a four-legged human slippage state estimator :  using the four-foot robot slippage data set established in step 1 to train the long-term and short-term memory network (LSTM),  so as to solve the form of mean square error to construct a loss function,  by calculating gradient through the error reverse propagation,  using random gradient descent method to optimize the network parameter (weight value and bias value),  making the loss function to reach the minimum value,  through LSTM to the memory ability of the history information and the fitting ability of the non-linear relationship,  establishing the correlation between the sensor data and the robot sliding state,  realizing the four-foot robot sliding parameter (friction coefficient,  sliding marker bit,  foot end linear speed at the next time,  an explicit estimation of the machine body linear velocity at the next moment;  step 3 :  establishing a four-foot robot motion controller :  taking the sliding parameter output by the sliding state estimator trained in step 2 as the observation data of the value network and the strategy network,  constructing a depth-strengthening learning network based on near-end strategy optimization algorithm,  and constructing a virtual simulation environment with four-foot robot and complex terrain,  setting the initial state,  reward function,  termination condition,  using bionics slippage analysis of four-foot robot,  taking high dynamic,  high stability,  high efficiency as target,  designing reward function aiming at slippage,  through the data generated by interaction movement of four-foot robot and environment in simulation,  the strategy network parameter is continuously updated by the gradient descent method so as to maximize the reward value,  and the four-foot robot control network is obtained after the training is finished.

The invention provides a quadruped robot swing leg obstacle avoidance method based on vision and path planning,  which performs path planning on the swing leg based on visual information,  and sets a prediction period to predict the swing leg in real time during the movement process to avoid encountering obstacles. The invention provides a quadruped robot swing leg obstacle avoidance method,  which provides a method that can dynamically adjust the swing leg trajectory during the movement of the quadruped robot,  which greatly enhances the traffic capacity of the quadruped robot under complex terrain; and the obstacle avoidance method is to plan the path of the swing leg. Before lifting the foot each time in the swing phase,  the path planning will be carried out once to avoid the situation that a certain swing leg is stuck by obstacles; in addition,  this obstacle avoidance method can avoid moving obstacles that suddenly appear in space. 1. A four-foot robot swinging leg obstacle avoiding method based on vision and path planning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) By the camera obtains the ground height map in real time and records the barrier information;  (2) starting the swinging phase,  according to the obtained ground height map,  performing global path planning,  obtaining the global path track of the swinging leg,  comprising :  taking the position of the current swinging leg as the starting point,  obtaining the heuristic landing point by heuristic algorithm,  at the same time,  determining the available heuristic landing point by performing spiral search around the obtained landing point by comprehensive vision,  as the needed end point,  performing global path planning;  performing spline interpolation according to the obtained global path point and the preset lifting foot height to obtain the global path track of the swinging leg;  the motion parameter of the global path planning comprises position,  speed and acceleration;  (3) judging whether the prediction period is entered,  if so,  executing the step (4);  if not,  executing the step (5);  the prediction period is selected according to the updating frequency of the ground height map and the control period of the control algorithm;  (4) predicting whether there is a collision,  if so,  executing the step (6);  if no collision is predicted,  performing step (5);  (5) obtaining the motion parameter of the global path planning,  moving along the global path track,  and executing the step (7);  (6) using the artificial potential field method to avoid the obstacle,  obtaining the motion path track and motion parameter calculated by the artificial potential field method,  moving along the path,  and executing the step (8);  (7) judging whether the swinging phase is finished,  if the swinging phase is not finished,  returning to the step (3);  if the swinging phase is finished,  executing step (9);  (8) judging whether the swinging phase is finished or reaches the landing point,  if the swinging phase is not finished and does not reach the landing point,  returning to the step (6);  if the swinging phase has ended or reaches the landing point,  executing the step (9);  (9) ending the swinging phase.

Systems and methods are described for reacting to a feature in an environment of a robot based on a classification of the feature. A system can detect the feature in the environment using a first sensor on the robot. For example,  the system can detect the feature using a feature detection system based on sensor data from a camera. The system can detect a mover in the environment using a second sensor on the robot. For example,  the system can detect the mover using a mover detection system based on sensor data from a lidar sensor. The system can fuse the data from detecting the feature and detecting the mover to produce fused data. The system can classify the feature based on the fused data and react to the feature based on classifying the feature.

The invention provides an anthropomorphic automatic driving strategy based on model predictive control,  which includes the following steps :  establishing a vehicle state prediction model based on a model predictive control algorithm based on a vehicle nonlinear kinematics model; based on the hybrid logic dynamic method,  combined with the vehicle state prediction model,  the collision safety hard constraints of autonomous vehicles are established; according to the collision safety hard constraints,  the decision planning optimization model is established with the performance objectives that characterize comfort and control energy consumption as the objective function; based on the driver's anthropomorphic behavior characteristics,  the performance goals in the decision-making planning optimization model are weighted to obtain an anthropomorphic autonomous driving strategy based on model predictive control. The invention can solve the technical problem that existing automatic driving decision-making planning can only realize obstacle avoidance driving in a simple environment,  and cannot accurately evaluate vehicle driving risks in real time when facing complex dynamic driving environments. 1. A humanoid automatic driving strategy based on model prediction control,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the vehicle speed and the front wheel corner are used as the system input to establish the vehicle non-linear kinematics model;  establishing a vehicle state prediction model based on model prediction control algorithm according to the vehicle nonlinear kinematics model,  comprising :  using Taylor formula to perform first-order linearization to the vehicle non-linear kinematics model,  omitting the high-order error term and discretization;  taking the centroid coordinate of the vehicle,  the vehicle heading angle,  the vehicle forward wheel rotating angle and the vehicle speed as the state variable;  setting the model prediction step length and the prediction step number,  making the vehicle state output completely,  obtaining the vehicle state prediction model;  based on the hybrid logic dynamic method,  combining the vehicle state prediction model to establish an automatic driving vehicle collision safety hard constraint,  comprising :  establishing a hybrid logic dynamic system model through logic description;  based on the mixed logic dynamic system model,  introducing logic variables to respectively process the collision safety conditions on the longitudinal and transverse movement dimensions;  according to the collision safety condition,  combining the vehicle state prediction model to obtain the automatic driving vehicle collision safety hard constraint;  according to the collision safety hard constraint,  taking the minimum control energy consumption,  the minimum corner input,  the minimum speed change,  the minimum lane departure distance of each planning period end point as the target function,  establishing a decision planning optimization model;  based on the anthropomorphic behaviour characteristic of the driver,  performing weight assignment to the performance target in the decision planning optimization model,  obtaining anthropomorphic automatic driving strategy based on model prediction control.

The invention discloses a bionic biped robot balance control method and a humanoid robot system. The bionic biped robot balance control method comprises the following steps of :  performing dynamic analysis on a biped robot to construct a simplified dynamic model; the simplified dynamic model is used to predict the state of the bipedal robot in the future time domain,  and the predicted state of the robot is obtained; set the expected state of the biped robot in the future time domain,  and use the bionic ankle joint strategy and hip joint strategy to correct the expected state to obtain the target expected state; solve the constructed optimization model to obtain the optimal three-dimensional force at the foot end,  so that the robot system state reaches the target state. The invention has faster control reaction speed and self-recovery ability,  stronger impact resistance and wide application range 1. A bionic biped robot balance control method,  wherein Including :  performing dynamic analysis on the biped robot,  constructing a simplified dynamic model;  using the simplified dynamic model to predict the state of the biped robot in the future time domain to obtain the predicted state of the robot;  setting the expected state of the biped robot in the future time domain,  using the bionic ankle joint strategy and hip joint strategy,  correcting the expected state,  obtaining the expected state of the target;  solving the constructed optimization model to obtain the optimal foot end three-dimensional force to make the robot system state reach the target state.

An underwater web-type humanoid robot based on pneumatic buoyancy control,  wherein It comprises an inflation bottle (1),  a trunk module (7),  an arm module (3),  a leg module (4),  a foot web (5),  a buoyancy adjusting module (2),  a sensing module and a control module (6); The invention discloses a positioning method and system for a multi-legged robot based on indoor scenes,  which determines the friction factor of the ground according to multiple ground parameters; define the driving type according to the friction factor and the tire coefficient of the multi-legged robot,  and the driving type is adapted to the type of ground on which the multi-legged robot travels; define the driving posture of the multi-legged robot according to the posture type of each driving foot This is compatible with the consideration of multiple posture types of driving feet And determine the driving posture of the multi-legged robot under the comprehensive definition of multiple driving feet In order to trigger the emergency measures of the multi-legged robot according to the driving posture of the multi-legged robot,  to ensure the anti-fall shape of the multi-legged robot,  it ensures the driving stability of the multi-legged robot. At the same time,  it obtains the surrounding environment images collected by the multi-legged robot,  defines multiple environmental features based on the surrounding environment images,  and defines the spatial relationship between the multi-legged robot and multiple environmental features to determine the multi-legged robot's current position in the indoor scene. 1. A locating method of multi-foot robot based on indoor scene,  wherein it is applied to the locating scene of multi-foot robot based on indoor scene;  The positioning method of the multi-foot robot based on indoor scene comprises :  collecting the position signal of the multi-foot robot,  and defining the position of the multi-foot robot according to the position signal of the multi-foot robot;  defining the indoor scene according to the upper image and the lower image collected by the multi-foot robot;  if the multi-foot robot is in the indoor scene,  collecting multiple ground parameters driven by the multi-foot robot,  and determining the friction factor of the ground according to the multiple ground parameters;  the running type is defined according to the friction factor and the tyre coefficient of the multi-foot robot,  at this time,  the running type is adapted to the ground type of the multi-foot robot;  defining the driving posture of the multi-foot robot according to the posture type of each driving foot,  and triggering the emergency measure of the multi-foot robot according to the driving posture of the multi-foot robot so as to ensure the anti-falling state of the multi-foot robot;  obtaining the peripheral environment image collected by the multi-foot robot,  and defining multiple environment characteristics according to the peripheral environment image,  defining the space relation between the multi-foot robot and the multiple environment characteristics,  so as to determine the current position of the multi-foot robot in the indoor scene.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot movement skill generation method based on explicit and implicit hybrid estimation,  which includes :  constructing a explicit and implicit hybrid estimation neural network,  a movement strategy neural network and a composite loss function; construct a training environment for humanoid robot motor skills; in the motor skills training environment,  explicit and implicit hybrid estimation neural network and motor strategy neural network are jointly trained iteratively based on composite loss function; during the training process,  the parameters of the neural network are continuously adjusted according to the gradient of the composite loss function to optimize the motor skill strategy; through multiple rounds of iterative training,  the motor skills strategy that completes the training is obtained; finally,  the motor skill strategy that has completed the training is transferred to the physical robot. The motor skill strategy generated by the present invention has higher stability and adaptability,  and can better adapt to different environments and task requirements. 1. A method for generating motion skill of humanoid robot based on explicit and implicit mixed estimation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  constructing a dominant-implicit hybrid estimation neural network,  a motion strategy neural network and a composite loss function;  S2 :  constructing an artificial robot motion skill training environment;  S3 :  in the motion skill training environment,  based on the composite loss function iteration joint training implicit hybrid estimation neural network and motion strategy neural network;  in the training process,  continuously adjusting the parameter of the neural network according to the gradient of the composite loss function so as to optimize the motion skill strategy;  obtaining the motion skill strategy for finishing the training through multi-round iteration training;  S4 :  and transferring the training sport skill strategy to the physical robot.

The invention discloses a small unmanned combat platform of a bionic hexapod robot. The small unmanned combat platform comprises a hexapod robot body,  wherein the hexapod robot body is used for adjusting the direction of a mounted weapon and the horizontal and pitching shooting angles; the clamping mechanism is used to fix and clamp the mounted weapon; the buffer mechanism is set between the six-legged robot body and the clamping mechanism,  and is used to mount weapons to play a buffering and shock-absorbing role when shooting; the automatic loading device is fixed above the body of the hexapod robot and is used to drive the automatic loading of the mounted weapon; the automatic firing device is arranged above the clamping mechanism and is used to complete the firing action of the mounted weapon; the detection and aiming mechanism is used to collect the image of the muzzle pointing in real time and determine the impact point of the weapon. The invention can realize the integration of investigation and strike,  has small volume,  compact structure and high concealment,  is suitable for individual soldiers or teams to carry,  and ensures the safety of combatants. 1. A small unmanned combat platform of bionic six-foot robot,  wherein it comprises a six-foot robot body,  for adjusting the direction and horizontal,  pitching shooting angle of the hanging weapon;  a clamping mechanism for fixing and clamping the hanging weapon;  a buffering mechanism arranged between the six-foot robot body and the clamping mechanism and used for buffering and damping when shooting with a hanging weapon;  an automatic loading device fixed on the upper part of the six-foot robot body for driving the automatic loading of the hanging weapon;  the automatic chamber-loading device comprises a stepping motor,  a motor fixing plate,  a chamber-loading steering engine,  a steering engine fixing bracket,  a deflector rod,  a sliding block,  a screw rod,  a sliding rail and a side plate;  the stepping motor is fixedly connected with the motor fixing plate,  the two sides of the slide rail are fixedly connected with the lateral plate and the motor fixing plate,  the lower part of the slide rail is fixedly connected with the six-foot robot;  the steering engine fixing bracket is fixedly connected with the sliding block and the upper chamber steering engine;  the output end of the stepping motor is connected with the screw rod,  the slide block is connected with the nut,  the slide block slides along the slide rail in a straight line;  the output end of the upper chamber steering engine is connected with the deflector rod;  when executing the automatic bore-loading action,  the stepping motor drives the screw rod to operate,  so that the sliding block moves backwards along the sliding rail direction,  causing the deflector rod connected with the bore-loading steering engine to drive the sleeve in the hanging weapon to move backwards,  finishing the bore-loading action,  at this time,  the bore-loading steering engine rotates 90 degrees,  so that the deflector rod is lifted upwards by 90 degrees to complete the release of the sleeve,  so as to complete the automatic hearth loading action;  an automatic firing device arranged above the clamping mechanism and used for finishing the firing of the hanging weapon;  a detection aiming mechanism for collecting the image pointed by the gun mouth in real time and judging the bullet point of the weapon;  the clamping mechanism comprises a hanging weapon,  an upper frame,  a connecting block,  a lower frame,  an upper die,  a lower die and a pin;  the upper mould and the lower mould are used for covering the holding part of the hanging weapon;  two buffer rods pass through the opening part of the fixing frame and are fixed at two ends of the buffer rods by nuts;  each buffer frame passes through two buffer rods,  the damper passes through the buffer rod and is located between the fixing frame and the buffer frame;
