 the first motor,  the second motor and the third motor are respectively used as the hip joint,  knee joint and ankle joint of the leg structure so as to simulate the movement of the insect leg;  the first motor is fixed between the upper connecting plate and the lower connecting plate;  one end of the thigh part is fixedly connected with the output end of the first motor and can rotate left and right along with the first motor;  the second motor is fixed on the other end of the thigh part,  the output end is fixedly connected with one end of the thigh part for driving the thigh part to swing up and down;  the third motor is fixed at the other end of the leg part,  the output end is fixedly connected with the foot part for driving the foot part to swing up and down.

The invention discloses a stair modeling method,  device,  legged robot and medium based on point cloud data According to the characteristics of stair point cloud data,  point cloud classification loss and geometric constraint loss are used to train the stair recognition model,  this enables the stair recognition model to accurately identify the pedal point cloud of the stair Then calculate the center point of each pedal based on the identified pedal point cloud And by correcting the center point of the pedal,  the deviation between the center point of the stair pedal and the coordinate system of the point cloud acquisition equipment is eliminated,  and the depth and height of the step are obtained based on the corrected center point,  making the step model based on the center point of the pedal and the depth and height of the step Modeling the obtained stair model is more accurate. 1. A stair modelling method based on point cloud data,  wherein the method comprises :  the point cloud data of the stair is input into the stair identification model to obtain multiple pedal point clouds,  when the stair identification model is trained,  the point cloud classification loss and geometric constraint loss are used,  each pedal point cloud is a set of point clouds corresponding to one pedal;  obtaining a centre point of each pedal based on the pedal point cloud;  correcting the central point of each pedal by rotating conversion to eliminate the deviation between the central point of the pedal and the coordinate system of the point cloud collecting device,  obtaining the corrected central point,  and obtaining the depth and height of the step according to the corrected central point;  generating a stair model according to the central points of all pedals and the depth and height of the steps;  training the stair identification model,  comprising :  based on the classification result of the stair identification model to the point cloud in the training data set,  calculating the cross entropy loss for representing the point cloud classification loss;  calculating the distance between the real normal vector of each pedal and the normal vector predicted by the stair identification model,  obtaining the curvature suppression loss for representing the geometric constraint loss;  according to the cross entropy loss and the curvature suppression loss,  calculating the total loss value,  according to the total loss value iteratively training the stair identification model.

This application provides a joint safety control method,  system and electronic equipment for a robot. The method includes :  obtaining motor parameter values monitored by sensors; comparing the motor parameter value with the target parameter value configured in the instruction issued by the main board,  and if the real-time deviation value between the motor parameter value and the target parameter value exceeds the preset deviation value,  determining that the robot is in an abnormal state; when the robot is in an abnormal state,  start the robot joint safety control mechanism and perform joint safety control on the robot according to the preset safety strategy. Based on the above method,  the safety of humanoid robot operation can be improved through the robot joint safety control mechanism. 1. A joint safety control method of robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the motor parameter value monitored by the sensor;  comparing the motor parameter value with the given parameter value configured in the instruction sent by the main board,  if the real-time deviation value between the motor parameter value and the target parameter value exceeds the preset deviation value,  judging that the robot is in abnormal state;  when the robot is in abnormal state,  starting the robot joint safety control mechanism,  and performing joint safety control to the robot according to the preset safety strategy.

Embodiments of the present application provide a control method,  device and vehicle. The method can be applied to the field of intelligent driving. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a first parking track and a second parking track by a vehicle,  wherein the end point of the first parking track is the starting point of the second parking track; in the first parking track,  the vehicle is in a first gear; in the second parking track,  the vehicle is in a second gear; and the first gear is different from the second gear Control the steering of the vehicle according to the second parking trajectory before the vehicle travels to the end point according to the first parking trajectory Embodiments of the present application can be applied to smart cars or electric vehicles,  helping to improve the smoothness and humanoid nature during parking,  thereby helping to improve the user's parking experience. 1. A control method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a first parking track and a second parking track,  the end point of the first parking track is the starting point of the second parking track,  the vehicle in the first parking track is in the first gear,  the vehicle in the second parking track is in the second gear,  the first gear is different from the second gear;  before the vehicle travels to the destination according to the first parking track,  controlling the vehicle to steer according to the second parking track.

The invention provides a running-jumping type humanoid robot with adjustable attitude in the air and a motion control method,  which comprises a two-leg adjusting mechanism,  a bouncing connecting rod mechanism,  a driving mechanism,  a four-rotor attitude control mechanism,  a sensing control module and a corresponding motion control method The double-leg adjusting mechanism comprises a speed reducing motor,  a transmission structure composed of three bevel gears,  and a double-leg connecting frame The bouncing linkage mechanism is a planar eight-linkage mechanism; the driving mechanism includes a bouncing motor and a gear set; the attitude control mechanism includes four sets of coreless motors,  spiral wings and corresponding connectors; the sensing control module comprises an encoder,  an attitude sensor and a control processing unit The bouncing mechanism,  the double-foot adjusting mechanism and the posture control mechanism of the invention are combined with each other to realize the continuous running and bouncing movement with controllable height and distance,  which is of great significance to improving the flexibility of the humanoid robot and its application in complex environments. 1. A runaway humanoid robot with adjustable air posture,  comprising a double-leg adjusting mechanism (1),  a posture control mechanism (2),  a leg mechanism (3) and a sensing control module (4),  wherein the double-leg adjusting mechanism (1) is used for controlling the included angle between the two side leg mechanisms (3) to generate forward acceleration;  the posture control mechanism (2) is used for adjusting the posture angle of the human-shaped robot in the air,  ensuring that the posture of the robot is stable after jumping,  and will not be turned;  the leg mechanism (3) is used for generating the bouncing when the human-shaped robot touches the ground,  pushing the human-shaped robot away from the ground,  performing forward running movement;  the sensing control module (4) realizes the detection of all motion control,  wireless data receiving,  machine body posture and mechanism angle.

A wheel leg type robot,  wherein it comprises a main machine (1),  a power source (2) and a pair of unfolding and folding wheel leg components set on the two sides of the main machine (1),  further comprising two rotation degree of freedom limiting components (3);  the unfolding and folding wheel leg assembly comprises a four-connecting rod mechanism,  a leg unfolding and folding joint (5) for driving the four-connecting rod mechanism to unfold or fold and a driving wheel assembly arranged at the tail end of the four-connecting rod mechanism,  the unfolding and folding wheel leg assembly is corresponding to the rotation freedom degree limiting assembly (3) one by one;  the pair of unfolding and folding wheel leg components are symmetrically arranged along a vertical symmetrical surface,  the front and back direction of the main machine (1) is parallel to the vertical symmetrical surface,  the forward direction of the driving wheel component is parallel to the vertical symmetrical surface;  In the corresponding unfolding and folding wheel leg assembly and the rotation degree of freedom defining assembly (3) :  the rotating degree of freedom limiting component (3) comprises a front and back swinging joint (301) for driving the leg unfolding and folding joint (5) to swing front and back,  and an inner and outer swinging joint (302) for driving the front and back swinging joint (301) to swing inside and outside,  when the front and back swinging joint (301) swings inwards,  the driving wheel assembly is close to the vertical symmetrical surface,  when the front and back swinging joint (301) swings outwards,  the driving wheel assembly is far away from the vertical symmetrical surface.

Enhance the overall movement ability of the robot while. 1. The present invention relates to a deep learning-based facial recognition system. The system comprises a data set module includes face recognition and facial attribute analysis library such as DeepFace,  OpenCV,  and NumPy libraries,  prefer DeepFace;  a pre trained emotion detection model prefer DeepFace GitHub repository;  an input device like webcam for capturing the images in real time;  image preprocessing module for reducing the image to a certain size and converting it to grayscale;  a classifier module to detect the faces in images;  a ML model Deep Face's convolutional neural network for predict the emotion;  and a display unit to show the output image with emotion label. Face detection,  alignment,  and preprocessing are all performed using OpenCV to extract key facial features,  which are then fed into the DeepFace model. The performance is encouraging,  as evidenced by the high accuracy rates achieved across a number of mood categories. A listening and writing optimization method,  wherein the method comprises :  executing the operation of recording the audition text and obtaining the audition text;  based on the book state and the human-shaped template,  judging whether the writer enters the listening and writing state;  if the listener enters the listening and writing state,  determining the playing time of the target vocabulary in the listening and writing text based on the preset method,  and executing the listening and writing operation based on the playing time;  The step of executing the operation of recording the audiotext and obtaining the audiotext comprises :  placing the book where the text to be written is located under the camera,  obtaining the text to be written based on the image of the text and the gesture of the student;  The step of determining the playing time of the target vocabulary in the dictation text based on the preset method comprises :  after playing the target vocabulary,  recording the time as the first time;  if the first time is less than or equal to the preset time threshold value,  detecting the set instruction,  taking the first time as the playing time of the target vocabulary in the audition text;  if the first time is greater than or equal to the preset time threshold value,  taking the time threshold value as the playing time of the target vocabulary in the dictation text;  wherein the preset time threshold is obtained by calculating according to the word number of the listening content,  the average writing speed of the user and the difficulty degree of the listening content.

The invention discloses a blind ladder climbing method of a quadruped robot and the quadruped robot. The blind ladder climbing method comprises the following steps of :  recalculating an expected landing point position of a swing leg in each control period and planning a swing track of the swing leg; detect whether the swing leg collides during the swing; when the swing leg does not collide,  control the swing leg to swing according to the latest planned initial swing trajectory; when it is detected that the swing leg collides with the vertical surface of the step during the lifting process,  adjust the XD direction trajectory to maintain the position where the collision occurs,  and raise the swing leg according to the ZD direction trajectory until it is raised to the highest point of the ZD direction trajectory. Continue to swing according to the initial swing trajectory; when it is detected that the swing leg collides with the vertical surface of the step during the falling process,  the XD direction trajectory in the subsequent control cycle is set as the XD coordinate of the current collision position to retreat by a preset step. The above method can reduce the impact of bumps on the robot's climbing and improve the stability of the robot's blind climbing of stairs. 1. A four-foot robot blind stair-climbing method,  wherein the swinging leg is controlled to swing according to the planned swinging track in the set swinging period,  each swinging period is divided into a plurality of control periods;  defining the world coordinate system (XD,  YD,  ZD),  wherein XD and ZD are respectively the horizontal advancing direction and the vertical lifting direction of the four-foot robot;  The method for planning the swinging track of each swinging period comprises :  re-calculating the expected foot point position of the swinging leg in each control period and taking the foot end position of the initial swinging of the swinging leg as the starting point and taking the expected foot point position as the end point to re-plan the initial swinging track of the swinging leg,  wherein the initial swinging track comprises an XD direction track and a ZD direction track;  During the swing,  it is detected whether the swing leg is collided :  when the swinging leg is not collided,  the swinging leg is controlled to swing according to the initial swinging track;  when it is detected that the swinging leg touches the vertical surface of the step in the lifting process,  the XD direction track is adjusted to the position where the collision occurs to keep unchanged,  the swinging leg is lifted according to the ZD direction track until the highest point of the ZD direction track is lifted,  and then the swinging leg is continuously swung according to the initial swinging track;  when the swing leg is detected to hit the vertical surface of the step step in the falling process,  the XD direction track in the subsequent control period is set as the XD coordinate of the current collision position to retreat the preset step length;  The calculation of the desired drop point position of the swing leg in the current swing period includes the calculation of the desired drop point pi,  e,  x-y of the swing leg in the horizontal plane and the maximum desired height zi in the vertical lifting direction,  and the calculation of the maximum desired height zi in the ZD direction is as follows :  zi=zi,  0 + (hmax + h0),  in the formula,  zi,  0 is the initial height of the foot end of the swinging leg i under the world coordinate system in the current swinging period,  hmax is the set step maximum step height,  h0 is the set height adding allowance;  The calculation formula of the desired drop point pi,  e,  x-y of the swing leg on the horizontal plane is as follows :  in the formula,  pi,  h,  d,  x-y is the projection coordinate corresponding to the hip joint position of the swinging leg i on the XDYD horizontal plane,  Tc is the supporting time of the supporting leg continuously supporting,  vc,  d,  x-y is the moving speed of the projection of the machine body mass centre on the XDYD horizontal plane,  g is the gravity acceleration,  vc,  e,  x-y is the expected speed of the projection of the fuselage centroid on the XDYD horizontal plane,  vc,  d,  x-y is the actual speed of the projection of the fuselage centroid on the XDYD horizontal plane.

The invention discloses a method for discovering multiple gaits of a multi-legged robot under the condition of limited resources Decompose multiple sets of robot strategy networks into perception modules and action modules All gaits share the perception module,  maintain an action module for each gait that can produce that gait,  use the mass-diversity algorithm to optimize all the above modules,  and deepen the action module set and attenuate the learning rate of the perception module. Solve the mismatch problem caused by shared perception modules. Compared with the existing multiple gait discovery method for multiple groups of robots,  the present invention has extremely high resource efficiency,  and only requires very few resources to obtain a group of multiple groups of robot gaits that are similar to or better than the existing method. The invention is easy to implement,  can be conveniently used in various gait discovery problems of various multi-legged robots,  and has great practical application potential. 1. A multi-foot robot multi-gait discovery method under resource limited condition,  wherein only one shared sensing module is stored,  specifically comprising the following steps :  step 1,  decomposing the multi-foot robot gait strategy into a sensing module and an action module;  at the first iteration,  the multi-foot robot action module set initializing as empty set,  randomly generating a shared sensing module xR and N action modules step 2,  in the subsequent iteration,  firstly training the multi-foot robot sensing module xR,  then N multi-foot robot action modules as father generation,  and using cross variation or gradient operator to generate N sub-generation action module step 3,  respectively splicing the N sub-generation action modules with the sensing module,  generating N sub-generation strategies,  operating the sub-generation strategies in the multi-foot robot simulation environment,  and evaluating the forward speed and gait of the sub-generation strategies;  step 4,  performing survival selection according to the forward speed and gait of the sub-generation strategy,  trying to update the action module in the sub-generation strategy to the multi-foot robot action module set a moving module with the highest advancing speed is kept for each gait;  step 5,  performing Tr iteration,  solving the problem of mismatching between the shared sensing module and the mobile module in the mobile module set;  step 6,  returning the shared sensing module xR and the action module in the action module set after all T iterations.

The invention provides a detection method for detecting human body posture to determine whether to fall,  which includes :  S0 obtaining image frames; s1 humanoid detection; s2 human body key point detection; s3 tracking :  Input the above detection result information into the tracking algorithm for tracking and matching based on the coordinate information of the humanoid in the video And save the results of human body key point detection to the tracking target. The saved key point detection results need to be further processed to find the center point Up (x,  y) of the key point of the upper body and the center point Dp (of the lower body and legs. x,  y) :  The center point of the upper body and the center point of the lower body and legs save Up and Dp to the tracking target,  and retain the historical information of the first 24 frames; s4 fall judgment; s5 outputs the result; s6 The current frame detection ends,  proceed to the next frame image,  and return to step S0. The method can be deployed to terminal equipment to realize real-time fall detection,  so that the detection efficiency is improved,  the cost is reduced to a certain extent,  and the method is a simple and feasible landing scheme 1. A detection method for detecting and judging whether a human body posture falls,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  S0,  obtaining the image frame;  S1,  human shape detection :  detecting the area where the human is located in the video frame image by the convolution neural network,  returning the detection result to the maximum external rectangle of the human-shaped area,  representing as the left upper coordinate (x0,  y0),  and the right lower coordinate (x1,  y1);  S2,  human body key point detection :  the step S1 in the result human-shaped area namely detecting the rectangular frame in the original image,  the human-shaped area image input to human body key point detecting network namely convolution neural network detecting human body 17 key point coordinate,  output the 34 numerical value,  2 a group corresponding to the 17 group coordinate point data;  S3,  tracking :  step S1,  The detection result information input tracking algorithm of step S2 performs tracking matching according to the coordinate information of the human shape in the video,  and stores the result of the human body key point detection into the tracking target,  wherein the stored key point detection result is to be further processed,  the central point Up (x,  y) of the key point of the upper half body,  and the central point Dp (x,  y) of the leg of the lower body :  the central point of the upper body Centre point of leg part of lower body the Up and Dp are stored in the tracking target,  and the history information of the previous 24 frames will be reserved;  S4,  tumble judgment :  S4.1 obtaining tracking target information :  obtaining the detection frame information before the current frame and the 24 frame :  the detection frame information of the current frame is recorded as now-box [x0,  y0,  x1,  y1],  wherein x0,  y0 represent the left upper angle coordinate of the frame,  x1,  y1 represent the right lower angle coordinate of the frame; A system and a method for detecting the carrier roller of a belt conveyor using a quadruped robot It includes a belt conveyor and a carrier roller arranged under the conveyor belt of the belt conveyor. The belt conveyor is equipped with an end signal transmitting/receiving module on the belt conveyor bracket below its carrier roller. The module is equipped with a WIFI router,  and the end signal transmitting/receiving module is provided with a WIFI router./The receiving module is connected to the on-site central control through optical fibers. A quadruped robot belt conveyor roller detection component is provided on the outside of the roller of the belt conveyor The four-legged robot belt conveyor roller detection component moves along the side of the belt conveyor through a preset program to detect each roller along the way,  and wirelessly transmits the detected abnormal roller status information and abnormal rollers. The coordinate position is fed back to the end signal transmitting/receiving module. The invention can effectively inspect the abnormal state of the carrier roller,  reduce the burden of manual inspection,  effectively reduce the shutdown time caused by the failure of the carrier roller,  improve the transportation efficiency of the belt conveyor,  and indirectly improve the production capacity of the enterprise. 1. A gripper designed for grasping objects when mounted on a robotic manipulator is disclosed. The robot gripper may utilize a single actuator to facilitate the grasping of objects of varying shape and size with three degrees of freedom of passive alignment,  thus enabling said robot gripper to grasp,  push and pull. Passive alignment features assist the robot gripper in executing robust and fast grasping of objects with minimal requirement for active feedback control. The mechanical robot gripper jaw is constructed of a compliant material and a curved rigid member to allow the gripper to cage objects.

The present application relates to the technical field of live broadcast cameras,  and in particular to a tracking method of a live broadcast camera with an automatic human body tracking function and a live broadcast camera. Includes the following steps :  starting the video; the camera obtains the target location; carry out moving target monitoring; the camera determines the position of the moving target and retains the area where the human target is located in the moving target area; segmenting the video image area to define the tracking area; according to the comparison principle,  determine whether the human target exceeds the tracking area. If it exceeds the tracking area,  the camera does not rotate. If it is in the tracking area,  the camera follows the human target for tracking and shooting. The live broadcast camera of this application realizes the electric rotation function through the drive of the motor,  combines the motor and the USB live broadcast camera into one,  and also uses software judgment and humanoid recognition,  and can filter unnecessary movements or animal postures,  so as to more accurately Judge and accurately track the direction of the humanoid,  allowing users to have a more comfortable experience. 1. A tracking method of live broadcast camera with human body automatic tracking function,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step A :  the video is started,  the motor is started,  and the camera starts to work;  step B :  obtaining the target position by the camera;  step C :  monitoring the moving target;  step D :  the camera determines the position of the moving target and keeps the area of the human body target in the moving target area;  step E :  dividing the video image area and dividing the tracking area;  step F :  according to the comparison principle,  judging whether the human body target exceeds the tracking area,  if it exceeds the tracking area,  the camera does not rotate,  if it is in the tracking area,  the camera follows the human body target to perform tracking shooting;  the step F adopts the dynamic human body tracking method of multi-algorithm fusion,  the method firstly designs the grey scale projection method of the sub-area to perform background compensation,  then adopts cross-frame differential method to detect the moving target,  then adopts Camshift algorithm to perform target tracking,  when the target tracking is failed,  re-adopting the cross-frame difference method to determine the position of the moving target,  then using Camshift algorithm to continue tracking;  in the tracking process,  when the target is partially shielded or completely shielded,  the cross-frame difference method or Camshift algorithm is converted into the particle filtering algorithm for prediction tracking,  after the shielding is ended,  the cross-frame difference method or Camshift algorithm is returned; This application discloses a humanoid preview distance estimation method,  system and medium for path tracking control. The method includes the following steps :  constructing a local planning path model; constructing a preview distance model that outputs a preview distance; construct a driving group correction factor model,  which obtains the driving group correction factor; correct the preview distance output by the preview distance model according to the driving group correction factor,  and reconstruct the local planning path model according to the corrected preview distance. This application considers the preview habits of the driving group and outputs the preview distances under different driving environments through the preview distance model,  taking into account both path tracking accuracy and vehicle driving stability. 1. A human-like pre-aiming distance estimation method for path tracking control,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  constructing a pre-aiming distance model,  wherein the pre-aiming distance is output by the model;  step 2 :  constructing a driving group correction factor model,  the model obtains the driving group correction factor;  step 3 :  constructing a local planning path model;  step 4 :  correcting the pre-aiming distance output by the pre-aiming distance model according to the driving group correction factor,  and reconstructing the local planning path model according to the corrected pre-aiming distance.

The invention relates to a foot type robot and a motion control method of the foot type robot The method includes :  responding to an anti-joint standing instruction,  the anti-joint standing instruction including switching from a positive joint standard standing state to an anti-joint standing state; determining the joint initial angle value of the standard standing state of the positive joint and the mechanical limit angle value of the standing state of the reverse joint; based on the whole body control algorithm,  enter the standard standing state of the positive joint; determining a first discrete angle value for moving from a positive joint standard standing state to an anti-joint standing state based on the joint initial angle value and the mechanical limit angle value; the first discrete angle value is converted into a first joint torque based on joint proportional differential control,  and the thigh motor and calf motor are controlled to rotate based on the first joint torque,  so that the legged robot reaches the anti-joint mechanical limit of the anti-joint standing state. By adopting the method,  the stable switching of different states of the foot type robot can be improved 1. A motion control method of foot-type robot,  wherein the method comprises :  in response to an anti-joint standing instruction,  the anti-joint standing instruction comprises switching from a normal joint standing state to an anti-joint standing state;  determining the joint initial angle value of the normal joint standard standing state and the mechanical limiting angle value of the reverse joint standing state;  based on the whole body control algorithm,  switching from the normal joint motion state to the normal joint standard standing state;  based on the joint initial angle value,  the mechanical limiting angle value,  determining the first discrete angle value moving from the normal joint standing state to the reverse joint standing state;  based on the joint proportion differential control,  converting the first discrete angle value into a first joint torque,  based on the first joint torque,  controlling the rotation of the thigh motor and the shank motor,  so as to make the foot robot reach the anti-joint mechanical limit of the anti-joint standing state.

A robot control circuit,  wherein it is applied to a robot,  the robot comprises a steering engine,  the circuit comprises a lifting detection module,  a main control module and a steering engine control module,  the lifting detection module is electrically connected with the main control module,  the main control module is electrically connected with the steering engine control module :  the lifting detecting module comprises a double-foot travel limiting switch,  if the switch state of the double-foot travel limiting switch is disconnected,  the lifting detecting module is used for sending an abnormal signal to the main control module;  the main control module is used for sending the closing signal to the steering engine control module when receiving the abnormal signal;  the steering engine control module is used for controlling the power supply loop between the steering engine and the battery to cut off when receiving the closing signal.

The invention discloses a foot structure of a humanoid robot and the robot The foot structure includes a foot bone,  a data processing circuit board,  and a sole The foot bone includes a skeleton,  four one-dimensional force sensors and a fixing plate,  and the four one-dimensional force sensors are fixed on the main skeleton through the fixing plate; the data processing circuit board realizes the collection and processing of one-dimensional force sensor information and the prediction of ZMP; the sole includes an aluminum substrate,  an EVA buffer layer and a rubber anti-slip sole. According to the invention,  the foot bone part is optimally designed by referring to the humanoid foot skeleton structure,  so that the strength and the attractiveness of the foot are ensured,  and the quality of the whole foot is effectively reduced; a one-dimensional force sensor is selected and reasonably fixed inside the foot,  and an independent data processing circuit board is designed to ensure efficient foot pressure information collection,  effectively reduce production costs,  and improve the maintainability of the circuit system; the three layers of brand-new plantar effectively improve the impact resistance and stability of the robot,  protecting the sensors while reducing maintenance costs. 1. A foot structure of humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises a foot bone (1),  a first one-dimensional force sensor (3),  a second one-dimensional force sensor (4),  a third one-dimensional force sensor (5),  a fourth one-dimensional force sensor (6),  a fixing plate (7),  a data processing circuit board (2),  an aluminium substrate (8),  an EVA buffer layer (9) and a rubber skid-proof bottom (11);  the foot bone (1) is fixedly set on the upper side of the data processing circuit board (2);  an aluminium substrate (8),  an EVA buffer layer (9) and a rubber skid-proof bottom (11) are fixedly set on the lower side of the data processing circuit board (2) back to the foot bone (1);  the first one-dimensional force sensor (3),  the second one-dimensional force sensor (4),  the third one-dimensional force sensor (5) and the fourth one-dimensional force sensor (6) are arranged in the circular groove,  and fixed on the main frame through the fixing plate (7),  so as to monitor the foot pressure distribution condition in real time.

The invention provides a fully flexible multi-modal high spatio-temporal resolution visual touch sensor,  which has multi-modal and high spatio-temporal resolution tactile perception capabilities and fully flexible contact and flexible operation capabilities. Its structure mainly includes a flexible sensing module with integrated structure sensing,  a lighting module,  a wireless module,  a mechanical connection module and a battery module. The invention has a fully flexible integrated structural design of the sensing structure,  and has the advantages of strong compliance,  convenient operation,  and high integration; the multi-modal tactile perception ability that integrates piezoelectricity and vision at the same time will provide the robot with multi-modal tactile perception ability with high spatiotemporal resolution,  which can realize the perception of surface texture,  contact force and vibration; the design of wireless transmission and built-in power supply further improves the integration and convenience of use of the sensor,  and can be widely used in a variety of robot end effectors including humanoid robot hands. 1. A full-flexible multi-modal high space-time resolution visual tactile sensor,  wherein it comprises :  a flexible sensing module composed of a transparent flexible silica gel body,  a non-transparent diffuse reflection film and a surface mechanical function film for providing flexible deformation and structure support as a sensor;  a lighting module composed of programmable LEDs and directly integrally formed in the flexible silica gel body for regulating and controlling the distribution,  wavelength and intensity of the lighting light field;  a piezoelectric sensing module composed of a piezoelectric film,  an electrode and a lead for sensing the stress;  an image collecting module composed of a micro-embedded camera module for collecting the visual signal;  a wireless module,  comprising an image interface circuit,  a piezoelectric signal collecting circuit,  a wireless communication module,  an IO port and an electric interface,  for controlling the light source,  transmitting the control instruction and the collected image and piezoelectric signal;  a battery module composed of a lithium battery with high energy density and used for providing electric energy for the illumination module and the image collecting module;  a mechanical connecting module for connecting the flexible measuring head and the rigid structure at the tail end of the mechanical claw and providing a mounting and containing space for the wireless collecting module and the power supply;  The flexible sensing module takes the mechanical connecting module as the substrate,  integrates the piezoelectric module,  the illuminating module and the image collecting module integrally into the uniform flexible and transparent silica gel,  and coats the uniform reflecting coating and the mechanical functional coating on the surface.

The invention provides a biped robot motion planning method and device based on linear sequential logic. The method includes :  step S1 :  modeling the map environment in which the biped robot moves according to the adjacency matrix and attribute matrix to obtain the map environment. directed graph; step S2 :  Search a trajectory that satisfies the objective function that minimizes the energy and time consumed by the bipedal robot to reach the target position based on the directed graph; step S3 :  Determine the linear sequential logic specification of the bipedal robot based on the trajectory,  and output the motion sequence ms of the bipedal robot. In order to solve the problems in the prior art that the algorithm for solving the motion trajectory of the robot is complex and the efficiency is low 1. A biped robot motion planning method based on linear time sequence logic,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 (S1) :  modelling the map environment moved by the biped robot according to the adjacent matrix and the attribute matrix to obtain the directed graph of the map environment;  step S2 :  based on the directed graph,  searching a track of a target function satisfying the minimum energy and time consumed by the biped robot to reach the target position;  step S3 :  based on the track,  determining the linear time sequence logic standard of the biped robot,  and outputting the motion sequence mS of the biped robot.

Various embodiments of the present technology generally relate to robotic devices,  artificial intelligence,  and computer vision. More specifically,  some embodiments relate to an imaging process for detecting failure modes in a robotic motion environment. In one embodiment,  a method of detecting failure modes in a robotic motion environment comprises collecting one or more images of a multiple scenes throughout a robotic motion cycle. we propose a method for monitoring and managing rotator-cuff (RC) tendon strains during human-robot collaborative shoulder rehabilitation. By integrating a high- resolution biomechanical model with a collaborative industrial robot arm and an impedance controller,  we provide feedback to prevent patients from assuming unsafe poses. The biomechanical model estimates RC tendon strain based on shoulder configuration,  muscle activation,  and external forces. Personalized strain maps are created to capture the relationship between RC strains and shoulder movement. Unsafe zones,  indicating high-strain regions,  are identified through clustering and ellipse fitting,  and these zones inform the parameters of the impedance controller for real-time safety control. This method supports safe patient-led and teleoperated movements,  with a physical therapist leading remotely via a haptic device. Validated through experiments,  our approach demonstrates safe shoulder joint torques under 1 Nm during free motion,  with higher torques only when patients push against the unsafe boundary or resist during teleoperation.

The present invention introduces a dynamic robot stability control system that incorporates an advanced method,  controller,  and storage solution to enhance the stability and agility of dynamic robots,  particularly humanoid robots. The system employs a sophisticated method for real-time analysis of sensor data to dynamically adjust the robot's movements for improved stability and balance. A specialized controller interprets sensor inputs and generates precise control signals for the robot's actuators,  utilizing complex algorithms for stability control. Furthermore,  an integrated storage solution efficiently stores and retrieves data necessary for stability control algorithms,  ensuring optimal performance even in resource-constrained environments. This innovative system significantly enhances the stability,  agility,  and overall performance of dynamic robots across various applications,  ranging from industrial automation to advanced humanoid robotics. Disclosed herein is a comprehensive robot balance control system comprising a method,  a controller,  and a computer-readable storage medium. The method involves several steps aimed at ensuring optimal balance and stability of a humanoid robot during motion. Initially,  the method adjusts a planned motion trajectory to match the current motion status by performing parameter adaptation adjustments. Subsequently,  it determines desired state parameters for the soles,  centroid,  and waist of the robot,  aligning them with the desired motion trajectory. Based on this information and the current motion status,  the method calculates a set of desired driving parameters that fulfill various requirements including robot dynamics,  sole control,  centroid control,  waist control,  and force distribution constraints. Finally,  the controller utilizes these desired driving parameters to control the movement of the humanoid robot,  ensuring balance and stability throughout its motion. The accompanying computer-readable storage medium stores necessary data and instructions for implementing this balance control method effectively. This system represents a significant advancement in robot stability control,  particularly for humanoid robots,  with potential applications in diverse fields including industrial automation and robotics research.

Soft robotics is a burgeoning field at the intersection of engineering,  materials science,  and biology,  offering unprecedented opportunities for developing robots with flexible and adaptive,  mechanisms. Recent research has pushed the boundaries of soft robotics,  introducing novel fabrication techniques,  advanced control algorithms,  and biomimetic designs. These developments have led to the creation of soft grippers,  actuators,  and wearable devices with unprecedented capabilities. Furthermore,  interdisciplinary collaborations with biologists and material scientists have unlocked new insights into the mechanics and behaviors of soft systems,  inspiring innovative solutions for real-world challenges. Looking ahead,  the future of soft robotics holds immense promise. Researchers are exploring applications in minimally invasive surgery,  rehabilitation therapy,  and disaster response,  where the ability to navigate confined spaces and interact gently with the environment is paramount. By continuing to push the boundaries of flexibility and adaptability,  soft robotics is poised to revolutionize the way we interact with machines and the world around us.

Embodiments of the present application provide a method for guiding vehicles to travel,  a map generation method for intersections,  related systems,  and storage media. The method comprises the following steps of :  generating M lane topological curves according to obstacles and lane lines in an intersection,  a driving-in road of the intersection,  a driving-out road of the intersection,  wherein the lane topological curves take the tail end of a driving-in lane of the driving-in road and the starting point of a driving-out lane of the driving-out road as end points; perform rationality detection processing on the M lane topology curves to obtain K 'lane topology curves,  where K' is not greater than M; when the vehicle is located on the incoming road,  a target path is determined from the K 'lane topology curves. The complete and reasonable lane topology curve generated by this solution is more in line with human driving habits,  can provide corresponding navigation guidance information for vehicles during autonomous driving,  and effectively improves the humanoid trajectory and traffic efficiency of vehicles passing through the intersection. 1. The invention discloses an automatic evaluation method and system for classroom teaching quality in colleges and universities,  and relates to the technical field of classroom quality evaluation. The method comprises the following steps of :  presenting the change of a humanoid area in a classroom space model through a classroom teaching video to obtain a moving track and verification information; capture action information,  facial orientation,  language text content and speech information according to time series visual feature set and time series audio feature set respectively; expand the original source time series feature segments according to the relationship between different original source time series feature segments; combine the interactive behaviors with high probability of occurrence into an interactive behavior conjecture set; according to the expanded original source time series feature segments,  feature fusion is carried out to determine the interactive quality index reflected by the interactive behavior,  and the classroom teaching quality is determined based on the classroom teaching type. According to the invention,  the precision and the accuracy of classroom teaching quality evaluation are improved,  and the reliability of teaching quality evaluation is ensured 1. An automatic evaluation method for classroom teaching quality in universities,  wherein it comprises :  constructing a classroom space model according to the classroom space structure information,  collecting the physical state information of the teacher and the student,  and constructing a human-shaped area corresponding to each person in the classroom space model according to the physical state information of the teacher and the student,  presenting the change of the human-shaped area in the classroom space model through the classroom teaching video,  and obtaining the moving track and checking information of each person;  checking the action information and the face orientation based on the checking information of each person,  determining the time sequence action set,  the time sequence face orientation set and the time sequence language text content set of the teacher and the student,  and judging between the teacher and the student,  the occurrence probability of the interaction behaviour between the student and the student and between the teacher and the teacher combines the interaction behaviour with high occurrence probability into an interaction behaviour guessing set,  determining the combination of different secondary characteristics corresponding to each interaction behaviour in the interaction behaviour guessing set; The invention provides a method,  system,  equipment and storage medium for adjusting lighting based on passenger flow. The method includes :  based on the mapping relationship between the lighting equipment group set in each lighting area and the image acquisition equipment; each image acquisition device performs humanoid recognition in the illuminated area; when the humanoid recognition is successful,  the lighting device group that has a mapping relationship with the image acquisition device is maintained to light up. The invention can automatically predict the path and light the lighting equipment of the next node in advance according to the movement trajectory of personnel,  thereby optimizing the lighting environment,  ensuring safety and improving humanized experience. 1. A method for adjusting illumination based on passenger flow,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S110,  presetting multiple illumination areas,  establishing a path node network based on the position relation,  wherein each illumination area is used as an independent path node;  S120,  based on the mapping relationship between the lighting device set in each lighting area and the image collecting device,  based on the historical data collected by the image collecting device and the path node network,  generating the historical motion track of each user in the path node network;  S130,  each image collecting device identifies the human shape in the illumination area;  S140,  when the human shape identification is successful,  keeping lighting the lighting device group with mapping relation with the image collecting device;  S150,  performing face recognition on the illumination area where at least one human shape is located;  obtaining a part of historical motion tracks within the same preset time period in the historical motion tracks of the user corresponding to the face identification currently collected;  after passing through the current path node in the history motion track of the user corresponding to the face identification,  identifying the other path node corresponding to the image collecting device of the image as the node to be selected;  counting the times summation of the appearance of the portrait in each node to be selected based on the historical motion track;  sequencing the node to be selected with the total times from more to less,  taking the node to be selected with the highest sequencing as the next path node of the user,  executing the step S170;  S170,  lighting the lighting device group corresponding to the next path node in real time.

The invention belongs to the field of intelligent control of robots,  and discloses an optimal gait control method,  system,  equipment and storage medium for a biped robot,  which includes :  obtaining the walking needs of the biped robot; based on the walking requirements of the bipedal robot,  several optimal gait parameters of the bipedal robot are obtained through particle swarm method combined with local search mechanism in different walking modes; training a generative adversarial network through the optimized gait parameters to obtain a gait parameter generation model; the control gait parameters of the biped robot are generated through the gait parameter generation model,  and the biped robot is controlled to walk according to the control gait parameters of the biped robot. It effectively avoids the problem that intelligent algorithms are easy to fall into local optimal solutions,  and can effectively control different walking modes. The bipedal robot can freely switch walking modes,  which can be applied to changing movements and achieve the effect of adaptive walking. 1. An optimal gait control method for biped robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the walking requirement of the biped robot;  based on the walking requirement of the biped robot,  the particle swarm method is combined with the local searching mechanism under different walking modes to obtain several optimal gait parameters of the biped robot;  generating an adversarial network through the several optimal gait parameter training,  obtaining a gait parameter generation model;  generating the control gait parameter of the biped robot through the gait parameter generation model,  and controlling the biped robot to walk according to the control gait parameter of the biped robot.

The present teachings relate to methods,  systems,  media,  and embodiments for lane planning for autonomous vehicles Receive sensor data that captures a ground image of the road on which the autonomous vehicle is located Based on the sensor data,  the current lane of the road currently occupied by the autonomous vehicle is detected According to the driving lane control model,  lane control for autonomous vehicles is planned based on the detected current lane and its own perceptual performance parameters. The self-aware performance parameter is used to predict the operating performance of the autonomous vehicle based on the current position of the autonomous vehicle The driving lane control model is generated based on recorded human driving data,  thereby achieving human-like lane control behavior in different scenarios. 1. A method,  comprising :  receiving a plurality of driving lane control models,  each of the plurality of driving lane control models being derived based on recorded human driving data associated with a plurality of persons under a plurality of different driving conditions;  receiving a set of visual images derived from the real-time sensor data indicative of the surface of the road on which the automatic vehicle is located;  detecting the lane of the road on which the automatic vehicle is located based on the set of visual images and at least one lane detection model based on machine learning;  based on the current driving condition associated with the current position of the automatic vehicle,  selecting a driving lane control model from the plurality of driving lane control models,  the current driving condition is determined based on the self-perceptual performance parameter of the automatic vehicle,  the self-perceptual performance parameter indicates and predicts at least one of the running performance of the automatic vehicle at the current position;  and based on the lane in which the automatic vehicle is located and the self-perceptual performance parameter,  planning the lane control for the automatic vehicle through the selected driving lane control model to generate the lane planning of the pedestrian-like lane control behaviour under the current driving condition.

The invention discloses a high-speed running planning method for a quadruped robot that considers the external characteristics of the motor Belongs to the field of robots,  the method comprises the following steps of :  by taking the maximum running speed of the quadruped robot as a target,  constructing an optimization model describing a generator of the whole body motion trail of the quadruped robot under the maximum output power of a motor according to the constraint formed by joint limit of the quadruped robot,  the output boundary of the motor,  a whole body dynamics model and the periodic characteristic of the motion trail; calculate joint output capability constraints based on battery voltage; the dynamic parameters and joint output capability constraints are substituted into the optimization model,  and the optimization model is solved through the sequential quadratic optimization method to obtain the whole body motion reference trajectory including gait parameters and leg swing trajectory parameters; control of a quadruped robot based on a whole-body motion reference trajectory. The present invention provides a method for identifying and tracking small targets of a quadruped robot. First,  the surrounding environment data is collected in real time through various sensors mounted on the quadruped robot to ensure comprehensive and accurate perception of the target; preprocessing sensor data,  including denoising,  filtering,  image enhancement,  etc.,  to improve the accuracy of subsequent target recognition; real-time processing of data through deep learning algorithms,  especially convolutional neural networks (CNN); using the trained neural network model,  the multi-thread method is used to cut the image and identify the small target efficiently and accurately; on the basis of target recognition,  a target tracking algorithm is introduced to ensure that the robot can continuously track the position of the target during movement and update the dynamic information of the target in real time. 1. A method for identifying and tracking small target of four-foot robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  using various sensors carried by the four-foot robot to collect the image data of the surrounding environment in real time,  pre-processing the collected image data,  and dividing the area appointed by the image into N area blocks;  step 2 :  the divided N area blocks are input to the YOLO detection module in parallel,  the multi-thread method is used for reasoning,  each detection result is mapped to the original picture,  at the same time,  the detection result of each area block is mapped to the original picture,  so as to ensure the accurate position information of the target;  step 3 :  based on the YOLO detection result,  firstly extracting the corresponding target area in the image,  performing visual characteristic extraction on the detected target through CNN convolution neural network,  extracting the appearance characteristic of the target,  then using these appearance characteristics to calculate the similarity of the target,  using the Hungarian algorithm to perform target association,  matching the target in the current frame with the target selected by the operator,  using Kalman filtering to the matched target,  predicting and updating the position and speed of the tracked target,  if the selected target is not matched,  predicting the target position of the current frame by Kalman filtering;  step 4 :  according to the current position and prediction information of the target,  through the known coordinate of the laser indicator carried by the four-foot robot under the camera coordinate system,  calculating the relative distance (dx,  dy) between the target and the laser indicator under the camera coordinate system,  through the external calibration parameter between the camera and the robot coordinate system,  combining the translation matrix and the rotation matrix of the camera and the robot,  converting the relative distance (dx,  dy) under the camera coordinate system into the relative position (Dx,  Dy) under the robot coordinate system;  step 5 :  By means of the inverse kinematics model,  the joint angle of the robot is solved,  and the joint angle obtained by the inverse kinematics calculation is implemented in the joint system of the robot,  the attitude control of the robot is realized,  so that the machine laser indicator can effectively follow the target.

The present invention relates to an anthropomorphic pedestrian crossing intention recognition method based on time series knowledge graph and cognitive reasoning,  aiming to improve the accuracy,  reliability and generalization of pedestrian crossing intention recognition by an automatic driving system. The method first constructs the required data set,  trains the video description generation model and the four-tuple extraction model,  and establishes a time-series knowledge graph for pedestrian crossing scenes. Then,  using cognitive reasoning technology,  the entity relationships in the temporal knowledge graph are extracted as crossing features and input into the model for training,  and a cognitive reasoning model for crossing scenes is obtained,  and pedestrians' crossing intentions are reasoned and stored. Finally,  the constructed model is applied to real-time scenarios to realize pedestrian crossing intention recognition through anthropomorphic cognitive analogy reasoning technology. This method has significant advantages in improving prediction accuracy,  enhancing system robustness,  and enhancing interpretability,  providing important support for the development of autonomous driving systems. 1. A humanoid pedestrian street crossing intention identification method based on time sequence knowledge map and cognitive reasoning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  using the open source data and the self-collected video data,  establishing a video description generation model to obtain the descriptive text of the video,  constructing a data set suitable for the invention;  S2 :  training the quaternion extracting model,  extracting the quaternion to construct the time sequence knowledge map facing the pedestrian crossing scene;  S3 :  adopting the cognitive reasoning technology,  extracting the hidden characteristic relation in the map and inputting into the reasoning model for training,  optimizing the model according to the training result,  obtaining the cognitive reasoning model aiming at the street crossing scene,  and storing the pedestrian street crossing intention obtained by the model reasoning in the subgraph in the form of quad;  S4 :  collecting the video data of the automatic driving vehicle,  constructing a real-time map for pedestrian intention identification;  S5 :  constructing anthropomorphic cognitive analogy reasoning technology,  using graph matching algorithm,  matching the real-time graph with the sub-graph in the time sequence knowledge graph,  so as to find the sub-graph with the highest similarity,  extracting the sub-graph pedestrian crossing intention as the current pedestrian crossing intention,  finishing the identification flow.

The invention belongs to the technical field related to the inverse kinematics algorithm of anthropomorphic robotic arms. It discloses a method for solving the inverse anthropomorphic kinematics of redundant robotic arms based on the human musculoskeletal model,  which includes the following steps :  (1) To minimize the muscle Construct the objective equation for loss; (2) Use the analytical IK algorithm in the position domain to calculate the inverse solution qs of the joint angle,  map qs to the initial value qind of the numerical IK solution,  and then use the LM method to optimize the solution of the joint angle q,  and use q as the initial value of the local optimal solution; (3) Conduct a local optimization search based on the initial value of the arm joint angle q until the termination criterion is met,  and select the optimal result among all current local optimal values as the global optimal solution qopt; (4) Establish a mapping between the musculoskeletal model and the anthropomorphic robotic arm through the swing angle of the arm,  and then map the obtained global optimal solution to the kinematic model of the robotic arm to determine the anthropomorphic posture of the robotic arm. The invention increases the sense of security and comfort of the robotic arm and improves the efficiency of human-computer interaction. 1. A road gate vehicle traffic detection method based on visual target identification,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step S1,  establishing feature type templates of different target types;  step S2,  shooting the road gate video by the camera;  step S3,  using H265 code,  dividing the grid of the image frame of the video according to the set mode,  each grid is called grid unit;  step S4,  recording the grid unit where the target is located,  and performing characteristic matching according to the characteristic type template;  step S5,  according to the characteristic matching result,  identifying the type of the moving target currently passing through the road gate;  step S6,  according to the continuous change of the grid,  judging whether there is multi-target continuous passing and target retention condition,  performing corresponding gate control decision and/or reminding decision.

A four-foot robot motion control method based on voice interaction,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining a voice signal;  identifying and analyzing the obtained voice signal to obtain a voice control signal;  based on the obtained voice control signal,  starting the voice control module in the four-foot robot,  processing the obtained voice control signal to obtain the control instruction;  according to the obtained control instruction,  setting the corresponding parameter,  transmitting the parameter to the four-foot robot WBC solver,  wherein the WBC solver is a robot motion control algorithm,  the corresponding joint torque is solved by the WBC,  position and speed command,  realizing the voice control of different motion states of the four-foot robot;  The different motion states are roughly divided into four types :  basic movement,  gait switching,  autonomous movement and emergency escape;  the switching between different gait states can be directly switched without buffer;  before obtaining the voice signal,  it needs to set the voice wake-up word for waking up the four-foot robot to perform voice identification,  waking up the four-foot robot based on the set voice wake-up word,  issuing a command to the four-foot robot to obtain the voice signal;  in the process of obtaining the voice signal,  collecting the voice signal through the microphone array set on the robot;  after awakening,  the microphone array determines the direction of the main microphone and collects the voice instruction;  after the motion instruction is finished,  refreshing the main microphone direction of the microphone module.

This article combines the scientific domains of robot force/torque control,  image processing,  artificial intelligence,  robot programming,  and human-robot communication to propose an interdisciplinary method to creating a robot demonstrator. In this sense,  we decided to use a robot manipulator to play against a person in the game tic tac toe,  sometimes referred to as noughts and crosses or Xs and Os. Subsequently,  the robot manoeuvre was programmed by artificial intelligence,  involving the use of force control throughout the drawing process on the whiteboard. The robot system that is being described is suitable for instructing pupils in many subjects and may be scaled based on the level of complexity. The final demonstrator not only educates students but also offers an appealing situation to encourage students to pursue careers in robotics. The outcomes of creating an experiential learning activity (ELA) with ROBOTS—learning robots built on Arduino cores—are the main topic of this study. Unlike traditional teaching-learning methods,  ELAs provide students the opportunity to work with practical applications and gain a deeper understanding of the fundamental ideas. The students were able to learn about robot arm placement,  tolerating while positioning,  sensor location,  and comprehending hysteresis through the use of scaffolding tactics in this ELA. A simple yet effective game to help with this knowledge development is TIC-T AC-TOE. In addition to the fundamental board game,  the ELA was given several extra characteristics,  which led to the development of other sensorics concepts. In the ELA,  motivation,  cooperation,  and application were also practiced in addition to other transversal competencies.

The invention discloses a method for counting the number of people entering and exiting through humanoid detection and speed calculation,  which includes the following processes :  (1) selecting a detection area in a video; (2) Perform humanoid detection on the first frame among the two adjacent selected frames; (3) Use the dense optical flow method to calculate the average displacement vector of each pedestrian in the detection area; (4) Calculate reference data for video samples; (5) Calculate the proportion N of a single pedestrian passing based on the average displacement vector of each pedestrian and the reference data of the video sample; (6) Calculate the total proportion of all pedestrians passing in the detection area,  that is,  the number of people passing. The method for counting the number of people entering and exiting provided by the invention has the advantages that the video is not required to be processed frame by frame,  the requirement on hardware performance is reduced,  the motion track of each pedestrian is not required to be tracked,  the method can be used under the conditions that the video quality is not high and the pedestrian detection rate is limited,  and the requirement on the video quality is reduced 1.  (2) performing human shape detection on the first frame in the selected two adjacent frames;  (3) performing dense optical flow calculation on the two adjacent frames of images taken at each time of processing,  obtaining a corresponding optical flow pattern,  and then combining the position information obtained by human shape detection with the optical flow pattern to obtain the average displacement vector of each pedestrian in the detection area,  recording the average light flow of the average displacement vector in the in-out direction as f average,  wherein f average and t difference satisfy f average = k*v*t difference,  wherein v is the moving speed of the pedestrian along the in-out direction,  k is the proportional coefficient of the average light flow f average and the pedestrian in the t difference along the in-out direction,  Therefore,  v=f mean/(k*t difference);  when calculating the average displacement vector of the pedestrian,  accumulating the position vector of the position area same as the pedestrian position area detected by the human shape in the light flow graph,  dividing the accumulated value by the pixel number of the area to obtain the average displacement vector of the pedestrian;  (4) collecting the video sample at the same sampling speed as the actual processing video to calculate the total displacement length S of the pedestrian passing through the selected detection area,  the average time t sample average and average speed v sample average,  wherein S total = v sample average * t sample average,  according to the process of (1)-(3) to obtain v sample average = f sample average/(k*t difference),  then S total = v sample average * t sample average = f sample average/(k*t difference) * t sample average;  (5) assuming that the total length of the detection area along the in-out direction is S total,  every time the pedestrian moves S total,  even if it passes one person,  when the pedestrian moves S total,  it is considered that S total/S total is passed,  that is,  N=S total/S total is the proportion of single pedestrian passing in the detection area,  wherein S = v*t = f mean/(k*t difference) * t,  then N=S mean/S total = f mean * t mean/(f sample mean * t sample mean);  (6) accumulating the passing proportion N calculated by each pedestrian obtained by the human shape detection to obtain the total number of people Sigma N passed by this detection.

The invention discloses a ground detection method and a ground detection device for a foot type robot. PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED :  To implement an environment warping approach in order to improve a robustness of contact-aware robot trajectory optimization by a change of coordinates from an ambient space to a flat space.
SOLUTION :  The disclosed method warps the ambient space of a curved terrain to a warped space with a flat terrain using an optimized mapping function. A contact-aware trajectory optimization procedure is then formulated in the warped space under a set of geometrical and physical constraints with decision variables pulled back from the ambient space to the warped flat space. The decision variables are parameterized using high-order spines with a set of control parameters which are optimized in the warped space in order to generate the gait trajectory in the ambient space. For example,  an objective function and constraint functions from the ambient space are pushed back to the warped space while force and rotational variables are pushed forward from the warped space to the ambient space. Such an approach achieves a higher success rate in finding optical solutions.

A high-accuracy method for identifying and removing obstacles on stairs The invention relates to a stair obstacle recognition and elimination combining regional growth and plane structure,  which belongs to the field of stair perception in humanoid robot environment perception,  and solves the problems that stair obstacles destroy the plane characteristics of stairs,  resulting in inaccurate stair parameters obtained by humanoid robots and causing empty stepping and wrestling Firstly,  the point cloud data is preprocessed by combining voxel filtering and straight-through filtering Secondly,  according to the KD-Tree algorithm,  the topological structure of point cloud data is established,  and the normal vector of point cloud is estimated by using the principle of minimizing the sum of projections of adjacent points,  so as to accurately complete the extraction of stair horizontal plane; judging the clustering situation of stair obstacles according to the region growing algorithm,  constructing a plane and analyzing the number of points in the plane to complete the rapid identification and elimination of obstacles; finally,  the three-dimensional parameters of stairs are estimated for stairs with obstacles and stairs with obstacles removed. The invention improves the perception ability of humanoid robots in complex stair environments 1. A high-precision stair obstacle identification and elimination method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  manufacturing multiple obstacles and measuring the stair,  the size of the obstacle and so on information,  using the depth camera to collect the stair environment point cloud;  step 2,  performing point cloud pre-processing by combining voxel filtering and direct-pass filtering algorithm,  filtering background,  obtaining point cloud of stair area;  step 3,  based on the staircase point cloud obtained in the step 2,  using KD tree to store the example point in the point cloud space so as to establish a tree-shaped data structure for quick search,  and extracting the horizontal plane point cloud of the staircase according to the normal vector constraint condition;  step 4,  based on the stair horizontal plane point cloud obtained in step 3,  using the area growth algorithm to perform plane clustering,  the obstacle clustering condition is divided into two types,  one is the obstacle of independent clustering,  the other is the obstacle of non-independent clustering,  step 5,  traversing each clustering plane,  according to the plane clustering result of the step 4,  using clustering point cloud threshold value to remove the obstacle of independent clustering,  constructing plane and using plane point mutation principle to remove the obstacle of non-independent clustering;  step 6,  based on step 5,  obtaining the plane point cloud of the barrier-free stair after removing the obstacle,  using the OBB bounding box method to perform three-dimensional parameter sensing of the stair.

A force-electric characteristic characterization system for humanoid exercise,  wherein it comprises a detection box,  a test system matched with the detection box;  an artificial leg mechanism and an artificial chest mechanism are suspended in the detection box;  a control host for monitoring the working conditions of the artificial leg mechanism and the artificial chest mechanism is arranged outside the detection box;  the artificial leg mechanism comprises a mechanical leg whose one end is fixedly connected with the inner top part of the detection box,  an artificial joint for driving the mechanical leg to swing and a bionic leg skin covered on the outer side of the mechanical leg;  the artificial thoracic cavity mechanism comprises a thoracic cavity mould for expanding and shrinking,  and a bionic thoracic cavity skin covered on the outer side of the thoracic cavity mould;  when testing,  the electronic material to be tested is respectively fixed on the bionic leg skin or/and the bionic thorax skin;  the bionic leg skin or bionic thorax skin comprises a silica gel substrate,  a heating circuit paved on the silica gel substrate and a sweat-discharging simulation mechanism;  the silica gel substrate is attached to the outer side of the mechanical leg or thorax mould;  The test system comprises :  an electrical testing module for detecting the change of one or more of the resistor,  the capacitor or the inductor of the electronic material and outputting the change to the control host;  an action control module for controlling the rotation angle and rotation speed of the artificial joint;  a bionic skin control module for controlling the heating circuit of the bionic leg skin and the bionic thorax skin and the sweat discharging simulation mechanism to work;  a force-temperature-humidity detecting module for recording the working parameters of the artificial leg mechanism and the artificial thorax mechanism and outputting the parameters to the control host.
