The invention provides a three-axis parallel large-posture space humanoid wrist that can be driven by a closed-loop rope of a fixed-length cable. It belongs to the field of robots,  and particularly relates to a humanoid wrist robot; specifically,  it includes three motors,  a static platform,  a moving platform,  three driving rods and three driven rods connected in parallel between the static platform and the moving platform,  three groups of guide components and three pairs of driving ropes; one ends of the three pairs of driving ropes are respectively connected to the output shafts of the three motors,  and the other ends are fixedly connected to the three driving rods through three sets of guide components to form a closed-loop rope drive. Since the wrist of the present invention can maintain the passing cable during movement The length of the cable remains unchanged,  which greatly improves the safety and aesthetics of the cable arrangement. The scheme of the invention can simultaneously meet the advantages of simple structure,  three-axis rotation,  large posture space,  closed-loop rope drive,  simple mathematical model,  etc. 1. A human-imitating wrist capable of driving a three-shaft parallel large-posture space through a closed-loop rope of a fixed-length cable,  belonging to the field of robot,  especially relating to a human-imitating wrist robot;  wherein :  It comprises three motors,  a static platform,  a movable platform,  three driving rods and three driven rods connected between the static platform and the movable platform in parallel,  three groups of guide components and three pairs of driving ropes;  the three driving rods are divided into a first driving rod,  a second driving rod and a third driving rod,  the three driven rods are divided into a first driven rod,  a second driven rod and a third driven rod,  the three motors are divided into a first motor,  a motor two and a motor three,  the three pairs of driving ropes,  each pair is a pair of driving ropes for driving the same rotating joint in a closed ring,  which are divided into a first,  a second,  a third driving rope,  the guide component comprises a guide wheel and a guide hole,  the outer cylindrical surface of the static platform is provided with a winding groove,  the centre of the static platform is provided with a large diameter through hole,  the guide component is installed on the static platform;  the first motor,  the second motor,  the third motor is fixedly connected with the static platform,  one end of the first drive rope is connected with the output shaft of the first motor,  the other end is fixedly connected with the first driving rod after winding on the different sides in the cylindrical surface winding groove of the static platform through the first guide wheel and the first guide hole,  so as to form a closed-loop drive,  the first driving rod is connected with the static platform through the first rotating pair,  the first driven rod is connected with the first driving rod through the fourth rotating pair;  the axes of the first rotating pair,  the second rotating pair and the third rotating pair are overlapped and vertical to the plane of the static platform,  the axes of the first rotating pair,  the second rotating pair,  the third rotating pair,  the fourth rotating pair,  the fifth rotating pair,  the sixth rotating pair,  the seventh rotating pair,  the eighth rotating pair and the ninth rotating pair are crossed at one point and the point is the geometric centre of the movable platform; The invention discloses a two-way deployable wheel-leg robot,  and relates to the field of mobile robots. It includes a robot body,  two deformable wheel-leg structures and a transmission structure. The deformable wheel-leg structures are symmetrically arranged on both sides of the robot body. The transmission structure comprises a rotary driving mechanism and a linear driving mechanism,  wherein the linear driving mechanism is used for driving the deformable wheel leg structure to deform,  so that the deformable wheel leg structure is unfolded into a walking leg state or shrunk into a circular roller wheel shape,  and the rotary driving mechanism drives the deformable wheel leg structure to rotate through a driving shaft so as to realize the advancing or retreating of the robot. The new type of wheel-legged robot that can be deployed in both directions in the present invention Through the deformable wheel leg structure and the transmission structure,  the switching of three movement modes of a wheel type form and two leg type forms can be realized,  so that the robot has the advantages of both wheel type and leg type,  can select appropriate movement modes according to different terrains when performing tasks in complex environments,  and has good adaptability,  high flexibility and strong obstacle surmounting ability. 1. A bidirectional unfolding wheel leg type robot,  wherein it comprises a robot body (1),  a transmission structure (3),  and two deformable wheel leg structures (2) symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the robot body (1);  the transmission structure (3) comprises a rotating driving mechanism and a linear driving mechanism,  the rotating driving mechanism is provided with a driving shaft (36);  the deformable wheel leg structure (2) comprises a rotating sliding block connecting piece (211),  a rotating sliding block (210),  a fixed bracket (22) and a rotating bracket (21),  and the fixed bracket (22) is fixedly connected with the hole shaft of the driving shaft (36);  the deformable wheel leg structure (2) further comprises multiple arc legs (215),  multiple connecting rod assemblies and multiple movable sliding blocks (24);  the rotating bracket (21) is provided with multiple supporting rods one extending in radial direction,  the fixed bracket (22) is provided with multiple supporting rods two extending in radial direction;  the arc leg (215) is respectively hinged with the corresponding supporting rod one and the movable sliding block (24),  and the movable sliding block (24) is slidingly connected with the corresponding supporting rod two;  at the same time,  the movable sliding block (24) is connected with the rotating sliding block (210) through the connecting rod assembly;  the rotating sliding block (210) is rotatably connected with the rotating sliding block connecting piece (211) through the first rolling bearing (29);  wherein the linear driving mechanism is used for driving the rotary slide block connecting piece (211) to axially move,  so that the circular arc leg (215) swings and the deformable wheel leg structure (2) is unfolded into walking leg state or shrunk into circular roller wheel shape;  the rotating driving mechanism through the driving shaft (36) drives the fixed bracket (22),  the arc leg (215) to do rotating movement,  so as to realize the forward or backward of the robot.

Embodiments of the present invention provide an autonomous path planning method for a wheel-legged robot The autonomous path planning and exploration in the unknown environment of the wheel-legged robot is realized,  which includes :  dividing the passable area in the global exploration map and constructing the path evaluation index according to the detection range,  movement ability,  movement state and exploration coverage of the wheel-legged robot sensor; according to the path evaluation index of the wheeled-legged robot,  the sampling points are determined in the local exploration map,  the cost and exploration gain of the path are calculated,  and the connected sampling points are screened out; according to the sampling points generated in the local exploration map,  the local exploration target point and the smooth path in the local exploration map are calculated; according to the global exploration map path evaluation index,  the sampling points are determined within the global exploration map range,  and the exploration path covering the global exploration map is generated. According to the technical solution provided by the embodiment of the present invention,  the autonomous path planning and exploration of the wheeled legged robot in an unknown environment can be realized. 1. An autonomous path planning method of wheel-leg robot,  wherein the method comprises :  according to the motion mode of the wheel leg robot,  the exercise ability and the detection range of the sensor,  the unknown map environment is divided into two parts of a local search map and a global search map,  the area satisfying the exercise ability of the wheeled leg robot is defined as a passable area,  dividing the map into a passable area and a non-passable area of the robot in the global search map range;  determining the path evaluation index in the passable area range according to the movement ability,  the movement state and the exploring coverage range of the wheel and leg robot;  determining the sampling point in the local search map according to the passable area and path evaluation index satisfying the movement ability of the leg robot,  calculating the cost of the path and the search gain,  and screening the connected sampling point;  according to the sampling point generated in the local search map,  calculating to obtain the local search target point and the smooth path in the local search map,  guiding the robot to move from the current position to the local search target point in the unknown environment to finish the autonomous search process in the local map range;  according to the global exploration map path evaluation index of the wheel leg robot,  determining the sampling point within the range of the global exploration map,  generating the global exploration target point and guiding the robot to leave the current local exploration map,  orderly connecting the smooth path in the local exploration map,  A search path covering the global search map is generated.

The invention discloses a substation multi-task fault detection device based on a hexapod robot,  and relates to the field of substation fault detection. The device includes a hexapod robot component,  a central controller,  a data acquisition component,  an active protection component and a fault supervision component; the central controller controls the six-legged robot assembly to perform cruising motion; the active protection component determines the abnormal environment state according to the temperature distribution data,  road condition image and obstacle distance of the environment,  and generates an adjustment command to adjust the movement of the hexapod robot component; fault supervision component :  determine the corona discharge level of the insulator in the substation based on the UV imaging data of the target inspection substation,  and generate a first fault warning when the discharge level is higher than the preset discharge level; when any temperature value in the temperature distribution data of the target inspection substation is not within the first preset temperature threshold range,  a second fault warning is generated. The invention can autonomously execute multi-task fault inspection of the substation and obtain accurate detection results. 1. A substation multi-task fault detection device based on six-foot robot,  wherein the device comprises a six-foot robot assembly,  a central controller,  a data collecting assembly,  an active protection assembly and a fault monitoring assembly;  the central controller,  the data collecting component and the active protection component are arranged in the six-foot robot component;  the central controller is respectively connected with the six-foot robot assembly,  the data collecting assembly and the active protection assembly;  the data collecting component is used for :  collecting the ultraviolet imaging data and the temperature distribution data of the target polling substation,  the temperature distribution data of the environment where the six-foot robot assembly is located,  the road condition image and the barrier distance;  the central controller is configured to :  determining a global cruise motion instruction according to a preset global cruise path;  determining a local cruise motion instruction according to the road condition image;  sending the global cruise motion instruction and the local cruise motion instruction to the six-foot robot assembly to control the six-foot robot assembly to perform cruise motion;  transmitting the temperature distribution data,  road condition image and barrier distance of the environment where the six-foot robot component is located to the active protection component,  transmitting the ultraviolet imaging data and temperature distribution data of the target inspection substation to the fault monitoring component;  wherein the preset global cruise path includes a plurality of target cruise substations;  the priority of the local cruise motion instruction is higher than that of the global cruise motion instruction;  The active protection component is used for :  determining the abnormal environment state according to the temperature distribution data,  the road condition image and the barrier distance of the environment where the six-foot robot assembly is located;  generating an adjusting instruction according to the abnormal environment state and sending the adjusting instruction to the six-foot robot component so as to adjust the movement of the six-foot robot component;  the priority of the adjusting instruction sent to the six-foot robot component by the active protection component is higher than the motion instruction sent to the six-foot robot component by the central controller;  the fault monitoring component is used for :  based on the pre-constructed electricity-light conversion transfer function,  according to the ultraviolet imaging data of the target inspection substation,  determining the corona discharge level of any insulator in the target inspection substation;  generating a first fault warning when the corona discharge level of any insulator is higher than the preset discharge level;  when any temperature value in the temperature distribution data of the target polling substation is not in the first preset temperature threshold range,  generating a second fault alarm.

This application discloses a coal mine underground scene reconstruction system and method. The coal mine underground scene reconstruction system includes :  a multi-source fusion sensor installed on a foot-type robot and used to collect data when the foot-type robot travels along a preset travel route. Scene spatial data and visual monitoring data of underground operating scenes; an edge intelligent computing terminal connected to the multi-source fusion sensor,  used to construct a navigation map based on the scene spatial data and visual monitoring data,  and perform digital reconstruction of the coal mine underground scene based on the navigation map and the scene spatial data. This application can make full use of the complex terrain adaptability of the legged robot to assist in digital reconstruction of multiple scenes in coal mines,  conduct comprehensive,  accurate and intelligent monitoring of coal mine underground scenes,  effectively promote the construction of transparent mines,  and reduce manual labor intensity. 1. A coal mine underground scene reconstruction system,  wherein it comprises :  a multi-source fusion sensor,  installed on the foot-type robot,  for collecting the scene space data and visual monitoring data of the underground operation scene when the foot-type robot travels along the preset travel route,  wherein the scene space data comprises the environment data around the foot-type robot,  the visual monitoring data comprises the operation equipment in the underground operation scene and the operation data thereof;  an edge intelligent calculating terminal connected with the multi-source fusion sensor for constructing a navigation map according to the scene space data and the visual monitoring data,  and digitally reconstructing the coal mine underground scene based on the navigation map and the scene space data.

The invention discloses an abnormal behavior monitoring method and terminal Determine whether it is a bathroom through scene recognition If not,  then extract the key point coordinates corresponding to the key points of the object to be analyzed in the time series from the multi-frame images in the surveillance video Input all key point coordinates into the trained improved VGGNet ‑ SVM model for behavior recognition Get the recognition result,  if it has abnormal behavior,  then use abnormal behavior prevention methods to process the recognition results If so,  perform speech recognition on the speech data in the collected surveillance video To determine whether abnormal behavior occurs,  when the frequency of keywords in the voice data reaches the preset threshold,  a prompt message will occur to remind the monitoring staff to focus on it,  and a special recognition method will be used for special scenarios,  so as to identify abnormal behavior in a timely and accurate manner. 1. An abnormal behaviour monitoring method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  collecting the monitoring video of the object to be analyzed and obtaining the multi-frame image from the monitoring video;  performing scene recognition according to the multi-frame image to obtain a scene recognition result;  judging whether the scene recognition result is toilet,  if not,  extracting the key point coordinate corresponding to the key point of the object to be analyzed on the time sequence for the multi-frame image;  inputting all the key point coordinates of the multi-frame image into the trained improved VGGNet-SVM model to perform behaviour identification to obtain the identification result;  if there is abnormal action in the identification result,  using the abnormal action prevention method to process the identification result;  if so,  collecting voice data from the monitoring video;  extracting keywords from the voice data according to a preset keyword database;  calculating the occurrence frequency of the key word,  and judging whether the occurrence frequency of the key word reaches the preset threshold value,  if so,  sending the prompt information to the monitoring worker of the monitoring video.

The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing passenger flow passing through a store based on humanoid tracking. The method comprises the following steps of :  receiving an external monitoring video of the store as input,  and performing video decoding and frame extraction to obtain a focus image set; use deep neural network algorithm to perform target detection on the focus image collection to identify pedestrians in the store entrance area and obtain the humanoid image collection; the DeepSORT multi-target tracking algorithm is used to track the humanoid image collection,  and each humanoid image in the humanoid image collection is matched to a tracking object in the store's external surveillance video; statistics of the passenger flow passing through the store entrance area within a specific time N. The invention has the advantages of high efficiency and accuracy,  strong real-time performance,  low cost and visual processing of data It provides store operators with a powerful tool to help them make critical business decisions and optimize operations. 1. A method for analyzing store passenger flow based on human shape tracking,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  (1) receiving a store external monitoring video as an input,  performing video decoding and frame extraction to obtain a focused image set;  (2) using the deep neural network algorithm to perform target detection on the key attention image set,  so as to identify the pedestrian in the shop door area,  obtaining the human-shaped image set;  (3) using DeepSORT multi-target tracking algorithm to track the human-shaped image set,  matching each human-shaped image in the human-shaped image set to one tracking object in the shop external monitoring video;  and (4) counting the passenger flow passing through the doorway area of the shop in the special time N.

The invention discloses a camera and personnel identification correlation method in a mine high-risk operation scene,  and relates to the field of mine operation scene monitoring Through the work ticket and monitoring equipment association module,  taking video surveillance data,  personnel positioning data,  operator information and work ticket information as input data Integrate video analysis and logo analysis,  realize the dynamic association between job tickets and monitoring equipment Rely on the position information of the operating point to obtain the grid position code corresponding to the operating point Then filter out the list of cameras whose monitoring range covers this location code Finally,  relying on the humanoid,  portrait,  and number of people recognition technology based on video images,  the above camera list is filtered twice,  and the camera monitoring points are associated with the operating points from the dimensions of close range,  long range,  etc. based on application requirements to achieve remote visibility of the operating site situation.,  to support targeted management and control and early warning functions of the operation process 1. A method for associating camera with personnel identification in mine high risk operation scene,  wherein the video monitoring data,  personnel positioning data,  personnel information and operation ticket information are used as input data through the operation ticket,  monitoring device association module,  fusion video analysis,  the identification analysis,  realizing the dynamic association of the job ticket and the monitoring device,  the technical route of the dynamic association of the job ticket and the monitoring device is as follows :  (1) for the two-dimensional space in the working area range,  defining the grid with fixed length and fixed width,  and orderly giving the unique position code;  (2) assigning a unique device code to the video monitoring device in the operation area,  collecting information thereof,  including longitude,  latitude,  elevation,  pitch angle,  focal length,  pixel size and visual angle range data;  (3) taking the height and pitching angle of the video monitoring device as input,  calculating the coverage range of each monitoring point in the two-dimensional grid space;  (4) combining the image identification analysis algorithm,  optimizing the coverage range of each monitoring point,  removing the invalid grid;  (5) selecting the available monitoring point position list from the position code of the working point and the position code information of the working staff;  (6) adopting the human shape,  human image,  number identification technology based on picture,  filtering the monitoring device list,  further screening the high risk operation best monitoring point position;  a series of selectable monitoring device lists can be obtained,  the number of people observed by the monitoring device is sorted from small to large,  and the monitoring device with the largest number of people can be selected as the long-range monitoring device;  The size of the human shape that can be observed by the monitoring device is sorted,  the seat close-range monitoring device with the largest human shape that can be observed is selected,  at last,  the average score of each camera is calculated by using the self-defined weighted average formula,  the monitoring device with the highest score is the optimal,  and the calculation formula of the priority score of the monitoring point is as follows :  wherein f1 represents the number of people that can be observed by the monitoring device;  f2 represents the human shape size observed by the monitoring device;  α β is the weighted value,  the value range is [0,  1],  and α + β = 1;  when alpha is equal to and beta is equal to ,  the priority fraction of the monitoring point uses the human shape size observed by the monitoring device as the reference,  the larger the human shape is observed,  the higher the image fineness is,  the higher the corresponding priority is,  namely the near-view monitoring point position;  when alpha is equal to and beta is equal to ,  the priority fraction of the monitoring point position is only referenced by the number of people observed by the monitoring device,  the more the number of people can be observed,  the higher the corresponding priority is,  namely the long-range monitoring point position,  the value of alpha beta should comprehensively consider the field environment of the high risk operation point and the software and hardware condition of the monitoring device;  In summary,  the grid position code corresponding to the operation point is obtained according to the position information of the operation point,  so as to screen the camera list in which the monitoring range covers the position code,  at last,  according to the human shape based on the video image,  the human image,  the camera monitoring point position is associated with the working point from the dimensionality of the near view and the far view according to the application requirement so as to realize the remote visual of the working field condition and support the pertinence management and control and pre-warning function of the working process.

A video matting method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  encoding the initial video to obtain a video code stream and dividing the video code stream into three paths;  reducing the resolution of the first path of video code stream to obtain the low resolution code stream,  and extracting the global characteristic data in the low resolution code stream;  performing multi-scale pool analysis to the second path of video code stream and extracting the local characteristic data in the second path of video code stream;  fusing the global characteristic data and the local characteristic data to obtain low-resolution characteristic data;  decoding the low-resolution characteristic data and the local characteristic data to obtain a low-resolution video,  wherein the low-resolution video comprises a human-shaped area identification result;  processing the third path of video code stream with increased resolution to obtain the high resolution code stream;  extracting the edge feature data in the high-resolution code stream;  decoding the edge characteristic data to obtain a high-resolution video,  wherein the high-resolution video comprises a human-shaped edge identification result;  fusing the human shape area identification result in the low resolution video and the human shape edge identification result in the high resolution video to obtain the human shape matting result in the initial video;  performing a low-resolution decoding process on the low-resolution feature data and the local feature data by a tree graph decoder;  obtaining the human shape area identification result according to the tree shape image prediction result output by the tree shape image decoder;  performing high resolution fine adjustment processing to the edge feature data by an edge detection decoder;  obtaining the human-shaped edge identification result according to the edge prediction result output by the edge detection decoder.

A computer-implemented method when executed by data processing hardware causes the data processing hardware to perform operations. The present invention belongs to the field of robot vision. Specifically,  the invention discloses a humanoid robot real-time grabbing path planning method based on a multimodal model. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  performing zero sample instance segmentation on an environment scene by using a multi-modal deep learning model,  wherein input parameters of the model comprise an origin cloud,  a point cloud subjected to BEV and post-processing,  and a two-dimensional picture,  and semantic features from a word embedding model; The four modal features are interacted and combined with the instance center of the two-dimensional segmentation result to generate the final three-dimensional instance segmentation; S2 calculating coordinates and rotation pose of the object itself by using the segmented three-dimensional instance,  using semantics and the instance of the object to input to generate a rotation vector of the object,  and then performing quaternion calculation; S3 accelerating the point cloud processing by using a quadtree lifting sampling algorithm and an octree point cloud slicing algorithm; S4. making real-time path planning; According to the method,  zero sample segmentation is adopted,  so that the three-dimensional point cloud labeling difficulty is reduced,  and the model has strong generalization capability. 1. A humanoid robot real-time grabbing path planning method based on multimodal model,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  using a multi-modal deep learning model to perform zero sample instance division on the environment scene,  the input parameter of the model has original point cloud,  BEV and post-processed point cloud and two-dimensional picture,  and semantic characteristic from the word embedding model;  four modal characteristics are interacted and combined with the example centre of the two-dimensional division result to generate the final three-dimensional example division;  S2,  calculating the coordinate and rotation pose of the object by the example after the three-dimensional example is divided,  inputting the semantic and the example of the object to generate the rotation vector of the object,  and then calculating the quaternion;  S3,  accelerating the point cloud processing by a four-fork tree lifting sampling algorithm and an eight-fork tree point cloud slicing algorithm;  S4,  performing real-time path planning.

The invention discloses a method and a device for human figure detection. The method comprises the following steps of :  determining images to be detected in a target video,  and for each image to be detected,  determining coordinate information of a human figure in the image to be detected; Wherein,  the number of the to-be-detected images is at least two; Determining a humanoid movement vector according to the humanoid coordinate information in all the images to be detected; Calculating humanoid movement parameters corresponding to the target video based on the humanoid movement vector and all the humanoid coordinate information; Based on the figure movement parameters of the target video,  figure detection information of the target video is generated. Therefore,  the present invention can realize human figure detection in various scenes. The application and popularization degree of human figure detection in various scenes can be improved,  human figure movement parameters can be calculated through existing image information,  the algorithm complexity and the storage resource consumption can be effectively reduced,  the human figure detection efficiency can be improved,  and the human figure detection accuracy can be improved. 1. The invention discloses a spacecraft surface crawling robot capable of automatically sensing movement. The crawling robot comprises a mechanical structure and a control system. The control system adopts hardware such as an embedded microprocessor,  an expansion interface board and the like,  and realizes autonomous movement through sensing,  planning and control. At the same time,  it can be matched with robot gait to control the existence of adsorption force,  and can reduce the moment required for raising legs of robot. Finally,  a dynamic simulation method is proposed to calculate the required adsorption force of the robot and verify the robot's crawling ability. ABSTRACT VOICE CONTROLLED ROBOT The integration of smart devices and robotics has revolutionized human-robot interaction,  shaping various industries and daily life. The project aims to design and implement a compact mobile robot capable of executing voice commands,  identifying specified targets,  and navigating obstacles autonomously. Leveraging the Raspberry Pi platform and Python programming,  the system integrates multiple functionalities like movement control,  obstacle avoidance,  object recognition,  and image processing. Equipped with a camera for real-time surveillance,  the robot employs image processing techniques to identify visitors,  distinguishing between authorized and unauthorized access to a premises. Additionally,  the system employs an automated mailing system to dispatch photos captured by the camera to designated recipients based on visitor validation. The project's novelty lies in its multi-functionality,  encompassing sophisticated obstacle avoidance algorithms,  visitor recognition via computer vision,  and cloud-based communication. The envisioned applications span home automation,  security,  education,  and research,  positioning the voice-controlled robot as a versatile tool for enhancing convenience,  safety,  and human-robot interaction in various domains.

This invention presents a real-time hand-gesture-based human-mobile robot interaction system powered by Raspberry Pi technology.Traditional methods of human-robot interaction often involve complex interfaces or manual controls,  limiting accessibility and user experience. In contrast,  our system enables intuitive and natural communication between humans and mobile robots through hand gestures,  enhancing user engagement and usability. The system accurately interprets real-time hand gestures captured by a Raspberry Pi camera module using computer vision techniques like OpenCV and Mediapipe,  along with TensorFlow-based gesture recognition models. These gestures are then translated into commands to control the movement of the mobile robot. Additionally,  we have incorporated an LED for illumination purposes to improve gesture detection. Overall,  our real-time human-mobile robot interaction system offers an innovative and efficient solution for intuitive communication and control in various robotics applications. The integration of hardware components like motors and GPIO pins with software algorithms ensures seamless interaction and reliable performance.

This research explores the evolving landscape of rehabilitation technology,  driven by the increasing prevalence of chronic conditions and the aging population. Automated rehabilitation systems,  powered by cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence and robotics,  offer the potential for personalized and efficient rehabilitation experiences. The success of these systems,  however,  hinges on the effective design and validation of their user interfaces to meet the diverse needs of users. Emphasizing the critical role of adaptive user interfaces (UI),  the article investigates design principles,  user feedback mechanisms,  and validation strategies. Topics covered include personalization,  responsive feedback,  intuitive navigation,  and gamification elements as essential components of adaptive UI design. The user- centered design process,  encompassing understanding user profiles,  iterative prototyping,  and accessibility considerations,  is highlighted. The technological foundations of adaptive UI,  such as artificial intelligence,  machine learning,  sensor integration,  and human-robot interaction,  are explored. Validation strategies,  including usability testing,  user feedback loops,  quantitative metrics,  and longitudinal studies,  are discussed to ensure the adaptability and sustainability of UI. The article also addresses challenges like ethical considerations,  interdisciplinary collaboration,  integration with clinical practices,  and the potential impact of emerging technologies on the future evolution of adaptive interfaces.

CT scans,  X-Ray,  and MRI scans are the common imaging methods among magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) that are the most reliable and secure. MRI detects every minute objects. Our paper aims to focus on the use of different techniques for the discovery of brain cancer using brain MRI. In this study,  we performed pre-processing using the bilateral filter (BF) for removal of the noises that are present in an MR image. This was followed by the binary thresholding and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) segmentation techniques for reliable detection of the tumor region. Training,  testing,  and validation datasets are used. Based on our machine,  we will predict whether the subject has a brain tumor or not. The resultant outcomes will be examined through various performance examined metrics that include accuracy,  sensitivity,  and specificity. It is desired that the proposed work would exhibit a more exceptional performance over its counterparts.

The invention discloses a repeatable landing buffer control method of a legged robot for a spacecraft,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control. On the premise of protecting the torque at the output end of the driving mechanism,  the landing buffering force required by the leg-foot mechanism is adjusted and provided by utilizing the active driving capability of the joints of the driving mechanism,  so that the load safety of the driving mechanism is protected while the impact kinetic energy is dissipated and the landing buffering is finished,  and the robot can stably and repeatedly finish multiple soft landings. The invention provides an active landing buffer control method of a legged robot for a spacecraft. By using a Cartesian spatial impedance control method based on a sectional parameter system and an application strategy,  a control strategy and a flow are designed,  and by actively controlling the moment of each leg and foot mechanism joint and the detection of the ground contact state,  the dissipation of landing impact energy is realized,  and the landing buffer is completed. 1. A leg-type robot repeatable landing buffer control method for spacecraft,  wherein it comprises :  during the falling process of the robot,  the structure of the leg and foot mechanism is kept unchanged before the robot touches the ground;  judging the number of the foot ends of the touchdown leg and foot mechanism;  when the number of the contacted leg and foot mechanisms is less than the designed value,  judging that the robot is not contacted with the ground,  judging that the robot is in landing state at this time,  the control parameter of the leg and foot mechanism is kept unchanged,  the robot changes the configuration through the foot end displacement of each leg and foot mechanism in the landing direction,  so as to adapt to the rugged terrain state;  when the number of the touched leg and foot mechanisms is equal to the designed value,  judging that the robot is in the best adaptive terrain state at this time,  storing the foot end position of each leg and foot mechanism at this time as the expected foot end position in the landing buffer process,  for the expected recovery state of the landing buffer process thereafter;  when the number of the grounded leg and foot mechanisms is greater than the designed value,  judging that the robot is in the grounded buffer state,  and the control parameter of each leg and foot mechanism is switched to the grounded buffer preset value so as to finish the dissipation kinetic energy and buffer process.

The present invention discloses a humanoid robot gait disturbance-resisting recovery control algorithm. It is characterized by that it adopts a new simplified model :  three-mass flywheel linear inverted pendulum model to describe the kinematics of robot,  and on said model the motion divergence algorithm is improved,  and it only needs to control the essentially unstable portion of motion divergence to implement stable walking; When the robot is interfered by an external force,  a compensation moment is deduced through the motion divergence deviation,  and is applied to the hip joint of the robot,  so that the center of mass of the robot and the track of the motion divergence can be corrected in time in a walking period after collision,  and stable walking under the collision environment is realized. According to the method,  the problem that the motion range of the traditional zero moment point or the pressure center of the robot is limited is fully considered,  a control target is transferred to the hip joint of the robot,  the anti-interference performance of the robot is improved,  and walking of the robot is more intelligent. 1. A human-like robot gait disturbed recovery control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  The motion divergence amount is improved to the three-mass flywheel linear inverted pendulum model to obtain the improved motion divergence amount Xi,  the moment needed by the track deviation caused by the hip joint compensation external force interference is deduced by the improved motion divergence amount Xi,  and the hip joint is controlled to resist interference.

Human Pose Estimation (HPE) is a technique for identifying and categorizing the joints of the human body. It's a method of collecting a set of coordinates for each joint (arm,  head,  torso,  and so on) that can be used to identify a person's positions. The connection between these two locations is referred to as a pair. The scientific community has recently paid a lot of attention to determining a human's 3D stance from a picture or video. The ever-expanding new range of applications (e.g.,  human-robot interaction,  gaming,  and sports performance monitoring) enabled by contemporary technological breakthroughs are the main drivers of this movement. Camera modules with more than three cameras capture human movements and save it as video clips. The Multi-view Matching Module chooses the 2D poses of the same person among all 2D poses and groups them,  while the 2D Pose Detection Module accurately identifies 2D joints in human bodies from video clips. Finally,  the 3D Pose Reconstruction Module converts two-dimensional poses into three-dimensional stances. All of the high-level requirements will be met if the four primary modules listed above perform properly.

Example methods and devices for touch-down detection for a robotic device are described herein. In an example embodiment,  a computing system may receive a force signal due to a force experienced at a limb of a robotic device. The system may receive an output signal from a sensor of the end component of the limb. Responsive to the received signals,  the system may determine whether the force signal satisfies a first threshold and determine whether the output signal satisfies a second threshold. Based on at least one of the force signal satisfying the first threshold or the output signal satisfying the second threshold,  the system of the robotic device may provide a touch-down output indicating touch-down of the end component of the limb with a portion of an environment.

Various embodiments of the present technology generally relate to robotic devices and artificial intelligence. More specifically,  some embodiments relate to a robotic device for picking items from a bin and perturbing items in a bin. The robotic device may include one or more picking elements and one or more perturbation elements for disturbing a present arrangement of items in the bin. In an exemplary embodiment,  a perturbation element comprises a compressed air valve. In some implementations,  the robotic device may also include one or more computer-vision systems. Based on image data from the one or more computer-vision systems,  a strategy for picking up items from the bin is determined. When no strategies with high probability of success exist,  the robotic device may perturb the contents of the bin to create new available pick-up points.

A hydropower station electromechanical device fault pre-warning method based on four-foot robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step 1,  establishing a plate-shaped structure model to obtain the motion video of the plate-shaped structure simulation,  establishing a plate-shaped structure model in the finite element software Abaqus,  setting the boundary constraint condition similar to the actual operation unit,  and dividing the grid of the plate-shaped structure according to the resolution of the video shot by the high speed camera,  calculating the motion information of the plate-shaped structure model;  extracting the moving light flow of the plate-shaped structure model according to the grid node by Python language,  establishing a structure space light flow field,  and storing the moving video simulated by the plate-shaped structure according to the frame rate shot by the high speed camera;  step 2,  constructing a FlowNet2 convolutional neural network model to obtain an optical flow prediction initial neural network model to construct a FlowNet2 convolutional neural network model,  using a motion video simulated by a plate-like structure as an input,  using a spatial optical flow field corresponding to the structure as an output,  training the FlowNet2 convolution neural network model to obtain an optical flow prediction initial neural network model;  step 3,  establishing a real structure space optical flow field to obtain the optical flow information of the electromechanical device motion,  using the real electromechanical device motion video collected by the high speed camera,  using the dense optical flow algorithm to calculate the dense optical flow of the video image,  establishing the real structure space optical flow field;  using the video image shot by the real machine set as the input of the optical flow prediction initial neural network model,  using the real space optical flow field to adjust the optical flow prediction initial neural network model parameter,  obtaining the optical flow prediction neural network model,  and using the electromechanical device video as the input of the optical flow prediction neural network model,  obtaining the optical flow information of the movement of the electromechanical device;  step 4,  the displacement calculation of the electromechanical device movement evaluates the relation between the optical flow information of the machine set device state based on the electromechanical device movement and the structure displacement movement,  performs displacement calculation on the device structure vibration response,  obtains the device structure displacement,  vibration frequency,  vibration type information,  uses the structure displacement,  vibration frequency,  the vibration type information change evaluates the machine set device state to obtain the machine set device fault information or fault pre-warning information.

The invention discloses a quadruped robot high-efficiency robust foot-drop planning method based on an elevation map. Includes the following steps :  Firstly,  an elevation map is constructed according to laser point clouds and odometer information,  And calculating topographical features,  And then get the traffic map,  Obtaining a local centroid trajectory in a trafficability map according to the target points,  Foot terminal diagrams are extracted around the candidate foot falling points and are subjected to map segmentation; The method comprises the following steps of :  extracting a convex hull from a segmented subgraph,  optimizing candidate foot falling points and the convex hull to obtain an optimal foot falling point,  reversely calculating a centroid position by using the optimal foot falling point,  performing rolling optimization on the centroid position and a centroid track,  and finally,  obtaining a local planning result which meets the centroid track and foot end motion at the same time; and finally,  extracting the convex hull from the segmented subgraph,  and optimizing the candidate foot falling point and the convex hull to obtain the optimal foot falling point. According to the method,  the convex hull is extracted from the elevation map,  so that terrain information is converted into convex constraints,  the solving success rate of the whole motion control of the quadruped robot is improved,  and the motion robustness of the quadruped robot when the quadruped robot crosses a complex terrain is improved. 1. A high-efficiency robust foot-falling planning method of four-foot robot based on altitude map,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  the movable four-foot robot collects the laser point cloud data in the travelling process in real time through the laser radar,  obtaining the odometer information of the four-foot robot,  and according to the odometer information,  using the uncertainty estimation method,  constructing a local elevation map taking the four-foot robot body as the centre;  S2,  calculating the terrain characteristic according to the local elevation map to obtain the gradient,  roughness and concave-convex degree of each grid point in the local elevation map;  S3,  generating a communication map by the terrain characteristic,  and constructing a terrain cost function of each grid point by using the gradient,  the roughness and the concave-convex degree;  S4,  dividing the terrain cost function according to the pre-set threshold value to obtain a binary communication map of each grid point;  S5,  obtaining the mass centre track of the four-foot robot according to the time elastic belt algorithm,  obtaining a gait time table containing the four-foot robot foot falling information,  appointing the gait period planned by the four-foot robot,  and obtaining the appointed time sequence according to the gait period and the gait time table;  combining the appointed time sequence,  interpolating the centroid track by the linear interpolation method,  obtaining the centroid pose sequence actually used for falling into the planning reference;  S6,  according to the default standing configuration of the four-foot robot,  obtaining the candidate foot point under each sub-target position of the centroid pose sequence;  S7,  extracting the foot terminal sub-graph near the candidate foot falling point,  processing the foot terminal sub-graph by the connection domain extracting method,  obtaining multiple connection domain sets in the foot terminal sub-graph;  S8,  in each of the set of connected domains,  primarily pre-processing the foot terminal map by using a pre-processing algorithm based on the principle of double limit points to obtain a pre-processed foot terminal map,  and then obtaining the candidate hillocks in the pre-processed foot terminal map by using a Gray constant scanning method;  S9,  according to the candidate convex hull and the candidate foot point,  constructing the total target function of the optimization problem and the constraint item of the optimization problem,  using a non-linear optimization library optimization to solve the total target function,  obtaining the optimal convex hull and the optimal foot point;  the total target function comprises a plurality of sub-target functions,  the plurality of sub-target functions perform linear weighting to obtain the total target function,  the constraint item comprises four-foot robot maximum step height constraint,  four-foot robot inter-leg collision constraint and four-foot robot leg extension limit constraint;  S10,  calculating the centroid position through the optimal foot-falling point,  inputting the centroid position to the time elastic belt algorithm for rolling optimization,  obtaining the centroid track satisfying the body and foot end movement of the four-foot robot at the same time;  the convergence judging condition of the time elastic belt algorithm is the centroid position of the centroid track after the rolling optimization must be corrected by the foot falling point.

The invention discloses a remote control ship human factor reliability analysis system and a control method thereof,  and relates to the field of intelligent ships. The system comprises an accident scenario setting module,  which is used for setting accident parameters of each emergency training; A shore-based control module,  configured to acquire behavior data based on the control of the intelligent ship by each operator; An evaluation and analysis module,  configured to perform human-to-human error rate evaluation on the performance of shore-based controllers according to the obtained behavior data through the process and method for emergency treatment of maritime accidents by the controllers; A modeling simulation module,  configured to establish a dynamic response model and a humanoid agent simulation according to data of the accident scenario setting module,  the evaluation and analysis module,  and the shore-based control module; A training module for training the controller by replacing part of the controller with the dynamic response model and the humanoid agent simulation. The invention can improve the emergency disposal ability of personnel. 1. A remote control ship cause reliability analysis system,  wherein it comprises :  an accident scene setting module for setting the accident parameter of each emergency training;  a shore-based control module for controlling the intelligent ship based on each operator and obtaining the behaviour data;  an evaluation analysis module for evaluating the human cause error rate according to the emergency treatment flow and method of the maritime accident by the controller and the obtained behaviour data to the bank-based controller;  a modelling simulation module for establishing a dynamic response model and a human-like agent simulation according to the data of the accident scene setting module,  the evaluation analysis module and the shore-based control module;  a training module for training the control personnel by replacing part of the control personnel by the dynamic response model and the human-like agent simulation;  based on the intelligent ship control by each operator,  obtaining behaviour data,  comprising :  collecting the information of the control staff to judge the time ti1,  the reaction time ti2,  the task execution time ti3 and the material consumption amount Ei;  the step of performing human error rate evaluation according to the performance of the obtained behavior data on the shore-based control personnel,  comprises :  determining the dependency relationship between the reliability factors of each drilling person and establishing Bayesian network,  according to the behaviour data,  using the method of combining Bayesian network with success probability index SLIM to perform human error rate HEP evaluation,  and using Bayesian network graph to perform sensitivity analysis;  wherein the step of establishing a dynamic response model and a human-like agent simulation according to the data of the accident scene setting module,  the evaluation analysis module and the shore-based control module comprises :  correcting the personnel defect for the result of the sensitivity analysis of each time,  and updating the data with small error rate of each time until there is no error in the obtained information,  constructing a dynamic response model by using the completely correct judgement,  operation and command scheduling information in the knowledge base and the work memory;  the dynamic response model comprises a task network model,  an operator model and an environment model;  the environment model is used for the scene design part to form an accident base for selection;  the operator model is combined with the human agent simulation to form an operator library,  and the operator is replaced in a certain scene;  the task network model directly distributes the appointed task to the system for emergency treatment exercise;  performing HBM simulation,  using the same policy Monte Carlo learning algorithm to perform model construction of training data set sample,  applying the sample data set to machine learning,  performing intensive learning through training sample data set,  performing confrontation in turn,  forming a confrontation network,  updating the data through training,  creating a class proxy;  wherein the method for combining Bayesian network success probability index SLIM according to the behavior data to perform human cause error rate HEP evaluation,  and using Bayesian network graph to perform sensitivity analysis,  comprising :  determining the reliability factor PSF of the emergency treatment exerciser;  determining the prior probability of each PSF according to the evidence synthesis rule;  determining the dependency relationship between each exerciser due to the reliability factor PSF and establishing Bayesian network;  determining the condition probability according to the equal probability distribution method;  the SLIM method is combined with the Bayesian network to calculate the human error rate;  performing human error rate HEP evaluation,  and using Bayesian network graph to perform sensitivity analysis.

The invention discloses a control method and device of a multi-legged robot,  an electronic device and a storage medium,  and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology and deep learning. The method for controlling the multi-legged robot comprises the following steps of :  acquiring current attitude parameters of the multi-legged robot; In a case that the type and/or quantity of the current attitude parameters meet a first preset condition,  inputting the current attitude parameters into a first model generated by training,  to obtain a first motion control strategy; The multi-legged robot is controlled based on the first motion control strategy. According to the type and/or quantity of the obtained attitude parameters of the multi-legged robot,  the corresponding model is adopted to generate the control strategy to control the motion of the multi-legged robot,  so that the stability and reliability of the motion of the multi-legged robot are ensured. 1. A control method of a multi-foot robot,  comprising :  obtaining the current attitude parameter of the multi-foot robot;  under the condition that the type and/or number of the current attitude parameter satisfy a first preset condition,  inputting the current attitude parameter into a first model generated by training,  so as to obtain a first motion control strategy;  controlling the multi-foot robot based on the first motion control strategy;  after obtaining the current attitude parameter of the multi-foot robot,  the method further comprises :  under the condition that the type and/or number of the current attitude parameter does not satisfy the first preset condition,  inputting the current attitude parameter into the second model generated by training,  so as to obtain the second motion control strategy;  controlling the multi-foot robot based on the second motion control strategy;  before the step of inputting the current attitude parameter into the first model generated by training,  the method further comprises :  obtaining a first motion control strategy based on a first initial model;  based on the first motion control strategy,  controlling the multi-foot robot model to move in the randomly generated environment,  so as to obtain the posture parameter and motion state parameter of the multi-foot robot under the first motion control strategy;  according to the attitude parameter and the motion state parameter,  adjusting the first initial model until the motion state of the multi-foot robot under the first motion control strategy determined based on the generated first model satisfies the second preset condition;  extracting a second gesture parameter set from the first gesture parameter set,  wherein the gesture parameter number contained in the second gesture parameter set is less than the gesture parameter number contained in the first gesture parameter set;  wherein the first gesture parameter set is used for obtaining the gesture parameter set of the first motion control strategy,  the first gesture parameter set comprises different types of gesture parameters of the multi-foot robot model at multiple moments in the motion process of the multi-foot robot model in the randomly generated environment;  inputting the first gesture parameter set,  the second gesture parameter set and the first motion control strategy to a second initial model to obtain a second motion control strategy;  according to the difference degree between the second motion control strategy and the first motion control strategy,  adjusting the second initial model until the motion state of the multi-foot robot under the second motion control strategy determined based on the generated second model satisfies the third preset condition.

The present invention uses improved PolarMask to perform human contour detection and posture recognition,  adopts an improved PolarMask model,  and performs the design of human contour polar coordinate modeling based on the characteristics of human contour; Then constructing an improved PolarMask model as a human contour segmentation model,  Add Channel Attention Mechanism Module,  Jumping connection is added to the original feature pyramid network based on YOLOV7,  which makes up for the detail information lost in the feature fusion process,  and finally,  a training strategy based on weak labels is adopted for training a primary human figure contour segmentation model capable of recognizing a rectangular box containing human figure position information and a posture type of a person; In the formal training process,  transfer learning is performed by using the pre-trained pre-trained weights of related information of the human contour learned in advance; and in the process of learning the real human contour,  the predicted human contour is continuously converged,  so that the human contour and the posture type are accurately identified. 1. The method for performing human shape outline detection and gesture identification by using improved PolarMask,  wherein the improved PolarMask model is used,  the ratio of the length and the width of the human-shaped surrounding frame identified by the PolarMask model is used for distributing the ray number of each area in the surrounding frame based on the human-shaped outline characteristic,  and the human-shaped outline polar coordinate modelling is designed;  then constructing an improved PolarMask model as a human contour segmentation model,  before the feature pyramid network performs feature fusion,  adding a channel attention mechanism module after each feature of different dimensions,  adding a jump connection in the feature pyramid network originally based on YOLOV7,  making up the detail information lost in the feature fusion process,  at last,  adopting the training strategy based on the weak label,  using the weak label data set of Box type to perform the pre-training of the humanoid profile segmentation model,  for training a primary humanoid contour segmentation model capable of identifying a rectangular frame containing humanoid position information and a human gesture type;  in the formal training process,  using the pre-trained pre-training weight for learning the related information of the human-shaped outline in advance to perform migration learning,  in the process of learning the real human-shaped outline,  making the predicted human-shaped outline converge continuously,  accurately identifying the human-shaped outline and posture type;  the construction of the improved PolarMask model is used as a human contour segmentation model,  based on the original PolarMask model,  based on the network structure of YOLOV7,  designing the YOLOAT-FPN characteristic pyramid network to replace the FPN network structure of the original PolarMask model,  improving the backbone network and characteristic pyramid structure of the original PolarMask model;  the human-shaped outline dividing model is composed of an encoder and three decoders;  The encoder uses YOLOAT_FPN feature pyramid network,  the YOLOAT_FPN feature pyramid network is based on the main network of YOLOV7 as follows :  (1) replacing the activation function of the original convolution module,  replacing the original activation function SiLU with a non-linear activation function GELU for natural language processing;  (2) adding a channel attention mechanism module before the feature fusion in the feature pyramid;  the channel attention mechanism module selects the SENet model,  the SENet model comprises two stages of compression and excitation,  the global space information is compressed in the compression stage,  then the feature learning is performed in the channel dimension,  so as to form the attention weight of each channel,  at last,  in the excitation stage,  the attention weight generated in the compression stage is applied to the corresponding channel,  specifically :  firstly performing compression stage,  using Global pooling to compress the input of H * W * C as the output of 1 * 1 * C,  then performing excitation stage,  comprising two full connection layers,  the first full connection layer has C/r neurons,  the output is 1 * 1 * (C/r),  and using an activation function ReLU;  The second full connection layer has C neurons,  the output is restored to 1 x 1 x C,  and an activation function Sigmoid is used,  wherein r is the compression value of the first full connection layer;  in the excitation stage,  by learning the characteristic information of each channel,  generating the attention weight of each channel,  and multiplying the channel attention weight of the final output 1*1 * C with the channel corresponding to the original characteristic pattern;  (3) the original YOLOV7 of the main network extracting the multiple scale of the characteristic diagram through channel attention mechanism module further extracting the important detail information,  and through 1*1 of convolution core to the shallow layer information with deep information proceed jump connection,  complete the characteristic fusion lost the detail information;  the three decoders refer to three parallel processing branches,  which are classified branches,  a central degree branch and a polar coordinate mask branch,  wherein the classification branch orderly uses 4 * 4 Conv and 1 * 1 Conv to perform feature extraction,  generating H * W * N feature map to perform prediction of N postures,  realizing prediction of segmentation target type,  H,  W respectively represents the length and width of the input characteristic image,  N represents the type of the posture to be predicted;  the central branch uses the 4 * 4 Conv and 1 * 1 Conv shared with the classification branch to extract the feature,  generating the H * W * 1 feature map to predict the polar coordinate central point;  The polar coordinate mask branch uses 4 x 4 Conv and 1 x 1 Conv in turn to perform feature extraction,  resulting in a feature map of H x W x 60 to predict the distance of the 60 rays of the polar coordinate.

The present application relates to the field of robotic technology,  In particular,  it relates to a method for planning and controlling legged robot,  its equipment,  robot and storage medium. Wherein,  the method comprises :  determining a foot end reference state of each leg according to a motion state of the legged robot and a swing parameter of each leg at a next moment,  for a leg starting to swing at a next moment,  planning a swing leg track with collision awareness according to a foot end dynamics model and a discrete collision model; The whole-body control of the legged robot is performed based on the motion state,  the reference state sequence and the foot end reference state,  wherein the whole-body control with collision awareness is performed based on the whole-body dynamics model and the discrete collision model for the supporting leg which is planned to be not touched by the ground. The whole-body control is performed based on the whole-body dynamics model and the discrete collision model. Therefore,  the problems that the robot hardware is high in abrasion degree,  short in service life,  incapable of meeting actual requirements and the like due to the fact that passive flexible buffering of collision of the foot type robot is limited,  algorithm control calculation amount is large,  control accuracy is low and the like in the prior art are solved. 1. A foot-type robot planning and control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the motion instruction and motion state of the foot-type robot;  generating a reference state sequence of the foot-type robot and a swinging parameter at the next time of each leg according to the motion instruction and the motion state;  determining the foot end reference state of each leg according to the motion state and the swinging parameter at the next time of each leg,  for the leg starting to swing at the next time,  according to the foot end dynamics model and the discrete collision model,  planning the swinging leg track with collision consciousness,  so that the impact generated after the advanced collision is in the target constraint range;  according to the motion state,  the reference state sequence and the foot end reference state,  performing systemic control on the foot type robot,  wherein,  for the supporting leg in planning,  and the supporting leg does not touch the ground,  according to the whole body dynamics model and the discrete collision model to perform the whole body control with collision consciousness,  so that the influence generated after the lag collision is in the target constraint range.

A computer executed process for mimicking human dialog,  referred to herein as a “humanoid” or “humanoid process software, ” can be configured to participate in multi-party conversations. The humanoid can monitor electronic communications in a conversation involving the humanoid and at least one other party. The humanoid can model the electronic communications by uniquely identifying each of the electronic communications as a stream of data. For example,  the data can be labeled and sorted in a database and/or arranged in a nodal graph representation. The humanoid can participate in the conversation based on the modeling.
