The present invention regards a reflex algorithm for a legged robot upon detecting an unexpected contact in order to reach a desired touchdown location using a leg stub re-swing. The proprioceptive leg-stub re-swing algorithm is a two-phase algorithm that is particularly beneficial in environments with unstructured terrain and wherein vision sensors may be damaged upon contact with protruding obstacles.

The present invention pertains to a system method for using depth sensors on the fore,  aft and bottom sides of a legged robot for stair climbing. The method uses real-time depth information to help with a legged robot's navigation on a variety of leveled terrains. Sensing methods are employed in addition to generating a composite field of view stretching from the front to the back of the legged robot. Downward facing depth cameras positioned at a particular angle enable the system to guide a legged robot over an environment which is being navigated by offering a persistent view of the environment. Other tools such as heightmap filling gradient map calculation,  and strategic foothold selection are also implemented.

A robot obstacle avoidance method includes :  obtaining a three-dimensional space point cloud,  and segmenting planes included in the three-dimensional space point cloud as a candidate ground set; Obtaining a ground normal vector,  screening and comparing the planes in the candidate ground set according to the ground normal vector and the ground height at the previous moment,  and determining the planes in the candidate ground set corresponding to the ground; Deleting the selected point cloud corresponding to the ground from the collected three-dimensional space point cloud to obtain an obstacle point cloud,  and generating a laser frame according to the obstacle point cloud; Local obstacle avoidance is performed based on the laser frames and the selected ground. Due to the fact that the three-dimensional space point cloud can be updated in real time,  and the positions of the obstacles in the scene can be correspondingly updated in real time,  the method can be effectively applied to obstacle avoidance of the humanoid robot,  and the obstacle avoidance precision of the humanoid robot is improved. 1. A robot obstacle avoidance method,  wherein the robot obstacle avoidance method comprises :  obtaining a three-dimensional space point cloud,  dividing the plane contained in the three-dimensional space point cloud as a candidate ground set;  obtaining a ground normal vector,  screening and comparing the planes in the candidate ground set according to the ground normal vector and the ground height at the last moment,  and determining the plane in the candidate ground set corresponding to the ground and most matched with the ground feature;  deleting the point cloud corresponding to the selected ground in the collected three-dimensional space point cloud to obtain an obstacle point cloud,  and generating a laser frame according to the obstacle point cloud;  performing local obstacle avoidance according to the laser frame and the selected ground;  before the step of screening and comparing the planes in the candidate ground set according to the ground normal vector and the ground height at the last moment,  the method further comprises :  for each plane of the candidate ground set,  selecting the plane equation to be determined by the preset parameter,  and randomly selecting multiple three-dimensional space points in the plane,  calculating the parameter in the plane equation,  selecting the residual point set in the plane to verify whether it meets the plane equation,  recording the number of three-dimensional space points in accordance with the plane equation,  repeating the above steps,  by randomly selecting the parameters in the plurality of plane equations determined by the plurality of pixel points in the plane for a plurality of times,  and recording the number of three-dimensional space points in accordance with the plane equation of the determined parameters,  selecting the plane equation with the most three-dimensional space point number,  re-calculating the plane parameter through the least square method,  determining the plane equation corresponding to the plane according to the calculated plane parameter.

The invention discloses a multi-legged robot for skiing. The robot comprises a robot body,  a front leg assembly and a rear leg assembly,  wherein the front leg assembly and the rear leg assembly are respectively connected with the robot body in a rotating mode,  and the front leg assembly and the rear leg assembly are arranged on the same side and are further connected with a ski in a rotating mode. The application has low center of gravity and high stability; the front leg component and the rear leg component which are arranged on the same side are rotatably connected to one snowboard,  so that the snowboard can realize various actions required by skiing; and meanwhile,  the two legs control one snowboard,  so that enough power can be provided for driving the snowboard to realize loads required by various angle changes. 1. A skiing multi-foot robot,  wherein the robot comprises a robot main body,  a front leg assembly and a back leg assembly,  the front leg assembly and the back leg assembly are provided with two,  the front leg assembly and the back leg assembly are respectively rotatably connected with the robot main body,  the front leg assembly and the back leg assembly set on the same side are further rotatably connected with the same ski;  the front leg component is rotatably connected with the ski through a ball pair component;  the back leg component is rotatably connected with the ski through a universal joint;  the front leg assembly comprises a first thigh and a first lower leg,  the first thigh and the first lower leg are rotatably connected,  the first thigh is further rotatably connected with the robot main body,  the first lower leg is rotatably connected with the ski through a ball pair assembly;  the rear leg component comprises a second thigh and a second lower leg,  the second thigh is rotatably connected with the second lower leg,  the second thigh is rotatably connected with the robot main body,  the second lower leg is rotatably connected with the ski through a universal joint;  a six-dimensional force sensor is installed between the front leg component and the ski,  and a six-dimensional force sensor is installed between the rear leg component and the ski.

The invention relates to an experimental device and a control method for remote unmanned observation of drifting motion of a target in distress by using Beidou positioning and short message communication technologies. The experimental device comprises an unmanned boat and a human-shaped drifting buoy,  wherein the buoy is at least provided with a wind wave and flow observation device and a Beidou positioning and Beidou communication device; and the Beidou communication device returns observation data in real time. The man-shaped drifting buoy is movably arranged in the carrying cabin of the unmanned vessel,  the unmanned vessel submerges into the water by opening the water permeable hole on the cabin bottom plate,  and the man-shaped drifting buoy floats up and leaves the carrying cabin to complete the distribution; The unmanned boat dives below the man-shaped drifting buoy to be recovered at a preset position and then floats upwards,  and after the man-shaped drifting buoy enters the carrying cabin,  the unmanned boat floats upwards and is recovered. By applying the Beidou technology,  the problem that the safety of manual observation is difficult to ensure when the wind is high and the waves are urgent is solved,  observation data support is provided for high-precision drift track prediction under extreme weather conditions,  and an experimental platform is provided for researching the sea-air interface scientific problem under extreme weather conditions. 1. An experimental device for remote unmanned observation of drift motion of distress target,  wherein it comprises :  a human-shaped floating buoy (607) and an unmanned boat,  the human-shaped floating buoy (607) is movably set in the carrying cabin (605) of the unmanned boat;  the human-shaped drifting buoy (607) comprises a cage ball (119) and a human-shaped simulation model (106);  at least three places between the cage ball (119) and the human-shaped simulation model (106) are connected by an elastic piece;  the human-shaped drifting buoy (607) is at least provided with a micro ocean current meter (115),  a micro anemometer (103),  a wave sensor (117),  a satellite positioning device and a satellite communication device,  the satellite communication device returns the wind wave flow observation data and satellite positioning data in real time;  the unmanned boat submerged in water,  the human-shaped floating buoy (607) away from the carrying cabin (605) after finishing placing;  the unmanned boat according to its own and human-shaped floating buoy (607) of the dipper locating data tracking human-shaped floating buoy (607),  under the preset position to the human-shaped floating buoy (607),  unmanned boat of the air bag charging floating finish recycling;  Optionally,  the mobile terminal is used to establish a signal connection via the wireless network card of the main controller (101),  and the main controller (101) is logged in to control the steering engine to adjust the angle of alpha angle,  beta angle and gamma angle and/or to adjust the parameters of the human simulation model (106).

The invention discloses a real-time face expression recognition method oriented to an edge computing end. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a training set and a test set,  and extracting initial emotion category labels of pictures of the training set; Building a model,  and inputting the pictures in the training set into the model respectively,  to obtain a predicted emotion category of each picture in the training set; The predicted emotion categories are respectively compared with the initial emotion category labels,  and the loss between the two is minimized,  the network parameters in the model are updated until the model maintains a stable emotion prediction performance on the training set,  and the model is saved; The models are tested with the test set until a model is obtained that performs well on the test set. According to the method,  the MF module and the SE module are introduced,  so that the memory access cost and parameters are effectively reduced,  and high identification accuracy is ensured. The invention also discloses a man-machine interaction system which can realize the action and voice feedback function based on the real-time expression state and has practical application value. 1. A real-time face expression recognition method facing to edge computing end,  wherein the specific steps are as follows :  step 1,  obtaining the training set and the test set from the picture library,  and extracting the initial emotion type label of each picture in the training set;  step 2,  establishing EC-RFERNet model,  and respectively inputting the picture in the training set into the model,  obtaining the predictive emotion type of each picture in the training set;  step 3,  respectively comparing the prediction emotion type of each picture with the initial emotion type label,  and minimizing the loss between the two,  updating the network parameter in the model,  until the model keeps stable emotion prediction performance on the training set,  storing the model;  step 4,  using the test set to test the model,  until obtaining the model with excellent performance on the test set;  step 5,  inputting any human face picture into the model to obtain the human face expression type corresponding to the picture.

FIELD :  data processing. SUBSTANCE :  invention generally relates to autonomous mobile robots for interacting with people and more specifically to autonomous mobile robots for assisting people in performing various tasks,  specifically to human-robot interaction based on mixed reality and specifically to human-robot interaction in programming and supervisory control processes. Embodiments of the present application relate to the technical field of intelligent traffic,  and in particular,  to a preference-based personification automatic driving model design method and system. The method includes the following steps :  adopting a bird's-eye view perception method to convert information of an automatic driving vehicle into a bird's-eye view,  and obtain environmental state information around the automatic driving vehicle; Employing a deep reinforcement learning method based on preference selection to map a bird's-eye view to continuous actions of an underlying layer to generate a driver model; Setting different action preferences to represent driving styles of different drivers,  and based on the different driving styles,  training the driver model to generate multiple alternative actions; Alternative actions close to the set action preferences are selected as final actions,  resulting in a preference-based anthropomorphic driver model. The automatic driving model solves the technical problem that the existing automatic driving model tends to be homogenized and cannot provide driving styles with different preferences. 1. A humanoid automatic driving model design method based on preference,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the bird ' s-eye-view sensing method is used for converting the automatic driving vehicle information into the bird ' s-eye-view and obtaining the environment state information around the automatic driving vehicle;  using the depth strengthening learning method based on the preference selection to map the bird ' s-eye view to the continuous action of the bottom layer to generate the driver model;  setting different action preferences to represent the driving styles of different drivers,  and training the driver model based on the different driving styles to generate multiple alternative actions;  selecting the alternative action close to the set action preference as the final action to obtain the anthropomorphic driver model based on the preference.

The invention discloses a method for perceiving local terrain of a legged robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  setting at least one laser radar on the legged robot,  acquiring external parameters of the legged robot relative to a body coordinate system of the legged robot,  and converting a point cloud obtained by scanning the laser radar into the body coordinate system of the legged robot; S2,  removing motion distortion from the point cloud,  converting to the gravity coordinate system of the legged robot,  and retaining the point cloud in a set range; S3,  reducing the dimension of the point cloud into a height information matrix; S4,  performing hole completion based on the height information matrix; S5,  removing the influence of the leg point cloud of the legged robot on the height matrix based on the height information matrix; S6,  analyzing the processed height information matrix,  and calculating a gradient information matrix and an obstacle information matrix for planning the foothold of the legged robot and avoiding the obstacle. The method has low dependence on a high-precision odometer,  and can be used for directly observing the terrain below the body of the legged robot and the surrounding terrain,  so that the perception is more accurate. 1. A foot-type robot local terrain sensing method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  setting at least one laser radar on the foot-type robot,  and obtaining the external parameter of the laser radar relative to the foot-type robot main body coordinate system,  converting the point cloud obtained by the laser radar scanning to the foot-type robot main body coordinate system,  periodically updating the point cloud obtained by scanning;  S2,  removing the motion distortion of the point cloud obtained in the step S1,  and converting to the foot robot gravity coordinate system,  keeping the point cloud in the set range;  S3,  reducing the point cloud obtained in the step S2 into a height information matrix;  S4,  performing cavity compensation based on the height information matrix obtained in the step S3;  S5,  based on the height information matrix obtained in step S4,  removing the influence of the foot-type robot leg point cloud on the height matrix;  S6,  analyzing the height information matrix processed in the step S5,  calculating the gradient information matrix and the barrier information matrix,  for foot point planning and obstacle avoiding of the foot robot.

A bionic welding robot,  wherein it comprises a main body part and a walking mechanism;  the main body part is provided with an environment detecting mechanism,  the environment detecting mechanism is used for detecting the environment information of the walking surface,  so as to locate the position of the welded work piece;  the walking mechanism is connected with the main body part,  the walking mechanism drives the main body part to move on the walking surface according to the environment information,  and the main body part is fixed with a welding device for welding the welded work piece.

The present invention pertains to a method for a quadruped robot to navigate through granular media,  such as deep sand and for providing improvements in the walking performance over various types of granular media. The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating teaching quality of a teacher. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring teaching scene data,  and detecting humanoid position information and face information of the teacher in the teaching scene data; The teaching scene data comprises a plurality of frames of picture data or video data in a preset teaching period; According to the humanoid position information,  identifying human body key point information of the teacher,  and identifying behavior posture information of the teacher; According to the human face information,  calculating expression features of the teacher,  and predicting expression classification information of the teacher; Converting the behavior posture information into behavior posture parameters and converting the expression classification information into expression parameters according to preset parameter settings; According to the posture parameters,  the expression parameters and the corresponding contribution coefficients,  a total teaching quality score is generated,  and the teaching quality of a teacher is comprehensively evaluated by combining expression recognition and behavior posture detection,  so that the teaching quality of the teacher is evaluated in multiple aspects,  and the teaching quality evaluation precision of the teacher is improved. 1. A teacher teaching quality evaluation method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the teaching scene data,  and detecting the human shape position information and the human face information of the teacher in the teaching scene data;  The teaching scene data includes :  several frames of picture data or video data in the pre-set teaching period;  according to the human shape position information,  identifying the human body key point information of the teacher,  and identifying the behaviour posture information of the teacher;  The identification of the behavior posture information of the teacher is specifically as follows :  generating the position change information of each human body key point according to the position of the human body key point in the human body position information of each frame of teaching scene data;  according to the position change information of each human body key point,  generating the combined heat map of all human body key point;  returning the combined thermogram to the thermogram of each part of the human body of the teacher,  and generating behaviour posture prediction result,  and counting the first occurrence times of each type posture prediction result;  taking the posture prediction result and the first occurrence number as the behaviour posture information;  calculating the expression characteristics of the teacher according to the face information,  and predicting the expression classification information of the teacher,  specifically :  reconstructing the picture pixel size of the human face information of each frame of teaching scene data in turn by the preset characteristic calculating module,  and extracting the expression characteristic;  generating calculation loss according to each expression feature;  inputting the calculation loss to a score full connection layer,  generating an expression prediction result;  counting the second appearing times of each type of expression prediction result according to the expression prediction result;  taking the expression prediction result and the second occurrence times as expression classification information;  according to the preset parameter setting,  converting the behaviour posture information into behaviour posture parameter,  converting the expression classification information into expression parameter;  according to the behaviour posture parameter and expression parameter and the corresponding contribution coefficient,  generating the teaching quality total score,  specifically is :  according to the behaviour posture information,  converting each type of posture prediction result into the corresponding behaviour posture parameter;  converting each type of expression prediction result into the corresponding expression parameter according to the expression classification information;  according to the set posture contribution coefficient of each type posture prediction result and the first occurrence times of each type posture prediction result,  summing the product of each behaviour posture parameter and the corresponding posture contribution coefficient,  obtaining the behaviour posture score;  according to the set expression contribution coefficient of each type expression prediction result and the second occurrence times of each type expression prediction result,  summing the product of each expression parameter and the corresponding expression contribution coefficient,  obtaining the expression score;  summing the product of the behaviour gesture score and the preset gesture score coefficient and the product of the expression score and the preset expression score coefficient to obtain the teaching quality total score.

The invention discloses a fault-tolerant gait control method for a spinal quadruped robot based on fault feature extraction. The method comprises the following steps of :  building an integral model of the spinal quadruped robot,  and setting various terrain environments; Planning the gait of the quadruped robot using the central pattern generator CPG; Designing a fault feature extractor,  predicting a joint torque value by the motor model network,  and comparing the joint torque value with the actual torque value of the robot joint to extract a fault feature of the joint motor; The failure mechanism of the spinal quadruped robot is designed according to the situations of motor failure,  joint locking and insufficient motor torque; Designing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm model; Training the robot in the simulation,  based on a fault mechanism,  taking sensor information and fault characteristic information of the robot as inputs and joint signal increments as outputs,  continuously training the controller until the strategy converges; The invention can self-adaptively adjust the gait to make the spinal quadruped robot cope with various faults. 1. A spinal four-foot robot fault-tolerant gait control method based on fault characteristic extraction,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  building a spine four-foot robot integral model in the simulation platform,  and setting multiple terrain environments;  step 2 :  using the central mode generator CPG to generate periodic rhythm signal,  planning the gait of the vertebral column four-foot robot,  for controlling the movement of the vertebral column four-foot robot in the step 1;  step 3 :  designing a motor fault characteristic extractor :  training a motor model network,  predicting the torque output of the vertebral column four-foot robot joint according to the current joint position error and the joint speed,  comparing with the actual joint torque value of the robot,  indicating the fault characteristic of the motor through the deviation signal;  step 4 :  according to the failure condition of the motor,  the joint locking and the motor torque shortage,  designing the failure mechanism of the vertebral column four-foot robot,  integrating into the robot training so that the robot can learn the fault-tolerant strategy;  step 5 :  designing deep strengthening learning algorithm,  constructing actor network and commentator network,  designing reward function,  using confidence domain strategy optimization algorithm TRPO to update strategy network;  wherein the actor network comprises the spinal four-foot robot spinal joint motion control in step 1,  the commentator network predicts the reward base value obtained by the current state of the robot;  step 6 :  training the robot until the policy convergence :  the CPG in the step 2 generates the basic gait of the four-foot robot,  the deep strengthening learning network uses the sensor information of the robot and the fault characteristic information in the step 3 as output,  outputs the joint signal increment corresponding to the fault condition,  in the simulation environment,  the robot is trained according to the fault mechanism in the step 4.

The present disclosure provides a quadruped robot path planning method and system based on environment trafficability analysis,  and relates to the field of mobile robot environment perception technology and navigation technology. The quadruped robot path planning method includes constructing a local grid elevation map always centered on a quadruped robot; Evaluating the passability of each grid by using the surface normal vector and the height difference of each grid of the map as geometric features of the local area to obtain a passable value of each grid; Mapping the passable values for each grid into occupancy probability values,  Acquire a trafficability map centered on a quadruped robot,  On the basis of the trafficability map,  the path planning of the quadruped robot is realized by using a rapid search random tree algorithm of the trafficability map,  a collision-free path between an initial position and an expected position is obtained,  and the autonomous navigation motion of the quadruped robot is controlled on the basis of a PID control tracking method. The present disclosure enables a quadruped robot to reach a target point autonomously and safely. 1. A four-foot robot path planning method based on environment-pass analysis,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining real-time dense point cloud data and pose information of the four-foot robot,  and pre-processing all data;  based on the pre-processed dense point cloud data and pose information,  constructing a local grid elevation map always taking the four-foot robot as centre;  taking the surface normal vector and height difference of each grid of the map as the geometrical characteristic of the local area to evaluate the passability of each grid and obtain the passable value of each grid;  mapping the passable value of each grid as the occupancy probability value,  obtaining the passable map taking the four-foot robot as the centre,  based on the passable map,  using the fast search random tree algorithm of the passable map to realize the path planning of the four-foot robot,  obtaining a non-collision path between the initial position and the expected position,  and controlling the autonomous navigation movement of the four-foot robot based on the PID control tracking method.

 rendering the preset virtual facial expression to the head of the virtual portrait so that the expression information conveyed by the virtual portrait is the same as the expression information of the human shape;  when the action information is identified as a tumble action,  the deprivacy method based on human shape detection of convolutional neurons further comprises :  generating a video connection sending request;  obtaining the face image information of the requestor;  obtaining a preset relationship knowledge map,  the preset relationship knowledge map comprises a preset human face image,  a preset related person face image having mapping relation with the preset human face image and image disclosure degree information of each preset related person face image and the preset related person face image having mapping relation with the preset human face image; The invention provides a method and a system for selecting an optimal continuous foot falling point of a legged robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  determining a feasible channel according to a scene; selecting a foot-falling area covered by the feasible channel; dividing each area; calculating a total rotation increment in each divided small area to realize rolling prediction; and finding an optimal scheme by taking the minimum sum of a movement accumulated deviation value of a robot body position and the total rotation increment as a target function. The method has the advantages of rolling prediction and optimal selection,  more reasonable landing point positions can be selected for the robot when the robot passes through the special terrain where the landing points are discrete,  the risk of overturning of the robot body and energy loss are reduced,  and the success rate of the robot passing through the terrain where the landing points are discrete is improved. 1. An optimal continuous foot-falling point selection method for foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the coordinate data of each sufficient area;  determining a feasible channel;  dividing the foot-falling area in the feasible channel into multiple regular shapes;  selecting the footed area closest to the current position as the next footed area,  traversing the three-dimensional coordinate position of the central point of each regular shape,  using the inverse kinematics to calculate the rotation angle values of all the machine body axial and leg joints stepping towards each regular shape centre of the next foot falling area when the robot is in the current machine body position,  excluding the regular shape whose calculation value does not meet the foot falling requirement,  according to the central position of the rest regular shape,  calculating the central position of the machine body after the robot finishes walking and the machine body moves forwards through the kinematics equation;  rolling to execute the last step,  obtaining all the predicted routes,  calculating the total rotation increment of the robot in all the predicted routes;  taking the minimum sum of the accumulated deviation value of the robot body position movement and the total rotation increment as the target function,  optimizing the foot falling point,  obtaining the optimal result.

The present disclosure relates to a ground attribute detection method for a legged robot,  comprising :  acquiring collision audio of feet of the legged robot with the ground; And detecting workability level attributes of a floor within a working environment of the legged robot based on the collision audio. By the embodiments of the present disclosure,  The sound of the collision of the feet of the legged robot with the ground is collected,  And detects a workable grade attribute of a ground surface in a working environment of the foot robot based on the sound,  Therefore,  the legs of the legged robot can be effectively controlled in a targeted manner according to the workable grade attribute,  so that on one hand,  the motion noise of the legged robot can be reduced,  and on the other hand,  the power consumption of the legged robot can be reduced,  thereby increasing the motion range of the legged robot. 1. A ground attribute detection method for foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the collision audio between the foot part of the foot-type robot and the ground;  and detecting the workable level attribute of the ground in the foot-type robot working environment according to the collision audio frequency;  the step of detecting the workable level attribute of the ground in the foot-type robot working environment according to the collision audio comprises :  filtering the collision audio,  sampling the filtered collision audio and performing short-time Fourier transform;  adding the result obtained by the short-time Fourier transformation to an image template with fixed size to obtain a first collision image;  The first collision image is input to a first neural network model to generate the workable level attribute.

The invention discloses a double-arm humanoid intelligent clothes folding robot. The double-arm humanoid intelligent clothes folding robot comprises an integrated control unit,  a visual recognition unit,  a task planning unit,  a double-mechanical-arm control unit,  a mobile platform control unit,  a man-machine interaction unit and a power supply unit. The problems to be solved by the present invention include robot recognition of surrounding scenes using RGBD cameras,  Generating names and corresponding coordinates of surrounding objects,  Visual classification of arbitrarily shaped garments,  And according to the classification result,  the robot invokes a paving algorithm to perform paving operation on the clothes by using the left and right mechanical arms,  After the clothes are paved,  a folding algorithm is called,  the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm are used for folding the clothes,  the clothes are placed in a designated area after being folded,  the robot can automatically navigate and avoid obstacles in real time according to tasks in operation,  and when a battery is lower than a threshold value,  the robot autonomously seeks a way and charges the clothes. 1. A double-arm humanoid intelligent clothes folding robot,  wherein It comprises an integrated control unit,  a vision identification unit,  a task planning unit,  a double-mechanical arm control unit,  a mobile platform control unit,  a man-machine interaction unit and a power supply unit;  the integrated control unit is used for integrating each unit of the whole double-arm humanoid intelligent clothes-folding robot;  the vision identifying unit is used for obtaining the vision information around the robot,  identifying the surrounding environment and confirming the corresponding position;  the task planning unit is used for classifying,  paving,  folding and stacking the folded clothes;  the task planning unit comprises a clothes classifying module,  a paving algorithm module and a folding algorithm module;  the clothes classifying module is used for visually classifying the clothes grasped by the robot and judging the type of the clothes;  the paving algorithm module is used for paving the target clothes and outputting the point coordinate and action content of the operation;  the paving algorithm module is used for paving the operation clothes from the folding state on the working table by using the preset 3 initial actions to the unfolding state,  so as to be convenient for the subsequent folding operation;  the paving algorithm module uses the depth strengthening learning model,  wherein the state is the paving state of the clothes,  the action is the preset 3 paving actions,  the reward is the area change after the action is executed,  the strategy is the function for calculating the next action according to the current state,  namely the depth strengthening learning model;  Specifically :  inputting the clothes state of the current wrinkle to the strategy,  the strategy gives the corresponding action with the largest reward and the corresponding operation point position,  the mechanical arm executes the action,  obtaining the new clothes state,  determining whether the state reaches the P% paving rate,  if reaching the paving rate action,  stopping,  if not,  continuously inputting the new state to the strategy to obtain the new action; The invention discloses a hexapod robot free gait planning method based on motion stability estimation. Belongs to the field of legged robot motion control technology,  and includes the following steps :  first,  solving and quantizing the real-time motion stability margin and the estimated stability margin of the hexapod robot,  and improving the forward-looking of the robot to its motion stability judgment through the stability margin estimation; Secondly,  the free gait sequence of the hexapod robot is planned based on the estimated value of the stability margin,  and the motion stability of the robot is improved by planning and adjusting the gait in advance. The invention adopts the hexapod robot free gait planning method based on motion stability estimation. The motion stability change trend of the hexapod robot in a period of time in the future can be estimated according to historical motion stability change information of the hexapod robot,  a gait sequence with better motion stability can be spontaneously generated in advance according to a stability estimation result,  and motion stability and environmental adaptability of the hexapod robot in an unpredictable environment are improved. 1. A six-foot robot free gait planning method based on motion stability estimation,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  solving and quantifying the real-time motion stability margin of the six-foot robot and establishing normalization for evaluating the real-time motion stability of the six-foot robot stable margin mathematical model,  through normalization the stable margin mathematical model calculates the real-time motion stable margin change of the six-foot robot;  establishing a motion stability margin estimation model of the six-foot robot based on the high-order polynomial fitting method,  bringing the real-time motion stability margin value under multiple time sampling points in the current motion process of the six-foot robot,  solving the undetermined coefficient of the motion stability margin estimation model of the six-foot robot,  and according to the motion stability margin estimation model of the six-foot robot,  calculating the stability margin estimation value of the six-foot robot at the end time of the future one-step motion under the current gait mode;  S2,  based on the stable margin estimation value,  planning the free gait sequence of the six-foot robot,  analyzing each sub-gait mode contained in the basic gait set of the six-foot robot,  establishing the mapping relationship between the stable margin estimation value of the six-foot robot and the basic gait set,  determining the basic gait set used by the next movement of the six-foot robot according to the stable margin estimation value;  according to the current gait mode of the six-foot robot and the motion overrun inhibition principle,  screening each sub-gait under the future one-step selectable basic gait set of the six-foot robot;  finally,  determining the sub-gait with maximum motion stability margin as the motion gait of the six-foot robot in the next step by calculating the motion stability margin of each sub-gait of the screened six-foot robot.

The present invention discloses a peripheral-central sensitization touch sensing device based on electric double layer theory. The sensing device of the invention is mainly composed of an ionization sensor,  an LM sensor and a synapse transistor. The voltage sensor is connected in series with the gate of the synaptic transistor,  and the voltage input of the gate of the synaptic transistor is adjusted by the voltage sensor,  so that the regulation and control of the synaptic stimulation excitatory current EPSC are indirectly realized; The LM sensor is connected in series with the source and drain electrodes of the synaptic transistor to directly regulate and control the synaptic stimulation excitatory current EPSC between the source and drain electrodes. According to the invention,  the characteristics of an electric sensor,  an LM sensor and a synapse transistor are fully combined,  and the combination of the plastic characteristic and the sensitization characteristic is realized,  so that the humanoid robot can be endowed with sharp sensing capability and injury stimulation prevention capability. 1. A peripheral-central axis sensitized touch sensing device based on double electric layer theory,  wherein comprising a synaptic transistor,  wherein the synaptic transistor is an N-type double-electric layer transistor;  an ionization sensor connected in series with the grid electrode of the synaptic transistor,  for indirectly realizing the regulation of the synaptic stimulation exciting current EPSC by regulating the grid electrode voltage;  an LM sensor,  the surface of the LM sensor is provided with four independent metal channels connected in parallel,  each independent metal channel is connected in series with a fixed resistor,  the whole of the four independent metal channels is connected in series with the source drain electrode of the synapse transistor,  for directly realizing the control of the synapse stimulation excitation current EPSC.

A multi-ship navigation method for simulating human behaviour based on knowledge distillation,  wherein the method automatic identification system obtains AIS data,  comprising the following steps :  (1) pre-processing the collected data,  comprising :  using random sampling continuous time stamp,  using linear interpolation to estimate the corresponding observation-action data from the discrete track to perform data filling,  further comprising :  using scene turning and rotating two ways to enhance the data;  The step comprises using the neural network fe with parameter phi e to perform action prediction,  optimizing the predicted action by minimizing the mean square error between the prediction action and the real action,  the calculation process is as formula :  in the formula,  E represents the calculation of the mean square error MSE,  fe (.theta.e) is the neural network with the parameter phi e,  Oi,  t are the observation of the unmanned ship i at the time t,  ai,  t are the actions of the unmanned ship i at the time t; The invention is applicable to the field of robots and discloses a footprint prediction method,  a footprint prediction device,  a humanoid robot and a computer readable storage medium. Wherein,  the method comprises :  acquiring an environmental depth map of the humanoid robot in a moving direction; Constructing an environment three-dimensional model based on the environment depth map; Screening out tigh region from the environment three-dimensional model; Determining the flat area as a target footprint,  wherein the target footprint is a future foothold of a foot of the humanoid robot. According to the scheme,  footprint prediction can be carried out on the humanoid robot based on vision,  and autonomous path planning under complex terrain is achieved. 1. A footprint prediction method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the environment depth map of the humanoid robot in the moving direction;  constructing an environment three-dimensional model based on the environment depth map;  screening the flat area in the environment three-dimensional model;  determining the flat area as a target footprint,  wherein the target footprint is a future footprint of a foot portion of the human-shaped robot;  wherein the environment three-dimensional model is represented by a triangular grid,  the step of screening a flat area in the environment three-dimensional model comprises :  calculating the normal line and curvature of each triangular grid in the environment three-dimensional model;  clustering based on the normal line and curvature of each triangular grid to obtain at least one flat area;  wherein the clustering is performed based on the normal and the curvature of each triangular grid to obtain at least one flat area,  comprising :  determining the triangular grid with minimum curvature as the initial seed grid;  detecting whether the normal of the adjacent grid of the seed grid satisfies the preset normal condition,  and detecting whether the curvature of the adjacent grid of the seed grid satisfies the preset curvature condition;  if the normal of the neighbourhood grid satisfies the normal condition,  adding the neighbourhood grid to the current area where the initial seed grid is located so as to update the current area;  if the curvature of the neighbourhood grid satisfies the curvature condition,  determining the neighbourhood grid as a new seed grid,  and returning to execute the detection whether the normal of the neighbourhood grid of the seed grid satisfies the preset normal condition,  and detecting whether the curvature of the adjacent grid of the seed grid satisfies the preset curvature condition and the subsequent steps until the new seed grid cannot be generated;  determining the updated current area as a flat area.

The invention discloses an agricultural wind-proof full-automatic small arched shed building machine. The machine is composed of two modules,  namely a rod-throwing arched frame building module and a film-covering soil-pressing module. On its bearing frame,  there are installed wheel type walking driving mechanism,  automatic rod taking and throwing device,  opposite double swing arm manipulator rod grabbing and inserting device,  film pre-forming arch tensioning and laying device,  4 groups of film pressing wheels and hydraulic lifting soil covering device. The two modules are connected together through a cross beam,  and can be combined to carry out composite operation,  or can be separated to be respectively used as a rod inserting machine and a shed covering film machine. The invention relates to an automatic greenhouse construction method. When a tractor moves forwards under the traction of the tractor,  double-swing-arm manipulators respectively rotate 180 degrees,  grasp greenhouse rods transmitted by an automatic rod throwing device,  bend and insert the greenhouse rods into soil,  and then rake the soil through a film covering component to finish greenhouse film covering. The machine is high in rod throwing speed and capable of providing fast small arched shed building capacity. The traction type machine can ensure long-distance shed film laying and stable shed building,  and can be normally operated in 5-stage wind working environment. The length of the throwing rod is 1.6-2.5 meters,  the width of a small arched shed can be built 70-150 cm,  and the height is 40-65 cm. 1. An agricultural wind-proof type full-automatic small shed building machine,  wherein it is composed of two modules :  The utility model Claims a rod-throwing arch-building module,  comprising an automatic rod-taking and rod-throwing device,  an opposite double-swinging arm mechanical arm automatic grabbing and bending rod-inserting device,  a clutch and a manual auxiliary rod-throwing component. The invention Claims a cover film soil pressing module,  comprising a film pre-arch tension paving device and 4 groups of film pressing wheels and a hydraulic lifting gap raking plate soil covering device. The two modules are connected together through the cross beam of the host frame,  which can be combined to perform the composite work,  or separated to be used as the rod inserting machine and the film covering machine.

The present application discloses a robot turning and squatting stable standing control method,  device,  equipment and storage medium,  obtaining the ontology perception information of a target humanoid robot,  including a target turning angle when performing a turning task,  and a target pelvic height when performing a squatting task; The ontology sensing information is input to the strategy network to obtain the output action,  The strategy network adopts reinforcement learning training in the emulator,  and the reward function comprises a first function encouraging the robot to squat to a specified pelvis height,  a second function encouraging the motion speed of the pelvis in a z-axis direction during the squatting process of the robot to be close to a desired squatting speed,  and a third function encouraging the robot to turn around to a specified angle; The output motion is converted into joint torque by a controller to control the motion of the robot. Loss of hardware equipment of the robot is avoided through simulation training. By adopting the reinforcement learning training,  a strategy network with better performance can be obtained,  and the stable standing control of the robot in the turning and squatting processes can be realized. 1. A method for controlling robot to turn around and squat and stand stably,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the main body sensing information of the target humanoid robot,  the main body sensing information comprises the corresponding target rotating angle when executing the turning task,  and the corresponding target pelvis height when executing the squat task;  inputting the main body sensing information to the policy network after training under the simulator,  obtaining the n-dimensional action output by the policy network,  n is equal to the number of joint degree of freedom of the target humanoid robot,  the policy network adopts an enhanced learning training method when training in the simulator,  The input of the policy network includes the ontology-aware information,  and the reward function includes :  a first function for encouraging the robot to squat to the appointed pelvis height,  a second function for encouraging the movement speed of the pelvis in the z-axis direction of the robot to squat to the expected squat speed,  and a third function for encouraging the robot to rotate to the appointed rotation angle;  the n-dimensional action is respectively converted into the joint torque by the proportional-differential PD controller,  and the corresponding joint motor is driven according to the joint torque so as to execute the turning task and the squat task.

The invention discloses a method,  a device and equipment for estimating the position of a center of mass of a quadruped robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  adopting initial state parameters and constructing an initial state input matrix; Determining a target state input matrix through the preset state transition matrix and the preset input transition matrix; Using real-time state data of the quadruped robot,  calculating positions of legs returning to soles of the robot and robot returning observation data,  and constructing an initial observation input matrix in combination with a preset observation state transition matrix; Performing least square method estimation on the plantar position returned by the robot and the observation data returned by the robot,  updating an initial observation input matrix,  and outputting a target observation input matrix; In combination with the Kalman filtering iterations,  corresponding centroid position data for the quadruped robot is output. Solves the problem that the existing foot robot state estimation method stability is very dependent on the sensor,  the four-foot robot in the unstructured terrain walking in the technical problem of inaccurate position estimation of the center of mass. 1. A four-foot robot centroid position estimation method,  wherein it comprises :  in response to the estimation request,  initializing the initial state parameter of the four-foot robot and constructing an initial state input matrix;  updating the initial state input matrix through the preset state transfer matrix and the preset input transfer matrix,  determining the target state input matrix;  adopting the real-time state data of the four-foot robot,  calculating the position of the robot leg returning to the sole and the robot returning to the observation data,  and combining the preset observation state transfer matrix to construct an initial observation input matrix;  performing least square estimation to the position of the foot bottom returned by the robot and the observation data returned by the robot,  determining the height value of the target foot end and updating the initial observation input matrix,  outputting the target observation input matrix;  performing Kalman filtering iteration on the target observation input matrix and the target state input matrix,  and outputting mass centre position data corresponding to the four-foot robot.

The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting the phase of the foot end of a legged-foot robot based on event triggering. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a joint corner,  a joint moment,  a foot end speed and an acceleration of the legged-foot robot at the current moment; Calculating foot end kinematic information based on the joint corner,  inputting the foot end kinematic information into a kinematic probability model,  and solving a foot end phase state under the model in combination with a virtual body angle; Calculating the three-dimensional observed force of the foot end based on the joint moment,  and inputting the three-dimensional observed force into the kinetic probability model,  and solving the phase state of the foot end under the model by combining the speed and acceleration of the foot end; Calculating and obtaining a model correction value based on the three-dimensional observation force of the foot end; The phase detection pre-model based on the reference time and the friction force is constructed by combining model correction values,  the actual foot phase transition probability is calculated by combining foot phase states under the two probability models,  the current ground-off or ground-touching event is judged,  the foot phase detection is completed,  and the detection accuracy is improved. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a phase detection pre-model based on the reference time and the friction force; and calculating the actual foot phase transition probability by combining the foot phase states under the two probability models. 1. A leg-foot type robot foot end phase detection method based on event trigger,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the observed values of the joint corner and the joint moment of the leg-foot robot at the current time,  and based on the joint corner,  calculating and obtaining the foot end speed and acceleration of the robot through kinematics;  based on the joint corner,  calculating the foot end kinematics information through the positive kinematics,  inputting the foot end kinematics information into the kinematics probability model,  combining with the virtual machine body angle,  solving the foot end phase state under the kinematics probability model;  based on the joint moment,  calculating the foot end three-dimensional observation force through Jacobian,  inputting the foot end three-dimensional observation force into the dynamic probability model,  combining the foot end speed and acceleration,  solving the foot end phase state under the dynamic probability model;  based on the three-dimensional observation force of the foot end,  obtaining the model correction numerical value by calculating the time length in accordance with the friction cone;  combining the model correction numerical value,  constructing a phase detection preposed model based on reference time and friction force,  and combining the foot end phase state under kinematics probability model and dynamics probability model,  calculating the actual foot end phase transition probability,  judging whether the current occurrence of a ground-to-ground event or a ground-to-ground event,  finishing the robot foot end phase detection.

The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring an action output curve of the quadruped robot based on a virtual model control method; Constructing a strategy framework by using an action output curve of the quadruped robot as an open-loop reference track and using an action output quantity generated by the reinforcement learning controller as a closed-loop optimization signal; According to a strategy framework,  a motion output curve of the quadruped robot is used as prior knowledge to guide the quadruped robot to learn,  the reinforcement learning controller is trained,  the trained reinforcement learning controller is obtained,  and motion control is carried out on the quadruped robot. A depth-strengthening learning robot motion control method based on prior knowledge,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  controlling the four-foot robot based on the virtual model control method to obtain the action output curve of the four-foot robot;  using the action output curve of the four-foot robot as the reference track of the open loop,  using the action output quantity generated by the strengthening learning controller as the optimized signal fed back by the closed loop belt,  building a strategy frame;  according to the strategy frame,  using the action output curve of the four-foot robot as a priori knowledge to guide the learning of the four-foot robot,  training the reinforced learning controller,  obtaining the trained reinforced learning controller;  using the trained strengthening learning controller to control the movement of the four-foot robot.

The invention discloses a method for evaluating a man-machine co-driving decision system based on a digital twin mode. The method comprises the following steps of :  firstly,  constructing a multi-sensor virtual model; The second step is to build a multi-level complex scene evaluation system; Third,  evaluating the anthropomorphic degree of the human-machine co-driving decision-making system; Fourth,  the performance of the man-machine co-driving decision system is evaluated. Beneficial effects :  the test efficiency of the man-machine co-driving decision system is improved,  and the iteration and optimization of the man-machine co-driving decision system are accelerated; Provides a comprehensive,  reliable set of perceptual information for the decision-making level; Ensuring comprehensiveness and validity of the driving scenario covered by the test; The anthropomorphic evaluation and test of the man-machine co-driving decision-making system under different driving styles and different scene complexities are realized; Performance of the man-machine co-driving decision-making system in a dangerous scene is analyzed through safety,  comfort and efficiency evaluation indexes.

A mobility surrogate includes a humanoid form supporting at least one camera that captures image data from a first physical location in which the first mobility surrogate is disposed to produce an image signal and a mobility base. The mobility base includes a support mechanism,  with the humanoid form affixed to the support on the mobility base and a transport module that includes mechanical drive mechanism and a transport control module including a processor and memory that are configured to receive control messages from a network and process the control messages to control the transport module according to the control messages received from the network.

The present invention belongs to the field of bionic robot technology,  and is especially one kind of humanoid sole structure. The technical scheme is as follows :  the human-shaped sole structure comprises a rear sole,  wherein the front end of the rear sole is rotatably connected with a front sole; the front end of the rear sole and the rear end of the front sole are mutually pressed through a plate spring; and the rear sole is provided with a detection sensor. The present invention provides a human-like sole structure capable of real-time detecting the stress condition of sole and simulating the rotation of front sole under the action of external force. 1. A humanoid sole structure,  wherein It comprises a rear sole (1),  the front end of the rear sole (1) is rotatably connected with a front sole (2),  the rear sole (1) is further provided with a plate spring (3),  the other end of the plate spring (3) is pressed on the front sole (2).

The invention relates to a human-robot fusion decision-making method with weight self-adaptive adjustment. Environmental information obtained by a robot through a laser sensor and an operator through using behavior entropy estimation workload are used as input of a shared fuzzy controller,  and control weight factors are output to achieve on-line distribution of control weights. The human-robot fusion decision-making method with the weight self-adaptive adjustment is simple in structure and convenient to use. The robot is then input to the robot actuators,  weighted by weight factors,  based on the improved VFH + autonomous obstacle avoidance module and the speed command output of the operator's operating handles,  to generate safe trajectories that allow the robot to avoid obstacles and dangerous areas. The method is suitable for a robot to execute complex operations on site in an unstructured environment,  and an operator can perform remote control,  so that the operator is prevented from being exposed in a dangerous or harmful environment,  the execution efficiency of a task can be improved,  the control precision is more accurate,  and the safety factor is higher. 1. A human-robot fusion decision method with self-adaptive weight adjustment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the obstacle avoiding module obtains the environment information through the laser sensor and outputs the command ur;  obtaining the quantified working load by using the operator behaviour entropy;  taking the environment information and the working load as the input of the sharing controller,  and outputting the sharing control weight through the sharing controller;  the robot based on the output command ur of the obstacle-avoiding module and the command state of the operating handle are decomposed into linear speed and angular speed part,  the linear speed and angular speed of the robot and the operator are weighted through the weight,  input to the robot actuator,  generating a safety speed command uf,  It makes the robot avoid the barrier.

The invention discloses a method and a system for autonomously climbing stairs by a quadruped robot based on local environment perception. A single depth camera is arranged at the abdomen of the quadruped robot body,  and the method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring depth data of a structured stair under a current visual angle of the robot,  clustering the depth data and performing plane segmentation by using a PEAC algorithm to obtain stair plane point cloud data; The PCA algorithm is utilized to calculate and obtain each plane of the current staircase,  and each plane of the staircase is determined to be a horizontal plane or a vertical plane; Based on each plane of stairs,  Stair characteristic parameters,  yaw angle errors and stair exit marker bit data are calculated,  foot end motion trails are generated,  a PD correction algorithm and a terrain adaptation algorithm are introduced,  a robot center-of-mass motion trail is generated,  model predictive control and whole body motion control tracking are utilized,  joint action quantity is obtained,  and the robot is controlled to complete stair climbing tasks. The method comprises the following steps of :  calculating stair characteristic parameters,  yaw angle errors and stair exit marker bit data,  generating a foot end motion trail,  introducing a PD correction algorithm and a terrain adaptation algorithm,  generating a robot center-of-mass motion trail,  performing model predictive control and whole body motion control tracking,  and controlling the robot to complete stair climbing tasks. According to the invention,  reliable sensing motion can be completed by using only a single depth camera,  and reliable stair climbing operation can be realized. 1. A four-foot robot autonomous stair climbing method based on local environment sensing,  wherein the abdomen of the four-foot robot main body is provided with a visual camera module,  the visual camera module comprises a single depth camera,  the method comprises :  obtaining the depth data of the structured stair under the current visual angle of the robot,  clustering and plane dividing the depth data by PEAC algorithm,  obtaining the stair plane point cloud data;  based on the stair plane point cloud data,  using PCA algorithm to calculate and obtain each plane of the current stair,  determining the type of each plane of the stair,  the type comprises a horizontal plane and a vertical plane;  based on the horizontal plane and the vertical plane of the stair,  calculating the stair characteristic parameter,  the yaw angle error and the stair mark bit data;  based on the characteristic parameter of the staircase,  the yaw angle error and the stair flag bit data,  generating a foot end motion track,  and introducing a PD correction algorithm and a terrain adaptation algorithm,  generating a robot centroid motion track,  the generated track uses model prediction control and whole body motion control tracking,  obtaining the joint action amount,  controlling the robot leg joint motion,  finishing the stair climbing task.

The present invention discloses a metamorphic quadruped robot. Relates to the technical field of robots,  Comprises a multi-link trunk mechanism,  a deformation mechanism,  a walking mechanism and a control system. The multi-link body mechanism comprises a plurality of links which are hinged end to end in sequence,  The four connecting rods are respectively provided with a walking mechanism which is symmetrically arranged in the front,  back,  left and right directions; the deformation mechanism is connected to the multi-connecting-rod trunk mechanism and can change the direction of the walking mechanism; the multi-connecting-rod trunk mechanism is provided with a control system; and the deformation mechanism and the walking mechanisms are respectively in communication connection with the control system. The metamorphic mechanism is used for changing the configuration and the degree of freedom of the mechanism,  and the shape of the body of the quadruped robot is changed by instructions of the control system and driving of the deformation mechanism,  so that the quadruped robot can turn or walk in a narrow space conveniently,  and the environmental adaptability of the quadruped robot is improved. 1. A cell-changing four-foot robot,  wherein comprising a multi-connecting rod trunk mechanism,  a deformation mechanism,  a walking mechanism and a control system,  the multi-connecting rod trunk mechanism comprises a plurality of connecting rods hinged end to end in turn,  wherein the four connecting rods are respectively provided with a walking mechanism,  and the walking mechanism is symmetrically arranged at front,  back,  left and right,  the deformation mechanism is connected to the multi-connecting rod trunk mechanism and can change the direction of the walking mechanism,  the multi-connecting rod trunk mechanism is provided with the control system,  the deformation mechanism and the walking mechanism are respectively connected with the control system.
The invention relates to a novel test stand for micro unmanned aerial vehicles.

The method comprises :  collecting a sensing data set of a real legged robot walking for a distance on a conventional road surface,  and preprocessing the sensing data set; Dividing the collected sensing data set to obtain a divided sensing data set; Establishing a model based on the partitioned sensing data set,  setting parameters according to the model,  and training the model to obtain a trained model; Inputting the sensing data set into the trained model,  and calculating to obtain an abnormal monitoring threshold value to perform abnormal monitoring; Performing an analysis based on the results of the anomaly monitoring. In the implementation of the method,  the reliability and the fault tolerance of abnormality monitoring are improved,  the capability of learning potential modes in complex sensing data is enhanced,  the complexity of modeling is reduced,  and the accuracy of abnormality monitoring is improved. 1. The invention discloses a control method and a control system of a magnetic levitation pump. According to different rotating speeds of rotors in a magnetic levitation pump system,  different control modes are implemented to adjust radial offset of the rotors; When the rotation speed of the rotor is low,  a linear control method is used to adjust the radial offset of the rotor; When the rotation speed of the rotor is high,  the rotor radial offset is adjusted by a humanoid intelligent integral control method; In the humanoid intelligent integral control method,  the unilateral magnetic pull force suffered by the rotor is calculated,  and the radial suspension force required for adjusting the rotor is calculated according to the unilateral magnetic pull force suffered by the rotor,  so that the control precision of controlling the radial offset of the rotor is improved; The humanoid intelligent integral control method improves the steady-state performance of the rotor in the magnetic levitation pump system at high rotation speed. The invention can avoid the problem that the single control method can not compromise the control precision and response. 1. A control method of magnetic suspension pump,  wherein Specifically as follows :  the rotating speed ns of the rotor in the magnetic suspension pump system is set by the control module group before the magnetic suspension pump works;  the control module group judges that the set rotating speed ns is low rotating speed or high rotating speed;  when the rotating speed is judged to be low rotating speed,  the control module group uses the linear control method to calculate the radial offset of the rotor;  when the target rotating speed is high rotating speed,  the control module group uses the humanoid intelligent integral control method to calculate the radial offset of the rotor;  then,  the suspension device in the magnetic suspension pump system is started by the control module group so as to keep the rotor in suspension state;  at this time,  the detecting system detects the radial offset of the rotor,  and transmits the radial offset of the rotor to the control module group through the data transmission system;  the control module group judges whether the radial offset rc of the rotor meets the requirement value of the corresponding control method,  if not,  the control module group calculates the control quantity u corresponding to the radial suspension force according to the rotating speed ns set as low rotating speed or high rotating speed,  and transmits the control quantity u to the PLC,  the PLC makes the magnetic suspension pump system change the radial suspension force of the rotor by controlling the frequency converter;  then starting the rotating device in the magnetic suspension pump to drive the rotor to rotate;  the detecting system detects the radial offset rc of the rotor in real time and feeds back to the control module group through the data transmission system;  the control module group selects the corresponding control method to calculate the control quantity u corresponding to the radial suspension force according to the rotating speed ns of the rotor in the magnetic suspension pump system,  so that the magnetic suspension pump system changes the radial suspension force of the rotor and controls and adjusts the radial offset rc of the rotor in real time.

The invention provides a method and a system for navigation obstacle avoidance and stair climbing of a quadruped robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  S1,  establishing a preset unstructured environment scene model of the quadruped robot; Step S2 :  the on-board binocular camera acquires and analyzes surrounding environment information,  and establishes a global map containing semantic information and a high-precision local elevation map centered on the robot; S3 :  the quadruped robot realizes autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance according to the global map and the A* path planning algorithm; Step S4 :  the quadruped robot is trained according to the asymmetric Actor-Critic network,  and plans a foot falling point in combination with the global map and the local elevation map,  thereby realizing motion control and stair climbing of the quadruped robot. According to the invention,  the problems of instability,  falling down and the like of the quadruped robot when the quadruped robot moves in a non-structural environment are avoided,  the potential safety hazard of the quadruped robot when the quadruped robot moves in a complex terrain is effectively solved,  the movement capability of the quadruped robot is improved,  and the safety and the efficiency of executing a specific task are ensured. 1. A four-foot robot navigation obstacle-avoiding and stair-climbing method,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 (S1) :  establishing a four-foot robot preset unstructured environment scene model;  step S2 :  the airborne binocular camera obtains and analyzes the surrounding environment information,  establishes a global map containing semantic information and a high-precision local elevation map taking the robot as centre;  step S3 :  the four-foot robot realizes autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance of the four-foot robot according to the global map and A* path planning algorithm;  step S4 :  the four-foot robot is trained according to the asymmetric Actor-Critic network and combined with the global map and the local elevation map to plan the foot falling point so as to realize the movement control of the four-foot robot and climb the stair.

A dynamic multi-obstacle avoidance method for a humanoid robot based on bidirectional A * and local perception includes the following steps :  S1 overall path planning :  based on initial basic map information,  using a bidirectional A * search algorithm to determine an optimal route of the humanoid robot; S2 local obstacle avoidance :  executing a local perception algorithm when the moving position of the humanoid robot coincides with the position of the dynamic obstacle; S3 :  optimizing the path planning of the humanoid robot in a dynamic obstacle-free environment by combining the overall path planning and the local obstacle avoidance. The invention relates to a humanoid robot dynamic multi-obstacle avoidance method based on bidirectional A* and local perception. The overall path is supplemented by the path planned by bidirectional A*. Local obstacle avoidance is mainly optimized according to dynamic real-time obstacle avoidance,  single perception is changed into bidirectional A* and local perception,  and exits are found from two sides of an obstacle,  so that the calculated amount is reduced,  and the problem that the A* algorithm is not applicable in a dynamic multi-obstacle environment is solved; and the method has a good application effect on scenes such as unknown forest crossing and cooperative combat. 1. A human-shaped robot dynamic multi-obstacle obstacle avoidance method based on bidirectional A* and local sensing,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 whole path planning :  based on the initial basic map information,  using the bidirectional A* search algorithm to determine the optimal route of the humanoid robot,  according to the direction of the route as the auxiliary route of the humanoid robot movement;  S2 partial obstacle avoidance :  When the position where the human-shaped robot is about to be moved is overlapped with the position of the dynamic obstacle,  the local sensing algorithm is executed,  specifically comprising :  S21 :  a sensor is arranged in front of the forward direction of the human-shaped robot,  the sensor senses the forward environment,  adds a tracking matrix and updates the dynamic barrier information in time;  S22 :  combining the information provided by the tracking matrix,  judging whether there is feasible domain in front of the humanoid robot;  S23 :  if there is feasible area,  guiding the humanoid robot to choose feasible direction to advance;  if there is no feasible area,  the humanoid robot returns to the previous position,  updates the dynamic barrier information in real time and executes the auxiliary route;  S3 :  The invention combines the whole path planning and local obstacle avoiding to optimize the path planning of the humanoid robot in the dynamic multi-obstacle environment.

The controller measures the user according to the panoramic image and controls the action assistance device to approach the user according to the navigation information. ;  .. A control system for controlling an electric walking aid,  including :

a navigation information device provided on the electric mobility device and configured to generate navigation information;  and
