The present invention provides a four-legged robot and a foot structure of a legged robot. The foot structure of a legged robot includes :  an ankle joint block,  which is disposed at a lower end of a lower leg of the legged robot; A foot main body hinged to the ankle joint block via a hinge shaft such that the foot main body swings about the hinge shaft when subjected to ground pressure; A pressing block disposed at a front side of the foot body; A limiting bolt penetrates through a through hole formed in the pressing block and is in threaded connection with a screw hole formed in the ankle joint block. The present invention can reduce the friction and noise of feet,  raise the durability of feet and ensure the reliability and service life of foot robot. 1. A foot structure of foot-type robot,  wherein Including :  an ankle joint block,  the ankle joint block is set at the lower end of the calf of the foot-type robot;  a foot main body,  the foot main body is hinged with the ankle joint block through a hinge shaft,  so that the foot main body swings around the hinge shaft when subjected to ground pressure;  a pressing block,  the pressing block is set on the front side of the foot main body;  a limiting bolt,  the limiting bolt passes through the through hole set on the pressing block,  and is screwed with the screw hole set on the ankle joint block;  a pressure sensor,  the pressure sensor is installed in the sensor containing cavity set at the front side of the ankle joint block,  the pressure sensor is located between the ankle joint block and the pressing block,  in the swinging process of the foot main body,  the pressing block will press the pressure sensor when swinging along with the foot main body,  so as to utilize the pressure sensor to detect the ground pressure borne by the foot main body;  the shape of the through hole on the section vertical to the upper and lower directions is waist-shaped hole,  the hole wall or hole end part of the waist-shaped hole is matched with the stop of the limiting bolt to limit the swinging range of the foot main body;  the through hole is divided into three sections in the upper and lower directions,  the lowest first section is a counter bore for containing the head part of the limiting bolt,  the uppermost third section is a counter bore,  the counter bore is opened on the surface opposite to the ankle joint block,  the middle second section is a through hole connecting the first section and the third section,  the size of the second section on the section is less than the size of the first section and the third section;  a reset spring located in the counter bore of the third section,  wherein one end of the reset spring is propped against the ankle joint block,  and the other end is propped against the counter bore bottom of the third section;  the limiting bolt passes through the core part of the offsetting spring and is screwed with the screw hole on the ankle joint block,  when the foot main body is not stressed by the ground pressure,  the offsetting spring drives the pressing block away from the ankle joint block.

The present invention discloses a humanoid robot shank optimization method based on a field drive principle,  comprising the following steps :  obtaining an initial humanoid robot shank through three-dimensional modeling,  and constructing a feature size set to be optimized based on a connection structure in the initial humanoid robot shank with other components; Setting a plurality of detection points for all connection structures,  acquiring stress field diagrams of all connection structures through finite element analysis; Strength evaluation is performed through the stress field map,  and adjustment is required when any connection structure does not meet the strength evaluation; The finite element analysis is repeated until the termination condition is met,  the optimized optimal feature size set is output,  and the initial humanoid robot shank is adjusted based on the optimal feature size set to obtain the humanoid robot shank design drawing. The invention also provides a leg optimization device of the humanoid robot. According to the method,  the design process of the leg of the humanoid robot can be effectively simplified,  and meanwhile,  the strength and the light weight of the final structure can be ensured. 1. A method for optimizing calf of humanoid robot based on field driving principle,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the calf of the initial humanoid robot through three-dimensional modelling,  and constructing the characteristic size set to be optimized based on the connection structure of the calf of the initial humanoid robot and other components;  setting multiple detection points for all connection structures,  obtaining stress field graphs of all connection structures by finite element analysis;  the stress field diagram is used to screen the stress maximum detection point set and the stress minimum detection point set for intensity evaluation,  when any one connection structure does not satisfy the intensity evaluation,  it needs to be adjusted :  if not exceeding the iteration threshold value,  adjusting the characteristic size according to the preset adjusting strategy;  if the iteration threshold value is exceeded,  adjusting the size of the non-connection structure and resetting the iteration times;  after finishing the adjustment,  repeating the finite element analysis until the termination condition is satisfied,  outputting the optimized optimal characteristic size set,  and adjusting the calf of the initial humanoid robot based on the optimal characteristic size set,  so as to obtain the optimal calf design map of the humanoid robot.

The present invention provides a microwave sensor performance parameter automatic test system and its method. An automatic test system for the performance parameters of microwave sensor is composed of a horizontally movable artificial human body,  a vertically movable installing frame,  a rotary disk,  a horizontal drive source,  a vertical drive source and a rotary drive source. The horizontal driving source is in transmission connection with the simulated human body and drives the simulated human body to reciprocate horizontally along one direction; the vertical driving source is in transmission connection with the mounting frame and drives the mounting frame to reciprocate vertically; the rotary driving source is in transmission connection with the turntable and drives the turntable to rotate; and the turntable is used for bearing a lamp under test provided with a microwave sensor under test. The method is equivalent to the method that testers enter the induction area of the microwave sensor under test from different azimuth angles and at different speeds at different installation heights,  so that the performance parameters of the microwave sensor are automatically tested,  a large amount of labor and time are saved,  the testing efficiency is high,  and the requirement on the space size of a testing site is greatly reduced. 1. An automatic test system for performance parameter of microwave sensor,  wherein comprising a simulation human body (20) capable of horizontally moving,  a mounting frame (30) capable of vertically moving,  a turntable (40) rotatably mounted on the mounting frame (30),  a horizontal driving source,  a vertical driving source,  and a rotating driving source,  the horizontal driving source is in transmission connection with the simulation human body (20),  the simulation human body (20) is driven to reciprocate horizontally along one direction,  the vertical driving source is in transmission connection with the mounting frame (30),  the mounting frame (30) is driven to reciprocate vertically,  the rotating driving source is in transmission connection with the turntable (40),  driving the turntable (40) to rotate,  the turntable (40) is used for bearing the in-test lamp (70) installed with the in-test microwave sensor (10).

The invention provides a method and a device for generating information of a target area in a video stream,  and relates to the technical field of video processing. The method is applied to a front end,  and comprises the following steps of :  responding to a stream identifier triggered by a user,  and initiating an address acquisition request including the stream identifier to a back end; Receiving the video stream address returned by the backend,  accessing the video stream address,  and obtaining a to-be-processed video stream; Creating a multi-layer canvas on the to-be-processed video stream,  monitoring a drawing operation of a user,  and filling a target picture frame drawn by the user to obtain a target area; According to the corresponding relationship between the canvas coordinate system of the canvas and the video stream coordinate system,  the coordinate information of the target region on the canvas coordinate system is converted into region information corresponding to the video stream coordinate system and sent to the rear end. According to the embodiment,  the drawing real-time performance can be improved,  the data transmission cost can be reduced,  the back-end resource consumption and the calculation burden can be reduced,  and the detection efficiency and the detection precision can be improved. 1. An information generation method of target area in video stream,  wherein the method is applied to the front end,  comprising :  in response to the stream identifier triggered by the user,  initiating an address acquisition request including the stream identifier to the rear end;  receiving the video stream address returned by the rear end,  accessing the video stream address and obtaining the video stream to be processed;  creating multiple layers of canvas on the video stream to be processed,  monitoring the drawing operation of the user,  filling the target frame drawn by the user,  obtaining the target area;  according to the corresponding relation between the canvas coordinate system of the canvas and the video stream coordinate system,  converting the coordinate information of the target area on the canvas coordinate system into the area information corresponding to the video stream coordinate system and sending the area information to the back end,  so that the back end uses the area information to perform humanoid detection on the target area.

Disclosed are a medical image classification method and apparatus,  and a medium and an electronic device. The method comprises :  selecting a target medical image sample from an unlabeled medical image sample set by using an active learning framework (210),  wherein a query strategy of the active learning framework is provided by a reinforcement learning model;  inputting,  into a medical image classification model,  the target medical image sample labeled by a labeling expert,  so as to train the medical image classification model (220);  if the training does not meet a predetermined condition,  acquiring a training result,  training the reinforcement learning model on the basis of the training result,  updating the query strategy by using the trained reinforcement learning model,  and proceeding to the sample selection step until the training meets the predetermined condition (230);  and inputting,  into the trained medical image classification model,  medical image data to be classified,  so as to perform classification (240). According to the method,  a long-term working mechanism for training a medical image classification model by means of human-robot collaboration is established,  thereby reducing the labeling cost and improving the labeling efficiency.

In this project a Wi-Fi controlled robot will be constructed taking an RC car as a starting point and Inspired by the famous Star Wars movie,  we decide a moving and interactive robot which is similar to the BB8 character of the sequel. The main goal of this project is to design a robot that can be controlled using Wi-Fi. The emphasis of this prototype is put on the coding,  focusing on C# and C/C++ languages. The robot communicates with the computer with a Wi-Fi module and the computer sends packages of information to the robot in order to control its movements and actions. A camera is also included,  so that the operator of the robot can see where it is going in real time. The robot will be controlled through a Ip address,  which will be connected to the ESP32 Wi-Fi module,  programmed in Arduino language,  to give instructions to the robot. The proposed system is based on a low-cost set of components allowing to control the device wirelessly by Wi-Fi. The user will be allowed to access an IP camera placed in the robot to get live images of its vision while controlling it via a mobile phone. In future it could be used for human–robot interactive applications.

The present invention discloses a high-spectrum-based ground object recognition method for a legged robot,  which is characterized by comprising the following steps :  acquiring high-spectrum images of several ground scenes,  and preprocessing the high-spectrum images; Labeling the preprocessed images,  generating a dataset,  and training a ground feature recognition model with a deep learning method; Processing the hyperspectral image to be recognized,  which is acquired in real time,  and inputting the processed hyperspectral image into the ground feature recognition model,  and the ground feature recognition model recognizes ground objects,  and performs semantic segmentation on the hyperspectral image; The semantically segmented images are converted into semantic maps to guide path planning and motion control of the legged robot. The invention discloses a high-spectrum-based ground object recognition method for a legged robot. A short-wave near-infrared high-spectrum camera is used for collecting a spectrum image of an environment,  and a deep learning ground object recognition model is used for outputting a result of the high-spectrum image,  so that the gait and obstacle avoidance of the legged robot are guided. The high-spectrum-based ground object recognition method for the legged robot comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a short-wave near-infrared high-spectrum camera,  acquiring a high-spectrum image of the environment,  and outputting the result of the high-spectrum image. 1. The present invention provides a humanoid robot fall prediction method,  which collects state data when a robot falls and is stable in different directions,  forms an SVM training data set and trains to obtain an SVM classifier; Input the state data of the robot into a trained SVM classifier,  and the SVM classifier outputs a classification result; In the judgment buffer time after the SVM classifier outputs the classification result,  the proportion of the period which is judged to be about to fall to the total control period is counted,  and the prediction result of the robot falling is finally determined according to the proportion output. The method of obtaining the training data set of the present invention is simple and can be applied to a fall prediction method when a robot is in motion. 1. A method for predicting tumble of humanoid robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  collecting state data when the robot is tumble and stable towards different directions,  forming an SVM training data set and training to obtain an SVM classifier;  inputting the state data of the robot into the trained SVM classifier,  outputting the classification result by the SVM classifier;  in the judging buffer time after the SVM classifier outputs the classification result,  counting the proportion of the period to be toppled in the total control period number,  outputting the finally determined robot toppled prediction result according to the proportion;  the state data comprises the speed and acceleration of the robot x-axis,  y-axis and z-axis and the distance between the ZMP and the boundary of the current supporting surface,  and forms a 7-dimensional feature vector;  the 0.2 s after each falling judgment of the classifier is the judging buffer time;  when the SVM classifier judges that the falling period is more than 90 %,  finally judging that it is to be fallen,  otherwise,  still judging that it is stable;  The method for obtaining the state data is as follows :  when the robot stands stably,  the robot is pushed to fall in a certain direction,  and all state data from the force to the complete fall of the robot is taken as a falling data set and a falling label is punched;  selecting proper thrust to make the robot approach to the unstable edge as much as possible but not fall down,  and obtaining the state data as the stable data set and marking the stable label;  and taking the falling data set with label and the stable data set as the training data set of the SVM classifier.

The invention discloses an intelligent autonomous exploration method and an intelligent autonomous exploration device for a legged robot suitable for a complex building indoor environment,  and relates to the field of autonomous exploration of unknown environments of robots. In the autonomous exploration process of the multi-layer indoor environment of the legged robot,  a multi-dimensional rotatable mechanism is utilized to decouple the orientation of the sensor from the posture of the chassis of the robot; Semantic information is added in the environment,  layered environment exploration is assisted,  and multi-layer environment rapid autonomous exploration which is not limited by robot postures is completed. 1. A foot-type robot intelligent autonomous exploration method and device suitable for complex building indoor environment,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the multi-dimensional rotatable mechanism based on bionics principle is used for loading the depth camera to provide environment depth information;  updating the boundary information according to the established occupied grid map;  performing viewpoint collection to the updated boundary and the newly added boundary;  evaluating the information gain of each viewpoint,  combining the semantic information,  obtaining the optimal viewpoint and optimal observation angle of each boundary;  if there is layered road marking point,  performing the three-dimensional space layered planning,  determining the space layer where the global covering path is located;  calculating the connection cost matrix between each boundary optimal viewpoint and between each boundary optimal viewpoint and the current position of the robot;  if there is map layered road mark point in the range,  it is set as the warehouse of the traveller problem to obtain the optimal global covering path including the return path;  calculating the dynamic feasible path for connecting the current position of the robot and the N optimal view points in the front of the global covering path,  and optimizing the path;  according to the size of the boundary and the number of the semantic information,  making an attraction function,  and planning the direction of the rotatable mechanism at each position on the dynamic feasible path;  when the target boundary is searched or the planning path collides with the new environment,  re-searching the global path and generating the dynamic feasible path;  if there is a layered road sign and the current layer exploration is finished,  the robot returns the layered road sign point,  enters the next layer and continues the exploration; PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED :  To provide a control system and method for controlling the operation of a legged robot.
SOLUTION :  A control system for controlling a legged robot comprises a processor and a memory. The present control system initializes a probabilistic filter using a parameter associated with a state of a reference pathway of a legged robot in response to a reception of a task,  the parameter being previously determined for the task,  allows the legged robot to move according to the task,  and encodes a reference pathway including a combination of different reference pathways,  relative to a coordinated motion primitive of different actuators of the legged robot. The present control system furthermore generates a reference pathway by decoding the parameter and executes the probabilistic filter to repeatedly track a state of a reference pathway satisfying a performance target as to the state of the legged robot in response to a reception of a feedback signal,  and updates the parameter.

The present invention provides a head orientation method of a humanoid robot with coordination of listening and vision,  which is characterized by mainly comprising the following steps :  firstly,  collecting voice signals and recording time through a microphone array; Then using the human voice recognition method to recognize,  counting the number of microphones that have collected the human voice; Setting candidate target position according to time when the number of human voice microphones is greater than 1; Rotating the camera and collecting video; Face image frames are obtained from the video,  a face recognition result is obtained by using a face recognition method,  and the number of faces is counted; Calculating face area and sorting when the number of faces is greater than 1; Setting a candidate target face according to the ranking; Then using lip movement detection algorithm to implement lip movement identification; Then when the number of human faces with lip movement is greater than 1,  the target direction is set according to the area; Finally,  the head of the humanoid robot is rotated to realize orientation. The present invention makes it possible for the humanoid robot to distinguish human voice from other voices and to interact accurately with target human voice. 1.  step S2,  orderly identifying the voice signal collected by the microphone by using the predetermined human voice identification method to obtain the voice identification result,  at the same time,  counting the number of the microphone whose voice identification result is human voice and setting the number of the human voice microphone;  step S3,  judging whether the number of the human voice microphones is greater than 1;  step S4,  when the number of the human voice microphones is greater than 1,  setting the orientation corresponding to the microphone firstly collected to the human voice as the candidate target orientation according to the time;  step S5,  the humanoid robot controls the camera to turn to the candidate target orientation through the control part,  and uses the camera to collect the video of the candidate target orientation;  step S6,  orderly obtaining the face image frame from the video,  and orderly identifying the face image frame by using the predetermined face identification method to obtain the face identification result containing the face position,  and counting the face number of the face image frame;  step S7,  judging whether the number of the human faces is greater than 1;  step S8,  when the number of the human face is greater than 1,  orderly calculating the area of the human face in the human face image frame and sequencing according to the sequence from large to small to obtain the human face area sequence; The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots,  and particularly relates to a passive walking robot motion control algorithm based on human body parameters. The passive walking robot motion control algorithm comprises the following steps of :  S1,  constructing a passive walking robot model in combination with a human body parameter model; S2,  divide the walking process into multiple phases; S3,  use the method of spatial operator algebra to perform dynamic modeling,  and construct a coordinate system according to the D-H modeling method; S4,  according to a spatial operator algebraic correlation theory,  a recursive algorithm is introduced into a dynamics modeling process; S5,  using the law of conservation of angular momentum,  establishing a kinetic model of the collision phase; S6,  performing motion characteristic analysis. According to the invention,  a passive walking robot model based on human body parameters is adopted,  a highly humanoid passive walking robot three-dimensional model is obtained,  and a floquet multiplier method is utilized to carry out local stability analysis,  so that the research result of the invention can be beneficial to realizing a walking aid device which is efficient,  energy-saving and simple and convenient to control. 1. A passive walking robot motion control algorithm based on human body parameter,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  combining the human body parameter model,  constructing a passive walking robot model;  S2,  according to the difference of the walking state of the passive walking robot model,  dividing the walking process into multiple phase states;  S3,  performing dynamic modelling by using space operator algebraic method,  constructing coordinate system according to D-H modelling method;  S4,  according to the space operator algebraic correlation theory,  introducing the recursion algorithm into the dynamic modelling process;  S5,  using the angular momentum conservation law,  establishing a dynamic model of collision phase;  S6,  performing motion characteristic analysis,  firstly establishing a Poncaley mapping function,  combining Newton-Lavson iteration rule,  solving the immovable point x and constructing the Jacobi matrix J (x) at the immovable point x,  The floquet multiplicative method is then used to determine whether the passive walking robot model has the ability to stabilize walking.

A highly integrated multifunctional five-finger smart hand for driving and controlling,  wherein it comprises :  five fingers,  a mounting base (14) and a driver (15);  wherein the thumb (10) and the forefinger (20) are all three-degree-of-freedom full-driving fingers,  which are respectively driven by the motor screw rod assembly to realize side swinging around the rotating shaft and bending in the plane,  the thumb (10) and the forefinger (20) are in the same mounting plane,  the mounting included angle between the thumb (10) and the forefinger (20) is alpha;  the middle finger (30),  the ring finger (40) and the little finger (50) are single degree of freedom under-actuated fingers,  which are driven by the motor screw assembly to realize bending in the plane;  the mounting base (14) comprises a thumb mounting frame and a four-finger mounting frame;  the motor screw assembly of the forefinger (20),  the middle finger (30),  the third finger (40) and the little finger (50) are installed in the four-finger mounting frame in parallel,  the motor screw assembly of the thumb (50) is installed in the thumb mounting frame;  The driver (15) is mounted on the back of the four-finger mounting frame for driving the motor screw assembly.

The invention relates to a motion control method of a quadruped robot based on a post-positioned attention neural network. Interaction of the quadruped robot with the simulated terrain is achieved with a simulation platform,  A simulation model of the quadruped robot is designed,  the simulation model is introduced into different terrains designed in a simulation platform for training,  corresponding reward function values are obtained according to actions taken by the quadruped robot and the current state,  and a near-end strategy optimization method PPO is used for continuous optimization to complete an expected motion task. 1. A four-foot robot motion control method based on postpositive attention neural network,  using the simulation platform to realize the interaction between the four-foot robot and the simulation terrain,  designing the simulation model of the four-foot robot,  leading it into the different terrain designed in the simulation platform for training,  obtaining the corresponding reward function value according to the action taken by the four-legged robot and the current state,  continuously optimizing by using the near-end strategy optimization method PPO,  completing the expected motion task,  the method comprises the following steps :  (1) establishing the simulation model of the four-foot robot,  determining the joint number,  position,  connection relationship and motor strength of the four-foot robot,  designing the collision range and foot contact force feedback of the four-foot robot;  (2) establishing a simulation world,  introducing the designed simulation terrain :  designing different ground gradient,  friction coefficient and height parameter in the simulation platform to realize the simulation terrain with different difficulties;  (3) designing a reward function,  and setting a reward function according to the movement target to be achieved;  (4) leading the simulation model of the four-foot robot into the simulation world established in the step (2),  and reading the current state of the four-foot robot;  (5) training the environment encoder of the first stage,  the input of the environment encoder is the privilege information of the environment,  the output is the environment vector zt,  reflecting the environment information of the four-foot robot;  (6) training the post-attention network of the second stage,  reading the motion action and joint motor state adopted by the four-foot robot,  through the post-attention network,  pre-processing it to obtain the low latitude characteristic vector lt as the intermediate variable,  the post-attention network comprises a gating circulation unit GRU,  an all-connected network FC;  The input is the state information of the four-foot robot,  the GRU firstly extracts the time relevance of the input information,  obtains the more important time information and reduces the data quantity;  the data processed by the GRU is filtered again by the Attention module,  and the input information is extracted into the low-dimensional important information in the two steps;  at last,  a layer of full-connection network outputs the low-latitude characteristic vector lt;  (7) calculating the mean square error between the output parameter of the post-attention network and the output parameter of the environment encoder,  optimizing the post-attention network parameter,  the output of the post-attention network enters the basic strategy,  the four-foot robot generates motion in the simulation,  using PPO to optimize the parameters of the environment coder and the basic strategy;  (8) repeating the steps (6) and (7),  so that the four-foot robot can successfully pass through the current simulation terrain,  then changing the terrain with higher difficulty for training;  and (9) performing the steps (6)-(8) for multiple times to obtain a four-foot machine motion controller capable of passing through multiple complex terrains.

A human shape indication guide vertical card,  wherein it comprises :  an indication guide plate,  a vertical seat and a counterweight;  the indication guide plate comprises a human-shaped plate,  a connection rod and a bottom bearing plate;  one surface of the herringbone card is used as the back surface,  and the back surface is fixedly connected with the connecting rod,  the bottom end of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with the bottom bearing plate;  the vertical seat is transverse H-shaped structure,  the top end is provided with a mounting groove,  the bottom bearing plate is set in the mounting groove;  the transverse two sides of the bottom bearing plate are provided with connecting columns,  the two side walls of the mounting groove are correspondingly provided with connecting holes,  the connecting columns and the connecting holes form a matched insertion,  so that the connecting columns cannot freely rotate in the connecting hole;  the two sides of the vertical seat are provided with a balance weight groove,  the balance weight is set in the balance weight groove to realize the stable installation of the vertical seat.

The invention provides a gait planning method,  a gait planning device,  an electronic device and a readable storage medium,  and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises :  Based on the current posture information of the upper body of the humanoid robot,  the first expected posture information at the end of the current gait cycle and the second expected posture information at the end of the next gait cycle,  Calculating to obtain a first angular acceleration track and a second angular acceleration track of an upper body posture of the humanoid robot in a remaining time period of a current gait cycle and a second angular acceleration track of the upper body posture of the humanoid robot in a next gait cycle,  Each of the three pieces of attitude information includes an angle of a target attitude angle and an angular velocity of the target attitude angle,  and the target attitude angle includes a pitch angle and/or a roll angle; According to the first angular acceleration track and the second angular acceleration track,  the position of the foot falling point of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait cycle is obtained through calculation,  and the position of the foot falling point enables the humanoid robot to be stable. Thus,  the posture of the upper body of the robot can meet the actual requirement,  and the stability of the robot can be ensured. 1. A gait planning method,  wherein it comprises :  according to the current posture information of the upper body of the humanoid robot,  at the first expected attitude information at the end of the current gait period and the second expected attitude information at the end of the next gait period,  calculating and obtaining the first angular acceleration trajectory of the upper body attitude of the humanoid robot in the residual time period of the current gait period and the second angular acceleration trajectory in the next gait period,  wherein the current attitude information,  the first expected attitude information and the second expected attitude information all include an angle of a target attitude angle and an angular velocity of the target attitude angle,  and the target attitude angle includes a pitch angle and/or a roll angle;  according to the first angular acceleration track and the second angular acceleration track,  calculating and obtaining the foot point position of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait period,  wherein the foot point position makes the humanoid robot stable;  wherein,  under the condition that the target attitude angle comprises a pitch angle,  the step of calculating to obtain the foot-falling point position of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait period according to the first angular acceleration trajectory and the second angular acceleration trajectory,  comprises :  according to the first angular acceleration track of the pitch angle and the centroid kinematics rule,  calculating and obtaining the first forward position and the first forward speed of the present moment and the first relational expression of the second forward position and the second forward speed of the present gait period;  according to the second angular acceleration track of the pitching angle and the centroid kinematics rule,  calculating to obtain the second relational expression of the initial third forward position and the third forward speed in the next step period and the fourth forward position and the fourth forward speed at the end;  according to the first relational expression and the second relational expression,  calculating the forward position of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait period;  under the condition that the target attitude angle comprises a roll angle,  the step of calculating to obtain the foot point position of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait period according to the first angular acceleration trajectory and the second angular acceleration trajectory,  comprises :  calculating the third relational expression of the first transverse position and the first transverse speed at the current moment and the second transverse position and the second transverse speed at the end of the current gait period according to the first angular acceleration track of the transverse rolling angle and the centroid kinematics rule;  according to the second angular acceleration track of the roll angle and the centroid kinematics rule,  calculating to obtain the fourth relational expression of the initial third transverse position and the third transverse speed in the next step period and the fourth transverse position and the fourth transverse speed of the tail;  according to the third relational expression and the fourth relational expression,  calculating to obtain the transverse position of the humanoid robot at the tail foot point of the current gait period.

The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling the comfort of a robot wheelchair by integrating SLAM and humanoid operation skills. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a grid map of the surrounding environment of the robot wheelchair; Obtaining a global path from a starting point to a target point of the robot wheelchair by using a global path planning algorithm; Using beta process autoregression hidden markov model algorithm to make segmentation treatment for global path; Using the segmented subpath as a template,  calling a human-like operation subskill learned based on the dynamic movement primitive,  and determining a human-like operation subskill corresponding to each subpath; Generalizing the human-like operation subskills corresponding to the subpaths by using a dynamic movement primitive algorithm,  and outputting a generalized human-like operation subskill sequence; The generalized human-like operation subskill sequences are integrated according to the global path and then regressed,  and the human-like operation skills at any position are called along the global path,  so that the robot wheelchair can autonomously drive along the global path by using the human-like operation skills. 1. A comfort control method for robot wheelchair,  wherein it comprises :  step S1,  obtaining the surrounding environment information and position information of the robot wheelchair,  obtaining the grid map of the surrounding environment through the laser SLAM algorithm;  step S2,  based on the grid map,  using the global path planning algorithm to obtain the global path from the starting point to the target point of the robot wheelchair;  step S3,  segmenting the global path by using the self-regression hidden Markov model algorithm of the tower process to obtain the segmented sub-path;  step S4,  taking the divided sub-path as the template,  calling the similar person operation sub-skill based on the dynamic motion basic element learning,  obtaining the optimal matching relation between the similar person operation sub-skill and the sub-path,  determining the similar person operation sub-skill corresponding to each sub-path;  step S5,  using the dynamic motion primitive algorithm to generalise the starting position,  the ending position and the duration of the similar person operation sub-skill corresponding to each sub-path,  and outputting the generalised similar person operation sub-skill sequence;  step S6,  integrating the generalized human-like operation sub-skill sequence according to the global path,  and using Gaussian process regression method for the integrated human-like operation sub-skill sequence,  transferring the human-like operation sub-skill at any position along the global path,  so as to realize the autonomous driving of the robot wheelchair along the global path by using the human-like operation sub-skill.

ABSTRACT Waste collection,  storage and transport are essential elements of any solid waste management system and can be major challenges in India. Waste collection is the responsibility of the municipal corporations in India,  and bins are normally provided for biodegradable and inert waste. Mixed biodegradable and inert waste is often dumped with open burning is a common practice in India. The Kitchen waste is often dumped into trash without realizing the recycling methods which can be turned into organic fertilizers for the farmers. Intention of our invention is to overcome above said shortcomings,  in which autonomous robot is developed for efficient navigation for garbage collection and employing vision based deep learning technique for classification and segregation of non- biodegradable from biodegradable waste with eco-friendly recycling of biodegradable waste into organic fertilizers.

The invention discloses a model updating method and a model updating device,  which are used for solving the problem that a legged robot cannot stably operate in a real environment on the basis of a preset motion decision model. In this application,  The method comprises :  The legged robot obtains a first motion attitude of the legged robot at a current moment,  A first motion posture of the legged robot at the current moment is input into the motion decision model to obtain a second motion posture of the legged robot at the next moment,  wherein the motion decision model is obtained by pre-training when a robot file is operated in a simulation environment by a computing device,  and the robot file is used for describing the legged robot. When the legged robot determines that the motion decision model needs to be updated according to the second motion posture,  the legged robot sends the second motion posture to the computing device,  and correspondingly,  the computing device re-trains the motion decision model according to the second motion posture. 1. A model updating method,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the first motion posture of the foot-type robot at the current time;  inputting the first motion posture at the current time into a motion decision model,  obtaining a second motion posture of the foot-type robot at the next time,  wherein the motion decision model is used for describing the relationship between the motion posture of the foot-type robot at the first time and the motion posture at the second time,  the first time is the time after the second time;  the motion decision model is obtained by pre-training when the robot file is operated in the simulation environment by the computing device,  the robot file is used for describing the foot-type robot;  when determining that the motion decision model needs to be updated according to the second motion attitude,  sending the second motion attitude to the computing device,  so that the computing device updates the parameter of the simulation environment according to the second motion attitude,  and re-training the motion decision model according to the simulation environment after updating the parameter.

The present application discloses a method for estimating a state of a multi-legged robot and a related device. The method includes :  calculating a position of each mechanical leg of the multi-legged robot at a current moment according to sensing information of the multi-legged robot collected at the current moment to obtain a position calculation result during an overturning process of the multi-legged robot; Observing a position of each leg of the multi-legged robot at the current moment according to a historically obtained state estimation result of the multi-legged robot at the current moment to obtain a position observation result; Determining reference information required for state estimation according to the motion form corresponding to the target stage where the current moment is located; The reference information indicates a degree of trust in the position calculation result and the position observation result,  respectively,  at the time of state estimation; According to the reference information,  the position calculation result and the position observation result,  the state of the multi-legged robot at the current moment and the next moment is estimated,  and the accuracy and the applicability of the state estimation are improved. 1. A state estimation method of a multi-foot robot,  wherein the multi-foot robot performs an empty turning action on a plane,  and the empty turning process is divided into a plurality of continuous stages,  one stage corresponds to a motion form of the multi-foot robot,  any motion form is used for indicating the contact condition between each mechanical leg of the multi-foot robot and the plane in the corresponding stage;  The method comprises :  in the empty turning process of the multi-foot robot,  according to the sensing information of the multi-foot robot collected at the current time,  calculating the position of each mechanical leg of the multi-foot robot at the current time,  obtaining the position calculation result;  observing the position of each mechanical leg of the multi-foot robot at the current time according to the state estimation result of the multi-foot robot at the current time obtained in history,  obtaining the position observation result;  determining the target stage in which the current time is located from the multiple stages,  and determining the reference information needed by the state estimation according to the motion form corresponding to the target stage;  The reference information indicates :  when estimating the state,  respectively calculating the trust degree of the position calculation result and the position observation result;  according to the reference information,  the position calculation result and the position observation result,  estimating the state of the multi-foot robot at the next time of the current time,  obtaining the state estimation result of the multi-foot robot at the next time.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control,  and particularly relates to a quadruped robot control method based on SLAM of an improved Cartograph. The control method comprises the following steps :  S1,  building a robot hardware platform; S2,  build a laboratory map; S3,  relocation; S4,  path planning; S5,  linear velocity and angular velocity calibration; S6,  conducting navigation. The optimized Cartograph SLAM algorithm of the present invention consumes shorter CPU time,  the peak value of CPU occupancy rate is slightly lower when the map is constructed,  and the calculation pressure is relatively small; The optimized Cartograph SLAM algorithm has significantly better mapping effect,  reduced measurement error,  and better robustness; Compared with a traditional GPS (Global Positioning System),  the system can realize autonomous navigation of the robot,  and is low in cost,  strong in practicability and wider in application range. 1. The invention relates to the field of computer vision,  and discloses a camera self-adaptive anti-overexposure real-time processing method and a camera self-adaptive anti-overexposure real-time processing system. The camera self-adaptive anti-overexposure real-time processing method comprises the following steps of :  A,  carrying out real-time human shape detection on a camera picture; B,  when it is detected that an effective humanoid appears in the camera picture,  performing pre-calculation of a brightness adjustment value required in the anti-overexposure treatment process; C,  performing anti-overexposure processing on the camera picture based on the pre-calculated value of the brightness adjustment value; D,  judging whether to end the anti-overexposure processing,  comprising :  calculating the information variation of brightness and other information of the current frame and the previous frame of the camera picture,  if it is greater than the preset threshold value,  deeming that the human body has left,  ending the anti-overexposure processing,  and returning to execute step A; If not greater than the preset threshold,  it is considered that the human body does not leave,  the camera picture continuous anti-overexposure processing,  the method has stronger environmental adaptability,  can process more complex human motion scene,  at the same time the requirements of the computing power of the device is lower,  to avoid the failure or vibration and other abnormal problems,  processing system has higher robustness. 1. A camera adaptive anti-overexposure real-time processing method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  A,  performing real-time human shape detection on the camera picture;  B,  when detecting that there is effective human shape in the camera picture,  pre-calculating the brightness adjusting value needed in the anti-exposure process;  C,  performing anti-over-exposure processing on the camera picture based on the pre-calculated value of the brightness adjusting value;  D,  judging whether to end the anti-overexposure process,  comprising :  when the human shape detection module cannot detect the human shape,  calculating the information variation of the current frame and the last frame of the camera picture,  wherein the information variation comprises the brightness variation,  if the information variation is greater than the preset threshold value,  the human body is considered to have left,  ending the anti-overexposure process,  returning to the step A;  if the information change amount is not greater than the preset threshold value,  the human body is considered not to leave,  and the camera picture is continuously performed with the anti-overexposure processing.

The present application relates to the technical field of robots,  and discloses a robot lower limb assembly,  a humanoid robot and a quadruped robot. The robot lower limb assembly includes :  a thigh assembly provided with a hollow inner cavity; A knee joint actuator disposed at an upper portion of the thigh assembly; A lower leg assembly having an upper end connected to a lower end of the upper leg assembly; The double-connecting-rod assembly is arranged in the hollow inner cavity,  the first end of the double-connecting-rod assembly is connected with the driving end of the knee joint actuator,  and the second end of the double-connecting-rod assembly is connected with the upper end of the shank assembly so as to drive the shank assembly to swing relative to the thigh assembly. In this embodiment,  the two links of the double link assembly can both transmit the driving force of the knee joint actuator. The present invention provides a method for recognition on objects’ shape and color based on humanoid robot,  which conducts the following steps through the loading of a robot :  capturing an image including the target object from the photographic apparatus the robot configured and converting its color space
recognizing the color of the target object through a color recognizing instruction based on the color space
conducting edge detection after processing binarization and denoising on the image to obtain the edge information of the target object that defines the shape of the target object. A method for identifying the shape and color of objects based on a humanoid robot,  which is loaded by a robot and then performs the following steps. The steps include :  
The photography device configured on the robot captures an image containing a target object and converts and defines its color space;  
Identify the color of the target object through a color recognition command according to the color space;  and 
After binarizing and denoising the image,  perform edge detection to obtain edge information of the target object and then define the shape of the target object.

The present application relates to a method,  device and equipment for controlling stair walking of a multi-legged robot. The method includes acquiring a gradient direction of stair information of walking of the multi-legged robot; Developing a walking path of the multi-legged robot according to the gradient direction of the stair information,  and setting an obstacle avoidance strategy and a gait switching sign on the walking path; The multi-legged robot is controlled to walk in the stair area according to the selected walking path,  the gait switching sign and the obstacle avoidance strategy. The method controls a multi-legged robot to walk in a stair area according to a selected walking path,  a gait switching sign and an obstacle avoidance strategy,  The mechanism capable of automatically switching on and off or switching the obstacle avoidance function according to the obstacle avoidance strategy is realized,  and the problem that the multi-legged robot cannot normally operate due to the fact that the structure of the stair triggers obstacle detection of the multi-legged robot is solved,  so that the multi-legged robot can automatically avoid the obstacle and walk on the stair. The invention solves the technical problem that the control mode of the robot used for electric power inspection can not automatically avoid obstacles on stairs. 1. A multi-foot robot stair walking control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the stair information of the multi-foot robot,  wherein the stair information comprises the stair area and the gradient direction of the stair;  according to the gradient direction of the stair information,  making a walking path of the multi-foot robot,  and setting a barrier-avoiding strategy and a gait switching mark on the walking path;  controlling the multi-foot robot to walk in the stair region according to the selected walking path,  the gait switching mark and the obstacle avoiding strategy;  The content of the obstacle avoidance policy includes :  setting an obstacle-avoiding detection opening mark,  an obstacle-avoiding detection closing mark,  an uplink obstacle-avoiding switching mark and a downlink obstacle-avoiding switching mark on the walking path;  if the multi-foot robot is switched from the flat ground mode to the obstacle-crossing mode according to the gait switching mark,  controlling the obstacle-avoiding detection function of the multi-foot robot to close or switching the obstacle-avoiding detection element to the upward view mode;  in the walking process of the multi-foot robot according to the walking path,  when the multi-foot robot identifies the obstacle-avoiding detection opening mark,  controlling the obstacle-avoiding detection element to open so that the multi-foot robot performs obstacle-avoiding detection;  in the walking process of the multi-foot robot according to the walking path,  when the multi-foot robot recognizes the obstacle-avoiding detection closing mark,  controlling the obstacle-avoiding detection element to close so that the multi-foot robot does not perform obstacle-avoiding detection,  until the multi-foot robot switches from the obstacle-crossing mode to the flat ground mode according to the gait switching mark,  controlling the multi-foot robot to perform obstacle avoidance detection;  or the multi-foot robot controls the obstacle-avoiding detecting element to be switched to the normal mode when the multi-foot robot identifies the uplink obstacle-avoiding switching mark according to the walking path walking process;  when the multi-foot robot recognizes the downlink obstacle-avoiding switching mark,  controlling the obstacle-avoiding detecting element to switch to the upward view mode,  until the multi-foot robot switches to the flat ground mode according to the gait switching mark,  controlling the obstacle-avoiding detecting element to switch to the normal mode.

The present application provides a biped robot,  a humanoid robot,  and a motion control method,  system,  and medium thereof. A motion control method of biped robot,  wherein it comprises :  according to the motion instruction of the biped robot,  calculating the joint torque value of the joint module when the biped robot finishes the motion indicated by the motion instruction,  wherein the joint module of the biped robot comprises a planetary speed reducer and a motor,  but does not comprise a torque sensor;  determining the input current value of the motor in the joint module according to the joint torque value and the current-torque mapping relation,  wherein the current-torque mapping relation is the corresponding relation between the input current of the motor in the joint module and the output torque of the planetary speed reducer;  according to the input current value,  controlling the input current of the motor in the joint module,  so as to control the output torque of the planetary speed reducer in the joint module,  so that the biped robot finishes the movement indicated by the movement instruction;  the motion instruction is a motion speed instruction or a reference position instruction input by a user,  the step of calculating the joint torque value of the joint module when the biped robot finishes the motion indicated by the motion instruction according to the motion instruction of the biped robot comprises :  calculating the body reference movement acceleration of the biped robot according to the movement speed instruction or the reference position instruction;  obtaining the contact force and the motion acceleration of the joint module by using the machine body reference motion acceleration and performing the optimal value solution based on the secondary planning;  using the dynamic equation of the biped robot to calculate the contact force and the movement acceleration of the joint module to obtain the joint torque value.

The invention discloses a method and a system for a four-legged robot dog to climb industrial stairs,  and relates to the technical field of four-legged robot dogs. The method comprises the following steps of :  starting the four-legged robot dog,  wherein the four-legged robot dog adopts a front-back elbow type motion,  and when a robot moves forward and encounters a step,  calculating the height of the step by calculating the time used in a leg falling process; When both front legs step on the steps,  the estimated step height adjusts the elevation angle of the machine dog,  the elevation angle being determined according to the step height; After the two rear legs are also stepped up to the steps stably,  one depression action is performed to adjust the body back to the horizontal posture; A completion signal is sent through an internal feedback mechanism to notify the operator of completion of the task. According to the method for climbing the industrial stairs by the four-legged robot dog,  the success rate of climbing the industrial stairs by the four-legged robot dog is remarkably improved,  the energy consumption of climbing the industrial stairs by the four-legged robot dog is effectively reduced,  the climbing strategy is adjusted according to the actual electric quantity and the attributes of the steps,  and the speed and the stability of climbing the industrial stairs by the four-legged robot dog are improved. 1. A method for four-foot robot dog to climb industrial stair,  wherein it comprises :  starting the four-foot robot dog,  the four-foot robot dog adopts the front and back elbow type movement,  when the robot meets the step,  calculating the height of the step by calculating the time used in the falling process of the leg;  when the two front legs are on the step,  the estimated step height adjusts the elevation angle of the robot dog,  the elevation angle is determined according to the step height;  after the two rear legs are stably stepped on the step,  the machine body is adjusted back to the horizontal posture;  the finishing signal is sent by the internal feedback mechanism to inform the operator to finish the task.

The invention discloses a control method of a legged robot and a robot. By adjusting the coefficient of friction corresponding to the foot end of the at least one leg from a first coefficient of friction to a second coefficient of friction within a first time interval if it is detected that the foot end of the at least one leg is in a slipping state in the present control cycle; Adjusting the coefficient of friction corresponding to the foot end of the at least one leg from the second coefficient of friction to the first coefficient of friction during a second time interval; The duration of the first time interval is less than the duration of the second time interval; The first coefficient of friction is greater than the second coefficient of friction. By,  upon detection of a slipping event of the foot end of at least one leg of the legged robot,  The coefficient of friction is reduced rapidly during a shorter first period of time,  and the coefficient of friction is allowed to rise slowly during a longer second period of time upon detection of a slip-off event of at least one leg,  thereby enabling more stable control and movement of the robot based on the different change states of the coefficient of friction under different conditions. 1. A foot-type robot control method,  wherein the foot-type robot comprises at least two legs,  the method comprises :  if the sliding event of the foot end of at least one leg is detected in the current control period,  adjusting the friction coefficient corresponding to the foot end of at least one leg from the first friction coefficient to the second friction coefficient;  adjusting the friction coefficient corresponding to the foot end of the at least one leg from the second friction coefficient to the first friction coefficient if the slip stopping event of the foot end of the at least one leg is detected;  the first friction coefficient is greater than the second friction coefficient;  The second coefficient of friction will be adaptively adjusted according to the slippage of the foot end of the at least one leg at each control cycle or at intervals of a certain number of control cycles.

The invention relates to a four-legged robot dog positioning and posture determining method based on point cloud pixel-level mapping,  and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps of :  inputting three-dimensional laser point cloud data acquired by a laser radar,  performing mapping conversion on the acquired three-dimensional data by taking a global reference coordinate system Z axis,  a Y axis and an X axis as references respectively,  and eliminating hashed points and isolated points; Calculating two-dimensional pixel mapping point weighted scores,  setting a score threshold and constructing a model to extract two-dimensional mapping feature points,  performing dynamic grid division on a two-dimensional mapping surface according to the number of target feature points and realizing uniform distribution of feature points; Using a fast global mapping scale feature vector matching method,  constructing a minimized mapping projection error according to the matching point pair to obtain the pose change of the mapping surface,  and correcting the three-dimensional point cloud with the value; The pose results of the three mapping planes are fused,  so that an accurate pose estimation of the four-legged robot dog can be quickly obtained. 1. A four-legged robot dog positioning and attitude determining method based on point cloud pixel level mapping,  wherein The method comprises the following steps :  S1 :  the three-dimensional laser point cloud data collected by the laser radar is input,  the collected three-dimensional data is mapped and converted by the point cloud pixel level mapping module based on the global reference coordinate system Z axis,  and the hash point and the isolated point are removed;  S2 :  calculating the weighted score of the two-dimensional pixel mapping point,  setting the score threshold and constructing the model to extract the two-dimensional mapping characteristic point,  dynamically dividing the two-dimensional mapping surface according to the number of the target characteristic point and realizing the uniform distribution of the characteristic point;  S3 :  using the matching method of the fast global mapping scale characteristic vector,  according to the matching point pair,  constructing the minimum mapping projection error to obtain the pose change of the Z-axis mapping surface,  and using the pose change of the Z-axis mapping surface to modify the three-dimensional laser point cloud;  S4 :  performing mapping conversion on the modified three-dimensional point cloud based on the Y-axis of the global reference coordinate system,  and executing the same content as the step S2-S3,  and modifying the three-dimensional laser point cloud according to the position change of the Y-axis mapping surface;  S5 :  finally,  mapping the modified three-dimensional laser point cloud with the X axis of the global reference coordinate system as the reference,  and executing the same content as the step S2-S3,  fusing the pose results of three mapping planes,  so as to obtain the pose estimation of the four-foot robot dog.

A four-foot robot path search method based on adaptive robust control and improved grey wolf algorithm fusion technology,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1,  when the fleet meets the complex unknown terrain similar to the gorge,  the optimal path is not clear and the fleet can successfully pass through,  the fleet sends the small fleet composed of six four-foot robots to enter the gorge,  at the same time,  sends four four four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles to fly to the upper part of the gorge;  step 2,  after six four-foot robots enter the gorge,  starting to adopt the self-adaptive robust formation control scheme to change the formation of the four-foot robot,  wherein three four-foot robots are triangular formation and the other three are changed according to the formation required by the improved grey wolf algorithm;  step 3,  after the four four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles fly over the gorge,  one of the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles flew to the end of the gorge quickly,  after determining the end point,  the information is transmitted to the four-foot robot formation,  directing the direction of travel of the whole four-foot robot formation,  at the same time,  the total length information of the gorge is sent to the other two four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles,  the total length is divided into three equal parts;  wherein one unmanned aerial vehicle flew from the robot formation movement starting point position to a quarter of the total length of the gorge,  and the other unmanned aerial vehicle flew to the middle of the total length of the gorge,  and there is also a accompanying four-foot robot formation for real-time transmission of path information to the starting point,  and the robot formation moves to the position of the gorge end point to stay,  after the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle initially flying to the end sends the information such as position and distance to the other unmanned aerial vehicles,  returning to the position of the formation starting point to the position of /4 of the total length of the gorge;  step 4,  using the self-adaptive robust formation control algorithm to control the array type of six four-foot robots,  so that three four-foot robots form a triangular array type,  named as delta group,  the side length of the triangular array type is consistent with the maximum vehicle width in the vehicle group,  the periphery of each four-foot robot body in the delta group is carried with an ultrasonic sensor,  when the distance between the system and the rock wall is too close,  the system will send an alarm to indicate that the line has reached the top end,  stopping approaching to the rock wall,  and starting to advance to the target position at the other side,  the other three are performed with formation transformation according to the improved grey wolf algorithm;  step 5,  after the four four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles fly over the gorge,  one of the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles flew to the end of the gorge quickly,  transmitting the path end point information to the four-foot robot formation,  guiding the direction of travel of the whole four-foot robot formation,  at the same time,  sending the total length information of the gorge to the other two four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles,  the total length is divided into four equal parts;  step 6,  the three four-foot robot in charge of searching are respectively named as α,  β,  γ,  the three four-foot robot according to improved grey wolf algorithm proceed path search,  α,  β,  γ,  δ three groups of four-foot robot calculation force initial descending; A disturbance suppression and stabilization control method of foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the motion gait of the foot-type robot is divided into a supporting phase and a swinging phase,  and a supporting phase foot-type robot position posture control model is established in the three-dimensional space;  mapping the virtual force needed by the motion of the foot-type robot to each motor of the leg and foot joint through the Jacobian matrix based on the established position and posture control model of the supporting foot-type robot so as to obtain the joint moment of the single leg of the foot-type robot;  establishing a swinging phase virtual force model and a position posture control model in the three-dimensional space based on the joint moment of the single leg of the foot-type robot;  establishing a system state space model of the foot robot according to the established swinging phase virtual force model and the position posture control model;  a SMO-EID disturbance suppression controller is configured for the system state space model,  wherein the disturbance suppression controller comprises an equivalent input disturbance estimator,  a sliding mode observer and a state feedback control rate so as to realize disturbance suppression and stable control of the foot robot.

The present invention relates to the field of information processing,  The invention discloses a tool identification method and a tool identification device based on deep learning and color space. Through an improved HSV color space,  according to the unique illumination characteristics of outdoor tools,  the trajectory of the brightness V value is adjusted,  and is changed from a fixed value to a dynamic value,  so that the original characteristics of data can be more expressed,  and the accuracy of characteristic extraction is ensured; Meanwhile,  by using the renet50 network,  algorithm overfitting is avoided; and by combining deep learning target detection and human shape detection,  the accuracy of tool identification is ensured. 1. A tooling identification method based on deep learning and colour space,  wherein the method comprises :  Step 101 :  obtaining a tool monitoring image data set;  step 102 :  performing data pre-processing on the tooling image data set image,  after screening the tooling image data set image,  performing resolution unified processing;  Step 103 :  performing data enhancement on the tooling image in the tooling image data set after the data pre-processing,  and performing enhancement on the HSV color space in the data comprises :  when the visual perception caused by different illumination is different,  calculating by the Value channel,  extracting the edge of the object by calculating the gradient;  when the foreground saturation is high,  the background uses the colour with low saturation to support the foreground and extract the information of the Saturation channel;  when it is in the indoor scene and the style is simple,  the weight value of the Hue channel is increased;  changing the value of the brightness V from static state to dynamic state;  step 104 :  constructing a tool identification network,  based on the characteristic that the difference between the tool except the colour is small,  using the residual network to avoid over-fit;  sending the tool image data set after data enhancement to the target detection humanoid network model for detection,  extracting the tool image humanoid data set;  step 105,  using the tool image data set after data enhancement to train the tool classification network,  obtaining the tool identification model;  Step 106 :  performing tool classification detection on the tool monitoring image to be detected using the tool identification model.

A method and apparatus for controlling the movement of a legged robot,  and a device,  a medium and a program. This study uses image processing and Internet of Things (IoT) technology to demonstrate a wireless hand gesture control robot with object identification. Users can remotely operate a robot using hand gestures that are photographed by a camera and analyzed using machine learning algorithms and image processing methods for gesture identification. The system has object detection capabilities as well,  allowing the robot to find and recognize items in its environment. In order to allow users to construct their own gestures and instructions,  the suggested system is made to be adaptive and versatile. Additionally,  it incorporates Internet of Things (IoT) technology,  enabling remote control and supervision of the robot via a web-based interface or a mobile application. The system offers a distinct and user-friendly interface and has potential uses in home automation,  surveillance,  and remote exploration

The invention discloses a method for controlling a four-foot twelve-degree-of-freedom robot to move stably. According to the information of the IMU sensor,  the foot end pressure sensor,  The motion range of the foot end track of the robot is restrained,  the foot end coordinates of the robot are converted into joint angles through a kinematics inverse solution process,  simulation training is carried out through a reward function and modulated parameters,  a stable diagonal trotting gait is obtained in simulation software,  and the robot can stably walk under complex terrain conditions such as rugged terrains and steps. 1. A method system for training four-foot robot movement by using enhanced learning model,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step one :  the four-foot robot is set as the stable standing posture and the state that the Euler angle is zero as the initial posture;  step two :  the foot end pressure sensor and the IMU sensor are used for reading the data to obtain the touchdown state of the four-foot robot and the Euler angle of the robot posture;  step three :  taking the earth touching state of the robot and the Euler angle of the posture and the motor angle of the robot as the input quantity of the strengthening learning model;  step four :  the motor angle and the Euler angle data are used for constructing a multi-layer sensing machine,  the motor angle and the ground contacting state and the Euler angle data are used for establishing a reward function,  and judging whether the robot is grounded according to the ground contacting state and the Euler angle,  if the robot is grounded,  then according to whether the total reward amount of the training is greater than the current maximum total reward amount,  if so,  updating the multi-layer perceptron,  if not,  not updating;  if not,  executing step five;  step five :  the strengthening learning model outputs the foot space coordinate,  uses the action space constraint mode,  and uses the inverse kinematics to solve to obtain the target motor angle,  and ensures that the motor angle is limited in a certain range,  and controls the next movement of the four-foot robot;  step six :  controlling the robot motor to rotate to the motor angle obtained in the step five,  repeating the step two to four,  so as to realize the closed-loop training of the robot.
