The invention discloses an obstacle avoidance method,  an obstacle avoidance device and a computer readable medium for an indoor bionic multi-legged robot. The method comprises the following steps of :  continuously acquiring indoor point cloud images by a camera mounted on the bionic multi-legged robot,  and calculating surface normal vectors of the point cloud images; Calculating the surface normal vector to obtain the estimated direction of gravity,  and rotating the point cloud image so that the Y-axis of the camera coordinate system is parallel to the estimated direction of gravity,  to correct the inclination generated when the bionic multi-legged robot moves; Calculating the height value and coordinate of each point of the corrected image,  and the bionic multi-legged robot proceeds,  avoids or crosses according to the height value and preset threshold value. According to the method,  the Y axis of the camera coordinate system is aligned with the direction estimated by the gravity,  so that the inclination generated when the robot moves is corrected; By calculating the height value of each point of the point cloud image from the ground,  the influence caused by the unfixed height of the machine body from the ground is avoided; The method has the advantages of no need of target identification,  less calculation amount and more accurate obstacle judgment. 1. An indoor bionic multi-foot robot obstacle-avoiding method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  continuously obtaining the indoor point cloud image by the camera mounted on the bionic multi-foot robot,  and calculating the surface normal vector of the point cloud image;  S2 :  counting the surface normal vector to obtain the gravitational force estimation direction,  and rotating the point cloud image so that the Y axis of the camera coordinate system is parallel to the gravitational force estimation direction,  so as to correct the inclination generated when the bionic multi-foot robot moves;  S3 :  calculating the height value and coordinate of each point of the corrected image,  the bionic multi-foot robot continuously advances,  avoids or spans according to the height value and the preset threshold value;  the surface normal vector of the point cloud image is calculated by PCA point cloud normal vector estimation method for estimating normal vector m;  in the S2,  the method for counting the surface normal vector and obtaining the estimated direction of the gravitational force,  and rotating the point cloud image so that the Y axis of the camera coordinate system is parallel to the estimated direction of the gravitational force comprises :  S2.1 :  setting the gravity direction as gn-1,  distributing the surface normal vector m to the set M1 and the set M2,  wherein M1 and M2 respectively represent the direction parallel to the gravity estimation direction and vertical to the gravity estimation direction;  M1 = (m :  theta (m,  gn-1) < e or theta (m,  gn-1) >  180 °-e) M2 = (m :  90 °-e < theta (m,  gn-1) < 90 ° + e) wherein theta (m,  gn-1) gn-1) represents the included angle between the normal vector m and the gravitational force estimation direction gn-1,  e is an iteration threshold value;  S2.2 :  searching the feature vector corresponding to the minimum feature value of the matrix M2 (M2) t-M1 (M1) t as the new estimation value gn of the gravitational force direction;  repeating S2.1 and S1.2 until the termination condition is satisfied,  and calculating to obtain the final gravitational force estimation direction g;  S2.3 :  calculating the cross product of the Y axis and the final gravitational force estimation direction g to obtain the vector n,  and unitizing the vector n;  S2.4 :  calculating the inner product of the Y axis and the final gravitational force estimation direction g to obtain the included angle delta thereof;  S2.5 :  taking n as axis,  rotating delta angle to obtain the corrected point cloud image,  so as to correct the inclination generated when the bionic multi-foot robot moves.

The invention discloses a design method of a humanoid robot vision sensing system. A computing unit NVIDIA Jetson orin is adopted,  and a sensing unit is composed of a depth camera Intel realsense D455,  a binocular camera StereoLabs ZED2i,  a laser radar Livox Avia,  a Lucid Helios 2ToF camera and a support plate made of resin materials. The sensing system is intended to simulate human vision,  thereby completing the tasks required for map construction,  object detection,  etc. In the moving process of the robot,  the D455 and Avia at the upper end of the system jointly calibrate to complete the mapping and positioning functions of the robot,  the StereoLabs ZED2i at the middle end of the system completes indoor and outdoor environment recognition,  and the Lucid Helios 2ToF camera at the lower end of the bracket completes the target detection function. The computing unit NVIDIA Jetson orin at the tail of the system provides computational support for it. The experimental device can effectively solve the problems of looseness and difficult fusion test of the humanoid robot in the moving process of the actual environment. 1.  The visual sensing system selects to fix the deep camera Intel realsense D455 and the laser radar Livox Avia on the head of the humanoid robot,  that is,  the upper end of the bracket,  placing the binocular camera StereoLabs ZED2i in the thorax of the humanoid robot,  that is,  fixing it on the front section of the bracket,  The Lucid Helios 2 ToF camera is fixed in the abdominal cavity of the humanoid robot,  namely fixed under the binocular camera StereoLabs ZED2i; The invention discloses an energy storage leg structure for a wheeled-legged robot and the wheeled-legged robot with the energy storage leg structure,  and belongs to the technical field of robots. The present invention participates in the construction of a leg structure by skillfully designing an energy storage device,  The thigh nitrogen springs and the shank nitrogen springs are used as energy storage elements of the wheel-leg quadruped robot,  so that energy can be recovered and released,  and energy consumption is reduced; At the same time,  the impact is reduced,  the stability of the system is increased,  and the energy efficiency of the wheel-legged quadruped robot is greatly improved,  so that under the driving of the thigh and calf joint motors,  the gait movement can be completed through the swing of the thigh and calf on the discontinuous ground to cross obstacles; The movement of the robot can be completed through the walking wheels on the continuous fluctuation ground,  and meanwhile,  the gravity center of the robot can be better changed under the driving of the thigh and shank joint motors so as to realize the stability of a machine body. The invention relates to a method for adjusting leg injury gait of a multi-legged robot based on biological simulation learning. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing a video data set of a multi-legged animal in a composite injury state by constructing a multi-legged animal shooting platform; Using the key point detection technology to label the video data articulation points to obtain the angle change data of the joints of the polypods; Condensation analysis is performed on the joint angle change data,  the obtained information is used as a parameter to be sent into the CPG,  and a periodic signal consistent with biological rhythm is generated to be used for controlling the joint angle of the injury robot. Said invention can implement that under the condition of that the multi-legged robot is faced with composite damage,  The task of achieving gait adjustment with biomimetic learning,  The method for analyzing the posture of organisms by using the key point detection technology based on the stacked DenseNet can provide good data support for the statistical analysis of biological actions,  and the CPG based on biological data generates stable periodic oscillation signals,  which is used for controlling the gait of the injured robot. Good results have been achieved. 1. A multi-foot robot leg damage gait adjusting method based on biological simulation learning,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  1) building a biological damage gait shooting platform,  using the flat mirror imaging principle to simultaneously observe the biological damage motion condition under the upward view and the side view view angle,  and using the high speed camera to shoot the clear biological composite damage gait video with high frame rate;  2) constructing a multi-foot biological key point detection data set,  defining the trunk and each leg joint of the multi-foot biological as the key point,  extracting the key frame of a small amount of biological composite damage gait video,  performing manual marking on the multi-foot biological key point in the video,  because the process only marks a small amount of data,  in order to expand the data set and prevent over-fitting caused by insufficient training data,  performing data enhancement processing on the data set image to train a more robust model;  3) using the key point detection technology based on deep learning,  using the encoder-frames network architecture,  through the full convolution neural network building the stacked DenseNet key point detection network model,  introducing the middle monitoring technology,  applying the loss for model training to the output of each hourglass-shaped memory module to minimize the sum of the training loss as the training target function of the model;  4) cyclic training to improve the model detection precision,  after each training is finished,  obtaining the output of the key point detection network,  in the sampling verification process,  the confidence degree of the key point estimation value is too low or the image of position excessive deviation,  and re-performing manual marking,  sending the marked result to the training set for the next training until the model satisfies the pre-set effect;  5) obtaining the biological damage motion gait signal,  converting the position coordinate information output by the key point detection network into the biological joint angle information,  using the sliding average filter and Savitzky-Golay smooth filter to reduce the noise of the angle data;  6) obtaining the training information of the periodic angle data,  calculating the statistical data to obtain the average amplitude and duty ratio of the angle signal,  using the fast Fourier transform to decompose the angle signal into different frequencies and the corresponding phase,  respectively calculating the autocorrelation coefficient of the angle curve under the given frequency,  selecting the frequency corresponding to the maximum angle curve autocorrelation coefficient and the corresponding phase as the frequency information and phase information of the periodic signal;  step 2 :  establishing the online mapping between the fault leg of the six-foot robot and the alternative gait set :  traversing all possible leg fault states of the six-foot robot,  according to whether the leg fault of the six-foot robot can find a group of leg motion states that make the robot always in a static stable state in an off-line alternative gait set,  traversing and screening the fault-tolerant leg fault state set of the six-foot robot,  if the robot is fault-tolerant in a certain leg fault state,  the online mapping relationship between the number and position distribution of the robot fault leg and the alternative gait set can be established,  when the number of the real-time fault leg is 0 and fault-tolerant,  the leg motion state of the robot in the next step will be selected in the three-leg alternative gait set,  when the number of the real-time fault legs is 1 and fault-tolerant,  the leg movement state of the robot in the next step will be selected in the four-leg alternative gait set,  when the number of the real-time fault legs is 2 and fault-tolerant,  the leg movement state of the robot in the next step will be selected in the five-leg alternative gait set; The wheel-foot robot comprises a machine body,  two leg parts symmetrically arranged on two sides of the machine body,  two mechanical arms symmetrically arranged at the front end of the machine body and splicing structures arranged on the mechanical arms; Each mechanical arm comprises a large arm part and a small arm part; One end of the large arm part is hinged with the front end of the machine body,  and the other end of the large arm part is hinged with the top end of the small arm part; The splicing structure comprises an adsorption iron,  an electromagnet and an electronic switch; The two adsorption irons are respectively located at hinged positions of the large arm portions and the small arm portions of the two mechanical arms,  and the two electromagnets and the electronic switch are both installed at the tail portion of the machine body; The electronic switch is used to control the on-off of the electromagnet; When the small arm part is matched with the large arm part to swing to a specified position,  the adsorption iron can be attracted with an electromagnet at the tail part of a robot body of other robots,  so that a multi-body robot is spliced end to end; and when the small arm part is matched with the large arm part to swing to a specified position,  the adsorption iron can be attracted with the electromagnet at the tail part of the robot body of other robots,  so that a multi-body robot is formed. According to the invention,  free splicing of the same type of wheeled-legged robot can be realized,  and the environmental adaptability and the overall load capacity of the wheeled-legged robot are enhanced. 1. A wheel-foot robot capable of realizing double-arm splicing,  wherein it comprises :  a machine body,  two leg parts symmetrically installed on the two sides of the machine body,  two three-degree-of-freedom mechanical arms symmetrically installed on the front end of the machine body and a splicing structure installed on the mechanical arm;  each mechanical arm comprises a large arm part and a small arm part;  one end of the big arm part is hinged with the front end of the machine body,  the other end of the big arm part is hinged with the top end of the small arm part;  The splicing structure comprises :  two absorbing irons,  two electromagnets and an electronic switch;  two adsorption irons are respectively located at the hinged part of the big arm part and the small arm part of the two mechanical arms,  and each adsorption iron is installed at the top end of the small arm part;  two electromagnets and one electronic switch are installed at the tail part of the machine body;  the electronic switch is located between the two electromagnets;  the electronic switch is used for controlling the on-off of the electromagnet;  when the small arm part is matched with the large arm part to swing to the appointed position,  the absorbing iron can be absorbed with the electromagnet at the tail part of the machine body of other robots so as to be spliced end to end to form a multi-body robot.

The present invention discloses a video-based identity recognition method,  apparatus,  device and storage medium. The method includes :  obtaining video data collected by a monitoring device; Performing humanoid detection on a video frame in the video data according to a humanoid detection algorithm to obtain a humanoid picture intercepted by a humanoid detection frame; Performing identity labeling on the same person in the figure picture,  and judging whether the person in the figure picture has a recognizable face; If yes,  performing identity matching through the recognized face,  outputting corresponding result information,  and performing identity binding; Otherwise,  the database is looked up whether there is relevant record information matched with the figure body in the figure picture,  and if yes,  the corresponding result information is output. Personal identification can be carried out at different angles and in different postures,  so that the intelligent application capability of the whole visual identification in various scenes is improved. 1. An identity recognition method based on video,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the video data collected in the monitoring device;  detecting the human shape of the video frame in the video data according to the human shape detection algorithm to obtain the human shape picture intercepted by the human shape detection frame;  marking the identity of the same person in the human shape picture,  and judging whether the person in the human shape picture has recognizable human face;  if so,  outputting the corresponding result information after matching the identity of the identified human face,  and binding the identity;  otherwise,  searching whether there is associated record information matched with the human-shaped body in the human-shaped picture in the database,  if so,  outputting corresponding result information.

The invention discloses a virtual digital person lip synchronization method and a virtual digital person lip synchronization system. A virtual digital humanoid lip shape synchronization method,  wherein the method comprises :  shooting the video according to the pre-obtained target corpus to obtain the sample video,  and extracting the face image and the audio information from the sample video;  the face image is processed by OpenFace tool to obtain face key point image,  and the audio information is pre-processed and converted into Mel frequency spectrum;  training the Wav2Lip model based on the face key point image and the Mel spectrogram,  and processing the target video by the trained Wav2Lip model to obtain the corresponding lip-shaped video.

The invention discloses a driver electrocardiogram state monitoring and classifying system and a driver electrocardiogram state monitoring and classifying method. According to the invention,  the microprocessor collects electrocardiosignals at a plurality of moments through the electrocardiosignal sensor,  and the humanoid marks the type of the real driving state at each moment; Constructing a driving ECG state classification neural network,  and optimizing training to obtain an optimized driving ECG state classification neural network; The electrocardio signal sensor collects real-time electrocardio signals and outputs the real-time electrocardio signals to the microprocessor. The microprocessor predicts and classifies the real-time ECG signals through the optimized driving ECG state classification neural network to obtain a real-time driving state prediction type,  and the real-time driving state prediction type is displayed through the display module. If the driving state prediction type belongs to driving fatigue,  voice early warning is performed through the early warning module. The advantage of this invention lies in the use of lightweight deep learning model,  fast response speed,  strong functionality; The physiological state of the driver can be monitored in real time,  so that early warning can be carried out in the first time. 1. A driver electrocardiogram state monitoring and classifying system,  wherein it comprises :  a microprocessor,  an electrocardiosignal sensor,  a display module and an early warning module;  the microprocessor is respectively connected with the electrocardiosignal sensor,  the display module and the pre-warning module in turn;  the microprocessor is arranged in the centre of the steering wheel of the vehicle;  the electrocardiosignal sensor is arranged at the handle of the steering wheel of the vehicle;  the display module is located in the middle of the steering wheel;  the pre-warning module is located on the right side of the display module;  the electrocardiosignal sensor is used for collecting the electrocardiosignal in real time and outputting to the microprocessor;  the microprocessor is used for classifying the electrocardiosignal collected in real time by the electrocardiogram state classifying method of the driver to obtain the driving state type of the driver,  outputting the driving state type to the display module to display,  and pre-warning by the pre-warning module.

According to the invention,  the problem that the humanoid robot in the prior art cannot accurately track and avoid obstacles on the moving object in the environment is solved; and by utilizing the NAO robot development platform and combining the vision sensor and the ultrasonic sensor,  the humanoid robot can accurately track the moving object in the environment and accurately avoid obstacles in the tracking process. 1. A method for human-shaped robot to track moving target and avoid obstacle,  wherein it comprises :  identifying the moving target and obtaining the position of the moving target in the space,  controlling the robot to track the moving target according to the calculation result of the control algorithm;  when tracking the moving target,  obtaining the distance between the robot and the surrounding object,  and controlling the human-shaped robot to perform the obstacle-avoiding action according to the calculation result of the obstacle-avoiding algorithm.

The invention provides a multi-gait switching and control method of a quadruped robot and a computer readable medium. The single gait cycle time is calculated by setting the vacation phase time,  the landing phase cycle time,  the phase difference and the timer frequency,  and the current bottoming system time is used as the phase control time. A multi-gait switching and control method of four-foot robot,  wherein obtaining the current touchdown system time through the four-foot robot,  taking the current touchdown system time as the phase control time;  calculating the time difference of the starting time of the single gait period of different legs;  calculating the duty ratio of different legs and different gait states according to the time difference of the starting time of the single gait period of different legs;  calculating the control variable of the current leg in real time,  realizing the control of the vacated foot and joint of the current leg.

The present invention provides a method for creating a security garment pattern for a humanoid body,  Comprising the steps of :  a. inputting a specific clothing pattern and an image of a human-like body into a clothing synthesis network by a security clothing pattern generating device in the case of acquiring at least one image of the human-like body,  synthesizing the clothing of the human-like body and the specific clothing pattern,  thereby generating a synthesized image; Step b :  the security clothing pattern generating means inputs the composite image to an image conversion network,  thereby converting the surrounding environment on the composite image and generating a converted image,  and inputs the converted image to an object detector to output detection information on a humanoid body; And c. using the first loss layer as reference to the detected information and the GT corresponding to the image of the anthropomorphic body to calculate the loss,  and updating the initial value by using the loss. 1. A method for generating at least one security garment pattern for a human-like body,  comprising :  step a :  under the condition of obtaining at least one image of the humanoid body,  the safety clothes pattern generating device executes the process of generating at least one specific clothes pattern with initial value and the process of inputting the specific clothes pattern and the image of the humanoid body to the clothes synthesis network,  causing the garment synthesis network to synthesize the garment of the human-like body and the particular garment pattern on the image of the human-like body,  thereby generating at least one composite image corresponding to the image of the human-like body;  step b :  The safety garment pattern generation device performs the following process :  inputting the composite image to an image conversion network so that the image conversion network converts a peripheral environment on the composite image and generates at least one converted image;  and inputting the converted image to an object detector to cause the object detector to output detection information representing the human-like body detected on the converted image with respect to the human-like body;  and step c :  The safety garment pattern generation device performs the following process :  calculating at least one loss by a first loss layer with reference to the detection information about the human-like body and at least one real value GT corresponding to the image of the human-like body;  and updating the initial value of the particular garment pattern with the loss,  thereby minimizing the loss.

A robot gait planning method,  wherein the method comprises :  according to the real time information of the centroid height of the humanoid robot at the current time and the first centroid height expected information of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait period,  planning the first centroid height change track of the humanoid robot in the residual stepping time period of the current gait period,  wherein the remaining stepping time period is the time period from the current time to the end of the current gait period;  according to the first centroid height expected information and the second centroid height expected information of the humanoid robot at the end of the next gait period,  planning the second centroid height change track of the humanoid robot in the next gait period;  according to the first centroid height change track,  the second centroid height change track,  the centroid forward real-time information of the humanoid robot at the current moment and the centroid forward expected stopping speed of the humanoid robot at the end of the next gait period,  calculating the centroid forward expected information and the foot point expected position of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait period satisfying the kinematics rule of the robot.

The invention relates to the technical field of image processing,  solves the problem that human shape privacy can not be shielded simply and accurately in the prior art,  and provides a human shape privacy shielding method,  device and equipment based on posture recognition. The method includes :  acquiring a real-time initial video image in a monitoring scene,  and backing up the initial video image to be recorded as a backup video image; Respectively processing the initial video image and the backup video image according to a preset human body gesture recognition rule to recognize the gesture of the current monitored object; A shielding trigger condition is preset,  when the posture of the current monitored object meets the shielding trigger condition,  stylization processing is triggered to be performed on the initial video image,  the processed video image is overlapped with the initial video image,  and the overlapped video image is output,  so that the human-shaped privacy shielding is realized; and when the posture of the current monitored object meets the shielding trigger condition,  the stylization processing is performed on the initial video image,  and the processed video image is overlapped with the initial video image. According to the invention,  the working process of human shape privacy shielding is reduced,  and the probability of false touch is reduced. 1. A human-shaped privacy shading method based on gesture identification,  wherein the method comprises :  S1 :  obtaining the real-time initial video image under the monitoring scene,  and then backing up the initial video image,  recording as the backup video image;  S2 :  respectively processing the initial video image and the backup video image according to the preset human body posture identification rule,  and identifying the posture of the current monitoring object;  S3 :  pre-setting a shielding trigger condition,  when the posture of the current monitored object is in accordance with the shielding trigger condition,  triggering the initial video image to be stylized,  superposing the processed video image with the initial video image,  outputting the superposed video image,  realizing the human-shaped privacy shielding;  the S2 comprises :  S21 :  detecting the human shape of the initial video image and extracting the human shape area corresponding to the monitored object;  S22 :  performing human face detection in the human shape area,  according to the human face identification result in the human shape area,  identifying the human face orientation of the current monitored object;  S23 :  performing filter processing and skin segmentation processing on the backup video image to extract a hand region,  determining the relative position relationship between the human-shaped region and the hand region,  and identifying the arm state of the current monitored object according to the relative position relationship;  S24 :  using the virtual closed curve to mark the minimum external ellipse of the hand area,  extracting the characteristic information of the minimum external ellipse,  according to the characteristic information of the minimum external ellipse,  identifying the palm state and gesture direction of the current monitored object;  S25 :  synthesizing the face orientation,  arm state,  palm state and gesture orientation of the current monitoring object to obtain the posture of the current monitoring object;  The S22 includes :  S221 :  performing face detection in the human-shaped area,  identifying whether there is a face of the monitored object in the human-shaped area;  S222 :  if the face of the monitored object is identified,  the direction of the face is opposite to the direction;  S223 :  if the face of the monitored object does not exist,  the face orientation is back to back orientation;  The S23 includes :  S231 :  respectively obtaining the first position information of the human-shaped area and the second position information of the hand area;  S232 :  according to the first position information and the second position information,  judging whether the hand area is in the human-shaped area;  S233 :  if the hand area is in the human-shaped area,  the arm state is forward hand extending state;  S234 :  if the hand area is not in the humanoid area,  further calculating the distance between the hand area and the humanoid area;  S235 :  further identifying the arm state as an inclined state or a horizontal stretching state according to the distance between the hand region and the human-shaped region;  The S24 includes :  S241 :  using the virtual closed curve to mark the minimum external ellipse of the hand area,  and calculating the ratio of the long axis to the short axis of the minimum external ellipse;  S242 :  judging the hand shape of the current monitored object according to the long-short axis ratio of the minimum external ellipse;  S243 :  according to the hand shape,  identifying the palm state as an extended state or a fist-holding state;  S244 :  calculating the long axis slope of the minimum external ellipse,  and identifying the gesture orientation as upward or downward according to the long axis slope.

The present invention belongs to the field of mental health detection technology. AI screening :  Through 30-60 seconds of real-time video collection technology combined with psychology + physiology to obtain relevant mental health indicators,  four risk levels of zero + low + medium + high (10 types of results) are studied and judged. Regular testing to obtain individual and group standards,  Accurate early warning,  form a psychological research and judgment report for the tested personnel,  remind the supervisors and psychologists to focus on medium + high-risk personnel; Verification :  An internationally advanced medical equipment that integrates health status detection and intervention,  comprehensive,  accurate,  safe,  and fast. For the screened adolescents,  complete the reactivity detection of more than 11000 substances in the human body within 5 minutes,  and According to the order of risk values,  so as to find the greatest risk,  hidden danger,  and root cause that affect individual health; The non-contact psychological testing device is convenient to use,  easy to use,  safe and stable. 1. This patent disclosure covers System,  Method and Design of Brain Tumor Detection Using Image Segmentation. The human brain is the major controller of the humanoid system. The abnormal growth and division of cells in the brain lead to a brain tumor,  and the further growth of brain tumors leads to brain cancer. In the area of human health,  Computer Vision plays a significant role,  which reduces the human judgment that gives accurate results. CT scans,  XRay,  and MRI scans are the common imaging methods among magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) that are the most reliable and secure. Our paper aims to focus on the use of different techniques for the discovery of brain cancer using brain MRI. We performed pre-processing using the bilateral filter (BF) for removal of the noises that are present in an MR image followed by the binary thresholding and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) segmentation techniques for reliable detection of the tumor region. Training,  testing,  and validation datasets are used. The resultant outcomes include accuracy,  sensitivity,  and specificity. It is desired that the proposed work would exhibit a more exceptional performance over its counterparts

The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing,  and provides an intelligent sitting posture monitoring method,  device,  equipment and a storage medium. The intelligent sitting posture monitoring method,  device,  equipment and the storage medium solve the technical problems that an existing sitting posture analysis mode is too absolute in result,  does not conform to a real using state,  and generates wrong guidance in the sitting posture analysis result. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a video stream of a target area comprising a target object and standard sitting posture parameters for representing a sitting posture state; Extracting a humanoid parameter and a face parameter of a target object corresponding to each frame in the video stream; The human shape parameters and the human face parameters are compared with the standard sitting posture parameters,  and a sitting posture state is output. The invention also includes a device,  an apparatus and a storage medium for carrying out the above method. According to the invention,  the humanoid parameters and the human face parameters of the target object in a time period are analyzed,  so that the situation that the normal activities of the target object are misjudged to be abnormal sitting postures is eliminated,  and the accuracy of sitting posture detection is improved; and the method and the device have the advantages that the human shape parameters and the human face parameters of the target object in a time period are analyzed,  so that the situation that the normal activities of the target object are misjudged to be abnormal sitting postures is eliminated. 1. An intelligent sitting posture monitoring method,  wherein the method comprises :  S1 :  obtaining the video stream including the target area of the target object and the standard sitting posture parameter for representing the sitting posture state;  wherein,  the S1 comprises :  S11 :  obtaining a video stream for standard sitting posture check and a check threshold;  S12 :  calculating the face attitude angle variance and face position variance corresponding to all frame images in the video stream;  S13 :  respectively comparing the face attitude angle variance and the face position variance with the corresponding check threshold value,  and outputting the comparison result;  S14 :  if the comparison result meets the requirement of the check threshold value,  outputting the sitting posture parameter as the standard sitting posture parameter;  Wherein,  the S14 comprises :  if the comparison result is :  if the human face attitude angle variance is less than or equal to the human face attitude angle variance threshold,  and the human shape position variance is less than or equal to the human shape position variance threshold,  then meeting the requirement,  at this time,  the sitting position parameter of the target object is used as the standard sitting position parameter;  the sitting posture parameter comprises :  human face position coordinate,  human shape position coordinate and human face attitude angle;  S15 :  if the comparison result does not meet the requirement of the check threshold value,  repeating S11 to S13 according to the preset interval time until the comparison result meets the requirement of the check threshold value,  outputting the standard sitting posture parameter;  the standard sitting posture parameter is each parameter when the sitting posture of the target object is stable,  at least comprising one of the following :  human shape position information,  human face attitude angle information,  human face feature information;  S2 :  extracting the real-time sitting posture parameter of the target object corresponding to each frame in the video stream;  wherein,  the S2 comprises :  analyzing the human shape parameter and the human face parameter of the target object in each frame forming the video stream as the real-time sitting posture parameter;  the real-time sitting posture parameter comprises human shape and relative position of human face,  human face posture angle and human shape posture angle;  The human shape parameter includes at least one of the following :  key point position of human body,  human body outline position;  The face parameter includes at least one of the following :  face characteristic information,  face attitude angle information;  S3 :  comparing the real-time sitting posture parameter with the standard sitting posture parameter,  and outputting sitting posture state;  wherein if the relative position of the human shape and the human face meets the offset requirement,  the posture angle exceeds the offset range,  the sitting posture is abnormal,  or if the relative position of the human shape and the human face exceeds the offset range,  the sitting posture is abnormal.

The present invention relates to a method and a system for assessing an unmanned vehicle anthropomorphic driving risk,  comprising the following steps :  using an active sensor or a passive sensor to realize environment sensing,  and collecting surrounding environment information of a driving scene of an unmanned vehicle; Performing risk assessment on road environment obstacles of the unmanned vehicle according to human driving experience to generate a driving scenario cost map; Establishing a risk field model by using Gaussian function according to the basic principle of unmanned vehicle anthropomorphic driving; The risk field of the unmanned vehicle is multiplied by the driving scene cost map,  and the quantified driving risk is evaluated. According to the method and the system for evaluating the unmanned vehicle anthropomorphic driving risk,  the dynamic changing driving risk can be calculated based on the human driving experience,  the dynamic changing driving risk is applied to the unmanned vehicle,  the anthropomorphic driving behavior can be generated,  the unmanned vehicle can be better integrated into the human driving ecology,  and the distrust of a human driver on the unmanned vehicle is eliminated. The method and the system for evaluating the unmanned vehicle anthropomorphic driving risk have the advantages that the dynamic changing driving risk can be calculated based on the human driving experience. 1. An evaluation method of unmanned vehicle driving risk,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  using the active or passive sensor to realize the environment sensing,  collecting the surrounding environment information of the driving scene of the unmanned vehicle;  S2,  performing risk evaluation on the road environment obstacle of the unmanned vehicle according to the human driving experience,  generating a driving scene cost graph;  S3,  according to the basic principle of anthropomorphic driving of unmanned vehicle,  using Gaussian function to establish risk field model;  S4,  multiplying the risk field of the unmanned vehicle with the driving scene cost map,  evaluating and obtaining the quantified driving risk.

The purpose of the present invention is to provide an intelligent door lock control assembly and a vehicle. Compared with the prior art,  the intelligent door lock control assembly provided by the utility model comprises a human-shaped detection module,  which is used for detecting whether a person is close to a vehicle; A camera module,  configured to shoot human face image data; An intelligent data processing module,  configured to receive the human face image data sent by the camera module and determine whether the corresponding user is an authorized user of the vehicle based on the human face image data; A main control module,  communicatively connected to the humanoid detection module and the intelligent data processing module; The intelligent data processing module is used for activating other modules after the human shape detection module detects that a person is close to the intelligent data processing module,  and unlocking the lock based on an instruction after the intelligent data processing module determines an authorized user. In this way,  when a person gets close to the vehicle,  other modules are activated,  so that the false trigger rate can be reduced,  and the effect of saving energy is achieved; and moreover,  the lock can be unlocked only when an authorized user is detected,  so that the safety is improved. 1. A method for a multi-legged robot having a body and a number of legs,  includes :  obtaining a current pose of the body,  forces applied to the body,  and joint angles of each of supporting legs of the legs;  creating a mapping matrix from the forces applied to the body to desired support forces applied to soles of the supporting legs;  obtaining priority targets by prioritizing the forces acting in different directions,  determining a weight matrix for each priority target,  and creating an optimization model of the support forces for each priority target based on the mapping matrix and the weight matrices;  solving the optimization model of each of the priority targets to obtain the desired support forces corresponding to each of the priority targets;  and calculating joint torques of the supporting legs for joint control,  based on the solved desired support forces and Jacobian matrices corresponding to the supporting legs.

The invention relates to the field of computer vision,  in particular to an embedded real-time human figure detection method and device. The method comprises the following steps of :  obtaining a human figure detection model based on a convolutional neural network by training in advance; Performing image collection in a spatial range to be detected by utilizing a human-shaped detection device,  and calculating an ROI region; Selecting a detection stage according to the ROI region,  dynamically adjusting the resolution of the image and inputting the adjusted image into the humanoid detection model; Utilizing a humanoid detection model,  in combination with a multi-kernel parallel algorithm and a fast convolution algorithm to conduct a convolution operation on the input image to extract feature data; A plurality of humanoid candidate boxes are obtained according to the characteristic data,  and a humanoid target is finally determined after screening and fusion. Model training is performed on the basis of the convolution neural network,  detection precision is high,  multi-core parallel and fast convolution algorithms are combined,  model resolution and focal length are dynamically adjusted,  hardware requirements are low,  and the requirement for miniaturization of a human body detection module can be met. 1. An embedded real-time human shape detection method,  wherein the human shape detection model based on convolution neural network is obtained by training in advance,  and stored in the human shape detection device;  the human shape detection method comprises :  using the human shape detecting device to collect the image in the space range to be detected,  and calculating the ROI area aiming at the currently collected image;  selecting the detection stage in the detection strategy according to the ROI area so as to dynamically adjust the image resolution,  and inputting the adjusted ROI area image into the humanoid detection model;  using the human shape detection model,  combining the multi-core parallel algorithm and fast convolution algorithm to perform convolution operation on the input image,  so as to extract the characteristic data;  obtaining multiple human-shaped candidate frames according to the characteristic data,  finally determining the human-shaped target in the space range to be tested by screening and fusing the multiple human-shaped candidate frames;  wherein the detection strategy comprises at least three detection stages,  the humanoid detection device performs dynamic transfer between the at least three detection stages according to a preset state transfer condition;  if the human shape detection device is initially in the first stage,  then within the space range to be detected,  the preset condition for the human shape detection device to perform state transition between the three stages is specifically as follows :  when the infrared pyroelectric sensor does not detect the human,  the human shape detecting device is kept in the first stage;  when the infrared pyroelectric sensor detects the human,  the human-shaped detecting device enters the second stage so as to start the infrared camera and use the first resolution to detect;  when the human is detected by using the first resolution and the proportion of the ROI area in the whole picture is less than the preset proportion,  the human shape detection device is kept in the second stage;  when the human is detected by using the first resolution and the proportion of ROI area in the whole picture is more than the pre-set proportion,  or the human is not detected by using the first resolution,  the human shape detecting device enters the third stage so as to change the second resolution to detect;  when the second resolution is used for detecting the human and the proportion of the ROI area in the whole picture is less than the preset proportion,  the human-shaped detecting device enters the second stage so as to detect with the first resolution;  when the human is detected by using the second resolution and the proportion of ROI area in the whole picture is more than the pre-set proportion,  the human shape detection device is kept in the third stage;  when no person is detected by using the second resolution,  the human shape detection device enters the first stage,  and the infrared camera is closed.

The invention provides a method,  a device and a system for estimating the elevation of a legged robot. Firstly,  the collected point cloud information of the laser radar is preprocessed; The point cloud is then divided into ground points and non-ground points,  Edge feature points and surface feature points are extracted from non-ground points,  then point cloud data are matched through normal distribution transformation,  relative pose transformation of the legged robot between adjacent frames is obtained through calculation,  the point cloud data with height information are mapped to an elevation map,  and a visual raster map is established. The method comprises the following steps of :  extracting edge feature points and surface feature points from non-ground points,  and matching the point cloud data through normal distribution transformation; and obtaining relative pose transformation of the legged robot between adjacent frames through calculation,  and mapping the point cloud data with the height information to the elevation map. According to the method,  the three-dimensional point cloud map can be established,  the current environment positioning information taking the robot as the center is obtained,  the height information of the surrounding environment of the robot is obtained,  the height change in the local environment is reflected in a refined mode,  and the requirements of robot foot end landing point planning and robot global path planning and real-time obstacle avoidance are met. The method has the advantages that the three-dimensional point cloud map is built,  the height information of the surrounding environment of the robot is obtained,  the height change in the local environment is reflected in a refined mode,  and the requirements of robot foot end landing point planning and robot global path planning and real-time obstacle avoidance are met. 1. A foot-type robot elevation estimation method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the data collected by each sensor,  pre-processing the collected data,  obtaining the pre-processed point cloud data;  dividing and clustering the point cloud data to obtain the classified point cloud cluster;  extracting the characteristic of the point cloud cluster to obtain the corresponding plane characteristic and edge characteristic;  aiming at the point cloud cluster with different characteristics,  performing the point cloud matching between frames of the characteristics,  calculating to obtain the relative pose conversion information of the foot-type robot between adjacent frames;  fusing the foot robot pose information after the inter-frame conversion with the point cloud after the data processing,  performing the real-time updating of the altitude map.

The invention discloses a gait planning method,  system and equipment for a biped humanoid robot,  and relates to the field of robots. According to the invention,  the track of the ankle joint of the swing leg is planned through the third-order Bezier curve,  so that not only can the generated track of the ankle joint be smoother,  but also the generated track can be easily adjusted until the track of the ankle joint of the swing leg which makes the biped humanoid robot walk most stably is found; Further,  According to the method,  a centroid track is planned on the basis of a preview control algorithm,  The three-centroid model is used for compensating the planned centroid track,  so that the centroid track of the biped humanoid robot in the walking process is closer to the actual situation,  the walking stability of the humanoid robot is improved,  the calculated amount in the planning process is greatly reduced,  and the biped humanoid robot has a wide application prospect. 1. A gait planning method of biped humanoid robot,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the walking parameter of the biped humanoid robot;  the walking parameter comprises walking period,  step length,  double-foot supporting period,  ZMP width,  foot lifting height and walking step number;  according to the walking parameter,  planning the target ZMP track,  and planning the swinging leg ankle joint track through the third-order Bessel curve;  based on the predictive control algorithm,  taking the planned target ZMP track as the future reference information of the predictive control,  and planning the centroid track;  using the three centroid models to compensate the planned centroid track to generate the compensated centroid track;  according to the compensated centroid track and the swinging leg ankle joint track,  calculating the joint angle of each joint of the leg part of the biped humanoid robot through the inverse kinematics method;  the walking of the biped humanoid robot is controlled according to the joint angle of each joint of the leg.

A manual cascade control method of myoelectricity artificial human dexterous prosthesis,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  under the mode control,  collecting the mode electromyographic signal and multiplexing electromyographic signal of the user;  S2 :  sampling the mode electromyographic signal and adding a moving window;  S3 :  calculating the characteristic of the mode electromyogram signal under the moving window;  S4 :  inputting the characteristic of the mode electromyogram signal to the classification model to generate an action mode instruction;  S5 :  switching the mode control state to the state control,  generating the action mode control state according to the energy of the multiplexing electromyographic signal and the action mode instruction,  and driving the artificial hand of the human dexterous artificial limb to move;  S6 :  switching to the mode control by the state control when the motion is in the end state;  the mode electromyographic signal is a multi-channel mode electromyographic signal generated by the surface of the front end of the stump,  the number of the channels is greater than or equal to 4;  the multiplexing myoelectric signal is a pair of myoelectric signal generated by the antagonistic muscle at the front end of the stump,  the number of the channel is 2;  one multiplexing electromyographic signal channel controls the positive direction of the motion,  and the other multiplexing electromyographic signal channel controls the reverse direction of the motion;  the speed of the motion and the energy value of the multiplexed electromyographic signal are in positive proportional relation.

The method comprises obtaining state data at a start time in a planning period; Determining a candidate footing point of each foot end in the planning cycle based on the state data at the starting time; Determining a first relational expression between a position change coefficient of the center of mass,  a stepping duty ratio,  and a foot end contact force by the candidate foot point according to the state data at the starting moment; Determining,  under the constraint of the constraint condition set,  a target centroid position change coefficient,  a target stepping duty ratio,  and a target footing point that satisfy a first relation; The legged robot is controlled to move in the planning period according to the target centroid position variation coefficient,  the target stepping duty ratio and the target foot point. 1. A foot-type robot motion control method,  wherein it comprises :  according to the state data of the starting time in the planning period,  determining the candidate landing point of each foot end in the planning period;  according to the state data of the starting time and the candidate landing point of each foot end,  determining the first relational expression between the mass centre position change coefficient,  the stepping duty ratio,  the landing point and the foot end contact force;  under the constraint of the constraint condition set,  determining the target centroid position change coefficient,  the target stepping duty ratio and the target landing point satisfying the first relational expression;  according to the target centroid position change coefficient,  the target stepping duty ratio and the target landing foot,  controlling the foot robot to move in the planning period;  wherein,  according to the state data of the starting time and the candidate landing point of each foot end,  determining the first relational expression between the mass centre position change coefficient,  stepping duty ratio,  landing point and foot end contact force,  comprising :  determining multiple sampling moments from the planning period; The invention relates to an LPA-based anthropomorphic automatic driving vehicle intersection steering training method and device. The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing an automatic driving vehicle intersection steering data set,  and randomly dividing the data set into a training set and a test set for each type of steering scene; Determining a characteristic quantity index reflecting a target related to steering control of an automobile,  and establishing a comprehensive cost function; Training vehicle steering trajectories based on an LPA algorithm,  each time of training,  training steering events in a training set in sequence,  repeating for many times,  selecting a trajectory with a minimum comprehensive cost for constraint and collision inspection,  and after cyclic detection,  determining an optimal trajectory as an output; Carrying out automatic driving intersection steering test in CARLA simulation environment; Compare the simulation results with the test set trajectory to evaluate the anthropomorphic effect of the LPA algorithm after training. Compared with the prior art,  the method has the characteristics of safety,  comfort and high efficiency in the aspect of processing the intersection steering of the automatic driving vehicle,  and has the driving advantages of a human driver. 1. A anthropomorphic automatic driving vehicle intersection steering training method based on LPA,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  based on the SH-NDS data,  through GPS information matching,  extracting two types of potential intersection turning accident front scenes of left turning and right turning,  collecting the effective event after checking to construct an automatic driving vehicle intersection turning data set;  step 2 :  aiming at each type of steering scene,  randomly dividing the data set into a training set and a test set;  step 3 :  determining the characteristic quantity index reflecting the automobile steering control related target,  establishing a comprehensive cost function,  wherein the related target comprises a safety target,  a comfort target and an efficiency target;  step 4 :  training the vehicle steering track based on LPA algorithm,  when training each time,  according to the steering event in the training set in sequence,  repeating for several times,  selecting the track with minimum comprehensive cost for constraint and collision detection,  after circularly detecting,  determining the optimal track as output;  step 5 :  in the CARLA simulation environment,  two kinds of intersection steering scenes are reappeared,  the steering of the automatic driving vehicle is controlled based on the best track obtained by training,  the movement data of the automatic driving vehicle in the steering process is collected,  the automatic driving intersection steering test is performed;  step 6 :  based on the characteristic quantity index of the related target,  comprehensively analyzing and testing the characteristic difference of the steering track of the human driving vehicle and the automatic driving vehicle,  evaluating the anthropomorphic effect after the LPA algorithm training.

The present application provides a machine vision-based automatic broadcast directing method,  a smart screen,  and a storage medium,  wherein the method includes :  collecting a video stream including all people in a scene; Obtaining a humanoid region in each frame of image through a humanoid detection algorithm,  and caching the humanoid region to a first storage queue in sequence; Judging whether the detected human-shaped area is in a standing state; Sequentially storing the standing human-shaped regions in a second storage queue; Obtaining the key point of the mouth of the human face from the human-shaped region in the standing state in the second storage queue,  and storing the key point in the third storage queue; Judging whether the selected person is in a speaking state according to the key points of the mouth of the human face; Speaking persons are sequentially cached in the fourth storage queue for automatic guide display. The present invention is applicable to the technical field of security management,  and provides a security data processing method and system based on image recognition. The method comprises the following steps :  receiving monitoring images uploaded by a plurality of security monitoring terminals,  recognizing fire features in the monitoring images,  and determining whether a fire occurs; When a fire occurs,  the security road map and the position information of the security monitoring terminal are retrieved,  and a safety evacuation route is determined according to the security road map and the position information; A route viewing link is generated so that the in-building broadcast terminal performs voice broadcast on the route viewing link. According to the invention,  the trapped person can access the route checking link by using a mobile phone to obtain a security road map and a security evacuation route,  and clearly know how to evacuate. In addition,  the humanoid characteristics in the monitoring image can be identified,  the area to be rescued is determined,  firefighters can conveniently and quickly rescue the area to be rescued,  and rescue efficiency is higher. 1. A security data processing method based on image identification,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  receiving the monitoring image uploaded by several security monitoring terminal,  identifying the fire characteristic in the monitoring image,  determining whether there is fire,  when the fire occurs,  adjusting the position information of the security route map and the security monitoring terminal,  determining the safe evacuation route according to the security route map and the position information;  generating route viewing link,  so that the building internal broadcasting terminal performs voice broadcasting to the route viewing link,  the user accesses the route viewing link,  it can obtain security route map and safe evacuation route;  identifying the human-shaped feature in the monitoring image,  determining the area to be rescued,  receiving the rescue point working staff of the input,  updating the security route map according to the rescue point information.

The present invention relates to the field of human-robot collaboration of underwater robots,  in particular to a method for direct manipulation of the human brain of a new underwater robot. Specifically :  using brain-computer interface to achieve EEG signal acquisition and realize the acquisition of original signals;  The motion imaging mode is used to train and learn the collected EEG signal data offline,  and a model of the motion imaging classification algorithm is formed,  according to which unknown EEG signals can be classified. The motion imaging classification algorithm model is used to classify real-time online EEG signals,  and then brain control instructions are obtained. Develop underwater visual target perception methods,  simplify motion imaging control instructions,  and determine target positions;  The instruction issuance program controls the underwater robotic arm according to the brain control signal instructions and the underwater visual target perception results to realize the grasping operation of underwater targets. The present invention adopts brain-computer interface and visual object perception method,  which improves the reliability and robustness of the system and has efficient underwater operation efficiency. 1. A human-machine cooperation method suitable for underwater robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  the image collecting module collects the underwater target image,  and the image is sent to the upper computer display through the lower computer control system,  at the same time,  the lower computer control system identifies the target in the image,  the identified target and the target position are sent to the upper computer to display;  the tester observes the target in the upper computer screen,  by imagination the target in the screen is selected by left hand or right hand movement;  in the motion imagination process,  EEG collecting device collects the EEG signal of the tester and sends it to EEG processing module in the upper computer,  after the motion imagination process is finished,  EEG processing module processes the EEG signal,  judging whether the imagination is left hand movement or right hand movement;  according to the motion imagination result,  determining the target in the screen;  if the target in the screen is greater than two,  multiple circulating motion imagination process,  finally determining the target in the captured screen;  EEG collecting device sends the target of the selected screen to the lower computer control system,  the lower computer control system calculates the position information of the target,  and according to the kinematics parameter of the mechanical arm,  calculating the movement position of each joint angle of the mechanical arm,  controlling the mechanical arm for target grabbing,  finishing operation;  the EEG processing module processes the EEG signal,  judging whether the imagination is left hand movement or right hand movement,  comprising the following steps :  according to historical EEG data,  constructing EEG data classification algorithm model,  training the model to obtain the model parameter so as to obtain the classification decision function;  performing feature extraction and classification to the real-time collected electroencephalogram EEG signal through the classification decision function,  obtaining the motion imagination data category,  namely imagined left-hand movement or imagination right-hand movement;  the constructing EEG data classification algorithm model,  training the model comprises the following steps :  filtering the EEG data,  and performing feature extraction to the EEG data after filtering,  forming feature vector;  using SVM classification algorithm to train the feature vector,  obtaining the two classification optimum the support vector,  optimum the support vector as the optimal input to the separation ultra-plane w = 0,  so as to obtain the classification decision function.

The invention relates to a humanoid robot navigation method,  based on a robot system,  comprising a robot and a plurality of movable distance measuring devices,  wherein the robot is provided with a manipulator and a plurality of sensors with fixed positions; The navigation method comprises a process of grabbing distance measuring equipment and a process of path planning; The process of grabbing the distance measuring equipment comprises the following steps of :  receiving a grabbing command by a manipulator; grabbing the distance measuring equipment of the type specified by the command by the manipulator; adaptively adjusting the position of the distance measuring equipment by the manipulator; and matching a corresponding SLAM algorithm by the robot according to the type of the distance measuring equipment. The process of grabbing the distance measuring equipment comprises the following steps of :  receiving the grabbing command by the manipulator; grabbing the distance measuring equipment of the type specified by the command by the manipulator; and adjusting the position of the distance measuring equipment by the manipulator in a self-adaptive manner. The path planning process comprises the following steps of :  combining map information,  surrounding obstacle information acquired by a sensor and/or a distance measuring device,  real-time position information of the robot and position information of a target point by the robot,  generating a path reaching the target point on the basis of an SLAM algorithm,  monitoring the position of the robot in real time in the traveling process of the robot to judge whether the robot deviates from the path or not,  and adjusting the path when the robot deviates from the path. The present invention makes it possible for the robot to replace the movable distance measuring equipment flexibly for auxiliary navigation to adapt to different scenes. 1. A humanoid robot navigation method,  based on the robot system,  wherein the robot system comprises a robot and multiple distance measuring devices capable of moving by hand,  the robot is provided with a mechanical hand and a sensor fixed with multiple positions;  the humanoid robot navigation method comprises a grabbing distance measuring device flow and a path planning process,  when the event A occurs,  the robot enters the grabbing distance measuring device flow,  event A occurs before the path planning process,  any time point after,  after;  The path planning process includes the following steps :  S1 :  the robot loads the existing map;  S2 :  the robot loads the position information of the target point and the real-time position information of the robot;  S3 :  robot combined with map,  surrounding obstacle information obtained by the sensor and/or distance measuring device,  real-time position information of the robot,  target point position information,  generating path reaching the target point based on SLAM algorithm;  S4 :  the robot travels according to the generated path;  The process of grasping the ranging device comprises the following steps :  T1 :  the mechanical hand of the robot receives the grabbing command;  T2 :  the mechanical hand of the robot grabs the distance measuring device of the appointed type of the order;  the event A comprises at least one of the following events :  Event 1 :  the robot receives the manual instruction,  manually appointing the type of the distance measuring device needed to be grasped by the mechanical hand;  Event 2 :  the robot performs the self-scene detection to judge the type of the distance measuring device needed to be captured;  Event 3 :  the robot in the path planning process,  cannot generate the path to the target point;  Event 4 :  The sensor on the robot is abnormal.

Land-Based,  Holonomic-Type,  Mecanum-Wheeled Mobile Robot for Queue Management in Supermarkets Mechatronic Design and Kinematic Analysis. ABSTRACT Due to the dyna mic character of consumer demand,  businesses are reevaluating their production strategies. Customers anticipate greater customizability and quicker turnaround times;  consequently,  product half- lives are decreasing. This study illustrates how to construct a mobile automaton for use in supermarkets to alleviate congestion in high-traffic areas such as checkout lanes and produce sections. In 2022,  the Division of Robotics in the Professional School of Mechatronics Engineering at Ricardo Palma University supervised some cutting-edge research. This question inspired the design of this project,  a holonomic robot equipped with an ESP32 camera for movement and collision avoidance,  in addition to HCSR PIR sensors and a Makeblock Ultrasonic sensor. Using a speaker to disseminate a voice message,  a robot can establish rapport with shoppers and maintain peace in a supermarket,  according to this study. Four mecanum omnidirectional wheels increase the robots mobility even further. In addition,  a kinematic model for a four-wheel omnidirectional robot of holonomic type was developed. Throughout the duration of the robots exercise,  the software simulated a supermarket. In this investigation,  a digital testing field for constructed robots is described. Its intended scope includes all grocery establishments in Peru. Finally,  success was achieved;  therefore,  the next phase of this project is to construct a humanoid prototype equipped with artificial intelligence and shopping-related sensors to assist people while grocery shopping.

The present invention proposes a dynamic human-machine collaborative assembly method and system based on limb motion prediction,  including an inertial measurement unit,  supporting controller,  industrial robot and computer. The supporting controller controls the inertial measurement unit to collect the operator's action information,  the computer extracts the signal characteristics of the inertial measurement unit,  and uses the support vector machine algorithm optimized by particle swarm optimization to identify limb motion. A hidden Markov model with variable parameters is proposed to predict the action sequence in real time,  which can infer the future intention of the operator and realize the dynamic variability of the assembly sequence. The proposed method can effectively predict the operator's next action through the operation of the industrial robot to complete the key steps with humans,  and realize the dynamic human-robot collaborative assembly with variable assembly sequence. The industrial robot of the present invention makes corresponding assembly actions according to the different choices of the operator,  realizes a dynamic and variable human-machine collaborative assembly scheme,  realizes flexible production and improves production efficiency. 1. The present invention provides a four-legged robot whole-body coordinated control method based on constraint and motion decoupling,  involving the field of robot control technology,  comprising :  step 1 :  establishing a dynamic model;  Step 2 :  Multiply the dynamic model with the zero-space mapping matrix of the constraint matrix to obtain the equation of motion space;  Step 3 :  Obtain the control rate that makes the system exhibit impedance characteristics;  Step 4 :  Convert the control rate in Cartesian space into joint driving moment through Jacobi mapping,  Step 5 :  Construct quadratic programming problems in constrained space;  Step 6 :  The joint driving moment in the constraint space is obtained,  and the joint torque obtained in the motion space is summed as a command sent to each drive joint motor. The present invention realizes trajectory tracking control and compliance control,  so as to maintain accurate motion control in walking,  and has a certain degree of compliance to adapt to the uneven ground,  realize the whole body coordinated control,  so that the robot walks smoothly without slipping. 1. A four-footed robot whole body coordination control method based on constraint and motion decoupling,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1 :  establishing the dynamics model of the four-footed robot;  step 2 :  multiplying the dynamics model of the four-footed robot by the zero space mapping matrix of the constraint matrix to obtain the motion space equation,  the difference between the original dynamics equation and the motion space equation is constraint space equation;  step 3 :  in the motion space,  converting the dynamics equation of the joint space into the Cartesian space,  obtaining the control rate of the system showing impedance characteristics step 4 :  converting the control rate in the Cartesian space into the joint driving torque through the Jacobi mapping;  step 5 :  solving the acceleration of the system so as to transfer the motion space to the constraint space,  so as to construct secondary planning problem in the constraint space;  step 6 :  solving the secondary planning problem,  obtaining the joint driving torque in the constraint space,  and the joint torque obtained in the moving space in the step 4 is added and used as the instruction for sending to each driving joint motor.

The present application discloses a fall detection method based on neural network humanoid detection recognition,  involving the field of computer vision technology. The method comprises :  obtaining a group of images to be identified transmitted by the first camera device in the room,  the group of images to be recognized includes a plurality of frame images;  Humanoid detection is performed on each frame of the image,  and only one humanoid image is obtained;  Obtain the pose information of the human form with only a humanoid image separately;  Get a trained behavior classifier;  Extract the pose characteristics of each humanoid pose information;  The central controller inputs the pose feature to the behavior classifier,  thereby obtaining a behavior classification label,  the behavior classification label includes a fall label,  and when the classification label is a fall label,  it is judged that the human figure in the image is in a falling state. The disclosure generally relates to methods and systems for enabling human robot interaction by cognition sharing which includes gesture and audio. Conventional techniques that use the gestures and the speech,  require extra hardware setup and are limited to navigation in structured outdoor driving environments. The present disclosure herein provides methods and systems that solves the technical problem of enabling the human robot interaction with a two-step approach by transferring the cognitive load from the human to the robot. An accurate shared perspective associated with the task is determined in the first step by computing relative frame transformations based on understanding of navigational gestures of the subject. Then,  the shared perspective transformed to the robot in the field view of the robot. The transformed shared perspective is then given to a language grounding technique in the second step,  to accurately determine a final goal associated with the task.
