The present invention discloses a rapid annotation method for grabbing data based on human experience learning,  including building a simulated grabbing data acquisition scene,  and loading the object CAD model into the simulation environment and preprocessing,  loading into the simulation environment and preprocessing the object CAD model in the sampling space intensively sampling a series of candidate grabbing and other steps,  the present invention uses the method to automatically generate a large-scale,  high-quality and low-cost humanoid grabbing dataset,  the dataset contains 10, 000 objects of 20, 000 scenes ( depth map),  in which 60, 000 positive and negative samples are captured,  a total of 120, 000. Its quality has been confirmed to exceed the existing recognized flat data set in dataset cross-verification,  simulation and physical grabbing test,  which can solve the problem of imbalance of positive and negative samples and greatly improve the efficiency of capturing sample annotation,  and can be generalized to other fields with large demand for data volume,  and has great potential in the current application background of deep learning. 1. A grabbing data fast marking method based on human experience learning,  wherein it comprises :  building the simulation capturing data collecting scene,  and loading the object CAD model to the simulation environment and pre-processing;  densely sampling a series of candidate grabs in the sampling space of the object CAD model loaded in the simulation environment and pre-processed;  for the candidate grasping,  using a two-stage coarse screening combined with the humanoid grabbing classification automatic marking model,  according to the construction of the simulated human grasping index library of seven factors and corresponding grabbing index calculating cost,  according to whether it accords with human experience to classify and label;  in the process,  firstly using manual marking expert set training to train the two-stage model,  the human grasping experience is transmitted to the model,  then the candidate grasping into the decision tree coarse screening model of the first stage,  through grabbing index online characteristics the fast screening out a large amount of negative sample;  then calculating all indexes of the remaining positive sample after coarse screening,  then sending into SVM-XGBoost combined fine screening model of the second stage to select the final positive sample,  and re-classifying the false positive sample in the first stage positive sample result to the final sample marking result;  performing multi-view angle rendering and grabbing association for the grabbing after marking,  integrating the data into a depth map,  grabbing configuration,  grabbing the ternary group data form of feasibility label,  obtaining the final simulated human grabbing data set.

In the method of embodiment of the present invention,  a drone rescue method and system based on deep learning is proposed,  the management server receives the data information of the missing person sent by the mobile terminal,  and sends a target tracking task to the drone swarm;  UAV swarms take aerial photography along preset routes;  The management server compares and identifies the aerial photography data and sends the identified suspected images to the drone swarm. UAV swarm performs secondary aerial photography and positioning of suspected targets;  The Administration Server sends data to the mobile terminal. The present invention sets the initial position assessment to generate the range of activities of the missing person,  and then completes the aerial photography coverage of the range of activities through the coordination and cooperation of the UAV group,  and then accurately identifies the target from the aerial image through the combination of recognition model and labor,  which is accurate,  efficient and convenient,  avoiding the problems of high cost,  time-consuming and low efficiency in manual search. 1. An unmanned aerial vehicle rescue method based on deep learning,  wherein the method comprises :  S1,  the management server receives the data information of the missing person sent by the mobile terminal,  generating the initial identification range and the final identification range,  and sending target tracking task to the unmanned aerial vehicle group based on the final identification range,  the data information comprises setting initial position,  target image and the missing time;  S2,  the unmanned aerial vehicle group according to the target tracking task aerial photography planning,  and aerial photography,  S3,  the management server receives the aerial photography data sent by the unmanned aerial vehicle group,  pre-aerial photography the image in the aerial photography data,  and comparing and identifying,  sending the identified suspected image to the unmanned aerial vehicle group;  S4,  the unmanned aerial vehicle group to the suspected image in the suspected image in the initial identification range for secondary aerial photography and positioning,  and the secondary aerial photography image and positioning data to the management server;  S5,  the management server sends the suspected image data in the secondary aerial photography image data,  positioning data and non-overlapping identification range to the mobile terminal.

An example method may include i) determining a first distance between a pair of feet of a robot at a first time,  where the pair of feet is in contact with a ground surface;  ii) determining a second distance between the pair of feet of the robot at a second time,  where the pair of feet remains in contact with the ground surface from the first time to the second time;  iii) comparing a difference between the determined first and second distances to a threshold difference;  iv) determining that the difference between determined first and second distances exceeds the threshold difference;  and v) based on the determination that the difference between the determined first and second distances exceeds the threshold difference,  causing the robot to react.

The present application belongs to the field of computer technology,  specifically relates to a leg and foot robot foothold determination method,  equipment and storage medium. The method includes :  obtaining the foothold search map in the direction of travel of the leg-footed robot;  Determine the location and search for the target passable area on the map;  Determine the foothold of the leg-foot robot based on the center position of the target passable area. It can solve the problem that the passable position closest to the default landing point may be close to the non-passable position,  resulting in the leg-foot robot may fall;  Since the center position of the leg-foot robot is determined according to the center position of the target passable area,  the distance between the center position and the impassable position is far,  so determining the foothold of the leg-foot robot according to the center position of the passable area can make the foothold point far from the impassable position,  which can avoid the slipping,  falling or stepping on the foot end of the leg robot,  and improve the safety of the determined landing point. 1. A foot-falling point determining method of leg-and-foot robot,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the foot-falling point search map of the leg-and-foot robot travel direction,  the foot-falling point search map is used for indicating whether each candidate position in the travel direction is passable;  determining a target passable area on the drop point search map,  the target passable area is determined based on a plurality of passable positions on the drop point search map;  based on the centroid position of the target passable area,  determining the leg falling point of the legged robot.

The present application relates to a data processing chip,  a module,  a terminal and a power management method,  and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The data processing chip comprises a power management unit,  a first cache unit,  a second cache unit,  and a data processing unit. The power management unit is used for controlling power supply to the first cache unit and the second cache unit. The first cache unit and the second cache unit are used for caching data. The power management unit is used for controlling power supply to the first cache unit in response to a first state of the data processing unit,  not supplying power to the second cache unit,  controlling power supply to the first cache unit in response to a second state of the data processing unit,  and supplying power to the second cache unit. According to the solution,  the power consumption of the terminal can be reduced.

For the control of a robot operated as part of a human-robot collaboration,  a preplanned movement sequence is provided that comprises a defined movement path along which the robot is to move in order to perform a specific task,  and a defined speed development according to which each point of the movement path is associated with a speed at which the robot is to move at the respective point. A method of improving the preplanned movement sequence comprises the following steps :  The robot is controlled to repeatedly run through the preplanned movement sequence;  during the repeated run-through of the preplanned movement sequence,  an environment of the robot is monitored and,  in so doing,  disturbances are detected that emanate from objects that are located in this environment or that enter into this environment so that an endangerment of the respective object by the robot results therefrom;  on the repeated run-through,  for a plurality of different sections of the movement path,  the frequency of disturbances detected in the respective section is determined;  after the repeated run-through of the preplanned movement sequence,  a modified speed development is determined in that,  for the different sections,  the speeds associated with the points of the respective section are modified in dependence on the frequency determined for the respective section;  finally,  an improved movement sequence that comprises the modified speed development is provided for the further control of the robot.

The present application provides a motion control method and apparatus,  a storage medium and an electronic device of a multi-legged robot,  the method comprising :  recording the instantaneous coordinates of the foot end of each leg of the multi-legged robot within a gait cycle,  wherein the instantaneous coordinates of the foot end of each leg are the instantaneous coordinates of the foot end of each leg when each leg is raised;  A virtual plane is constructed according to the instantaneous coordinates of the foot end of each leg to obtain a target virtual plane,  wherein the target virtual plane is used to simulate the slope of the ground where the multi-legged robot is located;  Compensate the attitude angle corresponding to the target virtual plane to the fuselage of the multi-legged robot to adjust the attitude angle of the fuselage of the multi-legged robot. The above technical scheme is used to solve the problem of poor adaptability of multi-legged robots to environmental terrain caused by relying on vision sensors for unknown environment exploration. 1. A motion control method of multi-foot robot,  wherein it comprises :  recording one gait cycle,  the foot end instantaneous coordinate of each leg of the multi-foot robot,  wherein the foot end instantaneous coordinate of each leg is the instantaneous coordinate of the foot end of each leg when the each leg lifting leg,  constructing a virtual plane according to the foot end transient coordinate of each leg,  obtaining the target virtual plane,  wherein the target virtual plane is used for simulating the gradient of the ground of the multi-foot robot,  compensating the attitude angle corresponding to the target virtual plane to the robot body of the multi-foot robot,  so as to adjust the attitude angle of the robot body of the multi-foot robot.

The present invention provides a method for planning the walking trajectory of a hexapod robot based on the control of fuselage velocity and angular velocity,  the method mainly comprises :  S1 :  determining the stride length of the hexapod robot when walking according to different target speeds;  S2 :  According to different target angular velocities,  combined with S1,  determine the turning radius of the hexapod robot;  S3 :  According to S1 and S2,  the parameters required to determine the target landing point are calculated by geometric method;  S4 :  Determine the position coordinates of the landing point under the body coordinate system when the hexapod robot is going straight,  turning and retreating;  S5 :  Sixth-degree polynomial trajectory planning for inverse kinematically calculated joint angles. The calculation of the foothold point in the present invention is a new type of calculation method,  and its overall trajectory planning method has the advantages of simplicity and efficiency,  and has strong universality. 1. The present invention discloses a composite bionic ghost imaging method and system,  the method comprises a two-dimensional motion detection of a target in a complex background based on the use of feedback axial vibration retinal technology,  obtaining the azimuth information of the target and the operating angular velocity;  According to the azimuth information of the target and the operating angular velocity,  the signal in a specific direction is recognized under image-free conditions;  According to the target recognition results,  the sub-field of view of the detection target is determined,  and the field of view is imaged with variable resolution. The present invention realizes ghost imaging technology with a large field of view and efficient perception performance by using a plurality of detectors,  and has the function of detection,  recognition,  and tracking integration. 1. A composite bionic ghost imaging method,  wherein the method comprises :  based on using feedback type axial vibration retina technology to realize two-dimensional motion detection of target under complex background,  obtaining the orientation information of the target and the operation angular velocity;  according to the orientation information of the target and the operation angle speed,  the signal in a certain direction is subjected to the target identification under the imaging-free condition;  according to the target identification result,  determining the sub-field of view of the detection target,  and performing variable resolution ghost imaging to the field of view.

The present invention discloses an intelligent robot for elderly care services,  involving the field of intelligent service robot technology,  the present invention is to generate thermal imaging images of the elderly by setting up service robot induction,  extracting and matching the thermographic images with the highest overlap with the preset humanoid humanoid picture,  and then dividing the selected humanoid picture into a part area,  extracting the temperature information after the division of the part area,  and obtaining the temperature coefficient value of each part area through normalized analysis of the temperature information,  Through the comparison of the temperature coefficient values of each part area to generate the temperature coefficient difference,  through the temperature coefficient difference combined with the preset temperature value to build a key detection of the human shape,  at the same time edit the reminder text to achieve the positioning and display of abnormal temperature of the elderly,  assist the family to take the elderly to medical examination in time,  ensure the health of the elderly,  and make the robot more intelligent. 1. An intelligent robot for caring old service,  comprising a robot,  a data storage module,  an area dividing module,  a heat analysis module and a remote editing module;  the service robot collects the heat imaging image of the old people in the preset time period and sends it to the data storage module;  the data storage module is used for receiving the information and storing it;  area dividing module through data storage module extracting and receiving the old heat imaging image and extracting any frame human-shaped picture,  the plurality of human-shaped picture and the preset human shape for overlapping and comparing,  and obtaining the overlapping degree of the human-shaped picture and the preset human-shaped picture,  through the size of the overlapping degree of the human-shaped picture from big to small ordering,  then dividing the part area of the first human-shaped picture,  and marking the human-shaped picture after dividing the part area and forming a picture part mark;  and the generated picture part mark is sent to the heat analysis module;  the heat analysis module receives the picture part mark and then analyzing and processing to generate temperature abnormal mark set,  when the temperature abnormal mark set is empty set,  it shows that the temperature of the old is normal;  when the temperature abnormal mark set is not empty set,  matching the matched picture part mark,  and then the area corresponding to the part mark is highlighted and formed a key detection human figure,  and sending the key detection human figure image to a remote editing module;  the remote editing module receives the key detecting human figure and editing the matched reminding text,  further sending the generated reminding text and key detecting human figure to the mobile phone terminal of the family member.

A method for perception and fitting for a stair tracker includes receiving sensor data for a robot adjacent to a staircase. For each stair of the staircase,  the method includes detecting,  at a first time step,  an edge of a respective stair of the staircase based on the sensor data. The method also includes determining whether the detected edge is a most likely step edge candidate by comparing the detected edge from the first time step to an alternative detected edge at a second time step,  the second time step occurring after the first time step. When the detected edge is the most likely step edge candidate,  the method includes defining,  by the data processing hardware,  a height of the respective stair based on sensor data height about the detected edge. The method also includes generating a staircase model including stairs with respective edges at the respective defined heights.

The present invention provides a humanoid robot anthropomorphic standing anti-disturbance control method,  based on the quadratic planning of the whole body motion control method to optimize the joint angle and contact force,  without imposing position constraints on the foot pressure center,  when disturbed,  effectively cooperate with the whole body joints of the humanoid robot to achieve anthropomorphic tiptoe movement;  The present invention also designs tiptoe trigger conditions and step trigger conditions,  by judging whether the trigger conditions are met,  the humanoid robot adopts corresponding anthropomorphic anti-disturbance strategies according to the size of the external disturbance;  Effectively combine tiptoe and walking to improve the robot's standing immunity. 1. A humanoid robot anthropomorphic standing anti-disturbance control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  if the humanoid robot on a period of unused step,  turning to S2,  if using step,  turning to S7;  S2,  optimizing the joint angle and contact force by using the whole body movement control method based on secondary planning without using step,  obtaining the desired foot part contact the force and each joint angle;  S3,  if the humanoid robot on one cycle does not use tiptoe,  turning to S4,  if using tiptoe,  turning to S5;  S4,  judging whether the tiptoe trigger condition is true,  if it is false,  without tiptoe can be restored and stable,  and turning to S9,  if it is true,  need tiptoe can be restored and stable,  turning to S5;  S5,  judging whether the stepping trigger condition is true,  if it is false,  without stepping to recover the stability,  and turning to S9,  if it is true,  it needs to be restored and stable,  turning to S6;  S6,  determining the supporting leg and the swinging leg,  turning to S7;  S7,  calculating the swinging leg falling point position,  and determining the desired position of the swinging leg ankle joint,  turning to S8;  S8,  optimizing the joint angle by using the whole body movement control method based on secondary planning,  obtaining the desired joint angle,  turning to S9;  S9,  sending the desired joint angle obtained by optimizing to the humanoid robot;  The whole body motion control method based on secondary planning,  specifically is as follows :  selecting the contact force,  six-dimensional floating base acceleration and each joint acceleration as optimization variable y,  selecting the constraint condition needed to be used,  and introducing relaxation factor v,  w,  constructing the following secondary planning problem :  s.t.V (Ay + a) ≤vW (By + b) = w,  wherein :  A,  a,  B,  b are coefficient matrix,  V,  W are weight matrix of constraint condition,  solving the secondary planning problem,  obtaining the optimized desired foot and contact joint angle.

Existing cognitive robotic applications follow a practice of building specific applications for specific use cases. However,  the knowledge of the world and the semantics are common for a robot for multiple tasks. In this disclosure,  to enable usage of knowledge across multiple scenarios,  a method and system for ontology guided indoor scene understanding for cognitive robotic tasks is described where in scenes are processed based on techniques filtered based on querying ontology with relevant objects in perceived scene to generate a semantically rich scene graph. Herein,  an initially manually created ontology is updated and refined in online fashion using external knowledge-base,  human robot interaction and perceived information. This knowledge helps in semantic navigation,  aids in speech,  and text based human robot interactions. Further,  in the process of performing the robotic tasks,  the knowledgebase gets enriched and the knowledge can be shared and used by other robots and services. [To be published with FIG. 2]

Learning human eye attention information through a deep learning network,  Thereby weighting the discriminative region in the vehicle re-recognition,  Deep self-learning and mutual-learning network is used to simulate the judgment mechanism of human eye to observe single vehicle and information between vehicles. Thereby improving the vehicle re-recognition accuracy,  The problem of ambiguity of prior knowledge and characteristics of manual design adopted in the existing vehicle re-recognition process is solved,  and meanwhile,  the prior knowledge and the characteristics can be automatically designed according to a human target mode and human behavior mode simulation can be automatically carried out by adopting a humanoid attention weighting mode,  so that local characteristic weighting can be carried out,  and the method can be applied to the fields of detection and classification of other objects. 1. A vehicle re-identification method based on human visual attention weighting,  wherein the specific process is as follows :  (1) constructing a data set composed of a vehicle re-identification data set and a vehicle type human attention weighted data set,  and dividing the vehicle re-identification data set into a test set and a training set;  wherein the vehicle type human attention weighting data set is collected by the human eye viewpoint to reveal the attention visual mechanism,  so as to search the position information of different attention set between the vehicle picture and different vehicles for extracting,  specifically as follows :  collecting the eye movement data of human when observing the vehicle picture by the eye movement instrument,  and human eye movement data in the comparison process when searching the same vehicle,  the eye movement position is used as the position area of the most discriminability of the vehicle to construct the vehicle type human attention weighting data set;  (2) inputting the license plate image in the data set into the ResNet network to extract the characteristic information of the region related to the attention as the vehicle type human attention weighting feature,  wherein the characteristic information of the region related to the attention comprises the colour information of the vehicle,  the outline information of the vehicle and the texture information of the vehicle;  (3),  self-learning the attention weighting characteristic of each vehicle type person in each license plate image obtained in the step (2);  (4) learning the attention weighting characteristics of the vehicle type people of two different vehicle images;  (5) the vehicle image input vehicle re-identification branch extracting vehicle re-identification feature,  vehicle re-identification branch and step (2) extracting feature of the network has the same structure;  (6) according to the vehicle weight identification feature extracted in step (5),  using the vehicle re-identification feature self-learning mode to generate the feature related to the vehicle weight identification;  (7) the vehicle re-identification feature self-learning feature introduced attention constraint for vehicle re-identification feature learning,  the vehicle discriminatory feature learning,  so as to fully excavate the difference information between the vehicle,  the difference characteristic of the vehicle is searched out;  (8) firstly training the vehicle re-identification network,  using ResNet50 as basic network,  basic network after pre-training the ImageNet data set using SGD optimizer for network optimization,  after the optimization of the network model stored in the local folder to obtain the trained model data,  then testing the vehicle re-identification network,  loading the trained model data,  and the size of the vehicle re-identification is set as 256 * 256,  by calculating the similarity between the vehicle for vehicle re-identification.

Disclosed in the present invention is a lung lobe segmentation method based on digital human technology. The method comprises :  performing non-rigid registration on a digital human image and a lung image of a clinical patient,  so as to obtain a deformation field and a deformed digital human image;  performing fitting by using the deformed digital human image,  so as to obtain a shape parameter of a digital human,  and generating a new digital human image according to the shape parameter;  then,  continuously iterating,  registering and updating the new digital human image and the lung image of the patient,  so as to obtain a digital human image closer to the lung image of the patient;  and finally,  performing non-rigid registration on the digital human image and the lung image of the patient,  obtaining a deformation field,  and adding the deformation field to a boundary point cloud or a mask image of a lung lobe of the digital human,  where an obtained result is a lung lobe segmentation result obtained by means of the method. In the method of the present invention,  organ segmentation in a medical image is performed by using a digital human model for the first time;  and by means of the method of the present invention,  the accuracy and stability of lung lobe segmentation when there is an abnormality or lesion in an image of a patient can be effectively improved.

A tracking identification monitoring system based on thermal image,  wherein it comprises :  at least one monitoring host,  for installing in an environment position to monitor the environment position of the person state,  each monitoring host comprises :  a control unit,  connected with at least one infrared lens,  the infrared lens continuously shooting the environment position to obtain multi-frame thermal image;  an operation unit,  connected with the control unit and through the control unit to receive the multi-frame thermal image,  the operation unit uses an AI human-shaped detection model after training to analyze the continuous received multi-frame thermal image,  to judge whether there is a human-shaped presence in a valid detection area in the multi-frame thermal image and a human-shaped action in a monitoring range,  when the human-shaped action has been in accordance with the condition of sending the warning message,  sending the warning message,  wherein the warning message comprises a preparation bed,  an isolated bed,  a fall,  a long sitting,  at least one of dangerous or static behavior;  a storage unit,  connected with the control unit and the operation unit,  for storing data and program;  an output/input unit,  connected with the control unit and the operation unit,  the output/input unit comprises at least one transmission interface,  used for establishing the connection and data transmission between the monitoring host and other external device;  a monitoring background,  connected with each monitoring host communication,  wherein the monitoring background comprises :  a cloud end host,  communicating with each monitoring host to receive the thermal image picture and warning message shot by each monitoring host;  a certain point host,  connected with the cloud end host and displaying the warning message;  wherein,  the AI human shape detection model identifying each frame thermal image,  executing the following process :  judging whether the human shape in the thermal image is located in the effective detection area,  if not,  abandoning the human shape; Brain tumor detection,  segmentation,  and classification are essential in clinical diagnosis and efficient treatment. Researchers have recently shown a greater interest in attaining accurate brain tumor categorization using the Internet of Things and machine learning. The rigidity of tumor classification and segmentation in magnetic resonance imaging is due to large data and indistinct boundaries. Machine learning assisted Brain Tumor Detection Framework has been proposed using IoT. Our paper includes establishing a deep convolutional neural network for spotting brain tumors from magnetic resonance imageries. The standard medical image dataset has been gathered and experimentally examined to validate the accuracy,  efficiency,  specificity,  sensitivity,  optimum automatic recognition for non-tumor and tumor regions,  and the model’s error rate utilizing statistical construction. This study pays its ability in brain irregularity recognition and analysis in the healthcare sector without humanoid intermediation

The invention discloses a dynamic target tracking method for a legged robot. First,  images and videos of pedestrians who wear masks,  who do not wear masks and who do not wear masks correctly during walking are collected,  and a data set for detecting wearing of the masks by the pedestrians is built. Secondly,  a target identification module based on a recurrent neural network is adopted to judge whether the pedestrian wears a mask,  and the facial position coordinates of the pedestrian who does not wear the mask in the current frame are obtained. Again,  the residual network is used as a reference network,  the facial semantic features of the pedestrian who does not wear the mask in the current image frame are extracted,  and the facial semantic features of the pedestrian in the next image frame are predicted. Finally,  a target tracking module based on a twin network is designed,  and the pedestrian who does not wear the mask is tracked by calculating the correlation coefficient between the semantic feature mapping of the facial position of the pedestrian in the current frame and the next frame,  so that the dynamic target can be tracked by the legged robot. The invention can be applied to the polling process of the foot type robot under the epidemic situation prevention and control condition. 1. A foot-type robot dynamic target tracking method,  wherein comprising training and testing two stages,  wherein the training stage is composed of a target identification module based on recursion neural network a target semantic feature extraction module based on residual network and a target tracking module based on twinning network;  the target semantic feature extraction module based on residual network uses ResNet-50 model as the reference network,  and deletes the next sampling operation of the last two layers,  wherein the step length of the 4 group and the 5 group of convolution block is set to be 1;  at last increasing the 1 * 1 convolution block,  the channel number of the output characteristic is reduced to 256,  and only using the template branch centre 7 * 7 area,  The module comprises a template branch and a search branch,  respectively used for extracting the target semantic feature in the current image frame and predicting the target semantic feature in the next image frame;  the target tracking module based on twinborn network comprises an identifying branch and a regression branch,  respectively used for obtaining the target semantic feature mapping in the next image frame and calculating the correlation coefficient between the current image frame and the target semantic feature mapping in the next image frame,  each branch uses the depth cross-correlation layer to combine the feature map;  Test Phase :  after finishing the training,  using the target identification module based on recursive neural network carried by the foot robot,  judging whether the pedestrian wearing the mask,  using the target tracking module based on twinborn network to track the pedestrian without wearing the mask.

The invention provides a method and a system for detecting foot end touch of a legged robot,  and belongs to the technical field of legged robots. The detection method comprises the following steps of :  selecting a foot falling point according to the preprocessed point cloud data in front of walking of the robot to obtain a planning result of a foot falling point position and a foot end track of a swinging phase; Carrying out touchdown detection based on the joint moment according to the planning result of the position of the foot falling point and the foot end track of the swing phase,  judging whether it is touchdown in advance,  according to one of touchdown in anticipation and touchdown in delay,  if so,  it is judged as touchdown,  and the legged robot is switched to the support phase; If not,  it is determined that the pedal is idle,  and the four-foot support is switched; The invention improves the accuracy of foot end touch detection. 1. A foot-end touchdown detection method of foot-type robot,  comprising the following steps :  according to the pre-processed robot walking front point cloud data to drop foot point selection,  obtaining the planning result of the foot falling point position and the swinging phase foot end track,  according to the planning result of the foot falling point position and the swinging phase foot end track,  using the external sensor to combine with the internal sensor,  based on the joint torque for ground detection,  judging whether it is in advance touchdown,  according to one of the expected touchdown and delay touchdown,  if it is,  judging the touchdown,  the foot type robot is switched to the supporting phase;  if not,  judging to be empty,  switching to four-foot support;  touchdown detection based on joint torque,  judging whether to contact the ground in advance,  if yes,  judging the touchdown,  the foot-type robot is switched to support phase;  if not,  continuously performing touchdown detection;  judging whether according to the expected touchdown,  if it is,  judging the touchdown,  the foot-type robot is switched to support phase;  if not,  continuously detecting the touchdown after the foot continues to detect the set distance;  judging whether the contact ground is delayed,  if so,  judging the touchdown,  the foot-type robot is switched to the supporting phase;  if not,  judging to be empty,  switching to four-foot support; Safety is one of the most important factors in the robot interaction with unknown and dynamic environments. Based on the presented design,  the position and stiffness level of the fingers can be adjusted simultaneously by changing the air gap between the magnets.

Each hinge support has thereon two support rods disposed in parallel with the hinge shaft,  the two support rods are symmetrically disposed at two sides of the hinge shaft along a width direction of the hinge support and close to the large arm or the small arm,  and the support rods have thereon a plurality of rotatable pulleys; The upper end of the large arm is provided with a driving shaft which is rotatably arranged,  the driving shaft is arranged in parallel with the supporting rod,  and one end of the driving shaft is connected with a driving motor; A single spiral pull rope is wound on the driving shaft,  two ends of the pull rope are respectively wound on the pulleys on the two supporting rods on the same side in sequence,  and the end part of the pull rope is fixed on one of the supporting rods or the pulleys. The present invention has the advantages of reasonable weight distribution,  less dead weight of mechanical arm,  high flexibility and stability of mechanical arm,  low cost,  etc. 1. A lightweight humanoid robot arm with smooth movement,  wherein it comprises a big arm (1),  small arm (2) and elbow joint (3),  the elbow joint (3) comprises two hinged hinged support (31),  two said hinged support (31) are respectively installed on the big arm (1) and the small arm (2);  each of the hinge support (31) is provided with two supporting rods (32) arranged in parallel with the hinge shaft,  two of the supporting rods (32) are symmetrically set on the two sides of the hinge shaft along the width direction of the hinge support (31),  and close to the big arm (1) or small arm (2),  the supporting rod (32) is provided with a plurality of rotatable pulleys (33);  the upper end of the big arm (1) is provided with a driving shaft (11) rotatably arranged,  the driving shaft (11) is parallel to the supporting rod (32),  and one end is connected with a driving motor (12);  the driving shaft (11) is wound with a single spiral pull rope (4),  two ends of the pull rope (4) respectively sequentially through the pulley (33) on the two supporting rods (32) at the same side,  and the end part is fixed on one of the supporting rod (32) or the pulley (33);  the driving shaft (11) is a screw rod,  the pull rope is wound in the groove of the screw rod;  the upper end of the big arm (1) is further provided with two transverse rods (81) arranged in parallel with the driving shaft (11),  two of the transverse rods (81) are respectively located at two sides of the driving shaft (11),  and lower than the driving shaft (11);  the transverse rod (81) is rotatably provided with a guide pulley (82),  two ends of the pull rope (4) are respectively wound from the upper part of the guide pulley (82) at the same side,  the sequentially (33) on the two supporting rods (32) around the same side,  the upper end of the big arm (1) is further provided with two guide rods (83) arranged in parallel with the driving shaft (11),  two of the guide rods (83) are respectively located at the two sides of the driving shaft (11),  and higher than the driving shaft (11);  the two guide rods (83) are slidably set up with a sliding plate (84),  the bottom of the sliding plate (84) is connected with a screw nut matched with the driving shaft (11),  the screw nut and the pull rope (4) are provided with a distance;  the transverse rod (81) is installed on the sliding plate (84).

The present invention relates to robot technology,  and is especially one kind of legged robot and its motion control method. The legged robot includes one head and one trunk connected to the head. Two leg assemblies connected to the crotch of the trunk body,  and two arm assemblies connected to the shoulders of the trunk body,  wherein all joints inside the leg assemblies and the arm assemblies are driven by motors; A battery module and a gravity center compensation device located below the battery module are arranged inside the trunk body,  The gravity center compensation device comprises an X-axis moving mechanism and a Y-axis moving mechanism,  The X-axis moving mechanism is used for driving the battery module to move left and right. The Y-axis moving mechanism is used for driving the battery module to move back and forth. The X-axis moving mechanism is matched with the Y-axis moving mechanism,  so that the battery module can move in a plurality of directions in a horizontal plane,  and the movement of the battery module is used for adjusting the gravity center of the foot type robot in the moving process,  so that the stability of the movement is ensured,  and the foot type robot is prevented from falling down. 1. A foot-type robot,  wherein it comprises :  a head part and a body main body connected with the head part;  two leg assemblies connected with the crotch of the trunk body,  two arm assemblies connected with the shoulder of the body main body,  each joint in the leg assembly and the arm assembly is driven by a motor;  wherein the trunk main body is provided with a battery module and a gravity compensation device located below the battery module,  the gravity compensation device comprises an X axis moving mechanism and a Y axis moving mechanism,  the X axis moving mechanism is used for driving the battery module to move left and right,  the Y-axis moving mechanism is used for driving the battery module to move back and forth.

The present invention relates to a design method of eye optical system of humanoid simulation robot. It adopts 3D structure in PC machine and optical tracing design EDA software to make design,  The simulated front part of the eyeball of the ocular optical system,  the simulated cornea and the simulated lens thereof,  the iris,  the corneal lens is replaced by the front lens with curvature,  the iris is drawn on the frosted plane of the second face of the front lens or on the mounting plane of the front lens in a colored drawing manner,  so as to achieve a more realistic effect; The design includes five steps. Said invention can reduce design difficulty and design cost,  Meanwhile,  during design,  the adaptability to the boundary condition of the existing eye module with the invariable appearance is enhanced,  a more perfect appearance can be achieved,  the condition of a video acquisition function is considered at the same time,  and favorable technical support is provided for the technical progress of a humanoid simulation robot product and the improvement of good use experience of a user. Based on the above,  the invention has good application prospect. 1. A design method for eye optical system of human-shaped simulation robot,  wherein the EDA software is designed by using the 3 D structure and the optical tracing design in the PC machine,  the simulation eyeball front part of the eye optical system,  the simulation cornea and the simulation lens,  iris,  using cornea front lens with curvature to replace,  the iris is painted on the frosted plane of the second surface of the front lens or on the mounting plane of the front lens in a coloured drawing manner,  the invention reaches more vivid effect;  The design comprises the following steps :  step A :  simplifying the eye module micro video camera of the human-shaped simulation robot and the optical design model of the simulation eye,  estimating the focal length and back intercept of the camera,  specifically,  using a simple near-axis model in the design software to perform the focal length and rear intercept design replacement of the camera,  the design effect and speed are improved;  step B :  designing the front lens of the eye module,  the first surface lens and the eyeball outer radius curvature the same,  and designing and changing the thickness of the first lens and the curvature lens,  actual application realizes the focus lifting effect of the camera and the front lens to the image input;  step C :  designing and selecting the position of the camera diaphragm hole as the alignment point of the second surface lens,  the second surface lens radius curvature and the curvature surface of the radius center of the center point are overlapped,  the light can smoothly converge on the focal plane of the camera,  step D :  the position of the front lens iris position,  the pupil corresponding to the middle,  in order to make it structural member,  according to the injection or the 3 D printing process to design,  specifically simulating pupil design thickness is between 0. 6 to 0. 8 mm,  the size of the pupil is 2.6-2.8mm,  under the premise of realizing the satisfy field angle of the pinhole camera,  and the satisfy average pupil size and better beautiful effect;  step E :  for the lens thickness design,  using the folding way to design,  processing satisfy,  and correcting the last eyeball curvature radius data in the model,  realizing the production in good processing base,  the processed eye module has beautiful appearance and better image acquisition effect.

The invention relates to the technical field of robots,  in particular to a gravity center control method,  an adjusting mechanism and a legged robot. The gravity center control method comprises the following steps of :  planning a motion trajectory of the robot,  and predicting theoretical motion state data of a center of mass of the robot by using a model; Acquiring the real motion state data of the center of mass of the robot in the actual motion process by the data acquisition device of the robot; During the actual movement of the robot,  By adjusting the position of the counterweight element on the robot body,  To compensate for a deviation value between the true motion state data and the theoretical motion state data of the center of mass,  The present invention adopts the method of regulating the horizontal position of the counterweight element on the robot body,  Compared with a motion self-adaptive method in the prior art,  the motion self-adaptive method has the advantages that the training times of a data model can be greatly reduced,  the difficulty of training the model is simplified,  the gravity center control precision can be improved,  and the motion stability of the legged robot is improved. 1. A foot-type robot gravity control method,  wherein it comprises :  planning the robot motion track,  predicting robot center of mass to the theoretical motion state data,  collecting the real movement state data of the robot center of mass the actual movement process by the data collecting device of the robot;  in the actual movement process of the robot,  by adjusting the position of the counterweight element on the robot body,  to compensate the deviation value center of mass the real motion state data and the theoretical motion state data.

The invention provides a gas unmanned station perimeter intrusion early warning method,  an electronic device and a storage medium. It determines whether there is a human-shaped target in the video through a human-shaped target detection model,  Then according to the detection result of the human-shaped target detection model,  it is selected whether to carry out early warning or not. Because the feature fusion network of the humanoid target detection model fuses each scale feature through the weight set obtained by training and learning,  The detection result of the human-shaped object detection model is improved,  The false alarm rate of early warning is reduced; in addition,  whether the target object exists in the monitoring video is determined firstly,  and when the target object exists in the monitoring video,  the corresponding video frame is input into the human-shaped target detection model to further determine whether the human-shaped target exists or not,  so that the human-shaped target detection model is prevented from detecting all the video frames,  and the detection efficiency is improved. 1. A pre-warning method for fuel gas unmanned station perimeter intrusion,  wherein it comprises :  S101,  obtaining the gas unmanned station perimeter real-time monitoring video;  S102,  determining whether the monitoring video has a target object,  if so,  extracting the video frame with the target object from the monitoring video;  S103,  inputting the video frame into the human-shaped target detection model,  determining whether the video frame has a human-shaped target,  if not,  then performing early warning;  wherein the human-shaped target detection model is trained to perform feature extraction to the input video frame by the backbone network,  the feature fusion network fuses each scale feature by the weight set obtained by learning,  the prediction network outputs the detection result whether the video frame has the human-shaped target,  The weight set includes a plurality of feature weights corresponding to respective scale features.

The present invention discloses a power transmission safety assurance method and its system,  electronic equipment,  The present invention pioneers the identification of targets passing through the vicinity of power transmission cables by means of thermal imaging sensors,  Excluding the influence of non-living body on the monitoring result,  By setting a first preset threshold,  Intelligently judging whether a target passing through the vicinity of the power transmission cable is a human shape or an animal,  When the object passing near the power transmission cable is human-shaped,  The server judges the distance between a person passing near the power transmission cable and a warning point and controls the execution mechanism to execute all levels of safety guarantee instructions,  The intelligent degree,  the reliability and the safety of the system are greatly improved,  the application scenarios of the system are expanded to a great extent,  and the capability of ensuring the life safety of the people is improved to a great extent. 1. An electric power transmission security assurance method,  wherein it comprises :  reading the current frame image collected by the infrared thermal imager set at the preset position in the power transmission security assurance system;  analyzing the current frame image and obtaining the current frame image data,  determining the target range according to the grey value of each point in the current frame image data and establishing a target search frame according to the preset step;  the server calculates the area of the target search frame and judges whether the area of the target search frame is greater than the first preset threshold value,  if the area of the target search frame is greater than the first preset threshold value,  judging the target is human shape,  calculating to obtain the target center of mass coordinate and calculating the warning distance according to the preset method;  server real time judging whether the warning distance is greater than the second preset threshold value,  if the warning distance is greater than the second preset threshold value,  the server sends the voice alarm instruction and judging whether the warning distance is greater than the third preset threshold value,  if the warning distance is greater than the third preset threshold value,  the server sends the light alarm instruction and judges whether the warning distance is greater than the fourth preset threshold value,  if the warning distance is greater than the fourth preset threshold value,  the server controls the power transmission safety guarantee system to cut off the current power transmission line and sends alarm information to the security system of the relevant department.

The present utility model provides a hip stabilizing structure and a humanoid robot having the same. The hip stabilizing structure comprises a mounting bracket,  a steering engine,  a U-shaped member and a fixing member,  wherein the mounting bracket is provided with a mounting port for mounting the steering engine; The mounting bracket and the fixing member connect and secure the two steering engines together. The steering engine comprises a main shaft and an auxiliary shaft which are arranged at two ends of the steering engine,  the main shaft and the auxiliary shaft are sleeved with steering wheels,  one end of the U-shaped piece is connected with the steering wheel of the main shaft,  and the other end of the U-shaped piece is connected with the steering wheel of the auxiliary shaft; The hip joint steering engine of the humanoid robot can control the legs of the robot to axially rotate,  In the utility model,  the bracket stabilizing structure is arranged on the output shaft of the double steering engine at the hip part of the robot,  The two end shafts of the steering engines are stably maintained and fixed through the support,  stress of the main shaft is dispersed to the auxiliary shaft,  rotation is not affected,  and stable operation of the steering engines is guaranteed; meanwhile,  the two steering engines at the hip are fixedly connected through the fixing piece,  so that the integration of the two steering engines is better,  the overall stability of the hip structure of the humanoid robot is guaranteed,  and the humanoid robot hip structure is convenient and practical. 1. A hip stable structure,  wherein it comprises a mounting bracket,  a steering engine,  a U-shaped piece and a fixing piece,  the mounting bracket is provided with a mounting opening for mounting the steering engine;  the steering engine comprises a main shaft and a secondary shaft set at the two ends of the steering engine,  the main shaft and the auxiliary shaft are sleeved with a steering wheel,  one end of the U-shaped piece is connected with the steering wheel of the main shaft,  the other end is connected with the rudder plate of the secondary shaft,  the side of the mounting bracket is provided with a fixing piece,  the fixing piece is attached to the steering engine,  and the lower end of the fixing piece is propped against the steering engine.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm structure,  and relates to the technical field of robot arms. A humanoid robot arm structure,  Comprising a back plate,  One side of the back plate is provided with a housing,  The top of one side of the cover shell is movably connected with a base plate,  One side of the base plate is movably connected with a mechanical arm; a rotating shaft is arranged between the back plate and the inner wall of the housing; one end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected to one side in the housing; the other end of the rotating shaft is movably connected to one side of the back plate; the surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first conical tooth; and the other side of the back plate is fixedly connected with a second motor. A humanoid robot arm structure,  comprising a back plate (1),  wherein one side of the back plate (1) is provided with a shell (7),  one side of the shell (7 top part is movably connected with a base plate (8),  one side of the base plate (8) is movably connected with a mechanical arm (9),  wherein a rotating shaft (10) is set between the back plate (1) and the inner wall of the shell (7),  one end of the rotating shaft (10) is fixedly connected to one side of the inner part of the shell (7),  the other end of the rotating shaft (10) is movably connected to one side of the back plate (1),  wherein the surface of the rotating shaft (10) is fixedly connected with a first tapered tooth (11),  the other side of the back plate (1) is fixedly connected with a second motor (13),  the output end of the second motor (13) is fixedly connected with a second conical tooth (12),  the first conical tooth (11) and the second conical tooth (12) are connected with meshing other.

The present utility model relates to the technical field of manipulators,  in particular to a variable-stiffness flexible humanoid manipulator,  comprising a grabbing assembly,  wherein the grabbing assembly comprises a forearm,  a palm,  a first motor,  a second motor,  a thumb,  a forefinger,  a middle finger,  a ring finger,  a little finger and an air pump,  wherein the middle finger comprises a frame,  an air bag with particles,  a hose and a pressure sensor,  and the grabbing assembly comprises a small arm,  a palm,  a first motor,  a second motor,  a thumb,  a forefinger,  a middle finger,  a ring finger,  a little finger and an air pump; The first motor drives the thumb to adjust the angle,  The second motor drives the little finger to adjust the angle,  So as to be closer to the structure of the human hand,  The thumb,  index finger,  middle finger,  ring finger and little finger are of the same structure,  The frame implements the action of bending grabbing,  The air bag with the particles is arranged on the inner side of the end part of the frame,  which is far away from the palm,  the air pump can inflate the air bag with the particles,  the pressure sensor is used for monitoring the grabbing force,  the frame part is made of silica gel,  and the effect of changing the rigidity is realized through the air bag with the particles and the frame,  so that the rigidity of the manipulator can be adjusted. 1. A variable rigidity flexible humanoid manipulator,  wherein it comprises a grabbing assembly;  the grabbing assembly comprises a small arm,  a palm,  a first motor,  a second motor,  a thumb,  a forefinger,  a middle finger,  a ring finger,  a small thumb and an air pump;  the palm is set on one side of the small arm,  the first motor is set in the palm,  the second motor is set in the palm,  the thumb is fixedly connected with the output shaft of the first motor,  and located on one side of the palm,  the forefinger is set on one side of the palm,  the middle finger is set on one side of the palm,  the ring finger is set on one side of the palm,  the small thumb is fixedly connected with the output shaft of the second motor,  and located on one side of the palm;  the middle finger comprises a frame,  an air bag with particles,  a hose and a pressure sensor,  the frame is set on one side of the palm,  the airbag with particles is set on the inner side of the frame,  the hose is connected with the air pump,  and is connected with the airbag with particles,  and passes through the frame,  the pressure sensor is set on one side of the airbag with particles.

A method for controlling motion of a legged robot includes determining one or more candidate landing points for each foot of the robot. The method further includes determining a first correlation between a center of mass position change parameter,  candidate landing points,  and foot contact force. The method further includes determining,  under a constraint condition set and based on the first correlation,  a target center of mass position change parameter,  a target step order,  and a target landing point for each foot selected among the one or more candidate landing points for the respective foot,  the constraint condition set constraining a step order. The method further includes controlling,  according to the target center of mass position change parameter,  the target step order,  and the target landing point for each foot,  motion of the legged robot in the preset period.

Disclosed are methods for monitoring operator fatigue. In particular,  indications of operator fatigue are obtained using a natural language-based communication interface (310). These are then processed using natural language-based processing (312) to determine a set of one or more data points indicative of the operator's current fatigue level. At the same time,  data indicative of the current ambient conditions within the system is obtained. It is then determined which actions are to be performed by a control circuit of the system to reduce operator fatigue. A respective rule can thus be generated that can be automatically applied by the control circuit when similar ambient conditions are subsequently encountered within the system.

The invention provides a method and a system for controlling a four-foot robot with a mechanical arm,  and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The present invention provides a method for controlling a four-legged robot with a mechanical arm,  comprising :  first,  obtaining current pose information of the four-legged robot; Determining disturbance feedforward of the quadruped robot according to the current pose information; Obtaining an expected pose of the end effector of the mechanical arm; Finally,  the robot end effector is controlled to move to a desired pose based on the perturbation feedforward. The present invention compensates the motion of the robot arm by utilizing the disturbance feedforward of the quadruped robot,  and can increase the positioning precision and stability of the end effector of the robot arm during fine operation. 1. A four-footed robot control method with mechanical arm,  wherein it comprises :  step 1 :  obtaining the current pose information of the four-footed robot;  Wherein,  Step 1 :  obtaining the current pose information of the four-footed robot,  comprising :  obtaining the current pose of the four-footed robot main body and the current angle of each joint of the mechanical arm;  the current pose information comprises the current pose of the four-footed robot main body and the current angle of each joint of the mechanical arm;  step 2 :  determining the disturbance feed-forward of the four-footed robot according to the current pose information;  wherein,  step 2 :  according to the current pose information,  determining the disturbance feed-forward of the four-footed robot,  comprising :  obtaining the current gravity centre position of the four-footed robot according to the current pose of the four-footed robot main body and the current angle of each joint of the mechanical arm;  the current centre-of-gravity position is the disturbance feed-forward of the four-footed robot;  step 3 :  obtaining the expected pose of the end effector of the mechanical arm;  step 4 :  controlling a mechanical arm end effector to move to a desired pose according to the disturbance feed-forward;  wherein,  Step 4 :  according to the disturbance feed-forward control mechanical arm end effector moves to the desired pose,  comprising :  calculating the expected angle of each joint of the mechanical arm in real time by using the kinematics inverse solution model according to the current gravity centre position;  controlling the mechanical arm end effector to move to the desired pose according to the desired angle.

The invention discloses a multi-legged robot for exploring and sampling and a method thereof. The multi-legged robot comprises a robot body component,  six leg components and a sampling and picking component. Through the left and right swing transmission of the six leg components,  the forward and backward movement and the posture adjustment of the machine body are controlled; And can control the direction,  position and posture of the sampling pick-up assembly so as to pick up the sample. The invention can realize the action with higher degree of freedom,  and can meet the actions of running in a narrow space,  climbing obstacles and the like,  and freely walking on land and waterways. 1. An exploration sampling multi-foot robot,  wherein comprising a body assembly,  a leg assembly,  a sampling pickup assembly;  the machine body assembly comprises a machine shell (1),  the centre of the shell (1) is provided with a rotating motor,  the rotating motor is connected with a rotating platform (11) capable of rotating horizontally in 360 degrees;  the leg assembly comprises a connecting piece (2) fixedly connected on the peripheral side of the shell (1),  the end part of the connecting piece (2) is connected with a thigh component (21) through the thigh joint,  the end part of the connecting piece (2) and the two ends of the thigh joint are provided with a motor,  the thigh joint comprises two vertical U-shaped frames (22),  one end of the thigh joint is connected with the motor of the connecting piece (2) through the transverse U-shaped frame (22),  the other end is connected with the motor of the thigh joint,  one end of the thigh part (21) far away from the thigh joint is vertically connected with a leg part (23) through the motor,  the end part of the leg part (23) is provided with a pressure sensor (24);  the leg assemblies are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the shell (1),  the number of two sides is the same;  the sampling pickup assembly comprises a storage device (3) set on the rotating platform (11),  the storage device is provided with a pickup device,  the pickup device comprises a screw rod (31) set above the storage device (3),  one end of the screw rod (31) is fixed with the storage device (3) through the bearing seat,  the other end is connected with a driving device,  the screw rod (31) is provided with a sliding table (34),  the bottom of the sliding table (34) is connected with an electric telescopic rod (341),  the telescopic rod end part is connected with a grabbing assembly driven by electric power;  the shell (1) is provided with a controller,  the rotating motor,  a motor,  a pressure sensor (24),  a driving device,  the electric telescopic rod (341) and the grabbing assembly are connected with the controller,  the controller has a wireless transmission function and is connected with an external wireless control device.

Tracking units for facial features with advanced training for natural rendering of human faces in real-time are provided. An example device receives a video stream,  and upon detecting a visual face,  selects a 3D model from a comprehensive set of head orientation classes. The device determines modifications to the selected 3D model to describe the face,  then projects a 2D model of tracking points of facial features based on the 3D model,  and controls,  actuates,  or animates hardware based on the facial features tracking points. The device can switch among an example comprehensive set of 35 different head orientation classes for each video frame,  based on suggestions computed from a previous video frame or from yaw and pitch angles of the visual head orientation. Each class of the comprehensive set is trained separately based on a respective collection of automatically marked images for that head orientation class.

The present application discloses a robot and a control method thereof,  a computer storage medium,  the method comprising :  acquiring data information of the robot in a teaching process; Inputting the data information as a training sample into a pre-established control model to train the control model; Judging the system stability of the robot based on the trained control model; If the system is stable,  the robot is controlled by the control model; If the system is not stable,  the process returns to the step of acquiring data information of the robot in the teaching process. Through the mode,  the precision loss of the model can be reduced,  the stability of the system is improved,  and the reproduction precision of the humanoid motion of the robot is also improved. 1. A control method of robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  obtaining the data information of the robot in the teaching process;  taking the data information as the training sample,  inputting to the pre-established control model,  to train the control model;  judging the system stability of the robot based on the training control model;  if the system is stable,  calculating the system convergence domain of the robot;  when the system convergence domain of the robot is greater than the preset threshold value,  then using the control model to control the robot;  if the system is not stable,  returning to the step of obtaining the data information of the robot in the teaching process.

The invention discloses a motion planning method for a humanoid robot to dynamically cross over continuous obstacles. The method comprises the following steps of :  1,  planning constraints for motion of the humanoid robot to continuously cross obstacles; Step 2 :  a motion planning algorithm for the humanoid robot to continuously cross the obstacle; Said step 1 includes geometric and bilegged motion constraints,  balance constraints,  and constraints to reduce ground collisions; The step 2 includes a general feasibility analysis unit,  a leg track generator,  a bipedal adapter and an upper body motion generator. The invention relates to a motion planning method for dynamically and continuously crossing obstacles by a humanoid robot. The motion trails of the legs,  the waist and the upper body of the humanoid robot are obtained,  and the humanoid robot can dynamically and continuously cross obstacles and obtain a stable and practical crossing gait through a leg trail planning method based on the motion of the upper body of the humanoid robot with centroid trail compensation. 1. A motion planning method of humanoid robot dynamic across continuous barrier,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  step 1) :  the humanoid robot continuously spans the movement programming restriction of the barrier;  step 2) :  the humanoid robot continuously spans the motion programming algorithm of the barrier;  the step 1) comprises geometric and double-leg motion constraint,  balance constraint,  reducing the constraint of ground collision;  the step 2) comprises a universal feasibility analysis unit,  a leg track generator,  a double-foot adapter and an upper body motion generator;  the step 2) specifically comprises the following steps :  the universal feasibility analysis unit,  specifically comprising :  determining the humanoid robot initial middle standing point,  inputting the condition constraint of crossing gait;  according to the difference of the size of the continuous obstacle and the distance between the continuous obstacles,  the humanoid robot autonomously analyzes the feasibility of the continuous obstacle crossing gait and the parameterization of the humanoid robot across the gait parameter planning;  the leg track generator,  under the humanoid robot coordinate system,  through a plurality of steps to obtain the motion track of the humanoid robot two legs :  the first step is to use the straight line inverted pendulum model to obtain the movement track of the support leg in three directions;  the second step is planning the track of swinging back in the world coordinate system,  so as to cross the obstacle;  the third step,  considering the relationship between the swinging back track and the supporting leg track in the world coordinate system,  obtaining the swinging leg track; Emotion Recognition is a trending research topic these days,  with its main motive to improve human-machine interaction. As human beings,  speech is the most natural way to express oneself. Emotions can be determined considering various factors like speech,  facial expressions,  and body language. Also,  Auscultation tests are performed to listen to the sounds of internal organs like lungs,  heart,  etc using a stethoscope. The existing classifiers are found to be good at end-to-end audio classification models,  aiming to learn a direct mapping from audio spectrograms to corresponding labels. The proposed idea is to define an Emotion Recognition (ER) system as a collection of methodologies by correlating audio signals and heartbeats of an individual for the detection of various emotions. The system aims to extract the most prominent features from the input audio file imported using a microphone and the sounds of the heart is measured via a digital stethoscope. As emotions bring a greater impact on the functionality of heart rate,  the recognizer is allowed to view the auscultation signal in the form of wave plots (heart rate),  the pitch diagram (for input speech),  and the resultant of both will help in the classification of individual emotions using deep learning techniques. Such a system can be used in a wide variety of application areas like interactive voice-based-assistant or caller-agent conversation and analysis of human mental and heart health prediction and human-robot interaction.

A robot foot end collision stability control method and apparatus,  and a foot robot. A single leg motion planning trajectory of a robot comprises a trajectory component in the heading direction of a foot end,  a trajectory component in the lateral shift direction of the foot end,  and a trajectory component in the lifting direction of the foot end. The method comprises :  upon detecting that the foot end of the swinging leg of the robot collides,  stopping planning the trajectory component of the swinging leg in the collision direction,  the trajectory component in the collision direction being the trajectory component in the heading direction and/or the trajectory component in the lateral shift direction;  according to an external force obtained in real time and received by the foot end of the swinging leg in the collision direction,  calculating a position offset in the collision direction on the basis of the foot end drag control mode;  and controlling the swinging leg to move using the position offset in the collision direction and the desired trajectory component in the non-collision direction. According to the method,  after the foot end of the robot collides,  the robot is prevented from falling down or being damaged,  etc.,  and thus the safety of the robot or the external environment is ensured.

The invention discloses a legged robot track tracking method,  a legged robot track tracking device and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps of :  performing attitude calculation according to sensor data of a legged robot to obtain attitude information of the legged robot; Performing gait detection according to the sensor data to obtain a stride period of the legged robot and a step length corresponding to the stride period; Obtaining a direction angle corresponding to the stride period from the attitude information; The motion trail of the legged robot is calculated according to the direction angle and the step length. Reliable tracking of the motion trail of the legged robot is achieved,  and therefore accurate control of the robot can be achieved according to the accurate motion trail obtained through calculation. 1. A foot-type robot trajectory tracking method,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  in the walking process of the foot-type robot,  according to the sensor data of the foot-type robot,  performing attitude calculation to obtain the posture information of the foot-type robot;  performing gait detection according to the sensor data to obtain a step period of the foot-type robot and a step length corresponding to the step-span period;  obtaining the direction angle corresponding to the step-span period from the gesture information;  according to the direction angle and the step length,  calculating to obtain the motion track of the foot-type robot;  the step of performing gait detection according to the sensor data to obtain the step period of the foot-type robot and the step length corresponding to the step period comprises :  performing peak detection to the sensor data to obtain each minimum peak point;  taking the period defined by two adjacent minimum peak points in each said minimum peak point point as a step-striding period;  calculating to obtain the step length corresponding to the step-span period according to the sensor data in the step-striding period;  the step of calculating and obtaining the step length corresponding to the step-span period according to the sensor data in the step-striding period comprises :  obtaining the acceleration value collected by the three-axis accelerometer in each time point in the step period,  for each time point,  averaging the acceleration value of three directions collected by the three-axis accelerometer,  obtaining the total acceleration value corresponding to each time point,  comparing the total acceleration value of each time point,  obtaining the maximum total accelerometer value and the minimum total acceleration meter value in the step period;  according to the preset proportion factor,  the maximum total accelerometer value and the minimum total accelerometer value to calculate to obtain the step length corresponding to the step period.

A humanoid grasping control method for bionic hand,  wherein it comprises :  obtaining the motor activity amplitude,  human finger curvature,  control dimension,  object type and five-finger expected gripping force;  according to the human finger bending range and the motor activity amplitude,  finding the corresponding relation between the human hand and the bionic hand posture,  generating the bionic hand data set;  based on the control dimension,  performing dimensionality reduction processing on the bionic hand data set,  generating a cooperative data set;  according to the cooperative data set and the object type,  generating a pre-grabbing posture,  controlling the motor to generate motion according to the first control law,  the first control law is switched between the non-singular end sliding mode control law and linear sliding mode control law according to the error;  after the bionic hand and the object,  contact the contact force,  combining the five-finger expected gripping force,  controlling the motor to move according to the second control law,  adjusting the pose of the bionic hand,  so as to finish the bionic hand grabbing the human body of the object.
