The invention belongs to the field of robot grabbing,  and particularly relates to a humanoid dexterous hand object grabbing method based on depth generation and a robot system. The humanoid dexterous hand object grabbing method and the robot system aim to solve the problems that the humanoid dexterous hand is complex in structure and high in driving mode freedom degree,  grabbing and operation planning complexity is high,  and application of the humanoid dexterous hand is greatly limited. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring single-view point cloud data of an object to be grabbed and complementing the point cloud; Sampling the complete point cloud data complemented by the farthest point sampling method; Generating a grasping configuration of the object to be grasped based on the sampling point set,  and performing fine adjustment of the grasping configuration; Through the fine-tuned grabbing configuration,  the humanoid dexterous hand is controlled to grab an object to be grabbed. According to the method,  the similar and unknown objects can be flexibly grabbed by the humanoid dexterous hand,  the accuracy and the precision of the grabbing configuration are high,  the network convergence speed is high,  the performance is good,  and the robustness is strong. 1. A depth-generated humanoid dexterous hand object grabbing method,  wherein the method comprises :  step S10,  obtaining the point cloud data of the object to be captured single visual angle observation,  obtaining the complete point cloud data of the object to be captured through the point cloud and full depth network;  step S20,  sampling the complete point cloud data of the object to be captured by the most remote point sampling method,  obtaining the sampling point set of the object to be captured;  step S30,  based on the sampling point set of the object to be captured,  generating the capturing configuration of the object to be captured by the capturing configuration,  and fine tuning the grabbing configuration through the fine tuning network,  obtaining the grabbing configuration after fine adjustment;  step S40,  based on the grabbing configuration after the fine adjustment,  controlling the humanoid dexterous hand to grasp the object to be captured.

To provide an iris authentication device and the like for performing iris authentication with high accuracy by reliably identifying left and right eyes. An iris authentication device 100 includes :  a first image input unit 11 to input a first image obtained by capturing an image of an authentication target;  a second image input unit 12 to input a second image obtained by capturing an image of a right eye or a left eye of the target;  a determination unit 13 to output a determination result of determining whether the second image is of a left eye or a right eye of the target on the basis of information including the first image,  as left/right information in association with the second image;  a detection unit 14 to detect an overlap between a region including the second image and a predetermined region in the first image;  a storage unit 15 to store iris characteristic information of a right eye and a left eye;  a score calculation unit 16 to compare iris characteristic information calculated from the second image with one or more pieces of characteristic information stored in the storage unit to calculate a verification score,  and calculate a first weighted verification score obtained by weighting the verification score with a detection result;  and an authentication unit 17 to authenticate a target captured in the second image on the basis of the calculated first weighted verification score.

Systems and methods for detecting and matching keypoints between different views of a scene are disclosed herein. One embodiment acquires first and second images;  subdivides the first and second images into first and second pluralities of cells,  respectively;  processes both pluralities of cells using a neural keypoint detection network to identify a first keypoint for a particular cell in the first plurality of cells and a second keypoint for a particular cell in the second plurality of cells,  at least one of the first and second keypoints lying in a cell other than the particular cell in the first or second plurality of cells for which it was identified;  and classifies the first keypoint and the second keypoint as a matching keypoint pair based,  at least in part,  on a comparison between a first descriptor associated with the first keypoint and a second descriptor associated with the second keypoint.

The present invention is capable of simultaneously realizing grasping mode prediction and grasping pose estimation,  avoiding complex grasping planning and allowing the soft and rigid artificial human hand to make slight contact with the desktop; Accurate control of the rigid and soft artificial hand can be realized,  so that the rigid and soft artificial hand can accurately and powerfully grab an object. 1. An automatic grabbing method of rigid and soft imitated hand based on deep learning,  wherein the method is based on the complementarity deep learning the method and under-actuated self-adaptive grabbing,  using the deep learning network of the different object grabbing mode,  and detecting and image processing by the object,  identifying the object grabbing mode,  grabbing area and grabbing angle,  simplifying the grabbing planning and control of humanoid hand;  The method is based on the obtaining module,  a first control module,  a second control module,  a grabbing module,  comprising the following steps :  the first step,  using the depth camera to obtain the RGB image of the object,  and training the model specifically :  the obtaining module is used for using the depth camera to obtain the RGB image of the object,  establishing a data set;  the data set is divided into a test set and a training set,  the training set is used for training YOLOv3 target detection algorithm to identify the capture mode,  the test set is used for effectively detecting the training result of YOLOv3 target detection algorithm;  inputting the RGB image into YOLOv3 target detection algorithm based on depth neural network model by the first control module,  outputting the grabbing mode and grabbing area of the object;  the second step,  using the second control module to input the RGB image obtained in the first step into the opencv software library,  and processing it based on the OpenCV image processing method;  outputting the grabbing angle of the object;  the third step,  the grabbing module according to the grabbing angle obtained in the third step,  the grabbing mode obtained in the second step,  grabbing area,  grabbing the object by the motor control just soft hand grabbing,  specifically :  3.1) initializing under the condition that the designed rigid soft imitated hand is empty,  setting the initial position mark of the motor;  3.2) according to the grabbing area and the grabbing angle,  controlling the mechanical arm connected with the soft hand-imitating hand to move to the preparation position at the position 20 cm above the grabbing point;  3.3) controlling the rotating ring number of the motor,  making the finger of the soft hand-imitated reach the pre-grabbing position;  3.4) according to the grabbing mode to control the soft hand to make the pre-grabbing mode configuration,  such as when grabbing a certain object,  the hand needs to rotate 90 degrees,  at this time,  it needs the soft hand-imitated hand pre-rotating 30 degrees,  realizing the pre-grabbing mode configuration;  3.5) according to the grabbing height,  controlling the mechanical arm to vertically move downwards to make the soft imitating hand grabbing end point to reach the desktop;  3.6) finishing self-adaptive grabbing and holding by hand,  the mechanical arm moves upwards to grab the object;  wherein the grasping height is obtained by a depth camera.

The invention relates to a mobile robot target following method based on SAC-PID. The method comprises the steps of collecting the state information of reinforcement learning,  outputting the target angular velocity and the target linear velocity of motion control of the mobile robot through the trained SAC reinforcement learning model,  and achieving end-to-end target following decision output. The method has the beneficial effects that the model of the tracking target is established,  the background and the following target are effectively distinguished,  the following method can be continuously applied under the shielding condition,  the realization is simple,  the convergence speed is high,  the target following accuracy is high,  the complicated application scene can be dealt with,  the robustness is stronger,  and the smooth control of the tracking process is realized. 1. The invention provides a supersonic combustion chamber pulse injection control method and system based on anthropomorphic active disturbance rejection. An intelligent prediction model of multiple target performance indexes of the combustion chamber of the scramjet engine is constructed,  high-efficiency and high-precision prediction of thrust and total pressure loss of combustion chamber,  And through multi-objective optimization method,  During the whole covered wire,  whole area and whole life period,  Main regulation and control parameters of pulse injection meeting the optimal performance index under the current condition are updated in real time,  self-interference rejection control is carried out on the parameters of the pulse injection through a humanoid self-interference rejection control algorithm,  oil and gas distribution is controllable under the factors of a complex nonlinear system,  uncertain external environment and the like,  and therefore the intelligent level of a combustion organization is improved. 1. An ultrasonic speed combustion chamber pulse injection control method based on humanoid self-interference rejection,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  analyzing the influence rule of the combustion engine under a certain working condition and pulse injection main controllable parameter to the combustion chamber thrust,  total pressure loss combustion performance index;  S2,  obtaining sample point of design variable interval by using Latin hypercube sampling under different working conditions of the super-combustion stamping engine,  performing experiment to obtain data set;  S3,  pre-processing the data set;  S4,  building the neural network,  forming combustion chamber performance prediction neural network model;  S5,  using the multi-target optimizing particle swarm algorithm,  combining with the neural network proxy model,  searching the combustion chamber thrust,  total pressure loss optimal fuel pulse injection design variable Pareto non-branching solution set;  Step S5 is specifically as follows :  under different working conditions of the super-combustion stamping engine,  taking the neural network agent model as fitness function,  using the multi-target optimization particle swarm algorithm to search the injection angle of the fuel pulse injection with the optimal pushing force and total pressure loss,  spraying position,  injection frequency,  injection pressure,  for the oil supply path number,  namely searching the Pareto non-branch solution set of fuel pulse injection design variable;  S6,  determining the global optimal variable of the fuel pulse injector as the control parameter of the pulse injection under the current condition,  using the humanoid self-disturbance rejection controller for real time control.

The adaptive anti-interference control module takes a yaw angular velocity error of a vehicle as an input,  simulates compensation and adjustment behaviors of a driver,  provides a compensation steering angle for feedforward input,  and simultaneously enhances robustness of a control strategy. According to the method,  the humanoid driving effect can be realized in path tracking control,  the comfort of passengers is ensured while high-efficiency and stable tracking control is realized,  and the acceptance degree of an automatic driving system is improved. 1. A human-like control strategy of automatic driving vehicle path tracking,  the human control strategy is realized by the controller,  the controller comprises a pre-aiming feed-forward module and an adaptive anti-interference control module,  wherein the human control strategy comprises :  simulating the human driver by the pre-aiming feed-forward module to cope with the steering decision and pre-operation behaviour of the front road,  simulating the human driver by the self-adaptive anti-interference control module to deal with the compensation and adjusting behaviour of the tracking error,  the feedforward of the pre-aiming feed-forward module and compensation of the adaptive anti-interference control module are respectively obtained by solving the front wheel angle and acting on the automatic driving vehicle,  so as to realize the automatic driving vehicle path tracking type control;  wherein the pre-aiming feed-forward module comprises a pre-aiming model of the sequentially connected,  a proportional controller and a driver neuromuscular system,  the driver neuromuscular system is characterized by a delay link and a first-order inertia link;  the self-adaptive anti-interference control module comprises a state expanding observer,  a differential tracker and a nonlinear state error feedback module,  the difference between the output of the differential tracker and the output of the state expansion observer is input to the nonlinear state error feedback module,  the sum of the output of the nonlinear state error feedback module and the output of the state expansion observer is used as the feedback and then input to the state expansion observer.

The utility model belongs to the technical field of stereoscopic goods shelves,  and particularly relates to a rail roadway type single upright post stacker for a stereoscopic goods shelf. An expansion platform is arranged on the right side of the upper end of the translation support base,  an automatic stacking frame is fixed on the right side of the expansion platform,  a humanoid support frame is fixed on the left side of the expansion platform,  the upper end of the humanoid support frame is connected with a track upright post,  and the upper end of the track upright post is movably connected with an upper stable guide beam; The track upright post is connected with a lifting drive assembly,  and the left side of the lifting drive assembly is connected with a sunk stacking operation box frame; The surface of the expansion platform is movably embedded with a pair of conveying belts,  and the conveying belts convey the lower-layer container of the automatic stacking rack to the left,  so that the lower-layer container of the automatic stacking rack penetrates through the humanoid supporting rack to move to the stacking operation box rack. The utility model improves the structure of the traditional single upright post stacker,  can realize the stacking access of a plurality of cargo boxes in one pass,  greatly improves the access efficiency of the stereoscopic goods shelf,  and avoids the defect that the traditional stacker can only access a single cargo box in one pass. 1. A rail-way single-column stacker for three-dimensional shelf,  wherein It comprises a translational support base (1),  a track upright post (2),  an upper stable guide beam (3),  a lifting drive component (4),  a stacking operation box frame (5),  an expanding platform (6),  a human-shaped support frame (7) and an automatic stacking frame (8);  the right side of the upper end of the translation supporting base (1) is provided with an expanding platform (6),  the right side of the expanding platform (6) is fixed with an automatic stacking frame (8),  the left side of the expanding platform (6) is fixed with a human-shaped supporting frame (7),  and the upper end of the human-shaped supporting frame (7) is connected with a rail upright post (2),  the upper end of the track upright post (2) is movably connected with the upper stable guide beam (3);  the track upright post (2) is connected with a lifting driving component (4),  and the left side of the lifting driving component (4) is connected with a sinking stacking operation box frame (5);  the surface of the expanding platform (6) is movably embedded with a pair of conveying belt (10),  the conveying belt (10) conveys the lower container of the automatic stacking frame (8) to the left,  making it pass through the human-shaped supporting frame (7) to move to the stacking operation box frame (5).

The invention discloses a method,  a system,  a device and a medium for motion planning of a mobile double-arm robot. The method,  the system,  the device and the medium are used for intelligent dynamic motion planning of the mobile high-redundancy double-arm robot,  and cooperative motion planning of a mobile base and a left hand and a right hand is realized by introducing a relative inverse accessibility graph of the mobile base and the left hand and the right hand; At the same time,  according to the RiDRM graph of the mobile base of the mobile double-arm robot relative to the right hand and the LiDRM graph of the mobile base relative to the left hand,  the mobile base seat posture and the upper arm operating posture which can meet the operating performance requirements of both the right hand and the left hand can be determined; The intelligent humanoid motion planning method for the mobile double-arm robot achieves intelligent humanoid motion planning of the mobile double-arm robot in a dynamic and unstructured environment,  and is simple in process,  good in motion planning effect and high in planning efficiency. 1. A mobile double-arm robot motion planning method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  constructing the RiDRM chart of the mobile base of the mobile double-arm robot relative to the right hand and the LiDRM chart of the mobile base relative to the left hand;  according to the target object to be captured,  determining the right hand of the mobile double-arm robot expected to grasp pose and left-hand desired grasping pose;  planning and decomposing the task to be executed of the mobile double-arm robot to obtain multiple sub-tasks;  and determining the right hand desired grasping pose and left hand desired grasping pose of the mobile double-arm robot,  respectively determining the right hand desired pose of each sub-task and the left-hand desired pose;  according to the right hand desired pose of each sub-task and the left-hand desired pose,  executing the sub-task,  converting the mobile base of the mobile double-arm robot relative to the right hand of the RiDRM image to the right hand desired position of the corresponding sub-task,  and converting the mobile base of the mobile double-arm robot to the left-hand expected position of the corresponding sub-task relative to the LiDRM image of the left-hand;  dynamically detecting whether there is new barrier in the environment;  if there is,  then updating the moving base of the mobile double-arm robot relative to the right hand of the RiDRM image pose set of the position of the selectable enable and mobile base relative to the left-hand LiDRM image pose set in the centralized position can be,  respectively obtaining the updated RiDRM picture of the mobile base of the mobile double-arm robot and the LiDRM picture of the mobile base opposite to the left hand;  according to the updated movement base of the mobile double-arm robot relative to the right hand of the RiDRM image and the mobile base relative to the left-hand LiDRM image,  determining the movable base of the movable double-arm robot of the selectable position set;  designing the optimal position set of the movable double-arm robot,  and adding the optimal position set of the movable double-arm robot to the selectable position set of the movable double-arm robot,  obtaining the selectable position set of the updated mobile double-arm robot;  using the evaluation function to comprehensively evaluate the pose of the selectable pose set of the updated mobile double-arm robot,  determining the optimal pose of the mobile robot;  according to the optimal pose of the mobile robot,  track planning and track tracking control;  judging whether the to-be-executed task of the mobile double-arm robot is finished,  if so,  ending the circulation;  if not,  returning to execute the next sub-task.

The invention discloses a manipulator flexible grabbing planning method and system based on grabbing gesture detection. The grabbing planning method includes the following steps :  obtaining current image information; Detecting the moving object in the image and acquiring the position of the object; The mechanical arm tracks the dynamic object in real time based on the visual servo control algorithm; When the object stops moving,  based on the trained gesture network obtaining the object predictive grabbing gesture,  at the same time,  based on the cross entropy method obtaining the object grabbing pose; Finally,  based on the predicted grabbing gesture and the object grabbing pose,  the mechanical arm and the mechanical arm execute a grabbing plan. The system consists of a graphic workstation,  a depth camera,  a workbench,  a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm and a dexterous hand. The flexible grabbing planning method and system of the manipulator can adapt to unknown objects and different gripper sizes,  can effectively track moving target objects in real time,  and realizes humanoid fine grabbing operation. 1. A mechanical hand dexterous grabbing planning method based on grasping gesture detection,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  collecting the scene RGBD image,  based on the scene RGBD image to obtain RGBD image of the target object in the motion,  wherein the RGBD image comprises RGB image and depth image;  obtaining the actual position of the target object based on the scene RGBD image;  the mechanical hand tracks the target object in real time according to the actual position of the target object;  based on depth neural network establishing a grasping gesture detection model,  based on grasping gesture data set of mechanical hand and RGB image data set of different target objects,  training the grasping gesture detection model,  after finishing training,  obtaining target grasping gesture detection model;  judging the target object state,  inputting the RGB image of the target object in the static state into the target grabbing gesture detection model,  obtaining the predicted grabbing gesture for grabbing the target object;  at the same time,  based on the depth image,  obtaining the grasping pose of the target object;  based on the predicted gripping gesture and the grasping pose,  the mechanical hand executes gripping.

The invention relates to a method for simulating actions of a bionic quadruped robot. Aiming at different simulated actions,  the invention provides two strategies for simulating actions. For common actions (head bending,  hand waving and the like),  motion capture data are subjected to zooming processing,  and then inverse kinematics solution is carried out. In order to minimize the error between the motion trajectory of the animal and the motion trajectory of the robot,  the invention converts the motion trajectory of the animal and the motion trajectory of the robot into a nonlinear optimization problem. For simulating walking actions,  firstly,  a classical quadruped robot walking control algorithm based on an SLIP model is analyzed,  and then some parameters in the data captured by the actions are extracted and applied to the walking control algorithm,  so that the walking stability of the robot can be ensured,  and the similarity of the action simulation can be as high as possible. 1. A method for simulating action of bionic quadruped robot,  wherein the action comprises common action and walking action,  the specific steps are as follows :  S1,  using the depth sensor to collect the animal video for initial action data extraction;  S2,  using open source attitude tracking tool Leep,  primarily tracking some key points,  obtaining the original motion data;  S3,  filtering and scaling the original motion data to obtain the reference motion data;  S4,  for the common action,  the reference motion data through the action re-mapping algorithm,  output motion constraint of the robot joint angle motion command with kinematics constraint,  S5,  for walking action,  selecting animal walking video,  then performing action capturing and extracting for the animal in the video;  S6,  extracting some parameters defined by data extracted by action through SLIP model,  so that the walking gait cycle and advancing speed of the robot can be matched with the animal,  S7,  for the robot walking track in a single period,  using the action re-mapping scheme,  optimizing and adjusting the gait track,  at last outputting walking gait similar to the animal.

The invention provides an intelligent luminous brick control method and system. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring a video image of human flow in a detection area by using a camera,  and pre-processing the acquired video image to obtain a pre-processed video image; Carrying out humanoid detection based on the preprocessed video image,  and utilizing the rectangular frame to form a humanoid region to obtain a humanoid rectangular frame; Dividing the detection area into several sub-areas according to the preset requirement,  each sub-area is mapped with a luminous brick group; The foot region of the humanoid rectangular frame is cut from the lower frame of the humanoid rectangular frame,  when the cut foot region and the sub-region are crossed,  the current sub-region is triggered,  and the luminous brick group with the mapping relation with the current sub-region is lightened. Based on the mapping relation between the sub-regions and the luminous brick groups,  different luminous effects can be changed,  the passing safety of vehicles and people in the zebra crossing region can be improved,  and interestingness and aesthetic feeling can be increased for the landscape region. 1. An intelligent luminous brick control method,  wherein it comprises :  Step 1 (S1) :  obtaining the video image of human flow in the detection area by using the video camera,  and pre-processing the obtained video image to obtain the pre-processed video image;  step S2 :  performing human shape detection based on the pre-processed video image,  and using the rectangular frame to form a human-shaped area,  obtaining a human-shaped rectangular frame;  step S3 :  dividing the detection area into a plurality of sub-areas according to the preset requirement,  a plurality of the sub-areas are closed areas of any polygon not overlapped with each other,  and each of the sub-areas is mapped with a light emitting brick group the light emitting brick group comprises at least one light emitting brick;  step S4 :  intercepting the foot area of the human-shaped rectangular frame from the lower frame of the human-shaped rectangular frame,  when the intercepted foot area is crossed with the sub-area,  triggering the current sub-area,  lighting the luminous brick group with mapping relationship with the current sub-area.

The invention provides an instruction set generating method and system for computer programming,  which comprises the following steps :  selecting target controller and configuring control strategy according to user demand; Dividing the command module according to the control strategy,  selecting command format,  and filling the format field into the specific area of the memory; Constructing a single complete instruction set by modularly assembling multiple instruction modules; The load buffer is transmitted to the destination controller via the network to wait for invocation. An instruction set generating method for computer programming,  wherein it comprises :  selecting the target controller according to the requirement of the user and configuring the control strategy;  dividing the instruction module according to the control strategy,  and selecting the instruction format,  filling the format field to the specific area of the memory;  constructing a single complete instruction set by the modularized assembling multi-section instruction module;  the loading buffer area is transmitted to the target controller to be called by the network.

The invention discloses an instruction set calling method,  device,  terminal and storage medium,  which detects the size of instruction set to be analyzed and RAM available space; The instruction set calling strategy is adjusted according to the size relationship between the instruction set to be analyzed and the RAM available space. According to the invention,  the instruction set calling strategy is timely adjusted according to the size of the RAN space,  so that the stable operation of the explanation control system is ensured,  and the program smoothness is ensured as much as possible. 1. An instruction set calling method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  detecting the size of the instruction set to be analyzed and the size of the available space of the RAM;  adjusting the instruction set calling strategy according to the size relation of the instruction set to be analyzed and the RAM available space,  comprising :  if the RAM available space size is greater than the size of the instruction set to be analyzed,  then distributing a global buffer area for each instruction frame in the RAM,  reading all the instruction set to be analyzed from the FLASH,  and storing each instruction frame in the corresponding global buffer area;  if the size of the available space of the RAM is less than the size of the instruction set to be analyzed,  application in the RAM,  according to the size of the public buffer area sequentially reading part of the instruction set to be analyzed from the FLASH to store in the public buffer area.

The designed framework will focus on the Regulating Healthcare Efficiency and Medical Services using machine Learning /Artificial Intelligence. The artificial intelligence (AI) technologies becoming ever present in modern business and everyday life is also steadily being applied to healthcare. The use of artificial intelligence in healthcare has the potential to assist healthcare providers in many aspects of patient care and administrative processes,  helping them improve upon existing solutions and overcome challenges faster. Most AI and healthcare technologies have strong relevance to the healthcare field,  but the tactics they support can vary significantly between hospitals and other healthcare organizations. Use of artificial intelligence in healthcare can perform just as well or better than humans at certain procedures,  such as diagnosing disease,  it will be a significant number of years before AI in healthcare replaces humans for a broad range of medical tasks. In recent years,  the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine and healthcare has been praised for the great promise it offers,  but has also been at the centre of heated controversy. This Framework offers an overview of how AI can benefit future healthcare,  in particular increasing the efficiency of clinicians,  improving medical diagnosis and treatment,  and optimizing the allocation of human and technical resources. The report identifies and clarifies the main clinical,  social and ethical risks posed by AI in healthcare,  more specifically :  potential errors and patient harm;  risk of bias and increased health inequalities;  lack of transparency and trust;  and vulnerability to hacking and data privacy breaches. The framework proposes mitigation measures and policy options to minimize these risks and maximize the benefits of medical AI,  including multistakeholder engagement through the AI production lifetime,  increased transparency and traceability,  in-depth clinical validation of AI tools,  and AI training and education for both clinicians and citizens. Machine learning is one of the most common forms of artificial intelligence in healthcare. It is a broad technique at the core of many approaches to AI and healthcare technology and there are many versions of it. Using artificial intelligence in healthcare,  the most widespread utilization of traditional machine learning is precision medicine. Being able to predict what treatment procedures are likely to be successful with patients based on their make-up and the treatment framework is a huge leap forward for many healthcare organizations. The majority of AI technology in healthcare that uses machine learning and precision medicine applications require data for training,  for which the end result is known. This is known as supervised learning. Our modern healthcare system is currently facing huge challenges exacerbated by the pandemic,  a rise in lifestyle-related diseases,  and an exploding world population. The good news is that using AI to create intelligent processes and workflows could make healthcare cheaper,  more effective,  more personalized,  and more equitable.

The invention discloses a posture generating method for driving an agent to reach multiple target points,  which comprises the following steps :  constructing a digital physical simulation model of a humanoid agent and establishing an initial world coordinate system; Acquiring posture change sequence data of human motion and converting it into skeleton structure data,  and converting joint rotation parameter of skeleton structure data into joint index parameter as reference characteristic; Acquiring state information of the agent,  calculating motion characteristics and reward functions of the agent based on the reinforcement learning network,  and updating weights of network nodes in the reinforcement learning network based on the reward functions; Inputting motion characteristics and reference characteristics into discriminator network to output network loss and updating discriminator network; The method comprises the following steps of :  constructing state information of an agent,  sequentially inputting the state information into a trained digital physical simulation model,  outputting motion characteristics of the agent,  and finishing rendering in a physical simulation environment. According to the method,  dynamic adjustment of different motion modes is realized,  and the accuracy of the agent reaching a specific target point is greatly improved. 1. An attitude generating method for driving intelligent body to reach multi-target point,  wherein it comprises :  constructing a digital physical simulation model of the human-type intelligent body with the physical simulation environment as the frame,  and establishing an initial world coordinate system;  obtaining the posture change sequence data of human body movement and converting it into bone structure data,  converting the joint rotation parameter of the bone structure data into joint index parameter under the initial world coordinate system as the reference feature;  obtaining the intelligent body state information corresponding to the reference feature,  and calculating the motion feature of the intelligent body and the corresponding reward function based on the reinforcement learning physical simulation model,  and updating the weight of each network node in the network reinforcement learning on the reward function;  inputting the motion feature and the reference feature into the discriminator network output network loss of the digital physical simulation model,  and updating the discriminator network based on the network loss;  setting the position information of the multi-target point and respectively calculating the steering activation factor corresponding to each target point,  constructing the intelligent body state information corresponding to each target point and sequentially the trained digital physical simulation model,  outputting the motion characteristic of the intelligent body and finishing rendering in the physical simulation environment.

The invention relates to a robot sole force flexible control method and a multi-legged robot platform,  wherein the robot platform comprises a controller and a plurality of legs; The leg includes a leg actuator,  and a leg drive mechanism for driving an end portion of the leg actuator to lift,  swing,  and fall; The end of the leg actuator is connected with a foot,  and the foot is provided with a contact sensor; The controller realizes the flexible control of the sole force through the following steps :  confirming the swinging foot and selecting the foot falling point; A leg drive mechanism for controlling the swing foot to drive the leg actuator to lift the corresponding foot; According to the planned swing curve,  the corresponding foot is swung to the position above the foot falling point; Controlling the extension of the corresponding leg part to lower the foot part,  and judging whether the foot part touches the ground or not through the contact sensor arranged on the corresponding foot part; When the foot touches the ground,  the corresponding leg stops extending and turns to a supporting state. The invention relates to an anti-collision method of a vehicle blind area,  an electronic device and a computer storage medium. The method comprises :  acquiring an image shot by a camera mounted on a vehicle through a 5G communication method; Analyzing the image for the presence of an obstacle; Identifying the contour shape of the obstacle if the obstacle exists in the image; Judging whether the contour shape of the obstacle has a humanoid shape; Analyzing the blind area range of the vehicle from the image if the contour shape of the obstacle has a humanoid shape; Judging whether the obstacle is in the blind area of the vehicle; If the obstacle is in the blind area range of the vehicle,  an alarm command is generated,  and the alarm command is sent to an alarm device mounted on the vehicle through a 5G communication method so as to enable the alarm device to give an alarm. According to the invention,  when the obstacle is determined to be in the blind area range of the vehicle,  an alarm command is sent to the alarm device through a 5G communication method,  so that the alarm device gives an alarm,  and the vehicle is prevented from colliding with the obstacle in the blind area,  so that the anti-collision efficiency of the blind area of the vehicle is improved. 1. An anti-collision method of vehicle blind area,  applied to the background service centre,  wherein the anti-collision method of the vehicle blind area comprises :  obtaining the image shot by the camera installed on the vehicle through the 5 G communication method;  analyzing whether there is an obstacle in the image;  if there is an obstacle in the image,  identifying the outline shape of the obstacle;  judging whether the outline shape of the obstacle has a human shape;  if the outline shape of the obstacle has a human-shaped shape,  analyzing the blind area range of the vehicle from the image;  judging whether the obstacle is in the blind area range of the vehicle;  and if the obstacle is in the blind area range of the vehicle,  generating an alarm instruction,  and sending the alarm instruction to the alarm device installed on the vehicle through the 5 G communication method so that the alarm device alarms.

The invention discloses an automatic driving anthropomorphic decision-making,  planning and control method considering workshop interaction behaviors. According to the method,  interaction behaviors under complex traffic scenes can be processed,  a reasonable humanoid lane change decision can be made,  a reasonable collision-free track can be planned for vehicles in real time,  and the method has good application potential. 1. An automatic driving type human decision considering workshop interaction,  planning and control method,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  obtaining itself by the vehicle-mounted data collecting device of the automatic driving vehicle;  surrounding vehicle and environment information;  S2,  based on the surrounding vehicle driving data collected under the natural driving scene,  realizing the identification of the cycle driving style,  and embedding the features of different driving styles into the design of the decision cost function and the driving risk field;  S3,  considering traffic safety,  traffic efficiency and driving comfort of the decision cost function of the main vehicle and the rear vehicle design,  S4,  based on the complete information non-cooperative game theory,  establishing a channel change decision model considering the main vehicle,  rear vehicle driving style and interaction behaviour,  introducing Stackelberg game to solve the dynamic interaction behaviour and decision making between the main vehicle and the rear vehicle;  S5,  establishing driving risk field model,  finishing the risk perception of road environment;  S6,  combining the risk field model and the model predictive control algorithm to plan a non-collision lane-changing path in real time as the main vehicle,  and synchronously realizing the motion control of the main vehicle.

[05] Artificial intelligence (AI) is,  without a doubt,  one of the hottest new topics in library computers. It involves teaching computers to carry out tasks that,  if completed by a human,  would be regarded as requiring a high level of intelligence. Clearly,  advancements in artificial intelligence will have a substantial impact on the future of librarianship. This is due to the fact that it will enable the development of computer systems and computers that are capable of thinking,  acting,  and even competing with human intelligence. AI is becoming more prevalent in a range of library-related tasks. Expert systems can aid people in locating information,  robots can read books and shelves,  and virtual reality enables immersive learning. Some may be concerned that artificial intelligence would make librarians less accessible to their customers,  but the reality is that new technology is more likely to assist libraries in achieving their goals than to leave librarians obsolete. As a result,  their support will be of higher quality. In today's quickly evolving digital culture,  libraries are becoming more valuable and important as a result of the use of artificial intelligence,  which will enhance library operations and services. There are humanoid robots with artificial intelligence in almost every facet of contemporary society,  including libraries. These robots perform tasks that humans cannot faster and more efficiently than humans. Therefore,  we wished to determine if and how public libraries are employing humanoid robots with artificial intelligence to assist with reference issues. This research's primary objective is to establish what artificial intelligence is and how it interacts with robots. This study examines how the employment of AI tools has impacted the operations of academic libraries. It uses a survey to explain and analyse the reality of implementing AI technology in libraries,  the amount of money libraries are willing to invest in AI,  and the obstacles libraries face when attempting to implement AI. The study concluded that central university libraries lacked the physical infrastructure required for technological advancement. This research explains why the majority of library employees (69%) lack knowledge about artificial intelligence.

A dynamic planning controller receives a maneuver for a robot and a current state of the robot and transforms the maneuver and the current state of the robot into a nonlinear optimization problem. The nonlinear optimization problem is configured to optimize an unknown force and an unknown position vector. At a first time instance,  the controller linearizes the nonlinear optimization problem into a first linear optimization problem and determines a first solution to the first linear optimization problem using quadratic programming. At a second time instance,  the controller linearizes the nonlinear optimization problem into a second linear optimization problem based on the first solution at the first time instance and determines a second solution to the second linear optimization problem based on the first solution using the quadratic programming. The controller also generates a joint command to control motion of the robot during the maneuver based on the second solution.

[05] Artificial intelligence (AI) is,  without a doubt,  one of the hottest new topics in library computers. It involves teaching computers to carry out tasks that,  if completed by a human,  would be regarded as requiring a high level of intelligence. Clearly,  advancements in artificial intelligence will have a substantial impact on the future of librarianship. This is due to the fact that it will enable the development of computer systems and computers that are capable of thinking,  acting,  and even competing with human intelligence. AI is becoming more prevalent in a range of library-related tasks. Expert systems can aid people in locating information,  robots can read books and shelves,  and virtual reality enables immersive learning. Some may be concerned that artificial intelligence would make librarians less accessible to their customers,  but the reality is that new technology is more likely to assist libraries in achieving their goals than to leave librarians obsolete. As a result,  their support will be of higher quality. In today's quickly evolving digital culture,  libraries are becoming more valuable and important as a result of the use of artificial intelligence,  which will enhance library operations and services. There are humanoid robots with artificial intelligence in almost every facet of contemporary society,  including libraries. These robots perform tasks that humans cannot faster and more efficiently than humans. Therefore,  we wished to determine if and how public libraries are employing humanoid robots with artificial intelligence to assist with reference issues. This research's primary objective is to establish what artificial intelligence is and how it interacts with robots. This study examines how the employment of AI tools has impacted the operations of academic libraries. It uses a survey to explain and analyse the reality of implementing AI technology in libraries,  the amount of money libraries are willing to invest in AI,  and the obstacles libraries face when attempting to implement AI. The study concluded that central university libraries lacked the physical infrastructure required for technological advancement. This research explains why the majority of library employees (69%) lack knowledge about artificial intelligence. Accompanied Drawing [FIG. 1] [FIG. 2]

A system that uses a client's behavioral biometrics—mouse dynamics,  keystrokes,  and mouse click patterns—to create a Machine Learning (ML) based customized security model for each client/user to secure website log-ins. The ML model can differentiate the user of interest from an impersonator—human or non-human (robot). The model collects relevant behavioral biometric data from the client when a new account is created by the client/user on a website or when the client initially logs-in to the website. The collected biometric data are used to train an ensemble of ML-based classifiers—a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) classifier,  a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier,  and an Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost) classifier—in the model. The trained versions of these classifiers are polled to give an optimal prediction in real-time (while the user is logging in). As a result,  real-time fraud detection can be accomplished without impacting the log-in performance of the website.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot multi-type motor control system based on CAN. The humanoid robot mainly comprises a closed-loop stepping motor,  four CAN servo motors and two RS485 steering engines,  and further comprises an industrial personal computer track planning module and a motion control module. The trajectory planning module adopts an ROS robot system to process trajectory information. The trajectory planning module and the motion control module use TCP communication,  A controller area network (CAN) bus protocol is used for communication in the motion control module,  the motion control module comprises an execution node module,  a feedback module and a conversion module,  the execution node module is responsible for issuing track information,  and the feedback module is responsible for collecting bus uploading data and feeding back and uploading the bus uploading data and has the function of a stepping motor controller. The conversion module is responsible for converting instructions on the bus into RS485 instructions. 1. A multi-type motor control system of humanoid robot based on CAN,  comprising three large levels :  industrial control computer hierarchy,  motion controller hierarchy,  executing mechanism level,  wherein the industrial computer hierarchy is mainly responsible for generating motor motion track,  the hierarchical function comprises not limited to robot positive kinematics analysis,  inverse kinematics solution,  motion planning and so on,  the motion controller hierarchy is mainly responsible for receiving the track information sent by the industrial computer hierarchy,  sending to the executing mechanism level,  and collecting the execution structure level information feedback to the industrial control computer hierarchy,  the executing mechanism level is mainly responsible for receiving the motion controller level track information or instruction,  executing and feeding back the corresponding information .

A system for detection of an anomaly in a discrete manufacturing process (DMP) with human-robot teams executing a task. Receive signals including robot,  worker and DMP signals. Predict a sequence of events (SOEs) from DMP signals. Determine whether the predicted SOEs in the DMP signals is inconsistent with a behavior of operation of the DMP described in a DMP model,  and if the predicted SOEs from DMP signals is inconsistent with the behavior,  then an alarm is to be signaled. Input worker data into a Human Performance (HP) model,  to obtain a state of the worker based on previously learned boundaries of human state. The state of the HW is then input into the HRI model and the DMP model to determine a classification of anomaly or no anomaly. Update a Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) model to obtain a control action of a robot or a type of an anomaly alarm.

The invention provides a motion control method,  a motion control device,  robot control equipment and a readable storage medium,  and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of :  calculating a reverse Jacobian matrix of a generalized coordinate vector of the whole body of the humanoid robot at the current moment relative to an actual task space vector; and according to the preset position limiting condition corresponding to the generalized coordinate vector of whole body,  combining the actual task space vector and the task space vector to be executed at the current moment into the null space of the reverse Jacobian matrix,  calculating a target generalized coordinate vector corresponding to the task space vector to be executed,  controlling the motion state of the humanoid robot according to the target generalized coordinate vector,  The motion of the humanoid robot is integrally optimized from the angle of zero space,  so that the aim of controlling the humanoid robot to avoid the motion limit of joints is fulfilled,  the arm operation space is expanded on the basis of maintaining the balance of the legs of the robot,  and the operation performance of the humanoid robot is improved. 1. A motion control method,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining the full-body generalized coordinate vector of the humanoid robot at the current time,  the actual task space vector and the task space vector to be executed,  wherein the generalized generalized coordinate vector is composed of the waist posture matrix of the humanoid robot and the mechanical arm posture matrix;  according to the waist posture matrix and the mechanical arm posture matrix,  calculating the reverse Jacobi matrix of the generalized generalized coordinate vector relative to the actual task space vector;  according to the preset position limiting condition corresponding to the generalized generalized coordinate vector,  combining the actual task space vector and the task space vector to be performed to the zero space of the reverse Jacobi matrix,  calculating the target generalized coordinate vector corresponding to the task space vector to be executed,  wherein the preset position limiting condition is used for describing the limit motion range of each joint of the humanoid robot in the moving process;  controlling the motion state of the humanoid robot according to the target generalized coordinate vector.

We are proposing a novel system to prevent robbery in highly secure areas with lesser power consumption. This system has face-recognition technology which grants access to only authorized people to enter that area. If others enter the place without access using some other means,  then the system alerts the personnel and image captured by the security camera and send to the authorized person through server. The face recognition system has been implemented to social robot which can recognize and tracking human face then mentioned the person name. The face recognition system of social robot results shows a good accurarcy for Human-Robot interaction. Monitoring human behaviours is a basic method for modeling machines which want to act like human beings;  however,  they usually cannot support all details and circumstances. Humans has the possibility to analyse different facts and actions at the same time and most of the time reactions happens automatically. Meantime,  they are learning how react and respond to the events during a long time. In contrast,  in order to have any type of interaction with robots,  they should be learned every things with details from the beginning steps. Needless to say that action and reaction from the machine.will just be possible by writing codes and using learning methods (Machine Learning)

A method includes receiving,  from a camera disposed on a robotic device,  a two-dimensional (2D) image of a body of an actor and determining,  for each respective keypoint of a first subset of a plurality of keypoints,  2D coordinates of the respective keypoint within the 2D image. The plurality of keypoints represent body locations. Each respective keypoint of the first subset is visible in the 2D image. The method also includes determining a second subset of the plurality of keypoints. Each respective keypoint of the second subset is not visible in the 2D image. The method further includes determining,  by way of a machine learning model,  an extent of engagement of the actor with the robotic device based on (i) the 2D coordinates of keypoints of the first subset and (ii) for each respective keypoint of the second subset,  an indicator that the respective keypoint is not visible.

The invention discloses a camera security monitoring early warning method based on a tripod head,  and belongs to the field of security monitoring. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring images in the field of view of a camera,  and finding out a judged humanoid target through target detection; Calculating the distance d between the current camera and the humanoid target each time a humanoid target is detected; Calculating evaluation of image acquisition stability to obtain stability index Q of the acquired image; Regulating and controlling the sensitivity of the camera holder according to the stability index Q of the collected image; Estimating a total estimated movement distance M of the humanoid target from the detected humanoid target to the current time; An early warning mechanism is constructed by total estimation of the moving speed M. According to the invention,  the estimated moving distance of the detected human body is calculated by a distance estimation method,  the final warning index is designed by endowing the estimated distance with a vector and overlapping the estimated distance,  and the warning index is set with a threshold value to judge whether to give an alarm,  so that the recognition rate and the reliability of detection in the security field are improved. 1. A camera security monitoring pre-warning method based on tripod head,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1 :  collecting the image in the camera field,  then finding the judged human-shaped target through target detection;  S2 :  each time when detecting a human-shaped target,  calculating the distance d between the current camera and the human-shaped target;  S3 :  calculating the evaluation of image acquisition stability,  obtaining the stability index Q of the collected image,  S4,  adjusting the sensitivity of the camera tripod head according to the stability index Q of the collected image;  S5 :  estimating the total estimated moving distance M of the human-shaped target from detecting the human-shaped target to the current time;  S6 :  constructing the pre-warning mechanism by the total estimated moving speed M.

The Sensor based human hand replication system is a system that can help and secure the human presence to be put under harmful situations such as radioactive and bio hazardous. The technology can also be helpful in very precise instrumentation workings like a doctor operating a patient by a robot without its own hands. The technology has its many useful applications in the field of robotics,  surgical operations,  humanoid robots,  etc.

In the actual operation stage,  the humanoid robot collects images in real time,  identifies the labyrinth ground boundary line,  estimates the position information of the humanoid robot,  and obtains the surrounding boundary information of the current position; Executing path finding navigation algorithm to obtain the target position of the next node and advancing to the target position of the node; Whether the humanoid robot falls and collides or not is detected,  and if yes,  a repositioning algorithm is executed to correct the position and orientation of the humanoid robot. The method only depends on a vision system,  the technology portability and popularization are high,  the fault-tolerant capability of the walking navigation is improved by the repositioning method,  and the success rate and the execution efficiency of the labyrinth navigation task are improved. 1. The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-foot robot load balancing method,  a multi-foot robot load balancing device and a multi-foot robot. The multi-foot robot load balancing method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring the current position and speed of a cargo on a trunk through a force sensor arranged on the trunk; Solving the expected posture required by the trunk when the cargo is balanced by feedback control law according to the current position and speed of the cargo; Determining the expected position of the virtual joint based on the expected posture of the torso,  and calculating the joint torque required by the real joint based on the robot full dynamics control algorithm based on the expected position; The calculated joint torque is sent to the corresponding real joint,  so that the torso reaches the expected posture. The method can fundamentally solve the problem that the multi-foot robot actively balances goods,  does not need to specially fix the goods in the process of transporting the goods,  can carry out balance control only by placing the goods near an expected position,  and can ensure the balance of the goods and the like even in the process of fast walking. 1. A load balancing method of multi-foot robot,  wherein the body of the multi-foot robot is provided with a force sensor,  the state of the body is described by the motion state of a plurality of virtual joints constructed between the trunk and the world coordinate origin,  the method comprises :  calculating the current position and speed of the goods on the trunk according to the measured value of the force sensor;  according to the current position and speed of the cargo through feedback control law to solve the multi-foot robot to make the cargo reach the desired attitude needed by the trunk when balancing;  wherein the relationship between the posture of the trunk and the acceleration of the cargo is solved by using the Lagrange satisfy of the cargo on the trunk,  so as to construct the feedback control law;  determining the desired position of the plurality of virtual joints according to the desired posture of the body,  calculating the desired speed and desired acceleration of the corresponding virtual joint through the desired position of the corresponding virtual joint;  a desired position based on each of the virtual joints,  the desired speed and desired acceleration to generalized joint acceleration and sole stress optimization model to solve to obtain optimal solution,  and according to the optimal solution and the multi-foot robot of the true joint satisfy the dynamic equation to solve the joint torque needed by each real joint,  wherein the generalized joint comprises the virtual joint of the robot and the real joint;  sending the calculated joint torque to the corresponding real joint,  so that the trunk reaches the desired attitude.
