 based on the " anthropomorphic " configuration design idea,  the lower limb exoskeleton configuration for free degree configuration;  in order to coordinate the movement of the supporting leg and the upper half body,  the hip joint (2) and the ankle joint (4) of the lower limb exoskeleton must respectively provided with an abduality-inward degree of freedom,  In order to realize the transfer of the center of gravity,  the degree of flexion-elongation of the hip joint (2) and the ankle joint (4) is indispensable;  In order to help to reach body target position,  lower limb exoskeleton sometimes must rotate,  so it is necessary to set a inner rotation-outer rotation degree of freedom on the hip joint (2) and ankle joint 4);  the knee joint 3) is provided with a flexion-extension degree of freedom,  the floor height of the swinging leg can be adjusted,  the gait movement such as upper and lower steps can be realized;  in order to balance the movement of the lower limb,  the bionic effect,  the pelvis (1) is provided with 6 degrees of freedom;  In order to achieve the bionic purpose,  lower limb exoskeleton needs to be configured with 20 degrees of freedom,  wherein the pelvic bone (1) has six degrees of freedom,  for the single leg,  the number of respectively of the hip joint (2),  the knee joint 3) and the ankle joint (4) is three,  one and three;  b,  based on the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration design of the series-parallel mechanism,  according to the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton freedom configuration,  designing a humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration based on the series-parallel mechanism,  specifically 3SPS 1SPS 6SPS 3SPS the single leg is composed of a mixing mechanism of 1SPS 3SPS 3SPS the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration based on the parallel connection mechanism uses the 6 SPS upper parallel mechanism (14) to simulate pelvis movement;  6,  the upper fixed ring (5) of the SPS upper parallel mechanism (14) is fixed with the waist of the human body;  by changing the length of the upper supporting rod (6) of the 6 SPS upper parallel mechanism (14),  driving the upper middle moving ring (7) to move,  so as to drive the hip joint movement;  for the configured single leg,  on the upper middle moving ring (7) of the 6 SPS upper parallel mechanism (14) is connected in series with 3 SPS upper middle parallel mechanism (15) to simulate the movement of the thigh around the hip joint by changing the length of the middle upper supporting rod (8) of the 3 SPS upper parallel mechanism (15),  driving the middle moving ring (9) to move,  so as to realize the hip joint flexion-extension,  abduing-inner retracting,  outer rotating-inner rotating motion of the active power,  then the middle moving ring (9) of the end of the parallel mechanism (15) in the 3 SPS is connected with a 1 SPS middle-lower series mechanism (16) in series for simulating the movement of the crus around the knee joint through the driving rod (10) to move,  realizing the active power of the lower middle movable ring (11) for knee-joint flexion-extension movement,  the tail end of the middle-lower series mechanism (16) is connected with a 3 SPS lower parallel mechanism (17) in series,  by changing the length of the supporting rod (12),  simulating the movement of the foot around the ankle joint realizing the lower movable ring (13) of the 3 SPS lower parallel mechanism (17) to joint and valgus to the ankle,  the active power of the outer rotation-inner rotation movement;  c,  based on the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton hip joint motion matching of the series-parallel mechanism,  in order to verify the motion matching effect of the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration and the wearer based on the parallel connection mechanism,  taking the hip joint as an example,  combining the human gait data measured by the experiment,  performing kinematics simulation on the 6 SPS upper parallel mechanism (14);  the analysis model of the SPS upper parallel mechanism (14) is composed of an upper fixed ring (5),  a middle upper movable ring (7) and 6 upper supporting rods (6),  namely an electric cylinder;  each electric cylinder respectively connected with the upper fixed ring (5) and the upper middle movable ring (7) through a spherical pair;  the central point o1 of the fixed ring (5) above respectively the central point o2 of the upper middle moving ring (7) is the coordinate origin to establish the upper fixed ring (5) and the upper middle moving ring (7) coordinate system o1x1y1z1,  o2x2y2z2;  6 SPS upper parallel mechanism (14) single electric cylinder and the upper fixed ring (5) and the middle upper movable ring (7) respectively the point Ai (i = 1,  ...,  6) and point Bi (i= 1,  ...,  6),  selecting 6 SPS on the parallel mechanism (14) on the moving ring on the point B1 and gait capture experiment in the wearing hip joint of the marking point as the reference object,  the kinematic matching effect for verification;  the human body hip joint flexion-extension-pitch angle under the ground walking gait measured by the experiment,  outspread-inward-rolling angle,  inner rotation-outer rotation angle-yaw angle as the kinematic simulation target track of the 6 SPS upper parallel mechanism (14);  the simulation result compared with the experiment result shows that the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration based on the mixing mechanism can realize human-machine gait matching effect,  so as to realize the active power of the wearer in each direction.

The invention discloses an organ playing action control method,  system and device based on a humanoid arm claw robot. The system comprises a music score storing and analyzing module,  an organ playing action sequence generating module,  an action instruction generating and sending module and an action instruction receiving and executing module. The music score storage and analysis module is used for completing the reading of the music score information. Then the piano playing action sequence generating module is utilized to obtain the piano playing action sequence of the anthropomorphic arm claw. Then,  an action instruction generating and sending module is utilized to convert the action of the arm claw into a corresponding action instruction and send the action instruction to the arm claw executing end. Finally,  the action instruction receiving and executing module is utilized to complete the receiving and executing of the action instruction by the mechanical arm and the claw,  and finally the playing of the humanoid arm claw robot on the piano is realized. Based on the method provided by the invention,  the humanoid arm claw piano playing robot can give full play to the performances of the arms and the claws,  and better piano playing effect is realized efficiently and stably. 1. A violin action control method based on humanoid arm claw robot,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  S1,  storing and analyzing the music score to obtain music book information;  storing the music book is specifically as follows :  storing the music score in the excel table,  storing the table music score information param,  the left hand music score information 1 and the right hand music score information r including the tempo of the music score in the table first column;  The note information is represented by numbers,  wherein :  the individual digit represents the height of the note;  the ten-bit and the positive and negative signs represent the sound area;  small number 0.5 represents up-half adjustment;  the number 0 represents a pause symbol;  each row uses the " | " symbol as the ending marker bit of the music score;  S2,  analyzing the obtained music book information according to step S1,  combining the performance of the arm and the paw;  planning the optimal combination of the action of the arm and the paw;  the step S2 adopts dynamic programming,  the arm different movement distance performance,  action performance of different fingers as the influence factor,  realizing the arm and paw optimal combination action of the planning,  the arm and the paw action optimal combination;  specifically comprising the following sub-steps :  S2.1,  according to the five fingers of the paw comprises action speed,  specific performance of action range respectively score,  according to the actual performance of the mechanical arm under different moving distance comprises moving time and track stability of the set score;  S2.2,  the note in the analyzed music book information is mapped to the corresponding 88 piano surface key number,  numbering the mechanical fingers;  numbering the mechanical arm position;  the position number of the mechanical arm is the piano key number corresponding to the steel piano key position where the thumb of the current mechanical arm is located;  S2.3,  reading the current note information,  according to the note playing order,  searching all the paw combination action of the current note by traversing the piano key;  and according to the score of the finger set in step S2.1,  calculating the finger action value for the finger distributed by each action combination;  S2.4,  according to the note playing order,  calculating the arm moving distance between the adjacent two notes obtained by the step S2.3,  and calculating the moving value of each combination according to the score of the arm moving distance set in step S2.1;  S2.5,  repeating step S2.3 to S2.4 until calculating the complete first music score,  calculating the score of all arm claw combination action,  and the moving value corresponding to the highest score path as the action optimal combination of the arm and the paw,  S3,  according to the action optimal combination of the arm and the paw obtained in step S2,  combining the music score information,  generating playing action sequence;  S4,  analyzing the obtained music book information according to step S1,  converting the playing action sequence obtained in the step S3 into the corresponding action instruction;  S5,  synchronously sending the action instruction obtained in the step S4 to the arm and the paw executor;  S6,  arm and paw actuator action receiving action instruction,  and synchronous matching execution of the multi-thread control arm and paw action.

The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving,  in particular,  it relates to an anthropomorphic lane-changing method and device for automatically driving vehicle,  vehicle and storage medium. Wherein the method comprises :  obtaining pre-constructed characteristic parameter set of humanized driving behavior,  designing the expected motion state and acceptable minimum spacing of the vehicle according to the characteristic parameters in the parameter set,  and when the vehicle meets the lane changing condition,  according to the characteristic parameters in the characteristic parameter set of humanized driving behavior,  expected motion state and acceptable minimum spacing to make transverse trajectory planning and longitudinal trajectory planning for said vehicle respectively,  The method comprises the following steps of :  obtaining a transverse lane changing track and a longitudinal lane changing track; coupling the transverse lane changing track and the longitudinal lane changing track to generate a target lane changing track of the vehicle; and controlling the vehicle to change lanes by using the target lane changing track. Therefore,  the problems of unclear key characteristics,  limited application scenes,  poor interpretability and the like existing in the personification decision of the automatic driving vehicle in the related technology are solved. 1. A humanoid lane changing method of automatic driving vehicle,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the pre-constructed personified driving behaviour characteristic parameter set;  designing the desired movement state and acceptable minimum distance of the vehicle according to the characteristic parameter in the anthropomorphic driving behavior characteristic parameter set,  and judging whether the vehicle satisfy changing condition according to the expected movement state and the acceptable minimum distance;  and according to the characteristic parameter in the anthropomorphic driving behavior characteristic parameter set,  when the vehicle satisfy the lane changing condition,  the desired movement state and the acceptable minimum distance to the vehicle respectively transverse track planning and longitudinal track planning,  obtaining the transverse track and longitudinal track track,  the coupling track track and the longitudinal track track,  generating the target track track of the vehicle,  and using the target lane changing track to control the vehicle to change lane;  according to the characteristic parameter in the anthropomorphic driving behavior characteristic parameter set,  the desired movement state and the acceptable minimum distance to the vehicle transverse track planning,  obtaining the transverse track,  comprising :  obtaining the current position coordinate and the target transverse coordinate of the vehicle;  in the process of changing the vehicle from the vehicle lane to the target lane,  when the vehicle is in the lane,  lane changing predicted time is the pre-collision time between the vehicle and the front vehicle,  and updating the pre-collision time to obtain the pre-collision time sequence through the rolling time domain mode,  when the vehicle enters the target lane,  and in the returning stage,  the lane-changing prediction duration is the reverse order value of the pre-collision time sequence;  based on the current position coordinate,  the target transverse coordinate,  the pre-collision time sequence,  the reverse sequence value of the pre-collision time sequence to generate the transverse lane track.

The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving,  in particular to an anthropomorphic lane changing method,  an anthropomorphic lane changing device,  an anthropomorphic lane changing vehicle and a storage medium of the anthropomorphic lane changing vehicle. The anthropomorphic lane changing method of the anthropomorphic lane changing vehicle comprises the following steps of :  acquiring vehicle speeds of a front vehicle and a rear vehicle which are adjacent to each other on a target lane of the anthropomorphic lane changing vehicle and a longitudinal distance between the front vehicle and the rear vehicle; Based on the speed difference between the vehicle and the front and back vehicles and the distance between the vehicle and the front vehicle and the back vehicle,  the acceleration intensity of the vehicle and the deceleration intensity of the back vehicle are blurred and matched,  sampling to obtain speed increasing and decreasing pairs,  The method comprises the following steps of :  calculating a safe lane change distance set when the vehicle is subjected to forced lane change according to acceleration and deceleration speed; screening to obtain an optimal acceleration and deceleration speed pair and a corresponding acceptable distance; coupling the vehicle after transverse planning and longitudinal planning to generate a target lane change track of the vehicle; and controlling the vehicle to execute forced lane change action by utilizing the target lane change track. Therefore,  the problems of difficulty in dynamically adapting to different lane change distances,  difficulty in keeping consistency of driving styles in decision-making and planning steps and the like during forced lane change of an automatic driving vehicle in the prior art are solved. 1. A humanoid lane changing method of automatic driving vehicle,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  obtaining the adjacent front and back vehicle speed on the vehicle and the target lane,  and the distance between the vehicle and the front and back vehicle;  calculating to obtain the first speed difference and the first distance between the vehicle and the front vehicle and the second vehicle speed difference and the second distance between the vehicle and the rear vehicle,  according to the first vehicle speed difference and the first distance fuzzy matching the acceleration intensity of the vehicle,  according to the second vehicle speed difference and the second distance fuzzy matching the deceleration intensity of the vehicle,  sampling based on the acceleration intensity and the deceleration intensity in the respective threshold range,  obtaining the acceleration and deceleration set,  according to the acceleration and deceleration of the set respectively calculating the safety lane change distance between the vehicle and the front and back vehicle,  obtaining the corresponding forced channel change condition set,  when the first distance and the second distance satisfy the plurality of conditions in the forced channel change condition set,  further screening from the corresponding acceleration and deceleration pair to obtain the optimal acceleration and deceleration speed pair and the corresponding safe lane change distance;  before sampling based on the acceleration intensity and the deceleration intensity in the respective threshold range,  further comprising :  obtaining the actual distance between the vehicle and the destination;  determining lane change intention strength according to the actual distance between the vehicle and the destination,  and based on the lane change intention strength matching acceleration threshold and deceleration threshold;  and performing transverse planning and longitudinal planning to the vehicle according to the optimal acceleration and deceleration speed pair and the safe lane changing distance,  respectively a transverse planning trajectory and a longitudinal planning trajectory,  and carrying out the coupling planning trajectory and the longitudinal planning trajectory,  generating the target lane changing of the vehicle,  and using the target lane-changing track to control the vehicle to perform the forced lane-changing action.

The present invention belongs to the field of automatic tea fermentation technology. specifically relates to a humanoid robot for a fermented tea production line and a full-automatic tea fermentation process. The humanoid robot for the fermented tea production line comprises a movable base,  a material box translation mechanism,  a lifting mechanism,  a mechanical arm,  a sensing device,  a spraying device and a control system,  The present invention adopts mobile operation robot to make "humanoid" operation,  Matched with automatic production line system,  The intelligent mobile robot is suitable for the requirements of a fermented tea processing technology,  can be operated in a humanoid manner and has an integrated fermented tea process function,  the automatic and unmanned operation can be carried out on the fermented tea processing process,  the manual operation is completely replaced,  and the harm to the health of a human body caused by long-term operation on a tea fermentation production line is avoided. 1. A fermented tea production line robot,  wherein it comprises :  a movable base,  for moving in the fermented tea production line;  a material box translation mechanism,  which is set on the mobile base for parallel taking and placing the fermentation material box from the fermented tea production line;  a lifting mechanism,  which is set on the moving base,  for horizontally lifting the bin translation mechanism;  a mechanical arm,  which is set on the moving mechanism;  a sensing device,  which is set on the mobile base,  for detecting the fermented material box in the tea fermenting environment and material box filling degree;  spraying device,  which is set on the mechanical arm,  for generating spray;  a control system,  the interior is provided with at least one fermentation process information comprising at least two process flows and a fermentation time axis state information,  based on the detection result of the sensing device,  judging the process flow of the fermentation material box or the tea in the fermentation material box,  controlling the mobile base,  a material box translation mechanism,  a lifting mechanism,  a mechanical arm and a spraying device based on the process flow to make the fermentation material box or the tea in the fermentation material box gradually executing the fermentation process,  monitoring whether the fermentation time axis satisfy of tea fermentation,  wherein :  the travel of the translation mechanism and the lifting mechanism comprises the following steps :  keeping the fermentation material box in the operation position;  the mechanical arm supports the spraying device to spray the travel of the fermentation material box on the working position.

The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid detection method for a nursing camera. The method comprises the following steps of :  acquiring N images to be detected,  wherein the N images to be detected are continuous N frames of images in a monitoring video acquired by the nursing camera; Calculating background images of N images to be detected; Determining a humanoid detection image of each of the N images to be detected according to the background image,  the humanoid detection image marking the detection range of the target humanoid; A first contour of a target figure in an image to be detected is determined based on a difference between two adjacent figure detection images. According to the method and the device,  the outline of the target humanoid in the image is determined through the difference value between the adjacent images to be detected,  the relation between the outline of the target humanoid and the background pixel point is eliminated,  the influence of video content changes caused by external environment changes such as illumination and the like on humanoid detection is avoided,  and therefore the humanoid detection accuracy is improved. 1. A human-shaped detection method of nursing camera,  wherein the method comprises :  obtaining N pieces of images to be detected,  the N pieces of images to be detected are continuous N frame images in the monitoring video collected by the nursing camera,  the N is an integer greater than 1;  calculating the background image of the N images to be detected;  according to the background image,  determining the human-shaped detection image of each image to be detected in the N images to be detected,  the human-shaped detection image marks the detection range of the target human shape;  determining a first profile of a target human shape in the image to be detected according to a difference between two adjacent human-shaped detection images;  determining the human-shaped detection image of each image to be detected in the N pieces of images to be detected according to the background image,  comprising :  obtaining the length range and width range of the target human shape;  extracting the RGB value of the background image to form a first characteristic matrix and N second characteristic matrixes composed of RGB values of each image to be detected;  respectively the difference value of the first characteristic matrix and the N second characteristic matrix,  obtaining N first difference matrix;  according to the position of continuous adjacent non-zero element in each first difference matrix,  calculating the length and width of the candidate target human shape;  if the length and width respectively the candidate target human shape is located in the length range and the width range,  the area area of the candidate target human shape is determined as the detection range of the target human shape corresponding to the image to be detected;  The method further comprises :  calculating the difference value of the ith second characteristic matrix and the i + 1 second characteristic matrix to obtain N-1 second difference value matrix,  the i is a positive integer less than N;  respectively the difference value between the N-1 first difference value matrix and the N-1 second difference value matrix in the N first difference value matrix,  obtaining N-1 third difference value matrix;  if the zero element in the third difference matrix is greater than or equal to the first threshold value,  the third difference matrix is determined as the target difference matrix;  updating the first characteristic matrix as the target characteristic matrix,  the target characteristic matrix is the sum of the target difference matrix and the first characteristic matrix.

The stereoscopic vision positioning and drawing method for quadruped robot in unstructured environment includes the following steps :  mutually calibrating the azimuth parameters in camera and IMU; Using IMU information between two frames of binocular camera to predict position of pixel point of previous frame in current frame,  using minimized photometric error to obtain pixel tracking information between two frames,  extracting feature combination of successful tracking; Calculating ORB local image feature description operators of the left and right images of the current key frame in the key frame queue; After the feature extraction of the current key frame is completed,  binocular stereoscopic image pair matching is performed,  pixel positions obtained by minimizing photometric errors and pixel positions obtained by feature extraction are fused,  redundant map feature points of the current key frame are screened,  and new map feature points are created according to binocular matching results; The robot motion drift in the period is optimized and reduced by utilizing the pose map,  and the loop detection is carried out. Visual pose state estimation in an unstructured environment is independently carried out,  so that the robot can conveniently complete navigation positioning in an outdoor unstructured environment. 1. An unstructured environment four-footed robot stereoscopic vision positioning map establishing method,  comprising the following steps :  step S1 :  demarcating the camera and the IMU inner orientation parameter,  comprising left and right vision to the target,  camera and inertial navigation calibration,  fully fusing the information between the IMU and binocular camera;  step S2 :  using the IMU information between two frames of the binocular camera to predict the position of the pixel point of the previous frame at the current frame,  using the minimized luminosity error to obtain the pixel tracking information between two frames,  extracting the feature combination of the successful tracking,  screening the local map feature point,  finishing the matching of the current frame pixel and the corresponding pixel of the local map point;  step S3 :  the feature extraction thread is responsible for calculating the ORB local image feature description operator of the current key frame left and right images in the key frame queue;  step S4 :  local modeling thread waiting for the characteristic extraction of the current key frame,  performing binocular stereo image pair matching,  fusing pixel obtained by minimizing the luminosity error and pixel position obtained by extracting feature,  and screening the redundant map feature point of the current key frame,  according to the binocular matching result,  creating a new map feature point ;  step S5 :  using the posture map optimization to reduce the four-foot robot motion drift in the period,  performing loop detection.

A fast detachable back bearing device of multi-foot robot,  comprising a device main body (1),  the device main body (1) is movably provided with a power leg (2),  wherein the device main body (1) is provided with a detachable bearing mechanism;  the bearing mechanism comprises a sliding rail (32),  the sliding rail (32) is provided with a dovetail groove for auxiliary setting combination installation,  the dovetail groove opened on the sliding rail (32) is movably mounted with a dovetail block (31),  the dovetail block (31) is fixedly mounted with a bearing plate (11),  the side wall of the slide rail (32) is screwed with a second bolt (36),  the screw head part of the second bolt (36) is jointed with the dovetail block (31).

A leg joint connecting device of multi-foot robot,  comprising a robot main body (1) and a supporting leg (3),  wherein the side end of the robot main body (1) is equipped with a detachable sealing cover (11),  the robot main body (1) is provided with a camera (12),  the number of the camera (12) is two,  the upper end of the robot main body (1) is provided with a radar (2),  the robot main body (1) is provided with a rotating shaft (14),  the supporting leg (3) is installed on the robot main body (1);  a connecting structure is arranged between the robot main body (1) and the supporting leg (3);  the supporting leg (3) is provided with a buffer structure.

An external force traction device of multi-foot robot,  comprising a robot main body (1),  wherein the upper surface of the robot main body (1) body is provided with a T-shaped sliding groove (3),  the upper surface right end of the robot main body (1) body is fixedly connected with a circular ring (2),  the middle part of the inner wall of the circular ring (2) is a sensing surface,  the front and back end of the upper ring surface of the circular ring (2) are provided with a vertical groove (8),  the left and right ends of the upper ring surface of the circular ring (2) are provided with a semicircular groove I (7),  the front and back ends of the groove surface of the two semicircular grooves I (7) are provided with a rectangular groove (6);  the inside of the circular ring (2) is provided with a traction mechanism,  the traction mechanism comprises a clamping ring (16),  a ball (4),  a half-circular ring one (20),  a top ring (11) and a semicircular ring two (15),  the inner ring surface of the clamping ring (16) is a thread surface.

The utility model provides a trunk mechanism of a quadruped robot and the quadruped robot. The trunk mechanism of the quadruped robot and the quadruped robot are used for improving balance,  flexibility,  stability and jumping capacity of the quadruped robot. The trunk mechanism of the quadruped robot comprises a rear trunk and a front trunk flexibly connected with the rear trunk,  wherein when the rotation directions of the two driving mechanisms are opposite and the rotation speeds of the two driving mechanisms are the same,  the front trunk rotates by taking the first direction as a rotating shaft so as to be curled or stretched; When the rotation directions of the two driving mechanisms are identical or the rotation rates of the two driving mechanisms are different,  the front trunk rotates by taking the second direction as a rotating shaft so as to be curled or stretched,  so that the steering of two degrees of freedom can be realized,  and the quadruped robot has higher balance,  flexibility,  stability and jumping capacity. 1. A torso mechanism of four-footed robot,  comprising a rear body and a front body flexibly connected with the rear body,  wherein the front body is provided with two driving mechanisms symmetrically arranged along the length direction of the front body;  the driving mechanism respectively connected with the two sides of the rear body;  the front body is configured to when the rotating direction of the two driving mechanisms are opposite and the rotating speed is the same,  the front body rotates in the first direction as the rotating shaft so as to shrink or extend;  when the rotating direction of the two driving mechanisms are the same or the rotating speed is different,  the front body rotates in the second direction as the rotating shaft so as to shrink or extend;  wherein the first direction is the width direction of the front body,  the second direction is the thickness direction of the front body.

The present application relates to a humanoid robot control method,  comprising :  mapping posture information corresponding to a human leg joint to humanoid robot leg joint servos,  the leg joint servos comprising a non-target optimized joint servo and a target optimized joint servo,  to obtain a desired rotation angle and a desired rotation angular velocity corresponding to the non-target optimized joint servo,  and an expected rotation angle and an expected rotation angular velocity corresponding to the target optimized joint servo;  constructing an optimization target function corresponding to the target optimized joint servo;  on the basis of the optimization target function,  optimizing the expected rotation angle and the expected rotation angular velocity of the target optimization joint servo to obtain a corrected expected rotation angle and a corrected expected rotation angular velocity corresponding to the target optimized joint servo;  and on the basis of the expected rotation angle and the expected rotation angular velocity corresponding to the non-target optimized joint servo and the corrected expected rotation angle and the corrected expected rotation angular velocity corresponding to the target optimized joint servo,  controlling each joint servo of the leg of the humanoid robot.

The present disclosure generally relates to user interfaces for displaying and using avatars. In some embodiments,  avatars are used to generate stickers for sending in a content-creation user interface. In some embodiments,  avatars are used to generate a representation of a contactable user in a contactable user editing user interface. Here we designed an eye gaze controlled robotic arm to help in the rehabilitation process of users with dysarthria impairment. Initially,  we compared different techniques to estimate eye gaze from webcam and compared their performance through user studies. Using the intelligent eye gaze tracking system,  users with dysarthria can select one of nine regions of screen in 2 secs on average. We developed new technique to control a video see through graphical user interface (GUI) with eye gaze,  use the GUI to control a robotic arm and kinematics equations to smoothen the arm movement for pick and drop task. The system was evaluated with 28 users. All users could undertake the designated task twice in first attempt in an average time less than 10 secs. A second study undertook a reachability task and 22 users could bring the robotic arm at any random position within its field of reach in less than 40 secs. Finally,  we evaluated the whole system involving the webcam based eye gaze tracker and video see through human robot interface through a user study involving people with dysarthria and they could bring the robotic arm at a pre-designated point within its working envelop in 1 min on average.

This disclosure relates to attention shifting of a robot in a group conversation with two or more attendees,  wherein at least one of them is a speaker. State of the art has dealt with several aspects of Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) including responding to a source of sound at a time,  addressing a fixed viewing area or determining who is the speaker based on eye gaze direction. However,  attention shifting to make the conversation human-like is a challenge. The present disclosure uses audio-visual perception for speaker localization. Only qualified direction of arrivals (DOAs) are used for the audio perception. Further the audio perception is complimented by visual perception employing real time face detection and lip movement detection. Use of HRI rules,  clustering of the DOAs,  dynamic adjustment of rotation of the robot and a dynamically updated knowledge repository enriches the robot with intelligence to shift attention with minimum human intervention. Industry 4.0 is spilling out from manufacturing to healthcare. In this patent,  we provide a brief history and key enabling technologies of Industry 4.0,  and its revolution in healthcare—Healthcare 4.0—and its reshaping of the landscape of the entire healthcare value chain. We discuss the shift in the system design paradigm from open,  small,  and single loop to closed,  large,  and multiple loops. We discuss some emerging research topics and challenges,  including healthcare big data,  automated medical production,  healthcare robotics,  and human–robot symbiosis. The main objectives of this patent are to define a standard framework for smart healthcare aimed at both daily and clinical settings. Moreover,  by incorporating the mobile computing technology in IoT based healthcare systems,  the reactive care system can be transformed to proactive and preventive healthcare systems. Relative to this context,  a cloud- centric IoT based smart student m-healthcare monitoring framework is proposed. This framework computes the student diseases severity by predicting the potential disease with its level by temporally mining the health measurements collected from medical and other IoT devices.

Our societies are experiencing an increase in the need for more adaptable,  scalable,  and automated human resources,  capabilities,  and services. These demands include human well-being,  safety and security,  a universal health care system,  and educational institutions. This is paving the way for the development of a new artificially intelligent support system that can make the lives of the many easier. The present invention aims to contribute to the resolution of such problems by providing a relief system that uses a new robotic species known as Human-Robots (HRs). These robots are designed to enhance the standard of living of humans in terms of education,  health care,  well-being,  and safety and security. The new species can work independently and move near and among HBs as well as within their natural settings. This allows it to share the HBs' workloads and responsibilities and is particularly attuned to the health of the HBs and their environment. The robotic species is dependent on a standardized reconfigurable system and platform that may assume a variety of forms,  is modular,  incremental,  scalable,  mobile,  intelligent,  networked,  social,  and may eventually be completely autonomous. The new human resources society will give rise to a new race of self-sufficient individuals who supply personal and public services. It will interact with our society as a new species.

A biped robot motor drive system and a smart temperature protection method. The motor drive system detects the temperature of key components such as a motor,  a power switch transistor and a busbar electrolytic capacitor. After the temperature reaches a first temperature threshold,  the system controls a motor maximum output power,  in order to inhibit a further increase in the temperature of the key components. After the temperature reaches a second temperature threshold,  the system issues temperature fault information to a biped robot central controller,  so that the biped robot stops a current task,  thereby ensuring the reliability of the motor and a motor driver. The motor drive system and the smart temperature protection method can increase the reliability of a lightweight motor drive system,  and are expected to further improve the flexibility and endurance capability of a biped robot.

The present invention provides an immunomolecular virus particle detection kit. An immune molecular virus particle detection kit,  comprising a monoclonal antibody,  biotin,  magnetic bead and streptavidin;  the monoclonal antibody is the monoclonal antibody of the virus envelope antigen;  the process of the kit for detecting virus particles is as follows :  carrying out biotin (biotin) modification to the monoclonal antibody of the virus envelope antigen,  coupling the magnetic beads with the streptavidin;  then incubating the monoclonal antibody modified by biotin and the solution containing virus,  antibody and virus particles or antigen forming complex,  then adding magnetic beads coupled with streptavidin to incubate,  the streptavidin on the magnetic bead is combined with the antibody coupled with biotin,  so as to capture virus particles with envelope,  then separating supernatant by magnetic separator,  complete virus particles and empty shell virus,  free envelope antigen can be separated from other virus components,  then performing qualitative or quantitative detection to the magnetic bead conjugate by PCR amplification.

According to the invention,  the landing state of the robot can be accurately obtained,  the motion stability control of the humanoid robot after landing is completed,  and meanwhile,  the switching control of the motion state of the robot becomes easy. 1. The invention discloses a quadruped robot simulation motion control method based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises extracting motion key node information from animal motion video by using video feature extraction network based on depth learning,  eliminating angle deviation and noise in animal motion node information by using X11 time sequence analysis method,  and extracting periodical rule of animal motion feature; Then using it as priori information to construct deep reinforcement learning network based on actor-comment frame,  learning corresponding scaling coefficients through the network,  realizing the size matching between the animal in the video and the corresponding quadruped robot,  Finally,  the optimized depth reinforcement learning network is deployed into a real quadruped robot,  and outputs corresponding joint angle positions according to the current state of the quadruped robot and corresponding simulation action rules,  so that simulation motion control of the quadruped robot is realized. The method disclosed by the invention has a good environment generalization effect and control stability. 1. A four-footed robot simulating motion control method based on deep reinforcement learning,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step one :  extracting the key information of the motion node of the related animal in the animal motion video by using the video feature extraction network based on the deep learning step two :  using X11 time sequence analysis method to eliminate the angle offset in the animal motion node information extracted in the step one,  and extracting the periodic rule of the animal motion feature from;  step three :  constructing a depth enhanced learning network based on the actor-comment algorithm,  and setting a virtual simulation environment of the four-footed robot,  inputting the periodic rule of the animal motion feature extracted in the step two as the priori information into the depth enhanced learning network,  setting the reward function,  training condition,  simulating interactive motion of the four-footed robot and the environment in the simulation,  continuously training depth enhanced learning network,  the four-footed robot in the virtual simulation environment has the ability of quickly simulating motion in the animal video,  so as to train and learn the depth-enhanced learning network,  obtaining the optimized depth enhanced learning network after finishing training;  step four :  the optimized depth enhanced learning network is deployed to the control system of the real four-footed robot,  the optimized depth enhanced learning network combines the state of the current four-footed robot and the simulation action output corresponding to the joint position,  so as to imitate the motion of the associated animal in the animal motion video;  the depth-enhanced learning network of reward function r is r=0.08rlin + 0.02rang 0.03rbody

The invention relates to a pedestrian flow density analysis system and an analysis method. The pedestrian flow density analysis system comprises a camera,  a controller and a plurality of radars. The radar is used for detecting the target when the target exists in the detection range of the radar,  obtaining target information,  and transmitting the target information to the controller,  so that the target can be detected in advance through the radar,  the problem that the target can not be found in time only through the camera is solved,  and the target can be detected in time in a blind area which can not be shot by the camera. In addition,  the camera shoots videos for all targets within the detection range of the priority radar,  and transmits the video to the controller,  The controller also analyzes the video,  Whether the target is a humanoid target or not is judged,  similarity calculation is carried out on the humanoid target,  the number of different humanoid targets is obtained,  and the number of the different humanoid targets is the stream density,  so that the problem of repeatedly counting the number of people in the same time period can be avoided,  the obtained statistical data is accurate,  and the calculation accuracy of the stream density is improved. 1. A human flow density analysis system,  wherein the system comprises a video camera,  a controller and a plurality of radar;  a plurality of said radar are fixedly set on the preset position of the area to be tested;  the detection range composed of multiple radars covers the area to be detected;  a plurality of the radar are in communication connection with the controller;  the radar is used for detecting the target in the detection range,  detecting the target,  obtaining the target information,  and transmitting the target information to the controller;  the target comprises a human or an object;  said video camera is in communication connection with said controller;  the controller is used for selecting the radar with the highest priority in the radar transmitting the target information at the current time as the priority radar,  and controlling the video camera according to the detection range of the priority radar;  the video camera is used for shooting all the target video in the detection range of the priority radar,  and transmitting the video to the controller;  the controller is further used for analyzing the video,  judging whether the target is a human-shaped target;  and calculating the similarity of the human-shaped target,  obtaining the number of different human-shaped target;  the number of the different human-shaped targets is the density of the people;  analyzing the video,  judging whether the target is human-shaped target specifically comprises :  performing grabbing frame processing to the video to obtain the image frame corresponding to each time;  taking the image frame corresponding to the first moment as the contrast image frame,  taking the image frame corresponding to the second moment as the image frame to be detected;  performing interpolation operation on the image frame to be tested and the contrast image frame to obtain the operation result,  and judging whether there is a moving target in the image frame to be detected according to the operation result;  if there is a moving target in the image frame to be tested,  taking the image frame to be detected as the target image frame,  and selecting the image frame corresponding to the next time of the image frame to be detected as the image frame to be detected,  returning to the step of performing interpolation operation on the image frame to be detected and the contrast image frame,  until the image frame corresponding to each time except the first time has been detected by the moving target;  if there is no moving target in the image frame to be tested,  taking the image frame to be detected as the contrast image frame,  and selecting the image frame corresponding to the next time of the image frame to be detected as the image frame to be detected,  returning to the step of performing interpolation operation on the image frame to be detected and the contrast image frame,  until the image frame corresponding to each time except the first time has been detected by the moving target;  for each of the target image frame,  extracting the HOG feature of the target image frame,  and based on the HOG feature,  using the trained SVM classification model to judge whether the target in the target image frame is a human-shaped target.

The system has certain processing and learning capability,  can obtain road surface topography information based on preliminary processing of sensor signals and feed back the road surface topography information to the upper layer system,  and collects and learns corresponding perception and processing results,  so that the perception and processing capability of the system on unknown topography is enhanced. A park management method based on video acquisition,  wherein the method comprises :  real-time collecting and obtaining the large graph data and small graph data through the video collecting unit,  and sending the large graph data and the small graph data to the data receiving server by means of load balancing cluster;  wherein the small image data is obtained by amplifying and/or cutting the large image data;  the data receiving server sends the large graph data and the small graph data to the search engine server,  at the same time,  sending the small graph data to the message queue;  using the analysis server to consume the message queue,  analyzing the picture information of the small picture data of consumption,  and storing each analyzed picture information in the database,  wherein the picture information comprises attribute and characteristic value of the picture;  through the analysis server to the small image data in the message queue for human faces,  human shape and vehicle identification,  the identified human face picture and/or human-shaped picture and/or vehicle picture stored in the database;  performing behaviour identification to the human faces the analysis server,  storing the identified face behavior data in the database;  analyzing the small image data in the message queue by the analyzing server,  marking the picture in the small image data according to the preset rule mark pre-warning information,  and storing the pre-warning information in the database;  reading the search engine server and the database by the application server,  and sending the picture meeting the preset requirement to the front end and displaying,  and providing with the map data by the search engine server to function image data.

The invention discloses a method and a device for judging whether a battery car enters an elevator or not,  and belongs to the field of image recognition. By calculating the motion trajectories of the storage battery car and the humanoid,  whether the foreground image enters the elevator or not is judged,  so that the process that the storage battery car enters the elevator can be automatically identified,  the labor is saved,  and the identification effect is high; By pre-arranging the identification algorithm in the monitoring equipment,  the response can be quickly and efficiently carried out,  and the occupied network resources are less; By masking the background model,  the foreground image is reserved,  interference factors are reduced,  and the recognition accuracy of the system is improved. By selecting representative pixel points in the image information,  the outline area of the foreground image is judged,  most interference factors are filtered,  the system load of the micro-processing unit is reduced,  and the requirement of the identification method on hardware equipment is lowered. 1. A judging method of whether the battery car enters the elevator,  wherein it is used for monitoring device,  the method comprises :  establishing a first identification model,  the first identification model is used for identifying battery car and human shape;  obtaining the first information,  the first information is shot by the monitoring device;  performing a first analysis on the first information by the first identification model to obtain a first analysis result;  judging whether to perform the second analysis according to the first analysis result;  the second analysis comprises calculating the motion track of the battery car and the human shape;  judging whether the battery car and the human shape enter the elevator according to the movement track;  if it is,  executing the first instruction,  the first instruction comprises an alarm prompt.

Dynamic control of a center of mass position is based on replacement of discrete motion of macro body (counterweighing solid or counterbalancing mechanisms) for continuous molecular flow of counterweighing liquid. Redistributing liquid counterweight between chambers attached to independently moving parts of robot allows its motion to new stable position without disruption in static stability and dynamic balance. Various embodiments include bipods/humanoids,  wheeled locomotion robots and hybrid wheeled/multi-pod bio-like robotic systems;  some embodiments allow reversible mutual reconfiguration between various structural arrangements. In humanoid embodiments,  method allows moving on uneven terrain or ascending staircases while maintaining static stability;  method also decreases the probability of fall and secures self-rising if a fall occurred. In some embodiments liquid counterweight may be transferred upon high barriers exceeding the height of robot by a few folds,  such as walls of the building or ledge or steep slope in mountains,  thus providing robots with capability principally not available to prior art.

When the robot enters the charging pile area,  the robot starts the charging pile detection algorithm to obtain the coordinate position of the charging pile in the real world; Step four,  when the charging pile is exposed in the abdominal camera visual field of the robot,  the four-legged robot charging pile accurate positioning algorithm is started,  to obtain the coordinates of the charging pile in the real world. By using the invention,  the robot can realize accurate positioning and charging,  realize charging autonomy and intellectualization,  and then realize long-term full-autonomous independent operation of the mobile robot. 1. The self-charging method for four-foot robot,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step one,  the robot captures the characteristic of the peripheral environment through the pre-set depth camera in the strange environment to realize positioning,  and establishing the corresponding sparse map in the process of moving in the environment from the charging pile;  then matching the two-dimensional coordinate information in the RGB image and the depth information of the pre-set depth camera to obtain the coordinate position of the charging pile in the real world,  and further close to the charging pile;  the top of the charging pile is provided with an electrode region and at least two two-dimensional codes,  the electrode region and the two-dimensional code are in the same plane;  the two-dimensional code encodes the ID of the two-dimensional code,  the central distance of the two-dimensional code and the electrode region,  and the two-dimensional code of the two vertical sides relative to the angle information of the two-dimensional code centre to the electrode region centre line; The invention relates to an automatic driving automobile man-like lane change decision planning method considering adhesion coefficient,  sending driver lane change data under three common adhesion coefficients into three neural network decision planning models based on LSTM,  firstly,  using neural network decision model deep learning method to learn human lane-changing decision behavior,  then using neural network planning model deep learning method to learn human lane-changing track to obtain predicted track output under every kind of attachment under the current traffic environment; In the driving task,  the estimated value of the actual road surface adhesion coefficient is received,  and the track fusion is carried out by combining the output track of the discrete adhesion coefficient,  so that the current real-time decision behavior and the planned track are obtained. According to the invention,  the mechanism of driving behaviors and driving habits of human drivers is researched,  and the automatic driving automobile can understand the human driving mode and drive like human beings,  so that the riding identity of people to the automatic driving automobile is improved,  and reference is provided for improving the acceptance of the intelligent driving automobile. 1. A decision-making planning method of automatic driving automobile humanoid considering road adhesion coefficient,  wherein the method comprises the following steps :  step one respectively collecting good road adhesion coefficient,  medium road adhesion coefficient and the proficiency driver lane data under low road adhesion coefficient;  step two,  pre-processing the collected channel data,  and statistical feature calculation,  characteristic structure,  carrying out ANOVA correlation analysis to the data characteristic sequence and the characteristic value collected under good road adhesion;  obtaining characteristic sequence and characteristic value with obvious influence to the driver lane change behavior,  introducing different attachment coefficient μ to collect the driving data,  analyzing how μ is how to affect the lane changing behavior of the driver,  obtaining the mapping relationship;  the analysis result shows that when the road adhesion coefficient μ is reduced compared with the normal adhesion condition :  (1),  changing the road cutting point away from the front vehicle;  (2),  reducing the peak value aymax of the lateral acceleration in the process of changing the road;  (3),  the changing time is increased;  step three,  the three common attachment coefficient μ = 0.1,  0.5,  the driver lane changing data respectively 0.8 is sent to three neural network decision planning models based on LSTM,  neural network decision planning model adopts hierarchical architecture,  firstly using neural network decision model deep learning learn human lane-changing decision behavior,  namely left lane changing,  right lane changing,  keeping three decisions of the following vehicle;  then using neural network planning model deep learning learn the human channel track,  obtaining the current traffic environment under each attached prediction track output,  namely μ = 0.1,  0.5,  0.8 of the three track;  step four,  in the driving task,  the decision planning system receives the actual road adhesion coefficient estimated by the sensing system in real time,  combining the output track of discrete attachment coefficient,  using Lagrange three-time polynomial interpolation method for track fusion :  wherein,  x0,  y0,  x1,  y1,  x2,  y2 is respectively = 0.1,  0.5,  0.8 of the track coordinate,  x,  y is the track coordinate value after fusion;  finally obtaining the real-time decision action under the current actual road condition and planning track,  and transmitting the planning track to the control layer as the tracking track.

The invention provides a method,  a system,  a server and a computer-readable storage medium for constructing a three-dimensional space based on voxel data. converting the pixel data into voxel data,  so as to be highly matched with the GPU operation,  the layer data and the connection data are designed by the voxel data,  and the parallel calculation speed is higher through the layer data and the connection data,  therefore,  compared with the existing CPU operation mode,  the performance of the data operation scheme based on the GPU is 2-3 orders of magnitude higher,  so that the AI algorithm is finer,  and the humanoid degree is higher; In the dynamic updating process,  since the parallel computing speed is high,  the data of the global super-large map of the game can be quickly updated; The whole set of data is divided into static data occupying a large area and dynamic data occupying a small area,  so that the occupied video memory space in the whole game process is small,  the time for refreshing the dynamic data each time is extremely short,  and the game is smoother. 1. A method for constructing three-dimensional space based on voxel data,  wherein it comprises the following steps :  in the x,  y,  z three-dimensional space,  taking a base plane of z = z ' the base plane is provided with multiple base points;  taking the base point as the bottom point,  taking z coordinate as the height,  forming multiple base columns,  each of the base column has L element points;  accessing the base column in parallel in the GPU,  and traversing each of the element points on the base column in each parallel thread,  and according to the voxel data index to the corresponding voxel point,  judging whether the voxel point is a hollow point or a solid point;  collecting the continuous hollow point section on each of the base column,  if the height of the continuous hollow point section is greater than or equal to the first preset height,  defining the continuous hollow point section as a voxel layer;  calculating and obtaining the position relationship between each of the voxel layer on each of the base column and each of the voxel layer on the adjacent base column,  if there is an overlapping part between the two voxel layers in the height direction,  then determining that there is connection data between the two voxel layers,  passing an operating object between two of the voxel layers;  the voxel point,  the voxel layer,  the connection data to form the three-dimensional space.

The invention discloses a posture reset control method of quadruped robot,  which comprises the following steps :  obtaining angular velocity,  acceleration and posture angle of robot; calculating to obtain real-time position and real-time speed of robot; Then according to the expected moving speed,  real-time speed and real-time position of the quadruped robot to the foot end moving track of each leg of the swinging phase of the quadruped robot; And calculating the servo motor rocker arm angle of each leg of the quadruped robot to generate servo control output command to control the motion state of each leg; When each leg of the swing phase touches the ground,  each leg of the swing phase stops moving immediately and is switched to the support phase,  each leg of the support phase is switched to the swing phase,  then data is continuously acquired,  and posture control of the next cycle is carried out; Until the quadruped robot stops moving. The invention also discloses a quadruped robot posture reset control device and a storage medium. 1. A four-footed robot posture reset control method,  wherein the posture reset control method comprises :  data resolving step :  obtaining the attitude angle of the four-footed robot,  acceleration and angular velocity;  matrix resolving step :  using kinematics to calculate the angular velocity of the four-footed robot,  attitude angle and acceleration to obtain the foot end position of each leg of the four-footed robot,  and combining the size data of the four-footed robot to calculate the real-time position and real time speed of the four-footed robot;  Swinging phase calculating step :  obtaining and according to the expected movement speed of the four-footed robot,  calculating the foot end movement track of each leg of the swinging phase of the four-footed robot by calculating real-time speed and real-time position;  at the same time,  using kinematics inverse solution to calculate the foot end motion track of each leg of the swinging phase of the four-footed robot to obtain the servo motor rocker arm angle of each leg of the swinging phase of the four-footed robot;  the step of calculating the support phase :  using VMC three-channel control algorithm to calculate the real-time speed and real-time position of the four-footed robot to obtain each leg of the four-footed robot of the supporting phase of the joint,  and using pseudo-torque model to the four-footed robot supporting phase of each leg of the joint conversion is servo motor desired speed;  at the same time,  updating the angle of the servo motor rocker arm of each leg of the supporting phase of the four-footed robot;  Control step :  generating a corresponding servo control instruction according to the servo motor rocker arm angle of each leg of the four-footed robot and the type of the servo motor and controlling the movement of each leg of the four-footed robot;  Detection steps :  when each leg of the swinging phase of the four-footed robot touches the ground,  each leg as the swinging phase stops moving and switches to the supporting phase,  each leg as the supporting phase is switched to the swinging phase,  then the data resolving step is performed;  until the four-foot robot stops moving.

Abstract One of the most prevalent nonverbal ways humans communicate their internal emotional states is through their facial expressions. Thus it's no surprise that facial expressions are important in interpersonal interactions. Psychology has identified six universally recognized facial expressions even though many other expressions can be used. The rapid growth of assistive technology applications,  such as human-robot interaction,  where a strong emotional awareness is critical for achieving the assistance task,  has sparked interest in facial expression recognition (FER). An effective face recognition system would be developed as part of this work (FER). Facial registration,  feature extraction,  and classification are the three main components of the FER system. This work uses the Image processing Technique and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms to recognize facial expressions in photographs. To begin,  a thorough investigation of the use of the HOG descriptor's histogram of oriented gradients in the FER issue is presented,  emphasizing how this potent method can be put to good use in this situation. After that,  a multi- SVM is trained to classify face expressions. An enhanced Cohn-Kanade (CK+) dataset and the JAFFE dataset are used to test the suggested method. Recognizing facial expressions using the suggested method has been validated. The TSR for the test data is evaluated,  and then a comparison with currently used techniques is shown in the research paper. In comparison to current state-of-the-art approaches,  HOG and SVM Face Recognition perform better.

An extracting method of gait profile map in monitoring video,  comprising :  decoding the monitoring video file or real-time monitoring video stream,  caching after obtaining the video frame sequence;  performing pedestrian detection on the video frame,  to obtain pedestrian target snapshot and pedestrian target frame,  and performing normalization operation to the pedestrian target frame,  obtaining the square snapshot and caching;  according to the pedestrian target snapshot,  extracting the pedestrian re-identification feature to cache,  and matching the extracted pedestrian re-identification feature with the pedestrian re-identification feature in the previous frame,  so as to realize the matching of the pedestrian target in the current video frame and the pedestrian target in the previous frame,  so as to realize the tracking of the same pedestrian target;  if successfully tracking the track of the same pedestrian target between continuous n frames,  obtaining the square snapshot of the pedestrian target in the continuous n frames;  respectively binarization processing to the segmentation result after the square snapshot in each frame is subjected to humanoid segmentation to obtain the gait contour map of the pedestrian target in the continuous n frames;  and caching the obtained gait profile map;  matching the extracted pedestrian re-identification feature with the pedestrian re-identification feature in the previous frame,  so as to realize the matching of the pedestrian target in the current video frame with the pedestrian target in the previous frame;  the method comprises :  for any one pedestrian target Pi in the current video frame,  respectively the similarity between the pedestrian re-identification feature F1 and each pedestrian re-identification feature in the cached previous frame;  if the similarity is greater than the preset threshold ThF;  then identifying the corresponding pedestrian re-identification feature as the similar feature of the pedestrian re-identification feature F1;  forming the similar feature set by the similar features of the pedestrian re-identification feature F1;  if the similar feature set is empty,  creating a new tracking target,  ending operation;  if the similar feature set is not empty,  then according to the similarity from large to small in order from the similar feature set in the pedestrian re-identification feature Fj,  and judging whether the pedestrian re-identification feature Fj is in the current video frame,  the pedestrian target of the pedestrian target Pi other pedestrian target identification feature similar;  if it is,  judging the pedestrian re-identification feature Fj is not matched with the pedestrian target Pi;  taking the next pedestrian re-identification feature from the similar feature set and then judging again;  if not,  judging the pedestrian re-identification feature Fj is matched with the pedestrian target Pi,  and matching the pedestrian target Pi to the pedestrian target of the pedestrian re-identification feature Fj,  ending the operation;  if the similar feature set,  there is no pedestrian re-identification feature matched with the pedestrian target Pi,  then eliminating the pedestrian target Pi;  wherein n is the preset threshold value; The invention discloses a detection method for the mechanical property of a whole working area of a rotating shaft based on a humanoid soft finger. The humanoid soft finger is fixedly arranged at the tail end of the mechanical armand is driven by the mechanical arm to move;  the humanoid soft finger drives the rotating shaft to move in the whole working area of the humanoid soft finger through a poking action process,  a pushing action process and a reversing action process;  the humanoid soft finger firstly tries to execute the poking action process repeatedly to obtain stable extrusion force,  and then executes the poking action process,  the pushing action process,  the reversing action process and the pushing action process repeatedly in sequence,  so that the rotating shaft performs periodic reciprocating motion in thewhole working area of the rotating shaft,  and the mechanical property detection in the pushing action process is carried out in real time in the movement process. According to the detection method,  the humanoid soft finger is used to complete the detection of the whole working area mechanical property of the rotating shaft,  and the detection process can be completed adaptively. 1.  the humanoid soft finger is installed and fixed on the end of the mechanical arm;  the mechanical arm drives the movement;  the rotating working surface of the rotating shaft,  respectively is a rotating page A and a rotating page B;  the angle sensor is used for directly measuring the relative rotation angle value between the rotating page A and the rotating page B;  the humanoid soft finger,  by poking action process,  pushing action process,  reversing action process,  driving the rotating shaft to move in the full working domain;  if the page B is fixed,  then the opening action process,  the page A is opened and away from the initial position,  the pushing action process,  pushing the page A,  making it move in the whole working domain interval of the rotating shaft,  the reversing action process is under the condition of not changing the current position of the page A;  changing the direction of pushing the rotating page A;  if the rotating page A is fixed,  the action of the rotating page A in the process is adjusted to the action of the rotating page B;  the humanoid soft finger firstly repeatedly attempts to perform the poking action process,  obtaining the stable extrusion force,  then repeatedly executing the poking action process,  pushing action process,  reversing action process; Disclosed is a dense height map construction method suitable for legged robot planning,  which method belongs to the technical field of dense height map construction. The construction method of the present invention specifically comprises :  using a Gaussian distribution model to estimate a measurement value of a laser radar,  and mapping the measurement value to a corresponding grid of a local map,  so as to perform multi-frame data fusion,  during which,  according to posture information of a robot,  a map grid covariance is updated,  a local map is correspondingly moved,  and a dynamic obstacle is removed,  so as to create a complete local dense map. The method of the present invention overcomes the defects of existing dense maps having a large data volume and a large construction calculation amount,  and not being updated in a timely manner,  and has the advantages of convenient construction,  high construction precision,  etc.;  by means of the method,  real-time construction can be completed;  and the method can be directly used for a navigation task of a legged robot.

The invention relates to a robot falling protection method and system based on impact prediction and active compliance.  the fall protection control model is a mapping model of the sensor value to the motion control parameter,  the motion control parameter comprises four parts :  the first part parameter is w1 to w6,  for controlling the posture of the front body,  wherein w1 represents the pitching angle of the robot shoulder joint w2 represents the rolling angle of the robot shoulder joint w3 represents the rolling angle of the robot elbow joint w4 represents the pitching angle of the robot hip joint w5 represents the turning angle of the robot hip joint w6 represents the pitching angle of the robot knee joint the second part parameter is w7 to w9,  used for controlling the torque of the touch ground,  joint w7 represents the speed of the torque change of the robot hip joint w8 represents the speed of the torque change of the robot knee joint w9 represents the speed of the torque change of the robot elbow joint the third part parameter is w10 to w12,  used for controlling the angle of the touch ground,  joint w10 represents the speed of the angle change of the robot hip joint w11 represents the speed of the angle change of the robot knee joint w12 represents the speed of the angle change of the robot elbow joint the fourth part parameter is w13,  w14,  for calculating the starting time of active compliance,  wherein the left and right hand-touch after active compliance starting time respectively t1 and t2,  calculated by the following formula :  t1 = w13/ *H - w14 * theta t2 = w13/ *H + w14 * theta,  wherein w13 represents the size of the influence of the robot mass centre height to the impact ground moment; According to the method,  visual perception and tactile perception are combined,  so that manipulator operation is closer to the real perception state of human beings,  the manipulator can still find a proper grabbing mode for complex situations with variable conditions,  tasks can be completed smoothly,  and meanwhile,  a manipulator database model is updated,  and a convenient condition is provided for subsequent teleoperation system research. 1. A five-finger mechanical hand imitating human grabbing method of visual touch fusion,  wherein the steps are as follows :  (1) collecting and collecting visual touch data according to the touch data information,  collecting the visual information collecting and tactile information;  the visual information is collected by the camera,  comprising the real motion information of the human hand,  the shape information of the object,  the visual information of the object texture;  tactile information comprises object surface texture tactile information collected by glove with flexible tactile sensor array and human grasping force information collected at the same time;  combining the object texture visual information in the visual information with the object surface texture tactile information;  using the classification method of machine learning to train the different object material arbiter;  determining the object surface material information;  the object surface sliding experiment,  comprising the following steps :  finger wearing a flexible tactile sensor array,  touching the object surface and sliding back and forth;  changing the resistance of the sensor unit in the pressing process;  the obtained haptic information;  (2) establishing human hand grasping database combined with visual touch data information collecting part to obtain the human actual movement information,  object shape information,  object texture visual information and object surface texture touch information,  establishing a human grasping database;  the human hand grabbing database comprises two parts :  according to the three-dimensional human hand action library established by the actual movement information of human hand,  and according to the object shape information,  object texture visual information,  object material information obtained by object surface texture tactile information and human grasping force library established by grasping force information;  (3) grabbing the database according to the human hand to grasp and learn;  combining the machine learning method,  grasping the data in the database according to the human hand to learn,  obtaining the mechanical hand grabbing different shapes,  different materials of the target object,  using the grabbing posture,  contact and grabbing force information,  creating a mechanical hand grabbing database;  based on the mechanical hand grabbing database,  setting the initial grabbing state for the mechanical hand,  the mechanical hand grabbing the object with different material shape,  using proper grabbing posture to finish the grabbing operation;  the mechanical hand grabbing database performs feedback updating according to the actual situation in the online study after the database;  (4) using the mechanical hand to grasp database,  performing online grasping learning based on visual touch;  firstly collecting object shape information,  object texture visual information and object surface texture touch information;  according to the mechanical hand grabbing database to obtain the initial grabbing state,  then carrying out mechanical hand actual grabbing operation,  at the same time,  performing touch force detection and sliding identification;  if sliding,  then adjusting the grabbing posture,  until reaching the stable grabbing state,  at the same time,  updating the mechanical grabbing database,  obtaining the corresponding relationship between the target object with different shapes and different materials and the mechanical hand posture loading force.
